name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice_topExteriorFrameTransition_eq_det_div
statement:
theorem genericCommonLattice_topExteriorFrameTransition_eq_det_div
    {n : ℕ} (M N : X.Modules)
    (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (bP : Module.Basis (Fin n) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)))
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin n) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M))
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin n) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj N))
    (hdetLeft : bM.det
      (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
        (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ bP) ≠ 0) :
    (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map
          ((asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
              (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e))).inv ≫
            (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
              (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e))).hom)
          n ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv 1)) =
      bN.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ bP) /
        bM.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ bP)
proof:
:= by
  exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorFrameTransition_eq_det_div
    (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
      (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)))
    (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
      (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e))) bP bM bN hdetLeft

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice_topExterior_common_coordinates
statement:
theorem genericCommonLattice_topExterior_common_coordinates
    {n : ℕ} (M N : X.Modules)
    (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (bP : Module.Basis (Fin n) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)))
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin n) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M))
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin n) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj N)) :
    ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map
        ((asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e))).inv ≫
          (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e))).hom)
        n
        ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv
          (bM.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ bP))) =
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).inv
        (bN.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ bP))
proof:
:= by
  exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorFrame_common_coordinates
    (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
      (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)))
    (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
      (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e))) bP bM bN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.finite_of_isClosed_of_genericPoint_not_mem
statement:
theorem finite_of_isClosed_of_genericPoint_not_mem
    [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (s : Set X) (hs : IsClosed s) (hη : genericPoint X ∉ s) : s.Finite
proof:
:= by
  letI : QuasiSober s := hs.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.quasiSober
  have hclosure : closure s ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro h
    apply hη
    rw [← hs.closure_eq]
    simpa only [h] using (Set.mem_univ (genericPoint X))
  have hfinite :=
    TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_coheight_one_of_closure_ne_univ
      (X := X) (p := s) hclosure
  exact hfinite.subset fun x hx ↦
    ⟨hx, AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint
      (X := X) fun h ↦ hη (h ▸ hx)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_left
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_left
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (o : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hSE : o.ShortExact)
    (h2 : o.X₂.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (h3 : o.X₃.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    o.X₁.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  have hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf hSE
  letI : Mono o.f := hSE.mono_f
  letI : Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map o.f) := by cat_disch
  obtain ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := h2.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N3, hN3⟩ := h3.vanishing
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ ?_, max N2 (N3 + 1), ?_⟩
  · cases n with
    | zero =>
        letI := h2.finite 0
        exact Module.Finite.of_injective
          (HMapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of k) o.f 0)
          (hMapₗ_zero_injective k o.f
            ((AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective
              (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map o.f).hom.app (op ⊤))).mp
                ((NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app
                  ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map o.f).hom).mp
                    (CategoryTheory.presheaf_mono_of_mono ..) (op ⊤))))
    | succ n =>
        exact finite_H_first_succ k o hS n (h3.finite n) (h2.finite (n + 1))
  · intro n hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : n ≠ 0)
    exact subsingleton_H_first_succ k o hS m
      (hN3 m (by omega)) (hN2 (m + 1) (by omega))

name: SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval
statement:
lemma underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval
    (I : Type u) [Finite I] (i : I)
    (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ) :
    (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom.app V
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval V) =
      ModuleCat.freeMk i
proof:
:= by
  let F := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let A : I → X.Modules :=
    fun _ ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N f g
    rfl
  letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) F := by
    infer_instance
  let e₁ : F.obj (∐ A) ≅ ∐ fun j ↦ F.obj (A j) :=
    PreservesCoproduct.iso F A
  let e₂ : (∐ fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) ≅
      ∐ fun _ : I ↦ (𝟙_ P) :=
    Limits.Sigma.mapIso (fun _ : I ↦ Iso.refl (𝟙_ P))
  have hι₁ :
      F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫ e₁.hom =
        Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i := by
    have hcomparison :
        Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫
            sigmaComparison F A =
          F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) := by
      exact Limits.ι_comp_sigmaComparison F A i
    have hsigma : sigmaComparison F A = e₁.inv := by rfl
    calc
      F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫ e₁.hom =
        (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫
          sigmaComparison F A) ≫ e₁.hom :=
            congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ e₁.hom) hcomparison.symm
      _ = (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫
          e₁.inv) ≫ e₁.hom := by rw [hsigma]
      _ = Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫
          (e₁.inv ≫ e₁.hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun k ↦ Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫ k)
          e₁.inv_hom_id
      _ = Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i := Category.comp_id _
  have hι₂ :
      Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫ e₂.hom =
        Limits.Sigma.ι (fun _ : I ↦ (𝟙_ P)) i := by
    change Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫
        Limits.Sigma.map (fun _ : I ↦ (Iso.refl (𝟙_ P)).hom) = _
    rw [Limits.Sigma.ι_map]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  have hι₃ :
      Limits.Sigma.ι (fun _ : I ↦ (𝟙_ P)) i ≫
          (modulePresheafFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom =
        finsuppFreeι X I i := by
    change Limits.Sigma.ι (fun _ : I ↦ (𝟙_ P)) i ≫
        Limits.Sigma.desc (fun j : I ↦ finsuppFreeι X I j) = _
    rw [Limits.Sigma.ι_desc]
  have hcomp :
      F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫
          (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom =
        finsuppFreeι X I i := by
    calc
      F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫
          (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom =
        ((F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫ e₁.hom) ≫ e₂.hom) ≫
          (modulePresheafFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom := by
            simp only [underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree,
              underlyingFreeIsoModulePresheafFree, Iso.trans_hom,
              Category.assoc]
            dsimp only [e₁, e₂, F, A, P]
            rfl
      _ = (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ F.obj (A j)) i ≫ e₂.hom) ≫
          (modulePresheafFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom := by
            rw [hι₁]
      _ = Limits.Sigma.ι (fun _ : I ↦ (𝟙_ P)) i ≫
          (modulePresheafFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom := by
            exact congrArg
              (fun k ↦ k ≫ (modulePresheafFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom) hι₂
      _ = finsuppFreeι X I i := hι₃
  have hfree :
      ((F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)).app V).hom
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) =
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval V := by
    change ((SheafOfModules.ιFree
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app V).hom
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) = _
    change _ = ((SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).unitHomEquiv
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ 𝟙 _)).val V
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_apply_coe]
    simp
    change
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app V))
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) =
        (ConcreteCategory.hom ((SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app V))
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
    rfl
  have hV := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app V) hcomp
  have hone := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hV
    (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
  change
    ((underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom.app V).hom
        (((F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)).app V).hom
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)) =
      ((finsuppFreeι X I i).app V).hom (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) at hone
  rw [hfree, finsuppFreeι_app_one] at hone
  exact hone

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply
statement:
lemma moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply
    {P Q : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ)
    (z : P.obj V) :
    (((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map f).app V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P).app V).hom z) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app Q).app V).hom
        (f.app V z)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  have h := adj.unit.naturality f
  simp only [Functor.id_map] at h
  have hV := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app V) h
  have hz := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hV z
  change
    (((adj.unit.app Q).app V).hom (f.app V z)) =
      ((((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map f).app V).hom
        (((adj.unit.app P).app V).hom z)) at hz
  exact hz.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleTensorUnitIso_hom_unit_apply
statement:
lemma moduleTensorUnitIso_hom_unit_apply
    (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ)
    (z : X.presheaf.obj V) :
    (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom.val.app V
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
            (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)))).app V).hom z) =
      z
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  change
    ((((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      (adj.counit.app (tensorUnitSheaf X))).app V).hom
        (((adj.unit.app
          ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj
            (tensorUnitSheaf X))).app V).hom z)) = z
  have h := adj.right_triangle_components (tensorUnitSheaf X)
  have hV := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app V) h
  have hz := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hV z
  change
    ((((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      (adj.counit.app (tensorUnitSheaf X))).app V).hom
        (((adj.unit.app
          ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj
            (tensorUnitSheaf X))).app V).hom z)) = z at hz
  exact hz

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerMap_underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_topWedge
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerMap_underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_topWedge
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ) :
    ((PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerFunctor (Fintype.card I)).map
      (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom).app V
        (by
          classical
          letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
          exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
            (SheafOfModules.freeSection
              (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval V)) =
      topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeGenerator X I V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map
      ((underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom.app V)
      (Fintype.card I)
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval V)) = _
  rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk]
  rw [topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeGenerator,
    ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator_eq_mk]
  congr 1
  funext j
  change
    (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom.app V
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval V) =
      ModuleCat.freeMk
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)
  exact underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval X I
    (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j) V

name: SchemeKTheory.topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso_hom_generator
statement:
lemma topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso_hom_generator
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ) :
    (topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso X I).hom.app V
        (topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeGenerator X I V) =
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso_inv_one X I V]
  have h := (topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso X I).inv_hom_id
  have hV := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app V) h
  have hone := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hV
    (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
  change
    ((topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso X I).hom.app V).hom
        (((topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso X I).inv.app V).hom
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)) =
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) at hone
  exact hone

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit_hom_unit_topWedge
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit_hom_unit_topWedge
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    (V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ) :
    (exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit X I).hom.val.app V
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf X
              (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I))
            (Fintype.card I))).app V).hom
          (by
            classical
            letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
            exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
              (SheafOfModules.freeSection
                (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval V))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app V
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let F : X.Modules :=
    SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let P₀ : P := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheaf X F) (Fintype.card I)
  let P₁ : P := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (finsuppFreePresheaf X I) (Fintype.card I)
  let P₂ : P := 𝟙_ P
  let α : P₀ ⟶ P₁ :=
    (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerFunctor (Fintype.card I)).map
      (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom
  let β : P₁ ⟶ P₂ :=
    (topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso X I).hom
  let w : P₀.obj V := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval V)
  let g : P₁.obj V := topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeGenerator X I V
  have hα :
      (((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map α).app V).hom
          ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₀).app V).hom w) =
        (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₁).app V).hom g := by
    have h := moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply X α V w
    have hw : α.app V w = g := by
      exact exteriorPowerMap_underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_topWedge
        X I V
    rw [hw] at h
    exact h
  have hβ :
      (((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map β).app V).hom
          ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₁).app V).hom g) =
        (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₂).app V).hom
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) := by
    have h := moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply X β V g
    have hg : β.app V g = (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) := by
      exact topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso_hom_generator X I V
    rw [hg] at h
    exact h
  have hunit :
      (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom.val.app V
          ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₂).app V).hom
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)) =
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) := by
    exact moduleTensorUnitIso_hom_unit_apply X V 1
  change
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app V
        ((moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom.val.app V
          ((((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map β).app V).hom
            ((((moduleSheafification X ⋙
              underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map α).app V).hom
                ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₀).app V).hom w)))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app V
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
  rw [hα, hβ, hunit]

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartMap_hom_adjunct
statement:
lemma determinantLocalChartMap_hom_adjunct
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let n := Nat.card (q.generators i).I
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    adj.homEquiv _ _
        ((exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
            (asIso (q.generators i).π) n ≪≫
          exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n).hom) =
      PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
          (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X U
            (q.generators i).π) n ≫
        (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U E.val n).hom ≫
        Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n) := by
  let U := q.X i
  let n := Nat.card (q.generators i).I
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let φ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X U
      (q.generators i).π) n
  change adj.homEquiv _ _
      ((SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).map φ ≫
          (exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n).hom) =
    φ ≫ (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U E.val n).hom ≫
      Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n)
  calc
    _ = φ ≫ adj.homEquiv _ _
        (exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n).hom :=
      adj.homEquiv_naturality_left φ
        (exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n).hom
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun k ↦ φ ≫ k)
      (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPowerSheafOverIso_hom_adjunct X U E n)

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartMap_adjunct_app_raw
statement:
lemma determinantLocalChartMap_adjunct_app_raw
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [IsIntegral X] [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let n := Nat.card (q.generators i).I
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        (SheafOfModules.free
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (q.generators i).I)) n
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    let e := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
        (asIso (q.generators i).π) n ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n
    let φ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X U
        (q.generators i).π) n
    let ρ := (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U E.val n).hom
    let η := Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n)
    ((adj.homEquiv _ _ e.hom).app T).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X E q i) =
      (((φ ≫ ρ ≫ η).app T).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X E q i)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i)))))
      (determinantLocalChartMap_hom_adjunct X E q i))
    (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X E q i)

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartMap_raw_app_topWedge
statement:
lemma determinantLocalChartMap_raw_app_topWedge
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [IsIntegral X] [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let n := Nat.card (q.generators i).I
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        (SheafOfModules.free
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (q.generators i).I)) n
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    let e := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
        (asIso (q.generators i).π) n ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n
    let φ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X U
        (q.generators i).π) n
    let ρ := (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U E.val n).hom
    let η := Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n)
    (((φ ≫ ρ ≫ η).app T).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X E q i)) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n)).app (op U)).hom
          (determinantLocalChartTopWedge X E q i) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let U := q.X i
  let n := Nat.card (q.generators i).I
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let φ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X U
      (q.generators i).π) n
  let ρ := (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U E.val n).hom
  let η := Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
    (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n)
  let w₀ := determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X E q i
  let w₁ := determinantLocalChartTopWedge X E q i
  have hmap : w₁ = φ.app T w₀ :=
    determinantLocalChartTopWedge_eq_map X E q i
  calc
    _ = (((ρ ≫ η).app T).hom (φ.app T w₀)) := rfl
    _ = (((ρ ≫ η).app T).hom w₁) :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ ((ρ ≫ η).app T).hom z) hmap.symm
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartMap_hom_unit_topWedge
statement:
lemma determinantLocalChartMap_hom_unit_topWedge
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [IsIntegral X] [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let n := Nat.card (q.generators i).I
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        (SheafOfModules.free
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (q.generators i).I)) n
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    let e := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
        (asIso (q.generators i).π) n ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U E n
    ((adj.homEquiv _ _ e.hom).app T).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X E q i) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val n)).app (op U)).hom
          (determinantLocalChartTopWedge X E q i) := by
  exact (determinantLocalChartMap_adjunct_app_raw X E q i).trans
    (determinantLocalChartMap_raw_app_topWedge X E q i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_mono
statement:
theorem normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_mono {F G : X.Modules} (i : F ⟶ G)
    [Mono i] [Mono (normalizationSheafUnit X G)] :
    Mono (normalizationSheafUnit X F)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (normalizationMorphism X)
  have h := adj.unit.naturality i
  dsimp only [Functor.id_obj, Functor.id_map] at h
  letI hG : Mono (adj.unit.app G) := by
    change Mono (normalizationSheafUnit X G)
    infer_instance
  change Mono (adj.unit.app F)
  constructor
  intro Z a b hab
  apply (cancel_mono i).1
  apply (cancel_mono (adj.unit.app G)).1
  calc
    (a ≫ i) ≫ adj.unit.app G = a ≫ (i ≫ adj.unit.app G) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = a ≫ (adj.unit.app F ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (normalizationMorphism X) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).map i) :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ a ≫ q) h
    _ = (a ≫ adj.unit.app F) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (normalizationMorphism X) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).map i :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (b ≫ adj.unit.app F) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (normalizationMorphism X) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).map i := by rw [hab]
    _ = b ≫ (adj.unit.app F ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (normalizationMorphism X) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).map i) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = b ≫ (i ≫ adj.unit.app G) := congrArg (fun q ↦ b ≫ q) h.symm
    _ = (b ≫ i) ≫ adj.unit.app G := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toGenericStalkSheaf_eval
statement:
theorem toGenericStalkSheaf_eval (F : X.Modules)
    {U : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj (unop U))
    (s : ↑(F.val.obj U)) :
    (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))) x).hom
        ((toGenericStalkSheaf X F).val.app U s) =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf (unop U)
        (genericPoint X) x.down.down).hom s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)
  rcases x with ⟨⟨hη⟩⟩
  let x : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) := ⟨⟨hη⟩⟩
  letI : Module ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) ↑M := inferInstance
  change (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M) x).hom
      (((Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv
        (genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F)).app U).hom s) = _
  simp only [CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv_apply_app]
  exact (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.pi_lift_π_apply
    (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M)
    (fun x => Φ.toPresheafFiber (unop U) x F.val.presheaf ≫
      genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F) x s).trans
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (toPresheafFiber_genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F (unop U) x.down.down) s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toGenericStalkSheaf_mono
statement:
theorem toGenericStalkSheaf_mono (F : X.Modules) [IsGenericallyTorsionFree X F] :
    Mono (toGenericStalkSheaf X F)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
      (toGenericStalkSheaf X F)) by
    cat_disch
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.mono_of_injective
  intro U s t hst
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) (unop U) s t
  intro x hx
  apply IsGenericallyTorsionFree.stalkToGeneric_injective x
  let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
    (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  let hη : genericPoint X ∈ unop U := hspec.mem_open (unop U).isOpen hx
  let y : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj (unop U) :=
    ⟨⟨hη⟩⟩
  change (toGenericStalkSheaf X F).val.app U s =
    (toGenericStalkSheaf X F).val.app U t at hst
  have hgeneric :
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf (unop U) (genericPoint X) hη).hom s =
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf (unop U) (genericPoint X) hη).hom t := by
    have hst' := congrArg (fun q =>
      (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))) y).hom q) hst
    simpa only [toGenericStalkSheaf_eval X F y] using hst'
  have hs := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes F.val.presheaf hx hspec) s
  have ht := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes F.val.presheaf hx hspec) t
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hs ht
  exact hs.trans (hgeneric.trans ht.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkExtensionUnit_injective
statement:
theorem genericStalkExtensionUnit_injective :
    Function.Injective (genericStalkExtensionUnit X F)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (normalizationFunctionFieldMap X).hom.toAlgebra
  let M := ↑(genericStalkAsFunctionFieldModule X F)
  letI : Module.Free ↑X.functionField M :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing ↑X.functionField M
  letI : Module.Flat ↑X.functionField M := Module.Flat.of_free
  letI : FaithfulSMul ↑X.functionField ↑(normalizationScheme X).functionField :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr
      (normalizationFunctionFieldMap X).hom.injective
  exact Module.Flat.tensorProduct_mk_injective
    ↑X.functionField M ↑(normalizationScheme X).functionField

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap_eval
statement:
theorem genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap_eval
    {U : X.Opensᵒᵖ}
    (y : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology
      (genericPoint (normalizationScheme X))).fiber.obj
        ((Opens.map (normalizationMorphism X).base).obj (unop U)))
    (s : ↑((genericStalkSheaf X F).val.obj U)) :
    (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(extendedGenericStalk X F)) y).hom
        ((genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap X F).app U s) =
      (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F).hom
        ((Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
          ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)))
            (normalizationGenericFiberMap X (unop U) y)).hom s)
proof:
:= by
  change (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(extendedGenericStalk X F)) y).hom
      ((Pi.lift (fun y => Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)))
          (normalizationGenericFiberMap X (unop U) y) ≫
            genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F)).hom s) = _
  erw [AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.pi_lift_π_apply]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change (ConcreteCategory.hom (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F)) _ =
    (ConcreteCategory.hom (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F)) _
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.ringCatStalkToFunctionField_germ
statement:
theorem ringCatStalkToFunctionField_germ (U : X.Opens)
    (hη : genericPoint X ∈ U) (a : ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U))) :
    (ringCatStalkToFunctionField X).hom
        ((X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη).hom a) =
      (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη).hom a
proof:
:= by
  have h := colimit.ι_post
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion (genericPoint X)).op ⋙ X.presheaf)
    (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) (op ⟨U, hη⟩)
  exact congrArg (fun f => (RingCat.Hom.hom f) a) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationFunctionFieldMap_germ
statement:
theorem normalizationFunctionFieldMap_germ (U : X.Opens)
    (hη : genericPoint X ∈ U) (a : ↑(X.presheaf.obj (op U))) :
    (normalizationFunctionFieldMap X).hom
        ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη).hom a) =
      ((normalizationScheme X).presheaf.germ
        ((Opens.map (normalizationMorphism X).base).obj U)
        (genericPoint (normalizationScheme X))
        (by
          change normalizationMorphism X (genericPoint (normalizationScheme X)) ∈ U
          simpa only [normalizationMorphism_genericPoint] using hη)).hom
          ((normalizationMorphism X).app U a)
proof:
:= by
  let x := genericPoint (normalizationScheme X)
  let hspec : Specializes (normalizationMorphism X x) (genericPoint X) := by
    rw [normalizationMorphism_genericPoint]
  have hcongr := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes X.presheaf hη hspec) a
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcongr
  change ((normalizationMorphism X).stalkMap x).hom
      ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq
        (normalizationMorphism_genericPoint X).symm)).hom.hom
          ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη).hom a)) = _
  erw [hcongr]
  exact (normalizationMorphism X).germ_stalkMap_apply U x
    (by simpa only [x, normalizationMorphism_genericPoint] using hη) a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkExtensionAddHom_smul
statement:
theorem genericStalkExtensionAddHom_smul
    (r : ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (r' : ↑((normalizationScheme X).ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk
      (genericPoint (normalizationScheme X))))
    (h : (normalizationFunctionFieldMap X).hom
        ((ringCatStalkToFunctionField X).hom r) =
      (ringCatStalkToFunctionField (normalizationScheme X)).hom r')
    (m : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))) :
    (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F).hom (r • m) =
      (ringCatStalkToFunctionField (normalizationScheme X)).hom r' •
        (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F).hom m
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module ↑X.functionField
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)) :=
    Module.compHom _ (RingCat.Hom.hom
      (inv (ringCatStalkToFunctionField X)))
  have hinv := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (IsIso.hom_inv_id (ringCatStalkToFunctionField X)) r
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hinv
  have hsource : r • m =
      (inv (ringCatStalkToFunctionField X)).hom
        ((ringCatStalkToFunctionField X).hom r) • m :=
    congrArg (fun t : ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) => t • m) hinv.symm
  rw [hsource]
  erw [map_smul (genericStalkExtensionUnit X F).hom
    ((ringCatStalkToFunctionField X).hom r) m]
  change (normalizationFunctionFieldMap X).hom
      ((ringCatStalkToFunctionField X).hom r) •
        (genericStalkExtensionUnit X F).hom m =
    (ringCatStalkToFunctionField (normalizationScheme X)).hom r' •
      (genericStalkExtensionUnit X F).hom m
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkExtensionComparison_mono
statement:
theorem genericStalkExtensionComparison_mono :
    Mono (genericStalkExtensionComparison X F)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
      (genericStalkExtensionComparison X F)) by
    cat_disch
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.mono_of_injective
  intro U s t hst
  apply AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.pi_ext _ fun x => ?_
  let Ψ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology
    (genericPoint (normalizationScheme X))
  rcases x with ⟨⟨hη⟩⟩
  let x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj (unop U) :=
    ⟨⟨hη⟩⟩
  let y : Ψ.fiber.obj
      ((Opens.map (normalizationMorphism X).base).obj (unop U)) := ⟨⟨by
    change normalizationMorphism X (genericPoint (normalizationScheme X)) ∈ unop U
    simpa only [normalizationMorphism_genericPoint] using hη⟩⟩
  have hxy : normalizationGenericFiberMap X (unop U) y = x :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change (genericStalkExtensionComparison X F).val.app U s =
    (genericStalkExtensionComparison X F).val.app U t at hst
  have hproj := congrArg (fun q =>
    (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(extendedGenericStalk X F)) y).hom q) hst
  change (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(extendedGenericStalk X F)) y).hom
      ((genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap X F).app U s) =
    (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(extendedGenericStalk X F)) y).hom
      ((genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap X F).app U t) at hproj
  have hext : (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F).hom
      ((Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))) x).hom s) =
    (genericStalkExtensionAddHom X F).hom
      ((Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))) x).hom t) := by
    rw [genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap_eval X F y s,
      genericStalkExtensionPresheafMap_eval X F y t] at hproj
    simpa only [hxy] using hproj
  exact genericStalkExtensionUnit_injective X F hext

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_map_to_normalizedPushforward
statement:
theorem normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_map_to_normalizedPushforward
    (A : X.Modules) (G : (normalizationScheme X).Modules)
    (α : A ⟶ normalizedPushforward X G) [Mono α] :
    Mono (normalizationSheafUnit X A)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (normalizationMorphism X)
  let u := normalizationSheafUnit X A
  let α' : A ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).obj G := α
  letI : Mono α' := by
    change Mono α
    infer_instance
  let β := (adj.homEquiv A G).symm α'
  have hα : u ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).map β = α' := by
    change adj.unit.app A ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (normalizationMorphism X)).map β = α'
    dsimp only [Functor.id_obj]
    simpa only [β, adj.homEquiv_unit] using
      (adj.homEquiv A G).apply_symm_apply α'
  exact mono_of_mono_fac hα

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_stalk_injective
statement:
theorem normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_stalk_injective (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : ∀ x, Function.Injective (normalizationSheafUnitStalk X F x)) :
    Mono (normalizationSheafUnit X F)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
      (normalizationSheafUnit X F)) by
    cat_disch
  let f := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
    (normalizationSheafUnit X F)
  change Mono f
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.mono_of_injective f
  have hsections :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.app_injective_iff_stalkFunctor_map_injective f.1).mp (by
    intro x
    change Function.Injective (normalizationSheafUnitStalk X F x)
    exact hF x)
  intro U
  rcases U with ⟨U⟩
  exact hsections U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationSheafUnit_mono_of_generic
statement:

    (F : X.Modules) [IsGenericallyTorsionFree X F]

      (normalizationSheafUnitStalk X F (genericPoint X))) :

  intro x a b hab

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationStructureQuotient_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem normalizationStructureQuotient_isFiniteType
    [(normalizedStructureModule X).IsFiniteType] :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_finsum_stalk_length_sub_mul_finrank
statement:
theorem zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_finsum_stalk_length_sub_mul_finrank
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (L R : X.Modules) [L.IsFiniteType] [R.IsFiniteType]
    (hηL : IsZero (L.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (hηR : IsZero (R.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (htorsionL : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L))
    (htorsionR : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)) :
    (zeroDimensionalLength k R : ℤ) - (zeroDimensionalLength k L : ℤ) =
      ∑ᶠ x : X,
        (((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)).toNat : ℤ) -
        ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L)).toNat : ℤ)) *
        (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let rightWeight : X → ℤ := fun x ↦
    ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)).toNat : ℤ) *
      (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ)
  let leftWeight : X → ℤ := fun x ↦
    ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L)).toNat : ℤ) *
      (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ)
  have rightSupport : (Function.support rightWeight).Finite :=
    (moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType R hηR).subset
      ((support_stalkLength_mul_finrank_subset_moduleSheafSupport k R).trans' (by
        intro x hx
        change rightWeight x ≠ 0 at hx
        dsimp only [rightWeight] at hx
        change (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)).toNat *
            Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) ≠ 0
        exact_mod_cast hx))
  have leftSupport : (Function.support leftWeight).Finite :=
    (moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType L hηL).subset
      ((support_stalkLength_mul_finrank_subset_moduleSheafSupport k L).trans' (by
        intro x hx
        change leftWeight x ≠ 0 at hx
        dsimp only [leftWeight] at hx
        change (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L)).toNat *
            Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) ≠ 0
        exact_mod_cast hx))
  calc
    (zeroDimensionalLength k R : ℤ) - (zeroDimensionalLength k L : ℤ) =
        (∑ᶠ x : X, rightWeight x) - ∑ᶠ x : X, leftWeight x := by
      rw [zeroDimensionalLength_intCast_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
        k R hηR htorsionR,
        zeroDimensionalLength_intCast_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
          k L hηL htorsionL]
    _ = ∑ᶠ x : X, (rightWeight x - leftWeight x) := by
      rw [finsum_sub_distrib rightSupport leftSupport]
    _ = ∑ᶠ x : X,
        (((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)).toNat : ℤ) -
        ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L)).toNat : ℤ)) *
        (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro x
      dsimp only [rightWeight, leftWeight]
      ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_degree_of_stalk_length_sub
statement:
theorem zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_degree_of_stalk_length_sub
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (L R : X.Modules) [L.IsFiniteType] [R.IsFiniteType]
    (hηL : IsZero (L.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (hηR : IsZero (R.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (htorsionL : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L))
    (htorsionR : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R))
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ x : X, D x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L)).toNat : ℤ)) :
    (zeroDimensionalLength k R : ℤ) - (zeroDimensionalLength k L : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_finsum_stalk_length_sub_mul_finrank
    k L R hηL hηR htorsionL htorsionR, AlgebraicCycle.degree]
  apply finsum_congr
  intro x
  rw [hcoeff x]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_degree_of_stalk_length_sub_of_coheight_one
statement:
theorem zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_degree_of_stalk_length_sub_of_coheight_one
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (L R : X.Modules) [L.IsFiniteType] [R.IsFiniteType]
    (hηL : IsZero (L.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (hηR : IsZero (R.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (htorsionL : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L))
    (htorsionR : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R))
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (hDsupport : D.support ⊆ {x : X | coheight x = 1})
    (hcoeff : ∀ (x : X), coheight x = 1 → D x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj R)).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj L)).toNat : ℤ)) :
    (zeroDimensionalLength k R : ℤ) - (zeroDimensionalLength k L : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D
proof:
:= by
  apply zeroDimensionalLength_sub_eq_degree_of_stalk_length_sub
    k L R hηL hηR htorsionL htorsionR D
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint X
  · subst x
    have hDη : D (genericPoint X) = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have hcoheight := hDsupport h
      have hzero : coheight (genericPoint X) = 0 := by
        change coheight (⊤ : X) = 0
        exact coheight_top X
      change coheight (genericPoint X) = 1 at hcoheight
      rw [hzero] at hcoheight
      norm_num at hcoheight
    letI : Subsingleton ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (genericPoint X)).obj L) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hηL
    letI : Subsingleton ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (genericPoint X)).obj R) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hηR
    simp only [hDη, Module.length_eq_zero, ENat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero,
      sub_self]
  · exact hcoeff x
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear_map_injective_of_mono
statement:
theorem moduleStalkFunctorLinear_map_injective_of_mono
    (x : X) {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) [Mono f] :
    Function.Injective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).PreservesMonomorphisms := by
    infer_instance
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.basis_det_comp_ne_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem basis_det_comp_ne_zero_of_injective
    {R P Q I : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (bP : Module.Basis I R P) (bQ : Module.Basis I R Q)
    (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    bQ.det (f ∘ bP) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free R Q := Module.Free.of_basis bQ
  letI : Module.Finite R Q := Module.Finite.of_basis bQ
  rw [bP.det_comp_basis bQ f]
  intro hdet
  exact (LinearMap.det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot.mp hdet)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot_of_injective
      (hf.comp (bQ.equiv bP (Equiv.refl I)).injective))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_genericCommonLatticeStalkBasisData
statement:
theorem exists_genericCommonLatticeStalkBasisData
    (M N : X.Modules)
    (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hN : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (x : X) [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (cM : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (cN : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N)) :
    ∃ cP : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)),
      Function.Injective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∧
      Function.Injective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∧
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)).hom) =
        Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M) ∧
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)).hom) =
        Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) ∧
      cM.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ cP) ≠ 0 ∧
      cN.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ cP) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M := hM
  letI : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N := hN
  let left := genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e
  let right := genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e
  have hinjLeft : Function.Injective
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left) :=
    moduleStalkFunctorLinear_map_injective_of_mono x left
  have hinjRight : Function.Injective
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) :=
    moduleStalkFunctorLinear_map_injective_of_mono x right
  letI : Module.Free (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis cN
  letI : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) :=
    Module.Finite.of_basis cN
  let eQ := moduleStalkCokernelIsoRangeQuotient X x right
  letI : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) ⧸
        LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) :=
    Module.Finite.quotient (X.presheaf.stalk x) _
  letI : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (cokernel right)) :=
    (Module.Finite.equiv_iff eQ.toLinearEquiv).mpr inferInstance
  have hCokernelFinrank : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (cokernel right)) = 0 :=
    Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff_isTorsion.mpr
      (genericCommonLatticeRightQuotient_stalk_isTorsion M N e hM x)
  have hQuotientFinrank : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) ⧸
        LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) = 0 := by
    rw [← eQ.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
    exact hCokernelFinrank
  have hright : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) := by
    have h := (LinearMap.range
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    rw [hQuotientFinrank, zero_add] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨n, bRange⟩ := Submodule.basisOfPid cN
    (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom)
  have hn : n = genericRank X N := by
    calc
      n = Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (LinearMap.range
            ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) := by
        simpa using (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis bRange).symm
      _ = Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N) := hright
      _ = genericRank X N := by
        simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis cN
  let rangeBasis : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N))
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) :=
    bRange.reindex (finCongr hn)
  let rightRangeEquiv :
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)) ≃ₗ[
        X.presheaf.stalk x]
        LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInjective
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom hinjRight
  let cP : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)) :=
    rangeBasis.map rightRangeEquiv.symm
  have hleft : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M) := by
    calc
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left).hom) =
        Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
            (genericCommonLattice X M N e)) :=
        LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinjLeft
      _ = genericRank X N := by
        simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis cP
      _ = Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M) := by
        simpa using (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis cM).symm
  have hdetLeft : cM.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left) ∘ cP) ≠ 0 :=
    basis_det_comp_ne_zero_of_injective cP cM
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left).hom hinjLeft
  have hdetRight : cN.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) ∘ cP) ≠ 0 :=
    basis_det_comp_ne_zero_of_injective cP cN
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom hinjRight
  refine ⟨cP, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [left] using hinjLeft
  · simpa only [right] using hinjRight
  · simpa only [left] using hleft
  · simpa only [right] using hright
  · simpa only [left] using hdetLeft
  · simpa only [right] using hdetRight

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_of_targetStalkBases
statement:
theorem exists_genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_of_targetStalkBases
    (M N : X.Modules) (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hN : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    {x : X}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X (SchemeKTheory.determinant X N) x)
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (cM : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (cN : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hframe : d.genericTrivialization =
      (determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization X N hN x cN).equiv) :
    ∃ cP : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)),
      (genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization
        X M N e hM hN x cM).equiv
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (cM.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
              (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ cP))) =
        d.genericTrivialization
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (cN.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
              (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ cP)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cP, _, hinjRight, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_genericCommonLatticeStalkBasisData M N e hM hN x cM cN
  refine ⟨cP, ?_⟩
  exact genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_of_stalkBases
    X M N e hM hN d cP cM cN hinjRight hframe

name: Submodule.length_quotient_eq_ord_prod_smithCoeffs
statement:
theorem length_quotient_eq_ord_prod_smithCoeffs
    (N : Submodule R M) (b : Basis ι R M)
    (h : Module.finrank R N = Module.finrank R M) :
    Module.length R (M ⧸ N) =
      Ring.ord R (∏ i, N.smithNormalFormCoeffs b h i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(N.quotientEquivPiSpan b h).length_eq,
    Module.length_pi_of_fintype]
  change (∑ i, Ring.ord R (N.smithNormalFormCoeffs b h i)) = _
  classical
  let a : ι → R := N.smithNormalFormCoeffs b h
  change (∑ i, Ring.ord R (a i)) = Ring.ord R (∏ i, a i)
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [Ring.ord]
  | @insert x s hx ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hx, Ring.ord_mul' R]
      · rw [Finset.sum_insert hx, ih]
      · exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr
          (N.smithNormalFormCoeffs_ne_zero b h x)

name: Submodule.det_smithNormalFormBotBasis_eq_prod_smithCoeffs
statement:
theorem det_smithNormalFormBotBasis_eq_prod_smithCoeffs
    (N : Submodule R M) (b : Basis ι R M)
    (h : Module.finrank R N = Module.finrank R M) :
    (N.smithNormalFormTopBasis b h).det
        (fun i ↦ (N.smithNormalFormBotBasis b h i : M)) =
      ∏ i, N.smithNormalFormCoeffs b h i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [N.smithNormalFormBotBasis_def b h]
  rw [AlternatingMap.map_smul_univ]
  rw [Basis.det_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Submodule.length_quotient_eq_ord_det_smithNormalForm
statement:
theorem length_quotient_eq_ord_det_smithNormalForm
    (N : Submodule R M) (b : Basis ι R M)
    (h : Module.finrank R N = Module.finrank R M) :
    Module.length R (M ⧸ N) =
      Ring.ord R ((N.smithNormalFormTopBasis b h).det
        (fun i ↦ (N.smithNormalFormBotBasis b h i : M)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [N.det_smithNormalFormBotBasis_eq_prod_smithCoeffs b h]
  exact N.length_quotient_eq_ord_prod_smithCoeffs b h

name: Submodule.associated_det_basis_with_det_smithNormalForm
statement:
theorem associated_det_basis_with_det_smithNormalForm
    (N : Submodule R M) (bM : Basis ι R M) (bN : Basis ι R N)
    (h : Module.finrank R N = Module.finrank R M) :
    Associated (bM.det (fun i ↦ (bN i : M)))
      ((N.smithNormalFormTopBasis bM h).det
        (fun i ↦ (N.smithNormalFormBotBasis bM h i : M)))
proof:
:= by
  change Associated (bM.det (N.subtype ∘ bN))
    ((N.smithNormalFormTopBasis bM h).det
      (N.subtype ∘ N.smithNormalFormBotBasis bM h))
  rw [bN.det_comp_basis bM N.subtype]
  rw [(N.smithNormalFormBotBasis bM h).det_comp_basis
    (N.smithNormalFormTopBasis bM h) N.subtype]
  exact LinearMap.associated_det_comp_equiv N.subtype
    (bM.equiv bN (Equiv.refl ι))
    ((N.smithNormalFormTopBasis bM h).equiv
      (N.smithNormalFormBotBasis bM h) (Equiv.refl ι))

name: Submodule.length_quotient_eq_ord_det_basis
statement:
theorem length_quotient_eq_ord_det_basis
    (N : Submodule R M) (bM : Basis ι R M) (bN : Basis ι R N)
    (h : Module.finrank R N = Module.finrank R M) :
    Module.length R (M ⧸ N) =
      Ring.ord R (bM.det (fun i ↦ (bN i : M)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [N.length_quotient_eq_ord_det_smithNormalForm bM h]
  exact (Ring.ord_eq_of_associated
    (N.associated_det_basis_with_det_smithNormalForm bM bN h)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleLength_hZero_eq_zeroDimensionalLength
statement:
theorem moduleLength_hZero_eq_zeroDimensionalLength (F : X.Modules)
    (hfinite : Module.Finite k (F.H 0)) :
    Module.length k (F.H 0) = zeroDimensionalLength k F
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite k (F.H 0) := hfinite
  exact Module.length_eq_finrank k (F.H 0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.eulerChar_eq_zeroDimensionalLength
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_zeroDimensionalLength (F : X.Modules)
    (higherVanishing : ∀ n, 0 < n → Subsingleton (F.H n)) :
    F.eulerChar k = (zeroDimensionalLength k F : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : ∀ n, 0 < n → F.h k n = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    letI : Subsingleton (F.H n) := higherVanishing n hn
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  rw [Scheme.Modules.eulerChar,
    eulerChar_finsum_eq (N := 0) (fun n ↦ F.h k n) hdim]
  simp [zeroDimensionalLength]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierStep.ofMono_quotient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofMono_quotient (inclusion : lower ⟶ upper) [Mono inclusion]
    (lowerFinite : lower.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (upperFinite : upper.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (quotientFinite : (cokernel inclusion).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (quotientEulerChar : (cokernel inclusion).eulerChar k = degree) :
    (ofMono inclusion lowerFinite upperFinite quotientFinite quotientEulerChar).quotient =
      cokernel inclusion
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierStep.eulerChar_upper_eq
statement:
theorem eulerChar_upper_eq (s : CartierStep k lower upper degree) :
    upper.eulerChar k = lower.eulerChar k + degree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := s.lowerFinite.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := s.upperFinite.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := s.quotientFinite.vanishing
  let N := max N₁ (max N₂ N₃)
  have hLower : ∀ n, N < n → Subsingleton (lower.H n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hN₁ n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left N₁ (max N₂ N₃)) hn)
  have hUpper : ∀ n, N < n → Subsingleton (upper.H n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hN₂ n (lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((le_max_left N₂ N₃).trans (le_max_right N₁ (max N₂ N₃))) hn)
  have hQuotient : ∀ n, N < n → Subsingleton (s.quotient.H n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hN₃ n (lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((le_max_right N₂ N₃).trans (le_max_right N₁ (max N₂ N₃))) hn)
  have hadd := eulerChar_additive k (shortComplex s) s.shortExact
    s.lowerFinite.finite s.upperFinite.finite s.quotientFinite.finite hLower hUpper hQuotient
  change upper.eulerChar k = lower.eulerChar k + s.quotient.eulerChar k at hadd
  rw [hadd, s.quotientEulerChar]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk.targetFinite
statement:
theorem targetFinite (walk : CartierWalk k F G degree)
    (hF : F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    G.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  induction walk with
  | refl F => exact hF
  | grow step tail ih => exact ih step.upperFinite
  | shrink step tail ih => exact ih step.lowerFinite
  | relabel e tail ih =>
      exact ih
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k e hF)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk.sourceFinite
statement:
theorem sourceFinite (walk : CartierWalk k F G degree)
    (hG : G.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:=
  walk.symm.targetFinite hG

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk.eulerChar_eq
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq (walk : CartierWalk k F G degree) :
    G.eulerChar k = degree + F.eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  induction walk with
  | refl F => simp
  | grow step tail ih =>
      calc
        _ = _ + _ := ih
        _ = _ := by rw [step.eulerChar_upper_eq]; ring
  | shrink step tail ih =>
      calc
        _ = _ + _ := ih
        _ = _ := by rw [step.eulerChar_upper_eq]; ring
  | relabel e tail ih =>
      calc
        _ = _ + _ := ih
        _ = _ := by
          rw [AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.eulerChar_eq_of_iso k e]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk.nonempty_divisorialSheaf
statement:
theorem nonempty_divisorialSheaf
    (hχ₀ : (structureModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (hD : IsWeilDivisor D) :
    Nonempty (CartierWalk k
      (SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ))
      (SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D) (D.degree k))
proof:
:= by
  induction D, hD using Function.locallyFinsupp.inductionOn with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨by
        simpa [AlgebraicCycle.degree] using
          (CartierWalk.refl
          (SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)) :
            CartierWalk k _ _ 0)⟩
  | add E hE ih p hp =>
      obtain ⟨walk⟩ := ih
      let step := CartierStep.addSingle (k := k) hχ₀ E hE p hp
      exact ⟨by simpa using walk.trans (CartierWalk.ofStep step)⟩
  | minus E hE ih p hp =>
      obtain ⟨walk⟩ := ih
      have hE' : IsWeilDivisor (E - single p 1) :=
        Function.locallyFinsupp.support_sub_single_subset hE hp
      let step := CartierStep.addSingle (k := k) hχ₀ (E - single p 1) hE' p hp
      have back : CartierWalk k (SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf E)
          (SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf (E - single p 1))
          (-(Module.finrank k (X.residueField p) : ℤ)) := by
        simpa using CartierWalk.ofStepSymm step
      have hdegree : AlgebraicCycle.degree k (E - single p 1) =
          AlgebraicCycle.degree k E +
            -(Module.finrank k (X.residueField p) : ℤ) := by
        rw [AlgebraicCycle.degree_minus, AlgebraicCycle.degree_single]
        simp only [one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      exact ⟨by rw [hdegree]; exact walk.trans back⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointSkyscraperSheafFunctor_map_epi
statement:
lemma pointSkyscraperSheafFunctor_map_epi
    (p : X) {A B : Ab.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f] :
    Epi ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor.map f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Epi
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor.map f).hom := by
    rw [NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app]
    intro U
    change Epi (Limits.Pi.map (fun _ :
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U.unop => f))
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    intro y
    have hf : Function.Surjective f :=
      (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective f).mp inferInstance
    choose x hx using fun i => hf ((Concrete.productEquiv (fun _ :
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U.unop => B)) y i)
    refine ⟨(Concrete.productEquiv (fun _ :
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U.unop => A)).symm x, ?_⟩
    apply (Concrete.productEquiv (fun _ :
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U.unop => B)).injective
    funext i
    rw [Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply, Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Pi.map_π, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [Concrete.productEquiv_symm_apply_π]
    simpa only [Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply] using hx i
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointSkyscraperSheafFunctor_map_shortExact
statement:
lemma pointSkyscraperSheafFunctor_map_shortExact
    (p : X) (S : ShortComplex Ab.{u}) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono S.f := hS.mono_f
  haveI : Epi S.g := hS.epi_g
  have hexact :
      (S.map (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor).Exact :=
    hS.exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel _ inferInstance inferInstance
  have hmono : Mono
      (S.map (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor).f := by
    change Mono ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor.map S.f)
    exact Functor.map_mono _ _
  have hepi : Epi
      (S.map (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor).g := by
    change Epi ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor.map S.g)
    exact pointSkyscraperSheafFunctor_map_epi p S.g
  exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' hexact hmono hepi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.restrictScalars_map_shortExact
statement:
lemma restrictScalars_map_shortExact {R R' : Type u} [Ring R] [Ring R']
    (f : R →+* R') (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R')) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact
  · exact (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact S).mp hS.exact
  · exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective S.f).mp hS.mono_f
  · exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective S.g).mp hS.epi_g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.localModuleSkyscraperFunctor_map_shortExact
statement:
lemma localModuleSkyscraperFunctor_map_shortExact
    (p : X) (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk p)))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (localModuleSkyscraperFunctor p)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p
  let r := (pointPresheafFiberToStalk p X.ringCatSheaf).hom
  have hres : (S.map (ModuleCat.restrictScalars r)).ShortExact :=
    restrictScalars_map_shortExact
      (R := ↑((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).presheafFiber.obj
        X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf))
      (R' := ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk p)) r S hS
  let Sres := S.map (ModuleCat.restrictScalars r)
  let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((Point.sheafFiber Φ).obj
    X.ringCatSheaf).carrier) Ab.{u}
  let T := @ShortComplex.map _ _ _ _ _ _ Sres F
    (moduleCatForgetToAb_preservesZeroMorphisms _)
  have hex : T.Exact := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact T).mpr (by
    change Function.Exact Sres.f Sres.g
    exact (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact Sres).mp hres.exact)
  have hmono : Mono T.f := by
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective]
    change Function.Injective Sres.f
    exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective Sres.f).mp hres.mono_f
  have hepi : Epi T.g := by
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    change Function.Surjective Sres.g
    exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective Sres.g).mp hres.epi_g
  have hab : T.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' hex hmono hepi
  let P := (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperSheafFunctor (A := Ab.{u})
  let Q := @ShortComplex.map _ _ _ _ _ Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms T P
    (by infer_instance)
  haveI : Mono T.f := hab.mono_f
  haveI : Epi T.g := hab.epi_g
  have hQexact : Q.Exact := by
    dsimp [Q]
    exact hab.exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel _ inferInstance inferInstance
  have hQmono : Mono Q.f := by
    change Mono (P.map T.f)
    exact Functor.map_mono P T.f
  have hQepi : Epi Q.g := by
    dsimp [Q, P]
    exact pointSkyscraperSheafFunctor_map_epi p T.g
  have hQ : Q.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' hQexact hQmono hQepi
  apply CategoryTheory.ShortExact.reflects_shortExact_of_faithful
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf)
  rw [← ShortComplex.map_comp]
  have hfun : localModuleSkyscraperFunctor p ⋙
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf =
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars r ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat ((Point.sheafFiber Φ).obj X.ringCatSheaf).carrier) Ab ⋙ P := by
    simpa [localModuleSkyscraperFunctor, P, Φ, r, Functor.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun F => ModuleCat.restrictScalars r ⋙ F)
        (Point.skyscraperSheafOfModules_eq_skyscraperSheaf Φ X.ringCatSheaf)
  let Rfun := ModuleCat.restrictScalars r ⋙
    forget₂ (ModuleCat ((Point.sheafFiber Φ).obj X.ringCatSheaf).carrier) Ab ⋙ P
  let SR := @ShortComplex.map _ _ _ _ _ Preadditive.preadditiveHasZeroMorphisms S Rfun
    (by infer_instance)
  let eQR : Q ≅ SR := ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (by simp [Q, SR, Rfun, P, T, F, Sres, Φ, r, ShortComplex.map_comp])
    (by simp [Q, SR, Rfun, P, T, F, Sres, Φ, r, ShortComplex.map_comp])
  have hSR : SR.ShortExact := ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso eQR hQ
  let e : (localModuleSkyscraperFunctor p ⋙
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf) ≅ Rfun := eqToIso hfun
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (S.mapNatIso e).symm hSR

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor_map_shortExact
statement:
lemma commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor_map_shortExact
    (p : X) (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk p)))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let r := AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.stalkCompare p
  have hres : (S.map (ModuleCat.restrictScalars r)).ShortExact :=
    restrictScalars_map_shortExact r S hS
  have hsky := localModuleSkyscraperFunctor_map_shortExact p _ hres
  let A := ModuleCat.restrictScalars r
  let B := localModuleSkyscraperFunctor p
  let e : S.map (A ⋙ B) ≅ (S.map A).map B := eqToIso (ShortComplex.map_comp S A B)
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso e.symm hsky

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.commLocalModuleSkyscraper_devissage_of_isFiniteLength
statement:
theorem commLocalModuleSkyscraper_devissage_of_isFiniteLength
    (p : X) {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ↑(X.presheaf.stalk p) M]
    (hM : IsFiniteLength ↑(X.presheaf.stalk p) M) :
    ∃ ps : List X, (∀ q ∈ ps, q = p) ∧
      ps.length = (Module.length ↑(X.presheaf.stalk p) M).toNat ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage
        ((commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p).obj
          (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk p) M)) ps)
proof:
:= by
  induction hM with
  | @of_subsingleton M _ _ hsub =>
      let K := commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p
      have hzeroM : IsZero (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk p) M) :=
        ModuleCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr hsub
      have hzero : IsZero (K.obj (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk p) M)) :=
        K.map_isZero hzeroM
      exact ⟨[], by simp, by simp, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso hzero.isoZero
        PointSkyscraperDevissage.zero⟩⟩
  | @of_simple_quotient M _ _ N _ hN ih =>
      let R := ↑(X.presheaf.stalk p)
      obtain ⟨I, hI, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
        isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mp
          (inferInstance : IsSimpleModule R (M ⧸ N))
      rw [IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hI] at e
      let f : N →ₗ[R] M := N.subtype
      let g : M →ₗ[R] ↑(X.residueField p) := e.toLinearMap.comp N.mkQ
      have hex : Function.Exact f g := by
        rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
        change (e.toLinearMap.comp N.mkQ).ker = N.subtype.range
        rw [LinearEquiv.ker_comp, N.ker_mkQ, N.range_subtype]
      have hinj : Function.Injective f := N.injective_subtype
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective g := e.surjective.comp N.mkQ_surjective
      let Sm := ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero f g hex.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
      have hSm : Sm.ShortExact :=
        ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact Sm hex hinj hsurj
      let K := commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p
      have hK : (Sm.map K).ShortExact :=
        commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor_map_shortExact p Sm hSm
      obtain ⟨ps, hps, hlenps, ⟨d⟩⟩ := ih
      have hlen := Module.length_eq_add_of_exact f g hinj hsurj hex
      have hlenN : Module.length R N ≠ ⊤ :=
        Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr hN
      have hlenK_eq : Module.length R ↑(X.residueField p) = 1 := by
        change Module.length R (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) = 1
        rw [← e.length_eq]
        exact Module.length_eq_one R (M ⧸ N)
      have hlenK : Module.length R ↑(X.residueField p) ≠ ⊤ := by
        rw [hlenK_eq]
        simp
      refine ⟨p :: ps, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with rfl | hq
        · rfl
        · exact hps q hq
      · have hlenps' : ps.length = (Module.length R N).toNat := by
          simpa [R] using hlenps
        rw [List.length_cons, hlen, ENat.toNat_add hlenN hlenK,
          hlenps', hlenK_eq]
        simp
      · exact ⟨by
          simpa [K, Sm, f, g, commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor,
            localModuleSkyscraperFunctor, Scheme.residueField] using
            (PointSkyscraperDevissage.extension p d
              (Sm.map K).f (Sm.map K).g (Sm.map K).zero hK)⟩

      {p : X | coheight p = 1}

  change lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization X hM hrank t p ≠ 0 at hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithTrivialization_change
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCycleWithTrivialization_change
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (t : RationalTrivialization X M) (b : LineBundleLocalData X M x) :
    lineBundleDivisorCycleWithTrivialization hM hrank t =
      AlgebraicGeometry.div (t.transitionFunction b) +
        lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame hM hrank b
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  let d := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank p
  change X.ord (t.transitionFunction d) p =
    X.ord (t.transitionFunction b) p +
      X.ord (b.regularTransitionFunction d) p
  by_cases hp : coheight p = 1
  · rw [t.transitionFunction_cocycle b d,
      X.ord_mul hp (t.transitionFunction_ne_zero b)
        (b.transitionFunction_ne_zero d),
      b.regularTransitionFunction_eq_transitionFunction]
  · rw [ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp, zero_add]
