name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_biprod
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_biprod (F G : X.Modules)
    (hF : F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (hG : G.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    (biprod F G).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨NF, hNF⟩ := hF.vanishing
  obtain ⟨NG, hNG⟩ := hG.vanishing
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ finite_H_biprod k F G n (hF.finite n) (hG.finite n),
    max NF NG, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact subsingleton_H_biprod k F G n
    (hNF n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left NF NG) hn))
    (hNG n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right NF NG) hn))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_free_fin
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_free_fin
    (hχ₀ : (structureModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) (n : ℕ) :
    Scheme.Modules.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hzero : (0 : X.Modules).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k :=
        ⟨fun m ↦ finite_H_zero (X := X) k m, 0,
          fun m _ ↦ subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) m⟩
      exact hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k
        (SchemeKTheory.freeFinZeroIsoZero X).symm hzero
  | succ n ih =>
      have hone :
          Scheme.Modules.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin 1))) :=
        hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k
          (SchemeKTheory.freeFinOneIsoUnit X).symm hχ₀
      have hsum :
          Scheme.Modules.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k (biprod
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)))) :=
        hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_biprod k _ _ ih hone
      let eSum :
          SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin n) ⊕ ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) ≅
            SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :=
        (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
          ((Equiv.sumCongr Equiv.ulift Equiv.ulift).trans
            (finSumFinEquiv.trans Equiv.ulift.symm)).toIso
      exact hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k
        (SchemeKTheory.freeBinaryIso X
          (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) ≪≫ eSum) hsum

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property_and_weight
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property_and_weight
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → X.Modules) (ps : ι → List X)
    (d : ∀ i, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A i) (ps i))
    (P : X → Prop) (hP : ∀ i p, p ∈ ps i → P p) (w : X → ℕ) :
    ∃ qs : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ qs → P p) ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage (∏ᶜ A) qs) ∧
      (qs.map w).sum = ∑ i, ((ps i).map w).sum
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ∀ (α : Type u) [Fintype α], Prop := fun α _ ↦
    ∀ (B : α → X.Modules) (rs : α → List X),
      (∀ i, PointSkyscraperDevissage (B i) (rs i)) →
      (∀ i p, p ∈ rs i → P p) →
      ∃ qs : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ qs → P p) ∧
        Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage (∏ᶜ B) qs) ∧
        (qs.map w).sum = ∑ i, ((rs i).map w).sum
  apply Fintype.induction_empty_option (P := Q)
  · intro α β _ e hα B rs dB hB
    let _ : Fintype α := Fintype.ofEquiv β e.symm
    obtain ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨dqs⟩, hsum⟩ := hα (B ∘ e) (rs ∘ e)
      (fun i ↦ dB (e i)) (fun i p hp ↦ hB (e i) p hp)
    refine ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
      (Pi.whiskerEquiv e (fun _ ↦ Iso.refl _)).symm dqs⟩, ?_⟩
    exact hsum.trans (e.sum_comp fun i ↦ ((rs i).map w).sum)
  · intro B rs dB hB
    have hzero : IsZero (∏ᶜ B) := by
      rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
      apply Pi.hom_ext
      intro i
      exact PEmpty.elim i
    exact ⟨[], by simp, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso hzero.isoZero
      PointSkyscraperDevissage.zero⟩, by simp⟩
  · intro α _ hα B rs dB hB
    obtain ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨dqs⟩, hsum⟩ := hα (fun i ↦ B (some i))
      (fun i ↦ rs (some i)) (fun i ↦ dB (some i))
      (fun i p hp ↦ hB (some i) p hp)
    let db := PointSkyscraperDevissage.biprod (dB none) dqs
    refine ⟨qs ++ rs none, ?_, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
      (productOptionIso B) db⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hp with hp | hp
      · exact hqs p hp
      · exact hB none p hp
    · simp only [List.map_append, List.sum_append, hsum, Fintype.sum_option]
      exact Nat.add_comm _ _
  · exact d
  · exact hP

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport_with_weighted_length
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport_with_weighted_length
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)) (w : X → ℕ) :
    ∃ ps : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ ps → p ∈ S) ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps) ∧
      (ps.map w).sum = ∑ p : S,
        (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat * w p.1
proof:
:= by
  let A : S → X.Modules := fun p ↦
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let points : S → List X := fun p ↦
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints p.1 (hfinite p)
  let d : ∀ p : S, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A p) (points p) := fun p ↦
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperDevissage p.1 (hfinite p)
  have hpoints : ∀ i p, p ∈ points i → p ∈ S := by
    intro i p hp
    have hpEq : p = i.1 :=
      mem_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints_eq i.1 (hfinite i) hp
    simpa only [hpEq] using i.2
  obtain ⟨ps, hps, ⟨dps⟩, hsum⟩ :=
    exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property_and_weight
      A points d (fun p ↦ p ∈ S) hpoints w
  have hlocal : ∀ p : S, ((points p).map w).sum =
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat * w p.1 := by
    intro p
    have hrep : points p = List.replicate (points p).length p.1 :=
      List.eq_replicate_length.mpr (fun q hq ↦
        mem_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints_eq p.1 (hfinite p) hq)
    rw [hrep, List.map_replicate, List.sum_const_nat,
      length_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints]
  letI : IsIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) :=
    toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso F S hSη hsupp
  refine ⟨ps, hps, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
    (asIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) dps⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [hsum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ ↦ hlocal p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem moduleSheafSupport_eq_of_iso {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ N) : moduleSheafSupport M = moduleSheafSupport N
proof:

  let ex := (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).mapIso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_tilde_eq
statement:
theorem moduleSheafSupport_tilde_eq {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (N : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    moduleSheafSupport (tilde N) = Module.support R N
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let e : (tilde N).presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[R]
      LocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl N :=
    IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv x.asIdeal.primeCompl
      (tilde.toStalk N x).hom
      (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap x.asIdeal.primeCompl N)
  exact e.toEquiv.nontrivial_congr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor
statement:
theorem moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor {S X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : S ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : X.Modules) :
    moduleSheafSupport ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M) =
      f.base ⁻¹' moduleSheafSupport M
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let e := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f x).app M
  exact e.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.nontrivial_congr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_spec
proof:
:= by
  let N := moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R N := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation M
  have hfinite : Module.Finite R N := inferInstance
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Module.support R N) := by
    letI : Module.Finite R N := hfinite
    exact Module.isClosed_support
  rw [moduleSheafSupport_eq_of_iso (asIso M.fromTildeΓ).symm,
    moduleSheafSupport_tilde_eq]
  exact hclosed

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_isAffine {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X]
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsClosed (moduleSheafSupport M)
proof:
:= by
  let e := X.isoSpec
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv).obj M
  letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor e.inv M
  have hN : IsClosed (moduleSheafSupport N) :=
    isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_spec N
  have hpre : moduleSheafSupport N =
      e.inv.base ⁻¹' moduleSheafSupport M :=
    moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor e.inv M
  have hclosed : IsClosed (e.hom.base ⁻¹' moduleSheafSupport N) :=
    hN.preimage e.hom.continuous
  convert hclosed using 1
  rw [hpre]
  ext x
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_moduleSheafSupport
proof:

  rw [moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor U.1.ι M] at hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_of_isClosed_not_mem_genericPoint
statement:
theorem finite_of_isClosed_not_mem_genericPoint
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [NoetherianSpace X]
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] {Z : Set X}
    (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hη : genericPoint X ∉ Z) : Z.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSfinite, hSclosed, hSirred, hZunion⟩ :=
    NoetherianSpace.exists_finite_set_isClosed_irreducible hZ
  rw [hZunion]
  apply hSfinite.sUnion
  intro T hTS
  let z : X := (hSirred T hTS).genericPoint
  have hzT : z ∈ T :=
    ((hSirred T hTS).isGenericPoint_genericPoint (hSclosed T hTS)).mem
  have hTsub : T ⊆ Z := by
    rw [hZunion]
    exact Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem hTS
  have hzη : z ≠ genericPoint X := by
    intro hz
    exact hη (hz ▸ hTsub hzT)
  have hzclosed : IsClosed ({z} : Set X) :=
    AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.isClosed_singleton_of_coheight_eq_one
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint hzη)
  have hTsingleton : T = {z} := by
    rw [← (hSirred T hTS).closure_genericPoint (hSclosed T hTS),
      hzclosed.closure_eq]
  rw [hTsingleton]
  exact Set.finite_singleton z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_subsingleton

    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]

    (hη : Subsingleton (M.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))) :
    (moduleSheafSupport M).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply finite_of_isClosed_not_mem_genericPoint
    (isClosed_moduleSheafSupport M)
  exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mpr hη

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero

    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.unitStalkMap_eq_zero_of_germ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem unitStalkMap_eq_zero_of_germ_eq_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (s : M.sections) (x : X)
    (hs : M.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial (s.val (op ⊤)) = 0) :
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map (M.unitHomEquiv.symm s)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).obj
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
  ext a
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, r, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    P a
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  trans 0
  · change TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf U x hxU
        (((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map
          (M.unitHomEquiv.symm s)).app (op U) r) = 0
    rw [show ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map
        (M.unitHomEquiv.symm s)).app (op U) r =
          (show X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op U) from r) •
            (show M.val.obj (op U) from s.val (op U)) by rfl]
    rw [M.val.germ_ringCat_smul]
    have hsgerm : M.presheaf.germ U x hxU (s.val (op U)) = 0 := by
      have hsec : M.presheaf.map U.leTop.op (s.val (op ⊤)) =
          s.val (op U) := s.property U.leTop.op
      calc
        _ = M.presheaf.germ U x hxU
              (M.presheaf.map U.leTop.op (s.val (op ⊤))) := congrArg _ hsec.symm
        _ = M.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial (s.val (op ⊤)) :=
          ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
            (M.presheaf.germ_res U.leTop x hxU) (s.val (op ⊤))
        _ = 0 := hs
    have hsgerm' : TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf U x hxU
        (s.val (op U)) = 0 := hsgerm
    rw [hsgerm', smul_zero]
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_stalk_of_generatingSections_germ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isZero_stalk_of_generatingSections_germ_eq_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (G : M.GeneratingSections)
    [G.IsFiniteType] (x : X)
    (hG : ∀ i, M.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
      ((G.s i).val (op ⊤)) = 0) :
    IsZero (M.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  let F : X.Modules ⥤ Ab.{u} := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
    dsimp only [F]
    infer_instance
  letI : F.PreservesEpimorphisms := by infer_instance
  letI : Epi G.π := G.epi
  let A : G.I → X.Modules := fun _ ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
  let p : F.obj (SheafOfModules.free G.I (R := X.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶
      F.obj M := F.map G.π
  letI : Epi p := by
    dsimp only [p]
    exact Functor.map_epi F G.π
  have hp : p = 0 := by
    letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
    let e : F.obj (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) ≅
        colimit (Discrete.functor fun i ↦ F.obj (A i)) :=
      PreservesCoproduct.iso F A
    apply (cancel_epi e.inv).1
    apply Limits.Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    rw [show e.inv = sigmaComparison F A by rfl]
    rw [Limits.ι_comp_sigmaComparison_assoc]
    change F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree i) ≫ F.map G.π = _
    rw [← F.map_comp]
    simp only [comp_zero]
    have hi : SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ G.π =
        M.unitHomEquiv.symm (G.s i) := by
      rw [← SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply]
      change M.unitHomEquiv.symm
        (M.freeHomEquiv (M.freeHomEquiv.symm G.s) i) = _
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hi]
    change (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map
        (M.unitHomEquiv.symm (G.s i))) = 0
    exact unitStalkMap_eq_zero_of_germ_eq_zero M (G.s i) x (hG i)
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply (cancel_epi p).1
  simp only [hp, zero_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_generatingSections
statement:
theorem isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_generatingSections
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (G : M.GeneratingSections)
    [G.IsFiniteType] : IsClosed (moduleSheafSupport M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro x hx
  change ¬ Nontrivial (M.presheaf.stalk x) at hx
  have hxsub : Subsingleton (M.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hx
  have hgi (i : G.I) :
      M.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial ((G.s i).val (op ⊤)) =
        M.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial 0 :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  choose V hxV i₁ i₂ hV using fun i ↦
    M.presheaf.germ_eq (U := ⊤) (V := ⊤) x trivial trivial
      ((G.s i).val (op ⊤)) 0 (hgi i)
  have hres (i : G.I) :
      M.presheaf.map (V i).leTop.op ((G.s i).val (op ⊤)) = 0 := by
    have hi₁ : i₁ i = (V i).leTop := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hi₂ : i₂ i = (V i).leTop := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simpa only [hi₁, hi₂, map_zero] using hV i
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let W : X.Opens := ⨅ i, V i
  have hxW : x ∈ W := by
    have hcoe : (W : Set X) = ⋂ i, (V i : Set X) := by
      dsimp only [W]
      exact Opens.coe_iInf V
    show x ∈ (W : Set X)
    rw [hcoe]
    exact Set.mem_iInter.mpr hxV
  refine ⟨(W : Set X), ?_, W.isOpen, hxW⟩
  intro y hyW
  change ¬ Nontrivial (M.presheaf.stalk y)
  apply not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
  apply isZero_stalk_of_generatingSections_germ_eq_zero M G y
  intro i
  have hyV : y ∈ V i := (show W ≤ V i from iInf_le V i) hyW
  calc
    M.presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((G.s i).val (op ⊤)) =
        M.presheaf.germ (V i) y hyV
          (M.presheaf.map (V i).leTop.op ((G.s i).val (op ⊤))) :=
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (M.presheaf.germ_res (V i).leTop y hyV)
        ((G.s i).val (op ⊤))).symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [hres, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_isFiniteType
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFiniteType] :
    IsClosed (moduleSheafSupport M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData M
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hq
  let hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  rw [hcover.isClosed_iff_coe_preimage]
  intro i
  let U : X.Opens := q.X i
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let η := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit
    U X.ringCatSheaf).symm
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType
      (p := q) i
  let H := (q.generators i).map F η
  letI : H.IsFiniteType := by
    dsimp only [H]
    infer_instance
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M
  let e : F.obj (M.over U) ≅ N :=
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let K := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso e H
  letI : K.IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType H e
  have hN : IsClosed (moduleSheafSupport N) :=
    isClosed_moduleSheafSupport_of_generatingSections N K
  rw [moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor U.ι M] at hN
  exact hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_subsingleton_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_subsingleton_of_isFiniteType
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFiniteType]
    (hη : IsZero (M.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))) :

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_globalTop_hom_unit_topWedge
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_globalTop_hom_unit_topWedge
    (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) [Fintype I] :
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ
proof:
:= op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let F : X.Modules :=
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
    let P₂ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower F.val (Fintype.card I)
    let e₃ := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso
      (exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit X I)
    let w₂ : P₂.obj (op U) := by
      classical
      letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
      exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval (op U))
    (e₃.hom.val.app T).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₂).app (op U)).hom w₂) =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) := by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  dsimp only
  exact exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit_hom_unit_topWedge X I (op U)

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_factor
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_factor
    (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) [Fintype I] :
    let F : X.Modules
proof:
:=
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
    let e₁ := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
      (freeOverIso X U I) (Fintype.card I)
    let e₂ := exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U F (Fintype.card I)
    let e₃ := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso
      (exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit X I)
    (exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit X U I).hom =
      e₁.hom ≫ e₂.hom ≫ e₃.hom ≫ (freeOverIso X U PUnit).inv := by
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_unit_topWedge_eq_freeOver_inv
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_unit_topWedge_eq_freeOver_inv
    [IsIntegral X] (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) [Fintype I] :
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ
proof:
:= op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I))
      (Fintype.card I)
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    let topFrame := exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit X U I
    let w₀ : P₀.obj T := by
      classical
      letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
      exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T)
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map topFrame.hom)
        (((adj.unit.app P₀).app T).hom w₀) =
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map
        (freeOverIso X U PUnit).inv)
          ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) := by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  dsimp only
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let F : X.Modules :=
    SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I))
    (Fintype.card I)
  let P₂ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower F.val (Fintype.card I)
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let topFrame := exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit X U I
  let e₁ := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
    (freeOverIso X U I) (Fintype.card I)
  let e₂ := exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U F (Fintype.card I)
  let e₃ := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso
    (exteriorPowerSheafFreeIsoFreePUnit X I)
  let w₀ : P₀.obj T := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T)
  let w₂ : P₂.obj (op U) := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval (op U))
  have h₁₂ := exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_unit_topWedge X U I
  dsimp only at h₁₂
  have h₃ := exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_globalTop_hom_unit_topWedge X U I
  dsimp only at h₃
  have hfactor := exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_factor X U I
  dsimp only at hfactor
  rw [hfactor]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change
    ((freeOverIso X U PUnit).inv.val.app T).hom
        ((e₃.hom.val.app T).hom
          (((e₁.hom ≫ e₂.hom).val.app T).hom
            (((adj.unit.app P₀).app T).hom w₀))) =
      ((freeOverIso X U PUnit).inv.val.app T).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)))
  rw [h₁₂, h₃]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkBasisToGenericBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stalkBasisToGenericBasis_apply
    (F : X.Modules) (x : X) (n : ℕ)
    [Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F)]
    (c : Module.Basis (Fin n) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X F x))
    (hdim : genericRank X F = n) (i : Fin n) :
    stalkBasisToGenericBasis X F x n c hinj hdim i =
      (stalkToGeneric X F x).hom (c i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [stalkBasisToGenericBasis, stalkToGenericLinearMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkBasisToGenericBasis_repr_stalkToGeneric
statement:
theorem stalkBasisToGenericBasis_repr_stalkToGeneric
    (F : X.Modules) (x : X) (n : ℕ)
    [Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F)]
    (c : Module.Basis (Fin n) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X F x))
    (hdim : genericRank X F = n)
    (m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) (i : Fin n) :
    (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X F x n c hinj hdim).repr
        ((stalkToGeneric X F x).hom m) i =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField (c.repr m i)
proof:
:= by
  let f := stalkToGenericLinearMap X F x
  let b := stalkBasisToGenericBasis X F x n c hinj hdim
  have hm : ∑ j, (c.repr m j) • c j = m := c.sum_repr m
  change b.repr (f m) i = _
  rw [← hm, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul]
  change b.repr (∑ j, algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
      (c.repr m j) • f (c j)) i = _
  have hfb (j : Fin n) : f (c j) = b j := by
    exact (stalkBasisToGenericBasis_apply X F x n c hinj hdim j).symm
  simp_rw [hfb]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  classical
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

statement:

        ((stalkToGeneric X F x).hom m) =

        (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map q) m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkBasisToGenericBasis_det_map
statement:
theorem stalkBasisToGenericBasis_det_map
    {F G : X.Modules} (x : X) (n : ℕ) (q : F ⟶ G)
    [Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F)]
    [Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj G)]
    (cF : Module.Basis (Fin n) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F))
    (cG : Module.Basis (Fin n) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj G))
    (hinjF : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X F x))
    (hinjG : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X G x))
    (hdimF : genericRank X F = n) (hdimG : genericRank X G = n) :
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
        (cG.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map q) ∘ cF)) =
      (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X G x n cG hinjG hdimG).det
        (((genericStalkFunctor X).map q) ∘
          stalkBasisToGenericBasis X F x n cF hinjF hdimF)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.Basis.det_apply, Module.Basis.det_apply, RingHom.map_det]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
    Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply]
  rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [stalkBasisToGenericBasis_apply]
  rw [stalkToGenericLinearMap_naturality]
  exact (stalkBasisToGenericBasis_repr_stalkToGeneric
    X G x n cG hinjG hdimG _ i).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkToGeneric_injective_of_map
statement:
theorem stalkToGeneric_injective_of_map
    {F G : X.Modules} (x : X) (q : F ⟶ G)
    (hinjQ : Function.Injective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map q))
    (hinjG : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X G x)) :
    Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X F x)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply hinjQ
  apply hinjG
  rw [← stalkToGenericLinearMap_naturality X x q a,
    ← stalkToGenericLinearMap_naturality X x q b]
  exact congrArg ((genericStalkFunctor X).map q) hab

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_common_coordinates
statement:
theorem genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_common_coordinates
    (M N : X.Modules) (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (hN : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (bP : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)))
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M))
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj N)) :
    (genericCommonLatticeDeterminantRationalTrivialization X M N e hN bM).equiv
        (bM.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
          (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ bP)) =
      SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X N hN
        ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).inv
          (bN.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ bP)))
proof:
:= by
  change SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X N hN
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map
        ((asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e))).inv ≫
          (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e))).hom)
        (genericRank X N)
        ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv
          (bM.det (((genericStalkFunctor X).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ bP)))) = _
  exact congrArg (SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X N hN)
    (genericCommonLattice_topExterior_common_coordinates X M N e bP bM bN)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_stalkToGeneric
statement:
theorem determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_stalkToGeneric
    (N : X.Modules) (q : N.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) {x : X} (hxi : x ∈ q.X i)
    (j : Fin (genericRank X N)) :
    (stalkToGeneric X N x).hom
        (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis X N q i hxi j) =
      determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis X N q i
        (((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open
          (q.X i).isOpen hxi) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let U := q.X i
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eOver : F.over U ≅ N.over U :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let hηi : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
  let a : I := determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X N q i hxi j
  have ha : a = determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X N q i hηi j := by
    rfl
  rw [determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_apply,
    determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_apply]
  dsimp only [determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkVector]
  rw [← ha]
  let v : I → X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.presheaf.stalk x) a 1
  change (stalkToGeneric X N x).hom
      (stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) N U x hxi I eOver
        ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm v)) =
    stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) N U (genericPoint X) hηi I eOver
      ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)).symm
        (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) a 1))
  rw [← stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_stalkToGeneric
    (X := X) N U x hxi I eOver]
  congr 1
  apply (freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I).injective
  calc
    freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I
        (stalkToGeneric X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x
          ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm v)) =
      (freeGenericStalkPiLocalLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).toLinearMap
        (stalkToGenericLinear F x
          ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm.toLinearMap v)) := by
      rfl
    _ = fractionPiLinearMap (X := X) I x v := by
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun
        (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_stalkToGenericLinear (X := X) I x) v
    _ = Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) a 1 := by
      funext k
      by_cases hak : a = k
      · subst k
        simp [v, fractionPiLinearMap]
      · simp [v, fractionPiLinearMap, Pi.single, hak, Ne.symm hak]
    _ = freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I
        ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)).symm
          (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) a 1)) := by
      change _ = freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I
        ((freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I).symm
          (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) a 1))
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ cP))) =

        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
          (cN.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ cP)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hleftBaseChange, hrightBaseChange]
  exact genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_hcommon_of_frame
    X M N e hN d bP bM bN hframe

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_specialized
statement:
theorem genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_specialized
    (M N : X.Modules) (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)

    (cM : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)

    (hinjP : Function.Injective
      (stalkToGeneric X (genericCommonLattice X M N e) x))
    (hinjM : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X M x))
    (hinjN : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X N x))
    (hdimP : genericRank X (genericCommonLattice X M N e) = genericRank X N)
    (hdimM : genericRank X M = genericRank X N)
    (hframe : d.genericTrivialization =
      (determinantBasisRationalTrivialization X N hN
        (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X N x (genericRank X N) cN hinjN rfl)).equiv) :
    (genericCommonLatticeDeterminantRationalTrivialization X M N e hN
      (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X M x (genericRank X N) cM hinjM hdimM)).equiv
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
          (cM.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map

      d.genericTrivialization

proof:

  apply genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon X M N e hN d
    (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X (genericCommonLattice X M N e) x
      (genericRank X N) cP hinjP hdimP)
    (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X M x (genericRank X N) cM hinjM hdimM)
    (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X N x (genericRank X N) cN hinjN rfl)
    cP cM cN hframe
  · exact stalkBasisToGenericBasis_det_map X x (genericRank X N)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_of_stalkBases
statement:
theorem genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_of_stalkBases
    (M N : X.Modules) (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hN : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    {x : X}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X (SchemeKTheory.determinant X N) x)
    (cP : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)))
    (cM : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (cN : Module.Basis (Fin (genericRank X N)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hinjRight : Function.Injective
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
        (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)))
    (hframe : d.genericTrivialization =
      (determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization X N hN x cN).equiv) :
    (genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization
      X M N e hM hN x cM).equiv
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
          (cM.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)) ∘ cP))) =
      d.genericTrivialization
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
          (cN.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
            (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)) ∘ cP)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M := hM
  letI : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N := hN
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M) :=
    genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj N) :=
    genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X N hN
  let ePN := (asIso ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
    (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e))).toLinearEquiv
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)) := by
    exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff ePN).mpr
      (genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X N hN)
  have hinjM : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X M x) :=
    IsGenericallyTorsionFree.stalkToGeneric_injective x
  have hinjN : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X N x) :=
    IsGenericallyTorsionFree.stalkToGeneric_injective x
  have hinjP : Function.Injective
      (stalkToGeneric X (genericCommonLattice X M N e) x) :=
    stalkToGeneric_injective_of_map X x
      (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e) hinjRight hinjN
  have hdimP : genericRank X (genericCommonLattice X M N e) =
      genericRank X N := by
    change Module.finrank X.functionField
        ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (genericCommonLattice X M N e)) =
      Module.finrank X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj N)
    exact LinearEquiv.finrank_eq ePN
  have hdimM : genericRank X M = genericRank X N := by
    change Module.finrank X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M) =
      Module.finrank X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj N)
    exact LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (genericCommonLatticeGenericIso X M N e).toLinearEquiv
  have hframe' : d.genericTrivialization =
      (determinantBasisRationalTrivialization X N hN
        (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X N x (genericRank X N) cN hinjN rfl)).equiv := by
    simpa [determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization] using hframe
  have h := genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_specialized
    X M N e hN d cP cM cN hinjP hinjM hinjN hdimP hdimM hframe'
  simpa [genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization] using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeStalkBasis_stalkToGeneric
statement:
theorem freeStalkBasis_stalkToGeneric (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (x : X) (i : I) :
    (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x).hom
        (freeStalkBasis X I x i) =
      freeGenericStalkBasis X I i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [freeStalkBasis_apply, freeGenericStalkBasis_apply]
  apply (freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  let v : I → X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    Pi.single (M := fun _ : I => X.presheaf.stalk x) i 1
  calc
    freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I
        ((stalkToGeneric X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x).hom
            ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm v)) =
      (freeGenericStalkPiLocalLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).toLinearMap
          (stalkToGenericLinear
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x
              ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm.toLinearMap v)) := by
        rfl
    _ = fractionPiLinearMap (X := X) I x v := by
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun
        (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_stalkToGenericLinear (X := X) I x) v
    _ = Pi.single (M := fun _ : I => X.functionField) i 1 := by
      funext j
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        simp [v, fractionPiLinearMap]
      · simp [v, fractionPiLinearMap, Pi.single, hij, Ne.symm hij]
