name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkToGeneric_smul
statement:
theorem stalkToGeneric_smul (F : X.Modules) (x : X)
    (r : X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (m : F.presheaf.stalk x) :
    stalkToGeneric X F x (r • m) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField r •
        stalkToGeneric X F x m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ur, a, ha⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ X.presheaf) r
  obtain ⟨Um, b, hb⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ F.presheaf) m
  rcases Ur with ⟨⟨U, hxU⟩⟩
  rcases Um with ⟨⟨V, hxV⟩⟩
  let W : X.Opens := U ⊓ V
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
  have hηW : genericPoint X ∈ W :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open W.isOpen hxW
  let iU : W ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let iV : W ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let aW : X.presheaf.obj (op W) :=
    X.presheaf.map iU.op a
  let bW : F.val.obj (op W) := F.presheaf.map iV.op b
  have hr : X.presheaf.germ W x hxW aW = r := by
    change X.presheaf.germ W x hxW
      (X.presheaf.map iU.op a) = r
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply iU x hxW a]
    exact ha
  have hm : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W x hxW bW = m := by
    change TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W x hxW
      (F.presheaf.map iV.op b) = m
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply F.presheaf iV x hxW b]
    exact hb
  have hlocal :
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W x hxW
          ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) =
        X.presheaf.germ W x hxW aW •
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W x hxW bW := by
    exact PresheafOfModules.germ_smul F.val x W hxW aW bW
  have hinput : r • m =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W x hxW
        ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) := by
    rw [← hr, ← hm]
    exact hlocal.symm
  rw [hinput]
  have hspecR := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes X.presheaf hxW
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)) aW
  have hspecM := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes F.presheaf hxW
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)) bW
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hspecR hspecM
  have hspecSMul := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes F.presheaf hxW
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial))
    ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hspecSMul
  change F.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W x hxW
          ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW)) =
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField r •
      F.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
        ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial) m
  rw [hspecSMul]
  have hgeneric :
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W (genericPoint X) hηW
          ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) =
        X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW aW •
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf W (genericPoint X) hηW bW := by
    exact PresheafOfModules.germ_smul F.val (genericPoint X) W hηW aW bW
  rw [hgeneric]
  rw [← hspecR, ← hspecM, hr, hm]
  simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.unitStalkLinearEquiv_stalkToGeneric
statement:
theorem unitStalkLinearEquiv_stalkToGeneric (x : X)
    (m : ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) :
    PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)
        (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x m) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
        (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf m
  have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxU
  have hs := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf hxU
        ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)) s
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hs
  rw [show stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hxU s) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U
          (genericPoint X) hηU s from hs]
  rw [PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ,
    PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ]
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  exact (Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hxU s).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.unit_stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem unit_stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule (x : X) :
    IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (stalkToGenericLinear
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x)
proof:
:= by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let S := nonZeroDivisors A
  let G : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
  let f := stalkToGenericLinear
    G x
  let eₓ := PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x
  let eηK := PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)
  letI : Module A (G.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) :=
    Module.compHom _ (algebraMap A X.functionField)
  let eη :
      G.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X) →ₗ[A] X.functionField :=
    { toFun := eηK
      map_add' := eηK.map_add
      map_smul' := by
        intro r m
        exact eηK.map_smul (algebraMap A X.functionField r) m }
  have hcoord : eη ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ eₓ.symm.toLinearMap =
      Algebra.linearMap A X.functionField := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro r
    change eηK (stalkToGeneric X
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x (eₓ.symm r)) =
        algebraMap A X.functionField r
    rw [unitStalkLinearEquiv_stalkToGeneric]
    simp only [eₓ, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hcoordLoc : IsLocalizedModule S
      (eη ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ eₓ.symm.toLinearMap) := by
    rw [hcoord]
    infer_instance
  have heηf : IsLocalizedModule S (eη ∘ₗ f) :=
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_right S
      eₓ.symm.toLinearMap eₓ.symm.bijective).mp hcoordLoc
  exact (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left S
    eη (by
      constructor
      · exact eηK.injective
      · exact eηK.surjective)).mp heηf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree
statement:
theorem freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (x : X) (i : I)
    (m : ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) :
    freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) m) =
      Pi.single (M := fun _ => X.presheaf.stalk x) i
      (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
  let A : I → X.Modules := fun _ => U
  let Fₓ := moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x
  let catE₁ := PreservesCoproduct.iso (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x)
    (fun _ : I => SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
  let e₁ := freeStalkCoproductLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
  let e₂ := freeStalkCoproductDirectSumLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
  let e₃ := freeStalkDirectSumPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
  let e₄ := freeStalkUnitPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
  have h₁ : Fₓ.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) ≫ catE₁.hom =
      Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j)) i := by
    apply (cancel_mono catE₁.inv).1
    calc
      (Fₓ.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) ≫ catE₁.hom) ≫ catE₁.inv =
          Fₓ.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) := by simp
      _ = Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j)) i ≫ catE₁.inv := by
        rw [show catE₁.inv = sigmaComparison Fₓ A by rfl]
        exact (Limits.ι_comp_sigmaComparison Fₓ A i).symm
  have h₁m := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₁ m
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h₁m
  have hrest := congrArg (fun z => e₄ (e₃ (e₂ z))) h₁m
  have h₂ := ModuleCat.ι_coprodIsoDirectSum_hom
    (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j)) i
  have h₂m := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₂ m
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h₂m
  change (ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j))).toLinearEquiv
      (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j)) i m) =
    DirectSum.lof (X.presheaf.stalk x) I
      (fun j => ↑(Fₓ.obj (A j))) i m at h₂m
  have h₂m' :
      e₂ (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j)) i m) =
        DirectSum.lof (X.presheaf.stalk x) I
          (fun j => ↑(Fₓ.obj (A j))) i m := by
    simpa only [e₂, freeStalkCoproductDirectSumLinearEquiv, Fₓ, A, U] using h₂m
  have hcoord :
      e₄ (e₃ (e₂ (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun j => Fₓ.obj (A j)) i m))) =
        Pi.single (M := fun _ => X.presheaf.stalk x) i
          (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x m) := by
    rw [h₂m']
    rw [DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype_lof]
    ext j
    change (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x)
      ((Pi.single (M := fun _ => ↑(Fₓ.obj (A i))) i m) j) =
        (Pi.single (M := fun _ => X.presheaf.stalk x) i
          (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x m)) j
    by_cases hji : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [Pi.single, Ne.symm hji]
  rw [show SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i =
    Limits.Sigma.ι A i by rfl]
  calc
    freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
        (Fₓ.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) m) =
      e₄ (e₃ (e₂ (e₁ (Fₓ.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) m)))) := by
        rfl
    _ = _ := hrest.trans hcoord

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_symm_single
statement:
theorem freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_symm_single (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (x : X) (i : I) (r : X.presheaf.stalk x) :
    (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm
        (Pi.single (M := fun _ => X.presheaf.stalk x) i r) =
      (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)
          ((PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x).symm r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree
statement:
theorem freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I]
    (i : I)
    (m : ↑((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) :
    freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I
        ((genericStalkFunctor X).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) m) =
      Pi.single (M := fun _ => X.functionField) i
        (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X) m)
proof:
:= by
  change freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (genericPoint X)).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) m) = _
  exact freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree (X := X) I (genericPoint X) i m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_stalkToGenericLinear
statement:
theorem freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_stalkToGenericLinear (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I]
    (x : X) :
    (freeGenericStalkPiLocalLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        stalkToGenericLinear
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x ∘ₗ
      (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x).symm.toLinearMap =
        fractionPiLinearMap (X := X) I x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' v]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_symm_single]
  change freeGenericStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I
      (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)
          ((PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x).symm 1))) i = _
  have hnat := (stalkToGenericNat (X := X) x).naturality
    (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)
  have happ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hnat
    ((PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x).symm 1)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at happ
  change stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)
        ((PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x).symm 1)) =
    (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (genericPoint X)).map
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)
      (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x
        ((PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x).symm 1)) at happ
  rw [happ]
  change freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (genericPoint X)).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)
        (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x
          ((PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x).symm 1))) i = _
  rw [freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_map_ιFree,
    unitStalkLinearEquiv_stalkToGeneric]
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst i
    simp [fractionPiLinearMap]
  · simp [fractionPiLinearMap, Pi.single, Ne.symm hji]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.free_stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem free_stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (x : X) :
    IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (stalkToGenericLinear
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let S := nonZeroDivisors A
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let f := stalkToGenericLinear F x
  let eₓ := freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
  let eη := freeGenericStalkPiLocalLinearEquiv (X := X) I x
  have hcoord : eη.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ eₓ.symm.toLinearMap =
      fractionPiLinearMap (X := X) I x := by
    exact freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_stalkToGenericLinear (X := X) I x
  have hpi : IsLocalizedModule S (fractionPiLinearMap (X := X) I x) := by
    change IsLocalizedModule S
      (LinearMap.pi fun i =>
        (Algebra.linearMap A X.functionField).comp (LinearMap.proj i))
    infer_instance
  have hcoordLoc : IsLocalizedModule S
      (eη.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ eₓ.symm.toLinearMap) := by
    rw [hcoord]
    exact hpi
  have heηf : IsLocalizedModule S (eη.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f) :=
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_right S
      eₓ.symm.toLinearMap eₓ.symm.bijective).mp hcoordLoc
  exact (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left S
    eη.toLinearMap eη.bijective).mp heηf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_stalkToGeneric
statement:
theorem stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_stalkToGeneric (M : X.Modules)
    (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (I : Type u)
    (eOver : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U ≅ M.over U)
    (m : ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I))) :
    stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) M U (genericPoint X)
        (((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxU) I eOver
        (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x m) =
      stalkToGeneric X M x
        (stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) M U x hxU I eOver m)
proof:
:= by
  let hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxU
  let S : Scheme.{u} := U
  let y : S := ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let z : S := ⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩
  let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app F).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  have hzy : Specializes z y := by
    change Specializes (⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩ : U) (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U)
    rw [subtype_specializes_iff]
    exact (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  let aFy := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app F
  let aFz := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f z).hom.app F
  let aMy := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M
  let aMz := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f z).hom.app M
  let localF :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat y).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat z).obj F :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hzy
  let localM :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat y).obj M ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat z).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hzy
  let globalF :
      (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := X) AddCommGrpCat (f y)).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := X) AddCommGrpCat (f z)).obj F :=
    F.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hzy.map f.continuous)
  let globalM :
      (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := X) AddCommGrpCat (f y)).obj M ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := X) AddCommGrpCat (f z)).obj M :=
    M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hzy.map f.continuous)
  let eY :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat y).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat y).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor S y).mapIso eRestr).hom
  let eZ :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat z).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (X := S) AddCommGrpCat z).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor S z).mapIso eRestr).hom
  have hF : localF ≫ aFz = aFy ≫ globalF := by
    exact restrictStalkNatIso_hom_stalkSpecializes f F hzy
  have hM : localM ≫ aMz = aMy ≫ globalM := by
    exact restrictStalkNatIso_hom_stalkSpecializes f M hzy
  have he : localF ≫ eZ = eY ≫ localM := by
    exact ((stalkSpecializesNat S hzy).naturality eRestr.hom).symm
  have hsquare :
      globalF ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f z).inv.app F ≫ eZ ≫ aMz =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).inv.app F ≫ eY ≫ aMy ≫
          globalM := by
    apply (cancel_epi aFy).1
    simp only [← Category.assoc]
    rw [← hF]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    dsimp only [aFz, aFy]
    simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc, he, Category.assoc, hM]
  have happ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hsquare m
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at happ
  change stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) M U (genericPoint X) hηU I eOver
      (stalkToGeneric X F x m) =
    stalkToGeneric X M x
      (stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) M U x hxU I eOver m) at happ
  exact happ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) (x : X) :
    IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (stalkToGenericLinear M x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let U := q.X i
  have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eOver : F.over U ≅ M.over U :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let S := nonZeroDivisors A
  let fF := stalkToGenericLinear F x
  let fM := stalkToGenericLinear M x
  let eₓ := stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) M U x hxi I eOver
  let eηK := stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso (X := X) M U (genericPoint X) hηU I eOver
  let eη :
      ↑((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F) ≃ₗ[A]
        ↑((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M) :=
    { toFun := eηK
      invFun := eηK.symm
      left_inv := eηK.left_inv
      right_inv := eηK.right_inv
      map_add' := eηK.map_add
      map_smul' := by
        intro r m
        exact eηK.map_smul (algebraMap A X.functionField r) m }
  have hfull : eη.toLinearMap ∘ₗ fF ∘ₗ eₓ.symm.toLinearMap = fM := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    calc
      eη (fF (eₓ.symm m)) = fM (eₓ (eₓ.symm m)) :=
        stalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_stalkToGeneric
          (X := X) M U x hxi I eOver (eₓ.symm m)
      _ = fM m := by rw [eₓ.apply_symm_apply]
  have hfree : IsLocalizedModule S fF := by
    exact free_stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule (X := X) I x
  have hleft : IsLocalizedModule S (eη.toLinearMap ∘ₗ fF) :=
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left S
      eη.toLinearMap eη.bijective).mpr hfree
  have hboth : IsLocalizedModule S
      (eη.toLinearMap ∘ₗ fF ∘ₗ eₓ.symm.toLinearMap) :=
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_right S
      eₓ.symm.toLinearMap eₓ.symm.bijective).mpr hleft
  rw [hfull] at hboth
  exact hboth

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkSheaf_germ_stalkIsoAt_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem genericStalkSheaf_germ_stalkIsoAt_hom (F : X.Modules) (x : X)
    (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ (genericStalkSheaf X F).presheaf U x hxU ≫
        (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom =
      Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology
        (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U =>
          AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
        ⟨⟨((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxU⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  let A := AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))
  let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
    (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  change colimit.ι ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).skyscraperPresheaf A)
        (op ⟨U, hxU⟩) ≫
      (colimit.isoColimitCocone ⟨
        pointSkyscraperStalkCoconeOfSpecializes (genericPoint X) x hspec A,
        pointSkyscraperStalkCoconeIsColimitOfSpecializes
          (genericPoint X) x hspec A⟩).hom = _
  exact colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_hom _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericSkyscraper_eval_smul
statement:
theorem genericSkyscraper_eval_smul
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) M]
    {U : X.Opensᵒᵖ}
    (y : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj (unop U))
    (a : ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U))
    (t : ↑((skyscraperSheafOfModules (genericPoint X)
      X.ringCatSheaf M).val.obj U)) :
    (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of M) y).hom (a • t) =
      (X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ (unop U) (genericPoint X) y.down.down).hom a •
        (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of M) y).hom t
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)
  letI : Module ↑(Φ.presheafFiber.obj X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf) M :=
    pointSheafFiberModule (genericPoint X) X.ringCatSheaf M
  have h₁ :
      (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) => AddCommGrpCat.of M) y).hom (a • t) =
        (Φ.toPresheafFiber (unop U) y X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf).hom a •
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) => AddCommGrpCat.of M) y).hom t := by
    refine (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (GrothendieckTopology.Point.skyscraperSMul_π Φ
        X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf (ModuleCat.of _ M) U a y) t).trans ?_
    exact GrothendieckTopology.Point.skyscraperSMulComponent_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  rw [h₁]
  have hfibsmul : ∀ (q : ↑(Φ.presheafFiber.obj X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf)) (z : M),
      q • z = (pointPresheafFiberToStalk (genericPoint X) X.ringCatSheaf).hom q • z :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [hfibsmul]
  have hfib :
      (pointPresheafFiberToStalk (genericPoint X) X.ringCatSheaf).hom
          ((Φ.toPresheafFiber (unop U) y X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf).hom a) =
        (X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ (unop U)
          (genericPoint X) y.down.down).hom a :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (toPresheafFiber_pointPresheafFiberToStalk (genericPoint X)
        X.ringCatSheaf (unop U) y.down.down) a
  rw [hfib]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt_hom_smul
statement:
theorem genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt_hom_smul (F : X.Modules) (x : X)
    (r : X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (m : (genericStalkSheaf X F).presheaf.stalk x) :
    (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom (r • m) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField r •
        (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom m
proof:
:= by
  let G := genericStalkSheaf X F
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)
  let K := TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)
  obtain ⟨Ur, a, ha⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ X.presheaf) r
  obtain ⟨Um, b, hb⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ G.presheaf) m
  rcases Ur with ⟨⟨U, hxU⟩⟩
  rcases Um with ⟨⟨V, hxV⟩⟩
  let W : X.Opens := U ⊓ V
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
  have hηW : genericPoint X ∈ W :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open W.isOpen hxW
  let iU : W ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let iV : W ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let aW : X.presheaf.obj (op W) := X.presheaf.map iU.op a
  let bW : G.val.obj (op W) := G.presheaf.map iV.op b
  have hr : X.presheaf.germ W x hxW aW = r := by
    change X.presheaf.germ W x hxW (X.presheaf.map iU.op a) = r
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply iU x hxW a]
    exact ha
  have hm : TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf W x hxW bW = m := by
    change TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf W x hxW
      (G.presheaf.map iV.op b) = m
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply G.presheaf iV x hxW b]
    exact hb
  have hlocal :
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf W x hxW
          ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) =
        X.presheaf.germ W x hxW aW •
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf W x hxW bW := by
    exact PresheafOfModules.germ_smul G.val x W hxW aW bW
  have hinput : r • m =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf W x hxW
        ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) := by
    rw [← hr, ← hm]
    exact hlocal.symm
  let y : Φ.fiber.obj W := ⟨⟨hηW⟩⟩
  have hevalSmul := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (genericStalkSheaf_germ_stalkIsoAt_hom (X := X) F x W hxW)
      ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW)
  have hevalB := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (genericStalkSheaf_germ_stalkIsoAt_hom (X := X) F x W hxW) bW
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hevalSmul hevalB
  have hcoord :
      (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom
          ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) =
        (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW).hom aW •
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom bW := by
    have hs := genericSkyscraper_eval_smul (X := X)
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)) y aW bW
    calc
      _ = (X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW).hom aW •
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom bW := hs
      _ = (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW).hom aW •
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom bW := by
        rw [ringCatStalk_smul_eq_functionField_smul X F,
          ringCatStalkToFunctionField_germ]
  have hscalar :
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField r =
        (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW).hom aW := by
    have hspecR := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes X.presheaf hxW
        ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)) aW
    rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hspecR
    rw [← hr]
    simpa [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hspecR
  have hevalB' :
      (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom bW =
        (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom m := by
    rw [← hm]
    exact hevalB.symm
  calc
    (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom (r • m) =
        (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf W x hxW
            ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW)) :=
      congrArg _ hinput
    _ = (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom
          ((show ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W)) from aW) • bW) := hevalSmul
    _ = (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW).hom aW •
        (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj W => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑K) y).hom bW := hcoord
    _ = algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField r •
        (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom m := by
      rw [hscalar, hevalB']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toGenericStalkSheafStalkAt_iso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem toGenericStalkSheafStalkAt_iso_hom (F : X.Modules) (x : X) :
    toGenericStalkSheafStalkAt (X := X) F x ≫
      (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom =
      stalkToGeneric X F x
proof:
:= by
  let G := genericStalkSheaf X F
  let A := AddCommGrpCat.of ↑(F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))
  let g := ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
    (toGenericStalkSheaf X F)).hom
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro U hxU
  let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
    (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  let hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U := hspec.mem_open U.isOpen hxU
  let y : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U :=
    ⟨⟨hηU⟩⟩
  have hmap := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ U x hxU g
  have hmap' : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U x hxU ≫
      toGenericStalkSheafStalkAt (X := X) F x =
        g.app (op U) ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf U x hxU := hmap
  have htarget : TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf U x hxU ≫
      (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom =
        Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology
          (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U => A) y := by
    change colimit.ι ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙
        (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).skyscraperPresheaf A)
          (op ⟨U, hxU⟩) ≫
        (colimit.isoColimitCocone ⟨
          pointSkyscraperStalkCoconeOfSpecializes (genericPoint X) x hspec A,
          pointSkyscraperStalkCoconeIsColimitOfSpecializes
            (genericPoint X) x hspec A⟩).hom = _
    exact colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_hom _ _
  have heval : g.app (op U) ≫
      Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology
        (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U => A) y =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU := by
    ext s
    exact toGenericStalkSheaf_eval X F y s
  have hspecGerm : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U x hxU ≫
      stalkToGeneric X F x =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU := by
    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes F.presheaf hxU hspec
  calc
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U x hxU ≫
        (toGenericStalkSheafStalkAt (X := X) F x ≫
          (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom) =
      (g.app (op U) ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf U x hxU) ≫
        (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, hmap']
    _ = g.app (op U) ≫
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf U x hxU ≫
          (genericStalkSheafStalkIsoAt (X := X) F x).hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = g.app (op U) ≫
        Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology
          (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U => A) y := by rw [htarget]
    _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU := heval
    _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.presheaf U x hxU ≫
        stalkToGeneric X F x := hspecGerm.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkSheafStalkLinearEquivAt_comp_toGeneric
statement:
theorem genericStalkSheafStalkLinearEquivAt_comp_toGeneric
    (F : X.Modules) (x : X) :
    (genericStalkSheafStalkLinearEquivAt (X := X) F x).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt (X := X) F x =
      stalkToGenericLinear (X := X) F x
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (toGenericStalkSheafStalkAt_iso_hom (X := X) F x) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt_isLocalizedModule
    (F : X.Modules) (x : X)
    (hF : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X F) :
    IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt (X := X) F x)
proof:
:= by
  let S := nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x)
  let eF := genericStalkSheafStalkLinearEquivAt (X := X) F x
  have hcomp : IsLocalizedModule S
      (eF.toLinearMap ∘ₗ toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt (X := X) F x) := by
    rw [genericStalkSheafStalkLinearEquivAt_comp_toGeneric]
    exact stalkToGenericLinear_isLocalizedModule_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
      (X := X) F hF x
  exact (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left S
    eF.toLinearMap eF.bijective).mp hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pullback_fst_cokernel_stalk_isTorsion_of_right_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem pullback_fst_cokernel_stalk_isTorsion_of_right_isLocalizedModule
    {A B G : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ G) (b : B ⟶ G) (x : X)
    (hb : IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map b).hom) :
    Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (cokernel (pullback.fst a b)))
proof:
:= by
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let S := nonZeroDivisors R
  let F := moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x
  let aₓ := F.map a
  let bₓ := F.map b
  let f := F.map (pullback.fst a b)
  let eQ := moduleStalkCokernelIsoRangeQuotient X x (pullback.fst a b)
  intro q
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LinearMap.range f.hom).mkQ_surjective (eQ.hom q)
  obtain ⟨⟨n, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S bₓ.hom (aₓ.hom m)
  let ℓA : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ F.obj A :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R _ ((s : R) • m))
  let ℓB : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ F.obj B :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R _ n)
  have hcompat : ℓA ≫ aₓ = ℓB ≫ bₓ := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro t
    change aₓ.hom (t • ((s : R) • m)) = bₓ.hom (t • n)
    calc
      aₓ.hom (t • ((s : R) • m)) =
          t • ((s : R) • aₓ.hom m) := by rw [map_smul, map_smul]
      _ = t • bₓ.hom n := congrArg (fun z => t • z) hs
      _ = bₓ.hom (t • n) := (map_smul bₓ.hom t n).symm
  let ℓP : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ pullback aₓ bₓ :=
    pullback.lift ℓA ℓB hcompat
  let eP := PreservesPullback.iso (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x) a b
  let z : F.obj (pullback a b) := eP.inv (ℓP (1 : R))
  have hz : f.hom z = (s : R) • m := by
    have hcompare := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (PreservesPullback.iso_inv_fst (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x) a b) (ℓP (1 : R))
    rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcompare
    have hlift := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (pullback.lift_fst ℓA ℓB hcompat) (1 : R)
    change f.hom z = (s : R) • m
    calc
      f.hom z = (pullback.fst aₓ bₓ).hom (ℓP (1 : R)) := by
        simpa only [F, f, aₓ, bₓ, eP, z] using hcompare
      _ = ℓA.hom (1 : R) := hlift
      _ = (s : R) • m := by
        change (1 : R) • ((s : R) • m) = (s : R) • m
        rw [one_smul]
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  change (s : R) • q = 0
  apply eQ.toLinearEquiv.injective
  rw [map_smul, map_zero]
  change (s : R) • eQ.hom q = 0
  rw [← hm]
  change (LinearMap.range f.hom).mkQ ((s : R) • m) = 0
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk ((s : R) • m) = 0
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pullback_snd_cokernel_stalk_isTorsion_of_left_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem pullback_snd_cokernel_stalk_isTorsion_of_left_isLocalizedModule
    {A B G : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ G) (b : B ⟶ G) (x : X)
    (ha : IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map a).hom) :
    Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (cokernel (pullback.snd a b)))
proof:
:= by
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let S := nonZeroDivisors R
  let F := moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x
  let aₓ := F.map a
  let bₓ := F.map b
  let f := F.map (pullback.snd a b)
  let eQ := moduleStalkCokernelIsoRangeQuotient X x (pullback.snd a b)
  intro q
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (LinearMap.range f.hom).mkQ_surjective (eQ.hom q)
  obtain ⟨⟨m, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S aₓ.hom (bₓ.hom n)
  let ℓA : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ F.obj A :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R _ m)
  let ℓB : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ F.obj B :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R _ ((s : R) • n))
  have hcompat : ℓA ≫ aₓ = ℓB ≫ bₓ := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro t
    change aₓ.hom (t • m) = bₓ.hom (t • ((s : R) • n))
    calc
      aₓ.hom (t • m) = t • aₓ.hom m := map_smul aₓ.hom t m
      _ = t • ((s : R) • bₓ.hom n) := congrArg (fun z => t • z) hs.symm
      _ = bₓ.hom (t • ((s : R) • n)) := by rw [map_smul, map_smul]
  let ℓP : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ pullback aₓ bₓ :=
    pullback.lift ℓA ℓB hcompat
  let eP := PreservesPullback.iso (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x) a b
  let z : F.obj (pullback a b) := eP.inv (ℓP (1 : R))
  have hz : f.hom z = (s : R) • n := by
    have hcompare := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (PreservesPullback.iso_inv_snd (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x) a b) (ℓP (1 : R))
    rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcompare
    have hlift := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (pullback.lift_snd ℓA ℓB hcompat) (1 : R)
    change f.hom z = (s : R) • n
    calc
      f.hom z = (pullback.snd aₓ bₓ).hom (ℓP (1 : R)) := by
        simpa only [F, f, aₓ, bₓ, eP, z] using hcompare
      _ = ℓB.hom (1 : R) := hlift
      _ = (s : R) • n := by
        change (1 : R) • ((s : R) • n) = (s : R) • n
        rw [one_smul]
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  change (s : R) • q = 0
  apply eQ.toLinearEquiv.injective
  rw [map_smul, map_zero]
  change (s : R) • eQ.hom q = 0
  rw [← hn]
  change (LinearMap.range f.hom).mkQ ((s : R) • n) = 0
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk ((s : R) • n) = 0
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeLeftQuotient_stalk_isTorsion
statement:
theorem genericCommonLatticeLeftQuotient_stalk_isTorsion
    (M N : X.Modules)
    (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (hN : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N) (x : X) :
    Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (cokernel (genericCommonLatticeToLeft X M N e)))
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback_fst_cokernel_stalk_isTorsion_of_right_isLocalizedModule
    (X := X) (toCommonGenericStalkSheafLeft X M N e)
      (toCommonGenericStalkSheafRight X N) x
  dsimp only [toCommonGenericStalkSheafRight]
  exact toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt_isLocalizedModule N x hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeRightQuotient_stalk_isTorsion
statement:
theorem genericCommonLatticeRightQuotient_stalk_isTorsion
    (M N : X.Modules)
    (e : genericStalkSheaf X M ≅ genericStalkSheaf X N)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) (x : X) :
    Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (cokernel (genericCommonLatticeToRight X M N e)))
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback_snd_cokernel_stalk_isTorsion_of_left_isLocalizedModule
    (X := X) (toCommonGenericStalkSheafLeft X M N e)
      (toCommonGenericStalkSheafRight X N) x
  let S := nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x)
  let cM := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (toGenericStalkSheaf X M)
  let eₓ := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map e.hom
  have hc : IsLocalizedModule S cM.hom :=
    toGenericStalkSheafStalkLinearAt_isLocalizedModule M x hM
  have heₓ : Function.Bijective eₓ.hom := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso eₓ
  have hcomp : IsLocalizedModule S (eₓ.hom ∘ₗ cM.hom) :=
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left S eₓ.hom heₓ).mpr hc
  simpa only [toCommonGenericStalkSheafLeft, Functor.map_comp,
    ModuleCat.hom_comp] using hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.freePUnitGenericTrivialization_algebraMap
statement:
theorem freePUnitGenericTrivialization_algebraMap (V : X.Opens)
    [Nonempty V] (a : X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V)) :
    freePUnitGenericTrivialization X
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V)) X.functionField a) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.presheaf V
        (genericPoint X)
        (((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr
          (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty V)))
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (Opposite.op V) a)
proof:
:= by
  let hηV : genericPoint X ∈ V :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty V))
  let u := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
  have hunit :
      (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)).symm
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V)) X.functionField a) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf V
          (genericPoint X) hηV a := by
    apply (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)).injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ]
    rfl
  unfold freePUnitGenericTrivialization
  rw [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, hunit]
  change
    ((PresheafOfModules.stalkFunctorLinear
      (R := X.presheaf) (genericPoint X)).map
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).map u.inv))
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf V
          (genericPoint X) hηV a) = _
  change
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat (genericPoint X)).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).map u.inv))).hom
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf V
          (genericPoint X) hηV a) = _
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalk_unit_finite
statement:
theorem moduleStalk_unit_finite :
    Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff
    (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X x)).mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalk_free_finite
statement:
theorem moduleStalk_free_finite (I : Type u) [Finite I] :
    Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free I (R := X.ringCatSheaf)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI (i : I) : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    moduleStalk_unit_finite X x
  change Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
      (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
  apply (Module.Finite.equiv_iff
    (PreservesCoproduct.iso (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x)
      (fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).toLinearEquiv).mpr
  exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff
    (ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum
      (fun _ : I ↦ (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).toLinearEquiv).mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalk_finite_of_generatingSections
statement:
theorem moduleStalk_finite_of_generatingSections
    (M : X.Modules) (G : M.GeneratingSections) [G.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
    dsimp only [F]
    infer_instance
  letI : F.PreservesEpimorphisms := by infer_instance
  letI : Epi (M.freeHomEquiv.symm G.s) := G.epi
  let p : F.obj (SheafOfModules.free G.I (R := X.ringCatSheaf)) ⟶ F.obj M :=
    F.map (M.freeHomEquiv.symm G.s)
  letI : Epi p := by
    change Epi (F.map (M.freeHomEquiv.symm G.s))
    exact @Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _ F (by infer_instance) _ _
      (M.freeHomEquiv.symm G.s) G.epi
  letI : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (F.obj (SheafOfModules.free G.I (R := X.ringCatSheaf))) :=
    moduleStalk_free_finite X x G.I
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective p.hom
    ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective p).mp inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalk_finite_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem moduleStalk_finite_of_isFiniteType
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData M
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hq
  let hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let U : X.Opens := q.X i
  let S : Scheme.{u} := U
  let y : S := ⟨x, hxi⟩
  let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let η := (Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit
    U X.ringCatSheaf).symm
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType
      (p := q) i
  let H := (q.generators i).map F η
  letI : H.IsFiniteType := by
    dsimp only [H]
    infer_instance
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M
  let e : F.obj (M.over U) ≅ N :=
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let K := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso e H
  letI : K.IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType H e
  letI : Module.Finite (S.presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear S y).obj N) :=
    moduleStalk_finite_of_generatingSections S y N K
  letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (S.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    (f.stalkMap y).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear S y).obj N) :=
    Module.compHom _ (f.stalkMap y).hom
  letI : IsScalarTower (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (S.presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear S y).obj N) := by
    constructor
    intro r s n
    change ((f.stalkMap y).hom r * s) • n =
      (f.stalkMap y).hom r • (s • n)
    exact mul_smul _ _ _
  letI : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (S.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    apply Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (Algebra.linearMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (S.presheaf.stalk y))
    exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (f.stalkMap y)).2
  have hN : Module.Finite (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear S y).obj N) :=
    Module.Finite.trans (S.presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear S y).obj N)
  let eStalk :
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear S y).obj N) ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk (f y)]
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (f y)).obj M) := by
    letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y M
    exact Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y M
  exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff eStalk).mp hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.isFiniteLength_of_finite_isTorsion
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_of_finite_isTorsion
    (R M : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] (hM : Module.IsTorsion R M) :
    IsFiniteLength R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, haAnn, haNZ⟩ :=
    Submodule.annihilator_top_inter_nonZeroDivisors hM
  have hkill : Module.IsTorsionBy R M a := by
    intro m
    exact Submodule.mem_annihilator.mp haAnn m Submodule.mem_top
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}
  have hquot : IsFiniteLength R Q :=
    isFiniteLength_quotient_span_singleton R haNZ
  have hArtR : IsArtinian R Q :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hquot).2
  let eQ : Q →ₛₗ[Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})] Q :=
    ⟨.id _, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
  letI : IsArtinianRing Q := by
    rw [IsArtinianRing]
    exact (eQ.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective Function.bijective_id).mp hArtR
  letI : Module Q M := hkill.module
  letI : Module.Finite Q M :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R Q M
  have hkillSet : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M (Ideal.span {a}) := by
    rwa [Module.isTorsionBySet_span_singleton_iff]
  have hArtM : IsArtinian R M :=
    (hkillSet.semilinearMap.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective
      Function.bijective_id).mpr (by infer_instance)
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr
    ⟨by infer_instance, hArtM⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalk_isFiniteLength_of_isFiniteType_of_isTorsion
statement:
theorem moduleStalk_isFiniteLength_of_isFiniteType_of_isTorsion
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFiniteType]
    (hM : Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M)) :
    IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    krullDimLE_of_coheight
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint hx)
  letI := moduleStalk_finite_of_isFiniteType X x M
  exact isFiniteLength_of_finite_isTorsion
    (X.presheaf.stalk x) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M) hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.ord_algebraMap_det_smithNormalForm_eq_length_moduleStalk_cokernel

theorem ord_algebraMap_det_smithNormalForm_eq_length_moduleStalk_cokernel
    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.ord_div_moduleStalkSmithDet_eq_cokernel_length_sub
statement:
theorem ord_div_moduleStalkSmithDet_eq_cokernel_length_sub
    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (hx : coheight x = 1)
    {P M N : X.Modules} (left : P ⟶ M) (right : P ⟶ N)
    {I J : Type u} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (bM : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (bN : Module.Basis J (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hleft : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (hright : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hdetLeft : moduleStalkSmithDet X x left bM hleft ≠ 0)
    (hdetRight : moduleStalkSmithDet X x right bN hright ≠ 0) :
    X.ord
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (moduleStalkSmithDet X x right bN hright) /
          algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (moduleStalkSmithDet X x left bM hleft)) x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (cokernel right))).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (cokernel left))).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft' : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
      (moduleStalkSmithDet X x left bM hleft) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective
        (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)).mpr hdetLeft
  have hright' : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
      (moduleStalkSmithDet X x right bN hright) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective
        (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)).mpr hdetRight
  rw [Scheme.ord_div hx _ _ hright' hleft']
  rw [ord_algebraMap_det_smithNormalForm_eq_length_moduleStalk_cokernel
      X x hx right bN hright hdetRight,
    ord_algebraMap_det_smithNormalForm_eq_length_moduleStalk_cokernel
      X x hx left bM hleft hdetLeft]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.length_moduleStalk_cokernel_eq_ord_det_commonBasis
statement:
theorem length_moduleStalk_cokernel_eq_ord_det_commonBasis
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    {P N : X.Modules} (f : P ⟶ N)
    {I : Type v} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (bP : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj P))
    (bN : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hinj : Function.Injective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f))
    (h : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N)) :
    Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (cokernel f)) =
      Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (bN.det (((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f) ∘ bP))
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_moduleStalk_cokernel_eq_range_quotient X x f]
  let e : ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj P) ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
      LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f).hom :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInjective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f).hom hinj
  let bRange := bP.map e
  let J : Type u := ULift.{u} (Fin (Fintype.card I))
  let σ : I ≃ J := (Fintype.equivFin I).trans Equiv.ulift.symm
  let bNFin := bN.reindex σ
  let bRangeFin := bRange.reindex σ
  have hcolength :=
    (LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f).hom
      ).length_quotient_eq_ord_det_basis bNFin bRangeFin h
  let v : I → (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N :=
    ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f) ∘ bP
  have hbRangeFin :
      (fun j ↦ (bRangeFin j : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N)) =
        v ∘ σ.symm := by
    funext j
    simp only [bRangeFin, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Function.comp_apply,
      bRange, Module.Basis.map_apply, v]
    rfl
  have hdet :
      bNFin.det
          (fun j ↦ (bRangeFin j : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N)) =
        bN.det v := by
    rw [hbRangeFin]
    simpa only [bNFin, Equiv.symm_symm] using
      (Module.Basis.det_reindex_symm bN v σ.symm)
  rw [hdet] at hcolength
  simpa only [v] using hcolength

    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_cokernel_stalk_length_sub_of_commonBasis_transition
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_cokernel_stalk_length_sub_of_commonBasis_transition
    {D : X.Modules} (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (hrankD : SingularCurve.genericRank X D = 1)
    {bpoint x : X} (b : LineBundleLocalData X D bpoint)
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X D x)
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (hx : coheight x = 1)
    {P M N : X.Modules} (left : P ⟶ M) (right : P ⟶ N)
    {I : Type v} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (bP : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj P))
    (bM : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (bN : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hinjLeft : Function.Injective
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left))
    (hinjRight : Function.Injective
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right))
    (hleft : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (LinearMap.range
          ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (hright : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (LinearMap.range
          ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj N))
    (hdetLeft : bM.det
      (((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left) ∘ bP) ≠ 0)
    (hdetRight : bN.det
      (((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) ∘ bP) ≠ 0)
    (htransition : b.regularTransitionFunction d =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
          (bN.det (((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) ∘ bP)) /
        algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
          (bM.det (((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left) ∘ bP))) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hD hrankD b x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (cokernel right))).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (cokernel left))).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
    hD hrankD b d x d.mem]
  rw [htransition]
  exact SingularCurve.ord_div_det_commonBasis_eq_cokernel_length_sub
    X x hx left right bP bM bN hinjLeft hinjRight hleft hright
      hdetLeft hdetRight

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_app
statement:
theorem restrictHomOverLE_app {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules}
    {U V : Y.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (q : M.over U ⟶ N.over U)
    (m : M.val.obj (op V)) :
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map
        (restrictHomOverLE Y hVU q)) m =
      q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.germ_eq_of_open_eq
statement:
private theorem germ_eq_of_open_eq
    (P : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat Y) {U V : Y.Opens} (hUV : U = V)
    (w : Y) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hwV : w ∈ V)
    (sU : ↑(P.obj (op U))) (sV : ↑(P.obj (op V))) (hs : HEq sU sV) :
    P.germ U w hwU sU = P.germ V w hwV sV
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  cases hs
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.genericTrivialization_algebraMap
statement:
theorem genericTrivialization_algebraMap (d : LineBundleLocalData Y L y)
    (V : Y.Opens) [Nonempty V] (hVd : V ≤ d.U)
    (a : Y.presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    d.genericTrivialization
        (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.obj (op V)) Y.functionField a) =
      L.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint Y)
        (((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr
          (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty V)))
        (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map
            (d.globalFrameOverLE V hVd).hom)
          ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) a))
proof:
:= by
  let hηV : genericPoint Y ∈ V :=
    ((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty V))
  rw [genericTrivialization, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    freePUnitGenericTrivialization_algebraMap]
  let S : Scheme.{u} := d.U
  let f : S ⟶ Y := Scheme.Opens.ι d.U
  let F : Y.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit
  let eOver : F.over d.U ≅ L.over d.U := d.globalFrame
  let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj L :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv d.U).app F).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv d.U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv d.U).app L
  let W : S.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
  have himage : f ''ᵁ W = V := by
    dsimp only [f, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hVd
  let b : F.val.obj (op V) :=
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) a
  let bImage : F.val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ W)) := by
    rw [himage]
    exact b
  let s : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).val.obj (op W) := by
    exact bImage
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_germ
      Y L d.U d.genericPoint_mem
      PUnit eOver V hVd hηV s
  dsimp only at h
  convert h using 1
  · congr 1
    apply germ_eq_of_open_eq _ himage.symm
        (genericPoint Y) _ _ _ _
    simp [s, bImage, b]
  · have hleft := restrictHomOverLE_app hVd eOver.hom b
    have hright := overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq hVd eOver.hom b
    dsimp only at hright
    apply germ_eq_of_open_eq _ himage.symm
        (genericPoint Y) _ _ _ _
    exact (heq_of_eq hleft).trans hright.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_eq_transitionFunction
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_eq_transitionFunction
    (d : LineBundleLocalData Y L y) (e : LineBundleLocalData Y L z) :
    d.regularTransitionFunction e = d.transitionFunction e
proof:
:= by
  unfold regularTransitionFunction transitionFunction
  apply e.genericTrivialization.injective
  rw [e.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply]
  let V := d.U ⊓ e.U
  have he := e.genericTrivialization_algebraMap V inf_le_right
    (d.transitionSection e)
  have hd := d.genericTrivialization_algebraMap V inf_le_left
    (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op V))
  rw [map_one] at hd
  rw [he, hd]
  exact congrArg
    (fun s ↦ L.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint Y)
      (((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr
        (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty V))) s)
    (globalFrame_transitionSection d e)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
statement:
theorem transitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
    (leftFrame : LineBundleLocalData Y L y)
    (rightFrame : LineBundleLocalData Y L z)
    (a b : Y.functionField) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hcommon : leftFrame.genericTrivialization a =
      rightFrame.genericTrivialization b) :
    leftFrame.transitionFunction rightFrame = b / a
proof:
:= by
  unfold transitionFunction
  simpa using
    (LinearEquiv.frameTransition_eq_div
      leftFrame.genericTrivialization rightFrame.genericTrivialization
      (LinearEquiv.refl Y.functionField
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFunctor Y).obj L))
      a b ha hcommon)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
    (leftFrame : LineBundleLocalData Y L y)
    (rightFrame : LineBundleLocalData Y L z)
    (a b : Y.functionField) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hcommon : leftFrame.genericTrivialization a =
      rightFrame.genericTrivialization b) :
    leftFrame.regularTransitionFunction rightFrame = b / a
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularTransitionFunction_eq_transitionFunction]
  exact transitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
    leftFrame rightFrame a b ha hcommon

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.RationalTrivialization.transitionFunction_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transitionFunction_ne_zero (t : RationalTrivialization Y L)
    (d : LineBundleLocalData Y L y) : t.transitionFunction d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply d.genericTrivialization.symm.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  apply t.equiv.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  exact one_ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.RationalTrivialization.transitionFunction_cocycle
statement:
theorem transitionFunction_cocycle (t : RationalTrivialization Y L)
    (d : LineBundleLocalData Y L y) {z : Y}
    (e : LineBundleLocalData Y L z) :
    t.transitionFunction e =
      t.transitionFunction d * d.transitionFunction e
proof:
:= by
  change e.genericTrivialization.symm (t.equiv 1) =
    d.genericTrivialization.symm (t.equiv 1) *
      e.genericTrivialization.symm (d.genericTrivialization 1)
  apply e.genericTrivialization.injective
  have hmap (q : Y.functionField ≃ₗ[Y.functionField]
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFunctor Y).obj L))
      (a : Y.functionField) : q a = a • q 1 := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using q.map_smul a 1
  rw [e.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply,
    hmap e.genericTrivialization, mul_smul]
  have hb : e.genericTrivialization.symm (d.genericTrivialization 1) •
      e.genericTrivialization 1 = d.genericTrivialization 1 := by
    rw [← hmap e.genericTrivialization]
    exact e.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply _
  have ha : d.genericTrivialization.symm (t.equiv 1) •
      d.genericTrivialization 1 = t.equiv 1 := by
    rw [← hmap d.genericTrivialization]
    exact d.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hb, ha]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.RationalTrivialization.transitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
statement:
theorem transitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates
    (t : RationalTrivialization Y L)
    (d : LineBundleLocalData Y L y)
    (a b : Y.functionField) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hcommon : t.equiv a = d.genericTrivialization b) :
    t.transitionFunction d = b / a
proof:
:= by
  unfold transitionFunction
  simpa using
    (LinearEquiv.frameTransition_eq_div
      t.equiv d.genericTrivialization
      (LinearEquiv.refl Y.functionField
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFunctor Y).obj L))
      a b ha hcommon)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization_eq_on_localData
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization_eq_on_localData
    {D : X.Modules} (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (hrankD : SingularCurve.genericRank X D = 1)
    (t : RationalTrivialization X D) {z : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X D z) (p : X) (hp : p ∈ d.U) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization X hD hrankD t p =
      X.ord (t.transitionFunction d) p
proof:
:= by
  let e := lineBundleLocalDataAt X D hD hrankD p
  by_cases hpcoh : coheight p = 1
  · rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization,
      t.transitionFunction_cocycle d e,
      X.ord_mul hpcoh (t.transitionFunction_ne_zero d)
        (d.transitionFunction_ne_zero e)]
    have hunit : X.ord (d.transitionFunction e) p = 0 := by
      rw [← d.regularTransitionFunction_eq_transitionFunction e]
      exact X.ord_of_isUnit (d.transitionSection_isUnit e) hpcoh ⟨hp, e.mem⟩
    rw [hunit, add_zero]
  · rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpcoh,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpcoh]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization_eq_cokernel_stalk_length_sub_of_commonBasis
statement:

    {D : X.Modules} (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)

    (bN : Module.Basis I (X.presheaf.stalk x)

    (hinjLeft : Function.Injective
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left))
    (hinjRight : Function.Injective
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right))
    (hleft : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (LinearMap.range
          ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left).hom) =
      Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj M))
    (hright : Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x)

          ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right).hom) =

      (((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) ∘ bP) ≠ 0)
    (hcommon : t.equiv
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField

      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (cokernel left))).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization_eq_on_localData
    X hD hrankD t d x d.mem]
  rw [t.transitionFunction_eq_div_of_common_coordinates d _ _
    ((map_ne_zero_iff _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective
        (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)).mpr hdetLeft) hcommon]
  exact SingularCurve.ord_div_det_commonBasis_eq_cokernel_length_sub
    X x hx left right bP bM bN hinjLeft hinjRight hleft hright

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.support_stalkLength_mul_finrank_subset_moduleSheafSupport
statement:
theorem support_stalkLength_mul_finrank_subset_moduleSheafSupport
    (F : X.Modules) :
    Function.support (fun x : X ↦
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)).toNat *
        Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x)) ⊆ moduleSheafSupport F
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxSupport
  letI : Subsingleton ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) :=
    not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hxSupport
  apply hx
  simp only [Module.length_eq_zero, ENat.toNat_zero, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.zeroDimensionalLength_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
statement:
theorem zeroDimensionalLength_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    (hη : IsZero (F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (htorsion : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)) :
    zeroDimensionalLength k F = ∑ᶠ x : X,
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)).toNat *
        Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x)
proof:
:= by
  let hsupport :=
    moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType F hη
  let S : Finset X := hsupport.toFinset
  have hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hsupport.mem_toFinset.mpr hx
  have hηSupport : genericPoint X ∉ moduleSheafSupport F := by
    change ¬ Nontrivial (F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))
    exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mpr
      (AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hη)
  have hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X := by
    intro p hp
    exact hηSupport (hp ▸ hsupport.mem_toFinset.mp p.2)
  have hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F) := fun p ↦
    moduleStalk_isFiniteLength_of_isFiniteType_of_isTorsion X p.1
      (hSη p) F (htorsion p.1 (hSη p))
  have hκ : ∀ p : S, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p.1) := fun p ↦
    finite_residueField_of_coheight_eq_one k
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint
        (X := X) (hSη p))
  have hlength := zeroDimensionalLength_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
    k F S hSη hsupp hfinite hκ
  let weight : X → ℕ := fun x ↦
    (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)).toNat *
      Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x)
  have hweight : Function.support weight ⊆ (S : Set X) :=
    (support_stalkLength_mul_finrank_subset_moduleSheafSupport k F).trans hsupp
  calc
    zeroDimensionalLength k F = ∑ p : S, weight p.1 := hlength
    _ = ∑ x ∈ S, weight x := by
      rw [← S.sum_attach]
      rfl
    _ = ∑ᶠ x : X, weight x :=
      (finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset weight hweight).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.zeroDimensionalLength_intCast_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
statement:
theorem zeroDimensionalLength_intCast_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    (hη : IsZero (F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (htorsion : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)) :
    (zeroDimensionalLength k F : ℤ) = ∑ᶠ x : X,
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)).toNat : ℤ) *
        (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let weight : X → ℕ := fun x ↦
    (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)).toNat *
      Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x)
  have hsupport : (Function.support weight).Finite :=
    (moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType F hη).subset
      (support_stalkLength_mul_finrank_subset_moduleSheafSupport k F)
  calc
    (zeroDimensionalLength k F : ℤ) = (↑(∑ᶠ x : X, weight x) : ℤ) :=
      congrArg Int.ofNat
        (zeroDimensionalLength_eq_finsum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
          k F hη htorsion)
    _ = ∑ᶠ x : X, (↑(weight x) : ℤ) :=
      (Nat.castAddMonoidHom ℤ).map_finsum hsupport
    _ = ∑ᶠ x : X,
        ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)).toNat : ℤ) *
          (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro x
      simp only [weight, Nat.cast_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hMapₗ_comp_apply
proof:
:= by
  have h : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map (a ≫ b) =
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map a ≫
        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map b :=
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp _ _ _
  exact ((Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply _ _ x).symm).trans (congrArg (fun t => Sheaf.H.map t n x) h.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hMapₗ_id_apply

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hMapₗ_zero_apply
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.h_biprod
statement:
theorem h_biprod (F G : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (hF : Module.Finite k (F.H n)) (hG : Module.Finite k (G.H n)) :

proof:
:= by
  letI := hF
  letI := hG
  rw [Scheme.Modules.h, Scheme.Modules.h, Scheme.Modules.h]
  exact (LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (hBiprodLinearEquiv k F G n)).trans
    Module.finrank_prod

proof:

  induction ps with
  | nil => exact finite_H_zero (X := X) k n
  | cons p ps ih =>

proof:

    fun n hn => subsingleton_H_skyscraper_of_pos p hn⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_middle
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_middle (o : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hSE : o.ShortExact) (h1 : o.X₁.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (h3 : o.X₃.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    o.X₂.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  have hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf hSE
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := h1.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N3, hN3⟩ := h3.vanishing
  refine ⟨fun n => finite_H_middle k o hS n (h1.finite n) (h3.finite n),
    max N1 N3, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact subsingleton_H_middle k o hS n
    (hN1 n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left N1 N3) hn))
    (hN3 n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right N1 N3) hn))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.eulerChar_additive_of_finite
statement:
theorem eulerChar_additive_of_finite (o : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hSE : o.ShortExact) (h1 : o.X₁.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (h2 : o.X₂.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (h3 : o.X₃.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    o.X₂.eulerChar k = o.X₁.eulerChar k + o.X₃.eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1⟩ := h1.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := h2.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N3, hN3⟩ := h3.vanishing
  let N := max N1 (max N2 N3)
  apply eulerChar_additive k o hSE h1.finite h2.finite h3.finite
  · intro n hn
    exact hN1 n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left N1 (max N2 N3)) hn)
  · intro n hn
    exact hN2 n (lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((le_max_left N2 N3).trans (le_max_right N1 (max N2 N3))) hn)
  · intro n hn
    exact hN3 n (lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((le_max_right N2 N3).trans (le_max_right N1 (max N2 N3))) hn)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.PointSkyscraperDevissage.higherVanishing
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => exact subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) n
  | iso e tail ih =>
      letI := ih
      exact (hLinearEquivOfIso k e n).toEquiv.subsingleton
  | extension p tail inclusion projection zero shortExact ih =>
      let o := ShortComplex.mk inclusion projection zero
      have hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf shortExact
