name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.PointSkyscraperDevissage.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic {F : X.Modules} {ps : List X}
    (d : PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps)
    (hκ : ∀ p ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p)) :
    F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨finite_H_zero (X := X) k, 0,
        fun n hn => subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) n⟩
  | iso e tail ih =>
      exact hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k e.symm (ih hκ)
  | @extension F G ps p tail inclusion projection zero shortExact ih =>
      let hκp := hκ p (by simp)
      let hκps : ∀ q ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField q) :=
        fun q hq => hκ q (by simp [hq])
      let o := ShortComplex.mk inclusion projection zero
      exact hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_middle k o shortExact (ih hκps)
        (hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_pointSkyscraper k p hκp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.PointSkyscraperDevissage.eulerChar_eq_sum
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum {F : X.Modules} {ps : List X}
    (d : PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps)
    (hκ : ∀ p ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p)) :
    F.eulerChar k =
      ((ps.map fun p => Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p)).sum : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      rw [eulerChar_eq_zeroDimensionalLength k (0 : X.Modules)
        (fun n _ => subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) n), zeroDimensionalLength]
      change ((Module.finrank k ((0 : X.Modules).H 0) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0
      haveI := subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) 0
      rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
      simp
  | iso e tail ih =>
      exact (eulerChar_eq_of_iso k e).trans (ih hκ)
  | @extension F G ps p tail inclusion projection zero shortExact ih =>
      let hκp := hκ p (by simp)
      let hκps : ∀ q ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField q) :=
        fun q hq => hκ q (by simp [hq])
      let o := ShortComplex.mk inclusion projection zero
      have h1 := tail.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k hκps
      have h3 := hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_pointSkyscraper k p hκp
      have h2 := hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_middle k o shortExact h1 h3
      rw [eulerChar_additive_of_finite k o shortExact h1 h2 h3,
        ih hκps, eulerChar_skyscraper k p]
      simp [add_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.PointSkyscraperDevissage.zeroDimensionalLength_eq_sum
statement:
theorem zeroDimensionalLength_eq_sum {F : X.Modules} {ps : List X}
    (d : PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps)
    (hκ : ∀ p ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p)) :
    zeroDimensionalLength k F =
      (ps.map fun p => Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p)).sum
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (eulerChar_eq_zeroDimensionalLength k F (d.higherVanishing k)).symm.trans
    (d.eulerChar_eq_sum k hκ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.subsingleton_H_pointSkyscraperSum
statement:
theorem subsingleton_H_pointSkyscraperSum (ps : List X) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Subsingleton ((pointSkyscraperSum ps).H n)
proof:
:= by
  induction ps with
  | nil => exact subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) n
  | cons p ps ih =>
      exact subsingleton_H_biprod k _ _ n
        (subsingleton_H_skyscraper_of_pos p hn) ih

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.h_pointSkyscraperSum_zero
statement:
theorem h_pointSkyscraperSum_zero (ps : List X)
    (hκ : ∀ p ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p)) :
    (pointSkyscraperSum ps).h k 0 =
      (ps.map fun p => Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction ps with
  | nil =>
      change Module.finrank k ((0 : X.Modules).H 0) = 0
      letI := subsingleton_H_zero (X := X) 0
      exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  | cons p ps ih =>
      let hκp := hκ p (by simp)
      let hκps : ∀ q ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField q) :=
        fun q hq => hκ q (by simp [hq])
      calc
        Scheme.Modules.h k (pointSkyscraperSum (p :: ps)) 0 =
            Scheme.Modules.h k
              (skyscraperSheafOfModules p X.ringCatSheaf
                ↑(X.residueField p) ⊞ pointSkyscraperSum ps) 0 := rfl
        _ = Scheme.Modules.h k
              (skyscraperSheafOfModules p X.ringCatSheaf ↑(X.residueField p)) 0 +
            Scheme.Modules.h k (pointSkyscraperSum ps) 0 :=
          h_biprod k _ _ 0
            (finite_H_skyscraper_of_finite_residueField k p hκp 0)
            (finite_H_pointSkyscraperSum k ps hκps 0)
        _ = Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p) +
            (ps.map fun q => Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField q)).sum := by
          rw [skyscraper_h_zero k p, ih hκps]
        _ = ((p :: ps).map fun q => Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField q)).sum := by
          simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_pointSkyscraperSum
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_pointSkyscraperSum (ps : List X)
    (hκ : ∀ p ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p)) :
    (pointSkyscraperSum ps).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨finite_H_pointSkyscraperSum k ps hκ, 0, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact subsingleton_H_pointSkyscraperSum k ps n (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.eulerChar_pointSkyscraperSum
statement:
theorem eulerChar_pointSkyscraperSum (ps : List X)
    (hκ : ∀ p ∈ ps, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p)) :
    (pointSkyscraperSum ps).eulerChar k =
      ((ps.map fun p => Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p)).sum : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar_eq_zeroDimensionalLength k (pointSkyscraperSum ps)
    (subsingleton_H_pointSkyscraperSum k ps), zeroDimensionalLength,
    h_pointSkyscraperSum_zero k ps hκ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.NormalizationPresentation.riemann_roch
statement:
theorem riemann_roch
    (p : NormalizationPresentation k sheaf normalizedStructure normalizedSheaf
      delta sheafDefect normalizedDegree) :
    sheaf.eulerChar k = p.correctedDegree + (structureModule X).eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  have hO := p.structureStep.eulerChar_upper_eq
  have hF := p.sheafStep.eulerChar_upper_eq
  rw [p.normalizedRiemannRoch, hO] at hF
  dsimp only [correctedDegree]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.NormalizationPresentation.ofMonosOfHigherVanishing_correctedDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofMonosOfHigherVanishing_correctedDegree
    (structureInclusion : structureModule X ⟶ normalizedStructure)
    (sheafInclusion : sheaf ⟶ normalizedSheaf)
    [Mono structureInclusion] [Mono sheafInclusion]
    (structureFinite : (structureModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (normalizedStructureFinite : normalizedStructure.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (structureQuotientFinite :
      (cokernel structureInclusion).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (structureQuotientHigherVanishing :
      ∀ n, 0 < n → Subsingleton ((cokernel structureInclusion).H n))
    (sheafFinite : sheaf.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (normalizedSheafFinite : normalizedSheaf.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (sheafQuotientFinite :
      (cokernel sheafInclusion).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (sheafQuotientHigherVanishing :
      ∀ n, 0 < n → Subsingleton ((cokernel sheafInclusion).H n))
    (normalizedRiemannRoch :
      normalizedSheaf.eulerChar k =
        normalizedDegree + normalizedStructure.eulerChar k) :
    (ofMonosOfHigherVanishing structureInclusion sheafInclusion structureFinite
      normalizedStructureFinite structureQuotientFinite structureQuotientHigherVanishing
      sheafFinite normalizedSheafFinite sheafQuotientFinite sheafQuotientHigherVanishing
      normalizedRiemannRoch).correctedDegree =
        normalizedDegree +
          (zeroDimensionalLength k (cokernel structureInclusion) : ℤ) -
          (zeroDimensionalLength k (cokernel sheafInclusion) : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.NormalizationPresentation.ofMonos_correctedDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofMonos_correctedDegree
    (structureInclusion : structureModule X ⟶ normalizedStructure)
    (sheafInclusion : sheaf ⟶ normalizedSheaf)
    [Mono structureInclusion] [Mono sheafInclusion]
    (structureFinite : (structureModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (normalizedStructureFinite : normalizedStructure.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (structureQuotientFinite :
      (cokernel structureInclusion).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (structureQuotientEulerChar :
      (cokernel structureInclusion).eulerChar k = delta)
    (sheafFinite : sheaf.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (normalizedSheafFinite : normalizedSheaf.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (sheafQuotientFinite :
      (cokernel sheafInclusion).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (sheafQuotientEulerChar :
      (cokernel sheafInclusion).eulerChar k = sheafDefect)
    (normalizedRiemannRoch :
      normalizedSheaf.eulerChar k =
        normalizedDegree + normalizedStructure.eulerChar k) :
    (ofMonos structureInclusion sheafInclusion structureFinite
      normalizedStructureFinite structureQuotientFinite structureQuotientEulerChar
      sheafFinite normalizedSheafFinite sheafQuotientFinite sheafQuotientEulerChar
      normalizedRiemannRoch).correctedDegree =
        normalizedDegree + delta - sheafDefect
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.RankNormalizationPresentation.riemann_roch
statement:
theorem riemann_roch
    (p : RankNormalizationPresentation k sheaf normalizedStructure normalizedSheaf
      rank delta sheafDefect normalizedDegree) :
    sheaf.eulerChar k = p.correctedDegree +
      (rank : ℤ) * (structureModule X).eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  have hO := p.structureStep.eulerChar_upper_eq
  have hF := p.sheafStep.eulerChar_upper_eq
  calc
    sheaf.eulerChar k = normalizedSheaf.eulerChar k - sheafDefect := by omega
    _ = normalizedDegree + (rank : ℤ) *
        normalizedStructure.eulerChar k - sheafDefect := by
      rw [p.normalizedRiemannRoch]
    _ = p.correctedDegree +
        (rank : ℤ) * (structureModule X).eulerChar k := by
      rw [hO]
      dsimp only [correctedDegree]
      ring

  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.k0ClassOf_of_isZero _
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ hE)

name: GRRKG6.image_generic
statement:
theorem image_generic {X A : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral A] (i : X ⟶ A)
    (hs : ∀ y : A, y ∈ Set.range i) : i (genericPoint X) = genericPoint A
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (genericPoint_spec X).image i.continuous
  have h2 : closure (i '' (Set.univ : Set X)) = Set.univ := by
    have : i '' (Set.univ : Set X) = Set.univ := by
      ext y; simpa using hs y
    rw [this, closure_univ]
  rw [h2] at h1
  have h3 : IsGenericPoint (genericPoint A) (Set.univ : Set A) := by
    have := (genericPoint_spec A)
    simpa [IsGenericPoint] using this.def
  exact h3.eq h1 |>.symm

name: GRRKG6.coheight_generic_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coheight_generic_eq_zero (A : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral A] :
    Order.coheight (genericPoint A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Order.coheight_eq_zero.mpr ?_
  intro b _
  exact Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec A).specializes trivial)

name: GRRKG6.finitePushforward_of_isIso
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_of_isIso (x : K0 X) :
    finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x) = k0ToG0 P (pullbackK0RingHom (inv i) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.k0ToG0_pullbackK0_iso' (asIso i).symm x
  have h2 := h.symm
  simp only [Iso.symm_inv, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, asIso_inv] at h2
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  exact h2

name: GRRKG6.closedImm_of_iso
statement:
theorem closedImm_of_iso (resP : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution P)
    (hrankX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators P)
    (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X) {c : K0 X} (hc : c = 0) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j P)
        (adamsRingHom hrankP j (resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j i resP.res
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankX j x) *
          ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd c) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) :
            KLoc j X))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd c) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) :
      KLoc j X) = 1 := by
    rw [hc]
    have : (Multiplicative.ofAdd (0 : K0 X)) = 1 := rfl
    rw [this, map_one]; rfl
  rw [hb, mul_one]
  have e1 : ∀ z : K0 X, pushLocF3 j i resP.res (algebraMap _ _ z) =
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j P) (resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X z))) := by
    intro z
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    rfl
  have hl : ∀ z : K0 P, resP.res (k0ToG0 P z) = z := fun z => by
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun resP.left z
    simpa only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] using this
  rw [e1, finitePushforward_of_isIso, finitePushforward_of_isIso, hl, hl]
  congr 1
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (GRRKG4.hψnat' (inv i) hrankP hrankX hj) x).symm

name: GRRKG6.conormalClass_zero_of_surj
statement:
theorem conormalClass_zero_of_surj (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A)
    (hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X) (hs : ∀ y : A, y ∈ Set.range i)
    {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) : N.conormalClass = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_ker_subscheme i hX
  let C := KG2B.coverJ i.ker hAreg hZ
  have hs' : ∀ y : A, y ∈ Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) := fun y => by
    rw [GRRKG4.range_ker]; exact hs y
  have hc0 : KG2B.codimZ i.ker = 0 := by
    unfold KG2B.codimZ
    change (Order.coheight (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker (genericPoint i.ker.subscheme))).toNat = 0
    rw [image_generic (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) hs', coheight_generic_eq_zero A]
    rfl
  have hC := libConormalAmb_hasConstantRank i C
  have hr : r = KG2B.codimZ i.ker := by
    obtain ⟨x⟩ : Nonempty X := inferInstance
    exact (rankAt_of_hasConstantRank N.rank x).symm.trans (rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hC x)
  exact class_zero_of_rank N.rank (hr.trans hc0)

name: GRRKG6.adamsRR_generalBase_all_of_data
statement:
theorem adamsRR_generalBase_all_of_data (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (hX : RegStalks X) (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X)
    {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have hA := T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n
  have hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (PY k Y n) := prod_regStalks hreg n
  have hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (PY k Y n) := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _
  have hrankX : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hrankY : ConstantRankGenerators Y := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n) := lambdaNilpotent_P n hY
  let resY := resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg
  let resP := resProd hY hreg n
  have hres : (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res = resP.res := res_eq _ _
  
  have hII : ∀ x : K0 X,
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (PY k Y n))
          (adamsRingHom hrankP j (resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
        pushLocF3 j i resP.res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankX j x) *
            ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hne : ∃ y : ↥(PY k Y n), y ∉ Set.range i
    · have h := GRRKG4.closedImmersion_field i hA hAreg hX hne hnilX N (j := j) (by omega) x
      rw [hres] at h
      exact h
    · push Not at hne
      haveI : Surjective i := ⟨hne⟩
      haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective i
      haveI : IsNoetherian (PY k Y n) := prodNoetherian n
      exact closedImm_of_iso i resP hrankX hrankP hnilX
        (conormalClass_zero_of_surj i hAreg hX hne N) (by omega) x
  
  have hI := adamsRR_caseI_prod_lib (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY j hj hrankP hrankY hnilP
  
  have hu : Units.map (pullLocF3 j i).toMonoidHom
      (SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n))) =
      SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n))) :=
    Units.ext (by
      rw [Units.coe_map, bott_pull j i (pullbackK0RingHom i) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i)
        (pullLocF3 j i) (pullLocF3_alg j i) hrankX hnilX hrankP hnilP]
      rfl)
  have htw : (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
          N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) :
          (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) *
        pullLocF3 j i (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j (PY k Y n))ˣ) :
            KLoc j (PY k Y n)) := by
    rw [ofAdd_sub, map_div, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Units.val_mul, ← hu, ← map_inv,
      Units.coe_map]
    rfl
  let iG : K0 X →+ K0 (PY k Y n) := resP.res.comp ((finitePushforward i).comp (k0ToG0 X))
  let πG : K0 (PY k Y n) →+ K0 Y := piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY
  have hcomp : πG (iG x) = fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x := by
    have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun resP.right (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at hr
    simp only [πG, iG, piK0, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
    rfl
  rw [← hcomp, htw]
  exact GRRKG1.twisted_comp iG πG
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankX j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankP j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankY j).toAddMonoidHom)
    (pushLocF3 j i resP.res) (locAddHom j πG) (pullLocF3 j i) _ _
    (projFormulaLoc j i resP.res resP.left resP.right) hII hI x

name: GRRKG6.adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase_all
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase_all (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (hX : RegStalks X) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hreg n i hX).some.conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRR_generalBase_all_of_data n i hY hreg hX (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
    (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hreg n i hX).some hj x

name: GRRKG6.isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion {X P : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian P] (i : X ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] : IsNoetherian X

name: GRRKG6.adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase_all_noinst
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase_all_noinst {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsDomain k] [IsNoetherianRing k] [M1.FiniteDimBase k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (n : ℕ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] (i : X ⟶ (PY k Y n)) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y) (hX : RegStalks X) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (x : haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion i; K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral Y
proof:
:= hY.1
    haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion i
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hreg n i hX).some.conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X))) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion i
  exact adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase_all n i hY hreg hX hj x

name: CIK1A.conormal_classOf_of_eq
statement:
theorem conormal_classOf_of_eq {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank A E r)
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames A E σ) :
    ∀ (I : A.IdealSheafData), I = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal A E σ →
      ∀ hc : IsFiniteLocallyFree I.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal I),
        k0ClassOf I.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal I) hc =
          pullbackK0RingHom I.subschemeι (k0ClassOf A E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  rintro I rfl hc
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (cosectionNativeConormalIso A E σ h)

name: CIK1A.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_eq
statement:
theorem conormal_hasConstantRank_of_eq {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank A E r)
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames A E σ) :
    ∀ (I : A.IdealSheafData), I = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal A E σ →
      HasConstantRank I.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal I) r
proof:
:= by
  rintro I rfl
  exact cosectionZeroSchemeConormal_hasConstantRank A E σ hE h

name: CIK1A.conormalDataOfCosection
statement:
theorem conormalDataOfCosection {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank A E r)
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames A E σ)
    (hker : i.ker = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal A E σ) : ConormalDataAmb i r
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasConstantRank_pullback X i.toImage _ r
    (conormal_hasConstantRank_of_eq E σ hE h i.ker hker)⟩

name: CIK1A.conormalClass_eq_pullback
statement:
theorem conormalClass_eq_pullback {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank A E r)
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames A E σ)
    (hker : i.ker = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal A E σ) {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') :
    N.conormalClass = pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf A E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsFiniteLocallyFree i.ker.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal i.ker) :=
    (conormal_hasConstantRank_of_eq E σ hE h i.ker hker).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h1 := pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i.toImage (ConormalSheaf.conormal i.ker) hc
  have h2 := conormal_classOf_of_eq E σ hE h i.ker hker hc
  calc N.conormalClass
      = pullbackK0RingHom i.toImage
          (k0ClassOf i.ker.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal i.ker) hc) := h1.symm
    _ = pullbackK0RingHom i.toImage
          (pullbackK0RingHom i.ker.subschemeι (k0ClassOf A E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)) := by
        rw [h2]
    _ = pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf A E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
        rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι]

name: CIK1A.finitePushforward_one_of_eq
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_one_of_eq [IsLocallyNoetherian A] {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank A E r)
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames A E σ) :
    ∀ (I : A.IdealSheafData), I = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal A E σ →
      finitePushforward I.subschemeι (k0ToG0 I.subscheme 1) =
        k0ToG0 A (lambdaMinusOne E hE)
proof:
:= by
  rintro I rfl
  rw [k0ToG0_one, finitePushforward_classOf,
    ← g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_finite_weaklyRegular_frames A E σ hE h]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso A _ _ (quasicoherentCosectionZeroSchemeCokernelIso A E σ).symm

name: CIK1A.finitePushforward_one_eq_cosection
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_one_eq_cosection [IsLocallyNoetherian A] {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank A E r) (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames A E σ)
    (hker : i.ker = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal A E σ) :
    finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X 1) = k0ToG0 A (lambdaMinusOne E hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GRRKG4.finitePushforward_iso (asIso i.toImage) i.ker.subschemeι i i.toImage_imageι 1,
    map_one]
  exact finitePushforward_one_of_eq E σ hE h i.ker hker

name: M1.FiniteDimBase.ringKrullDim_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [FiniteDimBase R] :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ (d R : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h := FiniteDimBase.krullDim_lt_top (R := R)
  unfold d
  cases hx : ringKrullDim R with
  | bot => exact bot_le
  | coe a =>
    rw [hx] at h
    have ha : a ≠ ⊤ := fun h' => by simp [h'] at h
    have : ((a.toNat : ℕ∞)) = a := ENat.coe_toNat ha
    simp only [WithBot.unbotD_coe]
    exact_mod_cast this.ge

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.presheaf_hom_ext
statement:
theorem presheaf_hom_ext {M' : PresheafOfModules (T.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (α β : relativePresheaf h ⟶ M')
    (H : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (c : Γ(T, W)),
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom (α.app (op W)) ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap h).app (op W))).d c) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom (β.app (op W)) ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap h).app (op W))).d c)) :
    α = β
proof:
:= by
  ext1 W
  exact CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext (fun c => H W.unop c)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.hom_ext_dsec
statement:
theorem hom_ext_dsec {N : T.Modules} (ψ ψ' : relativeSheaf h ⟶ N)
    (H : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (c : Γ(T, W)),
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ).app (op W)) (dsec h W c) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ').app (op W)) (dsec h W c)) :
    ψ = ψ'
proof:
:= by
  apply ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction T).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  apply presheaf_hom_ext
  intro W c
  exact H W c

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.dsec_add
statement: theorem dsec_add (W : T.Opens) (a b : Γ(T, W)) : dsec h W (a + b) = dsec h W a + dsec h W b
proof:
:= by
  unfold dsec
  rw [ModuleCat.Derivation.d_add]
  exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_add _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.dsec_mul
statement:
theorem dsec_mul (W : T.Opens) (a b : Γ(T, W)) :
    dsec h W (a * b) = a • dsec h W b + b • dsec h W a
proof:
:= by
  unfold dsec
  rw [ModuleCat.Derivation.d_mul]
  refine ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_add _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_)
  · exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _
  · exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.dsec_map
statement:
theorem dsec_map {W W' : T.Opens} (i : W' ≤ W) (c : Γ(T, W)) :
    ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (relativeSheaf h)).map (homOfLE i).op (dsec h W c) =
      dsec h W' (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dsec
  have h1 := PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
    (baseMap h) (homOfLE i).op c
  have h2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (etaH h) (homOfLE i).op
    ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap h).app (op W))).d c)
  exact h2.symm.trans (congrArg (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaH h).app _)) h1)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.psi_smul
statement:
theorem psi_smul (W : T.Opens) (a : Γ(T, W)) (x : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (relativeSheaf h)).obj (op W)) :
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ).app (op W)) (a • x) =
      a • ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ).app (op W)) x
proof:
:=
  (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.psi_add
statement:
theorem psi_add (W : T.Opens) (x y : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (relativeSheaf h)).obj (op W)) :
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ).app (op W)) (x + y) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ).app (op W)) x +
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ).app (op W)) y
proof:
:=
  (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_add _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_add
statement:
theorem van_add {W : T.Opens} {a b : Γ(T, W)} (ha : Van h ψ W a) (hb : Van h ψ W b) :
    Van h ψ W (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Van at *
  rw [dsec_add, psi_add, ha, hb, add_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_mul
statement:
theorem van_mul {W : T.Opens} {a b : Γ(T, W)} (ha : Van h ψ W a) (hb : Van h ψ W b) :
    Van h ψ W (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Van at *
  rw [dsec_mul, psi_add, psi_smul, psi_smul, ha, hb, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.dsec_one
statement: theorem dsec_one (W : T.Opens) : dsec h W 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := dsec_mul h W 1 1
  rw [one_mul, one_smul] at this
  exact add_left_cancel (a := dsec h W 1) (by rw [add_zero]; exact this.symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_one
statement: theorem van_one {W : T.Opens} : Van h ψ W 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold Van
  rw [dsec_one]
  exact map_zero _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_pow
statement: theorem van_pow {W : T.Opens} {a : Γ(T, W)} (ha : Van h ψ W a) (m : ℕ) : Van h ψ W (a ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact van_one ψ
  | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact van_mul ψ ih ha

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_restrict
statement:
theorem van_restrict {W W' : T.Opens} (i : W' ≤ W) {c : Γ(T, W)} (hc : Van h ψ W c) :
    Van h ψ W' (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Van at *
  rw [← dsec_map h i c]
  have := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ) (homOfLE i).op
    (dsec h W c)
  rw [this, hc]
  exact map_zero _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_of_mul_unit
statement:
theorem van_of_mul_unit {W : T.Opens} {a b : Γ(T, W)} (hu : IsUnit a) (hab : Van h ψ W (a * b))
    (ha : Van h ψ W a) : Van h ψ W b
proof:
:= by
  unfold Van at *
  rw [dsec_mul, psi_add, psi_smul, psi_smul, ha, smul_zero, add_zero] at hab
  rw [← smul_zero a] at hab
  exact (hu.smul_left_cancel).1 hab

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_local
statement:
theorem van_local (W : T.Opens) (c : Γ(T, W))
    (hloc : ∀ t ∈ W, ∃ (W' : T.Opens) (i : W' ≤ W), t ∈ W' ∧
      Van h ψ W' (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op c)) : Van h ψ W c
proof:
:= by
  choose W' i ht hv using hloc
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨_, N.isSheaf⟩ (fun x : W => W' x.1 x.2) W
    (fun x => homOfLE (i x.1 x.2)) ?_ _ 0 ?_
  · intro t ht'
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨t, ht'⟩, ht t ht'⟩
  · intro x
    have := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).map ψ)
      (homOfLE (i x.1 x.2)).op (dsec h W c)
    rw [dsec_map h (i x.1 x.2) c] at this
    have h0 := hv x.1 x.2
    unfold Van at h0
    rw [h0] at this
    refine this.symm.trans ?_
    exact (map_zero _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.dsec_zero
statement: theorem dsec_zero (W : T.Opens) : dsec h W 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := dsec_add h W 0 0
  rw [add_zero] at this
  exact add_left_cancel (a := dsec h W 0) (by rw [add_zero]; exact this.symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_zero
statement: theorem van_zero {W : T.Opens} : Van h ψ W 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Van
  rw [dsec_zero]
  exact map_zero _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.eq_zero_of_van
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_van (H : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (c : Γ(T, W)), Van h ψ W c) : ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_dsec h ψ 0 (fun W c => ?_)
  have := H W c
  unfold Van at this
  rw [this]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.pushout_induction
statement:
theorem pushout_induction {R S R' S' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S'] [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R' S']
    [IsScalarTower R S S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S'] [Algebra.IsPushout R S R' S']
    (P : S' → Prop) (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hmul : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x * y))
    (hl : ∀ a : S, P (algebraMap S S' a)) (hr : ∀ b : R', P (algebraMap R' S' b)) (x : S') : P x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R S R' S' ((Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R S R' S').symm x) := by
    simp
  rw [hx]
  generalize (Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R S R' S').symm x = z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact h0
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [Algebra.IsPushout.equiv_tmul]
    exact hmul _ _ (hl a) (hr b)
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact hadd _ _ hy hz

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_prodOpen_all
statement:
theorem van_prodOpen_all [IsAffine S] (H : IsPullback q p f g) {N : T.Modules}
    (ψ : relativeSheaf (p ≫ g) ⟶ N)
    (hY : ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (y : Γ(Y, V)), Van (p ≫ g) ψ (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (p.app V y))
    (hP : ∀ (W : P.Opens) (w : Γ(P, W)), Van (p ≫ g) ψ (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) (q.app W w))
    {V : Y.Opens} (hVa : IsAffineOpen V) {W' : P.Opens} (hWa : IsAffineOpen W')
    (x : Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V)) :
    Van (p ≫ g) ψ (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) x
proof:
:= by
  have hV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := le_top.trans (by simp)
  have hW : W' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := le_top.trans (by simp)
  have hU1 : prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ W' := inf_le_left
  have hU2 : prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ V := inf_le_right
  have hP' := prodOpen_isPushout H hW hV (isAffineOpen_top S) hWa hVa
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(P, W') := (f.appLE ⊤ W' hW).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(Y, V) := (g.appLE ⊤ V hV).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(P, W') Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) := (q.appLE W' _ hU1).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) := (p.appLE V _ hU2).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) :=
    ((q.appLE W' _ hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE ⊤ W' hW).hom).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(P, W') Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change ((q.appLE W' _ hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE ⊤ W' hW).hom) =
        (p.appLE V _ hU2).hom.comp (g.appLE ⊤ V hV).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp,
        appLE_comp_eq f g p q hW hV H.w.symm hU1 hU2])
  haveI : Algebra.IsPushout Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(P, W') Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) :=
    CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout.mp hP'
  haveI : Algebra.IsPushout Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(Y, V) Γ(P, W') Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) :=
    Algebra.IsPushout.symm inferInstance
  refine pushout_induction (R := Γ(S, ⊤)) (S := Γ(Y, V)) (R' := Γ(P, W')) _ (van_zero ψ)
    (fun a b ha hb => van_add ψ ha hb) (fun a b ha hb => van_mul ψ ha hb) ?_ ?_ x
  · intro a
    exact van_restrict ψ hU2 (hY V a)
  · intro b
    exact van_restrict ψ hU1 (hP W' b)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_all
statement:
theorem van_all [IsAffine S] (H : IsPullback q p f g) {N : T.Modules}
    (ψ : relativeSheaf (p ≫ g) ⟶ N)
    (hY : ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (y : Γ(Y, V)), Van (p ≫ g) ψ (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (p.app V y))
    (hP : ∀ (W : P.Opens) (w : Γ(P, W)), Van (p ≫ g) ψ (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) (q.app W w))
    (W : T.Opens) (c : Γ(T, W)) : Van (p ≫ g) ψ W c
proof:
:= by
  refine van_local ψ W c (fun t ht => ?_)
  obtain ⟨V, hVa, hpV, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := p.base t) (U := ⊤) trivial
  obtain ⟨W', hWa, hqW, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := q.base t) (U := ⊤) trivial
  have hV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := le_top.trans (by simp)
  have hW : W' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := le_top.trans (by simp)
  have hUa : IsAffineOpen (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) :=
    prodOpen_isAffine H hW hV (isAffineOpen_top S) hWa hVa
  have htU : t ∈ prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V := ⟨hqW, hpV⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu1, hu2⟩ := hUa.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W) ⟨t, ht⟩ htU
  have hle : T.basicOpen u ≤ prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V := T.basicOpen_le u
  refine ⟨T.basicOpen u, hu1, hu2, ?_⟩
  haveI := hUa.isLocalization_basicOpen u
  obtain ⟨⟨x, ⟨_, m, rfl⟩⟩, hx⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers u)
    (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hu1).op c)
  have hvu : Van (p ≫ g) ψ (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) (u ^ m) :=
    van_pow ψ (van_prodOpen_all H ψ hY hP hVa hWa u) m
  have hvx := van_prodOpen_all H ψ hY hP hVa hWa x
  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) Γ(T, T.basicOpen u) (u ^ m)) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (M := Submonoid.powers u) Γ(T, T.basicOpen u) ⟨u ^ m, m, rfl⟩
  have hvu' : Van (p ≫ g) ψ (T.basicOpen u)
      (algebraMap Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) Γ(T, T.basicOpen u) (u ^ m)) :=
    van_restrict ψ hle hvu
  have hvx' : Van (p ≫ g) ψ (T.basicOpen u)
      (algebraMap Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W' V) Γ(T, T.basicOpen u) x) :=
    van_restrict ψ hle hvx
  refine van_of_mul_unit ψ hunit ?_ hvu'
  rw [mul_comm]
  simp only at hx
  rw [hx]
  exact hvx'

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.van_of_comp_zero
statement:
theorem van_of_comp_zero {M N : T.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ relativeSheaf h) (ψ : relativeSheaf h ⟶ N)
    (hφψ : φ ≫ ψ = 0) (W : T.Opens) (s : M.val.obj (op W)) (c : Γ(T, W))
    (hs : φ.val.app (op W) s = dsec h W c) : Van h ψ W c
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun χ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (χ.val.app (op W)) s) hφψ
  unfold Van
  rw [← hs]
  exact this

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.cmp_dsec
statement:
theorem cmp_dsec {X Y' T' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y' ⟶ S) (p : T' ⟶ Y') (q : T' ⟶ X)
    (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) (V : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, V)) :
    (cmp f g p q w).val.app (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ V))
      (sectionMap q (relativeSheaf f) V (q ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl
        (sheafifyUnitApp V ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap f).app (op V))).d x))) =
      dsec p (q ⁻¹ᵁ V) (q.app V x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cmp_sectionMap f g p q w V (q ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl]
  have h1 : (cmp1 f g p q w).val.app (op V)
      (sheafifyUnitApp V ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap f).app (op V))).d x)) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op V))
        ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap f).app (op V))).d x) :=
    congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.app (op V))
      ((CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap f).app (op V))).d x)) (unit_cmp1 f g p q w)
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := cmp0_d f g p q w (W := op V) x
  rw [h2]
  have e : ∀ y : ((Nsh p).val.obj (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ V))),
      (Nsh p).val.map (homOfLE (le_rfl : q ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).op y = y := by
    intro y
    have : (homOfLE (le_rfl : q ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).op = 𝟙 _ := rfl
    rw [this]
    simp
  exact e _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.eq_zero_of_incl_comp_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_zero_of_van ψ (fun W c => van_all H ψ (fun V y => ?_) (fun W' w => ?_) W c)
  · exact van_of_comp_zero _ ψ h1 _ _ _ (cmp_dsec g (𝟙 S) (p ≫ g) p (by simp) V y)
  · exact van_of_comp_zero _ ψ h2 _ _ _
      (cmp_dsec f (𝟙 S) (p ≫ g) q (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact H.w.symm) W' w)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.epi_incl_desc
statement:
theorem epi_incl_desc [IsAffine S] (H : IsPullback q p f g) :
    Epi (biprod.desc (incl1 (g := g) (p := p)) (incl2 (f := f) (g := g) (p := p) (q := q) H.w.symm))
proof:
:= by
  refine Preadditive.epi_of_cancel_zero _ (fun {Z} ψ hψ => ?_)
  refine eq_zero_of_incl_comp_zero H ψ ?_ ?_
  · simpa using biprod.inl ≫= hψ
  · simpa using biprod.inr ≫= hψ

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinate_exists_uniform_overlap_extensions
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinate_exists_uniform_overlap_extensions
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i : Fin (n + 1))
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (s : ι →
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
        (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ j : AffineChartIndex n i, ∀ a : ι, ∃ t :
        (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
          (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j.1)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤),
      coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D •
          projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
            R n M i j.1 j.2
            (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
              R n M i j.1 j.2 (s a)) =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M i j.1 j.2.symm t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let y (j : AffineChartIndex n i) (a : ι) :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
      R n M i j.1 j.2
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
        R n M i j.1 j.2 (s a))
  let h := fun j : AffineChartIndex n i =>
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_surj_finite_family_right
      R n M i j.1 j.2.symm (y j)
  let d := fun j : AffineChartIndex n i => (h j).choose
  let x := fun (j : AffineChartIndex n i) (a : ι) =>
    ((h j).choose_spec a).choose
  have hx (j : AffineChartIndex n i) (a : ι) :
      coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ d j • y j a =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M i j.1 j.2.symm (x j a) :=
    ((h j).choose_spec a).choose_spec
  let D := Finset.univ.sup d
  refine ⟨D, fun j a => ?_⟩
  have hjD : d j ≤ D := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ j)
  let f := projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
    R n M i j.1 j.2.symm
  refine ⟨coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d j) • x j a, ?_⟩
  change coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D • y j a =
    f (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d j) • x j a)
  calc
    coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D • y j a =
        coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^
          ((D - d j) + d j) • y j a := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hjD]
    _ = coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d j) •
        (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ d j • y j a) := by
          rw [pow_add, mul_smul]
    _ = coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d j) •
        f (x j a) := by rw [hx]
    _ = f (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d j) • x j a) :=
      (f.map_smul _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_uniform_overlap_extensions
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_uniform_overlap_extensions
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ j : AffineChartIndex n i,
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ∃ t : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
            (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j.1)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤),
        coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D •
            projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
              R n M i j.1 j.2
              (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
                R n M i j.1 j.2
                (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)) =
          projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
            R n M i j.1 j.2.symm t
proof:
:= by
  let G := projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  exact projectiveCoordinate_exists_uniform_overlap_extensions R n M i
    (fun a => projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_overlap_extensions
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_overlap_extensions
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∀ j : AffineChartIndex n i,
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ∃ t : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
            (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j.1)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤),
        coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D •
            projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
              R n M i j.1 j.2
              (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
                R n M i j.1 j.2
                (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)) =
          projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
            R n M i j.1 j.2.symm t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let h := fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_uniform_overlap_extensions R n M i
  let d := fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (h i).choose
  let x := fun (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n i)
      (a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I) =>
    ((h i).choose_spec j a).choose
  let y := fun (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n i)
      (a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I) =>
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
      R n M i j.1 j.2
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
        R n M i j.1 j.2
        (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a))
  have hx (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n i)
      (a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I) :
      coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ d i • y i j a =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M i j.1 j.2.symm (x i j a) :=
    ((h i).choose_spec j a).choose_spec
  let D := Finset.univ.sup d
  refine ⟨D, fun i j a => ?_⟩
  have hiD : d i ≤ D := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i)
  let f := projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
    R n M i j.1 j.2.symm
  refine ⟨coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d i) • x i j a, ?_⟩
  change coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D • y i j a =
    f (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d i) • x i j a)
  calc
    coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D • y i j a =
        coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^
          ((D - d i) + d i) • y i j a := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hiD]
    _ = coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d i) •
        (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ d i • y i j a) := by
          rw [pow_add, mul_smul]
    _ = coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d i) •
        f (x i j a) := by rw [hx]
    _ = f (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ (D - d i) • x i j a) :=
      (f.map_smul _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (hB : CoverKahlerBaseChange g n) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (cover g n).scheme (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover g n).toBase)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hB
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ e.symm
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k n) n))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.cover_cotangent_class_of
statement:
theorem cover_cotangent_class_of (hB : CoverKahlerBaseChange g n) :
    k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover g n).toBase)
        (cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree g n hB) =
      (n + 1) • (cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hB
  have h1 : k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover g n).toBase)
        (cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree g n ⟨e⟩) =
      pullbackK0RingHom (q0 g n)
        (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec k n))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k n) n)) := by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k n) n)) e
  rw [h1, SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.cotangent_classOf]
  simp only [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one, twist_comparison_explicit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.cotangentClass_eq_kahler_of_cover
statement:
theorem cotangentClass_eq_kahler_of_cover (hB : CoverKahlerBaseChange g n)
    (hK : CoverKahlerTransport g n) :
    cotangentClass g n = OMG.kahlerClass g n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨eK⟩ := hK
  have hfl := cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree g n hB
  have h1 : OMG.kahlerClass g n = Psi g n
      (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover g n).toBase) hfl) := by
    unfold OMG.kahlerClass
    simp only [Psi, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ hfl) eK
  rw [h1, cover_cotangent_class_of g n hB]
  simp only [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.twist_comparison_of_snd_eq
statement:
theorem twist_comparison_of_snd_eq (h : (coverIso g n).hom ≫ pullback.snd g (toSpec k n) = q0 g n) :
    pullbackK0RingHom (OMG.sndP g n) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1)) = twistNeg g n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pullbackK0RingHom (OMG.sndP g n) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1)) =
      Psi g n (pullbackK0RingHom ((coverIso g n).hom ≫ OMG.sndP g n)
        (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1))) := by
    rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
    simp only [Psi]
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pullbackK0RingHom_id]
    rfl
  rw [h1]
  change Psi g n (pullbackK0RingHom ((coverIso g n).hom ≫ pullback.snd g (toSpec k n)) _) = _
  rw [h, twist_comparison_explicit]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basis_comparison
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basis_comparison
    {ι : Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (b : ι → Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range b))
    (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (αB :
      (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙
          (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M i).presheaf ⟶
        (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ N.presheaf)
    (hlinear : ∀ (j : ι) (s : Γ(Y, b j))
      (m : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i (b j)),
      αB.app (op j)
          (((affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i (b j)).smul s).hom m) =
        ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom (αB.app (op j) m))
    (hbij : ∀ j, Function.Bijective (αB.app (op j))) :
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  modulePresheafBasisSheafification_isQuasicoherent
    b hB (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M i) N
    αB hlinear hbij

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basicOpen_comparison
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basicOpen_comparison
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (N : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (αB :
      (inducedFunctor (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen : R →
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)).op ⋙
          (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M i).presheaf ⟶
        (inducedFunctor (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen : R →
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)).op ⋙ N.presheaf)
    (hlinear : ∀ (g : R)
      (s : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
      (m : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)),
      αB.app (op g)
          (((affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i
            (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).smul s).hom m) =
        ((N.val.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))).smul s).hom
          (αB.app (op g) m))
    (hbij : ∀ g, Function.Bijective (αB.app (op g))) :
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basis_comparison
    f M i (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen : R →
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
    PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens N αB hlinear hbij

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.evalChartH_toSpec
statement:
theorem evalChartH_toSpec (j : Fin 2) (a : k) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom a)) ≫ chart k j) ≫
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, chart_toSpec, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun b => ?_)
  simp

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ker_chart_idealH
proof:
:= by
  set φ := CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom a) with hφ
  have hr : Set.range (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) ⊆ Set.range (chart k j) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.coe_comp]
    exact Set.range_comp_subset_range _ _
  have hlift : IsOpenImmersion.lift (chart k j) (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) hr = Spec.map φ := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (chart k j), IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]
  have H := IsOpenImmersion.isPullback_lift_id (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) (chart k j) hr
  rw [hlift] at H
  have h1 := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) _ (𝟙 _) (chart k j) H ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  have hker : (Spec.map φ).ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      (RingHom.ker φ.hom).comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).hom.hom := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
    ext x
    have h := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality φ
    have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) h
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map φ)).hom x = 0 ↔ _
    rw [← map_eq_zero_iff (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom.hom
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1, h2]
  have key : (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j).ker.ideal (chartOpenH k j) =
      Ideal.comap (secEquivH k j).symm (RingHom.ker φ.hom) := by
    ext x
    have hx := congrArg (fun I => (((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom.hom x) ∈ I) h1
    simp only [Ideal.mem_comap] at hx
    have hinv : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).inv)
        ((CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom) x) = x := by
      rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]; simp
    rw [hinv, hker] at hx
    refine (Eq.to_iff hx).symm.trans ?_
    exact Iff.rfl
  rw [key, Ideal.comap_symm, show RingHom.ker φ.hom = Ideal.span {Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a} from
    Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom a, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.mOH_eq_zero
statement: theorem mOH_eq_zero : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (α0H k)) ≫ chart k 0 = mOH k
proof:
:= by
  unfold chart mOH
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  have h : (α0H k).comp (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom = HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1) (rfl : x01 k = _) := by
    ext z
    simp [α0H]
  rw [h]
  exact Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι _ _ _ _ _

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.mOH_eq_one
statement: theorem mOH_eq_one : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (α1H k)) ≫ chart k 1 = mOH k
proof:
:= by
  unfold chart mOH
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  have h : (α1H k).comp (chartEquiv k 1).toRingHom = HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) (mul_comm _ _ : x01 k = _) := by
    ext z
    simp [α1H]
  rw [h]
  exact Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι _ _ _ _ _

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.αH_prod
statement: theorem αH_prod : α0H k Polynomial.X * α1H k Polynomial.X = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (chartEquiv k 0).symm Polynomial.X =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩ := by
    rw [← chartEquiv_coordinateRatio k 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩]
    simp
  have h1 : (chartEquiv k 1).symm Polynomial.X =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 1 ⟨0, by decide⟩ := by
    rw [← chartEquiv_coordinateRatio k 1 ⟨0, by decide⟩]
    simp
  simp only [α0H, α1H, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
    h0, h1]
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, Submonoid.coe_one, x01]
  ring

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.mOH_opensRange
statement: theorem mOH_opensRange : (mOH k).opensRange = Proj.basicOpen (grading k 1) (x01 k)
proof:
:=
  Proj.opensRange_awayι _ _ _ _

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.overlapOpenH_eq
statement: theorem overlapOpenH_eq : overlapOpenH k = mOH k ''ᵁ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (chartOpenH k 0).1 = (chart k 0).opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  have h1 : (chartOpenH k 1).1 = (chart k 1).opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  have hm : mOH k ''ᵁ ⊤ = (mOH k).opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  have hx : (mOH k).opensRange = (chart k 0).opensRange ⊓ (chart k 1).opensRange :=
    (mOH_opensRange k).trans ((Proj.basicOpen_mul _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg₂ (· ⊓ ·) (opensRange_chart k 0).symm (opensRange_chart k 1).symm))
  rw [hm, hx]
  exact congrArg₂ (· ⊓ ·) h0 h1

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.overlapOpenH_le
statement:
theorem overlapOpenH_le :
    (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R01H k))).Opens) ≤ mOH k ⁻¹ᵁ overlapOpenH k
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapOpenH_eq, Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq]

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ΦH_isIso
statement: theorem ΦH_isIso : IsIso (ΦH k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ΦH
  refine (Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr (mOH k) (overlapOpenH_le k) (overlapOpenH_eq k) rfl
    (fun {R S} f => IsIso f)).2 ?_
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom']
  infer_instance

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.appLE_eq_of_eqH
statement:
theorem appLE_eq_of_eqH {X Y : Scheme} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (e' : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    Scheme.Hom.appLE f U V e = Scheme.Hom.appLE g U V e'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.trans_genH
statement:
theorem trans_genH (j : Fin 2) (αj : k[X] →+* R01H k)
    (hm : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj) ≫ chart k j = mOH k)
    (hle : overlapOpenH k ≤ (chartOpenH k j).1) (t : k[X]) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (R01H k))).hom.hom
      ((ΦH k).hom ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (secEquivH k j t))) = αj t
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (mOH k) (overlapOpenH_le k) (homOfLE hle).op
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (secEquivH k j t)) h1
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
  change (ΦH k).hom ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (secEquivH k j t)) = _ at h2
  rw [h2]
  have e1 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k[X])).Opens) ≤ chart k j ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpenH k j).1 :=
    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq (chart k j) ⊤).ge
  have e2 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R01H k))).Opens) ≤
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := le_rfl
  have h3 : ∀ e0 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R01H k))).Opens) ≤ mOH k ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpenH k j).1,
      Scheme.Hom.appLE (mOH k) (chartOpenH k j).1 ⊤ e0 =
      Scheme.Hom.appLE (chart k j) (chartOpenH k j).1 ⊤ e1 ≫
        Scheme.Hom.appLE (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) ⊤ ⊤ e2 := by
    intro e0
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
    exact appLE_eq_of_eqH hm.symm _ _ _ _
  rw [h3]
  have h4 : Scheme.Hom.appLE (chart k j) (chartOpenH k j).1 ⊤ e1 = ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom :=
    (Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom' (chart k j) ⊤).symm
  have h5 : Scheme.Hom.appLE (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) ⊤ ⊤ e2 =
      Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) := by
    simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Scheme.Hom.appTop]
  rw [h4, h5, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  have h6 : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom) (secEquivH k j t) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t := by
    change (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom)
      ((CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).inv)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t)) = _
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]; simp
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (R01H k))).hom.hom
    ((Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj))).hom z)) h6).trans ?_
  have h7 := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)
  have h8 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t)) h7
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h8
  refine h8.trans ?_
  have h9 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).hom.hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t) = t := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]; simp
  exact congrArg αj h9

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ΨH_injective
statement: theorem ΨH_injective : Function.Injective (ΨH k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := ΦH_isIso k
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (ΦH k ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (R01H k))).hom)).1

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ΨH_res0
statement:
theorem ΨH_res0 (t : k[X]) :
    ΨH k ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : overlapOpenH k ≤ (chartOpenH k 0).1)).op
      (secEquivH k 0 t)) = α0H k t
proof:
:=
  trans_genH k 0 (α0H k) (mOH_eq_zero k) inf_le_left t

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ΨH_res1
statement:
theorem ΨH_res1 (t : k[X]) :
    ΨH k ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : overlapOpenH k ≤ (chartOpenH k 1).1)).op
      (secEquivH k 1 t)) = α1H k t
proof:
:=
  trans_genH k 1 (α1H k) (mOH_eq_one k) inf_le_right t

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.hcomp_of_polyH
statement:
theorem hcomp_of_polyH (p0 q0 p1 q1 : k[X]) (h : α0H k p0 * α1H k q1 = α1H k p1 * α0H k q0) :
    (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (chartOpenH k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpenH k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpenH k 0).1)).op (secEquivH k 0 p0) *
      (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (chartOpenH k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpenH k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpenH k 1).1)).op (secEquivH k 1 q1) =
    (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (chartOpenH k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpenH k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpenH k 1).1)).op (secEquivH k 1 p1) *
      (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (chartOpenH k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpenH k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpenH k 0).1)).op (secEquivH k 0 q0)
proof:
:= by
  apply ΨH_injective k
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, ΨH_res0, ΨH_res1, ΨH_res1, ΨH_res0]
  exact h

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.chartOpenH_val
statement: theorem chartOpenH_val (j : Fin 2) : (chartOpenH k j).1 = (chart k j).opensRange

:=

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.pointInfH_toSpec
statement: theorem pointInfH_toSpec : pointInfH k ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.not_mem_chart_of_eval_zeroH
statement:
theorem not_mem_chart_of_eval_zeroH (i i' : Fin 2)
    (hD : chart k i ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k i').opensRange = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]))
    (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    chart k i (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) y) ∉
      (chart k i').opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) y ∈
      chart k i ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k i').opensRange := h
  rw [hD] at h1
  apply h1
  change (Polynomial.X : k[X]) ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)) y).asIdeal
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
  simp

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.pointInfH_not_mem
statement:
theorem pointInfH_not_mem (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    pointInfH k y ∉ (chartOpenH k 1).1

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.pointAt_zero_not_memH
statement:
theorem pointAt_zero_not_memH (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0 y ∉ (chartOpenH k 0).1
proof:
:= by
  have := not_mem_chart_of_eval_zeroH k 1 0 (chart_one_preimage k) y
  rw [chartOpenH_val]
  exact this

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ker_ideal_top_of_disjointH
statement:
theorem ker_ideal_top_of_disjointH {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (V : X.affineOpens) (h : ∀ y, f y ∉ V.1) : f.ker.ideal V = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ProjectiveLine.ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support _ V (fun z hz hzs => ?_)
  have hzs' : z ∈ ((Scheme.Hom.ker f).support : Set X) := hzs
  rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker, f.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at hzs'
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hzs'
  exact h y hz

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.chartOpenH_sup_eq_top

:= by
  have h := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k 1
  rw [chartOpenH_val, chartOpenH_val]
  refine top_le_iff.mp ?_
  rw [← h]
  refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i
  · exact (opensRange_chart k 0).symm.le.trans le_sup_left
  · exact (opensRange_chart k 1).symm.le.trans le_sup_right

statement: theorem pointAt_zero_ker_ne_botH : (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:

  set z := pointInfH k y with hz

    rw [hy', ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  apply pointInfH_not_mem k y

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.exists_cartierData_P1_zero_inf
statement:
theorem exists_cartierData_P1_zero_inf [IsDomain k] :
    ∃ (𝓛 : (P1 k).Modules) (_ : HasConstantRank (P1 k) 𝓛 1)
      (σc σi : tensorUnitSheaf (P1 k) ⟶ 𝓛),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SectionIsRegular σc ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SectionIsRegular σi ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σc = (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0).ker ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σi = (pointInfH k).ker
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral (P1 k) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isIntegral_space k 1
  have hcov := chartOpenH_sup_eq_top k
  have hX : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (0 : k) : k[X]) ≠ 0 := Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero 0
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_two_sections_of_charts
    (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0).ker (pointInfH k).ker
    (pointAt_zero_ker_ne_botH k) (pointInfH_ker_ne_bot k) (chartOpenH k 0) (chartOpenH k 1) hcov
    (secEquivH k 0 1) (secEquivH k 1 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 0))
    ?_ (ker_pointAt_zero_U1H k) ?_ (secEquivH_ne_zero k 1 hX)
    (secEquivH k 0 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 0)) (secEquivH k 1 1)
    (ker_pointInfH_U0 k) ?_ ?_
  · rw [ker_pointAt_zero_U0H, map_one, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
  · exact secEquivH_ne_zero k 0 one_ne_zero
  · rw [ker_pointInfH_U1, map_one, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
  · refine hcomp_of_polyH k _ _ _ _ ?_
    simp only [map_one, mul_one, map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact αH_prod k

name: ARRKG2A.zeroSection_isoE0
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isoE0 (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) :
    (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ (isoE0 D CN).hom =
      (localFrameCover A J D.cover).zeroSection ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J D.cover).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hL := quotientSection_isoUnionLeft (Cov CN)
    (localFrameCover A J D.cover) biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
  have hR := quotientSection_isoUnionRight (Cov CN)
    (localFrameCover A J D.cover) biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
  have e : ((Cov CN).zeroSection ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (Cov CN)
          (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).hom) ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionRight (Cov CN)
          (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).inv =
      (localFrameCover A J D.cover).zeroSection := by
    refine (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ _) hL).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ _) hR.symm).trans ?_
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  have hiso : (isoE0 D CN).hom =
      (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (Cov CN)
          (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).hom ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionRight (Cov CN)
          (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).inv ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J D.cover).hom := by
    simp only [isoE0, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [hiso, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (localFrameComponentIso A J D.cover).hom) e

name: ARRKG2A.hzs_of_chart
statement:
theorem hzs_of_chart (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) (hc : ChartGate D) :
    (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ EιOfIso D CN =
      secInf A J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : EιOfIso D CN =
      (isoE0 D CN).hom ≫ componentToTotal A J := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Category.assoc, zeroSection_isoE0 D CN, Category.assoc]
  refine (localFrameCover A J D.cover).baseCover.hom_ext _ _
    fun (i : D.cover.J) ↦ ?_
  have h2 := (localFrameCover A J D.cover).baseCover_quotientSection biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i
  have h3 : (localFrameCover A J D.cover).baseCover.f i ≫
      (localFrameCover A J D.cover).zeroSection ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J D.cover).hom ≫
          componentToTotal A J =
      (localFrameCover A J D.cover).chartSection biprod.snd
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i ≫
        localFrameToTotal A J D.cover i := by
    have e3 : (localFrameCover A J D.cover).chartι i ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J D.cover).hom ≫
          componentToTotal A J =
        localFrameToTotal A J D.cover i :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun g => g ≫ componentToTotal A J)
          (localFrameComponentIso_chart A J D.cover i)).trans
          (localFrameToTotal_recovery A J D.cover i).symm)
    refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (localFrameComponentIso A J D.cover).hom ≫
        componentToTotal A J) h2)).trans ?_
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => _ ≫ g) e3)
  exact h3.trans (hc i)

name: ARRKG2A.hbcP_of_zeroSection
statement:
theorem hbcP_of_zeroSection (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤)) (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J))
    (hzs : (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ EιOfIso D CN =
      secInf A J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
    (w : K0 (Ws A J)) :
    pullbackK0 (EιOfIso D CN) (FpK D w) =
      spK CN (resE D CN) (r₁K A J w)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (Cov CN).isNoetherian_scheme
  haveI : IsNoetherian (Zs A J) := inferInstance
  let G := oeGate A φ J
  haveI := G.qc
  haveI := G.fp
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
  let ε := EιOfIso D CN
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ε := by
    unfold ε EιOfIso
    infer_instance
  let I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ
  have hker1 : I.subschemeι.ker = (componentToTotal A J).ker := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact G.hid
  have hkerE : ε.ker = I.subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [hker1]
    exact Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso _ _
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
  let κ : Es CN ⟶ I.subscheme := IsClosedImmersion.lift I.subschemeι ε hkerE.symm.le
  have hκ : κ ≫ I.subschemeι = ε := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsIso κ := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_of_ker_eq ε I.subschemeι κ hκ hkerE
  haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase A J
  haveI hρ : IsIso (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase A J) :=
    CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq F (totalToClosedBase A J) I.subschemeι
      (componentToTotal A J) hker1
  haveI : IsFinite F := inferInstance
  have hL := G.hL
  have hreg := G.hreg
  have hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval G.σ)) :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional A J G.σ k
      φ hL hreg G.hid
  have hres := CIIL3B.bijective_k0ToG0_of_resolution (D.resM)
  have hy : k0ToG0 (Ms A J) (FpK D w) = finitePushforward F (k0ToG0 (Ws A J) w) :=
    ARRL1C.k0ToG0_Fp (D.resM) F w
  have hG := hbcE_general G.σ F hL hreg hs hres w _ hy
  have hψη := inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf A J I.subschemeι hker1
  let ρ : pullback F I.subschemeι ≅ Zs A J :=
    asIso (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase A J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback F I.subschemeι) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)
  have hsec : ρ.inv ≫ pullback.fst F I.subschemeι = secInf A J := hψη
  have hzsκ : (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ κ = ρ.inv ≫ pullback.snd F I.subschemeι := by
    rw [← cancel_mono I.subschemeι, Category.assoc, hκ, hzs, Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition,
      ← Category.assoc, hsec]
  have hzs' : ρ.inv ≫ pullback.snd F I.subschemeι ≫ (asIso κ).inv = (Cov CN).zeroSection := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hzsκ]
    simp
  have hcomp : ∀ x : G0 (Zs A J),
      finitePushforward (asIso κ).inv (finitePushforward (pullback.snd F I.subschemeι)
        (finitePushforward ρ.inv x)) =
      finitePushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection x := by
    intro x
    have h1 := finitePushforward_congr hzs'
    rw [← h1, ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp ρ.inv (pullback.snd F I.subschemeι ≫ (asIso κ).inv),
      ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp (pullback.snd F I.subschemeι) (asIso κ).inv]
    rfl
  have e1 : pullbackK0 ε (FpK D w) =
      pullbackK0 (asIso κ).hom (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι (FpK D w)) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply]
    simp [hκ]
  have step : k0ToG0 (Es CN) (pullbackK0 ε (FpK D w)) =
      finitePushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) (r₁K A J w)) := by
    have hr1 : r₁K A J w = pullbackK0 (secInf A J) w := pullbackK0RingHom_apply _ _
    rw [e1, k0ToG0_pullbackK0_iso, hG,
      k0ToG0_eq_pushforward_inv ρ (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι) w),
      pullbackK0_comp_apply, hsec, hcomp, hr1]
  calc pullbackK0 ε (FpK D w)
      = (resE D CN).res
          (k0ToG0 (Es CN) (pullbackK0 ε (FpK D w))) :=
        (DFunLike.congr_fun (resE D CN).left _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [step]; rfl

name: ARRKG2A.chartGate_of_range
statement: theorem chartGate_of_range (hr : RangeGate D) : ChartGate D
proof:
:= by
  unfold ChartGate
  intro (i : (localFrameCover A J D.cover).I)
  haveI : IsReduced (Zs A J) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsReduced ((localFrameCover A J D.cover).U i).toScheme := inferInstance
  haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase A J
  let C := localFrameCover A J D.cover
  let cs := C.chartSection biprod.snd (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := exists_factor_of_range F
    (cs ≫ localFrameToTotal A J D.cover i) (hr i)
  let e := cs ≫ localFrameToComponent A J D.cover i
  have hAe : cs ≫ localFrameToTotal A J D.cover i =
      e ≫ componentToTotal A J := by
    rw [localFrameToTotal_recovery]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hcond : h ≫ F = e ≫ componentToTotal A J := hh.trans hAe
  have hbase : e ≫ componentToCentre A J = C.baseCover.f i :=
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun g => cs ≫ g)
        (localFrameToComponent_toCentre A J D.cover i)).trans
        (C.chartSection_chartToAmbient biprod.snd
          (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i))
  have hh2 : h ≫ totalToClosedBase A J = C.baseCover.f i := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (iZ A J)]
    have h3 := totalToClosedBase_subschemeι A J
    have h4 := componentToTotal_toBase A J
    calc (h ≫ totalToClosedBase A J) ≫ iZ A J
        = h ≫ F ≫ totalGlobalToBase A J := by
          rw [Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun g => h ≫ g) h3
      _ = (e ≫ componentToTotal A J) ≫ totalGlobalToBase A J := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, hcond]
      _ = e ≫ componentToCentre A J ≫ iZ A J := by
          rw [Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun g => e ≫ g) h4
      _ = C.baseCover.f i ≫ iZ A J :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ iZ A J) hbase)
  let ρ := pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) ≫ totalToClosedBase A J
  have hlift : pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ ρ = C.baseCover.f i := by
    simp only [ρ, ← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
    exact hh2
  have hL : pullback.lift h e hcond = C.baseCover.f i ≫ inv ρ := by
    exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun g => pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ g)
      (IsIso.hom_inv_id ρ).symm).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ inv ρ) hlift)))
  have hsec := inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf A J (componentToTotal A J) rfl
  have hsec' : inv ρ ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) = secInf A J := hsec
  calc cs ≫ localFrameToTotal A J D.cover i = h ≫ F := hh.symm
    _ = (pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J)) ≫ F := by
        rw [pullback.lift_fst]
    _ = C.baseCover.f i ≫ secInf A J ≫ F := by
        rw [hL]
        exact (congrArg (fun g => (g ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J)) ≫ F) rfl).trans
          (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => (C.baseCover.f i ≫ inv ρ) ≫ g)
            (rfl : pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) ≫ F =
              pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) ≫ F))).trans
            (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => C.baseCover.f i ≫ g)
              ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ F) hsec')))).trans rfl))

name: ARRKG2A.hbcP_of_range
statement:
