name: SchemeKTheory.derivative_map'
statement:
theorem derivative_map' {A : Type v} {B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (g : A →+* B)
    (p : PowerSeries A) :
    d⁄dX B (PowerSeries.map g p) = PowerSeries.map g (d⁄dX A p)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [coeff_derivative, coeff_map, map_mul, map_add, map_natCast]

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_eq_of_mul'
statement:
theorem logDeriv_eq_of_mul' {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (u : (PowerSeries B)ˣ) (S : PowerSeries B)
    (h : S * (u : PowerSeries B) = X * d⁄dX B (u : PowerSeries B)) : logDeriv u = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDeriv, ← h, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_map'
statement:
theorem logDeriv_map' {A : Type v} {B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (g : A →+* B)
    (u : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) :
    logDeriv (Units.map (PowerSeries.map g).toMonoidHom u) = PowerSeries.map g (logDeriv u)
proof:
:= by
  apply logDeriv_eq_of_mul'
  rw [Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, ← map_mul, logDeriv_mul_self,
    map_mul, map_X, derivative_map']

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_adams
statement:
theorem rankAt_adams (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Y) :
    rankAtRingHom y (adams Y (k + 1) x) = rankAtRingHom y x
proof:
:= by
  have hU := map_rank_lambdaT_eq hrank y x
  rw [adams_apply]
  change rankAtRingHom y ((-1 : K0 Y) ^ (k + 1 + 1) *
    coeff (k + 1) (logDeriv (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x)))) = _
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
  have h1 : rankAtRingHom y (coeff (k + 1) (logDeriv (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x)))) =
      coeff (k + 1) (logDeriv (onePlusXUnit ^ (rankAtRingHom y x))) := by
    rw [← coeff_map, ← logDeriv_map', hU]
  have hu : ((onePlusXUnit : (ℤ⟦X⟧)ˣ) : ℤ⟦X⟧) = 1 + C 1 * X := by
    simp [onePlusXUnit]
  have h2 : logDeriv (onePlusXUnit ^ (rankAtRingHom y x)) =
      (rankAtRingHom y x) • logDeriv onePlusXUnit := by
    have := map_zsmul (logDerivHom (A := ℤ)) (rankAtRingHom y x) (Additive.ofMul onePlusXUnit)
    simpa [logDerivHom, ofMul_zpow] using this
  rw [h1, h2, map_zsmul, coeff_succ_logDeriv_of_eq 1 onePlusXUnit hu k]
  simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, one_pow, mul_one, Int.cast_id]
  have := neg_one_pow_mul_neg_one_pow (A := ℤ) k (rankAtRingHom y x)
  linear_combination this

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_mem_rankZeroIdeal
statement:
theorem adams_mem_rankZeroIdeal (k : ℕ) {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    adams Y (k + 1) x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:=
  mem_rankZeroIdeal.2 fun y => by rw [rankAt_adams hrank y k, mem_rankZeroIdeal.1 hx y]

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClassB12.mul
statement:
lemma IsLineClassB12.mul {a b : K0 Y} (ha : IsLineClassB12 a) (hb : IsLineClassB12 b) :
    IsLineClassB12 (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, ha'⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hb'⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨hP, hPe⟩ := classOf_mul_rankOne hN hM
  exact ⟨tensorSheaf Y N M, hP, by rw [ha', hb']; exact hPe⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClassB12.one
statement: lemma IsLineClassB12.one : IsLineClassB12 (1 : K0 Y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨tensorUnitSheaf Y, hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf, one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClassB12.pow
statement: lemma IsLineClassB12.pow {a : K0 Y} (ha : IsLineClassB12 a) (n : ℕ) : IsLineClassB12 (a ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using IsLineClassB12.one
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact ih.mul ha

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClassB12.multiset_prod
statement:
lemma IsLineClassB12.multiset_prod (s : Multiset (K0 Y)) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, IsLineClassB12 a) :
    IsLineClassB12 s.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simpa using IsLineClassB12.one
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons]
    exact (hs a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)).mul
      (ih fun b hb => hs b (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hb))

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_of_isLineClass
statement:
lemma adams_of_isLineClass (k : ℕ) {a : K0 Y} (ha : IsLineClassB12 a) :
    adams Y (k + 1) a = a ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact adams_classOf_rankOne Y N hN k

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_multiset_prod
statement:
lemma adams_multiset_prod (k : ℕ) (s : Multiset (K0 Y)) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, IsLineClassB12 a) :
    adams Y (k + 1) s.prod = (s.map fun a => a ^ (k + 1)).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_of_isLineClass k (IsLineClassB12.multiset_prod s hs), Multiset.prod_map_pow,
    Multiset.map_id']

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_esymm
statement:
lemma adams_esymm (k n : ℕ) (s : Multiset (K0 Y)) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, IsLineClassB12 a) :
    adams Y (k + 1) (s.esymm n) = (s.map fun a => a ^ (k + 1)).esymm n
proof:
:= by
  unfold Multiset.esymm
  rw [map_multiset_sum, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.powersetCard_map, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl fun T hT => ?_
  have hTs : T ≤ s := (Multiset.mem_powersetCard.1 hT).1
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  exact adams_multiset_prod k T fun a ha => hs a (Multiset.mem_of_le hTs ha)

name: SchemeKTheory.coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X
statement:
lemma coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X (n : ℕ) (s : Multiset (K0 Y)) :
    coeff n (s.map fun a => (1 + C a * X : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).prod = s.esymm n
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction generalizing n with
  | empty =>
    rcases n with _ | n <;> simp [Multiset.esymm]
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_mul, map_add, map_one, map_mul, constantCoeff_C,
        constantCoeff_X, mul_zero, add_zero, one_mul, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, ih]
      simp [Multiset.esymm]
    · have e : (1 + C a * X : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧) * (s.map fun a => (1 + C a * X : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).prod =
          (s.map fun a => (1 + C a * X : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).prod +
            C a * ((s.map fun a => (1 + C a * X : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).prod * X) := by ring
      rw [e, map_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_mul_X, ih, ih]
      unfold Multiset.esymm
      rw [Multiset.powersetCard_cons, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.map_map]
      congr 1
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Multiset.prod_cons]
      rw [Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaT_multiset_sum
statement:
lemma lambdaT_multiset_sum (s : Multiset (K0 Y)) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, IsLineClassB12 a) :
    ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y s.sum) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧) =
      (s.map fun a => (1 + C a * X : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.sum_cons, map_add, toMul_add, Units.val_mul, Multiset.map_cons,
      Multiset.prod_cons, ih fun b hb => hs b (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hb)]
    obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hs a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    rw [lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit, lambdaSeries_rankOne Y N hN]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaOp_multiset_sum
statement:
lemma lambdaOp_multiset_sum (n : ℕ) (s : Multiset (K0 Y)) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, IsLineClassB12 a) :
    lambdaOp Y n s.sum = s.esymm n
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaOp, lambdaT_multiset_sum s hs, coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaT_ringHom_of
statement:
theorem lambdaT_ringHom_of {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (φ : K0 Z →+* K0 W)
    (h : ∀ (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) (n : ℕ),
      φ (lambdaClass Z E hE n) = lambdaOp W n (φ (k0ClassOf Z E hE))) (x : K0 Z) :
    Additive.toMul (lambdaT W (φ x)) =
      Units.map (PowerSeries.map φ).toMonoidHom (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Z x))
proof:
:= by
  let Φ₁ : K0 Z →+ Additive (K0 W)⟦X⟧ˣ := (lambdaT W).comp φ.toAddMonoidHom
  let Φ₂ : K0 Z →+ Additive (K0 W)⟦X⟧ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.toAdditive (Units.map (PowerSeries.map φ).toMonoidHom)).comp (lambdaT Z)
  have hh : Φ₁ = Φ₂ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change lambdaT W (φ (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)) = Additive.ofMul (Units.map
      (PowerSeries.map φ).toMonoidHom (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))))
    rw [lambdaT_classOf]
    rw [toMul_ofMul]
    have : lambdaT W (φ (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)) = Additive.ofMul
        (Additive.toMul (lambdaT W (φ (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)))) := rfl
    rw [this]
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    rw [Units.coe_map, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit]
    ext n
    change _ = coeff n (PowerSeries.map φ (lambdaSeries Z E.1 E.2))
    rw [coeff_map]
    change lambdaOp W n (φ (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)) = _
    rw [← h, coeff_lambdaSeries]
  exact congrArg (fun ψ : K0 Z →+ Additive (K0 W)⟦X⟧ˣ => Additive.toMul (ψ x)) hh

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass_eq
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass_eq {W Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : W ⟶ Z) [Flat q]
    (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) (n : ℕ) :
    flatPullbackK0RingHom q (lambdaClass Z E hE n) =
      lambdaOp W n (flatPullbackK0RingHom q (k0ClassOf Z E hE))
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : ∀ (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E),
      flatPullbackK0RingHom q (k0ClassOf Z E hE) = k0ClassOf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global q E hE) := fun E hE => by
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  rw [lambdaClass_pullback_of q (flatPullbackK0RingHom q) hφ, hφ, lambdaOp_classOf]

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp {W Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : W ⟶ Z) [Flat q] (n : ℕ) (x : K0 Z) :
    flatPullbackK0 q (lambdaOp Z n x) = lambdaOp W n (flatPullbackK0 q x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  have := lambdaT_ringHom_of (flatPullbackK0RingHom q) (flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass_eq q) x
  have h2 := congrArg (fun u : (K0 W)⟦X⟧ˣ => coeff n (u : (K0 W)⟦X⟧)) this
  simp only [Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, coeff_map] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_lambdaClass
statement:
theorem adams_lambdaClass (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (k n : ℕ) :
    adams X (k + 1) (lambdaClass X E hE n) =
      lambdaOp X n (adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X E hE))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hrank E hE
  obtain ⟨Y, q, _, _, L, hL, M, hM, hinj, hlamE, -⟩ := splitting_principle_two pbInjectiveHyp hr hr
  apply hinj
  have hqE := pullback_classOf_eq_sum_of_lambda q E _ L hL hlamE
  have hline : ∀ a ∈ (Finset.univ.val.map fun i => k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree),
      IsLineClassB12 a := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 ha
    exact ⟨L i, hL i, rfl⟩
  rw [flatPullbackK0_adams, hlamE n, flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp, flatPullbackK0_adams, hqE,
    adams_esymm k n _ hline]
  have hsum : (∑ i, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      (Finset.univ.val.map fun i => k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree).sum := rfl
  have hpow : ∀ a ∈ (Finset.univ.val.map fun i => k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree),
      adams Y (k + 1) a = a ^ (k + 1) := fun a ha => adams_of_isLineClass k (hline a ha)
  have h3 : adams Y (k + 1) (∑ i, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      ((Finset.univ.val.map fun i => k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree).map
        fun a => a ^ (k + 1)).sum := by
    rw [hsum, map_multiset_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Multiset.map_congr rfl hpow
  rw [h3, lambdaOp_multiset_sum]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 ha
  exact (hline b hb).pow (k + 1)

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_lambdaClass
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_lambdaClass {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (n : ℕ) :
    adamsRingHom hrank m (lambdaClass X E hE n) =
      lambdaOp X n (adamsRingHom hrank m (k0ClassOf X E hE))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank hm, adamsRingHom_apply hrank hm]
  exact adams_lambdaClass hrank E hE k n

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_lambdaT
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_lambdaT {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : K0 X) :
    Additive.toMul (lambdaT X (adamsRingHom hrank m x)) =
      Units.map (PowerSeries.map (adamsRingHom hrank m)).toMonoidHom
        (Additive.toMul (lambdaT X x))
proof:
:=
  lambdaT_ringHom_of (adamsRingHom hrank m) (adamsRingHom_lambdaClass hrank hm) x

name: SchemeKTheory.map_gammaSubst
statement:
lemma map_gammaSubst {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (g : A →+* B) (f : A⟦X⟧) :
    PowerSeries.map g (gammaSubst f) = gammaSubst (PowerSeries.map g f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSubst_apply, gammaSubst_apply]
  have e : PowerSeries.map g (f.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)) =
      (PowerSeries.map g f).subst (PowerSeries.map g (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)) :=
    map_subst hasSubst_gammaSub _
  rw [e, map_gammaSub]

name: SchemeKTheory.map_adamsRingHom_gammaSeries
statement:
theorem map_adamsRingHom_gammaSeries {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : K0 X) :
    PowerSeries.map (adamsRingHom hrank m) (gammaSeries X x) =
      gammaSeries X (adamsRingHom hrank m x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun u : (K0 X)⟦X⟧ˣ => (u : (K0 X)⟦X⟧)) (adamsRingHom_lambdaT hrank hm x)
  simp only [Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe] at h
  rw [gammaSeries, gammaSeries, h, map_gammaSubst]

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_gammaOp
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_gammaOp {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (n : ℕ) (x : K0 X) :
    adamsRingHom hrank m (gammaOp X n x) = gammaOp X n (adamsRingHom hrank m x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaOp, gammaOp, ← map_adamsRingHom_gammaSeries hrank hm, coeff_map]

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_mem_FilGamma
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_mem_FilGamma {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (p : ℕ) {a : K0 X}
    (ha : a ∈ FilGamma X p) : adamsRingHom hrank m a ∈ FilGamma X p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  have hle : FilGamma X p ≤ Ideal.comap (adamsRingHom hrank (k + 1)) (FilGamma X p) := by
    refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨l, hl, hw, rfl⟩
    show adamsRingHom hrank (k + 1) _ ∈ FilGamma X p
    refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨l.map fun pr => (pr.1, adamsRingHom hrank (k + 1) pr.2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro pr hpr
      obtain ⟨pr', hpr', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hpr
      rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank hm]
      exact adams_mem_rankZeroIdeal hrank k (hl pr' hpr')
    · simpa [Function.comp_def] using hw
    · rw [map_list_prod, List.map_map, List.map_map]
      congr 1
      refine List.map_congr_left fun pr _ => ?_
      exact adamsRingHom_gammaOp hrank hm pr.1 pr.2
  exact hle ha

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_rankOne_sub_one
statement:
theorem adams_rankOne_sub_one (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (k : ℕ) :
    adams Y (k + 1) (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) =
      k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ (k + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, adams_classOf_rankOne Y L hL, adams_one_eq_one (X := Y) k]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_rankOne_sub_one_eq_sum
statement:
theorem adams_rankOne_sub_one_eq_sum (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (k : ℕ) :
    adams Y (k + 1) (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k + 1).choose (i + 1) : K0 Y) *
        (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) ^ (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_rankOne_sub_one L hL k]
  set a := k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h := add_pow (a - 1) 1 (k + 1)
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  rw [h, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (k + 1)]
  simp only [one_pow, mul_one, pow_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.kahlerClass_composite_PY
statement:
theorem kahlerClass_composite_PY :
    kahlerClassPY (Y := Y) n d =
      pullbackK0RingHom (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
        (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Y ↘ Spk k) d).isFiniteLocallyFree) +
      T1KG3.OMG.kahlerClass (Y ↘ Spk k) n
proof:
:=
  kahlerClass_composite (Y ↘ Spk k) n d

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.prodOpen_isAffine
statement:
theorem prodOpen_isAffine (hV₀ : IsAffineOpen V₀) (hWa : IsAffineOpen W) (hVa : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsAffineOpen (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W V)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE H hV hW (UY := prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W V) rfl
  have : IsAffine V := hVa
  have : IsAffine W := hWa
  have : IsAffine V₀ := hV₀
  exact .of_isIso hP.isoPullback.hom

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.prodOpen_isPushout
statement:
theorem prodOpen_isPushout (hV₀ : IsAffineOpen V₀) (hWa : IsAffineOpen W) (hVa : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout (f.appLE V₀ W hW) (g.appLE V₀ V hV)
      (q.appLE W (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W V) (by simp [prodOpen]))
      (p.appLE V (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W V) (by simp [prodOpen]))
proof:
:= by
  have := (isIso_pushoutSection_iff H hV hW (UY := prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) W V) rfl).1
    (isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen H hV hW rfl hV₀ hVa hWa)
  exact this

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.basis_baseChange
statement:
theorem basis_baseChange {R Sy A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing Sy] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R Sy] [Algebra A B] [Algebra Sy B] [Algebra R B]
    [IsScalarTower R A B] [IsScalarTower R Sy B] [Algebra.IsPushout R Sy A B] {I : Type u}
    (b : Module.Basis I A Ω[A⁄R]) :
    ∃ b' : Module.Basis I B Ω[B⁄Sy], ∀ i, b' i = KaehlerDifferential.map R Sy A B (b i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(b.baseChange B).map (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv R Sy A B), fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [Module.Basis.map_apply, Module.Basis.baseChange_apply]
  have key : ∀ x : Ω[A⁄R], KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv R Sy A B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ x) =
      KaehlerDifferential.map R Sy A B x := by
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range (KaehlerDifferential.D R A)) := by
      rw [KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation]; trivial
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv_tmul_D, KaehlerDifferential.map_D, one_smul]
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    | smul c y _ hy =>
      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← algebraMap_smul B c, map_smul, hy, map_smul,
        algebraMap_smul B c]
  exact key _

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.appLE_comp_eq
statement:
theorem appLE_comp_eq (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) {U : T.Opens} (hU1 : U ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ W) (hU2 : U ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    f.appLE V₀ W hW ≫ q.appLE W U hU1 = g.appLE V₀ V hV ≫ p.appLE V U hU2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
  exact appLE_congr_hom w.symm V₀ U _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.cmp0_frame
statement:
theorem cmp0_frame (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) {U : T.Opens} (hU1 : U ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ W) (hU2 : U ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (b : letI := (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom.toAlgebra; Ω[Γ(X, W)⁄Γ(S, V₀)]) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (g.appLE V₀ V hV).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) := (q.appLE W U hU1).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, U) := (p.appLE V U hU2).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V₀) Γ(T, U) := ((q.appLE W U hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, U) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change ((q.appLE W U hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom) =
        (p.appLE V U hU2).hom.comp (g.appLE V₀ V hV).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, appLE_comp_eq f g p q hW hV w hU1 hU2])
    ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op W)) (compareMap f hW b)) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app (op U))
        (compareMap p hU2 (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) b)) := by
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := (g.appLE V₀ V hV).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) := (q.appLE W U hU1).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, U) := (p.appLE V U hU2).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, V₀) Γ(T, U) := ((q.appLE W U hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, U) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change ((q.appLE W U hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ W hW).hom) =
        (p.appLE V U hU2).hom.comp (g.appLE V₀ V hV).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, appLE_comp_eq f g p q hW hV w hU1 hU2])
  revert b
  rw [← funext_iff]
  refine Cotangent.kaehler_semilinear_ext (M := ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).obj (op U)) (q.appLE W U hU1).hom _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · change ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op W)) (compareMap f hW 0)) = 0
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op)).map_zero
  · change ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app (op U))
        (compareMap p hU2 (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) 0)) = 0
    rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  · intro x y
    change ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op W)) (compareMap f hW (x + y))) = _
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op)).map_add _ _
  · intro x y
    change ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app (op U))
        (compareMap p hU2 (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) (x + y))) = _
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
  · intro a x
    change ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op W)) (compareMap f hW (a • x))) = _
    rw [map_smul]
    have h2 := (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op W))).map_smul a (compareMap f hW x)
    refine (congrArg _ h2).trans ?_
    exact PresheafOfModules.map_smul ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)) (homOfLE hU1).op (q.app W a) _
  · intro a x
    change ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app (op U))
        (compareMap p hU2 (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) (a • x))) = _
    rw [map_smul, ← algebraMap_smul Γ(T, U) a, map_smul, map_smul]
    rfl
  · intro b0
    have l1 : compareMap f hW (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) b0) =
        CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := (baseMap f).app (op W)) b0 := by
      letI := baseAlgebra f hW
      letI : Algebra (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) := (baseInclusion f W).hom.toAlgebra
      haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      exact KaehlerDifferential.map_D Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) Γ(X, W) b0
    have l2 : ∀ c : Γ(T, U), compareMap p hU2 (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, U) c) =
        CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := (baseMap p).app (op U)) c := by
      intro c
      letI := baseAlgebra p hU2
      letI : Algebra (baseSubring p U) Γ(T, U) := (baseInclusion p U).hom.toAlgebra
      haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, V) (baseSubring p U) Γ(T, U) :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      exact KaehlerDifferential.map_D Γ(Y, V) (baseSubring p U) Γ(T, U) Γ(T, U) c
    have l3 : KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U)
        (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) b0) =
        KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, U) (algebraMap Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U) b0) :=
      KaehlerDifferential.map_D _ _ _ _ b0
    change ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj (Nsh p)).map (homOfLE hU1).op
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app (op W)) (compareMap f hW
          (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) b0))) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app (op U)) (compareMap p hU2
        (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, W) Γ(T, U)
          (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) b0)))
    rw [l1, l3, l2, cmp0_d f g p q w b0, dAdd_apply]
    have h1 := PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
      (baseMap p) (homOfLE hU1).op (q.app W b0)
    have h2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (etaN p) (homOfLE hU1).op
      ((DD p q W).d (q.app W b0))
    exact h2.symm.trans (congrArg (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app _)) h1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.pb_neg_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : C * pullbackK0RingHom f B = 1 := by
    rw [← h, ← map_mul, hAB, map_one]
  calc pullbackK0RingHom f B = (D * C) * pullbackK0RingHom f B := by
        rw [mul_comm D C, hCD, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.rho0_hom_caseISpaceIso
statement:
theorem rho0_hom_caseISpaceIso :
    D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) Equiv.ulift ≫
      (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  haveI := D35.isIso_chartι (k := k) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
  unfold D35.rho0 CASE1.caseISpaceIso

    AffineFrameCover.standardChartIso]

      (mapIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv n).inv := rfl
  rw [e1]
  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.rho0_eq_inv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.rho0_twist
statement:
theorem rho0_twist (d : ℤ) :
    pullbackK0RingHom (D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) Equiv.ulift)
        (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n d) =
      (D35.singleCover (k := k) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho0_eq_inv]
  have h1 : pullbackK0RingHom (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).hom
      ((CASE1.caseICover k n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d) =
        projectiveTwistingK0Class k n d := by
    unfold AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class projectiveTwistingK0Class
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (CASE1B.caseITwistIso k n d)
  have h3 : ∀ x : K0 (CASE1.caseICover k n).scheme,
      pullbackK0RingHom (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).inv
        (pullbackK0RingHom (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).hom x) = x := by
    intro x
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp]
    erw [Iso.inv_hom_id, pullbackK0RingHom_id]
    rfl
  calc pullbackK0RingHom (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).inv (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n d)
      = pullbackK0RingHom (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).inv
          (pullbackK0RingHom (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).hom
            ((CASE1.caseICover k n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d)) := by rw [h1]
    _ = _ := h3 _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.OMGC.isPullback_q0
statement:
theorem isPullback_q0 :
    IsPullback (q0 g n) (cover g n).toBase (toSpec k n) g
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (i1 g n).hom ≫ (Dc g n).toBase = (cover g n).toBase :=
    AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase (freeEq g n) (Dc g n)
  have hp0 : IsPullback (ppm g n) (Dc g n).toBase (Cs (k := k) n).toBase g :=
    (Cs (k := k) n).isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g
  haveI : IsIso (D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := J.{u} n) Equiv.ulift) := inferInstance
  have hp1 : IsPullback (ppm g n ≫ D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := J.{u} n) Equiv.ulift)
      (Dc g n).toBase (toSpec k n) g := by
    refine hp0.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (asIso (D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := J.{u} n) Equiv.ulift))
      (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp [D35.rho0_toSpec]
    · simp
  refine hp1.of_iso (i1 g n).symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [q0]
  · simpa using (Iso.eq_inv_comp (i1 g n)).mpr h1
  · simp
  · simp

name: STEPW.psiQ_tmul

proof:
:= by

proof:
:= by

name: STEPW.qQ_injective
statement: theorem qQ_injective (q : R →+* T) (hq : Function.Injective q) : Function.Injective (qQ q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (R := ℤ) (M := ℚ)
    q.toIntAlgHom.toLinearMap hq
  have : ⇑(qQ q) = ⇑(LinearMap.lTensor ℚ q.toIntAlgHom.toLinearMap) := by
    funext x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul c r => simp
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  rw [this]
  exact h

name: STEPW.one_tmul_mem_Vq
statement: theorem one_tmul_mem_Vq {m : ℕ} {t : T} (ht : t ∈ F m) : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t ∈ Vq F m
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

name: STEPW.filt_tensor
statement: theorem filt_tensor (h : FiltData φ ρ F M) : Filt (fun j ↦ psiQ (φ j)) (rhoQ ρ) (Vq F) M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (h.anti m))
  · have : ((F (M + 1) : AddSubgroup T) : Set T) = {0} := by rw [h.bot]; rfl
    simp [Vq, this]
  · intro v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.nil t ht
      exact ⟨n, by
        show ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) ^ n = 0
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, hn, one_pow, tmul_zero]⟩
    | zero => exact IsNilpotent.zero
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact Commute.isNilpotent_add (Commute.all _ _) hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨n, by rw [smul_pow, hn, smul_zero]⟩
  · intro v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.zero t ht
      refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨(n : ℚ) • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] T), ?_, (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (t - (n : T)),
        one_tmul_mem_Vq hn, ?_⟩
      · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
      · rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
        have : (n : ℚ) • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] T) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : T) := by
          have h1 : (n : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : T) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : T) := by
            have := TensorProduct.smul_tmul (R := ℤ) n (1 : ℚ) (1 : T)
            simpa using this
          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one, h1]
        rw [this]; abel
    | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx
  · intro v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [rhoQ_tmul, h.rank t ht]; simp
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]
  · intro j hj m v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
      have := one_tmul_mem_Vq (h.eig j hj m t ht)
      have e : ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ((j : T) ^ m * t) := by
        have : ((j : ℚ) ^ m) = ((j ^ m : ℕ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast; rfl
      rw [psiQ_tmul, e, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
      exact this
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      have : psiQ (φ j) (x + y) - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • (x + y) =
          (psiQ (φ j) x - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • x) + (psiQ (φ j) y - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • y) := by
        rw [map_add, smul_add]; abel
      rw [this]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx =>
      have : psiQ (φ j) (c • x) - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • (c • x) =
          c • (psiQ (φ j) x - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • x) := by
        rw [map_smul, smul_sub, smul_comm]
      rw [this]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: STEPW.Filt.comap
statement:
theorem Filt.comap (Q : K →ₐ[ℚ] K') (hQ : Function.Injective Q)
    (hΨ : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → ∀ x, Q (Ψ j x) = Ψ' j (Q x)) (hρ : ∀ x, ρ' (Q x) = ρ x)
    {V' : ℕ → Submodule ℚ K'} {M : ℕ} (h : Filt Ψ' ρ' V' M) :
    Filt Ψ ρ (fun m ↦ (V' m).comap Q.toLinearMap) M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    exact Submodule.comap_mono (h.anti m)
  · rw [h.bot, Submodule.comap_bot]
    exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hQ
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.nil _ hv
    have hn' : Q v ^ n = 0 := hn
    exact ⟨n, hQ (by rw [map_pow, hn', map_zero])⟩
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨c, hc, y, hy, hcy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (h.zero hv)
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hc
    refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨r • (1 : K), Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _), v - r • (1 : K), ?_, by abel⟩
    show Q.toLinearMap (v - r • (1 : K)) ∈ V' 1
    have : Q.toLinearMap (v - r • (1 : K)) = y := by
      simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_sub, map_smul, map_one]
      have hcy' : r • (1 : K') + y = Q v := hcy
      rw [← hcy']
      abel
    rw [this]; exact hy
  · intro v hv
    rw [← hρ]
    exact h.rank _ hv
  · intro j hj m v hv
    show Q.toLinearMap (Ψ j v - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • v) ∈ V' (m + 1)
    simp only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_sub, map_smul, hΨ j hj]
    exact h.eig j hj m _ hv

name: STEPW.HasTower.hasFilt
statement:
theorem HasTower.hasFilt {ψ : ℕ → R →+* R} {ρ : R →+* ℤ} {r : R} (h : HasTower.{u, v} ψ ρ r) :
    HasFilt (fun j ↦ psiQ (ψ j)) (rhoQ ρ) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, _, q, φ, ρT, F, M, hq, hψ, hρ, hF, hr⟩ := h
  have hΨ : ∀ j x, qQ q (psiQ (ψ j) x) = psiQ (φ j) (qQ q x) := by
    intro j x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul c y => simp [hψ]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  have hρ' : ∀ x, rhoQ ρT (qQ q x) = rhoQ ρ x := by
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul c y => simp [hρ]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  refine ⟨_, M, Filt.comap (qQ q) (qQ_injective q hq) (fun j _ ↦ hΨ j) hρ' (filt_tensor hF), ?_⟩
  show (qQ q).toLinearMap ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] r) ∈ Vq F 0
  simpa using one_tmul_mem_Vq hr

name: STEPW.HasFilt.neg_tmul
statement:
theorem HasFilt.neg_tmul {Ψ : ℕ → ℚ ⊗[ℤ] R →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ ⊗[ℤ] R} {ρ : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] R →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ} {a : R}
    (h : HasFilt Ψ ρ ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a)) : HasFilt Ψ ρ ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (-a))
proof:
:= by
  have e : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (-a) = (-1 : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) :=
    (TensorProduct.tmul_neg (R := ℤ) (1 : ℚ) a).trans (neg_one_smul ℚ _).symm
  rw [e]
  exact h.smul _

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.ambientClass_eq
statement:
lemma ambientClass_eq : ambientClass g n =
    pullbackK0RingHom (rho g n) (k0ClassOf (space R n) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n))
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R n) n))
proof:
:= by

  exact (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (OMGB.kahlerBaseChangeIso (toSpec R n) n (ambient_square g n))).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.firstRelativeClass_eq

lemma firstRelativeClass_eq : firstRelativeClass g n m =
    pullbackK0RingHom (second g n m ≫ rho g m)
      (k0ClassOf (space R m) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R m))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R m) m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstRelativeClass, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _
    (OMGB.kahlerBaseChangeIso (toSpec R m) m (first_spec_square g n m))).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.secondRelativeClass_eq
statement:
lemma secondRelativeClass_eq : secondRelativeClass g n m =
    pullbackK0RingHom (first g n m ≫ rho g n)
      (k0ClassOf (space R n) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R n) n))
proof:

  exact (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _
    (OMGB.kahlerBaseChangeIso (toSpec R n) n (second_spec_square g n m))).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.commonClass_eq
statement:
lemma commonClass_eq : commonClass g n m =
    pullbackK0RingHom (first g n m ≫ rho g n)
      (k0ClassOf (space R n) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R n) n)) +
    pullbackK0RingHom (second g n m ≫ rho g m)
      (k0ClassOf (space R m) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R m))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R m) m))
proof:

  simpa only [commonClass, toSpecProduct_fst, toSpecProduct_snd] using
    ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_class
      R n m g (toBase g n m) (toSpecProduct g n m) (specProduct_square g n m)

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.commonClass_add_first
statement:
lemma commonClass_add_first : commonClass g n m =
    pullbackK0RingHom (first g n m) (ambientClass g n) + firstRelativeClass g n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambientClass_eq, firstRelativeClass_eq, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp]
  exact commonClass_eq g n m

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.commonClass_add_second
statement:
lemma commonClass_add_second : commonClass g n m =
    pullbackK0RingHom (second g n m) (ambientClass g m) + secondRelativeClass g n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambientClass_eq, secondRelativeClass_eq, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp]
  exact (commonClass_eq g n m).trans (add_comm _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.TveeIndependenceH2.conormalClass_congr
statement:
lemma conormalClass_congr {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i i' : X ⟶ Z)
    {r r' : ℕ}
    (h : i = i') (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) (N' : ConormalDataAmb i' r') :
    N.conormalClass = N'.conormalClass
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: M1.tvee_independent
statement: theorem tvee_independent : tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i1 = tvee hY hYreg hXreg m i2
proof:
:= by
  let g := Y ↘ Spk R
  let j := embedding g n m i1 i2 h
  letI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  letI := ambient_noetherian g n
  letI := ambient_noetherian g m
  letI : IsIntegral (ambient g n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj g n
  letI : IsIntegral (ambient g m) := isIntegral_pullback_proj g m
  letI := common_noetherian g n m
  letI := common_integral g n m
  letI := embedding_closed g n m i1 i2 h
  letI := embedding_first_closed g n m i1 i2 h
  letI := embedding_second_closed g n m i1 i2 h
  letI := first_smooth g n m
  letI := second_smooth g n m
  let NC := (conormalDataOfRegularAmb j (common_regStalks g n m hYreg) hXreg).some.conormalClass
  let N1 := (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hYreg n i1 hXreg).some.conormalClass
  let N2 := (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hYreg m i2 hXreg).some.conormalClass
  have hj1 : j ≫ first g n m = i1 := embedding_first g n m i1 i2 h
  have hj2 : j ≫ second g n m = i2 := embedding_second g n m i1 i2 h
  have hN1 := ConormalK0H2.regular_conormalClass_add j (first g n m) m
    (pullback_regStalks g hYreg n) (common_regStalks g n m hYreg) hXreg
  have hn1 : (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ first g n m)
      (pullback_regStalks g hYreg n) hXreg).some.conormalClass = N1 :=
    conormalClass_congr _ _ hj1
      (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ first g n m) (pullback_regStalks g hYreg n) hXreg).some
      (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hYreg n i1 hXreg).some
  rw [hn1] at hN1
  change NC = N1 + pullbackK0RingHom j (firstRelativeClass g n m) at hN1
  have hN2 := ConormalK0H2.regular_conormalClass_add j (second g n m) n
    (pullback_regStalks g hYreg m) (common_regStalks g n m hYreg) hXreg
  have hn2 : (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ second g n m)
      (pullback_regStalks g hYreg m) hXreg).some.conormalClass = N2 :=
    conormalClass_congr _ _ hj2
      (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ second g n m) (pullback_regStalks g hYreg m) hXreg).some
      (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hYreg m i2 hXreg).some
  rw [hn2] at hN2
  change NC = N2 + pullbackK0RingHom j (secondRelativeClass g n m) at hN2
  have hC1 : pullbackK0RingHom j (commonClass g n m) =
      pullbackK0RingHom i1 (ambientClass g n) +
        pullbackK0RingHom j (firstRelativeClass g n m) := by
    rw [commonClass_add_first, map_add, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hj1]
  have hC2 : pullbackK0RingHom j (commonClass g n m) =
      pullbackK0RingHom i2 (ambientClass g m) +
        pullbackK0RingHom j (secondRelativeClass g n m) := by
    rw [commonClass_add_second, map_add, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hj2]
  have e1 : pullbackK0RingHom j (commonClass g n m) - NC = tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i1 := by
    change pullbackK0RingHom j (commonClass g n m) - NC =
      pullbackK0RingHom i1 (ambientClass g n) - N1
    rw [hC1, hN1]
    abel
  have e2 : pullbackK0RingHom j (commonClass g n m) - NC = tvee hY hYreg hXreg m i2 := by
    change pullbackK0RingHom j (commonClass g n m) - NC =
      pullbackK0RingHom i2 (ambientClass g m) - N2
    rw [hC2, hN2]
    abel
  exact e1.symm.trans e2

name: M1.tClass_independent
statement:
theorem tClass_independent (k : ℕ) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y
proof:
:= hY.1
    tClass hY hYreg hXreg n i1 k = tClass hY hYreg hXreg m i2 k := by
  letI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  unfold tClass
  rw [tvee_independent hY hYreg hXreg n m i1 i2 h]

name: ARRL1C.k0ToG0_Fp
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_Fp (RM : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution M) (i : W ⟶ M)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (w : K0 W) :
    k0ToG0 M (Fp RM i w) = finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 W w)
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun RM.right (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 W w))

name: ARRL1C.hsupp
statement:
theorem hsupp (RM : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution M) (i : W ⟶ M)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : M.Opens) (hU : Set.range i = (U : Set M)ᶜ)
    (hW : Function.Surjective (k0ToG0 W)) :
    ∀ m : K0 M, pullbackK0 U.ι m = 0 → ∃ w : K0 W, Fp RM i w = m
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  have h0 : flatPullbackG0 U.ι (k0ToG0 M m) = 0 := by
    rw [← ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0, hm, map_zero]
  have hker : k0ToG0 M m ∈ (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).ker := h0
  rw [KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_closedImmersion i U hU]
    at hker
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hker
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hW g
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  have := k0ToG0_Fp RM i w
  rw [hg] at this
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun RM.left m
  change RM.res (k0ToG0 M m) = m at h2
  calc Fp RM i w = RM.res (k0ToG0 M (Fp RM i w)) :=
        (DFunLike.congr_fun RM.left (Fp RM i w)).symm
    _ = RM.res (k0ToG0 M m) := by rw [this]
    _ = m := h2

name: ARRL1C.hsupp_of_resolution
statement:
theorem hsupp_of_resolution (RM : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution M)
    (RW : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution W) (i : W ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U : M.Opens) (hU : Set.range i = (U : Set M)ᶜ) :
    ∀ m : K0 M, pullbackK0 U.ι m = 0 → ∃ w : K0 W, Fp RM i w = m
proof:
:=
  hsupp RM i U hU fun g =>
    ⟨RW.res g, DFunLike.congr_fun RW.right g⟩

name: IsLocalizedModule.injective_smul
proof:
:= by
  have h' := IsLocalizedModule.map_units f s
  rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff] at h'
  exact h'.1 (a₁ := x) (a₂ := y) h

name: IsLocalizedModule.surjective_smul
statement:
theorem surjective_smul {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule S f] (s : S) (y : N) :
    ∃ x : N, (s : R) • x = y
proof:
:= by
  have h' := IsLocalizedModule.map_units f s
  rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff] at h'
  exact h'.2 y

name: IsLocalizedModule.of_exact_ladder
statement:
theorem of_exact_ladder
    (i : A →ₗ[R] B) (d : B →ₗ[R] C) (i' : A' →ₗ[R] B') (d' : B' →ₗ[R] C')
    (a : A →ₗ[R] A') (b : B →ₗ[R] B') (c : C →ₗ[R] C')
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hex : Function.Exact i d)
    (hi' : Function.Injective i') (hex' : Function.Exact i' d')
    (hab : ∀ x, i' (a x) = b (i x)) (hbc : ∀ x, d' (b x) = c (d x))
    [IsLocalizedModule S b] [IsLocalizedModule S c] :
    IsLocalizedModule S a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    show Function.Bijective (fun x : A' => (s : R) • x)
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      refine hi' (injective_smul S b s ?_)
      show (s : R) • i' x = (s : R) • i' y
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_smul]
      exact congrArg i' hxy
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := surjective_smul S b s (i' y)
      have hdz : d' z = 0 := by
        refine injective_smul S c s ?_
        have hzero : d' ((s : R) • z) = 0 := by
          rw [hz]; exact hex'.apply_apply_eq_zero y
        rw [map_smul] at hzero
        rw [hzero, smul_zero]
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hex' z).1 hdz
      exact ⟨x, hi' (by rw [map_smul, hx, hz])⟩
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨⟨z, s⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S b (i' y)
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def] at hz
    have hcdz : c (d z) = c 0 := by
      rw [← hbc z, ← hz, map_smul, hex'.apply_apply_eq_zero y, smul_zero, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := S) (f := c) hcdz
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.smul_def, smul_zero] at ht
    have hdtz : d ((t : R) • z) = 0 := by rw [map_smul]; exact ht
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hex ((t : R) • z)).1 hdtz
    refine ⟨⟨x, t * s⟩, hi' ?_⟩
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def, map_smul, hab x, hx, map_smul, ← hz, Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_smul]
  · intro x₁ x₂ h
    have hbi : b (i x₁) = b (i x₂) := by rw [← hab, ← hab, h]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := S) (f := b) hbi
    refine ⟨t, hi ?_⟩
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.smul_def] at ht
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.smul_def, map_smul, map_smul, ht]

name: ExamplesLCI.nodal_isEisensteinAt
statement:
theorem nodal_isEisensteinAt :
    (nodal K).IsEisensteinAt (Ideal.span {(X + 1 : Polynomial K)})
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(nodal_monic K).leadingCoeff]
    intro h
    exact (span_X_add_one_isPrime K).ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 h)
  · intro n hn
    rw [nodal_natDegree] at hn
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    unfold nodal
    interval_cases n
    · simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, coeff_C_zero]
      norm_num
    · simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, coeff_C]
      norm_num
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    unfold nodal
    simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, coeff_C_zero, OfNat.zero_ne_ofNat, if_false, zero_sub,
      dvd_neg]
    rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have h1 : (X + 1 : Polynomial K) ≠ 0 := by simpa using X_add_C_ne_zero (1 : K)
    have h2 : (X ^ 2 : Polynomial K) = (X + 1) * q := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ h1
      rw [hq]; ring
    have h3 := congrArg (eval (-1 : K)) h2
    simp at h3

name: ExamplesLCI.ringKrullDim_k

proof:
:= by

    ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]

name: ExamplesLCI.ringKrullDim_quotient_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le :
    ringKrullDim (Kxy K ⧸ Ideal.span {nodal K}) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_le_of_nonZeroDivisor
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (nodal_ne_zero K))
  rw [ringKrullDim_k] at h
  
  generalize ringKrullDim (Kxy K ⧸ Ideal.span {nodal K}) = d at h ⊢
  induction d using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot => exact bot_le
  | coe d =>
    induction d using ENat.recTopCoe with
    | top => exact absurd h (by decide)
    | coe d =>
      have h' : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        exact h
      have h'' : d + 1 ≤ 2 := ENat.coe_le_coe.1 (WithBot.coe_le_coe.1 h')
      have h3 : d ≤ 1 := by omega
      exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 (ENat.coe_le_coe.2 h3)

name: ExamplesLCI.ringKrullDim_nodalRing_le
statement: theorem ringKrullDim_nodalRing_le : ringKrullDim (NodalRing K) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ringKrullDim_quotient_le K

name: ExamplesLCI.jetXY_x
statement: theorem jetXY_x : jetXY K (C X) = TrivSqZeroExt.inr ((1 : K), (0 : K))
proof:
:= by
  simp [jetXY, jetX]

name: ExamplesLCI.jetXY_y
statement: theorem jetXY_y : jetXY K X = TrivSqZeroExt.inr ((0 : K), (1 : K))
proof:
:= by
  simp [jetXY]

name: ExamplesLCI.jetXY_nodal
statement: theorem jetXY_nodal : jetXY K (nodal K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nodal, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, map_add, map_one, jetXY_y, jetXY_x]
  simp [pow_two, TrivSqZeroExt.inr_mul_inr]

name: ExamplesLCI.jetR_toNodal
statement: theorem jetR_toNodal (w : Kxy K) : jetR K (toNodal K w) = jetXY K w
proof: := rfl

name: ExamplesLCI.jetL_fst_of_mem
statement:
theorem jetL_fst_of_mem (z : NodeLocal K) (hz : z ∈ maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K)) :
    (jetL K z).fst = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, h⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (origin K).primeCompl z
  have h' : IsLocalization.mk' (NodeLocal K) a s = z := h
  subst h'
  rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.mk'_mem_maximal_iff (NodeLocal K) (origin K)] at hz
  rw [jetL, IsLocalization.lift_mk', TrivSqZeroExt.fst_mul]
  have : (jetR K a).fst = 0 := hz
  rw [this, zero_mul]

name: ExamplesLCI.maximalIdeal_not_principal
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_not_principal :
    ¬ ∃ t : NodeLocal K, maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K) = Ideal.span {t}
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  let xL : NodeLocal K := algebraMap (NodalRing K) (NodeLocal K) (toNodal K (C X))
  let yL : NodeLocal K := algebraMap (NodalRing K) (NodeLocal K) (toNodal K X)
  have hjx : jetL K xL = TrivSqZeroExt.inr ((1 : K), (0 : K)) := by
    simp only [xL, jetL, IsLocalization.lift_eq, jetR_toNodal, jetXY_x]
  have hjy : jetL K yL = TrivSqZeroExt.inr ((0 : K), (1 : K)) := by
    simp only [yL, jetL, IsLocalization.lift_eq, jetR_toNodal, jetXY_y]
  have hmem : ∀ w : Kxy K, (jetXY K w).fst = 0 →
      algebraMap (NodalRing K) (NodeLocal K) (toNodal K w) ∈ maximalIdeal _ := by
    intro w hw
    rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (NodeLocal K) (origin K)]
    exact hw
  have hxm : xL ∈ maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K) := hmem _ (by rw [jetXY_x]; rfl)
  have hym : yL ∈ maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K) := hmem _ (by rw [jetXY_y]; rfl)
  have htm : t ∈ maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K) := by rw [ht]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  rw [ht, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hxm hym
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hxm
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hym
  have ht0 := jetL_fst_of_mem K t htm
  have ex := congrArg (fun z => (jetL K z).snd) ha
  have ey := congrArg (fun z => (jetL K z).snd) hb
  simp only [map_mul, TrivSqZeroExt.snd_mul, ht0, hjx, hjy, TrivSqZeroExt.snd_inr,
    MulOpposite.op_zero, zero_smul, add_zero] at ex ey
  have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst ex
  have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd ex
  have e3 := congrArg Prod.fst ey
  have e4 := congrArg Prod.snd ey
  simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] at e1 e2 e3 e4
  
  have hα : (jetL K a).fst ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at e1; exact zero_ne_one e1
  have hv : (jetL K t).snd.2 = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 e2 with h | h
    · exact absurd h hα
    · exact h
  rw [hv, mul_zero] at e4
  exact zero_ne_one e4

name: ExamplesLCI.not_isRegularLocalRing
statement: theorem not_isRegularLocalRing : ¬ IsRegularLocalRing (NodeLocal K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hreg
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (NodeLocal K) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height (origin K) (NodeLocal K)]
    exact (Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_isPrime).trans (ringKrullDim_nodalRing_le K)
  have hspan := hreg.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  rw [← hspan] at hdim
  have hle : (maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K)).spanFinrank ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hdim
  have hfg : (maximalIdeal (NodeLocal K)).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hspan'⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_set_encard_eq_spanFinrank hfg
  have hs1 : s.encard ≤ 1 := by rw [hs]; exact_mod_cast hle
  rcases Set.encard_le_one_iff_eq.1 hs1 with h | ⟨t, rfl⟩
  · subst h
    apply maximalIdeal_not_principal K
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [← hspan']
    simp
  · exact maximalIdeal_not_principal K ⟨t, hspan'.symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.mappedIso_normalizeArrow
statement:
theorem mappedIso_normalizeArrow {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) {A B T : C} {N : D} (e : A ≅ B) (d : F.obj B ≅ N) (f : B ⟶ T) :
    F.map (e.hom ≫ f) = ((F.mapIso e) ≪≫ d).hom ≫ (d.inv ≫ F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.Esec_base_zero
statement:
theorem Esec_base_zero (V : Q.Opens) (a : baseSubring p V) :
    TF2.Esec p V a.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := ModuleCat.Derivation.d_map
    (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap p).app (Opposite.op V))) a
  exact (congrArg
    (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q).unit.app
      (relativePresheaf p)).app (Opposite.op V))) hd).trans (map_zero _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.Esec_appLE_zero
statement:
theorem Esec_appLE_zero (V : S.Opens) (W : Q.Opens) (h : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (a : Γ(S, V)) : TF2.Esec p W (p.appLE V W h a) = 0
proof:
:=
  Esec_base_zero p W ⟨_, appLE_mem_baseSubring p h a⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.pulledDifferential_unit
statement:
theorem pulledDifferential_unit :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app (TF3.idealOf j) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).map (pulledDifferential p j) = TF3.dI p j
proof:
:= by
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).homEquiv_unit
    (f := pulledDifferential p j)).symm.trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.pulledDifferential_unit_apply
statement:
theorem pulledDifferential_unit_apply (V : Q.Opens) (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf j, V)) :
    (pulledDifferential p j).app (j ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf j)).app V s) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app (relativeSheaf p)).app V
      (TF2.Esec p V (TF3.ιapp j V s))
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun f => f.app V s) (pulledDifferential_unit p j)).trans
    (TF3.dI_app p j V s)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.conormalDifferential_pulled
statement:
theorem conormalDifferential_pulled :
    TF3.c p j = (TF3.conormalIso j).hom ≫ pulledDifferential p j
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.conormalDifferential_unit_apply
statement:
theorem conormalDifferential_unit_apply (V : Q.Opens) (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf j, V)) :
    (TF3.c p j).app (j ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((TF3.conormalIso j).inv.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf j)).app V s)) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app (relativeSheaf p)).app V
      (TF2.Esec p V (TF3.ιapp j V s))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    ((TF3.conormalIso j).inv.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf j)).app V s))) (conormalDifferential_pulled p j)
  exact hc.trans ((congrArg (fun x => (pulledDifferential p j).app (j ⁻¹ᵁ V) x)
    (ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafIso_hom_inv_apply (TF3.conormalIso j) (j ⁻¹ᵁ V) _)).trans
      (pulledDifferential_unit_apply p j V s))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.idealCoefficient_symm
statement:
theorem idealCoefficient_symm (x : P.ker) :
    TF3.ιapp (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))) ⊤
      ((specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).symm x) =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of P.Ring)).inv x.val
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).apply_symm_apply x)
  have he := congrArg ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of P.Ring)).inv) h
  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of P.Ring)).hom_inv_id _).symm.trans he

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.cotangentSections_inv_mk
statement:
theorem cotangentSections_inv_mk (x : P.ker) :
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso P).inv (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))))).app ⊤
      ((specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  let s := (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).symm x
  have hu := pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso_unit P s
  have hx := congrArg (Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := P))
    ((specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).apply_symm_apply x)
  have h := hu.trans hx
  exact ((congrArg (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso P).inv.hom h).symm).trans
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso P).hom_inv_id _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.originalConormalDifferential_square
statement:
theorem originalConormalDifferential_square :
    (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map
      (TF3.c π (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))) =
    (libraryCotangentSectionsIso P).hom ≫ cotangentDifferentialSections P π
proof:
:=
  mappedIso_normalizeArrow (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B))
    (TF3.conormalIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))))
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso P)
    (pulledDifferential π (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.cotangentDifferentialSections_mk
statement:
theorem cotangentDifferentialSections_mk (x : P.ker) :
    cotangentDifferentialSections P π (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).unit.app
        (relativeSheaf π)).app ⊤
      (TF2.Esec π ⊤ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of P.Ring)).inv x.val))
proof:
:= by
  change (pulledDifferential π (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).app ⊤
    ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso P).inv (Extension.Cotangent.mk x)) = _
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun z =>
    (pulledDifferential π (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).app ⊤ z)
    (cotangentSections_inv_mk P x)
  have h₂ := pulledDifferential_unit_apply π
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))) ⊤
    ((specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).symm x)
  exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (congrArg (fun a =>
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).unit.app
        (relativeSheaf π)).app ⊤ (TF2.Esec π ⊤ a)) (idealCoefficient_symm P x)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.nativeDifferential_idealSquare_zero
statement:
theorem nativeDifferential_idealSquare_zero (x : P.ker) (hx : x.val ∈ P.ker ^ 2) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).unit.app
        (relativeSheaf π)).app ⊤
      (TF2.Esec π ⊤ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of P.Ring)).inv x.val)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : Extension.Cotangent.mk x = (0 : P.Cotangent) :=
    (Extension.Cotangent.mk_eq_zero_iff x).mpr hx
  exact (cotangentDifferentialSections_mk P π x).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (cotangentDifferentialSections P π).hom hmk).trans
      (map_zero (cotangentDifferentialSections P π).hom))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.koszul_exact
statement:
theorem CohReg.koszul_exact (G : (space R n).Modules) (e : ℤ) :
    Epi ((tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) G).map (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K e).d 1 0)) ∧
    ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift
      ((tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) G).map (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K e).d (k + 1) k))
      ((tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) G).map
        (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K e).d (k + 2) (k + 1)))
      (by rw [← Functor.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, Functor.map_zero]))
proof:
:= by
  let F : (space R n).Modules ⥤ (space R n).Modules := tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) G
  let D := projectiveKoszulData R n
  let K := D.K e
  have hFmap : ∀ {A B : (space R n).Modules} (f : A ⟶ B),
      F.map f = tensorSheafMap (space R n) f (𝟙 G) := by
    intro A B f
    simp [F, tensorSheafRightFunctor, tensorSheafMap]
    rfl
  have hiso : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ),
      IsIso ((F ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
        (Koszul.x R n i d)) := by
    intro i d
    rw [Koszul.x_fin]
    let r := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι
    have key : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
        (tensorSheafMap (space R n) (Koszul.X R n i d) (𝟙 G))) := by
      have hnat := restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
        (coordinateOpen R n i).ι (Koszul.X R n i d) (𝟙 G)
      rw [← Iso.eq_comp_inv] at hnat
      rw [hnat]
      haveI := Koszul.X_restrict_isIso R n i d
      haveI : IsIso (tensorSheafMap _
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (Koszul.X R n i d))
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (𝟙 G))) :=
        (tensorSheafMapIso _
          (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
            (Koszul.X R n i d)))
          (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
            (𝟙 G)))).isIso_hom
      infer_instance
    change IsIso (r.map (F.map (Koszul.X R n i d)))
    exact (congrArg (fun φ ↦ IsIso (r.map φ)) (hFmap (Koszul.X R n i d))).mpr key
  have hloc : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      Epi ((F ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (K.d 1 0)) ∧
      ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift
        ((F ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (K.d (k + 1) k))
        ((F ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (K.d (k + 2) (k + 1)))
        (by rw [← Functor.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, Functor.map_zero])) :=
    fun i ↦ Koszul.KData.epi_of_null (F ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι)
      D i (Koszul.KData.kos_null _ _ _ (n + 1) i i.isLt)
      (Koszul.KData.kos_isIso _ _ _ _ i (hiso i) (n + 1)) e
  refine ⟨Koszul.epi_of_restrict R n _ (fun i ↦ (hloc i).1), fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  refine Koszul.epi_of_restrict R n _ (fun i ↦ ?_)
  haveI := restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (coordinateOpen R n i)
  exact Koszul.epi_map_kernelLift _ _ _ _ ((hloc i).2 k)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.isMumfordRegular_succ
statement:
theorem CohReg.isMumfordRegular_succ (F : (space R n).Modules) (m : ℤ)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) : IsMumfordRegular R n F (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  let G' := moduleTwist R n F (m + 1 - q)
  let T := tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) G'
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts T := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts T
  let K := (projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  obtain ⟨hE0, hEk⟩ := CohReg.koszul_exact R n G' (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  have hvan : ∀ k, k ≤ n + 1 →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) (T.obj (K.X (k + 1)))
        (q + k)) := by
    intro k _
    let Rk := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) (q + k)
    haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts Rk := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts Rk
    have hg := Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (k + 1) (-((k : ℤ) + 1)) (by push_cast; ring)
    refine hg (fun Y ↦ IsZero (Rk.obj (T.obj Y))) (fun Z hZ ↦ Rk.map_isZero (T.map_isZero hZ))
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact (Koszul.isZero_biprod hZ hZ').of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (T.mapBiprod Z Z') ≪≫ Rk.mapBiprod (T.obj Z) (T.obj Z'))
    · exact (hreg (q + k) (by omega)).of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _ ≪≫
          moduleTwistTwistIso R n F (m + 1 - q) (-((k : ℤ) + 1)) (m - ((q + k : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)))
  have hchase := Regularity.chase (toSpec R n) (fun k ↦ T.obj (K.X k))
    (fun k ↦ T.map (K.d (k + 1) k))
    (fun k ↦ by rw [← T.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, T.map_zero])
    hE0 hEk
    (n + 1) (T.map_isZero (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ (n + 1) _ (n + 1 + 1) (by omega))) q
    hvan
  obtain ⟨e0⟩ := Koszul.KData.kos_X0 (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
    (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  exact hchase.of_iso ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) q).mapIso
    (T.mapIso e0 ≪≫ tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _ ≪≫
      moduleTwistTwistIso R n F _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.isMumfordRegular_of_le
statement:
theorem CohReg.isMumfordRegular_of_le (F : (space R n).Modules)
    {m m' : ℤ} (hmm' : m ≤ m') (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) : IsMumfordRegular R n F m'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Int.exists_add_of_le hmm'
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hreg
  | succ k ih =>
    have := CohReg.isMumfordRegular_succ R n F _ (ih (by omega))
    simpa [add_assoc] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.mul_surjective_right
statement:
theorem CohReg.mul_surjective_right (F : (space R n).Modules) (m : ℤ)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) :
    Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
      ((tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map
        (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0)))
proof:
:= by
  let G' := moduleTwist R n F m
  let T := tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) G'
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts T := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts T
  let K := (projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨hE0, hEk⟩ := CohReg.koszul_exact R n G' (-(n : ℤ))
  have hvan : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) (T.obj (K.X (k + 1)))
        (0 + k)) := by
    intro k hk _
    let Rk := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) (0 + k)
    haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts Rk := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts Rk
    have hg := Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-(n : ℤ)) (k + 1) (-(k : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
    refine hg (fun Y ↦ IsZero (Rk.obj (T.obj Y))) (fun Z hZ ↦ Rk.map_isZero (T.map_isZero hZ))
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact (Koszul.isZero_biprod hZ hZ').of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (T.mapBiprod Z Z') ≪≫ Rk.mapBiprod (T.obj Z) (T.obj Z'))
    · exact (hreg (0 + k) (by omega)).of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _ ≪≫
          moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m (-(k : ℤ)) (m - ((0 + k : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)))
  exact Regularity.chase_epi (toSpec R n) (fun k ↦ T.obj (K.X k))
    (fun k ↦ T.map (K.d (k + 1) k))
    (fun k ↦ by rw [← T.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, T.map_zero])
    hE0 hEk
    (n + 1) (T.map_isZero (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ (n + 1) _ (n + 1 + 1) (by omega))) 0
    hvan

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.mul_surjective_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem CohReg.mul_surjective_of_isMumfordRegular (F : (space R n).Modules) (m : ℤ)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) :
    Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map
        (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0)))
proof:
:= by
  let ι := tensorSheafRightFunctorIsoLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
  let f := ((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0
  have h := CohReg.mul_surjective_right R n F m hreg
  have hnat : (tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map f =
      ι.inv.app _ ≫ (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map f ≫
        ι.hom.app _ := by
    rw [ι.hom.naturality, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  change Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
    ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map f))
  rw [hnat, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
  exact epi_comp' inferInstance (epi_comp' h inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.descent
statement:
theorem CohReg.descent (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m)
    (hgen : Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F (m + 1))) :
    Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map
      (Regularity.lmap (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0))) :=
    CohReg.mul_surjective_pushforward R n F m hreg
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := Regularity.twist_succ R n F m
  have h2 := Regularity.gen_of_iso (toSpec R n) hgen e1.symm
  have h3 := Regularity.ε_naturality (toSpec R n)
    (Regularity.lmap (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0))
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  have h3' : Epi (Regularity.ε (toSpec R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
      (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 1)) ≫
      Regularity.lmap (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0)) := by
    rw [← h3]
    exact epi_comp' (Functor.map_epi _ _) h2
  have hfac : Regularity.Factor (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
      (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 1) :=
    Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-(n : ℤ)) 1 0 (by push_cast; ring)
      (Regularity.Factor (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m))
      (fun Z hZ ↦ Regularity.factor_zero _ _ hZ)
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ Regularity.factor_biprod _ _ hZ hZ')
      (Regularity.factor_iso _ _ (Regularity.factor_unit _ _) (projectiveTwistingZeroIso R n).symm)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfac _ (Regularity.ε (toSpec R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
      (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 1)))
  have h5 : Epi (Regularity.rmap (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 0)
      (Regularity.ε (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m))) := by
    rw [hs, Category.assoc, Regularity.swap, ← Category.assoc] at h3'
    exact @epi_of_epi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h3'
  have h6 := Regularity.epi_right (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-1))
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _) _ h5
  obtain ⟨θN⟩ := Regularity.untwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (moduleTwist R n F m)))
  obtain ⟨θB⟩ := Regularity.untwist R n (moduleTwist R n F m)
  have hsrc := Regularity.gen_of_iso _ (Regularity.gen_pullback (toSpec R n) _) θN.symm
  have htgt := Regularity.gen_of_gen_epi _ hsrc _ h6
  exact Regularity.gen_of_iso _ htgt θB

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem CohReg.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).counit.app F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, E, t, ht⟩ := projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_tensor_sections R n F
  obtain ⟨G, -⟩ := projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSections_generate R n F D E t ht
  have hbase : Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F (D : ℤ)) :=
    Regularity.gen_of_iso (toSpec R n)
      (Regularity.gen_of_epi (toSpec R n) (projectiveGeneratingSectionsFreeEvaluation R n _ G)
        (projectiveGeneratingSectionsFreeEvaluation_epi R n _ G))
      (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _)
  have hdown : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ m : ℤ, 0 ≤ m → Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F (m + j)) →
      Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro m _ h; simpa using h
    | succ j ih =>
      intro m hm h
      refine CohReg.descent R n F m (CohReg.isMumfordRegular_of_le R n F hm hreg) ?_
      refine ih (m + 1) (by omega) ?_
      have e : m + 1 + (j : ℤ) = m + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e]
      exact h
  have h0 := hdown D 0 le_rfl (by simpa using hbase)
  exact Regularity.gen_of_iso (toSpec R n) h0
    (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl F) (projectiveTwistingZeroIso R n) ≪≫
      tensorSheafRightUnitor (space R n) F)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.newton_rankOne
statement:
theorem newton_rankOne (ψ : ℕ → A →+* A) (x : A) (lam : ℕ → A) (h1 : lam 1 = x)
    (h2 : ∀ l, 2 ≤ l → lam l = 0)
    (hN : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ψ m x = ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (-1 : A) ^ (l + 1) * lam l * ψ (m - l) x +
      (-1 : A) ^ (m + 1) * (m : A) * lam m) :
    ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ψ m x = x ^ m
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  induction m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [hN (m + 1) hm]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0
    · simp [h1]
    · rw [h2 (m + 1) (by omega), mul_zero, add_zero,
        Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
      · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, ih hm0, h1]; ring
      · intro l hl hl1
        rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hl
        rw [h2 l (by omega), mul_zero, zero_mul]
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.newton_natural
statement:
theorem newton_natural (φ : A →+* B) (ψA : ℕ → A →+* A) (ψB : ℕ → B →+* B) (e : A)
    (lamA : ℕ → A) (lamB : ℕ → B) (hlam : ∀ l, lamB l = φ (lamA l))
    (hA : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ψA m e = ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (-1 : A) ^ (l + 1) * lamA l * ψA (m - l) e +
      (-1 : A) ^ (m + 1) * (m : A) * lamA m)
    (hB : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ψB m (φ e) =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (-1 : B) ^ (l + 1) * lamB l * ψB (m - l) (φ e) +
      (-1 : B) ^ (m + 1) * (m : B) * lamB m) :
    ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ψB m (φ e) = φ (ψA m e)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro hm
    rw [hB m hm, hA m hm, map_add, map_sum]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l hl ↦ ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hl
      rw [ih (m - l) (by omega) (by omega), hlam]
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
    · rw [hlam]; simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, map_natCast]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.IsNewton.rankOne
statement:
theorem IsNewton.rankOne {ψ : ℕ → K0 Y →+* K0 Y} (hψ : IsNewton ψ) (L : Y.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ψ m (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) = k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ m
proof:
:=
  newton_rankOne ψ _ (lambdaClass Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (lambdaClass_one Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (fun l hl ↦ lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt Y L 1 hL l (by omega))
    (fun m hm ↦ hψ L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree m hm) m hm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.IsNewton.natural
statement:
theorem IsNewton.natural {W : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ Y) (φ : K0 Y →+* K0 W)
    (hφ : ∀ (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E),
      φ (k0ClassOf Y E hE) =
        k0ClassOf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE))
    {ψY : ℕ → K0 Y →+* K0 Y} (hY : IsNewton ψY) {ψW : ℕ → K0 W →+* K0 W} (hW : IsNewton ψW)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (a : K0 Y) : ψW m (φ a) = φ (ψY m a)
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction Y (fun a ↦ ψW m (φ a) = φ (ψY m a)) (by simp) ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · intro a b ha hb; simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  · intro a ha; simp only [map_neg, ha]
  · intro E hE
    refine newton_natural φ ψY ψW (k0ClassOf Y E hE) (lambdaClass Y E hE)
      (fun l ↦ lambdaClass W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE) l)
      (fun l ↦ (lambdaClass_pullback_of f φ hφ E hE l).symm) (hY E hE) ?_ m hm
    intro m hm
    rw [hφ]
    exact hW _ _ m hm
