name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.loc_addHom_ext
statement:
theorem loc_addHom_ext (j : ℕ) (f g : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : A) →+ Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : B))
    (h : ∀ a, f (algebraMap A _ a) = g (algebraMap A _ a)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : A)) x
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
  have hsx : algebraMap A (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : A)) (s : A) =
      ((j ^ k : ℕ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : A)) := by
    simp only at hk ⊢
    rw [← hk]; push_cast; rfl
  simp only at hs
  rw [hsx, mul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul] at hs
  have hu : IsUnit ((j ^ k : ℕ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : B)) := by
    have := IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : B))
      (⟨((j : ℕ) : B) ^ k, k, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : B))
    simpa using this
  have e := congrArg f hs
  have e' := congrArg g hs
  rw [map_nsmul, h, ← e', map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul] at e
  exact hu.mul_left_cancel e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.kLocPush_algebraMap
statement:
theorem kLocPush_algebraMap (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (a : K0 (space R n)) :
    kLocPush j R n hn res (algebraMap _ _ a) =
      algebraMap _ _ (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ a)))
proof:
:=
  locAddHom_algebraMap j (projectiveK0Pushforward R n hn res) a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.eq_kLocPush
statement:
theorem eq_kLocPush (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (pushPi : adamsKLoc j (space R n) →+ adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) =
      algebraMap _ _ (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ a)))) :
    pushPi = kLocPush j R n hn res
proof:
:=
  loc_addHom_ext j _ _ fun a ↦ by rw [pushPi_alg, kLocPush_algebraMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.projectiveK0Pushforward_pb_mul
statement:
theorem projectiveK0Pushforward_pb_mul
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hleft : res.comp (k0ToG0 _) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (hright : (k0ToG0 _).comp res = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (b : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (a : K0 (space R n)) :
    projectiveK0Pushforward R n hn res (EulerIndependence.pb R n b * a) =
      b * projectiveK0Pushforward R n hn res a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [projectiveK0Pushforward, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [k0ToG0_mul]
  have hpb : EulerIndependence.pb R n b = pullbackK0 (toSpec R n) b := by
    change flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n) b = _
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0_eq_flatPullbackK0]
  rw [hpb, projectiveDerivedPushforward_projectionFormula]
  set g := projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 (space R n) a)
  have hg : g = k0ToG0 _ (res g) := (DFunLike.congr_fun hright g).symm
  rw [hg, ← k0ToG0_mul]
  have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hleft (b * res g)
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun hleft (res g)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.kLocPush_pb_mul
statement:
theorem kLocPush_pb_mul (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hleft : res.comp (k0ToG0 _) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (hright : (k0ToG0 _).comp res = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (b : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (x : adamsKLoc j (space R n)) :
    kLocPush j R n hn res (algebraMap _ _ (EulerIndependence.pb R n b) * x) =
      algebraMap _ _ b * kLocPush j R n hn res x
proof:
:= by
  have := loc_addHom_ext j
    ((kLocPush j R n hn res).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (algebraMap _ _ (EulerIndependence.pb R n b))))
    ((AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (algebraMap _ _ b)).comp (kLocPush j R n hn res)) (fun a ↦ by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft]
      rw [← map_mul, kLocPush_algebraMap, kLocPush_algebraMap, ← map_mul]
      exact congrArg _ (projectiveK0Pushforward_pb_mul R n hn res hleft hright b a))
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_blueprint
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_blueprint (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hleft : res.comp (k0ToG0 _) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (ψP : ℕ → K0 (space R n) →+* K0 (space R n)) (hψP : IsNewton ψP)
    (ψY : ℕ → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+* K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (hψY : IsNewton ψY)
    (bott : Multiplicative (K0 (space R n)) →* (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ)
    (hbott : IsBottLine j bott)
    (pushPi : adamsKLoc j (space R n) →+ adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) =
      algebraMap _ _ (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ a))))
    (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (ψY j (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      pushPi (algebraMap _ _ (ψP j y) *
        (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace' R n hn res (fun a ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun hleft a) j hj (ψP j)
    (ψY j) (hψP.twist R n (-1) j (by omega)) (hψP.pb R n hψY j (by omega)) bott hbott.one
    (hbott.twist R n (-1)) pushPi pushPi_alg y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_kLocPush
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_kLocPush (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hleft : res.comp (k0ToG0 _) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (ψP : ℕ → K0 (space R n) →+* K0 (space R n)) (hψP : IsNewton ψP)
    (ψY : ℕ → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+* K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (hψY : IsNewton ψY)
    (bott : Multiplicative (K0 (space R n)) →* (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ)
    (hbott : IsBottLine j bott) (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (ψY j (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      kLocPush j R n hn res (algebraMap _ _ (ψP j y) *
        (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_blueprint R n hn j hj res hleft ψP hψP ψY hψY bott hbott _
    (kLocPush_algebraMap j R n hn res) y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_lib
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_lib (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hleft : res.comp (k0ToG0 _) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (space R n))
    (hrankY : ConstantRankGenerators (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (space R n)) (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (adamsRingHom hrankY j (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      kLocPush j R n hn res (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankP j y) *
        (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (space R n) hrankP hnilP
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_kLocPush R n hn j hj res hleft _
    (adamsRingHom_newton hrankP) _ (adamsRingHom_newton hrankY) _
    (bott_line j (space R n) hrankP hnilP) y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.rankZeroNilpotent_space
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_space (hX : RankZeroNilpotent (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    RankZeroNilpotent (space R n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsReduced (K0 (space R n) ⧸ nilradical (K0 (space R n))) :=
    (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced _).1 (Ideal.radical_isRadical ⊥)
  have hw1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 (space R n))) (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1))
      = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 (space R n))))
      (projectiveSpace_k0_relation_add_neg R n)
    rw [map_pow, map_add, map_neg, map_one, map_zero] at h
    have h0 := IsNilpotent.eq_zero ⟨n + 1, h⟩
    linear_combination -h0
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := projectiveSpace_k0_span R n a
  have hc : Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 (space R n))) a =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 (space R n))) (EulerIndependence.pb R n (∑ i, g i)) := by
    rw [hg, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, hw1, one_pow, mul_one]
  have hc0 : ∀ x, rankAtRingHom x (∑ i, g i) = 0 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := toSpec_surjective R n x
    rw [← rankAtRingHom_flatPullbackK0, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    change rankAtRingHom y (EulerIndependence.pb R n (∑ i, g i)) = 0
    rw [← rankAtQuot_mk, ← hc, rankAtQuot_mk, ha y]
  have hpc : Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 (space R n)))
      (EulerIndependence.pb R n (∑ i, g i)) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (mem_nilradical.2 ((hX _ hc0).map _))
  exact mem_nilradical.1 (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 (hc.trans hpc))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.genericPoint_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_basicOpen {f : Polynomial R n} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    genericPoint R n ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) f
proof:
:=
  (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading R n) (f := f) _).mpr
    (fun hmem ↦ hf (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.genericPoint_mem_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_of_isOpen {u : Set (space R n)} (hu : IsOpen u) (hne : u.Nonempty) :
    genericPoint R n ∈ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', hle⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
      (Proj.isBasis_basicOpen (grading R n)) (U := ⟨u, hu⟩) hy
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hU'
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    subst h0
    have := (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading R n) (f := 0) y).mp hyU'
    exact this (Ideal.zero_mem _)
  exact hle (genericPoint_mem_basicOpen R n hf)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.irreducibleSpace_space_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_space_of_isDomain : IrreducibleSpace (space R n) where
  isPreirreducible_univ
proof:
:= by
    intro u v hu hv hune hvne
    refine ⟨genericPoint R n, Set.mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact genericPoint_mem_of_isOpen R n hu ⟨hune.choose, hune.choose_spec.2⟩
    · exact genericPoint_mem_of_isOpen R n hv ⟨hvne.choose, hvne.choose_spec.2⟩
  toNonempty := ⟨genericPoint R n⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.exists_ringKrullDim_le
statement: theorem exists_ringKrullDim_le [IsLocalRing R] : ∃ d : ℕ, ringKrullDim R ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  have h := ringKrullDim_lt_top (R := R)
  cases hk : ringKrullDim R with
  | bot => exact ⟨0, bot_le⟩
  | coe k =>
    cases k with
    | top => rw [hk] at h; exact absurd h (lt_irrefl _)
    | coe d => exact ⟨d, le_rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.regularRes_left
statement:
theorem regularRes_left (d : ℕ) (hd : ringKrullDim R ≤ d) :
    (regularRes R d hd).comp (k0ToG0 _) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun a ↦ ?_
  exact AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply
    (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 _) (k0ToG0_bijective_spec_of_isRegularRing R d hd)) a

proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun a ↦ ?_
  exact AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply
    (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 _) (k0ToG0_bijective_spec_of_isRegularRing R d hd)) a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_regularLocal
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_regularLocal (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_spec_of_isDomain R) j
          (regularRes R _ (exists_ringKrullDim_le R).choose_spec
            (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      kLocPush j R n hn (regularRes R _ (exists_ringKrullDim_le R).choose_spec)
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_space_of_isDomain R n) j y) *
          (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (space R n) (constantRankGenerators_space_of_isDomain R n)
            (lambdaNilpotent_space_of_isLocalRing R n)
            (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
            (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_lib R n hn j hj _ (regularRes_left R _ _) _ _ _ y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mat_comp
statement:
theorem Koszul.mat_comp {P P' Q Q' S S' : C} (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : P' ⟶ Q) (c : P' ⟶ Q')
    (a' : Q ⟶ S) (b' : Q' ⟶ S) (c' : Q' ⟶ S') :
    Koszul.mat a b c ≫ Koszul.mat a' b' c' = Koszul.mat (a ≫ a') (b ≫ a' + c ≫ b') (c ≫ c')
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;>
    simp [Koszul.mat, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp, add_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mat_zero
statement:
theorem Koszul.mat_zero {P P' Q Q' : C} :
    Koszul.mat (0 : P ⟶ Q) (0 : P' ⟶ Q) (0 : P' ⟶ Q') = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Koszul.mat]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.map_mat
statement:
theorem Koszul.map_mat {P P' Q Q' S S' : C} (f : P ⟶ Q) (g : P' ⟶ Q')
    (a : Q ⟶ S) (b : Q' ⟶ S) (c : Q' ⟶ S') :
    biprod.map f g ≫ Koszul.mat a b c = Koszul.mat (f ≫ a) (g ≫ b) (g ≫ c)
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Koszul.mat]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mat_map
statement:
theorem Koszul.mat_map {P P' Q Q' S S' : C} (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : P' ⟶ Q) (c : P' ⟶ Q')
    (f : Q ⟶ S) (g : Q' ⟶ S') :
    Koszul.mat a b c ≫ biprod.map f g = Koszul.mat (a ≫ f) (b ≫ f) (c ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Koszul.mat, Preadditive.add_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.map_comp
statement:
theorem Koszul.map_comp {P P' Q Q' S S' : C} (f : P ⟶ Q) (g : P' ⟶ Q') (f' : Q ⟶ S)
    (g' : Q' ⟶ S') : biprod.map f g ≫ biprod.map f' g' = biprod.map (f ≫ f') (g ≫ g')
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.shd_sq
statement:
theorem Koszul.shd_sq (A : ChainComplex C ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    (Koszul.shd A (k + 1) : A.X (k + 1) ⟶ A.X k) ≫ Koszul.shd A k = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact (isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt _ _
  | succ k =>
    change (-A.d (k + 2) (k + 1)) ≫ (-A.d (k + 1) k) = 0
    simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg,
      HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.coneD_sq
statement:
theorem Koszul.coneD_sq {A B : ChainComplex C ℕ} (φ : A ⟶ B) (k : ℕ) :
    Koszul.coneD φ (k + 1) ≫ Koszul.coneD φ k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Koszul.coneD, Koszul.coneD, Koszul.mat_comp, ← Koszul.mat_zero]
  congr 1
  · exact HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d _ _ _ _
  · change φ.f (k + 1) ≫ B.d (k + 1) k + (-A.d (k + 1) k) ≫ φ.f k = 0
    rw [φ.comm, Preadditive.neg_comp, add_neg_cancel]
  · exact Koszul.shd_sq A k

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.cone_d
statement:
theorem Koszul.cone_d {A B : ChainComplex C ℕ} (φ : A ⟶ B) (k : ℕ) :
    (Koszul.cone φ).d (k + 1) k = Koszul.coneD φ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [Koszul.cone]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.shd_shMap
statement:
theorem Koszul.shd_shMap {A A' : ChainComplex C ℕ} (α : A ⟶ A') (k : ℕ) :
    (Koszul.shMap α (k + 1) : A.X k ⟶ A'.X k) ≫ Koszul.shd A' k =
      Koszul.shd A k ≫ Koszul.shMap α k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact (isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt _ _
  | succ k =>
    change α.f (k + 1) ≫ (-A'.d (k + 1) k) = (-A.d (k + 1) k) ≫ α.f k
    rw [Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, α.comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.coneMap_comm
statement:
theorem Koszul.coneMap_comm {A B A' B' : ChainComplex C ℕ} (φ : A ⟶ B) (φ' : A' ⟶ B')
    (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B') (w : φ ≫ β = α ≫ φ') (k : ℕ) :
    Koszul.coneMapF α β (k + 1) ≫ Koszul.coneD φ' k =
      Koszul.coneD φ k ≫ Koszul.coneMapF α β k
proof:
:= by
  have wk : φ.f k ≫ β.f k = α.f k ≫ φ'.f k := by
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, w, HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  rw [Koszul.coneMapF, Koszul.coneMapF, Koszul.coneD, Koszul.coneD, Koszul.map_mat, Koszul.mat_map]
  congr 1
  · exact β.comm _ _
  · exact wk.symm
  · exact Koszul.shd_shMap α k

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.coneMap_f
statement:
theorem Koszul.coneMap_f {A B A' B' : ChainComplex C ℕ} (φ : A ⟶ B) (φ' : A' ⟶ B')
    (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B') (w : φ ≫ β = α ≫ φ') (k : ℕ) :
    (Koszul.coneMap φ φ' α β w).f k = biprod.map (β.f k) (Koszul.shMap α k)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.m2_comp
statement:
theorem Koszul.m2_comp {P P' Q Q' S S' : C} (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : P' ⟶ Q) (e : P ⟶ Q')
    (c : P' ⟶ Q') (a' : Q ⟶ S) (b' : Q' ⟶ S) (e' : Q ⟶ S') (c' : Q' ⟶ S') :
    Koszul.m2 a b e c ≫ Koszul.m2 a' b' e' c' =
      Koszul.m2 (a ≫ a' + e ≫ b') (b ≫ a' + c ≫ b') (a ≫ e' + e ≫ c') (b ≫ e' + c ≫ c')
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;>
    simp [Koszul.m2, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp] <;> abel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.m2_add
statement:
theorem Koszul.m2_add {P P' Q Q' : C} (a a' : P ⟶ Q) (b b' : P' ⟶ Q) (e e' : P ⟶ Q')
    (c c' : P' ⟶ Q') :
    Koszul.m2 a b e c + Koszul.m2 a' b' e' c' = Koszul.m2 (a + a') (b + b') (e + e') (c + c')
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Koszul.m2, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp] <;> abel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.m2_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄; rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mat_eq_m2
statement:
theorem Koszul.mat_eq_m2 {P P' Q Q' : C} (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : P' ⟶ Q) (c : P' ⟶ Q') :
    Koszul.mat a b c = Koszul.m2 a b 0 c
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Koszul.mat, Koszul.m2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.map_eq_m2
statement:
theorem Koszul.map_eq_m2 {P P' Q Q' : C} (f : P ⟶ Q) (g : P' ⟶ Q') :

proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Koszul.m2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.isZero_biprod
statement: theorem Koszul.isZero_biprod {A B : C} (hA : IsZero A) (hB : IsZero B) : IsZero (A ⊞ B)
proof:
:=
  (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).2 (biprod.hom_ext _ _ (hA.eq_of_tgt _ _) (hB.eq_of_tgt _ _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.step_d
statement:
theorem step_d (D : Koszul.KData C) (v : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((D.step v).K d).d (k + 1) k =
      Koszul.m2 (P' := Koszul.sh (D.K d) (k + 1)) ((D.K (d + 1)).d (k + 1) k) ((D.ψ v d).f k) 0
        (Koszul.shd (D.K d) k)
proof:
:=
  (Koszul.cone_d _ _).trans (Koszul.mat_eq_m2 _ _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.step_ψf
statement:
theorem step_ψf (D : Koszul.KData C) (v a : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((D.step v).ψ a d).f k =
      Koszul.m2 ((D.ψ a (d + 1)).f k) 0 0 (Koszul.shMap (D.ψ a d) k)
proof:
:=
  Koszul.map_eq_m2 _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.null_step_self
statement: theorem null_step_self (D : Koszul.KData C) (v : ℕ) : (D.step v).Null v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun d k ↦ Koszul.m2 (P' := Koszul.sh (D.K d) k) (Q' := (D.K (d + 1)).X k)
    0 0 (𝟙 _) 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d
    rw [step_ψf, step_d]; erw [Koszul.m2_comp]
    exact Koszul.m2_congr (by simp) ((isZero_zero C).eq_of_src _ _)
      ((isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt _ _) ((isZero_zero C).eq_of_src _ _)
  · intro d k
    rw [step_ψf, step_d, step_d]; erw [Koszul.m2_comp, Koszul.m2_comp, Koszul.m2_add]
    refine Koszul.m2_congr (by simp) (by simp) ?_ ?_
    · simp [Koszul.shd]
      rfl
    · simp [Koszul.shMap]
      exact (add_zero _).symm
  · intro a d k
    rw [step_ψf, step_ψf]; erw [Koszul.m2_comp, Koszul.m2_comp]
    refine Koszul.m2_congr (by simp; rfl) (by simp) ?_ ?_
    · simp [Koszul.shMap]
    · simp
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.null_step_of_null
statement:
theorem null_step_of_null (D : Koszul.KData C) (v j : ℕ) (hj : D.Null j) :
    (D.step v).Null j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, h0, hs, hc⟩ := hj
  refine ⟨fun d k ↦ Koszul.m2 (h (d + 1) k) 0 0 (shh D h d k), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d
    rw [step_ψf, step_d]; erw [Koszul.m2_comp]
    exact Koszul.m2_congr (by simp [h0]) ((isZero_zero C).eq_of_src _ _)
      ((isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt _ _) ((isZero_zero C).eq_of_src _ _)
  · intro d k
    rw [step_ψf, step_d, step_d]; erw [Koszul.m2_comp, Koszul.m2_comp, Koszul.m2_add]
    refine Koszul.m2_congr ?_ ?_ (by simp) ?_
    · simp only [comp_zero, zero_comp, add_zero]
      exact hs (d + 1) k
    · simp only [shh, comp_zero, zero_comp, add_zero, zero_add]
      exact ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hc v d k) (Preadditive.neg_comp _ _)).trans
        (add_neg_cancel _)).symm
    · cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp [Koszul.shMap, Koszul.shd, shh, h0]
        exact (Preadditive.neg_comp_neg _ _).symm
      | succ k =>
        simp [Koszul.shMap, Koszul.shd, shh, hs]
        exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (Preadditive.neg_comp_neg _ _).symm
          (Preadditive.neg_comp_neg _ _).symm
  · intro a d k
    rw [step_ψf, step_ψf]; erw [Koszul.m2_comp, Koszul.m2_comp]
    refine Koszul.m2_congr ?_ (by simp) (by simp) ?_
    · simp only [comp_zero, add_zero]
      exact hc a (d + 1) k
    · cases k with
      | zero => exact (isZero_zero C).eq_of_src _ _
      | succ k =>
        simp [Koszul.shMap, shh]
        exact (Preadditive.comp_neg _ _).trans ((congrArg Neg.neg (hc a d k)).trans
          (Preadditive.neg_comp _ _).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.kos_null
statement:
theorem kos_null (L : ℤ → C) (x : ℕ → ∀ d : ℤ, L d ⟶ L (d + 1))
    (hx : ∀ a b d, x a d ≫ x b (d + 1) = x b d ≫ x a (d + 1)) :
    ∀ m j, j < m → (kos L x hx m).Null j
  | 0, j, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | m + 1, j, hj => by
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj | rfl
    · exact null_step_of_null _ _ _ (kos_null L x hx m j hj)
    · exact null_step_self _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.isIso_map_biprod_map
statement:
theorem isIso_map_biprod_map {E : Type*} [Category E] [Preadditive E] [HasBinaryBiproducts E]
    [HasZeroObject E] (G : C ⥤ E) [G.Additive] {P P' Q Q' : C} (f : P ⟶ Q) (g : P' ⟶ Q')
    (hf : IsIso (G.map f)) (hg : IsIso (G.map g)) : IsIso (G.map (biprod.map f g))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts G := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts G
  have e : G.map (biprod.map f g) = (G.mapBiprod P P').hom ≫
      biprod.map (G.map f) (G.map g) ≫ (G.mapBiprod Q Q').inv := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.eq_comp_inv]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;>
      simp only [Functor.mapBiprod_hom, Category.assoc, biprod.lift_fst, biprod.lift_snd,
        biprod.map_fst, biprod.map_snd, biprod.lift_fst_assoc, biprod.lift_snd_assoc,
        ← G.map_comp]
  haveI : IsIso (biprod.map (G.map f) (G.map g)) :=
    ⟨⟨biprod.map (inv (G.map f)) (inv (G.map g)),
      by rw [Koszul.map_comp]; apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp,
      by rw [Koszul.map_comp]; apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp⟩⟩
  rw [e]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.isIso_map_of_isZero
statement:
theorem isIso_map_of_isZero {E : Type*} [Category E] [Preadditive E]
    (G : C ⥤ E) [G.Additive] {P Q : C} (f : P ⟶ Q) (hP : IsZero P) (hQ : IsZero Q) :
    IsIso (G.map f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨0, (G.map_isZero hP).eq_of_src _ _, (G.map_isZero hQ).eq_of_src _ _⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.kos_isIso
statement:
theorem kos_isIso {E : Type*} [Category E] [Preadditive E] [HasBinaryBiproducts E]
    [HasZeroObject E] (G : C ⥤ E) [G.Additive] (L : ℤ → C) (x : ℕ → ∀ d : ℤ, L d ⟶ L (d + 1))
    (hx : ∀ a b d, x a d ≫ x b (d + 1) = x b d ≫ x a (d + 1)) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : ∀ d, IsIso (G.map (x j d))) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ), IsIso (G.map (((kos L x hx m).ψ j d).f k))
  | 0, d, 0 => hj d
  | 0, d, k + 1 => isIso_map_of_isZero G _ (isZero_zero C) (isZero_zero C)
  | m + 1, d, k => by
    change IsIso (G.map (biprod.map (((kos L x hx m).ψ j (d + 1)).f k)
      (Koszul.shMap ((kos L x hx m).ψ j d) k)))
    refine isIso_map_biprod_map G _ _ (kos_isIso G L x hx j hj m (d + 1) k) ?_
    cases k with
    | zero => exact isIso_map_of_isZero G _ (isZero_zero C) (isZero_zero C)
    | succ k => exact kos_isIso G L x hx j hj m d k

                                                                    
def Good (L : ℤ → C) (e : ℤ) (Y : C) : Prop
proof:
:=
  ∀ P : C → Prop, (∀ Z, IsZero Z → P Z) → (∀ Z Z', P Z → P Z' → P (Z ⊞ Z')) → P (L e) → P Y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.kos_good
statement:
theorem kos_good (L : ℤ → C) (x : ℕ → ∀ d : ℤ, L d ⟶ L (d + 1))
    (hx : ∀ a b d, x a d ≫ x b (d + 1) = x b d ≫ x a (d + 1)) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (e : ℤ), e = d + (m : ℤ) - (k : ℤ) → Good L e (((kos L x hx m).K d).X k)
  | 0, d, 0, e, he => fun P _ _ hL => by
    have : e = d
proof:
:= by simpa using he
    subst this
    exact hL
  | 0, d, k + 1, e, _ => fun P h0 _ _ => h0 _ (isZero_zero C)
  | m + 1, d, k, e, he => fun P h0 h2 hL => by
    change P ((((kos L x hx m).K (d + 1)).X k) ⊞ Koszul.sh ((kos L x hx m).K d) k)
    refine h2 _ _ (kos_good L x hx m (d + 1) k e (by push_cast at he ⊢; omega) P h0 h2 hL) ?_
    cases k with
    | zero => exact h0 _ (isZero_zero C)
    | succ k => exact kos_good L x hx m d k e (by push_cast at he ⊢; omega) P h0 h2 hL

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.kos_isZero
statement:
theorem kos_isZero (L : ℤ → C) (x : ℕ → ∀ d : ℤ, L d ⟶ L (d + 1))
    (hx : ∀ a b d, x a d ≫ x b (d + 1) = x b d ≫ x a (d + 1)) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ), m < k → IsZero (((kos L x hx m).K d).X k)
  | 0, d, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | 0, d, k + 1, _ => isZero_zero C
  | m + 1, d, k, h => by
    change IsZero ((((kos L x hx m).K (d + 1)).X k) ⊞ Koszul.sh ((kos L x hx m).K d) k)
    refine Koszul.isZero_biprod (kos_isZero L x hx m (d + 1) k (by omega)) ?_
    cases k with
    | zero => exact isZero_zero C
    | succ k => exact kos_isZero L x hx m d k (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.kos_X0
statement:
theorem kos_X0 (L : ℤ → C) (x : ℕ → ∀ d : ℤ, L d ⟶ L (d + 1))
    (hx : ∀ a b d, x a d ≫ x b (d + 1) = x b d ≫ x a (d + 1)) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ), Nonempty (((kos L x hx m).K d).X 0 ≅ L (d + m))
  | 0, d => ⟨eqToIso (by simp; rfl)⟩
  | m + 1, d => by
    obtain ⟨e⟩
proof:
:= kos_X0 L x hx m (d + 1)
    exact ⟨Koszul.biprodZeroIso (isZero_zero C) ≪≫ e ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg L (by push_cast; ring))⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.epi_kernelLift_of_contraction
statement:
theorem Koszul.epi_kernelLift_of_contraction {E : Type*} [Category E] [Preadditive E]
    {X₁ X₂ X₃ : E} (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (g : X₂ ⟶ X₃) (w : f ≫ g = 0) [HasKernel g]
    (s : X₂ ⟶ X₁) (t : X₃ ⟶ X₂) (h : g ≫ t + s ≫ f = 𝟙 X₂) : Epi (kernel.lift g f w)
proof:
:= by
  have hsf : s ≫ f = 𝟙 X₂ - g ≫ t := by rw [← h]; abel
  have key : (kernel.ι g ≫ s) ≫ kernel.lift g f w = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι g)).1
    rw [Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι, Category.assoc, hsf, Preadditive.comp_sub,
      Category.comp_id, kernel.condition_assoc, zero_comp, sub_zero, Category.id_comp]
  exact epi_of_epi_fac key

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.KData.epi_of_null
statement:
theorem Koszul.KData.epi_of_null {E : Type*} [Category E] [Preadditive E] [HasKernels E]
    (G : C ⥤ E) [G.Additive] (D : Koszul.KData C) (j : ℕ) (hN : D.Null j)
    (hI : ∀ d k, IsIso (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f k))) (d : ℤ) :
    Epi (G.map ((D.K d).d 1 0)) ∧
    ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift (G.map ((D.K d).d (k + 1) k)) (G.map ((D.K d).d (k + 2) (k + 1)))
      (by rw [← G.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, G.map_zero]))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, h0, hs, -⟩ := hN
  have hcomm : ∀ i i', inv (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f i)) ≫ G.map ((D.K d).d i i') =
      G.map ((D.K (d + 1)).d i i') ≫ inv (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f i')) := by
    intro i i'
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← G.map_comp, (D.ψ j d).comm, G.map_comp,
      Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  constructor
  · refine epi_of_epi_fac (f := G.map (h d 0) ≫ inv (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f 1))) (h := 𝟙 _) ?_
    rw [Category.assoc, hcomm, ← Category.assoc, ← G.map_comp, ← h0, IsIso.hom_inv_id]
  · intro k
    refine Koszul.epi_kernelLift_of_contraction _ _ _
      (G.map (h d (k + 1)) ≫ inv (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f (k + 2))))
      (G.map (h d k) ≫ inv (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f (k + 1)))) ?_
    have e := congrArg (fun φ ↦ G.map φ ≫ inv (G.map ((D.ψ j d).f (k + 1)))) (hs d k)
    simp only [IsIso.hom_inv_id, G.map_add, G.map_comp, Preadditive.add_comp,
      Category.assoc] at e
    rw [e]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hcomm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mulHom_app_apply
statement:
theorem Koszul.mulHom_app_apply {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.mulHom a) U x = Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op a * x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mulHom_comp
statement:
theorem Koszul.mulHom_comp {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a b : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    Koszul.mulHom a ≫ Koszul.mulHom b = Koszul.mulHom (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  let x' : Y.presheaf.obj U := x
  change Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op b * (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op a * x') =
    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (a * b) * x'
  rw [map_mul]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mulHom_one
statement: theorem Koszul.mulHom_one {Y : Scheme.{u}} : Koszul.mulHom (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  let x' : Y.presheaf.obj U := x
  change Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op 1 * x' = x'
  rw [map_one, one_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.unitMulSheafIso_hom
statement:
theorem Koszul.unitMulSheafIso_hom {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Γ(Y, ⊤)ˣ) :
    (unitMulSheafIso a).hom = Koszul.mulHom a.1
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.pushedMul_comp
statement:
theorem Koszul.pushedMul_comp {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (a b : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)) :
    Koszul.pushedMul U a ≫ Koszul.pushedMul U b = Koszul.pushedMul U (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Koszul.pushedMul, Koszul.pushedMul, ← Functor.map_comp, Koszul.mulHom_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.pushedMul_one
statement:
theorem Koszul.pushedMul_one {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) :
    Koszul.pushedMul U 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [Koszul.pushedMul, Koszul.mulHom_one, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.pushedMul_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem Koszul.pushedMul_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)) :
    Koszul.pushedMul U a ≫ pushedUnitRestriction hVU =
      pushedUnitRestriction hVU ≫ Koszul.pushedMul V ((X.homOfLE hVU).appTop a)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushedUnitRestriction hVU) W.unop
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map (Koszul.mulHom a)) W.unop s) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).map (Koszul.mulHom ((X.homOfLE hVU).appTop a))) W.unop
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pushedUnitRestriction hVU) W.unop s)
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app, pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply]
  erw [Koszul.mulHom_app_apply, Koszul.mulHom_app_apply]
  erw [map_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.toScheme_presheaf_map, Scheme.homOfLE_appTop]
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ a) = X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ a)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.awayRatio_self
statement: theorem Koszul.awayRatio_self (a : Fin (n + 1)) : Koszul.awayRatio R n a a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [Koszul.awayRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_one]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  exact ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.ratio_self
statement: theorem Koszul.ratio_self (a : Fin (n + 1)) : Koszul.ratio R n a a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Koszul.ratio, Koszul.awayRatio_self]
  exact map_one _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.awayMap_identity
statement:
theorem Koszul.awayMap_identity (a b j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n) (f := coordinate R n a)
        (x := coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b) rfl
        (Koszul.awayRatio R n a j) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n) (f := coordinate R n b)
        (x := coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a)
        (mul_comm _ _) (Koszul.awayRatio R n b j) * coordinateOverlapRatio R n a b
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [Koszul.awayRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, coordinateOverlapRatio,
    Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.ratio_overlap
statement:
theorem Koszul.ratio_overlap (a b j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (Koszul.ratio R n a j) =
      (space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
        (Koszul.ratio R n b j) *
      (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 a b : Γ(space R n, coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (Koszul.ratio R n a j) =
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b)).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n) (f := coordinate R n a)
          (x := coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b) rfl
          (Koszul.awayRatio R n a j)) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading R n)
      (f := coordinate R n a) (x := coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b) rfl) (Koszul.awayRatio R n a j)).symm
  have hb : (space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
        (Koszul.ratio R n b j) =
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b)).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n) (f := coordinate R n b)
          (x := coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a)
          (mul_comm _ _) (Koszul.awayRatio R n b j)) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading R n)
      (f := coordinate R n b) (x := coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) (mul_comm _ _)) (Koszul.awayRatio R n b j)).symm
  have ht : (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 a b : Γ(space R n, coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b)) =
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinateOverlapEquation R n a b)).hom
        (coordinateOverlapRatio R n a b) := by
    rw [twistTransitionSectionUnit, Units.coe_map, twistTransitionUnit, zpow_one,
      coordinateOverlapRatioUnit_val]
    rfl
  rw [ha, hb, ht]
  exact (congrArg _ (Koszul.awayMap_identity R n a b j)).trans (map_mul _ _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.transition_mul
statement:
theorem Koszul.transition_mul (a b j : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d a b ≫
        Koszul.pushedMul (coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b)
          (((space R n).homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_left)).appTop
              (Koszul.chartCoeff R n a j)) =
      Koszul.pushedMul (coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b)
          (((space R n).homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_right)).appTop
              (Koszul.chartCoeff R n b j)) ≫
        pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n (d + 1) a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionIso, coordinateOverlapTransitionIso, Koszul.unitMulSheafIso_hom,
    Koszul.unitMulSheafIso_hom]
  change Koszul.pushedMul _ _ ≫ Koszul.pushedMul _ _ = Koszul.pushedMul _ _ ≫ Koszul.pushedMul _ _
  rw [Koszul.pushedMul_comp, Koszul.pushedMul_comp]
  congr 1
  have hres : ∀ {U V : (space R n).Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (r : Γ(space R n, U)),
      ((space R n).homOfLE h).appTop (U.topIso.inv.hom r) =
        V.topIso.inv.hom ((space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r) :=
    fun h r ↦ ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (SchemeProjectiveBundle.topIso_homOfLE h) r
  simp only [Koszul.chartCoeff, hres, Units.coe_map]
  have hsplit : twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (d + 1) a b =
      twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d a b * twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 a b := by
    unfold twistTransitionSectionUnit
    rw [twistTransitionUnit_add]
    exact map_mul _ _ _
  have key : (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d a b : Γ(space R n, _)) *
      (space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (Koszul.ratio R n a j) =
      (space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
        (Koszul.ratio R n b j) * (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (d + 1) a b : Γ(space R n, _)) := by
    rw [hsplit, Units.val_mul, Koszul.ratio_overlap]
    ring
  let φ := CommRingCat.Hom.hom (coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b).topIso.inv
  exact (map_mul φ _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg φ key).trans (map_mul φ _ _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.mulPi_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem Koszul.mulPi_π (j a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Koszul.mulPi R n j ≫
        Pi.π (fun b ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOpen R n b)) a =
      Pi.π (fun b ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOpen R n b)) a ≫
        Koszul.chartMul R n j a
proof:
:=
  Limits.Pi.map_π _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.X_compat
statement:
theorem Koszul.X_compat (j : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    (Koszul.ι R n d ≫ Koszul.mulPi R n j) ≫ coordinateDescentLeft R n =
      (Koszul.ι R n d ≫ Koszul.mulPi R n j) ≫ coordinateDescentRight R n (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩
  have hK' := congrArg (· ≫ Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOverlapOpen R n ij.1 ij.2)) (a, b))
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_overlap_compatibility R n d)
  change (Koszul.ι R n d ≫ coordinateDescentLeft R n) ≫ _ =
    (Koszul.ι R n d ≫ coordinateDescentRight R n d) ≫ _ at hK'
  simp only [Category.assoc, coordinateDescentLeft_π, coordinateDescentRight_π] at hK' ⊢
  simp only [Koszul.mulPi_π_assoc, Koszul.chartMul, Koszul.pushedMul_naturality_assoc,
    Koszul.pushedMul_naturality]
  rw [reassoc_of% hK', Koszul.transition_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.X_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem Koszul.X_ι (j : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    Koszul.X R n j d ≫ Koszul.ι R n (d + 1) = Koszul.ι R n d ≫ Koszul.mulPi R n j
proof:
:=
  projectiveTwistingSheafLift_ι R n (d + 1) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.X_comm
statement:
theorem Koszul.X_comm (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    Koszul.X R n a d ≫ Koszul.X R n b (d + 1) = Koszul.X R n b d ≫ Koszul.X R n a (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (Koszul.ι R n (d + 1 + 1))).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Koszul.X_ι, Koszul.X_ι_assoc]
  congr 1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro c
  simp only [Category.assoc, Koszul.mulPi_π, Koszul.mulPi_π_assoc, Koszul.chartMul,
    Koszul.pushedMul_comp, mul_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.X_restrict_proj
statement:
theorem Koszul.X_restrict_proj (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (Koszul.X R n i d) ≫
        localFrameProjection R n (d + 1) i = localFrameProjection R n d i
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Koszul.chartCoeff R n i i = 1 := by
    rw [Koszul.chartCoeff, Koszul.ratio_self]
    exact map_one _
  have key : Koszul.X R n i d ≫ Koszul.ι R n (d + 1) ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOpen R n j)) i =
      Koszul.ι R n d ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOpen R n j)) i := by
    rw [Koszul.X_ι_assoc, Koszul.mulPi_π, Koszul.chartMul, hc, Koszul.pushedMul_one,
      Category.comp_id]
  dsimp only [localFrameProjection]
  show _ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (Koszul.ι R n (d + 1)) ≫
      _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (Koszul.ι R n d) ≫ _
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, key]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.X_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem Koszul.X_restrict_isIso (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (Koszul.X R n i d))
proof:
:= by
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map (Koszul.X R n i d) =
      localFrameProjection R n d i ≫
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n (d + 1) i).hom := by
    rw [← Koszul.X_restrict_proj, Category.assoc]
    change _ = _ ≫ (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n (d + 1) i).inv ≫
      (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n (d + 1) i).hom
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [e]
  haveI : IsIso (localFrameProjection R n d i) :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d i).isIso_inv
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.x_fin
statement: theorem Koszul.x_fin (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) : Koszul.x R n i d = Koszul.X R n i d
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.x_comm
statement:
theorem Koszul.x_comm (a b : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    Koszul.x R n a d ≫ Koszul.x R n b (d + 1) = Koszul.x R n b d ≫ Koszul.x R n a (d + 1)
proof:
:= by

  split_ifs <;> simp [Koszul.X_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.epi_of_restrict
statement:
theorem Koszul.epi_of_restrict {A B : (space R n).Modules} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hf : ∀ i, Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map f)) :
    Epi f
proof:
:= by
  refine epi_of_projectiveCoordinate_over_epi R n f (fun i ↦ ?_)
  let e := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (coordinateOpen R n i)
  have h1 : Epi ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R n).ringCatSheaf (coordinateOpen R n i) ⋙
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (coordinateOpen R n i)).functor).map f) := by
    rw [← NatIso.naturality_2 e f]
    haveI := hf i
    infer_instance
  exact (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (coordinateOpen R n i)).functor.epi_of_epi_map h1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.epi_map_kernelLift
statement:
theorem Koszul.epi_map_kernelLift {C' E : Type*} [Category C'] [Category E] [Preadditive C']
    [Preadditive E] (G : C' ⥤ E) [G.Additive] {X Y Z : C'} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (w : g ≫ f = 0) [HasKernel f] [HasKernel (G.map f)] [PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) G]
    (h : Epi (kernel.lift (G.map f) (G.map g) (by rw [← G.map_comp, w, G.map_zero]))) :
    Epi (G.map (kernel.lift f g w))
proof:
:= by
  have e : G.map (kernel.lift f g w) =
      kernel.lift (G.map f) (G.map g) (by rw [← G.map_comp, w, G.map_zero]) ≫
        inv (kernelComparison f G) := by
    rw [← map_lift_kernelComparison f G w, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [e]
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Koszul.epi_kernelLift_map
statement:
theorem Koszul.epi_kernelLift_map {C' E : Type*} [Category C'] [Category E] [Preadditive C']
    [Preadditive E] (G : C' ⥤ E) [G.Additive] [G.PreservesEpimorphisms] {X Y Z : C'}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : X ⟶ Y) (w : g ≫ f = 0) [HasKernel f] [HasKernel (G.map f)]
    [PreservesLimit (parallelPair f 0) G] (h : Epi (kernel.lift f g w)) :
    Epi (kernel.lift (G.map f) (G.map g) (by rw [← G.map_comp, w, G.map_zero]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_lift_kernelComparison f G w]
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveKoszulData_exact
statement:
theorem projectiveKoszulData_exact (d : ℤ) :
    Epi (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K d).d 1 0) ∧
    ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K d).d (k + 1) k)
      (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K d).d (k + 2) (k + 1)) (HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d _ _ _ _))
proof:
:= by
  have hloc : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
          (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K d).d 1 0)) ∧
      ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
          (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K d).d (k + 1) k))
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).map
          (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K d).d (k + 2) (k + 1))) (by
            rw [← Functor.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, Functor.map_zero])) :=
    fun i ↦ Koszul.KData.epi_of_null (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n i).ι)
      (projectiveKoszulData R n) i (Koszul.KData.kos_null _ _ _ (n + 1) i i.isLt)
      (Koszul.KData.kos_isIso _ _ _ _ i (fun d ↦ by
        rw [Koszul.x_fin]
        exact Koszul.X_restrict_isIso R n i d) (n + 1)) d
  refine ⟨Koszul.epi_of_restrict R n _ (fun i ↦ (hloc i).1),
    fun k ↦ Koszul.epi_of_restrict R n _ (fun i ↦ ?_)⟩
  haveI := restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (coordinateOpen R n i)
  exact Koszul.epi_map_kernelLift _ _ _ _ ((hloc i).2 k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul
statement:
lemma affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : Y.Modules) (x : M.val.obj (op ⊤)) :
    affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsMap f M
        ((1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤), f.appTop.hom] x) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M).app ⊤ x
proof:
:= by
  change (ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars
    f.appTop.hom _) ((1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤), f.appTop.hom] x) = _
  have : CommRing (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(X, ⊤))
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars_hom_apply]
  change (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) •
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M).val.app
        (op ⊤) ≫
        (affineSchemePushforwardTopModuleIso f
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)).hom) x) = _
  rw [one_smul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemeModuleSpecΓPullbackUnit

    (x : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) :
    (((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Spec.map phi)).unit.app E) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso phi
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (Spec.map phi)).obj E)).hom)) x =

        (Spec.map phi)).unit.app E).app ⊤ x
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemeIso_image_top
statement: private lemma affineSchemeIso_image_top (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] : f ''ᵁ ⊤ = ⊤

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemeIso_topSectionMap_eq_inv_appTop
statement:
private lemma affineSchemeIso_topSectionMap_eq_inv_appTop (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] :
    (f.appIso ⊤).inv ≫
        Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineSchemeIso_image_top f).symm).op =
      (asIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso f.appTop := by
    change IsIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_mono f.appTop).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [f.naturality]
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_app_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  change X.presheaf.map _ =
    (asIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)).inv ≫ Scheme.Γ.map f.op
  have hright : (asIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)).inv ≫
      Scheme.Γ.map f.op = 𝟙 _ :=
    (asIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)).inv_hom_id
  rw [hright]
  convert X.presheaf.map_id (op (⊤ : X.Opens)) using 1 <;> subsingleton

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemeRestrictIsoTopAddIso_map_smul
statement:
private lemma affineSchemeRestrictIsoTopAddIso_map_smul (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f]
    (M : Y.Modules) (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) (x : Γ(M.restrict f, ⊤)) :
    (affineSchemeRestrictIsoTopAddIso f M).hom
        (((M.restrict f).smul r).hom x) =
      (M.smul ((asIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)).inv r)).hom
        ((affineSchemeRestrictIsoTopAddIso f M).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  change M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineSchemeIso_image_top f).symm).op
      ((M.restrictAppIso f ⊤).hom (r • x)) =
    (M.smul ((asIso (Scheme.Γ.map f.op)).inv r)).hom
      (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineSchemeIso_image_top f).symm).op
        ((M.restrictAppIso f ⊤).hom x))
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  change (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineSchemeIso_image_top f).symm).op
      ((f.appIso ⊤).inv r)) • _ = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    affineSchemeIso_topSectionMap_eq_inv_appTop]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemeIsoSpecInvGlobalSectionsIso_inv_apply
statement:
private lemma affineSchemeIsoSpecInvGlobalSectionsIso_inv_apply (M : Y.Modules)
    (x : M.val.obj (op ⊤)) :

      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction Y.isoSpec.inv).unit.app M).app ⊤ x
proof:

    Functor.mapIso_inv,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemeIsoSpecHomGlobalSectionsIso_inv_apply

private lemma affineSchemeIsoSpecHomGlobalSectionsIso_inv_apply
    (P : (Spec (.of Γ(X, ⊤))).Modules)

    Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemePushforwardChartIso_hom_app_appTop_apply
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsIso_hom_one_tmul
statement:
lemma affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsIso_hom_one_tmul
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (x : M.val.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsIso f M).hom
        ((1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤), f.appTop.hom] x) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M).app ⊤ x
proof:
:= by
  let MY := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv).obj M
  letI : MY.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  let E : AffineQuasicoherent (.of Γ(Y, ⊤)) := ⟨MY, inferInstance⟩
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj MY
  let y := (affineSchemeIsoSpecInvGlobalSectionsIso M).inv x
  have hB : (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso f.appTop.hom E).hom
        ((1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤), f.appTop.hom] y) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map f.appTop)).unit.app E.obj).app ⊤ y := by
    rw [← affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_eq_iso_hom]
    rw [affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul]
    exact affineSchemeModuleSpecΓPullbackUnit f.appTop E.obj y
  change ((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).map
      ((affineSchemePullbackCanonicalNatIso f).inv.app M))
    ((affineSchemeIsoSpecHomGlobalSectionsIso P).inv
      ((affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso f.appTop.hom E).hom
        (((ModuleCat.extendScalars f.appTop.hom).map
          (affineSchemeIsoSpecInvGlobalSectionsIso M).inv)
          ((1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤), f.appTop.hom] x)))) = _
  rw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
  rw [hB]
  rw [affineSchemeIsoSpecHomGlobalSectionsIso_inv_apply]
  let adjPull := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  let adjChart := affineSchemePullbackChartAdjunction f
  let c := affineSchemePullbackCanonicalNatIso f
  have hcomp : adjChart.unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        ((adjPull.leftAdjointUniq adjChart).inv.app M) =
    adjPull.unit.app M := by
    rw [← Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app adjPull adjChart M,
      Category.assoc, ← (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map_comp]
    rw [(adjPull.leftAdjointUniq adjChart).hom_inv_id_app,
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map_id]
    change adjPull.unit.app M ≫
        𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) =
      adjPull.unit.app M
    exact Category.comp_id _
  have hcompTop := congrArg (fun q => q.app (⊤ : Y.Opens)) hcomp
  have hcompX := CategoryTheory.congr_fun hcompTop x
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_obj_obj, Opens.map_top, Functor.id_obj,
    affineSchemePullbackChartAdjunction, Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight_unit, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Adjunction.comp_unit_app, Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app,
    homOfLE_leOfHom, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app, AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp,
    AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, adjChart, adjPull] at hcompX
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv ⋙
    Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map f.appTop) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom).obj M
  let a : N.val.obj (op (⊤ : X.Opens)) :=
    (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE
      (X.isoSpec.hom.image_preimage_le ⊤)).op).hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map f.appTop)).unit.app MY).app ⊤).hom
          ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (Y.isoSpec.inv.image_preimage_le ⊤)).op).hom x))
  let z : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop) ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward Y.isoSpec.inv).obj N).val.obj (op ⊤) := a
  have hza : z = a := by
    change (((SheafOfModules.Hom.val (𝟙 N)).app
      (op (⊤ : X.Opens))).hom' a) = a
    exact affineSchemeModules_id_app_apply N ⊤ a
  have hz := affineSchemePushforwardChartIso_hom_app_appTop_apply f N z
  let w := ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).leftAdjointUniq
    (affineSchemePullbackChartAdjunction f)).inv.app M).app
      (⊤ : X.Opens)).hom
  change w
      ((((affineSchemePushforwardChartIso f).hom.app N).app ⊤).hom z) = _
    at hcompX
  rw [hz] at hcompX
  rw [hza] at hcompX
  change w _ = _
  simp [w, affineSchemePullbackChartAdjunction, y, E, P, MY,
    affineSchemeIsoSpecInvGlobalSectionsIso_inv_apply]
  change w (((SheafOfModules.Hom.val (𝟙 N)).app
    (op (⊤ : X.Opens))).hom' a) = _
  rw [affineSchemeModules_id_app_apply N ⊤ a]
  exact hcompX

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdFromChern_delta
statement:
theorem tdFromChern_delta (c : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M)
    (h : ∀ i, c i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0) : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern c = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logTd c = 0 := by
    unfold GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logTd
    have : (fun m : ℕ ↦ if m = 0 then (0 : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M) else
        GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff
          (fun j ↦ PowerSeries.coeff j (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)) m •
          GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.powerSum c m) = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
      funext m
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · simp [hm]
      · simp [hm, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.powerSum_delta c h m]
    rw [this, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum_zero]
  unfold GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern
  rw [h0, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.dualChern_chernSeq_line
statement:
theorem dualChern_chernSeq_line (L L' : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1)
    (h : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL + totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL' = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (chernSeq k (closedPosV4 k) L') j =
      chernSeq k (closedPosV4 k) L j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chernSeq_line k _ L hL j]
  unfold GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern
  rw [chernSeq_line k _ L' hL' j]
  rcases j with _ | _ | j
  · simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn]
  · simp only [lineChern, chernLineValOn]
    have h' : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL = -totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL' :=
      calc totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL
          = (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL + totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL') -
              totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL' := by abel
        _ = -totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL' := by rw [h]; abel
    simp [h']
    exact neg_one_smul ℚ (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL')
  · simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualTot_line
statement:
theorem tdDualTot_line (L L' : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1)
    (h : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL + totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL' = 0) :
    tdDualTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) L' = tdLine k L hL
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k
  have hc := chernData_constRank (hP := closedPosV4 k)
    (whitney_projectiveIntegral (closedPosV4 k)) hL'
  have e1 : tdDualTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) L' =
      GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern
        (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (chernSeq k (closedPosV4 k) L')) :=
    hc.dual.tdFromChern_eq_tot.symm
  rw [e1, funext (dualChern_chernSeq_line k L L' hL hL' h)]
  exact tdFromChern_chernSeq_line k _ L hL

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualTot_unit
statement:
theorem tdDualTot_unit :
    tdDualTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) (tensorUnitSheaf W) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k
  have hu : HasConstantRank W (tensorUnitSheaf W) 1 := hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  have hcap : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (tensorUnitSheaf W) hu = 0 := totalCapOn_tensorUnit (opsV4 k)
  have hc := chernData_constRank (hP := closedPosV4 k)
    (whitney_projectiveIntegral (closedPosV4 k)) hu
  have e1 : tdDualTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) (tensorUnitSheaf W) =
      GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern
        (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (chernSeq k (closedPosV4 k) (tensorUnitSheaf W))) :=
    hc.dual.tdFromChern_eq_tot.symm
  rw [e1]
  refine tdFromChern_delta _ fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, chernSeq_line k _ _ hu j]
  rcases j with _ | _ | j
  · simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn]
  · simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn, hcap]
  · simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.pullbackTwistTensorIso
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistTensorIso :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf X)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree i
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree 1)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (-1))
  have e0 : C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (1 + -1) = C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0 :=
    congrArg C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨(asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom i (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)))).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).mapIso
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorIso hpos 1 (-1)
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility_of_restrictionIndependence hpos 1 (-1)
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartRestrictionIndependence hpos 1 (-1))) ≪≫
        eqToIso e0 ≪≫ C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso) ≪≫
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso i⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.cap_pullback_twist_add
statement:
theorem cap_pullback_twist_add :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) +
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  have h2 := hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
  have hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)))) 1 := by
    simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf h1 h2
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := pullbackTwistTensorIso C hpos i
  rw [← totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) _ _ h1 h2 hT,
    cap_isoOn (ops := opsV4 k) hT hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨e⟩,
    totalCapOn_tensorUnit (opsV4 k)]

  exact ⟨_, libConormalAmb_hasConstantRank i (quasiregularCover_amb i

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan_kahler_pullback
statement:
theorem tdTan_kahler_pullback (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    tdTan k X (pullbackK0RingHom i
      (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
        (T1KG3.OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
          (T1KG3.OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1))))) =
      (tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
            (n + 1 + 1) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  have hK := (FIN.ch_fShriekCan_kahler k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi).1
  have hcl : pullbackK0RingHom i
      ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) =
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
        ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))).isFiniteLocallyFree :=
    pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i _ _
  rw [hK, tdTan_sub, tdTan_nsmul, hcl, tdTanInv_one, mul_one,
    tdTan_pullback_twist (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)) (cover_hpos (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)) i k]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan_relCotangentVirtual
statement:
theorem tdTan_relCotangentVirtual (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) r) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i hr.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
            (n + 1 + 1)) * tdInvN k (closedPosV4 k) i := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  unfold relCotangentVirtual
  rw [tdTan_sub, tdTan_kahler_pullback k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi, tdTanInv_classOf,
    tdInvN_eq_tdInvDualTot (closedPosV4 k) i hr]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.grr_chow_kahler
statement:
theorem grr_chow_kahler (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) r) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i hr.isFiniteLocallyFree)
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ x
  rw [CAN.ch_fShriekCan k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x,
    tdTan_relCotangentVirtual k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hr]
  rfl

theorem conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.grr_chow_kahler_f
statement:
theorem grr_chow_kahler_f (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree k hX hY hYreg hXreg i))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := conormal_hasConstantRank k hX hY hYreg hXreg i
  subst hi
  intro _ _ _ x
  exact grr_chow_kahler k hX hXreg hY hYreg _ hf i rfl hr x

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.rhs_independent
statement:
theorem rhs_independent (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n n' : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f)
    (i' : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (hi' : i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).toBase = f) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [i'.IsOver (Spk k)] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (x : K0 X),
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree k hX hY hYreg hXreg i))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i' (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree k hX hY hYreg hXreg i'))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n' + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ _ _ x
  rw [← grr_chow_kahler_f k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x,
    ← grr_chow_kahler_f k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i' hi' x]

name: ARRLciUncond.closedImmersion_field_lci

    (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range i)
    (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X) {r : ℕ} (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j A)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral A) j

      pushLocF3 j i (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *

    (hreg : RegStalks Y) {r : ℕ} (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X) {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))

  ARRLciTop.adamsRR_lci_all_of_data n i htwGate hY hreg C hnilX N hj x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseModulePullback_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem projectiveBaseModulePullback_isFinitePresentation
    (Q : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.FinitePresentation R Q] :
    (projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Q).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Q
  let P := projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Q
  letI : B.IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation (R := CommRingCat.of R) Q
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens :=
    fun j ↦ coordinateOpen R n j.down
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2 (by
      change ⨆ j : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n j.down = ⊤
      simpa only [U, iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n)
  letI : ∀ j, (P.over (U j)).IsFinitePresentation := fun j ↦ by
    letI : IsAffine (U j).toScheme :=
      coordinateOpen_isAffine R n j.down
    let f : (U j).toScheme ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
      (U j).ι ≫ toSpec R n
    let L := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj B
    letI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
      pullback_isFinitePresentation_of_isAffine f B
    let K := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U j).ι).obj P
    let e : K ≅ L :=
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (U j).ι).app P ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (U j).ι (toSpec R n)).app B
    letI : K.IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
        (U j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e.symm inferInstance
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U j)).inverse.obj K
    letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U j) K
    let eOver : P.over (U j) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U j)).unitIso.app (P.over (U j)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U j)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U j)).app P)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U j))).prop_of_iso eOver.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover P U hU
