name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularLocalRing_of_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_of_quotient_span_singleton {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] {x : S} (hx : IsSMulRegular S x) (hxm : x ∈ maximalIdeal S)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] : IsRegularLocalRing S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let π : S →+* S ⧸ Ideal.span {x} := Ideal.Quotient.mk _
  have hπs : Function.Surjective π := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal S).map π = maximalIdeal (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
    map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective π hπs
  obtain ⟨T, hTcard, hTspan⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
    (maximalIdeal (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  set d := (maximalIdeal (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank with hd
  let G : Finset S := T.image (Function.surjInv hπs)
  have hGimg : π '' (G : Set S) = (T : Set (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) := by
    ext y
    simp only [G, Set.mem_image, Finset.coe_image, Finset.mem_coe]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simpa [Function.surjInv_eq hπs] using ht
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, Function.surjInv_eq hπs y⟩
  have hGmap : (Ideal.span (G : Set S)).map π = maximalIdeal (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, hGimg]; exact hTspan
  have hker : RingHom.ker π = Ideal.span {x} := Ideal.mk_ker
  have hxle : Ideal.span {x} ≤ maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]; simpa using hxm
  have hc : Ideal.comap π ⊥ = Ideal.span {x} := by
    rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]; exact hker
  have hm : maximalIdeal S = Ideal.span (G : Set S) ⊔ Ideal.span {x} := by
    have h1 : (maximalIdeal S).map π = (Ideal.span (G : Set S)).map π := hmap.trans hGmap.symm
    have e1 := Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective π hπs (maximalIdeal S)
    have e2 := Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective π hπs (Ideal.span (G : Set S))
    rw [h1, hc] at e1
    rw [hc] at e2
    rw [sup_eq_left.mpr hxle] at e1
    exact (e2.symm.trans e1).symm
  have hdimq : ringKrullDim (S ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := S ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).symm
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim hx hxm
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  rw [← hdim, hdimq]
  have hle : (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank ≤ d + 1 := by
    have hfin : ((G : Set S) ∪ {x}).Finite := G.finite_toSet.union (Set.finite_singleton x)
    have hspan : Ideal.span ((G : Set S) ∪ {x}) = maximalIdeal S := by
      rw [Ideal.span_union, hm]
    rw [← hspan]
    refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite hfin).trans ?_
    calc ((G : Set S) ∪ {x}).ncard ≤ (G : Set S).ncard + ({x} : Set S).ncard :=
          Set.ncard_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ d + 1 := by
          rw [Set.ncard_singleton, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
          have : G.card ≤ T.card := Finset.card_image_le
          omega
  have : (((maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (((d + 1 : ℕ)) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast hle
  simpa using this

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isSMulRegular_localization_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ c : Localization.AtPrime Q, algebraMap R _ x * c = 0 → c = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨a, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq Q.primeCompl c
    rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (M := Q.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime Q) x,
      ← IsLocalization.mk'_mul, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hc
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hc
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    have h2 : (m.1 * a) * x = 0 := by rw [← hm]; ring
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp hx).2 _ h2
  intro a b hab
  have : algebraMap R _ x * (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hab
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (key _ this)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_localization
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_localization {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (Q : Ideal R) [Q.IsPrime] (hIQ : I ≤ Q) [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ I)] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI hQbar : (Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker])
  haveI hloc : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ I) Q.primeCompl)
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q))) := inferInstance
  have hsub : Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ I) Q.primeCompl =
      (Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).primeCompl := by
    ext y
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid, Submonoid.mem_map, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ hmem
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq] at hab
      have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk I b ∈ Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by rw [hab]; exact hmem
      obtain ⟨c, hcQ, hc⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp h1
      have h2 : b - c ∈ I := by rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq]; exact hc.symm
      apply hb
      have : b = (b - c) + c := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact Q.add_mem (hIQ h2) hcQ
    · intro h
      exact ⟨a, fun ha => h (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha), by simp [Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]⟩
  rw [hsub] at hloc
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) :=
    IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization _
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime (Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)))).toRingEquiv

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularLocalRing_localization_of_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_of_quotient_span_singleton {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] {x : R} (hx : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) (Q : Ideal R) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hxQ : x ∈ Q) [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S := Localization.AtPrime Q with hS
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing S := IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing Q.primeCompl S inferInstance
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x} with hI
  have hIQ : I ≤ Q := by rw [hI, Ideal.span_le]; simpa using hxQ
  have hxm : algebraMap R S x ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hxQ
  have hmapI : Ideal.span {algebraMap R S x} = I.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    rw [hI, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap R S x}) := by
    rw [hmapI]
    exact isRegularLocalRing_quotient_localization I Q hIQ
  exact isRegularLocalRing_of_quotient_span_singleton
    (isSMulRegular_localization_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hx Q) hxm

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M T]
    [IsRegularRing A] : IsRegularRing T
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing T := IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing M T inferInstance
  refine ⟨fun q' _ => ?_⟩
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (localizationAtPrimeEquivComap M q')

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M T]
    [IsRegularRing T] (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime] (hq : Disjoint (M : Set A) q) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  haveI hq' : (q.map (algebraMap A T)).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint M T q inferInstance hq
  have hc : (q.map (algebraMap A T)).comap (algebraMap A T) = q :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M T inferInstance hq
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (q.map (algebraMap A T))) :=
    IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization _
  have key : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
      p = (q.map (algebraMap A T)).comap (algebraMap A T) →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p) := by
    rintro p hp rfl
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
      (localizationAtPrimeEquivComap M (q.map (algebraMap A T))).symm
  exact key q hc.symm

name: BlowupRegularAR12.exists_common_unit
statement:
theorem exists_common_unit {ι : Type*} (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (s : Finset ι)
    (Q : ι → R → Prop) (hQ : ∀ i u v, Q i u → Q i (u * v))
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ u ∉ P, Q i u) : ∃ u ∉ P, ∀ i ∈ s, Q i u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, P.primeCompl.one_mem, by simp⟩
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨u1, hu1, hQ1⟩ := h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    obtain ⟨u2, hu2, hQ2⟩ := ih fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    refine ⟨u1 * u2, fun hm => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases (Ideal.IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem inferInstance).mp hm with h1 | h1
      exacts [hu1 h1, hu2 h1]
    · intro i hi
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
      · exact hQ _ _ _ hQ1
      · rw [mul_comm]; exact hQ _ _ _ (hQ2 i hi)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.exists_unit_killing_ann
statement:
theorem exists_unit_killing_ann [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (ys : List R)
    (hA : IsWeaklyRegular (Localization.AtPrime P) (ys.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P))))
    (hmax : ∀ y ∈ ys, algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P) y ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) :
    ∃ u ∉ P, ∀ y ∈ ys, ∀ x : R, y * x = 0 → u * x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hreg : ∀ y ∈ ys, IsSMulRegular A (algebraMap R A y) := by
    intro y hy
    have hperm : List.Perm (ys.map (algebraMap R A))
        ((y :: ys.erase y).map (algebraMap R A)) :=
      (List.perm_cons_erase hy).map _
    have h2 := IsLocalRing.isWeaklyRegular_of_perm_of_subset_maximalIdeal hA hperm (by
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
      exact hmax y' hy')
    simp only [List.map_cons] at h2
    exact (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff _ _ _ |>.mp h2).1
  have key : ∀ y ∈ ys, ∃ u ∉ P, ∀ x : R, y * x = 0 → u * x = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    set I : Ideal R := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft R y) with hI
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian I
    have hloc : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ u ∉ P, u * g = 0 := by
      intro g hg
      have hgI : g ∈ I := hG ▸ Submodule.subset_span hg
      have hg0 : y * g = 0 := hgI
      have : algebraMap R A g = 0 := by
        have h0 : algebraMap R A y * algebraMap R A g = 0 := by rw [← map_mul, hg0, map_zero]
        exact hreg y hy (a₁ := algebraMap R A g) (a₂ := 0) (by simp [smul_eq_mul, h0])
      obtain ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, hu0⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff P.primeCompl A g).mp this
      exact ⟨u, hu, hu0⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hk⟩ := exists_common_unit P G (fun g u => u * g = 0)
      (fun g u v h => by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm v, ← mul_assoc, h, zero_mul]) hloc
    have hspan : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span R (G : Set R), u * x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem g hg => exact hk g hg
      | zero => simp
      | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [mul_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
      | smul c a _ ha => rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, ha, mul_zero]
    refine ⟨u, hu, fun x hx => hspan x ?_⟩
    rw [hG]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hall⟩ := exists_common_unit P ys.toFinset
    (fun y u => ∀ x : R, y * x = 0 → u * x = 0)
    (fun y u v h x hx => by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm v, ← mul_assoc, h x hx, zero_mul])
    (fun y hy => key y (List.mem_toFinset.mp hy))
  exact ⟨u, hu, fun y hy => hall y (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hy)⟩

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin_of_regular
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin_of_regular (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R]
    (n : ℕ) : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial.isEmptyRingEquiv R (Fin 0)).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    haveI := ih
    haveI : IsRegularRing (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) :=
      SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularRing_polynomial _
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).toRingEquiv.symm

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R]
    (σ : Type) [Finite σ] : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin_of_regular R (Nat.card σ)
  exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv
    (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv R (Finite.equivFin σ).symm).toRingEquiv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.shortExact_left_isQuasicoherent_on_Spec
statement:
theorem shortExact_left_isQuasicoherent_on_Spec
    {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec A).Modules)
    [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let B : PUnit → (Spec A).Modules := fun _ => T.X₂
  let C : PUnit → (Spec A).Modules := fun _ => T.X₃
  let u : ∀ V : (Spec A).Opens,
      Γ(T.X₁, V) →ₗ[A] (∀ _ : PUnit, Γ(T.X₂, V)) :=
    fun V => LinearMap.pi fun _ => Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.f V
  let d : ∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, (∀ _ : PUnit, Γ(T.X₂, V)) →ₗ[A]
      (∀ _ : PUnit, Γ(T.X₃, V)) :=
    fun V => LinearMap.pi fun _ =>
      (Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.g V).comp (LinearMap.proj PUnit.unit)
  refine Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_exact_ladder
    T.X₁ B C (fun _ => inferInstance) (fun _ => inferInstance)
    u d ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U V h x i
    change Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.f V (T.X₁.mapₗ h x) =
      T.X₂.mapₗ h (Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.f U x)
    exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ T.f h x
  · intro U V h s k
    change Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.g V (T.X₂.mapₗ h (s PUnit.unit)) =
      T.X₃.mapₗ h (Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.g U (s PUnit.unit))
    exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ T.g h (s PUnit.unit)
  · intro V x y hxy
    have h := congrFun hxy PUnit.unit
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.evaluation
        (Spec A).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)) := by
      infer_instance
    letI : PreservesLimit (cospan T.f T.f) (SheafOfModules.evaluation
        (Spec A).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)) := by
      exact SheafOfModules.evaluationPreservesLimit
        (F := cospan T.f T.f) (Opposite.op V)
    have hmono : Mono ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
        (Spec A).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)).map T.f) :=
      @preserves_mono_of_preservesLimit _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation
          (Spec A).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)) _ _ T.f
        inferInstance hT.mono_f
    exact ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
        (Spec A).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)).map T.f)).mp hmono) h
  · intro V
    let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation
      (Spec A).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)
    have hzero : E.PreservesZeroMorphisms := by
      dsimp only [E]
      exact Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
    let TE := @ShortComplex.map _ _ _ _ _ _ T E hzero
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E := by
      dsimp only [E]
      infer_instance
    letI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair T.g 0) E := by
      exact SheafOfModules.evaluationPreservesLimit
        (F := parallelPair T.g 0) (Opposite.op V)
    have hE : TE.Exact :=
      @ShortComplex.Exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel
        _ _ _ _ _ _ T _ hT.exact E hzero
        inferInstance
        hT.mono_f inferInstance
    have hfun : Function.Exact TE.f TE.g :=
      (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact
        TE).mp hE
    intro y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hy0 : TE.g (y PUnit.unit) = 0 := by
        have h := congrFun hy PUnit.unit
        change Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.g V (y PUnit.unit) = 0 at h
        change Scheme.Modules.appₗ T.g V (y PUnit.unit) = 0
        exact h
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hfun (y PUnit.unit)).mp hy0
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      funext i
      cases i
      exact hx
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      funext i
      cases i
      exact (hfun _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.shortExact_left_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem shortExact_left_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian_of_isAffine
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, ⊤)]
    (T : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    [T.X₂.IsFinitePresentation] [T.X₃.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    T.X₁.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv
  let S := T.map F
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact X.isoSpec.inv T hT
  letI : S.X₂.IsFinitePresentation := by
    change (F.obj T.X₂).IsFinitePresentation
    exact isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv T.X₂
  letI : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation := by
    change (F.obj T.X₃).IsFinitePresentation
    exact isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv T.X₃
  letI : S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    exact shortExact_left_isQuasicoherent_on_Spec S hS
  letI : S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.shortExact_left_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian S hS
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom
  letI : (G.obj S.X₁).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom S.X₁
  letI : ((F ⋙ G).obj T.X₁).IsFinitePresentation := by
    change (G.obj S.X₁).IsFinitePresentation
    infer_instance
  let e : (F ⋙ G).obj T.X₁ ≅ T.X₁ :=
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
        X.isoSpec.hom X.isoSpec.inv).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr X.isoSpec.hom_inv_id ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId).app T.X₁)
  exact
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      e inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveKernel_isFinitePresentation_of_epi
statement:
theorem projectiveKernel_isFinitePresentation_of_epi
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {M N : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules}
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] [N.IsFinitePresentation]
    (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f] :
    (kernel f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let K := kernel f
  let S : ShortComplex X.Modules :=
    ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι f) f (kernel.condition f)
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel f }
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens :=
    fun j => coordinateOpen R n j.down
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2 (by
      change ⨆ j : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n j.down = ⊤
      simpa only [U, iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n)
  letI : ∀ j, (K.over (U j)).IsFinitePresentation := fun j => by
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U j).ι
    let T := S.map F
    have hT : T.ShortExact :=
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact (U j).ι S hS
    letI : IsAffine (U j).toScheme :=
      coordinateOpen_isAffine R n j.down
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ((U j).toScheme, ⊤) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian
        ⟨(⊤ : (U j).toScheme.Opens), isAffineOpen_top (U j).toScheme⟩
    letI : T.X₂.IsFinitePresentation := by
      change (F.obj M).IsFinitePresentation
      exact isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (U j).ι M
    letI : T.X₃.IsFinitePresentation := by
      change (F.obj N).IsFinitePresentation
      exact isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (U j).ι N
    let L := F.obj K
    letI : L.IsFinitePresentation := by
      change T.X₁.IsFinitePresentation
      exact shortExact_left_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian_of_isAffine
        T hT
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U j)).inverse.obj L
    letI : P.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U j) L
    let e : K.over (U j) ≅ P :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U j)).unitIso.app (K.over (U j)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U j)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U j)).app K)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U j))).prop_of_iso e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover K U hU

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike_of_dimension_lt
statement:
theorem projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike_of_dimension_lt
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (i : ℕ) (hni : n < i) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n) M i)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :
      IsZero
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
          (toSpec R n) M i) :=
    quasicoherent_affineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove_dimension
      R n M i hni
  exact
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        hzero.isoZero.symm inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike_of_degree_budget
statement:
theorem projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike_of_degree_budget
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (hn : 0 < n)
    (r i : ℕ) (hri : n < i + r)
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n) M i)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing i M with
  | zero =>
      exact projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike_of_dimension_lt
        R n M i (by omega)
  | succ r ih =>
      by_cases hni : n < i
      · exact projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike_of_dimension_lt
          R n M i hni
      · obtain ⟨D⟩ := projectiveTwistGenerated R n M
        letI : Module.Finite R (D.G.I →₀ R) :=
          D.coefficient_isFinite
        letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (D.G.I →₀ R) :=
          Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
        letI :
            (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
              (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) D.d).IsFinitePresentation :=
          projectiveTwistingBaseModule_isFinitePresentation
            R n (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) D.d
        letI : Epi D.projection := D.projection_epi
        letI : (kernel D.projection).IsFinitePresentation :=
          projectiveKernel_isFinitePresentation_of_epi R n D.projection
        have hK :
            SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
              (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
                (toSpec R n) (kernel D.projection) (i + 1)) :=
          ih (i + 1) (by omega) (kernel D.projection)
        have hG :
            SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
              (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
                (toSpec R n)
                (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
                  (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) D.d) i) :=
          projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
            R (D.G.I →₀ R) n hn D.d i
        have hMqc :
            (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
              (toSpec R n) M i).IsQuasicoherent :=
          affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_all_of_isQuasicoherent
            R n M i
        let S : ShortComplex (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules :=
          ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι D.projection) D.projection
            (kernel.condition D.projection)
        have hS : S.ShortExact :=
          { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel D.projection }
        exact
          SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_right_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
            (toSpec R n) S hS i hG hMqc hK

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularLocalRing_localization_polynomial_of_comap
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_polynomial_of_comap (P : Ideal A[X]) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : P.comap C = maximalIdeal A) : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := maximalIdeal A with hm
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl _ inferInstance
  obtain ⟨G, hGcard, hGspan⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
    (m.fg_of_isNoetherianRing)
  set d := m.spanFinrank with hd
  have hmd : m.height = (d : ℕ∞) := by
    have h1 := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim (R := A))
    have h2 := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := A)
    rw [← h2] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  let ψ : A[X] →+* (ResidueField A)[X] := Polynomial.mapRingHom (residue A)
  have hψs : Function.Surjective ψ := Polynomial.map_surjective _ (residue_surjective)
  have hψk : RingHom.ker ψ = m.map C := by
    rw [Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, ker_residue]
  have hmP : m.map C ≤ P := by
    rw [← hP]; exact Ideal.map_comap_le
  haveI : (P.map ψ).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hψs (by rw [hψk]; exact hmP)
  set fb := Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (P.map ψ) with hfb
  have hfbmem : fb ∈ P.map ψ := Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator_mem _
  obtain ⟨f, hfP, hfψ⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective ψ hψs).mp hfbmem
  have hPeq : P = m.map C ⊔ Ideal.span {f} := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      have hxψ : ψ x ∈ P.map ψ := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem ψ hx
      rw [← Submodule.IsPrincipal.span_singleton_generator (P.map ψ), Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
        at hxψ
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hxψ
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hψs a
      have hk : x - g * f ∈ RingHom.ker ψ := by
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_mul, hfψ]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr ha.symm
      rw [hψk] at hk
      have : x = (x - g * f) + g * f := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left hk)
        (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f)))
    · exact sup_le hmP (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hfP))
  have hmG : m = Ideal.span (G : Set A) := hGspan.symm
  have hmapC : m.map C = Ideal.span (C '' (G : Set A)) := by
    rw [hmG, Ideal.map_span]
  have hCG : (C '' (G : Set A)).Finite := G.finite_toSet.image _
  have hCGcard : (C '' (G : Set A)).ncard ≤ d := by
    calc (C '' (G : Set A)).ncard ≤ (G : Set A).ncard := Set.ncard_image_le G.finite_toSet
      _ = d := by rw [Set.ncard_coe_finset, hGcard]
  have hmPrime : (m.map C).IsPrime := inferInstance
  have hht : (m.map C).height = (d : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [Polynomial.height_map_C m, hmd]
  obtain ⟨T, hTfin, hTspan, hTle⟩ : ∃ T : Set A[X], T.Finite ∧ Ideal.span T = P ∧
      ((T.ncard : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ P.height := by
    by_cases hf : f ∈ m.map C
    · have hPm : P = m.map C := by
        rw [hPeq]; exact sup_eq_left.mpr (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hf))
      refine ⟨C '' (G : Set A), hCG, by rw [← hmapC, hPm], ?_⟩
      rw [hPm, hht]
      exact_mod_cast hCGcard
    · have hlt : m.map C < P := lt_of_le_of_ne hmP fun h => hf (h ▸ hfP)
      have hlt' := Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime hlt
      rw [hht] at hlt'
      have hle1 : (d : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ P.height := (ENat.add_one_le_iff (by simp)).mpr hlt'
      refine ⟨C '' (G : Set A) ∪ {f}, hCG.union (Set.finite_singleton f), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Ideal.span_union, ← hmapC, ← hPeq]
      · refine le_trans ?_ hle1
        have : (C '' (G : Set A) ∪ {f}).ncard ≤ (C '' (G : Set A)).ncard + 1 := by
          calc (C '' (G : Set A) ∪ {f}).ncard ≤ (C '' (G : Set A)).ncard + ({f} : Set A[X]).ncard :=
                Set.ncard_union_le _ _
            _ = (C '' (G : Set A)).ncard + 1 := by rw [Set.ncard_singleton]
        have h2 : (C '' (G : Set A) ∪ {f}).ncard ≤ d + 1 := this.trans (by omega)
        exact_mod_cast h2
  have hB : maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) = Ideal.map (algebraMap A[X] _) P :=
    (Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal).symm
  have hspan : (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).spanFinrank ≤ T.ncard := by
    have hmapT := Ideal.map_span (algebraMap A[X] (Localization.AtPrime P)) T
    rw [hTspan] at hmapT
    rw [hB, hmapT]
    exact (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (hTfin.image _)).trans
      (Set.ncard_image_le hTfin)
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime P) = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P _
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  rw [hdim]
  have : ((maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).spanFinrank : ℕ∞) ≤ P.height :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hspan) hTle
  exact_mod_cast this

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularLocalRing_localization_polynomial
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_polynomial {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R]
    (P : Ideal R[X]) [P.IsPrime] : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Q : Ideal R := P.comap C with hQ
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := inferInstance
  haveI hA : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocalization (Q.primeCompl.map C) (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X] :=
    Polynomial.isLocalization Q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime Q)
  have disj : Disjoint ((Q.primeCompl.map C : Submonoid R[X]) : Set R[X]) P := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun a ⟨b, hb⟩ ha => hb.1 ?_
    rw [← hb.2] at ha
    exact ha
  set P' : Ideal (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X] :=
    P.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X]) with hP'
  haveI hP'prime : P'.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Q.primeCompl.map C) _ P inferInstance disj
  have hcomapP : P'.comap (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X]) = P :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Q.primeCompl.map C) _ inferInstance disj
  have hcomapC : P'.comap (C : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X]) =
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q) := by
    have h1 : (P'.comap (C : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X])).comap
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) = Q := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_comap]
      have : (C : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X]).comp
          (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) =
          (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X]).comp C := by
        ext r
        simp
      rw [this, ← Ideal.comap_comap, hcomapP]
    have := IsLocalization.map_under Q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      (P'.comap (C : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X]))
    have h1' : Ideal.under R (P'.comap (C : Localization.AtPrime Q →+*
        (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X])) = Q := h1
    rw [h1'] at this
    rw [← this, Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
  haveI := isRegularLocalRing_localization_polynomial_of_comap P' hcomapC
  haveI hloc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime P') P := by
    have := IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (R := R[X]) (Q.primeCompl.map C) (Localization.AtPrime P') P'
    have this' : IsLocalization
        (P'.comap (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X])).primeCompl
        (Localization.AtPrime P') := this
    have hsub : (P'.comap (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime Q)[X])).primeCompl =
        P.primeCompl := by
      ext x
      simp only [Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff]
      rw [hcomapP]
    rw [hsub] at this'
    exact this'
  let e : Localization.AtPrime P' ≃+* Localization.AtPrime P :=
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (Localization.AtPrime P')).symm.toRingEquiv
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (R := Localization.AtPrime P')
    (R' := Localization.AtPrime P) e

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.rank_add_of_quasiregular
statement:
theorem rank_add_of_quasiregular (R0 A : Type u) [CommRing R0] [CommRing A] [Algebra R0 A]
    (I : Ideal A) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) [Nontrivial (A ⧸ I)] {m d : ℕ}
    [Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m R0 A]
    [Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d R0 (A ⧸ I)] : x.length + d = m
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nontrivial A := (Ideal.Quotient.mk I).domain_nontrivial
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R0 A :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth m
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R0 (A ⧸ I) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth d
  haveI : Algebra.FormallySmooth R0 A := inferInstance
  haveI : Algebra.FormallySmooth R0 (A ⧸ I) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Free (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent := x.free
  have hker : RingHom.ker (algebraMap A (A ⧸ I)) = I := Ideal.mk_ker
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_cotangent_equiv I (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A (A ⧸ I))) hker
  have hr : Module.rank (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent = x.length := by
    rw [rank_eq_card_basis x.conormalBasis]; simp
  have hm : Module.rank (A ⧸ I) ((A ⧸ I) ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄R0]) = m := by
    rw [Module.rank_baseChange]
    simpa using Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
      (R := R0) (S := A) m
  have hd : Module.rank (A ⧸ I) Ω[(A ⧸ I)⁄R0] = d :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential (R := R0)
      (S := A ⧸ I) d
  exact TF5.rank_conormal_add R0 A (A ⧸ I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective I.Cotangent e hr hm hd

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.baseChangeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.baseChangeMap_isIso
    {V W : Y.Opens} (T : Submonoid Γ(Y, W))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) (h : V ≤ W)
    (hT :
      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V) :=
        (baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
      IsLocalization T Γ(Y, V))
    (hM : AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f M i h) :
    IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V) :=
    (baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization T Γ(Y, V) := hT
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V)
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).obj
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  letI : IsLocalizedModule T
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f M i h).hom := hM
  let hbc : IsBaseChange Γ(Y, V)
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f M i h).hom :=
    IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange T Γ(Y, V) _
  let e := hbc.equiv
  have heq :
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h =
        ModuleCat.ofHom e.toLinearMap := by
    change (ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.homEquiv
      (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).symm
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f M i h) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom e.toLinearMap
    apply (ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.homEquiv
      (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    ext x
    erw [ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.toRestrictScalars_hom_apply]
    change affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i h x =
      e (1 ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x)
    rw [IsBaseChange.equiv_tmul, one_smul]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact e.toModuleIso.isIso_hom

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso
    {V W : Y.Opens} (T : Submonoid Γ(Y, W))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) (h : V ≤ W)
    (hT :
      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V) :=
        (baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
      IsLocalization T Γ(Y, V))
    [IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h)] :
    AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f M i h
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V) :=
    (baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization T Γ(Y, V) := hT
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V)
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).obj
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  change IsLocalizedModule T
    (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f M i h).hom
  letI : Module Γ(Y, W)
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V) :=
    Module.compHom _ (baseOpenRestriction h).hom
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V)
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  apply (isLocalizedModule_iff_isBaseChange
    (S := T) (A := Γ(Y, V))
    (f := (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f M i h).hom)).2
  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
    (asIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h)).toLinearEquiv
  intro x
  exact affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul f M i h x

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictUnitIso_hom_app_apply
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_hom_app_apply {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] (V : Y.Opens)
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj (unitX Z), V)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom.app V s = (q.appIso V).hom s
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictPushforwardUnitIso_hom_app_apply
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardUnitIso_hom_app_apply (V : U.toScheme.Opens)
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (unitX X)), V)) :
    (restrictPushforwardIso i U (unitX X)).hom.app V s =
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage i U V)).op s
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => f s) (restrictPushforwardIso_hom_app i U (unitX X) V)

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.nativeStructureMap_restrict
statement:
theorem nativeStructureMap_restrict :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (nativeStructureMap i) ≫
      (restrictNativeTargetIso i U).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫ nativeStructureMap (i ∣_ U)
proof:
:= by
  ext V s
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom.app ((i ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    ((restrictPushforwardIso i U (unitX X)).hom.app V
      (i.app (U.ι ''ᵁ V) s)) =
    (i ∣_ U).app V ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom.app V s)
  rw [restrictUnitIso_hom_app_apply, restrictUnitIso_hom_app_apply,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  change (restrictPushforwardIso i U (unitX X)).hom.app V
    (i.app (U.ι ''ᵁ V) s) = (i ∣_ U).app V s
  exact (restrictPushforwardUnitIso_hom_app_apply i U V _).trans
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (morphismRestrict_app i U V) s).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictNativeKernelIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem restrictNativeKernelIso_inclusion :
    (restrictNativeKernelIso i U).hom ≫ kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (i ∣_ U)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap i)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := CoherentExtensionAR5.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits U.ι
  simp only [restrictNativeKernelIso, Iso.trans_hom, kernel.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι]
  rw [← Category.assoc, PreservesKernel.iso_hom, kernelComparison_comp_ι]

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictIdealIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem restrictIdealIso_inclusion :
    (restrictIdealIso i U).hom ≫ idealModuleι (i ∣_ U).ker =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealModuleι i.ker) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictIdealIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion, restrictNativeKernelIso_inclusion,
    ← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion]

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictIdealIso_kernel_square
statement:
theorem restrictIdealIso_kernel_square :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealKernelIso i).hom ≫
      (restrictNativeKernelIso i U).hom =
    (restrictIdealIso i U).hom ≫ (idealKernelIso (i ∣_ U)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictIdealIso, Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictIdealIso_inv_inclusion
statement:
theorem restrictIdealIso_inv_inclusion :
    (restrictIdealIso i U).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealModuleι i.ker) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom = idealModuleι (i ∣_ U).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (restrictIdealIso i U).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp,
    restrictIdealIso_inclusion]

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictIdealIso_app_inclusion
statement:
theorem restrictIdealIso_app_inclusion (V : U.toScheme.Opens)
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (SchemeKTheory.TF3.idealOf i), V)) :
    SchemeKTheory.TF3.ιapp (i ∣_ U) V ((restrictIdealIso i U).hom.app V s) =
      (U.ι.appIso V).hom (SchemeKTheory.TF3.ιapp i (U.ι ''ᵁ V) s)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := congrArg (fun f => f.app V s) (restrictIdealIso_inclusion i U)
  change SchemeKTheory.TF3.ιapp (i ∣_ U) V ((restrictIdealIso i U).hom.app V s) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom.app V
      (SchemeKTheory.TF3.ιapp i (U.ι ''ᵁ V) s) at hi
  exact hi.trans (restrictUnitIso_hom_app_apply U.ι V _)

name: SchemeKTheory.KernelRestrictionH2.restrictConormalIso_kernel_square
statement:
theorem restrictConormalIso_kernel_square :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map (conormalKernelIso i).hom ≫
      (restrictKernelConormalIso i U).hom =
    (restrictConormalIso i U).hom ≫ (conormalKernelIso (i ∣_ U)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let C := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso i (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι U.ι (i ∣_ U)
    (morphismRestrict_ι i U).symm
  have hs :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map (idealKernelIso i).hom) ≫
        C.hom.app (kernel (nativeStructureMap i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (restrictNativeKernelIso i U).hom =
      C.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.TF3.idealOf i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (restrictIdealIso i U).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (idealKernelIso (i ∣_ U)).hom := by
    have hn :
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map (idealKernelIso i).hom) ≫
          C.hom.app (kernel (nativeStructureMap i)) =
        C.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.TF3.idealOf i) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealKernelIso i).hom) :=
      C.hom.naturality (idealKernelIso i).hom
    have hm :
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealKernelIso i).hom) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (restrictNativeKernelIso i U).hom =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (restrictIdealIso i U).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (idealKernelIso (i ∣_ U)).hom := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
      exact congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map f)
        (restrictIdealIso_kernel_square i U)
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i ∣_ U)).map (restrictNativeKernelIso i U).hom) hn).trans
          ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
            (congrArg (fun f => C.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.TF3.idealOf i) ≫ f) hm)))

  unfold restrictConormalIso conormalKernelIso restrictKernelConormalIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (i ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
    (SchemeKTheory.TF3.conormalIso i).hom ≫ f) hs

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.ZeroNaturality.cast_app
statement:
lemma ZeroNaturality.cast_app {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U = U')
    (hN : (Γ(N, U) : Type u) = Γ(N, U')) (hM : (Γ(M, U) : Type u) = Γ(M, U'))
    (y : Γ(M, U)) :
    cast hN (φ.app U y) = φ.app U' (cast hM y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.ZeroNaturality.zeroAddEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem ZeroNaturality.zeroAddEquiv_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    (V : Y.Opens) (x : (restrictToPreimage f M V).H 0) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv f N V
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ 0 V x) =
      φ.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv f M V x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_apply,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  erw [← Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality (hT := isTerminalTop)]
  exact ZeroNaturality.cast_app φ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι_image_top _ _ _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.ZeroNaturality.presheafZeroIso_naturality
statement:
theorem ZeroNaturality.presheafZeroIso_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafMap f φ 0 ≫
        (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafZeroIso f N).hom =
      (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafZeroIso f M).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext x
  exact ZeroNaturality.zeroAddEquiv_naturality f φ U.unop x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso_naturality
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f 0).map φ ≫
        (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso f N).hom =
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso f M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_map]
  simp only [affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ZeroNaturality.presheafZeroIso_naturality, Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).counit.naturality
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map φ)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroNatIso_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroNatIso_app (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) :
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroNatIso f).app M = affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso f M
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff
statement:
theorem epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f 0).map φ) ↔
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro _
    rw [← NatIso.naturality_1 (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroNatIso f) φ]
    infer_instance
  · intro _
    rw [← NatIso.naturality_2 (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroNatIso f) φ]
    infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_mem_FilGamma
statement:
theorem gammaOp_mem_FilGamma {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) (n : ℕ) :
    gammaOp Y n x ∈ FilGamma Y n
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨[(n, x)], by simpa using hx, by simp, by simp⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaDatum_add
statement:
theorem gammaDatum_add {x y : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    gammaDatum (x + y) (Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy) = (gammaDatum x hx).mul (gammaDatum y hy)
proof:
:= by
  refine ChernDatum.ext_g ?_
  show PowerSeries.map (toK0Q Y) (gammaSeries Y (x + y)) =
    PowerSeries.map (toK0Q Y) (gammaSeries Y x) * PowerSeries.map (toK0Q Y) (gammaSeries Y y)
  rw [gammaSeries_add, map_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaDatum_zero
statement:
theorem gammaDatum_zero :
    gammaDatum (0 : K0 Y) (Ideal.zero_mem _) = ChernDatum.one
proof:
:= by
  refine ChernDatum.ext_g ?_
  show PowerSeries.map (toK0Q Y) (gammaSeries Y 0) = 1
  rw [gammaSeries_zero, map_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.chPosGamma_add
statement:
theorem chPosGamma_add (D : ℕ) {x y : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y)
    (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    chPosGamma D (x + y) (Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy) = chPosGamma D x hx + chPosGamma D y hy
proof:
:= by
  unfold chPosGamma
  rw [gammaDatum_add, chPos_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.toddGamma_add
statement:
theorem toddGamma_add (D : ℕ) {x y : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y)
    (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    toddGamma D (x + y) (Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy) = toddGamma D x hx * toddGamma D y hy
proof:
:= by
  unfold toddGamma
  rw [gammaDatum_add, ToddGr_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.chGammaK_add
statement:
theorem chGammaK_add (D : ℕ) {x y : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y)
    (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) (k : ℕ) :
    chGammaK D (x + y) (Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy) k = chGammaK D x hx k + chGammaK D y hy k
proof:
:= by
  unfold chGammaK
  rw [gammaDatum_add, chK_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.newton_gamma
statement:
theorem newton_gamma {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ((-1 : K0Q Y) ^ (p.1 + 1) * powSum (gammaDatum x hx) p.1) *
        toK0Q Y (gammaOp Y p.2 x) = (n : K0Q Y) * toK0Q Y (gammaOp Y n x)
proof:
:=
  newton_identity (gammaDatum x hx) n

name: SchemeKTheory.powSum_gamma_one
statement:
theorem powSum_gamma_one {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    powSum (gammaDatum x hx) 1 = toK0Q Y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSum_one_eq]
  show toK0Q Y (gammaOp Y 1 x) = _
  rw [gammaOp_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.powSum_gamma_two
statement:
theorem powSum_gamma_two {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    powSum (gammaDatum x hx) 2 = toK0Q Y x ^ 2 - 2 * toK0Q Y (gammaOp Y 2 x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSum_two_eq]
  show toK0Q Y (gammaOp Y 1 x) ^ 2 - 2 * toK0Q Y (gammaOp Y 2 x) = _
  rw [gammaOp_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaDatum_congr
statement:
theorem gammaDatum_congr {x y : K0 Y} (h : x = y) (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y)
    (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) : gammaDatum x hx = gammaDatum y hy
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.isLineClass_sub_one_mem
statement: theorem isLineClass_sub_one_mem {ℓ : K0 Y} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) : ℓ - 1 ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [mem_rankZeroIdeal]
  intro y
  rw [map_sub, map_one, rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hN y]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.isGammaLine_of_isLineClass
statement: theorem isGammaLine_of_isLineClass {ℓ : K0 Y} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) : IsGammaLine Y (ℓ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := h
  exact isGammaLine_rankOne_sub_one Y N hN

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaDatum_line
statement:
theorem gammaDatum_line {ℓ : K0 Y} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) :
    gammaDatum (ℓ - 1) (isLineClass_sub_one_mem h) = lineDatum (lineF h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ChernDatum.ext_g ?_
  show PowerSeries.map (toK0Q Y) (gammaSeries Y (ℓ - 1)) = 1 + C (toK0Q Y (ℓ - 1)) * X
  have e : gammaSeries Y (ℓ - 1) = 1 + C (ℓ - 1) * X := isGammaLine_of_isLineClass h
  rw [e, map_add, map_one, map_mul, map_C, map_X]

name: SchemeKTheory.subOneSum_cons
statement:
theorem subOneSum_cons (a : {ℓ : K0 Y // IsLineClassB12 ℓ}) (L : LineList Y) :
    subOneSum (a :: L) = (a.1 - 1) + subOneSum L
proof:
:= by
  simp [subOneSum]

name: SchemeKTheory.subOneSum_mem
statement: theorem subOneSum_mem (L : LineList Y) : subOneSum L ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  | cons a L ih => rw [subOneSum_cons]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ (isLineClass_sub_one_mem a.2) ih

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaDatum_subOneSum
statement:
theorem gammaDatum_subOneSum (L : LineList Y) :
    gammaDatum (subOneSum L) (subOneSum_mem L) = splitDatum (lineFs L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    refine ChernDatum.ext_g ?_
    show PowerSeries.map (toK0Q Y) (gammaSeries Y (subOneSum [])) = 1
    have : subOneSum ([] : LineList Y) = 0 := by simp [subOneSum]
    rw [this, gammaSeries_zero, map_one]
  | cons a L ih =>
    rw [gammaDatum_congr (subOneSum_cons a L) (subOneSum_mem _)
      (Ideal.add_mem _ (isLineClass_sub_one_mem a.2) (subOneSum_mem L)),
      gammaDatum_add (isLineClass_sub_one_mem a.2) (subOneSum_mem L),
      gammaDatum_line, ih]
    rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.sumLine_sub_length
statement: theorem sumLine_sub_length (L : LineList Y) : sumLine L - (L.length : K0 Y) = subOneSum L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [sumLine, subOneSum]
  | cons a L ih =>
    rw [subOneSum_cons, ← ih]
    simp only [sumLine, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
    abel

name: SchemeKTheory.sumLine_sub_length_mem
statement:
theorem sumLine_sub_length_mem (L : LineList Y) :
    sumLine L - (L.length : K0 Y) ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumLine_sub_length]; exact subOneSum_mem L

name: SchemeKTheory.toddOfClass_sumLine
statement:
theorem toddOfClass_sumLine (D : ℕ) (L : LineList Y) :
    toddOfClass D (sumLine L) L.length (sumLine_sub_length_mem L) =
      (L.map fun p => RG6B.Td D (gcl D 1 (lineF p.2))).prod
proof:
:= by
  unfold toddOfClass toddGamma
  rw [gammaDatum_congr (sumLine_sub_length L) (sumLine_sub_length_mem L) (subOneSum_mem L),
    gammaDatum_subOneSum, ToddGr_splitDatum, lineFs, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.chGamma_sumLine
statement:
theorem chGamma_sumLine (D : ℕ) (L : LineList Y) :
    chGamma D (sumLine L) L.length (sumLine_sub_length_mem L) = chSplit D (lineFs L)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chGamma chPosGamma
  rw [gammaDatum_congr (sumLine_sub_length L) (sumLine_sub_length_mem L) (subOneSum_mem L),
    gammaDatum_subOneSum]
  have h := length_add_chPos_splitDatum (Φ := gammaFiltQ Y) D (lineFs L)
  have hl : (lineFs L).length = L.length := List.length_map _
  rw [hl] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.sumLine_prodLines
statement:
theorem sumLine_prodLines (L M : LineList Y) :
    sumLine (prodLines L M) = sumLine L * sumLine M
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [prodLines, sumLine]
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [prodLines]
    simp only [sumLine] at ih ⊢
    rw [List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [List.map_map, mul_comm, ← List.sum_map_mul_right]
    exact congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun b _ => by simp [mul_comm])

name: SchemeKTheory.lineF_mul
statement:
theorem lineF_mul (a b : {ℓ : K0 Y // IsLineClassB12 ℓ}) :
    lineF (a.2.mul b.2) = linProd (lineF a.2) (lineF b.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show toK0Q Y (a.1 * b.1 - 1) = toK0Q Y (a.1 - 1) + toK0Q Y (b.1 - 1) +
    toK0Q Y (a.1 - 1) * toK0Q Y (b.1 - 1)
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one]
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.lineFs_prodLines
statement:
theorem lineFs_prodLines (L M : LineList Y) :
    lineFs (prodLines L M) = prodList (lineFs L) (lineFs M)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    have h1 : lineFs (prodLines (a :: l) M) =
        lineFs (M.map fun b => ⟨a.1 * b.1, a.2.mul b.2⟩) ++ lineFs (prodLines l M) := by
      rw [prodLines]; simp [lineFs]
    have h2 : lineFs (M.map fun b => ⟨a.1 * b.1, a.2.mul b.2⟩) =
        (lineFs M).map (linProd (lineF a.2)) := by
      simp only [lineFs, List.map_map]
      exact List.map_congr_left fun b _ => lineF_mul a b
    rw [h1, h2, ih]
    rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.chGamma_prodLines
statement:
theorem chGamma_prodLines (D : ℕ) (L M : LineList Y) :
    chGamma D (sumLine (prodLines L M)) (prodLines L M).length
        (sumLine_sub_length_mem (prodLines L M)) =
      chGamma D (sumLine L) L.length (sumLine_sub_length_mem L) *
        chGamma D (sumLine M) M.length (sumLine_sub_length_mem M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chGamma_sumLine, chGamma_sumLine, chGamma_sumLine, lineFs_prodLines, chSplit_prodList]

name: SchemeKTheory.decomp_of_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((m + 1).choose (i + 1 + 1) : K0 X) * a ^ (i + 1 + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
    have := rankZeroIdeal_pow_le_FilGamma (i + 1 + 1) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow haI _)
    exact FilGamma_antitone (by omega : 2 ≤ i + 1 + 1) this
  · rw [h]
    simp only [Nat.choose_one_right, zero_add, pow_one]
    rw [add_comm]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_line_decomp
statement:
theorem adams_line_decomp {ℓ : K0 X} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ r ∈ FilGamma X 2, adamsRingHom hrank (m + 1) (ℓ - 1) = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : K0 X) * (ℓ - 1) + r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := h
  refine decomp_of_sum (isLineClass_sub_one_mem ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩) ?_
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank (by omega)]
  exact adams_rankOne_sub_one_eq_sum N hN m

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_line_gcl
statement:
theorem adams_line_gcl {ℓ : K0 X} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) (m D : ℕ) :
    gcl D 1 (adamsLineF hrank h m) = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • gcl D 1 (lineF h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gcl_qsmul]
  refine gcl_eq_of_sub_mem D 1 ?_
  obtain ⟨r, hr, e⟩ := adams_line_decomp hrank h m
  show toK0Q X (adamsRingHom hrank (m + 1) (ℓ - 1)) -
    algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * toK0Q X (ℓ - 1) ∈ FilGammaQ X (1 + 1)
  rw [e, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast, ← map_natCast (algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X)), add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hr

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_line_gcl_pow
statement:
theorem adams_line_gcl_pow {ℓ : K0 X} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) (m D k : ℕ) :
    (gcl D 1 (adamsLineF hrank h m)) ^ k = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ^ k • (gcl D 1 (lineF h)) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_line_gcl hrank h m D, smul_pow]

name: SchemeKTheory.gr_th_psi_Td_line
statement:
theorem gr_th_psi_Td_line {ℓ : K0 X} (h : IsLineClassB12 ℓ) (m D : ℕ) :
    RG6B.th (m + 1) D (gcl D 1 (lineF h)) * RG6B.Td D (gcl D 1 (adamsLineF hrank h m)) =
      algebraMap ℚ (GrGammaQ X D) ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * RG6B.Td D (gcl D 1 (lineF h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_line_gcl hrank h m D]
  exact th_mul_Td_smul (m + 1) (gcl_one_pow_succ D (lineF h))

name: FIN.arrwK_iff
statement:
theorem arrwK_iff (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ)
    [IsIntegral X] (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hXreg : RegStalks X) (j : ℕ)
    (x : K0 X) (w : K0 Y) : ARRwK hY hreg n i hXreg j x w ↔ CAN.ARRw hY hreg n i hXreg j x w
proof:
:= by
  have h := T1KG3.OMGB.cotangentClass_eq_kahler (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n
  unfold ARRwK CAN.ARRw
  rw [h]

name: FIN.adamsRiemannRoch_kahler
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_kahler (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    ARRwK hY hYreg n i hXreg j x (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  exact (arrwK_iff hY hYreg n i hXreg j x _).2
    (CAN.adamsRiemannRoch_forall hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj x)

name: FIN.cover_kahlerClass
statement:
theorem cover_kahlerClass {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (g : Y ⟶ D35.Yk k) (n : ℕ) :
    k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover g (n + 1)).toBase)
        (T1KG3.OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree g (n + 1)
          (T1KG3.OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange g (n + 1))) =
      (n + 1 + 1) • (cover g (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1) - 1
proof:
:=
  T1KG3.OMGC.cover_cotangent_class_of g (n + 1) (T1KG3.OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange g (n + 1))

name: FIN.ch_fShriekCan_kahler
statement:
theorem ch_fShriekCan_kahler (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) :
    pullbackK0RingHom i
        (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (T1KG3.OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
            (T1KG3.OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)))) =
      (n + 1 + 1) • pullbackK0RingHom i
        ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) - 1 ∧
    (haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
                (n + 1 + 1)) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, CAN.ch_fShriekCan k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi⟩
  rw [cover_kahlerClass]
  simp only [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_source_map_smul_on_basicOpen
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_source_map_smul_on_basicOpen
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) {U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens} (g : R)
    (hDU : projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ U)
    (r : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), U))
    (m : SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) U) :
    let P
proof:
:=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
    let α :=
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
        R n d p
    α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
        (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (r • m)) =
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hDU).hom r •
        α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
          (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m) := by
  dsimp only
  let P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
  let α :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
      R n d p
  letI : Module
      Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)
      (P.presheaf.obj (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))) := by
    change Module
      Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
          (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
    exact SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_module
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
        (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)
  have hPsmul :
      P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (r • m) =
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hDU).hom r •
          P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m := by
    calc
      _ = ((Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE hDU).op).hom r •
          P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m :=
        P.map_smul (homOfLE hDU).op r m
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction_eq hDU]
  calc
    α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
        (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (r • m)) =
      α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
        ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hDU).hom r •
          P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m) :=
      congrArg
        (fun q => α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)) q)
        hPsmul
    _ = _ :=
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_app_basicOpen_map_smul
        R n d p g
          ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hDU).hom r)
          (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m)

    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) {U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens} (g : R)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_naturality_to_basicOpen
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_naturality_to_basicOpen
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) {U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens} (g : R)
    (hDU : projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ U)

      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)).presheaf.obj
        (op U)) :

proof:

        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_naturality_smul_to_basicOpen
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_naturality_smul_to_basicOpen
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) {U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens} (g : R)
    (hDU : projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ U)
    (r : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), U))
    (m : (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)).presheaf.obj
        (op U)) :

proof:
:= projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
    let P :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_map_smul_after_restrict_basicOpen
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_map_smul_after_restrict_basicOpen
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) {U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens} (g : R)
    (hDU : projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ U)
    (r : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), U))
    (m : SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) U) :
    let N
proof:
:= projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
    let α :=
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
        R n d p
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (α.app (op U) (r • m)) =
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
        (r • α.app (op U) m) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
  let P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      f M (p + 1)
  let α :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
      R n d p
  calc
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (α.app (op U) (r • m)) =
        α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
          (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (r • m)) := by
      exact (α.naturality_apply (homOfLE hDU).op (r • m)).symm
    _ = (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hDU).hom r •
        α.app (op (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
          (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m) := by
      exact
        projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_source_map_smul_on_basicOpen
          R n d p g hDU r m
    _ = (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hDU).hom r •
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (α.app (op U) m) := by
      exact
        projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_naturality_smul_to_basicOpen
          R n d p g hDU r m
    _ = N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
          (r • α.app (op U) m) := by
      exact
        (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde_map_smul_to_basicOpen
          R n d p g hDU r (α.app (op U) m)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_map_smul
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_map_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
    (r : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), U))
    (m : SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) U) :
    (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
      R n d p).app (op U) (r • m) =
        r • (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
          R n d p).app (op U) m
proof:
:= by
  let f := toSpec R n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
  let P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      f M (p + 1)
  let α :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
      R n d p
  let F :=
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).obj N
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext F U
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨D, hDB, rfl⟩, hxD, hDU⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx U.2
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hDB
  have hres :
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (α.app (op U) (r • m)) =
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
          (r • α.app (op U) m) := by
    exact
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_map_smul_after_restrict_basicOpen
        R n d p g hDU r m
  calc
    N.presheaf.germ U x hx (α.app (op U) (r • m)) =
        N.presheaf.germ (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g) x hxD
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
            (α.app (op U) (r • m))) :=
      (N.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hDU) x hxD _).symm
    _ = N.presheaf.germ (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g) x hxD
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
            (r • α.app (op U) m)) := by
      rw [hres]
    _ = N.presheaf.germ U x hx
          (r • α.app (op U) m) :=
      N.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hDU) x hxD _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_stalk_isIso
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_stalk_isIso
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :
    IsIso
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map
        (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
          R n d p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
  let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
  let α :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
      R n d p
  constructor
  · apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis
      PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens
    intro U hU
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hU
    exact
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_app_basicOpen_bijective
        R n d p g).1
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, s, hs⟩ :=
      N.presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis
        PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens x t
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hU
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_app_basicOpen_bijective
        R n d p g).2 s
    refine ⟨TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.presheaf
      (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g) x hxU q, ?_⟩
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply, hq, hs]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison_toSheafify_comp
statement:
lemma projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison_toSheafify_comp
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    let P
proof:
:=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
    let L :=
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison
        R n d p
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) P.presheaf ≫
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).map L).1 =
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
        R n d p := by
  dsimp only
  let P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
  let g :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageModulePresheafComparison
      R n d p
  let L :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison
      R n d p
  change
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) P.presheaf ≫
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf.obj).map L.val =
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
        R n d p
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf_map_sheafificationHomEquiv_def
    (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf.obj) L]
  have hL :
      PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv
          (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf.obj) L = g := by
    dsimp only [L,
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison]
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ g
  rw [hL]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison_isIso
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison_isIso
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison
        R n d p)
proof:
:= by
  let P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
  let L :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison
      R n d p
  let T :=
    SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u}
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf
  let ℓ := T.map L
  letI (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :
      IsIso
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map ℓ.hom) := by
    let S := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x
    let η :=
      CategoryTheory.toSheafify
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) P.presheaf
    let α :=
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison
        R n d p
    letI : IsIso (S.map α) :=
      projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImagePresheafComparison_stalk_isIso
        R n d p x
    letI : IsIso (S.map η) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso
        x AddCommGrpCat.{u} P.presheaf
    have hcomp :
        S.map η ≫ S.map ℓ.hom = S.map α := by
      rw [← S.map_comp]
      exact congrArg S.map
        (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationComparison_toSheafify_comp
          R n d p)
    letI : IsIso (S.map η ≫ S.map ℓ.hom) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      infer_instance
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (S.map η) (S.map ℓ.hom)
  haveI : IsIso ℓ :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso ℓ
  haveI : IsIso ℓ.hom := by
    exact Functor.map_isIso
      (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) ℓ
  have hToPresheaf :
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf.obj).map L.val =
        ℓ.hom := rfl
  letI : IsIso
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf.obj).map L.val) := by
    rw [hToPresheaf]
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso L.val := by
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso L.val
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf.obj)
  have hForget :
      (SheafOfModules.forget.{u}
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).map L =
        L.val := rfl
  letI : IsIso
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u}
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).map L) := by
    rw [hForget]
    infer_instance
  exact isIso_of_fully_faithful
    (SheafOfModules.forget.{u}
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf) L
