name: B6.todd_key
statement:
theorem todd_key :
    (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 (sOf hXreg hY hYreg i hj) = 1 ∧
    ∀ τ : B5.KQ X, (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 τ = 1 →
      (ctxOf hX).Ψ j τ = sOf hXreg hY hYreg i hj * τ →
      ∀ D : ℕ, (∀ p, D < p → (ctxOf hX).pr hj p ((ctxOf hX).dual hj
          (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))) = 0) →
        τ = (ctxOf hX).toddW hj D ((ctxOf hX).dual hj (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hXc : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hXrn := rankZeroNilpotent_of_projective hX
  have hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X := lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent hXrn
  obtain ⟨T, hTn, hTi, hTc, hTT, g, Lm, Mm, hL, hM, hnilT, hinj, hEaq, hEbq, hnilL, hnilM, ⟨t0⟩⟩ :=
    exists_tower hXrn (hEa i) (hEb hXreg hY hYreg i)
  haveI := hTn
  let CK := ctxOf hX
  let CT := ctxK0 hTc hTT t0
  let φ := pullbackK0RingHom g
  have hφ : ∀ (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E),
      φ (k0ClassOf X E hE) = k0ClassOf T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) := fun E hE =>
    pullbackK0RingHom_classOf g E hE
  have hcomm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : K0 X), φ (adamsRingHom hXc m x) = adamsRingHom hTc m (φ x) := by
    intro m x
    cases m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m =>
      rw [adamsRingHom_apply hXc (by omega), adamsRingHom_apply hTc (by omega)]
      exact adams_pullback g φ hφ (m + 1) x
  have hq : Function.Injective (qQ φ) := qQ_injective φ hinj
  have hqΨ : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ x, qQ φ (CK.Ψ m x) = CT.Ψ m (qQ φ x) :=
    fun m _ x => qQ_adams hXc hTc φ hcomm m x
  
  have htvee := tvee_eq hXreg hY hYreg i
  have hφtv : φ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i) =
      ∑ i', k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree -
        ∑ k', k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree := by
    rw [htvee, map_sub, hEaq, hEbq]
  have hℓ : ∀ i', IsNilpotent (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree) - 1) := by
    intro i'
    have := (hnilL i').map (B5.toKQ T)
    rwa [map_sub, map_one] at this
  have hm : ∀ k', IsNilpotent (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree) - 1) := by
    intro k'
    have := (hnilM k').map (B5.toKQ T)
    rwa [map_sub, map_one] at this
  have hadams : ∀ c : K0 T, CT.Ψ j (B5.toKQ T c) = B5.toKQ T (adamsRingHom hTc j c) := by
    intro c
    show adamsQ hTc j ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] adamsRingHom hTc j c
    simp [adamsQ, psiQ_tmul]
  have hℓψ : ∀ i', CT.Ψ j (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ j := by
    intro i'
    rw [hadams, adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hTc (Lm i') (hL i') (by omega), map_pow]
  have hmψ : ∀ k', CT.Ψ j (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ j := by
    intro k'
    rw [hadams, adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hTc (Mm k') (hM k') (by omega), map_pow]
  have htv : qQ φ (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) =
      ∑ i', B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree) -
        ∑ k', B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    have e : qQ φ (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) =
        B5.toKQ T (φ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) := by
      simp [B5.toKQ_apply, qQ_tmul]
    rw [e, hφtv, map_sub, map_sum, map_sum]
  
  have ht : qQ φ (B5.tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i hj) *
      ∏ i', ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ r =
      ∏ k', ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ r := by
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ,
        β = bott j X hXc hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hbp := bott_pull j g φ hφ (pullLoc φ j) (pullLoc_algebraMap φ j) hTc hnilT hXc hnilX
      (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)
    rw [hφtv, ← hβ] at hbp
    have hsplit := bott_split j hTc hnilT Lm hL Mm hM
    rw [hbp] at hsplit
    have hinv : pullLoc φ j ((β⁻¹ : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) :
        Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) * pullLoc φ j (β : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))
        = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one]
    have h1 : pullLoc φ j ((β⁻¹ : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) :
          Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) *
        ∏ i', algebraMap _ _ (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
          (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) =
        ∏ k', algebraMap _ (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T)) (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
          (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) := by
      rw [← hsplit, ← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
    have h2 := congrArg (B5.locToQ j hj T) h1
    rw [map_mul, map_prod, map_prod] at h2
    simp only [B5.locToQ_algebraMap, map_sum, map_pow] at h2
    have h3 : qQ φ (B5.tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i hj) =
        B5.locToQ j hj T (pullLoc φ j ((β⁻¹ : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) :
          Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))) := by
      unfold B5.tQ
      rw [qQ_locToQ, hβ]
      rfl
    rw [h3]
    exact h2
  exact todd_descent CK CT (qQ φ) hq hqΨ hj
    (fun i' => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree))
    (fun k' => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree))
    hℓ hm hℓψ hmψ (B5.tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i hj) (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) htv ht

name: B6.tau_exists_unique
statement:
theorem tau_exists_unique :
    ∃! τ : B5.KQ X, (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 τ = 1 ∧
      (ctxOf hX).Ψ j τ = sOf hXreg hY hYreg i hj * τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs0, -⟩ := todd_key hX hXreg hY hYreg i hj
  obtain ⟨τ, h0, hψ⟩ := (ctxOf hX).exists_tau hj hs0
  exact ⟨τ, ⟨h0, hψ⟩, fun τ' h' => (ctxOf hX).tau_unique hj hs0 h'.1 h'.2 h0 hψ⟩

name: B6.f_shift
statement:
theorem f_shift (p : ℕ) {x : B5.KQ X} (hx : x ∈ B3.FilGammaQ X p) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x ∈ B3.FilGammaQ Y (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hXc (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X) p] at hx
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hYc (towerHyp_of_projective hY) (genericPoint Y)]
  exact F_mem_GqA (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (B5.tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i (le_refl 2)) (arr_ctx hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi (le_refl 2))
    (dRel i) (tauF_spec hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInv hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2))
    (tauF_spec hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)).1 hx

name: B6.gr_f_eq
statement:
theorem gr_f_eq (p : ℕ) (hdp : dRel i ≤ p)
    (w : B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) p) :
    ∃ (hF : B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf (w : B5.KQ X) ∈
          B3.FilGammaQ Y (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat))
      (hΦ : PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) (w : B5.KQ X) ∈
          B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat)),
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf (w : B5.KQ X), hF⟩ :
          ↥(B3.FilGammaQ Y (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat))) :
        B3.Gr Y (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat)) =
        B3.grEquiv (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) (towerHyp_of_projective hY)
          (genericPoint Y) (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat)
          ⟨PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) (w : B5.KQ X), hΦ⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  have hTY := towerHyp_of_projective hY
  have hm : ((p : ℤ) - dRel i) = (((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat : ℕ) :=
    (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
  have hF := f_shift hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p
    (B3.Wt_le_FilGammaQ hXc hTX (genericPoint X) p w.2)
  have hΦ := Phi_mem_Wt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p _ hm w.2
  refine ⟨hF, hΦ, ?_⟩
  unfold B3.grEquiv
  rw [LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, Submodule.mem_comap]
  show B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf (w : B5.KQ X) -
      PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) (w : B5.KQ X) ∈ _
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hYc hTY (genericPoint Y)]
  have h := F_sub_Phi_mem (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (B5.tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i (le_refl 2)) (arr_ctx hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi (le_refl 2))
    (dRel i) (tauF_spec hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInv hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2))
    (tauF_spec hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)).1 w.2
  have e : ((((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat) = ((p : ℤ) - dRel i).toNat + 1 := by omega
  rw [e] at h
  exact h

name: ARRASM.ringKrullDim_stalk_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_le {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : X ⟶ space k N)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (y : X) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk y) ≤ ((N + M1.FiniteDimBase.d k : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Fin (N + 1), j y ∈ coordinateOpen k N c := by
    have : j y ∈ (⨆ c : Fin (N + 1), coordinateOpen k N c) := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at this
    exact this
  let V : X.Opens := j ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen k N c
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V := (coordinateOpen_isAffine k N c).preimage j
  have hy : y ∈ V := hc
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k N) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k N
  have hΓ : ringKrullDim Γ(X, V) ≤ ((N + M1.FiniteDimBase.d k : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    have hsurj := Scheme.Hom.app_surjective j (coordinateOpen k N c)
      (coordinateOpen_isAffine k N c)
    exact (ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective (j.app (coordinateOpen k N c)).hom hsurj).trans
      (ClosedImmersionCoverF11.ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le k N c)
  obtain ⟨ys, rfl⟩ : ∃ ys : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, V), hV.fromSpec ys = y := by
    have : y ∈ Set.range hV.fromSpec := by rw [hV.range_fromSpec]; exact hy
    exact this
  have hy' : hV.fromSpec ys ∈ (V : Set X) := by
    rw [← hV.range_fromSpec]; exact ⟨ys, rfl⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨V, hV⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk (hV.fromSpec ys)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨hV.fromSpec ys, hy'⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization ys.asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk (hV.fromSpec ys)) :=
    hV.isLocalization_stalk' ys hy'
  have h1 := IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height ys.asIdeal
    (X.presheaf.stalk (hV.fromSpec ys))
  rw [h1]
  exact (Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top ys.isPrime.ne_top).trans hΓ

name: ARRASM.hasCovers_open
statement: theorem hasCovers_open (hM : HasCovers M) (U : M.Opens) : HasCovers (U : Scheme.{u})
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF
  haveI := hF
  obtain ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ := CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_extension_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι F
  obtain ⟨E, hE, g, hg⟩ := hM G hG
  haveI := hg
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj E, pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global U.ι E hE,
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map g ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app G).inv
      ≫ e.hom, ?_⟩
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map g) := inferInstance
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: ARRASM.bijective_k0ToG0_open
statement:
theorem bijective_k0ToG0_open (hP : AR11.ProjEmb k M)
    (hreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme M) (U : M.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (U : Scheme.{u}))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj⟩ := hP
  haveI := hj
  have hcM : HasCovers M := fun F hF => by
    haveI := hF
    exact ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_noetherian k N j F
  refine k0ToG0_bijective_of_regular_cover (d := N + M1.FiniteDimBase.d k) ?_ (hasCovers_open hcM U) ?_
  · refine finiteDimAffineCover_of_stalk (N + M1.FiniteDimBase.d k) (fun x => ?_)
    haveI : IsIso (U.ι.stalkMap x) := inferInstance
    let e := asIso (U.ι.stalkMap x)
    calc ringKrullDim (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk x)
        = ringKrullDim (M.presheaf.stalk (U.ι x)) :=
          (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm
      _ ≤ ((N + M1.FiniteDimBase.d k : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := ringKrullDim_stalk_le j (U.ι x)
  · exact BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_of_openImmersion U.ι hreg

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.leftAdjointUniq_whiskerRight
statement:
lemma leftAdjointUniq_whiskerRight
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    {F F' : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} {H : D ⥤ E} {K : E ⥤ D}
    (adj₁ : F ⊣ G) (adj₂ : F' ⊣ G) (adj₃ : H ⊣ K) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (adj₁.leftAdjointUniq adj₂).hom H =
      ((adj₁.comp adj₃).leftAdjointUniq (adj₂.comp adj₃)).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  apply ((adj₁.comp adj₃).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  rw [Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  simp only [Functor.id_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.whiskerRight_app]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← G.map_comp,
    adj₃.unit_naturality ((adj₁.leftAdjointUniq adj₂).hom.app X),
    G.map_comp, ← Category.assoc,
    Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.leftAdjointUniq_whiskerLeft
statement:
lemma leftAdjointUniq_whiskerLeft
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} {F F' : D ⥤ E} {G : E ⥤ D}
    (adj₀ : L ⊣ R) (adj₁ : F ⊣ G) (adj₂ : F' ⊣ G) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft L (adj₁.leftAdjointUniq adj₂).hom =
      ((adj₀.comp adj₁).leftAdjointUniq (adj₀.comp adj₂)).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  apply ((adj₀.comp adj₁).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.comp_unit_app,
    Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  simp only [Functor.id_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [← R.map_comp, Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullbackCompIso_eq_leftAdjointUniq
statement:
lemma openSheafPullbackCompIso_eq_leftAdjointUniq {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h] :
    openSheafPullbackCompIso g h = by
      letI
proof:
:= Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous h.isOpenEmbedding
      letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous g.isOpenEmbedding
      letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous (g ≫ h).isOpenEmbedding
      let adjH := h.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
      let adjG := g.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      let adjGH := (g ≫ h).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
      exact (adjH.comp adjG).leftAdjointUniq adjGH := by
  dsimp only
  ext P
  letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous h.isOpenEmbedding
  letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous g.isOpenEmbedding
  let adjH := h.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
    (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
  let adjG := g.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
    (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
  apply ((adjH.comp adjG).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext U
  dsimp only [adjH, adjG]
  simp only [ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.comp_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Functor.comp_map]
  simp_rw [Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous_unit_app_hom_app]
  simp_rw [Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous_map_hom_app]
  simp_rw [Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous_unit_app_hom_app]
  dsimp [openSheafPullbackCompIso, openEmbeddingFunctorCompIso]
  change P.obj.map _ ≫ P.obj.map _ ≫ P.obj.map _ = P.obj.map _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_natIso
statement:
theorem extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_natIso
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D]
    (F G : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (e : F ≅ G) {C₀ : C} {D₀ : D} (eG : G.obj C₀ ≅ D₀)
    (A : C) (i : ℕ) (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext C₀ A i) :
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (e.hom.app A)).postcomp D₀ (add_zero i)
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F (e.app C₀ ≪≫ eG) A i x) =
      extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso G eG A i x
proof:
:= by
  change ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (eG.inv ≫ e.inv.app C₀)).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add i)).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (e.hom.app A)) (add_zero i) =
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ eG.inv).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor G) (zero_add i)
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_natIso]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackConstantIso_comp
statement:
theorem openPullbackConstantIso_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h] :
    functorCompEndpointIso
        (h.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        ((openPullbackConstantIso h).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))
        ((openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) =
      (openSheafPullbackCompIso g h).app
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) ≪≫
        (openPullbackConstantIso (g ≫ h)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous h.isOpenEmbedding
  letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous g.isOpenEmbedding
  letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous (g ≫ h).isOpenEmbedding
  let adjH := h.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
    (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
  let adjG := g.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
    (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
  let adjZ := constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
    AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop
  let adjY := constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
    AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop
  let adjX := constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
    AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop
  let adjGH := (g ≫ h).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous
    (E := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)
  rw [openSheafPullbackCompIso_eq_leftAdjointUniq g h]
  change
    (Functor.whiskerRight ((adjZ.comp adjH).leftAdjointUniq adjY).hom
        (g.isOpenEmbedding.functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y))).app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)) ≫
      ((adjY.comp adjG).leftAdjointUniq adjX).hom.app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)) =
    (Functor.whiskerLeft
        (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        ((adjH.comp adjG).leftAdjointUniq adjGH).hom).app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)) ≫
      ((adjZ.comp adjGH).leftAdjointUniq adjX).hom.app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  rw [congr_app (leftAdjointUniq_whiskerRight (adjZ.comp adjH) adjY adjG)
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)),
    Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_trans_app]
  rw [congr_app (leftAdjointUniq_whiskerLeft adjZ (adjH.comp adjG) adjGH)
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)),
    Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_trans_app]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openExtRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem openExtRestriction_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h]
    (A : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Z) (i : ℕ)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) A i) :
    let F
proof:
:= h.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let G := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H := (g ≫ h).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits h
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits h
    letI : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive h
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits G := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
    letI : G.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive g
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits H := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (g ≫ h)
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits H := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (g ≫ h)
    letI : H.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive (g ≫ h)
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
      ((openSheafPullbackCompIso g h).hom.app A)).postcomp
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) (add_zero i)
      (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso G
        ((openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))
        (F.obj A) i
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F
          ((openPullbackConstantIso h).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) A i x)) =
      extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso H
        ((openPullbackConstantIso (g ≫ h)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) A i x := by
  dsimp only
  let hExtZ : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Z) :=
    fun P Q a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ P Q a b
  let hExtY : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y) :=
    fun P Q a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ P Q a b
  let hExtX : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
    fun P Q a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ P Q a b
  letI : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Z) := hExtZ
  letI : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y) := hExtY
  letI : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) := hExtX
  let F := h.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let G := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let H := (g ≫ h).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let hFLim : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits h
  let hFColim : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits h
  let hFAdd : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive h
  let hGLim : PreservesFiniteLimits G := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  let hGColim : PreservesFiniteColimits G := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  let hGAdd : G.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive g
  let hHLim : PreservesFiniteLimits H := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (g ≫ h)
  let hHColim : PreservesFiniteColimits H := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (g ≫ h)
  let hHAdd : H.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive (g ≫ h)
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := hFLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := hFColim
  letI : F.Additive := hFAdd
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := hGLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits G := hGColim
  letI : G.Additive := hGAdd
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits H := hHLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits H := hHColim
  letI : H.Additive := hHAdd
  let hFGLim : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G hFLim hGLim
  let hFGColim : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ G) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G hFColim hGColim
  let hFGAdd : (F ⋙ G).Additive := inferInstance
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G) := hFGLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ G) := hFGColim
  rw [@extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    hExtZ hExtY hExtX F G hFAdd hGAdd hFLim hFColim hGLim hGColim _ _ _
    ((openPullbackConstantIso h).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))
    ((openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) A i x,
    openPullbackConstantIso_comp g h]
  exact @extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_natIso _ _ _ _ _ _ hExtZ hExtX
    (F ⋙ G) H hFGAdd hHAdd hFGLim hFGColim hHLim hHColim
    (openSheafPullbackCompIso g h)
    _ _ ((openPullbackConstantIso (g ≫ h)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) A i x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_comp
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h]
    (N : Z.Modules) (i : ℕ) (x : N.H i) :
    Sheaf.H.map
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g h).inv.app N)) i
        (openRestrictionHAddHom g
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor h).obj N) i
          (openRestrictionHAddHom h N i x)) =
      openRestrictionHAddHom (g ≫ h) N i x
proof:
:= by
  let A := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  have hp :
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g h).inv.app N) =
        (openSheafPullbackCompIso g h).hom.app A := rfl
  simp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, Sheaf.H.map_apply]
  rw [hp]
  exact openExtRestriction_comp g h A i x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finiteProjectivePush_exact
statement:
theorem finiteProjectivePush_exact

    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
      (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn (space R n).Modules
      (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (space R n))
      (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject
        (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
        (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f) A)
      (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject
        (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
        (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f) B)
      (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finiteConcentratedDerivedPushforward_eq_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem finiteConcentratedDerivedPushforward_eq_finitePushforward
    (f : X ⟶ space R n) [IsFinite f] :
    SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages
        0
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImage
          (finiteProjectivePush R n f))
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent
          (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
          (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f))
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImageLongExact
          0
          (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
          (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f)
          (finiteProjectivePush_exact R n f)) =
      SchemeKTheory.finitePushforward f
proof:
:=
  SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfConcentratedHigherDirectImages_eq_map
      0
      (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
      (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f)
      (finiteProjectivePush_exact R n f)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward_comp_finite
statement:
theorem projectiveDerivedPushforward_comp_finite
    (hn : 0 < n) (f : X ⟶ space R n) [IsFinite f] :
    (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn).comp
        (SchemeKTheory.finitePushforward f) =
      projectiveAfterConcentratedDerivedPushforward R n hn
        (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
        (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f)
        (finiteProjectivePush_exact R n f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finiteConcentratedDerivedPushforward_eq_finitePushforward R n f]
  exact projectiveDerivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated R n hn
    (finiteProjectivePush R n f)
    (finiteProjectivePush_coherent R n f)
    (finiteProjectivePush_exact R n f)

name: PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
statement:
theorem shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
    (S : ShortComplex (PresheafOfModules.{u} R)) :
    S.Exact ↔ ∀ U, (S.map (evaluation R U)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let h : JointlyReflectIsomorphisms (fun U => evaluation R U) := by
    constructor
    intro X Y f hf
    rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso f (toPresheaf R),
      NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
    intro U
    letI : IsIso ((evaluation R U).map f) := hf U
    change IsIso ((forget₂ (ModuleCat (R.obj U)) AddCommGrpCat).map
      ((evaluation R U).map f))
    infer_instance
  exact h.exact_iff S

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.ideal_unit_structure_zero
statement:
theorem ideal_unit_structure_zero :
    ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map (ConormalSheaf.structureMap j.ker) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext V x
  have hz := TF3.i_app_ιapp (j ≫ p) V x
  change j.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (p.app V (TF3.ιapp (j ≫ p) V x)) = 0 at hz
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := TF4.exists_ideal_section j (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (p.app V (TF3.ιapp (j ≫ p) V x)) hz
  have hk := congrArg (fun t => t.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) s)
    (kernel.condition (ConormalSheaf.structureMap j.ker))
  change (ConormalSheaf.structureMap j.ker).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (p.app V (TF3.ιapp (j ≫ p) V x)) = 0
  rw [← hs]
  exact hk

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion_structure_zero
statement:
theorem pulledIdealInclusion_structure_zero :
    pulledIdealInclusion j p ≫ ConormalSheaf.structureMap j.ker = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p
  apply (A.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  change A.homEquiv _ _ (A.homEquiv _ _ |>.symm
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom)) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map (ConormalSheaf.structureMap j.ker) = _
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (ideal_unit_structure_zero j p)).trans ?_
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  simp only [Functor.map_zero]
  exact (comp_zero).symm

    idealComparison j p ≫ ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker = pulledIdealInclusion j p
proof:
:=
  kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_unit
statement:
theorem idealComparison_unit :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map
        (idealComparison j p ≫ ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker) =
    ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealComparison_inclusion]
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).homEquiv_unit
    (f := pulledIdealInclusion j p)).symm.trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_app_inclusion
statement:
theorem idealComparison_app_inclusion (V : P.Opens) (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p), V)) :
    TF3.ιapp j (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((idealComparison j p).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))).app V s)) =
    p.app V (TF3.ιapp (j ≫ p) V s)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun t => t.app V s) (idealComparison_unit j p)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_comp_dI
statement: theorem idealComparison_comp_dI : idealComparison j p ≫ TF3.dI p j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p
  apply (A.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  ext V s
  change (TF3.dI p j).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    ((idealComparison j p).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) ((A.unit.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))).app V s)) = 0
  rw [TF3.dI_app]
  have hι := idealComparison_app_inclusion j p V s
  have hbase : TF2.Esec p (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (p.app V (TF3.ιapp (j ≫ p) V s)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using
      TF4.Esec_base (πP := p) (V := V) le_rfl (TF3.ιapp (j ≫ p) V s)
  have he := (congrArg (TF2.Esec p (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)) hι).trans hbase
  exact (congrArg (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app
    (SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)) he).trans (map_zero _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealComparison_comp_adjoint_dI
statement:
theorem pulledIdealComparison_comp_adjoint_dI :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (idealComparison j p) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (TF3.dI p j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j
  apply (A.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  change idealComparison j p ≫ A.homEquiv _ _ ((A.homEquiv _ _).symm (TF3.dI p j)) = _
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine (idealComparison_comp_dI j p).trans ?_
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  simp only [Functor.map_zero]
  exact (comp_zero).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.isoTail_comp_zero
statement:
theorem isoTail_comp_zero {C : Type*} [Category C] [HasZeroMorphisms C]
    {A B D E F T : C} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (c : D ⟶ E)
    (e : E ≅ F) (d : E ⟶ T) (h : c ≫ d = 0) :
    (a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ e.hom) ≫ (e.inv ≫ d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [h]
  simp only [comp_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison_comp_c
statement: theorem conormalComparison_comp_c : conormalComparison j p ≫ TF3.c p j = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact isoTail_comp_zero (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (idealComparison j p)) (TF3.conormalIso j).symm
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).homEquiv _ _).symm (TF3.dI p j))
    (pulledIdealComparison_comp_adjoint_dI j p)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.iso_image_preimage
statement: lemma iso_image_preimage (T : Y.Opens) : q ''ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ T) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  change (∃ x, x ∈ q ⁻¹ᵁ T ∧ q x = y) ↔ y ∈ T
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Scheme.Hom.homeomorph q).surjective y
    exact ⟨x, hy, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.iso_restrict_unit_app
statement:
lemma iso_restrict_unit_app (M : Y.Modules) (T : Y.Opens) :
    IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M).app T)
proof:
:= by
  have he := iso_image_preimage q T
  have hh : homOfLE (q.image_preimage_le T) = (eqToIso he).hom := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change IsIso (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (q.image_preimage_le T)).op)
  rw [hh]
  infer_instance

  intro T
  exact iso_restrict_unit_app q M T

proof:
:= by
  letI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).IsEquivalence :=
    (isoRestrictionEquivalence q).isEquivalence_functor
  exact CategoryTheory.ShortExact.shortExact_map_iff (S := T) (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.iso_source_open_image
statement:
lemma iso_source_open_image (U : Q'.Opens) :
    qX ''ᵁ (i' ⁻¹ᵁ U) = i ⁻¹ᵁ (qQ ''ᵁ U)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (∃ x', i' x' ∈ U ∧ qX x' = x) ↔ i x ∈ qQ ''ᵁ U
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i' x', hx', ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun f : X' ⟶ Q ↦ f x') hi).symm
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', he⟩
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := (Scheme.Hom.homeomorph qX).surjective x
    have hc : qQ (i' x') = i (qX x') :=
      (congrArg (fun f : X' ⟶ Q ↦ f x') hi).symm
    have hx : i' x' = y' := (Scheme.Hom.homeomorph qQ).injective (hc.trans he.symm)
    exact ⟨x', hx.symm ▸ hy', rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.iso_section_annihilator_iff
statement:
lemma iso_section_annihilator_iff (U : Q'.Opens) (a : Γ(Q, qQ ''ᵁ U)) :
    i.app (qQ ''ᵁ U) a = 0 ↔ i'.app U ((qQ.appIso U).hom a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let W := i' ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let e := BaseSubringRestrictionH2.generator_image_le i i' qX qQ hi U W le_rfl
  have ho := iso_source_open_image i i' qX qQ hi U
  have hh : homOfLE e = (eqToIso ho).hom := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  letI : IsIso (homOfLE e) := by rw [hh]; infer_instance
  let k := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op ≫ (qX.appIso W).hom
  have hk := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (C := CommRingCat) k).1
  have hs := BaseSubringRestrictionH2.appLE_image_restrict i i' qX qQ hi U W le_rfl
  have ha : k (i.app (qQ ''ᵁ U) a) = i'.app U ((qQ.appIso U).hom a) :=
    by
      simpa [Scheme.Hom.appLE, W, k] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hs a
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact ha.symm.trans ((congrArg k hz).trans (map_zero k.hom))
  · intro hz
    exact hk (ha.trans (hz.trans (map_zero k.hom).symm))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.iso_native_zero_iff
statement:
lemma iso_native_zero_iff {M : Q'.Modules}
    (k : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Q)) :
    k ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i) = 0 ↔
      k ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom ≫
        ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i' = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro U
    ext a
    have ha := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app U a) hz
    change i.app (qQ ''ᵁ U) (k.app U a) = 0 at ha
    change i'.app U ((qQ.appIso U).hom (k.app U a)) = 0
    exact (iso_section_annihilator_iff i i' qX qQ hi U (k.app U a)).mp ha
  · intro hz
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro U
    ext a
    have ha := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app U a) hz
    change i'.app U ((qQ.appIso U).hom (k.app U a)) = 0 at ha
    change i.app (qQ ''ᵁ U) (k.app U a) = 0
    exact (iso_section_annihilator_iff i i' qX qQ hi U (k.app U a)).mpr ha

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.isoNativeKernelIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem isoNativeKernelIso_inclusion :
    (isoNativeKernelIso i i' qX qQ hi).hom ≫ kernel.ι (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i') =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (kernel.ι (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ
  let f := F.map (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i)
  let g := (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom ≫ ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i'
  let t := (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom
  letI := CoherentExtensionAR5.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits qQ
  let A := PreservesKernel.iso F (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i)
  let B := ClosedIdealKernelH2.kernelIsoOfZeroIff f g
    (fun k ↦ iso_native_zero_iff i i' qX qQ hi k)
  let C := kernel.mapIso g (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i')
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ) (Iso.refl _) (Category.comp_id g)
  let k := kernel.ι (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i')
  have hC : C.hom ≫ k = kernel.ι g ≫ t := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
  have hB : B.hom ≫ kernel.ι g = kernel.ι f := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
  have hA : A.hom ≫ kernel.ι f = F.map (kernel.ι (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i)) :=
    (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ kernel.ι f)
      (PreservesKernel.iso_hom F (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i))).trans
        (kernelComparison_comp_ι (ClosedIdealKernelH2.nativeStructureMap i) F)
  change (A.hom ≫ B.hom ≫ C.hom) ≫ k = _
  exact (Category.assoc A.hom (B.hom ≫ C.hom) k).trans
    ((congrArg (fun z ↦ A.hom ≫ z) (Category.assoc B.hom C.hom k)).trans
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ A.hom ≫ B.hom ≫ z) hC).trans
        ((congrArg (fun z ↦ A.hom ≫ z) (Category.assoc B.hom (kernel.ι g) t).symm).trans
          ((congrArg (fun z ↦ A.hom ≫ z ≫ t) hB).trans
            ((Category.assoc A.hom (kernel.ι f) t).symm.trans
              (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ t) hA))))))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.iso_square_closed
statement: lemma iso_square_closed : IsClosedImmersion i'
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsClosedImmersion ((qX ≫ i) ≫ inv qQ) := inferInstance
  have he : (qX ≫ i) ≫ inv qQ = i' := by
    rw [hi, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact he ▸ hc

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.isoIdealIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem isoIdealIso_inclusion :
    (isoIdealIso i i' qX qQ hi).hom ≫
        SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι i'.ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι i.ker) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := iso_square_closed i i' qX qQ hi
  simp only [isoIdealIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [ClosedIdealKernelH2.idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion, isoNativeKernelIso_inclusion,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, ClosedIdealKernelH2.idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.originalIdealComparison_open_square
statement:
theorem originalIdealComparison_open_square :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p) ≫
      eI.hom =
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp).hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback p').map eI0.hom ≫
        ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j' p'
proof:
:= by
  let C := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback p'
  let ki := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker
  let kj' := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j'.ker
  let ki' := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (j' ≫ p').ker
  have hz : F.map eI0.hom ≫ (F.map ki' ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p').hom) =
      F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).map ki ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qP).hom) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p').hom := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ F.map f ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p').hom) hI0
  letI : Mono kj' := by
    change Mono (kernel.ι (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.structureMap j'.ker))
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_mono kj').mp
  have hl : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
      (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p) ≫ eI.hom) ≫ kj' =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion j p) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hI, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
      ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_inclusion]
  have hc : ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j' p' ≫ kj' =
      F.map ki' ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p').hom := by
    exact (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_inclusion j' p').trans
      (ConormalRestrictionMapH2.pulledIdealInclusion_eq_map_unit j' p')
  have hr : (C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫ F.map eI0.hom ≫
      ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j' p') ≫ kj' =
      C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
        F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).map ki ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qP).hom) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p').hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hc]
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫ f) hz
  have hm : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
      (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion j p) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom =
      C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
        F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).map ki ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qP).hom) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p').hom := by
    rw [ConormalRestrictionMapH2.pulledIdealInclusion_eq_map_unit]
    exact ConormalRestrictionMapH2.pulledCoefficient_restrict p qQ qP p' hp ki
  exact hl.trans (hm.trans hr.symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.nativePulledIdealComparison_open_square
statement:
theorem nativePulledIdealComparison_open_square :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map (nativePulledIdealComparison j p) ≫
        (pulledModuleRestrictionIso j qX qQ j' hj eI).hom =
      (openSquareCompositePullbackIdealIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp eI0).hom ≫
        nativePulledIdealComparison j' p'
proof:
:= by
  have hk := pulledMap_restrict_square j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p)
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j' p') eI0.hom eI.hom
    (originalIdealComparison_open_square j p j' p' qQ qP hp eI0 eI hI0 hI)
  exact hk.trans (Category.assoc
    ((pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp).hom.app
      (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (j' ≫ p')).map eI0.hom)
      (nativePulledIdealComparison j' p')).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.originalConormalComparison_open_square
statement:
theorem originalConormalComparison_open_square :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison j p) ≫
        (originalConormalRestrictionIso qQ j j' qX hj eI).hom =
      (openSquareCompositeConormalIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp eI0).hom ≫
        ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison j' p'
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalComparison_eq_nativePulled, conormalComparison_eq_nativePulled]
  exact isoConjugatedMap_restrict (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX)
    (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)) (TF3.conormalIso j)
    (TF3.conormalIso (j' ≫ p')) (TF3.conormalIso j')
    (openSquareCompositePullbackIdealIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp eI0)
    (pulledModuleRestrictionIso j qX qQ j' hj eI)
    (nativePulledIdealComparison j p) (nativePulledIdealComparison j' p')
    (nativePulledIdealComparison_open_square j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp eI0 eI hI0 hI)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.openSquareSequence_first_square
statement:
theorem openSquareSequence_first_square :
    (openSquareSequenceSourceIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp eI0).hom ≫

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.affine_resLE_iso_square
statement:
lemma affine_resLE_iso_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    hV.isoSpec.inv ≫ f.resLE U V e = Spec.map (f.appLE U V e) ≫ hU.isoSpec.inv
proof:
:= by
  have hs := congrArg (fun z ↦ hV.isoSpec.inv ≫ z ≫ hU.isoSpec.inv)
    (Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE f U V e)
  simpa only [← hV.isoSpec_hom, ← hU.isoSpec_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using hs.symm

theorem exists_affine_shortExact_restriction {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion (j ≫ p)] [Smooth p] (x : X) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧
      ((ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence j p).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, e, hW, hU, hV, hxU, _, heq, hS, hsm, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    CompatibleClosedChartH2.exists_compatibleClosedChart j p x
  exact ⟨(j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U, hS, hxU,
    originalConormalSequence_chart_shortExact j p U V e hW heq hU hV hS hsm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSequenceTransportH2.originalConormalSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem originalConormalSequence_shortExact {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion (j ≫ p)] [Smooth p] :
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence j p).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let U : X → X.Opens := fun x ↦ (exists_affine_shortExact_restriction j p x).choose
  have hx : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U x := fun x ↦
    (exists_affine_shortExact_restriction j p x).choose_spec.2.1
  have hS : ∀ x : X, ((ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence j p).map
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U x).ι)).ShortExact := fun x ↦
    (exists_affine_shortExact_restriction j p x).choose_spec.2.2
  have hcover : ⨆ x, U x = ⊤ := top_unique (by
    intro x _
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hx x⟩)
  exact Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_restrict_cover X
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence j p) U
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).mpr hcover) hS

name: KSpecialization.G2HTWB.rLine_eq_piW_sub
statement:
theorem rLine_eq_piW_sub {L : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L)
    (hL : HasConstantRank _ L 1)
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)] :
    haveI
proof:
:= (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
    rLine σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL =
      G2GC2.piW Y J - (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL) := by
  haveI := (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
  have hπs := G2GC2.piW_comp_section Y J
    (secOf σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)) (secOf_pr _ _ _)
  have e : rLine σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL =
      (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp ((finitePushforward
        (secOf σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J))).comp
          (rLine σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL)) := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hπs, AddMonoidHom.id_comp]
  rw [e, secOf_comp_rLine σ _ _ hL]
  ext g
  simp [tauW]

name: KSpecialization.G2HTWB.rLine_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rLine_eq_iff {L₀ L₁ : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] [L₁.IsQuasicoherent] [L₁.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ₀ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₀) (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₁)
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank _ L₀ 1) (hL₁ : HasConstantRank _ L₁ 1)
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)]
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)] :
    haveI
proof:
:= (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
    rLine σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₀ =
        rLine σ₁ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₁ ↔
      (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL₀) = (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL₁) := by
  haveI := (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
  rw [rLine_eq_piW_sub Y J σ₀ hL₀, rLine_eq_piW_sub Y J σ₁ hL₁]
  exact sub_right_inj (a := G2GC2.piW Y J)

name: KSpecialization.G2HTWB.rLine_rigid_of_piTwist
statement:
theorem rLine_rigid_of_piTwist {L₀ L₁ : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] [L₁.IsQuasicoherent] [L₁.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ₀ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₀) (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₁)
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank _ L₀ 1) (hL₁ : HasConstantRank _ L₁ 1)
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)]
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)]
    (hpi : haveI := (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
      (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL₀) = (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL₁)) :
    rLine σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₀ =
      rLine σ₁ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₁
proof:
:=
  (rLine_eq_iff Y J σ₀ σ₁ hL₀ hL₁).2 hpi

name: KSpecialization.G2HTWB.piTwist_of_htw
statement:
theorem piTwist_of_htw {L₀ L₁ : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] [L₁.IsQuasicoherent] [L₁.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank _ L₀ 1) (hL₁ : HasConstantRank _ L₁ 1)
    (htw : pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ClassOf _ (lineBundleDual _ L₀)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₀)) =
      pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ClassOf _ (lineBundleDual _ L₁)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₁))) :
    haveI
proof:
:= (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
    (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL₀) = (G2GC2.piW Y J).comp (tauW Y J hL₁) := by
  simp only [tauW, htw]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    IsLocalizedModule.Away
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
        R n M i j k hij)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization.Away
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationAway R n i j k hij
  exact moduleSpecΓAwayLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
    (S := CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k)
    (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
      (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
    (projectiveCoordinateOverlapAffineModel R n M j k)

:=

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_iso
statement:
theorem CohQ.cls_iso {X : Scheme.{u}} {E E' : X.Modules} (hE : IsCoherentLike X E)
    (hE' : IsCoherentLike X E') (e : E ≅ E') : g0ClassOf X E hE = g0ClassOf X E' hE'
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) hE hE'
    (show (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance) (isZero_zero _) e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_middle
statement:
theorem CohQ.cls_middle {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsCoherentLike X A)
    (hB : IsCoherentLike X B) (hD : IsCoherentLike X D)
    {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    g0ClassOf X B hB = g0ClassOf X A hA + g0ClassOf X D hD
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) hA hB hD zero h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_zero
statement:
theorem CohQ.cls_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (hE : IsCoherentLike X E)
    (hZ : IsZero E) : g0ClassOf X E hE = 0
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) hE hZ

statement:

    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) : Epi (quillenCounit R n F)
proof:
:=
  CohReg.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular R n F hreg

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.higher_isZero
statement:
theorem CohQ.higher_isZero (F : (space R n).Modules) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) F (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := CohReg.isMumfordRegular_of_le R n F
    (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by positivity) hreg (q + 1) (Nat.succ_pos q)
  rw [sub_self] at h
  exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n F) (q + 1) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.pp_fp
statement:
theorem CohQ.pp_fp (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n F

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.kernel_fp
statement:
theorem CohQ.kernel_fp (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) : (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := CohQ.pp_fp R n F
  haveI := CohQ.ε_epi R n F hreg
  exact projectiveKernel_isFinitePresentation_of_epi R n (quillenCounit R n F)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.pullback_vanishing
statement:
theorem CohQ.pullback_vanishing (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (p : ℕ)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d ∨ n ≤ p) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F)) d) (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let V := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
  haveI hP : P.IsFinitePresentation := CohQ.pp_fp R n F
  rcases hd with hd | hp
  · haveI := pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n F
    haveI : Module.Finite R Γ(F, ⊤) :=
      PushforwardFree.globalSections_finite R n F (pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n F)
    haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
    haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n F
    let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj V
    haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n F)
    let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app V
    have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
    let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ V := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
    let e2 : P ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
    let e3 : moduleTwist R n P d ≅ projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm d :=
      tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) P _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n e3.symm (p + 1) (Quillen.baseModule_vanishing R n Qm p d hd)
  · haveI : (moduleTwist R n P d).IsFinitePresentation :=
      CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n P d
    exact quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt R n _ p (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.kernel_vanishing
statement:
theorem CohQ.kernel_vanishing (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) (-(i : ℤ))) (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hε := CohQ.ε_epi R n F hreg
  let S := quillenCounitSeq R n F
  have hS : S.ShortExact := Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n F hε
  rcases i with _ | k
  · have hR0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
        S.g) := by
      refine (epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff
        (toSpec R n) S.g).2 ?_
      have htri := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).right_triangle_components F
      exact epi_of_epi_fac htri
    have hw : (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map S.g ≫
        affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂ (toSpec R n) S hS 0).zero
    have hδ : affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 := by
      exact hR0.left_cancellation _ _ (hw.trans comp_zero.symm)
    have hP1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₂ (0 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _) (0 + 1)
        (CohQ.pullback_vanishing R n F 0 0 (Or.inl (by omega)))
    have h1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₁ (0 + 1)) :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S hS 0).isZero_of_both_zeros
        hδ (hP1.eq_of_tgt _ _)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _).symm _ h1
  · let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
    let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
    have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
    have h1 := hreg (k + 1) (by omega)
    rw [zero_sub] at h1
    have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ (k + 1)) :=
      h1
    have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂ (k + 1 + 1)) :=
      CohQ.pullback_vanishing R n F (k + 1) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by omega)
    exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' (k + 1)).isZero_of_both_zeros
      (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.twist_isRegular
statement:
theorem CohQ.twist_isRegular (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = i + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have e := moduleTwistTwistIso R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) 1 (0 - ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (-(i : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact Quillen.R_iso R n e.symm (i + 1) (CohQ.kernel_vanishing R n F hreg i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.syzygy_spec
statement:
theorem CohQ.syzygy_spec (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    ∀ i, (quillenSyzygy R n F i).IsFinitePresentation ∧
      IsMumfordRegular R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i) 0
  | 0 => ⟨hF, hreg⟩
  | i + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= CohQ.syzygy_spec F hF hreg i
    haveI := h1
    haveI := CohQ.kernel_fp R n _ h2
    exact ⟨CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n _ 1, CohQ.twist_isRegular R n _ h2⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.pushforward_counit_injective
statement:
theorem CohQ.pushforward_counit_injective (G : (space R n).Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] :
    Function.Injective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G))).hom
proof:
:= by
  let V := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
  haveI : Module.Finite R Γ(G, ⊤) :=
    PushforwardFree.globalSections_finite R n G (pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n G)
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n G
  let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj V
  haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n G)
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app V
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
  let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ V := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
  let e2 : P ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
  let e3 : moduleTwist R n P ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅
      projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) P _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
  let eBP : projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Qm) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅ P :=
    e3.symm ≪≫ Quillen.twistCastZeroIso R n P
  let A := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj P)
  let eTot : (R × Qm) ≃ₗ[R] R × A :=
    Quillen.sqZeroSplitEquiv R Qm n ≪≫ₗ (LinearEquiv.refl R R).prodCongr
      (coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv R n _ ≪≫ₗ
        projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n _ ≪≫ₗ Quillen.secEquiv R n eBP ≪≫ₗ
        PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n P)
  let f : A →ₗ[R] Qm := ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G))).hom
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro y
    have htri := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (toSpec R n)).right_triangle_components G
    have h2 : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).unit.app V) ≫
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G)) = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← Functor.map_comp]
      erw [htri]
      exact (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map_id _
    exact ⟨_, congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom y) h2⟩
  let φ : (R × Qm) →ₗ[R] (R × Qm) := (LinearMap.prodMap LinearMap.id f) ∘ₗ eTot.toLinearMap
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj b
    refine ⟨eTot.symm (a, x), ?_⟩
    simp [φ, hx]
  have hinj := OrzechProperty.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism φ hφ
  intro x y hxy
  have hxy' : f x = f y := hxy
  have h1 : eTot.symm (0, x) = eTot.symm (0, y) := hinj (by simp [φ, hxy'])
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (eTot.symm.injective h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.R0_kernel_isZero
statement:
theorem CohQ.R0_kernel_isZero (G : (space R n).Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := CohQ.pushforward_counit_injective R n G
  haveI : (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)).IsFinitePresentation := CohQ.kernel_fp R n G hreg
  haveI : (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n G))
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isLeftAdjoint
  let ι := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (kernel.ι (quillenCounit R n G)))
  have hι : Function.Injective ι.hom := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective ι).1 inferInstance
  have hcomp : ι ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G)) = 0 := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, kernel.condition, Functor.map_zero,
      Functor.map_zero]
  have h0 : ∀ s, ι.hom s = 0 := fun s ↦ hinj (by
    have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom s) hcomp
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    rw [this, map_zero])
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)))) :=
    ⟨fun s t ↦ hι ((h0 s).trans (h0 t).symm)⟩
  have hΓ := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G))))
  have hT := (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).map_isZero hΓ
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)))
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)))
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G))) :=
    hT.of_iso (@asIso _ _ _ _ c hc).symm
  exact hV.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.step
statement:
theorem CohQ.step (G : (space R n).Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 1 ≤ n)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n G (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) q)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)) (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hε := CohQ.ε_epi R n G hreg
  let S := quillenCounitSeq R n G
  have hS : S.ShortExact := Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n G hε
  let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
  let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ q) := h
  have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂ (q + 1)) :=
    CohQ.pullback_vanishing R n G q (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (Or.inl (by omega))
  exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' q).isZero_of_both_zeros
    (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.dimension
statement:
theorem CohQ.dimension (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : n ≤ p) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) M (p + 1))
proof:
:=
  quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt R n M p (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.vanishing
statement:
theorem CohQ.vanishing (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ q, q ≤ i → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) (-(q : ℤ))) q)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ j, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F j))) (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) := by
    intro j
    haveI := (CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg j).1
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistNegZeroIso R n _).symm 0
      (CohQ.R0_kernel_isZero R n _ (CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg j).2)
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = 0 := by omega
    exact h0 0
  | succ i ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases q with _ | q
    · exact h0 (i + 1)
    · obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg (i + 1)
      haveI := hG
      by_cases hqn : q + 1 ≤ n
      · refine CohQ.step R n (quillenSyzygy R n F (i + 1)) hGreg q hqn ?_
        have e := moduleTwistTwistIso R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) 1
          (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(q : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
        exact Quillen.R_iso R n e.symm q (ih q (by omega))
      · haveI := CohQ.kernel_fp R n _ hGreg
        haveI := CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n
          (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F (i + 1)))) (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
        exact CohQ.dimension R n _ q (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.isZero_of_regular
statement:
theorem CohQ.isZero_of_regular (G : (space R n).Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0)
    (h0 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) G 0)) : IsZero G
proof:
:= by
  have hε := CohQ.ε_epi R n G hreg
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G) :=
    h0.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) G).symm
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).isLeftAdjoint
  have hP : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).map_isZero hV
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  exact (cancel_epi (quillenCounit R n G)).1 (hP.eq_of_src _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.syzygy_kernel_isZero
statement:
theorem CohQ.syzygy_kernel_isZero (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    IsZero (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg n
  haveI := hG
  haveI hZ := CohQ.kernel_fp R n _ hGreg
  have hregZ : IsMumfordRegular R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n))) 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [zero_sub]
    by_cases hqn : q ≤ n
    · exact CohQ.vanishing R n F hF hreg n q hqn
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, q = p + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      haveI := CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n
        (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n))) (-((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
      exact CohQ.dimension R n _ p (by omega)
  exact CohQ.isZero_of_regular R n _ hregZ (CohQ.R0_kernel_isZero R n _ hGreg)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.resolution_shortExact
statement:
theorem CohQ.resolution_shortExact (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f : Quillen.Zq R n F (i + 1) ⟶ Quillen.M R n F i) (g : Quillen.M R n F i ⟶ Quillen.Zq R n F i)
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i
  haveI := hG
  have hε := CohQ.ε_epi R n _ hGreg
  let S := quillenCounitSeq R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n _ hε
  let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-(i : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
  let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  let e : Quillen.Zq R n F (i + 1) ≅ S'.X₁ :=
    moduleTwistTwistIso R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) 1
      (-((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(i : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact Quillen.transport R n e S'.f S'.g S'.zero hS'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillen_zq_isFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).1
  exact CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillen_base_isFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (CohQ.syzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).1
  exact pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillen_M_isFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := quillen_base_isFinitePresentation R n F hF hreg i
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj (quillenBase R n F i)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global _ _
  exact CohQ.fp_of_iso (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _)
    (projectiveTwistingTensor_isFinitePresentation R n _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleTwist_isZero_aux
statement:
private theorem moduleTwist_isZero_aux {F : (space R n).Modules} (hF : IsZero F) (m : ℤ) :
    IsZero (moduleTwist R n F m)
proof:
:=
  (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n m)).map_isZero hF

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillen_zq_isZero
proof:
:= by
  have hZn := CohQ.syzygy_kernel_isZero R n F hF hreg
  have h1 := moduleTwist_isZero_aux R n hZn 1
  have h2 := moduleTwist_isZero_aux R n h1 (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  show IsZero (moduleTwist R n (quillenSyzygy R n F (n + 1)) (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))
  rw [quillenSyzygy_succ]
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillen_key
statement:
private theorem quillen_key (S : AddSubgroup (G0 (space R n)))
    (hS : ∀ (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules), T.IsFinitePresentation → ∀ (d : ℤ)
      (h : IsCoherentLike (space R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))),
      g0ClassOf (space R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) h ∈ S)
    (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0)
    (hZq : ∀ i, (Quillen.Zq R n F i).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hT : ∀ i, (quillenBase R n F i).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hM : ∀ i, (Quillen.M R n F i).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hZr : IsZero (Quillen.Zq R n F (n + 1))) :
    ∀ k i, i + k = n + 1 → g0ClassOf (space R n) (Quillen.Zq R n F i) (hZq i) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hi
    obtain rfl : i = n + 1 := by omega
    rw [CohQ.cls_zero _ hZr]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hi
    have h1 := ih (i + 1) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨f, g, w, hex⟩ := CohQ.resolution_shortExact R n F hF hreg i
    have hrel := CohQ.cls_middle (hZq (i + 1)) (hM i) (hZq i) w hex
    have hMS := hS (quillenBase R n F i) (hT i) (-(i : ℤ)) (hM i)
    change g0ClassOf (space R n) (Quillen.M R n F i) (hM i) ∈ S at hMS
    rw [hrel] at hMS
    exact (S.add_mem_cancel_left h1).1 hMS

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.g0ClassOf_mem_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem CohQ.g0ClassOf_mem_of_isMumfordRegular (S : AddSubgroup (G0 (space R n)))
    (hS : ∀ (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules), T.IsFinitePresentation → ∀ (d : ℤ)
      (h : IsCoherentLike (space R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))),
      g0ClassOf (space R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) h ∈ S)
    (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    g0ClassOf (space R n) F hF ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hZq := quillen_zq_isFinitePresentation R n F hF hreg
  have hT := quillen_base_isFinitePresentation R n F hF hreg
  have hM := quillen_M_isFinitePresentation R n F hF hreg
  have hZr := quillen_zq_isZero R n F hF hreg
  have key := quillen_key R n S hS F hF hreg hZq hT hM hZr
  have h0 := key (n + 1) 0 (by omega)
  have e0 : Quillen.Zq R n F 0 ≅ F := Quillen.twistNegZeroIso R n F
  have hcls : g0ClassOf (space R n) (Quillen.Zq R n F 0) (hZq 0) = g0ClassOf (space R n) F hF :=
    CohQ.cls_iso _ _ e0
  rw [← hcls]
  exact h0

name: ARRASM.hψnat
