name: B7.pr_intCast_of_pos
statement: theorem pr_intCast_of_pos (r : ℤ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : RG6B.pr W k (r : K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (r : K) ∈ W 0 := by
    have : (r : K) = (r : ℚ) • (1 : K) := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
      simp
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem)
  exact RG6B.pr_of_mem_ne h (by omega)

name: B7.addCharW_add_intCast
statement:
theorem addCharW_add_intCast (D : ℕ) (g : PowerSeries ℚ) (u : K) (r : ℤ) :
    B4.addCharW W D g (u + (r : K)) = B4.addCharW W D g u
proof:
:= by
  unfold B4.addCharW B4.powSumW
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1
  rw [map_add, pr_intCast_of_pos r hk1, add_zero]

name: B7.toddW_dual_add_intCast
statement:
theorem toddW_dual_add_intCast (C : B6.Ctx K) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (D : ℕ) (u : K) (r : ℤ) :
    C.toddW hj D (C.dual hj (u + (r : K))) = C.toddW hj D (C.dual hj u)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj
  unfold B6.Ctx.toddW B4.ToddW B6.Ctx.dual
  rw [addCharW_dualW, addCharW_dualW, addCharW_add_intCast]

name: B7.chGr_eq_theta
statement:
theorem chGr_eq_theta (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] [IsIntegral X]
    (hT : TowerHypSTEPW X) (D : ℕ) (x : K0 X) :
    chGr X D x = thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hT (genericPoint X) D
      (toK0Q X x)
proof:
:=
  (theta_toK0Q _ hT _ D x _ _).symm

name: B7.fQ_filt
statement:
theorem fQ_filt (p : ℕ) (a : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) (ha : a ∈ (gammaFiltQ X).F p) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf a ∈ (gammaFiltQ Y).F (((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have h1 : a ∈ B3.FilGammaQ X p := by
    rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hXc (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X)]
    exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hXc (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X) p a).1 ha
  have h2 := f_shift hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p h1
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hYc (towerHyp_of_projective hY) (genericPoint Y)] at h2
  exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hYc (towerHyp_of_projective hY) (genericPoint Y) _ _).2 h2

name: B7.f_sub_Phi_mem
statement:
theorem f_sub_Phi_mem (p : ℕ) (hdp : B6.dRel i ≤ p) {w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X}
    (hw : w ∈ B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) p) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf w - PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w ∈
      B3.Gq (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := F_sub_Phi_mem (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (B5.tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i (le_refl 2)) (arr_ctx hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi (le_refl 2))
    (B6.dRel i) (tauF_spec hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInv hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2))
    (tauF_spec hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)).1 hw
  have e : ((((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat) = ((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat + 1 := by omega
  rw [e] at h
  exact h

name: B7.grPush_theta
statement:
theorem grPush_theta {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁) (w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD
        (thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) (towerHyp_of_projective hX)
          (genericPoint X) D₁ w) =
      thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) (towerHyp_of_projective hY)
        (genericPoint Y) D₂ (PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  have hTY := towerHyp_of_projective hY
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hXc) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hXc hTX (genericPoint X) 2 le_rfl
  induction w using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (B3.Wt hXc) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | @homogeneous p m =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := m
    show grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD (thetaX hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D₁ w) =
      thetaX hYc hTY (genericPoint Y) D₂ (PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w)
    rw [thetaX_of_mem hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D₁ hw]
    by_cases hd : B6.dRel i ≤ (p : ℤ)
    · have hm : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
      have hΦ := Phi_mem_Wt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p _ hm hw
      rw [thetaX_of_mem hYc hTY (genericPoint Y) D₂ hΦ]
      unfold grPush
      rw [fGr_gcl_of_le _ _ _ hD hd]
      refine B4.gcl_eq_of_sub_mem D₂ _ ?_
      show B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf w - PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w ∈
        (gammaFiltQ Y).F ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat) + 1)
      exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hYc hTY (genericPoint Y) _ _).2
        (f_sub_Phi_mem hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p hd hw)
    · have hlt : (p : ℤ) < B6.dRel i := by omega
      unfold grPush
      rw [fGr_gcl_of_lt _ _ _ hD hlt, Phi_eq_zero_of_lt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p hlt hw,
        map_zero]

name: B7.pr_PhiF
statement:
theorem pr_PhiF (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i) (w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w) =
      PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2)
        ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat) w)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hXc) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hXc hTX (genericPoint X) 2 le_rfl
  induction w using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (B3.Wt hXc) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | @homogeneous p w0 =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := w0
    show (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w) =
      PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2)
        ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat) w)
    by_cases hd : B6.dRel i ≤ (p : ℤ)
    · have hm' : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
      have hΦ := Phi_mem_Wt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p _ hm' hw
      by_cases hmp : m = ((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat
      · have e : ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat = p := by omega
        rw [e, (ctxOf hX).pr_of_mem_same (le_refl 2) hw, hmp,
          (ctxOf hY).pr_of_mem_same (le_refl 2) hΦ]
      · have e : ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat ≠ p := by omega
        rw [(ctxOf hX).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hw e, map_zero,
          (ctxOf hY).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hΦ hmp]
    · have hlt : (p : ℤ) < B6.dRel i := by omega
      have e : ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat ≠ p := by omega
      rw [Phi_eq_zero_of_lt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p hlt hw, map_zero,
        (ctxOf hX).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hw e, map_zero]

name: B7.pr_PhiF_neg
statement:
theorem pr_PhiF_neg (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i < 0) (w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hXc) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hXc hTX (genericPoint X) 2 le_rfl
  induction w using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (B3.Wt hXc) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | @homogeneous p w0 =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := w0
    show (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2) w) = 0
    by_cases hd : B6.dRel i ≤ (p : ℤ)
    · have hm' : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
      have hΦ := Phi_mem_Wt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p _ hm' hw
      have hmp : m ≠ ((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat := by omega
      rw [(ctxOf hY).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hΦ hmp]
    · have hlt : (p : ℤ) < B6.dRel i := by omega
      rw [Phi_eq_zero_of_lt hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi p hlt hw, map_zero]

name: B7.grr_weight
statement:
theorem grr_weight (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) (m : ℕ) :
    ((0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i) →
      (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
        PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i (le_refl 2)
          ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat)
            (tauF hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2) * x))) ∧
    ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i < 0 → (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fQ_eq_Phi hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi (le_refl 2) x]
  exact ⟨fun h => pr_PhiF hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi m h _,
    fun h => pr_PhiF_neg hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi m h _⟩

name: B7.thetaX_injective_Wt
statement:
theorem thetaX_injective_Wt {D p : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ D) {w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X}
    (hw : w ∈ B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) p)
    (h : thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) (towerHyp_of_projective hX)
      (genericPoint X) D w = 0) : w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  rw [thetaX_of_mem hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D hw] at h
  have h1 := (B4.gcl_eq_zero_iff hp _).1 h
  have h2 : w ∈ B3.Gq hXc (p + 1) :=
    (mem_filGammaQ_iff hXc hTX (genericPoint X) (p + 1) w).1 h1
  have := B3.Wt_disjoint_Gq hXc p
  exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 this) w hw h2

name: B7.theta_tau
statement:
theorem theta_tau {D : ℕ}
    (hDt : ∀ p, D < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))) = 0) :
    thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X) D
        (tauF hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)) =
      tdDual X D (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  set v := B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i with hv
  set r := rankAtRingHom (genericPoint X) v with hr
  have hz := sub_rank_mem hXc (genericPoint X) v
  have e : B5.toKQ X v = toK0Q X (v - (r : K0 X)) + ((r : ℤ) : K0Q X) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_intCast]
    show toK0Q X v = _
    abel
  rw [tau_eq_todd hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2) D hDt, e]
  show thetaX hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D
    ((ctxK0 hXc hTX (genericPoint X)).toddW (le_refl 2) D
      ((ctxK0 hXc hTX (genericPoint X)).dual (le_refl 2) _)) = _
  rw [toddW_dual_add_intCast]
  exact theta_toddW_dual hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D hz

name: B7.grr_gr_gamma
statement:
theorem grr_gr_gamma (x : K0 X) {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁)
    (hDt : ∀ p, D₁ < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))) = 0) :
    chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD
        (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))
proof:
:= by
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  have hTY := towerHyp_of_projective hY
  rw [chGr_eq_theta Y hTY D₂, chGr_eq_theta X hTX D₁, mul_comm, ← theta_tau hX hXreg hY hYreg f i hi hDt,
    ← map_mul, grPush_theta hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD]
  have h2 : toK0Q Y (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) = B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf (toK0Q X x) :=
    (B5.mapQ_toKQ _ x).symm
  rw [h2, fQ_eq_Phi hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi (le_refl 2) (toK0Q X x)]

name: B7.rank_tvee
statement:
theorem rank_tvee (y : X) :
    rankAtRingHom y (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i) = B6.dRel i
proof:
:= by
  rw [tvee_eq hXreg hY hYreg i, map_sub, rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAtRingHom_classOf,
    rankAt_of_hasConstantRank (hEa i), rankAt_of_hasConstantRank (hEb hXreg hY hYreg i)]
  unfold B6.dRel
  rfl

name: B7.grr_gr_gamma_exists
statement:
theorem grr_gr_gamma_exists (x : K0 X) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℕ, ∀ {D₁ D₂ : ℕ}, D₀ ≤ D₁ → ∀ (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁),
      chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
        grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD
          (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := exists_dual_bound hX hXreg hY hYreg i (le_refl 2)
  refine ⟨D₀, fun {D₁ D₂} h1 hD => ?_⟩
  exact grr_gr_gamma hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x hD fun p hp => hD₀ p (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hp)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartToOverlapRight_coordinateRatio_pow_mul_transition
statement:

    (D : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n i j
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ D) *

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_transition_smul_coordinateRatio_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_transition_smul_coordinateRatio_smul
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (x : projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRight R n M i j hij) :
    (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j :
        CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) •
      (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ D • x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j :
      CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) •
    (coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n i j
      (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ D) • x) = x
  rw [← mul_smul, mul_comm,
    coordinateChartToOverlapRight_coordinateRatio_pow_mul_transition, one_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_twist_compatible_extensions
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_twist_compatible_extensions
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∀ j : AffineChartIndex n i,
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ∃ t : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
            (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j.1)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤),
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
              R n M i j.1 j.2
              (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
                R n M i j.1 j.2
                (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)) =
          (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j.1 :
              CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j.1) •
            projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
              R n M i j.1 j.2.symm t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_overlap_extensions R n M
  refine ⟨D, fun i j a => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hD i j a
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  let y :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv
      R n M i j.1 j.2
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
        R n M i j.1 j.2
        (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a))
  calc
    y = (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j.1 :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j.1) •
        (coordinateRatio R n j.1 ⟨i, j.2.symm⟩ ^ D • y) :=
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_transition_smul_coordinateRatio_smul
        R n M D i j.1 j.2.symm y).symm
    _ = (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j.1 :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j.1) •
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M i j.1 j.2.symm t := congrArg
            (fun z => (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j.1 :
              CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j.1) • z) ht

name: GRRKG6.conormalClass_zero_field
statement:
theorem conormalClass_zero_field (hs : ∀ y : space k n, y ∈ Set.range i) :
    (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hco : Order.coheight (i (genericPoint X)) = 0 := by
    rw [image_generic i hs]; exact coheight_generic_eq_zero _
  have h0 : (Order.coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0 := by rw [hco]; rfl
  exact class_zero_of_rank (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).rank h0

name: GRRKG6.closedImmersion_field_surj
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_field_surj (hs : ∀ y : space k n, y ∈ Set.range i) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (space k n))
        (adamsRingHom (ARRASM.rankA k n) j ((ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
            (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
            (Multiplicative.ofAdd
              (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass) :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Surjective i := ⟨hs⟩
  haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective i
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  exact closedImm_of_iso i (ARRASM.resA k n) (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
    (ARRASM.rankA k n) (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
    (conormalClass_zero_field k n i hX hs) hj x

name: GRRKG6.adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed_all
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed_all (hn : 0 < n) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) j
          ((resSpec k).res (fG k n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      kLocPush j k n hn (resSpec k).res
        (pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (adamsCotangentClass k n) -
                (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:=
  by
  by_cases hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range i
  · exact adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed k n i hX hn hne hj x
  · push Not at hne
    exact adamsRiemannRoch_of_inputs
      (adamsRRInputsOfLibrary j k n hn i hj
        (ResolutionRegularClosedF15.resolutionOfRegularClosed k n i hX) (ARRASM.resA k n)
        (resSpec k) (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) (ARRASM.rankA k n)
        (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _)
        (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
        (constantRankGenerators_and_lambdaNilpotent_space_field k n).2
        (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX)
        (closedImmersion_field_surj k n i hX hne (by omega))) x

name: GRRKG6.adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed_all_noinst
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed_all_noinst (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space k n) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral X]
    (hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X) (hn : 0 < n) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (x : haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion i; K0 X) :
    haveI : IsNoetherian X
proof:
:= isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion i
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) j
          ((resSpec k).res (fG k n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      kLocPush j k n hn (resSpec k).res
        (pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (adamsCotangentClass k n) -
                (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X))) := by
  haveI : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_closedImmersion i
  exact adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed_all k n i hX hn hj x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular

theorem higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)

:= by

    (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by positivity) hreg (q + 1) (Nat.succ_pos q)
  rw [sub_self] at h
