    (Quillen.pullbackPushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg) hF _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.pullback_vanishing
statement:
theorem Quillen.pullback_vanishing (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (p : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d ∨ n ≤ p) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F)) d) (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let V := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
  have hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) P :=
    Quillen.pullbackPushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg
  have hPd : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (moduleTwist R n P d) :=
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) P _ hP
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)
  rcases hd with hd | hp
  · obtain ⟨hfin, -⟩ := globalSections_finite_projective R n F hF
      (higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular R n F hF hreg)
    haveI := hF
    haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFinitePresentation
    haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
    haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n F
    let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj V
    haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n F)
    let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app V
    have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
    let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ V := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
    let e2 : P ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
    let e3 : moduleTwist R n P d ≅ projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm d :=
      tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) P _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n e3.symm (p + 1) (Quillen.baseModule_vanishing R n Qm p d hd)
  · haveI : (moduleTwist R n P d).IsFinitePresentation := hPd.isFinitePresentation
    exact quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt R n _ p (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.kernel_vanishing
statement:
theorem Quillen.kernel_vanishing (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) (-(i : ℤ))) (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hε := Quillen.ε_epi R n F hF hreg
  let S := quillenCounitSeq R n F
  have hS : S.ShortExact := Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n F hε
  rcases i with _ | k
  · 
    have hR0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
        S.g) := by
      refine (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff (toSpec R n) S.g).2 ?_
      have htri := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).right_triangle_components F
      exact epi_of_epi_fac htri
    have hw : (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map S.g ≫
        affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂ (toSpec R n) S hS 0).zero
    have hδ : affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 := by
      exact hR0.left_cancellation _ _ (hw.trans comp_zero.symm)
    have hP1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₂ (0 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _) (0 + 1)
        (Quillen.pullback_vanishing R n F hF hreg 0 0 (Or.inl (by omega)))
    have h1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₁ (0 + 1)) :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S hS 0).isZero_of_both_zeros
        hδ (hP1.eq_of_tgt _ _)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _).symm _ h1
  · 
    let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
    let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
    have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
    have h1 := hreg (k + 1) (by omega)
    rw [zero_sub] at h1
    have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ (k + 1)) :=
      h1
    have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂ (k + 1 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.pullback_vanishing R n F hF hreg (k + 1) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by omega)
    exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' (k + 1)).isZero_of_both_zeros
      (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.twist_isRegular
statement:
theorem Quillen.twist_isRegular (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = i + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have e := moduleTwistTwistIso R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) 1 (0 - ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (-(i : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact Quillen.R_iso R n e.symm (i + 1) (Quillen.kernel_vanishing R n F hF hreg i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenCounit_kernel_spec
statement:
theorem quillenCounit_kernel_spec (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    (quillenCounitSeq R n F).ShortExact ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F)) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) 1) ∧
      IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n F)) 1) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n F (Quillen.ε_epi R n F hF hreg),
    Quillen.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isMumfordRegular R n F hF hreg,
    Quillen.pullbackPushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg,
    Quillen.kernel_counit_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg,
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _
      (Quillen.kernel_counit_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _),
    Quillen.twist_isRegular R n F hF hreg⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_quillenResolutionStep
statement:
theorem exists_quillenResolutionStep (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    ∃ (Z : (space R n).Modules)
      (f : Z ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F))
      (g : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F) ⟶ F) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact ∧ IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) Z ∧
        IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (moduleTwist R n Z 1) ∧
        IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n Z 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -, h4, h5, h6⟩ := quillenCounit_kernel_spec R n F hF hreg
  exact ⟨_, _, _, _, h1, h4, h5, h6⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.constToDegreeZero_bijective
statement:
theorem Quillen.constToDegreeZero_bijective (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (Quillen.constToDegreeZero k n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b h ↦ MvPolynomial.C_injective _ _ (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hh := (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule 0 p).1 hp
  have hle := hh.totalDegree_le
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 (by omega)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.sqH0_smul_eq
statement:
theorem Quillen.sqH0_smul_eq (n : ℕ)
    (r : R) (x : ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))).homology 0)) :
    r • x = (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q r) • x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenSyzygy_zero
statement: theorem quillenSyzygy_zero (F : (space R n).Modules) : quillenSyzygy R n F 0 = F
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenSyzygy_succ
statement:
theorem quillenSyzygy_succ (F : (space R n).Modules) (i : ℕ) :
    quillenSyzygy R n F (i + 1) = moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) 1
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenSyzygy_spec
statement:
theorem quillenSyzygy_spec (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (quillenSyzygy R n F i) ∧
      IsMumfordRegular R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i) 0
  | 0 => ⟨hF, hreg⟩
  | i + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= quillenSyzygy_spec F hF hreg i
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, h5, h6⟩ := quillenCounit_kernel_spec R n _ h1 h2
    exact ⟨h5, h6⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.pushforward_counit_injective
statement:
theorem Quillen.pushforward_counit_injective (G : (space R n).Modules)
    (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) :
    Function.Injective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G))).hom
proof:
:= by
  let V := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
  obtain ⟨hfin, -⟩ := globalSections_finite_projective R n G hG
    (higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular R n G hG hreg)
  haveI := hG
  haveI : G.IsFinitePresentation := hG.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n G
  let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj V
  haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n G)
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app V
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
  let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ V := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
  let e2 : P ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
  let e3 : moduleTwist R n P ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅
      projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) P _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
  let eBP : projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Qm) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅ P :=
    e3.symm ≪≫ Quillen.twistCastZeroIso R n P
  let A := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj P)
  let eTot : (R × Qm) ≃ₗ[R] R × A :=
    Quillen.sqZeroSplitEquiv R Qm n ≪≫ₗ (LinearEquiv.refl R R).prodCongr
      (coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv R n _ ≪≫ₗ
        projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n _ ≪≫ₗ Quillen.secEquiv R n eBP ≪≫ₗ
        PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n P)
  let f : A →ₗ[R] Qm := ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G))).hom
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro y
    have htri := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (toSpec R n)).right_triangle_components G
    have h2 : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).unit.app V) ≫
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G)) = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← Functor.map_comp]
      erw [htri]
      exact (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map_id _
    exact ⟨_, congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom y) h2⟩
  let φ : (R × Qm) →ₗ[R] (R × Qm) := (LinearMap.prodMap LinearMap.id f) ∘ₗ eTot.toLinearMap
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj b
    refine ⟨eTot.symm (a, x), ?_⟩
    simp [φ, hx]
  have hinj := OrzechProperty.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism φ hφ
  intro x y hxy
  have hxy' : f x = f y := hxy
  have h1 : eTot.symm (0, x) = eTot.symm (0, y) := hinj (by simp [φ, hxy'])
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (eTot.symm.injective h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R0_kernel_isZero
statement:
theorem Quillen.R0_kernel_isZero (G : (space R n).Modules) (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := Quillen.pushforward_counit_injective R n G hG hreg
  have hZ : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)) :=
    Quillen.kernel_counit_isFiniteLocallyFree R n G hG hreg
  haveI : (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)).IsFinitePresentation := hZ.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n G))
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isLeftAdjoint
  let ι := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (kernel.ι (quillenCounit R n G)))
  have hι : Function.Injective ι.hom := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective ι).1 inferInstance
  have hcomp : ι ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (quillenCounit R n G)) = 0 := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, kernel.condition, Functor.map_zero,
      Functor.map_zero]
  have h0 : ∀ s, ι.hom s = 0 := fun s ↦ hinj (by
    have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom s) hcomp
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    rw [this, map_zero])
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)))) :=
    ⟨fun s t ↦ hι ((h0 s).trans (h0 t).symm)⟩
  have hΓ := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G))))
  have hT := (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).map_isZero hΓ
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)))
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)))
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (kernel (quillenCounit R n G))) :=
    hT.of_iso (@asIso _ _ _ _ c hc).symm
  exact hV.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.step
statement:
theorem Quillen.step (G : (space R n).Modules) (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 1 ≤ n)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n G (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) q)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n G)) (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hε := Quillen.ε_epi R n G hG hreg
  let S := quillenCounitSeq R n G
  have hS : S.ShortExact := Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n G hε
  let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
  let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ q) := h
  have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂ (q + 1)) :=
    Quillen.pullback_vanishing R n G hG hreg q (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (Or.inl (by omega))
  exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' q).isZero_of_both_zeros
    (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.dimension
statement:
theorem Quillen.dimension (M : (space R n).Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) M)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : n ≤ p) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) M (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  exact quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt R n M p (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.Z_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem Quillen.Z_isFiniteLocallyFree (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i)))
proof:
:=
  Quillen.kernel_counit_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _ (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).1
    (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.vanishing
statement:
theorem Quillen.vanishing (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ q, q ≤ i → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) (-(q : ℤ))) q)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ j, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F j))) (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) := by
    intro j
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistNegZeroIso R n _).symm 0
      (Quillen.R0_kernel_isZero R n _ (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg j).1
        (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg j).2)
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = 0 := by omega
    exact h0 0
  | succ i ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases q with _ | q
    · exact h0 (i + 1)
    · obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg (i + 1)
      by_cases hqn : q + 1 ≤ n
      · refine Quillen.step R n (quillenSyzygy R n F (i + 1)) hG hGreg q hqn ?_
        have e := moduleTwistTwistIso R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) 1
          (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(q : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
        exact Quillen.R_iso R n e.symm q (ih q (by omega))
      · have hZ := Quillen.kernel_counit_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _ hG hGreg
        exact Quillen.dimension R n _ (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _ hZ
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)) q (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.isZero_of_regular
statement:
theorem Quillen.isZero_of_regular (G : (space R n).Modules) (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0)
    (h0 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) G 0)) : IsZero G
proof:
:= by
  have hε := Quillen.ε_epi R n G hG hreg
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G) :=
    h0.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) G).symm
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).isLeftAdjoint
  have hP : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).map_isZero hV
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  exact (cancel_epi (quillenCounit R n G)).1 (hP.eq_of_src _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenSyzygy_kernel_isZero
statement:
theorem quillenSyzygy_kernel_isZero (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    IsZero (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg n
  have hZ := Quillen.Z_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg n
  have hregZ : IsMumfordRegular R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n))) 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [zero_sub]
    by_cases hqn : q ≤ n
    · exact Quillen.vanishing R n F hF hreg n q hqn
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, q = p + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      exact Quillen.dimension R n _ (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _ hZ
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)) p (by omega)
  exact Quillen.isZero_of_regular R n _ hZ hregZ (Quillen.R0_kernel_isZero R n _ hG hGreg)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenBase_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem quillenBase_isFiniteLocallyFree (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (quillenBase R n F i)
proof:
:=
  Quillen.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isMumfordRegular R n _ (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).1
    (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.M_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem Quillen.M_isFiniteLocallyFree (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Quillen.M R n F i)
proof:
:=
  tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ (quillenBase_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg i))
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.Zq_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem Quillen.Zq_isFiniteLocallyFree (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Quillen.Zq R n F i)
proof:
:=
  tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _ (quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i).1
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.transport
statement:
theorem Quillen.transport {A A' B D : (space R n).Modules} (e : A' ≅ A) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) :
    ∃ (f' : A' ⟶ B) (g' : B ⟶ D) (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:=
  ⟨e.hom ≫ f, g, by rw [Category.assoc, w, comp_zero],
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (S₁ := ShortComplex.mk f g w)
      (ShortComplex.isoMk e.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp)) h⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quillenResolution_shortExact
statement:
theorem quillenResolution_shortExact (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f : Quillen.Zq R n F (i + 1) ⟶ Quillen.M R n F i) (g : Quillen.M R n F i ⟶ Quillen.Zq R n F i)
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := quillenSyzygy_spec R n F hF hreg i
  have hε := Quillen.ε_epi R n _ hG hGreg
  let S := quillenCounitSeq R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := Quillen.shortExact_of_epi R n _ hε
  let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-(i : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
  let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  let e : Quillen.Zq R n F (i + 1) ≅ S'.X₁ :=
    moduleTwistTwistIso R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F i))) 1
      (-((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(i : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact Quillen.transport R n e S'.f S'.g S'.zero hS'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.classOf_resolutionTerm
statement:
theorem Quillen.classOf_resolutionTerm (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)
    (hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) T) (d : ℤ)
    (h : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n)
      (tensorSheaf (space R n) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))) :
    k0ClassOf (space R n)
        (tensorSheaf (space R n) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) h =
      flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n) (k0ClassOf _ T hT) * Quillen.O R n d
proof:
:= by
  have hpb : flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n) (k0ClassOf _ T hT) =
      k0ClassOf (space R n) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ T hT) := by
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  rw [hpb]
  exact (k0ClassOf_mul (space R n) ⟨_, pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ T hT⟩
    ⟨projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d⟩).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.isZero_of_functor_obj_eq
statement:
theorem Quillen.isZero_of_functor_obj_eq {𝒜 ℬ : Type*} [Category 𝒜] [Category ℬ]
    [Limits.HasZeroMorphisms 𝒜] [Limits.HasZeroMorphisms ℬ] (F : 𝒜 ⥤ ℬ)
    [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] {A : 𝒜} (hA : IsZero A) {B : ℬ} (h : F.obj A = B) : IsZero B
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact F.map_isZero hA

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ClassOf_eq_sum_quillen
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_eq_sum_quillen (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    k0ClassOf (space R n) F hF =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : K0 (space R n)) ^ i *
        (flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n)
            (k0ClassOf _ (quillenBase R n F i) (quillenBase_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg i)) *
          Quillen.O R n (-(i : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  have e0 : Quillen.Zq R n F 0 ≅ F := Quillen.twistNegZeroIso R n F
  have hZr : IsZero (Quillen.Zq R n F (n + 1)) := by
    have hZn := quillenSyzygy_kernel_isZero R n F hF hreg
    have h1 : IsZero (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n))) 1) :=
      Quillen.isZero_of_functor_obj_eq
        (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 1)) hZn rfl
    have h2 : IsZero (moduleTwist R n (moduleTwist R n (kernel (quillenCounit R n (quillenSyzygy R n F n))) 1)
        (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) :=
      Quillen.isZero_of_functor_obj_eq
        (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) h1 rfl
    exact h2
  have hS : ∀ i, i < n + 1 → ∃ (f : Quillen.Zq R n F (i + 1) ⟶ Quillen.M R n F i)
      (g : Quillen.M R n F i ⟶ Quillen.Zq R n F i) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact := fun i _ ↦ quillenResolution_shortExact R n F hF hreg i
  have key := SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_eq_alternating_sum (space R n) (Quillen.M R n F) (Quillen.Zq R n F)
    (Quillen.M_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg) (Quillen.Zq_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg)
    (n + 1) hS hZr
  rw [← k0ClassOf_iso (space R n) (Quillen.Zq_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg 0) hF e0, key]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  exact congrArg _ (Quillen.classOf_resolutionTerm R n _ _ _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ClassOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= (flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n)).toAlgebra
    k0ClassOf (space R n) F hF ∈ Submodule.span (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
      (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Quillen.O R n (-(i : ℤ))) := by
  letI := (flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n)).toAlgebra
  rw [k0ClassOf_eq_sum_quillen R n F hF hreg, Finset.sum_range]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hmem := Submodule.smul_mem (Submodule.span (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
      (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Quillen.O R n (-(i : ℤ))))
    ((-1 : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) ^ (i : ℕ) *
      k0ClassOf _ (quillenBase R n F i) (quillenBase_isFiniteLocallyFree R n F hF hreg i))
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one,
    mul_assoc] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: B3.fd_sum
statement:
lemma fd_sum (k q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (fwdDiff (1 : ℤ))^[k] (fun r : ℤ => r ^ q) 0 = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * dcoef k q
proof:
:= by
  rw [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, range_eq_Ico, sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (Nat.succ_pos k), dcoef,
    mul_sum]
  have h0 : (((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k - 0) * (k.choose 0 : ℕ)) • (fun r : ℤ => r ^ q) (0 + (0 : ℕ) • (1 : ℤ))) = 0 := by
    simp [zero_pow (by omega : q ≠ 0)]
  rw [h0, zero_add]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [mem_Ico] at hm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (show m ≤ k by omega)
  subst ht
  simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
  have e : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (m + t - m) = (-1) ^ (m + t + 1) * (-1) ^ (m + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, ← pow_add]
    have : m + t + 1 + (m + 1) = t + 2 * (m + 1) := by ring
    rw [this, pow_add, pow_mul]; simp
  rw [e]; ring

name: B3.dcoef_eq_zero
statement: lemma dcoef_eq_zero {k q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqk : q < k) : dcoef k q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (fwdDiff_iter_pow_eq_zero_of_lt (R := ℤ) hqk) 0
  rw [fd_sum k q hq] at h
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h | h
  · exact absurd h (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
  · exact h

name: B3.dcoef_self_ne_zero
statement: lemma dcoef_self_ne_zero {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : dcoef k k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h := congrFun (fwdDiff_iter_eq_factorial (R := ℤ) (n := k)) 0
  rw [fd_sum k k hk, h0, mul_zero] at h
  simp at h
  exact (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k) (by exact_mod_cast h.symm)

name: B3.one_tmul_mem_FilGammaQ
statement:
lemma one_tmul_mem_FilGammaQ {p : ℕ} {y : K0 X} (hy : y ∈ FilGamma X p) :
    (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y ∈ FilGammaQ X p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

name: B3.FilGammaQ_antitone
statement: theorem FilGammaQ_antitone {p p' : ℕ} (h : p ≤ p') : FilGammaQ X p' ≤ FilGammaQ X p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (fun y hy => FilGamma_antitone h hy))

name: B3.tmul_mul_tmul'
statement:
lemma tmul_mul_tmul' (a b : K0 X) :
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) * ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]

name: B3.adamsQ_tmul
statement:
lemma adamsQ_tmul (m : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (y : K0 X) :
    adamsQ hX m (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) = c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] adamsRingHom hX m y
proof:
:= by
  simp [adamsQ]

name: B3.adamsQ_one_apply
statement: lemma adamsQ_one_apply (u : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) : adamsQ hX 1 u = u
proof:
:= by
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c y => rw [adamsQ_tmul, adamsRingHom_apply hX le_rfl, SchemeKTheory.adams_one]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb]

name: B3.Wt_le_Gq
statement: lemma Wt_le_Gq {p q : ℕ} (h : p ≤ q) : Wt hX q ≤ Gq hX p
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun q : {q : ℕ // p ≤ q} => Wt hX q.1) ⟨q, h⟩

name: B3.Gq_antitone
statement: lemma Gq_antitone {p p' : ℕ} (h : p ≤ p') : Gq hX p' ≤ Gq hX p
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun q => Wt_le_Gq hX (h.trans q.2)

name: B3.adamsQ_eigen_of_one_le
statement:
theorem adamsQ_eigen_of_one_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {q : ℕ} {u : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X}
    (hu : u ∈ Wt hX q) : adamsQ hX m u = ((m : ℚ) ^ q) • u
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m 2 with h | h
  · have : m = 1 := by omega
    subst this
    rw [adamsQ_one_apply]; simp
  · have hu' : u ∈ W (adamsQ hX) m q := by
      rw [← adamsQ_W_eq hX hT x₀ (le_refl 2) h q]; exact hu
    exact adamsQ_eigen hX hu'

name: B3.Gq_zero
statement: theorem Gq_zero : Gq hX 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := (adamsQ_isInternal hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl).submodule_iSup_eq_top
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← h]
  exact iSup_le fun q => Wt_le_Gq hX (Nat.zero_le q)

name: B3.Gq_mul
statement:
theorem Gq_mul {a b : ℕ} {u v : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hu : u ∈ Gq hX a) (hv : v ∈ Gq hX b) :
    u * v ∈ Gq hX (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : {q : ℕ // a ≤ q} => Wt hX q.1)
    (motive := fun u => u * v ∈ Gq hX (a + b)) hu ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ w hw
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : {q : ℕ // b ≤ q} => Wt hX q.1)
      (motive := fun v => w * v ∈ Gq hX (a + b)) hv ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro ⟨q', hq'⟩ w' hw'
      exact Wt_le_Gq hX (Nat.add_le_add hq hq') (adamsQ_W_mul hX 2 hw hw')
    · simp
    · intro x y hx hy
      rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  · simp
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: B3.Gq_mul_zero
statement: theorem Gq_mul_zero {a : ℕ} {u v : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hu : u ∈ Gq hX a) : v * u ∈ Gq hX a
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ∈ Gq hX 0 := by rw [Gq_zero hX hT x₀]; trivial
  rw [mul_comm]; simpa using Gq_mul hX hu hv

name: B3.mem_Gq_one_of_rank_eq_zero
statement: theorem mem_Gq_one_of_rank_eq_zero {u : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hu : rankQ x₀ u = 0) : u ∈ Gq hX 1
proof:
:= by
  have htop : u ∈ ⨆ q : ℕ, Wt hX q := by
    rw [show (⨆ q : ℕ, Wt hX q) = ⊤ from
      (adamsQ_isInternal hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl).submodule_iSup_eq_top]
    trivial
  have key : ∃ c : ℚ, u - c • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) ∈ Gq hX 1 ∧ rankQ x₀ u = c := by
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : ℕ => Wt hX q)
      (motive := fun u => ∃ c : ℚ, u - c • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) ∈ Gq hX 1 ∧ rankQ x₀ u = c) htop
      ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro q v hv
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
      · have hv0 : v ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {(1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X)} := by
          rw [← adamsQ_W_zero hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl]; exact hv
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hv0
        refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
        · rw [map_smul, map_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      · refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [zero_smul, sub_zero]; exact Wt_le_Gq hX hq hv
        · exact (adamsQ_pos_weight hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl hq hv).1
    · exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩
    · rintro a b ⟨c, hc, hrc⟩ ⟨d, hd, hrd⟩
      refine ⟨c + d, ?_, by rw [map_add, hrc, hrd]⟩
      have : a + b - (c + d) • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) = (a - c • 1) + (b - d • 1) := by
        rw [add_smul]; abel
      rw [this]; exact add_mem hc hd
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hr⟩ := key
  rw [hu] at hr
  rw [← hr, zero_smul, sub_zero] at hc
  exact hc

name: B3.QK_tmul
statement:
theorem QK_tmul (k : ℕ) (y : K0 X) :
    QK hX k ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] qOp X k y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [QK, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  rw [qOp, TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [mem_Ico] at hm
  rw [adamsQ_tmul, adamsRingHom_apply hX hm.1, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    zsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: B3.QK_apply_Wt
statement:
theorem QK_apply_Wt (k : ℕ) {q : ℕ} {u : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hu : u ∈ Wt hX q) :
    QK hX k u = ((dcoef k q : ℤ) : ℚ) • u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [QK, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  have h : ∀ m ∈ Ico 1 (k + 1), adamsQ hX m u = ((m : ℚ) ^ q) • u := fun m hm =>
    adamsQ_eigen_of_one_le hX hT x₀ (mem_Ico.1 hm).1 hu
  rw [sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => by rw [h m hm, smul_smul]), ← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  simp [dcoef]

name: B3.QK_mem_Gq
statement:
theorem QK_mem_Gq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {u : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hu : u ∈ Gq hX 1) :
    QK hX k u ∈ Gq hX k
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : {q : ℕ // 1 ≤ q} => Wt hX q.1)
    (motive := fun u => QK hX k u ∈ Gq hX k) hu ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ v hv
    rw [QK_apply_Wt hX hT x₀ k hv]
    by_cases hqk : q < k
    · rw [dcoef_eq_zero hq hqk]; simp
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Wt_le_Gq hX (not_lt.1 hqk) hv)
  · simp
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: B3.one_tmul_mem_Gq_one
statement:
theorem one_tmul_mem_Gq_one {y : K0 X} (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y ∈ Gq hX 1
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_Gq_one_of_rank_eq_zero hX hT x₀ ?_
  have := (mem_rankZeroIdeal.1 hy) x₀
  simp [rankQ, this]

name: B3.gammaOp_tmul_mem_Gq
statement:
theorem gammaOp_tmul_mem_Gq {y : K0 X} (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] gammaOp X n y ∈ Gq hX n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [Gq_zero hX hT x₀]; trivial
    · have hu := one_tmul_mem_Gq_one hX hT x₀ hy
      have hN := congrArg (fun z : K0 X => (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z) (gammaOp_newton X n y)
      simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_sum] at hN
      have hL : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ((n : K0 X) * gammaOp X n y) =
          (n : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] gammaOp X n y) := by
        rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
      rw [hL] at hN
      have hR : (∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (qOp X p.1 y * gammaOp X p.2 y)) ∈ Gq hX n := by
        refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p hp => ?_
        rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        rw [← tmul_mul_tmul']
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.1 with h0 | h0
        · rw [h0, qOp_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
        · have h1 : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] qOp X p.1 y ∈ Gq hX p.1 := by
            rw [← QK_tmul]; exact QK_mem_Gq hX hT x₀ h0 hu
          have h2 := ih p.2 (by omega)
          have := Gq_mul hX h1 h2
          rwa [hp] at this
      have hne : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
      have : (n : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] gammaOp X n y) ∈ Gq hX n := by rw [hN]; exact hR
      have h3 := Submodule.smul_mem _ ((n : ℚ)⁻¹) this
      rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul] at h3

name: B3.listProd_tmul_mem_Gq
statement:
theorem listProd_tmul_mem_Gq :
    ∀ l : List (ℕ × K0 X), (∀ pr ∈ l, pr.2 ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) →
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (l.map fun pr => gammaOp X pr.1 pr.2).prod ∈ Gq hX (l.map Prod.fst).sum
  | [], _ => by
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, List.sum_nil]
    rw [Gq_zero hX hT x₀]; trivial
  | (n, y) :: l, hl => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [← tmul_mul_tmul']
    exact Gq_mul hX (gammaOp_tmul_mem_Gq hX hT x₀ (hl (n, y) (by simp)) n)
      (listProd_tmul_mem_Gq l fun pr hpr => hl pr (by simp [hpr]))

include hT x₀ in

name: B3.FilGammaQ_le_Gq
statement: theorem FilGammaQ_le_Gq (p : ℕ) : FilGammaQ X p ≤ Gq hX p
proof:
:= by
  have hmain : ∀ y : K0 X, y ∈ FilGamma X p → (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y ∈ Gq hX p := by
    intro y hy
    change y ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X) (gammaMonomials X p) at hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hw, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact Gq_antitone hX hw (listProd_tmul_mem_Gq hX hT x₀ l hl)
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul r a _ ha =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, ← tmul_mul_tmul']
      exact Gq_mul_zero hX hT x₀ ha
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact hmain y hy

name: B3.decompose_eq_zero_of_mem_Gq
statement:
theorem decompose_eq_zero_of_mem_Gq {p q : ℕ} (hqp : q < p) {z : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X}
    (hz : z ∈ Gq hX p) : (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) z q : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : {q : ℕ // p ≤ q} => Wt hX q.1)
    (motive := fun z => (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) z q : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) = 0) hz ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨q', hq'⟩ v hv
    exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne (Wt hX) hv (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hqp hq'))
  · simp
  · intro a b ha hb
    simp [DirectSum.decompose_add, ha, hb]

name: B3.projQ_apply
statement:
lemma projQ_apply (q : ℕ) (z : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    projQ hX q z = (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) z q : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X)
proof: := rfl

name: B3.decompose_mem_FilGammaQ
statement:
theorem decompose_mem_FilGammaQ {y : K0 X} (hy : y ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) q : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) ∈ FilGammaQ X q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set u : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X := (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y with hu
  have hu1 : u ∈ Gq hX 1 := one_tmul_mem_Gq_one hX hT x₀ hy
  set a : ℕ → ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X := fun q' => (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u q' : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) with ha
  have ha_mem : ∀ q', a q' ∈ Wt hX q' := fun q' => (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u q').2
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := decompose_eq_zero_of_mem_Gq hX (by omega : 0 < 1) hu1
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Finset.exists_nat_subset_range (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u).support
  have haN : ∀ q', N ≤ q' → a q' = 0 := by
    intro q' hq'
    have hnot : q' ∉ (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u).support := fun h => by
      have := Finset.mem_range.1 (hN h); omega
    have h0 : DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u q' = 0 := by
      by_contra hne; exact hnot (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne)
    simp [ha, h0]
  have hsum : u = ∑ q' ∈ range N, a q' := by
    calc u = ∑ q' ∈ (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u).support,
          (DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u q' : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :=
          (DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (Wt hX) u).symm
      _ = ∑ q' ∈ range N, a q' := by
          refine Finset.sum_subset hN fun x _ hx => ?_
          have h0 : DirectSum.decompose (Wt hX) u x = 0 := by
            by_contra hne; exact hx (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne)
          simp [ha, h0]
  have hQ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → QK hX k u ∈ FilGammaQ X k := fun k hk => by
    rw [hu, QK_tmul]
    exact one_tmul_mem_FilGammaQ (qOp_mem_FilGamma X hy k hk)
  have hQsum : ∀ k, QK hX k u = ∑ q' ∈ range N, ((dcoef k q' : ℤ) : ℚ) • a q' := by
    intro k
    conv_lhs => rw [hsum]
    rw [map_sum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun q' _ => QK_apply_Wt hX hT x₀ k (ha_mem q')
  have claim : ∀ n q', 1 ≤ q' → N ≤ q' + n → a q' ∈ FilGammaQ X q' := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro q' _ h
      rw [haN q' (by omega)]; exact zero_mem _
    | succ n ih =>
      intro q' hq' hN'
      by_cases hqN : N ≤ q'
      · rw [haN q' hqN]; exact zero_mem _
      · have hqlt : q' < N := by omega
        have hmem : q' ∈ range N := mem_range.2 hqlt
        have hQ' := hQ q' hq'
        rw [hQsum q', ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hmem] at hQ'
        have hrest : ∑ q'' ∈ (range N).erase q', ((dcoef q' q'' : ℤ) : ℚ) • a q'' ∈
            FilGammaQ X q' := by
          refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun q'' hq'' => ?_
          rw [mem_erase, mem_range] at hq''
          obtain ⟨hne, hlt⟩ := hq''
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q'' q' with h1 | h1
          · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q'' with h0 | h0
            · rw [h0, ha0, smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
            · rw [dcoef_eq_zero h0 h1]; simp
          · have h2 : q' < q'' := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (Ne.symm hne)
            have h3 := ih q'' (by omega) (by omega)
            exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (FilGammaQ_antitone h2.le h3)
        have hdiag : ((dcoef q' q' : ℤ) : ℚ) • a q' ∈ FilGammaQ X q' := by
          have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hQ' hrest
          simpa using this
        have hd : ((dcoef q' q' : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast dcoef_self_ne_zero hq'
        have := Submodule.smul_mem _ (((dcoef q' q' : ℤ) : ℚ)⁻¹) hdiag
        rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd, one_smul] at this
  exact claim N q hq (by omega)

name: B3.mem_span_rankZero_of_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_span_rankZero_of_rank_eq_zero {w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hw : rankQ x₀ w = 0) :
    w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ((fun y : K0 X => (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) ''
      ((rankZeroIdeal X : Ideal (K0 X)) : Set (K0 X)))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X, ∃ w' ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ((fun y : K0 X => (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) ''
      ((rankZeroIdeal X : Ideal (K0 X)) : Set (K0 X))),
      w - w' = (rankQ x₀ w) • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) := by
    intro w
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by simp⟩
    | tmul c y =>
      have hz : y - ((rankAtRingHom x₀ y : ℤ) : K0 X) ∈ rankZeroIdeal X := by
        rw [mem_rankZeroIdeal]
        intro y'
        rw [map_sub, map_intCast, Int.cast_id,
          rankAtRingHom_eq_of_constantRankGenerators hX y y' x₀, sub_self]
      refine ⟨c • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (y - ((rankAtRingHom x₀ y : ℤ) : K0 X))),
        Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
      have e1 : c • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (y - ((rankAtRingHom x₀ y : ℤ) : K0 X))) =
          c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (y - ((rankAtRingHom x₀ y : ℤ) : K0 X)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      have e2 : c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ((rankAtRingHom x₀ y : ℤ) : K0 X) =
          (rankQ x₀ (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y)) • (1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) := by
        rw [rankQ, rhoQ_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
          mul_one, ← zsmul_one (rankAtRingHom x₀ y), TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
          TensorProduct.smul_tmul', zsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rw [e1, ← e2, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add, add_sub_cancel]
    | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha', h1⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', h2⟩ := hb
      refine ⟨a' + b', add_mem ha' hb', ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, add_smul, ← h1, ← h2]; abel
  obtain ⟨w', hw', h⟩ := key w
  rw [hw, zero_smul, sub_eq_zero] at h
  rw [h]; exact hw'

name: B3.Wt_le_FilGammaQ
statement: theorem Wt_le_FilGammaQ (q : ℕ) : Wt hX q ≤ FilGammaQ X q
proof:
:= by
  letI : GradedAlgebra (Wt hX) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
  · intro w hw
    have h1 : w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {(1 : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X)} := by
      rw [← adamsQ_W_zero hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl]; exact hw
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 h1
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have h2 : (1 : K0 X) ∈ FilGamma X 0 := by rw [FilGamma_zero]; trivial
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
    exact one_tmul_mem_FilGammaQ h2
  · intro w hw
    have hrank := (adamsQ_pos_weight hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl hq hw).1
    have hspan := mem_span_rankZero_of_rank_eq_zero hX x₀ hrank
    have hle : Submodule.span ℚ ((fun y : K0 X => (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) ''
        ((rankZeroIdeal X : Ideal (K0 X)) : Set (K0 X))) ≤
        (FilGammaQ X q).comap (projQ hX q) := by
      refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact decompose_mem_FilGammaQ hX hT x₀ hy hq
    have h3 := hle hspan
    have hp : projQ hX q w = w := DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same (Wt hX) hw
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, hp] at h3
    exact h3

name: B3.Gq_le_FilGammaQ
statement: theorem Gq_le_FilGammaQ (p : ℕ) : Gq hX p ≤ FilGammaQ X p
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun q => (Wt_le_FilGammaQ hX hT x₀ q.1).trans (FilGammaQ_antitone q.2)

name: B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq
statement: theorem FilGammaQ_eq_Gq (p : ℕ) : FilGammaQ X p = Gq hX p
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (FilGammaQ_le_Gq hX hT x₀ p) (Gq_le_FilGammaQ hX hT x₀ p)

name: B3.decompose_eq_zero_of_mem_FilGammaQ
proof:
:=
  decompose_eq_zero_of_mem_Gq hX hqm ((FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hX hT x₀ m) ▸ hz)

name: B3.FilGammaQ_mul_mem
statement:
theorem FilGammaQ_mul_mem {a b : ℕ} {u v : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hu : u ∈ FilGammaQ X a)
    (hv : v ∈ FilGammaQ X b) : u * v ∈ FilGammaQ X (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hX hT x₀] at hu hv ⊢
  exact Gq_mul hX hu hv

name: B3.Gq_eq_sup
statement: theorem Gq_eq_sup (p : ℕ) : Gq hX p = Wt hX p ⊔ Gq hX (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun q => ?_) (sup_le (Wt_le_Gq hX le_rfl) (Gq_antitone hX p.le_succ))
  rcases q.2.eq_or_lt with h | h
  · rw [← h]; exact le_sup_left
  · exact le_sup_of_le_right (Wt_le_Gq hX h)

name: B3.Wt_disjoint_Gq
statement: theorem Wt_disjoint_Gq (p : ℕ) : Disjoint (Wt hX p) (Gq hX (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hind : iSupIndep (W (adamsQ hX) 2) := iSupIndep_W 2 le_rfl
  have h := hind.disjoint_biSup (x := p) (y := {i | p + 1 ≤ i}) (by simp)
  refine h.mono_right ?_
  exact iSup_le fun q => le_iSup₂_of_le q.1 q.2 le_rfl

name: B3.FilGammaQ_eq_sup
statement:
theorem FilGammaQ_eq_sup (p : ℕ) :
    FilGammaQ X p = Wt hX p ⊔ FilGammaQ X (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hX hT x₀, FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hX hT x₀, Gq_eq_sup]

name: B3.adamsQ_sub_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hX hT x₀] at hy ⊢
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : {q : ℕ // p ≤ q} => Wt hX q.1)
    (motive := fun y => adamsQ hX m y - ((m : ℚ) ^ p) • y ∈ Gq hX (p + 1)) hy ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ v hv
    rw [adamsQ_eigen_of_one_le hX hT x₀ hm hv, ← sub_smul]
    rcases hq.eq_or_lt with h | h
    · subst h; simp
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Wt_le_Gq hX h hv)
  · simp
  · intro a b ha hb
    have : adamsQ hX m (a + b) - ((m : ℚ) ^ p) • (a + b) =
        (adamsQ hX m a - ((m : ℚ) ^ p) • a) + (adamsQ hX m b - ((m : ℚ) ^ p) • b) := by
      rw [map_add, smul_add]; abel
    rw [this]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: B3.adamsQ_mem_FilGammaQ
statement:
theorem adamsQ_mem_FilGammaQ {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (p : ℕ) {y : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X}
    (hy : y ∈ FilGammaQ X p) : adamsQ hX m y ∈ FilGammaQ X p
proof:
:= by
  have h := adamsQ_sub_smul_mem hX hT x₀ hm p hy
  have h2 : adamsQ hX m y = (adamsQ hX m y - ((m : ℚ) ^ p) • y) + ((m : ℚ) ^ p) • y := by abel
  rw [h2]
  exact add_mem (FilGammaQ_antitone p.le_succ h) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.leading_mem_ker
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.leading_mem_ker (z : Bˣ) (N : ℕ) (χ : B →+ G) (κ : A →+ G)
    (hvan : ∀ (a : A) (d : ℤ), -(N : ℤ) ≤ d → d < 0 →
      χ (((z ^ d : Bˣ) : B) * algebraMap A B a) = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ a : A, χ (algebraMap A B a) = κ a)
    (g : Fin (N + 1) → A) (hg : ∑ i, g i • ((z : B) ^ (i : ℕ)) = 0)
    (i₀ : Fin (N + 1)) (htop : ∀ j, i₀ < j → g j = 0) :
    κ (g i₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ((z ^ (-(i₀ : ℤ)) : Bˣ) : B) * ∑ i, g i • ((z : B) ^ (i : ℕ)) = 0 := by
    rw [hg, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum] at hmul
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1),
      ((z ^ (-(i₀ : ℤ)) : Bˣ) : B) * (g i • ((z : B) ^ (i : ℕ))) =
        ((z ^ ((i : ℤ) - i₀) : Bˣ) : B) * algebraMap A B (g i) := by
    intro i
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (algebraMap A B _),
      mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add]
    ring_nf
  simp only [hterm] at hmul
  have h := congrArg χ hmul
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i₀] at h
  · simpa [hdiag] using h
  · intro i _ hi
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hi with hlt | hgt
    · apply hvan
      · have := i.2; have := i₀.2; omega
      · have : (i : ℕ) < i₀ := hlt
        omega
    · rw [htop i hgt, map_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
  · intro h'; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i₀) h'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.linearIndependent
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.linearIndependent (z : Bˣ) (N : ℕ) (χ : B →+ G) (κ : A →+ G)
    (hκ : Function.Injective κ)
    (hvan : ∀ (a : A) (d : ℤ), -(N : ℤ) ≤ d → d < 0 →
      χ (((z ^ d : Bˣ) : B) * algebraMap A B a) = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ a : A, χ (algebraMap A B a) = κ a) :
    LinearIndependent A (fun i : Fin (N + 1) ↦ (z : B) ^ (i : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  classical
  let s : Finset (Fin (N + 1)) := Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ g i ≠ 0
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨i, by simp [s, hi]⟩
  let i₀ := s.max' hs
  have hi₀ : g i₀ ≠ 0 := by
    have := s.max'_mem hs
    simpa [s] using this
  have htop : ∀ j, i₀ < j → g j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    by_contra hjne
    have : j ≤ i₀ := s.le_max' j (by simp [s, hjne])
    exact absurd hj (not_lt.mpr this)
  have := EulerIndependence.leading_mem_ker z N χ κ hvan hdiag g hg i₀ htop
  exact hi₀ (hκ (by rw [this, map_zero]))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.tilde_isZero
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.tilde_isZero (M : ModuleCat.{u} S) [Subsingleton M] :
    IsZero ((tilde.functor S).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (tilde.functor S).IsLeftAdjoint := (tilde.adjunction (R := S)).isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : (tilde.functor S).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_isLeftAdjoint _
  exact Functor.map_isZero _ (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton M)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.isZero_of_quasicoherent
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.isZero_of_quasicoherent (N : (Spec S).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    [hN : Subsingleton (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)] : IsZero N
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) := hN
  exact (EulerIndependence.tilde_isZero _).of_iso (asIso N.fromTildeΓ).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.baseModule_H_succ_subsingleton
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.baseModule_H_succ_subsingleton (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (q : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex S n M
  haveI hHS : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj M) (q + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero S n d hd q)
  let eS :=
    coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv S n q M
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic S n d)
  haveI : Subsingleton ↑(C.homology (q + 1)) := eS.toEquiv.subsingleton
  let eRestrict :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedHomologyLinearEquiv
      R Q n d (q + 1)
  haveI : Subsingleton
      ↑((projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedSquareZeroCechComplex
        R Q n d).homology (q + 1)) := eRestrict.toEquiv.subsingleton
  haveI : Subsingleton
      ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).homology (q + 1)) :=
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalComparisonHomologyLinearEquiv
      R Q n d (q + 1)).toEquiv.subsingleton
  let P := projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R Q
  letI : P.IsFinitePresentation :=
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward_isFinitePresentation R Q n d
  letI : P.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  let e := coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv R n q P
    (quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic R n P)
  haveI : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj P) (q + 1)) :=
    e.symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  let e2 := projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardPositiveCohomologyLinearEquiv R Q n d q
  constructor
  intro x y
  have h := e2.symm.injective (a₁ := (0, x)) (a₂ := (0, y)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  exact congrArg Prod.snd h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.baseModule_H_zero_subsingleton
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.baseModule_H_zero_subsingleton (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex S n M
  haveI hHS : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj M) 0) :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg S n hn d hd
  let eS := coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv S n M
  haveI : Subsingleton ↑(C.homology 0) := eS.toEquiv.subsingleton
  let eRestrict :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedHomologyLinearEquiv R Q n d 0
  haveI : Subsingleton
      ↑((projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedSquareZeroCechComplex
        R Q n d).homology 0) := eRestrict.toEquiv.subsingleton
  haveI : Subsingleton
      ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).homology 0) :=
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalComparisonHomologyLinearEquiv
      R Q n d 0).toEquiv.subsingleton
  haveI : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)) 0) :=
    (coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv R n
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  let e2 := projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardZeroCohomologyLinearEquiv R Q n d
  constructor
  intro x y
  have h := e2.symm.injective (a₁ := (0, x)) (a₂ := (0, y)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  exact congrArg Prod.snd h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_succ_isZero
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_succ_isZero (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ) :
    IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hBC : ∀ g : R, IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n)
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)
        (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)) := fun g =>
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R Q g n d p
  have e := projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationIso R n
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p hBC
  haveI : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) (p + 1)) :=
    EulerIndependence.baseModule_H_succ_subsingleton R Q n d hd p
  have hz : IsZero (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p) :=
    EulerIndependence.tilde_isZero _
  exact hz.of_iso e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_zero_isZero
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_zero_isZero (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) 0)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R Q
  letI hMq : (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).IsQuasicoherent :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModule_isQuasicoherent R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d
  letI hNq : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n _
  haveI : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) 0) :=
    EulerIndependence.baseModule_H_zero_subsingleton R Q n hn d hd
  have e : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) 0 ≃ₗ[R]
      Γ(projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d, ⊤) :=
    projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n _
  haveI hsub : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d))) :=
    e.symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  have hN : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) :=
    EulerIndependence.isZero_of_quasicoherent _
  exact hN.of_iso
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.g0ClassOf_isZero
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.g0ClassOf_isZero {X : Scheme.{u}} (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E)
    (h : IsZero E) : g0ClassOf X E hE = 0
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) hE h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.euler_classOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.euler_classOf_eq_zero (L : EulerIndependence.System R n) (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L)
    (T : (space R n).Modules) (hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) T)
    (hz : ∀ i, IsZero
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) T i)) :
    EulerIndependence.euler R n L (k0ClassOf _ T hT) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [EulerIndependence.euler, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, k0ToG0_classOf,
    SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_classOf]
  unfold GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  have hi : IsZero (L.higher ⟨T, show IsCoherentLike _ T from hT.isFinitePresentation⟩ i) := by
    rw [hL]; exact hz i
  simp only [EulerIndependence.g0ClassOf_isZero _ _ hi, smul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n)
    (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L) (d : ℤ) (hd₁ : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (hd₂ : d < 0)
    (a : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    EulerIndependence.euler R n L (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d * EulerIndependence.pb R n a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let F : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
    ((EulerIndependence.euler R n L).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d))).comp
      (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAddMonoidHom
  have hF : F = 0 := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
    change EulerIndependence.euler R n L (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d *
      flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n) (k0ClassOf _ V hV)) = 0
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
    have hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) P :=
      pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (toSpec R n) V hV
    have hmul : projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d * k0ClassOf _ P hP =
        k0ClassOf _ (tensorSheaf _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) P)
          (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d) hP) :=
      k0ClassOf_mul (space R n) ⟨_, projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d⟩ ⟨P, hP⟩
    rw [hmul]
    apply EulerIndependence.euler_classOf_eq_zero R n L hL
    intro i
    haveI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV.isFinitePresentation
    let Q := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj V).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)
    haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation V
    haveI : Module.Finite R Q := inferInstance
    let e : tensorSheaf _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) P ≅
        projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d :=
      tensorSheafMapIso _ (Iso.refl _)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso (EulerIndependence.tildeIso V))
    refine IsZero.of_iso ?_
      ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
        (toSpec R n) i).mapIso e)
    rcases i with _ | p
    · exact EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_zero_isZero R Q n hn d hd₂
    · exact EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_succ_isZero R Q n d hd₁ p
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hF a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.unit_zpow
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.unit_zpow (d : ℤ) :
    (projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit R n 1) ^ d = projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit R n d
proof:
:= by
  induction d using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      apply Units.ext
      simp [projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit_val, projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [zpow_add_one, ih, ← projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit_add]
  | pred k ih =>
      rw [zpow_sub_one, ih, mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul, ← projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit_add]
      congr 1
      ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.chi_matrix_upper
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.chi_matrix_upper (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n)
    (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j < i) :
    EulerIndependence.chi R n L j (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-(i : ℤ))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero R n hn L hL ((j : ℤ) - i)
    (by have := i.2; omega) (by have : (j : ℕ) < i := hji; omega) 1
  rw [map_one, mul_one] at h
  simp only [EulerIndependence.chi, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft,
    projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul]
  rw [show (j : ℤ) + -(i : ℤ) = (j : ℤ) - i by ring]
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.chi_matrix_diag
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.chi_matrix_diag (L : EulerIndependence.System R n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    EulerIndependence.chi R n L i (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-(i : ℤ))) = EulerIndependence.euler R n L 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [EulerIndependence.chi, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft,
    projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul, add_neg_cancel, projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.leading_coefficient
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.leading_coefficient (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n)
    (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L) (g : Fin (n + 1) → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hg : ∑ i, EulerIndependence.pb R n (g i) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n 1 ^ (i : ℕ) = 0)
    (i₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (htop : ∀ j, i₀ < j → g j = 0) :
    EulerIndependence.euler R n L (EulerIndependence.pb R n (g i₀)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
  refine EulerIndependence.leading_mem_ker (projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit R n 1) n (EulerIndependence.euler R n L)
    ((EulerIndependence.euler R n L).comp (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAddMonoidHom) ?_ (fun _ => rfl) g hg i₀ htop
  intro a d hd₁ hd₂
  rw [EulerIndependence.unit_zpow]
  exact EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero R n hn L hL d hd₁ hd₂ a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.linearIndependent_powers
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.linearIndependent_powers (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n)
    (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L)
    (hκ : Function.Injective fun a ↦ EulerIndependence.euler R n L (EulerIndependence.pb R n a)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
    LinearIndependent (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
      (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ projectiveTwistingK0Class R n 1 ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
  letI := (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
  refine EulerIndependence.linearIndependent (projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit R n 1) n (EulerIndependence.euler R n L)
    ((EulerIndependence.euler R n L).comp (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAddMonoidHom) hκ ?_ (fun _ => rfl)
  intro a d hd₁ hd₂
  rw [EulerIndependence.unit_zpow]
  exact EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero R n hn L hL d hd₁ hd₂ a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.g0_tilde_biprod
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.g0_tilde_biprod (A B : ModuleCat.{u} S) [Module.FinitePresentation S A]
    [Module.FinitePresentation S B] [Module.FinitePresentation S (A ⊞ B : ModuleCat.{u} S)] :
    g0ClassOf _ (tilde (A ⊞ B)) (tilde_isFinitePresentation (A ⊞ B)) =
      g0ClassOf _ (tilde A) (tilde_isFinitePresentation A) +
        g0ClassOf _ (tilde B) (tilde_isFinitePresentation B)
proof:
:= by
  let T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} S) :=
    ShortComplex.mk (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B) (by simp)
  have hT : T.ShortExact := ⟨(ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).exact⟩
  letI : (tilde.functor S).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT => tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor S) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology _
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (tilde.functor S) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology _
  have hT' := hT.map_of_exact (tilde.functor S)
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle (Spec S).Modules
    (IsCoherentLike (Spec S))
    (tilde_isFinitePresentation A) (tilde_isFinitePresentation (A ⊞ B))
    (tilde_isFinitePresentation B) (T.map (tilde.functor S)).zero hT'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.g0T_congr
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.g0T_congr {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.FinitePresentation R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.FinitePresentation R N] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    EulerIndependence.g0T R M = EulerIndependence.g0T R N
proof:
:=
  SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso _ _ ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).mapIso e.toModuleIso)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.g0T_prod
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.g0T_prod (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.FinitePresentation R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.FinitePresentation R N] :
    EulerIndependence.g0T R (M × N) = EulerIndependence.g0T R M + EulerIndependence.g0T R N
proof:
:= by
  let A : ModuleCat.{u} (CommRingCat.of R) := ModuleCat.of R M
  let B : ModuleCat.{u} (CommRingCat.of R) := ModuleCat.of R N
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (A ⊞ B : ModuleCat.{u} (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A B).toLinearEquiv.symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (EulerIndependence.g0_tilde_biprod A B)
  exact SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso _ _
    ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).mapIso (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A B).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.g0T_HZero_baseModule
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.g0T_HZero_baseModule (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    [Module.FinitePresentation R
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0)]
    [Module.FinitePresentation R Q] :
    EulerIndependence.g0T R (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) =
      EulerIndependence.g0T R Q
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite R (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_finite_of_positive_dimension R n hn _
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0 ×
       CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (R × Q) := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  have h := EulerIndependence.g0T_congr R
    ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardZeroCohomologyLinearEquiv R Q n
      ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)).symm.trans (EulerIndependence.squareZeroHZeroEquiv R Q n))
  rw [EulerIndependence.g0T_prod, EulerIndependence.g0T_prod, EulerIndependence.g0T_congr R (EulerIndependence.HZeroEquiv R n)] at h
  exact add_left_cancel h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.euler_pb
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.euler_pb (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n) (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L)
    (a : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    EulerIndependence.euler R n L (EulerIndependence.pb R n a) = k0ToG0 _ a
proof:
:= by
  have hF : (EulerIndependence.euler R n L).comp (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAddMonoidHom = k0ToG0 _ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
    change EulerIndependence.euler R n L (flatPullbackK0RingHom (toSpec R n) (k0ClassOf _ V hV)) =
      k0ToG0 _ (k0ClassOf _ V hV)
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
    have hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) P :=
      pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (toSpec R n) V hV
    have hO := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    have hmul : k0ClassOf _ P hP =
        k0ClassOf _ (tensorSheaf _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) P)
          (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _ hO hP) := by
      have hm := k0ClassOf_mul (space R n) ⟨_, hO⟩ ⟨P, hP⟩
      change projectiveTwistingK0Class R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) * k0ClassOf _ P hP =
        k0ClassOf _ (tensorSheaf _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) P)
          (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _ hO hP) at hm
      have h0 : projectiveTwistingK0Class R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_zero]; exact projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero R n
      rw [h0, one_mul] at hm
      exact hm
    rw [hmul]
    haveI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV.isFinitePresentation
    let Q := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj V).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)
    haveI hQfp : Module.FinitePresentation R Q := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation V
    haveI : Module.Finite R Q := inferInstance
    let MQ := projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    let e : tensorSheaf _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) P ≅ MQ :=
      tensorSheafMapIso _ (Iso.refl _)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso (EulerIndependence.tildeIso V))
    let T := tensorSheaf _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) P
    have hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) T := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _ hO hP
    let eH : ∀ i, L.higher ⟨T, show IsCoherentLike _ T from hT.isFinitePresentation⟩ i ≅
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) MQ i :=
      fun i => eqToIso (hL _ i) ≪≫
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
          (toSpec R n) i).mapIso e
    simp only [EulerIndependence.euler, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, k0ToG0_classOf,
      SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_classOf]
    unfold GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
    · simp only [pow_zero, one_smul]
      
      let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj MQ
      letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (ModuleCat.of R Q) := hQfp
      letI : MQ.IsQuasicoherent :=
        projectiveTwistingBaseModule_isQuasicoherent R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) _
      letI : N.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n MQ
      let X := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj MQ) 0
      haveI : Module.Finite R X := projectiveTwistingBaseModuleZeroCohomology_finite R Q n hn _
      haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R X := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R X
      let eX : ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) ≃ₗ[R] X := by
        change Γ(MQ, ⊤) ≃ₗ[R] X
        exact (projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n MQ).symm
      let chain : L.higher ⟨T, show IsCoherentLike _ T from hT.isFinitePresentation⟩ 0 ≅
          tilde (ModuleCat.of R X) :=
        eH 0 ≪≫
          SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso
            (toSpec R n) MQ ≪≫ EulerIndependence.tildeIso N ≪≫
          (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).mapIso eX.toModuleIso
      have h1 := SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso (L.higher_mem _ 0)
        (tilde_isFinitePresentation (R := CommRingCat.of R) (ModuleCat.of R X)) chain
      have h2 : EulerIndependence.g0T R X = EulerIndependence.g0T R Q := EulerIndependence.g0T_HZero_baseModule R Q n hn
      have h3 : g0ClassOf _ V hV.isFinitePresentation = EulerIndependence.g0T R Q :=
        SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso _ _ (EulerIndependence.tildeIso V)
      exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3.symm)
    · intro i _ hi
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
      have hz : IsZero (L.higher ⟨T, show IsCoherentLike _ T from hT.isFinitePresentation⟩
          (p + 1)) :=
        (EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_succ_isZero R Q n _ (by omega) p).of_iso (eH (p + 1))
      have hc := EulerIndependence.g0ClassOf_isZero _ (L.higher_mem _ (p + 1)) hz
      exact (congrArg (fun x => ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p.succ) • x) hc).trans (smul_zero _)
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)) h
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hF a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.linearIndependent_powers_of_k0ToG0_injective
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.linearIndependent_powers_of_k0ToG0_injective (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n)
    (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))) :
    letI
proof:
:= (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
    LinearIndependent (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
      (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ projectiveTwistingK0Class R n 1 ^ (i : ℕ)) :=
  EulerIndependence.linearIndependent_powers R n hn L hL (fun a b h => hinj (by
    simpa only [EulerIndependence.euler_pb R n hn L hL] using h))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.leading_coefficient_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem EulerIndependence.leading_coefficient_k0ToG0 (hn : 0 < n) (L : EulerIndependence.System R n)
    (hL : EulerIndependence.IsAffineLocal R n L) (g : Fin (n + 1) → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hg : ∑ i, EulerIndependence.pb R n (g i) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n 1 ^ (i : ℕ) = 0)
    (i₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (htop : ∀ j, i₀ < j → g j = 0) :
    k0ToG0 _ (g i₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← EulerIndependence.euler_pb R n hn L hL]
  exact EulerIndependence.leading_coefficient R n hn L hL g hg i₀ htop

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerIndependence.chi_matrix_diag_eq_one

    LinearIndependent (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
