name: TopCat.Presheaf.subsingleton_stalk_of_isBasis
statement:
theorem subsingleton_stalk_of_isBasis {X : TopCat.{u}} (P : X.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {B : Set (Opens X)} (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hzero : ∀ U ∈ B, Subsingleton (P.obj (op U))) (x : X) :
    Subsingleton (P.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ u : P.stalk x, u = 0 := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, sU, rfl⟩ := P.exists_germ_eq u
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hWB, rfl⟩, hxW, hWU⟩ := hB.exists_subset_of_mem_open hxU U.2
    have hres : P.map (homOfLE hWU).op sU = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ (hzero W hWB) _ 0
    rw [← P.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hWU) x hxW sU]
    have h0 := congrArg (fun z => (ConcreteCategory.hom (P.germ W x hxW)) z) hres
    simp only [map_zero] at h0
    exact h0
  exact ⟨fun a b => by rw [key a, key b]⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_of_isBasis
statement:
theorem isZero_of_isBasis {X : TopCat.{u}} (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    {B : Set (Opens X)} (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hzero : ∀ U ∈ B, Subsingleton (F.obj.obj (op U))) : IsZero F
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero]
  intro x
  rw [AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.subsingleton_stalk_of_isBasis F.obj hB hzero x

name: TopCat.Presheaf.isZero_sheafify_of_isBasis
statement:
theorem isZero_sheafify_of_isBasis {X : TopCat.{u}} (P : X.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {B : Set (Opens X)} (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hzero : ∀ U ∈ B, Subsingleton (P.obj (op U))) :
    IsZero ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero]
  intro x
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat.{u} P
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
    (CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) P))).symm
  rw [AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.subsingleton_stalk_of_isBasis P hB hzero x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.shiftedHom_framed
statement:
lemma shiftedHom_framed
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {M : Type w} [AddMonoid M] [HasShift C M]
    {X₀ X₁ X₂ Y₀ Y₁ Y₂ : C} {a : M}
    (p₂ : X₀ ⟶ X₁) (p₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (f : ShiftedHom X₂ Y₀ a)
    (q₁ : Y₀ ⟶ Y₁) (q₂ : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂) :
    (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₂).comp
        ((ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₁).comp
          (f.comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₁) (zero_add a)) (add_zero a) |>.comp
            (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₂) (zero_add a))
        (add_zero a) =
      (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl (p₂ ≫ p₁)).comp
        (f.comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl (q₁ ≫ q₂)) (zero_add a)) (add_zero a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShiftedHom.comp_assoc _ _ _ _ (zero_add a) (by simp),
    ← ShiftedHom.comp_assoc _ _ _ (add_zero 0) (add_zero a) (by simp),
    ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp_mk₀,
    ShiftedHom.comp_assoc f (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₁)
      (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₂) (zero_add a) (zero_add 0) (by simp),
    ShiftedHom.mk₀_comp_mk₀]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.shiftedHom_map_framed
statement:
lemma shiftedHom_map_framed
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D]
    {M : Type w} [AddMonoid M] [HasShift C M] [HasShift D M]
    (G : C ⥤ D) [G.CommShift M]
    {X₀ X₁ Y₀ Y₁ : C} {A B : D} {a : M}
    (p₂ : A ⟶ G.obj X₀) (p₁ : X₀ ⟶ X₁)
    (f : ShiftedHom X₁ Y₀ a) (q₁ : Y₀ ⟶ Y₁)
    (q₂ : G.obj Y₁ ⟶ B) :
    (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₂).comp
        ((((ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₁).comp
          (f.comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₁) (zero_add a)) (add_zero a)).map G).comp
            (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₂) (zero_add a))
        (add_zero a) =
      (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl (p₂ ≫ G.map p₁)).comp
        ((f.map G).comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl (G.map q₁ ≫ q₂)) (zero_add a))
        (add_zero a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShiftedHom.map_comp, ShiftedHom.map_comp, ShiftedHom.map_mk₀,
    ShiftedHom.map_mk₀]
  exact shiftedHom_framed p₂ (G.map p₁) (f.map G) (G.map q₁) q₂

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_comp_functor
statement:
lemma LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_comp_functor
    {C D E : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Category.{u} E]
    {M : Type w} [AddMonoid M] [HasShift C M] [HasShift D M] [HasShift E M]
    {W₁ : MorphismProperty C} {W₂ : MorphismProperty D} {W₃ : MorphismProperty E}
    [W₁.IsCompatibleWithShift M] [W₂.IsCompatibleWithShift M]
    [W₃.IsCompatibleWithShift M]
    (Phi : LocalizerMorphism W₁ W₂) (Psi : LocalizerMorphism W₂ W₃)
    [Phi.functor.CommShift M] [Psi.functor.CommShift M]
    {X Y : C} {m : M}
    [h₁ : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₁ M X Y]
    [h₂X : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M (Phi.functor.obj X) (Phi.functor.obj X)]
    [h₂ : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M (Phi.functor.obj X) (Phi.functor.obj Y)]
    [h₂Y : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M (Phi.functor.obj Y) (Phi.functor.obj Y)]
    [h₃X : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₃ M
      (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj X)) (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj X))]
    [h₃ : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₃ M
      (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj X)) (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y))]
    [h₃Y : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₃ M
      (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y)) (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y))]
    (f : SmallShiftedHom W₁ X Y m) :
    letI : (Phi.comp Psi).functor.CommShift M
proof:
:=
      localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
    Psi.smallShiftedHomMap (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
        (Phi.smallShiftedHomMap (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) f) =
      (Phi.comp Psi).smallShiftedHomMap (localizerMorphismCompObjIso Phi Psi X)
        (localizerMorphismCompObjIso Phi Psi Y) f := by
  letI : (Phi.comp Psi).functor.CommShift M :=
    localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
  let Omega := Phi.comp Psi
  letI : Omega.functor.CommShift M := localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
  apply (SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₃ W₃.Q).injective
  let G₁ := Phi.localizedFunctor W₁.Q W₂.Q
  let G₂ := Psi.localizedFunctor W₂.Q W₃.Q
  let e₁ := CatCommSq.iso Phi.functor W₁.Q W₂.Q G₁
  let e₂ := CatCommSq.iso Psi.functor W₂.Q W₃.Q G₂
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift e₁.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift e₂.hom M := inferInstance
  rw [Psi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₂.Q W₃.Q (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) G₂ e₂,
    Phi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₂.Q (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) G₁ e₁]
  dsimp only [Functor.comp_obj]
  let a₁ : (Phi.functor ⋙ Psi.functor) ⋙ W₃.Q ≅
      Phi.functor ⋙ (Psi.functor ⋙ W₃.Q) :=
    Phi.functor.associator Psi.functor W₃.Q
  let a₂ : Phi.functor ⋙ (Psi.functor ⋙ W₃.Q) ≅
      Phi.functor ⋙ (W₂.Q ⋙ G₂) := Phi.functor.isoWhiskerLeft e₂
  let a₃ : Phi.functor ⋙ (W₂.Q ⋙ G₂) ≅
      (Phi.functor ⋙ W₂.Q) ⋙ G₂ := (Phi.functor.associator W₂.Q G₂).symm
  let a₄ : (Phi.functor ⋙ W₂.Q) ⋙ G₂ ≅
      (W₁.Q ⋙ G₁) ⋙ G₂ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight e₁ G₂
  let a₅ : (W₁.Q ⋙ G₁) ⋙ G₂ ≅ W₁.Q ⋙ (G₁ ⋙ G₂) :=
    W₁.Q.associator G₁ G₂
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₁.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₂.hom M := by
    dsimp [a₂]
    infer_instance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₃.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₄.hom M := by
    dsimp [a₄]
    infer_instance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₅.hom M := inferInstance
  let e₁₂ := a₁ ≪≫ a₂
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift e₁₂.hom M := by
    dsimp [e₁₂]
    infer_instance
  let e₁₂₃ := e₁₂ ≪≫ a₃
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift e₁₂₃.hom M := by
    dsimp [e₁₂₃]
    infer_instance
  let e₁₂₃₄ := e₁₂₃ ≪≫ a₄
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift e₁₂₃₄.hom M := by
    dsimp [e₁₂₃₄]
    infer_instance
  let e : Omega.functor ⋙ W₃.Q ≅ W₁.Q ⋙ (G₁ ⋙ G₂) := e₁₂₃₄ ≪≫ a₅
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift e.hom M := by
    dsimp [e]
    infer_instance
  have hcomp := Omega.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₃.Q
    (localizerMorphismCompObjIso Phi Psi X) (localizerMorphismCompObjIso Phi Psi Y)
    (G₁ ⋙ G₂) e f
  let p₂ : W₃.Q.obj (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj X)) ⟶
      G₂.obj (W₂.Q.obj (Phi.functor.obj X)) :=
    W₃.Q.map (Iso.refl (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj X))).inv ≫
      e₂.hom.app (Phi.functor.obj X)
  let p₁ : W₂.Q.obj (Phi.functor.obj X) ⟶ G₁.obj (W₁.Q.obj X) :=
    W₂.Q.map (Iso.refl (Phi.functor.obj X)).inv ≫ e₁.hom.app X
  let q₁ : G₁.obj (W₁.Q.obj Y) ⟶ W₂.Q.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y) :=
    e₁.inv.app Y ≫ W₂.Q.map (Iso.refl (Phi.functor.obj Y)).hom
  let q₂ : G₂.obj (W₂.Q.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y)) ⟶
      W₃.Q.obj (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y)) :=
    e₂.inv.app (Phi.functor.obj Y) ≫
      W₃.Q.map (Iso.refl (Psi.functor.obj (Phi.functor.obj Y))).hom
  let a := SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₁ W₁.Q f
  change
    (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₂).comp
        ((((ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₁).comp
          ((a.map G₁).comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₁) (zero_add m))
            (add_zero m)).map G₂).comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₂) (zero_add m))
        (add_zero m) = _
  refine (shiftedHom_map_framed G₂ p₂ p₁ (a.map G₁) q₁ q₂).trans ?_
  rw [← a.comp_map G₁ G₂]
  have hp : p₂ ≫ G₂.map p₁ =
      e₂.hom.app (Phi.functor.obj X) ≫ G₂.map (e₁.hom.app X) := by
    dsimp [p₂, p₁]
    simp
  have hq : G₂.map q₁ ≫ q₂ =
      G₂.map (e₁.inv.app Y) ≫ e₂.inv.app (Phi.functor.obj Y) := by
    dsimp [q₁, q₂]
    simp
  rw [hp, hq]
  simpa [localizerMorphismCompObjIso, Omega, a, e, e₁₂₃₄, e₁₂₃,
    e₁₂, a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅]
    using hcomp.symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_comp_functor_of_isos
statement:
lemma LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_comp_functor_of_isos
    {C D E : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Category.{u} E]
    {M : Type w} [AddMonoid M] [HasShift C M] [HasShift D M] [HasShift E M]
    {W₁ : MorphismProperty C} {W₂ : MorphismProperty D} {W₃ : MorphismProperty E}
    [W₁.IsCompatibleWithShift M] [W₂.IsCompatibleWithShift M]
    [W₃.IsCompatibleWithShift M]
    (Phi : LocalizerMorphism W₁ W₂) (Psi : LocalizerMorphism W₂ W₃)
    [Phi.functor.CommShift M] [Psi.functor.CommShift M]
    {X₁ Y₁ : C} {X₂ Y₂ : D} {X₃ Y₃ : E} {m : M}
    [h₁ : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₁ M X₁ Y₁]
    [h₂X : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ X₂]
    [h₂ : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ Y₂]
    [h₂Y : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M Y₂ Y₂]
    [h₃X : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₃ M X₃ X₃]
    [h₃ : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₃ M X₃ Y₃]
    [h₃Y : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₃ M Y₃ Y₃]
    (e₁X : Phi.functor.obj X₁ ≅ X₂) (e₁Y : Phi.functor.obj Y₁ ≅ Y₂)
    (e₂X : Psi.functor.obj X₂ ≅ X₃) (e₂Y : Psi.functor.obj Y₂ ≅ Y₃)
    (f : SmallShiftedHom W₁ X₁ Y₁ m) :
    letI : (Phi.comp Psi).functor.CommShift M
proof:
:=
      localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
    Psi.smallShiftedHomMap e₂X e₂Y (Phi.smallShiftedHomMap e₁X e₁Y f) =
      (Phi.comp Psi).smallShiftedHomMap
        (localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi e₁X e₂X)
        (localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi e₁Y e₂Y) f := by
  letI : (Phi.comp Psi).functor.CommShift M :=
    localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
  let Omega := Phi.comp Psi
  letI : Omega.functor.CommShift M := localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
  apply (SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₃ W₃.Q).injective
  let G₁ := Phi.localizedFunctor W₁.Q W₂.Q
  let G₂ := Psi.localizedFunctor W₂.Q W₃.Q
  let c₁ := CatCommSq.iso Phi.functor W₁.Q W₂.Q G₁
  let c₂ := CatCommSq.iso Psi.functor W₂.Q W₃.Q G₂
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c₁.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c₂.hom M := inferInstance
  rw [Psi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₂.Q W₃.Q e₂X e₂Y G₂ c₂,
    Phi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₂.Q e₁X e₁Y G₁ c₁]
  dsimp only [Functor.comp_obj]
  let a₁ : (Phi.functor ⋙ Psi.functor) ⋙ W₃.Q ≅
      Phi.functor ⋙ (Psi.functor ⋙ W₃.Q) :=
    Phi.functor.associator Psi.functor W₃.Q
  let a₂ : Phi.functor ⋙ (Psi.functor ⋙ W₃.Q) ≅
      Phi.functor ⋙ (W₂.Q ⋙ G₂) := Phi.functor.isoWhiskerLeft c₂
  let a₃ : Phi.functor ⋙ (W₂.Q ⋙ G₂) ≅
      (Phi.functor ⋙ W₂.Q) ⋙ G₂ := (Phi.functor.associator W₂.Q G₂).symm
  let a₄ : (Phi.functor ⋙ W₂.Q) ⋙ G₂ ≅
      (W₁.Q ⋙ G₁) ⋙ G₂ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight c₁ G₂
  let a₅ : (W₁.Q ⋙ G₁) ⋙ G₂ ≅ W₁.Q ⋙ (G₁ ⋙ G₂) :=
    W₁.Q.associator G₁ G₂
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₁.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₂.hom M := by
    dsimp [a₂]
    infer_instance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₃.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₄.hom M := by
    dsimp [a₄]
    infer_instance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift a₅.hom M := inferInstance
  let c₁₂ := a₁ ≪≫ a₂
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c₁₂.hom M := by
    dsimp [c₁₂]
    infer_instance
  let c₁₂₃ := c₁₂ ≪≫ a₃
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c₁₂₃.hom M := by
    dsimp [c₁₂₃]
    infer_instance
  let c₁₂₃₄ := c₁₂₃ ≪≫ a₄
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c₁₂₃₄.hom M := by
    dsimp [c₁₂₃₄]
    infer_instance
  let c : Omega.functor ⋙ W₃.Q ≅ W₁.Q ⋙ (G₁ ⋙ G₂) := c₁₂₃₄ ≪≫ a₅
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c.hom M := by
    dsimp [c]
    infer_instance
  have hcomp := Omega.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₃.Q
    (localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi e₁X e₂X)
    (localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi e₁Y e₂Y) (G₁ ⋙ G₂) c f
  let p₂ : W₃.Q.obj X₃ ⟶ G₂.obj (W₂.Q.obj X₂) :=
    W₃.Q.map e₂X.inv ≫ c₂.hom.app X₂
  let p₁ : W₂.Q.obj X₂ ⟶ G₁.obj (W₁.Q.obj X₁) :=
    W₂.Q.map e₁X.inv ≫ c₁.hom.app X₁
  let q₁ : G₁.obj (W₁.Q.obj Y₁) ⟶ W₂.Q.obj Y₂ :=
    c₁.inv.app Y₁ ≫ W₂.Q.map e₁Y.hom
  let q₂ : G₂.obj (W₂.Q.obj Y₂) ⟶ W₃.Q.obj Y₃ :=
    c₂.inv.app Y₂ ≫ W₃.Q.map e₂Y.hom
  let z := SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₁ W₁.Q f
  change
    (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₂).comp
        ((((ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl p₁).comp
          ((z.map G₁).comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₁) (zero_add m))
            (add_zero m)).map G₂).comp (ShiftedHom.mk₀ 0 rfl q₂) (zero_add m))
        (add_zero m) = _
  refine (shiftedHom_map_framed G₂ p₂ p₁ (z.map G₁) q₁ q₂).trans ?_
  rw [← z.comp_map G₁ G₂]
  have hp : p₂ ≫ G₂.map p₁ =
      W₃.Q.map e₂X.inv ≫ W₃.Q.map (Psi.functor.map e₁X.inv) ≫
        c₂.hom.app (Phi.functor.obj X₁) ≫ G₂.map (c₁.hom.app X₁) := by
    dsimp [p₂, p₁]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    have hnat : c₂.hom.app X₂ ≫ G₂.map (W₂.Q.map e₁X.inv) =
        W₃.Q.map (Psi.functor.map e₁X.inv) ≫
          c₂.hom.app (Phi.functor.obj X₁) := by
      simpa only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] using
        (c₂.hom.naturality e₁X.inv).symm
    slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [hnat]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hq : G₂.map q₁ ≫ q₂ =
      G₂.map (c₁.inv.app Y₁) ≫ c₂.inv.app (Phi.functor.obj Y₁) ≫
        W₃.Q.map (Psi.functor.map e₁Y.hom) ≫ W₃.Q.map e₂Y.hom := by
    dsimp [q₁, q₂]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    have hnat : G₂.map (W₂.Q.map e₁Y.hom) ≫ c₂.inv.app Y₂ =
        c₂.inv.app (Phi.functor.obj Y₁) ≫
          W₃.Q.map (Psi.functor.map e₁Y.hom) := by
      simpa only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] using
        c₂.inv.naturality e₁Y.hom
    slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [hnat]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hp, hq]
  simpa [localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso, localizerMorphismCompObjIso, Omega, z,
    c, c₁₂₃₄, c₁₂₃, c₁₂, a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅]
    using hcomp.symm

name: M1.length_eq_height_of_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem length_eq_height_of_isWeaklyRegular {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (rs : List A) (hP : Ideal.ofList rs = P)
    (hreg : IsWeaklyRegular A rs) : (rs.length : ℕ∞) = P.height
proof:
:= by
  let B := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ P := fun r hr => by
    rw [← hP]; exact Ideal.subset_span hr
  have hR : IsRegular B (rs.map (algebraMap A B)) :=
    hreg.isRegular_of_isLocalization_of_mem B P hmem
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular
    (rs.map (algebraMap A B)) hR
  have hI : Ideal.ofList (rs.map (algebraMap A B)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_ofList, hP]
    exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal P B
  have h0 : ringKrullDim (B ⧸ Ideal.ofList (rs.map (algebraMap A B))) = 0 := by
    rw [hI]
    exact ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField
      (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient _ |>.mp inferInstance)
  rw [h0, zero_add, List.length_map,
    IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P B] at hdim
  exact_mod_cast hdim

name: STEPW.flagTower_q_surjective
statement:
theorem flagTower_q_surjective : ∀ (r : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r), Function.Surjective (flagTower r E hE).q
  | 0, _, _, _ => fun x ↦ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  | r + 1, X, E, hE => by
    have hC
proof:
:= (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose_spec
    have hpos := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card
      hC (Nat.succ_pos r)
    have ih := flagTower_q_surjective r _
      ((exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE)
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := AffineFrameCover.toBase_surjective _ hpos x
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ih y
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩

name: STEPW.hasTower_generic
statement:
theorem hasTower_generic {R : Type u1} [CommRing R] {T : Type w} [CommRing T] {r : ℕ}
    (ψ : ℕ → R →+* R) (ρ : R →+* ℤ) (q : R →+* T) (hq : Function.Injective q)
    (φ : ℕ → T →+* T) (ρT : T →+* ℤ) (hcomm : ∀ j x, q (ψ j x) = φ j (q x))
    (hρ : ∀ x, ρT (q x) = ρ x) (c : Fin r → T) (hnil : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (c i - 1))
    (hρc : ∀ i, ρT (c i) = 1) (hφc : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → ∀ i, φ j (c i) = c i ^ j)
    (x : R) (hx : q x = ∑ i, c i) : HasTower.{u1, w} ψ ρ x
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin r → T := fun i ↦ c i - 1
  have hρa : ∀ i, ρT (a i) = 0 := fun i ↦ by simp [a, hρc i]
  have hψa : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → ∀ i, φ j (a i) = (1 + a i) ^ j - 1 := by
    intro j hj i
    simp only [a, map_sub, map_one, hφc j hj i, add_sub_cancel]
  refine ⟨T, inferInstance, q, φ, ρT, F a, Classical.choose (F_bot hnil), hq, hcomm, hρ,
    ⟨F_anti a, Classical.choose_spec (F_bot hnil), fun t ht ↦ F_one_nil hnil ht,
      fun t ht ↦ F_zero_dec ht, fun t ht ↦ F_rank _ hρa ht,
      fun j hj m t ht ↦ F_eig (φ j) j (hψa j hj) ht⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [mem_F_zero, hx]
  exact Subring.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ by
    have : c i = a i + 1 := (sub_add_cancel (c i) 1).symm
    rw [this]
    exact Subring.add_mem _ (Subring.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩) (Subring.one_mem _)

name: STEPW.hasTower_classOf
statement:
theorem hasTower_classOf [IsNoetherian X] (hX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hT : TowerHypSTEPW X)
    (x₀ : X) (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    HasTower.{u + 1, u + 1} (adamsRingHom hX) (rankAtRingHom x₀)
      (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hY, hnil⟩ := hT E r hE
  let T := flagTower r E hE
  obtain ⟨y₀, -⟩ := flagTower_q_surjective r E hE x₀
  haveI : IsNoetherian T.Y := isNoetherian_of_isProper T.q
  let q : K0 X →+* K0 T.Y := flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q
  have hq : Function.Injective q := by
    have h := T.injective pbInjectiveHyp inferInstance
    intro x y hxy
    exact h (by rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]; exact hxy)
  have hφ : ∀ (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E),
      q (k0ClassOf X E hE) = k0ClassOf T.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.q).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global T.q E hE) := by
    intro E hE
    simp only [q, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  have hcomm : ∀ j x, q (adamsRingHom hX j x) = adamsRingHom hY j (q x) := by
    intro j x
    cases j with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k =>
      rw [adamsRingHom_apply hX (by omega), adamsRingHom_apply hY (by omega)]
      exact adams_pullback T.q q hφ (k + 1) x
  have hρ : ∀ x, rankAtRingHom y₀ (q x) = rankAtRingHom x₀ x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : q x = pullbackK0RingHom T.q x := by
      simp only [q, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_apply,
        pullbackK0_eq_flatPullbackK0]
    rw [h1, rankAtRingHom_pullbackK0RingHom]
    exact rankAtRingHom_eq_of_constantRankGenerators hX x _ _
  refine hasTower_generic (adamsRingHom hX) (rankAtRingHom x₀) q hq (adamsRingHom hY)
    (rankAtRingHom y₀) hcomm hρ
    (fun i ↦ k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (fun i ↦ (nil_iff _ _).1 (hnil i)) ?_ ?_ _ ?_
  · intro i
    simp only [rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank (T.rankOne i)]
    simp
  · intro j hj i
    exact adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hY (T.L i) (T.rankOne i) (by omega)
  · simp only [q, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    exact T.pullback_class_eq_sum hE.isFiniteLocallyFree

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction_id (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    (x : (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheaf f M i).obj (op V)) :
    affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f M i (le_refl V) x = x
proof:
:= by
  let P := affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheaf f M i
  have hmor : (homOfLE (le_refl V)).op = 𝟙 (op V) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change P.map (homOfLE (le_refl V)).op x = x
  rw [hmor, P.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (i : ℕ) {U V W : Y.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W)
    (x : (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheaf f M i).obj (op W)) :
    affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f M i hUV
        (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f M i hVW x) =
      affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f M i (hUV.trans hVW) x
proof:
:= by
  let P := affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheaf f M i
  have hmor : (homOfLE (hUV.trans hVW)).op =
      (homOfLE hVW).op ≫ (homOfLE hUV).op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change P.map (homOfLE hUV).op (P.map (homOfLE hVW).op x) =
    P.map (homOfLE (hUV.trans hVW)).op x
  rw [hmor, Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction_naturality
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (i : ℕ) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheaf f M i).obj (op W)) :
    affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f N i h
        ((affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafMap f φ i).app (op W) x) =
      (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafMap f φ i).app (op V)
        (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f M i h x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (congr_arg (fun k => k x)
    (congr_arg AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom
      ((affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafMap f φ i).naturality (homOfLE h).op))).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.addEquiv₀_precomp
statement:
lemma addEquiv₀_precomp {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Abelian C]
    [HasExt.{u} C] {A B D : C} (p : A ⟶ B) (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext B D 0) :
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ p).comp x (zero_add 0)) =
      p ≫ CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x
proof:
:= by
  apply (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective A D).injective
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply,
    ← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafZeroAddEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafZeroAddEquiv_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheaf f M 0).obj (op W)) :
    affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafZeroAddEquiv f M V
        (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafRestriction f M 0 h x) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (f.preimage_mono h)).op
        (affineLocalCohomologyAddPresheafZeroAddEquiv f M W x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M
  let j : f ⁻¹ᵁ V ⟶ f ⁻¹ᵁ W := homOfLE (f.preimage_mono h)
  change affineLocalFreeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) F
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
          (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap j)).comp x (zero_add 0))) =
    F.obj.map j.op (affineLocalFreeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) F
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))
  rw [addEquiv₀_precomp]
  exact TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv_naturality j F
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x)

statement: theorem y_mem (j : Fin (n + 1)) : y j ∈ cK y
proof: := Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: BlowupRegularAR12.eL_injective
statement: theorem eL_injective (hr : IsRegular (y 0)) : Function.Injective (eL y)
proof:
:=
  chartLocalizationMap_injective (cK y) (RingHom.id R) (rK y) (fun _ _ h => h) hr

name: BlowupRegularAR12.aL_mul
statement:
theorem aL_mul (k : Fin n) :
    aL y k * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (y 0)) (y 0) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (y 0)) (y k.succ)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.mk'_spec (Localization.Away (y 0)) (y k.succ)
    (⟨y 0, 1, pow_one _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0))

name: BlowupRegularAR12.eL_ratio
statement:
theorem eL_ratio (k : Fin n) :
    eL y (ratioElement (cK y) (rK y) ⟨y k.succ, y_mem y _⟩) = aL y k
proof:
:= by
  have h := chartLocalizationMap_mk (cK y) (RingHom.id R) (rK y) 1
    (generator (cK y) ⟨y k.succ, y_mem y _⟩) (generator_mem_grade_one _ _)
  rw [reesEval_generator] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [aL, Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (pow_one _)

:= by
  simp [thetaL]

proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaL]

name: BlowupRegularAR12.algebraMap_mem_range
statement: theorem algebraMap_mem_range (c : R) : algebraMap R LL c ∈ (thetaL y).range
proof:
:=
  ⟨MvPolynomial.C c, thetaL_C y c⟩

name: BlowupRegularAR12.mk'_mem_range
statement:
theorem mk'_mem_range {b : R} (hb : b ∈ cK y) :
    IsLocalization.mk' LL b (⟨y 0, 1, pow_one _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) ∈ (thetaL y).range
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · rw [IsLocalization.mk'_self LL (x := y 0) (Submonoid.mem_powers _)]
      exact (thetaL y).range.one_mem
    · exact ⟨MvPolynomial.X k, thetaL_X y k⟩
  | zero => simp only [IsLocalization.mk'_zero]; exact (thetaL y).range.zero_mem
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one] at ha hb ⊢
    rw [map_add, add_mul]
    exact (thetaL y).range.add_mem ha hb
  | smul c a _ ha =>
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one] at ha ⊢
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact (thetaL y).range.mul_mem (algebraMap_mem_range y c) ha

name: BlowupRegularAR12.mk'_pow_mem_range
statement:
theorem mk'_pow_mem_range (m : ℕ) : ∀ {c : R}, c ∈ cK y ^ m →
    IsLocalization.mk' LL c (⟨y 0 ^ m, m, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) ∈ (thetaL y).range
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro c _
    have : (⟨y 0 ^ 0, 0, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) = 1 := Subtype.ext (pow_zero _)
    rw [this, IsLocalization.mk'_one]
    exact algebraMap_mem_range y c
  | succ m ih =>
    intro c hc
    rw [pow_succ] at hc
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hc ?_ ?_
    · intro a ha b hb
      have : IsLocalization.mk' LL (a * b) (⟨y 0 ^ (m + 1), m + 1, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) =
          IsLocalization.mk' LL a (⟨y 0 ^ m, m, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) *
            IsLocalization.mk' LL b (⟨y 0, 1, pow_one _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) := by
        rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_mul]
        congr 1
        exact Subtype.ext (pow_succ _ _)
      rw [this]
      exact (thetaL y).range.mul_mem (ih ha) (mk'_mem_range y hb)
    · intro a b ha hb
      rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one] at ha hb ⊢
      rw [map_add, add_mul]
      exact (thetaL y).range.add_mem ha hb

name: BlowupRegularAR12.eL_mem_range
statement: theorem eL_mem_range (z : Chart y) : eL y z ∈ (thetaL y).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grade (cK y))
    (generator_mem_grade_one _ (rK y)) z
  have ha' : a ∈ grade (cK y) m := by
    convert ha using 1
    simp
  have h := chartLocalizationMap_mk (cK y) (RingHom.id R) (rK y) m a ha'
  have hae : reesEval (cK y) (RingHom.id R) a = (a : R[X]).coeff m := by
    change Polynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id R) 1 (a : R[X]) = _
    rw [show (a : R[X]) = monomial m ((a : R[X]).coeff m) from ha']
    simp
  rw [hae] at h
  have hc : (a : R[X]).coeff m ∈ cK y ^ m := (mem_reesAlgebra_iff _ _).mp a.property m
  have h2 := mk'_pow_mem_range y m hc
  change chartLocalizationMap (cK y) (RingHom.id R) (rK y) _ ∈ _
  rw [h]
  have e : (Localization.mk ((a : R[X]).coeff m) ⟨(RingHom.id R) (rK y).1 ^ m, m, rfl⟩ :
      Localization.Away (y 0)) =
      IsLocalization.mk' LL ((a : R[X]).coeff m) (⟨y 0 ^ m, m, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0)) :=
    congrFun (congrFun Localization.mk_eq_mk' _) _
  exact e ▸ h2

name: BlowupRegularAR12.thetaL_range_le_eL_range
statement: theorem thetaL_range_le_eL_range : (thetaL y).range ≤ (eL y).range
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
    rw [thetaL_C]
    refine ⟨baseElement (cK y) (rK y) a, ?_⟩
    exact chartLocalizationMap_id_baseElement (cK y) (rK y) a
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact (eL y).range.add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p k hp =>
    rw [map_mul, thetaL_X]
    exact (eL y).range.mul_mem hp ⟨_, eL_ratio y k⟩

name: BlowupRegularAR12.eL_range_eq
statement: theorem eL_range_eq : (eL y).range = (thetaL y).range
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩; exact eL_mem_range y z) (thetaL_range_le_eL_range y)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.degree_cons
statement: theorem degree_cons (e : ℕ) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) : (Finsupp.cons e α).degree = e + α.degree
proof:
:= by
  simp [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Finsupp.cons_zero, Finsupp.cons_succ]

name: BlowupRegularAR12.key_monomial
statement:
theorem key_monomial (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (c : R) (e : ℕ) :
    algebraMap R LL (MvPolynomial.eval y (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.cons e α) c)) =
      (algebraMap R LL (y 0)) ^ (e + α.degree) * thetaL y (MvPolynomial.monomial α c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_monomial, thetaL, MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial,
    Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (by simp), Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (by simp), Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [Finsupp.cons_zero, Finsupp.cons_succ, map_mul, map_prod, map_pow]
  have h : ∀ k : Fin n, algebraMap R LL (y k.succ) = aL y k * algebraMap R LL (y 0) :=
    fun k => (aL_mul y k).symm
  simp only [h, mul_pow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
  ring

name: BlowupRegularAR12.degree_le_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem degree_le_of_mem_support {h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R} {α : Fin n →₀ ℕ}
    (hα : α ∈ h.support) : α.degree ≤ h.totalDegree
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.le_totalDegree hα

name: BlowupRegularAR12.homog_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem homog_isHomogeneous (m : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hm : h.totalDegree ≤ m) :
    (homog m h).IsHomogeneous m
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.sum _ _ _ fun α hα => ?_
  apply MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial
  rw [degree_cons]
  have := degree_le_of_mem_support hα
  omega

name: BlowupRegularAR12.algebraMap_eval_homog
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eval_homog (m : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hm : h.totalDegree ≤ m) :
    algebraMap R LL (MvPolynomial.eval y (homog m h)) =
      (algebraMap R LL (y 0)) ^ m * thetaL y h
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [h.as_sum]
  rw [homog, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun α hα => ?_
  rw [key_monomial]
  have := degree_le_of_mem_support hα
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (this.trans hm)]

name: BlowupRegularAR12.coeff_homog
statement:
theorem coeff_homog (m : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    (homog m h).coeff (Finsupp.cons (m - α.degree) α) = h.coeff α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [homog, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  have hiff : ∀ β : Fin n →₀ ℕ,
      (Finsupp.cons (m - β.degree) β = Finsupp.cons (m - α.degree) α) ↔ β = α := by
    intro β
    constructor
    · intro hb
      exact (Finsupp.cons_injective2 hb).2
    · rintro rfl; rfl
  simp_rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, hiff]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  by_cases hα : α ∈ h.support
  · simp [hα]
  · simp [hα, MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hα]

name: BlowupRegularAR12.algebraMap_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_injective (hr : IsRegular (y 0)) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R LL)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.injective LL (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_isRegular (y 0) hr)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.coeff_mem_of_thetaL_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_of_thetaL_eq_zero (hr : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y)
    (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (h0 : thetaL y h = 0) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    h.coeff α ∈ cK y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := algebraMap_eval_homog y h.totalDegree h le_rfl
  rw [h0, mul_zero] at h1
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.eval y (homog h.totalDegree h) = 0 :=
    algebraMap_injective y hr (by rw [h1, map_zero])
  have h3 := hqr h.totalDegree (homog h.totalDegree h) (homog_isHomogeneous _ h le_rfl)
    (by rw [h2]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _) (Finsupp.cons (h.totalDegree - α.degree) α)
  rwa [coeff_homog] at h3

name: BlowupRegularAR12.thetaB_surjective
statement: theorem thetaB_surjective : Function.Surjective (thetaB y)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.rangeRestrict_surjective _

name: BlowupRegularAR12.thetaB_C
statement:
theorem thetaB_C (c : R) : thetaB y (MvPolynomial.C c) =
    ⟨algebraMap R LL c, algebraMap_mem_range y c⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (thetaL_C y c)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.rB_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement: theorem rB_mem_nonZeroDivisors : rB y ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Bsub y)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R LL (y 0)) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (y 0)
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    simp only [rB, Subring.coe_mul, Subring.coe_zero] at this
    exact (hu.mul_right_eq_zero).mp this
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    simp only [rB, Subring.coe_mul, Subring.coe_zero] at this
    exact (hu.mul_left_eq_zero).mp this

name: BlowupRegularAR12.algebraMap_mem_span_rB
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_span_rB {c : R} (hc : c ∈ cK y) :
    (⟨algebraMap R LL c, algebraMap_mem_range y c⟩ : Bsub y) ∈ Ideal.span {rB y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨⟨_, mk'_mem_range y hc⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [rB, Subring.coe_mul]
  exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec LL c (⟨y 0, 1, pow_one _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (y 0))

name: BlowupRegularAR12.thetaB_mem_span_rB_iff
statement:
theorem thetaB_mem_span_rB_iff (hr : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    thetaB y h ∈ Ideal.span {rB y} ↔ ∀ α, h.coeff α ∈ cK y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hh
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hh
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hh
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := thetaB_surjective y b
    have h0 : thetaL y (h - MvPolynomial.C (y 0) * q) = 0 := by
      have this : thetaL y q * algebraMap R LL (y 0) = thetaL y h := congrArg Subtype.val hb
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, thetaL_C, mul_comm, this, sub_self]
    intro α
    have := coeff_mem_of_thetaL_eq_zero y hr hqr _ h0 α
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul] at this
    have h2 : y 0 * q.coeff α ∈ cK y := Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (y_mem y 0)
    have := (cK y).add_mem this h2
    simpa using this
  · intro hh
    rw [h.as_sum, map_sum]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun α _ => ?_
    have hm : MvPolynomial.monomial α (h.coeff α) =
        MvPolynomial.C (h.coeff α) * MvPolynomial.monomial α 1 := by
      simp [MvPolynomial.C_mul_monomial]
    rw [hm, map_mul, thetaB_C]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (algebraMap_mem_span_rB y (hh α))

name: BlowupRegularAR12.Bsub_isNoetherianRing
statement: theorem Bsub_isNoetherianRing [IsRegularRing R] : IsNoetherianRing (Bsub y)
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_of_surjective (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Bsub y) (thetaB y)
    (thetaB_surjective y)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_Bsub
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_Bsub [IsRegularRing R] [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ cK y)] (hr : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y) : IsRegularRing (Bsub y)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Bsub_isNoetherianRing y
  haveI : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n) (R ⧸ cK y)) :=
    isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular (R ⧸ cK y) (Fin n)
  haveI hq : IsRegularRing (Bsub y ⧸ Ideal.span {rB y}) :=
    IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (quotEquiv y hr hqr).symm
  refine ⟨fun Q _ => ?_⟩
  by_cases hQ : rB y ∈ Q
  · exact isRegularLocalRing_localization_of_quotient_span_singleton
      (rB_mem_nonZeroDivisors y) Q hQ
  · letI : Algebra (Bsub y) LL := (Bsub y).subtype.toAlgebra
    haveI : IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers (rB y)) LL := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨_, k, rfl⟩
        change IsUnit (algebraMap (Bsub y) LL (rB y ^ k))
        rw [map_pow]
        exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (y 0)).pow k
      · intro z
        obtain ⟨⟨c, ⟨_, k, rfl⟩⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers (y 0)) z
        refine ⟨(⟨algebraMap R LL c, algebraMap_mem_range y c⟩, ⟨rB y ^ k, k, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
        change z * ((rB y ^ k : Bsub y) : LL) = algebraMap R LL c
        simpa [rB, map_pow] using hz
      · intro a b hab
        exact ⟨1, by simp [Subtype.ext hab]⟩
    haveI : IsRegularRing LL := isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (A := R) (Submonoid.powers (y 0))
    refine isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization (T := LL) (Submonoid.powers (rB y)) Q ?_
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ hk
    exact hQ (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_of_pow_mem inferInstance k hk)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_chart
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_chart [IsRegularRing R] [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ cK y)] (hr : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y) : IsRegularRing (Chart y)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isRegularRing_Bsub y hr hqr
  exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (chartEquivBsub y hr).symm

name: B7.dualW_of_mem
statement: theorem dualW_of_mem {a : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ W a) : dualW W x = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • x
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  by_cases h : p = a
  · subst h; rw [RG6B.pr_of_mem_same hx]
  · rw [RG6B.pr_of_mem_ne hx h, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: B7.dualW_smul
statement: theorem dualW_smul (c : ℚ) (x : K) : dualW W (c • x) = c • dualW W x
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => ?_
  rw [map_smul, map_smul, pr_dualW, smul_comm]

name: B7.dualW_one
statement: theorem dualW_one : dualW W (1 : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualW_of_mem (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem : (1 : K) ∈ W 0)]
  simp

name: B7.dualW_mul
statement: theorem dualW_mul (x y : K) : dualW W (x * y) = dualW W x * dualW W y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn W with
  | zero =>
    have : dualW W (0 : K) = 0 := by
      have := dualW_smul (W := W) 0 (0 : K); simpa using this
    simp [this]
  | @homogeneous a m =>
    induction y using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn W with
    | zero =>
      have : dualW W (0 : K) = 0 := by
        have := dualW_smul (W := W) 0 (0 : K); simpa using this
      simp [this]
    | @homogeneous b n =>
      have hmn : (m : K) * n ∈ W (a + b) := SetLike.mul_mem_graded m.2 n.2
      rw [dualW_of_mem hmn, dualW_of_mem m.2, dualW_of_mem n.2, pow_add, mul_smul_comm,
        smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul, mul_comm ((-1 : ℚ) ^ b)]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, dualW_add, dualW_add, hy, hy', mul_add]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, dualW_add, dualW_add, hx, hx', add_mul]

name: B7.dualW_dualW
statement: theorem dualW_dualW (x : K) : dualW W (dualW W x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine B6.ext_pr (W := W) fun p => ?_
  rw [pr_dualW, pr_dualW, smul_smul, ← mul_pow]
  simp

name: B7.dualW_line
statement:
theorem dualW_line {ℓ ℓ' : K} (hℓ : IsNilpotent (ℓ - 1)) (hψ : C.Ψ j ℓ = ℓ ^ j)
    (hinv : ℓ * ℓ' = 1) : C.dual hj ℓ = ℓ'
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj
  set l : K := TOWERW.logOnePlus (ℓ - 1) with hl
  have hlnil : IsNilpotent l := TOWERW.isNilpotent_logOnePlus hℓ
  have hlW : l ∈ W C.Ψ j 1 := by
    rw [mem_W, pow_one]
    have h : (C.Ψ j).toRingHom (ℓ - 1) = (1 + (ℓ - 1)) ^ j - 1 := by
      simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_sub, map_one, hψ,
        add_sub_cancel]
    exact TOWERW.psi_logOnePlus hℓ (C.Ψ j).toRingHom j h
  have hexp : IsNilpotent.exp l = ℓ := by
    rw [hl, TOWERW.exp_logOnePlus hℓ]; exact add_sub_cancel _ _
  show dualW (W C.Ψ j) ℓ = ℓ'
  rw [← hexp, dualW_exp hlW hlnil]
  have h1 : IsNilpotent.exp (-l) * IsNilpotent.exp l = 1 := by
    rw [← IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) hlnil.neg hlnil, neg_add_cancel,
      IsNilpotent.exp_zero]
  calc IsNilpotent.exp (-l) = IsNilpotent.exp (-l) * (ℓ * ℓ') := by rw [hinv, mul_one]
    _ = (IsNilpotent.exp (-l) * IsNilpotent.exp l) * ℓ' := by rw [hexp, mul_assoc]
    _ = ℓ' := by rw [h1, one_mul]

name: B7.dual_split
statement:
theorem dual_split {L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra ℚ L] (CK : Ctx K) (CL : Ctx L)
    (q : K →ₐ[ℚ] L) (hqΨ : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ x, q (CK.Ψ m x) = CL.Ψ m (q x))
    {a b : ℕ} (ℓ ℓ' : Fin a → L) (m m' : Fin b → L)
    (hℓ : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (ℓ i - 1)) (hm : ∀ k, IsNilpotent (m k - 1))
    (hℓψ : ∀ i, CL.Ψ j (ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ j) (hmψ : ∀ k, CL.Ψ j (m k) = m k ^ j)
    (hℓi : ∀ i, ℓ i * ℓ' i = 1) (hmi : ∀ k, m k * m' k = 1) (x : K)
    (hx : q x = ∑ i, ℓ i - ∑ k, m k) :
    q (CK.dual hj x) = ∑ i, ℓ' i - ∑ k, m' k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← B6.dual_q CK CL q hqΨ hj, hx]
  letI := CL.gr hj
  change dualW (W CL.Ψ j) (∑ i, ℓ i - ∑ k, m k) = _
  rw [dualW_sub, dualW_sum, dualW_sum]
  congr 1
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => dualW_line CL hj (hℓ i) (hℓψ i) (hℓi i)
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => dualW_line CL hj (hm k) (hmψ k) (hmi k)

name: B7.k0Class_mul_lineBundleDual
statement:
theorem k0Class_mul_lineBundleDual (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) :
    k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf Y (lineBundleDual Y L) (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      1
proof:
:= by
  have hD := (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id hL
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i => (LineBundleDual.exists_triv L q hcard i).some
  let T := tensorLineBundleDualIso L q.X q.coversTop e
  have hLD := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y L (lineBundleDual Y L)
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hD
  have hmul := k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨lineBundleDual Y L, hD⟩
  change k0ClassOf Y L _ * k0ClassOf Y (lineBundleDual Y L) hD =
    k0ClassOf Y (tensorSheaf Y L (lineBundleDual Y L)) hLD at hmul
  rw [hmul]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso Y hLD (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y) T

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso_restriction
statement:
theorem
    projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso_restriction
    (g : R) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p, ⊤)) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
    let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
    (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso
        R n g d p).hom
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
        f M (p + 1) h
        (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTopLinearEquiv
          R n d p x) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
  let A := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
  letI : IsAffine D := by
    dsimp only [D, projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
    exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g
  letI : IsAffine (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) :=
    isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
  let candidateMap :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N h
  let actualMap :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      f M (p + 1) h
  letI : IsIso candidateMap :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent
      N h
  letI : IsIso actualMap :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R g n d p
  have hcandidate :
      (asIso candidateMap).inv
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) =
        ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[A,
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x) := by
    rw [← SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul
      N h x]
    exact (asIso candidateMap).hom_inv_id_apply _
  change ((asIso candidateMap).inv ≫
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTensorIso
        R n g d p).hom ≫
      (asIso actualMap).hom)
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
      f M (p + 1) h
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTopLinearEquiv
        R n d p x)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [hcandidate]
  change actualMap
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom).map
        (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTopLinearEquiv
          R n d p).toModuleIso.hom
        ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[A,
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x)) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
      f M (p + 1) h
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTopLinearEquiv
        R n d p x)
  rw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  rfl

name: B4.ChernDatum.gi_eq_of_g_eq
statement: theorem gi_eq_of_g_eq {d d' : ChernDatum Φ} (h : d.g = d'.g) : d.gi = d'.gi
proof:
:= by
  calc d.gi = d.gi * (d'.g * d'.gi) := by rw [d'.inv, mul_one]
    _ = (d.g * d.gi) * d'.gi := by rw [← h]; ring
    _ = d'.gi := by rw [d.inv, one_mul]

name: B4.ChernDatum.ext_g
statement: theorem ext_g {d d' : ChernDatum Φ} (h : d.g = d'.g) : d = d'
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := gi_eq_of_g_eq h
  cases d
  cases d'
  simp_all

name: B4.coeff_X_deriv_mem
statement: theorem coeff_X_deriv_mem (d : ChernDatum Φ) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (X * d⁄dX R d.g) ∈ Φ.F n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | m
  · rw [coeff_zero_X_mul]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (d.hg (m + 1))

name: B4.nsr_mem
statement: theorem nsr_mem (d : ChernDatum Φ) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (nsr d) ∈ Φ.F n
proof:
:=
  coeff_mul_mem Φ (coeff_X_deriv_mem d) d.hgi n

name: B4.coeff_zero_nsr
statement: theorem coeff_zero_nsr (d : ChernDatum Φ) : coeff 0 (nsr d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsr, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_mul, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply (X * _),
    coeff_zero_X_mul, zero_mul]

name: B4.powSum_mem
statement: theorem powSum_mem (d : ChernDatum Φ) (k : ℕ) : powSum d k ∈ Φ.F k
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (nsr_mem d k)

name: B4.coeff_nsr_eq
statement: theorem coeff_nsr_eq (d : ChernDatum Φ) (k : ℕ) : coeff k (nsr d) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * powSum d k
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSum, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
  simp

name: B4.nsr_mul
statement: theorem nsr_mul (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) : nsr (d₁.mul d₂) = nsr d₁ + nsr d₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold nsr ChernDatum.mul
  simp only
  rw [Derivation.leibniz]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (X * d⁄dX R d₂.g * d₂.gi) * d₁.inv + (X * d⁄dX R d₁.g * d₁.gi) * d₂.inv

name: B4.nsr_one
statement: theorem nsr_one : nsr (ChernDatum.one : ChernDatum Φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold nsr ChernDatum.one
  simp

name: B4.powSum_mul
statement:
theorem powSum_mul (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) (k : ℕ) :
    powSum (d₁.mul d₂) k = powSum d₁ k + powSum d₂ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSum, powSum, powSum, nsr_mul, map_add, mul_add]

name: B4.powSum_one
statement: theorem powSum_one (k : ℕ) : powSum (ChernDatum.one : ChernDatum Φ) k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSum, nsr_one, map_zero, mul_zero]

name: B4.newton_identity
statement:
theorem newton_identity (d : ChernDatum Φ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ((-1 : R) ^ (p.1 + 1) * powSum d p.1) * coeff p.2 d.g =
      (n : R) * coeff n d.g
proof:
:= by
  have h : X * d⁄dX R d.g = nsr d * d.g := by
    unfold nsr
    linear_combination (-(X * d⁄dX R d.g)) * d.inv
  have h2 := congrArg (coeff n) h
  rw [coeff_mul n (nsr d) d.g] at h2
  simp only [coeff_nsr_eq] at h2
  rw [← h2]
  rcases n with _ | m
  · rw [coeff_zero_X_mul]; simp [powSum, coeff_zero_nsr]
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative]; push_cast; ring

name: B4.powSum_zero
statement: theorem powSum_zero (d : ChernDatum Φ) : powSum d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSum, coeff_zero_nsr, mul_zero]

name: B4.powSum_one_eq
statement: theorem powSum_one_eq (d : ChernDatum Φ) : powSum d 1 = coeff 1 d.g
proof:
:= by
  have h := newton_identity d 1
  rw [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ] at h
  simp [powSum_zero, d.g0] at h
  linear_combination h

name: B4.powSum_two_eq
statement:
theorem powSum_two_eq (d : ChernDatum Φ) :
    powSum d 2 = coeff 1 d.g ^ 2 - 2 * coeff 2 d.g
proof:
:= by
  have h := newton_identity d 2
  have h1 := powSum_one_eq d
  rw [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ] at h
  simp [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ, powSum_zero, d.g0, h1] at h
  linear_combination -h

name: B4.powSumF_mul
statement:
theorem powSumF_mul (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) (k : ℕ) :
    powSumF (d₁.mul d₂) k = powSumF d₁ k + powSumF d₂ k
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (powSum_mul d₁ d₂ k)

name: B4.powSumF_one
statement: theorem powSumF_one (k : ℕ) : powSumF (ChernDatum.one : ChernDatum Φ) k = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (powSum_one k)

name: B4.qsmul_add
statement: theorem qsmul_add {n : ℕ} (c : ℚ) (a b : Φ.F n) : qsmul c (a + b) = qsmul c a + qsmul c b
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (mul_add _ _ _)

name: B4.qsmul_zero
statement: theorem qsmul_zero {n : ℕ} (c : ℚ) : qsmul c (0 : Φ.F n) = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (mul_zero _)

name: B4.addCharGr_mul
statement:
theorem addCharGr_mul (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) :
    addCharGr D f (d₁.mul d₂) = addCharGr D f d₁ + addCharGr D f d₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharGr, powSumF_mul, qsmul_add, gcl_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: B4.addCharGr_one
statement: theorem addCharGr_one (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : addCharGr D f (ChernDatum.one : ChernDatum Φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharGr, powSumF_one, qsmul_zero, gcl_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: B4.chK_mul
statement:
theorem chK_mul (D : ℕ) (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) (k : ℕ) :
    chK D (d₁.mul d₂) k = chK D d₁ k + chK D d₂ k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chK, powSumF_mul, qsmul_add, gcl_add]

name: B4.chPos_mul
statement:
theorem chPos_mul (D : ℕ) (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) :
    chPos D (d₁.mul d₂) = chPos D d₁ + chPos D d₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chPos, chK_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: B4.chPos_one
statement: theorem chPos_one (D : ℕ) : chPos D (ChernDatum.one : ChernDatum Φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chPos, chK, powSumF_one, qsmul_zero, gcl_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: B4.gcl_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem gcl_pow_eq_zero (D : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (a : Φ.F k) :
    (gcl D k a) ^ (D + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ b : Φ.F (k * m), (gcl D k a) ^ m = gcl D (k * m) b := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact ⟨⟨1, Φ.mem_zero 1⟩, by rw [pow_zero]; exact (gcl_zero_one D).symm⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨⟨(b : R) * a, Φ.mul_mem b.2 a.2⟩, by rw [pow_succ, hb, gcl_mul]; rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := key (D + 1)
  rw [hb]
  exact gcl_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self D) (by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D + 1) hk)) b

name: B4.isNilpotent_addCharGr
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_addCharGr (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (d : ChernDatum Φ) :
    IsNilpotent (addCharGr D f d)
proof:
:= by
  refine isNilpotent_sum fun k hk => ?_
  exact ⟨D + 1, gcl_pow_eq_zero D (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1 _⟩

name: B4.ToddGr_mul
statement:
theorem ToddGr_mul (D : ℕ) (d₁ d₂ : ChernDatum Φ) :
    ToddGr D (d₁.mul d₂) = ToddGr D d₁ * ToddGr D d₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [ToddGr, ToddGr, ToddGr, addCharGr_mul,
    IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (GrT.commute _ _) (isNilpotent_addCharGr D _ d₁)
      (isNilpotent_addCharGr D _ d₂)]

name: B4.ToddGr_one
statement: theorem ToddGr_one (D : ℕ) : ToddGr D (ChernDatum.one : ChernDatum Φ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ToddGr, addCharGr_one, IsNilpotent.exp_zero]

name: B4.pow_sub_pow_mem
statement:
theorem pow_sub_pow_mem (Φ : RingFilt R) {u v : R} (hu : u ∈ Φ.F 1) (hv : v ∈ Φ.F 1)
    (huv : u - v ∈ Φ.F 2) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : u ^ k - v ^ k ∈ Φ.F (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have h := (Commute.all u v).geom_sum₂_mul (m + 1)
  rw [← h]
  have hs : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), u ^ i * v ^ (m + 1 - 1 - i)) ∈ Φ.F m := by
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_
    have := Φ.mul_mem (Φ.pow_mem hu i) (Φ.pow_mem hv (m + 1 - 1 - i))
    have e : i + (m + 1 - 1 - i) = m := by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hi; omega
    rwa [e] at this
  have h2 := Φ.mul_mem hs huv
  exact h2

name: B4.coeff_C_mul_X'
statement:
theorem coeff_C_mul_X' {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (C a * X) = if n = 1 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := coeff_C_mul_X_pow a 1 n
  simpa [pow_one] using this

name: B4.powSum_lineDatum
statement:
theorem powSum_lineDatum (a : Φ.F 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    powSum (lineDatum a) k = (a : R) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have hD : d⁄dX R (1 + C (a : R) * X) = C (a : R) := by simp
  unfold powSum nsr lineDatum
  simp only
  rw [hD, show X * C (a : R) * PowerSeries.mk (fun n => (-(a : R)) ^ n) =
      X * (C (a : R) * PowerSeries.mk (fun n => (-(a : R)) ^ n)) by ring,
    coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_C_mul, coeff_mk, neg_pow]
  have h2 : ((-1 : R)) ^ (m + 1 + 1) * (-1) ^ m = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_add, show m + 1 + 1 + m = 2 * (m + 1) by ring, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  linear_combination ((a : R) * (a : R) ^ m) * h2

name: B4.powSumF_lineDatum_gcl
statement:
theorem powSumF_lineDatum_gcl (D : ℕ) (a : Φ.F 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    gcl D k (powSumF (lineDatum a) k) = (gcl D 1 a) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [gcl_one_pow]
  exact gcl_congr D k (powSum_lineDatum a hk)

name: B4.addCharGr_lineDatum
statement:
theorem addCharGr_lineDatum (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hf : coeff 0 f = 0) (a : Φ.F 1) :
    addCharGr D f (lineDatum a) = RG6B.ev D (gcl D 1 a) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_eq_sum_Icc D _ f hf]
  unfold addCharGr
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  rw [gcl_qsmul, powSumF_lineDatum_gcl D a (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1]

name: B4.ToddGr_lineDatum
statement:
theorem ToddGr_lineDatum (D : ℕ) (a : Φ.F 1) :
    ToddGr D (lineDatum a) = RG6B.Td D (gcl D 1 a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ToddGr, addCharGr_lineDatum D _ coeff_zero_logTd]
  exact exp_ev_logTd (gcl_one_pow_succ D a)

name: B4.exp_sub_one_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [TOWERW.exp_eq_ev hb, RG6B.ev_eq_sum]
  have : Finset.range (D + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 D) := by
    ext m; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [this, Finset.sum_insert (by simp)]
  simp [coeff_exp]

name: B4.chK_lineDatum
statement:
theorem chK_lineDatum (D : ℕ) (a : Φ.F 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    chK D (lineDatum a) k = ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (gcl D 1 a) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold chK
  rw [gcl_qsmul, powSumF_lineDatum_gcl D a hk]

name: B4.chPos_lineDatum
statement:
theorem chPos_lineDatum (D : ℕ) (a : Φ.F 1) :
    chPos D (lineDatum a) = IsNilpotent.exp (gcl D 1 a) - 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (exp_sub_one_eq (gcl_one_pow_succ D a)).symm
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => chK_lineDatum D a (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1

name: B4.ToddGr_splitDatum
statement:
theorem ToddGr_splitDatum (D : ℕ) (l : List (Φ.F 1)) :
    ToddGr D (splitDatum l) = (l.map fun a => RG6B.Td D (gcl D 1 a)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ToddGr_one D
  | cons a l ih => rw [splitDatum, ToddGr_mul, ToddGr_lineDatum, ih, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]

name: B4.length_add_chPos_splitDatum
statement:
theorem length_add_chPos_splitDatum (D : ℕ) (l : List (Φ.F 1)) :
    (l.length : GrT Φ D) + chPos D (splitDatum l) = chSplit D l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [splitDatum, chPos_one, chSplit]
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [splitDatum, chPos_mul, chPos_lineDatum, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
      chSplit, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← chSplit, ← ih]
    ring

name: B4.gcl_linProd
statement:
theorem gcl_linProd (D : ℕ) (a b : Φ.F 1) :
    gcl D 1 (linProd a b) = gcl D 1 a + gcl D 1 b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gcl_add]
  refine gcl_eq_of_sub_mem D 1 ?_
  show (a : R) + b + a * b - (a + b) ∈ Φ.F (1 + 1)
  have := Φ.mul_mem a.2 b.2
  convert this using 1
  ring

name: B4.exp_gcl_linProd
statement:
theorem exp_gcl_linProd (D : ℕ) (a b : Φ.F 1) :
    IsNilpotent.exp (gcl D 1 (linProd a b)) =
      IsNilpotent.exp (gcl D 1 a) * IsNilpotent.exp (gcl D 1 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gcl_linProd, IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (GrT.commute _ _) ⟨D + 1, gcl_one_pow_succ D a⟩
    ⟨D + 1, gcl_one_pow_succ D b⟩]

name: B4.chSplit_prodList
statement:
theorem chSplit_prodList (D : ℕ) (l m : List (Φ.F 1)) :
    chSplit D (prodList l m) = chSplit D l * chSplit D m
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [prodList, chSplit]
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [prodList]
    unfold chSplit at ih ⊢
    rw [List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [List.map_map, ← List.sum_map_mul_left]
    exact congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left fun b _ => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, exp_gcl_linProd])

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.pullLocF3_alg
statement:
theorem pullLocF3_alg (b : K0 P) :
    pullLocF3 j i (algebraMap _ _ b) = algebraMap _ _ (pullbackK0RingHom i b)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ _ b

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.res_pushforward_mul_pullback
statement:
theorem res_pushforward_mul_pullback [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsLocallyNoetherian P] (res : G0 P →+ K0 P)
    (hl : res.comp (k0ToG0 P) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (hr : (k0ToG0 P).comp res = AddMonoidHom.id _) (a : K0 X) (b : K0 P) :
    res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X (a * pullbackK0RingHom i b))) =
      res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X a)) * b
proof:
:= by
  have hres_smul : ∀ (c : K0 P) (g : G0 P), res (c • g) = c * res g := by
    intro c g
    have h1 : g = k0ToG0 P (res g) := (DFunLike.congr_fun hr g).symm
    conv_lhs => rw [h1, ← k0ToG0_mul]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hl (c * res g)
  rw [finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback, hres_smul, mul_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsRRFinal.projFormulaLoc
statement:
theorem projFormulaLoc [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsLocallyNoetherian P] (res : G0 P →+ K0 P)
    (hl : res.comp (k0ToG0 P) = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (hr : (k0ToG0 P).comp res = AddMonoidHom.id _)
    (a : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) (b : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 P)) :
    pushLocF3 j i res (a * pullLocF3 j i b) = pushLocF3 j i res a * b
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : ∀ a₀ : K0 X, ∀ b : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 P),
      pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a₀ * pullLocF3 j i b) =
        pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a₀) * b := by
    intro a₀
    have key := loc_addHom_ext j
      ((pushLocF3 j i res).comp
        (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) a₀) |>.comp
          (pullLocF3 j i).toAddMonoidHom))
      ((AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a₀))))
      (fun b₀ ↦ by
        show pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a₀ * pullLocF3 j i (algebraMap _ _ b₀)) =
          pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a₀) * algebraMap _ _ b₀
        rw [pullLocF3_alg, ← map_mul]
        unfold pushLocF3
        rw [locAddHom_algebraMap, locAddHom_algebraMap, ← map_mul]
        congr 1
        exact res_pushforward_mul_pullback i res hl hr a₀ b₀)
    intro b
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun key b
  have key := loc_addHom_ext j
    ((pushLocF3 j i res).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulRight (pullLocF3 j i b)))
    (AddMonoidHom.mulRight b |>.comp (pushLocF3 j i res))
    (fun a₀ ↦ h1 a₀ b)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key a

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.mapRingHom_kAlg_compH
statement:
theorem mapRingHom_kAlg_compH (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg Y k φk U)).comp
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k)) =
      Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1))
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) (by simp)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (integerMap_comp (DeformationSpace.kAlg Y k φk U)) a

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.blowupToLineOver_comp_mapH
statement:
theorem blowupToLineOver_comp_mapH :
    blowupGlobalToLineOver Y J k φk ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k))) =
      InfinityGlobal.blowupToIntegerLine Y J
proof:
:= by
  refine colimit.hom_ext fun U => ?_
  change blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ _ = blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, blowupAffineι_toLineOver, InfinityGlobal.blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine]
  unfold blToLineOverU InfinityGlobal.blowupToIntegerLineU
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  rw [mapRingHom_kAlg_compH Y k φk U]

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.toLineOver_comp_mapH
statement:
theorem toLineOver_comp_mapH :
    DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k))) =
      InfinityGlobal.deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeSpec.hom_ext fun U => ?_
  change DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊥ U ≫ _ = DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊥ U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.affineι_toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk U,
    InfinityGlobal.deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine]
  unfold InfinityGlobal.deformationToIntegerLineU AffineDeformationSpace.toLine
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  refine RingHom.ext fun p => ?_
  simp only [DeformationSpace.lineHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [show (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg Y k φk U))
      ((Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k)) p) =
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1))) p from
    RingHom.congr_fun (mapRingHom_kAlg_compH Y k φk U) p]

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.toP1Global_comp_mapH
statement:
theorem toP1Global_comp_mapH :
    toP1Global Y J k φk ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (integerMap k) 1 =
      InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ _ = blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, blowupGlobalι_toP1, Category.assoc,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.projectiveLineChart_map (integerMap k) 0, ← Category.assoc,
      blowupToLineOver_comp_mapH, InfinityGlobal.blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1]
  · change lineTι Y J ≫ _ = lineTι Y J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, lineTι_toP1, Category.assoc,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.projectiveLineChart_map (integerMap k) 1, ← Category.assoc,
      toLineOver_comp_mapH, InfinityGlobal.lineTι_totalToIntegerP1]

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.kdgc_C1H
statement:
theorem kdgc_C1H :
    (infinityFibreι Y J).ker =
      (pullback.fst (toP1Global Y J k φk) (pointInfKDGc k)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion (pointInfKDGc k) (toP1Global Y J k φk)]
  refine ideal_eq_of_two_charts Y J _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [ker_infinityFibreι, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      InfinityGlobal.blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      ker_pointInf_comap_chart, ← blowupToLineOver_comp_mapH Y J k φk,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, ker_zero_comap_map,
      ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, blowupGlobalι_toP1, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      ker_pointInf_comap_chart]
  · rw [ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint _ _ (disjoint_range_infinityFibreι_lineTι Y J),
      ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, lineTι_toP1, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint (pointInfKDGc k) (chart k 1) ?_, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_top]
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩ h
    exact pointInfKDGc_not_mem_range_chart_one k s h

theorem exists_eq_of_isIso_fst {T P S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ P) (p : S ⟶ P)

proof:

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.exists_points_inf_one
statement:
theorem exists_points_inf_one [Nonempty J.subscheme] :
    ∃ w₁ w₂ : subschemeTotalGlobal Y J,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J w₁ ∈ Set.range (pointInfKDGc integerRing) ∧
      SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J w₂ ∈ Set.range (chart integerRing 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty J.subscheme›
  have SqW := isPullback_totalIntegerP1 Y J
  let s1 : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J :=
    SqW.lift (𝟙 _) (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint_toSpec, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  let s2 : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J :=
    SqW.lift (𝟙 _) (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ pointOneKDGc integerRing) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, pointOneKDGc_toSpec, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  have hs1 : s1 ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint := SqW.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hs2 : s2 ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ pointOneKDGc integerRing := SqW.lift_snd _ _ _
  refine ⟨s1 x, s2 x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e1 := congrArg (fun q => q x) hs1
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at e1
    rw [e1]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · have e2 := congrArg (fun q => q x) hs2
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at e2
    rw [e2]
    exact pointOneKDGc_mem_range_chart_one integerRing _

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ker_fst_pointAt_zero_ne_bot
statement:
theorem ker_fst_pointAt_zero_ne_bot [Nonempty J.subscheme] :
    (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0)).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0)) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr hb
  obtain ⟨w₁, -, ⟨s, hs⟩, -⟩ := exists_points_inf_one Y J
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_eq_of_isIso_fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
    (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0) w₁
  have hmem : SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J w₁ ∈ Set.range (chart integerRing 1) := by
    rw [← map_toP1_apply Y J k φk, hz]
    unfold DeformationSpace.pointAt
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.projectiveLineChart_map (integerMap k) 1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hs] at hmem
  exact pointInfKDGc_not_mem_range_chart_one integerRing s hmem

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.ker_fst_pointInf_ne_bot
statement:
theorem ker_fst_pointInf_ne_bot [Nonempty J.subscheme] :
    (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) (pointInfKDGc k)).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
      (pointInfKDGc k)) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr hb
  obtain ⟨-, w₂, -, hmem⟩ := exists_points_inf_one Y J
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_eq_of_isIso_fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
    (pointInfKDGc k) w₂
  rw [← map_toP1_apply Y J k φk, hz, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pointInfKDGc_map,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hmem
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hmem
  exact pointInfKDGc_not_mem_range_chart_one integerRing _ ⟨s, hs⟩

    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))

        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x

:=

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M (p + 1)
        (coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R n M p r x) a =
      coordinateCechModuleSectionsCofaceLinearMap R n M p r a
        (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M p x
          (a ∘ r.succAbove))
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap,
    coordinateCechModuleHigherPiCofaceLinearMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M p x a =
      (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))
  let hPi := Limits.productIsProduct' (Discrete.functor f)
  let hRaw := (AddCommGrpCat.HasLimit.productLimitCone f).isLimit
  let e := coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiIso R n M p
  have he :
      e.hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun b ↦ f b) a) =
        Pi.π f a :=
    IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp hPi hRaw ⟨a⟩
  exact congrArg (fun k : _ ⟶ f a ↦ k.hom x) he

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) :
    coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R n M p r x =
      ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n M).δ r).hom x
proof:
:= by
  apply (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
    R n M (p + 1)).injective
  funext a
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleSectionsCofaceLinearMap_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  have h :=
    coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n M p r a
  exact (congrArg (fun k => k.hom x) h).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) :
    coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear R n M p x =
      (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj M).d p (p + 1)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear R n M p x =
    ((((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor
      (coordinateCechCover R n)).obj M.presheaf).d p (p + 1)).hom x)
  simp only [CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor,
    Limits.FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor_obj_d,
    CochainComplex.of_d]
  change _ =
    (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n M) p).hom x
  simp only [coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rw [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD]
  let f := fun r : Fin (p + 2) ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n M).δ r
  have hhom_sum (s : Finset (Fin (p + 2))) :
      (∑ r ∈ s, f r).hom = ∑ r ∈ s, (f r).hom := by
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => rfl
    | @insert r s hr ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hr, Finset.sum_insert hr,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_add, ih]
  rw [show (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n M).δ r) =
      ∑ r, f r by rfl]
  rw [hhom_sum]
  rw [AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply (fun r => (f r).hom) Finset.univ x]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  dsimp only [f]
  rw [AddCommGrpCat.hom_zsmul]
  change ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R n M p r x =
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n M).δ r).hom x
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply]
  generalize ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) = z
  cases z <;> rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓAwayLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem moduleSpecΓAwayLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (r : R) [IsLocalization.Away r S]
    (M : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsLocalizedModule.Away r
      (moduleSpecΓAwayLocalizationMap (S := S) r M)
proof:
:= by
  let l := ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.map
    (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op).hom
  let e := (localizedModuleSpecΓOfAwayLinearEquiv (S := S) r M).symm
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away r l :=

  rw [show moduleSpecΓAwayLocalizationMap (S := S) r M =

theorem pf_hom_inv (e : X ≅ Y) (y : G0 Y) :
    finitePushforward e.hom (finitePushforward e.inv y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : finitePushforward e.hom (finitePushforward e.inv y) =
      finitePushforward (e.inv ≫ e.hom) y := by
    rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]; rfl
  have h2 := congrArg (fun F => F y) (finitePushforward_congr (Iso.inv_hom_id e))

name: ARRKG2A.arr_caseII
statement:
theorem arr_caseII (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J))
    (hCN : ∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = codim J) (hd : 0 < codim J)
    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    (G : ARRCaseIIGatesA D φ CN) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (Zs A J)) :
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j) (pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) D.resA.res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) D.resA.res
        (thetaZ D j * locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hrE := rankBetween D CN hCN hd
  have hE := hErank D
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty ((Cov CN).basisIndex i) := fun i => ⟨Sum.inr PUnit.unit⟩
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (Es CN) :=
    lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent
      ((Cov CN).rankZeroNilpotent_scheme hpos (Nat.succ_pos _) hE D.rankZeroNilZ)
  have hEN : k0ClassOf (Zs A J) (Nsh J ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (Zs A J))
      hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = conormalClass D + 1 := by
    rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.k0ClassOf_biprod (hNrank D).isFiniteLocallyFree
      hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree hE.isFiniteLocallyFree]
    rfl
  have hkos : spK CN (resE D CN) 1 =
      lambdaMinusOne (Cov CN).tautologicalKernel
        ((Cov CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) := by
    have h := RiemannRoch.KNFB.koszulProd_adaptedCover CN hE
    simp only [spK, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [h]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (resE D CN).left _
  have hproj : ∀ (y : KLoc j (Es CN)) (x : KLoc j (Zs A J)),
      locAddHom j (spK CN (resE D CN))
        (locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom (Cov CN).zeroSection) y * x) =
      y * locAddHom j (spK CN (resE D CN)) x := by
    intro y x
    have h := projFormulaLoc j (Cov CN).zeroSection (resE D CN).res (resE D CN).left
      (resE D CN).right x y
    rw [ARRASM.pullLocF3_eq] at h
    rw [mul_comm _ x, mul_comm y]
    exact h
  have hkoszul : ∀ z : K0 (Zs A J),
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Es CN)) (adamsRingHom (rankE D CN) j (spK CN (resE D CN) z)) =
      locAddHom j (spK CN (resE D CN))
        (thetaZ D j * algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs A J)) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j z)) := by
    intro z
    have key := SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection_noTwist_ARRM4
      (j := j) hj hE (Cov CN) (rankZ A J) (hnilZ' D) (rankE D CN) hnilP
      (conormalClass D) hEN (spK CN (resE D CN)) (locAddHom j (spK CN (resE D CN)))
      (fun x => locAddHom_algebraMap _ _ _) hproj hkos z
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact key
  have hπs : ∀ z, πK D CN hrE (spK CN (resE D CN) z) = z := by
    intro z
    have h7 := KSpecialization.derivedPushforward_comp_section (C := Cov CN) hrE
      (Cov CN).zeroSection (Cov CN).zeroSection_toBase
    have h7z := DFunLike.congr_fun h7 (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) z)
    have h8 := DFunLike.congr_fun (resE D CN).right
      (finitePushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) z))
    simp only [πK, spK, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h7z h8 ⊢
    rw [h8, h7z]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun D.resZ.left z
  refine ARRASM.adams_transport_loc j (FpK D) (ipK D) (spK CN (resE D CN))
    (πK D CN hrE) (pullbackK0RingHom (IntegralARRM346.totalComplement A J).ι) (j₀K A φ J)
    (pullbackK0RingHom (EιOfIso D CN)) (r₀K A φ J) (r₁K A J) (prK A J)
    (adamsRingHom (rankM A J) j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j) (adamsRingHom (rankE D CN) j)
    (adamsRingHom (rankU A J φ hne) j) (adamsRingHom (rankW A J) j)
    (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) (thetaZ D j) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (hpr₀ A φ J)
    (ARRASM.pr_section _ _ (secInf_pr A J)) hkoszul hπs G.hrigid x
  · intro m hm
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := D.hsupp j m hm
    exact ⟨w, by rw [← ARRASM.Floc_eq_locAddHom]; exact hw⟩
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat (IntegralARRM346.totalComplement A J).ι (rankU A J φ hne) (rankM A J) hj
  · intro w
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    exact hresF_proved D w
  · intro w
    have h := KSpecialization.ARRG45.hbc0_K0 A J k φ D.resM D.resA w
    simp only [j₀K, FpK, ipK, r₀K, ARRL1C.Fp, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    exact h
  · intro w
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    exact G.hbcP w
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat _ (rankA A) (rankM A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat (EιOfIso D CN) (rankE D CN) (rankM A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat _ (rankZ A J) (rankW A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat (secInf A J) (rankZ A J) (rankW A J) hj

name: ARRKG2A.arr_caseII_K0
statement:
theorem arr_caseII_K0 (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J))
    (hCN : ∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = codim J) (hd : 0 < codim J)
    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    (G : ARRCaseIIGatesA D φ CN) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 (Zs A J)) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j A)
        (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j (D.resA.res (finitePushforward (iZ A J)
          (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) D.resA.res
        (algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs A J)) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j x) * thetaZ D j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := arr_caseII D φ CN hCN hd hne G hj (algebraMap _ _ x)
  have e1 : pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) D.resA.res (algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs A J)) x) =
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j A) (D.resA.res (finitePushforward (iZ A J)
        (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) x))) := by
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    rfl
  rw [e1, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, mul_comm] at h
  exact h

proof:
:= coordinateOpen R n i
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M
    let eU : U.toScheme ≅
        Spec (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing R n i)) :=
      Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)

      restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv M U

  dsimp only
  rfl
