statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailIso_native
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j ≠ i)
    (t : projectiveCoordinateChartRestrictedSections R n M i) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateOpen R n i
    let V := coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j
    let h : V ≤ U :=
      (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_left
    projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailNativeMap
        R n M i j hji t =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
        (projectiveCoordinateChartRestrictedNativeSectionsAddEquiv
          R n M i t) := by
  dsimp only
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateChartRing R n i)
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) :=
    (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n i j).toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization.Away (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) :=
    coordinateChartToOverlapLeft_isLocalization R n i j hji
  rw [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailNativeMap_eq_stage4]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage4_eq_stage4b]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage4b]
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage4a]
  rw [restrictFunctorComp_symm_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage3]
  rw [restrictFunctorComp_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage2]
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage1]
  rw [restrictFunctorComp_symm_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapRestrictionTailStage0]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateChartRestrictedNativeSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  rw [restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  rw [restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  simp only [id_eq, Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
  erw [addEquiv_cast_trans_apply]
  erw [addEquiv_cast_trans_apply]
  repeat rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  apply SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_map_cast
  · rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    exact (coordinateOpen R n i).ι_image_top
  · rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    exact (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι_image_top

    ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map eN.hom).app ⊤).hom
      ((localizedModuleSpecΓOfAwayLinearEquiv
        (S := CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j)
        (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩) N).symm
          (N.presheaf.map
            (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
              (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)).leTop.op s))) =
      T.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ (⊤ :
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens) ≤
            (⊤ : (Spec
              (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing R n i))).Opens) from le_top)).op
        (eN.hom.app ⊤ s) := by
  dsimp only
  let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n i j))
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateChartRing R n i)
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) :=
    (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n i j).toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization.Away (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) :=
    coordinateChartToOverlapLeft_isLocalization R n i j hji

    IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization
      (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)
  let N := projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i

  let P := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M

      Spec (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing R n i)) :=
    Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
  let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor eU.inv).obj P
  let eN : N ≅ T := projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModelIso R n M i
  have himage : q ''ᵁ
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens) =
        PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway_eq_basicOpen
      (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)
  rw [localizedModuleSpecΓOfAwayLinearEquiv_symm_apply]
  change (eN.hom.app (q ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens))).hom
      (N.presheaf.map (eqToIso himage).op.hom
        (N.presheaf.map
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
            (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)).leTop.op s)) =
    T.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens) ≤
            (⊤ : (Spec
              (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing R n i))).Opens) from le_top)).op
      (eN.hom.app ⊤ s)
  have hinput :
      N.presheaf.map
          (eqToIso himage).op.hom
        (N.presheaf.map
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
            (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hji⟩)).leTop.op s) =
      N.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ

            (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens) ≤
              (⊤ : (Spec
                (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing R n i))).Opens) from le_top)).op s := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  rw [hinput]
  let f := (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ
    (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens) ≤
        (⊤ : (Spec
          (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing R n i))).Opens) from le_top)).op
  have hnat := eN.hom.mapPresheaf.naturality f
  have hnat' := congrArg (fun k => k.hom s) hnat
  simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] using hnat'

      (ModuleCat.of A Γ(N, W))
  let assocH :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
        f M (p + 1) W)
  let z := (asIso cVW).inv x
  let wN := assocN.inv
    ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S, (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] z)
  let zH := eV z
  let wH := assocH.inv
    ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S, (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] zH)
  have hz : cVW z = x := by
    exact (asIso cVW).inv_hom_id_apply x
  have hcandidate :
      (asIso cUW).inv (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) = wN := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso cUW).1
    have hcUWInv := (asIso cUW).inv_hom_id_apply
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x)
    change cUW ((asIso cUW).inv
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x)) =
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x at hcUWInv
    rw [hcUWInv]
    have hcompC :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_comp
        N hUV hVW
    change assocN.hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map cVW ≫
        cUV = cUW at hcompC
    have hcompCApply := congrArg (fun q => q wN) hcompC
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcompCApply
    rw [← hcompCApply]
    simp only [wN]
    rw [assocN.inv_hom_id_apply,
      ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul, hz,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  have htransport : eU wN = wH := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso assocH.hom).1
    have hnat :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_naturality
        hUV hVW eTop.hom
    have hnatApply := congrArg
      (fun q => q wN) hnat
    change
      (assocN.hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map eV) wN =
        (eU ≫ assocH.hom) wN at hnatApply
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnatApply
    calc
      assocH.hom (eU wN) =
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars
            (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map eV
              (assocN.hom wN) :=
        hnatApply.symm
      _ = ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S,
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] zH) := by
        simp only [wN]
        rw [assocN.inv_hom_id_apply,
          ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
      _ = assocH.hom wH := by
        simp only [wH]
        rw [assocH.inv_hom_id_apply]
  have hactual :
      aUW wH =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
          f M (p + 1) hUV (aVW zH) := by
    dsimp only [aUW, aVW, hUW]
    rw [← SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp
        f M (p + 1) hUV hVW]
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, wH]
    rw [assocH.inv_hom_id_apply,
      ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  change ((asIso cUW).inv ≫ eU ≫ (asIso aUW).hom)
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
      f M (p + 1) hUV
      (((asIso cVW).inv ≫ eV ≫ (asIso aVW).hom) x)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [hcandidate, htransport]
  exact hactual

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso_restriction_of_le
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso_restriction_of_le
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (g h : R)
    (hle : projectiveBaseBasicOpen R h ≤ projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p,
      projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)) :
    (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso
        R n h d p).hom
        ((projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hle).op x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) hle
        ((projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso
          R n g d p).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let U := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R h
  let V := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  letI : IsAffine U := by
    dsimp only [U, projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
    exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) h
  letI : IsAffine V := by
    dsimp only [V, projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
    exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g
  letI :
      IsIso
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
          (show U ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)) :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R h n d p
  letI :
      IsIso
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
          (show V ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)) :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R g n d p
  exact projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso_restriction
    R n U V hle d p x

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.chartEquivBsub_baseElement
statement:
theorem chartEquivBsub_baseElement (hr : IsRegular (y 0)) :
    chartEquivBsub y hr (baseElement (cK y) (rK y) (y 0)) = rB y
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change eL y (baseElement (cK y) (rK y) (y 0)) = algebraMap R _ (y 0)
  exact chartLocalizationMap_id_baseElement (cK y) (rK y) (y 0)

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularRing_chart_quot
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_chart_quot [IsRegularRing R] [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ cK y)] (hr : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y) :
    IsRegularRing (Chart y ⧸ Ideal.span {baseElement (cK y) (rK y) (y 0)})
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Bsub_isNoetherianRing y
  haveI : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n) (R ⧸ cK y)) :=
    isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular (R ⧸ cK y) (Fin n)
  haveI hq : IsRegularRing (Bsub y ⧸ Ideal.span {rB y}) :=
    IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (quotEquiv y hr hqr).symm
  have h : Ideal.span {rB y} = (Ideal.span {baseElement (cK y) (rK y) (y 0)}).map
      (chartEquivBsub y hr : Chart y →+* Bsub y) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    exact congrArg (fun z => Ideal.span {z}) (chartEquivBsub_baseElement y hr).symm
  exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv
    (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ (chartEquivBsub y hr) h).symm

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularRing_chart_quot'
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_chart_quot' {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] {n : ℕ} {K' : Ideal R}
    (r : K') (y : Fin (n + 1) → R) (hK : K' = cK y) (hr : r.1 = y 0)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ K')] (hreg : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y) :
    IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade K') (generator K' r) ⧸
      Ideal.span {baseElement K' r r.1})
proof:
:= by
  subst hK
  have : r = rK y := Subtype.ext hr
  subst this
  exact isRegularRing_chart_quot y hreg hqr

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularRing_chartFamily_quot
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_chartFamily_quot {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [IsRegularRing S] (J : Ideal S)
    [IsRegularRing (S ⧸ J)] {m : ℕ} (y' : Fin m → S) (hI : J = Ideal.span (Set.range y'))
    (hw : IsWeaklyRegular S (List.ofFn y')) (hnzd : ∀ i, IsRegular (y' i)) (i : Fin m) :
    IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade J) (generatorOfFamily J y' hI i) ⧸
      Ideal.span {baseElement J ⟨y' i, hI.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ (y' i)})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by have := Fin.pos i; omega⟩
  have hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y' :=
    SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isQuasiregular_of_isWeaklyRegular (n + 1) y' hw
  have hqr' := hqr.comp_equiv (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i)
  have hK : J = cK (y' ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i) := by
    rw [hI]; congr 1
    rw [Set.range_comp, (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i).range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]
  have hr : (⟨y' i, hI.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ : J).1 =
      (y' ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i) 0 := by
    simp
  exact isRegularRing_chart_quot' (K' := J) ⟨y' i, hI.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
    (y' ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i) hK hr (by simpa using hnzd i) hqr'

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularAt_pullback_of_piece
statement:
theorem isRegularAt_pullback_of_piece {X B Z V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : B ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X)
    (φ : V ⟶ B) [IsOpenImmersion φ] (m : W ⟶ pullback f g) (a : W ⟶ V)
    (hl : IsPullback m a (pullback.fst f g) φ) (hW : IsRegularScheme W) (e : ((pullback f g : Scheme.{u}) : Type u))
    (he : (pullback.fst f g) e ∈ Set.range φ) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((pullback f g).presheaf.stalk e)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion m := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsOpenImmersion) hl.flip inferInstance
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := pullback.fst f g)
    (g := φ) e v hv.symm
  refine ?_
  have : m (hl.isoPullback.inv t) = e := by
    rw [← ht1, ← hl.isoPullback_inv_fst]
    rfl
  rw [← this]
  exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion m _ (hW _)

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.exists_piece
statement:
theorem exists_piece {X B Z V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : B ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X) (φ : V ⟶ B) (a : W ⟶ V)
    (b : W ⟶ Z) (hout : IsPullback b a g (φ ≫ f)) :
    ∃ m : W ⟶ pullback f g, IsPullback m a (pullback.fst f g) φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, IsPullback.of_right' hout (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g).flip⟩

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.le_of_mem_EAff
statement:
theorem le_of_mem_EAff {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (K : Ideal R) (e : EAff K) :
    K ≤ ((ReesBlowup.projection K) ((pullback.fst _ _ : EAff K ⟶ _) e)).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (ReesBlowup.projection K) ((pullback.fst _ _ : EAff K ⟶ _) e) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K))) ((pullback.snd _ _ : EAff K ⟶ _) e) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.condition]
  rw [hc]
  intro k hk
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk K k ∈ ((pullback.snd _ _ : EAff K ⟶ _) e).asIdeal
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hk]
  exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_EAff
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_EAff {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] (K : Ideal R)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ K)] : IsRegularScheme (EAff K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro e
  set z : ReesBlowup.scheme K := (pullback.fst _ _ : EAff K ⟶ _) e with hz
  have hKP : K ≤ ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal := le_of_mem_EAff K e
  set P : Ideal R := ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal with hP
  haveI : P.IsPrime := ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).isPrime
  set A := Localization.AtPrime P with hA
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing A := IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization P
  have hle : K.map (algebraMap R A) ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]; exact Ideal.map_mono hKP
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ K.map (algebraMap R A)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_quotient_localization K P hKP
  obtain ⟨g, hg, ys, -, hprop⟩ := SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_chart_regular_generators P A K hle
  obtain ⟨hKA, hwA⟩ := hprop P.primeCompl A (IsLocalization.map_units A ⟨g, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff.mpr hg⟩)
  have hmax : ∀ y ∈ ys, algebraMap R A y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    intro y hy
    apply hle
    rw [hKA]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hkill⟩ := exists_unit_killing_ann P ys hwA hmax
  have hh : g * u ∉ P := fun hm =>
    ((Ideal.IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem inferInstance).mp hm).elim hg hu
  letI S := Localization.Away (g * u)
  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap R S g) := by
    have := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S) (g * u)
    rw [map_mul] at this
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left this
  obtain ⟨hKS, hwS⟩ := hprop (Submonoid.powers (g * u)) S hunit
  haveI : IsRegularRing S := isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (A := R) (Submonoid.powers (g * u))
  haveI : IsRegularRing (S ⧸ K.map (algebraMap R S)) :=
    isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (A := R ⧸ K)
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ K) (Submonoid.powers (g * u)))
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_preimage_localised K (g * u) (S := S) z hh
  haveI := isOpenImmersion_localised K (g * u) (S := S)
  set y' : Fin ys.length → S := fun k => algebraMap R S (ys.get k) with hy'
  have hrange : Set.range y' = {x | x ∈ ys.map (algebraMap R S)} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_map, hy']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ys.get k, List.get_mem _ _, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp ha
      exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hI : K.map (algebraMap R S) = Ideal.span (Set.range y') := by
    rw [hKS, hrange]
  let 𝒰 := ReesBlowup.affineOpenCoverOfSpan (K.map (algebraMap R S)) y' hI
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := 𝒰.covers v
  let i := 𝒰.idx v
  have hw : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular S (List.ofFn y') := by
    have : List.ofFn y' = ys.map (algebraMap R S) := by
      calc List.ofFn y' = List.ofFn ((algebraMap R S) ∘ ys.get) := rfl
        _ = (List.ofFn ys.get).map (algebraMap R S) := List.map_ofFn.symm
        _ = ys.map (algebraMap R S) := by rw [List.ofFn_get]
    rw [this]; exact hwS
  have hnzd : ∀ k, IsRegular (y' k) := fun k =>
    isRegular_algebraMap_of_killing (S := S) (h := g * u) (g := g) (u := u) rfl
      (hkill _ (List.get_mem _ _))
  
  let J : Ideal S := K.map (algebraMap R S)
  let r : J := ⟨y' i, by rw [show J = Ideal.span (Set.range y') from hI]; exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  let f0 : Spec (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade J) (generator J r))) ⟶
      ReesBlowup.scheme J := 𝒰.f i
  let c : Spec (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade J) (generator J r))) ⟶
      ReesBlowup.scheme K := f0 ≫ schemeMapOfEq K (algebraMap R S) _ rfl
  let φ : R →+* HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade J) (generator J r) :=
    (baseRingHom J r).comp (algebraMap R S)
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion f0 := inferInstanceAs (IsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i))
  have hproj : f0 ≫ ReesBlowup.projection J = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom J r)) :=
    chartMap_projection J r
  have hc : c ≫ ReesBlowup.projection K = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) := by
    change (f0 ≫ schemeMapOfEq K (algebraMap R S) _ rfl) ≫ ReesBlowup.projection K = _
    rw [Category.assoc, schemeMapOfEq_comp_projection, ← Category.assoc, hproj, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hmap : K.map φ = Ideal.span {baseElement J r r.1} := by
    rw [← map_baseRingHom_eq_span_baseElement J r]
    exact (Ideal.map_map (algebraMap R S) (baseRingHom J r)).symm
  have hreg : IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade J) (generator J r) ⧸ K.map φ) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact isRegularRing_chartFamily_quot J y' hI hw hnzd i
  have hout := isPullback_quotient φ K
  rw [← hc] at hout
  obtain ⟨m, hl⟩ := exists_piece (ReesBlowup.projection K)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K))) c _ _ hout
  refine isRegularAt_pullback_of_piece _ _ c m _ hl ?_ e ?_
  · exact isRegularScheme_spec _
  · refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    change schemeMapOfEq K (algebraMap R S) _ rfl (𝒰.f (𝒰.idx v) q) = z
    rw [hq]
    exact hv

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_EGlobal
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_EGlobal (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hX : IsRegularScheme X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : IsRegularScheme I.subscheme) : IsRegularScheme (EGlobal X I)
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  have hb : (pullback.fst (toBase X I) I.subschemeι) e ∈ (⊤ : (blowup X I).Opens) := trivial
  rw [← iSup_opensRange_affineι X I] at hb
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hb
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(X, U.1) := isRegularRing_sections X hX U
  haveI : IsRegularRing (Γ(X, U.1) ⧸ I.ideal U) := isRegularRing_sections_quotient X I hI U
  have hab : affineι X I U ≫ toBase X I =
      ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ≫ U.2.fromSpec := by
    rw [← (isPullback_affine X I U).w]
    rfl
  have P1 : IsPullback (pullback.snd _ _ : EAff (I.ideal U) ⟶ _) (pullback.fst _ _)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U)))) (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U)) :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).flip
  have hout : IsPullback ((pullback.snd _ _ : EAff (I.ideal U) ⟶ _) ≫ I.subschemeCover.f U)
      (pullback.fst _ _ : EAff (I.ideal U) ⟶ _) I.subschemeι (affineι X I U ≫ toBase X I) := by
    rw [hab]
    exact P1.paste_horiz (isPullback_subschemeCover X I U)
  obtain ⟨m, hl⟩ := exists_piece (toBase X I) I.subschemeι (affineι X I U) _ _ hout
  exact isRegularAt_pullback_of_piece _ _ (affineι X I U) m _ hl
    (isRegularScheme_EAff (I.ideal U)) e hU

name: TOWERW.towerHyp_flagTower
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCoordinateSplitAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCoordinateSplitAddEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]

    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleCatOfHom_rTensor_eq_tensorHom
statement:
theorem moduleCatOfHom_rTensor_eq_tensorHom
    {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module R B]
    (f : A →ₗ[R] B) :
    ModuleCat.ofHom (f.rTensor Q) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R Q)
proof:
:= by
  change
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (f.rTensor Q) :
      ModuleCat.of R A ⊗ ModuleCat.of R Q ⟶
        ModuleCat.of R B ⊗ ModuleCat.of R Q) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
  intro a q
  rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul]
  rfl

name: STEPW.adamsQ_comm
statement:
theorem adamsQ_comm (hX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (j j' : ℕ) (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    adamsQ hX j (adamsQ hX j' x) = adamsQ hX j' (adamsQ hX j x)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ y : K0 X, adamsRingHom hX j (adamsRingHom hX j' y) =
      adamsRingHom hX j' (adamsRingHom hX j y) := by
    intro y
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
    · rfl
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j' with rfl | hj'
    · rfl
    have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun (adamsRingHom_comp hX hj hj') y
    have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (adamsRingHom_comp hX hj' hj) y
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2, mul_comm]
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c y =>
    show psiQ _ (psiQ _ (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y)) = psiQ _ (psiQ _ (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y))
    rw [psiQ_tmul, psiQ_tmul, psiQ_tmul, psiQ_tmul, hc]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: STEPW.hasFilt_one_tmul
statement:
theorem hasFilt_one_tmul (hX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hT : TowerHypSTEPW X)
    (x₀ : X) (r : K0 X) :
    HasFilt (adamsQ hX) (rankQ x₀) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] r)
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction X (fun r ↦ HasFilt (adamsQ hX) (rankQ x₀) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] r)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ r
  · rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero]; exact HasFilt.zero
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]; exact ha.add hb
  · intro a ha
    exact HasFilt.neg_tmul ha
  · intro F hF
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hX F hF
    exact (hasTower_classOf hX hT x₀ F r hr).hasFilt

name: STEPW.hasFilt_all
statement:
theorem hasFilt_all (hX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hT : TowerHypSTEPW X)
    (x₀ : X) (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) : HasFilt (adamsQ hX) (rankQ x₀) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact HasFilt.zero
  | tmul c r =>
    have := (hasFilt_one_tmul hX hT x₀ r).smul c
    rwa [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
  | add x y hx hy => exact hx.add hy

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi
statement: theorem counit_epi (F : X.Modules) : Epi (counitHom i F)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i
  have w := adj.right_triangle_components F
  haveI : IsSplitEpi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (adj.counit.app F)) :=
    ⟨⟨⟨adj.unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F), w⟩⟩⟩
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (adj.counit.app F)) := inferInstance
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).epi_of_epi_map (f := counitHom i F) this

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_projective
statement:
theorem exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_projective
    (hbase : ∀ T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules, T.IsFinitePresentation →
      ∃ P : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ P ∧ ∃ e : P ⟶ T, Epi e)
    (G : (space R n).Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : (space R n).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E ∧ ∃ e : E ⟶ G, Epi e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular_twist R n G
  let G' := moduleTwist R n G m
  haveI hG' : G'.IsFinitePresentation := CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n G m
  haveI := CohQ.ε_epi R n G' hm
  haveI := pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n G'
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0, e1, he1⟩ := hbase ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G')
    (pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n G')
  haveI := he1
  have hP := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (toSpec R n) _ hP0
  let L := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-m)
  have hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) L := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) L
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) L hL
  haveI : T.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape T
  let e0 : T.obj G' ≅ G :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) L G' ≪≫
      moduleTwistTwistIso R n G m (-m) 0 (by ring) ≪≫ Quillen.twistZeroIso R n G
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).map e1) := inferInstance
  refine ⟨T.obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj P0),
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) L _ hL hP,
    T.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).map e1 ≫ quillenCounit R n G') ≫ e0.hom, ?_⟩
  haveI : Epi (T.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).map e1 ≫ quillenCounit R n G')) :=
    inferInstance
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree
    (hbase : ∀ T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules, T.IsFinitePresentation →
      ∃ P : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ P ∧ ∃ e : P ⟶ T, Epi e)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space R n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : X.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree X E ∧ ∃ g : E ⟶ F, Epi g
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space R n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian R n
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite i F
  obtain ⟨E', hE', e, he⟩ :=
    exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_projective R n hbase ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F)
  haveI := he
  haveI := counit_epi i F
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E', pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global i _ hE',
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map e ≫ counitHom i F, ?_⟩
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map e) := inferInstance
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_free_spec
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_spec (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (T : (Spec A).Modules) [T.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ e : SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec A).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) ⟶ T,
      Epi e
proof:
:= by
  let G := affineFiniteGeneratingSections A T
  haveI : Finite G.I := inferInstance
  let f : G.I ≃ ULift.{u} (Fin (Nat.card G.I)) := (Finite.equivFin _).trans Equiv.ulift.symm
  let iso := (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := (Spec A).ringCatSheaf)).mapIso f.toIso
  haveI : Epi iso.inv := inferInstance
  exact ⟨Nat.card G.I, iso.inv ≫ G.π, epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi iso.inv) G.epi⟩

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_spec
statement:
theorem exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_spec (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)

proof:

statement:
theorem exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_noetherian
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space R n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : X.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree X E ∧ ∃ g : E ⟶ F, Epi g
proof:

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_field
statement:
theorem exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_field (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space K n) [IsClosedImmersion i]

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian_affine
proof:
:= by
  haveI : A.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  let GA := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj A).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let l : GA ⟶ GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.map f).1.app (.op ⊤)
  let I : ModuleCat R := kernel l
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj A) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation A
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GA :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ A).finitePresentation_iff.mpr inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R GA := inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R I :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective (kernel.ι l : I ⟶ GA).hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R I := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  have htilde : ((tilde.functor R).obj I).IsFinitePresentation := tilde_isFinitePresentation I
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT => tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology _
  letI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent A
  letI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent B
  let eA0 := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB0 := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj GA ≅ A := eA0
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj GB ≅ B := eB0
  let e : (tilde.functor R).obj I ≅ kernel f :=
    PreservesKernel.iso (tilde.functor R) l ≪≫
      kernel.mapIso _ _ eA eB (by
        dsimp only [eA, eB, eA0, eB0, GA, GB, l]
        exact ((tilde.adjunction (R := R)).counit.naturality f))
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e htilde

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Y.Opens))
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y) (fun V ↦ V.2) _ fun V ↦ ?_
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens)) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits' _
  letI : (G.obj A).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ A

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ringKrullDim Γ(space K n, coordinateOpen K n j) ≤ ((n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K : ℕ) :
      WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv K n j)]
  rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing]
  have : Nat.card (AffineChartIndex n j) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
    simp
  rw [this]
  have := M1.FiniteDimBase.ringKrullDim_le K
  calc ringKrullDim K + (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (M1.FiniteDimBase.d K : WithBot ℕ∞) + n :=
        add_le_add_left this _
    _ = ((n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by push_cast; ring

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_regular_cover
statement:
theorem exists_regular_cover {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space K n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    ∃ (C : X.OpenCover.{u}) (R : C.I₀ → CommRingCat.{u}), (∀ j, IsRegularRing (R j)) ∧
      ∃ _ : ∀ j, Spec (R j) ≅ C.X j, ∀ j, ringKrullDim (R j) ≤
        ((n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens := fun j => i ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen K n j.down
  have hU : IsOpenCover U := by
    have hD : ⨆ j : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)), coordinateOpen K n j.down = ⊤ := by
      simpa only [iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top K n
    refine top_le_iff.mp (fun x _ => ?_)
    have hx : i.base x ∈ (⨆ j : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)), coordinateOpen K n j.down) := by
      rw [hD]; trivial
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hx
    exact (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup).2 ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hA : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (U j) := fun j =>
    (coordinateOpen_isAffine K n j.down).preimage i
  refine ⟨Scheme.openCoverOfIsOpenCover X U hU, fun j => Γ(X, U j), fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact SheafSyzygyF10.isRegularRing_sections (hA j) hreg
  · refine ⟨fun j => (hA j).isoSpec.symm, fun j => ?_⟩
    have hsurj := Scheme.Hom.app_surjective i (coordinateOpen K n j.down)
      (coordinateOpen_isAffine K n j.down)
    exact (ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective (i.app (coordinateOpen K n j.down)).hom hsurj).trans
      (ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le K n j.down)

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_isSheafSyzygy
statement:
theorem exists_isSheafSyzygy {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (cover : ∀ F : X.Modules, F.IsFinitePresentation →
      ∃ E : X.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree X E ∧ ∃ g : E ⟶ F, Epi g) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation],
      ∃ Z : X.Modules, SheafSyzygyF10.IsSheafSyzygy Z F m
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro F _; exact ⟨F, ⟨Iso.refl F⟩⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro F _
    obtain ⟨E, hE, g, hg⟩ := cover F inferInstance
    haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE.isFinitePresentation
    haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
    haveI hk : (kernel g).IsFinitePresentation :=
      kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian g
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := ih (kernel g)
    exact ⟨Z, E, hE, g, hg, hk, hZ⟩

name: ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_syzygy_finiteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem exists_syzygy_finiteLocallyFree {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space K n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ Z : X.Modules, SheafSyzygyF10.IsSheafSyzygy Z F (n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree X Z
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := exists_isSheafSyzygy
    (fun G _ => exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_noetherian K n i G) (n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K) F
  obtain ⟨C, R, hR, e, hdim⟩ := exists_regular_cover K n i hreg
  haveI : ∀ j, IsRegularRing (R j) := hR
  exact ⟨Z, hZ, SheafSyzygyF10.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy C _ (fun j => R j) e hdim hZ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.G2HYPC.kahlerClass_eq_snd
statement: theorem kahlerClass_eq_snd : OMG.kahlerClass g n = (n + 1) • sndTwist g n - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := OMGB.kahler_baseChange g n
  have h1 : OMG.kahlerClass g n = pullbackK0RingHom (OMG.sndP g n)
      (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec k n))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k n) n)) := by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k n) n)) e
  rw [h1, SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.cotangent_classOf]
  simp only [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.G2HYPC.nsmul_sndTwist_sub
statement: theorem nsmul_sndTwist_sub : (n + 1) • (sndTwist g n - twistNeg g n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := OMGB.cotangentClass_eq_kahler g n
  rw [kahlerClass_eq_snd, cotangentClass] at h
  rw [smul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  exact (sub_left_inj.mp h).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_projectiveMap_structureRingHom_preimage
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_projectiveMap_structureRingHom_preimage
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (n : ℕ) (U : (space A n).Opens) (c : A) :
    (map φ n).app U
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space A n) (R := CommRingCat.of A) U c) =
      structureRingHom
        (X := space B n) (R := CommRingCat.of B)
        (map φ n ⁻¹ᵁ U) (φ c)
proof:
:= by
  let m := map φ n
  have hn :
      (space A n).presheaf.map U.leTop.op ≫ m.app U =
        m.appTop ≫
          (space B n).presheaf.map (m ⁻¹ᵁ U).leTop.op := by
    have h := m.naturality U.leTop.op
    exact h
  change
    m.app U
        ((space A n).presheaf.map U.leTop.op
          (globalSec (X := space A n) (R := CommRingCat.of A) c)) =
      (space B n).presheaf.map (m ⁻¹ᵁ U).leTop.op
        (globalSec (X := space B n) (R := CommRingCat.of B) (φ c))
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hn, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [projectiveMap_globalSec]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_sections_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_sections_smul
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (c : R)
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
        R Q n d p a (c • x) =
      c • projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
        R Q n d p a x
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let h :=
    preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
      (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n p a
  let f := M.presheaf.map (eqToHom h.symm).op
  change
    f.hom
        ((map (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n).app U
            (structureRingHom
              (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U c) • x) =
      structureRingHom
          (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S)
          (coordinateCechIntersection S n p a)
          (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q c) •
        f.hom x
  rw [projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_projectiveMap_structureRingHom_preimage]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  rw [structureRingHom_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_pushforwardCechBaseModuleLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_pushforwardCechBaseModuleLinearEquiv_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_pushforwardCechBaseModuleLinearEquiv R Q n d p a x =

    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d) p) :
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalTermLinearEquiv R Q n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R n
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d) p r x) =
      coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf
            (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d) p r
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalTermLinearEquiv R Q n d p x)
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  let M₀ := projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d
  let M₁ := projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d
  apply (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
    S n M₁ (p + 1)).injective
  funext a
  rw [projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalTermLinearEquiv_pi]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi]
  rw [projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalTermLinearEquiv_pi]
  change
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((M₀.presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op)
          (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M₀ p x
            (a ∘ r.succAbove))) =
      (M₁.presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom S n p r a).op)
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
          (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M₀ p x
            (a ∘ r.succAbove)))

    R Q n d p r a
      (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M₀ p x
        (a ∘ r.succAbove))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_fstTermLinearMap_apply

theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_fstTermLinearMap_apply

    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_fstTermLinearMap R Q n d p x =
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap
        R Q n d p).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ :=
    coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p
  apply e₁.injective
  funext a
  change
    e₁ (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_termProductLinearEquiv R Q n d p x).1 a =
      e₁
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap
          R Q n d p).hom x) a
  rw [projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_termProductLinearEquiv_fst]
  rw [projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_pushforwardCechBaseModuleLinearEquiv_apply]

  have h :=
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap_π
      R Q n d p a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_sndTermLinearMap_apply

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_finite_of_positive_dimension
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_finite_of_positive_dimension
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite R
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d < 0
  · letI : Subsingleton
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) 0) :=
      projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg
        R n hn d hd
    let e : (Fin 0 → R) ≃ₗ[R]
        CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) 0 :=
      LinearEquiv.ofSubsingleton _ _
    exact Module.Finite.equiv e
  · have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := le_of_not_gt hd
    rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hd0]
    exact projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_finite R n d.toNat

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechHomologyZero_finite
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechHomologyZero_finite
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite R
      ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).homology 0)
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex S n M
  letI : Module.Finite S
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj M) 0) := by
    dsimp only [M]
    exact projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_finite_of_positive_dimension
      S n hn d
  let eS := coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv S n M
  letI : Module.Finite S ↑(C.homology 0) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv eS.symm
  letI : Module.Finite R ↑(C.homology 0) :=
    Module.Finite.trans S ↑(C.homology 0)
  let eRestrict :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedHomologyLinearEquiv
      R Q n d 0
  letI : Module.Finite R
      ↑((projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedSquareZeroCechComplex
        R Q n d).homology 0) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv eRestrict.symm
  exact Module.Finite.equiv
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalComparisonHomologyLinearEquiv
      R Q n d 0).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleZeroCohomology_finite
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleZeroCohomology_finite
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite R
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
            (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  let H₀ :=
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)) 0
  let H₁ :=
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) 0
  let H₂ :=
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
          (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) 0
  let e : H₀ ≃ₗ[R] H₁ × H₂ :=
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardZeroCohomologyLinearEquiv
      R Q n d
  letI : Module.Finite R H₀ :=
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardZeroCohomology_finite
      R Q n hn d
  letI : Module.Finite R (H₁ × H₂) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv e
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
    (LinearMap.snd R H₁ H₂) (by
      intro y
      exact ⟨(0, y), rfl⟩)

name: SchemeKTheory.spec_g0T_pi_fin
statement:
theorem spec_g0T_pi_fin (d : ℕ) :
    EulerIndependence.g0T k (Fin d → k) = d • EulerIndependence.g0T k k
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_nsmul]
    exact EulerIndependence.g0ClassOf_isZero _ _ (EulerIndependence.tilde_isZero _)
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [EulerIndependence.g0T_congr k (Fin.consLinearEquiv k (fun _ : Fin (d + 1) ↦ k)).symm,
      EulerIndependence.g0T_prod, ih, succ_nsmul']

name: SchemeKTheory.spec_g0T_self_eq_one
statement:

    EulerIndependence.g0T k k = k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1
proof:
:= by
  change _ = k0ToG0 _ (k0ClassOf _ (tensorUnitSheaf _) (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _))
  rw [k0ToG0_classOf]

name: SchemeKTheory.spec_g0ClassOf_eq_eulerChar_smul
statement:
theorem spec_g0ClassOf_eq_eulerChar_smul (F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike _ F) :
    g0ClassOf _ F hF = Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k F • k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_eulerChar_eq_finrank_globalSections k F]
  let M := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj F).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation k M :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation F
  have h1 : g0ClassOf _ F hF = EulerIndependence.g0T k M :=
    g0ClassOf_iso _ _ (EulerIndependence.tildeIso F)
  let d := Module.finrank k M
  have h2 : EulerIndependence.g0T k M = EulerIndependence.g0T k (Fin d → k) :=
    EulerIndependence.g0T_congr k (Module.finBasis k M).equivFun
  rw [h1, h2, spec_g0T_pi_fin, spec_g0T_self_eq_one, natCast_zsmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.deg_comp_eq_eulerChar_of_deg_one
statement:
theorem deg_comp_eq_eulerChar_of_deg_one {CH : Type*} [CommRing CH]
    (ch : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) →+* CH) (chG : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) →+ CH)
    (hch : chG.comp (k0ToG0 _) = ch.toAddMonoidHom) (deg : CH →+ ℚ) (hdeg : deg 1 = 1) :
    deg.comp chG =
      (Int.castAddHom ℚ).comp (g0Euler k (fun F hF ↦ by
        letI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
        exact AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k F))
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  have hE : ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E = g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2 := rfl
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hE]
  have h1 : chG (k0ToG0 _ 1) = ch 1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hch 1
  rw [g0Euler_g0ClassOf, spec_g0ClassOf_eq_eulerChar_smul k E.1 E.2, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, h1,
    map_one, hdeg, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Int.coe_castAddHom]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.grr_relative_lci
statement:
theorem grr_relative_lci {r : ℕ} (C : RegularCover i.ker r)
    [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)]
    (x : K0 X) (w : K0 Y)
    (hw : k0ToG0 Y w = projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward (cover_rank (Y ↘ Spk k) hn)
      (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))) :

      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^ (n + 1))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.ch_fShriekCan_lci
statement:
theorem ch_fShriekCan_lci (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) {r : ℕ} (C : RegularCover i.ker r) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
                (n + 1 + 1)) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x)) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ x
  exact grr_relative_lci k hY hYreg (Nat.succ_pos n) i C x _
    (CAN.k0ToG0_fShriekCan_cover k hX hY hYreg f hf i hi x)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.tdTan_kahler_pullback'
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    tdTan k X (pullbackK0RingHom i
      (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
        (T1KG3.OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
          (T1KG3.OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1))))) =
      (tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
            (n + 1 + 1) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  have hK : pullbackK0RingHom i
      (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
        (T1KG3.OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
          (T1KG3.OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)))) =
      (n + 1 + 1) • pullbackK0RingHom i
        ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) - 1 := by
    rw [FIN.cover_kahlerClass]
    simp only [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one]
  have hcl : pullbackK0RingHom i
      ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) =
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
        ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
          ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))).isFiniteLocallyFree :=
    pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i _ _
  rw [hK, tdTan_sub, tdTan_nsmul, hcl, tdTanInv_one, mul_one,
    tdTan_pullback_twist (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)) (cover_hpos (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)) i k]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.grr_chow_lci_comp
statement:
theorem grr_chow_lci_comp (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) {r : ℕ} (C : RegularCover i.ker r) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_cover i C))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ x
  rw [ch_fShriekCan_lci k hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C x,
    tdTan_relCotangentVirtual_lci k hX hY i (conormal_hasConstantRank_of_cover i C)]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.grr_chow_lci
statement:

    (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) {r : ℕ} (C : RegularCover i.ker r) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan k X
            (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_cover i C))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  subst hi
  intro _ _ _ x

statement:
theorem rhs_independent_lci (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n n' : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f)
    (i' : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (hi' : i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).toBase = f)
    {r r' : ℕ} (C : RegularCover i.ker r) (C' : RegularCover i'.ker r') :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [i'.IsOver (Spk k)] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (x : K0 X),
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_cover i C))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (tdTan k X (relCotangentVirtual k i' (conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_cover i' C'))
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  intro _ _ _ _ x
  rw [← grr_chow_lci k hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C x, ← grr_chow_lci k hX hY hYreg f hf i' hi' C' x]

name: STEPW.ideal_pow_eig
statement:
theorem ideal_pow_eig (I : Ideal A) (φ : A →+* A) (j : ℕ)
    (h0 : ∀ c, φ c - c ∈ I) (h1 : ∀ x ∈ I, φ x - (j : A) * x ∈ I ^ 2) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ v ∈ I ^ m, φ v - (j : A) ^ m * v ∈ I ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro v _
    simpa using h0 v
  | succ m ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [pow_succ' I m] at hv
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on (C := fun v ↦ φ v - (j : A) ^ (m + 1) * v ∈ I ^ (m + 1 + 1))
      hv (fun x hx y hy ↦ ?_) (fun a b ha hb ↦ ?_)
    ·
      have e := h1 x hx
      have f := ih y hy
      have hφy : φ y ∈ I ^ m := by
        have : φ y = (φ y - (j : A) ^ m * y) + (j : A) ^ m * y := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ m) f)
          (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hy)
      have key : φ (x * y) - (j : A) ^ (m + 1) * (x * y) =
          (φ x - (j : A) * x) * φ y + ((j : A) * x) * (φ y - (j : A) ^ m * y) := by
        rw [map_mul]; ring
      rw [key]
      have h2 : I ^ (m + 1 + 1) = I ^ 2 * I ^ m := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
      have h3 : I ^ (m + 1 + 1) = I * I ^ (m + 1) := by rw [pow_succ' I (m + 1)]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [h2]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul e hφy
      · rw [h3]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx) f
    · have : φ (a + b) - (j : A) ^ (m + 1) * (a + b) =
          (φ a - (j : A) ^ (m + 1) * a) + (φ b - (j : A) ^ (m + 1) * b) := by
        rw [map_add]; ring
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ ha hb

name: STEPW.one_add_pow_eq
statement: theorem one_add_pow_eq (b : A) (j : ℕ) : ∃ g : A, (1 + b) ^ j = 1 + (j : A) * b + b ^ 2 * g
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨g + j + b * g, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ, hg]
    push_cast
    ring

name: STEPW.gen_inputs
statement:
theorem gen_inputs (hφ : ∀ i, φ (b i) = (1 + b i) ^ j - 1)
    (hdec : ∀ c : A, ∃ n : ℤ, ∃ y ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range b), c = (n : A) + y) :
    (∀ c, φ c - c ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range b)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range b), φ x - (j : A) * x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range b) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  set I := Ideal.span (Set.range b) with hI
  have hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ I := fun i ↦ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  
  have hφI : ∀ y ∈ I, φ y ∈ I := by
    intro y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [hφ i]
      have : (1 + b i) ^ j - 1 = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, (1 + b i) ^ k) * b i := by
        have := geom_sum_mul (1 + b i) j
        simpa using this.symm
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hb i)
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx
  have h0 : ∀ c, φ c - c ∈ I := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨n, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hdec c
    have : φ ((n : A) + y) - ((n : A) + y) = φ y - y := by rw [map_add, map_intCast]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (hφI y hy) hy
  refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := one_add_pow_eq (b i) j
    rw [hφ i, hg]
    have : 1 + (j : A) * b i + b i ^ 2 * g - 1 - (j : A) * b i = b i ^ 2 * g := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hb i) 2)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    have : φ (x + y) - (j : A) * (x + y) = (φ x - (j : A) * x) + (φ y - (j : A) * y) := by
      rw [map_add]; ring
    rw [this]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x hxI hx =>
    have key : φ (c • x) - (j : A) * (c • x) =
        φ c * (φ x - (j : A) * x) + (j : A) * ((φ c - c) * x) := by
      rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul]; ring
    rw [key]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)
    rw [pow_two]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (h0 c) hxI

name: STEPW.mem_F
statement: theorem mem_F {m : ℕ} {t : T} : t ∈ F a m ↔ ∃ h : t ∈ Asub a, (⟨t, h⟩ : Asub a) ∈ Iid a ^ m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    exact ⟨⟨t, h⟩, hh, rfl⟩

name: STEPW.F_anti
statement: theorem F_anti (m : ℕ) : F a (m + 1) ≤ F a m
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (mem_F a).mp ht
  exact (mem_F a).mpr ⟨h, Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ m) hh⟩

name: STEPW.mem_F_zero
statement: theorem mem_F_zero {t : T} : t ∈ F a 0 ↔ t ∈ Asub a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_F]
  simp

name: STEPW.Iid_isNilpotent
statement: theorem Iid_isNilpotent [Finite ι] (hnil : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (a i)) : IsNilpotent (Iid a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical (Submodule.fg_span (Set.toFinite (Set.range (gen a))))]
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnil i
  exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext (by simpa [gen] using hn)⟩

name: STEPW.F_one_nil
statement:
theorem F_one_nil [Finite ι] (hnil : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (a i)) {t : T} (ht : t ∈ F a 1) :
    IsNilpotent t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (mem_F a).mp ht
  rw [pow_one] at hh
  have hle : Iid a ≤ nilradical (Asub a) := by
    rw [← Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical (Submodule.fg_span (Set.toFinite (Set.range (gen a))))]
    exact Iid_isNilpotent hnil
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hle hh
  exact ⟨n, by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hn⟩

name: STEPW.F_bot
statement: theorem F_bot [Finite ι] (hnil : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (a i)) : ∃ M, F a (M + 1) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Iid_isNilpotent hnil
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (mem_F a).mp ht
  have := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n) hh
  rw [hn] at this
  have h0 : (⟨t, h⟩ : Asub a) = 0 := by simpa using this
  have : t = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h0
  rw [this]; exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _

name: STEPW.Asub_dec
statement:
theorem Asub_dec {t : T} (ht : t ∈ Asub a) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, ∃ y : Asub a, y ∈ Iid a ∧ t = (n : T) + y.1
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Subring.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨0, gen a i, Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩, by simp [gen]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, Submodule.zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | one => exact ⟨1, 0, Submodule.zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨n, u, hu, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨m, v, hv, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨n + m, u + v, Submodule.add_mem _ hu hv, by push_cast; ring⟩
  | neg x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, u, hu, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨-n, -u, Submodule.neg_mem _ hu, by push_cast; ring⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨n, u, hu, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨m, v, hv, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨n * m, (n : Asub a) * v + (m : Asub a) * u + u * v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hv)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hu)) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hu)
    · push_cast; ring

name: STEPW.F_zero_dec
statement: theorem F_zero_dec {t : T} (ht : t ∈ F a 0) : ∃ n : ℤ, t - (n : T) ∈ F a 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Asub_dec ((mem_F_zero a).mp ht)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact (mem_F a).mpr ⟨y.2, by simpa using hy⟩

name: STEPW.phi_mem_Asub
statement:
theorem phi_mem_Asub (φ : T →+* T) (hφ : ∀ i, φ (a i) ∈ Asub a) {x : T} (hx : x ∈ Asub a) :
    φ x ∈ Asub a
proof:
:= by
  have : Asub a ≤ (Asub a).comap φ := by
    rw [Subring.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hφ i
  exact this hx

name: STEPW.F_eig
statement:
theorem F_eig (φ : T →+* T) (j : ℕ) (hφ : ∀ i, φ (a i) = (1 + a i) ^ j - 1) {m : ℕ} {t : T}
    (ht : t ∈ F a m) : φ t - (j : T) ^ m * t ∈ F a (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ i, φ (a i) ∈ Asub a := by
    intro i
    rw [hφ i]
    exact Subring.sub_mem _ (Subring.pow_mem _ (Subring.add_mem _ (Subring.one_mem _)
      (Subring.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self i))) _) (Subring.one_mem _)
  let φA : Asub a →+* Asub a := φ.restrict (Asub a) (Asub a) fun x hx ↦ phi_mem_Asub φ hmem hx
  have hφA : ∀ i, φA (gen a i) = (1 + gen a i) ^ j - 1 := by
    intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [φA, gen, hφ i]
  have hdec : ∀ c : Asub a, ∃ n : ℤ, ∃ y ∈ Iid a, c = (n : Asub a) + y := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨n, y, hy, hc⟩ := Asub_dec c.2
    exact ⟨n, y, hy, Subtype.ext (by simpa using hc)⟩
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := gen_inputs (gen a) φA j hφA hdec
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (mem_F a).mp ht
  have key := ideal_pow_eig (Iid a) φA j h0 h1 m _ hh
  have hz : φ t - (j : T) ^ m * t = (φA ⟨t, h⟩ - (j : Asub a) ^ m * ⟨t, h⟩ : Asub a).1 := by
    simp [φA]
  rw [hz]
  exact (mem_F a).mpr ⟨_, key⟩

name: STEPW.F_rank
statement: theorem F_rank (ρ : T →+* ℤ) (hρ : ∀ i, ρ (a i) = 0) {t : T} (ht : t ∈ F a 1) : ρ t = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (mem_F a).mp ht
  rw [pow_one] at hh
  have : Iid a ≤ RingHom.ker (ρ.comp (Asub a).subtype) := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hρ i
  exact this hh

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.derivedPushforward_acyclic
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_acyclic [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hv : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (K0Basis.higher C F (q + 1))) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (g0ClassOf C.scheme F hF.isFinitePresentation) =
      k0ToG0 X (K0Basis.pushClass C F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf,
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum_of_concentrated]
  · have hp := pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos F hF hv
    rw [K0Basis.pushClass_eq C F hp, k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso C.toBase F)
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, i = q + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) _ (hv q)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.canonical_acyclic
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := K0Basis.twist_pullback_unit_iso C t
  exact K0Basis.higher_isZero_of_iso C e (q + 1)
    (K0Basis.pullback_twist_acyclic C hpos hE _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X) t ht q)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.derivedPushforward_pullback_mul_canonical
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_pullback_mul_canonical [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < r) (b : K0 X) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos b * C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class j)) =
      b • projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class j))
proof:
:= by
  let L : K0 X →+ G0 X :=
    (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank).comp
      ((k0ToG0 C.scheme).comp ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class j)).comp
        (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos).toAddMonoidHom))
  let R : K0 X →+ G0 X :=
    (k0ActG0 X).flip (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class j)))
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    have hO := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (j : ℤ)
    have hOpush := K0Basis.pushforward_canonical_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos hE (j : ℤ)
      (by omega)
    have hOacyc := canonical_acyclic C hpos hE (j : ℤ) (by omega)
    change projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (k0ToG0 C.scheme
        (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) *
          k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (j : ℤ)) hO)) =
      k0ActG0 X (k0ClassOf X V hV) (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (j : ℤ)) hO)))
    rw [K0Basis.pb_mul_classOf C hpos V hV _ hO, k0ToG0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf,
      derivedPushforward_acyclic C hpos hrank
        (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (j : ℤ)))
        (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) hO)
        (fun q ↦ K0Basis.pullback_twist_acyclic C hpos hE V hV (j : ℤ) (by omega) q),
      derivedPushforward_acyclic C hpos hrank _ hO hOacyc,
      K0Basis.pushClass_pullback_tensor C V hV _ hOpush, ← smul_def, k0ToG0_mul]
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 X →+ G0 X ↦ f b) hLR

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.derivedPushforward_projectionFormula_K0
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_projectionFormula_K0 [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (y : K0 X) (w : K0 C.scheme) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos y * w)) =
      y • projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (k0ToG0 C.scheme w)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  let bs := C.projectiveBundleK0Basis hpos hr hE
  have hw : w = ∑ i : Fin r, C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (bs.repr w i) *
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← bs.sum_repr w]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, C.projectiveBundleK0Basis_apply hpos hr hE, K0Basis.z_pow C hpos]
    rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [hw]
  conv_rhs => rw [hw]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul,
    derivedPushforward_pullback_mul_canonical C hpos hE hrank i i.isLt,
    derivedPushforward_pullback_mul_canonical C hpos hE hrank i i.isLt, mul_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.cover_hpos
statement: theorem cover_hpos (n : ℕ) : ∀ i, Nonempty ((cover g n).basisIndex i)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ ⟨ULift.up 0⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.cover_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem cover_hasConstantRank (n : ℕ) :
    HasConstantRank Y (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.FreeM Y (J.{u} n)) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasConstantRank_free_type Y (J.{u} n)
  have hc : Nat.card (J.{u} n) = n + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr Equiv.ulift]; simp
  rw [hc] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.coverIso_inv_toBase
statement:
theorem coverIso_inv_toBase (n : ℕ) :
    (coverIso g n).inv ≫ (cover g n).toBase = pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (coverIso g n).hom ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n) = (cover g n).toBase :=
    D35.freeBundleIso_hom_fst (Equiv.ulift : J.{u} n ≃ Fin (n + 1)) g (cover g n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.projectiveBundlePullbackK0_cover_apply
statement:
theorem projectiveBundlePullbackK0_cover_apply (n : ℕ) (y : K0 Y) :
    (cover g n).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (cover_hpos g n) y = pullbackK0 (cover g n).toBase y
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundlePullbackK0]
  letI : Flat (cover g n).toBase := (cover g n).toBase_flat (cover_hpos g n)
  rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.piShriek_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem piShriek_projectionFormula {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (resP : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (y : K0 Y) (z : G0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    piShriek g hn (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y • z) = y • piShriek g hn z
proof:
:= by
  set e := coverIso g n with he
  have hz : z = k0ToG0 _ (resP.res z) :=
    (congrArg (fun φ : G0 _ →+ G0 _ => φ z) resP.right).symm
  set w0 := resP.res z
  haveI : Flat e.hom := inferInstance
  have hpush : finitePushforward e.inv z = k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 e.hom w0) := by
    rw [hz, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0, ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv]
  have hfst := coverIso_inv_toBase g n
  have hA : finitePushforward e.inv (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y • z) =
      pullbackK0 (cover g n).toBase y • finitePushforward e.inv z := by
    rw [← finitePushforward_projectionFormula e.inv z (pullbackK0 (cover g n).toBase y),
      pullbackK0_comp_apply]
    rw [hfst]
  have hB := derivedPushforward_projectionFormula_K0 (cover g n) (cover_hpos g n)
    (Nat.succ_pos n) (cover_hasConstantRank (Y := Y) n) (cover_rank g hn) y (pullbackK0 e.hom w0)
  change (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
      (cover_rank g hn)) (finitePushforward e.inv _) = y • (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
      (cover_rank g hn)) (finitePushforward e.inv z)
  rw [hA, hpush, ← k0ToG0_mul, ← projectiveBundlePullbackK0_cover_apply g n y]
  exact hB

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.piShriek0_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem piShriek0_projectionFormula (y : K0 Y) (z : G0 (pullback g (toSpec k 0))) :
    piShriek0 g (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k 0)) y • z) = y • piShriek0 g z
proof:
:=
  finitePushforward_projectionFormula _ z y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.piShriekAll_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem piShriekAll_projectionFormula (n : ℕ)
    (resP : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (y : K0 Y) (z : G0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    piShriekAll g n (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y • z) =
      y • piShriekAll g n z
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact piShriek0_projectionFormula g y z
  | succ m => exact piShriek_projectionFormula g (Nat.succ_pos m) resP y z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.fShriekG0All_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem fShriekG0All_projectionFormula (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (resP : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (y : K0 Y) (x : G0 X) :
    fShriekG0All g n i (pullbackK0 (i ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y • x) =
      y • fShriekG0All g n i x
proof:
:= by
  change piShriekAll g n (finitePushforward i _) = y • piShriekAll g n (finitePushforward i x)
  rw [← pullbackK0_comp_apply, closedImmersion_projectionFormula]
  exact piShriekAll_projectionFormula g n resP y _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.res_smul
statement: theorem res_smul (y : K0 Y) (u : G0 Y) : resY.res (y • u) = y * resY.res u
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 Y) := by
    intro a b h
    have := congrArg resY.res h
    simpa [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, resY.left] using this
  apply hinj
  have h1 : ∀ v : G0 Y, k0ToG0 Y (resY.res v) = v := fun v ↦
    congrArg (fun φ : G0 Y →+ G0 Y => φ v) resY.right
  rw [h1, k0ToG0_mul, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.fShriekK0All_succ
statement:
theorem fShriekK0All_succ (m : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k (m + 1)))
    [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    fShriekK0All g resY (m + 1) i = fShriekK0 resY g (Nat.succ_pos m) i
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.fShriekK0All_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem fShriekK0All_projectionFormula (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (resP : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (y : K0 Y) (x : K0 X) :
    fShriekK0All g resY n i (pullbackK0 (i ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y * x) =
      y * fShriekK0All g resY n i x
proof:
:= by
  change resY.res (fShriekG0All g n i (k0ToG0 X (_ * x))) =
    y * resY.res (fShriekG0All g n i (k0ToG0 X x))
  rw [k0ToG0_mul, fShriekG0All_projectionFormula g n i resP, res_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.fShriekK0PI_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem fShriekK0PI_projectionFormula (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (y : K0 Y) (x : K0 X) :
    fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i (pullbackK0 (i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) y * x) =
      y * fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x
proof:
:=
  fShriekK0All_projectionFormula _ _ n i (resProd hY hreg n) y x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.piShriekAll_projectionFormula_PI
statement:
theorem piShriekAll_projectionFormula_PI (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (n : ℕ) (y : K0 Y) (z : G0 (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))) :
    piShriekAll (Y ↘ Spk k) n (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) y • z) =
      y • piShriekAll (Y ↘ Spk k) n z
proof:
:=
  piShriekAll_projectionFormula _ n (resProd hY hreg n) y z
