name: B4.addCharW_add
statement:
theorem addCharW_add (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x y : K) :
    addCharW W D f (x + y) = addCharW W D f x + addCharW W D f y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharW, powSumW_add, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: B4.addCharW_sub
statement:
theorem addCharW_sub (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x y : K) :
    addCharW W D f (x - y) = addCharW W D f x - addCharW W D f y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharW, powSumW_sub, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: B4.addCharW_zero
statement: theorem addCharW_zero (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : addCharW W D f (0 : K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [addCharW, powSumW]

name: B4.addCharW_series_add
statement:
theorem addCharW_series_add (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) :
    addCharW W D (f + g) x = addCharW W D f x + addCharW W D g x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharW, map_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: B4.addCharW_series_sub
statement:
theorem addCharW_series_sub (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) :
    addCharW W D (f - g) x = addCharW W D f x - addCharW W D g x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharW, map_sub, sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: B4.psi_pr
statement:
theorem psi_pr (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (k : ℕ) (x : K) :
    psi (pr W k x) = (j : ℚ) ^ k • pr W k x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : D < k
  · rw [pr_eq_zero_of_bound H hk, map_zero, smul_zero]
  · exact H.psi_eq (pr_mem k x)

name: B4.psi_powSumW
statement:
theorem psi_powSumW (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (k : ℕ) (x : K) :
    psi (powSumW W k x) = (j : ℚ) ^ k • powSumW W k x
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSumW, map_rat_smul, psi_pr H, smul_comm]

name: B4.psi_addCharW
statement:
theorem psi_addCharW (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) :
    psi (addCharW W D f x) = addCharW W D (rescale (j : ℚ) f) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharW, map_sum, map_rat_smul, psi_powSumW H, coeff_rescale]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: B4.pr_zero_addCharW
statement: theorem pr_zero_addCharW (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) : pr W 0 (addCharW W D f x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addCharW, powSumW, map_sum, map_rat_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
  have hk1 : k ≠ 0 := by have := (mem_Icc.1 hk).1; omega
  rw [pr_of_mem_ne (pr_mem k x) (Ne.symm hk1), smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: B4.addCharW_mem_Fil
statement: theorem addCharW_mem_Fil (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) : addCharW W D f x ∈ Fil W 1
proof:
:=
  Fil_one_iff.2 (pr_zero_addCharW f x)

name: B4.addCharW_nilp
statement:
theorem addCharW_nilp (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) :
    (addCharW W D f x) ^ (D + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  pow_succ_eq_zero H (addCharW_mem_Fil f x)

name: B4.isNilpotent_addCharW
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_addCharW (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) :
    IsNilpotent (addCharW W D f x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨D + 1, addCharW_nilp H f x⟩

name: B4.ToddW_zero
statement: theorem ToddW_zero : ToddW W D (0 : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ToddW, addCharW_zero, IsNilpotent.exp_zero]

name: B4.ToddW_add
statement:
theorem ToddW_add (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x y : K) :
    ToddW W D (x + y) = ToddW W D x * ToddW W D y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ToddW, ToddW, ToddW, addCharW_add,
    IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) (isNilpotent_addCharW H _ x)
      (isNilpotent_addCharW H _ y)]

name: B4.ThetaNormW_add
statement:
theorem ThetaNormW_add (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x y : K) :
    ThetaNormW W j D (x + y) = ThetaNormW W j D x * ThetaNormW W j D y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ThetaNormW, ThetaNormW, ThetaNormW, addCharW_add,
    IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) (isNilpotent_addCharW H _ x)
      (isNilpotent_addCharW H _ y)]

name: B4.ThetaW_add
statement:
theorem ThetaW_add (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x y : K) (m n : ℕ) :
    ThetaW W j D (x + y) (m + n) = ThetaW W j D x m * ThetaW W j D y n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ThetaW, ThetaW, ThetaW, ThetaNormW_add H, pow_add]
  ring

name: B4.ToddW_mul_ToddW_neg
statement:
theorem ToddW_mul_ToddW_neg (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) :
    ToddW W D x * ToddW W D (-x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := ToddW_add H x (-x)
  rw [add_neg_cancel, ToddW_zero] at this
  exact this.symm

name: B4.ToddW_sub
statement:
theorem ToddW_sub (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x y : K) :
    ToddW W D (x - y) * ToddW W D y = ToddW W D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ToddW_add H, sub_add_cancel]

name: B4.ThetaNormW_sub
statement:
theorem ThetaNormW_sub (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x y : K) :
    ThetaNormW W j D (x - y) * ThetaNormW W j D y = ThetaNormW W j D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ThetaNormW_add H, sub_add_cancel]

name: B4.psi_exp_of_nilp
statement:
theorem psi_exp_of_nilp (psi : K →+* K) {a : K} {N : ℕ} (h : a ^ (N + 1) = 0) :
    psi (IsNilpotent.exp a) = IsNilpotent.exp (psi a)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (psi a) ^ (N + 1) = 0 := by rw [← map_pow, h, map_zero]
  rw [TOWERW.exp_eq_ev h, TOWERW.exp_eq_ev h', TOWERW.map_ev]

name: B4.psi_ToddW
statement:
theorem psi_ToddW (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) :
    psi (ToddW W D x) = IsNilpotent.exp (addCharW W D (rescale (j : ℚ) logTd) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ToddW, psi_exp_of_nilp psi (addCharW_nilp H logTd x), psi_addCharW H]

name: B4.ThetaNormW_mul_psi_ToddW
statement:
theorem ThetaNormW_mul_psi_ToddW (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) :
    ThetaNormW W j D x * psi (ToddW W D x) = ToddW W D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [psi_ToddW H, ThetaNormW, ToddW,
    ← IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) (isNilpotent_addCharW H _ x)
      (isNilpotent_addCharW H _ x), ← addCharW_series_add, sub_add_cancel]

name: B4.ThetaW_mul_psi_ToddW
statement:
theorem ThetaW_mul_psi_ToddW (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) (n : ℕ) :
    ThetaW W j D x n * psi (ToddW W D x) = algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ n * ToddW W D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ThetaW, mul_assoc, ThetaNormW_mul_psi_ToddW H]

name: B4.pr_exp
statement:
theorem pr_exp (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ W 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ D) :
    pr W k (IsNilpotent.exp a) = ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • a ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hn := pow_succ_eq_zero H (Fil_of_mem ha le_rfl)
  rw [TOWERW.exp_eq_ev hn, ev_eq_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · rw [map_smul, pr_of_mem_same (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded k ha), coeff_exp]
    simp
  · intro m _ hmk
    rw [map_smul, pr_of_mem_ne (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded m ha) (Ne.symm hmk),
      smul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk)) h

name: B4.pr_zero_split
statement:
theorem pr_zero_split (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) :
    pr W 0 (∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i)) = (Fintype.card ι : ℚ) • (1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
    rw [pr_exp H (ha i) (Nat.zero_le D)]]
  simp [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ]

name: B4.powSumW_split
statement:
theorem powSumW_split (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ D) : powSumW W k (∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i)) = ∑ i, a i ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [powSumW, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [pr_exp H (ha i) hk, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_smul]

name: B4.ev_eq_sum_Icc
statement:
theorem ev_eq_sum_Icc (D : ℕ) (a : K) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hf : coeff 0 f = 0) :
    ev D a f = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 D, coeff k f • a ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_eq_sum]
  have : range (D + 1) = insert 0 (Icc 1 D) := by
    ext m; simp only [mem_range, mem_insert, mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [this, Finset.sum_insert (by simp), hf, zero_smul, zero_add]

name: B4.addCharW_split
statement:
theorem addCharW_split (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1)
    (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hf : coeff 0 f = 0) :
    addCharW W D f (∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i)) = ∑ i, ev D (a i) f
proof:
:= by
  unfold addCharW
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by
    rw [powSumW_split H a ha (mem_Icc.1 hk).2]]
  simp_rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (ev_eq_sum_Icc D (a i) f hf).symm

name: B4.exp_finset_sum
statement:
theorem exp_finset_sum {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (b : α → K)
    (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, IsNilpotent (b i)) :
    IsNilpotent.exp (∑ i ∈ s, b i) = ∏ i ∈ s, IsNilpotent.exp (b i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.prod_insert hi,
      IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) (hb i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
        (isNilpotent_sum (fun j hj => hb j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))),
      ih (fun j hj => hb j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))]

name: B4.isUnit_exp
statement: theorem isUnit_exp {b : K} (hb : IsNilpotent b) : IsUnit (IsNilpotent.exp b)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (IsNilpotent.exp (-b)) ?_
  rw [← IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) hb hb.neg, add_neg_cancel,
    IsNilpotent.exp_zero]

name: B4.exp_ev_logTd
statement:
theorem exp_ev_logTd {a : K} {D : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    IsNilpotent.exp (ev D a logTd) = Td D a
proof:
:= by
  have hy : (ev D a (Tdser - 1)) ^ (D + 1) = 0 :=
    TOWERW.pow_ev_eq_zero h constantCoeff_Tdser_sub_one
  have e : ev D a logTd = TOWERW.logOnePlus (ev D a (Tdser - 1)) := by
    rw [logTd, TOWERW.ev_subst h constantCoeff_Tdser_sub_one, TOWERW.logOnePlus_eq_ev hy]
  rw [e, TOWERW.exp_logOnePlus ⟨D + 1, hy⟩, TOWERW.ev_sub h, ev_one]
  simp [Td]

name: B4.isNilpotent_ev_logTd
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_ev_logTd {a : K} {D : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    IsNilpotent (ev D a logTd)
proof:
:=
  ⟨D + 1, TOWERW.pow_ev_eq_zero h constantCoeff_logTd⟩

name: B4.th_mul_Td_smul
statement:
theorem th_mul_Td_smul (j : ℕ) {a : K} {D : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    th j D a * Td D ((j : ℚ) • a) = algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) * Td D a
proof:
:= by
  have h4 := congrArg (ev D a) (Theta_mul_rescale_Tdser j)
  rw [ev_mul h, ev_mul h, ev_C, TOWERW.ev_rescale] at h4
  exact h4

name: B4.ToddW_split
statement:
theorem ToddW_split (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) :
    ToddW W D (∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i)) = ∏ i, Td D (a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ToddW, addCharW_split H a ha logTd coeff_zero_logTd,
    exp_finset_sum _ _ (fun i _ => isNilpotent_ev_logTd (pow_succ_eq_zero H (Fil_of_mem (ha i) le_rfl)))]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ =>
    exp_ev_logTd (pow_succ_eq_zero H (Fil_of_mem (ha i) le_rfl))

name: B4.th_eq_exp
statement:
theorem th_eq_exp (j : ℕ) {a : K} {D : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    th j D a = algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) *
      IsNilpotent.exp (ev D a (logTd - rescale (j : ℚ) logTd))
proof:
:= by
  have hja : ((j : ℚ) • a) ^ (D + 1) = 0 := by rw [smul_pow, h, smul_zero]
  have e1 : ev D a (logTd - rescale (j : ℚ) logTd) =
      ev D a logTd - ev D ((j : ℚ) • a) logTd := by
    rw [TOWERW.ev_sub h, TOWERW.ev_rescale]
  have hn1 := isNilpotent_ev_logTd h
  have hn2 := isNilpotent_ev_logTd hja
  have hu : IsUnit (IsNilpotent.exp (ev D ((j : ℚ) • a) logTd)) := isUnit_exp hn2
  have key : th j D a * Td D ((j : ℚ) • a) = algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) * Td D a :=
    th_mul_Td_smul j h
  rw [← exp_ev_logTd hja, ← exp_ev_logTd h] at key
  refine hu.mul_right_cancel ?_
  rw [key, e1, mul_assoc, ← IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) (Commute.isNilpotent_sub (Commute.all _ _) hn1 hn2) hn2,
    sub_add_cancel]

name: B4.ThetaW_split
statement:
theorem ThetaW_split (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) :
    ThetaW W j D (∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i)) (Fintype.card ι) = ∏ i, th j D (a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : coeff 0 (logTd - rescale (j : ℚ) logTd) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, coeff_zero_logTd, coeff_zero_rescale _ _ coeff_zero_logTd, sub_zero]
  have hnil : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (ev D (a i) (logTd - rescale (j : ℚ) logTd)) := fun i =>
    ⟨D + 1, TOWERW.pow_ev_eq_zero (pow_succ_eq_zero H (Fil_of_mem (ha i) le_rfl))
      (by rw [map_sub, constantCoeff_logTd, constantCoeff_rescale', constantCoeff_logTd, sub_zero])⟩
  rw [ThetaW, ThetaNormW, addCharW_split H a ha _ hc, exp_finset_sum _ _ (fun i _ => hnil i),
    ← Finset.card_univ, ← Finset.prod_const, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ =>
    (th_eq_exp j (pow_succ_eq_zero H (Fil_of_mem (ha i) le_rfl))).symm

name: B4.prod_th_psi_Td_intrinsic
statement:
theorem prod_th_psi_Td_intrinsic (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) :
    (∏ i, th j D (a i)) * psi (∏ i, Td D (a i)) =
      algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ Fintype.card ι * ∏ i, Td D (a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ThetaW_split H a ha, ← ToddW_split H a ha]
  exact ThetaW_mul_psi_ToddW H _ _

name: B4.split_E1_shape
statement:
theorem split_E1_shape (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) (hb : ∀ k, b k ∈ W 1) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : Fintype.card ι = d + Fintype.card κ) :
    ∃ t s : K, t * ∏ i, th j D (a i) = ∏ k, th j D (b k) ∧ s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t ∧
      pr W 0 s = 1 ∧
      s = ThetaNormW W j D (∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (b k) - ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set xa : K := ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (a i) with hxa
  set xb : K := ∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (b k) with hxb
  have hj0 : (j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by have := H.hj; positivity
  refine ⟨((j : ℚ) ^ d)⁻¹ • ThetaNormW W j D (xb - xa), ThetaNormW W j D (xb - xa), ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rw [← ThetaW_split H a ha, ← ThetaW_split H b hb, ThetaW, ThetaW, ← hxa, ← hxb, hd,
      Algebra.smul_def, ← ThetaNormW_sub H xb xa]
    have : algebraMap ℚ K (((j : ℚ) ^ d)⁻¹) * (algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ)) ^ (d + Fintype.card κ) =
        algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ Fintype.card κ := by
      rw [← map_pow, ← map_mul, ← map_pow]
      congr 1
      rw [pow_add]; field_simp
    linear_combination (ThetaNormW W j D (xb - xa) * ThetaNormW W j D xa) * this
  · rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hj0), one_smul]
  · have hy := addCharW_mem_Fil (W := W) (D := D)
      (logTd - rescale (j : ℚ) logTd) (xb - xa)
    rw [ThetaNormW, TOWERW.exp_eq_ev (addCharW_nilp H _ _), pr_zero_ev H hy, constantCoeff_exp,
      one_smul]

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.kahlerMap_smul
statement:
theorem kahlerMap_smul {R A R' A' : CommRingCat.{u}} {φ : R ⟶ A} {φ' : R' ⟶ A'}
    {g : R ⟶ R'} {g' : A ⟶ A'} (h : g ≫ φ' = φ ≫ g')
    (a : A) (ω : CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential φ) :
    CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map h (a • ω) =
      g' a • (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map h ω : CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential φ')
proof:
:=
  (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map h).hom.map_smul a ω

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.inverseRingSquare
proof:
:= by
  calc
    eR.inv ≫ φ = eR.inv ≫ (φ ≫ eA.hom) ≫ eA.inv := by simp
    _ = eR.inv ≫ (eR.hom ≫ φ') ≫ eA.inv := by rw [← h]
    _ = φ' ≫ eA.inv := by simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.kahlerIsoRoundTrip_eq_id
proof:
:= by
  apply CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext
  intro a
  change CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map (inverseRingSquare eR eA h)
    (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map h (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) =
      CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a
  rw [CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map_d, CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map_d]
  exact congrArg (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := φ))
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom eA.hom_inv_id a)

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.kahlerMap_leftInverse
statement:
theorem kahlerMap_leftInverse {R A R' A' : CommRingCat.{u}} {φ : R ⟶ A} {φ' : R' ⟶ A'}
    (eR : R ≅ R') (eA : A ≅ A') (h : eR.hom ≫ φ' = φ ≫ eA.hom) :
    Function.LeftInverse (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map (inverseRingSquare eR eA h))
      (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map h)
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (kahlerIsoRoundTrip_eq_id eR eA h)

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.kahlerMap_bijective_of_ringIso
proof:
:= by
  have hL := kahlerMap_leftInverse eR eA h
  have hR := kahlerMap_leftInverse eR.symm eA.symm (inverseRingSquare eR eA h)
  exact ⟨hL.injective, hR.surjective⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.gammaRingSquare
statement:
theorem gammaRingSquare :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ gammaRingHom φ = φ ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.gammaKahler_d
statement:
theorem gammaKahler_d (a : A) :
    gammaKahler φ (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := φ) a) =
      CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := gammaRingHom φ) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a)
proof:
:=
  CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map_d (gammaRingSquare φ) a

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.gammaKahler_bijective
statement: theorem gammaKahler_bijective : Function.Bijective (gammaKahler φ)
proof:
:=
  kahlerMap_bijective_of_ringIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).symm
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).symm (gammaRingSquare φ)

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.gammaDifferentialSections_d
statement:
theorem gammaDifferentialSections_d (a : Γ(Spec A, ⊤)) :
    gammaDifferentialSections φ (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := gammaRingHom φ) a) =
      TF2.Esec (Spec.map φ) ⊤ a
proof:
:=
  relativeDifferentialSections_D (Spec.map φ) (U := ⊤) (V := ⊤) le_top a

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.affineDifferential_eq_gamma
statement:
theorem affineDifferential_eq_gamma :
    affineDifferential φ = gammaKahler φ ≫ gammaDifferentialSections φ
proof:
:= by
  apply CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext
  intro a
  exact (affineDifferential_d φ a).trans
    ((congrArg (gammaDifferentialSections φ) (gammaKahler_d φ a)).trans
      (gammaDifferentialSections_d φ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a))).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.gammaRingHom_isStandardSmooth
statement:
theorem gammaRingHom_isStandardSmooth (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth φ.hom) :
    RingHom.IsStandardSmooth (gammaRingHom φ).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (RingHom.isStandardSmooth_respectsIso.cancel_left_isIso
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv (gammaRingHom φ)).mp
  change RingHom.IsStandardSmooth
    (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ gammaRingHom φ).hom)
  rw [gammaRingSquare]
  exact RingHom.isStandardSmooth_respectsIso.1 φ.hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv hsm

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.affineDifferential_bijective_of_standardSmooth
statement:
theorem affineDifferential_bijective_of_standardSmooth
    (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth φ.hom) :
    Function.Bijective (affineDifferential φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Function.Bijective (gammaDifferentialSections φ) :=
    relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_standardSmooth (Spec.map φ) le_top
      (isAffineOpen_top _) (isAffineOpen_top _) (gammaRingHom_isStandardSmooth φ hsm)
  rw [affineDifferential_eq_gamma]
  exact hg.comp (gammaKahler_bijective φ)

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.affineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth_d
statement:

proof:
:=
  (congrArg (affineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth φ hsm).inv
    (affineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth_d φ hsm a).symm).trans

name: SchemeKTheory.KahlerRingTransportH2.algebraKahlerIso_inv_D

name: RegularAffineK0G0.projective_moduleSpecΓ_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem projective_moduleSpecΓ_of_isFiniteLocallyFree (E : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E) :
    Module.Projective R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hproj⟩ := SchemeProjectiveSpace.sections_finite_projective_of_isFiniteLocallyFree E hE
    (U := ⊤) (isAffineOpen_top _)
  let e : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) ≃+* R :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  haveI : RingHomInvPair (e : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) →+* R) (e.symm : R →+* _) :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  haveI : RingHomInvPair (e.symm : R →+* _) (e : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) →+* R) :=
    RingHomInvPair.symm _ _
  let e₂ : Γ(E, ⊤) ≃ₛₗ[(e : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) →+* R)]
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj E) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun c x => by
        change c • x = ((Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens).leTop.op)
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv (e c)) • x
        have h1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv (e c) = c := by
          change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv) c = c
          rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]; rfl
        have h2 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens).leTop = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [h1, h2, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
        rfl
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv e₂

name: RegularAffineK0G0.surjective_of_classOf
statement:
theorem surjective_of_classOf {O : Type*} {Ex : O → O → O → Prop} {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B]
    (φ : B →+ ExactGrothendieck.Group O Ex)
    (h : ∀ x, ∃ b, φ b = ExactGrothendieck.classOf O Ex x) : Function.Surjective φ
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _ y
  induction z using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p + q, by rw [map_add, hp, hq, map_add]⟩
  | single x n =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h x
      refine ⟨n • b, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zsmul, hb]
      change n • (QuotientAddGroup.mk' _ (Finsupp.single x 1)) = _
      rw [← map_zsmul, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: RegularAffineK0G0.k0ToG0_comp_tildeK
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_comp_tildeK :
    (k0ToG0 X).comp (tildeK R) = (tildeG R).comp (ModuleResolution.k0ToG0 R)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro M
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tildeK, tildeG, k0ToG0, ModuleResolution.k0ToG0,
    ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]
  rfl

name: RegularAffineK0G0.gammaG_comp_tildeG
statement: theorem gammaG_comp_tildeG : (gammaG R).comp (tildeG R) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tildeG, gammaG, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  haveI : Module.Finite R M := hM
  exact (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ModuleResolution.IsFG R)
    _ hM (show Module.Finite R (ModuleCat.of R PUnit.{u + 1}) from inferInstance)
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _) ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app M).symm)

name: RegularAffineK0G0.tildeG_comp_gammaG
statement: theorem tildeG_comp_gammaG : (tildeG R).comp (gammaG R) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tildeG, gammaG, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike X) _ hE
    (show (0 : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance)
    (isZero_zero _) (by
      haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent (R := CommRingCat.of R) E
      let i := asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E)
      exact i)

name: RegularAffineK0G0.tildeK_surjective
statement: theorem tildeK_surjective : Function.Surjective (tildeK R)
proof:
:= by
  apply surjective_of_classOf
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := finite_moduleSpecΓ R E
  haveI := projective_moduleSpecΓ_of_isFiniteLocallyFree R E hE
  refine ⟨ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ (ModuleResolution.IsFGProj R) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj E)
    ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [tildeK, ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]
  haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent (R := CommRingCat.of R) E
  let i := asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E)
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ hE i

name: RegularAffineK0G0.k0ToG0_bijective_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R M → HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 X)
proof:
:= by
  have hφ := ModuleResolution.k0ToG0_bijective_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLE d hd
  have hT : Function.Bijective (tildeG R) :=
    ⟨Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := gammaG R) (DFunLike.congr_fun (gammaG_comp_tildeG R)),
     Function.RightInverse.surjective (g := gammaG R) (DFunLike.congr_fun (tildeG_comp_gammaG R))⟩
  have hc : ∀ y, k0ToG0 X (tildeK R y) = tildeG R (ModuleResolution.k0ToG0 R y) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun (k0ToG0_comp_tildeK R)
  refine ⟨fun a b hab => ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := tildeK_surjective R a
    obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := tildeK_surjective R b
    rw [hc, hc] at hab
    rw [hφ.1 (hT.1 hab)]
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hT.2 z
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hφ.2 w
    exact ⟨tildeK R y, hc y⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (y : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear R Q n d p y =
      (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).d p (p + 1)).hom y
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear R Q n d p y =
    ((((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor (coordinateCechCover R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
        (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf).d p (p + 1)).hom y)
  simp only [CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor,
    Limits.FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor_obj_d,
    CochainComplex.of_d]
  change
    coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear R Q n d p y =
      (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
        (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)) p).hom y
  simp only [coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r y) =
      _
  simp_rw [coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply]
  rw [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD]
  let f := fun r : Fin (p + 2) ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r
  have hhom_sum (s : Finset (Fin (p + 2))) :
      (∑ r ∈ s, f r).hom = ∑ r ∈ s, (f r).hom := by
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => rfl
    | @insert r s hr ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hr, Finset.sum_insert hr,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_add, ih]
  rw [show (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r) =
      ∑ r, f r by rfl]
  rw [hhom_sum]
  rw [AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply (fun r => (f r).hom) Finset.univ y]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  dsimp only [f]
  rw [AddCommGrpCat.hom_zsmul]
  generalize ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) = z
  cases z <;> rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingHigherDifferentialLinear_eq_alternatingCofaces
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingHigherDifferentialLinear_eq_alternatingCofaces
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferentialLinear R n d p =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d p x = _
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  let ev :
      (coordinateCechHigherTerm R n (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p →+
        coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)) →+
        coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f x
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hsum :
      ((∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface R n d p r) x) =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2),
          (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
            coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface R n d p r) x := by
    change ev (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface R n d p r) = _
    exact map_sum ev _ Finset.univ
  rw [hsum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply]
  rw [show coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface R n d p r x =
      coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r x by
    exact (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
      R n d p r x).symm]
  let evL :
      (coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p →ₗ[R]
        coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)) →+
        coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f x
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  exact (map_zsmul evL ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val)
    (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleEvBase_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleEvBase_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (z : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p ⊗[R] Q)
    (f : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p →ₗ[R]
      coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) (p + 1)) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleEvBase R Q n d p z f =
      f (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv R Q n d p z)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (z : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p ⊗[R] Q)
    (f : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p →ₗ[R]
      coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport R Q n d p z f =
      coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv R Q n d (p + 1)
        (f.rTensor Q z)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear_conj
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear_conj
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (z : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p ⊗[R] Q) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleDifferentialLinear R Q n d p
        (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p z) =
      coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1)
          ((coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferentialLinear
            R n d p).rTensor Q z)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoface (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
      coordinateCechBaseModuleEvBase R Q n d p z
          (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r) =
        coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport R Q n d p z
          (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r) := by
    rw [coordinateCechBaseModuleEvBase_apply, coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport_apply]
    exact coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_conj R Q n d p r z
  change
    coordinateCechBaseModuleEvBase R Q n d p z
        (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r) =
      coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv R Q n d (p + 1)
        ((coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferentialLinear
          R n d p).rTensor Q z)
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_zsmul]
  simp_rw [hcoface]
  have htransport :
      coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport R Q n d p z
          (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
            coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r) =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          coordinateCechBaseModuleTransport R Q n d p z
            (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    simp_rw [map_zsmul]
  rw [← htransport]
  rw [← coordinateCechTwistingHigherDifferentialLinear_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexComponentIso_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexComponentIso_hom_apply

      (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechModuleComplex R Q n d))).X p)) :

proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_spec
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_spec (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] :
    IsRegularScheme (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal) :=
    IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization _
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (StructureSheaf.stalkIso R x).toRingEquiv

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularAt_of_openImmersion
statement:
theorem isRegularAt_of_openImmersion {V X : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (v : V)
    (h : IsRegularLocalRing (V.presheaf.stalk v)) : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (j v))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (j.stalkMap v) := inferInstance
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (asIso (j.stalkMap v)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_chart'
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_chart' {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] {n : ℕ} {K' : Ideal R}
    (r : K') (y : Fin (n + 1) → R) (hK : K' = cK y) (hr : r.1 = y 0)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ K')] (hreg : IsRegular (y 0))
    (hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y) :
    IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade K') (generator K' r))
proof:
:= by
  subst hK
  have : r = rK y := Subtype.ext hr
  subst this
  exact isRegularRing_chart y hreg hqr

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegular_algebraMap_of_killing
proof:
:= by
  subst hh
  have key : ∀ z : S, algebraMap R S y * z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (Submonoid.powers (g * u)) z
    rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (M := Submonoid.powers (g * u)) S y, ← IsLocalization.mk'_mul,
      IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hz
    obtain ⟨⟨_, j, rfl⟩, hm⟩ := hz
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨(g * u) ^ (j + 1), j + 1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have h1 : y * ((g * u) ^ j * a) = 0 := by
      rw [← hm]; ring
    have h2 := hy _ h1
    calc (g * u) ^ (j + 1) * a = g * (u * ((g * u) ^ j * a)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h2, mul_zero]
  refine (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr ?_
  intro a b hab
  have : algebraMap R S y * (a - b) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hab
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (key _ this)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_chartFamily
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_chartFamily {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [IsRegularRing S] (J : Ideal S)
    [IsRegularRing (S ⧸ J)] {m : ℕ} (y' : Fin m → S) (hI : J = Ideal.span (Set.range y'))
    (hw : IsWeaklyRegular S (List.ofFn y')) (hnzd : ∀ i, IsRegular (y' i)) (i : Fin m) :
    IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade J)
      (generatorOfFamily J y' hI i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by have := Fin.pos i; omega⟩
  have hqr : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular y' :=
    SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isQuasiregular_of_isWeaklyRegular (n + 1) y' hw
  have hqr' := hqr.comp_equiv (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i)
  have hK : J = cK (y' ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i) := by
    rw [hI]; congr 1
    rw [Set.range_comp, (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i).range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]
  have hr : (⟨y' i, hI.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ : J).1 =
      (y' ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i) 0 := by
    simp
  exact isRegularRing_chart' (K' := J) ⟨y' i, hI.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
    (y' ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n + 1)) i) hK hr (by simpa using hnzd i) hqr'

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularAt_reesScheme_of_not_le
statement:
theorem isRegularAt_reesScheme_of_not_le (z : ReesBlowup.scheme K)
    (hKP : ¬ K ≤ ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((ReesBlowup.scheme K).presheaf.stalk z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkP⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hKP
  let r : K := ⟨k, hk⟩
  haveI : IsRegularRing (Localization.Away k) :=
    isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (A := R) (Submonoid.powers k)
  have hz : z ∈ (ReesBlowup.principalOpenMap K r).opensRange := by
    rw [ReesBlowup.principalOpenMap_opensRange]
    exact hkP
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hz
  rw [← hv]
  exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ v (isRegularScheme_spec (Localization.Away k) v)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.exists_preimage_localised
statement:
theorem exists_preimage_localised {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsLocalization.Away h S]
    (z : ReesBlowup.scheme K) (hz : h ∉ ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal) :
    ∃ v : ReesBlowup.scheme (K.map (algebraMap R S)),
      schemeMapOfEq K (algebraMap R S) _ rfl v = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Ideal R := ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal with hP
  haveI : P.IsPrime := ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).isPrime
  haveI : Module.Flat R S := IsLocalization.flat S (Submonoid.powers h)
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers h : Set R) P := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ hk
    exact hz (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_of_pow_mem inferInstance k hk)
  haveI hq : (P.map (algebraMap R S)).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers h) S P inferInstance hdisj
  let y : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) := ⟨P.map (algebraMap R S), hq⟩
  have hy : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) y = (ReesBlowup.projection K) z := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    exact IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers h) S inferInstance hdisj
  have hpb := isPullback_schemeMapOfEq K (K.map (algebraMap R S)) rfl
  obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := ReesBlowup.projection K)
    (g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) z y hy.symm
  refine ⟨hpb.isoPullback.inv t, ?_⟩
  rw [← ht1, ← hpb.isoPullback_inv_fst]
  rfl

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isOpenImmersion_localised
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_localised {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalization.Away h S] :
    IsOpenImmersion (schemeMapOfEq K (algebraMap R S) (K.map (algebraMap R S)) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Flat R S := IsLocalization.flat S (Submonoid.powers h)
  have hpb := isPullback_schemeMapOfEq K (K.map (algebraMap R S)) rfl
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization h
  exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsOpenImmersion) hpb.flip inferInstance

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularAt_reesScheme_of_le
statement:
theorem isRegularAt_reesScheme_of_le (z : ReesBlowup.scheme K)
    (hKP : K ≤ ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((ReesBlowup.scheme K).presheaf.stalk z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Ideal R := ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal with hP
  haveI : P.IsPrime := ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).isPrime
  set A := Localization.AtPrime P with hA
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing A := IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization P
  have hle : K.map (algebraMap R A) ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]; exact Ideal.map_mono hKP
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ K.map (algebraMap R A)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_quotient_localization K P hKP
  obtain ⟨g, hg, ys, -, hprop⟩ := SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_chart_regular_generators P A K hle
  obtain ⟨hKA, hwA⟩ := hprop P.primeCompl A (IsLocalization.map_units A ⟨g, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff.mpr hg⟩)
  have hmax : ∀ y ∈ ys, algebraMap R A y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    intro y hy
    apply hle
    rw [hKA]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hkill⟩ := exists_unit_killing_ann P ys hwA hmax
  have hh : g * u ∉ P := fun hm =>
    ((Ideal.IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem inferInstance).mp hm).elim hg hu
  letI S := Localization.Away (g * u)
  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap R S g) := by
    have := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S) (g * u)
    rw [map_mul] at this
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left this
  obtain ⟨hKS, hwS⟩ := hprop (Submonoid.powers (g * u)) S hunit
  haveI : IsRegularRing S := isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (A := R) (Submonoid.powers (g * u))
  haveI : IsRegularRing (S ⧸ K.map (algebraMap R S)) :=
    isRegularRing_of_isLocalization (A := R ⧸ K)
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ K) (Submonoid.powers (g * u)))
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_preimage_localised K (g * u) (S := S) z hh
  haveI := isOpenImmersion_localised K (g * u) (S := S)
  rw [← hv]
  refine isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ v ?_
  set y' : Fin ys.length → S := fun k => algebraMap R S (ys.get k) with hy'
  have hrange : Set.range y' = {x | x ∈ ys.map (algebraMap R S)} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_map, hy']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ys.get k, List.get_mem _ _, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp ha
      exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hI : K.map (algebraMap R S) = Ideal.span (Set.range y') := by
    rw [hKS, hrange]
  let 𝒰 := ReesBlowup.affineOpenCoverOfSpan (K.map (algebraMap R S)) y' hI
  have hcov := 𝒰.covers v
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcov
  have key : IsRegularLocalRing ((ReesBlowup.scheme (K.map (algebraMap R S))).presheaf.stalk ((𝒰.f (𝒰.idx v)) q)) := by
    refine isRegularAt_of_openImmersion (𝒰.f (𝒰.idx v)) q ?_
    have hw : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular S (List.ofFn y') := by
      have : List.ofFn y' = ys.map (algebraMap R S) := by
        calc List.ofFn y' = List.ofFn ((algebraMap R S) ∘ ys.get) := rfl
          _ = (List.ofFn ys.get).map (algebraMap R S) := List.map_ofFn.symm
          _ = ys.map (algebraMap R S) := by rw [List.ofFn_get]
      rw [this]; exact hwS
    have hnzd : ∀ k, IsRegular (y' k) := fun k =>
      isRegular_algebraMap_of_killing (S := S) (h := g * u) (g := g) (u := u) rfl
        (hkill _ (List.get_mem _ _))
    haveI : IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (K.map (algebraMap R S)))
        (generatorOfFamily (K.map (algebraMap R S)) y' hI (𝒰.idx v))) :=
      isRegularRing_chartFamily (K.map (algebraMap R S)) y' hI hw hnzd (𝒰.idx v)
    exact isRegularScheme_spec _ q
  rw [hq] at key
  exact key

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_reesScheme
statement: theorem isRegularScheme_reesScheme : IsRegularScheme (ReesBlowup.scheme K)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  by_cases hKP : K ≤ ((ReesBlowup.projection K) z).asIdeal
  · exact isRegularAt_reesScheme_of_le K z hKP
  · exact isRegularAt_reesScheme_of_not_le K z hKP

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.P_eq
statement:
theorem P_eq (j : ℕ) : P R n j = pr (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) j (n + 1)
    (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.eulerLift_P
statement: theorem eulerLift_P (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n + 1) : eulerLift R n ≫ P R n j = contr R n j
proof:
:= by
  rw [P_eq]
  have h := lift_pr (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) (contr R n) j (n + 1)
    (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n) hj
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.I_eq
statement:
theorem I_eq (j : ℕ) : I R n j = inj (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) j (n + 1)
    (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.I_P
statement:
theorem I_P (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < n + 1) :
    I R n j ≫ P R n i = if i = j then 𝟙 (Ltw R n (-1)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [I_eq, P_eq]
  exact inj_pr (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) j (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
    (hE1 n) i hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.contr_fin'
statement: theorem contr_fin' (j : Fin (n + 1)) : contr R n j.val = eulerContraction R n j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [contr, dif_pos j.isLt]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.sum_P_I
statement: theorem sum_P_I : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), P R n j ≫ I R n j = 𝟙 (X1 R n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_pr_inj (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
    (hE1 n)
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_kernelLift_over
statement:
theorem isIso_kernelLift_over (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsIso (kernel.lift ((Ov R n a).map (eulerMap R n)) ((Ov R n a).map (eulerLift R n))
      (by rw [← Functor.map_comp, eulerLift_comp_eulerMap, Functor.map_zero]))
proof:
:= by
  refine isIso_kernelLift_chart (n + 1) a.val a.isLt
    (fun k : ULift.{u} (AffineChartIndex n a) ↦ (k.down.1 : Fin (n + 1)).val) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    (fun j ↦ (Ov R n a).map (P R n j)) (fun j ↦ (Ov R n a).map (I R n j)) ?_
    ((Ov R n a).map (eulerLift R n)) (tauIso R n a (-1))
    (fun k ↦ LineBundleDual.coframe _ (cotangentChartIso R n a) k)
    (fun k ↦ LineBundleDual.frameSec _ (cotangentChartIso R n a) k) ?_ ?_ ?_
    (fun j ↦ (Ov R n a).map (Koszul.x R n j (-1))) ?_ ?_ ((Ov R n a).map (eulerMap R n))
    ((Ov R n a).mapIso (zIso' (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1)
      (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (-1 + 1) (hE3 n))) ?_ ?_
  · intro k; exact (k.down.1).isLt
  · intro k h; exact k.down.2 (Fin.ext h)
  · intro k k' h
    exact ULift.ext _ _ (Subtype.ext (Fin.ext h))
  · intro j hj hja
    exact ⟨ULift.up ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, fun h ↦ hja (by rw [← h])⟩, rfl⟩
  · have h := congrArg (Ov R n a).map (sum_P_I R n)
    simpa [Functor.map_sum, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_id] using h
  · intro i j; exact LineBundleDual.frameSec_coframe _ (cotangentChartIso R n a) i j
  · exact LineBundleDual.sum_coframe_frameSec _ (cotangentChartIso R n a)
  · intro k
    have hk : (k.down.1 : Fin (n + 1)).val < n + 1 := k.down.1.isLt
    have h1 : eulerLift R n ≫ P R n (k.down.1 : Fin (n + 1)).val =
        eulerContraction R n k.down.1 := by
      rw [eulerLift_P R n _ hk, contr_fin']
    show (Ov R n a).map (eulerLift R n) ≫ (Ov R n a).map (P R n (k.down.1 : Fin (n + 1)).val) ≫
      (tauIso R n a (-1)).hom = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, h1]
    change (eulerContraction R n k.down.1).over (coordinateOpen R n a) ≫ _ = _
    rw [contraction_over_tau]
    exact eulerChartMap_nonpivot R n a k.down
  · have h0 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (eulerLift R n ≫ P R n j) ≫ Koszul.x R n j (-1) = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj ↦ by rw [eulerLift_P R n j (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)])]
      exact sum_contr_x R n
    have h1 := congrArg (Ov R n a).map h0
    rw [Functor.map_sum, Functor.map_zero] at h1
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using h1
  · have : Koszul.x R n a.val (-1) = Koszul.X R n a (-1) := Koszul.x_fin R n a (-1)
    show IsIso ((Ov R n a).map (Koszul.x R n a.val (-1)))
    rw [this]
    exact (over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso _ _).2 (Koszul.X_restrict_isIso R n a (-1))
  · have h := comp_d_zIso' (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) (n + 1)
      (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n) (hE3 n) (𝟙 (X1 R n))
    have h1 := congrArg (Ov R n a).map h
    rw [Functor.map_sum, Category.id_comp, Functor.map_comp] at h1
    simpa only [Category.id_comp, Functor.map_comp, Functor.mapIso_hom] using h1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_eulerToKernel_over
statement:
theorem isIso_eulerToKernel_over (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsIso ((eulerToKernel R n).over (coordinateOpen R n a))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits (Ov R n a) :=
    overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) (coordinateOpen R n a)
  haveI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair (eulerMap R n) 0) (Ov R n a) :=
    PreservesLimitsOfShape.preservesLimit
  have h := isIso_kernelLift_over R n a
  have e := map_lift_kernelComparison (eulerMap R n) (Ov R n a) (eulerLift_comp_eulerMap R n)
  haveI : IsIso ((Ov R n a).map (eulerToKernel R n) ≫
      kernelComparison (eulerMap R n) (Ov R n a)) := by
    rw [eulerToKernel, e]; exact h
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (kernelComparison (eulerMap R n) (Ov R n a))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_eulerToKernel
statement: theorem isIso_eulerToKernel : IsIso (eulerToKernel R n)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space R n)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) ↦ coordinateOpen R n i.down) :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := space R n) _).2 (by
      change ⨆ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)), coordinateOpen R n i.down = ⊤
      simpa only [iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n)
  exact moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover (eulerToKernel R n)
    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) ↦ coordinateOpen R n i.down) hU
    (fun i ↦ isIso_eulerToKernel_over R n i.down)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartToOverlapLeft_isLocalization
statement:
theorem coordinateChartToOverlapLeft_isLocalization
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : j ≠ i) :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateChartRing R n i)
        (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j)
proof:
:=
      (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j)
        (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j =
          coordinate R n i * coordinate R n j by rfl)).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hij⟩)
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) := by
  simpa only [coordinateRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem, pow_one] using
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalization_mul
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j)
      (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j =
        coordinate R n i * coordinate R n j by rfl)
      (by omega))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartToOverlapRight_isLocalization
statement:
theorem coordinateChartToOverlapRight_isLocalization
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :

        (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j)
proof:
:=
      (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)
        (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j =
          coordinate R n j * coordinate R n i by
            simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
            ring)).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩)
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) := by
  simpa only [coordinateRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem, pow_one] using
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalization_mul
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)
      (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j =
        coordinate R n j * coordinate R n i by
          simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
          ring)
      (by omega))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway
statement:
theorem opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (r : R) [IsLocalization.Away r S] :
    Set.range (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).base =
      Set.range (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away r)))).base
proof:
:= by
  let E := IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers r) S
    (Localization.Away r)
  letI : IsIso (CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso E.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv)
  letI : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom)) :=
    inferInstance
  have e := (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers r) S
    (Localization.Away r)).symm.toAlgHom.comp_algebraMap
  rw [← e, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp]
  change Set.range ((Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away r)))).base ∘
    (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers r) S
          (Localization.Away r)).symm.toAlgHom.toRingHom)).base) = _
  rw [Set.range_comp, show Set.range (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers r) S
          (Localization.Away r)).symm.toAlgHom.toRingHom)).base =
      Set.univ by
    apply Set.range_eq_univ.mpr
    intro y
    refine ⟨(inv (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom)).base) y, ?_⟩
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (IsIso.inv_hom_id (Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom)).base) y,
    Set.image_univ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway_eq_basicOpen
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (r : R) [IsLocalization.Away r S] :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
proof:
:=
      IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization r
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).opensRange =
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r := by
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  change Set.range (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).base =
    (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
  rw [opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway r]
  exact PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range
    (Localization.Away r) r

name: B7.mem_filGammaQ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_filGammaQ_iff (p : ℕ) (z : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    z ∈ SchemeKTheory.FilGammaQ X p ↔ z ∈ B3.Gq hX p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    change z ∈ Ideal.map (toK0Q X) (FilGamma X p) at hz
    rw [Ideal.map, Ideal.span] at hz
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact B3.FilGammaQ_le_Gq hX hT x₀ p (B3.one_tmul_mem_FilGammaQ hy)
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul r a _ ha =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      exact B3.Gq_mul_zero hX hT x₀ ha
  · intro hz
    have hle : B3.Gq hX p ≤ (SchemeKTheory.FilGammaQ X p).restrictScalars ℚ := by
      refine iSup_le fun q => ?_
      intro w hw
      have h1 := B3.Wt_le_FilGammaQ hX hT x₀ q.1 hw
      have h2 : w ∈ SchemeKTheory.FilGammaQ X q.1 := by
        have : B3.FilGammaQ X q.1 ≤ (SchemeKTheory.FilGammaQ X q.1).restrictScalars ℚ := by
          refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
          rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (toK0Q X) hy
        exact this h1
      exact (gammaFiltQ X).anti q.2 h2
    exact hle hz

name: B7.dcoef_self
statement: lemma dcoef_self {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : B3.dcoef k k = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * (k.factorial : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (fwdDiff_iter_eq_factorial (R := ℤ) (n := k)) 0
  rw [B3.fd_sum k k hk] at h
  simp only [Pi.natCast_apply] at h
  have h2 : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1)) * ((-1) ^ (k + 1) * B3.dcoef k k) = B3.dcoef k k := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]; simp
  rw [← h2, h]

name: B7.powSum_gamma_eq
statement:
theorem powSum_gamma_eq {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) (a : ℕ) :
    (-1 : K0Q X) ^ (a + 1) * powSum (gammaDatum z hz) a = toK0Q X (qOp X a z)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    have h1 := newton_gamma hz n
    have h2 := congrArg (toK0Q X) (gammaOp_newton X n z)
    simp only [map_mul, map_sum, map_natCast] at h2
    have h3 : ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, ((-1 : K0Q X) ^ (p.1 + 1) * powSum (gammaDatum z hz) p.1) *
          toK0Q X (gammaOp X p.2 z) =
        ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, toK0Q X (qOp X p.1 z) * toK0Q X (gammaOp X p.2 z) :=
      h1.trans h2
    have hm : (n, 0) ∈ antidiagonal n := by simp
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hm, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hm] at h3
    have hrest : ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal n).erase (n, 0),
          ((-1 : K0Q X) ^ (p.1 + 1) * powSum (gammaDatum z hz) p.1) *
            toK0Q X (gammaOp X p.2 z) =
        ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal n).erase (n, 0), toK0Q X (qOp X p.1 z) *
            toK0Q X (gammaOp X p.2 z) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      have hlt : p.1 < n := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.2 with h0 | h0
        · exfalso; apply hp.1; ext <;> simp <;> omega
        · omega
      rw [ih p.1 hlt]
    rw [hrest, gammaOp_zero, map_one] at h3
    simpa using add_right_cancel h3

name: B7.QK_sub_mem
statement:
theorem QK_sub_mem {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {v : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hv : v ∈ B3.Gq hX 1) :
    B3.QK hX k v - ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k v ∈ B3.Gq hX (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun q : {q : ℕ // 1 ≤ q} => B3.Wt hX q.1)
    (motive := fun v => B3.QK hX k v - ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k v ∈
      B3.Gq hX (k + 1)) hv ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ w hw
    rw [B3.QK_apply_Wt hX hT x₀ k hw]
    by_cases hqk : q = k
    · subst hqk
      rw [show prK hX hT x₀ q w = w from (B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).pr_of_mem_same (le_refl 2) hw]
      simp
    · rw [show prK hX hT x₀ k w = 0 from
        (B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hw (Ne.symm hqk), smul_zero, sub_zero]
      by_cases hqk' : q < k
      · rw [B3.dcoef_eq_zero hq hqk']; simp
      · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (B3.Wt_le_Gq hX (show k + 1 ≤ q by omega) hw)
  · simp
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [map_add, map_add, smul_add]
    have : B3.QK hX k a + B3.QK hX k b -
        (((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k a + ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k b) =
        (B3.QK hX k a - ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k a) +
        (B3.QK hX k b - ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k b) := by abel
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem ha hb

name: B7.powSum_sub_mem
statement:
theorem powSum_sub_mem {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    powSum (gammaDatum z hz) k - (k.factorial : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k (toK0Q X z) ∈
      B3.Gq hX (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : toK0Q X z ∈ B3.Gq hX 1 := B3.one_tmul_mem_Gq_one hX hT x₀ hz
  have h := QK_sub_mem hX hT x₀ hk hu
  have hQ : B3.QK hX k (toK0Q X z) = toK0Q X (qOp X k z) := B3.QK_tmul hX k z
  have hP := powSum_gamma_eq hz k
  set ε : ℚ := (-1) ^ (k + 1) with hε
  have hεε : ε * ε = 1 := by
    rw [hε, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]; simp
  have hP' : powSum (gammaDatum z hz) k = ε • B3.QK hX k (toK0Q X z) := by
    rw [hQ, ← hP]
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (Algebra.smul_def (A := ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) ε _).symm
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    have : algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X) ε * (-1 : K0Q X) ^ (k + 1) = 1 := by
      have hc : (-1 : K0Q X) ^ (k + 1) = algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X) ε := by
        rw [hε, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
      rw [hc, ← map_mul, hεε, map_one]
    rw [this, one_mul]
  have hd : ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) = ε * (k.factorial : ℚ) := by
    rw [dcoef_self hk]; push_cast; rfl
  have e : powSum (gammaDatum z hz) k - (k.factorial : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k (toK0Q X z) =
      ε • (B3.QK hX k (toK0Q X z) - ((B3.dcoef k k : ℤ) : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k (toK0Q X z)) := by
    rw [hP', hd, smul_sub, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc, hεε, one_mul]
  rw [e]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h

name: B7.addCharW_dualW
statement:
theorem addCharW_dualW (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (x : K) :
    addCharW W D f (B6.dualW W x) = addCharW W D (rescale (-1 : ℚ) f) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold addCharW powSumW
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [B6.pr_dualW, coeff_rescale, smul_comm (k.factorial : ℚ), smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: B7.Wt_le_gammaFiltQ
statement: theorem Wt_le_gammaFiltQ (p : ℕ) : ∀ w ∈ B3.Wt hX p, w ∈ (gammaFiltQ X).F p
proof:
:=
  fun _ hw => (mem_filGammaQ_iff hX hT x₀ p _).2 (B3.Wt_le_Gq hX le_rfl hw)

name: B7.thetaX_of_mem
statement:
theorem thetaX_of_mem (D : ℕ) {a : ℕ} {w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X} (hw : w ∈ B3.Wt hX a) :
    thetaX hX hT x₀ D w = gcl D a ⟨w, Wt_le_gammaFiltQ hX hT x₀ a w hw⟩

name: B7.pr_sub_powSum_mem
statement:
theorem pr_sub_powSum_mem {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ((k.factorial : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k (toK0Q X z)) - powSum (gammaDatum z hz) k ∈
      (gammaFiltQ X).F (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := powSum_sub_mem hX hT x₀ hz hk
  have h' := Submodule.neg_mem _ h
  rw [neg_sub] at h'
  exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hX hT x₀ (k + 1) _).2 h'

name: B7.rankQ_toK0Q
statement: theorem rankQ_toK0Q {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) : rankQ x₀ (toK0Q X z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (mem_rankZeroIdeal.1 hz) x₀
  simp [rankQ, toK0Q, this]

name: B7.prK_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem prK_zero_eq_zero {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    prK hX hT x₀ 0 (toK0Q X z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).pr_zero_eq (le_refl 2) (toK0Q X z)
  rw [show prK hX hT x₀ 0 (toK0Q X z) = (B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).pr (le_refl 2) 0 (toK0Q X z) from rfl,
    this]
  have h0 : (B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).ρ (toK0Q X z) = 0 := rankQ_toK0Q x₀ hz
  rw [h0, zero_smul]

name: B7.theta_rankZero
statement:
theorem theta_rankZero (D : ℕ) {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    thetaX hX hT x₀ D (toK0Q X z) = chPosGamma D z hz
proof:
:= by
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hX) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl
  show thetaFun (Φ := gammaFiltQ X) (W := B3.Wt hX) (Wt_le_gammaFiltQ hX hT x₀) D (toK0Q X z) = _
  unfold thetaFun chPosGamma chPos
  have hr : Finset.range (D + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 D) := by
    ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [hr, Finset.sum_insert (by simp)]
  have h0 : gcl D 0 (⟨(RG6B.pr (B3.Wt hX) 0) (toK0Q X z), Wt_le_gammaFiltQ hX hT x₀ 0 _
      (RG6B.pr_mem 0 _)⟩ : (gammaFiltQ X).F 0) = 0 := by
    have : (⟨(RG6B.pr (B3.Wt hX) 0) (toK0Q X z), Wt_le_gammaFiltQ hX hT x₀ 0 _
      (RG6B.pr_mem 0 _)⟩ : (gammaFiltQ X).F 0) = 0 := Subtype.ext (prK_zero_eq_zero hX hT x₀ hz)
    rw [this, gcl_zero]
  rw [h0, zero_add]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1
  unfold B4.chK
  refine gcl_eq_of_sub_mem D k ?_
  have h := pr_sub_powSum_mem hX hT x₀ hz hk1
  have hF := (gammaFiltQ X).F (k + 1)
  have hmul := Ideal.mul_mem_left ((gammaFiltQ X).F (k + 1)) (algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X) ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹)) h
  have e : algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X) ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) *
      (((k.factorial : ℚ) • prK hX hT x₀ k (toK0Q X z)) - powSum (gammaDatum z hz) k) =
      (prK hX hT x₀ k (toK0Q X z)) - algebraMap ℚ (K0Q X) ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) *
        powSum (gammaDatum z hz) k := by
    rw [mul_sub, ← Algebra.smul_def (A := ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X), ← Algebra.smul_def (A := ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X),
      smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_smul]
  rw [e] at hmul
  exact hmul

name: B7.chGammaZ_natCast
statement:
theorem chGammaZ_natCast {Y : Scheme.{u}} (D : ℕ) (y : K0 Y) (r : ℕ)
    (hy : y - ((r : ℤ) : K0 Y) ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) (hy' : y - (r : K0 Y) ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    chGammaZ D y (r : ℤ) hy = chGamma D y r hy'

:= by

name: B7.sub_rank_mem
statement:
theorem sub_rank_mem (hX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (x₀ : X) (y : K0 X) :
    y - ((rankAtRingHom x₀ y : ℤ) : K0 X) ∈ rankZeroIdeal X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rankZeroIdeal]
  intro y'
  rw [map_sub, map_intCast, Int.cast_id,
    rankAtRingHom_eq_of_constantRankGenerators hX y y' x₀, sub_self]

name: B7.theta_toK0Q
statement:
theorem theta_toK0Q (D : ℕ) (y : K0 X) (r : ℤ) (hy : y - (r : K0 X) ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    thetaX hX hT x₀ D (toK0Q X y) = chGammaZ D y r hy
proof:
:= by
  have e : toK0Q X y = (r : K0Q X) + toK0Q X (y - (r : K0 X)) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_intCast]; abel
  rw [e, map_add, map_intCast, theta_rankZero hX hT x₀ D hy]

name: B7.thetaX_exp

name: B7.theta_addCharW_gamma
statement:
theorem theta_addCharW_gamma (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    thetaX hX hT x₀ D (@addCharW _ _ _ (B3.Wt hX) (adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl) D f
        (toK0Q X z)) = addCharGr D f (gammaDatum z hz)
proof:
:= by
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hX) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hX hT x₀ 2 le_rfl
  exact @theta_addCharW _ _ _ (gammaFiltQ X) (B3.Wt hX) _ (Wt_le_gammaFiltQ hX hT x₀) D f
    (toK0Q X z) (fun k => powSumF (gammaDatum z hz) k)
    (fun k hk => pr_sub_powSum_mem hX hT x₀ hz hk)

name: B7.theta_toddW
statement:
theorem theta_toddW (D : ℕ) {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    thetaX hX hT x₀ D ((B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).toddW (le_refl 2) D (toK0Q X z)) =
      toddGamma D z hz
proof:
:= by
  unfold B6.Ctx.toddW B4.ToddW toddGamma ToddGr
  rw [thetaX_exp hX hT x₀ D ((B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).addChar_nilp (le_refl 2) D _ _)]
  congr 1
  exact theta_addCharW_gamma hX hT x₀ D _ hz

name: B7.theta_toddW_dual
statement:
theorem theta_toddW_dual (D : ℕ) {z : K0 X} (hz : z ∈ rankZeroIdeal X) :
    thetaX hX hT x₀ D ((B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).toddW (le_refl 2) D
        ((B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).dual (le_refl 2) (toK0Q X z))) = toddGammaDual D z hz
proof:
:= by
  unfold B6.Ctx.toddW B4.ToddW toddGammaDual B6.Ctx.dual
  rw [thetaX_exp hX hT x₀ D ((B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).addChar_nilp (le_refl 2) D _ _)]
  congr 1
  letI := (B6.ctxK0 hX hT x₀).gr (le_refl 2)
  rw [addCharW_dualW]
  exact theta_addCharW_gamma hX hT x₀ D _ hz
