name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso_restriction
statement:
theorem projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso_restriction
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (U V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V)
    [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V]
    [IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
        (show U ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top))]
    [IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
        (show V ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top))]
    (x : Γ(projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p, V)) :
    (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso
        R n M p U).hom
        ((projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hUV).op x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUV
        ((projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso
          R n M p V).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let N := projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p
  let W := (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
  let A := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), W)
  let S := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), V)
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), U)
  let hVW : V ≤ W := le_top
  let hUW : U ≤ W := hUV.trans hVW
  letI : IsAffine W := isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
  let cUV := SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N hUV
  let cVW := SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N hVW
  let cUW := SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N hUW
  let aUV :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUV
  let aVW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hVW
  let aUW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUW
  letI : IsIso cUV :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent N hUV
  letI : IsIso cVW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent N hVW
  letI : IsIso cUW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent N hUW
  letI : IsIso aUV :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_isIso_of_comp
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUV hVW
  let eTop :=
    (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTopLinearEquiv
      R n M p).toModuleIso
  let eV := (ModuleCat.extendScalars
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom).map eTop.hom
  let eU := (ModuleCat.extendScalars
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUW).hom).map eTop.hom
  let assocN :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
      (ModuleCat.of A Γ(N, W))
  let assocH :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) W)
  let z := (asIso cVW).inv x
  let wN := assocN.inv
    ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S, (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] z)
  let zH := eV z
  let wH := assocH.inv
    ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S, (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] zH)
  have hz : cVW z = x := (asIso cVW).inv_hom_id_apply x
  have hcandidate :
      (asIso cUW).inv (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) = wN := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso cUW).1
    have hcUWInv := (asIso cUW).inv_hom_id_apply
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x)
    change cUW ((asIso cUW).inv
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x)) =
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x at hcUWInv
    rw [hcUWInv]
    have hcompC :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_comp N hUV hVW
    change assocN.hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map cVW ≫
        cUV = cUW at hcompC
    have hcompCApply := congrArg (fun q => q wN) hcompC
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcompCApply
    rw [← hcompCApply]
    simp only [wN]
    rw [assocN.inv_hom_id_apply, ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul, hz,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  have htransport : eU wN = wH := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso assocH.hom).1
    have hnat :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_naturality
        hUV hVW eTop.hom
    have hnatApply := congrArg (fun q => q wN) hnat
    change
      (assocN.hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map eV) wN =
        (eU ≫ assocH.hom) wN at hnatApply
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnatApply
    calc
      assocH.hom (eU wN) =
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars
            (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map eV
              (assocN.hom wN) := hnatApply.symm
      _ = ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S,
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] zH) := by
        simp only [wN]
        rw [assocN.inv_hom_id_apply, ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
      _ = assocH.hom wH := by
        simp only [wH]
        rw [assocH.inv_hom_id_apply]
  have hactual :
      aUW wH =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUV (aVW zH) := by
    dsimp only [aUW, aVW, hUW]
    rw [← SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUV hVW]
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, wH]
    rw [assocH.inv_hom_id_apply, ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  change ((asIso cUW).inv ≫ eU ≫ (asIso aUW).hom)
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) hUV
      (((asIso cVW).inv ≫ eV ≫ (asIso aVW).hom) x)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [hcandidate, htransport]
  exact hactual

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_projectiveModule
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_projectiveModule
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (hBC : ∀ g : R, IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top))) :
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let N := projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p
  let α :=
    projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageBasisComparison R n M p hBC
  apply
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basicOpen_comparison
      R (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) N α
  · intro g s m
    letI : IsAffine (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g) := by
      dsimp only [projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
      exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g
    letI := hBC g
    change
      (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso
        R n M p (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)).inv (s • m) =
      s • (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso
        R n M p (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)).inv m
    exact (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso
      R n M p (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)).inv.hom.map_smul s m
  · intro g
    letI : IsAffine (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g) := by
      dsimp only [projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
      exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g
    letI := hBC g
    exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTildeOpenIso
        R n M p (projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)).inv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isFinitePresentation_of_projectiveModule
statement:
theorem
    affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isFinitePresentation_of_projectiveModule
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (hBC : ∀ g : R, IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)))
    [Module.FinitePresentation R (M.H (p + 1))] :
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let N := projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p
  letI : N.IsFinitePresentation := by
    dsimp only [N, projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde]
    exact tilde_isFinitePresentation _
  exact
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationIso
          R n M p hBC).symm inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r x) a =
      coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a
        (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d p x
          (a ∘ r.succAbove))
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap, coordinateCechTwistingHigherPiCofaceLinearMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p) :
    coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r x =
      ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)).δ r).hom x
proof:
:= by
  apply coordinateCechTwistingHigherTerm_ext R n d (p + 1)
  intro a
  rw [← coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi]
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap_apply]
  have h :=
    coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p r a
  exact (congrArg (fun k => k.hom x) h).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R Q n d p x a =
      (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))
  let hPi := Limits.productIsProduct' (Discrete.functor f)
  let hRaw := (AddCommGrpCat.HasLimit.productLimitCone f).isLimit
  let e := coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiIso R Q n d p
  have he :
      e.hom ≫
          AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
            (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun b ↦ f b) a) =
        Pi.π f a := by
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp hPi hRaw ⟨a⟩
  exact congrArg (fun k : _ ⟶ f a ↦ k.hom x) he

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_conj
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_conj
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (z : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p ⊗[R] Q) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r
        (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p z) =
      coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) ((coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r).rTensor Q z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (y : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p) :
    coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r y =
      ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r).hom y
proof:
:= by
  let e :=
    coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
      R Q n d p
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective y
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      calc
        coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r (e 0) =
            coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r 0 := congrArg _ (map_zero e)
        _ = 0 := map_zero _
        _ = ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
              (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r).hom 0 :=
            (map_zero _).symm
        _ = ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
              (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r).hom (e 0) :=
            congrArg _ (map_zero e).symm
  | tmul x q =>
      apply (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1)).injective
      funext a
      let xπ :=
        coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d p x
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)
      let e₀ :=
        coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p
      let e₁ :=
        coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1)
      let δQ :=
        ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r)
      let π₀ :=
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)
      let π₁ :=
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) b))) a
      let ρ :=
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op
      have hδ : δQ ≫ π₁ = π₀ ≫ ρ :=
        coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p r a
      calc
        coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R Q n d (p + 1)
            (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap R Q n d p r (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q))) a =
          coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R Q n d (p + 1)
            (e₁ ((coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r x) ⊗ₜ[R] q)) a := by
              have hc := coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_conj R Q n d p r (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)
              rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul] at hc
              exact congrArg
                (fun w ↦ coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
                  R Q n d (p + 1) w a) hc
        _ = coordinateCechTwistingSectionsTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
              R Q n d (p + 1) a
                (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d (p + 1)
                  (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r x) a ⊗ₜ[R] q) := by
              exact
                coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv_tmul_apply
                  R Q n d (p + 1) (coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap R n d p r x) q a
        _ = coordinateCechTwistingSectionsTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
              R Q n d (p + 1) a
                (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap
                  R n d p r a xπ ⊗ₜ[R] q) := by
              rw [coordinateCechTwistingHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi]
        _ = ρ
              (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv
                R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) (xπ ⊗ₜ[R] q)) := by
              exact coordinateCechTwistingSectionsTensorBaseModuleAddEquiv_coface
                R Q n d p r a (xπ ⊗ₜ[R] q)
        _ = ρ (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
              R Q n d p (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)) (a ∘ r.succAbove)) := by
              rw [
                coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermTensorBaseModuleLinearEquiv_tmul_apply]
        _ = (π₀ ≫ ρ).hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)) := by
              change ρ
                (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
                  R Q n d p (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)) (a ∘ r.succAbove)) =
                ρ (π₀.hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)))
              exact congrArg ρ
                (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply R Q n d p
                  (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)) (a ∘ r.succAbove))
        _ = (δQ ≫ π₁).hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q)) :=
              congrArg (fun k => k.hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q))) hδ.symm
        _ = coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
              R Q n d (p + 1) (δQ.hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q))) a := by
              change π₁.hom (δQ.hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q))) =
                coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
                  R Q n d (p + 1) (δQ.hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q))) a
              exact (coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply R Q n d (p + 1)
                (δQ.hom (e₀ (x ⊗ₜ[R] q))) a).symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
      exact
        (((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r).hom.map_add
            (e x) (e y)).symm

name: PresheafOfModules.isZero_of_forall_isZero
statement:
theorem isZero_of_forall_isZero {C : Type w} [Category.{v} C] {R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}}
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} R) (h : ∀ V, IsZero (P.obj V)) : IsZero P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro Q
    refine ⟨{ default := 0, uniq := fun g => ?_ }⟩
    ext V x
    have hV : g.app V = 0 := (h V).eq_zero_of_src _
    simp [hV]
  · intro Q
    refine ⟨{ default := 0, uniq := fun g => ?_ }⟩
    ext V x
    have hV : g.app V = 0 := (h V).eq_zero_of_tgt _
    simp [hV]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ V, IsZero ((affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M i).obj V)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i)
proof:
:=
  Functor.map_isZero (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj))
    (PresheafOfModules.isZero_of_forall_isZero _ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isZero_of_forall_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isZero_of_forall_subsingleton {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ U : X.Opens, Subsingleton Γ(M, U)) : IsZero M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro N
    refine ⟨{ default := 0, uniq := fun g => ?_ }⟩
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro U
    ext x
    have hx : x = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ (h U) x 0
    subst hx
    simp
  · intro N
    refine ⟨{ default := 0, uniq := fun g => ?_ }⟩
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro U
    ext y
    exact @Subsingleton.elim _ (h U) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isZero_of_toSheafAb_isZero
statement:
theorem isZero_of_toSheafAb_isZero {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    (h : IsZero ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj M)) : IsZero M
proof:
:= by
  refine isZero_of_forall_subsingleton M (fun U => ?_)
  have h1 := (Functor.map_isZero (sheafToPresheaf _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) h).obj (op U)
  rwa [AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton] at h1

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) {B : Set Y.Opens} (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hzero : ∀ U ∈ B,
      Subsingleton ((affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f M i).obj (op U))) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.isZero_of_toSheafAb_isZero
  rw [show (Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i)
      = (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f M i) from
      affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_toSheaf f M i]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.isZero_sheafify_of_isBasis _ hB hzero

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem familyEuler_classOf (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (rank : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base ExactBase →+ ℤ) (E : Total) :
    familyEuler push hpush rank (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Total ExactTotal E) =
      rank (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base ExactBase (push E))
proof:
:= by
  simp [familyEuler, indexClass]

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_baseChange
statement:
theorem familyEuler_baseChange
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (rank : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base ExactBase →+ ℤ)
    (rank' : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base' ExactBase' →+ ℤ)
    (hindex :
      (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase).comp (indexClass push hpush) =
        (indexClass push' hpush').comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal))
    (hrank : rank'.comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase) = rank) :
    familyEuler push hpush rank =
      (familyEuler push' hpush' rank').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hrank]
  change (rank'.comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase)).comp
      (indexClass push hpush) =
    (rank'.comp (indexClass push' hpush')).comp
      (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hindex]
  rfl

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_baseChange_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem familyEuler_baseChange_of_object_classes
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (rank : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base ExactBase →+ ℤ)
    (rank' : ExactGrothendieck.Group Base' ExactBase' →+ ℤ)
    (hobject : ∀ E : Total,
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (pullBase (push E)) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (push' (pullTotal E)))
    (hrank : rank'.comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase) = rank) :
    familyEuler push hpush rank =
      (familyEuler push' hpush' rank').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)
proof:
:=
  familyEuler_baseChange push hpush push' hpush' pullTotal hpullTotal pullBase hpullBase rank rank'
    (baseChange_hom_eq_of_object_classes push hpush push' hpush' pullTotal hpullTotal
      pullBase hpullBase hobject) hrank

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.eqToHom_x
statement:
theorem eqToHom_x {p q : ℤ} (h : p = q) (a : ℕ) :
    eqToHom (congrArg L h) ≫ x a q = x a p ≫ eqToHom (congrArg L (congrArg (· + 1) h))
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.psi_zIso
statement:
theorem psi_zIso (a : ℕ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (d c : ℤ) (hc : d + m = c),
    ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).ψ a d).f 0 ≫ (zIso L x hx m (d + 1)).hom =
      (zIso L x hx m d).hom ≫ eqToHom (congrArg L hc) ≫ x a c ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg L (by rw [← hc]; ring : c + 1 = d + 1 + m))
  | 0, d, c, hc => by
    have hc' : d = c
proof:
:= by simpa using hc
    subst hc'
    simp [zIso, Koszul.KData.kos, Koszul.KData.base, Koszul.baseHom, Koszul.baseMapF]
    erw [Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  | m + 1, d, c, hc => by
    have ih := psi_zIso a m (d + 1) c (by rw [← hc]; push_cast; ring)
    have h1 : ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx (m + 1)).ψ a d).f 0 ≫ biprod.fst =
        biprod.fst ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).ψ a (d + 1)).f 0 := by
      show (((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).step m).ψ a d).f 0 ≫ _ = _
      rw [Koszul.KData.step_ψf]
      simp only [Koszul.m2]
      simp
      exact biprod.lift_fst _ _
    simp only [zIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, Koszul.biprodZeroIso]
    rw [← Category.assoc, h1]
    erw [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% ih]
    simp only [eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_trans_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.hom_ext_P
proof:
:=
  biprod.hom_ext _ _ h1 h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.liftP_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftP_fst (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) {T : C}
    (a : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K (d + 1)).X 1)
    (b : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 0) :
    liftP L x hx m d a b ≫ fstP L x hx m d = a
proof: := biprod.lift_fst _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.liftP_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftP_snd (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) {T : C}
    (a : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K (d + 1)).X 1)
    (b : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 0) :
    liftP L x hx m d a b ≫ sndP L x hx m d = b
proof: := biprod.lift_snd _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.zIso_succ_hom
statement:
theorem zIso_succ_hom (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    (zIso L x hx (m + 1) d).hom = fstZ L x hx m d ≫ (zIso L x hx m (d + 1)).hom ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg L (by push_cast; ring : d + 1 + (m : ℤ) = d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [zIso, Koszul.biprodZeroIso]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.d10_succ_fst
statement:
theorem d10_succ_fst (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx (m + 1)).K d).d 1 0 ≫ fstZ L x hx m d =
      fstP L x hx m d ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K (d + 1)).d 1 0 +
        sndP L x hx m d ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).ψ m d).f 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx (m + 1)).K d).d 1 0 =
    Koszul.coneD ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).ψ m d) 0 from
      Koszul.cone_d ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).ψ m d) 0]
  simp only [Koszul.coneD, Koszul.mat]
  exact biprod.lift_fst _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.pr_of_le
statement:
theorem pr_of_le (e : ℤ) (j : ℕ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e), m ≤ j →
    pr L x hx e j m d h = 0
  | 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, d, h, hj => by
    have h1
proof:
:= pr_of_le e j m (d + 1) (by push_cast at h ⊢; omega) (by omega)
    have h2 : ¬ j = m := by omega
    simp [pr, h1, h2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.pr_succ_of_lt
statement:
theorem pr_succ_of_lt (e : ℤ) (j m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + (m + 1 : ℕ) - 1 = e) (hj : j < m) :
    pr L x hx e j (m + 1) d h =
      fstP L x hx m d ≫ pr L x hx e j m (d + 1) (by push_cast at h ⊢; omega)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ¬ j = m := by omega
  simp [pr, h2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.pr_succ_self
statement:
theorem pr_succ_self (e : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + (m + 1 : ℕ) - 1 = e) :
    pr L x hx e m (m + 1) d h =
      sndP L x hx m d ≫ (zIso L x hx m d).hom ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg L (by push_cast at h; omega : d + (m : ℤ) = e))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pr_of_le L x hx e m m (d + 1) (by push_cast at h ⊢; omega) le_rfl
  simp [pr, h1]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.lift_pr
statement:
theorem lift_pr (e : ℤ) {T : C} (s : ℕ → (T ⟶ L e)) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e), j < m →
      lift L x hx e s m d h ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h = s j
  | 0, _, _, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | m + 1, d, h, hj => by
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj | rfl
    · rw [pr_succ_of_lt L x hx e j m d h hj, lift, ← Category.assoc, liftP_fst]
      exact lift_pr e s j m (d + 1) _ hj
    · rw [pr_succ_self, lift, ← Category.assoc, liftP_snd]
      simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.pr_hom_ext
statement:
theorem pr_hom_ext (e : ℤ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e) {T : C}
    {f g : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 1},
    (∀ j, j < m → f ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h = g ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h) → f = g
  | 0, d, _, T, f, g, _ => (isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt f g
  | m + 1, d, h, T, f, g, hfg => by
    apply hom_ext_P
    · refine pr_hom_ext e m (d + 1) (by push_cast at h ⊢; omega) (fun j hj ↦ ?_)
      have
proof:
:= hfg j (by omega)
      rwa [pr_succ_of_lt L x hx e j m d h hj, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc] at this
    · have := hfg m (by omega)
      rw [pr_succ_self, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc] at this
      simpa only [← Category.assoc, cancel_mono] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.comp_d_zIso
statement:
theorem comp_d_zIso (e : ℤ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e) (hc : e + 1 = d + (m : ℤ))
    {T : C} (f : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 1),
    f ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).d 1 0 ≫ (zIso L x hx m d).hom =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (f ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h) ≫ x j e ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg L hc)
  | 0, d, h, hc, T, f => by
    simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
    have hz : IsZero (((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx 0).K d).X 1)
proof:
:= isZero_zero C
    rw [hz.eq_of_tgt f 0, zero_comp]
  | m + 1, d, h, hc, T, f => by
    have ih := comp_d_zIso e m (d + 1) (by push_cast at h ⊢; omega) (by push_cast at hc ⊢; omega)
      (f ≫ fstP L x hx m d)
    have hc : d + (m : ℤ) = e := by push_cast at h; omega
    have hpsi := psi_zIso L x hx m m d e hc
    rw [zIso_succ_hom, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have e1 : f ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx (m + 1)).K d).d 1 0 ≫ fstZ L x hx m d ≫
        (zIso L x hx m (d + 1)).hom ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg L (by push_cast; ring : d + 1 + (m : ℤ) = d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
        ((f ≫ fstP L x hx m d) ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K (d + 1)).d 1 0 ≫
          (zIso L x hx m (d + 1)).hom) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg L (by push_cast; ring : d + 1 + (m : ℤ) = d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
        (f ≫ sndP L x hx m d) ≫ (((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).ψ m d).f 0 ≫
          (zIso L x hx m (d + 1)).hom) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg L (by push_cast; ring : d + 1 + (m : ℤ) = d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx (m + 1)).K d |>.d 1 0), d10_succ_fst]
      simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, Category.assoc]
    rw [e1, ih, hpsi, pr_succ_self, Preadditive.sum_comp]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj ↦ ?_)
      rw [pr_succ_of_lt L x hx e j m d h (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)]
      simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.comp_d_zIso'
statement:
theorem comp_d_zIso' (e : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e) (hc : d + (m : ℤ) = e + 1)
    {T : C} (f : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 1) :
    f ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).d 1 0 ≫ (zIso' L x hx m d (e + 1) hc).hom =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (f ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h) ≫ x j e
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := comp_d_zIso L x hx e m d h hc.symm f
  have h2 : (f ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).d 1 0 ≫ (zIso L x hx m d).hom) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg L hc) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (f ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h) ≫ x j e := by
    rw [h1, Preadditive.sum_comp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ ↦ ?_)
    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← h2, zIso', Iso.trans_hom, eqToIso.hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.comp_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comp_d_eq_zero (e : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e) (hc : d + (m : ℤ) = e + 1)
    {T : C}
    (f : T ⟶ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 1)
    (hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (f ≫ pr L x hx e j m d h) ≫ x j e = 0) :
    f ≫ ((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).d 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (cancel_mono (zIso' L x hx m d (e + 1) hc).hom).1 ?_
  rw [Category.assoc, comp_d_zIso' L x hx e m d h hc f, hsum, zero_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.inj_pr
statement:
theorem inj_pr (e : ℤ) (j m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < m) :
    inj L x hx e j m d h ≫ pr L x hx e i m d h = if i = j then 𝟙 (L e) else 0
proof:
:=
  lift_pr L x hx e (fun i ↦ if i = j then 𝟙 (L e) else 0) i m d h hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.sum_pr_inj
statement:
theorem sum_pr_inj (e : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (h : d + m - 1 = e) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, pr L x hx e j m d h ≫ inj L x hx e j m d h =
      𝟙 (((Koszul.KData.kos L x hx m).K d).X 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine pr_hom_ext L x hx e m d h (fun i hi ↦ ?_)
  rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, Category.id_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, inj_pr L x hx e _ m d h i hi]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hj
    simp [Ne.symm hj]
  · intro hi'
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 hi) hi'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.eq_sum_pr_inj
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Category.comp_id f, ← sum_pr_inj L x hx e m d h]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.iso_map_mate_cancel
statement:
theorem iso_map_mate_cancel {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (A : F ⊣ G) {N N' : C} {M : D}
    (e : N ≅ N') (f : N ⟶ G.obj M) :
    F.map e.hom ≫ (A.homEquiv _ _).symm (e.inv ≫ f) = (A.homEquiv _ _).symm f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, ← Category.assoc,
    ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.ideal_inclusion_comp_native
statement:
theorem ideal_inclusion_comp_native :
    idealModuleι i.ker ≫ nativeStructureMap i = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext V s
  exact TF3.i_app_ιapp i V s

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.native_zero_iff_image_zero
statement:
theorem native_zero_iff_image_zero {M : P.Modules} (f : M ⟶ unitX P) :
    f ≫ nativeStructureMap i = 0 ↔ f ≫ structureMap i.ker = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    ext V s
    have ha : i.app V (f.app V s) = 0 :=
      congrArg (fun q => q.app V s) hf
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := TF4.exists_ideal_section i V (f.app V s) ha
    change (structureMap i.ker).app V (f.app V s) = 0
    rw [← ht]
    exact congrArg (fun q => q.app V t) (kernel.condition (structureMap i.ker))
  · intro hf
    have hfac := kernel.lift_ι (structureMap i.ker) f hf
    have h0 : kernel.ι (structureMap i.ker) ≫ nativeStructureMap i = 0 :=
      ideal_inclusion_comp_native i
    rw [← hfac, Category.assoc, h0, comp_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion
statement:
theorem idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion :
    (idealKernelIso i).hom ≫ kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap i) = idealModuleι i.ker
proof:
:=
  kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion
statement:
theorem idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion :
    (idealKernelIso i).inv ≫ idealModuleι i.ker = kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap i)
proof:
:=
  kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.kernelPulledInclusion_eq_original
statement:
theorem kernelPulledInclusion_eq_original :
    kernelPulledInclusion j p =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map (idealKernelIso (j ≫ p)).inv ≫
        ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion j p
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p
  change (A.homEquiv _ _).symm
    (kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p)) ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map (idealKernelIso (j ≫ p)).inv ≫ (A.homEquiv _ _).symm
      (idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker ≫
        SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom)
  rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, ← Category.assoc,
    idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion]

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.kernelPulledInclusion_comp_native
statement:
theorem kernelPulledInclusion_comp_native :
    kernelPulledInclusion j p ≫ nativeStructureMap j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion j p ≫
      nativeStructureMap j = 0 :=
    (native_zero_iff_image_zero j _).mpr
      (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion_structure_zero j p)
  rw [kernelPulledInclusion_eq_original, Category.assoc, h0, comp_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.kernelIdealComparison_inclusion
statement:
theorem kernelIdealComparison_inclusion :
    kernelIdealComparison j p ≫ kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap j) =
      kernelPulledInclusion j p
proof: := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.originalComparison_kernel_square
statement:
theorem originalComparison_kernel_square :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map (idealKernelIso (j ≫ p)).hom ≫
      kernelIdealComparison j p =
    ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p ≫ (idealKernelIso j).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap j))).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, kernelIdealComparison_inclusion, Category.assoc,
    idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion, ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_inclusion,
    kernelPulledInclusion_eq_original, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.originalConormalComparison_kernel_square
statement:
theorem originalConormalComparison_kernel_square :
    (conormalKernelIso (j ≫ p)).hom ≫ kernelConormalComparison j p =
      ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison j p ≫ (conormalKernelIso j).hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold conormalKernelIso kernelConormalComparison
    ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [(Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.naturality_assoc]
  have hs :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map (idealKernelIso (j ≫ p)).hom) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (kernelIdealComparison j p) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (idealKernelIso j).hom := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map f)
      (originalComparison_kernel_square j p)
  exact congrArg (fun f => (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫ f) hs

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.kernelDI_app
statement:
theorem kernelDI_app (V : Q.Opens) (s : Γ(kernel (nativeStructureMap j), V)) :
    (kernelDI j p).app V s =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)).app V
          (TF2.Esec p V ((kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap j)).app V s))
proof:
:= by
  have hi := congrArg (fun f => f.app V s) (idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion j)
  change (TF3.dI p j).app V ((idealKernelIso j).inv.app V s) = _
  rw [TF3.dI_app]
  exact congrArg (fun a => ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)).app V (TF2.Esec p V a)) hi

name: SchemeKTheory.ClosedIdealKernelH2.originalConormalDifferential_kernel_square
statement:
theorem originalConormalDifferential_kernel_square :
    TF3.c p j = (conormalKernelIso j).hom ≫ kernelConormalDifferential j p
proof:
:= by
  unfold conormalKernelIso kernelConormalDifferential kernelDI TF3.c
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [iso_map_mate_cancel]

name: SchemeKTheory.F12.length_eq_height
statement:
theorem length_eq_height (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsDomain R] [Algebra k R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k R] [hI : I.IsPrime] (x : QuasiregularGenerators R I) :
    (x.length : ℕ∞) = I.height
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing R := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k R
  have hne := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.ringKrullDim_ne_top k (R := R)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    have hbot : ringKrullDim R ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      have := ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial (R := R)
      rw [h] at this
      simp at this
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hbot
    have hy' : y ≠ ⊤ := fun h => hne (by rw [← hy, h]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hy'
    exact ⟨m, by rw [← hy]⟩
  have hgr : ringKrullDim (associatedGradedRing R I) = (n : ℕ∞) :=
    SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing' k I hI.ne_top n hn
  have hMv : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) (R ⧸ I)) =
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + (x.length : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing]
    simp
  have e1 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + (x.length : ℕ∞) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hMv, ← hgr]
    exact (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (R := associatedGradedRing R I)
      (grEquivMvPolynomial x)).symm
  have e2 := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height k R I
  rw [hn] at e2
  have hnt : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hI.ne_top
  have hbot : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    have := ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial (R := R ⧸ I)
    rw [h] at this
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hbot
  rw [← hd] at e1 e2
  have e1' : d + (x.length : ℕ∞) = (n : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast e1
  have e2' : d + I.height = (n : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast e2
  have hdt : d ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at e1'
    simp at e1'
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hdt
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : ℕ, I.height = (h : ℕ∞) := by
    have hlt := Ideal.height_lt_top (I := I) hI.ne_top
    exact ⟨I.height.toNat, by rw [ENat.coe_toNat hlt.ne]⟩
  rw [hh] at e2' ⊢
  have a1 : m + x.length = n := by exact_mod_cast e1'
  have a2 : m + h = n := by exact_mod_cast e2'
  have : x.length = h := by omega
  rw [this]

name: SchemeKTheory.F12.ideal_eq_primeIdealOf
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_primeIdealOf (U : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).affineOpens)
    (hη : i (genericPoint X) ∈ U.1) :
    (i.ker.ideal U) = (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hV : IsAffineOpen (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := U.2.preimage i
  haveI : Nonempty (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩⟩
  have h := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := i) (x := genericPoint X) U.1 U.2
    (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) hV le_rfl hη
  rw [hV.primeIdealOf_genericPoint (X := X), genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine] at h
  rw [← h, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  ext a
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: SchemeKTheory.F12.coheight_eq_of_quasiregularCover
proof:
:= by
  set η := genericPoint X with hηdef
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := C.covers (i.toImage η)
  have hpt : i.ker.subschemeι (i.toImage η) = i η := by
    have h := Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι i
    calc i.ker.subschemeι (i.toImage η) = (i.toImage ≫ i.imageι) η := rfl
      _ = i η := by rw [h]
  have hjη : i η ∈ (C.U j).1 := hpt ▸ hj
  have hU := (C.U j).2
  haveI : Nonempty (C.U j).1 := ⟨⟨i η, hjη⟩⟩
  letI : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n))
  letI := (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kSec k _ (C.U j).1).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, (C.U j).1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finiteType_kSec k _ hU
  have hp := ideal_eq_primeIdealOf k n i (C.U j) hjη
  haveI : (i.ker.ideal (C.U j)).IsPrime := by
    rw [hp]; exact (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i η, hjη⟩).isPrime
  have hlen := length_eq_height k (C.gens j)
  rw [C.length_eq j, hp] at hlen
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf _ hU (i η) hjη]
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight] at *
  exact hlen.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.F12.rank_eq_codim
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight_eq_of_quasiregularCover k n i C]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.F12.rank_eq_codim_of_regular
statement:
theorem rank_eq_codim_of_regular {r : ℕ} (J : Type u)
    (U : J → (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).affineOpens)
    (covers : ∀ z : i.ker.subscheme, ∃ j, i.ker.subschemeι z ∈ (U j).1)
    (gens : ∀ j, SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators
      Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U j) (i.ker.ideal (U j)))
    (length_eq : ∀ j, (gens j).length = r) :
    r = (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat
proof:
:=
  rank_eq_codim k n i
    (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.QuasiregularCover.ofRegular J U covers gens
      length_eq)

name: ARRKG.isPullback_zToK_P1

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.appIso_restricted_section
statement:
lemma appIso_restricted_section {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (T : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, T)) :
    (q.appIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)).hom
        (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (q.image_preimage_le T)).op a) = q.app T a
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (q.app_appIso_inv T) a
  have hh := congrArg (q.appIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)).hom h
  exact hh.symm.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (q.appIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)).inv_hom_id _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.restrictUnitIso_unit_app
statement:
lemma restrictUnitIso_unit_app {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (T : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, T)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app (tensorUnitSheaf Y)).app T a) =
        q.app T a
proof:
:=
  appIso_restricted_section q T a

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.coefficient_restrict_unit
statement:
lemma coefficient_restrict_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {M : Y.Modules} {M' : X.Modules} (k : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf Y)
    (k' : M' ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ≅ M')
    (he : e.hom ≫ k' = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map k ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom) (T : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(M, T)) :
    k'.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (e.hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ T) (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M).app T s)) =
        q.app T (k.app T s)
proof:
:= by
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M
  let b := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map e.hom
  let c := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map k'
  let d := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map k)
  let f := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app (tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let t := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
  have hb : b ≫ c = d ≫ t :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map_comp e.hom k').symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map z) he).trans
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map_comp _ _))
  have hn : a ≫ d = k ≫ f := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.naturality k).symm
  have hh : a ≫ b ≫ c = k ≫ f ≫ t :=
    (congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ z) hb).trans
      ((Category.assoc a d t).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ t) hn))
  have hs := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.app T s) hh
  exact hs.trans (restrictUnitIso_unit_app q T (k.app T s))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.Esec_restrict_unit
statement:
lemma Esec_restrict_unit (T : Q.Opens) (a : Γ(Q, T)) :
    (relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp).hom.app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qQ).unit.app (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)).app T
        (TF2.Esec p T a)) = TF2.Esec p' (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T) (qQ.app T a)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := TF2.Esec_map p (qQ.image_preimage_le T) a
  have ht := relativeSheafRestriction_Esec p p' qQ qP hp (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T)
    (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (qQ.image_preimage_le T)).op a)
  exact (congrArg ((relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp).hom.app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T))
    hr.symm).trans (ht.trans (congrArg (TF2.Esec p' (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T))
      (appIso_restricted_section qQ T a)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.openUnitRoute_homEquiv
statement:
lemma openUnitRoute_homEquiv (M : Y.Modules) (N : X'.Modules)
    (a : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) ⟶ N) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q)).homEquiv M N a =
    openUnitRoute f q M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.openUnitRoute_square
statement:
lemma openUnitRoute_square (M : Y.Modules) :
    openUnitRoute f q M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v g comm).hom.app M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)) ≫
        (openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Category.assoc
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
      ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v g comm).hom.app M))).trans
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_coherence f q v g comm M).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.openUnitRoute_map
statement:
lemma openUnitRoute_map {M : Y.Modules} {N : X.Modules}
    (a : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M ⟶ N) :
    openUnitRoute f q M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map a) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app N)
proof:
:= by
  let t := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M
  let b := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M))
  let c := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map a)
  let d := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a
  let e := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app N)
  have hn : b ≫ c = d ≫ e :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map_comp _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map z)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.naturality a).symm).trans
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map_comp _ _))
  change (t ≫ b) ≫ c = (t ≫ d) ≫ e
  exact (Category.assoc t b c).trans
    ((congrArg (fun z ↦ t ≫ z) hn).trans (Category.assoc t d e).symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.openUnitRoute_square_sections
statement:
lemma openUnitRoute_square_sections (M : Y.Modules) (T : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(M, T)) :
    ((openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M))).app T
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ T)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app T s)) =
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v g comm).hom.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ f ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ T) (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M).app T s))
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ z.app T s) (openUnitRoute_square f q v g comm M)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.pulledModuleRestrictionIso_unit_sections
statement:
lemma pulledModuleRestrictionIso_unit_sections {M : Y.Modules} {M' : Y'.Modules}
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M ≅ M') (T : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(M, T)) :
    (pulledModuleRestrictionIso f q v g comm e).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ f ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ T) (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M).app T s)) =
    ((openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm).hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M')).app T
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M').app (v ⁻¹ᵁ T)
        (e.hom.app (v ⁻¹ᵁ T) (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app T s)))
proof:
:= by
  let x := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app T s
  let z := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ T) x
  let k := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map e.hom
  let D := openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm
  have hu := openUnitRoute_square_sections f q v g comm M T s
  have hd := congrArg (fun a ↦ a.app T z) (D.hom.naturality k)
  have he := congrArg (fun a ↦ a.app (v ⁻¹ᵁ T) x)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.naturality e.hom)
  exact (congrArg (k.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ f ⁻¹ᵁ T)) hu.symm).trans
    (hd.symm.trans (congrArg (((D.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M')).app T)) he.symm))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.openUnitRoute_square_post
statement:
lemma openUnitRoute_square_post {M : Y.Modules} {N : X'.Modules}
    (r : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M) ⟶ N) :
    openUnitRoute f q M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v g comm).hom.app M ≫ r) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map r) ≫
      (openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm).hom.app N
proof:
:= by
  let R := Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f
  let L := Scheme.Modules.pushforward g ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward v
  let C := (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v g comm).hom.app M
  let D := openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M
  let b := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M))
  let d := D.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M))
  have hs : openUnitRoute f q M ≫ R.map C = a ≫ b ≫ d :=
    openUnitRoute_square f q v g comm M
  have hn : d ≫ R.map r = L.map r ≫ D.hom.app N := (D.hom.naturality r).symm
  have hm : b ≫ L.map r = (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map r) :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map_comp _ _).symm
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ openUnitRoute f q M ≫ z) (R.map_comp C r)).trans
    ((Category.assoc (openUnitRoute f q M) (R.map C) (R.map r)).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ R.map r) hs).trans
        ((Category.assoc a (b ≫ d) (R.map r)).trans
          ((congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ z) (Category.assoc b d (R.map r))).trans
            ((congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ b ≫ z) hn).trans
              ((congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ z) (Category.assoc b (L.map r) (D.hom.app N)).symm).trans
                (congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ z ≫ D.hom.app N) hm)))))))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.openUnitRoute_chart_map
statement:
lemma openUnitRoute_chart_map {M : Y.Modules} {M' : Y'.Modules} {N : X'.Modules}
    (a : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M ⟶ M')
    (b : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M' ⟶ N) :
    openUnitRoute f q M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v g comm).hom.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a ≫ b) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map
        (a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M' ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map b) ≫
      (openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm).hom.app N
proof:
:= by
  have hs := openUnitRoute_square_post f q v g comm ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a ≫ b)
  have hn := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.naturality a).symm
  have hi : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a ≫ b) =
      a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M' ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map b :=
    (congrArg (fun z ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M) ≫ z)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map_comp _ _)).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map b) hn).trans
          (Category.assoc _ _ _)))
  exact hs.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).map z ≫
        (openPushforwardSquareIso f q v g comm).hom.app N) hi)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.originalGlobalDifferentialRoute_app
statement:
lemma originalGlobalDifferentialRoute_app (T : Q.Opens) (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf j, T)) :
    (originalGlobalDifferentialRoute p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).app T s =
      ((openPushforwardSquareIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))).app T
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j').unit.app
            (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p')).app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T)
              (TF2.Esec p' (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T) (qQ.app T (TF3.ιapp j T s))))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := TF3.dI_app p j T s
  have hu := pulledModuleRestrictionIso_unit_sections j qX qQ j' hj
    (relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp) T (TF2.Esec p T (TF3.ιapp j T s))
  have he := Esec_restrict_unit p p' qQ qP hp T (TF3.ιapp j T s)
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦
    (pulledRelativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).hom.app (qX ⁻¹ᵁ j ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qX).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p))).app (j ⁻¹ᵁ T) z)) hd).trans
      (hu.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦
        ((openPushforwardSquareIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))).app T
            (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j').unit.app
              (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p')).app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T) z)) he))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.chartGlobalDifferentialRoute_app
statement:
lemma chartGlobalDifferentialRoute_app
    (eI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj (TF3.idealOf j) ≅ TF3.idealOf j')
    (hI : eI.hom ≫ SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j'.ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom)
    (T : Q.Opens) (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf j, T)) :
    (chartGlobalDifferentialRoute p' qQ j j' qX hj eI).app T s =
      ((openPushforwardSquareIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))).app T
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j').unit.app
            (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p')).app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T)
              (TF2.Esec p' (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T) (qQ.app T (TF3.ιapp j T s))))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := TF3.dI_app p' j' (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T)
    (eI.hom.app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qQ).unit.app (TF3.idealOf j)).app T s))
  have hc := coefficient_restrict_unit qQ
    (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker)
    (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j'.ker) eI hI T s
  exact (congrArg
    (((openPushforwardSquareIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))).app T) hd).trans
        (congrArg (fun a ↦
          ((openPushforwardSquareIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))).app T
              (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j').unit.app
                (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p')).app (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T) (TF2.Esec p' (qQ ⁻¹ᵁ T) a))) hc)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.originalDI_restrict
statement:
lemma originalDI_restrict
    (eI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj (TF3.idealOf j) ≅ TF3.idealOf j')
    (hI : eI.hom ≫ SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j'.ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom) :
    chartGlobalDifferentialRoute p' qQ j j' qX hj eI =
      originalGlobalDifferentialRoute p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  ext s
  exact (chartGlobalDifferentialRoute_app p' qQ j j' qX hj eI hI T s).trans
    (originalGlobalDifferentialRoute_app p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj T s).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.pulledDifferential_restrict_mate
statement:
lemma pulledDifferential_restrict_mate :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qX)).homEquiv (TF3.idealOf j)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map (pulledDifferential p j) ≫
            (pulledRelativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).hom) =
      originalGlobalDifferentialRoute p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj
proof:
:= by
  rw [openUnitRoute_homEquiv]
  let R := Scheme.Modules.pushforward qX ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map (pulledDifferential p j)
  let b := (pulledRelativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).hom
  have hs := openUnitRoute_map j qX (pulledDifferential p j)
  have hu := pulledDifferential_unit p j
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ openUnitRoute j qX (TF3.idealOf j) ≫ z) (R.map_comp a b)).trans
    ((Category.assoc (openUnitRoute j qX (TF3.idealOf j)) (R.map a) (R.map b)).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ R.map b) hs).trans
        (congrArg (fun z ↦ (z ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qX).unit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)))) ≫ R.map b) hu)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.chartPulledDifferential_mate
statement:
lemma chartPulledDifferential_mate
    (eI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj (TF3.idealOf j) ≅ TF3.idealOf j') :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qX)).homEquiv (TF3.idealOf j)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))
          ((pulledModuleRestrictionIso j qX qQ j' hj eI).hom ≫ pulledDifferential p' j') =
      chartGlobalDifferentialRoute p' qQ j j' qX hj eI
proof:
:= by
  rw [openUnitRoute_homEquiv]
  let R := Scheme.Modules.pushforward qX ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j
  let C := (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app (TF3.idealOf j)
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map eI.hom
  let b := pulledDifferential p' j'
  have hs := openUnitRoute_chart_map j qX qQ j' hj eI.hom b
  have hu := congrArg (fun z ↦ eI.hom ≫ z) (pulledDifferential_unit p' j')
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ openUnitRoute j qX (TF3.idealOf j) ≫ R.map z)
    (Category.assoc C a b)).trans
      (hs.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qQ).unit.app (TF3.idealOf j) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward qQ).map z ≫
            (openPushforwardSquareIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))) hu))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.pulledDifferential_restrict
statement:
theorem pulledDifferential_restrict
    (eI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj (TF3.idealOf j) ≅ TF3.idealOf j')
    (hI : eI.hom ≫ SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j'.ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map (pulledDifferential p j) ≫
        (pulledRelativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).hom =
      (pulledModuleRestrictionIso j qX qQ j' hj eI).hom ≫ pulledDifferential p' j'
proof:
:= by
  apply (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).comp
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction qX)).homEquiv (TF3.idealOf j)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j').obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p'))).injective
  exact (pulledDifferential_restrict_mate p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).trans
    ((originalDI_restrict p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj eI hI).symm.trans
      (chartPulledDifferential_mate p' qQ j j' qX hj eI).symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.originalConormalDifferential_restrict
statement:
theorem originalConormalDifferential_restrict
    (eI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj (TF3.idealOf j) ≅ TF3.idealOf j')
    (hI : eI.hom ≫ SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j'.ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map
        (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι j.ker) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso qQ).hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map (TF3.c p j) ≫
        (pulledRelativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj).hom =
      (originalConormalRestrictionIso qQ j j' qX hj eI).hom ≫ TF3.c p' j'
proof:
:= by
  have hs := pulledDifferential_restrict p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj eI hI
  have ht := ConormalPastingH2.isoConjugatedMap_restrict (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX)
    (TF3.conormalIso j) (Iso.refl _) (TF3.conormalIso j') (Iso.refl _)
    (pulledModuleRestrictionIso j qX qQ j' hj eI)
    (pulledRelativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP hp j j' qX hj)
    (pulledDifferential p j) (pulledDifferential p' j') hs
  have hid := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map_id
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p))
  simpa only [hid, Iso.refl_inv, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp, conormalDifferential_pulled, originalConormalRestrictionIso] using ht

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalDifferentialRestrictionH2.originalConormalDifferential_chart_restrict
statement:
theorem originalConormalDifferential_chart_restrict :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map (TF3.c p j) ≫
      (chartPulledRelativeSheafIso j p U V e hW).hom =

      chartConormalDifferential j p U V e hW heq

name: M1.adamsRiemannRoch_baseRing
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_baseRing
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralOver R X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralOver R Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk R) = X ↘ Spk R) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n) (hi : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f ∧
      haveI : IsClosedImmersion i
proof:
:= hi
      haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
      ∀ (j : ℕ), 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 X, RT.ARR hY hYreg n i hXreg j x :=
  RT.adamsRiemannRoch_top hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf

name: M1.adamsRiemannRoch_baseRing_forall
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_baseRing_forall
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralOver R X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralOver R Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk R) = X ↘ Spk R) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    ARRwK hY hYreg n i hXreg j x (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) :=
  adamsRiemannRoch_kahler hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj x

      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk (R : Type u)) (toSpec (R : Type u) n) = f ∧

:= hi

name: M1.adamsRiemannRoch_int
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_int {X Y : Scheme.{0}} [X.Over (Spk ℤ)] [Y.Over (Spk ℤ)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk ℤ)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk ℤ)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralOver ℤ X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralOver ℤ Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk ℤ) = X ↘ Spk ℤ) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY ℤ Y n) (hi : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk ℤ) (toSpec ℤ n) = f ∧

:= hi
      haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
      ∀ (j : ℕ), 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 X, RT.ARR hY hYreg n i hXreg j x :=
  adamsRiemannRoch_baseRing hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveRelativeTwistDevissage.higherDirectImage_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem higherDirectImage_isCoherentLike
    (hn : 0 < n) {M : (space R n).Modules}
    (D : ProjectiveRelativeTwistDevissage R n M) :
    ∀ i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n) M i)
proof:
:= by
  induction D with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      let F :=
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
          (toSpec R n) i
      exact
        (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
            F.mapZeroObject.symm inferInstance
  | generator Q d =>
      intro i
      exact
        projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
          R Q n hn d i
  | iso e tail ih =>
      intro i
      let F :=
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
          (toSpec R n) i
      exact
        (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
            (F.mapIso e).symm (ih i)
  | @quotient K M Q _ _ _ d tail inclusion projection zero_relation shortExact coherent ih =>
      let S := ShortComplex.mk inclusion projection zero_relation
      letI : M.IsFinitePresentation := coherent
      have hK : ∀ i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
            (toSpec R n) K i) :=
        ih
      have hG : ∀ i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
            (toSpec R n)
            (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) i) :=
        fun i ↦
          projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
            R Q n hn d i
      exact
        affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_right_isCoherentLike_all
          R n S shortExact hK hG

name: M1.fLoc_eq
statement:
theorem fLoc_eq (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK R X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK R Y)
    (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk R) = X ↘ Spk R) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f) (j : ℕ) (z : KLoc j X) :
    locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk R) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hYreg))
        (pushI n i hY hYreg j z) = fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j z
proof:
:= by
  have key : (locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk R) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hYreg))).comp
      (pushI n i hY hYreg j) = fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j := by
    apply loc_addHom_ext
    intro a
    have e1 : pushI n i hY hYreg j (algebraMap _ _ a) =
        algebraMap _ _ ((resProd hY hYreg n).res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X a))) := by
      unfold pushI pushLocF3
      rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
      rfl
    have hr : ∀ v, k0ToG0 _ ((resProd hY hYreg n).res v) = v := fun v =>
      DFunLike.congr_fun (resProd hY hYreg n).right v
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [e1, locAddHom_algebraMap, fLoc, locAddHom_algebraMap,
      fShriekCan_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi]
    congr 1
    unfold piK0 fShriekK0PI fShriekK0All fShriekG0All
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key z

name: M1.adams_intrinsic
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK R X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK R Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk R) = X ↘ Spk R) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
        (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
      fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          tClass hY hYreg hXreg n i j) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  have h := adamsRiemannRoch_kahler hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj x
  unfold ARRwK at h
  rw [fLoc_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi] at h
  exact h

name: M1.adams_intrinsic_exists
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_exists (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK R X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK R Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk R) = X ↘ Spk R) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f ∧
      haveI : IsClosedImmersion i
proof:
:= ‹_›
      haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
      haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
      ∀ {j : ℕ}, 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 X,
        algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
            (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
          fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
            (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
              tClass hY hYreg hXreg n i j) := by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hfi⟩ := RT.exists_factorisation hX hY f hf
  refine ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, ?_⟩
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
  intro j hj x
  exact adams_intrinsic hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hfi hj x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageSections_baseChangeMap_one_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma preimageSections_baseChangeMap_one_tmul
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    preimageSections_baseChangeMap f M h
        ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x) =
      preimageSections_map f M h x
proof:
:= by
  letI := restrictToPreimage_sections_module f M W
  letI := restrictToPreimage_sections_module f M V
  simp only [preimageSections_baseChangeMap,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearIso]
  change affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearEquiv f M V
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M 0 h
        ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom]
          (affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearEquiv f M W).symm x)) = _
  rw [affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  change affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv f M V
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M 0 h
        ((affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearEquiv f M W).symm x)) = _
  rw [affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_zero_compatibility]
  change preimageSections_map f M h
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearEquiv f M W
        ((affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearEquiv f M W).symm x)) = _
  rw [(affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearEquiv f M W).apply_symm_apply]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_eq
statement:
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_eq
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M 0 h =
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).map
          (affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearIso f M W).hom ≫
        preimageSections_baseChangeMap f M h ≫
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_linearIso f M V).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp [preimageSections_baseChangeMap]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_isIso_iff
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_isIso_iff
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M 0 h) ↔
      IsIso (preimageSections_baseChangeMap f M h)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hIso
    letI : IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M 0 h) := hIso
    dsimp only [preimageSections_baseChangeMap]
    infer_instance
  · intro hIso
    letI : IsIso (preimageSections_baseChangeMap f M h) := hIso
    rw [affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_eq]
    infer_instance

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_zero_iff_sections
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_zero_iff_sections
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) :
    AffineLocalCohomologyBaseChange f M 0 ↔ AffineLocalSectionsBaseChange f M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hCoh V W h hV hW
    exact (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_isIso_iff f M h).mp
      (hCoh h hV hW)
  · intro hSections V W h hV hW
    exact (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_zero_isIso_iff f M h).mpr
      (hSections h hV hW)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.incl1_comp_kahlerRestrict
statement:
theorem incl1_comp_kahlerRestrict [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] :
    incl1 (g := g) (p := OMG.piP g n) ≫ kahlerRestrict g n d = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : incl1 (g := g) (p := OMG.piP g n) = biprod.inl ≫ (kahlerCompositeIso g n d).hom := by
    simp [kahlerCompositeIso, phi]
  rw [h1, kahlerRestrict]
