name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.kahler_composite_exact
statement:
theorem kahler_composite_exact [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] :
    (ShortComplex.mk (incl1 (g := g) (p := OMG.piP g n)) (kahlerRestrict g n d)
      (incl1_comp_kahlerRestrict g n d)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let A := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (OMG.piP g n)).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf g)
  let B := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (OMG.sndP g n)).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec k n))
  have hS' : (ShortComplex.mk (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) biprod.snd (by simp)).ShortExact :=
    ⟨(ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).exact⟩
  refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso ?_ hS'
  refine ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl A) (kahlerCompositeIso g n d) (kahlerPiIso g n) ?_ ?_
  · simp [kahlerCompositeIso, phi]
  · simp [kahlerRestrict]
    rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF1.kahlerClass_composite
statement:
theorem kahlerClass_composite [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] :
    kahlerClassAbs g n d =

          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank g d).isFiniteLocallyFree) +
      OMG.kahlerClass g n
proof:

  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact _ _ _ _ (incl1_comp_kahlerRestrict g n d)
    (kahler_composite_exact g n d)

    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk R) = X ↘ Spk R) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n)

statement:
theorem ideal_eq_primeIdealOf_amb (U : Z.affineOpens) (hη : i (genericPoint X) ∈ U.1) :
    (i.ker.ideal U) = (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hV : IsAffineOpen (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := U.2.preimage i
  haveI : Nonempty (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩⟩
  have h := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := i) (x := genericPoint X) U.1 U.2
    (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) hV le_rfl hη
  rw [hV.primeIdealOf_genericPoint (X := X), genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine] at h
  rw [← h, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  ext a
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.length_eq_coheight_ofList_amb
statement:
theorem length_eq_coheight_ofList_amb (U : Z.affineOpens)
    (hη : i (genericPoint X) ∈ U.1) (rs : List Γ(Z, U))
    (hI : i.ker.ideal U = Ideal.ofList rs)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(Z, U) rs) :
    (rs.length : ℕ∞) = coheight (i (genericPoint X))
proof:
:= by
  have hU := U.2
  haveI : Nonempty U.1 := ⟨⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Z, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  have hp := ideal_eq_primeIdealOf_amb i U hη
  haveI : (i.ker.ideal U).IsPrime := by
    rw [hp]; exact (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).isPrime
  have hlen0 := M1.length_eq_height_of_isWeaklyRegular (i.ker.ideal U) rs hI.symm hreg
  have hlen : (rs.length : ℕ∞) =
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).asIdeal.height := by
    rw [← hp]; exact hlen0
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf _ hU (i (genericPoint X)) hη]
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight] at *
  exact hlen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.exists_regular_chart_amb
statement:
theorem exists_regular_chart_amb (z0 : X) :
    ∃ (U : Z.affineOpens) (_ : i z0 ∈ U.1) (rs : List Γ(Z, U)),
      i.ker.ideal U = Ideal.ofList rs ∧ RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(Z, U) rs ∧
      rs.length = (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat
proof:
:= by
  set η := genericPoint X with hηdef
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Z.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show i z0 ∈ (⊤ : Z.Opens) from trivial)
  let Vaff : Z.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  have hηx : i η ⤳ i z0 :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial : η ⤳ z0).map i.continuous
  have hηV : i η ∈ V := hηx.mem_open V.isOpen hxV
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Z, V) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian Vaff
  let x : V := ⟨i z0, hxV⟩
  let ξ : V := ⟨i η, hηV⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(Z, V) (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk Z.presheaf x
  haveI hlocx := hV.isLocalization_stalk x
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z)) := hZ (i z0)
  set J : Ideal Γ(Z, V) := (hV.primeIdealOf ξ).asIdeal with hJdef
  have hJ : i.ker.ideal Vaff = J := ideal_eq_primeIdealOf_amb i Vaff hηV
  have hQ : J.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z))) =
      RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z0).hom := by
    rw [← SchemeKTheory.F14.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_map hV x ξ hηx]
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrime i z0).symm
  have hprime : (J.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z)))).IsPrime := by
    rw [← SchemeKTheory.F14.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_map hV x ξ hηx]
    infer_instance
  have hle : J.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z))) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z)) :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hprime.ne_top
  haveI hregq : IsRegularLocalRing
      (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z) ⧸ J.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z)))) := by
    haveI := hX z0
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
      (((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hQ).trans
        (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (i.stalkMap_surjective z0))).symm)
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, ys, -, hys⟩ := SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_chart_regular_generators
    (hV.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z)) J hle
  have hD : IsAffineOpen (Z.basicOpen g) := hV.basicOpen g
  let Daff : Z.affineOpens := Z.affineBasicOpen (U := Vaff) g
  haveI hlocD := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  obtain ⟨hJS, hregS⟩ := hys (Submonoid.powers g) Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen g)
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit g)
  have hxD : i z0 ∈ Z.basicOpen g := by
    rw [Scheme.mem_basicOpen' (X := Z) g x]
    exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (Z.presheaf.stalk (x : Z))
      (hV.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal g).mpr hgp
  have hker : i.ker.ideal Daff =
      Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen g))) := by
    have := i.ker.map_ideal_basicOpen Vaff g
    rw [← this, hJ]
    exact hJS
  refine ⟨Daff, hxD, ys.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen g)), hker, hregS, ?_⟩
  have hξD : i η ∈ Z.basicOpen g := hηx.mem_open (Z.basicOpen g).isOpen hxD
  have hl := length_eq_coheight_ofList_amb i Daff hξD _ hker hregS
  have hl' : ((ys.map (algebraMap Γ(Z, V) Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen g))).length : ℕ∞) =
      coheight (i η) := hl
  rw [← hl']
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.conormalDataOfRegularAmb
statement:
theorem conormalDataOfRegularAmb :
    Nonempty (ConormalDataAmb i (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat)
proof:
:=
  ⟨ConormalDataAmb.ofQuasiregular i (quasiregularCover_amb i hZ hX)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.length_eq_coheight_amb
statement:
theorem length_eq_coheight_amb (U : Z.affineOpens)
    (hη : i (genericPoint X) ∈ U.1)
    (x : QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Z, U) (i.ker.ideal U)) :
    (x.length : ℕ∞) = coheight (i (genericPoint X))
proof:
:= by
  have hU := U.2
  haveI : Nonempty U.1 := ⟨⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩⟩
  letI := (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kSec k _ U.1).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(Z, U.1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finiteType_kSec k _ hU
  have hp := ideal_eq_primeIdealOf_amb i U hη
  haveI : (i.ker.ideal U).IsPrime := by
    rw [hp]; exact (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).isPrime
  have hlen0 := SchemeKTheory.F12.length_eq_height k x
  have hlen : (x.length : ℕ∞) =
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).asIdeal.height := by
    rw [← hp]; exact hlen0
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf _ hU (i (genericPoint X)) hη]
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight] at *
  exact hlen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.coheight_eq_of_quasiregularCover_amb
proof:
:= by
  set η := genericPoint X with hηdef
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := C.covers (i.toImage η)
  have hpt : i.ker.subschemeι (i.toImage η) = i η := by
    have h := Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι i
    calc i.ker.subschemeι (i.toImage η) = (i.toImage ≫ i.imageι) η := rfl
      _ = i η := by rw [h]
  have hjη : i η ∈ (C.U j).1 := hpt ▸ hj
  have hU := (C.U j).2
  haveI : Nonempty (C.U j).1 := ⟨⟨i η, hjη⟩⟩
  letI := (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kSec k _ (C.U j).1).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(Z, (C.U j).1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finiteType_kSec k _ hU
  have hp := ideal_eq_primeIdealOf_amb i (C.U j) hjη
  haveI : (i.ker.ideal (C.U j)).IsPrime := by
    rw [hp]; exact (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i η, hjη⟩).isPrime
  have hlen := SchemeKTheory.F12.length_eq_height k (C.gens j)
  rw [C.length_eq j, hp] at hlen
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf _ hU (i η) hjη]
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight] at *
  exact hlen.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.rank_eq_codim_amb
statement:
theorem rank_eq_codim_amb {r : ℕ} (C : ConormalSheaf.QuasiregularCover i.ker r) :
    r = (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight_eq_of_quasiregularCover_amb k i C]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.conormalDataOfRegular_prod
statement:
theorem conormalDataOfRegular_prod {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (i : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hX : RegStalks X) :
    Nonempty (ConormalDataAmb i (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) :=
    T1CL.prod_lft (k := k) n
  haveI := T1CL.prod_isNoetherian (k := k) (Y := Y) n
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  haveI : IsIntegral (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  exact conormalDataOfRegularAmb i (prod_regStalks hreg n) hX

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.appLE_eq_of_eq
statement:
lemma appLE_eq_of_eq {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f g : X ⟶ S) (hfg : f = g)
    (T : S.Opens) (W : X.Opens) (ef : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ T) (eg : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ T) :
    f.appLE T W ef = g.appLE T W eg
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.restrictedKahler_ext
proof:
:= by
  let lift (γ : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars e.inv.hom).obj
      (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential f) ⟶ M) :
      CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential f ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars e.hom.hom).obj M :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (X := CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential f)
      (Y := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars e.hom.hom).obj M) {
      toFun := γ
      map_add' := γ.hom.map_add
      map_smul' := by
        intro a ω
        have he : e.inv (e.hom a) = a := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom e.hom_inv_id a
        have hγ := γ.hom.map_smul (e.hom a) ω
        change γ (e.inv (e.hom a) • ω) = e.hom a • γ ω at hγ
        exact (congrArg γ (congrArg (fun c : A ↦ c • ω) he.symm)).trans hγ }
  have hl : lift α = lift β := CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext hd
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro ω
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hl ω

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.openRestrictionSheafification_unit
statement:
lemma openRestrictionSheafification_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P) ≫
        (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (openRestrictionSheafificationIso q P).hom =
      (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P)
proof:
:= by
  let rη := (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P)
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj ((moduleSheafification Y).obj P)
  change (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P) ≫
    (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      ((moduleSheafification X).map rη ≫ (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app Q) = rη
  let η₀ := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P)
  let η₁ := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj Q)
  let ε := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app Q
  have hn : η₀ ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ((moduleSheafification X).map rη) =
      rη ≫ η₁ := ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.naturality rη).symm
  have ht : η₁ ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ε = 𝟙 _ :=
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).right_triangle_components Q
  exact (congrArg (fun f ↦ η₀ ≫ f)
    ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map_comp ((moduleSheafification X).map rη) ε)).trans
    ((Category.assoc η₀
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ((moduleSheafification X).map rη))
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ε)).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ε) hn).trans
        ((Category.assoc rη η₁ ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ε)).trans
          ((congrArg (fun f ↦ rη ≫ f) ht).trans (Category.comp_id rη)))))

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.generator_preimage_le
statement:
lemma generator_preimage_le (T : P.Opens) (W : Q'.Opens)
    (e : qQ ''ᵁ W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ T) : W ≤ p' ⁻¹ᵁ (qP ⁻¹ᵁ T)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : qQ x ∈ qQ ''ᵁ W := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have he := e hx'
  change p (qQ x) ∈ T at he
  change qP (p' x) ∈ T
  have hh := congrArg (fun f : Q' ⟶ P ↦ f x) h
  change p (qQ x) = qP (p' x) at hh
  exact hh ▸ he

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.appLE_restrict
statement:
lemma appLE_restrict (T : P.Opens) (W : Q'.Opens)
    (e : qQ ''ᵁ W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ T) :
    p.appLE T (qQ ''ᵁ W) e ≫ (qQ.appIso W).hom =
      qP.app T ≫ p'.appLE (qP ⁻¹ᵁ T) W (generator_preimage_le p p' qQ qP h T W e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
    ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE]
  exact appLE_eq_of_eq _ _ h _ _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.generator_image_le
statement:
lemma generator_image_le (T : P'.Opens) (W : Q'.Opens)
    (e : W ≤ p' ⁻¹ᵁ T) : qQ ''ᵁ W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ (qP ''ᵁ T)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  change p (qQ x) ∈ qP ''ᵁ T
  have hh := congrArg (fun f : Q' ⟶ P ↦ f x) h
  change p (qQ x) = qP (p' x) at hh
  rw [hh]
  exact ⟨p' x, e hx, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.appLE_image_restrict
statement:
lemma appLE_image_restrict (T : P'.Opens) (W : Q'.Opens)
    (e : W ≤ p' ⁻¹ᵁ T) :
    p.appLE (qP ''ᵁ T) (qQ ''ᵁ W) (generator_image_le p p' qQ qP h T W e) ≫
        (qQ.appIso W).hom =
      (qP.appIso T).hom ≫ p'.appLE T W e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom',
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
  exact appLE_eq_of_eq _ _ h _ _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.pullbackSet_image
statement:
lemma pullbackSet_image (W : Q'.Opens) :
    (qQ.appIso W).hom '' Cotangent.pullbackSet p (qQ ''ᵁ W) =
      Cotangent.pullbackSet p' W
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨T, e, a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨qP ⁻¹ᵁ T, generator_preimage_le p p' qQ qP h T W e, qP.app T a, ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun f ↦ f a) (appLE_restrict p p' qQ qP h T W e)).symm
  · rintro ⟨T, e, a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨p.appLE (qP ''ᵁ T) (qQ ''ᵁ W)
      (generator_image_le p p' qQ qP h T W e) ((qP.appIso T).inv a),
      ⟨qP ''ᵁ T, generator_image_le p p' qQ qP h T W e, (qP.appIso T).inv a, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have hh := congrArg (fun f ↦ f ((qP.appIso T).inv a))
      (appLE_image_restrict p p' qQ qP h T W e)
    simpa only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] using hh

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.baseSubring_map
statement:
lemma baseSubring_map (W : Q'.Opens) :
    (Cotangent.baseSubring p (qQ ''ᵁ W)).map (qQ.appIso W).hom.hom =
      Cotangent.baseSubring p' W
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cotangent.baseSubring, RingHom.map_closure]
  rw [pullbackSet_image p p' qQ qP h W]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.mem_baseSubring_iff
statement:
lemma mem_baseSubring_iff (W : Q'.Opens) (a : Γ(Q, qQ ''ᵁ W)) :
    (qQ.appIso W).hom a ∈ Cotangent.baseSubring p' W ↔
      a ∈ Cotangent.baseSubring p (qQ ''ᵁ W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← baseSubring_map p p' qQ qP h W, Subring.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, he⟩
    have hba : b = a := (qQ.appIso W).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective he
    exact hba ▸ hb
  · intro ha
    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.baseSubringRingEquiv_coe
statement:
lemma baseSubringRingEquiv_coe (W : Q'.Opens)
    (a : Cotangent.baseSubring p (qQ ''ᵁ W)) :
    (baseSubringRingEquiv p p' qQ qP h W a : Γ(Q', W)) = (qQ.appIso W).hom a.1
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.baseInclusion_square
statement:
lemma baseInclusion_square (W : Q'.Opens) :
    (baseSubringIso p p' qQ qP h W).hom ≫ Cotangent.baseInclusion p' W =
      Cotangent.baseInclusion p (qQ ''ᵁ W) ≫ (qQ.appIso W).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.baseSubringIso_naturality
statement:
lemma baseSubringIso_naturality {W V : Q'.Opens} (i : op W ⟶ op V) :
    (Cotangent.basePresheaf p).map (qQ.opensFunctor.op.map i) ≫
        (baseSubringIso p p' qQ qP h V).hom =
      (baseSubringIso p p' qQ qP h W).hom ≫ (Cotangent.basePresheaf p').map i
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (qQ.appIso_hom_naturality i) a.1

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeKahlerMap_d
statement:
lemma relativeKahlerMap_d (W : Q'.Opens) (a : Γ(Q, qQ ''ᵁ W)) :
    relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h W (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) =
      CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d ((qQ.appIso W).hom a)
proof:
:=
  CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.map_d (baseInclusion_square p p' qQ qP h W) a

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeKahlerMap_bijective
statement:
lemma relativeKahlerMap_bijective (W : Q'.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective (relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h W)
proof:
:=
  KahlerRingTransportH2.kahlerMap_bijective_of_ringIso
    (baseSubringIso p p' qQ qP h W) (qQ.appIso W)
    (baseInclusion_square p p' qQ qP h W)

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeKahlerIso_hom
statement:
lemma relativeKahlerIso_hom (W : Q'.Opens) :
    (relativeKahlerIso p p' qQ qP h W).hom = relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h W
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeKahlerRestrictionAppIso_apply
statement:
lemma relativeKahlerRestrictionAppIso_apply (W : Q'.Opens)
    (ω : ((openRestrictionPresheaf qQ).obj (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p)).obj (op W)) :
    (relativeKahlerRestrictionAppIso p p' qQ qP h W).hom ω =
      relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h W ω
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeKahlerRestriction_naturality
statement:
lemma relativeKahlerRestriction_naturality {W V : Q'.Opens} (i : op W ⟶ op V) :
    ((openRestrictionPresheaf qQ).obj (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p)).map i ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Q'.presheaf.map i).hom).map
          (relativeKahlerRestrictionAppIso p p' qQ qP h V).hom =
      (relativeKahlerRestrictionAppIso p p' qQ qP h W).hom ≫
        (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p').map i
proof:
:= by
  apply restrictedKahler_ext (Cotangent.baseInclusion p (qQ ''ᵁ W)) (qQ.appIso W)
  intro a
  change relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h V
      ((Cotangent.relativePresheaf p).map (qQ.opensFunctor.op.map i)
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) =
    (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p').map i
      (relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h W (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a))
  have hl := PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
    (Cotangent.baseMap p) (qQ.opensFunctor.op.map i) a
  have hr := PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
    (Cotangent.baseMap p') i ((qQ.appIso W).hom a)
  exact (congrArg (relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h V) hl).trans
    ((relativeKahlerMap_d p p' qQ qP h V _).trans
      ((congrArg (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := Cotangent.baseInclusion p' V))
        (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (qQ.appIso_hom_naturality i) a)).trans
          (hr.symm.trans (congrArg ((Cotangent.relativePresheaf p').map i)
            (relativeKahlerMap_d p p' qQ qP h W a).symm))))

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeSheafRestriction_unit
statement:
lemma relativeSheafRestriction_unit :
    (openRestrictionPresheaf qQ).map
        ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q).unit.app (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p)) ≫
      (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Q').map (relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP h).hom =
    (relativePresheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP h).hom ≫
      (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q').unit.app (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p')
proof:
:= by
  let C := openRestrictionSheafificationIso qQ (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p)
  let K := relativePresheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP h
  let I := relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP h
  let η₀ := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q').unit.app
    ((openRestrictionPresheaf qQ).obj (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p))
  have hc : C.hom ≫ I.hom = (moduleSheafification Q').map K.hom :=
    C.hom_inv_id_assoc _
  have hu := openRestrictionSheafification_unit qQ (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p)
  exact (congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Q').map I.hom) hu.symm).trans
    ((Category.assoc η₀ ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Q').map C.hom)
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Q').map I.hom)).trans
      ((congrArg (fun f ↦ η₀ ≫ f)
        (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Q').map_comp C.hom I.hom).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun f ↦ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Q').map f) hc))).trans
            ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q').unit.naturality K.hom).symm))

name: SchemeKTheory.BaseSubringRestrictionH2.relativeSheafRestriction_Esec
statement:
lemma relativeSheafRestriction_Esec (W : Q'.Opens) (a : Γ(Q, qQ ''ᵁ W)) :
    (relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP h).hom.app W
        (TF2.Esec p (qQ ''ᵁ W) a) =
      TF2.Esec p' W ((qQ.appIso W).hom a)
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app (op W) (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a))
    (relativeSheafRestriction_unit p p' qQ qP h)
  change (relativeSheafRestrictionIso p p' qQ qP h).hom.app W
      (TF2.Esec p (qQ ''ᵁ W) a) =
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q').unit.app (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p')).app (op W)
      (relativeKahlerMap p p' qQ qP h W (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) at he
  exact he.trans (congrArg
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Q').unit.app (Cotangent.relativePresheaf p')).app (op W))
    (relativeKahlerMap_d p p' qQ qP h W a))

    (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i W) :

statement:
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp_one_tmul
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W)
    (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i W) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hUV
        ((1 : Γ(Y, U)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, V), (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom]
          (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hVW
            ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom] x))) =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i (hUV.trans hVW)
        ((1 : Γ(Y, U)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W),
          (baseOpenRestriction (hUV.trans hVW)).hom] x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  exact affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_comp f M i hUV hVW x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.middle
statement:
theorem AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.middle

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.right
statement:
theorem AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.right
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ)
    (h₁ : AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f S.X₁ n)

    AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f S.X₃ n

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.left
statement:
theorem AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.left
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ)
    (h₂ : AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f S.X₂ n)
    (h₃ : AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f S.X₃ n) :
    AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f S.X₁ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
  exact affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_left_succ_isZero
    f S hS j (h₃ j (by omega)) (h₂ (j + 1) (by omega))

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.biprod
statement:
theorem AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.biprod
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M N : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (hM : AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f M n)
    (hN : AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f N n) :
    AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f (M ⊞ N) n
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex X.Modules :=
    ShortComplex.mk (biprod.inl : M ⟶ M ⊞ N) biprod.snd (by simp)
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct M N).shortExact
  exact AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.middle
    f S hS n hM hN

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.biproduct
statement:
theorem AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove.biproduct
    {J : Type} [Fintype J] (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : J → X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (hM : ∀ j, AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f (M j) n) :
    AffineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove f (⨁ M) n
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  let F := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f i
  have hdiagram : IsZero (Discrete.functor (F.obj ∘ M)) :=
    (Discrete.functor (F.obj ∘ M)).isZero (fun j ↦ hM j.as i hi)
  have hsum : IsZero (⨁ fun j ↦ F.obj (M j)) :=
    (biproduct.isLimit (F.obj ∘ M)).isZero_pt hdiagram
  exact IsZero.of_iso hsum (F.mapBiproduct M)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_mapₗ_of_exact_ladder
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_mapₗ_of_exact_ladder (N : (Spec R).Modules)
    {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (B : ι → (Spec R).Modules) (C : κ → (Spec R).Modules)
    (u : ∀ V : (Spec R).Opens, Γ(N, V) →ₗ[R] (∀ i, Γ(B i, V)))
    (d : ∀ V : (Spec R).Opens, (∀ i, Γ(B i, V)) →ₗ[R] (∀ k, Γ(C k, V)))
    (hu : ∀ {U V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ⟶ U) (x : Γ(N, U)) (i : ι),
      u V (N.mapₗ h x) i = (B i).mapₗ h (u U x i))
    (hd : ∀ {U V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ⟶ U) (s : ∀ i, Γ(B i, U)) (k : κ),
      d V (fun i => (B i).mapₗ h (s i)) k = (C k).mapₗ h (d U s k))
    (hinj : ∀ V, Function.Injective (u V))
    (hex : ∀ V, Function.Exact (u V) (d V))
    (S : Submonoid R) {V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ⟶ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
    (hB : ∀ i, IsLocalizedModule S ((B i).mapₗ h))
    (hC : ∀ k, IsLocalizedModule S ((C k).mapₗ h)) :
    IsLocalizedModule S (N.mapₗ h)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hB
  haveI := hC
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule S (LinearMap.piMap fun i => (B i).mapₗ h) :=
    IsLocalizedModule.pi S (fun i => (B i).mapₗ h)
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule S (LinearMap.piMap fun k => (C k).mapₗ h) :=
    IsLocalizedModule.pi S (fun k => (C k).mapₗ h)
  exact IsLocalizedModule.of_exact_ladder S (u ⊤) (d ⊤) (u V) (d V) (N.mapₗ h)
    (LinearMap.piMap fun i => (B i).mapₗ h) (LinearMap.piMap fun k => (C k).mapₗ h)
    (hinj ⊤) (hex ⊤) (hinj V) (hex V)
    (fun x => funext fun i => hu h x i) (fun s => funext fun k => hd h s k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_exact_ladder
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_of_exact_ladder (N : (Spec R).Modules)
    {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (B : ι → (Spec R).Modules) (C : κ → (Spec R).Modules)
    (hB : ∀ i, (B i).IsQuasicoherent) (hC : ∀ k, (C k).IsQuasicoherent)
    (u : ∀ V : (Spec R).Opens, Γ(N, V) →ₗ[R] (∀ i, Γ(B i, V)))
    (d : ∀ V : (Spec R).Opens, (∀ i, Γ(B i, V)) →ₗ[R] (∀ k, Γ(C k, V)))
    (hu : ∀ {U V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ⟶ U) (x : Γ(N, U)) (i : ι),
      u V (N.mapₗ h x) i = (B i).mapₗ h (u U x i))
    (hd : ∀ {U V : (Spec R).Opens} (h : V ⟶ U) (s : ∀ i, Γ(B i, U)) (k : κ),
      d V (fun i => (B i).mapₗ h (s i)) k = (C k).mapₗ h (d U s k))
    (hinj : ∀ V, Function.Injective (u V))
    (hex : ∀ V, Function.Exact (u V) (d V)) :
    N.IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  rw [isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ]
  intro f
  exact isLocalizedModule_mapₗ_of_exact_ladder N B C u d hu hd hinj hex _ _
    (fun i => (isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ (B i)).mp (hB i) f)
    (fun k => (isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ (C k)).mp (hC k) f)

    (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension n) (ambient_square g n) inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.first_smooth
statement: lemma first_smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension m (first g n m)
proof:
:= by
  letI := pi_smooth g m
  letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange m
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
    (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension m) (first_square g n m) inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.second_smooth
statement: lemma second_smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (second g n m)
proof:
:= by
  letI := pi_smooth g n
  letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange n
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
    (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension n) (second_square g n m) inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.first_separated
statement: lemma first_separated : IsSeparated (first g n m)
proof:
:= by
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
    (P := @IsSeparated) (first_square g n m) inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.second_separated
statement: lemma second_separated : IsSeparated (second g n m)
proof:
:= by
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
    (P := @IsSeparated) (second_square g n m) inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.toBase_smooth
statement: lemma toBase_smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (m + n) (toBase g n m)
proof:
:= by
  letI := pi_smooth g n
  letI := first_smooth g n m
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.factor_compatibility
statement:
lemma factor_compatibility :
    (first g n m ≫ rho g n) ≫ toSpec R n =
      (second g n m ≫ rho g m) ≫ toSpec R m
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (first g n m ≫ pi g n) ≫ g := by
      rw [Category.assoc, (ambient_square g n).w, ← Category.assoc]
    _ = (second g n m ≫ pi g m) ≫ g :=
      congrArg (fun a => a ≫ g) (toBase_eq_second g n m)
    _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc, (ambient_square g m).w]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.toSpecProduct_fst
statement:
lemma toSpecProduct_fst :
    toSpecProduct g n m ≫ pullback.fst (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m) = first g n m ≫ rho g n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toSpecProduct, pullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.toSpecProduct_snd
statement:
lemma toSpecProduct_snd :
    toSpecProduct g n m ≫ pullback.snd (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m) = second g n m ≫ rho g m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toSpecProduct, pullback.lift_snd]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specProduct_square_commutes
statement:
lemma specProduct_square_commutes :
    toSpecProduct g n m ≫ projectiveProductStructure R n m = toBase g n m ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  change toSpecProduct g n m ≫ (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ toSpec R n) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, toSpecProduct_fst, Category.assoc, (ambient_square g n).w]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeFirst_pi
statement: lemma specConeFirst_pi : specConeFirst g n m s ≫ pi g n = s.snd
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specConeFirst, pi, pullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeFirst_rho
statement:
lemma specConeFirst_rho :
    specConeFirst g n m s ≫ rho g n = s.fst ≫ pullback.fst (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specConeFirst, rho, pullback.lift_snd]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeSecond_pi
statement: lemma specConeSecond_pi : specConeSecond g n m s ≫ pi g m = s.snd
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specConeSecond, pi, pullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeSecond_rho
statement:
lemma specConeSecond_rho :
    specConeSecond g n m s ≫ rho g m = s.fst ≫ pullback.snd (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specConeSecond, rho, pullback.lift_snd]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeLift_first
statement: lemma specConeLift_first : specConeLift g n m s ≫ first g n m = specConeFirst g n m s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specConeLift, first, pullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeLift_second
statement: lemma specConeLift_second : specConeLift g n m s ≫ second g n m = specConeSecond g n m s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [specConeLift, second, pullback.lift_snd]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeLift_toBase
statement: lemma specConeLift_toBase : specConeLift g n m s ≫ toBase g n m = s.snd
proof:
:= by
  rw [toBase, ← Category.assoc, specConeLift_first, specConeFirst_pi]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeLift_toSpecProduct
statement: lemma specConeLift_toSpecProduct : specConeLift g n m s ≫ toSpecProduct g n m = s.fst
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, toSpecProduct_fst, ← Category.assoc, specConeLift_first, specConeFirst_rho]
  · rw [Category.assoc, toSpecProduct_snd, ← Category.assoc, specConeLift_second,
      specConeSecond_rho]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specConeLift_unique
statement:
lemma specConeLift_unique (k : s.pt ⟶ common g n m)
    (hkq : k ≫ toSpecProduct g n m = s.fst) (hkp : k ≫ toBase g n m = s.snd) :
    k = specConeLift g n m s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : k ≫ first g n m = specConeFirst g n m s := by
    apply (ambient_square g n).hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← toSpecProduct_fst, ← Category.assoc, hkq, specConeFirst_rho]
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← toBase, hkp, specConeFirst_pi]
  have h2 : k ≫ second g n m = specConeSecond g n m s := by
    apply (ambient_square g m).hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← toSpecProduct_snd, ← Category.assoc, hkq, specConeSecond_rho]
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← toBase_eq_second, hkp, specConeSecond_pi]
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · exact h1.trans (specConeLift_first g n m s).symm
  · exact h2.trans (specConeLift_second g n m s).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.specProduct_square
statement:
lemma specProduct_square :
    IsPullback (toSpecProduct g n m) (toBase g n m) (projectiveProductStructure R n m) g
proof:
:=
  IsPullback.of_isLimit (PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk (specProduct_square_commutes g n m)
    (specConeLift g n m) (specConeLift_toSpecProduct g n m) (specConeLift_toBase g n m)
    (specConeLift_unique g n m))

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.ambient_noetherian
statement: lemma ambient_noetherian [IsNoetherian Y] : IsNoetherian (ambient g n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of R)) := ⟨g⟩
  exact T1CL.prod_isNoetherian (k := R) (Y := Y) n

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.common_noetherian
statement: lemma common_noetherian [IsNoetherian Y] : IsNoetherian (common g n m)
proof:
:= by
  letI := ambient_noetherian g n
  letI := ambient_noetherian g m
  letI : IsLocallyNoetherian (common g n m) := inferInstance
  letI : QuasiCompact (first g n m) := inferInstance
  letI : CompactSpace (common g n m) :=
    QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (first g n m)
  exact {}

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.common_integral
statement: lemma common_integral [IsIntegral Y] : IsIntegral (common g n m)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIntegral (ambient g n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj g n
  letI : IsIntegral (pullback (pi g n ≫ g) (toSpec R m)) :=
    isIntegral_pullback_proj (pi g n ≫ g) m
  exact isIntegral_of_iso (nestedIso g n m)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.common_regStalks
statement:
lemma common_regStalks [IsNoetherian Y] (hY : RegStalks Y) :
    RegStalks (common g n m)
proof:
:= by
  letI := ambient_noetherian g n
  exact regStalks_of_openImmersion (nestedIso g n m).hom
    (pullback_regStalks (pi g n ≫ g) (pullback_regStalks g hY n) m)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_first
statement: lemma embedding_first : embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ first g n m = i1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embedding, first, pullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_second
statement: lemma embedding_second : embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ second g n m = i2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embedding, second, pullback.lift_snd]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_toBase
statement: lemma embedding_toBase : embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ toBase g n m = i1 ≫ pi g n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toBase, ← Category.assoc, embedding_first]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_toBase_second
statement: lemma embedding_toBase_second : embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ toBase g n m = i2 ≫ pi g m
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedding_toBase, h]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_closed
statement: lemma embedding_closed [IsClosedImmersion i1] : IsClosedImmersion (embedding g n m i1 i2 h)
proof:
:= by
  letI := first_separated g n m
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ first g n m) := by
    rw [embedding_first]
    infer_instance
  exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ (first g n m)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_first_closed
statement:
lemma embedding_first_closed [IsClosedImmersion i1] :
    IsClosedImmersion (embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ first g n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedding_first]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.embedding_second_closed
statement:
lemma embedding_second_closed [IsClosedImmersion i2] :
    IsClosedImmersion (embedding g n m i1 i2 h ≫ second g n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedding_second]
  infer_instance

name: B5.E1_of_arr
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [← h x, hchi]

name: B5.Phi_apply
statement: theorem Phi_apply (F : K →ₗ[ℚ] L) (τi w : K) : Phi F τi w = F (τi * w)
proof: := rfl

name: B5.Phi_psi
statement:
theorem Phi_psi {psiK : K →ₐ[ℚ] K} {psiL : L →ₐ[ℚ] L} {F : K →ₗ[ℚ] L} {t : K}
    (h : ARRAbs psiK psiL F t) {j d : ℕ} {s τ τi : K} (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t)
    (hτ : psiK τ = s * τ) (hi : τ * τi = 1) (w : K) :
    Phi F τi (psiK w) = (j : ℚ) ^ d • psiL (Phi F τi w)
proof:
:= by
  have e : s * psiK τi = τi :=
    RG6B.s_mul_psi_inv (psi := (psiK : K →+* K)) hτ hi
  rw [Phi_apply, Phi_apply, h, ← map_smul]
  congr 1
  calc τi * psiK w = psiK w * (s * psiK τi) := by rw [e]; ring
    _ = psiK w * (((j : ℚ) ^ d • t) * psiK τi) := by rw [hs]
    _ = (j : ℚ) ^ d • (t * psiK (τi * w)) := by
        rw [map_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]; congr 1; ring

name: M1.ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ringKrullDim Γ(space R n, coordinateOpen R n j) ≤ ringKrullDim R + n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.coordinateOpenSectionsEquivR R n j),
    MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing]
  have : Nat.card (AffineChartIndex n j) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
    simp
  rw [this]

name: M1.ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le_add_d
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le_add_d (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [FiniteDimBase R] (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ringKrullDim Γ(space R n, coordinateOpen R n j) ≤ ((n + FiniteDimBase.d R : ℕ) :
      WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  refine (ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le R n j).trans ?_
  have := FiniteDimBase.ringKrullDim_le R
  calc ringKrullDim R + (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (FiniteDimBase.d R : WithBot ℕ∞) + n :=
        add_le_add_left this _
    _ = ((n + FiniteDimBase.d R : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by push_cast; ring

name: ARRASM.locMap_comp
statement:
theorem locMap_comp {S T V : Scheme.{u}} (f : K0 S →+* K0 T) (g : K0 T →+* K0 V) :
    (locMap (j := j) g).comp (locMap (j := j) f) = locMap (j := j) (g.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 S))
  ext a
  simp [locMap_algebraMap]

name: ARRASM.locMap_comm
statement:
theorem locMap_comm {S T₁ T₂ V : Scheme.{u}} (f : K0 S →+* K0 T₁) (g : K0 T₁ →+* K0 V)
    (f' : K0 S →+* K0 T₂) (g' : K0 T₂ →+* K0 V) (h : g.comp f = g'.comp f') (x : KLoc j S) :
    locMap (j := j) g (locMap (j := j) f x) = locMap (j := j) g' (locMap (j := j) f' x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun (locMap_comp (j := j) f g) x
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (locMap_comp (j := j) f' g') x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, h]

name: ARRASM.ext_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ext_of_algebraMap {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f g : KLoc j S →+ KLoc j T)
    (h : ∀ a : K0 S, f (algebraMap _ _ a) = g (algebraMap _ _ a)) (x : KLoc j S) : f x = g x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (loc_addHom_ext j f g h) x

name: ARRASM.Floc_eq_locAddHom
statement:
theorem Floc_eq_locAddHom {W M : Scheme.{u}} (F : K0 W →+ K0 M) :
    ARRKG.Floc j F = locAddHom j F
proof:
:=
  loc_addHom_ext j _ _ fun a => by rw [ARRKG.Floc_algebraMap, locAddHom_algebraMap]

name: ARRASM.adams_transport_loc
statement:
theorem adams_transport_loc {M A E U W Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : ℕ)
    (FpK : K0 W →+ K0 M) (ipK : K0 Z →+ K0 A) (spK : K0 Z →+ K0 E) (πK : K0 E →+ K0 Z)
    (resK : K0 M →+* K0 U) (j₀K : K0 M →+* K0 A) (jPK : K0 M →+* K0 E)
    (r₀K r₁K : K0 W →+* K0 Z) (prK : K0 Z →+* K0 W)
    (ψM : K0 M →+* K0 M) (ψA : K0 A →+* K0 A) (ψE : K0 E →+* K0 E) (ψU : K0 U →+* K0 U)
    (ψW : K0 W →+* K0 W) (ψZ : K0 Z →+* K0 Z) (θZ : KLoc j Z)
    (hsupp : ∀ m : KLoc j M, locMap (j := j) resK m = 0 → ∃ w : KLoc j W, locAddHom j FpK w = m)
    (hresψ : resK.comp ψM = ψU.comp resK) (hresF : ∀ w, resK (FpK w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀K (FpK w) = ipK (r₀K w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jPK (FpK w) = spK (r₁K w))
    (hψ₀ : j₀K.comp ψM = ψA.comp j₀K) (hψP : jPK.comp ψM = ψE.comp jPK)
    (hψr₀ : r₀K.comp ψW = ψZ.comp r₀K) (hψr₁ : r₁K.comp ψW = ψZ.comp r₁K)
    (hpr₀ : r₀K.comp prK = RingHom.id _) (hpr₁ : r₁K.comp prK = RingHom.id _)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z : K0 Z, algebraMap _ (KLoc j E) (ψE (spK z)) =
      locAddHom j spK (θZ * algebraMap _ (KLoc j Z) (ψZ z)))
    (hπs : ∀ z, πK (spK z) = z) (hrigid : r₀K = r₁K) (x : KLoc j Z) :
    locMap (j := j) ψA (locAddHom j ipK x) = locAddHom j ipK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hpr : ∀ (rK : K0 W →+* K0 Z), rK.comp prK = RingHom.id _ →
      ∀ a : KLoc j Z, locMap (j := j) rK (locMap (j := j) prK a) = a := fun rK h a => by
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun (locMap_comp (j := j) prK rK) a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this, h]
    have h' : locMap (j := j) (RingHom.id (K0 Z)) = RingHom.id _ := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
      ext b
      simp [locMap_algebraMap]
    rw [h']; rfl
  have hlocId : locMap (j := j) (RingHom.id (K0 Z)) = RingHom.id _ := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
    ext b
    simp [locMap_algebraMap]
  have hpr : ∀ (rK : K0 W →+* K0 Z), rK.comp prK = RingHom.id _ →
      ∀ a : KLoc j Z, locMap (j := j) rK (locMap (j := j) prK a) = a := fun rK h a => by
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun (locMap_comp (j := j) prK rK) a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this, h, hlocId]; rfl
  have e1 : ∀ w : KLoc j W, locMap (j := j) resK (locAddHom j FpK w) = 0 := fun w =>
    ext_of_algebraMap (j := j) ((locMap (j := j) resK).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j FpK)) 0
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, hresF]) w
  have e2 : ∀ w : KLoc j W, locMap (j := j) j₀K (locAddHom j FpK w) =
      locAddHom j ipK (locMap (j := j) r₀K w) := fun w =>
    ext_of_algebraMap (j := j) ((locMap (j := j) j₀K).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j FpK))
      ((locAddHom j ipK).comp (locMap (j := j) r₀K).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, hbc₀]) w
  have e3 : ∀ w : KLoc j W, locMap (j := j) jPK (locAddHom j FpK w) =
      locAddHom j spK (locMap (j := j) r₁K w) := fun w =>
    ext_of_algebraMap (j := j) ((locMap (j := j) jPK).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j FpK))
      ((locAddHom j spK).comp (locMap (j := j) r₁K).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, hbcP]) w
  have e4 : ∀ z : KLoc j Z, locMap (j := j) ψE (locAddHom j spK z) =
      locAddHom j spK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ z) := fun z =>
    ext_of_algebraMap (j := j) ((locMap (j := j) ψE).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j spK))
      ((locAddHom j spK).comp ((AddMonoidHom.mulLeft θZ).comp
        (locMap (j := j) ψZ).toAddMonoidHom))
      (fun a => by
        show locMap (j := j) ψE (locAddHom j spK (algebraMap _ _ a)) =
          locAddHom j spK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ (algebraMap _ _ a))
        rw [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap]
        exact hkoszul a) z
  have e5 : ∀ z : KLoc j Z, locAddHom j πK (locAddHom j spK z) = z := fun z =>
    ext_of_algebraMap (j := j) ((locAddHom j πK).comp (locAddHom j spK)) (AddMonoidHom.id _)
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, hπs]) z
  refine KSpecialization.adams_transport (KM := KLoc j M) (KX := KLoc j A) (KP := KLoc j E)
    (KU := KLoc j U) (KW := KLoc j W) (KZ := KLoc j Z)
    (locAddHom j FpK) (locAddHom j ipK) (locAddHom j spK) (locAddHom j πK)
    (locMap (j := j) resK).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) j₀K).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) jPK).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) r₀K) (locMap (j := j) r₁K)
    (locMap (j := j) prK)
    (locMap (j := j) ψM).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) ψA).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) ψE).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) ψU).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) ψW).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) ψZ).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) prK θZ) θZ hsupp
    (fun m => locMap_comm (j := j) ψM resK resK ψU hresψ m) e1 e2 e3
    (fun m => locMap_comm (j := j) ψM j₀K j₀K ψA hψ₀ m)
    (fun m => locMap_comm (j := j) ψM jPK jPK ψE hψP m)
    (fun w => locMap_comm (j := j) ψW r₀K r₀K ψZ hψr₀ w)
    (fun w => locMap_comm (j := j) ψW r₁K r₁K ψZ hψr₁ w)
    (hpr r₀K hpr₀ θZ) (hpr r₁K hpr₁ θZ) (hpr r₀K hpr₀) (hpr r₁K hpr₁) e4 e5
    (by rw [hrigid]) x

name: SchemeKTheory.mem_rankZeroIdeal
statement: lemma mem_rankZeroIdeal {x : K0 Y} : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y ↔ ∀ y : Y, rankAtRingHom y x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rankZeroIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaMonomials_mono
statement: lemma gammaMonomials_mono {p q : ℕ} (h : p ≤ q) : gammaMonomials Y q ⊆ gammaMonomials Y p
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ⟨l, hl, hw, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨l, hl, h.trans hw, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.FilGamma_antitone
statement: theorem FilGamma_antitone : Antitone (FilGamma Y)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  Ideal.span_mono (gammaMonomials_mono h)

name: SchemeKTheory.FilGamma_zero
statement: theorem FilGamma_zero : FilGamma Y 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (show (1 : K0 Y) ∈ gammaMonomials Y 0 from ⟨[], by simp, by simp, by simp⟩)

name: SchemeKTheory.mul_mem_gammaMonomials
statement:
lemma mul_mem_gammaMonomials {p q : ℕ} {a b : K0 Y} (ha : a ∈ gammaMonomials Y p)
    (hb : b ∈ gammaMonomials Y q) : a * b ∈ gammaMonomials Y (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hw, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨l', hl', hw', rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨l ++ l', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro pr hpr
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hpr with h | h
    exacts [hl pr h, hl' pr h]
  · rw [List.map_append, List.sum_append]
    omega
  · rw [List.map_append, List.prod_append]

name: SchemeKTheory.FilGamma_mul
statement: theorem FilGamma_mul (p q : ℕ) : FilGamma Y p * FilGamma Y q ≤ FilGamma Y (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold FilGamma
  rw [Ideal.span_mul_span']
  apply Ideal.span_mono
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  exact mul_mem_gammaMonomials ha hb

name: SchemeKTheory.FilGamma_mul_mem
statement:
theorem FilGamma_mul_mem {p q : ℕ} {a b : K0 Y} (ha : a ∈ FilGamma Y p) (hb : b ∈ FilGamma Y q) :
    a * b ∈ FilGamma Y (p + q)
proof:
:=
  FilGamma_mul p q (Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hb)

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroIdeal_le_FilGamma_one
statement: theorem rankZeroIdeal_le_FilGamma_one : rankZeroIdeal Y ≤ FilGamma Y 1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨[(1, x)], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hx
  · simp
  · simp [gammaOp_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroIdeal_pow_le_FilGamma
statement: theorem rankZeroIdeal_pow_le_FilGamma (p : ℕ) : rankZeroIdeal Y ^ p ≤ FilGamma Y p
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp [FilGamma_zero]
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact (Ideal.mul_mono ih rankZeroIdeal_le_FilGamma_one).trans (FilGamma_mul p 1)

name: SchemeKTheory.map_rank_lambdaSeries
statement:
lemma map_rank_lambdaSeries (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) :
    PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y) (lambdaSeries Y E hE) = (1 + X : ℤ⟦X⟧) ^ (rankAt y E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hrank E hE
  rw [rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hr y]
  ext n
  rw [coeff_map, coeff_lambdaSeries, lambdaClass, rankAtRingHom_classOf,
    rankAt_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_exteriorPowerSheaf E r hr n) y]
  have : ((1 + X : ℤ⟦X⟧) ^ r) = (((1 + Polynomial.X) ^ r : Polynomial ℤ) : ℤ⟦X⟧) := by simp
  rw [this, Polynomial.coeff_coe, Polynomial.coeff_one_add_X_pow]

name: SchemeKTheory.map_rank_lambdaT_eq
statement:
lemma map_rank_lambdaT_eq (x : K0 Y) :
    Units.map (PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y)).toMonoidHom
        (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x)) = onePlusXUnit ^ (rankAtRingHom y x)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ₁ : K0 Y →+ Additive (ℤ⟦X⟧)ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.toAdditive (Units.map (PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y)).toMonoidHom)).comp
      (lambdaT Y)
  let Φ₂ : K0 Y →+ Additive (ℤ⟦X⟧)ˣ :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun x => Additive.ofMul (onePlusXUnit ^ (rankAtRingHom y x)))
      (fun a b => by rw [map_add, zpow_add]; rfl)
  have h : Φ₁ = Φ₂ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change Additive.ofMul (Units.map (PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y)).toMonoidHom
      (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2)))) = Additive.ofMul (onePlusXUnit ^
        (rankAtRingHom y (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2)))
    rw [lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, rankAtRingHom_classOf]
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    rw [Units.coe_map, zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
    exact map_rank_lambdaSeries hrank y E.1 E.2
  exact congrArg (fun ψ : K0 Y →+ Additive (ℤ⟦X⟧)ˣ => Additive.toMul (ψ x)) h

name: SchemeKTheory.map_rank_lambdaSeries_of_rank_zero
statement:
lemma map_rank_lambdaSeries_of_rank_zero {x : K0 Y} (hx : rankAtRingHom y x = 0) :
    PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y)
      ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_rank_lambdaT_eq hrank y x
  rw [hx, zpow_zero] at h
  have := congrArg (fun u : (ℤ⟦X⟧)ˣ => (u : ℤ⟦X⟧)) h
  simpa using this

name: SchemeKTheory.map_gammaSub
statement:
lemma map_gammaSub {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (g : A →+* B) :
    PowerSeries.map g (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = gammaSub
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_gammaOp_of_rank_zero
statement:
lemma rankAt_gammaOp_of_rank_zero {x : K0 Y} (hx : rankAtRingHom y x = 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    rankAtRingHom y (gammaOp Y n x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := map_rank_lambdaSeries_of_rank_zero hrank y hx
  have h2 : PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y) (gammaSeries Y x) = 1 := by
    have e : PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y)
        ((((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).subst
          (gammaSub : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)) =
        (PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y)
          (((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧))).subst
          (PowerSeries.map (rankAtRingHom y) (gammaSub : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)) :=
      map_subst hasSubst_gammaSub _
    rw [gammaSeries_eq, e, h1, map_gammaSub]
    have : (1 : ℤ⟦X⟧).subst (gammaSub : ℤ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by
      rw [← gammaSubst_apply, map_one]
    exact this
  have h3 := congrArg (coeff n) h2
  rw [coeff_map, coeff_one, if_neg (by omega)] at h3
  exact h3

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_mem_rankZeroIdeal
statement:
lemma gammaOp_mem_rankZeroIdeal {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    gammaOp Y n x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:=
  mem_rankZeroIdeal.2 fun y => rankAt_gammaOp_of_rank_zero hrank y (mem_rankZeroIdeal.1 hx y) hn

name: SchemeKTheory.prod_mem_rankZeroIdeal_of_weight
statement:
lemma prod_mem_rankZeroIdeal_of_weight (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators Y) :
    ∀ l : List (ℕ × K0 Y), (∀ pr ∈ l, pr.2 ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) → 1 ≤ (l.map Prod.fst).sum →
      (l.map fun pr => gammaOp Y pr.1 pr.2).prod ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | (n, x) :: l, hl, hw => by
    have hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:= hl (n, x) (by simp)
    have hl' : ∀ pr ∈ l, pr.2 ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y := fun pr hpr => hl pr (by simp [hpr])
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [gammaOp_zero, one_mul]
      refine prod_mem_rankZeroIdeal_of_weight hrank l hl' ?_
      simpa using hw
    · exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (gammaOp_mem_rankZeroIdeal hrank hx hn)

name: SchemeKTheory.FilGamma_one_eq
statement: theorem FilGamma_one_eq (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators Y) : FilGamma Y 1 = rankZeroIdeal Y
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ rankZeroIdeal_le_FilGamma_one
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro a ⟨l, hl, hw, rfl⟩
  exact prod_mem_rankZeroIdeal_of_weight hrank l hl hw

name: ARRLciTop.rank_pos_of_ne
statement:
theorem rank_pos_of_ne (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range i) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) : 0 < r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  set c := i (genericPoint X) with hc
  have hcne : c ≠ genericPoint A := by
    intro h
    apply hy
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range i) := i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hmem : genericPoint A ∈ Set.range i := ⟨_, h⟩
    have hsp : y ∈ closure ({genericPoint A} : Set A) := by
      rw [(genericPoint_spec A).def]; trivial
    exact closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem) hcl hsp
  have hle : c ≤ genericPoint A :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec A).specializes trivial)
  have hlt : c < genericPoint A := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge => hcne
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Order.coheight c :=
    le_trans le_add_self (Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt)
  have hr := GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.coheight_eq_of_cover i C
  rw [hc, hr] at h1
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: ARRLciTop.closedImmersion_field_lci
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_field_lci (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A)
    (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range i)
    (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X) {r : ℕ} (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j A)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral A) j
          ((KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j i (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
            (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X))
proof:
:= by
  have hne' : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) := by
    rw [range_ker]; exact hne
  have hd := rank_pos_of_ne i hne C
  have h := AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.arr_caseII_ambient_lci_of_htw i.ker hA hAreg C (phiK (A := A))
    hd hne' (htw i.ker hA hAreg C (phiK (A := A)) hd hne') hj
    (algebraMap _ _ (pullbackK0RingHom (phiX i).inv x))
  have e1 : ∀ z : K0 i.ker.subscheme,
      pushLocF3 j (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (algebraMap _ (KLoc j i.ker.subscheme) z) =
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j A) ((KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (finitePushforward
        (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme z))) := by
    intro z
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    rfl
  rw [e1, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, mul_comm] at h
  rw [finitePushforward_iso (phiX i) (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) i (phiX_comp i) x]
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (pushLocF3_iso (phiX i) (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) i j
    (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (phiX_comp i)), AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  show _ = pullLocF3 j (phiX i).inv _
  rw [map_mul, pullLocF3_alg]
  have hcl := conormalClass_phiX i N C.conormal_hasConstantRank
  have hbot := pullLoc_bott i j hnilX (AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.hnilZL i.ker hA) N _ hcl
  rw [hbot]
  unfold AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.thetaL AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.nclL
  congr 2
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (hψnat' (phiX i).inv (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _)
    (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hj) x).symm

name: ARRLciTop.conormalClass_zero_of_surj_lci
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r = 0 := by
    rw [GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.rank_eq_codim_of_cover i C, image_generic i hs,
      coheight_generic_eq_zero A]
    rfl
  rw [GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalClass_eq i N (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C)]
  exact class_zero_of_rank (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank hr

name: ARRLciTop.adamsRR_lci_all_of_data
statement:
theorem adamsRR_lci_all_of_data (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hreg : RegStalks Y) {r : ℕ} (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X) {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have hA := T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n
  have hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (PY k Y n) := prod_regStalks hreg n
  have hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (PY k Y n) := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _
  have hrankX : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hrankY : ConstantRankGenerators Y := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n) := lambdaNilpotent_P n hY
  let resY := resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg
  let resP := resProd hY hreg n
  have hres : (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res = resP.res := res_eq _ _
  
  have hII : ∀ x : K0 X,
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (PY k Y n))
          (adamsRingHom hrankP j (resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
        pushLocF3 j i resP.res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankX j x) *
            ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hne : ∃ y : ↥(PY k Y n), y ∉ Set.range i
    · have h := closedImmersion_field_lci i htw hA hAreg hne hnilX C N (j := j) (by omega) x
      rw [hres] at h
      exact h
    · push Not at hne
      haveI : Surjective i := ⟨hne⟩
      haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective i
      haveI : IsNoetherian (PY k Y n) := prodNoetherian n
      exact closedImm_of_iso i resP hrankX hrankP hnilX
        (conormalClass_zero_of_surj_lci i hne C N) (by omega) x
  
  have hI := adamsRR_caseI_prod_lib (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY j hj hrankP hrankY hnilP
  
  have hu : Units.map (pullLocF3 j i).toMonoidHom
      (SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n))) =
      SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n))) :=
    Units.ext (by
      rw [Units.coe_map, bott_pull j i (pullbackK0RingHom i) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i)
        (pullLocF3 j i) (pullLocF3_alg j i) hrankX hnilX hrankP hnilP]
      rfl)
  have htw' : (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
          N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) :
          (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) *
        pullLocF3 j i (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n)))⁻¹ :
            (KLoc j (PY k Y n))ˣ) : KLoc j (PY k Y n)) := by
    rw [ofAdd_sub, map_div, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Units.val_mul, ← hu, ← map_inv,
      Units.coe_map]
    rfl
  let iG : K0 X →+ K0 (PY k Y n) := resP.res.comp ((finitePushforward i).comp (k0ToG0 X))
  let πG : K0 (PY k Y n) →+ K0 Y := piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY
  have hcomp : πG (iG x) = fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x := by
    have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun resP.right (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at hr
    simp only [πG, iG, piK0, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
    rfl
  rw [← hcomp, htw']
  exact GRRKG1.twisted_comp iG πG
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankX j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankP j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankY j).toAddMonoidHom)
    (pushLocF3 j i resP.res) (locAddHom j πG) (pullLocF3 j i) _ _
    (projFormulaLoc j i resP.res resP.left resP.right) hII hI x

name: ARRLciTop.arrwKLci_iff
statement:
theorem arrwKLci_iff (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ)
    (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i] {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) (j : ℕ) (x : K0 X) (w : K0 Y) :
    ARRwKLci hY hreg n i C j x w ↔ ARRwLci hY hreg n i C j x w
proof:
:= by
  have h := T1KG3.OMGB.cotangentClass_eq_kahler (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n
  unfold ARRwKLci ARRwLci
  rw [h]

name: ARRLciTop.arr_lci_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem arr_lci_of_closedImmersion (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i] {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    ARRwLci hY hreg n i C j x (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  exact adamsRR_lci_all_of_data n i htw hY hreg C (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
    (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C) hj x

name: ARRLciTop.adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall'
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall' (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    ARRwLci hY hYreg n i C j x (M1.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  rw [M1.fShriekCan_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi]
  exact arr_lci_of_closedImmersion htw hY hYreg n i C hj x

name: ARRLciTop.adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    ARRwKLci hY hYreg n i C j x (M1.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  exact (arrwKLci_iff hY hYreg n i C j x _).2
    (adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall' htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hj x)

name: ARRLciTop.adamsRiemannRoch_lci_exists
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_lci_exists (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k)
    (hlci : ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f ∧
        ∃ r, Nonempty (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r),
        haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
        ∀ (j : ℕ), 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 X,
          ARRwLci hY hYreg n i C j x (M1.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) := by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, r, ⟨C⟩⟩ := hlci
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
  refine ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, r, C, ?_⟩
  intro j hj x
  exact adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall' htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hfi C hj x

name: ARRLciTop.adams_intrinsic_lci
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_lci (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i)) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
        (M1.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
      M1.fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          M1.LCI.tClassLci hY n i hN j) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  have h := adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hj x
  unfold ARRwKLci at h
  rw [M1.fLoc_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi] at h
  exact h

statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_lci_exists (htw : HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)

    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k)
    (hlci : ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f ∧
        ∃ r, Nonempty (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f ∧
      ∃ hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i),
        haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
        haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
        ∀ {j : ℕ}, 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 X,
          algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
              (M1.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
            M1.fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
              (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
                M1.LCI.tClassLci hY n i hN j) := by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, r, ⟨C⟩⟩ := hlci
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi

  refine ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree, ?_⟩

proof:

  haveI q2 : (R2 T.X₂).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI q3 : (R2 T.X₃).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI : ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom)).X₁.IsQuasicoherent := q1
  haveI : ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map

  haveI : ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.spec_isFinitePresentation_biprod
statement:
theorem spec_isFinitePresentation_biprod {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (A B : (Spec R).Modules)
    [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] : (A ⊞ B).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let GA := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj A).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj A) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation A
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj B) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation B
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GA :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ A).finitePresentation_iff.mpr inferInstance
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GB :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ B).finitePresentation_iff.mpr inferInstance
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ↑(GA ⊞ GB) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (Iso.toLinearEquiv (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd GA GB)).symm
  letI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent A
  letI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent B
  let eA0 := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB0 := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj GA ≅ A := eA0
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj GB ≅ B := eB0
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT => tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology _
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts (tilde.functor R) :=
    preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryProducts _
  let e : (tilde.functor R).obj (GA ⊞ GB) ≅ A ⊞ B :=
    ((tilde.functor R).mapBiprod GA GB) ≪≫ biprod.mapIso eA eB
  haveI : ((tilde.functor R).obj (GA ⊞ GB)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation (GA ⊞ GB)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e inferInstance

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.isFinitePresentation_biprod
statement:
