    [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] : (A ⊞ B).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Y.Opens))
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y) (fun V ↦ V.2) _ fun V ↦ ?_
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec
  haveI : G.Additive := ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} => rfl⟩
  haveI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits' _
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts G := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryProducts _
  letI : (G.obj A).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ A
  letI : (G.obj B).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ B
  have h := spec_isFinitePresentation_biprod (G.obj A) (G.obj B)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
    (Spec Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso (G.mapBiprod A B).symm h

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.isFinitePresentation_pullback
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pullback {A B D : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ D) (g : B ⟶ D)
    [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] [D.IsFinitePresentation] :
    (pullback f g).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (A ⊞ B).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_biprod A B
  haveI hk : (kernel (biprod.desc f (-g))).IsFinitePresentation :=
    ClosedImmersionCoverF11.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian _
  let e := IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso
    (Abelian.PullbackToBiproductIsKernel.isLimitPullbackToBiproduct f g)
    (kernelIsKernel (biprod.desc f (-g)))
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (show kernel (biprod.desc f (-g)) ≅ pullback f g from e.symm) hk

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.P_ext_aux
proof:
:= by
  haveI : B.IsFinitePresentation := hB
  haveI : A.IsFinitePresentation := hA.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : D.IsFinitePresentation := hD.isFinitePresentation
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_charts C R e B (fun j => chart_finite C R e j B) (fun j => ?_)
  let T : ShortComplex X.Modules := ShortComplex.mk i g hs.zero
  have hT := chart_shortExact C R e j T hs.exact (inferInstanceAs A.IsQuasicoherent)
    (inferInstanceAs B.IsQuasicoherent) (inferInstanceAs D.IsQuasicoherent)
  obtain ⟨_, hAp⟩ := chart_bundle C R e j A hA
  obtain ⟨_, hDp⟩ := chart_bundle C R e j D hD
  haveI : Module.Projective (R j) ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₁) := hAp
  haveI : Module.Projective (R j) ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₃) := hDp
  have h1 : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₁) 1 :=
    hasPDLT_one_of_moduleProjective _
  have h3 : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₃) 1 :=
    hasPDLT_one_of_moduleProjective _
  exact moduleProjective_of_hasPDLT_one _ (hT.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₂ 1 h1 h3)

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.P_ker_aux
proof:
:= by
  haveI : A.IsFinitePresentation := hA
  haveI : B.IsFinitePresentation := hB.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : D.IsFinitePresentation := hD.isFinitePresentation
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_charts C R e A (fun j => chart_finite C R e j A) (fun j => ?_)
  let T : ShortComplex X.Modules := ShortComplex.mk i g hs.zero
  have hT := chart_shortExact C R e j T hs.exact (inferInstanceAs A.IsQuasicoherent)
    (inferInstanceAs B.IsQuasicoherent) (inferInstanceAs D.IsQuasicoherent)
  obtain ⟨_, hBp⟩ := chart_bundle C R e j B hB
  obtain ⟨_, hDp⟩ := chart_bundle C R e j D hD
  haveI : Module.Projective (R j) ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₂) := hBp
  haveI : Module.Projective (R j) ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₃) := hDp
  have h2 : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₂) 1 :=
    hasPDLT_one_of_moduleProjective _
  haveI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₃) 1 :=
    hasPDLT_one_of_moduleProjective _
  have h3 : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((T.map (chartFunctor C R e j)).X₃) (1 + 1) :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 (1 + 1) (by omega)
  exact moduleProjective_of_hasPDLT_one _ (hT.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ 1 h2 h3)

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Q_kernel_aux
statement:
theorem Q_kernel_aux {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (hA : IsCoherentLike X A)
    (hB : IsCoherentLike X B) : IsCoherentLike X (kernel f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : A.IsFinitePresentation := hA
  haveI : B.IsFinitePresentation := hB
  exact ClosedImmersionCoverF11.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian f

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.isSheafSyzygy_ofIso
statement:
theorem isSheafSyzygy_ofIso : ∀ (m : ℕ) {Z F F' : X.Modules},
    SheafSyzygyF10.IsSheafSyzygy Z F m → (F ≅ F') → SheafSyzygyF10.IsSheafSyzygy Z F' m
  | 0, _, _, _, ⟨e1⟩, e => ⟨e1 ≪≫ e⟩
  | m + 1, _, _, _, ⟨E, hE, g, hg, hker, hK⟩, e => by
    haveI
proof:
:= hg
    haveI : IsIso e.hom := inferInstance
    have ek : kernel g ≅ kernel (g ≫ e.hom) := (kernelCompMono g e.hom).symm
    exact ⟨E, hE, g ≫ e.hom, inferInstance,
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso ek hker,
      isSheafSyzygy_ofIso m hK ek⟩

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.pdLE_of_kernelForm
statement:
theorem pdLE_of_kernelForm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (M : X.Modules), IsCoherentLike X M →
    (∀ Z, SheafSyzygyF10.IsSheafSyzygy Z M m → IsFiniteLocallyFree X Z) →
    AbelianResolutionF15.PdLE (setup C R e hcover) m M
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro M _ hyp
    exact (AbelianResolutionF15.pdLE_zero_iff _).2 (hyp M ⟨Iso.refl M⟩)
  | succ m ih =>
    intro M hM hyp Z hZ
    obtain ⟨K, E, i, g, hs, hE, hK, hZ'⟩ := hZ
    haveI := hs.epi
    haveI := hs.mono
    have hker : (kernel g).IsFinitePresentation := by
      haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
      exact (Q_kernel_aux g (hE.isFinitePresentation : IsCoherentLike X E) hM : IsCoherentLike X _)
    have ek : K ≅ kernel g :=
      IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (s := KernelFork.ofι i hs.zero)
        (t := KernelFork.ofι (kernel.ι g) (kernel.condition g))
        (hs.exact.exact.fIsKernel) (kernelIsKernel g)
    refine ih K hK (fun Z' hZ'' => hyp Z' ⟨E, hE, g, hs.epi, hker, isSheafSyzygy_ofIso m hZ'' ek⟩)
      Z hZ'

name: ResolutionRegularClosedF15.k0ToG0_bijective_of_regular_closed
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_of_regular_closed (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K]
    [M1.FiniteDimBase K] (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ space K n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 X)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i
  obtain ⟨C, R, hR, e, hdim⟩ := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_regular_cover K n i hreg
  haveI : ∀ j, IsRegularRing (R j) := hR
  have hcover : ∀ F : X.Modules, F.IsFinitePresentation →
      ∃ E : X.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree X E ∧ ∃ g : E ⟶ F, Epi g := fun F hF => by
    haveI := hF
    exact ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_epi_finiteLocallyFree_noetherian K n i F
  have hd : ∀ M : X.Modules, (setup C (fun j => R j) e hcover).Q M →
      AbelianResolutionF15.PdLE (setup C (fun j => R j) e hcover) (n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K) M :=
    fun M hM => by
    haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
    exact pdLE_of_kernelForm C (fun j => R j) e hcover _ M hM fun Z hZ =>
      SheafSyzygyF10.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy C _ (fun j => R j) e hdim hZ
  exact AbelianResolutionF15.k0ToG0_bijective (setup C (fun j => R j) e hcover) _ hd

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_naturality
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] {N P : Y.Modules} (φ : N ⟶ P) (i : ℕ) (x : N.H i) :
    Sheaf.H.map
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).map φ)) i
        (openRestrictionHAddHom g N i x) =
      openRestrictionHAddHom g P i
        (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).map φ) i x)
proof:
:= by
  let hExtY : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y) :=
    fun A B a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let hExtX : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
    fun A B a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let F := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let hLim : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  let hColim : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  let hAdd : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive g
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := hLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := hColim
  letI : F.Additive := hAdd
  let A := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  let B := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj P
  let p : A ⟶ B := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).map φ
  let e := (openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  have hp : F.map p =
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).map φ) := rfl
  simp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, Sheaf.H.map_apply]
  rw [← hp]
  exact @extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality _ _ _ _ _ _ hExtY hExtX
    F hAdd hLim hColim _ _ e _ _ p i x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.middle_of_exact_five_ladder_explicit
statement:
private theorem middle_of_exact_five_ladder_explicit
    (d₀ : D →ₗ[R] A) (d₁ : A →ₗ[R] B) (d₂ : B →ₗ[R] C) (d₃ : C →ₗ[R] E)
    (d₀' : D' →ₗ[R] A') (d₁' : A' →ₗ[R] B') (d₂' : B' →ₗ[R] C')
    (d₃' : C' →ₗ[R] E')
    (vD : D →ₗ[R] D') (vA : A →ₗ[R] A') (vB : B →ₗ[R] B')
    (vC : C →ₗ[R] C') (vE : E →ₗ[R] E')
    (hexA : Function.Exact d₀ d₁) (hexB : Function.Exact d₁ d₂)
    (hexC : Function.Exact d₂ d₃)
    (hexA' : Function.Exact d₀' d₁') (hexB' : Function.Exact d₁' d₂')
    (hexC' : Function.Exact d₂' d₃')
    (hDA : ∀ x, d₀' (vD x) = vA (d₀ x))
    (hAB : ∀ x, d₁' (vA x) = vB (d₁ x))
    (hBC : ∀ x, d₂' (vB x) = vC (d₂ x))
    (hCE : ∀ x, d₃' (vC x) = vE (d₃ x))
    (hD : IsLocalizedModule S vD) (hA : IsLocalizedModule S vA)
    (hC : IsLocalizedModule S vC) (hE : IsLocalizedModule S vE) :
    IsLocalizedModule S vB
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hD
  haveI := hA
  haveI := hC
  haveI := hE
  exact IsLocalizedModule.middle_of_exact_five_ladder S d₀ d₁ d₂ d₃ d₀' d₁' d₂' d₃'
    vD vA vB vC vE hexA hexB hexC hexA' hexB' hexC' hDA hAB hBC hCE

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.middle_succ
statement:
theorem AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.middle_succ
    {V W : Y.Opens} (T : Submonoid Γ(Y, W))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h : V ≤ W) (i : ℕ)
    (h₁ : ∀ j, AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f S.X₁ j h)
    (h₃ : ∀ j, AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f S.X₃ j h) :
    AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f S.X₂ (i + 1) h
proof:
:= by
  let φ := (baseOpenRestriction h).hom
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ
  let W₃ :=
    (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₃ f S hS i).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (op W))
  let W₁ :=
    (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₁ f S (i + 1)).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (op W))
  let W₂ :=
    (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂ f S hS (i + 1)).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (op W))
  let V₃ :=
    ((affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₃ f S hS i).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (op V))).map F
  let V₁ :=
    ((affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₁ f S (i + 1)).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (op V))).map F
  let V₂ :=
    ((affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂ f S hS (i + 1)).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (op V))).map F
  have hW₃ : W₃.Exact :=
    (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₃ f S hS i)).mp
        (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₃_exact f S hS i) (op W)
  have hW₁ : W₁.Exact :=
    (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₁ f S (i + 1))).mp
        (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₁_exact f S hS (i + 1)) (op W)
  have hW₂ : W₂.Exact :=
    (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂ f S hS (i + 1))).mp
        (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂_exact f S hS (i + 1)) (op W)
  have hV₃raw :=
    (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₃ f S hS i)).mp
        (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₃_exact f S hS i) (op V)
  have hV₁raw :=
    (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₁ f S (i + 1))).mp
        (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₁_exact f S hS (i + 1)) (op V)
  have hV₂raw :=
    (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂ f S hS (i + 1))).mp
        (affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂_exact f S hS (i + 1)) (op V)
  have hV₃ : V₃.Exact := hV₃raw.map F
  have hV₁ : V₁.Exact := hV₁raw.map F
  have hV₂ : V₂.Exact := hV₂raw.map F
  let vD :=
    (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f S.X₃ i h).hom
  let vA :=
    (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f S.X₁ (i + 1) h).hom
  let vB :=
    (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f S.X₂ (i + 1) h).hom
  let vC :=
    (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f S.X₃ (i + 1) h).hom
  let vE :=
    (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear f S.X₁ (i + 2) h).hom
  exact middle_of_exact_five_ladder_explicit T
    W₃.f.hom W₃.g.hom W₁.g.hom W₂.g.hom
    V₃.f.hom V₃.g.hom V₁.g.hom V₂.g.hom
    vD vA vB vC vE
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact W₃).mp hW₃)
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact W₁).mp hW₁)
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact W₂).mp hW₂)
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact V₃).mp hV₃)
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact V₁).mp hV₁)
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact V₂).mp hV₂)
    (fun x => (affineLocalConnectingMap_restriction_naturality
      f S hS i h x).symm)
    (fun x => (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_coefficient_naturality
      f S.f (i + 1) h x).symm)
    (fun x => (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_coefficient_naturality
      f S.g (i + 1) h x).symm)
    (fun x => (affineLocalConnectingMap_restriction_naturality
      f S hS (i + 1) h x).symm)
    (h₃ i) (h₁ (i + 1)) (h₃ (i + 1)) (h₁ (i + 2))

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.middle_positive
statement:
theorem AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.middle_positive
    {V W : Y.Opens} (T : Submonoid Γ(Y, W))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h : V ≤ W)
    (h₁ : ∀ j, AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f S.X₁ j h)
    (h₃ : ∀ j, AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f S.X₃ j h) :
    ∀ j, 0 < j →
      AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization T f S.X₂ j h
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : j ≠ 0)
  exact AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.middle_succ
    T f S hS h i h₁ h₃

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage_eulerChar_eq_h
statement:
theorem projectiveHigherDirectImage_eulerChar_eq_h
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (i : ℕ) :
    Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
          (toSpec k n) M i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.h k M i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  letI :
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec k n) M i).IsQuasicoherent :=
    affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_all_of_isQuasicoherent
      k n M i
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_eulerChar_eq_finrank_globalSections
    k]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.h]
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      exact_mod_cast
        (projectiveHigherDirectImageZeroGlobalSectionsLinearEquiv
          k n M).finrank_eq
  | succ p =>
      exact_mod_cast
        (projectivePositiveHigherDirectImageGlobalSectionsLinearEquiv
          k n M p).finrank_eq

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
statement:
theorem projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
    (hn : 0 < n) (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    M.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, n, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hM : SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (space k n) M := by
      change M.IsFinitePresentation
      infer_instance
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        let F :=
          SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
            (toSpec k n) M 0
        letI : F.IsFinitePresentation :=
          projectiveHigherDirectImage_coherent k n hn ⟨M, hM⟩ 0
        letI : Module.FinitePresentation k
            ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of k)).obj F) :=
          moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation F
        exact Module.Finite.equiv
          (projectiveHigherDirectImageZeroGlobalSectionsLinearEquiv
            k n M)
    | succ p =>
        let F :=
          SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
            (toSpec k n) M (p + 1)
        letI : F.IsFinitePresentation :=
          projectiveHigherDirectImage_coherent k n hn ⟨M, hM⟩ (p + 1)
        letI : Module.FinitePresentation k
            ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of k)).obj F) :=
          moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation F
        exact Module.Finite.equiv
          (projectivePositiveHigherDirectImageGlobalSectionsLinearEquiv
            k n M p)
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
    exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (quasicoherent_sheafH_isZero_of_dimension k n M q (by omega))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projective_h_eq_zero_of_dimension
statement:
theorem projective_h_eq_zero_of_dimension
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i : ℕ) (hi : n < i) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k M i = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.h]
  letI : Subsingleton (M.H (q + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (quasicoherent_sheafH_isZero_of_dimension k n M q (by omega))
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.g0Euler_comp_projectiveDerivedPushforward
statement:
theorem g0Euler_comp_projectiveDerivedPushforward
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    (SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k
        (fun F hF ↦ by
          letI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
          exact
            AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
              k F)).comp
        (projectiveDerivedPushforward k n hn) =
      SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k
        (fun M hM ↦ by
          letI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
          exact projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k n hn M)
proof:
:= by
  let s := projectiveHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem k n hn
  let hfiniteX :
      ∀ M : (space k n).Modules, M.IsFinitePresentation →
        M.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k :=
    fun M hM ↦ by
      letI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
      exact projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k n hn M
  let hfiniteY :
      ∀ F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules, F.IsFinitePresentation →
        F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k :=
    fun F hF ↦ by
      letI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
      exact
        AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
          k F
  have h :=
    SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.g0Euler_comp_derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages
      (X := space k n) (Y := Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) k n
      s.higher s.higher_mem s.longExactWitness hfiniteX hfiniteY
      (fun E i ↦ by
        letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2
        exact projectiveHigherDirectImage_eulerChar_eq_h
          k n E.1 i)
      (fun E i hi ↦ by
        letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2
        exact projective_h_eq_zero_of_dimension
          k n E.1 i hi)
  change
    (SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfiniteY).comp
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem s) =
      SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfiniteX
  rw [SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_eq]
  exact h

name: ResolutionSurjectiveF15.g0Class_iso
statement:
theorem g0Class_iso {A B : X.Modules} [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation]
    (e : A ≅ B) : g0Class X A = g0Class X B
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike X (0 : X.Modules) from
      (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation)
    (isZero_zero _) e

name: ResolutionSurjectiveF15.g0Class_mem_range_of_isSheafSyzygy
statement:
theorem g0Class_mem_range_of_isSheafSyzygy :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) {Z F : X.Modules} [F.IsFinitePresentation],
      SheafSyzygyF10.IsSheafSyzygy Z F m → IsFiniteLocallyFree X Z →
        g0Class X F ∈ (k0ToG0 X).range
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rintro Z F _ ⟨e⟩ hZ
    haveI := hZ
    haveI : Z.IsFinitePresentation := hZ.isFinitePresentation
    refine ⟨k0Class X Z, ?_⟩
    rw [k0ToG0_k0Class]
    exact g0Class_iso X e
  | succ m ih =>
    rintro Z F _ ⟨E, hE, g, hg, hker, hK⟩ hZ
    haveI := hE
    haveI := hg
    haveI := hker
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih (F := kernel g) hK hZ
    have hS := SheafSyzygyF10.shortExact_kernel_of_epi g
    have hmid := g0Class_middle X (kernel.condition g) hS
    have hE' : g0Class X E = k0ToG0 X (k0Class X E) := (k0ToG0_k0Class X E).symm
    refine ⟨k0Class X E - y, ?_⟩
    rw [map_sub, hy, ← hE', hmid]
    abel

name: ResolutionSurjectiveF15.k0ToG0_surjective_of_regular_closed
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_surjective_of_regular_closed (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K]
    [M1.FiniteDimBase K] (n : ℕ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ space K n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    Function.Surjective (k0ToG0 X)
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F),
      g0ClassOf X F hF ∈ (k0ToG0 X).range := by
    intro F hF
    haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZl⟩ := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_syzygy_finiteLocallyFree K n i hreg F
    exact g0Class_mem_range_of_isSheafSyzygy X _ hZ hZl
  intro y
  have hq : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (k0ToG0 X).range : G0 X →+ G0 X ⧸ (k0ToG0 X).range) = 0 :=
    ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (A := G0 X ⧸ (k0ToG0 X).range) (fun E ↦ by
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
      exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 (hall V hV))
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff y).1 (DFunLike.congr_fun hq y)

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.ppEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem ppEquiv_apply (a : Fin 3) (u v : Chart a) (huv : u ≠ v) (hc : ∀ j, j = u ∨ j = v)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Chart a) k) : ppEquiv k a u v huv hc p = toPP k a u p
proof: := rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.cover
statement:
theorem cover (a : Fin 3) (u v : Fin 3) (hu : u ≠ a) (hv : v ≠ a)
    (hall : ∀ j : Fin 3, j = a ∨ j = u ∨ j = v) :
    ∀ j : Chart a, j = cv a u hu ∨ j = cv a v hv
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
  rcases hall j with h | h | h
  · exact absurd h hj
  · left; exact Subtype.ext h
  · right; exact Subtype.ext h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.e2_fpoly
statement: theorem e2_fpoly : e2 k (fpoly k 2) = ExamplesLCI.nodal k
proof:
:= by
  simp [e2, ppEquiv_apply, fpoly, rp, toPP, cv, ExamplesLCI.nodal]
  ring

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.e1_fpoly
statement: theorem e1_fpoly : e1 k (fpoly k 1) = C (1 - X ^ 2) * X + C (-X ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  simp [e1, ppEquiv_apply, fpoly, rp, toPP, cv]
  ring

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.e0_fpoly
statement: theorem e0_fpoly : e0 k (fpoly k 0) = C (X ^ 2 - 1) * X + C (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [e0, ppEquiv_apply, fpoly, rp, toPP, cv]
  ring

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.prime_linear
statement:
theorem prime_linear (a b : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b) :
    Prime (C a * X + C b : Polynomial (Polynomial k))
proof:
:=
  UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime.mp (irreducible_C_mul_X_add_C ha hab.isRelPrime)

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fpoly_prime_two
statement: theorem fpoly_prime_two : Prime (fpoly k 2)
proof:
:=
  (MulEquiv.prime_iff (e2 k)).mp (by rw [e2_fpoly]; exact ExamplesLCI.nodal_prime k)

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fpoly_prime_one
statement: theorem fpoly_prime_one : Prime (fpoly k 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine (MulEquiv.prime_iff (e1 k)).mp ?_
  rw [e1_fpoly]
  refine prime_linear k _ _ ?_ ⟨1 + X ^ 2, -X, by ring⟩
  intro h
  have := congrArg (eval 0) h
  simp at this

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fpoly_prime_zero
statement: theorem fpoly_prime_zero : Prime (fpoly k 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine (MulEquiv.prime_iff (e0 k)).mp ?_
  rw [e0_fpoly]
  refine prime_linear k _ _ ?_ ⟨0, -1, by ring⟩
  intro h
  have := congrArg (eval 0) h
  simp at this

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fpoly_prime
statement: theorem fpoly_prime (a : Fin 3) : Prime (fpoly k a)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a
  · exact fpoly_prime_zero k
  · exact fpoly_prime_one k
  · exact fpoly_prime_two k

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fpoly_ne_zero
statement: theorem fpoly_ne_zero (a : Fin 3) : fpoly k a ≠ 0
proof: := (fpoly_prime k a).ne_zero

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.not_dvd_X
statement:
theorem not_dvd_X (α β : Polynomial k) (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hf : ¬ IsUnit (C α * X + C β)) :
    ¬ (C α * X + C β : Polynomial (Polynomial k)) ∣ X
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h0 := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 0) hq
  simp only [coeff_X_zero, mul_coeff_zero, coeff_add, mul_zero, coeff_C_zero, zero_add] at h0
  have hq0 : q.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0.symm with h | h
    · exact absurd h hβ
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ := X_dvd_iff.mpr hq0
  apply hf
  have h1 : (X : Polynomial (Polynomial k)) * ((C α * X + C β) * q') = X * 1 := by
    rw [mul_one]
    conv_rhs => rw [hq]
    ring
  have h2 := mul_left_cancel₀ X_ne_zero h1
  exact ⟨⟨_, q', h2, by rw [mul_comm]; exact h2⟩, rfl⟩

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.rp_two_not_mem_one
statement: theorem rp_two_not_mem_one : rp k 1 2 ∉ Ideal.span {fpoly k 1}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← map_dvd_iff (e1 k), e1_fpoly]
  have hx : e1 k (rp k 1 2) = X := by simp [e1, ppEquiv_apply, rp, toPP, cv]
  rw [hx]
  refine not_dvd_X k _ _ (by simp) ?_
  rw [← e1_fpoly]
  exact fun h => (fpoly_prime_one k).not_unit ((MulEquiv.isUnit_map (e1 k)).mp h)

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.rp_two_not_mem_zero
statement: theorem rp_two_not_mem_zero : rp k 0 2 ∉ Ideal.span {fpoly k 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← map_dvd_iff (e0 k), e0_fpoly]
  have hx : e0 k (rp k 0 2) = X := by simp [e0, ppEquiv_apply, rp, toPP, cv]
  rw [hx]
  refine not_dvd_X k _ _ (by simp) ?_
  rw [← e0_fpoly]
  exact fun h => (fpoly_prime_zero k).not_unit ((MulEquiv.isUnit_map (e0 k)).mp h)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul
    (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (x : Γ(Q, W)) :
    openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q h
        ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x) =
      Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x
proof:
:= by
  change (ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars
    (baseOpenRestriction h).hom _)
      ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x) = _
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars_hom_apply]
  change (1 : Γ(Y, V)) • Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x = _
  rw [one_smul]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_tmul
statement:
lemma openSectionsBaseChangeMap_tmul
    (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (a : Γ(Y, V)) (x : Γ(Q, W)) :
    openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q h
        (a ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x) =
      a • Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x
proof:
:= by
  change (ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars
    (baseOpenRestriction h).hom _)
      (a ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x) = _
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars_hom_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageTopIso_globalSec
statement:
lemma preimageTopIso_globalSec
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) (r : Γ(Y, V)) :
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).topIso.hom
        (globalSec (X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) r) =
      f.app V r
proof:
:= by
  change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv ≫
      (preimageToSpec f V).appTop ≫
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).topIso.hom).hom r) = f.app V r
  rw [preimageToSpec, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop,
    Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_appTop]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [morphismRestrict_appTop]
  apply congrArg (fun q : Γ(Y, V) ⟶ Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) => q.hom r)
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.topIso_hom, Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  erw [f.naturality]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  let a : op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) ⟶ op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    ((Opens.map f.base).map (eqToHom V.ι_image_top)).op ≫
      (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f V ⊤)).op ≫
        (eqToHom (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι_image_top.symm).op
  change f.app V ≫ X.presheaf.map a = f.app V
  have ha : a = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [ha, X.presheaf.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
statement:
theorem presheaf_cast_eq_map
    {T : TopCat.{u}} (P : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {U V : Opens T} (e : U = V) (x : P.obj (op U)) :
    AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W => ↑(P.obj (op W))) e) x =
      P.map (eqToHom e.symm).op x
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  have hmor : (eqToHom rfl : U ⟶ U).op = 𝟙 (op U) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hmor]
  exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun (P.map_id (op U)) x |>.symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.ringPresheaf_cast_eq_map
statement:
theorem ringPresheaf_cast_eq_map
    {T : TopCat.{u}} (P : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    {U V : Opens T} (e : U = V) (x : P.obj (op U)) :
    AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W => ↑(P.obj (op W))) e) x =
      P.map (eqToHom e.symm).op x
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  have hmor : (eqToHom rfl : U ⟶ U).op = 𝟙 (op U) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hmor]
  exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun (P.map_id (op U)) x |>.symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.module_sections_cast_smul
statement:
theorem module_sections_cast_smul
    (N : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} (e : U = V)
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(N, U)) :
    AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W => Γ(N, W)) e) (r • x) =
      AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W => Γ(X, W)) e) r •
        AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W => Γ(N, W)) e) x
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction_topIso
statement:
lemma baseOpenRestriction_topIso
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    W.topIso.inv ≫ (Y.homOfLE h).appTop =
      baseOpenRestriction h ≫ V.topIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono V.topIso.hom).mp
  rw [baseOpenRestriction_eq]
  have hn := Y.restrictFunctorΓ.hom.naturality (homOfLE h).op
  change (Y.homOfLE h).appTop ≫ V.topIso.hom =
    W.topIso.hom ≫ Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op at hn
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [hn]
  simp

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso_hom_smul
statement:
lemma affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso_hom_smul
    (Q : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) (r : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤))
    (x : Γ(Q.restrict U.ι, ⊤)) :
    (affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso Q U).hom (r • x) =
      U.topIso.hom r • (affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso Q U).hom x
proof:
:= by
  change Q.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top.symm).op
      ((Q.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom (r • x)) =
    (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top.symm).op r) •
      Q.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top.symm).op
        ((Q.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom x)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.sectionsEquiv_left
statement:
private theorem sectionsEquiv_left (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : Γ(Q, V)) :
    (affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm.symm
      ((compTopIso Q h).hom ((pullTopIso Q h).inv ((pullTopIso Q h).hom
        ((compTopIso Q h).inv
          ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm x))))) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.sectionsEquiv_right
statement:
private theorem sectionsEquiv_right (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Y.homOfLE h)).obj (Q.restrict W.ι), ⊤)) :
    (pullTopIso Q h).hom ((compTopIso Q h).inv
      ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm
        ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm.symm
          ((compTopIso Q h).hom ((pullTopIso Q h).inv x))))) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Iso.hom_inv_id_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictionCompIso_inv_restrict
statement:
lemma affineOpenRestrictionCompIso_inv_restrict
    (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (x : Γ(Q, W)) :
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      (affineOpenRestrictionCompIso Q h)).inv
        ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm
          (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Y.homOfLE h)).unit.app
          (Q.restrict W.ι)).app ⊤
        ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q W).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  change ((affineOpenRestrictionCompIso Q h).inv.app ⊤)
      ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm
        (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x)) = _
  simp [affineOpenRestrictionCompIso,
    affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv,
    affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso]
  change (Q.presheaf.map _ ≫ Q.presheaf.map _ ≫ Q.presheaf.map _) x =
    (Q.presheaf.map _ ≫ Q.presheaf.map _) x
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenPullbackTargetSectionsSemilinearEquiv_restrict
statement:
lemma affineOpenPullbackTargetSectionsSemilinearEquiv_restrict
    (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (x : Γ(Q, W)) :
    affineOpenPullbackTargetSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q h
        (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Y.homOfLE h)).unit.app (Q.restrict W.ι)).app ⊤
        ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q W).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  let g := Y.homOfLE h
  let N := Q.restrict W.ι
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app N)).hom
        (((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
          (affineOpenRestrictionCompIso Q h)).inv
            ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q V).symm
              (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x))) = _
  rw [affineOpenRestrictionCompIso_inv_restrict]
  have huniq := Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction g)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g) N
  have htop := congrArg (fun q => q.app (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens)) huniq
  have hx := CategoryTheory.congr_fun htop
    ((affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q W).symm x)
  exact hx

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_affineOpen_transport
statement:
lemma openSectionsBaseChangeMap_affineOpen_transport
    (Q : Y.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (z : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).obj
      (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, W) Γ(Q, W))) :
    affineOpenPullbackTargetSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q h
        (openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q h z) =
      affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsMap (Y.homOfLE h) (Q.restrict W.ι)
        (affineOpenTensorSemilinearEquiv Q h z)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, W) Γ(Y, V) :=
    (baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤) Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) :=
    (Y.homOfLE h).appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (.+.) hx hy
  | tmul a x =>
      change Γ(Y, V) at a
      change Γ(Q, W) at x
      rw [openSectionsBaseChangeMap_tmul, LinearEquiv.map_smulₛₗ,
        affineOpenPullbackTargetSectionsSemilinearEquiv_restrict]
      rw [affineOpenTensorSemilinearEquiv, TensorProduct.congr_tmul]
      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul, map_smul]
      rw [affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul]
      rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent
    (Q : Y.Modules) [Q.IsQuasicoherent]
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    [IsAffine V.toScheme] [IsAffine W.toScheme] :
    IsIso (openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let eD := affineOpenTensorSemilinearEquiv Q h
  let eC := affineOpenPullbackTargetSectionsSemilinearEquiv Q h
  let G := affineSchemePullbackGlobalSectionsMap
    (Y.homOfLE h) (Q.restrict W.ι)
  have hG := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso G
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply eD.injective
    apply hG.1
    rw [← openSectionsBaseChangeMap_affineOpen_transport Q h x,
      ← openSectionsBaseChangeMap_affineOpen_transport Q h y, hxy]

    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := eD.surjective t

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_id_injective
statement:
lemma openRestrictionHAddHom_id_injective (X : Scheme.{u}) (N : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (openRestrictionHAddHom (𝟙 X) N i)
proof:
:= by
  let F := ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let eF : F ≅ 𝟭 _ := openSheafPullbackIdIso X
  letI : F.IsEquivalence := Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso eF.symm
  letI : F.Full := inferInstance
  letI : F.Faithful := inferInstance
  letI : F.PreservesInjectiveObjects := inferInstance
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (𝟙 X)
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (𝟙 X)
  letI : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive (𝟙 X)
  let C := (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
    (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  let A := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  let phi := F.mapExtAddHom C A i
  let hmap := (F.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesInjectiveObjects C A i).injective
  intro x y hxy
  apply hmap
  dsimp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso] at hxy ⊢
  let e := (openPullbackConstantIso (𝟙 X)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  change (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      (phi x) (zero_add i) =
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      (phi y) (zero_add i) at hxy
  change phi x = phi y
  have hxy' := congrArg (fun z =>
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.hom).comp z
      (zero_add i)) hxy
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp] at hxy'
  convert hxy' using 1 <;> rfl

statement:
theorem finiteAffineG0Pushforward_flatBaseChange
    (phi : R →+* S) (psi : R →+* A) (hphi : phi.Flat) (hpsi : psi.Finite)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Spec (.of S), ⊤)] :
    letI : IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom psi))
proof:
:=
      (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff (CommRingCat.ofHom psi)).2 hpsi
    letI : IsFinite
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi))) :=
      (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi))).2
          (affineBaseChangeLeftHom_finite phi psi hpsi)
    (SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0 phi hphi).comp
        (finiteAffineG0Pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom psi))) =
      (finiteAffineG0Pushforward
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi)))).comp
        (SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0 (affineBaseChangeRightHom phi psi)
          (affineBaseChangeRightHom_flat phi psi hphi)) := by
  letI : IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom psi)) :=
    (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff (CommRingCat.ofHom psi)).2 hpsi
  letI : IsFinite
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi))) :=
    (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi))).2
        (affineBaseChangeLeftHom_finite phi psi hpsi)
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  change SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0 phi hphi
      (finiteAffineG0Pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom psi))
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf (Spec (.of A)) E.1 E.2)) =
    finiteAffineG0Pushforward
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi)))
      (SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0 (affineBaseChangeRightHom phi psi)
        (affineBaseChangeRightHom_flat phi psi hphi)
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf (Spec (.of A)) E.1 E.2))
  rw [finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf,
    SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0_classOf,
    SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0_classOf,
    finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf]
  letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2
  exact SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso _ _
    (affineBaseChangeObjIso phi psi ⟨E.1, inferInstance⟩)

      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBaseChangeLeftHom phi psi))) :=

name: SheafSyzygyF10.isRegularRing_sections
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_sections [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) : IsRegularRing Γ(X, U)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
  refine ⟨fun p hp => ?_⟩
  let y : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) := ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hy : hU.fromSpec y ∈ U := by
    have h : hU.fromSpec y ∈ (U : Set X) := by
      rw [← hU.range_fromSpec]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact h
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨hU.fromSpec y, hy⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization p.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y)) :=
    hU.isLocalization_stalk' y hy
  haveI := hreg (hU.fromSpec y)
  let e := IsLocalization.algEquiv p.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime p)
    (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y))
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv.symm

proof:

      rw [← hU.range_fromSpec]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact h
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨hU.fromSpec y, hy⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization p.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y)) :=
