name: SheafSyzygyF10.finite_projective_of_isSheafSyzygy
statement:
theorem finite_projective_of_isSheafSyzygy {X : Scheme.{u}} {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (G : X.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} R) [G.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (hG : ∀ T : ShortComplex X.Modules, T.ShortExact → T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent →
      T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent → T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent → (T.map G).ShortExact)
    (hE : ∀ E : X.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      Module.Finite R (G.obj E) ∧ Module.Projective R (G.obj E)) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) {K F : X.Modules}, IsSheafSyzygy K F m → F.IsQuasicoherent →
      Module.Finite R (G.obj F) → HasProjectiveDimensionLE (G.obj F) m →
      Module.Finite R (G.obj K) ∧ Module.Projective R (G.obj K)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rintro K F ⟨e⟩ _ hfin hpd
    refine ⟨Module.Finite.equiv (Iso.toLinearEquiv (G.mapIso e.symm)), ?_⟩
    have h0 : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (G.obj K) 0 :=
      hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso (G.mapIso e).symm 1
    rw [← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero] at h0
    exact ModuleCat.projective_of_module_projective (G.obj K)
  | succ m ih =>
    rintro K F ⟨E, hEl, g, hg, hker, hK⟩ hF hfin hpd
    haveI : E.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
    haveI := hF
    haveI := hker
    haveI : (kernel g).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
    haveI := hg
    have hS := hG _ (shortExact_kernel_of_epi g) inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    obtain ⟨hEfin, hEproj⟩ := hE E hEl
    haveI : Module.Finite R (G.obj E) := hEfin
    haveI : Module.Projective R (G.obj E) := hEproj
    haveI : Projective (G.obj E) := inferInstance
    have hP : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (G.obj E) (m + 1) :=
      hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge (G.obj E) 1 (m + 1) (by omega)
    have hpd' : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (G.obj (kernel g)) m :=
      hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (m + 1) hP hpd
    have hfin' : Module.Finite R (G.obj (kernel g)) := by
      haveI : IsNoetherian R (G.obj E) := inferInstance
      exact Module.Finite.of_injective (G.map (kernel.ι g)).hom
        (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_injective_f hS)
    exact ih hK inferInstance hfin' hpd'

name: SheafSyzygyF10.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy {X : Scheme.{u}} (C : X.OpenCover.{u}) (d : ℕ)
    (R : C.I₀ → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (R i)] [∀ i, IsRegularRing (R i)]
    (e : ∀ i, Spec (CommRingCat.of (R i)) ≅ C.X i)
    (hdim : ∀ i, ringKrullDim (R i) ≤ d)
    {K F : X.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hK : IsSheafSyzygy K F d) : IsFiniteLocallyFree X K
proof:
:= by
  haveI : K.IsQuasicoherent := hK.isQuasicoherent d inferInstance
  have key : ∀ i, Module.Finite (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj K))) ∧
      Module.Projective (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj K))) := by
    intro i
    let G : X.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} (R i) :=
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom ⋙
        moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))
    haveI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).Additive := ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} => rfl⟩
    haveI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).Additive := ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} => rfl⟩
    haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).Additive := ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} => rfl⟩
    haveI : G.PreservesZeroMorphisms := Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive G
    let R2 : X.Modules → (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R i))).Modules := fun M =>
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj M)
    refine finite_projective_of_isSheafSyzygy G ?_ ?_ d hK inferInstance ?_ ?_
    · intro T hT h1 h2 h3
      have hT1 := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact (C.f i) T hT
      have hT2 := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact (e i).hom _ hT1
      haveI q1 : (R2 T.X₁).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
      haveI q2 : (R2 T.X₂).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
      haveI q3 : (R2 T.X₃).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
      haveI : ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom)).X₁.IsQuasicoherent := q1
      haveI : ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom)).X₂.IsQuasicoherent := q2
      haveI : ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom)).X₃.IsQuasicoherent := q3
      exact (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff
        ((T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i))).map
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom))).mpr hT2
    · intro E hE
      have h1 := isFiniteLocallyFree_restrict (C.f i) E hE
      have h2 := isFiniteLocallyFree_restrict (e i).hom _ h1
      haveI := h2.isFinitePresentation
      haveI : (R2 E).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
      have hfp := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation (R2 E)
      have hfin : Module.Finite (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj (R2 E)) :=
        inferInstance
      exact ⟨hfin, RegularAffineK0G0.projective_moduleSpecΓ_of_isFiniteLocallyFree (R i) _ h2⟩
    · haveI := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (C.f i) F
      haveI := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (e i).hom
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj F)
      haveI : (R2 F).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
      have hfp := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation (R2 F)
      have hfin : Module.Finite (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj (R2 F)) :=
        inferInstance
      exact hfin
    · haveI := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (C.f i) F
      haveI := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (e i).hom
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj F)
      haveI : (R2 F).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
      have hfp := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation (R2 F)
      have hfin : Module.Finite (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj (R2 F)) :=
        inferInstance
      haveI : Module.Finite (R i) (G.obj F) := hfin
      exact IsRegularRing.hasProjectiveDimensionLE d (hdim i) (G.obj F)
  exact OpenCoverGluingF9.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_spec_projective C K R e
    (fun i => (key i).1) (fun i => (key i).2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.chase
statement:
theorem Regularity.chase {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Xs : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (δ : ∀ k, Xs (k + 1) ⟶ Xs k) (sq : ∀ k, δ (k + 1) ≫ δ k = 0) (h0 : Epi (δ 0))
    (hex : ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift (δ k) (δ (k + 1)) (sq k)))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : IsZero (Xs (N + 1))) (q : ℕ)
    (hvan : ∀ k, k ≤ N →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f (Xs (k + 1)) (q + k))) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f (Xs 0) q)
proof:
:= by
  have hRzero : ∀ (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ), IsZero M →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i) :=
    fun M i hM ↦ (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f i).map_isZero hM
  have hRiso : ∀ {M M' : X.Modules} (_ : M ≅ M') (i : ℕ),
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i) →
        IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M' i) :=
    fun e i h ↦ h.of_iso ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f i).mapIso e).symm
  have hwin : ∀ (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (i : ℕ),
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₂ i) →
        IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₁ (i + 1)) →
          IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₃ i) := by
    intro S hS i h₂ h₁
    exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂_exact f S hS i).isZero_of_both_zeros
      (h₂.eq_of_src _ _) (h₁.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  have claim : ∀ j k, k + j = N →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f (kernel (δ k)) (q + k + 1)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk
      obtain rfl : k = N := by omega
      exact hRzero _ _ (hN.of_mono (kernel.ι (δ k)))
    | succ j ih =>
      intro k hk
      haveI := hex k
      let g := kernel.lift (δ k) (δ (k + 1)) (sq k)
      let S := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι g) g (kernel.condition g)
      have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel g }
      refine hwin S hS (q + k + 1) (hvan (k + 1) (by omega)) ?_
      have e : kernel g ≅ kernel (δ (k + 1)) :=
        (kernelCompMono g (kernel.ι (δ k))).symm ≪≫ kernelIsoOfEq (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _)
      exact hRiso e.symm _ (ih (k + 1) (by omega))
  haveI := h0
  let S0 := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι (δ 0)) (δ 0) (kernel.condition _)
  have hS0 : S0.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel (δ 0) }
  exact hwin S0 hS0 q (hvan 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) (claim N 0 (by simp))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.chase_epi
statement:
theorem Regularity.chase_epi {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Xs : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (δ : ∀ k, Xs (k + 1) ⟶ Xs k) (sq : ∀ k, δ (k + 1) ≫ δ k = 0) (h0 : Epi (δ 0))
    (hex : ∀ k, Epi (kernel.lift (δ k) (δ (k + 1)) (sq k)))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : IsZero (Xs (N + 1))) (q : ℕ)
    (hvan : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f (Xs (k + 1)) (q + k))) :
    Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map (δ 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hRzero : ∀ (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ), IsZero M →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i) :=
    fun M i hM ↦ (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f i).map_isZero hM
  have hRiso : ∀ {M M' : X.Modules} (_ : M ≅ M') (i : ℕ),
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M i) →
        IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M' i) :=
    fun e i h ↦ h.of_iso ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f i).mapIso e).symm
  have hwin : ∀ (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (i : ℕ),
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₂ i) →
        IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₁ (i + 1)) →
          IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₃ i) := by
    intro S hS i h₂ h₁
    exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂_exact f S hS i).isZero_of_both_zeros
      (h₂.eq_of_src _ _) (h₁.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  have claim : ∀ j k, k + j = N →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f (kernel (δ k)) (q + k + 1)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk
      obtain rfl : k = N := by omega
      exact hRzero _ _ (hN.of_mono (kernel.ι (δ k)))
    | succ j ih =>
      intro k hk
      haveI := hex k
      let g := kernel.lift (δ k) (δ (k + 1)) (sq k)
      let S := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι g) g (kernel.condition g)
      have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel g }
      refine hwin S hS (q + k + 1) (hvan (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      have e : kernel g ≅ kernel (δ (k + 1)) :=
        (kernelCompMono g (kernel.ι (δ k))).symm ≪≫ kernelIsoOfEq (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _)
      exact hRiso e.symm _ (ih (k + 1) (by omega))
  haveI := h0
  let S0 := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι (δ 0)) (δ 0) (kernel.condition _)
  have hS0 : S0.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel (δ 0) }
  exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂_exact f S0 hS0 q).epi_f
    ((claim N 0 (by simp)).eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isMumfordRegular_succ
statement:
theorem isMumfordRegular_succ (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) : IsMumfordRegular R n F (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  let G' := moduleTwist R n F (m + 1 - q)
  have hG' : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G' :=
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F _ hF (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) G'
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) G' hG'
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) G' hG'
  haveI : T.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape T
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts T := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts T
  let K := (projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  obtain ⟨hE0, hEk⟩ := projectiveKoszulData_exact R n (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  have hvan : ∀ k, k ≤ n + 1 →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) (T.obj (K.X (k + 1)))
        (q + k)) := by
    intro k _
    let Rk := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) (q + k)
    haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts Rk := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts Rk
    have hg := Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (k + 1) (-((k : ℤ) + 1)) (by push_cast; ring)
    refine hg (fun Y ↦ IsZero (Rk.obj (T.obj Y))) (fun Z hZ ↦ Rk.map_isZero (T.map_isZero hZ))
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact (Koszul.isZero_biprod hZ hZ').of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (T.mapBiprod Z Z') ≪≫ Rk.mapBiprod (T.obj Z) (T.obj Z'))
    · exact (hreg (q + k) (by omega)).of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (moduleTwistTwistIso R n F (m + 1 - q) (-((k : ℤ) + 1)) (m - ((q + k : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)))
  haveI := hE0
  have hchase := Regularity.chase (toSpec R n) (fun k ↦ T.obj (K.X k))
    (fun k ↦ T.map (K.d (k + 1) k))
    (fun k ↦ by rw [← T.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, T.map_zero])
    (T.map_epi _)
    (fun k ↦ Koszul.epi_kernelLift_map T _ _ _ (hEk k))
    (n + 1) (T.map_isZero (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ (n + 1) _ (n + 1 + 1) (by omega))) q
    hvan
  obtain ⟨e0⟩ := Koszul.KData.kos_X0 (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
    (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  exact hchase.of_iso ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) q).mapIso
    (T.mapIso e0 ≪≫ moduleTwistTwistIso R n F _ _ _ (by push_cast; ring))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.mul_surjective
statement:
theorem Regularity.mul_surjective (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) :
    Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F (m + 1))).map
        (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-((n : ℤ) + 1))).d 1 0)))
proof:
:= by
  let G' := moduleTwist R n F (m + 1)
  have hG' : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G' :=
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F _ hF
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) G'
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) G' hG'
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) G' hG'
  haveI : T.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape T
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts T := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts T
  let K := (projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  obtain ⟨hE0, hEk⟩ := projectiveKoszulData_exact R n (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  have hvan : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) (T.obj (K.X (k + 1)))
        (0 + k)) := by
    intro k hk _
    let Rk := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) (0 + k)
    haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts Rk := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts Rk
    have hg := Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (k + 1) (-((k : ℤ) + 1)) (by push_cast; ring)
    refine hg (fun Y ↦ IsZero (Rk.obj (T.obj Y))) (fun Z hZ ↦ Rk.map_isZero (T.map_isZero hZ))
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact (Koszul.isZero_biprod hZ hZ').of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (T.mapBiprod Z Z') ≪≫ Rk.mapBiprod (T.obj Z) (T.obj Z'))
    · exact (hreg (0 + k) (by omega)).of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (moduleTwistTwistIso R n F (m + 1) (-((k : ℤ) + 1)) (m - ((0 + k : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)))
  haveI := hE0
  exact Regularity.chase_epi (toSpec R n) (fun k ↦ T.obj (K.X k))
    (fun k ↦ T.map (K.d (k + 1) k))
    (fun k ↦ by rw [← T.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, T.map_zero])
    (T.map_epi _)
    (fun k ↦ Koszul.epi_kernelLift_map T _ _ _ (hEk k))
    (n + 1) (T.map_isZero (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ (n + 1) _ (n + 1 + 1) (by omega))) 0
    hvan

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isMumfordRegular_of_le
statement:
theorem isMumfordRegular_of_le (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    {m m' : ℤ} (hmm' : m ≤ m') (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) : IsMumfordRegular R n F m'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Int.exists_add_of_le hmm'
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hreg
  | succ k ih =>
    have := isMumfordRegular_succ R n F hF _ (ih (by omega))
    simpa [add_assoc] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.lmap_comp
statement:
theorem Regularity.lmap_comp (M : X.Modules) {P Q T : X.Modules} (g : P ⟶ Q) (g' : Q ⟶ T) :
    Regularity.lmap M g ≫ Regularity.lmap M g' = Regularity.lmap M (g ≫ g')
proof:
:=
  ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X M).map_comp g g').symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.lmap_id
statement: theorem Regularity.lmap_id (M P : X.Modules) : Regularity.lmap M (𝟙 P) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X M).map_id P

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.lmap_add
statement:
theorem Regularity.lmap_add (M : X.Modules) {P Q : X.Modules} (g g' : P ⟶ Q) :
    Regularity.lmap M (g + g') = Regularity.lmap M g + Regularity.lmap M g'
proof:
:=
  (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X M).map_add

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.rmap_eq
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.lmap_eq
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.swap
statement:
theorem Regularity.swap {M N P Q : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : P ⟶ Q) :
    Regularity.rmap P f ≫ Regularity.lmap N g = Regularity.lmap M g ≫ Regularity.rmap Q f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Regularity.rmap_eq, Regularity.lmap_eq, Regularity.lmap_eq, Regularity.rmap_eq]
  exact ((moduleSheafification X).map_comp _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (moduleSheafification X).map
      (MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange (Regularity.uMap f) (Regularity.uMap g)).symm).trans
      ((moduleSheafification X).map_comp _ _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.unitor_aux
statement:
private theorem Regularity.unitor_aux {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] (Sh : C ⥤ D)
    {A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ : C} {M N : D} (u : A₁ ⟶ A₂) (v₁ : A₁ ⟶ B₁) (v₂ : A₂ ⟶ B₂) (w : B₁ ⟶ B₂)
    (hnat : u ≫ v₂ = v₁ ≫ w) (ε₁ : Sh.obj B₁ ⟶ M) (ε₂ : Sh.obj B₂ ⟶ N) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hε : Sh.map w ≫ ε₂ = ε₁ ≫ f) :
    Sh.map u ≫ Sh.map v₂ ≫ ε₂ = Sh.map v₁ ≫ ε₁ ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Sh.map_comp_assoc, hnat, Sh.map_comp_assoc, hε]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.rightUnitor_naturality
statement:
theorem Regularity.rightUnitor_naturality {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    Regularity.rmap (tensorUnitSheaf X) f ≫ (tensorSheafRightUnitor X N).hom =
      (tensorSheafRightUnitor X M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Regularity.rmap_eq]
  exact Regularity.unitor_aux (moduleSheafification X) _ _ _ _
    (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor_naturality (Regularity.uMap f)) _ _ f
    ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (structurePresheafId X)).counit.naturality f)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.epi_right
statement:
theorem Regularity.epi_right (N : X.Modules) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    {P Q : X.Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q) (hf : Epi f) : Epi (Regularity.rmap N f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X N hN
  haveI : (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X N).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape _
  haveI : (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms.of_iso (tensorSheafRightFunctorIsoLeftFunctor X N).symm
  exact Functor.map_epi _ f

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.ε_fac
statement:
theorem Regularity.ε_fac {P : S.Modules} {M : X.Modules}
    (g : (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj P ⟶ M) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).homEquiv _ _ g) ≫ Regularity.ε p M = g
proof:
:=
  ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).homEquiv_counit _ _ _).symm.trans
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).homEquiv _ _).symm_apply_apply g)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.ε_naturality
statement:
theorem Regularity.ε_naturality {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map f) ≫ Regularity.ε p N =
      Regularity.ε p M ≫ f
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).counit_naturality f

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.gen_of_epi
statement:
theorem Regularity.gen_of_epi {P : S.Modules} {M : X.Modules}
    (g : (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj P ⟶ M) (hg : Epi g) : Regularity.Gen p M
proof:
:=
  @epi_of_epi_fac _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hg (Regularity.ε_fac p g)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.gen_of_gen_epi
statement:
theorem Regularity.gen_of_gen_epi {M M' : X.Modules} (h : Regularity.Gen p M) (q : M ⟶ M')
    (hq : Epi q) : Regularity.Gen p M'
proof:
:=
  Regularity.gen_of_epi p (Regularity.ε p M ≫ q) (@epi_comp' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h hq)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.gen_of_iso
statement:
theorem Regularity.gen_of_iso {M M' : X.Modules} (h : Regularity.Gen p M) (e : M ≅ M') :
    Regularity.Gen p M'
proof:
:=
  Regularity.gen_of_gen_epi p h e.hom inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.gen_pullback
statement:
theorem Regularity.gen_pullback (P : S.Modules) :
    Regularity.Gen p ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj P)
proof:
:=
  Regularity.gen_of_epi p (𝟙 _) inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.factor_zero
statement:
theorem Regularity.factor_zero (B : X.Modules) {Y : X.Modules} (hY : IsZero Y) :
    Regularity.Factor p B Y
proof:
:= by
  intro P g
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  exact ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X B).map_isZero hY).eq_of_tgt _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.factor_biprod
statement:
theorem Regularity.factor_biprod (B : X.Modules) {Z Z' : X.Modules} (hZ : Regularity.Factor p B Z)
    (hZ' : Regularity.Factor p B Z') : Regularity.Factor p B (Z ⊞ Z')
proof:
:= by
  intro P g
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj B)
  obtain ⟨s₁, h₁⟩ := hZ P (g ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.fst)
  obtain ⟨s₂, h₂⟩ := hZ' P (g ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.snd)
  refine ⟨s₁ ≫ Regularity.lmap N biprod.inl + s₂ ≫ Regularity.lmap N biprod.inr, ?_⟩
  have htot : Regularity.lmap B (biprod.fst : Z ⊞ Z' ⟶ Z) ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.inl +
      Regularity.lmap B (biprod.snd : Z ⊞ Z' ⟶ Z') ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.inr = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [Regularity.lmap_comp, Regularity.lmap_comp, ← Regularity.lmap_add, biprod.total, Regularity.lmap_id]
  have c₁ := Regularity.swap (Regularity.ε p B) (biprod.inl : Z ⟶ Z ⊞ Z')
  have c₂ := Regularity.swap (Regularity.ε p B) (biprod.inr : Z' ⟶ Z ⊞ Z')
  calc g = g ≫ (Regularity.lmap B (biprod.fst : Z ⊞ Z' ⟶ Z) ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.inl +
      Regularity.lmap B (biprod.snd : Z ⊞ Z' ⟶ Z') ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.inr) := by
        rw [htot, Category.comp_id]
    _ = (g ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.fst) ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.inl +
        (g ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.snd) ≫ Regularity.lmap B biprod.inr := by
        simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [h₁, h₂]
        simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc, c₁, c₂]
        rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.factor_iso
statement:
theorem Regularity.factor_iso (B : X.Modules) {Y Y' : X.Modules} (hY : Regularity.Factor p B Y)
    (e : Y ≅ Y') : Regularity.Factor p B Y'
proof:
:= by
  intro P g
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj B)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hY P (g ≫ Regularity.lmap B e.inv)
  refine ⟨s ≫ Regularity.lmap N e.hom, ?_⟩
  have c := Regularity.swap (Regularity.ε p B) e.hom
  have hid : Regularity.lmap B e.inv ≫ Regularity.lmap B e.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [Regularity.lmap_comp, e.inv_hom_id, Regularity.lmap_id]
  calc g = (g ≫ Regularity.lmap B e.inv) ≫ Regularity.lmap B e.hom := by
        rw [Category.assoc, hid, Category.comp_id]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [hs]
        simp only [Category.assoc, c]
        rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.factor_unit
statement: theorem Regularity.factor_unit (B : X.Modules) : Regularity.Factor p B (tensorUnitSheaf X)
proof:
:= by
  intro P g
  let h := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).homEquiv _ _
    (g ≫ (tensorSheafRightUnitor X B).hom)
  have hg' := Regularity.ε_fac p (g ≫ (tensorSheafRightUnitor X B).hom)
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map h ≫ (tensorSheafRightUnitor X _).inv, ?_⟩
  have hn : (tensorSheafRightUnitor X _).inv ≫
      Regularity.rmap (tensorUnitSheaf X) (Regularity.ε p B) =
        Regularity.ε p B ≫ (tensorSheafRightUnitor X B).inv := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← Regularity.rightUnitor_naturality, Category.assoc,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [Category.assoc, hn]
  rw [← Category.assoc, hg']
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.mul_surjective_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem Regularity.mul_surjective_of_isMumfordRegular (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) :
    Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map
        (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0)))
proof:
:= by
  let G' := moduleTwist R n F m
  have hG' : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G' :=
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F _ hF
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) G'
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) G' hG'
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) G' hG'
  haveI : T.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape T
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts T := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts T
  let K := (projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨hE0, hEk⟩ := projectiveKoszulData_exact R n (-(n : ℤ))
  have hvan : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) (T.obj (K.X (k + 1)))
        (0 + k)) := by
    intro k hk _
    let Rk := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) (0 + k)
    haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts Rk := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts Rk
    have hg := Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-(n : ℤ)) (k + 1) (-(k : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
    refine hg (fun Y ↦ IsZero (Rk.obj (T.obj Y))) (fun Z hZ ↦ Rk.map_isZero (T.map_isZero hZ))
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ ?_) ?_
    · exact (Koszul.isZero_biprod hZ hZ').of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (T.mapBiprod Z Z') ≪≫ Rk.mapBiprod (T.obj Z) (T.obj Z'))
    · exact (hreg (0 + k) (by omega)).of_iso
        (Rk.mapIso (moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m (-(k : ℤ)) (m - ((0 + k : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)))
  haveI := hE0
  exact Regularity.chase_epi (toSpec R n) (fun k ↦ T.obj (K.X k))
    (fun k ↦ T.map (K.d (k + 1) k))
    (fun k ↦ by rw [← T.map_comp, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, T.map_zero])
    (T.map_epi _)
    (fun k ↦ Koszul.epi_kernelLift_map T _ _ _ (hEk k))
    (n + 1) (T.map_isZero (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ (n + 1) _ (n + 1 + 1) (by omega))) 0
    hvan

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.mul_surjective_pushforward
statement:
theorem Regularity.mul_surjective_pushforward (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)).map
        (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0)))
proof:
:=
  (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff (toSpec R n) _).1 (Regularity.mul_surjective_of_isMumfordRegular R n F hF m hreg)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.untwist
statement:
theorem Regularity.untwist (M : (space R n).Modules) :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf (space R n)
      (tensorSheaf (space R n) M (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 0))
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-1)) ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e0⟩ := Koszul.KData.kos_X0 (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
    (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-(n : ℤ))
  exact ⟨tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl M) e0)
      (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
    tensorSheafAssociator (space R n) M _ _ ≪≫
    tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl M) (projectiveTwistingTensorIso R n _ (-1) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n) (by push_cast; ring)) ≪≫
      projectiveTwistingZeroIso R n) ≪≫
    tensorSheafRightUnitor (space R n) M⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.twist_succ
statement:
theorem Regularity.twist_succ (F : (space R n).Modules) (m : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
      (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 0) ≅ moduleTwist R n F (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e0⟩ := Koszul.KData.kos_X0 (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
    (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-(n : ℤ))
  exact ⟨tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e0 ≪≫
    moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m _ (m + 1) (by push_cast; ring)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.descent
statement:
theorem Regularity.descent (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F)
    (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F m)
    (hgen : Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F (m + 1))) :
    Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map
      (Regularity.lmap (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0))) :=
    Regularity.mul_surjective_pushforward R n F hF m hreg
  
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := Regularity.twist_succ R n F m
  have h2 := Regularity.gen_of_iso (toSpec R n) hgen e1.symm
  
  have h3 := Regularity.ε_naturality (toSpec R n)
    (Regularity.lmap (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0))
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  have h3' : Epi (Regularity.ε (toSpec R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
      (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 1)) ≫
      Regularity.lmap (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).d 1 0)) := by
    rw [← h3]
    exact epi_comp' (Functor.map_epi _ _) h2
  
  have hfac : Regularity.Factor (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m)
      (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 1) :=
    Koszul.KData.kos_good (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
      (Koszul.x_comm R n) (n + 1) (-(n : ℤ)) 1 0 (by push_cast; ring)
      (Regularity.Factor (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m))
      (fun Z hZ ↦ Regularity.factor_zero _ _ hZ)
      (fun Z Z' hZ hZ' ↦ Regularity.factor_biprod _ _ hZ hZ')
      (Regularity.factor_iso _ _ (Regularity.factor_unit _ _) (projectiveTwistingZeroIso R n).symm)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfac _ (Regularity.ε (toSpec R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
      (moduleTwist R n F m) (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 1)))
  
  have h5 : Epi (Regularity.rmap (((projectiveKoszulData R n).K (-(n : ℤ))).X 0)
      (Regularity.ε (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m))) := by
    rw [hs, Category.assoc, Regularity.swap, ← Category.assoc] at h3'
    exact @epi_of_epi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h3'
  
  have h6 := Regularity.epi_right (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-1))
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _) _ h5
  obtain ⟨θN⟩ := Regularity.untwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (moduleTwist R n F m)))
  obtain ⟨θB⟩ := Regularity.untwist R n (moduleTwist R n F m)
  have hsrc := Regularity.gen_of_iso _ (Regularity.gen_pullback (toSpec R n) _) θN.symm
  have htgt := Regularity.gen_of_gen_epi _ hsrc _ h6
  exact Regularity.gen_of_iso _ htgt θB

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular [IsNoetherianRing R] (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n F 0) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).counit.app F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation (space R n) hF
  obtain ⟨D, E, t, ht⟩ := projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_tensor_sections R n F
  obtain ⟨G, -⟩ := projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSections_generate R n F D E t ht
  have hbase : Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F (D : ℤ)) :=
    Regularity.gen_of_iso (toSpec R n)
      (Regularity.gen_of_epi (toSpec R n) (projectiveGeneratingSectionsFreeEvaluation R n _ G)
        (projectiveGeneratingSectionsFreeEvaluation_epi R n _ G))
      (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _)
  have hdown : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ m : ℤ, 0 ≤ m → Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F (m + j)) →
      Regularity.Gen (toSpec R n) (moduleTwist R n F m) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro m _ h; simpa using h
    | succ j ih =>
      intro m hm h
      refine Regularity.descent R n F hF m (isMumfordRegular_of_le R n F hF hm hreg) ?_
      refine ih (m + 1) (by omega) ?_
      have e : m + 1 + (j : ℤ) = m + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e]
      exact h
  have h0 := hdown D 0 le_rfl (by simpa using hbase)
  exact Regularity.gen_of_iso (toSpec R n) h0
    (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl F) (projectiveTwistingZeroIso R n) ≪≫
      tensorSheafRightUnitor (space R n) F)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.tensor_subsingleton
statement:
theorem Regularity.tensor_subsingleton (A : Type*) (B : Type*) (N : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Subsingleton N] :
    Subsingleton (TensorProduct A B N)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : TensorProduct A B N, x = 0 := fun x ↦ by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => rfl
    | tmul a b => rw [Subsingleton.elim b 0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]
  exact ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [h a, h b]⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.H_subsingleton_of_iso
statement:
theorem Regularity.H_subsingleton_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {M M' : X.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ M') (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    [h : Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f M' i).obj
      (op V))] :
    Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f M i).obj
      (op V))
proof:
:= by
  let E := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ i).mapIso
    ((Modules.toSheafAb (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme).mapIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).mapIso e))
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.H_subsingleton_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem Regularity.H_subsingleton_of_shortExact {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    (h₂ : Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f S.X₂ i).obj
      (op V)))
    (h₁ : Subsingleton
      ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f S.X₁ (i + 1)).obj (op V))) :
    Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f S.X₃ i).obj
      (op V))
proof:
:= by
  have hex := (PresheafOfModules.shortComplex_exact_iff_pointwise _ _).1
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂_exact f S hS i) (op V)
  have hz₁ : IsZero ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂ f S hS i).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op V))).X₁ :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.2 h₂
  have hz₃ : IsZero ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalLongExactPresheaf₂ f S hS i).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op V))).X₃ :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.2 h₁
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.1
    (hex.isZero_of_both_zeros (hz₁.eq_of_src _ _) (hz₃.eq_of_tgt _ _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.baseModule_H_subsingleton
statement:
theorem Regularity.baseModule_H_subsingleton (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (q : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).H (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI h0 : Subsingleton (((Modules.toSheafAb (space (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d)).H (q + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d hd q)
  haveI h1 := (coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n q (projectiveTwistingSheaf (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d)).toEquiv.subsingleton
  haveI h2 := (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_restrictedHomologyLinearEquiv
    R Q n d (q + 1)).toEquiv.subsingleton
  haveI h3 := (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCohomologyFinite_totalComparisonHomologyLinearEquiv
    R Q n d (q + 1)).toEquiv.subsingleton
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R Q
  letI : (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).IsFinitePresentation :=
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward_isFinitePresentation R Q n d
  haveI h4 := (coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv R n q
    (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)
    (quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic R n _)).symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  haveI h5 := (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardPositiveCohomologyLinearEquiv
    R Q n d q).symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  exact ⟨fun a b ↦ congrArg Prod.snd (h5.elim (0, a) (0, b))⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.baseModule_basicOpen_subsingleton
statement:
theorem Regularity.baseModule_basicOpen_subsingleton (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d)
    (p : ℕ) (g : R) :
    Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf (toSpec R n)
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) (p + 1)).obj
        (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Regularity.baseModule_H_subsingleton R Q n d hd p
  haveI := Regularity.tensor_subsingleton R (Localization.Away g)
    (((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).H (p + 1))
  haveI := (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleGeometricPositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv
    R Q g n d p).symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  exact (projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n _ (p + 1)).toEquiv.subsingleton

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.tw_shortExact
statement:
theorem Regularity.tw_shortExact (d : ℤ) (S : ShortComplex (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (tensorSheafLeftFunctor (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hflf := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d
  letI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ hflf
  letI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ hflf

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.serre_aux
statement:
theorem Regularity.serre_aux
    (hgen : ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      ∃ d₀ : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ q : ℕ, n ≤ q + k → ∀ g : R,
        Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf (toSpec R n)
          (Regularity.tw R n d M) (q + 1)).obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro M _
    refine ⟨0, fun d _ q hq g ↦ ?_⟩
    letI : (Regularity.tw R n d M).IsFinitePresentation :=
      projectiveTwistingTensor_isFinitePresentation R n M d
    exact quasicoherent_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt R n
      (Regularity.tw R n d M) q (by omega) g
  | succ k ih =>
    intro M _
    obtain ⟨D⟩ := hgen M
    letI : Module.Finite R (D.G.I →₀ R) := D.coefficient_isFinite
    letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (D.G.I →₀ R) :=
      Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
    letI : (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
        (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) D.d).IsFinitePresentation :=
      projectiveTwistingBaseModule_isFinitePresentation R n (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) D.d
    letI : Epi D.projection := D.projection_epi
    letI : (kernel D.projection).IsFinitePresentation :=
      projectiveKernel_isFinitePresentation_of_epi R n D.projection
    obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩ := ih (kernel D.projection)
    refine ⟨max d₁ (-(n : ℤ) - D.d), fun d hd q hq g ↦ ?_⟩
    let S : ShortComplex (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules :=
      ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι D.projection) D.projection (kernel.condition D.projection)
    have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel D.projection }
    have hS' := Regularity.tw_shortExact R n d S hS
    have h₂ : Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf
        (toSpec R n) (Regularity.tw R n d (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
          (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) D.d)) (q + 1)).obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))) := by
      haveI := Regularity.baseModule_basicOpen_subsingleton R (D.G.I →₀ R) n (d + D.d)
        (by have := le_max_right d₁ (-(n : ℤ) - D.d); omega) q g
      exact Regularity.H_subsingleton_of_iso (toSpec R n)
        (Regularity.twBaseModuleIso R n (ModuleCat.of R (D.G.I →₀ R)) d D.d) (q + 1) _
    have h₁ := hd₁ d (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hd) (q + 1) (by omega) g
    exact Regularity.H_subsingleton_of_shortExact (toSpec R n) _ hS' (q + 1) _ h₂ h₁

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.serreVanishing_basicOpen
statement:
theorem serreVanishing_basicOpen
    (hgen : ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M)
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ d₀ : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ (q : ℕ) (g : R),
      Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf (toSpec R n)
        (Regularity.tw R n d M) (q + 1)).obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d₀, h⟩ := Regularity.serre_aux R n hgen n M
  exact ⟨d₀, fun d hd q g ↦ h d hd q (by omega) g⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.serreVanishing
statement:
theorem serreVanishing
    (hgen : ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M)
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ d₀ : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ q : ℕ,
      IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n) (Regularity.tw R n d M) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d₀, h⟩ := serreVanishing_basicOpen R n hgen M
  refine ⟨d₀, fun d hd q ↦ ?_⟩
  refine SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis
    _ _ _ PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens ?_
  rintro U ⟨g, rfl⟩
  exact h d hd q g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.chart_exists_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem Regularity.chart_exists_isMumfordRegular
    (hgen : ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M)
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n) (Regularity.tw R n (m - q) M) q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d₀, h⟩ := serreVanishing R n hgen M
  refine ⟨d₀ + n, fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  by_cases hpn : p + 1 ≤ n
  · exact h _ (by push_cast; omega) p
  · letI : (Regularity.tw R n (d₀ + n - ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) M).IsFinitePresentation :=
      projectiveTwistingTensor_isFinitePresentation R n M _
    exact quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt R n _ p (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.chart_regular_basicOpen
statement:
theorem Regularity.chart_regular_basicOpen
    (hgen : ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M)
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ (q' : ℕ) (g : R),
      Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf (toSpec R n)
        (Regularity.tw R n (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) M) (q' + 1)).obj
          (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d₀, h⟩ := serreVanishing_basicOpen R n hgen M
  refine ⟨d₀ + n, fun m hm q' g ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hq : q' + 1 ≤ n
  · exact h _ (by push_cast; omega) q' g
  · letI : (Regularity.tw R n (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) M).IsFinitePresentation :=
      projectiveTwistingTensor_isFinitePresentation R n M _
    exact quasicoherent_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt R n _ q' (by omega) g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
    (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm R n d 0)
    (hx : coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d 0 x = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext e
  by_contra hae
  obtain ⟨hdeg, hallowed⟩ := (x a).2 e hae
  have hnegative : ∃ j : Fin (n + 1), e j < 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hsum : 0 ≤ coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e := by
      exact Finsupp.sum_nonneg fun j _ => h j
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hnegative
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hallowed j hj
  have hj_eq : j = a 0 := by
    calc
      j = a t := ht.symm
      _ = a 0 := congrArg a (Fin.eq_zero t)
  have hai : e (a 0) < 0 := by simpa only [← hj_eq] using hj
  let b : Fin (n + 1) :=
    if h : a 0 = 0 then ⟨1, by omega⟩ else 0
  have hb : b ≠ a 0 := by
    dsimp only [b]
    split_ifs with h
    · intro heq
      have heq' := congrArg (fun z : Fin (n + 1) => z.val) (heq.trans h)
      exact Nat.one_ne_zero heq'
    · intro heq
      exact h heq.symm
  let ab : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) := fun _ => b
  have hab : (x ab).1 e = 0 := by
    by_contra hbe
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ((x ab).2 e hbe).2 (a 0) hai
    apply hb
    simpa only [ab] using ht
  let A : Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1) := Fin.cases (a 0) (fun _ => b)
  have hA0 : A ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove = ab := by
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    rfl
  have hA1 : A ∘ (1 : Fin 2).succAbove = a := by
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    rfl
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun z => (z A).1 e) hx
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff] at hcoeff
  change
    (∑ r : Fin 2, (-1 : R) ^ r.val * (x (A ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e) = 0
    at hcoeff
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul,
    Fin.val_one, pow_one, neg_one_mul, hA0, hA1, hab, zero_add] at hcoeff
  exact hae (neg_eq_zero.mp hcoeff)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
    (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) 0)
    (hx : coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d 0 x = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff :
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d 0
          (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d 0 x) = 0 := by
    rw [← coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
    rw [← coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional]
    rw [hx, map_zero]
  have hz :=
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
      R n hn d hd
        (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d 0 x) hdiff
  apply (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d 0).injective
  simpa using hz

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechZeroCocycles_subsingleton_of_neg

    (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    Subsingleton (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechZeroCocycles R n d)
proof:
:= by

  intro x y
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hx :
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d 0 x.1 = 0 :=
    x.2
  have hy :
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d 0 y.1 = 0 :=
    y.2
  exact
    (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
      R n hn d hd x.1 hx).trans
      (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_zero_injective_of_neg
        R n hn d hd y.1 hy).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingNegativePushforward_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingNegativePushforward_isFinitePresentation
    (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let N :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  letI : (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).IsQuasicoherent :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_isQuasicoherent R n d
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  let e :
      Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) 0 ≃ₗ[R]
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj N := by
    change Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) 0 ≃ₗ[R]
      Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, ⊤)
    exact projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroLinearEquivSections R n d
  letI :
      Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) 0) :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg R n hn d hd
  letI :
      Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj N) :=
    e.symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj N) :=
    module_finitePresentation_of_subsingleton R
  exact isFinitePresentation_of_moduleSpecΓ N

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n p r a).op
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  let f := projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q
  let m := map f n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d
  let U₀ := coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
  let U₁ := coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) a
  let V₀ := coordinateCechIntersection S n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
  let V₁ := coordinateCechIntersection S n (p + 1) a
  let gR : U₁ ⟶ U₀ := coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a
  let gS : V₁ ⟶ V₀ := coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom S n p r a
  let h₀ : m ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ = V₀ :=
    preimage_coordinateCechIntersection f n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
  let h₁ : m ⁻¹ᵁ U₁ = V₁ :=
    preimage_coordinateCechIntersection f n (p + 1) a
  change
    M.presheaf.map (eqToHom h₁.symm).op
        (M.presheaf.map
          (((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map m.base).map gR).op) x) =
      M.presheaf.map gS.op
        (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom h₀.symm).op x)
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p a)
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d p a) :
    ((projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
      R Q n d p a x).1).1 e.1 =
      (x.1 e.1).1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let eS :=
    coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv
      (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p a
  let eR := coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv R n d p a
  let y :=
    (finsuppProdLinearEquiv R Q
      (coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d p a) (eS x)).1
  change (eR.symm y).1 e.1 = (x.1 e.1).1
  have h :=
    coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply
      R n d p a (eR.symm y) e
  rw [eR.apply_symm_apply] at h
  rw [← h]
  rfl

theorem coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_zero

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceInfinitesimalFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceInfinitesimalFinsupp_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)

      (x.1 e.1).2
proof:
:= by

    coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp,
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv,
