name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece R n d p a)
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (he : ¬(coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d ∧ e.AllowedOn n a)) :
    x.1 e = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hx
  exact he (x.2 e hx)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_coface_apply_of_allowed
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_coface_apply_of_allowed
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) ⊗[R] Q)
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d (p + 1) a)
    (h :
      coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e.1 = d ∧
        e.1.AllowedOn n (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a).rTensor Q x) e =
      coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp R Q n d p
        (a ∘ r.succAbove) x ⟨e.1, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      change (0 : Q) =
        (0 : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent
          n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) →₀ Q) ⟨e.1, h⟩
      rfl
  | tmul y q =>
      simp [coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp,
        coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap,
        TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply,
        coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add, coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_add,
        Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_coface_apply_of_not_allowed
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_coface_apply_of_not_allowed
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) ⊗[R] Q)
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d (p + 1) a)
    (h :
      ¬(coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e.1 = d ∧
        e.1.AllowedOn n (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a).rTensor Q x) e = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | tmul y q =>
      have hy :=
        coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
          R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) y e.1 h
      simp [hy, coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp,
        coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap,
        TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply,
        coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add, coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_add,
        Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p
      (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
      R Q n d (p + 1) a
      (coordinateLaurentCoface
        (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p r a x)).1 =
      coordinateLaurentCoface R n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext e
  by_cases ht :
      coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d ∧ e.AllowedOn n a
  · let et : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d (p + 1) a :=
      ⟨e, ht⟩
    rw [projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_apply
      R Q n d (p + 1) a _ et]
    change (x.1 e).1 =
      ((projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
        R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1).1 e
    by_cases hs :
        coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d ∧
          e.AllowedOn n (a ∘ r.succAbove)
    · let es : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent
          n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) :=
        ⟨e, hs⟩
      rw [projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_apply
        R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x es]
    · have hx :=
        coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) x e hs
      have hy :=
        coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
          R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1 e hs
      rw [hx, hy]
      rfl
  · have hleft :=
      coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
        R n d (p + 1) a
        (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1) a
          (coordinateLaurentCoface
            (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p r a x)).1 e ht
    have hright :=
      coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
        R n d (p + 1) a
        (coordinateLaurentCoface R n d p r a
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1) e ht
    exact hleft.trans hright.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_injective
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp R Q n d p a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x y h
  apply ((coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv R n d p a).rTensor Q).injective
  apply (TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft R Q
    (coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d p a)).injective
  simpa only [coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_snd_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_snd_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p
      (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
      R Q n d (p + 1) a
      (coordinateLaurentCoface
        (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p r a x)).2 =
      (coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a).rTensor Q
        (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).2
proof:
:= by
  apply coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_injective
    R Q n d (p + 1) a
  ext e
  change
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceInfinitesimalFinsupp
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        (coordinateLaurentCoface
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p r a x) e =
      coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a).rTensor Q
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).2) e
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceInfinitesimalFinsupp_apply]
  change (x.1 e.1).2 = _
  by_cases h :
      coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e.1 = d ∧
        e.1.AllowedOn n (a ∘ r.succAbove)
  · rw [coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_coface_apply_of_allowed
      R Q n d p r a _ e h]
    change (x.1 e.1).2 =
      projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceInfinitesimalFinsupp
        R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x ⟨e.1, h⟩
    rw [projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceInfinitesimalFinsupp_apply]
  · rw [coordinateLaurentPieceTensorFinsupp_coface_apply_of_not_allowed
      R Q n d p r a _ e h]
    have hx :=
      coordinateLaurentPiece_apply_eq_zero_of_not_allowedDegree
        (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p
        (a ∘ r.succAbove) x e.1 h
    rw [hx]
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p
      (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        (coordinateLaurentCoface
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p r a x) =
      projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentSplitCofaceLinearMap
        R Q n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_fst_coface
      R Q n d p r a x
  · exact projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_snd_coface
      R Q n d p r a x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_symm_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_symm_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv R n d (p + 1) a).symm
        (coordinateLaurentCoface R n d p r a x) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op
        ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
          R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
    R n d (p + 1) a).injective
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h :=
    (ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.cofaceCompatible
      R n (projectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry R n d))
      p r a
      ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
        R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).symm x)
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a x =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x
proof:
:= by
  change
    (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
      R n d (p + 1) a).symm
        (coordinateLaurentCoface R n d p r a
          (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
            R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)) = _
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_symm_coface,
    AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv_rTensor_symm_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv_rTensor_symm_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) ⊗[R] Q) :
    ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv
      R n d (p + 1) a).rTensor Q).symm
        ((coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a).rTensor Q x) =
      (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap
        R n d p r a).rTensor Q
        (((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv
          R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).rTensor Q).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul y q =>
      change
        (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv
          R n d (p + 1) a).symm
            (coordinateLaurentCoface R n d p r a y) ⊗ₜ[R] q =
          coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a
            ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv
              R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).symm y) ⊗ₜ[R] q
      congr 1
      simp [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap,
        coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x) =
      coordinateLaurentCoface (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  let S := projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q
  change
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv S n d (p + 1) a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)) =
      coordinateLaurentCoface S n d p r a
        (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv S n d p
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x))
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv_coface]
  exact
    (ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.cofaceCompatible
      S n (projectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry S n d))
      p r a
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
        R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x) =
      projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentSplitCofaceLinearMap
        R Q n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  change
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)) =
      projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentSplitCofaceLinearMap
        R Q n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x))
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv_coface]
  exact projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv_coface
    R Q n d p r a
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechLaurentAddEquiv
        R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x) =
      projectiveTwistingCechTwistTensorCofaceAddHom R Q n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  change
    ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
        R n d (p + 1) a).symm
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)).1,
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)).2) =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op
        ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
          R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).symm
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1),
        (coordinateLaurentCofaceLinearMap R n d p r a).rTensor Q
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).2)
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv_coface]
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_symm_coface
      R n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1
  · rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x) =
      projectiveTwistingCechTwistSectionsTensorCofaceAddHom
        R Q n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  change
    ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)).1,
      ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv
        R n d (p + 1) a).rTensor Q).symm
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)).2) =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).1,
        (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsCofaceLinearMap
          R n d p r a).rTensor Q
          (((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv
            R n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).rTensor Q).symm
            (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
              R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).2))
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv_coface]
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · exact coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentLinearEquiv_rTensor_symm_coface
      R Q n d p r a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistTensorAddEquiv
          R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove) x).2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module.Finite R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSplitAddEquiv
        R Q n d p a x =
      projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateLaurentPieceLinearEquiv R Q n d p a
        (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n d p a
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechSectionsAddEquiv
            R Q n d p a x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.deg_eq
statement: theorem deg_eq : (-3 : ℤ) + 1 + 1 + 1 = 0
proof: := by norm_num

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.le_range
statement:
theorem le_range (a : Fin 3) {W : (space k 2).Opens} (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) :
    W ≤ (coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι.opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem chartEquiv_apply (a : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a)
    (r : Γ(space k 2, W)) : chartEquiv k a W hW r = (coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι.app W r
proof: := rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pc_res
statement:
theorem pc_res (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) {V W : (space k 2).Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (m : Γ(Ot k d, V)) :
    pc k a d W ((Ot k d).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m) =
      (coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme.presheaf.map
        ((Opens.map (coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι.base).map (homOfLE h)).op (pc k a d V m)
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (PiC k 2 a d) (homOfLE h) m

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pc_add
statement:
theorem pc_add (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (m m' : Γ(Ot k d, W)) :
    pc k a d W (m + m') = pc k a d W m + pc k a d W m'
proof:
:=
  map_add (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k 2 a d) W).hom m m'

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pc_smul
statement:
theorem pc_smul (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (r : Γ(space k 2, W))
    (m : Γ(Ot k d, W)) : pc k a d W (r • m) = (coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι.app W r * pc k a d W m
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul (PiC k 2 a d) r m

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.Dtop_eq
statement: theorem Dtop_eq (a : Fin 3) : Dtop k a = coordinateOpen k 2 a
proof:
:= by
  show (coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.piC_unitSec
statement:
theorem piC_unitSec (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) :
    pc k a d (Dtop k a) (unitSec k a d) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app
    (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k 2 d a) ⊤
    (show Γ(unitModules (coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme, ⊤) from
      (1 : Γ((coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme, ⊤)))
  change (localFrameProjection k 2 d a).app ⊤ (unitSec k a d) = _ at h1
  rw [localFrameProjection_app_eq] at h1
  have hpe := ((coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι.preimage_image_eq (⊤ : (coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme.Opens))
  have h2 := congrArg ((coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpe).op) h1
  change ((coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpe).op)
      (((coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpe.symm).op)
        (pc k a d (Dtop k a) (unitSec k a d))) =
      ((coordinateOpen k 2 a).toScheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpe).op) 1 at h2
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl,
    op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, map_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.le_Dtop
statement:
theorem le_Dtop (a : Fin 3) {W : (space k 2).Opens} (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) :
    W ≤ Dtop k a
proof: := hW.trans (Dtop_eq k a).ge

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_eSec
statement:
theorem chartCoord_eSec (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) : chartCoord k a d W hW (eSec k a d W hW) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (chartEquiv k a W hW).symm (pc k a d W
    ((Ot k d).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_Dtop k a hW)).op (unitSec k a d))) = 1
  rw [pc_res, piC_unitSec, map_one, map_one]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pc_injective
statement:
theorem pc_injective (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) :
    Function.Injective (pc k a d W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ : ∃ V, (coordinateOpen k 2 a).ι ''ᵁ V = W :=
    ⟨_, by rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      inf_eq_right.mpr hW]⟩
  intro m m' h
  exact Pi_app_injective k 2 a d V m m' h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_apply
statement:
theorem chartCoord_apply (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (m : Γ(Ot k d, W)) :
    chartCoord k a d W hW m = (chartEquiv k a W hW).symm (pc k a d W m)
proof: := rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_injective
statement:
theorem chartCoord_injective (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) : Function.Injective (chartCoord k a d W hW)
proof:
:= by
  intro m m' h
  rw [chartCoord_apply, chartCoord_apply] at h
  exact pc_injective k a d W hW ((chartEquiv k a W hW).symm.injective h)

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.eq_smul_eSec
statement:
theorem eq_smul_eSec (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (m : Γ(Ot k d, W)) :
    m = chartCoord k a d W hW m • eSec k a d W hW
proof:
:= by
  apply chartCoord_injective k a d W hW
  rw [map_smul, chartCoord_eSec, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_bijective
statement:
theorem chartCoord_bijective (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) : Function.Bijective (chartCoord k a d W hW)
proof:
:=
  ⟨chartCoord_injective k a d W hW, fun s => ⟨s • eSec k a d W hW, by
    rw [map_smul, chartCoord_eSec, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]⟩⟩

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartBasis_apply
statement:
theorem chartBasis_apply (a : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (i : Fin 1) : chartBasis k a d W hW i = eSec k a d W hW
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, Module.Basis.singleton_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact (chartCoord_eSec k a d W hW).symm

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pc_X
statement:
theorem pc_X (a i : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a)
    (m : Γ(Ot k d, W)) :
    pc k a (d + 1) W (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.X k 2 i d) W m) =
      chartEquiv k a W hW (res k a W hW (Koszul.ratio k 2 a i)) * pc k a d W m
proof:
:= by
  have h := PiC_X_app k 2 a i d W m
  unfold pc
  rw [h, Koszul.mulHom_app_apply, bridge k 2 a i W hW]
  rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_X
statement:
theorem chartCoord_X (a i : Fin 3) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (m : Γ(Ot k d, W)) :
    chartCoord k a (d + 1) W hW (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.X k 2 i d) W m) =
      res k a W hW (Koszul.ratio k 2 a i) * chartCoord k a d W hW m
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCoord_apply, chartCoord_apply, pc_X k a i d W hW, map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_cast
statement:
theorem chartCoord_cast (a : Fin 3) {d d' : ℤ} (h : d = d') (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (m : Γ(Ot k d, W)) :
    chartCoord k a d' W hW
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (eqToHom (congrArg (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 2) h)) W m) =
      chartCoord k a d W hW m
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_mono
statement:
theorem chartCoord_mono (a i j l : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (m : Γ(Ot k (-3), W)) :
    chartCoord k a (-3 + 1 + 1 + 1) W hW (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (mono k i j l) W m) =
      res k a W hW (Koszul.ratio k 2 a i * Koszul.ratio k 2 a j * Koszul.ratio k 2 a l) *
        chartCoord k a (-3) W hW m
proof:
:= by
  unfold mono
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [chartCoord_X, chartCoord_X, chartCoord_X, map_mul, map_mul]
  ring

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.chartCoord_cubic
statement:
theorem chartCoord_cubic (a : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) (m : Γ(Ot k (-3), W)) :
    chartCoord k a (-3 + 1 + 1 + 1) W hW (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (cubic k) W m) =
      res k a W hW (fchart k a) * chartCoord k a (-3) W hW m
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubic
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.sub_app]
  change chartCoord k a _ W hW (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (mono k 1 1 2) W m -
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (mono k 0 0 0) W m - Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (mono k 0 0 2) W m) = _
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, chartCoord_mono, chartCoord_mono, chartCoord_mono, fchart, map_sub,
    map_sub]
  ring

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.gU_isUnit
statement:
theorem gU_isUnit (a : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a) :
    IsUnit (gU k a W hW)
proof:
:= by
  let m1 : Γ(Ot k 0, W) := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k 2).inv W
    (show Γ(SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (space k 2), W) from (1 : Γ(space k 2, W)))
  have h1 : (show Γ(space k 2, W) from
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k 2).hom W m1) = 1 :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k 2) W _
  rw [eq_smul_eSec k a 0 W hW m1, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul] at h1
  have h2 : chartCoord k a 0 W hW m1 * gU k a W hW = 1 := h1
  exact ⟨⟨gU k a W hW, chartCoord k a 0 W hW m1, by rw [mul_comm]; exact h2, h2⟩, rfl⟩

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.sval_eq
statement:
theorem sval_eq (a : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a)
    (m : Γ(Ot k (-3), W)) :
    sval k W m = res k a W hW (fchart k a) * chartCoord k a (-3) W hW m * gU k a W hW
proof:
:= by
  set m0 : Γ(Ot k 0, W) := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
    (eqToHom (congrArg (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 2) (deg_eq))) W
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (cubic k) W m) with hm0
  have h0 : m0 = (res k a W hW (fchart k a) * chartCoord k a (-3) W hW m) • eSec k a 0 W hW := by
    rw [eq_smul_eSec k a 0 W hW m0, hm0, chartCoord_cast k a deg_eq, chartCoord_cubic]
  have hs : sval k W m = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k 2).hom W m0 := by
    unfold sval sigma0
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hs, h0, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  rfl

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.sectionsEquiv_ratio_ne
statement:
theorem sectionsEquiv_ratio_ne (a j : Fin 3) (h : j ≠ a) :
    coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k 2 a (Koszul.ratio k 2 a j) = MvPolynomial.X ⟨j, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv
  have h1 : (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k 2) (coordinate k 2 a)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 2 a) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm
        (Koszul.ratio k 2 a j) = Koszul.awayRatio k 2 a j := by
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rfl
  change awayCoordinateEquiv k 2 a ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k 2) (coordinate k 2 a)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 2 a) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm
        (Koszul.ratio k 2 a j)) = _
  rw [h1]
  unfold awayCoordinateEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change _ = awayCoordinateHom k 2 a (MvPolynomial.X ⟨j, h⟩)
  rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [coordinateRatio, Koszul.awayRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.sectionsEquiv_ratio
statement:
theorem sectionsEquiv_ratio (a j : Fin 3) :
    coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k 2 a (Koszul.ratio k 2 a j) = rp k a j
proof:
:= by
  unfold rp
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    rw [Koszul.ratio_self, map_one]
  · exact sectionsEquiv_ratio_ne k a j h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.sectionsEquiv_fchart
statement:
theorem sectionsEquiv_fchart (a : Fin 3) :
    coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k 2 a (fchart k a) = fpoly k a
proof:
:= by
  unfold fchart fpoly
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, sectionsEquiv_ratio]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fchart_ne_zero
statement: theorem fchart_ne_zero (a : Fin 3) : fchart k a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply fpoly_ne_zero k a
  rw [← sectionsEquiv_fchart, h, map_zero]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.res_fchart_ne_zero
statement:
theorem res_fchart_ne_zero (a : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a)
    [Nonempty W] : res k a W hW (fchart k a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply fchart_ne_zero k a
  apply map_injective_of_isIntegral (space k 2) (homOfLE hW)
  rw [map_zero]
  exact h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.sval_eSec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sval_eSec_ne_zero (a : Fin 3) (W : (space k 2).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a)
    [Nonempty W] : sval k W (eSec k a (-3) W hW) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sval_eq k a W hW, chartCoord_eSec, mul_one]
  exact mul_ne_zero (res_fchart_ne_zero k a W hW) (gU_isUnit k a W hW).ne_zero

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.basicOpen_ratio
statement:
theorem basicOpen_ratio (a b : Fin 3) :
    (space k 2).basicOpen (Koszul.ratio k 2 a b) = coordinateOpen k 2 a ⊓ coordinateOpen k 2 b
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hpa : p ∈ coordinateOpen k 2 a := (space k 2).basicOpen_le _ hp
    refine ⟨hpa, ?_⟩
    have hu := ((space k 2).mem_basicOpen _ p hpa).mp hp
    have h2 := (isUnit_germ_awayToSection_mk_iff k 2 a p hpa 1 (coordinate k 2 b)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 2 b)).mp hu
    exact h2
  · rintro ⟨hpa, hpb⟩
    refine ((space k 2).mem_basicOpen _ p hpa).mpr ?_
    exact (isUnit_germ_awayToSection_mk_iff k 2 a p hpa 1 (coordinate k 2 b)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 2 b)).mpr hpb

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_blowup_poly
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_blowup_poly {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ I)] : IsRegularScheme (blowup I)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsRegularRing R[X] := SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularRing_polynomial R
  haveI : IsRegularRing (R[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I) :=
    IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (polyCentreQuotEquiv I).symm
  exact isRegularScheme_reesScheme (centreIdeal I)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_of_openImmersion
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_of_openImmersion {V X : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (h : IsRegularScheme X) : IsRegularScheme V
proof:
:= fun v => by
  haveI := h (j v)
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (asIso (j.stalkMap v)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_of_isRegularScheme_spec
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_isRegularScheme_spec {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (h : IsRegularScheme (Spec (CommRingCat.of C))) : IsRegularRing C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun q _ => ?_⟩
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing
      ((structurePresheafInCommRingCat C).stalk (⟨q, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum C)) :=
    h ⟨q, inferInstance⟩
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (StructureSheaf.stalkIso C ⟨q, inferInstance⟩).toRingEquiv.symm

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_sections
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_sections (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (hY : IsRegularScheme Y)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) : IsRegularRing Γ(Y, U.1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  exact isRegularRing_of_isRegularScheme_spec (C := Γ(Y, U.1))
    (isRegularScheme_of_openImmersion U.2.fromSpec hY)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_sections_quotient
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_sections_quotient (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (hJ : IsRegularScheme J.subscheme) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsRegularRing (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) := inferInstance
  exact isRegularRing_of_isRegularScheme_spec (C := Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
    (@isRegularScheme_of_openImmersion _ _ (J.subschemeCover.f U) (J.subschemeCover.map_prop U) hJ)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.exists_affineOpen_mem
statement: theorem exists_affineOpen_mem (y : Y) : ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, y ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Y.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show y ∈ (⊤ : Y.Opens) from trivial)
  exact ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, hyU⟩

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_blowupGlobal
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_blowupGlobal (hY : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hJ : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) :
    IsRegularScheme (blowupGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  have hb : b ∈ (⊤ : (blowupGlobal Y J).Opens) := trivial
  rw [← iSup_opensRange_blowupAffineι Y J] at hb
  obtain ⟨U, a, rfl⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hb
  haveI := hY U
  haveI := hJ U
  exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ a (isRegularScheme_blowup_poly (J.ideal U) a)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_line
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_line (hY : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing Γ(Y, U.1)) :
    IsRegularScheme (DeformationSpace.line Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpen_mem Y (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ l)
  obtain ⟨a, -, hal⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback (isPullback_lineAffine Y U)
    ⟨DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ l, hU⟩ l rfl
  haveI := hY U
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(Y, U.1)[X] := SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularRing_polynomial _
  rw [← hal]
  exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ a (isRegularScheme_spec _ a)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_totalGlobal
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_totalGlobal (hY : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hJ : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) :
    IsRegularScheme (totalGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rcases totalGlobal_points Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ b (isRegularScheme_blowupGlobal Y J hY hJ b)
  · exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ l (isRegularScheme_line Y hY l)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_totalGlobal'
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_totalGlobal' [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (hY : IsRegularScheme Y)
    (hZ : IsRegularScheme J.subscheme) : IsRegularScheme (totalGlobal Y J)
proof:
:=
  isRegularScheme_totalGlobal Y J (isRegularRing_sections Y hY)
    (isRegularRing_sections_quotient Y J hZ)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_relativeSpec
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_relativeSpec (𝒜 : AlgebraData Y)
    (h : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing (𝒜.ring U)) :
    IsRegularScheme (RelativeSpec.relativeSpec Y 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  have hb : b ∈ (⊤ : (RelativeSpec.relativeSpec Y 𝒜).Opens) := trivial
  rw [← RelativeSpec.iSup_opensRange_affineι Y 𝒜] at hb
  obtain ⟨U, a, rfl⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hb
  haveI := h U
  exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ a (isRegularScheme_spec _ a)

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_subschemeUGlobal
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_subschemeUGlobal
    (hJ : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) :
    IsRegularScheme (subschemeUGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine isRegularScheme_relativeSpec Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) fun U => ?_
  haveI := hJ U
  exact SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularRing_polynomial _

name: BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_subschemeTotalGlobal
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_subschemeTotalGlobal
    (hJ : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsRegularRing (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) :
    IsRegularScheme (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rcases subschemeTotalGlobal_points Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ b (isRegularScheme_subschemeUGlobal Y J hJ b)
  · exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion _ l (isRegularScheme_subschemeUGlobal Y J hJ l)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf_map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf_map_apply

    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) {U V : Y.Opensᵒᵖ}

    (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M i).map g x =

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_toSheaf

name: M1.tveeCan_eq
statement:
theorem tveeCan_eq {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f) :
    letI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    tveeCan hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf = tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i := by
  letI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  unfold tveeCan
  have hs := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (RT.exists_factorisation hX hY f hf))
  letI := hs.1
  exact tvee_independent hY hYreg hXreg _ n _ i (hs.2.trans hi.symm)

name: M1.tClassCan_eq
statement:
theorem tClassCan_eq {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY R Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = f) (j : ℕ) :
    letI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    letI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    tClassCan hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf j = tClass hY hYreg hXreg n i j := by
  letI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  letI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  unfold tClassCan tClass
  rw [tveeCan_eq hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi]

name: M1.tClassCan_isUnit
statement: theorem tClassCan_isUnit (j : ℕ) : IsUnit (tClassCan hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tClassCan
  exact Units.isUnit _

name: M1.adams_intrinsic_can
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_can {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    letI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    letI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
        (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
      fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          tClassCan hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf j) := by
  letI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  letI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  obtain ⟨n, i, hclosed, hi⟩ := RT.exists_factorisation hX hY f hf
  letI : IsClosedImmersion i := hclosed
  rw [tClassCan_eq hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi j]
  exact adams_intrinsic hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj x

name: B6.Ctx.pr_psi
statement: theorem pr_psi (p : ℕ) (x : K) : C.pr hj p (C.Ψ j x) = (j : ℚ) ^ p • C.pr hj p x
proof:
:= by

name: B6.Ctx.pr_mem

name: B6.Ctx.pr_of_mem_same

statement: theorem pr_zero_eq (x : K) : C.pr hj 0 x = C.ρ x • (1 : K)
proof:

    (fun p hp x hx => (rank_eq_zero_of_mem_W j C.H hj hp hx).1) x

name: B6.Ctx.eq_zero_of_eigen
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_eigen {μ : ℚ} (hμ : ∀ p : ℕ, μ ≠ (j : ℚ) ^ p) {v : K}
    (hv : C.Ψ j v = μ • v) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj

name: B6.Ctx.exists_cover
statement:
theorem exists_cover (xs : Finset K) :
    ∃ (S : Subalgebra ℚ K) (_ : Module.Finite ℚ S) (hS : StableSub C.Ψ S) (D : ℕ),
      (∀ x ∈ xs, x ∈ S) ∧
      @RG6B.WeightHyp S _ _ (W (subPsi S hS) j) (C.subGr hj S hS)
        (subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) j D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, hxs⟩ := exists_finite_stable_subalgebra C.H C.comm xs
  haveI := hfin
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := subalg_weightHyp C.H S hS j hj
  exact ⟨S, hfin, hS, D, hxs, hD⟩

name: B6.Ctx.val_graded
statement:
theorem val_graded (S : Subalgebra ℚ K) (hS : StableSub C.Ψ S) :
    ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ W (subPsi S hS) j p, S.val x ∈ W C.Ψ j p
proof:
:= by
  intro p x hx
  rw [mem_W] at hx ⊢
  have := congrArg (fun y : S => (y : K)) hx
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_smul] at this
  rw [subPsi_val S hS hj] at this
  exact this

name: B6.Ctx.pr_val
statement:
theorem pr_val (S : Subalgebra ℚ K) (hS : StableSub C.Ψ S) (p : ℕ) (x : S) :
    ((@RG6B.pr S _ _ (W (subPsi S hS) j) (C.subGr hj S hS) p x : S) : K) =
      C.pr hj p (x : K)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.subGr hj S hS
  letI := C.gr hj
  exact (pr_map S.val (C.val_graded hj S hS) p x).symm

name: B6.Ctx.weaken
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.hj, H.psi_eq, fun hp => H.bound (lt_of_le_of_lt h hp)⟩

name: B6.Ctx.isUnit_of_pr_zero
statement: theorem isUnit_of_pr_zero {τ : K} (h : C.pr hj 0 τ = 1) : IsUnit τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, D, hxs, hH⟩ := C.exists_cover hj {τ}
  letI := C.subGr hj S hS
  let τ' : S := ⟨τ, hxs τ (by simp)⟩
  have h' : RG6B.pr (W (subPsi S hS) j) 0 τ' = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [C.pr_val hj S hS]
    exact h
  exact (RG6B.isUnit_of_pr_zero hH h').map S.val

name: B6.Ctx.exists_tau
statement:
theorem exists_tau {s : K} (hs : C.pr hj 0 s = 1) :
    ∃ τ : K, C.pr hj 0 τ = 1 ∧ C.Ψ j τ = s * τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, D, hxs, hH⟩ := C.exists_cover hj {s}
  letI := C.subGr hj S hS
  let s' : S := ⟨s, hxs s (by simp)⟩
  have hs' : RG6B.pr (W (subPsi S hS) j) 0 s' = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [C.pr_val hj S hS]
    exact hs
  obtain ⟨τ', h0, hτ⟩ := RG6B.exists_tau hH hs'
  refine ⟨(τ' : K), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← C.pr_val hj S hS, h0]; rfl
  · have := congrArg (fun y : S => (y : K)) hτ
    simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul] at this
    rw [← subPsi_val S hS hj τ']
    exact this

name: B6.Ctx.tau_unique
statement:
theorem tau_unique {s τ τ' : K} (hs : C.pr hj 0 s = 1) (h1 : C.pr hj 0 τ = 1)
    (h2 : C.Ψ j τ = s * τ) (h1' : C.pr hj 0 τ' = 1) (h2' : C.Ψ j τ' = s * τ') : τ = τ'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, D, hxs, hH⟩ := C.exists_cover hj {s, τ, τ'}
  letI := C.subGr hj S hS
  have hsS : s ∈ S := hxs s (by simp)
  have hτS : τ ∈ S := hxs τ (by simp)
  have hτ'S : τ' ∈ S := hxs τ' (by simp)
  let s₀ : S := ⟨s, hsS⟩
  let a : S := ⟨τ, hτS⟩
  let b : S := ⟨τ', hτ'S⟩
  have hpr : ∀ (y : S) (z : K), (y : K) = z → C.pr hj 0 z = 1 →
      RG6B.pr (W (subPsi S hS) j) 0 y = 1 := by
    intro y z hyz hz
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [C.pr_val hj S hS, hyz]
    exact hz
  have hpsi : ∀ (y : S) (z u : K), (y : K) = z → C.Ψ j z = u →
      (((subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) y : S) : K) = u := by
    intro y z u hyz hzu
    rw [← hyz] at hzu
    show ((subPsi S hS j y : S) : K) = u
    rw [subPsi_val S hS hj y, hzu]
  have := RG6B.tau_unique hH (hpr s₀ s rfl hs) (hpr a τ rfl h1)
    (Subtype.ext (by
      rw [hpsi a τ (s * τ) rfl h2]; rfl))
    (hpr b τ' rfl h1')
    (Subtype.ext (by
      rw [hpsi b τ' (s * τ') rfl h2']; rfl))
  exact congrArg (fun y : S => (y : K)) this

name: B6.Ctx.toddW_stable
statement:
theorem toddW_stable {D E : ℕ} (hDE : D ≤ E) {x : K} (hx : ∀ p, D < p → C.pr hj p x = 0) :
    C.toddW hj E x = C.toddW hj D x
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj
  unfold toddW B4.ToddW
  rw [addCharW_stable hDE _ hx]

name: B6.Ctx.thetaNormW_stable
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj
  unfold thetaNormW B4.ThetaNormW
  rw [addCharW_stable hDE _ hx]

name: B6.Ctx.addChar_nilp
statement:
theorem addChar_nilp (D : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℚ) (x : K) :
    IsNilpotent (@B4.addCharW K _ _ (W C.Ψ j) (C.gr hj) D f x)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj
  unfold B4.addCharW
  refine isNilpotent_sum fun k hk => ?_
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1
  have hmem : RG6B.pr (W C.Ψ j) k x ∈ W C.Ψ j k := RG6B.pr_mem k x
  have hnil : IsNilpotent (RG6B.pr (W C.Ψ j) k x) :=
    (rank_eq_zero_of_mem_W j C.H hj hk1 hmem).2
  unfold B4.powSumW
  exact (hnil.smul _).smul _

name: STEPW.Filt.mono_nat
statement:
theorem Filt.mono_nat {V : ℕ → Submodule ℚ K} {M : ℕ} (h : Filt Ψ ρ V M) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    V b ≤ V a
proof:
:= by
  induction hab with
  | refl => exact le_rfl
  | step _ ih => exact (h.anti _).trans ih

name: STEPW.Filt.bot_of_le
statement:
theorem Filt.bot_of_le {V : ℕ → Submodule ℚ K} {M : ℕ} (h : Filt Ψ ρ V M) {m : ℕ} (hm : M + 1 ≤ m) :
    V m = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have := h.mono_nat hm
  rw [h.bot] at this
  exact le_bot_iff.mp this

name: STEPW.HasFilt.zero
statement: theorem HasFilt.zero : HasFilt Ψ ρ (0 : K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ ⊥, 0, ⟨fun _ ↦ le_rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩
  · intro v hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hv
    subst hv
    exact IsNilpotent.zero
  · exact bot_le
  · intro v hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hv
    subst hv
    exact map_zero _
  · intro j _ m v hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hv
    subst hv
    simp

name: STEPW.HasFilt.add
statement: theorem HasFilt.add {x y : K} (hx : HasFilt Ψ ρ x) (hy : HasFilt Ψ ρ y) : HasFilt Ψ ρ (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, M, hV, hxV⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨V', M', hV', hyV⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨fun m ↦ V m ⊔ V' m, max M M', ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, Submodule.add_mem_sup hxV hyV⟩
  · intro m
    exact sup_le_sup (hV.anti m) (hV'.anti m)
  · rw [hV.bot_of_le (by omega), hV'.bot_of_le (by omega)]
    simp
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hv
    exact Commute.isNilpotent_add (Commute.all _ _) (hV.nil a ha) (hV'.nil b hb)
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hv
    obtain ⟨c, hc, a', ha', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hV.zero ha)
    obtain ⟨d, hd, b', hb', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hV'.zero hb)
    refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨c + d, Submodule.add_mem _ hc hd, a' + b',
      Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨a', ha', b', hb', rfl⟩, by abel⟩
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hv
    rw [map_add, hV.rank a ha, hV'.rank b hb, add_zero]
  · intro j hj m v hv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hv
    have h1 := hV.eig j hj m a ha
    have h2 := hV'.eig j hj m b hb
    have : Ψ j (a + b) - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • (a + b) =
        (Ψ j a - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • a) + (Ψ j b - ((j : ℚ) ^ m) • b) := by
      rw [map_add, smul_add]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup h1 h2

name: STEPW.HasFilt.smul
statement: theorem HasFilt.smul {x : K} (c : ℚ) (hx : HasFilt Ψ ρ x) : HasFilt Ψ ρ (c • x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, M, hV, hxV⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨V, M, hV, Submodule.smul_mem _ c hxV⟩

name: STEPW.hasFilt_of_span
statement:
theorem hasFilt_of_span {S : Set K} (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, HasFilt Ψ ρ s)
    {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span ℚ S) : HasFilt Ψ ρ x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem s hs => exact hS s hs
  | zero => exact HasFilt.zero
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => exact ha.add hb
  | smul c a _ ha => exact ha.smul c

name: STEPW.mem_W
statement: theorem mem_W {j p : ℕ} {x : K} : x ∈ W Ψ j p ↔ Ψ j x = ((j : ℚ) ^ p) • x
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff

name: STEPW.kp_zero
statement: theorem kp_zero (x : K) : kp Ψ j 0 x = x
proof: := by simp [kp]

name: STEPW.kp_succ_eq
statement:
theorem kp_succ_eq (n : ℕ) : kp Ψ j (n + 1) =
    ((Ψ j).toLinearMap - algebraMap ℚ (Module.End ℚ K) ((j : ℚ) ^ n)) * kp Ψ j n
proof:
:= by
  have : ∏ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (X - C ((j : ℚ) ^ m)) =
      (X - C ((j : ℚ) ^ n)) * ∏ m ∈ Finset.range n, (X - C ((j : ℚ) ^ m)) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, mul_comm]
  rw [kp, kp, this, map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C]

name: STEPW.kp_succ_apply'
statement:
theorem kp_succ_apply' (n : ℕ) (x : K) :
    kp Ψ j (n + 1) x = Ψ j (kp Ψ j n x) - ((j : ℚ) ^ n) • kp Ψ j n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [kp_succ_eq]
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]

name: STEPW.kp_succ_apply
statement:
theorem kp_succ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : K) :
    kp Ψ j (n + 1) x = kp Ψ j n (Ψ j x - ((j : ℚ) ^ n) • x)
proof:
:= by
  have : kp Ψ j (n + 1) = kp Ψ j n * ((Ψ j).toLinearMap -
      algebraMap ℚ (Module.End ℚ K) ((j : ℚ) ^ n)) := by
    rw [kp, kp, Finset.prod_range_succ, map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C]
  rw [this]
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]

name: STEPW.kp_mem
statement:
theorem kp_mem {V : ℕ → Submodule ℚ K} {M : ℕ} (hV : Filt Ψ ρ V M) (hj : 2 ≤ j) {v : K}
    (hv : v ∈ V 0) (n : ℕ) : kp Ψ j n v ∈ V n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [kp_zero]; exact hv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [kp_succ_apply']
    exact hV.eig j hj n _ ih

name: STEPW.exists_killing
statement: theorem exists_killing {x : K} (hx : HasFilt Ψ ρ x) (hj : 2 ≤ j) : ∃ M, kp Ψ j (M + 1) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, M, hV, hv⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  have := kp_mem j hV hj hv (M + 1)
  rwa [hV.bot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this

name: STEPW.pow_injective
statement: theorem pow_injective (hj : 2 ≤ j) : Function.Injective fun p : ℕ ↦ ((j : ℚ) ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have h0 : (j : ℚ) ^ a = (j : ℚ) ^ b := h
  have h' : j ^ a = j ^ b := by exact_mod_cast h0
  exact Nat.pow_right_injective hj h'

name: STEPW.iSupIndep_W
statement: theorem iSupIndep_W (hj : 2 ≤ j) : iSupIndep (W Ψ j)
proof:
:=
  (Module.End.eigenspaces_iSupIndep (Ψ j).toLinearMap).comp (pow_injective j hj)

name: STEPW.exists_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_preimage (hj : 2 ≤ j) (n : ℕ) (z : K) (hz : z ∈ ⨆ p : Fin n, W Ψ j p) :
    ∃ w ∈ (⨆ p : Fin n, W Ψ j p), Ψ j w - ((j : ℚ) ^ n) • w = z
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem i x hx =>
    have hne : ((j : ℚ) ^ (i : ℕ)) - (j : ℚ) ^ n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have := pow_injective j hj (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
      have := i.2
      omega
    refine ⟨(((j : ℚ) ^ (i : ℕ)) - (j : ℚ) ^ n)⁻¹ • x,
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i hx), ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, mem_W.mp hx, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← sub_smul]
    have : ((j : ℚ) ^ (i : ℕ) - (j : ℚ) ^ n)⁻¹ * (j : ℚ) ^ (i : ℕ) -
        (j : ℚ) ^ n * ((j : ℚ) ^ (i : ℕ) - (j : ℚ) ^ n)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      field_simp
    rw [this, one_smul]
  | zero => exact ⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨w₁, h₁, e₁⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨w₂, h₂, e₂⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨w₁ + w₂, Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, smul_add, ← e₁, ← e₂]
    abel

name: STEPW.mem_iSup_of_kp
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_of_kp (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : K), kp Ψ j n y = 0 → y ∈ ⨆ p : Fin n, W Ψ j p
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro y hy
    rw [kp_zero] at hy
    subst hy
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ n ih =>
    intro y hy
    have hz0 : kp Ψ j n (Ψ j y - ((j : ℚ) ^ n) • y) = 0 := by rw [← kp_succ_apply]; exact hy
    have hzS := ih _ hz0
    have hSle : (⨆ p : Fin n, W Ψ j p) ≤ ⨆ p : Fin (n + 1), W Ψ j p :=
      iSup_le fun p ↦ le_iSup (fun q : Fin (n + 1) ↦ W Ψ j q) p.castSucc
    obtain ⟨w, hwS, hw⟩ := exists_preimage j hj n _ hzS
    have hyw : y - w ∈ W Ψ j n := by
      rw [mem_W, map_sub, smul_sub]
      have : Ψ j y - Ψ j w = ((j : ℚ) ^ n) • y - ((j : ℚ) ^ n) • w := by
        have h1 := sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub.mp hw
        rw [← neg_sub, h1, neg_sub]
      exact this
    have : y = w + (y - w) := by abel
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hSle hwS)
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (Fin.last n) hyw)

name: STEPW.iSup_W_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_W_eq_top (H : ∀ x : K, HasFilt Ψ ρ x) (hj : 2 ≤ j) : ⨆ p : ℕ, W Ψ j p = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_killing j (H x) hj
  have := mem_iSup_of_kp j hj (M + 1) x hM
  exact (iSup_le fun p : Fin (M + 1) ↦ le_iSup (fun q : ℕ ↦ W Ψ j q) (p : ℕ)) this

name: STEPW.isInternal
statement:
theorem isInternal (H : ∀ x : K, HasFilt Ψ ρ x) (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (W Ψ j)
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).mpr
    ⟨iSupIndep_W j hj, iSup_W_eq_top j H hj⟩

name: STEPW.W_mul_mem
statement:
theorem W_mul_mem {p q : ℕ} {x y : K} (hx : x ∈ W Ψ j p) (hy : y ∈ W Ψ j q) :
    x * y ∈ W Ψ j (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_W] at *
  rw [map_mul, hx, hy, smul_mul_smul_comm, pow_add]

name: STEPW.one_mem_W
statement: theorem one_mem_W (j : ℕ) : (1 : K) ∈ W Ψ j 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_W, map_one]; simp

name: STEPW.exists_level
statement:
theorem exists_level (hV : Filt Ψ ρ V M) {x : K} (hx0 : x ∈ V 0) (hne : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m, x ∈ V m ∧ x ∉ V (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n, x ∉ V (n + 1) := by
    refine ⟨M, fun h ↦ hne ?_⟩
    rw [hV.bot, Submodule.mem_bot] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, ?_, Nat.find_spec hex⟩
  cases h : Nat.find hex with
  | zero => exact hx0
  | succ k =>
    have := Nat.find_min hex (m := k) (by omega)
    simpa using this

name: STEPW.eigen_level
statement:
theorem eigen_level (hV : Filt Ψ ρ V M) (hj : 2 ≤ j) {x : K} (hx0 : x ∈ V 0) (hne : x ≠ 0) {p : ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ W Ψ j p) : x ∈ V p ∧ x ∉ V (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := exists_level hV hx0 hne
  have hpm : p = m := by
    by_contra hpm
    apply hm'
    have h1 := hV.eig j hj m x hm
    rw [mem_W.mp hx, ← sub_smul] at h1
    have hne' : ((j : ℚ) ^ p - (j : ℚ) ^ m) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hpm (pow_injective j hj (sub_eq_zero.mp h))
    have := Submodule.smul_mem _ (((j : ℚ) ^ p - (j : ℚ) ^ m)⁻¹) h1
    rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne', one_smul] at this
  subst hpm
  exact ⟨hm, hm'⟩

name: STEPW.W_le_W
statement:
theorem W_le_W (H : ∀ x : K, HasFilt Ψ ρ x)
    (hcomm : ∀ j j', 2 ≤ j → 2 ≤ j' → ∀ x, Ψ j (Ψ j' x) = Ψ j' (Ψ j x))
    {j j' : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hj' : 2 ≤ j') (p : ℕ) : W Ψ j p ≤ W Ψ j' p
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨V, M, hV, hxV⟩ := H x
  obtain ⟨hxp, -⟩ := eigen_level j hV hj hxV hx0 hx
  have hy : Ψ j' x - ((j' : ℚ) ^ p) • x ∈ V (p + 1) := hV.eig j' hj' p x hxp
  have hyW : Ψ j' x - ((j' : ℚ) ^ p) • x ∈ W Ψ j p := by
    rw [mem_W, map_sub, map_smul, hcomm j j' hj hj', mem_W.mp hx, map_smul, smul_sub, smul_comm]
  by_cases hy0 : Ψ j' x - ((j' : ℚ) ^ p) • x = 0
  · rw [mem_W]; exact sub_eq_zero.mp hy0
  · exact absurd hy
      (eigen_level j hV hj (hV.mono_nat (Nat.zero_le _) hy) hy0 hyW).2

name: STEPW.W_eq
statement:
theorem W_eq (H : ∀ x : K, HasFilt Ψ ρ x)
    (hcomm : ∀ j j', 2 ≤ j → 2 ≤ j' → ∀ x, Ψ j (Ψ j' x) = Ψ j' (Ψ j x))
    {j j' : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hj' : 2 ≤ j') (p : ℕ) : W Ψ j p = W Ψ j' p
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (W_le_W Ψ ρ H hcomm hj hj' p) (W_le_W Ψ ρ H hcomm hj' hj p)

name: STEPW.W_zero_eq_span
statement:
theorem W_zero_eq_span (H : ∀ x : K, HasFilt Ψ ρ x) (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    W Ψ j 0 = Submodule.span ℚ {(1 : K)}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨V, M, hV, hxV⟩ := H x
    obtain ⟨a, ha, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hV.zero hxV)
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp ha
    have hyW : y ∈ W Ψ j 0 := by
      have h1 : c • (1 : K) ∈ W Ψ j 0 :=
        Submodule.smul_mem _ c (one_mem_W j)
      have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hx h1
      rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    by_cases hy0 : y = 0
    · subst hy0
      simpa using ha
    · exact absurd hy (eigen_level j hV hj (hV.anti 0 hy) hy0 hyW).2
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact one_mem_W j

name: STEPW.rank_eq_zero_of_mem_W
statement:
theorem rank_eq_zero_of_mem_W (H : ∀ x : K, HasFilt Ψ ρ x) (hj : 2 ≤ j) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    {x : K} (hx : x ∈ W Ψ j p) : ρ x = 0 ∧ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0; exact ⟨map_zero _, IsNilpotent.zero⟩
  obtain ⟨V, M, hV, hxV⟩ := H x
  obtain ⟨hxp, -⟩ := eigen_level j hV hj hxV hx0 hx
  have h1 : x ∈ V 1 := hV.mono_nat hp hxp
  exact ⟨hV.rank x h1, hV.nil x h1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv_apply
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M, ⊤)) :
    restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv M U x =
      AddEquiv.cast
        (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(M, W)) U.ι_image_top) x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.conormalClass_add
statement:
theorem conormalClass_add
    (h0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb (j ≫ p)))
    (h1 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb j))
    (h2 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p))) :
    k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb j) h1 =
      k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb (j ≫ p)) h0 +
        k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)) h2
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact X h0 h1 h2
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison_comp_c j p)
    (ConormalSequenceTransportH2.originalConormalSequence_shortExact j p)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.conormalClass_add_pullback
statement:
theorem conormalClass_add_pullback
    (h0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb (j ≫ p)))
    (h1 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb j))
    (hp : IsFiniteLocallyFree Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)) :
    k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb j) h1 =
      k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb (j ≫ p)) h0 +
        pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p) hp)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact conormalClass_add j p h0 h1 _

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.conormalData_add
statement:
theorem conormalData_add {r0 r1 : ℕ}
    (N0 : ConormalDataAmb (j ≫ p) r0) (N1 : ConormalDataAmb j r1)
    (hp : IsFiniteLocallyFree Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)) :
    N1.conormalClass = N0.conormalClass +
      pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p) hp)
proof:
:=
  conormalClass_add_pullback j p N0.rank.isFiniteLocallyFree N1.rank.isFiniteLocallyFree hp

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.conormal_virtual_cancel
statement:
theorem conormal_virtual_cancel {r0 r1 : ℕ}
    (N0 : ConormalDataAmb (j ≫ p) r0) (N1 : ConormalDataAmb j r1)
    (M : Q.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Q M)
    (hp : IsFiniteLocallyFree Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)) :
    pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q M hM) - N1.conormalClass =
      pullbackK0RingHom j
        (k0ClassOf Q M hM - k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p) hp) - N0.conormalClass
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalData_add j p N0 N1 hp, map_sub]
  abel

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.conormalData_add_of_relativeDimension
statement:
theorem conormalData_add_of_relativeDimension {r0 r1 : ℕ}
    (N0 : ConormalDataAmb (j ≫ p) r0) (N1 : ConormalDataAmb j r1) :
    N1.conormalClass = N0.conormalClass +
      pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p n))
proof:
:=
  by
    letI : Smooth p := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n p
    exact conormalData_add j p N0 N1 (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p n)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.conormal_virtual_cancel_of_relativeDimension
statement:
theorem conormal_virtual_cancel_of_relativeDimension {r0 r1 : ℕ}
    (N0 : ConormalDataAmb (j ≫ p) r0) (N1 : ConormalDataAmb j r1)
    (M : Q.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Q M) :
    pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q M hM) - N1.conormalClass =
      pullbackK0RingHom j
        (k0ClassOf Q M hM - k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p n)) - N0.conormalClass
proof:
:=
  by
    letI : Smooth p := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n p
    exact conormal_virtual_cancel j p N0 N1 M hM (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p n)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.regular_conormalClass_add
statement:
theorem regular_conormalClass_add
    (hP : RegStalks P) (hQ : RegStalks Q) (hX : RegStalks X) :
    (conormalDataOfRegularAmb j hQ hX).some.conormalClass =
      (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ p) hP hX).some.conormalClass +
        pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p n))
proof:
:=
  conormalData_add_of_relativeDimension j p n
    (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ p) hP hX).some (conormalDataOfRegularAmb j hQ hX).some

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalK0H2.regular_conormal_virtual_cancel
statement:
theorem regular_conormal_virtual_cancel
    (hP : RegStalks P) (hQ : RegStalks Q) (hX : RegStalks X)
    (M : Q.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Q M) :
    pullbackK0RingHom j (k0ClassOf Q M hM) -
        (conormalDataOfRegularAmb j hQ hX).some.conormalClass =
      pullbackK0RingHom j
        (k0ClassOf Q M hM - k0ClassOf Q (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p n)) -
            (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ p) hP hX).some.conormalClass
proof:
:=
  conormal_virtual_cancel_of_relativeDimension j p n
    (conormalDataOfRegularAmb (j ≫ p) hP hX).some (conormalDataOfRegularAmb j hQ hX).some M hM

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.exists_poly_of_mem_mul
statement:
theorem exists_poly_of_mem_mul (f : ι → R) (s : Set ι) (m : ℕ) {a : R}
    (ha : a ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ m) :
    ∃ P : MvPolynomial ι R, P ∈ Ideal.span ((X : ι → MvPolynomial ι R) '' s) ∧
      P.IsHomogeneous (m + 1) ∧ eval f P = a
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on ha ?_ ?_
  · intro b hb c hc
    obtain ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous f c).1 hc
    have hL : ∃ L : MvPolynomial ι R, L ∈ Ideal.span ((X : ι → MvPolynomial ι R) '' s) ∧
        L.IsHomogeneous 1 ∧ eval f L = b := by
      refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
      · rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨X j, Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, isHomogeneous_X R j, by simp⟩
      · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, isHomogeneous_zero _ _ _, map_zero _⟩
      · rintro x y - - ⟨L₁, h₁, h₁', rfl⟩ ⟨L₂, h₂, h₂', rfl⟩
        exact ⟨L₁ + L₂, add_mem h₁ h₂, h₁'.add h₂', map_add _ _ _⟩
      · rintro r x - ⟨L, h, h', rfl⟩
        refine ⟨MvPolynomial.C r * L, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h, ?_, by simp⟩
        simpa using (isHomogeneous_C ι r).mul h'
    obtain ⟨L, hL, hL1, rfl⟩ := hL
    refine ⟨L * G, Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hL, ?_, map_mul _ _ _⟩
    simpa [add_comm] using hL1.mul hG
  · rintro x y ⟨P, hP, hP', rfl⟩ ⟨Q, hQ, hQ', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨P + Q, add_mem hP hQ, hP'.add hQ', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.eval_mem_of_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem eval_mem_of_coeff_mem (f : ι → R) (s : Set ι) (m : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial ι R)
    (hP : P ∈ Ideal.span ((X : ι → MvPolynomial ι R) '' s)) (hPh : P.IsHomogeneous (m + 1))
    (hc : ∀ α, P.coeff α ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) :
    eval f P ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [P.as_sum, map_sum]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun α hα => ?_
  obtain ⟨j, hjs, hj⟩ := (mem_ideal_span_X_image.1 hP) α hα
  have hdeg : α.degree = m + 1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact (mem_support_iff.mp hα) (hPh.coeff_eq_zero h)
  have hle : Finsupp.single j 1 ≤ α := by
    rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff]
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj
  set β := α - Finsupp.single j 1 with hβ
  have hαβ : α = Finsupp.single j 1 + β := (add_tsub_cancel_of_le hle).symm
  have hβdeg : β.degree = m := by
    have h := hdeg
    rw [hαβ, map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at h
    omega
  have hmono := monomial_single_add (s := β) (n := j) (e := 1) (a := P.coeff α)
  rw [← hαβ, pow_one] at hmono
  rw [hmono, map_mul, eval_X]
  have hmon : eval f (monomial β (P.coeff α)) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range f) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ m := by
    refine SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.eval_mem_mul_span_pow f _
      (isHomogeneous_monomial _ hβdeg) fun γ => ?_
    rw [coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs
    · exact hc α
    · exact zero_mem _
  rw [pow_succ']
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hjs, rfl⟩) hmon

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.inf_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem inf_mul_pow_le (f : ι → R) (hf : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular f) (s : Set ι)
    (m : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ (m + 2) ⊓ Ideal.span (f '' s) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ m ≤
      Ideal.span (f '' s) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 ha
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hPh, rfl⟩ := exists_poly_of_mem_mul f s m ha₂
  exact eval_mem_of_coeff_mem f s m P hP hPh (hf (m + 1) P hPh ha₁)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.mem_mul_pow_pred
statement:
theorem mem_mul_pow_pred (f : ι → R) (hf : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular f) (s : Set ι)
    {a : R} (n : ℕ) (han : a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ n) (haJ : a ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s)) :
    a ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ k, k ≤ n - 1 → a ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) * Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ k from
    h _ le_rfl
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _; simpa using haJ
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    refine inf_mul_pow_le f hf s k (Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, ih (by omega)⟩)
    exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) han

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.smul_top_eq
statement: theorem smul_top_eq (K : Ideal A) : (K • ⊤ : Submodule A A) = K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.isSMulRegular_quot_of
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_quot_of (K : Ideal A) (x : A) (h : ∀ g, x * g ∈ K → g ∈ K) :
    IsSMulRegular (A ⧸ (K • ⊤ : Submodule A A)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_top_eq]
  intro a b hab
  induction a using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with | H a => ?_
  induction b using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with | H b => ?_
  change x • Submodule.Quotient.mk a = x • Submodule.Quotient.mk b at hab
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hab
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  refine h _ ?_
  simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_sub] using hab

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.colon_of_isSMulRegular_quot
statement:
theorem colon_of_isSMulRegular_quot (K : Ideal A) (x : A)
    (h : IsSMulRegular (A ⧸ (K • ⊤ : Submodule A A)) x) (g : A) (hg : x * g ∈ K) : g ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_top_eq] at h
  have hz : x • (Submodule.Quotient.mk g : A ⧸ K) = x • 0 := by
    rw [smul_zero, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact hg
  have h0 := h hz
  rwa [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h0

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.ofList_take_ofFn
statement:
theorem ofList_take_ofFn {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → A) (i : ℕ) :
    Ideal.ofList ((List.ofFn x).take i) = Ideal.span (x '' {j | (j : ℕ) < i})
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg Ideal.span (Set.ext fun r => ?_)
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_image]
  rw [List.mem_take_iff_getElem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hjn : j < n := by simpa using (lt_min_iff.1 hj).2
    exact ⟨⟨j, hjn⟩, (lt_min_iff.1 hj).1, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨j, lt_min_iff.2 ⟨hj, by simp⟩, by simp⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.mem_wIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wIdeal_iff (J : Ideal R) (g : extendedRees R I) :
    g ∈ wIdeal R I J ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, (g : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n ∈ J * I ^ (n - 1).toNat
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.coeff_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem coeff_C_mul_T (a : R) (n m : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff m = if n = m then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T]
  change (Finsupp.single n a) m = _
  rw [Finsupp.single_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.degreeOne_mem_wIdeal
statement:
theorem degreeOne_mem_wIdeal (J : Ideal R) (a : I) (ha : (a : R) ∈ J) :
    degreeOne R I a ∈ wIdeal R I J
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [coe_degreeOne, coeff_C_mul_T]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; simpa using ha
  · exact zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.span_image_le
statement:
theorem span_image_le {ι : Type*} (f : ι → R) (hfI : ∀ i, f i ∈ I) (s : Set ι) :
    Ideal.span (f '' s) ≤ I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_le.2 (by rintro _ ⟨j, -, rfl⟩; exact hfI j)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem mul_pow_le {J : Ideal R} (hJ : J ≤ I) (n : ℤ) :
    J * I ^ (n - 1).toNat ≤ I ^ n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt n 0 with hn | hn
  · rw [Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr hn, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; exact le_top
  · have : n.toNat = (n - 1).toNat + 1 := by omega
    rw [this, pow_succ']
    exact Ideal.mul_mono_left hJ

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.degreeOne_mem_span
statement:
theorem degreeOne_mem_span {ι : Type*} (f : ι → R) (hfI : ∀ i, f i ∈ I) (s : Set ι) (b : R)
    (hb : b ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s)) :
    degreeOne R I ⟨b, span_image_le f hfI s hb⟩ ∈
      Ideal.span ((fun i => degreeOne R I ⟨f i, hfI i⟩) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  | zero =>
    have : degreeOne R I ⟨0, span_image_le f hfI s (zero_mem _)⟩ = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext; simp
    rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    have : degreeOne R I ⟨x + y, span_image_le f hfI s (add_mem hx hy)⟩ =
        degreeOne R I ⟨x, span_image_le f hfI s hx⟩ +
          degreeOne R I ⟨y, span_image_le f hfI s hy⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext; simp [add_mul]
    rw [this]; exact add_mem ihx ihy
  | smul r x hx ihx =>
    have : degreeOne R I ⟨r • x, span_image_le f hfI s (Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx)⟩ =
        algebraMap R (extendedRees R I) r * degreeOne R I ⟨x, span_image_le f hfI s hx⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
    rw [this]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ihx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.monomial_mem_span
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_span {ι : Type*} (f : ι → R) (hfI : ∀ i, f i ∈ I) (s : Set ι) (n : ℤ)
    {c : R} (hc : c ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) * I ^ (n - 1).toNat) :
    (⟨_, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I (mul_pow_le (span_image_le f hfI s) n hc)⟩ :
        extendedRees R I) ∈
      Ideal.span ((fun i => degreeOne R I ⟨f i, hfI i⟩) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  induction hc using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
  | mem_mul_mem b hb d hd =>
    have hd' : LaurentPolynomial.C d * T (n - 1) ∈ extendedRees R I :=
      isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I hd
    have : (⟨_, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I (mul_pow_le (span_image_le f hfI s) n
        (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hb hd))⟩ : extendedRees R I) =
        degreeOne R I ⟨b, span_image_le f hfI s hb⟩ * ⟨_, hd'⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_degreeOne, map_mul]
      have hT : (T n : R[T;T⁻¹]) = T 1 * T (n - 1) := by
        rw [← T_add]; congr 1; ring
      rw [hT]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (degreeOne_mem_span f hfI s b hb)
  | add x hx y hy ihx ihy =>
    have : (⟨_, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I (mul_pow_le (span_image_le f hfI s) n
        (add_mem hx hy))⟩ : extendedRees R I) =
        ⟨_, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I (mul_pow_le (span_image_le f hfI s) n hx)⟩ +
        ⟨_, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I (mul_pow_le (span_image_le f hfI s) n hy)⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [add_mul]
    rw [this]; exact add_mem ihx ihy

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.span_eq_wIdeal
statement:
theorem span_eq_wIdeal {ι : Type*} (f : ι → R) (hfI : ∀ i, f i ∈ I) (s : Set ι) :
    Ideal.span ((fun i => degreeOne R I ⟨f i, hfI i⟩) '' s) =
      wIdeal R I (Ideal.span (f '' s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact degreeOne_mem_wIdeal R I _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩)
  · intro g hg
    have hsum : g = ∑ n ∈ (g : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff.support,
        (⟨_, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I (mul_pow_le (span_image_le f hfI s) n (hg n))⟩ :
          extendedRees R I) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
      exact eq_sum_support R (g : R[T;T⁻¹])
    rw [hsum]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun n _ => monomial_mem_span f hfI s n (hg n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.ker_subschemeHom
statement: theorem ker_subschemeHom : RingHom.ker (subschemeHom R I) = wIdeal R I I
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, mem_wIdeal_iff]
  have key : subschemeHom R I g = 0 ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, (g : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n ∈ I := by
    rw [← (nonPosHom_injective (R ⧸ I)).eq_iff, map_zero, nonPosHom_subschemeHom]
    constructor
    · intro h n
      have h' := congrArg (fun p : (R ⧸ I)[T;T⁻¹] => p.coeff n) h
      simp only [coeff_reduceLaurent, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at h'
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 h'
    · intro h
      rw [eq_sum_support R (g : R[T;T⁻¹]), map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n _ => ?_
      rw [reduceLaurent_C_mul_T, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (h n), map_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [key]
  refine forall_congr' fun n => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => Ideal.mul_le_right h⟩
  rcases le_or_gt n 0 with hn | hn
  · rw [Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr (by omega : n - 1 ≤ 0), pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.mul_top]
    exact h
  · have h2 := coeff_mem_of_mem R I g.2 n
    have : n.toNat = (n - 1).toNat + 1 := by omega
    rwa [this, pow_succ'] at h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.colon_wIdeal
statement:
theorem colon_wIdeal {ι : Type*} (f : ι → R) (hq : SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular f)
    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) (s : Set ι) (a : I)
    (ha : ∀ b, (a : R) * b ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) → b ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s))
    (g : extendedRees R I) (hg : degreeOne R I a * g ∈ wIdeal R I (Ideal.span (f '' s))) :
    g ∈ wIdeal R I (Ideal.span (f '' s))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have h1 := hg (n + 1)
  have hc : ((degreeOne R I a * g : extendedRees R I) : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff (n + 1) =
      (a : R) * (g : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n := by
    simp only [MulMemClass.coe_mul, coe_degreeOne]
    rw [show LaurentPolynomial.C (a : R) * T 1 * (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) =
        (LaurentPolynomial.C (a : R) * (g : R[T;T⁻¹])) * T 1 by ring, coeff_mul_T, ← LaurentPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_sub_cancel_right]
  rw [hc] at h1
  have hgJ : (g : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n ∈ Ideal.span (f '' s) := ha _ (Ideal.mul_le_right h1)
  have hgI : (g : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ n.toNat := by
    rw [hspan]; exact coeff_mem_of_mem R I g.2 n
  have h2 := mem_mul_pow_pred f hq s n.toNat hgI hgJ
  rwa [hspan, show n.toNat - 1 = (n - 1).toNat by omega] at h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.isWeaklyRegular_degreeOne
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_degreeOne (x : RegularGenerators R I) :
    IsWeaklyRegular (extendedRees R I) (List.ofFn fun i => degreeOne R I (x.genMem i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin]
  intro i
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < x.length := by simpa using i.2
  have hR := (isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin _ _).1 x.isWeaklyRegular ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
  rw [ofList_take_ofFn] at hR ⊢
  have hspanS : Ideal.span ((fun j => degreeOne R I (x.genMem j)) '' {j | (j : ℕ) < i}) =
      wIdeal R I (Ideal.span (x.gen '' {j | (j : ℕ) < i})) :=
    span_eq_wIdeal x.gen x.gen_mem _
  rw [hspanS]
  refine isSMulRegular_quot_of _ _ fun g hg => ?_
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, List.getElem_ofFn] at hg hR
  refine colon_wIdeal x.gen x.isQuasiregular x.span_eq _ (x.genMem ⟨i, hi⟩) ?_ g hg
  intro b hb
  exact colon_of_isSMulRegular_quot _ _ hR b hb
