name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (x : RegularGenerators A (RingHom.ker φ)) (P : ModuleCat.{u} B) [Projective P] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj P) x.length
proof:
:= by
  set f := List.ofFn x.gen with hfdef
  have hker : Ideal.ofList f = RingHom.ker φ := by
    rw [hfdef, SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ofList_ofFn, x.span_eq]
  let ψ : (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) ≃+* B :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφ)
  have hψ : ∀ a : A, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = φ a := fun a => rfl
  let P' : ModuleCat.{u} (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ.toRingHom).obj P
  haveI hP' : Projective P' :=
    ((ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv ψ).map_projective_iff P).2 inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Projective (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) P' := P'.projective_of_module_projective
  letI : Module A P' := Module.compHom P' (algebraMap A (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f))
  haveI : IsScalarTower A (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) P' := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  have h := KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient f
    x.isWeaklyRegular P'
  let e' : (P' : Type u) ≃ₗ[A] ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj P : Type u) :=
      { toFun := fun p => p
        invFun := fun p => p
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := fun a p => by
          change (ψ (algebraMap A _ a)) • p = φ a • p
          rw [Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, hψ]
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  let e : ModuleCat.of A P' ≅ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj P := e'.toModuleIso
  have h2 : HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj P) f.length :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e _
  have hlen : f.length = x.length := by simp [hfdef]
  rw [hlen] at h2
  exact h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.ker_ideal_chart
statement:
theorem ker_ideal_chart (ι : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact ι] (φ : S →+* B)
    (iU : Spec (.of B) ⟶ X) (iV : Spec (.of S) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion iV]
    (H : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) iU iV ι) :
    (RingHom.ker φ).map (chartEquiv iV) = ι.ker.ideal (chartOpen iV)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion ι (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) iU iV H
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  rw [← Ideal.comap_symm]
  ext y
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
  have h2 : y ∈ ι.ker.ideal (chartOpen iV) ↔
      (iV.appIso ⊤).hom y ∈ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ := by
    rw [h1, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change _ ↔ ((iV.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ (iV.appIso ⊤).inv) y ∈ _
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  rw [h2, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, RingHom.mem_ker]
  have h3 := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  have h4 : ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).app ⊤).hom ((iV.appIso ⊤).hom y) = 0 ↔
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom).hom
        ((iV.appIso ⊤).hom y) = 0 := by
    rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom).1).symm
  rw [h4, h3]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.isPullback_uChart_subschemeTotalι
statement:
theorem isPullback_uChart_subschemeTotalι :
    IsPullback (subschemeι R I) (pushout.inl (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)))
      (uChartι I ≫ blowupι I) (subschemeTotalι I)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [inl_subschemeTotalι, subschemeToBlowup, Category.assoc]
  · apply le_antisymm
    · intro w hw
      rw [← preimage_blowupι_opensRange I]
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hw
      exact ⟨uChartι I q, by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]; exact hq⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨subschemeι R I y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc,
        ← subschemeToBlowup, ← inl_subschemeTotalι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.isPullback_tChart_subschemeTotalι
statement:
theorem isPullback_tChart_subschemeTotalι :
    IsPullback (reduceLine I) (pushout.inr (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)))
      (trivialι I) (subschemeTotalι I)
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_trivialι_subschemeTotalι I).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.mem_range_subschemeTotalι_cover
statement:
theorem mem_range_subschemeTotalι_cover (w : subschemeTotal I) :
    ∃ j, subschemeTotalι I w ∈ (affineChartOpen I j).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
    (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))) w
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · refine ⟨⟨false⟩, ?_⟩
    have : colimit.ι (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))) WalkingSpan.zero y =
        pushout.inr (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I) y) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.snd).symm
    rw [this, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inr_subschemeTotalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact mem_chartOpen _ _
  · refine ⟨⟨true⟩, ?_⟩
    change subschemeTotalι I (pushout.inl (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) y) ∈ _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inl_subschemeTotalι, subschemeToBlowup, Category.assoc,
      Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact mem_chartOpen _ _
  · refine ⟨⟨false⟩, ?_⟩
    change subschemeTotalι I (pushout.inr (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) y) ∈ _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inr_subschemeTotalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact mem_chartOpen _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.covers_total
statement:
theorem covers_total (z : (subschemeTotalι I).ker.subscheme) :
    ∃ j, (subschemeTotalι I).ker.subschemeι z ∈ (affineChartOpen I j).1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (subschemeTotalι I).ker.subschemeι z ∈ Set.range (subschemeTotalι I) := by

        Set.range (subschemeTotalι I).ker.subschemeι := ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Scheme.Hom.support_ker,
      (subschemeTotalι I).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at h1
    exact h1

  exact mem_range_subschemeTotalι_cover I w

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.isPullback_globalUChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_globalUChart (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (subschemeι Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U))
      (pushout.inl (subGmToU (J.ideal U)) (gmToTrivialLine (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ≫
        subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U)
      ((uChartι (J.ideal U) ≫ blowupι (J.ideal U)) ≫ totalAffineι Y J U)
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_uChart_subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U)).paste_vert
    (isPullback_subschemeTotalAffine Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.mem_globalChartOpen
statement:
theorem mem_globalChartOpen (U : Y.affineOpens) (w : subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)
    (hw : totalGlobalToBase Y J (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J w) ∈ U.1) :
    ∃ b, subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J w ∈ (globalChartOpen (J := J) U b).1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (affineBaseι Y U) := by unfold affineBaseι; infer_instance
  have hrange := opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback (isPullback_subschemeTotalAffineSpec Y J U)
  have hw' : w ∈ (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U).opensRange := by
    rw [hrange]
    refine ⟨U.2.isoSpec.hom ⟨_, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    change (U.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι) _ = _
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hw'
  have hcomm : subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U w') =
      totalAffineι Y J U (subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U) w') := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, subschemeTotalAffineι_totalGlobalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [hcomm]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := mem_range_subschemeTotalι_cover (J.ideal U) w'
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  rcases b with ⟨_ | _⟩
  · obtain ⟨q, -, hq⟩ := hb
    change trivialι (J.ideal U) q = subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U) w' at hq
    rw [← hq, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact mem_chartOpen _ q
  · obtain ⟨q, -, hq⟩ := hb
    change (uChartι (J.ideal U) ≫ blowupι (J.ideal U)) q = subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U) w' at hq
    rw [← hq, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact mem_chartOpen _ q

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.covers_totalGlobal
statement:
theorem covers_totalGlobal (covers₀ : ∀ z : J.subscheme, ∃ j, J.subschemeι z ∈ (U₀ j).1)
    (z : (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).ker.subscheme) :
    ∃ k : ι₀ × ULift.{u} Bool,
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).ker.subschemeι z ∈ (globalChartOpen (J := J) (U₀ k.1) k.2).1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).ker.subschemeι z ∈
      Set.range (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) := by
    have h1 : (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).ker.subschemeι z ∈
        Set.range (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).ker.subschemeι := ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Scheme.Hom.support_ker,
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at h1
    exact h1
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz
  rw [← hw]
  have hbase : totalGlobalToBase Y J (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J w) =
      J.subschemeι (SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToClosedBase Y J w) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToClosedBase_subschemeι]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := covers₀ (SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToClosedBase Y J w)
  rw [← hbase] at hj
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := mem_globalChartOpen (U₀ j) w hj
  exact ⟨(j, b), hb⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationRegularWAlpha.gens_totalGlobal_length

  (globalChartGens_length _ _ _).trans (length_eq₀ k.1)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.h1Cotangentι_surjective
statement:
theorem h1Cotangentι_surjective [Subsingleton P.CotangentSpace] :
    Function.Surjective P.h1Cotangentι
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact ⟨⟨x, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.cotangentMap_injective
statement:
theorem cotangentMap_injective [Subsingleton P.CotangentSpace] (f : P.Hom Q) :
    Function.Injective (Extension.Cotangent.map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := h1Cotangentι_surjective P x
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := h1Cotangentι_surjective P y
  have hm : Extension.H1Cotangent.map f x' = Extension.H1Cotangent.map f y' :=
    Subtype.ext h
  have he : x' = y' := (Extension.H1Cotangent.equivOfFormallySmooth P Q).injective (by
    simpa only [Extension.H1Cotangent.equivOfFormallySmooth_apply f] using hm)
  exact congrArg P.h1Cotangentι he

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.exact_cotangentMap_cotangentComplex
statement:
theorem exact_cotangentMap_cotangentComplex [Subsingleton P.CotangentSpace]
    (f : P.Hom Q) : Function.Exact (Extension.Cotangent.map f) Q.cotangentComplex
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Extension.H1Cotangent.equivOfFormallySmooth P Q).surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨P.h1Cotangentι y, ?_⟩
    have hm : Extension.H1Cotangent.map f y = ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
      simpa only [Extension.H1Cotangent.equivOfFormallySmooth_apply f] using hy
    exact congrArg Q.h1Cotangentι hm
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have h := Extension.CotangentSpace.map_cotangentComplex f y
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (P.cotangentComplex y) 0, map_zero] at h
    exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.cotangentComplex_surjective
statement:
theorem cotangentComplex_surjective [Subsingleton Ω[B⁄R]] :
    Function.Surjective Q.cotangentComplex
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact (Q.exact_cotangentComplex_toKaehler x).mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.ambient_surjective
statement: theorem ambient_surjective : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:= by

  exact ⟨algebraMap R A r, (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A B r).symm.trans hr⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalMap_injective
statement:
theorem conormalMap_injective [FormallySmooth R A] :
    Function.Injective (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FormallySmooth R (baseExtension hf).Ring :=
    inferInstanceAs (FormallySmooth R R)
  haveI : FormallySmooth R (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).Ring :=
    inferInstanceAs (FormallySmooth R A)
  haveI : Subsingleton (baseExtension hf).CotangentSpace :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (B ⊗[R] Ω[R⁄R]))
  exact cotangentMap_injective _ _ (baseHom hf)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalMap_exact
statement:
theorem conormalMap_exact [FormallySmooth R A] :
    Function.Exact (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
      (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FormallySmooth R (baseExtension hf).Ring :=
    inferInstanceAs (FormallySmooth R R)
  haveI : FormallySmooth R (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).Ring :=
    inferInstanceAs (FormallySmooth R A)
  haveI : Subsingleton (baseExtension hf).CotangentSpace :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (B ⊗[R] Ω[R⁄R]))
  exact exact_cotangentMap_cotangentComplex _ _ (baseHom hf)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalDifferential_surjective
statement:
theorem conormalDifferential_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FormallyUnramified R B :=
    FormallyUnramified.of_surjective (Algebra.ofId R B) hf
  exact cotangentComplex_surjective _

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalMap_mk
statement:
theorem conormalMap_mk (r : R) (hr : algebraMap R B r = 0) :

      Extension.Cotangent.mk ⟨algebraMap R A r,
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A B r).symm.trans hr⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalDifferential_mk

theorem conormalDifferential_mk (a : A) (ha : algebraMap A B a = 0) :
    (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex (Extension.Cotangent.mk ⟨a, ha⟩) =
      1 ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D R A a

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalDifferential_split
statement:
theorem conormalDifferential_split [FormallySmooth R A] :
    ∃ s : (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).CotangentSpace →ₗ[B]
        (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).Cotangent,
      (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex.comp s = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Projective B (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).CotangentSpace :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective B (B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄R]))
  exact Module.projective_lifting_property _ LinearMap.id
    (conormalDifferential_surjective hf)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.map_mem_square_iff
statement:
theorem map_mem_square_iff [FormallySmooth R A] (r : R)
    (hr : algebraMap R B r = 0) :
    algebraMap R A r ∈ (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B)) ^ 2 ↔
      r ∈ (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R B)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hA := (Extension.Cotangent.mk_eq_zero_iff
    (P := ambientExtension (A := A) hf)
    ⟨algebraMap R A r, (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A B r).symm.trans hr⟩).symm
  have hR := Extension.Cotangent.mk_eq_zero_iff (P := baseExtension hf) ⟨r, hr⟩
  have he : conormalMap (A := A) hf (Extension.Cotangent.mk ⟨r, hr⟩) = 0 ↔
      Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := baseExtension hf) ⟨r, hr⟩ = 0 :=
    (conormalMap_injective hf).eq_iff' (map_zero _)
  rw [conormalMap_mk hf r hr] at he
  exact hA.trans (he.trans hR)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalMap_comp
statement:
theorem conormalMap_comp [FormallySmooth R A] :
    (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex.comp (conormalMap hf) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact ((conormalMap_exact (A := A) hf) (conormalMap hf x)).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalComparisonH2.conormalSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem conormalSequence_shortExact [FormallySmooth R A] :
    (conormalSequence (A := A) hf).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [conormalSequence]
  haveI : CategoryTheory.Mono (ModuleCat.ofHom (conormalMap (A := A) hf)) :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr (conormalMap_injective hf)
  haveI : CategoryTheory.Epi (ModuleCat.ofHom
      (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex) :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr (conormalDifferential_surjective hf)
  exact ⟨(ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mpr
    (conormalMap_exact hf)⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.eqToHom_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eqToHom_hom_eq_zero {R T : CommRingCat.{u}} (h : R = T) (z : R)
    (hz : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (eqToHom h)) z = 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.exists_ideal_section
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_section (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) (ha : i.app V a = 0) :
    ∃ s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i, V), TF3.ιapp i V s = a
proof:
:= by
  open SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf in
  have hex := idealModule_exact i.ker V
  have h0 : (structureMap i.ker).app V a = 0 := by
    rw [structureMap_app]
    have h2 := Scheme.Hom.congr_app i.toImage_imageι.symm V
    rw [h2, Scheme.Hom.comp_app] at ha
    simp only [eqToHom_op, eqToHom_map] at ha
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at ha
    have h3 := eqToHom_hom_eq_zero _ _ ha
    have h4 := ((ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (i.toImage.app (i.imageι ⁻¹ᵁ V))).1
      (h3.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    exact h4
  exact (hex a).1 h0

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.conormal_exact_middle
statement:
theorem conormal_exact_middle (πX : X ⟶ S) (hi : i ≫ πP = πX) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (TF3.c πP i) (psi πP πX i hi) (TF3.c_comp_psi πP i πX hi)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  refine exact_of_gen i πX hi (TF3.c πP i) (TF3.c_comp_psi πP i πX hi) ?_
  intro M h hc V a ha
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := exists_ideal_section i V a ha
  have e0 : ((TF3.conormalIso i).inv ≫ TF3.c πP i) ≫ h = 0 := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hc]; simp
  have e1 : TF3.dI πP i ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h = 0 := by
    have h1 := TF3.unit_comp_pushforward_c πP i
    have k1 : TF3.dI πP i ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h =
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (TF3.idealOf i) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((TF3.conormalIso i).inv ≫ TF3.c πP i)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h :=
      (congrArg (fun φ => φ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h) h1).symm
    have k2 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (TF3.idealOf i) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((TF3.conormalIso i).inv ≫ TF3.c πP i)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (TF3.idealOf i) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (((TF3.conormalIso i).inv ≫ TF3.c πP i) ≫ h) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg _ (Functor.map_comp _ _ _).symm)
    have k3 : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (TF3.idealOf i) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (((TF3.conormalIso i).inv ≫ TF3.c πP i) ≫ h) = 0 := by
      refine (congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf i) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map z) e0).trans ?_
      rw [Functor.map_zero]
      exact Limits.comp_zero
    exact k1.trans (k2.trans k3)
  have e2 : (TF3.dI πP i ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h).app V s = 0 := by
    rw [e1]; rfl
  have e3 : (TF3.dI πP i).app V s =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (relativeSheaf πP)).app V
        (Esec πP V (TF3.ιapp i V s)) := TF3.dI_app πP i V s
  have e4 := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv_unit (f := h)
  show ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h).app V
      (Esec πP V (TF3.ιapp i V s)) = 0
  rw [e4]
  exact (congrArg (fun z => ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h).app V z) e3.symm).trans e2

name: B6.th_eq_sum_exp
proof:

name: B6.Ctx.mem_W_sub_iff
statement:
theorem mem_W_sub_iff (S : Subalgebra ℚ K) (hS : StableSub C.Ψ S) {p : ℕ} (x : S) :
    x ∈ W (subPsi S hS) j p ↔ (x : K) ∈ W C.Ψ j p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => C.val_graded hj S hS p x h, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_W] at h ⊢
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_smul, subPsi_val S hS hj x]
  exact h

name: B6.Ctx.pr_zero_exp
statement: theorem pr_zero_exp {a : K} (ha : C.pr hj 0 a = 0) : C.pr hj 0 (IsNilpotent.exp a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, D, hxs, hH⟩ := C.exists_cover hj {a}
  letI := C.subGr hj S hS
  let a' : S := ⟨a, hxs a (by simp)⟩
  have ha' : a' ∈ RG6B.Fil (W (subPsi S hS) j) 1 := by
    rw [RG6B.Fil_one_iff]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [C.pr_val hj S hS]
    exact ha
  have hn : a' ^ (D + 1) = 0 := RG6B.pow_succ_eq_zero hH ha'
  have h1 : RG6B.pr (W (subPsi S hS) j) 0 (IsNilpotent.exp a') = 1 := by
    rw [TOWERW.exp_eq_ev hn, RG6B.pr_zero_ev hH ha', PowerSeries.constantCoeff_exp, one_smul]
  have h2 : S.val (IsNilpotent.exp a') = IsNilpotent.exp a :=
    IsNilpotent.map_exp ⟨D + 1, hn⟩ S.val
  calc C.pr hj 0 (IsNilpotent.exp a) = C.pr hj 0 ((IsNilpotent.exp a' : S) : K) := by
        rw [← h2]; rfl
    _ = ((RG6B.pr (W (subPsi S hS) j) 0 (IsNilpotent.exp a') : S) : K) :=
        (C.pr_val hj S hS 0 _).symm
    _ = 1 := by rw [h1]; rfl

name: B6.Ctx.pr_zero_toddW
statement: theorem pr_zero_toddW (D : ℕ) (x : K) : C.pr hj 0 (C.toddW hj D x) = 1
proof:

  unfold toddW B4.ToddW

name: B6.Ctx.pr_zero_thetaNormW
statement: theorem pr_zero_thetaNormW (D : ℕ) (x : K) : C.pr hj 0 (C.thetaNormW hj D x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.gr hj
  unfold thetaNormW B4.ThetaNormW

name: B6.Ctx.psi_toddW
statement:
theorem psi_toddW (x : K) (D : ℕ) (hD : ∀ p, D < p → C.pr hj p x = 0) :
    C.Ψ j (C.toddW hj D x) = C.thetaNormW hj D (-x) * C.toddW hj D x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, D', hxs, hH⟩ := C.exists_cover hj {x}
  letI := C.subGr hj S hS
  letI := C.gr hj
  have hH' := weaken hH (le_max_right D D')
  let x' : S := ⟨x, hxs x (by simp)⟩
  have hg := C.val_graded hj S hS
  have key : B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') x' *
      (subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) (B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x') =
      B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x' := B4.ThetaNormW_mul_psi_ToddW hH' x'
  have e1 : B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') (-x') *
      B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') x' = 1 := by
    rw [← B4.ThetaNormW_add hH', neg_add_cancel]
    unfold B4.ThetaNormW
    rw [B4.addCharW_zero, IsNilpotent.exp_zero]
  have key2 : (subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) (B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x') =
      B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') (-x') *
        B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x' := by
    calc _ = (B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') (-x') *
          B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') x') *
          (subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) (B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x') := by
            rw [e1, one_mul]
      _ = B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') (-x') *
          (B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j (max D D') x' *
          (subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) (B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x')) := by
            rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [key]
  have hn1 : IsNilpotent (B4.addCharW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') B4.logTd x') :=
    B4.isNilpotent_addCharW hH' _ _
  have hn2 : IsNilpotent (B4.addCharW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D')
      (B4.logTd - PowerSeries.rescale (j : ℚ) B4.logTd) (-x')) :=
    B4.isNilpotent_addCharW hH' _ _
  have m1 := ToddW_map S.val hg (max D D') x' hn1
  have m2 := ToddW_map S.val hg (max D D') x' hn1
  have m3 := ThetaNormW_map S.val hg j (max D D') (-x') hn2
  have h3 := congrArg S.val key2
  rw [map_mul, ← m1, ← m3] at h3
  have h4 : S.val ((subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) (B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x')) =
      C.Ψ j (S.val (B4.ToddW (W (subPsi S hS) j) (max D D') x')) :=
    subPsi_val S hS hj _
  rw [h4, ← m2] at h3
  have hD' : ∀ p, D < p → C.pr hj p (-x) = 0 := fun p hp => by rw [map_neg, hD p hp, neg_zero]
  have e2 : C.toddW hj (max D D') x = C.toddW hj D x := C.toddW_stable hj (le_max_left _ _) hD
  have e3 : C.thetaNormW hj (max D D') (-x) = C.thetaNormW hj D (-x) :=
    C.thetaNormW_stable hj (le_max_left _ _) hD'
  rw [← e2, ← e3]
  exact h3

name: B6.s_eq_theta
statement:
theorem s_eq_theta {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [Algebra ℚ T] (CT : Ctx T) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    {a b : ℕ} (aa : Fin a → T) (bb : Fin b → T) (haa : ∀ i, aa i ∈ W CT.Ψ j 1)
    (hbb : ∀ k, bb k ∈ W CT.Ψ j 1) (t : T)
    (ht : t * ∏ i, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (IsNilpotent.exp (-aa i)) ^ r =
      ∏ k, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (IsNilpotent.exp (-bb k)) ^ r) :
    ∃ E₀ : ℕ, ∀ E, E₀ ≤ E → ((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • t =
      CT.thetaNormW hj E (∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (bb k) - ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (aa i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hS, D, hxs, hH⟩ := CT.exists_cover hj
    (insert t (Finset.univ.image aa ∪ Finset.univ.image bb))
  letI := CT.subGr hj S hS
  letI := CT.gr hj
  refine ⟨D, fun E hE => ?_⟩
  have hH' := Ctx.weaken hH hE
  have hg := CT.val_graded hj S hS
  let aa' : Fin a → S := fun i => ⟨aa i, hxs _ (by simp)⟩
  let bb' : Fin b → S := fun k => ⟨bb k, hxs _ (by simp)⟩
  let t' : S := ⟨t, hxs _ (by simp)⟩
  have haa' : ∀ i, aa' i ∈ W (subPsi S hS) j 1 := fun i =>
    (CT.mem_W_sub_iff hj S hS _).2 (haa i)
  have hbb' : ∀ k, bb' k ∈ W (subPsi S hS) j 1 := fun k =>
    (CT.mem_W_sub_iff hj S hS _).2 (hbb k)
  have hna : ∀ i, (aa' i) ^ (E + 1) = 0 := fun i =>
    pow_succ_eq_zero hH' (Fil_of_mem (haa' i) le_rfl)
  have hnb : ∀ k, (bb' k) ^ (E + 1) = 0 := fun k =>
    pow_succ_eq_zero hH' (Fil_of_mem (hbb' k) le_rfl)
  have hexpa : ∀ i, S.val (IsNilpotent.exp (aa' i)) = IsNilpotent.exp (aa i) := fun i =>
    IsNilpotent.map_exp ⟨E + 1, hna i⟩ S.val
  have hexpb : ∀ k, S.val (IsNilpotent.exp (bb' k)) = IsNilpotent.exp (bb k) := fun k =>
    IsNilpotent.map_exp ⟨E + 1, hnb k⟩ S.val
  have hexpna : ∀ i, S.val (IsNilpotent.exp (-aa' i)) = IsNilpotent.exp (-aa i) := fun i =>
    IsNilpotent.map_exp (IsNilpotent.neg ⟨E + 1, hna i⟩) S.val
  have hexpnb : ∀ k, S.val (IsNilpotent.exp (-bb' k)) = IsNilpotent.exp (-bb k) := fun k =>
    IsNilpotent.map_exp (IsNilpotent.neg ⟨E + 1, hnb k⟩) S.val
  have ht0 : S.val t' = t := rfl
  have ht' : t' * ∏ i, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (IsNilpotent.exp (-aa' i)) ^ r =
      ∏ k, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (IsNilpotent.exp (-bb' k)) ^ r := by
    have inj : Function.Injective S.val := Subtype.val_injective
    apply inj
    simp only [map_mul, map_prod, map_sum, map_pow, hexpna, hexpnb, ht0]
    exact ht
  have ht2 : t' * ∏ i, RG6B.th j E (aa' i) = ∏ k, RG6B.th j E (bb' k) := by
    simp only [th_eq_sum_exp j (hna _), th_eq_sum_exp j (hnb _)]
    exact ht'
  set xa' : S := ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (aa' i) with hxa'
  set xb' : S := ∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (bb' k) with hxb'
  have hA := B4.ThetaW_split hH' aa' haa'
  have hB := B4.ThetaW_split hH' bb' hbb'
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hA hB
  unfold B4.ThetaW at hA hB
  have hsub := B4.ThetaNormW_sub hH' xb' xa'
  have hinv : B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j E (-xa') *
      B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j E xa' = 1 := by
    rw [← B4.ThetaNormW_add hH', neg_add_cancel]
    unfold B4.ThetaNormW
    rw [B4.addCharW_zero, IsNilpotent.exp_zero]
  set u := B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j E xa' with hu
  set v := B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j E (xb' - xa') with hv
  set w := B4.ThetaNormW (W (subPsi S hS) j) j E (-xa') with hw
  set J : S := algebraMap ℚ S (j : ℚ) with hJ
  have e : t' * (J ^ a * u) = J ^ b * (v * u) := by
    rw [hA, hsub, hB]
    exact ht2
  have e' : t' * J ^ a = J ^ b * v := by
    linear_combination w * e + (J ^ b * v - t' * J ^ a) * hinv
  have hj0 : (j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℚ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linarith
  have hJb : IsUnit (J ^ b) :=
    ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hj0).map (algebraMap ℚ S)).pow b
  have hc : ((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) * (j : ℚ) ^ b = (j : ℚ) ^ a := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast (j : ℚ) b, ← zpow_add₀ hj0, ← zpow_natCast]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hfin' : ((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • t' = v := by
    refine hJb.mul_left_cancel ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    calc J ^ b * (algebraMap ℚ S ((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) * t')
        = algebraMap ℚ S (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) * (j : ℚ) ^ b) * t' := by
          rw [map_mul, map_pow]; ring
      _ = J ^ a * t' := by rw [hc, map_pow]
      _ = J ^ b * v := by rw [mul_comm, e']
  have hn3 : IsNilpotent (B4.addCharW (W (subPsi S hS) j) E
      (B4.logTd - PowerSeries.rescale (j : ℚ) B4.logTd) (xb' - xa')) :=
    B4.isNilpotent_addCharW hH' _ _
  have m := ThetaNormW_map S.val hg j E (xb' - xa') hn3
  have h5 := congrArg S.val hfin'
  rw [map_smul, ht0, hv, ← m] at h5
  have h6 : S.val (xb' - xa') = ∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (bb k) - ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (aa i) := by
    rw [hxb', hxa', map_sub, map_sum, map_sum]
    simp only [hexpa, hexpb]
  rw [h6] at h5
  exact h5

name: B6.q_graded
statement: theorem q_graded : ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ W CK.Ψ j p, q x ∈ W CT.Ψ j p

name: B6.pr_q

name: B6.dual_q
statement: theorem dual_q (x : K) : CT.dual hj (q x) = q (CK.dual hj x)
proof:
:= by
  letI := CK.gr hj
  letI := CT.gr hj
  symm
  refine dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => ?_
  have h1 : CT.pr hj p (q x) = q (CK.pr hj p x) := pr_q CK CT q hqΨ hj p x
  have h2 : CT.pr hj p (q (CK.dual hj x)) = q (CK.pr hj p (CK.dual hj x)) :=
    pr_q CK CT q hqΨ hj p _
  show RG6B.pr (W CT.Ψ j) p (q (CK.dual hj x)) = _ • RG6B.pr (W CT.Ψ j) p (q x)
  change CT.pr hj p (q (CK.dual hj x)) = _ • CT.pr hj p (q x)
  rw [h2, h1]
  have : CK.pr hj p (CK.dual hj x) = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ p) • CK.pr hj p x := pr_dualW p x
  rw [this, map_smul]

name: B6.todd_descent
statement:
theorem todd_descent {K T : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K] [CommRing T] [Algebra ℚ T]
    (CK : Ctx K) (CT : Ctx T) (q : K →ₐ[ℚ] T) (hq : Function.Injective q)
    (hqΨ : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ x, q (CK.Ψ m x) = CT.Ψ m (q x))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) {a b : ℕ} (ℓ : Fin a → T) (m : Fin b → T)
    (hℓ : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (ℓ i - 1)) (hm : ∀ k, IsNilpotent (m k - 1))
    (hℓψ : ∀ i, CT.Ψ j (ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ j) (hmψ : ∀ k, CT.Ψ j (m k) = m k ^ j)
    (tK tv : K) (htv : q tv = ∑ i, ℓ i - ∑ k, m k)
    (ht : q tK * ∏ i, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, ℓ i ^ r = ∏ k, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, m k ^ r) :
    CK.pr hj 0 (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK) = 1 ∧
    ∀ τ : K, CK.pr hj 0 τ = 1 → CK.Ψ j τ = (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK) * τ →
      ∀ D : ℕ, (∀ p, D < p → CK.pr hj p (CK.dual hj tv) = 0) →
        τ = CK.toddW hj D (CK.dual hj tv)
proof:
:= by
  
  set l : Fin a → T := fun i => TOWERW.logOnePlus (ℓ i - 1) with hl
  set l' : Fin b → T := fun k => TOWERW.logOnePlus (m k - 1) with hl'
  have hlnil : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (l i) := fun i => TOWERW.isNilpotent_logOnePlus (hℓ i)
  have hlnil' : ∀ k, IsNilpotent (l' k) := fun k => TOWERW.isNilpotent_logOnePlus (hm k)
  have hlW : ∀ i, l i ∈ W CT.Ψ j 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [mem_W, pow_one]
    have h : (CT.Ψ j).toRingHom (ℓ i - 1) = (1 + (ℓ i - 1)) ^ j - 1 := by
      simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_sub, map_one, hℓψ i,
        add_sub_cancel]
    exact TOWERW.psi_logOnePlus (hℓ i) (CT.Ψ j).toRingHom j h
  have hlW' : ∀ k, l' k ∈ W CT.Ψ j 1 := by
    intro k
    rw [mem_W, pow_one]
    have h : (CT.Ψ j).toRingHom (m k - 1) = (1 + (m k - 1)) ^ j - 1 := by
      simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_sub, map_one, hmψ k,
        add_sub_cancel]
    exact TOWERW.psi_logOnePlus (hm k) (CT.Ψ j).toRingHom j h
  have hexp : ∀ i, IsNilpotent.exp (l i) = ℓ i := fun i => by
    rw [hl]; simp only; rw [TOWERW.exp_logOnePlus (hℓ i)]; exact add_sub_cancel _ _
  have hexp' : ∀ k, IsNilpotent.exp (l' k) = m k := fun k => by
    rw [hl']; simp only; rw [TOWERW.exp_logOnePlus (hm k)]; exact add_sub_cancel _ _
  
  have ht_root : q tK * ∏ i, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (IsNilpotent.exp (-(-l i))) ^ r =
      ∏ k, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (IsNilpotent.exp (-(-l' k))) ^ r := by
    simp only [neg_neg, hexp, hexp']
    exact ht
  have hW1 : ∀ i, (-l i) ∈ W CT.Ψ j 1 := fun i => Submodule.neg_mem _ (hlW i)
  have hW1' : ∀ k, (-l' k) ∈ W CT.Ψ j 1 := fun k => Submodule.neg_mem _ (hlW' k)
  obtain ⟨E₀, hE₀⟩ := s_eq_theta CT hj (fun i => -l i) (fun k => -l' k) hW1 hW1' (q tK) ht_root
  
  set xa : T := ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (-l i) with hxa
  set xb : T := ∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (-l' k) with hxb
  have hdual : q (CK.dual hj tv) = xa - xb := by
    rw [← dual_q CK CT q hqΨ hj, htv]
    letI := CT.gr hj
    change dualW (W CT.Ψ j) (∑ i, ℓ i - ∑ k, m k) = _
    rw [dualW_sub, dualW_sum, dualW_sum]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [← hexp i, dualW_exp (hlW i) (hlnil i)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [← hexp' k, dualW_exp (hlW' k) (hlnil' k)]
  have hneg : ∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (-l' k) - ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (-l i) = -(q (CK.dual hj tv)) := by
    rw [hdual, neg_sub]
  
  have hs0 : CK.pr hj 0 (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK) = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨E₁, hE₁⟩ : ∃ E₁, ((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • q tK =
        CT.thetaNormW hj E₁ (∑ k, IsNilpotent.exp (-l' k) - ∑ i, IsNilpotent.exp (-l i)) :=
      ⟨E₀, hE₀ E₀ le_rfl⟩
    have h1 : CT.pr hj 0 (q (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK)) = 1 := by
      rw [map_smul, hE₁]
      exact CT.pr_zero_thetaNormW hj E₁ _
    rw [pr_q CK CT q hqΨ hj] at h1
    apply hq
    rw [h1, map_one]
  refine ⟨hs0, fun τ hτ0 hτψ D hD => ?_⟩
  
  have hD' : ∀ p, D < p → CT.pr hj p (xa - xb) = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← hdual, pr_q CK CT q hqΨ hj, hD p hp, map_zero]
  have hD'' : ∀ p, D < p → CT.pr hj p (xb - xa) = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← neg_sub, map_neg, hD' p hp, neg_zero]
  set E := max E₀ D with hE
  have hsT : q (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK) = CT.thetaNormW hj D (xb - xa) := by
    rw [map_smul, hE₀ E (le_max_left _ _)]
    exact CT.thetaNormW_stable hj (le_max_right _ _) hD''
  have hs0T : CT.pr hj 0 (q (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK)) = 1 := by
    rw [pr_q CK CT q hqΨ hj, hs0, map_one]
  have hτT0 : CT.pr hj 0 (q τ) = 1 := by
    rw [pr_q CK CT q hqΨ hj, hτ0, map_one]
  have hτTψ : CT.Ψ j (q τ) = q (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK) * q τ := by
    rw [← hqΨ j hj, hτψ, map_mul]
  have hTd0 : CT.pr hj 0 (CT.toddW hj D (xa - xb)) = 1 := CT.pr_zero_toddW hj D _
  have hTdψ : CT.Ψ j (CT.toddW hj D (xa - xb)) =
      q (((j : ℚ) ^ ((a : ℤ) - b)) • tK) * CT.toddW hj D (xa - xb) := by
    rw [CT.psi_toddW hj (xa - xb) D hD', hsT, neg_sub]
  have hu := CT.tau_unique hj hs0T hτT0 hτTψ hTd0 hTdψ
  apply hq
  rw [hu, ← hdual, toddW_q CK CT q hqΨ hj]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.preimageToSpec_algebraMap
statement:
theorem preimageToSpec_algebraMap :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
    let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageToSpec f D ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (CommRingCat.of R) T)) =
      V.ι ≫ f := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  change (f ∣_ D) ≫ D.toSpecΓ ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (CommRingCat.of R) T)) =
    V.ι ≫ f
  rw [IsAffineOpen.algebraMap_Spec_obj]
  change (f ∣_ D) ≫ D.toSpecΓ ≫
      Spec.map
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE le_top).op) =
    V.ι ≫ f
  simp only [Spec.map_comp,
    Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_top_assoc,
    toSpecΓ_SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_inv, Category.comp_id,
    morphismRestrict_ι]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationOpenIso_over_projectiveBasicOpenLocalization
statement:
theorem localizationOpenIso_over_projectiveBasicOpenLocalization :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let S := Localization.Away g
    let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
    let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T := projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
    (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ≫
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageToSpec f D ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
      toSpec S n := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T := projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
  have hφ :
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S) ≫
          CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R T) := by
    ext r
    exact φ.commutes r
  have hloc :
      (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ≫ V.ι =
        map (algebraMap R S) n := by
    change (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ≫
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι =
      map (algebraMap R S) n
    exact localizationOpenIso_hom_ι R g n
  apply (cancel_mono
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap R S)))).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rw [hφ]
  rw [show SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageToSpec f D ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap R T)) =
      V.ι ≫ f by
    exact preimageToSpec_algebraMap R g n]
  rw [← Category.assoc, hloc]
  exact map_toSpec (algebraMap R S) n

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationOpenIso_globalSec
statement:
theorem localizationOpenIso_globalSec
    (t : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
    let S := Localization.Away g
    let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)]
      Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D) := projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
    (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom.appTop
        (globalSec (X := V.toScheme)
          (R := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)) t) =
      globalSec (X := space S n)
        (R := CommRingCat.of S) (φ.symm t) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T := projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let q := SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageToSpec f D
  have hsquare :
      e.hom ≫ q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
        toSpec S n :=
    localizationOpenIso_over_projectiveBasicOpenLocalization R g n
  have hsquare_app :
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop ≫
          q.appTop) ≫ e.hom.appTop =
        (toSpec S n).appTop := by
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] using
      congrArg (fun z => z.appTop) hsquare
  have hnat :=
    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality
      (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
  change (q.appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso T).inv.hom t) =
    (toSpec S n).appTop.hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv.hom (φ.symm t))
  calc
    (q.appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso T).inv.hom t) =
      (q.appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso T).inv.hom (φ (φ.symm t))) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z => (q.appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom
              ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso T).inv.hom z))
            (φ.apply_symm_apply t).symm
    _ = (q.appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop.hom
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv.hom
            (φ.symm t))) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun z => (q.appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom z)
            (congrArg (fun z => z.hom (φ.symm t)) hnat)
    _ = (((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop ≫
          q.appTop) ≫ e.hom.appTop).hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv.hom
          (φ.symm t)) := rfl
    _ = (toSpec S n).appTop.hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv.hom
          (φ.symm t)) := by
          exact congrArg (fun z => z.hom
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv.hom (φ.symm t)))
            hsquare_app

theorem localizationOpenIso_structureRingHom
    (U : (space (Localization.Away g) n).Opens)
    (t : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
    let S := Localization.Away g
    let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
    let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T := projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
    let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
    (e.hom.appIso U).inv
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S)
          U (φ.symm t)) =
      structureRingHom (X := V.toScheme) (R := T)
        (e.hom ''ᵁ U) t := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ D
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T := projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply]
  rw [← localizationOpenIso_globalSec R g n t]
  change (e.hom.appIso U).inv
      (e.hom.appLE (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) U le_top
        (globalSec (X := V.toScheme) (R := T) t)) =
    V.toScheme.presheaf.map (e.hom ''ᵁ U).leTop.op
      (globalSec (X := V.toScheme) (R := T) t)
  have hg := Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv e.hom
    (U := (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)) (V := U) le_top
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hg]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseOpenRestriction_top_eq
statement:
theorem projectiveBaseOpenRestriction_top_eq
    (a : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)) :
    let D
proof:
:= projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
    let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom a =
      algebraMap R T
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom a) := by
  dsimp only
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
  rw [IsAffineOpen.algebraMap_Spec_obj
      (R := CommRingCat.of R) (U := D),
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction_eq]
  change (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE h).op a =
    (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE le_top).op
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom a))
  have ha :
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom a) =
        a :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom_inv_id_apply a
  calc
    (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE h).op a =
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op a := by congr 1
    _ = (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom a)) :=
      congrArg
        (fun z => (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE le_top).op z) ha.symm

  dsimp only
  change projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMapTransportProp R g n d p z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_zero R g n d p
  | add x y hx hy => exact projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_add R g n d p x y hx hy
  | tmul a x => exact projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_tmul R g n d p a x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let eD :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv
      R g n d (p + 1)
  let eC :=
    projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHSemilinearEquiv
      R g n d (p + 1)
  let G :=
    projectiveTwistingPositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n d p
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply eD.injective
    apply G.injective
    rw [← projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
        R g n d p x,
      ← projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
        R g n d p y,
      hxy]
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := G.surjective (eC y)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := eD.surjective t
    refine ⟨x, eC.injective ?_⟩
    rw [projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
        R g n d p x,
      hx, ht]

name: B7Lci.tveeLci_eq
statement:
theorem tveeLci_eq :
    M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (T1KG3.OMG.kahlerSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k) n))
          (hEa i).isFiniteLocallyFree -
        k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb i) hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  unfold M1.LCI.tveeLci
  refine congrArg₂ (· - ·) ?_ rfl
  unfold T1KG3.OMG.kahlerClass
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]

name: B7Lci.todd_keyL
statement:
theorem todd_keyL :
    (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 (sOfL hY i hNr hj) = 1 ∧
    ∀ τ : B5.KQ X, (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 τ = 1 →
      (ctxOf hX).Ψ j τ = sOfL hY i hNr hj * τ →
      ∀ D : ℕ, (∀ p, D < p → (ctxOf hX).pr hj p ((ctxOf hX).dual hj
          (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0) →
        τ = (ctxOf hX).toddW hj D ((ctxOf hX).dual hj
          (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)))
proof:
:= by
  have hXc : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hXrn := rankZeroNilpotent_of_projective hX
  have hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X := lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent hXrn
  obtain ⟨T, hTn, hTi, hTc, hTT, g, Lm, Mm, hL, hM, hnilT, hinj, hEaq, hEbq, hnilL, hnilM, ⟨t0⟩⟩ :=
    exists_tower hXrn (hEa i) hNr
  haveI := hTn
  let CK := ctxOf hX
  let CT := ctxK0 hTc hTT t0
  let φ := pullbackK0RingHom g
  have hφ : ∀ (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E),
      φ (k0ClassOf X E hE) = k0ClassOf T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) := fun E hE =>
    pullbackK0RingHom_classOf g E hE
  have hcomm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : K0 X), φ (adamsRingHom hXc m x) = adamsRingHom hTc m (φ x) := by
    intro m x
    cases m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m =>
      rw [adamsRingHom_apply hXc (by omega), adamsRingHom_apply hTc (by omega)]
      exact adams_pullback g φ hφ (m + 1) x
  have hq : Function.Injective (qQ φ) := qQ_injective φ hinj
  have hqΨ : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ x, qQ φ (CK.Ψ m x) = CT.Ψ m (qQ φ x) :=
    fun m _ x => qQ_adams hXc hTc φ hcomm m x
  have htvee := tveeLci_eq i hNr
  have hφtv : φ (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      ∑ i', k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree -
        ∑ k', k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree := by
    rw [htvee, map_sub, hEaq, hEbq]
  have hℓ : ∀ i', IsNilpotent (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree) - 1) := by
    intro i'
    have := (hnilL i').map (B5.toKQ T)
    rwa [map_sub, map_one] at this
  have hm : ∀ k', IsNilpotent (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree) - 1) := by
    intro k'
    have := (hnilM k').map (B5.toKQ T)
    rwa [map_sub, map_one] at this
  have hadams : ∀ c : K0 T, CT.Ψ j (B5.toKQ T c) = B5.toKQ T (adamsRingHom hTc j c) := by
    intro c
    show adamsQ hTc j ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] adamsRingHom hTc j c
    simp [adamsQ, psiQ_tmul]
  have hℓψ : ∀ i', CT.Ψ j (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ j := by
    intro i'
    rw [hadams, adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hTc (Lm i') (hL i') (by omega), map_pow]
  have hmψ : ∀ k', CT.Ψ j (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ j := by
    intro k'
    rw [hadams, adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hTc (Mm k') (hM k') (by omega), map_pow]
  have htv : qQ φ (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      ∑ i', B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree) -
        ∑ k', B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    have e : qQ φ (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
        B5.toKQ T (φ (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)) := by
      simp [B5.toKQ_apply, qQ_tmul]
    rw [e, hφtv, map_sub, map_sum, map_sum]
  have ht : qQ φ (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree hj) *
      ∏ i', ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ r =
      ∏ k', ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ r := by
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ,
        β = bott j X hXc hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hbp := bott_pull j g φ hφ (pullLoc φ j) (pullLoc_algebraMap φ j) hTc hnilT hXc hnilX
      (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    rw [hφtv, ← hβ] at hbp
    have hsplit := bott_split j hTc hnilT Lm hL Mm hM
    rw [hbp] at hsplit
    have hinv : pullLoc φ j ((β⁻¹ : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) :
        Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) * pullLoc φ j (β : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))
        = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one]
    have h1 : pullLoc φ j ((β⁻¹ : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) :
          Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) *
        ∏ i', algebraMap _ _ (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
          (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) =
        ∏ k', algebraMap _ (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T)) (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
          (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) := by
      rw [← hsplit, ← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
    have h2 := congrArg (B5.locToQ j hj T) h1
    rw [map_mul, map_prod, map_prod] at h2
    simp only [B5.locToQ_algebraMap, map_sum, map_pow] at h2
    have h3 : qQ φ (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree hj) =
        B5.locToQ j hj T (pullLoc φ j ((β⁻¹ : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) :
          Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))) := by
      unfold tQL
      rw [qQ_locToQ, hβ]
      rfl
    rw [h3]
    exact h2
  exact todd_descent CK CT (qQ φ) hq hqΨ hj
    (fun i' => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm i') (hL i').isFiniteLocallyFree))
    (fun k' => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm k') (hM k').isFiniteLocallyFree))
    hℓ hm hℓψ hmψ (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree hj)
    (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)) htv ht

name: B7Lci.tau_exists_uniqueL
statement:
theorem tau_exists_uniqueL :
    ∃! τ : B5.KQ X, (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 τ = 1 ∧
      (ctxOf hX).Ψ j τ = sOfL hY i hNr hj * τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs0, -⟩ := todd_keyL hX hY i hNr hj
  obtain ⟨τ, h0, hψ⟩ := (ctxOf hX).exists_tau hj hs0
  exact ⟨τ, ⟨h0, hψ⟩, fun τ' h' => (ctxOf hX).tau_unique hj hs0 h'.1 h'.2 h0 hψ⟩

name: B7Lci.tauF_specL
statement:
theorem tauF_specL : (ctxOf hX).pr hj 0 (tauFL hX hY i hNr hj) = 1 ∧
    (ctxOf hX).Ψ j (tauFL hX hY i hNr hj) = sOfL hY i hNr hj * tauFL hX hY i hNr hj
proof:
:=
  (tau_exists_uniqueL hX hY i hNr hj).exists.choose_spec

name: B7Lci.tauF_isUnitL
statement: theorem tauF_isUnitL : IsUnit (tauFL hX hY i hNr hj)
proof:
:=
  (ctxOf hX).isUnit_of_pr_zero hj (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr hj).1

name: B7Lci.tauF_mul_tauInvL
statement: theorem tauF_mul_tauInvL : tauFL hX hY i hNr hj * tauInvL hX hY i hNr hj = 1
proof:
:=
  (tauF_isUnitL hX hY i hNr hj).mul_val_inv

name: B7Lci.fQ_eq_PhiL
statement:
theorem fQ_eq_PhiL (x : B5.KQ X) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x = PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr hj (tauFL hX hY i hNr hj * x)
proof:
:=
  F_eq_Phi (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf) (tauF_mul_tauInvL hX hY i hNr hj) x

name: B7Lci.exists_dual_boundL
statement:
theorem exists_dual_boundL :
    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ p, D < p → (ctxOf hX).pr hj p ((ctxOf hX).dual hj
      (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := (ctxOf hX).gr hj
  exact exists_weight_bound (W := W (ctxOf hX).Ψ j) _

name: B7Lci.tau_eq_toddL
statement:
theorem tau_eq_toddL (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ p, D < p → (ctxOf hX).pr hj p ((ctxOf hX).dual hj
      (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0) :
    tauFL hX hY i hNr hj =
      (ctxOf hX).toddW hj D ((ctxOf hX).dual hj
        (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)))
proof:
:=
  (todd_keyL hX hY i hNr hj).2 _ (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr hj).1
    (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr hj).2 D hD

name: B7Lci.Phi_mem_WtL
statement:
theorem Phi_mem_WtL (p m : ℕ) (hpm : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = m) {w : B5.KQ X}
    (hw : w ∈ B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) p) :
    PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w ∈
      B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) m
proof:
:=
  Phi_mem_W (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree (le_refl 2)) harr
    (B6.dRel i) (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInvL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)) hw hpm

name: B7Lci.Phi_eq_zero_of_ltL
proof:
:=
  Phi_eq_zero (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree (le_refl 2)) harr
    (B6.dRel i) (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInvL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)) hw hpd

name: B7Lci.f_shiftL
statement:
theorem f_shiftL (p : ℕ) {x : B5.KQ X} (hx : x ∈ B3.FilGammaQ X p) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x ∈ B3.FilGammaQ Y (((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hXc (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X) p] at hx
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hYc (towerHyp_of_projective hY) (genericPoint Y)]
  exact F_mem_GqA (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree (le_refl 2)) harr
    (B6.dRel i) (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInvL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2))
    (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)).1 hx

name: B7Lci.fQ_filtL
statement:
theorem fQ_filtL (p : ℕ) (a : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) (ha : a ∈ (gammaFiltQ X).F p) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf a ∈ (gammaFiltQ Y).F (((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have h1 : a ∈ B3.FilGammaQ X p := by
    rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hXc (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X)]
    exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hXc (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X) p a).1 ha
  have h2 := f_shiftL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p h1
  rw [B3.FilGammaQ_eq_Gq hYc (towerHyp_of_projective hY) (genericPoint Y)] at h2
  exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hYc (towerHyp_of_projective hY) (genericPoint Y) _ _).2 h2

name: B7Lci.f_sub_Phi_memL
statement:
theorem f_sub_Phi_memL (p : ℕ) (hdp : B6.dRel i ≤ p) {w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X}
    (hw : w ∈ B3.Wt (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) p) :
    B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf w - PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w ∈
      B3.Gq (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := F_sub_Phi_mem (ctxOf hX) (ctxOf hY) (le_refl 2) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)
    (tQL hY n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree (le_refl 2)) harr
    (B6.dRel i) (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)).2
    (tauF_mul_tauInvL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2))
    (tauF_specL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)).1 hw
  have e : ((((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat) = ((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat + 1 := by omega
  rw [e] at h
  exact h

name: B7Lci.grPush_thetaL
statement:
theorem grPush_thetaL {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁) (w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    grPushL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr hD
        (thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) (towerHyp_of_projective hX)
          (genericPoint X) D₁ w) =
      thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) (towerHyp_of_projective hY)
        (genericPoint Y) D₂ (PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hYc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  have hTY := towerHyp_of_projective hY
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hXc) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hXc hTX (genericPoint X) 2 le_rfl
  induction w using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (B3.Wt hXc) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | @homogeneous p m =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := m
    show grPushL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr hD (thetaX hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D₁ w) =
      thetaX hYc hTY (genericPoint Y) D₂ (PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w)
    rw [thetaX_of_mem hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D₁ hw]
    by_cases hd : B6.dRel i ≤ (p : ℤ)
    · have hm : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
      have hΦ := Phi_mem_WtL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p _ hm hw
      rw [thetaX_of_mem hYc hTY (genericPoint Y) D₂ hΦ]
      unfold grPushL
      rw [fGr_gcl_of_le _ _ _ hD hd]
      refine B4.gcl_eq_of_sub_mem D₂ _ ?_
      show B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf w - PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w ∈
        (gammaFiltQ Y).F ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat) + 1)
      exact (mem_filGammaQ_iff hYc hTY (genericPoint Y) _ _).2
        (f_sub_Phi_memL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p hd hw)
    · have hlt : (p : ℤ) < B6.dRel i := by omega
      unfold grPushL
      rw [fGr_gcl_of_lt _ _ _ hD hlt, Phi_eq_zero_of_ltL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p hlt hw,
        map_zero]

name: B7Lci.pr_PhiFL
statement:
theorem pr_PhiFL (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i) (w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w) =
      PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2)
        ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat) w)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hXc) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hXc hTX (genericPoint X) 2 le_rfl
  induction w using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (B3.Wt hXc) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | @homogeneous p w0 =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := w0
    show (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w) =
      PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2)
        ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat) w)
    by_cases hd : B6.dRel i ≤ (p : ℤ)
    · have hm' : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
      have hΦ := Phi_mem_WtL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p _ hm' hw
      by_cases hmp : m = ((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat
      · have e : ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat = p := by omega
        rw [e, (ctxOf hX).pr_of_mem_same (le_refl 2) hw, hmp,
          (ctxOf hY).pr_of_mem_same (le_refl 2) hΦ]
      · have e : ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat ≠ p := by omega
        rw [(ctxOf hX).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hw e, map_zero,
          (ctxOf hY).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hΦ hmp]
    · have hlt : (p : ℤ) < B6.dRel i := by omega
      have e : ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat ≠ p := by omega
      rw [Phi_eq_zero_of_ltL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p hlt hw, map_zero,
        (ctxOf hX).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hw e, map_zero]

name: B7Lci.pr_PhiF_negL
statement:
theorem pr_PhiF_negL (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i < 0) (w : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) :
    (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  letI : GradedAlgebra (B3.Wt hXc) := adamsQ_gradedAlgebra hXc hTX (genericPoint X) 2 le_rfl
  induction w using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (B3.Wt hXc) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | @homogeneous p w0 =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := w0
    show (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) w) = 0
    by_cases hd : B6.dRel i ≤ (p : ℤ)
    · have hm' : (p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i = ((((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
      have hΦ := Phi_mem_WtL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p _ hm' hw
      have hmp : m ≠ ((p : ℤ) - B6.dRel i).toNat := by omega
      rw [(ctxOf hY).pr_of_mem_ne (le_refl 2) hΦ hmp]
    · have hlt : (p : ℤ) < B6.dRel i := by omega
      rw [Phi_eq_zero_of_ltL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr p hlt hw, map_zero]

name: B7Lci.grr_weightL
statement:
theorem grr_weightL (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) (m : ℕ) :
    ((0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i) →
      (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
        PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2)
          ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat)
            (tauFL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2) * x))) ∧
    ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i < 0 → (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fQ_eq_PhiL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) x]
  exact ⟨fun h => pr_PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr m h _,
    fun h => pr_PhiF_negL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr m h _⟩

name: B7Lci.theta_tauL
statement:
theorem theta_tauL {D : ℕ}
    (hDt : ∀ p, D < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0) :
    thetaX (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) (towerHyp_of_projective hX) (genericPoint X) D
        (tauFL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2)) =
      tdDual X D (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  set v := M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree with hv
  set r := rankAtRingHom (genericPoint X) v with hr
  have hz := sub_rank_mem hXc (genericPoint X) v
  have e : B5.toKQ X v = toK0Q X (v - (r : K0 X)) + ((r : ℤ) : K0Q X) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_intCast]
    show toK0Q X v = _
    abel
  rw [tau_eq_toddL hX hY i hNr (le_refl 2) D hDt, e]
  show thetaX hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D
    ((ctxK0 hXc hTX (genericPoint X)).toddW (le_refl 2) D
      ((ctxK0 hXc hTX (genericPoint X)).dual (le_refl 2) _)) = _
  rw [toddW_dual_add_intCast]
  exact theta_toddW_dual hXc hTX (genericPoint X) D hz

name: B7Lci.grr_gr_gammaL
statement:
theorem grr_gr_gammaL (x : K0 X) {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁)
    (hDt : ∀ p, D₁ < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0) :
    chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      grPushL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr hD
        (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree))
proof:
:= by
  have hTX := towerHyp_of_projective hX
  have hTY := towerHyp_of_projective hY
  rw [chGr_eq_theta Y hTY D₂, chGr_eq_theta X hTX D₁, mul_comm,
    ← theta_tauL hX hY i hNr hDt, ← map_mul, grPush_thetaL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr harr hD]
  have h2 : toK0Q Y (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) = B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf (toK0Q X x) :=
    (B5.mapQ_toKQ _ x).symm
  rw [h2, fQ_eq_PhiL hX hY hYreg f hf i hNr (le_refl 2) (toK0Q X x)]

name: B7Lci.hNr_of_cover
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have h := (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank
  rwa [GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.rank_eq_codim_of_cover i C] at h

name: B7Lci.adams_intrinsic_lci_field
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_lci_field (htw : ARRLciTop.HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i)) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
        (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
      B5.fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          M1.LCI.tClassLci hY n i hN j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ARRLciTop.arrwKLci_iff hY hYreg n i C j x _).2
    (ARRLciTop.adamsRiemannRoch_lci_forall_field htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hj x)
  unfold ARRLciTop.ARRwKLci at h
  rw [B5.fLoc_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi] at h
  exact h

name: B7Lci.adams_intrinsic_Q_lci
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_Q_lci (htw : ARRLciTop.HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i)) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    B5.ARRAbs (B5.psiQ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j))
      (B5.psiQ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j))
      (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf) (tQL hY n i hN hj)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, mul_add, hu, hv]
  | tmul q a =>
    have h1 := adams_intrinsic_lci_field htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hN hj a
    have h2 := congrArg (B5.locToQ j hj Y) h1
    rw [B5.locToQ_algebraMap, B5.fLoc, B5.locToQ_locAddHom, map_mul, B5.locToQ_algebraMap] at h2
    have e : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : ℚ) (b : K0 Z), q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b = q • B5.toKQ Z b := by
      intro Z q b
      rw [B5.toKQ_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [B5.fQ, B5.mapQ_tmul, B5.psiQ_tmul, B5.psiQ_tmul, e q (adamsRingHom _ j a), mul_smul_comm,
      map_smul, e q]
    rw [B5.mapQ, ← B5.mapQ] at h2
    rw [h2, mul_comm]
    rfl

name: B7Lci.arr_ctx_lci
statement:
theorem arr_ctx_lci (htw : ARRLciTop.HtwGate.{u}) (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {r : ℕ}
    (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i)) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    B5.ARRAbs ((ctxOf hX).Ψ j) ((ctxOf hY).Ψ j) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf) (tQL hY n i hN hj)
proof:
:=
  adams_intrinsic_Q_lci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hN hj

name: B7Lci.grr_gr_gamma_lci
statement:
theorem grr_gr_gamma_lci (x : K0 X) {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁)
    (hDt : ∀ p, D₁ < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i
        (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0) :
    chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      grPushLci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hD
        (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i
          (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree))
proof:
:=
  grr_gr_gammaL hX hY hYreg f hf i (hNr_of_cover i C)
    (arr_ctx_lci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C (hNr_of_cover i C).isFiniteLocallyFree (le_refl 2))
    x hD hDt

name: B7Lci.grr_gr_gamma_lci_exists
statement:
theorem grr_gr_gamma_lci_exists (x : K0 X) :
    ∃ D₀ : ℕ, ∀ {D₁ D₂ : ℕ}, D₀ ≤ D₁ → ∀ (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁),
      chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
        grPushLci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C hD
          (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i
            (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := exists_dual_boundL hX i (hNr_of_cover i C) (le_refl 2)
  refine ⟨D₀, fun {D₁ D₂} h1 hD => ?_⟩
  exact grr_gr_gamma_lci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C x hD
    fun p hp => hD₀ p (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hp)

name: B7Lci.grr_weight_lci
statement:
theorem grr_weight_lci (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 X) (m : ℕ) :
    ((0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i) →
      (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
        PhiFL hX hY hYreg f hf i (hNr_of_cover i C) (le_refl 2)
          ((ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) (((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i).toNat)
            (tauFL hX hY i (hNr_of_cover i C) (le_refl 2) * x))) ∧
    ((m : ℤ) + B6.dRel i < 0 → (ctxOf hY).pr (le_refl 2) m (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf x) = 0)
proof:
:=
  grr_weightL hX hY hYreg f hf i (hNr_of_cover i C)
    (arr_ctx_lci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi C (hNr_of_cover i C).isFiniteLocallyFree (le_refl 2)) x m

name: B7Lci.rank_tveeLci
statement:
theorem rank_tveeLci (y : X) :
    rankAtRingHom y (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i
      (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree) = B6.dRel i
proof:
:= by
  have hNr := hNr_of_cover i C
  rw [show M1.LCI.tveeLci n i (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      M1.LCI.tveeLci n i hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree from rfl, tveeLci_eq i hNr, map_sub,
    rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank (hEa i),
    rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hNr]
  unfold B6.dRel
  rfl

name: B7Lci.arr_ctx_of_regular
statement:
theorem arr_ctx_of_regular (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i)) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    B5.ARRAbs ((ctxOf hX).Ψ j) ((ctxOf hY).Ψ j) (B5.fQ hX hY hYreg f hf) (tQL hY n i hN hj)
proof:
:= by
  have h := B6.arr_ctx hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj
  unfold B5.tQ at h
  rw [B5.tClass_eq_tClassLci hY hYreg hXreg n i hN j] at h
  exact h

name: B7Lci.b7_grr_gr_gamma_of_core
statement:
theorem b7_grr_gr_gamma_of_core (x : K0 X) {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁)
    (hDt : ∀ p, D₁ < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))) = 0) :
    chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      B7.grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD
        (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))
proof:
:=
  grr_gr_gammaL hX hY hYreg f hf i (B6.hEb hXreg hY hYreg i)
    (arr_ctx_of_regular hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi _ (le_refl 2)) x hD hDt

name: B7Lci.grPushLci_eq_grPush
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: B7Lci.grr_gr_gamma_lci_of_regular
statement:
theorem grr_gr_gamma_lci_of_regular {r : ℕ} (C : GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.RegularCover i.ker r)
    (x : K0 X) {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁)
    (hDt : ∀ p, D₁ < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i
        (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree))) = 0) :
    chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      B7.grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD
        (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (M1.LCI.tveeLci n i
          (GRRBlueprintV4.G2C.conormalDataOfLci i C).rank.isFiniteLocallyFree))

:=
  B7.grr_gr_gamma hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x hD hDt

name: B7Lci.b7_grr_gr_gamma_of_lci
statement:
theorem b7_grr_gr_gamma_of_lci (htw : ARRLciTop.HtwGate.{u}) (x : K0 X) {D₁ D₂ : ℕ}
    (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + B6.dRel i ≤ D₁)
    (hDt : ∀ p, D₁ < p → (ctxOf hX).pr (le_refl 2) p ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2)
      (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))) = 0) :
    chGr Y D₂ (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      B7.grPush hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hD
        (chGr X D₁ x * tdDual X D₁ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))
