:=
  grr_gr_gamma_lci htw hX hY hYreg f hf i hi (ARRLciTop.regularCover_prod hYreg n i hXreg) x hD hDt

name: B5.toKQ_apply
statement: theorem toKQ_apply {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : K0 Z) : toKQ Z a = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a
proof: := rfl

name: B5.locToQ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem locToQ_algebraMap {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : K0 Z) :
    locToQ j hj Z (algebraMap _ _ a) = toKQ Z a
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ _ a

name: B5.psiQ_tmul
statement:
theorem psiQ_tmul {Z : Scheme.{u}} (φ : K0 Z →+* K0 Z) (q : ℚ) (a : K0 Z) :
    psiQ φ (q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) = q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] φ a
proof:
:= by
  simp [psiQ]

name: B5.mapQ_tmul
statement:
theorem mapQ_tmul {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : K0 X →+ K0 Y) (q : ℚ) (a : K0 X) :
    mapQ g (q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) = q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] g a
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapQ, intLin_apply]

name: B5.mapQ_toKQ
statement:
theorem mapQ_toKQ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : K0 X →+ K0 Y) (a : K0 X) :
    mapQ g (toKQ X a) = toKQ Y (g a)
proof: := mapQ_tmul g 1 a

name: B5.locToQ_locAddHom
statement:
theorem locToQ_locAddHom {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : K0 X →+ K0 Y)
    (z : KLoc j X) :
    locToQ j hj Y (locAddHom j g z) = mapQ g (locToQ j hj X z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) z
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := s.2
  have hz' : (j ^ m : ℕ) • z = algebraMap _ _ a := by
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    simp only at hz
    rw [← hm] at hz
    simpa [map_pow, map_natCast] using hz
  have hc : ((j ^ m : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (pow_ne_zero _ (by omega))
  apply smul_right_injective (KQ Y) hc
  simp only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  rw [← map_nsmul, ← map_nsmul, ← map_nsmul, ← map_nsmul, hz', locAddHom_algebraMap,
    locToQ_algebraMap, locToQ_algebraMap, mapQ_toKQ]

name: B5.fLoc_eq
statement:
theorem fLoc_eq (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) (j : ℕ) (z : KLoc j X) :
    locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hYreg))
        (pushI n i hY hYreg j z) = fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j z
proof:
:= by
  have key : (locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hYreg))).comp
      (pushI n i hY hYreg j) = fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j := by
    apply loc_addHom_ext
    intro a
    have e1 : pushI n i hY hYreg j (algebraMap _ _ a) =
        algebraMap _ _ ((resProd hY hYreg n).res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X a))) := by
      unfold pushI pushLocF3
      rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
      rfl
    have hr : ∀ v, k0ToG0 _ ((resProd hY hYreg n).res v) = v := fun v =>
      DFunLike.congr_fun (resProd hY hYreg n).right v
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [e1, locAddHom_algebraMap, fLoc, locAddHom_algebraMap, CAN.fShriekCan_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi]
    congr 1
    unfold piK0 fShriekK0PI fShriekK0All fShriekG0All
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key z

name: B5.adams_intrinsic
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
        (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
      fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          tClass hY hYreg hXreg n i j) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  have h := FIN.adamsRiemannRoch_kahler hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj x
  unfold FIN.ARRwK at h
  rw [fLoc_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi] at h
  exact h

name: B5.tvee_eq_kahlerVirtual
statement:
theorem tvee_eq_kahlerVirtual (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (dX dY : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (X ↘ Spk k)] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dY (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i = TF7.kahlerVirtual k dX dY f := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  exact TF7.tangent_virtual_PY dX dY hX hXreg hY hYreg n i f hi hf

name: B5.adams_intrinsic_smooth
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_smooth (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (dX dY : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (X ↘ Spk k)] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dY (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f)
    (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
        (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x)) =
      fLoc hX hY hYreg f hf j
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnil
            (Multiplicative.ofAdd (TF7.kahlerVirtual k dX dY f)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) :
              KLoc j X)) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  have h := adams_intrinsic hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj x
  rw [tClass, tvee_eq_kahlerVirtual hX hXreg hY hYreg dX dY f hf i hi] at h
  exact h

name: B5.adams_intrinsic_Q
statement:
theorem adams_intrinsic_Q (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    ARRAbs (psiQ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j))
      (psiQ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j))
      (fQ hX hY hYreg f hf) (tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i hj) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv => simp only [map_add, mul_add, hu, hv]
  | tmul q a =>
    have h1 := adams_intrinsic hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj a
    have h2 := congrArg (locToQ j hj Y) h1
    rw [locToQ_algebraMap, fLoc, locToQ_locAddHom, map_mul, locToQ_algebraMap] at h2
    have e : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : ℚ) (b : K0 Z), q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b = q • toKQ Z b := by
      intro Z q b
      rw [toKQ_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [fQ, mapQ_tmul, psiQ_tmul, psiQ_tmul, e q (adamsRingHom _ j a), mul_smul_comm, map_smul,
      e q]
    rw [mapQ, ← mapQ] at h2
    rw [h2, mul_comm]
    rfl

name: B5.E1_intrinsic
statement:
theorem E1_intrinsic (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (chi : KQ Y →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hchi : haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
      ∀ y, chi (psiQ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j) y) = chi y)
    (x : KQ X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
    (chi.comp (fQ hX hY hYreg f hf)) x = (chi.comp (fQ hX hY hYreg f hf))
      (tQ hY hYreg hXreg n i hj *
        psiQ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j) x) :=
  E1_of_arr (adams_intrinsic_Q hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi hj) chi hchi x

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.nonempty_pullback_iso_zero_exc
statement:
theorem nonempty_pullback_iso_zero_exc {L N : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1) (hN : HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) N 1)
    (σ₀ : tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ L) (σE : tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ N)
    (hid₀ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀ = (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0).ker)
    (hidE : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σE = (componentToTotal Y J).ker) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)).obj L ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨𝓛, h𝓛, σc, σi, -, -, hec, hei⟩ := exists_cartierData_P1_zero_inf k
  haveI hW : IsIntegral (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) :=
    IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  haveI : Nonempty J.subscheme := inferInstance
  have hpt : pointInfH k = pointInfKDGc k := rfl
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J
  let g := F ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk
  have Hc : (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0).ker.comap F = (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0).ker.comap g :=
    (kdgc_C3a_zero Y J k φk).trans (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion _ _)
  have Hi : (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F = (pointInfH k).ker.comap g := by
    rw [hpt]
    exact (kdgc_C3bH Y J k φk).trans (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion _ _)
  have Hc_ne : (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0).ker.comap F ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [kdgc_C3a_zero Y J k φk]; exact ker_fst_pointAt_zero_ne_bot Y J k φk
  have Hi_ne : (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [kdgc_C3bH Y J k φk]; exact ker_fst_pointInf_ne_bot Y J k φk
  have eL : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj L ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj 𝓛) := by
    have e1 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec F σ₀) =
        (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec hL σ₀ F, hid₀]
    have e2 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec g σc) =
        (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec h𝓛 σc g, hec, Hc]
    exact nonempty_iso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hL F)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) (pullbackSec F σ₀) (pullbackSec g σc)
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hL F) _ (by rw [e1]; exact Hc_ne))
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) _ (by rw [e2]; exact Hc_ne))
      (e1.trans e2.symm)
  have eN : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj N ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj 𝓛) := by
    have e1 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec F σE) =
        (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec hN σE F, hidE]
    have e2 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec g σi) =
        (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec h𝓛 σi g, hei, Hi]
    exact nonempty_iso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hN F)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) (pullbackSec F σE) (pullbackSec g σi)
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hN F) _ (by rw [e1]; exact Hi_ne))
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) _ (by rw [e2]; exact Hi_ne))
      (e1.trans e2.symm)
  exact ⟨eL.some ≪≫ eN.some.symm⟩

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.pullbackK0_dual_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_dual_eq_of_iso {W M : Scheme.{u}} (F : W ⟶ M) {L N : M.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) (hN : HasConstantRank M N 1)
    (hDL : IsFiniteLocallyFree M (lineBundleDual M L))
    (hDN : IsFiniteLocallyFree M (lineBundleDual M N))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj L ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj N) :
    pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L) hDL) =
      pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M N) hDN)
proof:
:= by
  have hab : pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso W _ _ e
  have hL1 : pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) *
      pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L) hDL) = 1 := by
    rw [← pullbackK0_mul, SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.k0ClassOf_mul_lineBundleDual
      M L hL hDL, pullbackK0_one]
  have hN1 : pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree) *
      pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M N) hDN) = 1 := by
    rw [← pullbackK0_mul, SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.k0ClassOf_mul_lineBundleDual
      M N hN hDN, pullbackK0_one]
  rw [hab] at hL1
  calc pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L) hDL)
      = pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L) hDL) *
          (pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree) *
            pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M N) hDN)) := by
        rw [hN1, mul_one]
    _ = (pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree) *
          pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L) hDL)) *
          pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M N) hDN) := by ring
    _ = pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M N) hDN) := by
        rw [hL1, one_mul]

name: TwistEqualityHtwALCI.htwOf_all
statement:
theorem htwOf_all (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤)) (G₀ : ZeroGate A J k φ) :
    HtwOf J hA G₀ (oeGate A φ J)
proof:
:= by
  letI := G₀.qc; letI := G₀.fp; letI := (oeGate A φ J).qc; letI := (oeGate A φ J).fp
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  have hid₀ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G₀.σ = (fibreιGlobal A J k φ 0).ker :=
    G₀.hid.trans (congrArg Scheme.Hom.ker (fibreιGlobal_zero_eq A J k φ).symm)
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_pullback_iso_zero_exc A J k φ G₀.hL (oeGate A φ J).hL G₀.σ
    (oeGate A φ J).σ hid₀ (oeGate A φ J).hid
  exact pullbackK0_dual_eq_of_iso (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J) G₀.hL (oeGate A φ J).hL
    (KSpecialization.G2GC1.isFiniteLocallyFree_dual G₀.hL)
    (KSpecialization.G2GC1.isFiniteLocallyFree_dual (oeGate A φ J).hL) e

name: AmpleGGAR3.ampleGG_projectiveSpace
statement: theorem ampleGG_projectiveSpace : AmpleGG (space K n)
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  haveI := hV.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : (tensorUnitSheaf (space K n)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _).isFinitePresentation
  haveI : (V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    ResolutionRegularClosedF15.isFinitePresentation_biprod _ _
  obtain ⟨m, P, N, ⟨eP⟩, hPfl, e, he⟩ :=
    TwistFreeCoverF18.exists_epi_twist_gg K n (V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n))
  haveI := he
  let L := projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m
  have hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space K n) L := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree K n m
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap (space K n) e (𝟙 L)) :=
    epi_tensorSheafMap_id e L hL
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap (space K n) (biprod.fst : V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n) ⟶ V)
      (𝟙 L)) := epi_tensorSheafMap_id _ L hL
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap (space K n)
      (biprod.snd : V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n) ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n))
      (𝟙 L)) := epi_tensorSheafMap_id _ L hL
  have hG : IsGG (tensorSheaf (space K n) (V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n)) L) := by
    haveI : Epi ((TwistFreeCoverF18.twistCancel K n P m).inv ≫
        tensorSheafMap (space K n) e (𝟙 L)) :=
      epi_comp _ _
    exact isGG_of_finite (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) eP
      ((TwistFreeCoverF18.twistCancel K n P m).inv ≫ tensorSheafMap (space K n) e (𝟙 L))
  refine ⟨L, AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact isGG_of_epi (isGG_of_epi hG (tensorSheafMap (space K n)
      (biprod.snd : V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n) ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n)) (𝟙 L)))
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor (space K n) L).hom
  · exact isGG_of_epi (isGG_of_epi hG (tensorSheafMap (space K n)
      (biprod.fst : V ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (space K n) ⟶ V) (𝟙 L)))
      (tensorSheafSymmetry (space K n) V L).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inl
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r)) =
      (MvPolynomial.monomial m r, 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff :
      mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule R
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) σ
          (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r)) =
        Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r) := by
    rw [mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule_apply]
    rfl
  change
    ((mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquiv R σ).symm
        (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.fst R R Q)
          (mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule R
            (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) σ
            (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r)))),
      (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)).symm
        (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.snd R R Q)
          (mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule R
            (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) σ
            (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r))))) =
      (MvPolynomial.monomial m r, 0)
  rw [hcoeff]
  apply Prod.ext
  · ext d
    change
      (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.fst R R Q)
          (Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r))) d =
        (Finsupp.single m r) d
    rw [Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap_apply, Finsupp.mapRange_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split <;> rfl
  · change
      (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)).symm
          (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.snd R R Q)
            (Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r))) = 0
    apply (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor
      (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)).injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero]
    ext d
    change ((Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r)) d).2 = 0
    rw [Finsupp.single_apply]
    split <;> rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inr
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (q : Q) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q)) =
      (0, MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff :
      mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule R
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) σ
          (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q)) =
        Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q) := by
    rw [mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule_apply]
    rfl
  change
    ((mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquiv R σ).symm
        (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.fst R R Q)
          (mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule R
            (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) σ
            (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q)))),
      (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)).symm
        (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.snd R R Q)
          (mvPolynomialFinsuppLinearEquivOfModule R
            (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) σ
            (MvPolynomial.monomial m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q))))) =
      (0, MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] q)
  rw [hcoeff]
  apply Prod.ext
  · ext d
    change
      (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.fst R R Q)
          (Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q))) d =
        (0 : (σ →₀ ℕ) →₀ R) d
    rw [Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap_apply, Finsupp.mapRange_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    split <;> rfl
  · change
      (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)).symm
          (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.snd R R Q)
            (Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q))) =
        MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] q
    apply (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor
      (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)).injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    ext d
    change
      (Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap (LinearMap.snd R R Q)
        (Finsupp.single m (TrivSqZeroExt.inr q))) d =
      (MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor (R := R) (N := Q) (σ := σ)
        (MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] q)) d
    rw [Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap_apply, Finsupp.mapRange_apply,
      MvPolynomial.scalarRTensor_apply_tmul_apply,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split
    · rw [LinearMap.snd_apply, one_smul]
      exact TrivSqZeroExt.snd_inr R q
    · rw [map_zero, zero_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (m : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (a : projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.monomial m a) =
      (MvPolynomial.monomial m a.fst,
        MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] a.snd)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.monomial m a) =
      squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.monomial m
          (TrivSqZeroExt.inl a.fst + TrivSqZeroExt.inr a.snd)) := by
            rw [TrivSqZeroExt.inl_fst_add_inr_snd_eq]
    _ = (MvPolynomial.monomial m a.fst,
        MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] a.snd) := by
      rw [map_add, map_add,
        squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inl,
        squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inr]
      apply Prod.ext <;> simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_X_mul_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_X_mul_monomial
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (i : σ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (a : projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        ((MvPolynomial.X i :
            MvPolynomial σ (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q)) *
          MvPolynomial.monomial m a) =
      ((MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R) *
          MvPolynomial.monomial m a.fst,
        (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R) •
          (MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 ⊗ₜ[R] a.snd))
proof:
:= by
  simp [MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul,
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_X_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_X_mul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (i : σ)
    (x : MvPolynomial σ (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q)) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        ((MvPolynomial.X i :
            MvPolynomial σ (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q)) * x) =
      ((MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R) *
          (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).1,
        (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R) •
          (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← x.support_sum_monomial_coeff]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum,
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_X_mul_monomial,
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial,
    Prod.fst_sum, Prod.snd_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Prod.ext
  · rw [Prod.fst_sum]
  · rw [Prod.snd_sum]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_C_mul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (r : R)
    (x : MvPolynomial σ (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q)) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.C (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r) * x) =
      (MvPolynomial.C r *
          (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).1,
        (MvPolynomial.C r : MvPolynomial σ R) •
          (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource :
      MvPolynomial.C (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r) * x = r • x := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    rfl
  have hfst :
      MvPolynomial.C r *
          (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).1 =
        r • (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).1 := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    rfl
  have hsnd :
      (MvPolynomial.C r : MvPolynomial σ R) •
          (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).2 =
        r • (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).2 := by
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (MvPolynomial σ R) r _
  rw [hsource, hfst, hsnd, map_smul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_map_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_map_inl
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.map (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) p) =
      (p, 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← p.support_sum_monomial_coeff]
  simp only [map_sum, MvPolynomial.map_monomial,
    projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom_apply,
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_monomial_inl]
  apply Prod.ext
  · rw [Prod.fst_sum]
  · rw [Prod.snd_sum]
    simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_map_inl_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_map_inl_mul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (σ : Type v) (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (x : MvPolynomial σ (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q)) :
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ
        (MvPolynomial.map (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) p * x) =
      (p * (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).1,
        p • (squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q σ x).2)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on generalizing x with
  | C r =>
      simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, hp, hq, add_mul, add_smul]
      apply Prod.ext <;> simp
  | mul_X p i hp =>
      rw [(MvPolynomial.map
          (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q)).map_mul,
        MvPolynomial.map_X, mul_assoc, hp,
        squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_X_mul]
      apply Prod.ext
      · simp [mul_assoc]
      · rw [mul_smul]

name: SheafSyzygyPdG2.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy_of_chartPd

theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy_of_chartPd [∀ i, IsNoetherianRing (R i)] (d : ℕ)

      (fun E hE => chart_bundle C R e i E hE) d hK inferInstance (chart_finite C R e i F) (hpd i)
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_charts C R e K
    (fun i => (key i).1) (fun i => (key i).2)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.inv_equivariant
statement: lemma inv_equivariant (c : O ⟶ O) : Φ₂.map c ≫ θ.inv = θ.inv ≫ Φ₁.map c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← hθ, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.retract_key
statement:
lemma retract_key (Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) (τ : Ψ₁.obj O ≅ Ψ₂.obj O)
    (hτ : ∀ c : O ⟶ O, Ψ₁.map c ≫ τ.hom = τ.hom ≫ Ψ₂.map c) {V : 𝒞}
    (a b' : V ⟶ O) (b a' : O ⟶ V) :
    (Ψ₁.map a ≫ τ.hom ≫ Ψ₂.map b) ≫ (Ψ₂.map b' ≫ τ.inv ≫ Ψ₁.map a') =
      Ψ₁.map (a ≫ b ≫ b' ≫ a')
proof:
:= by
  have h := hτ (b ≫ b')
  calc _ = Ψ₁.map a ≫ (τ.hom ≫ Ψ₂.map (b ≫ b')) ≫ τ.inv ≫ Ψ₁.map a' := by
          simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = Ψ₁.map a ≫ (Ψ₁.map (b ≫ b') ≫ τ.hom) ≫ τ.inv ≫ Ψ₁.map a' := by rw [h]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.retract_sum_aux
statement:
lemma retract_sum_aux (Ψ : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) [Ψ.Additive] :
    ∑ j, ∑ k, Ψ.map (a j ≫ b j ≫ a k ≫ b k) = Ψ.map ((∑ j, a j ≫ b j) ≫ (∑ k, a k ≫ b k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, Ψ.map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum, Ψ.map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.mulP_app_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mulP_app_apply (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) (U : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (x : P.obj U) :
    (mulP P s).app U x = resC s U • x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.mulP_naturality
statement:
lemma mulP_naturality {P Q : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (φ : P ⟶ Q) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) : φ ≫ mulP Q s = mulP P s ≫ φ
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  change (mulP Q s).app U (φ.app U x) = φ.app U ((mulP P s).app U x)
  rw [mulP_app_apply, mulP_app_apply]
  exact ((φ.app U).hom.map_smul (show (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj U from
    resC s U) x).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.mul_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_app (M : X.Modules) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    (mul M s).app U x = res s U • x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.mul_naturality
statement:
lemma mul_naturality {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    φ ≫ mul N s = mul M s ≫ φ
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Modules.hom_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
  ext x
  change (mul N s).app U (φ.app U x) = φ.app U ((mul M s).app U x)
  rw [mul_app, mul_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.unit_eq_mul
statement:
lemma unit_eq_mul (c : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :
    c = mul (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (SplitKernel.endVal c)
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Modules.hom_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
  ext x
  rw [SplitKernel.app_eq_mul_endVal c U x, mul_app]
  exact mul_comm (G := Γ(X, U)) _ _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.moduleSheafification_map_mulP
statement:
theorem moduleSheafification_map_mulP
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (moduleSheafification X).map (mulP P s) = mul ((moduleSheafification X).obj P) s
proof:
:= by
  apply ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  have h := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.naturality (mulP P s)
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] at h
  exact h.symm.trans (mulP_naturality ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P) s).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.tensorSheafMap_mul_id
statement:
theorem tensorSheafMap_mul_id (A B : X.Modules) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    tensorSheafMap X (mul A s) (𝟙 B) = mul (tensorSheaf X A B) s
proof:
:= by
  have h : (show underlyingCommPresheaf X A ⟶ underlyingCommPresheaf X A from (mul A s).val) ⊗ₘ
      (𝟙 (underlyingCommPresheaf X B)) =
      mulP (underlyingCommPresheaf X A ⊗ underlyingCommPresheaf X B) s := by
    ext U : 1
    apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
    intro a b
    exact (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' (show (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj U from
      resC s U) a b).symm
  unfold tensorSheafMap
  erw [h]
  exact moduleSheafification_map_mulP _ s

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.pushforward_map_mul
statement:
lemma pushforward_map_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (B : X.Modules) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (mul B (f.appTop s)) =
      mul ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B) s
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Modules.hom_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
  ext x
  change res (f.appTop s) (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) • (show Γ(B, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) from x) =
    f.app U (res s U) • (show Γ(B, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) from x)
  congr 1
  have h := f.naturality (homOfLE le_top : U ⟶ ⊤).op
  have h' := congrArg (fun q => q.hom s) h
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h'
  rw [res, res]
  exact h'.symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.pullback_map_mul
statement:
lemma pullback_map_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (A : Y.Modules) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (mul A s) =
      mul ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj A) (f.appTop s)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  have h := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.naturality (mul A s)
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] at h
  rw [pushforward_map_mul]
  exact h.symm.trans (mul_naturality _ s).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.sheafification_map_mulP'
statement:
theorem sheafification_map_mulP' (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map (mulP' P s) =
      mul ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj P) s
proof:
:= by
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  have h := adj.unit.naturality (mulP' P s)
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] at h
  exact h.symm.trans (mulP_naturality (adj.unit.app P) s).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.preimage_structureRingHom_eq
statement:
lemma preimage_structureRingHom_eq (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (T : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (r : Γ(Y, U)) :
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.appIso T).inv (structureRingHom T r) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U from
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le T)).op (f.app U r)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : globalSec (X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) r = (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv (f.app U r) := by
    rw [← preimageTopIso_globalSec f U r]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso _).symm
  rw [structureRingHom_apply]
  erw [hg]
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ (f.app U r)) = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.toSheaf_restrict_mul
statement:
lemma toSheaf_restrict_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map (mul M (f.appTop s))) =
      smulEnd (R := Γ(Y, U)) (restrictToPreimage f M U) (res s U)
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext T x
  change res (f.appTop s) ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ T.unop) •
      (show Γ(M, (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ T.unop) from x) =
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.appIso T.unop).inv (structureRingHom T.unop (res s U)) •
      (show Γ(M, (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ T.unop) from x)
  congr 1
  rw [preimage_structureRingHom_eq]
  have h := f.naturality (homOfLE le_top : U ⟶ ⊤).op
  have h' := congrArg (fun q => q.hom s) h
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h'
  rw [res, res]
  erw [h']
  simp only [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.presheafMap_mul
statement:
lemma presheafMap_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafMap f (mul M (f.appTop s)) q =
      mulP' (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M q) s
proof:
:= by
  refine PresheafOfModules.hom_ext fun U => ?_
  ext x
  rw [affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafMap_app_apply,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_apply, toSheaf_restrict_mul]
  exact (smul_eq_H_map (R := Γ(Y, U.unop)) _ _ _ x).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.higherDirectImage_map_mul
statement:
theorem higherDirectImage_map_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map (mul M (f.appTop s)) =
      mul (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M q) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_map, presheafMap_mul]
  exact sheafification_map_mulP' _ s

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.lhsFunctor_map_mul
statement:
lemma lhsFunctor_map_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (lhsFunctor f M q).map (mul (tensorUnitSheaf Y) s) =
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map
        (mul (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
          (tensorUnitSheaf Y)) M) (f.appTop s))
proof:
:= by
  change (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map
    (tensorSheafMap X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (mul _ s)) (𝟙 M)) = _
  rw [pullback_map_mul, tensorSheafMap_mul_id]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.unitComparison_equivariant
statement:
lemma unitComparison_equivariant (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (q : ℕ)
    (c : tensorUnitSheaf Y ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf Y) :
    (lhsFunctor f M q).map c ≫ (unitComparison f M q).hom =
      (unitComparison f M q).hom ≫ (rhsFunctor f M q).map c
proof:
:= by
  set s := SplitKernel.endVal c
  have hc : c = mul (tensorUnitSheaf Y) s := unit_eq_mul c
  let G := affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M q
  let e := tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y G
  have hA : (rhsFunctor f M q).map c ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ mul G s := by
    change tensorSheafMap Y c (𝟙 G) ≫ e.hom = _
    rw [hc, tensorSheafMap_mul_id, mul_naturality]
  have hA' : mul G s ≫ e.inv = e.inv ≫ (rhsFunctor f M q).map c := by
    have h2 := congrArg (fun g => e.inv ≫ g ≫ e.inv) hA
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hB : (lhsFunctor f M q).map c ≫
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map
        (pullbackUnitTensorIso f M).hom =
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map
        (pullbackUnitTensorIso f M).hom ≫ mul G s := by
    rw [hc, lhsFunctor_map_mul,
      ← (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map_comp, ← mul_naturality,
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map_comp,
      higherDirectImage_map_mul]
  change (lhsFunctor f M q).map c ≫
      ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map
        (pullbackUnitTensorIso f M).hom ≫ e.inv) =
    ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).map
        (pullbackUnitTensorIso f M).hom ≫ e.inv) ≫ (rhsFunctor f M q).map c
  rw [← Category.assoc, hB]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hA']

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.projective_localizedModule_of_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem projective_localizedModule_of_isLocalizedModule {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (Rₚ : Type u) [CommRing Rₚ] [Algebra R Rₚ] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ I]
    (Mₚ : Type u) [AddCommGroup Mₚ] [Module R Mₚ] [Module Rₚ Mₚ] [IsScalarTower R Rₚ Mₚ]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] Mₚ) [IsLocalizedModule I.primeCompl f] [Module.Projective Rₚ Mₚ] :
    Module.Projective (Localization.AtPrime I) (LocalizedModule I.primeCompl M)
proof:
:= by
  set e := (IsLocalization.algEquiv I.primeCompl Rₚ (Localization.AtPrime I)).toRingEquiv
  refine Module.Projective.of_equiv (M := Mₚ) (R := Rₚ) (σ := e)
    { __ := IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv I.primeCompl f
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap I.primeCompl M)
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro r m
  obtain ⟨r, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq I.primeCompl r
  apply ((Module.End.isUnit_iff _).mp
    (IsLocalizedModule.map_units (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap I.primeCompl M) s)).1
  dsimp [e]
  simp only [← map_smul, ← smul_assoc, IsLocalization.smul_mk'_self, algebraMap_smul,
    IsLocalization.map_id_mk']

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.tilde_toStalk_isLocalizedModule
statement:
lemma tilde_toStalk_isLocalizedModule (P : ModuleCat.{u} S) (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top S) :
    IsLocalizedModule x.asIdeal.primeCompl (tilde.toStalk P x).hom
proof: := inferInstance

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.projective_of_tildeIso
statement:
theorem projective_of_tildeIso (P : ModuleCat.{u} S) [Module.FinitePresentation S P]
    {V : (Spec S).Modules} (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec S) V)
    (e : (tilde.functor S).obj P ≅ V) : Module.Projective S P
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.projective_of_localization_maximal
  intro I hI
  let p : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨I, hI.isPrime⟩
  let x : Spec S := p
  let xt : PrimeSpectrum.Top S := p
  have h0 := tilde_toStalk_isLocalizedModule P xt
  let Rₚ := (Spec.structureSheaf S).presheaf.stalk x
  haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ I := StructureSheaf.IsLocalization.to_stalk S x
  let Mₚ := (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj V
  letI : Module Rₚ Mₚ := inferInstanceAs (Module ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk x) Mₚ)
  letI : Module S Mₚ := Module.compHom Mₚ (algebraMap S Rₚ)
  haveI : IsScalarTower S Rₚ Mₚ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  haveI := (free_finite_stalk V hV x).1
  haveI : Module.Free Rₚ Mₚ :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module.Free ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk x) Mₚ)
  let T := (tilde.functor S).obj P
  let MT := (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj T
  letI : Module Rₚ MT := inferInstanceAs (Module ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk x) MT)
  letI : Module S MT := Module.compHom MT (algebraMap S Rₚ)
  haveI : IsScalarTower S Rₚ MT := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  let ψ : MT ≃ₗ[Rₚ] Mₚ := ((stalkLinearFunctor x).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  let ψS : MT ≃ₗ[S] Mₚ := ψ.restrictScalars S
  let f₀ : P →ₗ[S] MT :=
    { toFun := (tilde.toStalk P xt).hom
      map_add' := (tilde.toStalk P xt).hom.map_add
      map_smul' := (tilde.toStalk P xt).hom.map_smul }
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule I.primeCompl f₀ := h0
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule I.primeCompl (ψS.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f₀) :=
    IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv _ f₀ ψS
  exact projective_localizedModule_of_isLocalizedModule I Rₚ Mₚ (ψS.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f₀)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.exists_retract_of_tildeIso
statement:
theorem exists_retract_of_tildeIso (P : ModuleCat.{u} S) [Module.Finite S P]
    [Module.Projective S P] {V : (Spec S).Modules} (e : (tilde.functor S).obj P ≅ V) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → (V ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (Spec S)))
      (b : Fin n → (tensorUnitSheaf (Spec S) ⟶ V)), ∑ j, a j ≫ b j = 𝟙 V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' S P
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property g LinearMap.id hg
  let a₀ : Fin n → (P →ₗ[S] S) := fun j => LinearMap.proj j ∘ₗ h
  let b₀ : Fin n → (S →ₗ[S] P) := fun j => g ∘ₗ LinearMap.single S (fun _ : Fin n => S) j
  have hab₀ : ∑ j, b₀ j ∘ₗ a₀ j = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← hh]
    ext y
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.coe_proj, Function.eval, LinearMap.coe_single, b₀, a₀]
    rw [← map_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.univ_sum_single (h y)
  let F := tilde.functor S
  let u : F.obj (ModuleCat.of S S) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf (Spec S) := tildeSelf
  refine ⟨n, fun j => e.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (a₀ j)) ≫ u.hom,
    fun j => u.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (b₀ j)) ≫ e.hom, ?_⟩
  have hsum : ∑ j, (ModuleCat.ofHom (a₀ j) ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (b₀ j) :
      ModuleCat.of S P ⟶ ModuleCat.of S P) = 𝟙 _ := by
    ext y
    have := congrArg (fun q : P →ₗ[S] P => q y) hab₀
    simpa using this
  calc ∑ j, (e.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (a₀ j)) ≫ u.hom) ≫
        (u.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (b₀ j)) ≫ e.hom)
      = ∑ j, e.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (a₀ j) ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (b₀ j)) ≫ e.hom :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
          simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Functor.map_comp]
    _ = e.inv ≫ F.map (∑ j, ModuleCat.ofHom (a₀ j) ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (b₀ j)) ≫ e.hom := by
        rw [F.map_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.comp_sum]
    _ = 𝟙 V := by
        rw [hsum]
        erw [F.map_id]
        rw [Category.id_comp]
        exact e.inv_hom_id

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.HigherProjectionFormula.exists_retract_unit
statement:
theorem exists_retract_unit (V : (Spec S).Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec S) V) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → (V ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (Spec S)))
      (b : Fin n → (tensorUnitSheaf (Spec S) ⟶ V)), ∑ j, a j ≫ b j = 𝟙 V
proof:
:= by
  haveI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : V.IsLocallyFree := hV.isLocallyFree
  haveI : V.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation S ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S).obj V) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation V
  haveI : IsIso V.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
  haveI : Module.Projective S ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S).obj V) :=
    projective_of_tildeIso _ hV (asIso V.fromTildeΓ)
  exact exists_retract_of_tildeIso ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S).obj V) (asIso V.fromTildeΓ)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_projectionFormula {S : CommRingCat.{u}}
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec S) (M : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) (V : (Spec S).Modules)
    (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec S) V) :
    Nonempty (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f
        (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) M) q ≅
      tensorSheaf (Spec S) V (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hab⟩ := exists_retract_unit V hV
  exact ⟨higherProjectionIsoOfRetract f M q V a b hab⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem projectiveHigherDirectImage_projectionFormula (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)
    (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) V)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (hM : IsCoherentLike (space R n) M) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (projectiveHigherDirectImage R n
        ⟨tensorSheaf _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V) M,
          tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike _ _ M
            (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (toSpec R n) V hV) hM⟩ q ≅
      tensorSheaf _ V (projectiveHigherDirectImage R n ⟨M, hM⟩ q))
proof:
:=
  SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_projectionFormula
    (toSpec R n) M q V hV

name: SchemeKTheory.projectiveDerivedPushforward_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem projectiveDerivedPushforward_projectionFormula (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (x : G0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)) (y : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn
        (pullbackK0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) y • x) =
      y • SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn x
proof:
:=
  projectiveDerivedPushforward_projectionFormula_of_higher R n hn
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage_projectionFormula R n) x y

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.exists_chart
statement: theorem exists_chart [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (y : X) : Nonempty (Chart f n y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀, U, hU, hyU, e, hsm⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (n := n) (f := f) y
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ U e).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) := hsm
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨y, hyU⟩⟩
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n
  have hrank := Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
    (R := Γ(S, V₀)) (S := Γ(X, U)) n
  exact ⟨⟨V₀, hV₀, U, hU, hyU, e,
    (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq _ _ (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq hrank)).reindex
      (Equiv.ulift.{u}).symm⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.frameCover_sectionBasis

    (frameCover f n).sectionBasis y k = sheafifyUnitApp (chart f n y).U (chartFrame f n y k)
proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.local_iso
statement:
theorem local_iso (y : X) {V : Y.Opens} (hVa : IsAffineOpen V) (hV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (chart f n y).V₀) :
    IsIso ((cmp f g p q H.w.symm).over (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) (chart f n y).U V))
proof:
:= by
  set ch := chart f n y with hch
  have hU1 : prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ ch.U := inf_le_left
  have hU2 : prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ V := inf_le_right
  have hUa : IsAffineOpen (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    prodOpen_isAffine H ch.e hV ch.hV₀ ch.hU hVa
  have hP := prodOpen_isPushout H ch.e hV ch.hV₀ ch.hU hVa
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(X, ch.U) := (f.appLE ch.V₀ ch.U ch.e).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(Y, V) := (g.appLE ch.V₀ V hV).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, ch.U) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    (q.appLE ch.U _ hU1).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    (p.appLE V _ hU2).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    ((q.appLE ch.U _ hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE ch.V₀ ch.U ch.e).hom).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(X, ch.U) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change ((q.appLE ch.U _ hU1).hom.comp (f.appLE ch.V₀ ch.U ch.e).hom) =
        (p.appLE V _ hU2).hom.comp (g.appLE ch.V₀ V hV).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp,
        appLE_comp_eq f g p q ch.e hV H.w.symm hU1 hU2])
  haveI : Algebra.IsPushout Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(X, ch.U) Γ(Y, V)
      Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) :=
    CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout.mp hP
  haveI : Algebra.IsPushout Γ(S, ch.V₀) Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, ch.U)
      Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) := Algebra.IsPushout.symm inferInstance
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := basis_baseChange (Sy := Γ(Y, V)) (B := Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V)) ch.b
  have key : ∀ k : ULift.{u} (Fin n),
      (cmp f g p q H.w.symm).val.app (op (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V))
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap q (relativeSheaf f) ch.U _ hU1
          (sheafifyUnitApp ch.U (chartFrame f n y k))) =
      sheafifyUnitApp (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) (compareMap p hU2 (b' k)) := by
    intro k
    refine (cmp_sectionMap f g p q H.w.symm ch.U _ hU1 _).trans ?_
    have h1 : (cmp1 f g p q H.w.symm).val.app (op ch.U) (sheafifyUnitApp ch.U (chartFrame f n y k)) =
        ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q H.w.symm).app (op ch.U)) (chartFrame f n y k) :=
      congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.app (op ch.U)) (chartFrame f n y k))
        (unit_cmp1 f g p q H.w.symm)
    have h2 := cmp0_frame f g p q ch.e hV H.w.symm hU1 hU2 (ch.b k)
    rw [h1, hb' k]
    exact h2
  have hxN : ∀ g' : Γ(T, prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V),
      Function.Bijective (frameMap (relativePresheaf p) (fun k => compareMap p hU2 (b' k))
        (T.basicOpen g') (T.basicOpen_le g')) :=
    fun g' => relative_frameMap_bijective p hVa hUa hU2 b' g'
  let φN := overIsoFree (fun k => compareMap p hU2 (b' k)) hUa hxN
  let C := frameCover f n
  let j : C.pullbackFrameIndex q := ⟨y, ⟨⟨prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V, hUa⟩, hU1⟩⟩
  let φA := (C.pullbackFrameCover q).frame j
  have claim : φA.hom ≫ (cmp f g p q H.w.symm).over (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) = φN.inv := by
    refine Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) _ _
      (fun k ↦ ?_)
    rw [SheafOfModules.freeCofan_inj]
    apply LineBundleDual.unitMod_hom_ext
    have hR := overIsoFree_inv_ιFree (fun k => compareMap p hU2 (b' k)) hUa hxN k
    have hS := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionBasis_apply_overFrame
      (C.pullbackFrameCover q) j k
    have hT := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis C q j k
    have hK := key k
    have hC := frameCover_sectionBasis f n y k
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (hK.trans hR.symm)
    refine Eq.trans (b := (cmp f g p q H.w.symm).val.app (op (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V))
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover q).sectionBasis j k)) ?_ ?_
    · rw [hS]
      rfl
    · rw [← hT, ← hC]
      rfl
  have hiso : (cmp f g p q H.w.symm).over (prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) ch.U V) = φA.inv ≫ φN.inv := by
    exact ((Iso.inv_comp_eq φA).2 claim.symm).symm
  rw [hiso]
  exact (φA.symm ≪≫ φN.symm).isIso_hom

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.isIso_cmp
statement: theorem isIso_cmp : IsIso (cmp f g p q H.w.symm)
proof:
:= by
  let ι := Σ y : X, {V : Y.affineOpens // V.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (chart f n y).V₀}
  let Uc : ι → T.Opens := fun i => prodOpen (q := q) (p := p) (chart f n i.1).U i.2.1.1
  have hcov : (Opens.grothendieckTopology T).CoversTop Uc := by
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    refine top_unique fun t _ => ?_
    have hy : q.base t ∈ (chart f n (q.base t)).U := (chart f n (q.base t)).hyU
    have hpt : p.base t ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ (chart f n (q.base t)).V₀ := by
      change g.base (p.base t) ∈ (chart f n (q.base t)).V₀
      have : g.base (p.base t) = f.base (q.base t) := by
        have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.base t) H.w
        exact this.symm
      rw [this]
      exact (chart f n (q.base t)).e hy
    obtain ⟨V, hVa, hpV, hVle⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hpt
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨q.base t, ⟨⟨V, hVa⟩, hVle⟩⟩, hy, hpV⟩
  exact moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover (cmp f g p q H.w.symm) Uc hcov
    (fun i => local_iso f n H i.1 i.2.1.2 i.2.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveAfterConcentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent
statement:
theorem projectiveAfterConcentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (push :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} →
        (space R n).Modules)
    (hpush : ∀ E, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (space R n) (push E))
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M})
    (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (projectiveAfterConcentratedHigherDirectImage R n push hpush E i)
proof:
:=
  projectiveHigherDirectImage_coherent R n hn
    (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject push hpush E) i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem projectiveDerivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (push :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} →
        (space R n).Modules)
    (hpush : ∀ E, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (space R n) (push E))
    (hexact : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn (space R n).Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (space R n))
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject push hpush A)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject push hpush B)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedPushObject push hpush C)) :
    (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn).comp
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages
          0
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImage push)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent
            push hpush)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImageLongExact
            0 push hpush hexact)) =
      projectiveAfterConcentratedDerivedPushforward
        R n hn push hpush hexact
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfConcentratedHigherDirectImages_eq_map
      0 push hpush hexact]
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]
  change
    projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf (space R n) (push E) (hpush E)) =
      projectiveAfterConcentratedDerivedPushforward
        R n hn push hpush hexact
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)
  rw [projectiveDerivedPushforward_classOf]
  rw [projectiveAfterConcentratedDerivedPushforward,
    SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_classOf]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateEquiv_roundtrip
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateEquiv_roundtrip
    (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let X
proof:
:= ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
    let U := coordinateOpen R n i
    let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
    let unitX := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X
    let E := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let eF : E.functor.obj (O.over U) ≅
        E.functor.obj (unitX.over U) :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app O ≪≫
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d i).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).symm ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app unitX).symm
    let q : O.over U ≅ unitX.over U :=
      E.unitIso.app (O.over U) ≪≫
        E.inverse.mapIso eF ≪≫
        E.unitIso.symm.app (unitX.over U)
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app O).inv ≫
        E.functor.map q.hom ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app unitX).hom =
      (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d i).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).inv := by
  dsimp only
  simp
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.modulesHomApp_heq
statement:
private theorem modulesHomApp_heq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    {A B : X.Opens} (h : A = B)
    (x : Γ(M, A)) (y : Γ(M, B)) (hxy : HEq x y) :
    HEq (f.val.app (Opposite.op A) x)
      (f.val.app (Opposite.op B) y)
proof:
:= by
  subst B
  cases hxy
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitAmbientSection_heq_of_eq
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitAmbientSection_heq_of_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) {V W : X.Opens}
    (hVW : V = W) (hV : V ≤ U) (hW : W ≤ U)
    {sV : Γ(pushedUnit X U, V)} {sW : Γ(pushedUnit X U, W)}
    (hs : HEq sV sW) :
    HEq (pushedUnitAmbientSection U V hV sV)
      (pushedUnitAmbientSection U W hW sW)
proof:
:= by
  subst W
  have hs' : sV = sW := eq_of_heq hs
  subst sW
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictHomOverLE_app_terminal_heq
statement:
private theorem restrictHomOverLE_app_terminal_heq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (f : M.over U ⟶ N.over U)
    (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    HEq ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU f).val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))) x)
      (f.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) x)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app_ambient_right
statement:
private theorem projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app_ambient_right
    (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z))
    (yRestr : Γ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).restrict (coordinateOpen R n i).ι,
      (coordinateOpen R n i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z))
    (hyRestr : HEq yRestr y) :
    HEq
      (((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d i).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).inv).val.app
        (Opposite.op ((coordinateOpen R n i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z)) yRestr)
      (pushedUnitAmbientSection (coordinateOpen R n i) Z hZi
        ((Limits.Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
              (coordinateOpen R n t)) i).app Z
          ((Limits.kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft R n -
              coordinateDescentRight R n d)).app Z y)))
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateOpen R n i
  let f : U.toScheme ⟶ X := U.ι
  let W : U.toScheme.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ Z
  have hImage : f ''ᵁ W = Z := by
    dsimp only [f, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hZi
  rw [SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  unfold projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso
  change HEq
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f).inv.val.app
      (Opposite.op W)
      ((localFrameProjection R n d i).app W yRestr)) _
  rw [localFrameProjection_app_eq]
  change HEq
    ((f.appIso W).inv
      ((unitModules U.toScheme).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (f.preimage_image_eq W).symm).op
        ((Limits.Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen R n t)) i).app
          (f ''ᵁ W)
          ((Limits.kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft R n -
              coordinateDescentRight R n d)).app
            (f ''ᵁ W) yRestr)))) _
  rw [pushedUnit_image_appIso_inv_map_eq_ambientSection]
  let K := Limits.kernel.ι
    (coordinateDescentLeft R n - coordinateDescentRight R n d)
  let P := Limits.Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen R n t)) i
  have hK : HEq (K.app (f ''ᵁ W) yRestr) (K.app Z y) :=
    modulesHomApp_heq K hImage yRestr y hyRestr
  have hP : HEq
      (P.app (f ''ᵁ W) (K.app (f ''ᵁ W) yRestr))
      (P.app Z (K.app Z y)) :=
    modulesHomApp_heq P hImage _ _ hK
  exact pushedUnitAmbientSection_heq_of_eq U hImage
    (U.ι_image_le W) hZi hP

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverIso_eq_Q
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverIso_eq_Q (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d i = coordinateOverIsoQ R n d i
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.heq_app_rewrite
proof: := h ▸ H

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app_ambient
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app_ambient
    (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z)) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d i).hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hZi))) y =
      pushedUnitAmbientSection (coordinateOpen R n i) Z hZi
        ((Limits.Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
              (coordinateOpen R n t)) i).app Z
          ((Limits.kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft R n -
              coordinateDescentRight R n d)).app Z y))
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateOpen R n i
  let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  have hmain := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq
    hZi (coordinateOverIsoQ R n d i).hom y
  dsimp only at hmain
  have hround :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateEquiv_roundtrip R n d i
  dsimp only at hround
  have hmain2 := heq_app_rewrite hround _ _ hmain
  have hleft : HEq
      ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d i).hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hZi))) y)
      ((coordinateOverIsoQ R n d i).hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hZi))) y) :=
    heq_of_eq (congrArg (fun e : (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).over (coordinateOpen R n i) ≅
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).over (coordinateOpen R n i) ↦
      ConcreteCategory.hom (e.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hZi)))) y) (coordinateOverIso_eq_Q R n d i))
  let f : U.toScheme ⟶ X := U.ι
  let W : U.toScheme.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ Z
  have hImage : f ''ᵁ W = Z := by
    dsimp only [f, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hZi
  let yImage : Γ(O, f ''ᵁ W) := by
    rw [hImage]
    exact y
  let yRestr : Γ(O.restrict f, W) := yImage
  have hyRestr : HEq yRestr y := by
    dsimp only [yRestr, yImage]
    exact cast_heq _ _
  have hright := projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app_ambient_right R n d i Z hZi y yRestr hyRestr
  exact eq_of_heq (hleft.trans (hmain2.symm.trans hright))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso_hom_app
    (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z)) :
    (projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n d i Z hZi).hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) y =
      pushedUnitAmbientSection (coordinateOpen R n i) Z hZi
        ((Limits.Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
              (coordinateOpen R n t)) i).app Z
          ((Limits.kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft R n -
              coordinateDescentRight R n d)).app Z y))
proof:
:= by
  have hrestrict := restrictHomOverLE_app_terminal_heq hZi
    (show (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).over
          (coordinateOpen R n i) ⟶
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf
          (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).over
            (coordinateOpen R n i) from
      (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d i).hom) y
  have hambient :=
    projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app_ambient
      R n d i Z hZi y
  exact eq_of_heq (hrestrict.trans (heq_of_eq hambient))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_add
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_add
    (d e : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZ : Z ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) :
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (d + e) i j Z hZ =
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d i j Z hZ *
        coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n e i j Z hZ
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict]
  rw [twistTransitionSectionUnit_add, Units.val_mul, map_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_zero
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZ : Z ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) :
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n 0 i j Z hZ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict]
  have hunit : twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 0 i j = 1 := by
    unfold twistTransitionSectionUnit
    rw [twistTransitionUnit_zero]
    exact map_one _
  rw [hunit]
  exact map_one _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one
    (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    let hZ : Z ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j
proof:
:= by
      rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
      exact le_inf hZi hZj
    (projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso
      R n d i j Z hZi hZj).hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z)))
        (show Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) from 1) =
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z hZ := by
  dsimp only
  let hZ : Z ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j := by
    rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hZi hZj
  let Ci := projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n d i Z hZi
  let Cj := projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n d j Z hZj
  let oneZ : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) := 1
  let y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z) :=
    Ci.inv.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ
  have hi : Ci.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) y = oneZ := by
    dsimp only [y]
    change (Ci.inv ≫ Ci.hom).val.app
      (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ = oneZ
    rw [Ci.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have hcompat :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_mul_explicit
      R n d i j Z hZ y
  rw [← projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso_hom_app
      R n d i Z hZi y,
    ← projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso_hom_app
      R n d j Z hZj y] at hcompat
  have hmul :
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d i j Z hZ *
        coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z hZ = 1 := by
    rw [← coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_add]
    simpa only [add_neg_cancel] using
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_zero R n i j Z hZ
  have hmul' :
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z hZ *
        coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d i j Z hZ = 1 := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact hmul
  let v : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) :=
    Cj.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) y
  let u : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) :=
    Ci.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) y
  have hu : u = oneZ := by
    dsimp only [u]
    exact hi
  have hcompat' :
      u = coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d i j Z hZ * v := by
    dsimp only [u, v]
    exact hcompat
  change Cj.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) y =
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z _
  change v = coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z hZ
  calc
    v = 1 * v := (one_mul v).symm
    _ = (coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z _ *
          coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d i j Z _) *
        v := by rw [hmul']
    _ = coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z _ *
        (coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d i j Z _ *
          v) := mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ = coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z _ *
        u := by rw [hcompat']
    _ = coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z _ := by
      rw [hu]
      simp [oneZ]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_add
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_add
    (d e : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n (d + e) i j Z hZi hZj =
      projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n e i j Z hZi hZj ≪≫
        projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n d i j Z hZi hZj
proof:
:= by
  refine tensorUnitSheaf_over_iso_ext ?_
  let hZ : Z ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j := by
    rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hZi hZj
  let A := projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n e i j Z hZi hZj
  let B := projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n d i j Z hZi hZj
  let C :=
    projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n (d + e) i j Z hZi hZj
  let oneZ : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) := 1
  let ae : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) :=
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-e) i j Z hZ
  let bd : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) :=
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) i j Z hZ
  have hA :
      A.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ = ae := by
    dsimp only [A, oneZ, ae]
    exact projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one
      R n e i j Z hZi hZj
  have hB :
      B.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ = bd := by
    dsimp only [B, oneZ, bd]
    exact projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one
      R n d i j Z hZi hZj
  have hBae :
      B.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) ae = ae * bd := by
    have hlinear :=
      (B.hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z)))).hom.map_smul ae oneZ
    change
      B.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) (ae * oneZ) =
        ae * (show Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) from
          B.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ) at hlinear
    dsimp only [oneZ] at hlinear
    calc
      B.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) ae =
          ae * (show Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) from
            B.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ) := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using hlinear
      _ = ae * bd := by rw [hB]
  refine (evaluation_map_apply C.hom _ _).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (evaluation_map_apply (A ≪≫ B).hom _ _).symm)
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (iso_trans_hom_val_app A B _ _).symm
  rw [hA, hBae]
  rw [show C.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ =
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-(d + e)) i j Z hZ by
    dsimp only [C, oneZ]
    exact projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one
      R n (d + e) i j Z hZi hZj]
  dsimp only [ae, bd]
  rw [neg_add_rev]
  exact coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_add R n (-e) (-d) i j Z hZ

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame_overMap
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame_overMap
    (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i) :
    let X
proof:
:= ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
    let U := coordinateOpen R n i
    let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hZi)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hZi)
    freeOverMapIso X U Z hZi PUnit ≪≫
        F.mapIso (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame R n d i) ≪≫
          c.app (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) =
      projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d i Z hZi := by
  dsimp only
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateOpen R n i
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hZi)
  let q := freeOverMapIso X U Z hZi PUnit
  let uU := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let uZ := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over Z)
  let η := SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE hZi)
  have hu := LineBundleLocalData.freePUnitIsoUnit_overMap_naturality
    (X := X) hZi
  dsimp only at hu
  have hu' : q.hom ≫ F.map uU.hom = uZ.hom ≫ η.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono η.hom).1
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← hu]
    simp
    rfl
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver,
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change
    (q.hom ≫ F.map uU.hom) ≫
          F.map (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d i).inv ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
          (homOfLE hZi)).app (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)).hom =
      (uZ.hom ≫ η.inv) ≫
          F.map (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d i).inv ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
          (homOfLE hZi)).app (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)).hom
  rw [hu']

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver_relative
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver_relative
    (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d i Z hZi ≪≫
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d j Z hZj).symm =
      SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit ≪≫
        projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n d i j Z hZi hZj ≪≫
          SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit.symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver,
    projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorFrameOver_relative_add
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorFrameOver_relative_add
    (d e : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver Z
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d i Z hZi)
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n e i Z hZi) ≪≫
        (LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver Z
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d j Z hZj)
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n e j Z hZj)).symm =
      projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n (d + e) i Z hZi ≪≫
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n (d + e) j Z hZj).symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver_relative_comp]
  rw [projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver_relative,
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver_relative,
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver_relative]
  rw [projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_add]
  let u :
      SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over Z) PUnit ≅
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf
          (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).over Z :=
    SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
  let A := projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n e i j Z hZi hZj
  let B := projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n d i j Z hZi hZj
  change (u ≪≫ A ≪≫ u.symm) ≪≫ (u ≪≫ B ≪≫ u.symm) =
    u ≪≫ (A ≪≫ B) ≪≫ u.symm
  apply Iso.ext
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictIsoOverLE_comp
statement:
private theorem restrictIsoOverLE_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {L M N : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (e : L.over U ≅ M.over U)
    (f : M.over U ≅ N.over U) :
    LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU (e ≪≫ f) =
      LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU e ≪≫
        LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU f
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_hom, Iso.trans_hom]
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp X hVU _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictIsoOverLE_symm
statement:
private theorem restrictIsoOverLE_symm
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {L M : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens}

    LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU e.symm =
      (LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU e).symm
proof:
:= by
