name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_overMap
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_overMap
    (d e : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    [Nonempty (coordinateOpen R n i)] :
    LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hZi
        (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i) =
      (LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver Z
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d i Z hZi)
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n e i Z hZi)).symm ≪≫
          projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n (d + e) i Z hZi
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateOpen R n i
  let D := projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame R n d i
  let E := projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame R n e i
  let S := projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame R n (d + e) i
  let DZ := projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n d i Z hZi
  let EZ := projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n e i Z hZi
  let SZ := projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameOver R n (d + e) i Z hZi
  let GU := (freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫
    LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U D E
  let HU := (freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ S
  have hlocal :
      projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i = GU.symm ≪≫ HU := by
    apply Iso.ext
    simp [projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso, GU, HU,
      X, U, D, E, S]
  have hGU :
      LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hZi GU =
        (freeOverIso X Z PUnit).symm ≪≫
          LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver Z DZ EZ := by
    have h := LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_tensorFrame
      (X := X) hZi D E
    dsimp only at h
    rw [projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame_overMap,
      projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame_overMap] at h
    exact h
  have hHU :
      LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hZi HU =
        (freeOverIso X Z PUnit).symm ≪≫ SZ := by
    have h := LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_globalFreeFrame
      (X := X) hZi S
    dsimp only at h
    rw [projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrame_overMap] at h
    exact h
  rw [hlocal, restrictIsoOverLE_comp, restrictIsoOverLE_symm, hGU, hHU]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [DZ, EZ, SZ]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.comparisonHom_eq_of_relativeIso_eq
statement:
private theorem comparisonHom_eq_of_relativeIso_eq
    {C : Type*} [Category C] {K M N : C}
    (a b : K ≅ M) (c d : K ≅ N)
    (h : a ≪≫ b.symm = c ≪≫ d.symm) :
    a.inv ≫ c.hom = b.inv ≫ d.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi a.hom).1
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hh := congrArg Iso.hom h
  change a.hom ≫ b.inv = c.hom ≫ d.inv at hh
  rw [← Category.assoc, hh, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_restrict_eq
    (d e : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) hZi
        (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i).hom =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) hZj
        (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e j).hom
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hZ : Nonempty Z
  · letI : Nonempty Z := hZ
    letI : Nonempty (coordinateOpen R n i) :=
      hZ.map (fun z ↦ ⟨z.1, hZi z.2⟩)
    letI : Nonempty (coordinateOpen R n j) :=
      hZ.map (fun z ↦ ⟨z.1, hZj z.2⟩)
    change
      (LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hZi
        (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i)).hom =
      (LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hZj
        (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e j)).hom
    rw [projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_overMap,
      projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_overMap]
    apply comparisonHom_eq_of_relativeIso_eq
    exact projectiveTwistingTensorFrameOver_relative_add
      R n d e i j Z hZi hZj
  · letI : IsEmpty Z := ⟨fun z ↦ hZ ⟨z⟩⟩
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_isEmpty_open
      (X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (U := Z) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_compatible
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_compatible
    (d e : ℤ) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) ↦
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.localHomSection
          (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOpen R n i.down)
          (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i.down).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro Z i j f g
  have hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i.down := f.le
  have hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j.down := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hZi from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hZj from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  apply congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over Z)).map
  exact projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_restrict_eq
    R n d e i.down j.down Z hZi hZj

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorHom_over
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorHom_over
    (d e : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveTwistingTensorHom R n d e).over (coordinateOpen R n i) =
      (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i).hom
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens :=
    fun j ↦ coordinateOpen R n j.down
  let hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2 (by
      change ⨆ j : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n j.down = ⊤
      simpa only [U, iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n)
  change
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.glueHom X U hU
      (fun j ↦ (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e j.down).hom)
      (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_compatible R n d e)).over
        (U (ULift.up i)) =
      (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i).hom
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over X U hU
    (fun j ↦ (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e j.down).hom)
    (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_compatible R n d e) (ULift.up i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorHom_isIso
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorHom_isIso
    (d e : ℤ) :
    IsIso (projectiveTwistingTensorHom R n d e)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens :=
    fun i ↦ coordinateOpen R n i.down
  let hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2 (by
      change ⨆ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n i.down = ⊤
      simpa only [U, iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n)
  change IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.glueHom X U hU
    (fun i ↦ (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i.down).hom)
    (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_compatible R n d e))
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso X U hU
    (fun i ↦ (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i.down).hom)
    (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso_compatible R n d e)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorIso_hom_over
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorIso_hom_over
    (d e : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveTwistingTensorIso R n d e).hom.over (coordinateOpen R n i) =
      (projectiveTwistingTensorFrameIso R n d e i).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact projectiveTwistingTensorHom_over R n d e i

name: LocalisationExactAR5.restrict_uMap_comp_counit
statement:
theorem restrict_uMap_comp_counit {E : X.Modules} {M : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules}
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E ≅ M) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (uMap U e) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app M = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).left_triangle_components E
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.naturality e.hom
  have hn' : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map e.hom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E) ≫ e.hom := hn
  simp only [uMap, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  erw [hn', ← Category.assoc, h, Category.id_comp]

name: LocalisationExactAR5.biprod_isFinitePresentation_affine
statement:
theorem biprod_isFinitePresentation_affine {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (A B : (Spec R).Modules)
    [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] : (A ⊞ B).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let GA := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj A).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj A) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation A
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GA :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ A).finitePresentation_iff.mpr inferInstance
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj B) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation B
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GB :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ B).finitePresentation_iff.mpr inferInstance
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ↑(GA ⊞ GB) :=
    (Iso.toLinearEquiv (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd GA GB)).finitePresentation_iff.mpr
      (Module.FinitePresentation.prod GA GB)
  have htilde : ((tilde.functor R).obj (GA ⊞ GB)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation _
  letI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent A
  letI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent B
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj GA ≅ A := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj GB ≅ B := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  haveI : (tilde.functor R).Additive := inferInstance
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT => tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology _
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts (tilde.functor R) :=
    preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts (tilde.functor R)
  let e : (tilde.functor R).obj (GA ⊞ GB) ≅ A ⊞ B :=
    (tilde.functor R).mapBiprod GA GB ≪≫ biprod.mapIso eA eB
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e htilde

name: LocalisationExactAR5.biprod_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem biprod_isFinitePresentation {Y : Scheme.{u}} (A B : Y.Modules)
    [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] : (A ⊞ B).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Y.Opens))
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y) (fun V ↦ V.2) _ fun V ↦ ?_
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec
  letI : (G.obj A).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ A
  letI : (G.obj B).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ B
  haveI : G.Additive := CoherentExtensionAR5.restrictFunctor_additive _
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts G :=
    preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts G
  have h := biprod_isFinitePresentation_affine (G.obj A) (G.obj B)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (G.mapBiprod A B).symm h

name: LocalisationExactAR5.isIso_restrict_uMap
proof:
:= by
  have h := restrict_uMap_comp_counit U e
  have hc : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app M) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit _
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc (inferInstance : IsIso e.hom) h

name: LocalisationExactAR5.class_sub_mem_supported_of_iso
statement:
theorem class_sub_mem_supported_of_iso [IsNoetherian X] (E1 E2 : X.Modules)
    (hE1 : IsCoherentLike X E1) (hE2 : IsCoherentLike X E2)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E1 ≅ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E2) :
    g0ClassOf X E1 hE1 - g0ClassOf X E2 hE2 ∈ supportedClasses U.ι
proof:
:= by
  haveI : E1.IsFinitePresentation := hE1
  haveI : E2.IsFinitePresentation := hE2
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E2).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ E2
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E2)
      |>.IsQuasicoherent :=
    QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_opens_ι U (NoetherianSpace.isCompact _) _
  let α := uMap U e
  let β := uMap U (Iso.refl ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E2))
  haveI hα : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map α) := isIso_restrict_uMap U e
  haveI hβ : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map β) := isIso_restrict_uMap U _
  let E3 : X.Modules := pullback α β
  have hP : IsPullback (pullback.fst α β) (pullback.snd α β) α β := IsPullback.of_hasPullback α β
  haveI : PreservesLimit (cospan α β) (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι) :=
    ((CoherentExtensionAR5.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits U.ι).preservesFiniteLimits
      WalkingCospan).preservesLimit
  have hPU := hP.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (pullback.fst α β)) :=
    hPU.isIso_fst_of_isIso
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (pullback.snd α β)) :=
    hPU.isIso_snd_of_isIso
  haveI : E3.IsFinitePresentation := by
    let k : E3 ≅ kernel (biprod.desc α (-β)) :=
      IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (Abelian.PullbackToBiproductIsKernel.isLimitPullbackToBiproduct α β)
        (limit.isLimit _)
    haveI : (E1 ⊞ E2).IsFinitePresentation := biprod_isFinitePresentation E1 E2
    haveI := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian
      (A := E1 ⊞ E2) (B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E2)) (biprod.desc α (-β))
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso k.symm inferInstance
  have hE3 : IsCoherentLike X E3 := inferInstanceAs E3.IsFinitePresentation
  have h1 := class_sub_mem_supportedClasses_of_restrict_isIso U.ι (pullback.fst α β) hE3 hE1
    KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike
  have h2 := class_sub_mem_supportedClasses_of_restrict_isIso U.ι (pullback.snd α β) hE3 hE2
    KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike
  have := sub_mem h2 h1
  simpa using this

name: LocalisationExactAR5.exists_ses_extension
statement:
theorem exists_ses_extension [IsNoetherian X] (S : ShortComplex (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) [S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation] [S.X₂.IsFinitePresentation]
    [S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation] (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation]
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E ≅ S.X₂) :
    ∃ (E' E'' : X.Modules) (_ : E'.IsFinitePresentation) (_ : E''.IsFinitePresentation)
      (ι : E' ⟶ E) (π : E ⟶ E'') (z : ι ≫ π = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk ι π z).ShortExact ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E' ≅ S.X₁) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E'' ≅ S.X₃)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj S.X₃ |>.IsQuasicoherent :=
    QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_opens_ι U (NoetherianSpace.isCompact _) _
  let p : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj S.X₃ := uMap U e ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map S.g
  haveI : (kernel p).IsFinitePresentation :=
    ClosedImmersionCoverF11.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian p
  let ι : kernel p ⟶ E := kernel.ι p
  haveI : (cokernel ι).IsFinitePresentation := KSpecialization.cokernel_isFinitePresentation ι
  have hcomm : R.map p ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app S.X₃ = e.hom ≫ S.g := by
    have hn := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.naturality S.g
    have hn' : R.map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map S.g) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app S.X₃ =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app S.X₂ ≫ S.g := hn
    have h0 := restrict_uMap_comp_counit U e
    simp only [p, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    erw [hn', ← Category.assoc, h0]
    rfl
  haveI hc : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app S.X₃) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit _
  let φ0 : Arrow.mk (R.map p) ≅ Arrow.mk S.g :=
    Arrow.isoMk e (@asIso _ _ _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app S.X₃) hc) hcomm.symm
  let φ1 : R.obj (kernel p) ≅ S.X₁ :=
    PreservesKernel.iso R p ≪≫
      KernelFork.mapIsoOfIsLimit (limit.isLimit _) hS.fIsKernel φ0
  have hφ1 : R.map ι ≫ e.hom = φ1.hom ≫ S.f := by
    have h1 : (KernelFork.mapOfIsLimit (limit.cone (parallelPair (R.map p) 0))
        hS.fIsKernel φ0.hom) ≫ S.f = kernel.ι (R.map p) ≫ e.hom :=
      KernelFork.mapOfIsLimit_ι _ _ _
    simp only [φ1, Iso.trans_hom, KernelFork.mapIsoOfIsLimit_hom, Category.assoc]
    erw [h1]
    rw [PreservesKernel.iso_hom, ← Category.assoc, kernelComparison_comp_ι]
  let φ2 : R.obj (cokernel ι) ≅ S.X₃ :=
    PreservesCokernel.iso R ι ≪≫ cokernel.mapIso (R.map ι) S.f φ1 e hφ1 ≪≫
      IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _) hS.gIsCokernel
  refine ⟨kernel p, cokernel ι, inferInstance, inferInstance, ι, cokernel.π ι,
    cokernel.condition ι, { exact := ShortComplex.exact_cokernel ι }, ⟨φ1⟩, ⟨φ2⟩⟩

name: LocalisationExactAR5.exists_isCoherentLike_extension
statement:
theorem exists_isCoherentLike_extension [IsNoetherian X] (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike (U : Scheme.{u}) F) :
    ∃ E : X.Modules, IsCoherentLike X E ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  obtain ⟨E, hE, he⟩ := CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_extension_of_opens U F
  exact ⟨E, hE, he⟩

name: LocalisationExactAR5.flatPullbackG0_opens_ι_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_opens_ι_surjective [IsNoetherian X] :
    Function.Surjective (flatPullbackG0 U.ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply GLocalisationOpen.surjective_of_classOf_mem_range
  rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_isCoherentLike_extension U F hF
  refine ⟨g0ClassOf X E hE, ?_⟩
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike (U : Scheme.{u}))
    _ hF (show IsCoherentLike (U : Scheme.{u}) (0 : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (Limits.isZero_zero _)
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app E).symm ≪≫ e)

name: LocalisationExactAR5.extObj_spec
statement:
theorem extObj_spec (F : {M : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules // IsCoherentLike (U : Scheme.{u}) M}) :
    IsCoherentLike X (extObj U F) ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (extObj U F) ≅ F.1)
proof:
:=
  (exists_isCoherentLike_extension U F.1 F.2).choose_spec

name: LocalisationExactAR5.psi_comp_flatPullbackG0
statement:
theorem psi_comp_flatPullbackG0 :
    (psi U).comp (flatPullbackG0 U.ι) = QuotientAddGroup.mk' (supportedClasses U.ι)
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M}
    (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X))
    (A := G0 X ⧸ supportedClasses U.ι) ?_
  intro x
  change psi U (flatPullbackG0 U.ι (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2)) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2)
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  let P : {M : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules // IsCoherentLike (U : Scheme.{u}) M} :=
    ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj x.1, by
      letI : x.1.IsFinitePresentation := x.2
      exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global U.ι x.1⟩
  change psi U (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ P) = _
  unfold psi
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf]
  rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem]
  obtain ⟨hP, ⟨e⟩⟩ := extObj_spec U P
  exact class_sub_mem_supported_of_iso U (extObj U P) x.1 hP x.2
    (e ≪≫ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app x.1).symm)

name: LocalisationExactAR5.ker_flatPullbackG0_opens_ι
statement: theorem ker_flatPullbackG0_opens_ι : (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).ker = supportedClasses U.ι
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (psi_comp_flatPullbackG0 U)
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at h
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.1 hx, map_zero] at h
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff x).1 h.symm
  · exact supportedClasses_le_ker_flatPullbackG0 U.ι

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.restrictToPreimage_compIso_naturality
statement:
lemma restrictToPreimage_compIso_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map φ) ≫
        (restrictToPreimage_compIso f N h).hom =
      (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).map φ
proof:
:= by
  let e : Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
      (preimageHomOfLE f h) (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).symm ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (by
      rw [preimageHomOfLE, Scheme.homOfLE_ι])
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).map φ ≫ e.hom.app N =
    e.hom.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).map φ
  exact e.hom.naturality φ

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i V x =
      Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).map φ)) i x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_coefficient_naturality
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_coefficient_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (i : ℕ)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i W) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f N i h
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i W x) =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i V
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i h x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_map, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_apply]
  have hopen := openRestrictionHAddHom_naturality
    (preimageHomOfLE f h)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map φ) i x
  let T := SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf
  let a : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).obj (restrictToPreimage f M W) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).obj (restrictToPreimage f N W) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map φ)
  let b : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).obj (restrictToPreimage f N W) ⟶
      restrictToPreimage f N V := (restrictToPreimage_compIso f N h).hom
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f h)).obj (restrictToPreimage f M W) ⟶
      restrictToPreimage f M V := (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom
  let d : restrictToPreimage f M V ⟶ restrictToPreimage f N V :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).map φ
  let y := openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f h) (restrictToPreimage f M W) i x
  have hnat : a ≫ b = c ≫ d := restrictToPreimage_compIso_naturality f φ h
  calc
    _ = Sheaf.H.map (T.map b) i (Sheaf.H.map (T.map a) i y) := congrArg _ hopen.symm
    _ = Sheaf.H.map (T.map (a ≫ b)) i y :=
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ Sheaf.H.map z i y) (Functor.map_comp T a b)).trans
        (Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply (T.map a) (T.map b) y)).symm
    _ = Sheaf.H.map (T.map (c ≫ d)) i y :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ Sheaf.H.map (T.map z) i y) hnat
    _ = _ :=
      (congrArg (fun z ↦ Sheaf.H.map z i y) (Functor.map_comp T c d)).trans
        (Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply (T.map c) (T.map d) y)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafMap_app_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafMap_app_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (i : ℕ)
    (U : Y.Opensᵒᵖ) (x : (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheaf f M i).obj U) :
    (affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafMap f φ i).app U x =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i U.unop x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_id_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_id_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens)
    (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f (𝟙 M) i V x = x
proof:
:= by
  change Sheaf.H.map
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).map (𝟙 M))) i x = x
  exact (congrArg (fun ψ => Sheaf.H.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map ψ) i x)
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _)).trans
    ((congrArg (fun ψ => Sheaf.H.map ψ i x)
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _)).trans (Sheaf.H.map_id_apply x))

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_comp_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N P : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P)
    (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens) (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f (φ ≫ ψ) i V x =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f ψ i V
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i V x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_apply,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  exact (congrArg (fun θ => Sheaf.H.map θ i x)
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp _ _ _)).trans (Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply _ _ x)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_add_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap_add_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ ψ : M ⟶ N)
    (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens) (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i V) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f (φ + ψ) i V x =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i V x +
        affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f ψ i V x
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro A B g h
    rfl
  let T := SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf
  letI : T.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro A B g h
    rfl
  change Sheaf.H.map
      (T.map (F.map (φ + ψ))) i x =
    Sheaf.H.map
        (T.map (F.map φ)) i x +
      Sheaf.H.map
        (T.map (F.map ψ)) i x
  have e1 : F.map (φ + ψ) = F.map φ + F.map ψ := Functor.map_add F
  have e2 : T.map (F.map (φ + ψ)) = T.map (F.map φ) + T.map (F.map ψ) :=
    (congrArg T.map e1).trans (Functor.map_add T)
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ Sheaf.H.map z i x) e2).trans (Sheaf.H.map_add_apply _ _ x)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModulePresheafFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechComplex_smul_apply
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechComplex_smul_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (y : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
        (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p) :
    ((((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
          (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c)).f p).hom y) =
      c • y
proof:
:= by
  let e :=
    coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
      R Q n d p
  apply e.injective
  funext a
  rw [coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [e.map_smul]
  change _ = c • e y a
  rw [coordinateCechBaseModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  have hπ :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π R n p
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
          (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c) a
  have hπy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hπ y
  change
    (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
        (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom
        ((((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
          (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
              (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c)).f p).hom y) =
      c •
        (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
            (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom y at hπy
  exact hπy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality
statement:
theorem forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (c : R) :
    let C
proof:
:=
      projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechModuleComplex
        R Q n d
    let F :=
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat R) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let φ :=
      (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
            (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c)
    F.map (c • 𝟙 C) ≫
        (forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexIso
          R Q n d).hom =
      (forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexIso
        R Q n d).hom ≫ φ := by
  dsimp only
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro p
  ext y
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_map_f,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  exact (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechComplex_smul_apply R Q n d p c y).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechModuleComplex
      R Q n d).homology p)) :
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv
        R Q n d p (c • x) =
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n p).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
            (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c)).hom
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv
          R Q n d p x)
proof:
:= by
  let C :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechModuleComplex
      R Q n d
  let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat R) AddCommGrpCat
  let G := F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let e := forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexIso R Q n d
  let α : C ⟶ C := c • 𝟙 C
  let φ :=
    (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
          (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c)
  let e₁ := ((C.sc p).mapHomologyIso F).symm
  let e₂ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (iso := e) p
  have hx := projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomology_smul_eq_map R Q n d p c x
  change e₂.hom (e₁.hom (c • x)) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ p).hom
      (e₂.hom (e₁.hom x))
  rw [hx]
  let αsc :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
      (ModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map α)
  have h₁ := ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality αsc F
  have h₁x := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₁ x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h₁x
  change e₁.hom
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α p).hom x) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map α) p).hom
      (e₁.hom x) at h₁x
  rw [h₁x]
  have hsquare :
      G.map α ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ φ :=
    forgetProjectiveTwistingBaseModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality R Q n d c
  have h₂ :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map α) p ≫ e₂.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ p := by
    change
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map α) p ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom p =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom p ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ p
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      ← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp, hsquare]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₂ (e₁.hom x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechHomology_smul_eq_map
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechHomology_smul_eq_map
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (z : ↑(((coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
        (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).homology p)) :
    c • z =
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n p).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
            (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) c)).hom z
proof:
:= by
  let e :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv
      R Q n d p
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := e.surjective z
  have hlin :=
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv
      (R := R) (Q := Q) n d p).map_smul c x
  change e (c • x) = c • e x at hlin
  rw [← hlin]
  exact projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul R Q n d p c x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv_smul
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechModuleComplex
      R Q n d).homology (p + 1))) :
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv R Q n d p
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv (R := R) (Q := Q) n d p (c • x)) =
      c • projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv R Q n d p
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv (R := R) (Q := Q) n d p x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv
    (R := R) (Q := Q) n d p).map_smul]
  rw [projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechHomology_smul_eq_map]
  let M :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d
  let F := (Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M
  let y : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H F (p + 1) :=
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv R Q n d p
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv
        (R := R) (Q := Q) n d p x)
  have hnat :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule_coordinateCechAcyclic R Q n d)
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule_coordinateCechAcyclic R Q n d)
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c) p
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechModuleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv
        (R := R) (Q := Q) n d p x)
  change _ =
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)
      (p + 1) y at hnat
  have hsmul : c • y =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)
        (p + 1) y :=
    @smul_eq_H_map (space R n) (CommRingCat.of R)
      (projectiveSpaceOverSpec R n) M c (p + 1) y
  exact hnat.trans hsmul.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveBaseChangeUnit_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveBaseChangeUnit_isBaseChange
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away g
    let N :=

        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule S n
            (ModuleCat.of S
              ↑((ModuleCat.extendScalars
                (algebraMap R S)).obj (ModuleCat.of R Q))) d)) (p + 1)

    let _ : IsScalarTower R S N :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    IsBaseChange S
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear
        R Q g n d p) := by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let N :=
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule S n
          (ModuleCat.of S
            ↑((ModuleCat.extendScalars
              (algebraMap R S)).obj (ModuleCat.of R Q))) d)) (p + 1)
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N (algebraMap R S)
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  change IsBaseChange S
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear
      R Q g n d p)
  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv
      R Q g n d p)

name: AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.pointAt_ne_of_isUnit

theorem pointAt_ne_of_isUnit (c c' : k) (hu : IsUnit (c' - c)) (x y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    pointAt k c x ≠ pointAt k c' y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  unfold pointAt at h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
  have h2 := (chart k 1).isOpenEmbedding.injective h
  have h3 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c) x = PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c') y := h2

    rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
    simp
  rw [h3, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap] at h4

name: AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.eps0_ker_ne_bot
statement:
theorem eps0_ker_ne_bot [Nontrivial k] [IsIntegral Y] :
    (KSpecialization.G2GC1.eps0 Y J k φk).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fibreιGlobal_zero_eq]
  intro h
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0) := by
    rw [fibreιGlobal_zero_eq]; exact isClosedImmersion_eps0 Y J k φk
  haveI : IsIso (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0) := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr h
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty Y := inferInstance
  set z := fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1 y with hz
  set y' := (inv (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0)) z with hy'
  have hy'z : fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 y' = z := by
    rw [hy', ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1⟩ : ∃ s : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k),
      s ≫ pointAt k 0 = fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk :=
    ⟨_, (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk 0).w⟩
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2⟩ : ∃ s : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k),
      s ≫ pointAt k 1 = fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1 ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk :=
    ⟨_, (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk 1).w⟩
  have e1 := congrArg (fun q => q y') hs1
  have e2 := congrArg (fun q => q y) hs2
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at e1 e2
  rw [hy'z] at e1
  exact pointAt_ne_of_isUnit k 0 1 (by simp) _ _ (e1.trans e2.symm)

    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    (G₀ : ZeroGate A J k φ) (htw : HtwOf J hA G₀ (oeGate A φ J))
    (hbcP : HbcPGate J hA C CN) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (Zs A J)) :
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j)
        (pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (thetaL J hA C j * locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W J hA
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_W J hA
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_eps0 A J k φ
  let Cq := C.toQuasiregular
  have hE := G2C1.hErankC Cq
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_adaptedCover_Z J hA CN hE
  let resA := KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
  let U := IntegralARRM346.totalComplement A J
  let ε := εL J C CN
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ε := by
    change IsClosedImmersion (G2C1.EιOfIsoC Cq CN)
    unfold G2C1.EιOfIsoC
    infer_instance
  
  let GP := oeGate A φ J
  haveI := GP.qc
  haveI := GP.fp
  haveI := G₀.qc
  haveI := G₀.fp
  have hker₀ : (G2GC1.eps0 A J k φ).ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G₀.σ).subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι, G₀.hid]
  have hkerP : (componentToTotal A J).ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf GP.σ).subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι, GP.hid]
  have hkerE : ε.ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf GP.σ).subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [← hkerP]
    exact Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso _ _
  have hzs : (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ ε = ARRRIG.secInfG A J ≫ F := G2C1.hzsC Cq CN
  have gates := G2GC1.mixedGysin_gates A J k φ G₀.σ GP.σ G₀.hL GP.hL G₀.hreg GP.hreg hker₀ hkerP
    ε hkerE (Cov CN).zeroSection hzs
  obtain ⟨hc₀, hcP, hbc₀G, hbcPG, hrig⟩ := gates
  haveI := G2GC1.isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero A J k φ G₀.σ hker₀
  haveI := G2GC1.isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf A J GP.σ hkerP
  haveI := isIntegral_EsL J hA C CN
  
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty ((Cov CN).basisIndex i) := fun i => ⟨Sum.inr PUnit.unit⟩
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (Es CN) :=
    lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent
      ((Cov CN).rankZeroNilpotent_scheme hpos (Nat.succ_pos _) hE (rankZeroNilpotent_Z J hA))
  have hEN : k0ClassOf (Zs A J) (Nsh J ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (Zs A J))
      hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = nclL J C + 1 := by
    rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.k0ClassOf_biprod (G2C1.hNrankC Cq).isFiniteLocallyFree
      hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree hE.isFiniteLocallyFree]
    rfl
  have hkoszul : ∀ z : K0 (Zs A J),
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Es CN)) (adamsRingHom (rankEL J hA C CN) j (spL J hA C CN z)) =
      locAddHom j (spL J hA C CN)
        (thetaL J hA C j * algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs A J)) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j z)) :=
    fun z => ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.hkoszul_zsPush CN _ hE hj (rankZ A J) (hnilZL J hA)
      (rankEL J hA C CN) hnilP (nclL J C) hEN z
  
  have hU : Set.range F = ((U : (Ms A J).Opens) : Set (Ms A J))ᶜ := by
    ext x
    simp [U, F, IntegralARRM346.totalComplement]
  have hUd : ∀ w, F w ∉ U := fun w h => by
    have : F w ∈ ((U : (Ms A J).Opens) : Set (Ms A J))ᶜ := hU ▸ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact this h
  have hsupp := KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_closedImmersion
    F U hU
  have hrank := rankBetweenL J CN hCN hd
  have h7 := KSpecialization.derivedPushforward_comp_section (C := Cov CN) hrank
    (Cov CN).zeroSection (Cov CN).zeroSection_toBase
  have hcA : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 A) := fun a b h => by
    have := congrArg resA.res h
    simpa [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, resA.left] using this
  
  have hmix : ∀ w : K0 (Ws A J), k0ToG0 A (j₀K A φ J (FpL J hA C w)) =
      finitePushforward (iZ A J) (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) (r₀K A φ J w)) := by
    have key : (k0ToG0 A).comp ((j₀K A φ J).toAddMonoidHom.comp (FpL J hA C)) =
        (finitePushforward (iZ A J)).comp ((k0ToG0 (Zs A J)).comp (r₀K A φ J).toAddMonoidHom) := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := V
      change k0ToG0 A (j₀K A φ J (FpL J hA C (k0ClassOf _ V hV))) =
        finitePushforward (iZ A J) (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) (r₀K A φ J (k0ClassOf _ V hV)))
      have hm : k0ToG0 _ (FpL J hA C (k0ClassOf _ V hV)) = finitePushforward F
          (g0ClassOf (Ws A J) V hV.isFinitePresentation) := by
        rw [k0ToG0_FpL, k0ToG0_classOf]
      simp only [j₀K, r₀K, pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
      exact KSpecialization.ARRG45.hbc0_unconditional A J k φ V hV _ hm
    exact fun w => DFunLike.congr_fun key w
  have hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀K A φ J (FpL J hA C w) = (resA.res.comp ((finitePushforward (iZ A J)).comp
      (k0ToG0 (Zs A J)))) (r₀K A φ J w) := fun w =>
    MixedLCI.hbc₀_of_mixed (FpL J hA C) (resA.res.comp ((finitePushforward (iZ A J)).comp
      (k0ToG0 (Zs A J)))) (j₀K A φ J) (r₀K A φ J) (k0ToG0 A) (k0ToG0 (Zs A J))
      (finitePushforward (iZ A J)) hmix
      (fun z => DFunLike.congr_fun resA.right _) hcA w
  
  have hbcP' : ∀ w, pullbackK0RingHom ε (FpL J hA C w) = spL J hA C CN (r₁K A J w) := by
    have key : (pullbackK0RingHom ε).toAddMonoidHom.comp (FpL J hA C) =
        (spL J hA C CN).comp (r₁K A J).toAddMonoidHom := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := V
      change pullbackK0RingHom ε (FpL J hA C (k0ClassOf _ V hV)) =
        spL J hA C CN (r₁K A J (k0ClassOf _ V hV))
      simp only [r₁K, pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
      exact hbcP V hV
    exact fun w => DFunLike.congr_fun key w
  
  have hresF : ∀ w, pullbackK0RingHom U.ι (FpL J hA C w) = 0 := by
    have hUc := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_open_total J hA U
    have key : (pullbackK0RingHom U.ι).toAddMonoidHom.comp (FpL J hA C) = 0 := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := V
      change pullbackK0RingHom U.ι (FpL J hA C (k0ClassOf _ V hV)) = 0
      rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply, FpL, DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.regPushOfRegularCover_k0ClassOf]
      exact PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_eq_zero_of_flat hUc
        (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total J hA) U.ι _ _ _
        ((KSpecialization.AR5R.isZero_restrict_pushforward_of_disjoint F U hUd V).of_iso
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app _).symm)
    exact fun w => DFunLike.congr_fun key w
  refine MixedLCI.adams_transport_mixed_loc_of_G j (FpL J hA C)
    (resA.res.comp ((finitePushforward (iZ A J)).comp (k0ToG0 (Zs A J)))) (spL J hA C CN)
    (pullbackK0RingHom U.ι) (j₀K A φ J) (pullbackK0RingHom ε) (r₀K A φ J) (r₁K A J) (prK A J)
    (adamsRingHom (rankM A J) j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j) (adamsRingHom (rankEL J hA C CN) j)
    (adamsRingHom (rankU A J φ hne) j) (adamsRingHom (rankW A J) j)
    (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) (thetaL J hA C j)
    (k0ToG0 _) (k0ToG0 A) (k0ToG0 _) (k0ToG0 _) (flatPullbackG0 U.ι) (finitePushforward F)
    (G2GC1.gysD G₀.σ (G2GC1.eps0 A J k φ) hker₀ G₀.hL) (G2GC1.gysD GP.σ ε hkerE GP.hL)
    (finitePushforward (iZ A J)) (finitePushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection)
    (G2GC1.rLine G₀.σ F (totalToClosedBase A J) G₀.hL)
    (G2GC1.rLine GP.σ F (totalToClosedBase A J) GP.hL)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hbc₀G hbcPG ?_ (hrig htw) hcA ?_ hresF hbc₀ hbcP' ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (hpr₀ A φ J)
    (ARRASM.pr_section _ _ (secInf_pr A J)) hkoszul x
  · intro m
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
  · intro g hg
    have : g ∈ (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).ker := hg
    rw [hsupp] at this
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := this
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  · intro m
    rw [hc₀ m]
    simp only [j₀K, pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  · intro m
    rw [hcP m, pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  · exact Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank)
      (fun z => DFunLike.congr_fun h7 z)
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat U.ι (rankU A J φ hne) (rankM A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat _ (rankA A) (rankM A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat ε (rankEL J hA C CN) (rankM A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat _ (rankZ A J) (rankW A J) hj
  · exact ARRASM.hψnat (secInf A J) (rankZ A J) (rankW A J) hj

name: AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.arr_caseII_ambient_lci
statement:
theorem arr_caseII_ambient_lci (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤)) (hd : 0 < r)
    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    (htw : ∃ G₀ : ZeroGate A J k φ, HtwOf J hA G₀ (oeGate A φ J))
    (hbcP : ∃ CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J),
      (∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = r) ∧ HbcPGate J hA C CN)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (Zs A J)) :
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j)
        (pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (thetaL J hA C j * locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G₀, hG₀⟩ := htw
  obtain ⟨CN, hCN, hP⟩ := hbcP
  exact arr_caseII_lci_of_gates J hA hAreg C φ CN hCN hd hne G₀ hG₀ hP hj x

name: AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.arr_caseII_ambient_lci_K0
statement:
theorem arr_caseII_ambient_lci_K0 (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤)) (hd : 0 < r)
    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    (htw : ∃ G₀ : ZeroGate A J k φ, HtwOf J hA G₀ (oeGate A φ J))
    (hbcP : ∃ CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J),
      (∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = r) ∧ HbcPGate J hA C CN)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 (Zs A J)) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j A)
        (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j ((KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (finitePushforward (iZ A J)
          (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs A J)) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j x) * thetaL J hA C j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := arr_caseII_ambient_lci J hA hAreg C φ hd hne htw hbcP hj (algebraMap _ _ x)
  have e1 : pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
      (algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs A J)) x) =
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j A) ((KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (finitePushforward (iZ A J)
        (k0ToG0 (Zs A J) x))) := by
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    rfl
  rw [e1, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, mul_comm] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_of_shortExact {A B C : Type v} [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module R B] [AddCommGroup C] [Module R C]
    [Module.Flat R B] [Module.Flat R C]
    (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (g : B →ₗ[R] C) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hfg : Function.Exact f g) : Module.Flat R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_injective']
  intro I
  
  have h1 : Function.Injective (f.lTensor I) :=
    LinearMap.lTensor_injective_of_exact_of_flat g hg f hf hfg I
  
  have h2 : Function.Injective (LinearMap.rTensor B I.subtype) :=
    Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_injective'.mp inferInstance I
  have hcomm : (LinearMap.rTensor B I.subtype).comp (f.lTensor I) =
      (f.lTensor R).comp (LinearMap.rTensor A I.subtype) := by
    rw [LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor, LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor]
  have h3 : Function.Injective ((f.lTensor R).comp (LinearMap.rTensor A I.subtype)) := by
    rw [← hcomm]
    exact h2.comp h1
  exact Function.Injective.of_comp h3

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.toCycles_surjective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.toCycles_surjective (hdd : ∀ p, (d (p + 1)).comp (d p) = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ p, Function.Exact (d p) (d (p + 1))) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (PushforwardFree.toCycles K d hdd p)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (hexact p y).mp hy
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.subtype_comp_toCycles
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.subtype_comp_toCycles (hdd : ∀ p, (d (p + 1)).comp (d p) = 0) (p : ℕ) :
    (LinearMap.ker (d (p + 1))).subtype.comp (PushforwardFree.toCycles K d hdd p) = d p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_ker_step
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_ker_step [∀ p, Module.Flat R (K p)]
    (hexact : ∀ p, Function.Exact (d p) (d (p + 1))) (p : ℕ)
    (h : Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (d (p + 1)))) :
    Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (d p))
proof:
:= by
  have hdd : ∀ p, (d (p + 1)).comp (d p) = 0 := fun p ↦ by
    ext x
    exact (hexact p).apply_apply_eq_zero x
  refine PushforwardFree.flat_of_shortExact (LinearMap.ker (d p)).subtype (PushforwardFree.toCycles K d hdd p)
    Subtype.val_injective (PushforwardFree.toCycles_surjective K d hdd hexact p) ?_
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨⟨x, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    simp [PushforwardFree.toCycles] at this
    exact this
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [PushforwardFree.toCycles, LinearMap.codRestrict_apply]
    exact y.2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_ker_of_tensorExact
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_ker_of_tensorExact [∀ p, Module.Flat R (K p)]
    (hexact : ∀ p, Function.Exact (d p) (d (p + 1))) (m : ℕ)
    (hI : ∀ I : Ideal R, Function.Exact ((d m).rTensor I) ((d (m + 1)).rTensor I)) :
    Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (d (m + 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hdd : ∀ p, (d (p + 1)).comp (d p) = 0 := fun p ↦ by
    ext x
    exact (hexact p).apply_apply_eq_zero x
  set Z := LinearMap.ker (d (m + 2))
  let ι := Z.subtype
  let π := PushforwardFree.toCycles K d hdd (m + 1)
  have hιπ : ι.comp π = d (m + 1) := PushforwardFree.subtype_comp_toCycles K d hdd (m + 1)
  have hπd : π.comp (d m) = 0 := by
    ext x
    change d (m + 1) (d m x) = 0
    exact (hexact m).apply_apply_eq_zero x
  rw [Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_injective']
  intro I
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (ι.rTensor I) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.rTensor_surjective I
      (PushforwardFree.toCycles_surjective K d hdd hexact (m + 1)) y
    have hx : (d (m + 1)).rTensor I x = 0 := by
      rw [← hιπ, LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      exact hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ((hI I) x).mp hx
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, hπd, LinearMap.rTensor_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
  
  have h2 : Function.Injective (LinearMap.lTensor (K (m + 2)) I.subtype) :=
    Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_injective'.mp inferInstance I
  have hcomm : (LinearMap.lTensor (K (m + 2)) I.subtype).comp (ι.rTensor I) =
      (ι.rTensor R).comp (LinearMap.lTensor Z I.subtype) := by
    rw [LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor, LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor]
  have h3 : Function.Injective ((ι.rTensor R).comp (LinearMap.lTensor Z I.subtype)) := by
    rw [← hcomm]
    exact h2.comp hinj
  exact Function.Injective.of_comp h3

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_ker_zero_of_exact
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_ker_zero_of_exact [∀ p, Module.Flat R (K p)]
    (hexact : ∀ p, Function.Exact (d p) (d (p + 1))) (m : ℕ)
    (hI : ∀ I : Ideal R, Function.Exact ((d m).rTensor I) ((d (m + 1)).rTensor I)) :
    Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (d 0))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ j p, p + j = m + 2 → Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (d p)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
        intro p hp
        obtain rfl : p = m + 2 := by omega
        exact PushforwardFree.flat_ker_of_tensorExact K d hexact m hI
    | succ j ih =>
        intro p hp
        exact PushforwardFree.flat_ker_step K d hexact p (ih (p + 1) (by omega))
  exact key (m + 2) 0 (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.projective_ker_zero_of_exact
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.projective_ker_zero_of_exact [IsNoetherianRing R] [∀ p, Module.Flat R (K p)]
    (hexact : ∀ p, Function.Exact (d p) (d (p + 1))) (m : ℕ)
    (hI : ∀ I : Ideal R, Function.Exact ((d m).rTensor I) ((d (m + 1)).rTensor I))
    [Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker (d 0))] :
    Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker (d 0))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := PushforwardFree.flat_ker_zero_of_exact K d hexact m hI
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.ker (d 0)) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  exact Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_homology_isZero
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_homology_isZero (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj M).homology (p + 1))) :
    Function.Exact (PushforwardFree.d R n M p) (PushforwardFree.d R n M (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let K := (coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj M
  have hK : K.ExactAt (p + 1) := (HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology K _).mpr h
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' K p (p + 1) (p + 2) (by simp) (by simp),
    ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff] at hK
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hK x hx
    exact ⟨y, (coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply R n M p y).trans hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply,
      coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply]
    change (K.d p (p + 1) ≫ K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)).hom y = 0
    rw [K.d_comp_d]
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_sheafH
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_sheafH (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1))))
    (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (PushforwardFree.d R n M p) (PushforwardFree.d R n M (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_homology_isZero
  let e := coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n
    ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)
    (quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic R n M) p
  haveI : Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (hH p)
  haveI : Subsingleton ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (p + 1)).obj
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)) := e.toEquiv.subsingleton
  change IsZero ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (p + 1)).obj
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.cech_H0_flat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.cech_H0_flat (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : ∀ p, Module.Flat R ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1))))
    (hI : ∀ I : Ideal R,
      Function.Exact ((PushforwardFree.d R n M n).rTensor I) ((PushforwardFree.d R n M (n + 1)).rTensor I)) :
    Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (PushforwardFree.d R n M 0))
proof:
:=
  haveI := hflat
  PushforwardFree.flat_ker_zero_of_exact (fun p ↦ ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p)) (PushforwardFree.d R n M)
    (PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_sheafH R n M hH) n hI

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.cech_H0_projective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.cech_H0_projective (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]

    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1))))
    (hI : ∀ I : Ideal R,

    [Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker (PushforwardFree.d R n M 0))] :
