    (PushforwardFree.d R n M) (PushforwardFree.cech_exact_of_sheafH R n M hH) n hI

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherCoface_component
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherCoface_component
    (M : (space k n).Opens ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ r ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) ≫
        M.map
          (Pi.lift
            (P := coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) a)
            (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
              Pi.π
                (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a s))
                (r.succAbove t))).op
proof:
:= by
  have hcech :
      (((Functor.rightOp
        (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).cech).map
          (SimplexCategory.δ r)).unop) =
        (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).mapPower
          r.succAbove := by
    rfl
  change (Pi.lift _ ≫ Pi.π _ a) = _
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [hcech]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces (p : ℕ) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential,
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface]
  change (((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor (coordinateCechCover k n)).obj
    M).d p (p + 1)) = _
  simp only [CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor,
    Limits.FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor_obj_d, CochainComplex.of_d]
  change (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechCosimplicialObject k n M) p) = _
  simp only [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_comp_π
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_comp_π (s p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          a =
      if s ≤ (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card then
        Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          a
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_coface
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_coface
    (s p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r ≫
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s (p + 1) =
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro a
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_comp_π]
  by_cases ha : s ≤ (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card
  · rw [if_pos ha]
  · simp only [if_neg ha, comp_zero]
    dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface]
    rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherCoface_component k n M p r a]
    rw [← Category.assoc, PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_comp_π]
    have hdelete :
        ¬s ≤ (coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove)).card := by
      intro h
      exact ha (h.trans
        (coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_succAbove_le n a r))
    rw [if_neg hdelete, zero_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_differential
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_differential (s p : ℕ) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s (p + 1) =
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p
proof:
:= by
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_zsmul, Preadditive.zsmul_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportProjection_coface]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction_comp_supportSectionIso
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction_comp_supportSectionIso
    {p : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (ha : coordinateCechWordSupport n a = S)
    (hdelete :
      coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove) = S) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r ≫
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M a S ha).hom =
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M
        (a ∘ r.succAbove) S hdelete).hom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction,
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  rw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface_apply
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface_apply
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
      a).hom
        ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x) =
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r
        ((Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherCoface_component k n M p r a) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply
    (p : ℕ) (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
      a).hom
        ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom x) =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r
          ((Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  let ev :
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p ⟶
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1)) →+
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f.hom x
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hsum :
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2),
          (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
            PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x := by
    change ev (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r) = _
    exact map_sum ev _ Finset.univ
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  change
    (Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
      a).hom
        (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r
          ((Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
  rw [map_zsmul]
  congr 1
  exact PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherCoface_apply k n M p r x a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    {p : ℕ} (v : {v : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v}) :
    coordinateCechWordSupport n
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) = S
proof:
:=
  (coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_eq_of_surjective n
      (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS) v.1 v.2).trans
    (coordinateCechWordSupport_enumeration n S m hS)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ) (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (v : {v : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v}) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS p x v =
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) S
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v)).hom
          ((Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v)).hom x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ) (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            a).hom x = 0) :
    surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S) m p
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS p x) =
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1)
        ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply]
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply,
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply]
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_zsmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  · rw [dif_pos h, PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply]
    let vr : {w : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective w} :=
      ⟨v.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
    have htarget :
        coordinateCechWordSupport n
            (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) = S :=
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v
    have hdelete :
        coordinateCechWordSupport n
            (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘
              r.succAbove) = S := by
      change coordinateCechWordSupport n
        (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS ∘
          (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove)) = S
      exact
        (coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_eq_of_surjective n
          (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS)
          (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove) h).trans
            (coordinateCechWordSupport_enumeration n S m hS)
    have hcomp :=
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction_comp_supportSectionIso
        k n M (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) r
          S htarget hdelete
    have helem := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hcomp
      ((Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘
          r.succAbove)).hom x)
    have hz := congrArg (fun z ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) • z) helem.symm
    simpa only [vr, PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord,
      Function.comp_def, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hz
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    have hlt :
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘
            r.succAbove)).card < m := by
      simpa only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord, Function.comp_def] using
        coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_lt_of_injective_of_not_surjective
          n (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS)
            (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_injective n S m hS)
              (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove) h
    have hxzero := hxsmall
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘ r.succAbove) hlt
    rw [hxzero, map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupport_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupport_cocycle_is_boundary
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ b : surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S) m p,
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S) m p b =
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  have hc :
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S) m (p + 1)
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1) x) = 0 := by
    rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
      k n M S m hS (p + 1) x hxsmall, hcycle]
    funext v
    rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply]
    simp
  exact surjectiveWordAddCommGroup_cocycle_is_boundary
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S) m p hmp
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1) x) hc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective
    {p m : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m) :
    Function.Surjective (PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex n a ha)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let iS : coordinateCechWordSupport n a :=
    (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha i
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
    (mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a iS.1).1 iS.2
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  apply ((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).injective
  change
    (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha
        (((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).symm
          ⟨a t, _⟩) =
      (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha i
  rw [((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).apply_symm_apply]
  exact Subtype.ext ht

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex
    {p m : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m) :
    coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a) m ha ∘
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex n a ha = a
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  change
    (((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha)
      (((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).symm
        ⟨a t, _⟩)).1 = a t
  rw [((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).apply_symm_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_fixedSupportWord
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_fixedSupportWord
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    {p : ℕ} (v : {v : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v}) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex n
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v)
        (by
          rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v]
          exact hS) =
      v.1
proof:
:= by
  let a := PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v
  let ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m := by
    rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v]
    exact hS
  have hsupport : coordinateCechWordSupport n a = S :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v
  have henum :
      coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n
          (coordinateCechWordSupport n a) m ha =
        coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS := by
    funext i
    simp [coordinateCechSupportEnumeration, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_apply,
      hsupport]
  have hrec :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex n a ha
  rw [henum] at hrec
  funext t
  apply coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_injective n S m hS
  have ht := congrFun hrec t
  simpa only [a, PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord, Function.comp_apply] using ht

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply
    (m p : ℕ)
    (b : ∀ S : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S.1) m p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun c : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p c)))
      a).hom
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b) =
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue k n M m p b a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension, map_sum,
    Finset.sum_eq_single a]
  · rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Pi.ι_π_eq_id,
      ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  · intro c _ hc
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Pi.ι_π_of_ne _ hc]
    rfl
  · intro ha
    exact (ha (Finset.mem_univ a)).elim

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIso_primitiveValue_of_support_eq
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIso_primitiveValue_of_support_eq
    (m p : ℕ)
    (b : ∀ T : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M T.1) m p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (ha : coordinateCechWordSupport n a = S)
    (hS : S.card = m) :
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M a S ha).hom
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue k n M m p b a) =
      b ⟨S, hS⟩
        ⟨PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex n a
            (by rw [ha]; exact hS),
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective n a
            (by rw [ha]; exact hS)⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst S
  dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue]
  rw [dif_pos hS]
  exact Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_primitiveExtension
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_primitiveExtension
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ)
    (b : ∀ T : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M T.1) m p) :
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS p
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b) =
      b ⟨S, hS⟩
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply,
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply]
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIso_primitiveValue_of_support_eq
    k n M m p b (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v)
      S (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v) hS]
  apply congrArg (b ⟨S, hS⟩)
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_fixedSupportWord n S m hS v

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_differential_apply_of_card
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_differential_apply_of_card
    (m p : ℕ)
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (b : ∀ S : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S.1) m p)
    (hb : ∀ S : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportSections k n M S.1) m p (b S) =
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S.1 m S.2 (p + 1) x)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
      a).hom
        ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom
          (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b)) =
      (Pi.π
        (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
        a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let S : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m :=
    ⟨coordinateCechWordSupport n a, ha⟩
  let v : {v : Fin (p + 2) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v} :=
    ⟨PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex n a ha,
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective n a ha⟩
  let y :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b
  have hysmall :
      ∀ c : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n c).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun d : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p d)))
            c).hom y = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply]
    dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue]
    rw [dif_neg (ne_of_lt hc)]
  have hchain :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
      k n M S.1 m S.2 p y hysmall
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_primitiveExtension
    k n M S.1 m S.2 p b] at hchain
  have hextract :
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S.1 m S.2 (p + 1)
          ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) =
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S.1 m S.2 (p + 1) x :=
    hchain.symm.trans (hb S)
  have hv := congrFun hextract v
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply,
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportCochain_apply] at hv
  have hword :
      PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S.1 m S.2 v = a := by
    exact PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex n a ha
  have hcomponent := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord n S.1 m S.2 v) S.1
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportWord_support n S.1 m S.2 v)).hom).1 hv
  rw [hword] at hcomponent
  simpa only [y] using hcomponent

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportLayer_cocycle_primitive
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportLayer_cocycle_primitive
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) =
            (Pi.π
              (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
                M.obj
                  (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
              a).hom x) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card ≠ m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p c)))
            a).hom y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprimitive (S : PushforwardFree.PresheafCechSupportOfCard n m) :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupport_cocycle_is_boundary
      k n M S.1 m S.2 p hmp x hxsmall hcycle
  choose b hb using hprimitive
  let y :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    exact PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_differential_apply_of_card
      k n M m p x b hb a ha
  · intro a ha
    rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply]
    dsimp only [PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue]
    rw [dif_neg ha]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportLayer_cocycle_peel
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportLayer_cocycle_peel
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m + 1 →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              (x -
                (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0) ∧
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom
          (x - (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hylayer, hyexact⟩ :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechFixedSupportLayer_cocycle_primitive
      k n M m p hmp x hxsmall hcycle
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    have hle :
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card ≤ m := by
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (by simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ha)
    by_cases heq : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m
    · rw [map_sub, hylayer a heq, sub_self]
    · have hlt : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hle heq
      have hdy :
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0 := by
        rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro r _
        have hdelete :
            (coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove)).card < m :=
          (coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_succAbove_le n a r).trans_lt hlt
        rw [hyexact (a ∘ r.succAbove) (ne_of_lt hdelete),
          map_zero, smul_zero]
      rw [map_sub, hxsmall a hlt, hdy, sub_zero]
  · rw [map_sub, hcycle]
    have hdd :
        (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom
            ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0 := by
      have h :=
        (PushforwardFree.complex k n M).d_comp_d
          p (p + 1) (p + 2)
      change
        ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom) y = 0
      rw [show PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1) = 0 by
        exact h]
      rfl
    rw [hdd, sub_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupport_cocycle_peel_iterate
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupport_cocycle_peel_iterate
    (m r p : ℕ) (hmrp : m + r ≤ p + 2)
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m + r →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              (x -
                (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0) ∧
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom
          (x - (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing x with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a ha
        simpa only [Nat.add_zero, map_zero, sub_zero] using hxsmall a ha
      · simpa only [map_zero, sub_zero] using hcycle
  | succ r ih =>
      have hmrp' : m + r ≤ p + 2 := by omega
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀small, hy₀cycle⟩ :=
        ih hmrp' x hxsmall hcycle
      let z :=
        x - (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y₀
      have hmp : m + r ≤ p + 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁small, hy₁cycle⟩ :=
        PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupportLayer_cocycle_peel
          k n M (m + r) p hmp z hy₀small hy₀cycle
      refine ⟨y₀ + y₁, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a ha
        have hres :
            x -
                (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom
                  (y₀ + y₁) =
              z -
                (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y₁ := by
          rw [map_add]
          dsimp only [z]
          abel
        rw [hres]
        apply hy₁small a
        omega
      · have hres :
            x -
                (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom
                  (y₀ + y₁) =
              z -
                (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y₁ := by
          rw [map_add]
          dsimp only [z]
          abel
        rw [hres]
        exact hy₁cycle

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero_of_dimension
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero_of_dimension
    (p : ℕ) (hnp : n < p + 1)
    (x : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hx :
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : PushforwardFree.presheafCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : 1 + (n + 1) ≤ p + 2 := by omega
  have hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < 1 →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    have hmem :
        a 0 ∈ coordinateCechWordSupport n a :=
      (mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a (a 0)).2 ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a 0, hmem⟩
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, hres, -⟩ :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechSupport_cocycle_peel_iterate
      k n M 1 (n + 1) p hbound x hxsmall hx
  have hresZero :
      x - (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y = 0 := by
    apply (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv
      (fun a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) a)))).injective
    funext a
    rw [Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply,
      Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
    have hle :
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card ≤ n + 1 := by
      have :=
        Finset.card_le_card
          (Finset.subset_univ (coordinateCechWordSupport n a))
      simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using this
    have ha := hres a (by omega)
    simpa using ha
  exact ⟨y, (sub_eq_zero.mp hresZero).symm⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension
    {q : ℕ} (hnq : n < q) :
    (PushforwardFree.complex k n M).ExactAt q
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | p := q
  · omega
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff'
    (PushforwardFree.complex k n M)
    p (p + 1) (p + 2) (by simp) (by simp)]
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  change
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0 at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero_of_dimension
      k n M p hnq x hx
  exact ⟨y, hy⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.presheafCechHomology_isZero_of_dimension
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.presheafCechHomology_isZero_of_dimension
    {q : ℕ} (hnq : n < q) :
    IsZero ((PushforwardFree.complex k n M).homology q)
proof:
:=
  (PushforwardFree.presheafCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension k n M hnq).isZero_homology

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.resLin_apply
statement:

    (h : V ⟶ U) (x : Γ(M, U)) : PushforwardFree.resLin R n M h x = (M.presheaf.map h.op).hom x

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.resLin_comp

:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv_tmul (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (x : ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p)) (ν : N) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv R n N M p (x ⊗ₜ ν) a =
      (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M p x a) ⊗ₜ ν

:= by
  simp [PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.d_component
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.d_component (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (x : ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M (p + 1) (PushforwardFree.d R n M p x) a =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        PushforwardFree.resLin R n M (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a)
          (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M p x (a ∘ r.succAbove))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PushforwardFree.d, coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, map_zsmul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherCofaceLinearMap_pi]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.E_π
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.E_π (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (z : ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) ⊗[R] N) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M p) a).hom (PushforwardFree.E R n N M p z) = PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv R n N M p z a
proof:
:=
  Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_symm_apply_π _ _ _

:=

    (PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv R n N M p).injective

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.E_zero
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.E_zero (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ) :
    PushforwardFree.E R n N M p 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M p)).injective
  funext a
  rw [Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply, Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
  change (Pi.π (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M p) a).hom (PushforwardFree.E R n N M p 0) =
    (Pi.π (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M p) a).hom 0
  rw [PushforwardFree.E_π, map_zero, map_zero]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.delete_apply
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.delete_apply (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) (y : Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗[R] N) :
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechDeleteRestriction R n (PushforwardFree.tensorPresheaf R n N M) a r).hom y =
      (PushforwardFree.resLin R n M (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a)).rTensor N y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.E_comm
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.E_comm (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (z : ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) ⊗[R] N) :
    (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential R n (PushforwardFree.tensorPresheaf R n N M) p).hom
        (PushforwardFree.E R n N M p z) =
      PushforwardFree.E R n N M (p + 1) ((PushforwardFree.d R n M p).rTensor N z)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M (p + 1))).injective
  funext a
  rw [Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply, Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
  change (Pi.π (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M (p + 1)) a).hom
      ((PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential R n (PushforwardFree.tensorPresheaf R n N M) p).hom
        (PushforwardFree.E R n N M p z)) =
    (Pi.π (PushforwardFree.PF R n N M (p + 1)) a).hom (PushforwardFree.E R n N M (p + 1) ((PushforwardFree.d R n M p).rTensor N z))
  rw [PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply, PushforwardFree.E_π]
  simp only [PushforwardFree.E_π, PushforwardFree.delete_apply]
  let L1 : (↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) ⊗[R] N) →ₗ[R]
      (Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) a) ⊗[R] N) :=
    ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      ((PushforwardFree.resLin R n M (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a)).rTensor N ∘ₗ
        (LinearMap.proj (a ∘ r.succAbove)) ∘ₗ (PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv R n N M p).toLinearMap)
  let L2 : (↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) ⊗[R] N) →ₗ[R]
      (Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) a) ⊗[R] N) :=
    (LinearMap.proj a) ∘ₗ (PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv R n N M (p + 1)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (PushforwardFree.d R n M p).rTensor N
  have key : L1 = L2 := TensorProduct.ext' fun x ν ↦ by
    simp only [L1, L2, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, PushforwardFree.termTensorEquiv_tmul,
      LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, PushforwardFree.d_component, TensorProduct.sum_tmul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
    exact map_zsmul ((TensorProduct.mk R _ N).flip ν) _ _
  have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun key z
  simp only [L1, L2, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hz
  exact hz

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.d_comp_d
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.d_comp_d (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ) :
    (PushforwardFree.d R n M (p + 1)).comp (PushforwardFree.d R n M p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change PushforwardFree.d R n M (p + 1) (PushforwardFree.d R n M p x) = 0
  rw [coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply, coordinateCechModuleDifferentialLinear_apply]
  let K := (coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj M
  change (K.d p (p + 1) ≫ K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)).hom x = 0
  rw [K.d_comp_d]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.tensor_exact_of_dimension
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.tensor_exact_of_dimension (M : (space R n).Modules) (q : ℕ) (hq : n < q + 1) :
    Function.Exact ((PushforwardFree.d R n M q).rTensor N) ((PushforwardFree.d R n M (q + 1)).rTensor N)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hP := PushforwardFree.presheafCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension R n
      (PushforwardFree.tensorPresheaf R n N M) hq
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ q (q + 1) (q + 2) (by simp) (by simp),
      ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff] at hP
    have hE : (PushforwardFree.presheafCechNativeHigherDifferential R n
        (PushforwardFree.tensorPresheaf R n N M) (q + 1)).hom (PushforwardFree.E R n N M (q + 1) x) = 0 := by
      rw [PushforwardFree.E_comm, hx, PushforwardFree.E_zero]
    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := hP _ hE
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := PushforwardFree.E_surjective R n N M q Y
    refine ⟨y, PushforwardFree.E_injective R n N M (q + 1) ?_⟩
    rw [← PushforwardFree.E_comm]
    exact hY
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, PushforwardFree.d_comp_d, LinearMap.rTensor_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_H0_flat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_H0_flat (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : ∀ p, Module.Flat R ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1)))) :
    Module.Flat R (LinearMap.ker (PushforwardFree.d R n M 0))
proof:
:=
  PushforwardFree.cech_H0_flat R n M hflat hH fun I ↦
    PushforwardFree.tensor_exact_of_dimension R n I M n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_H0_projective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_H0_projective (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : ∀ p, Module.Flat R ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1))))
    [Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker (PushforwardFree.d R n M 0))] :
    Module.Projective R (LinearMap.ker (PushforwardFree.d R n M 0))
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.res_res
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.res_word
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.res_word (M : (space R n).Modules) {b b' : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)} (h : b = b')
    (x : ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M 0)) {W : (space R n).Opens}
    (h₁ : W ⟶ PushforwardFree.V R n b) (h₂ : W ⟶ PushforwardFree.V R n b') :
    PushforwardFree.resLin R n M h₁ (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 0 x b) =
      PushforwardFree.resLin R n M h₂ (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 0 x b')
proof:
:= by
  subst h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.toC0_apply
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.toC0_apply (M : (space R n).Modules) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 0 (PushforwardFree.toC0 R n M s) b =
      PushforwardFree.resLin R n M (homOfLE le_top : PushforwardFree.V R n b ⟶ ⊤) s
proof:
:= by
  simp [PushforwardFree.toC0]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.toC0_mem_ker
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.toC0_mem_ker (M : (space R n).Modules) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    PushforwardFree.toC0 R n M s ∈ LinearMap.ker (PushforwardFree.d R n M 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  apply (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 1).injective
  funext a
  rw [PushforwardFree.d_component, map_zero, Fin.sum_univ_two, PushforwardFree.toC0_apply, PushforwardFree.toC0_apply,
    PushforwardFree.res_res R n M _ _ (homOfLE le_top), PushforwardFree.res_res R n M _ _ (homOfLE le_top)]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.cover
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.cover :
    (⊤ : (space R n).Opens) ≤ iSup (PushforwardFree.V R n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  have hcov := coordinateCechCover_isOpenCover R n
  have hx : x ∈ iSup (coordinateCechCover R n) := by
    rw [hcov]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨fun _ ↦ i, ?_⟩
  exact (Pi.lift (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ 𝟙 (coordinateCechCover R n i))).le hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.toC0_injective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.toC0_injective (M : (space R n).Modules) :
    Function.Injective (PushforwardFree.toC0 R n M)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  have := TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (PushforwardFree.V R n) ⊤
    (fun b ↦ homOfLE le_top) (PushforwardFree.cover R n) s t (fun b ↦ ?_)
  · exact this
  have h := congrArg (fun y ↦ coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 0 y b) hst
  simp only [PushforwardFree.toC0_apply] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.toC0_surjective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.toC0_surjective (M : (space R n).Modules) (x : ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M 0))
    (hx : PushforwardFree.d R n M 0 x = 0) : ∃ s, PushforwardFree.toC0 R n M s = x
proof:
:= by
  let sf : ∀ b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1), Γ(M, PushforwardFree.V R n b) :=
    fun b ↦ coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 0 x b
  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M).1
      (PushforwardFree.V R n) sf := by
    intro b b'
    let a : Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1) := ![b 0, b' 0]
    have hι : PushforwardFree.V R n b ⊓ PushforwardFree.V R n b' ≤ coordinateCechIntersection R n 1 a := by
      refine (Pi.lift (P := PushforwardFree.V R n b ⊓ PushforwardFree.V R n b') (fun t ↦ homOfLE ?_)).le
      fin_cases t
      · exact inf_le_left.trans (Pi.π (fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover R n (b t)) 0).le
      · exact inf_le_right.trans (Pi.π (fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover R n (b' t)) 0).le
    have hw1 : a ∘ (1 : Fin 2).succAbove = b := by
      funext t
      fin_cases t
      rfl
    have hw0 : a ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove = b' := by
      funext t
      fin_cases t
      rfl
    change PushforwardFree.resLin R n M (Opens.infLELeft (PushforwardFree.V R n b) (PushforwardFree.V R n b')) (sf b) =
      PushforwardFree.resLin R n M (Opens.infLERight (PushforwardFree.V R n b) (PushforwardFree.V R n b')) (sf b')
    rw [← PushforwardFree.res_word R n M hw1 x (homOfLE hι ≫ coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n 0 1 a),
      ← PushforwardFree.res_word R n M hw0 x (homOfLE hι ≫ coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n 0 0 a),
      PushforwardFree.resLin_comp, PushforwardFree.resLin_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    congr 1
    have h0 := congrArg (fun y ↦ coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 1 y a) hx
    simp only [map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at h0
    rw [PushforwardFree.d_component, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h0
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h0)).symm
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)
    (PushforwardFree.V R n) ⊤ (fun b ↦ homOfLE le_top) (PushforwardFree.cover R n) sf hcompat
  refine ⟨s, (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M 0).injective ?_⟩
  funext b
  rw [PushforwardFree.toC0_apply]
  exact hs b

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_flat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_flat (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : ∀ p, Module.Flat R ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1)))) :
    Module.Flat R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  haveI := PushforwardFree.chart_H0_flat R n M hflat hH
  Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (PushforwardFree.H0Equiv R n M)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_projective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_projective (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : ∀ p, Module.Flat R ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1))))
    [Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤)] :
    Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_flat R n M hflat hH
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R Γ(M, ⊤) := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  exact Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.term_flat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.term_flat (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat R Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Flat R ↑(coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hsec p
  haveI : Module.Flat R (∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
      Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :=
    Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R _ _).symm
  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M p)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_flat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_flat (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat R Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1)))) :
    Module.Flat R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_flat R n M (PushforwardFree.term_flat R n M hsec) hH

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_projective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_projective (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat R Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1))))
    [Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤)] :
    Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  PushforwardFree.chart_globalSections_projective R n M (PushforwardFree.term_flat R n M hsec) hH

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.globalSections_finite
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.globalSections_finite (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (hP : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hP
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hP : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat R Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (q + 1)))) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤) ∧ Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := PushforwardFree.globalSections_finite R n M hP
  exact ⟨inferInstance, PushforwardFree.chart_projective R n M hsec hH⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.sheafH_isZero_of_higherDirectImage
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.sheafH_isZero_of_higherDirectImage (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (p : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (p + 1))) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let e := projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafificationIso R n M p
    (fun g ↦ projectiveModule_projectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n M g (p + 1))
  have hT : IsZero (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p) := h.of_iso e.symm
  haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).Additive :=
    ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} ↦ rfl⟩
  haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
  have hΓ : IsZero ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n M p)) :=
    Functor.map_isZero _ hT
  have hM : IsZero (ModuleCat.of R (M.H (p + 1))) :=
    hΓ.of_iso (projectiveModulePositiveHigherDirectImageTilde_isoTop R n M p)
  haveI : Subsingleton (M.H (p + 1)) := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hM
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (M.H (p + 1)))
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_of_higherDirectImage
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_of_higherDirectImage (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hP : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat R Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (q + 1))) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤) ∧ Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  PushforwardFree.chart R n M hP hsec fun q ↦ PushforwardFree.sheafH_isZero_of_higherDirectImage R n M q (hR q)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.structureRingHom_flat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.structureRingHom_flat (U : (space R n).Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    (structureRingHom (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U).Flat
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((toSpec R n).appLE ⊤ U le_top).hom.Flat :=
    HasRingHomProperty.appLE @Flat (toSpec R n) (toSpec_isFlat R n)
      ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨U, hU⟩ le_top
  have h0 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom.Flat :=
    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv)
  have heq : structureRingHom (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U =
      ((toSpec R n).appLE ⊤ U le_top).hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom := by
    ext r
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact h0.comp h1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.sec_flat_of_chartFlat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.sec_flat_of_chartFlat (M : (space R n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (h : Module.Flat Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)
      Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :
    Module.Flat R Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) :=
    (structureRingHom (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
      (coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)).toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat R Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) :=
    PushforwardFree.structureRingHom_flat R n _ (coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a)
  haveI : IsScalarTower R Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)
      Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) :=
    ⟨fun r s m ↦ mul_smul _ s m⟩
  exact Module.Flat.trans R Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_of_chartFlat
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_of_chartFlat (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hP : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)
        Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (q + 1))) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤) ∧ Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  PushforwardFree.chart_of_higherDirectImage R n M hP
    (fun p a ↦ PushforwardFree.sec_flat_of_chartFlat R n M p a (hsec p a)) hR

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.pushforward_isFinitePresentation_of_pos
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.pushforward_isFinitePresentation_of_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  have h : (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M 0).IsFinitePresentation :=
    projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike R n hn M 0
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) M) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.coordinateOpen_zero_eq_top
statement: theorem PushforwardFree.coordinateOpen_zero_eq_top : coordinateOpen R 0 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R 0
  simpa using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.pushforward_isFinitePresentation_zero
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.pushforward_isFinitePresentation_zero
    (M : (space R 0).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R 0)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv _
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine (toSpec R 0) M

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem pushforward_isFinitePresentation (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · exact PushforwardFree.pushforward_isFinitePresentation_zero R M
  · exact PushforwardFree.pushforward_isFinitePresentation_of_pos R n hn M

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart_of_chartFlat_of_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.chart_of_chartFlat_of_isFinitePresentation (n : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hsec : ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)),
      Module.Flat Γ(space R n, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)
        Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (q + 1))) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤) ∧ Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  PushforwardFree.chart_of_chartFlat R n M (pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n M) hsec hR

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_of_bijective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_of_bijective {A B M : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module B M] (θ : A →+* B) (hθ : Function.Bijective θ)
    (h : @Module.Flat A M _ _ (Module.compHom M θ)) : Module.Flat B M
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M θ
  let e := RingEquiv.ofBijective θ hθ
  letI : Algebra B A := e.symm.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat B A := RingHom.Flat.of_bijective (f := e.symm.toRingHom) e.symm.bijective
  haveI : IsScalarTower B A M := ⟨fun b a m => by
    show θ (e.symm b * a) • m = b • (θ a • m)
    rw [map_mul, mul_smul]
    congr 1
    exact e.apply_symm_apply b⟩
  exact Module.Flat.trans B A M

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.finite_of_bijective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.finite_of_bijective {A B M : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module B M] (θ : A →+* B)
    (h : @Module.Finite A M _ _ (Module.compHom M θ)) : Module.Finite B M
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M θ
  letI : Algebra A B := θ.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower A B M := ⟨fun a b m => by
    show (θ a * b) • m = θ a • (b • m)
    rw [mul_smul]⟩
  exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A B M

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.projective_of_bijective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.projective_of_bijective {A B M : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] (θ : A →+* B) (hθ : Function.Bijective θ)
    (h : @Module.Projective A _ M _ (Module.compHom M θ)) : Module.Projective B M
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M θ
  let f : A ≃+* B := RingEquiv.ofBijective θ hθ
  haveI i1 : RingHomInvPair (f : A →+* B) (f.symm : B →+* A) := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv f
  haveI i2 : RingHomInvPair (f.symm : B →+* A) (f : A →+* B) := RingHomInvPair.symm _ _
  let e₂ : M ≃ₛₗ[(f : A →+* B)] M :=
    { toFun := fun m => m
      invFun := fun m => m
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (σ' := (f.symm : B →+* A)) e₂

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.fp_of_bijective
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.fp_of_bijective {A B M ι : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module B M] [Finite ι] (θ : A →+* B) (hθ : Function.Bijective θ)
    (b : Module.Basis ι B M) : @Module.FinitePresentation A M _ _ (Module.compHom M θ)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M θ
  let f : B ≃+* A := (RingEquiv.ofBijective θ hθ).symm
  let b' : Module.Basis ι A M := b.mapCoeffs f (fun c x => by
    show θ (f c) • x = c • x
    congr 1
    exact (RingEquiv.ofBijective θ hθ).apply_symm_apply c)
  haveI : Module.Projective A M := Module.Projective.of_basis b'
  haveI : Module.Finite A M := Module.Finite.of_basis b'
  exact Module.finitePresentation_of_projective A M

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_of_le_frame
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_of_le_frame (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) (i : C.I)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ C.U i) : Module.Flat Γ(X, V) Γ(M, V)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  show Module.Flat Γ(X, V) (M.val.obj (op V))
  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (C.restrictedSectionLinearEquiv i V hV).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.smul_eq
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.smul_eq (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (a : Γ(X, U))
    (x : Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, V)) :
    a • x = (show Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) from
      (PushforwardFree.ψ hU V a • (show Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) from x)))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_piece_gen
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_piece_gen (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) (i : C.I)
    (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (hV1 : (algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(Spec Γ(X, U), V)).Flat)
    (hV : PushforwardFree.W hU V ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, V)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, PushforwardFree.W hU V) := (PushforwardFree.ψ hU V).toAlgebra
  have h2 : (hU.isoSpec.hom.app V ≫ (U.ι.appIso (hU.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv).hom.Flat :=
    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(X, PushforwardFree.W hU V) := hV1.comp h2
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(X, PushforwardFree.W hU V) Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) :=
    PushforwardFree.flat_of_le_frame C i _ hV
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) := Module.compHom _ (PushforwardFree.ψ hU V)
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, PushforwardFree.W hU V) Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) :=
    Module.Flat.trans Γ(X, U) Γ(X, PushforwardFree.W hU V) _
  let e : Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, V) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU V) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_piece
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_piece (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) (i : C.I)
    (f : Γ(X, U)) (hf : PushforwardFree.W hU (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
proof:
:= by
  refine PushforwardFree.flat_piece_gen hU C i _ ?_ hf
  rw [RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff]
  exact IsLocalization.flat _ (Submonoid.powers f)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.span
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.span (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) :
    Ideal.span {f : Γ(X, U) | ∃ i, PushforwardFree.W hU (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ≤ C.U i} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ h
  let p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) := ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩
  let y : U.toScheme := hU.isoSpec.inv p
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, y.1 ∈ C.U i := by
    have hx : y.1 ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i) := by rw [C.covers]; trivial
    simpa [Opens.mem_iSup] using hx
  let O : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens := hU.isoSpec.inv ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
  have hpO : p ∈ O := hi
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨f, rfl⟩, hpf, hfO⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hpO O.isOpen
  have hfm : f ∉ m := hpf
  apply hfm
  apply hle
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  refine le_trans (U.ι.image_mono ?_) (U.ι.image_preimage_le (C.U i))
  intro z hz
  have h1 : hU.isoSpec.hom z ∈ O := hfO hz
  have h2 : hU.isoSpec.inv (hU.isoSpec.hom z) = z := Scheme.hom_inv_apply _ z
  change U.ι (hU.isoSpec.inv (hU.isoSpec.hom z)) ∈ C.U i at h1
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact h1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.flat_top
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.flat_top (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set Γ(X, U) := {f | ∃ i, PushforwardFree.W hU (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ≤ C.U i}
  haveI : (PushforwardFree.model M hU).IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom hU.isoSpec.hom (M.restrict U.ι)
  haveI hloc : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away r.1 (PushforwardFree.res M hU r.1) :=
    fun r => (Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ
      (PushforwardFree.model M hU)).mp inferInstance r.1
  exact Module.flat_of_isLocalized_span Γ(X, U) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, ⊤) s (PushforwardFree.span hU C)
    (fun r => Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r.1))
    (fun r => PushforwardFree.res M hU r.1)
    (fun r => PushforwardFree.flat_piece hU C r.2.choose r.1 r.2.choose_spec)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.fp_piece
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.fp_piece (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) (i : C.I)
    (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (hV : PushforwardFree.W hU V ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(Spec Γ(X, U), V) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, V)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  have hφ : Function.Bijective
      (hU.isoSpec.hom.app V ≫ (U.ι.appIso (hU.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv).hom :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  have h := PushforwardFree.fp_of_bijective _ hφ (C.restrictedSectionBasis i _ hV)
  letI : Module Γ(Spec Γ(X, U), V) (M.val.obj (op (PushforwardFree.W hU V))) :=
    Module.compHom _ (hU.isoSpec.hom.app V ≫ (U.ι.appIso (hU.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv).hom
  let e : (M.val.obj (op (PushforwardFree.W hU V))) ≃ₗ[Γ(Spec Γ(X, U), V)] Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, V) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.fp_top
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.fp_top (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, U) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set Γ(X, U) := {f | ∃ i, PushforwardFree.W hU (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ≤ C.U i}
  haveI : (PushforwardFree.model M hU).IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom hU.isoSpec.hom (M.restrict U.ι)
  haveI hloc : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers r.1) (PushforwardFree.res M hU r.1) :=
    fun r => (Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ
      (PushforwardFree.model M hU)).mp inferInstance r.1
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_localizationSpan' s (PushforwardFree.span hU C)
    (Mₚ := fun r => Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r.1))
    (Rₚ := fun r => Γ(Spec Γ(X, U), PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r.1))
    (fun r => PushforwardFree.res M hU r.1)
    (fun r => PushforwardFree.fp_piece hU C r.2.choose _ r.2.choose_spec)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.of_frame
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.of_frame (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X M)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) ∧ Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) ∧
      Module.Projective Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : U = PushforwardFree.W hU ⊤ := by
    simp only [PushforwardFree.W, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top]
  let ρ : Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU ⊤) ⟶ Γ(M, U) := M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hW).op
  let θ : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U) := (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hW).op).hom.comp (PushforwardFree.ψ hU ⊤)
  have hθ : Function.Bijective θ := by
    have h1 : Function.Bijective (algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(Spec Γ(X, U), ⊤)) := by
      show Function.Bijective ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫
        (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
      have : (homOfLE le_top : (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) ⟶ ⊤) = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [this, op_id]
      exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
    have h2 : Function.Bijective
        (hU.isoSpec.hom.app ⊤ ≫ (U.ι.appIso (hU.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).inv).hom :=
      ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
    have h3 : Function.Bijective (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hW).op).hom :=
      ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
    exact h3.comp (h2.comp h1)
  have hρ : ∀ (a : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, PushforwardFree.W hU ⊤)),
      ρ (PushforwardFree.ψ hU ⊤ a • x) = θ a • ρ x :=
    fun a x => Scheme.Modules.map_smul M (eqToHom hW) _ _
  haveI := PushforwardFree.flat_top hU C
  haveI := PushforwardFree.fp_top hU C
  haveI : Module.Projective Γ(X, U) Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, ⊤) :=
    Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation
  have hall : @Module.Flat Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) _ _ (Module.compHom _ θ) ∧
      @Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) _ _ (Module.compHom _ θ) ∧
      @Module.Projective Γ(X, U) _ Γ(M, U) _ (Module.compHom _ θ) := by
    letI : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) := Module.compHom _ θ
    let ρl : Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, ⊤) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(M, U) :=
      { toFun := fun x => ρ x
        map_add' := fun x y => map_add ρ.hom x y
        map_smul' := fun a x => hρ a x }
    let e : Γ(PushforwardFree.model M hU, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(M, U) :=
      LinearEquiv.ofBijective ρl (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ρ)
    exact ⟨Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv e.symm, Module.Finite.equiv e,
      Module.Projective.of_equiv' e⟩
  exact ⟨PushforwardFree.flat_of_bijective θ hθ hall.1, PushforwardFree.finite_of_bijective θ hall.2.1,
    PushforwardFree.projective_of_bijective θ hθ hall.2.2⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sections_finite_projective_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem sections_finite_projective_of_isFiniteLocallyFree {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)

:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sections_flat_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem sections_flat_of_isFiniteLocallyFree {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.hsec
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.hsec (M : (space R n).Modules) (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree _ M) :
