  fun p a => sections_flat_of_isFiniteLocallyFree M hM (coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.opensRange
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.opensRange (f : R) :
    (PushforwardFree.ι f).opensRange = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.exists_free
statement:
theorem PushforwardFree.exists_free (N : (Spec R).Modules)
    [Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)]
    [Module.Projective R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ∃ f : R, p ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ∧
      Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule.Away f (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)) ∧
      Module.Finite (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule.Away f (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)) ∧
      Module.finrank (Localization.Away f)
          (LocalizedModule.Away f (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)) =
        Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N) p ∧
      Nontrivial (Localization.Away f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Module.finitePresentation_of_projective R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)
  have hU := (Module.freeLocus_eq_univ_iff (R := R) (M := moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)).mpr
    inferInstance
  have hfree : Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)) :=
    Module.mem_freeLocus.mp (hU ▸ Set.mem_univ p)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hfr, hrank⟩ := Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers
    p.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.asIdeal.primeCompl
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)) (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
  refine ⟨r, (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen _ _).mpr hr, hfr, ?_, hrank, ?_⟩
  swap
  · exact (show Localization (Submonoid.powers r) →+* Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal from
      IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers r) (T := p.asIdeal.primeCompl) _
        (RingHom.id _) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hr)).domain_nontrivial
  exact Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers r)
    (Rₚ := Localization.Away r)
    (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers r) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_globalSections_projective
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_globalSections_projective (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    [Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)]
    [Module.Projective R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)] :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec R) N
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨PushforwardFree.localGeneratorsData N, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hasConstantRank_of_globalSections_projective
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_globalSections_projective (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    [Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)]
    [Module.Projective R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)] (r : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N) p = r) :
    HasConstantRank (Spec R) N r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PushforwardFree.localGeneratorsData N, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    fun (p : PrimeSpectrum R) ↦ ?_⟩
  haveI := (PushforwardFree.exists_free N p).choose_spec.2.1
  haveI := (PushforwardFree.exists_free N p).choose_spec.2.2.1
  haveI := (PushforwardFree.exists_free N p).choose_spec.2.2.2.2
  change Nat.card (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex (Localization.Away (PushforwardFree.exists_free N p).choose)
    (LocalizedModule.Away (PushforwardFree.exists_free N p).choose (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N))) = r
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Module.finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex,
    (PushforwardFree.exists_free N p).choose_spec.2.2.2.1, hr p]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hasConstantRank_of_globalSections_free
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_globalSections_free (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    [Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)]
    [Module.Free R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N)] :
    HasConstantRank (Spec R) N (Module.finrank R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N))
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_of_globalSections_projective N _ fun p ↦ by
    rw [Module.rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free]
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.globalSections_finite_projective
statement:
theorem globalSections_finite_projective (n : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) M)
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (q + 1))) :
    Module.Finite R Γ(M, ⊤) ∧ Module.Projective R Γ(M, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  exact PushforwardFree.chart_of_chartFlat_of_isFinitePresentation R n M (PushforwardFree.hsec R n M hM) hR

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree (n : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) M)
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (q + 1))) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfin, hproj⟩ := globalSections_finite_projective R n M hM hR
  haveI := hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n M
  haveI : Module.Finite R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)
  haveI : Module.Projective R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    Module.Projective.of_equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_globalSections_projective _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem pushforward_hasConstantRank (n : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) M)
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) M (q + 1)))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) Γ(M, ⊤) p = r) :
    HasConstantRank (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M) r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfin, hproj⟩ := globalSections_finite_projective R n M hM hR
  haveI := hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n M
  haveI : Module.Finite R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)
  haveI : Module.Projective R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    Module.Projective.of_equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)
  refine hasConstantRank_of_globalSections_projective _ r fun p ↦ ?_
  rw [← congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)) p]
  exact hr p

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.d_le_m
statement: theorem d_le_m : d ≤ m

:= by

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.kahlerClass_conormal
statement:
theorem kahlerClass_conormal :
    pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf Z (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Z ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Z ↘ Spk k) m).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb i)
        (TF6.hasConstantRank_libConormalAmb_sub k i hZ hX (m := m) (d := d)).isFiniteLocallyFree +
      k0ClassOf X (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (i ≫ (Z ↘ Spk k)))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (i ≫ (Z ↘ Spk k)) d).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact TF2.kahlerClass_conormal_of_seq (Z ↘ Spk k) (i ≫ (Z ↘ Spk k)) i rfl
    (conormalSeq k i hZ hX m d) _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.kahlerClass_conormal_of_data
statement:
theorem kahlerClass_conormal_of_data {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) :
    pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf Z (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Z ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Z ↘ Spk k) m).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      N.conormalClass +
      k0ClassOf X (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (i ≫ (Z ↘ Spk k)))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (i ≫ (Z ↘ Spk k)) d).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  kahlerClass_conormal k i hZ hX m d

proof: := rfl

name: ARRKG.zpow_smul_eq
statement:
theorem zpow_smul_eq (Z : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) (x : KLoc j Z) :
    ((j : ℤ) ^ n) • x = algebraMap (K0 Z) (KLoc j Z) (((j : ℕ) : K0 Z) ^ n) * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul]
  simp

name: ARRKG.map_intCast_mul
statement:
theorem map_intCast_mul {W M : Scheme.{u}} (F : K0 W →+ K0 M) (c : ℤ) (x : K0 W) :
    F ((c : K0 W) * x) = (c : K0 M) * F x
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : ∀ y : K0 W, F (-y) = -F y := fun y => by
    have h : F (-y) + F y = 0 := by
      rw [← map_add, neg_add_cancel, map_zero]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
  induction c using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have e1 : (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : K0 W) * x = ((n : ℤ) : K0 W) * x + x := by
      push_cast; ring
    have e2 : (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : K0 M) * F x = ((n : ℤ) : K0 M) * F x + F x := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e1, e2, map_add, ih]
  | pred n ih =>
    have e1 : (((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ)) : K0 W) * x = ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : K0 W) * x + -x := by
      push_cast; ring
    have e2 : (((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ)) : K0 M) * F x = ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : K0 M) * F x + -F x := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e1, e2, map_add, ih, hneg]

name: ARRKG.Floc_algebraMap
statement:
theorem Floc_algebraMap {W M : Scheme.{u}} (F : K0 W →+ K0 M) (x : K0 W) :
    Floc j F (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (F x)
proof:
:= by
  have := IsLocalizedModule.map_apply (Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ)) (locLin j W) (locLin j M)
    (toLin F) x
  exact this

name: ARRKG.algebraMap_natCast_unit
statement:
theorem algebraMap_natCast_unit (Z : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (K0 Z) (KLoc j Z) (((j : ℕ) : K0 Z) ^ N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_pow]
  exact (IsLocalization.map_units (KLoc j Z)
    (⟨((j : ℕ) : K0 Z), Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ : Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))).pow N

name: ARRKG.Floc_mk'
statement:
theorem Floc_mk' {W M : Scheme.{u}} (F : K0 W →+ K0 M) (a : K0 W) (N : ℕ) :
    algebraMap (K0 M) (KLoc j M) (((j : ℕ) : K0 M) ^ N) *
        Floc j F (IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j W) a (pe j W N)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (F a)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j W) a (pe j W N) *
      algebraMap (K0 W) (KLoc j W) (((j : ℕ) : K0 W) ^ N) = algebraMap _ _ a :=
    IsLocalization.mk'_spec (KLoc j W) a _
  have h2 : algebraMap (K0 M) (KLoc j M) (((j : ℕ) : K0 M) ^ N) *
      Floc j F (IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j W) a (pe j W N)) =
      Floc j F (((j ^ N : ℕ) : KLoc j W) * IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j W) a (pe j W N)) := by
    rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    simp
  rw [h2, mul_comm]
  have : ((j ^ N : ℕ) : KLoc j W) = algebraMap (K0 W) (KLoc j W) (((j : ℕ) : K0 W) ^ N) := by
    simp
  rw [this, h1, Floc_algebraMap]

name: ARRKG.hsupp_loc
statement:
theorem hsupp_loc (j : ℕ) (RM : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution M) (i : W ⟶ M)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : M.Opens) (hU : Set.range i = (U : Set M)ᶜ)
    (hW : Function.Surjective (k0ToG0 W)) :
    ∀ m : KLoc j M, SchemeKTheory.locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom U.ι) m = 0 →
      ∃ w : KLoc j W, Floc j (ARRL1C.Fp RM i) w = m
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 M)) m
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := s.2
  have hs : s = pe j M n := Subtype.ext hn.symm
  subst hs
  have hm' := hm
  rw [SchemeKTheory.locMap, IsLocalization.map_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hm'
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hm'
  have hres : pullbackK0 U.ι (((j : ℕ) : K0 M) ^ k * a) = 0 := by
    rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_apply, map_mul, map_pow, map_natCast]
    simpa [pullbackK0RingHom_apply] using hk
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0⟩ := ARRL1C.hsupp RM i U hU hW _ hres
  refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j W) w0 (pe j W (k + n)), ?_⟩
  have hu := algebraMap_natCast_unit j M (k + n)
  refine (hu.mul_right_inj).mp ?_
  have h3 : algebraMap (K0 M) (KLoc j M) (((j : ℕ) : K0 M) ^ n) *
      IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j M) a (pe j M n) = algebraMap _ _ a := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec (KLoc j M) a (pe j M n)
  rw [Floc_mk', hw0, pow_add, map_mul, map_mul]
  rw [mul_assoc]
  change _ = _ * (_ * IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j M) a (pe j M n))
  rw [h3]

name: ARRKG.hsupp_loc_of_resolution
statement:
theorem hsupp_loc_of_resolution (j : ℕ) (RM : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution M)
    (RW : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution W) (i : W ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U : M.Opens) (hU : Set.range i = (U : Set M)ᶜ) :
    ∀ m : KLoc j M, SchemeKTheory.locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom U.ι) m = 0 →
      ∃ w : KLoc j W, Floc j (ARRL1C.Fp RM i) w = m
proof:
:=
  hsupp_loc j RM i U hU fun g => ⟨RW.res g, DFunLike.congr_fun RW.right g⟩

name: AR5R.Nilp.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_fin
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_fin {S T : Type*} [CommRing S] [AddCommGroup T] [Module S T]
    [Module.Finite S T] (s : S) (h : ∀ x : T, ∃ k : ℕ, s ^ k • x = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : T, s ^ n • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T0, hT0⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top : (⊤ : Submodule S T).FG)
  choose k hk using h
  refine ⟨∑ g ∈ T0, k g, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hle : Submodule.span S (T0 : Set T) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lsmul S T (s ^ ∑ g ∈ T0, k g)) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro g hg
    change s ^ (∑ g ∈ T0, k g) • g = 0
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hg), pow_add,
      mul_smul, hk g, smul_zero]
  have hx := hle (hT0 ▸ Submodule.mem_top : x ∈ Submodule.span S (T0 : Set T))
  exact hx

name: AR5R.Nilp.exists_pow_le_of_nilp
statement:
theorem exists_pow_le_of_nilp {A S T : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [AddCommGroup T]
    [Module S T] [Module.Finite S T] (ψ : A →+* S) (J : Ideal A) (hJ : J.FG)
    (h : ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ m : T, ∃ k : ℕ, (ψ j) ^ k • m = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ r ∈ J ^ n, ∀ m : T, ψ r • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrad : J.map ψ ≤ (Module.annihilator S T).radical := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_fin (T := T) (ψ j) (h j hj)
    exact ⟨n, Module.mem_annihilator.2 hn⟩
  have hfg : (J.map ψ).FG := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hJ
    refine ⟨s.image ψ, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← Ideal.map_span, hs]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hrad hfg
  refine ⟨n, fun r hr m => ?_⟩
  have hmem : ψ r ∈ (J.map ψ) ^ n := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem ψ hr
  exact Module.mem_annihilator.1 (hn hmem) m

name: AR5R.Nilp.section_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem section_eq_zero_of_isZero {X : Scheme.{u}} {F : X.Modules} (hF : IsZero F)
    (V : X.Opens) (z : Γ(F, V)) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := hF.isTerminal.isTerminalObj (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V))
  let f : ModuleCat.of Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V)).obj F) :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton Γ(X, V) _ z)
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (h2.hom_ext f 0) (1 : Γ(X, V))
  have h3 : (1 : Γ(X, V)) • z = 0 := this
  simpa using h3

name: AR5R.Nilp.emap_comp_eq
statement:
theorem emap_comp_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (E : X.Modules) {A B C : X.Opens} (f : op B ⟶ op A)
    (g : op A ⟶ op C) (h : op B ⟶ op C) (x : Γ(E, B)) :
    E.presheaf.map g (E.presheaf.map f x) = E.presheaf.map h x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 2

name: AR5R.Nilp.section_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
theorem section_eq_zero_of_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E)) (s : Γ(E, V)) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) = V := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    exact inf_eq_right.2 hVU
  have hz := section_eq_zero_of_isZero hE (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom h).op s :
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E, U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V))
  have h1 : E.presheaf.map (eqToHom h.symm).op (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom h).op s) = s := by
    rw [emap_comp_eq E (eqToHom h).op (eqToHom h.symm).op (𝟙 _) s]
    simp
  have h2 : E.presheaf.map (eqToHom h.symm).op (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom h).op s) = 0 := by
    rw [hz]
    exact map_zero _
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

name: AR5R.Nilp.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_restrict_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_restrict_zero (x : R) (m : Γ(F, ⊤))
    (hm : F.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen x : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op m = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ n • m = 0
proof:
:=
  (aux_of_qc F).uniqueness x le_top m hm

name: AR5R.Nilp.smul_eq_zero_on_basicOpen
statement:
theorem smul_eq_zero_on_basicOpen (s : R) (hs : ∀ m : Γ(F, ⊤), s • m = 0) (f : R)
    (z : Γ(F, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec R).Opens))) : s • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := (aux_of_qc F).existence f le_top z
  have hreg : IsSMulRegular Γ(F, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec R).Opens)) (f ^ n) :=
    (F.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen le_rfl).pow n
  refine hreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul ?_
  have h1 : f ^ n • (s • z) = s • (f ^ n • z) := smul_comm _ _ _
  have h2 := F.map_smul_Spec (homOfLE (le_top : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
    s t
  rw [← ht] at h1
  refine h1.trans ?_
  refine h2.symm.trans ?_
  exact (congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom (F.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (le_top : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op)) (hs t)).trans
    (map_zero _)

name: AR5R.Nilp.smul_eq_zero_of_top
statement:
theorem smul_eq_zero_of_top (s : R) (hs : ∀ m : Γ(F, ⊤), s • m = 0) (U : (Spec R).Opens)
    (y : Γ(F, U)) : s • y = 0
proof:
:= by
  let ι := {f : R // (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ U}
  have hcov : U ≤ ⨆ A : ι, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen A.1 : (Spec R).Opens) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨f, rfl⟩, hxf, hfU⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens hp
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨f, hfU⟩, hxf⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨F.presheaf, F.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab (Spec R))
    (fun A : ι ↦ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen A.1 : (Spec R).Opens)) U (fun A ↦ homOfLE A.2) hcov
    _ _ fun A ↦ ?_
  change F.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op (s • y) = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op 0
  have h := smul_eq_zero_on_basicOpen F s hs A.1 (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op y)
  exact (F.map_smul_Spec (homOfLE A.2).op s y).trans (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: AR5R.Nilp.tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top_spec
statement:
theorem tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top_spec (s : R) (hs : ∀ m : Γ(F, ⊤), s • m = 0) :
    tMul ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv s) F = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change tRes ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv s) U • m = 0
  have hkey : ∀ y : Γ(F, U.unop),
      (show Γ(Spec R, U.unop) from tRes ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv s) U) • y = s • y :=
    fun _ => rfl
  refine (hkey m).trans ?_
  exact smul_eq_zero_of_top F s hs U.unop m

name: AR5R.Nilp.app_map_top
statement:
theorem app_map_top {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Z) (U : Z.Opens) (s : Γ(Z, ⊤)) :
    g.app U (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (g.appTop s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, g.naturality, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AR5R.Nilp.smul_specE
statement:
theorem smul_specE (c : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (U : (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).Opens) (m : Γ(specE E, U)) :
    c • m = ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op c : Γ(Y, Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U)) •
      (@id Γ(E, Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) m) : Γ(E, Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Y.isoSpec.hom.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).inv c) = c := by
    simp [Scheme.isoSpec]
  have h0 := app_map_top Y.isoSpec.hom U ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).inv c)
  rw [hc] at h0
  calc c • m = (Y.isoSpec.hom.app U ((Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).inv c)) •
        (@id Γ(E, Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) m) : Γ(E, Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U)) := rfl
    _ = _ := by rw [h0]

name: AR5R.Nilp.smul_top
statement:
theorem smul_top (c : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (m : Γ(E, ⊤)) :
    (c • (@id Γ(specE E, ⊤) m) : Γ(specE E, ⊤)) = (c • m : Γ(E, ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  refine (smul_specE E c ⊤ m).trans ?_
  have h1 : (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op c : Γ(Y, Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)) = c := by
    change Y.presheaf.map (𝟙 _) c = c
    simp
  rw [h1]
  rfl

name: AR5R.Nilp.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_restrict_zero_aff
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_restrict_zero_aff [E.IsQuasicoherent] (x : Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (m : Γ(E, ⊤)) (hm : E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le x)).op m = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ n • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (specE E).IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine _ E
  have heq : Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen x : (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).Opens) =
      Y.basicOpen x := Scheme.map_PrimeSpectrum_basicOpen_of_affine Y x
  have hm2 : (specE E).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen x :
      (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op (m : Γ(specE E, ⊤)) = 0 := by
    have h2 := emap_comp_eq E (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le x)).op (eqToHom heq).op
      (homOfLE (le_top : Y.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen x :
        (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op m
    rw [hm, map_zero] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_restrict_zero (specE E) x
    (m : Γ(specE E, ⊤)) hm2
  exact ⟨n, (smul_top E (x ^ n) m).symm.trans hn⟩

name: AR5R.Nilp.tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top
statement:
theorem tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top [E.IsQuasicoherent] (c : Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (hc : ∀ m : Γ(E, ⊤), c • m = 0) : tMul c E = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (specE E).IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine _ E
  have h1 : tMul ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).inv c) (specE E) = 0 :=
    tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top_spec (specE E) c (fun m => (smul_top E c m).trans (hc m))
  have h2 := tMul_pushforward Y.isoSpec.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).inv c) E
  have hc2 : Y.isoSpec.hom.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).inv c) = c := by
    simp [Scheme.isoSpec]
  rw [hc2, h1] at h2
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforward Y.isoSpec.hom).map_injective
    (by rw [← h2, Functor.map_zero])

name: AR5R.Nilp.finite_top
statement: theorem finite_top [E.IsFinitePresentation] : Module.Finite Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(E, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (specE E).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      (pushforwardIsoRestrictInverse Y.isoSpec E).symm
      (isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv E)
  have hfp := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation (specE E)
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(Y, ⊤) (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (specE E)) := inferInstance
  let e : Γ(E, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] Γ(specE E, ⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun m => m
      invFun := fun m => m
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun c m => (smul_top E c m).symm
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (e ≪≫ₗ topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ (specE E)).symm

statement:

name: AR5R.Nilp.exists_pow_killed_on_affine
statement:
theorem exists_pow_killed_on_affine
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) = (I.support : Set X)ᶜ)
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hE : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj E))
    (W : X.affineOpens) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ r ∈ (I.ideal W) ^ n,
      tMul (KSpecialization.AR4.localGen (W : X.Opens) r)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (W : X.Opens) := W.2
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, (W : X.Opens)) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian W
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ E
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ((W : X.Opens), ⊤)
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E, ⊤) :=
    finite_top ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E)
  have hJ : (I.ideal W).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  have hnilp : ∀ j ∈ I.ideal W,
      ∀ m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E, ⊤),
      ∃ k : ℕ, (psi (W : X.Opens) j) ^ k • m = 0 := by
    intro j hj m
    have hVU : (W : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ ((W : X.Opens) : Scheme).basicOpen
        (AR4.localGen (W : X.Opens) j) ≤ U := by
      rw [localGen_eq_topIso_inv, Scheme.Opens.ι_image_basicOpen_topIso_inv]
      intro p hp
      have hpW : p ∈ (W : X.Opens) := X.basicOpen_le j hp
      have hnot : p ∉ (I.support : Set X) := by
        intro hps
        have h3 := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem (I := I) (U := W) hpW).1 hps
        rw [Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at h3
        exact h3 j hj hp
      show p ∈ (U : Set X)
      rw [hU]
      exact hnot
    refine exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_restrict_zero_aff
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E) (AR4.localGen (W : X.Opens) j) m ?_
    exact section_eq_zero_of_le (V := (W : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ ((W : X.Opens) : Scheme).basicOpen
        (AR4.localGen (W : X.Opens) j)) hVU E hE _
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_le_of_nilp (psi (W : X.Opens)) (I.ideal W) hJ hnilp
  exact ⟨n, fun r hr =>
    tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : X.Opens).ι).obj E) _
      (hn r hr)⟩

name: AR5R.Nilp.pow_le_of_le

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.closed_appLE_surjective
statement:
theorem closed_appLE_surjective {X Q : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (V : Q.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (W : X.Opens) (heq : W = j ⁻¹ᵁ V) (h : W ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    Function.Surjective (j.appLE V W h)
proof:
:= by
  subst W
  simpa [Scheme.Hom.appLE] using j.app_surjective V hV

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_appLE_comp
statement:
theorem chart_appLE_comp {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    (U : P.Opens) (V : Q.Opens) (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (h : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    p.appLE U V e ≫ j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h = (j ≫ p).app U
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
  exact (Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE (j ≫ p) (U := U)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.chartScalarTower
statement:
theorem chartScalarTower {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    (U : P.Opens) (V : Q.Opens) (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (h : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    letI
proof:
:= (p.appLE U V e).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ((j ≫ p).app U).hom.toAlgebra
    IsScalarTower Γ(P, U) Γ(Q, V) Γ(X, (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
  letI := (p.appLE U V e).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := (j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := ((j ≫ p).app U).hom.toAlgebra
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  ext r
  change ((j ≫ p).app U).hom r =
    (j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h).hom ((p.appLE U V e).hom r)
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom r) (chart_appLE_comp j p U V e h)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.chartNativeSpecSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem chartNativeSpecSequence_shortExact {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion (j ≫ p)] (U : P.Opens) (V : Q.Opens)
    (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth (p.appLE U V e).hom) :
    (chartNativeSpecSequence j p U V e h hU).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  letI := (p.appLE U V e).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := (j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := ((j ≫ p).app U).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := chartScalarTower j p U V e h
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(P, U) Γ(Q, V) := hsm
  exact NativeConormalExactH2.nativeSpecSequenceOfSurjective_shortExact
    ((j ≫ p).app_surjective U hU)

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.closed_resLE_of_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem closed_resLE_of_preimage_eq {X Q : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q)

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_resLE_comp
statement:
theorem chart_resLE_comp {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    (U : P.Opens) (V : Q.Opens) (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (h : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h ≫ p.resLE U V e = (j ≫ p) ∣_ U
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_resLE_compositeClosed
statement:
theorem chart_resLE_compositeClosed {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion (j ≫ p)] (U : P.Opens) (V : Q.Opens) (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (h : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    IsClosedImmersion (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h ≫ p.resLE U V e)
proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.standardSmooth_appLE_basicOpen
statement:
theorem standardSmooth_appLE_basicOpen {Q P : Scheme.{u}} (p : Q ⟶ P)
    {U : P.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {V : Q.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth (p.appLE U V e).hom)
    (r : Γ(P, U)) :
    RingHom.IsStandardSmooth
      (p.appLE (P.basicOpen r) (Q.basicOpen (p.appLE U V e r))
        (by rw [Scheme.basicOpen_appLE]; exact inf_le_right)).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := hU.isLocalization_basicOpen r
  letI := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen (p.appLE U V e r)
  rw [IsAffineOpen.appLE_eq_away_map p hU hV e r]
  exact RingHom.isStandardSmooth_localizationPreserves.away _ r _ _ hsm

name: SchemeKTheory.CompatibleClosedChartH2.exists_compatibleClosedChart
statement:
theorem exists_compatibleClosedChart {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion (j ≫ p)] [Smooth p] (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : P.Opens) (V : Q.Opens) (e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (h : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (_ : IsAffineOpen V),
      (j ≫ p) x ∈ U ∧ j x ∈ V ∧
        (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U = j ⁻¹ᵁ V ∧ IsAffineOpen ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) ∧
          RingHom.IsStandardSmooth (p.appLE U V e).hom ∧
            Function.Surjective ((j ≫ p).app U) ∧
              Function.Surjective (j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h) ∧
                p.appLE U V e ≫ j.appLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) h = (j ≫ p).app U ∧
                  (chartNativeSpecSequence j p U V e h hU).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀, V₀, hV₀, hx₀, e₀, hsm₀⟩ := Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth p (j x)
  let W := KSpecialization.bigOpen (j ≫ p) (j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
  have hxW : (j ≫ p) x ∈ W := by
    have heq := KSpecialization.preimage_bigOpen (j ≫ p) (j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
    have : x ∈ (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ W := by rw [heq]; exact hx₀
    exact this
  have hix : (j ≫ p) x ∈ U₀ := e₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := hU₀.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨(j ≫ p) x, hxW⟩ hix
  let U := P.basicOpen r
  let V := Q.basicOpen (p.appLE U₀ V₀ e₀ r)
  have hVeq : V = V₀ ⊓ p ⁻¹ᵁ U := Scheme.basicOpen_appLE p V₀ U₀ e₀ r
  have e : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U := hVeq ▸ inf_le_right
  have hWle : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀ :=
    (KSpecialization.le_bigOpen_iff (j ≫ p) U (j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)).mp hr
  have heq : (j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U = j ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
    ext y
    rw [hVeq]
    change p (j y) ∈ U ↔ j y ∈ V₀ ∧ p (j y) ∈ U
    exact ⟨fun hy => ⟨hWle hy, hy⟩, fun hy => hy.2⟩
  have hjx : j x ∈ V := by
    rw [hVeq]
    exact ⟨hx₀, hxr⟩
  exact ⟨U, V, e, heq.le, hU₀.basicOpen r, hV₀.basicOpen _, hxr, hjx, heq,
    (hU₀.basicOpen r).preimage (j ≫ p),
    standardSmooth_appLE_basicOpen p hU₀ hV₀ e₀ hsm₀ r,
    (j ≫ p).app_surjective U (hU₀.basicOpen r),
    closed_appLE_surjective j V (hV₀.basicOpen _) _ heq heq.le,
    chart_appLE_comp j p U V e heq.le,
    chartNativeSpecSequence_shortExact j p U V e heq.le (hU₀.basicOpen r)
      (standardSmooth_appLE_basicOpen p hU₀ hV₀ e₀ hsm₀ r)⟩

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.sigma_frames
statement: theorem sigma_frames : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames (Amb k) (Eb k) (sigma k)
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_chart k (psi k x)
  have hx' : x ∈ V ⊓ (psi k) ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen k 2 a := ⟨hx, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWV⟩ :=
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 (Amb k).isBasis_affineOpens) hx'
  have hWa : psi k ''ᵁ W ≤ coordinateOpen k 2 a :=
    ((psi k).image_mono (hWV.trans inf_le_right)).trans ((psi k).image_preimage_le _)
  refine ⟨W, hWV.trans inf_le_left, hxW, hW, 1, basisA k a W hWa, ?_⟩
  haveI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨x, hxW⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty (psi k ''ᵁ W) := ⟨⟨psi k x, ⟨x, hxW, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  have key : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(Amb k, W)
      [(show Γ(Amb k, W) from ((sigma k).val.app (op W)).hom (basisA k a W hWa 0))] := by
    rw [RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff]
    exact IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero (sigma_basisA_ne_zero k a W hWa 0)
  simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero]
  exact key

  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hn, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ← Functor.map_comp]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.cm_meet
statement:
theorem cm_meet (a : Fin 3) (h : rp k a 2 ∉ Ideal.span {fpoly k a}) :
    (Set.range (cm k a) ∩ Set.range (cm k 2)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let U := Ua k a
  let P : PrimeSpectrum Γ(Amb k, U.1) := ⟨(Iσ k).ideal U, isPrime_Ua k a⟩
  let s := chartRingEquiv k a (Koszul.ratio k 2 a 2)
  have hsP : s ∉ P.asIdeal := by
    change chartRingEquiv k a (Koszul.ratio k 2 a 2) ∉ (Iσ k).ideal (Ua k a)
    rw [ideal_Ua_poly, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← polyEquiv_rp, map_dvd_iff]
    rwa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h
  let p := U.2.fromSpec P
  have hp2 : p ∈ (Ua k 2).1 := by
    have hb : P ∈ U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (Amb k).basicOpen s := by
      rw [U.2.fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen]
      exact hsP
    have hpre := Scheme.preimage_basicOpen (psi k) (Koszul.ratio k 2 a 2)
    rw [basicOpen_ratio] at hpre
    have hb' : p ∈ (psi k) ⁻¹ᵁ (coordinateOpen k 2 a ⊓ coordinateOpen k 2 2) := by
      rw [hpre]
      exact hb
    exact hb'.2
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : U.2.isoSpec.inv P ∈ Set.range ((Iσ k).glueDataObjι U) := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_glueDataObjι]
    exact ⟨P, fun x hx => hx, rfl⟩
  have hiq : iota k (cm k a q) = p := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeCover_map_subschemeι]
    change (Ua k a).1.ι ((Iσ k).glueDataObjι (Ua k a) q) = p
    rw [hq]
    rfl
  refine ⟨cm k a q, ⟨q, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [range_cm]
  change iota k (cm k a q) ∈ (Ua k 2).1
  rw [hiq]
  exact hp2

name: RA1.adamsRiemannRoch_euler_all
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_euler_all (hn : 0 < n) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        ((g0Euler k (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
          k n hn i hover) (k0ToG0 X x) : ℤ) : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) =
      kLocPush j k n hn (resSpec k).res
        (pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (adamsCotangentClass k n) -
                (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_comp
statement:
lemma openSectionsBaseChangeMap_comp
    (Q : Y.Modules) {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    (baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
        (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, W) Γ(Q, W))).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map
          (openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q hVW) ≫
      openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q hUV =
        openSectionsBaseChangeMap Q (hUV.trans hVW)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_one_tmul,
    ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul,
    openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul,
    openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  change Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op
      (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op x) =
    Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hUV.trans hVW)).op x
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Q.presheaf.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso_nested_restriction
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso_nested_restriction
    (g h : R) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p,
      projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
    let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
    let U := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R (g * h)
    let V := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let hUV : U ≤ V := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul_le_left g h
    (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso
        R n (g * h) d p).hom
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
        f M (p + 1) hUV
        ((projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeBasicOpenIso
          R n g d p).hom x) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let N := projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p
  let U := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R (g * h)
  let V := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let W := (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
  let A := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), W)
  let S := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), V)
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), U)
  let hUV : U ≤ V := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul_le_left g h
  let hVW : V ≤ W := le_top
  let hUW : U ≤ W := hUV.trans hVW
  letI : IsAffine U := by
    dsimp only [U, projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
    exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) (g * h)
  letI : IsAffine V := by
    dsimp only [V, projectiveBaseBasicOpen]
    exact IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g
  letI : IsAffine W :=
    isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
  let cUV :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N hUV
  let cVW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N hVW
  let cUW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap N hUW
  let aUV :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      f M (p + 1) hUV
  let aVW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      f M (p + 1) hVW
  let aUW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
      f M (p + 1) hUW
  letI : IsIso cUV :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent
      N hUV
  letI : IsIso cVW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent
      N hVW
  letI : IsIso cUW :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_isIso_of_isQuasicoherent
      N hUW
  letI : IsIso aUV :=
    projectiveTwistingNestedBasicOpenBaseChangeMap_isIso R n g h d p
  letI : IsIso aVW :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R g n d p
  letI : IsIso aUW :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R (g * h) n d p
  let eTop :=
    (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTildeTopLinearEquiv
      R n d p).toModuleIso
  let eV :=
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom).map eTop.hom
  let eU :=
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUW).hom).map eTop.hom
  let assocN :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
      (ModuleCat.of A Γ(N, W))
  let assocH :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
        f M (p + 1) W)
  let z := (asIso cVW).inv x
  let wN := assocN.inv
    ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S, (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] z)
  let zH := eV z
  let wH := assocH.inv
    ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S, (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] zH)
  have hz : cVW z = x := by
    exact (asIso cVW).inv_hom_id_apply x
  have hcandidate :
      (asIso cUW).inv (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) = wN := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso cUW).1
    have hcUWInv := (asIso cUW).inv_hom_id_apply
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x)
    change cUW ((asIso cUW).inv
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x)) =
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x at hcUWInv
    rw [hcUWInv]
    have hcompC :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_comp
        N hUV hVW
    change assocN.hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map cVW ≫
        cUV = cUW at hcompC
    have hcompCApply := congrArg (fun q => q wN) hcompC
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcompCApply
    rw [← hcompCApply]
    simp only [wN]
    rw [assocN.inv_hom_id_apply,
      ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul, hz,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSectionsBaseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  have htransport : eU wN = wH := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso assocH.hom).1
    have hnat :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_naturality
        hUV hVW eTop.hom
    have hnatApply := congrArg
      (fun q => q wN) hnat
    change
      (assocN.hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map eV) wN =
        (eU ≫ assocH.hom) wN at hnatApply
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnatApply
    calc
      assocH.hom (eU wN) =
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars
            (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map eV
              (assocN.hom wN) :=
        hnatApply.symm
      _ = ((1 : T) ⊗ₜ[S,
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom] zH) := by
        simp only [wN]
        rw [assocN.inv_hom_id_apply,
          ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
      _ = assocH.hom wH := by
        simp only [wH]
        rw [assocH.inv_hom_id_apply]
  have hactual :
      aUW wH =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
          f M (p + 1) hUV (aVW zH) := by
    dsimp only [aUW, aVW, hUW]
    rw [← SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp
        f M (p + 1) hUV hVW]
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, wH]
    rw [assocH.inv_hom_id_apply,
      ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  change ((asIso cUW).inv ≫ eU ≫ (asIso aUW).hom)
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op x) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
      f M (p + 1) hUV
      (((asIso cVW).inv ≫ eV ≫ (asIso aVW).hom) x)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [hcandidate, htransport]
  exact hactual

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.k0ClassOf_relativeSheaf_congr

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.tangent_virtual
statement:
theorem tangent_virtual (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i
        (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree k hX hY hYreg hXreg i) =
      kahlerVirtual k dX dY f
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme := (cover_projectiveIntegralK k hY).1
  have hZ : RegStalks (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme :=
    scheme_regStalks (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)) hYreg (cover_card k)
  have hZs : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n + 1 + dY) ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k) := by
    change SmoothOfRelativeDimension _ ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase ≫ Y ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  have e : i ≫ ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k := by
    change i ≫ ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase ≫ Y ↘ Spk k) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, hi, hf]
  have hXs : SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (i ≫ ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k)) := by
    rw [e]; infer_instance
  have h1 := kahlerClass_conormal k i hZ hXreg (n + 1 + dY) dX
  have h2 := kahlerClass_composite_square (g := Y ↘ Spk k)
    (OMGC.isPullback_q0 (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)) dY
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k)
      (n + 1 + dY)).isFiniteLocallyFree
    (OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
      (OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)))
  have h3 := k0ClassOf_relativeSheaf_congr e
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (i ≫ ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k)) dX).isFiniteLocallyFree
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (X ↘ Spk k) dX).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h4 : pullbackK0RingHom i (pullbackK0RingHom (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase
      (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Y ↘ Spk k) dY).isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      pullbackK0RingHom f (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Y ↘ Spk k) dY).isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hi]
  unfold GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.relCotangentVirtual kahlerVirtual
  have h5 := congrArg (pullbackK0RingHom i) h2
  rw [map_add, h4] at h5
  replace h5 : pullbackK0RingHom i
      (k0ClassOf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme ↘ Spk k)
          (n + 1 + dY)).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      pullbackK0RingHom f (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Y ↘ Spk k) dY).isFiniteLocallyFree) +
      pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
        (OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
          (OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)))) := h5
  change _ - k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb i) _ = _
  rw [← h3]
  exact sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.2
    ((add_comm _ _).trans ((h1.symm.trans h5).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)))

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.grr_chow_intrinsic
statement:
theorem grr_chow_intrinsic (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan k X (kahlerVirtual k dX dY f)
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ _ x
  rw [← tangent_virtual k dX dY hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi]
  exact GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.grr_chow_kahler_f k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.grr_chow_intrinsic_exists
statement:
theorem grr_chow_intrinsic_exists (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    ∀ [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) f
          (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan k X (kahlerVirtual k dX dY f)
            (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X)))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  intro _ _ x
  obtain ⟨n, i, hic, hi⟩ := GRRBlueprintV4.RT2.exists_factorisation_pos k hX hY f hf
  haveI := hic
  haveI : i.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change i ≫ ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase ≫ Y ↘ Spk k) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, hi, hf]⟩
  exact grr_chow_intrinsic k dX dY hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x

name: B7.coeff_pushSeries
statement:
theorem coeff_pushSeries (r : R₁⟦X⟧) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff m (pushSeries F d r) =
      if 0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + d then F (coeff (((m : ℤ) + d).toNat) r) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [pushSeries]

name: B7.pushSeries_mem
statement: theorem pushSeries_mem (r : ReesPS Φ₁) : ∀ m, coeff m (pushSeries F d (r : R₁⟦X⟧)) ∈ Φ₂.F m
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  rw [coeff_pushSeries]
  split_ifs with h
  · have := hF (((m : ℤ) + d).toNat) _ (r.2 _)
    have e : ((((m : ℤ) + d).toNat : ℤ) - d).toNat = m := by omega
    rwa [e] at this
  · exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: B7.reesPush_coeff
statement:
theorem reesPush_coeff (r : ReesPS Φ₁) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff m ((reesPush F d hF r : ReesPS Φ₂) : R₂⟦X⟧) =
      if 0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + d then F (coeff (((m : ℤ) + d).toNat) (r : R₁⟦X⟧)) else 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_pushSeries F d _ m

name: B7.reesPush_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem reesPush_mem_ideal {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + d ≤ D₁) {r : ReesPS Φ₁}
    (hr : r ∈ ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) : reesPush F d hF r ∈ ReesIdeal Φ₂ D₂
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [reesPush_coeff]
  split_ifs with h
  · have hn : ((m : ℤ) + d).toNat ≤ D₁ := by omega
    have := hF (((m : ℤ) + d).toNat + 1) _ (hr _ hn)
    have e : (((((m : ℤ) + d).toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - d).toNat = m + 1 := by omega
    rwa [e] at this
  · exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: B7.fGr_mk
statement:
theorem fGr_mk {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + d ≤ D₁) (r : ReesPS Φ₁) :
    fGr F d hF hD (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) r : ReesPS Φ₁ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ₂ D₂) (reesPush F d hF r) : ReesPS Φ₂ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ₂ D₂)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: B7.reesPush_gclPS_of_le
statement:
theorem reesPush_gclPS_of_le {n : ℕ} (hnd : d ≤ n) (a : Φ₁.F n) :
    reesPush F d hF (gclPS n a) = gclPS (((n : ℤ) - d).toNat) ⟨F a, hF n a a.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext m
  rw [reesPush_coeff]
  show _ = coeff m (C (F (a : R₁)) * X ^ (((n : ℤ) - d).toNat))
  rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  show (if 0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + d then F (coeff _ (C (a : R₁) * X ^ n)) else 0) = _
  rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  by_cases h : 0 ≤ (m : ℤ) + d
  · rw [if_pos h]
    by_cases hmn : m = ((n : ℤ) - d).toNat
    · have : ((m : ℤ) + d).toNat = n := by omega
      rw [if_pos this, if_pos hmn]
    · have : ¬ ((m : ℤ) + d).toNat = n := by omega
      rw [if_neg this, if_neg hmn, map_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have : ¬ m = ((n : ℤ) - d).toNat := by omega
    rw [if_neg this]

name: B7.reesPush_gclPS_of_lt
statement:
theorem reesPush_gclPS_of_lt {n : ℕ} (hnd : (n : ℤ) < d) (a : Φ₁.F n) :
    reesPush F d hF (gclPS n a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext m
  rw [reesPush_coeff]
  show _ = coeff m (0 : R₂⟦X⟧)
  rw [map_zero]
  split_ifs with h
  · show F (coeff _ (C (a : R₁) * X ^ n)) = 0
    rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg (by omega), map_zero]
  · rfl

name: B7.fGr_gcl_of_le
statement:
theorem fGr_gcl_of_le {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + d ≤ D₁) {n : ℕ} (hnd : d ≤ n) (a : Φ₁.F n) :
    fGr F d hF hD (gcl D₁ n a) = gcl D₂ (((n : ℤ) - d).toNat) ⟨F a, hF n a a.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  show fGr F d hF hD (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) (gclPS n a) :
    ReesPS Φ₁ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) = _
  rw [fGr_mk, reesPush_gclPS_of_le F d hF hnd]
  rfl

name: B7.fGr_gcl_of_lt
statement:
theorem fGr_gcl_of_lt {D₁ D₂ : ℕ} (hD : (D₂ : ℤ) + d ≤ D₁) {n : ℕ} (hnd : (n : ℤ) < d)
    (a : Φ₁.F n) : fGr F d hF hD (gcl D₁ n a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show fGr F d hF hD (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) (gclPS n a) :
    ReesPS Φ₁ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ₁ D₁) = _
  rw [fGr_mk, reesPush_gclPS_of_lt F d hF hnd]
  exact map_zero (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ₂ D₂))

      haveI : IsClosedImmersion i
proof:

            (spk_projectiveIntegralOver ℤ) (regStalks_spec ℤ) (𝟙 _) (by simp) x) =

  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, h⟩ := M1.adams_intrinsic_exists (R := ℤ) (X := Spk ℤ) (Y := Spk ℤ)
    (spk_projectiveIntegralOver ℤ) (regStalks_spec ℤ) (spk_projectiveIntegralOver ℤ)

  rwa [adams_spk_int, adams_spk_int] at this

    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m)) ⟶ PY R (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m))) n)
      (hi : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m)) ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = 𝟙 _ ∧
      haveI : IsClosedImmersion i
proof:
:= hi
      haveI : IsIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m))) := (residue_projectiveIntegralOver R m).1
      ∀ (j : ℕ), 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m))),
        RT.ARR (residue_projectiveIntegralOver R m) (residue_regStalks R m) n i
          (residue_regStalks R m) j x :=
  M1.adamsRiemannRoch_baseRing (R := R) (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m)))
    (Y := Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ m))) (residue_projectiveIntegralOver R m)
    (residue_regStalks R m) (residue_projectiveIntegralOver R m) (residue_regStalks R m) (𝟙 _)
    (by simp)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingNestedBasicOpenBaseChangeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingNestedBasicOpenBaseChangeMap_isIso
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (g h : R) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R (g * h) ≤
          projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g from
            PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul_le_left g h))
proof:
:= by
  let U := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R (g * h)
  let V := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let W := (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
  let hUV : U ≤ V := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul_le_left g h
  let hVW : V ≤ W := le_top
  letI :
      IsIso
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) hVW) :=
    projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R g n d p
  letI :
      IsIso
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1)
          (hUV.trans hVW)) := by
    exact projectiveTwistingAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso R (g * h) n d p
  exact
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_isIso_of_comp
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (p + 1) hUV hVW

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.unit_map_mate
statement:
theorem unit_map_mate {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (adj : F ⊣ G) {N : C} {M : D} (f : N ⟶ G.obj M) :
    adj.unit.app N ≫ G.map (F.map f ≫ adj.counit.app M) = f
proof:
:= by
  have h := (adj.homEquiv N M).apply_symm_apply f
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_counit] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.specRelativeSheaf_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem specRelativeSheaf_isQuasicoherent {R A : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ A)
    (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth φ.hom) :
    (relativeSheaf (Spec.map φ)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI := (gammaRingHom φ).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec A, ⊤) :=
    gammaRingHom_isStandardSmooth φ hsm
  obtain ⟨ι, σ, hσ, hι, ⟨P⟩⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.out (R := Γ(Spec R, ⊤)) (S := Γ(Spec A, ⊤))
  letI : Finite σ := hσ
  letI : Finite ι := hι
  let n := P.dimension
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (Spec.map φ) := ⟨fun _ =>
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _, ⊤, isAffineOpen_top _, by trivial, le_top,
      P.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension rfl⟩⟩
  letI : (relativeSheaf (Spec.map φ)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (Spec.map φ) n).isFinitePresentation
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.specRelativeSheafIsoTilde_unit
statement:
theorem specRelativeSheafIsoTilde_unit {R A : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ A)
    (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth φ.hom) :
    (tilde.isoTop (R := A) (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential φ)).hom ≫
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A)).map (specRelativeSheafIsoTilde φ hsm).inv =
    (affineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth φ hsm).hom
proof:
:= by
  let adj := tilde.adjunction (R := A)
  let M := relativeSheaf (Spec.map φ)
  let e := affineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth φ hsm
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent := specRelativeSheaf_isQuasicoherent φ hsm
  letI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := A) M) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  change adj.unit.app (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential φ) ≫
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := A)).map
      ((tilde.functor A).map e.hom ≫ adj.counit.app M) = e.hom
  exact unit_map_mate adj e.hom

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.specRelativeSheafIsoTilde_inv_d
statement:
theorem specRelativeSheafIsoTilde_inv_d {R A : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ A)
    (hsm : RingHom.IsStandardSmooth φ.hom) (a : A) :

      ((tilde.isoTop (R := A) (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential φ)).hom
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := φ) a)) =
      TF2.Esec (Spec.map φ) ⊤ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a)
proof:
:=
  (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (specRelativeSheafIsoTilde_unit φ hsm)
    (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := φ) a)).trans
      (affineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth_d φ hsm a)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.algebraTensorIso_inv_tmul

theorem algebraTensorIso_inv_tmul {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (M : ModuleCat A) (b : B) (m : M) :
    (algebraTensorIso (B := B) M).inv (b ⊗ₜ[A] m) = b ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A B] m
proof:

  (congrArg (algebraTensorIso (B := B) M).inv (algebraTensorIso_apply M b m).symm).trans

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.pulledOmegaSectionsIso_one_tmul_D
statement:
theorem pulledOmegaSectionsIso_one_tmul_D (a : A) :
    (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).hom
      ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D R A a) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))).unit.app
        (relativeSheaf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))))).app ⊤
      (TF2.Esec (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))) ⊤
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv a))
proof:
:= by
  let M := relativeSheaf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent := algebraRelativeSheaf_isQuasicoherent (R := R) (A := A)
  let e := algebraAffineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth (R := R) (A := A)
  let t := (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A B)).map e.hom
  change cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap (algebraMap A B) M
    (t ((algebraTensorIso (B := B) (ModuleCat.of A Ω[A⁄R])).inv
      ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D R A a))) = _
  have h₁ := algebraTensorIso_inv_tmul (B := B) (ModuleCat.of A Ω[A⁄R])
    1 (KaehlerDifferential.D R A a)
  have h₂ := ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul (algebraMap A B) e.hom
    1 (KaehlerDifferential.D R A a)
  have h₃ := algebraAffineDifferentialIsoOfStandardSmooth_D (R := R) (A := A) a
  exact (congrArg (fun z => cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap (algebraMap A B) M (t z)) h₁).trans
    ((congrArg (cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap (algebraMap A B) M) h₂).trans
      ((congrArg (fun z => cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap (algebraMap A B) M
        ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A B] z)) h₃).trans
          (nativeTensorMap_one_tmul (algebraMap A B) M _)))

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.cotangentDifferentialSections_eq_extension
statement:
theorem cotangentDifferentialSections_eq_extension :
    cotangentDifferentialSections P (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R P.Ring))) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom P.cotangentComplex ≫
        (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := P.Ring) (B := B)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Extension.Cotangent.mk_surjective y
  exact (cotangentDifferentialSections_mk P
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R P.Ring))) x).trans
      ((pulledOmegaSectionsIso_one_tmul_D (R := R) (A := P.Ring) (B := B) x.val).symm.trans
        (congrArg (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := P.Ring) (B := B)).hom

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.originalConormalDifferential_extension_square

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.functionExact_transport
statement:
theorem functionExact_transport {X Y Z X' Y' Z' : Type*} [Zero Z] [Zero Z']
    (f : X → Y) (g : Y → Z) (f' : X' → Y') (g' : Y' → Z')
    (a : X → X') (b : Y → Y') (c : Z → Z')
    (ha : Function.Surjective a) (hb : Function.Injective b) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (hc0 : c 0 = 0) (hf : ∀ x, b (f x) = f' (a x))
    (hg : ∀ y, c (g y) = g' (b y)) (he : Function.Exact f' g') :
    Function.Exact f g
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hy' : g' (b y) = 0 := (hg y).symm.trans ((congrArg c hy).trans hc0)
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := (he (b y)).mp hy'
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ha x'
    exact ⟨x, hb ((hf x).trans ((congrArg f' hx).trans hx'))⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    apply hc
    exact (hg (f x)).trans ((congrArg g' (hf x)).trans
      (((he (f' (a x))).mpr ⟨a x, rfl⟩).trans hc0.symm))

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.functionSurjective_transport
statement:
theorem functionSurjective_transport {Y Z Y' Z' : Type*}
    (g : Y → Z) (g' : Y' → Z') (b : Y → Y') (c : Z → Z')
    (hb : Function.Surjective b) (hc : Function.Bijective c)
    (hg : ∀ y, c (g y) = g' (b y)) (hs : Function.Surjective g') :
    Function.Surjective g
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hs (c z)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hb y'
  exact ⟨y, hc.injective ((hg y).trans ((congrArg g' hy).trans hy'))⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeSourceNormalizer_surjective
statement:
theorem nativeSourceNormalizer_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (nativeSourceNormalizer (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
proof:
:=
  (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom).surjective.comp
    ((ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).mapIso
        (pulledIdealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)))).hom).surjective.comp
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).mapIso (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p))).hom).surjective)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeComparison_sections_apply
statement:
theorem nativeComparison_sections_apply
    (x : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).obj
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb (j ≫ p))) :
    (libraryCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p) x) =
      conormalMap (A := A) hf (nativeSourceNormalizer (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (libraryCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p) x) =
      (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.conormalIso j).hom
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p) x)) :=
    libraryCotangentSectionsIso_hom_apply (ambientExtension (A := A) hf) _
  have h₂ : (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.conormalIso j).hom
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p) x)) =
      conormalMap (A := A) hf (nativeSourceNormalizer (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x) := by
    have hn := @nativeConormalComparison_sections R A B
      (inferInstanceAs (CommRing R)) (inferInstanceAs (CommRing A))
      (inferInstanceAs (CommRing B)) (inferInstanceAs (Algebra R A))
      (inferInstanceAs (Algebra R B)) (inferInstanceAs (Algebra A B))
      (inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R A B)) hquot hamb x
    have hm₁ := affineSections_map_apply (conormalComparison j p) x
    have hm₂ := affineSections_map_apply (TF3.conormalIso j).hom
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p) x)
    have hL : (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.conormalIso j).hom
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p) x)) =
        (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
          ((TF3.conormalIso j).hom.app ⊤ ((conormalComparison j p).app ⊤ x)) :=
      (congrArg (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom hm₂).trans
        (congrArg (fun q => (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
          ((TF3.conormalIso j).hom.app ⊤ q)) hm₁)
    have hs₁ := affineSections_map_apply (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom x
    have hs₂ := affineSections_map_apply
      (pulledIdealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).hom
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom x)
    have hS : nativeSourceNormalizer (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x =
        (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
          ((pulledIdealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).hom.app ⊤
          ((TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom.app ⊤ x)) :=
      (congrArg (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom hs₂).trans
        (congrArg (fun q => (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
          ((pulledIdealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).hom.app ⊤ q)) hs₁)
    have hN : (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((TF3.conormalIso j).hom.app ⊤ ((conormalComparison j p).app ⊤ x)) =
        conormalMap (A := A) hf
          ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
            ((pulledIdealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).hom.app ⊤
            ((TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom.app ⊤ x))) := hn
    have hC : conormalMap (A := A) hf
          ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
            ((pulledIdealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).hom.app ⊤
            ((TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom.app ⊤ x))) =
        conormalMap (A := A) hf (nativeSourceNormalizer (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x) :=
      congrArg (conormalMap (A := A) hf) hS.symm
    exact hL.trans (hN.trans hC)
  exact h₁.trans h₂

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeDifferential_sections_square
statement:
theorem nativeDifferential_sections_square :
    (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.c p j) ≫
      (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).inv =
    (libraryCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).Ring :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R A)
  apply isoTarget_cancel (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).symm
  exact (originalConormalDifferential_extension_square (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).trans
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeDifferential_sections_apply
statement:
theorem nativeDifferential_sections_apply
    (x : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).obj
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb j)) :
    (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).inv
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.c p j) x) =
      (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
        ((libraryCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom x)
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (nativeDifferential_sections_square
    (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)) x

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeAffine_maps_exact
statement:
theorem nativeAffine_maps_exact : Function.Exact
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (conormalComparison j p))
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.c p j))
proof:
:=
  functionExact_transport _ _ (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
    (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
    (nativeSourceNormalizer (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
    (libraryCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
    (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).inv
    (nativeSourceNormalizer_surjective (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
    (map_zero _)
    (nativeComparison_sections_apply (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
    (nativeDifferential_sections_apply (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
    (conormalMap_exact (A := A) hf)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeAffine_differential_surjective
statement:
theorem nativeAffine_differential_surjective : Function.Surjective
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of B)).map (TF3.c p j))
proof:
:=
  functionSurjective_transport _ _
    (libraryCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
    (pulledOmegaSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).inv
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).surjective
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)
    (nativeDifferential_sections_apply (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
    (conormalDifferential_surjective (A := A) hf)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerPullbackH2.nativeAffineSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem nativeAffineSequence_shortExact :
    (nativeAffineSequence (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono (nativeAffineSequence (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).f :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr
      (nativeConormalComparison_injective (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
  haveI : Epi (nativeAffineSequence (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).g :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr
      (nativeAffine_differential_surjective (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
  exact ⟨(ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mpr
    (nativeAffine_maps_exact (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))⟩

statement:
theorem nativeAffineSequenceOfSurjective_shortExact [Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R A] :

proof:

  letI : Fact (Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B)) :=
    ⟨ConormalComparisonH2.ambient_surjective (A := A) hf⟩
  exact nativeAffineSequence_shortExact (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapExactFunctor_comp
statement:
theorem extMapExactFunctor_comp
    {C D E : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Category.{u} E]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [Abelian E]
    [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D] [HasExt.{u} E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    {X Y : C} {n : ℕ} (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X Y n) :
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G)
proof:
:=
      @comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ G) :=
      @comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
    (x.mapExactFunctor F).mapExactFunctor G = x.mapExactFunctor (F ⋙ G) := by
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ G) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
  dsimp only [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor]
  let Phi := F.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
  let Psi := G.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
  letI : (Phi.comp Psi).functor.CommShift ℤ :=
    localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi
  let eFX : Phi.functor.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X) :=
    (F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X
  let eFY : Phi.functor.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y) :=
    (F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y
  let eGX : Psi.functor.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X)) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor E 0).obj (G.obj (F.obj X)) :=
    (G.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app (F.obj X)
  let eGY : Psi.functor.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y)) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor E 0).obj (G.obj (F.obj Y)) :=
    (G.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app (F.obj Y)
  rw [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_comp_functor_of_isos
    Phi Psi
    (X₁ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X)
    (Y₁ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)
    (X₂ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X))
    (Y₂ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y))
    (X₃ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor E 0).obj (G.obj (F.obj X)))
    (Y₃ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor E 0).obj (G.obj (F.obj Y)))
    eFX eFY eGX eGY x]
  have hComm : (localizerMorphismCompCommShift Phi Psi) =
      (inferInstance :
        ((F ⋙ G).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).CommShift ℤ) := by
    generalize h₁ : localizerMorphismCompCommShift (M := ℤ) Phi Psi = cs₁
    generalize h₂ : (inferInstance :
      ((F ⋙ G).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).CommShift ℤ) = cs₂
    rcases cs₁ with ⟨e₁, _, _⟩
    rcases cs₂ with ⟨e₂, _, _⟩
    congr 1
    funext a
    ext K i
    have he₁ := congrArg (fun s =>
      ((((Functor.CommShift.commShiftIso (Phi.comp Psi).functor
        (self := s) a).hom.app K).f i))) h₁
    have he₂ := congrArg (fun s =>
      ((((Functor.CommShift.commShiftIso
        ((F ⋙ G).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
        (self := s) a).hom.app K).f i))) h₂
    dsimp only [Functor.CommShift.commShiftIso] at he₁ he₂
    rw [← he₁, ← he₂]
    simp [Phi, Psi, Functor.commShiftIso_comp_hom_app]
  rw [hComm]
  letI : (Phi.comp Psi).functor.CommShift ℤ := by
    change ((F ⋙ G).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).CommShift ℤ
    infer_instance
  change (Phi.comp Psi).smallShiftedHomMap
      (localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi eFX eGX)
      (localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi eFY eGY) x =
    (Phi.comp Psi).smallShiftedHomMap
      (((F ⋙ G).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X)
      (((F ⋙ G).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y) x
  have hX : localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi eFX eGX =
      ((F ⋙ G).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso, localizerMorphismCompObjIso,
        eFX, eGX, Phi, Psi, Functor.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor]
    · simp [localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso, localizerMorphismCompObjIso,
        eFX, eGX, Phi, Psi, Functor.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor, hi]
  have hY : localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso Phi Psi eFY eGY =
      ((F ⋙ G).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso, localizerMorphismCompObjIso,
        eFY, eGY, Phi, Psi, Functor.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor]
    · simp [localizerMorphismCompEndpointIso, localizerMorphismCompObjIso,
        eFY, eGY, Phi, Psi, Functor.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor, hi]
  rw [hX, hY]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.addEquiv_cast_smul_sections
statement:
theorem addEquiv_cast_smul_sections
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V : X.Opens} (h : U = V)
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(M, W)) h) (r • x) =
      (M.smul
        (AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(X, W)) h) r)).hom
          (AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(M, W)) h) x)

:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.presheaf_map_homOfLE_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Modules.presheaf_map_homOfLE_comp_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V V' W : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V)
    (hV'U : V' ≤ U) (hWV' : W ≤ V')
    (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV').op
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV'U).op x)
proof:
:= by
  repeat rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateOverlapCanonicalNativeSectionsAddEquiv_eq
statement:
