name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overlapNative_smul
statement:
theorem overlapNative_smul
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j)
    (z : projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsBase R n M i j) :
    projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i j (a • z) =
      (M.smul ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading R n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)).hom a)).hom
          (projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i j z)
proof:
:= by
  let V := coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j
  let eV : V.toScheme ≅
      Spec (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j)) :=
    Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)
  have hsource : a • z =
      ((projectiveCoordinateOverlapAffineModel R n M i j).smul
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
          (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).inv a)).hom z := by
    rfl
  rw [← projectiveCoordinateOverlapCanonicalNativeSectionsAddEquiv_eq,
    ← projectiveCoordinateOverlapCanonicalNativeSectionsAddEquiv_eq]
  rw [hsource]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateOverlapCanonicalNativeSectionsAddEquiv,
    AddEquiv.trans_apply,
    Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv_apply]
  erw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply]
  erw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  rw [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso_hom_smul]
  congr 1
  have heV : eV.inv ''ᵁ
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens) =
      (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
  have hinner (r : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j)), ⊤)) :
      V.toScheme.presheaf.map ((eqToIso heV.symm).op.hom)
          ((eV.inv.appIso ⊤).inv r) =
        eV.hom.appTop r := by
    have hcomp :
        V.toScheme.presheaf.map ((eqToIso heV.symm).op.hom) ≫
            eV.inv.appTop =
          (eV.inv.appIso ⊤).hom := by
      rw [eV.inv.naturality]
      rw [eV.inv.appIso_hom]
      apply congrArg (fun q =>
        eV.inv.app (eV.inv ''ᵁ
            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
              (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).Opens)) ≫
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of
            (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).presheaf.map q)
      apply Subsingleton.elim
    have hinvcomp :
        (eV.inv.appIso ⊤).inv ≫
            V.toScheme.presheaf.map ((eqToIso heV.symm).op.hom) =
          eV.hom.appTop := by
      apply (cancel_mono eV.inv.appTop).1
      rw [Category.assoc, hcomp]
      simp [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, hinvcomp]
  change V.topIso.hom
      (V.toScheme.presheaf.map ((eqToIso heV.symm).op.hom)
        ((eV.inv.appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).inv a))) =
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)).hom a
  rw [hinner]
  have happ := Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top
    (grading R n) (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
  change eV.hom.appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
        (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).hom ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading R n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)).hom ≫
        V.topIso.inv at happ
  rw [happ]
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  rw [(Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j))).inv_hom_id_apply]
  exact V.topIso.inv_hom_id_apply _

theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv_smul

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.native_compatible
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.native_compatible
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
          (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i s) =
      (M.smul (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j).1).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
            (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
              R n M j (E.component j)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv
      R n M i j hji.symm) (E.compatible j hji)
  rw [projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv_leftRight,
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap,
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv_smul,
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTransitionSection_mul_cocycle
statement:
theorem localFrameTransitionSection_mul_cocycle
    (d : ℤ) (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameTransitionSectionIJ R n d i j k *
        localFrameTransitionSectionJL R n d i j k =
      localFrameTransitionSectionIL R n d i j k
proof:
:= by
  rw [localFrameTransitionSectionIJ_eq, localFrameTransitionSectionJL_eq,
    localFrameTransitionSectionIL_eq]
  let F := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading R n)
    (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k)
    (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R n i j k) (by omega)
      ).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
  change Units.map F
        (Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ R n i j k).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j)) *
      Units.map F
        (Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit R n d j k)) =
    Units.map F
      (Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIL R n i j k).toMonoidHom
        (twistTransitionUnit R n d i k))
  rw [← map_mul]
  exact congrArg (Units.map F) (twistTransitionUnit_cocycle R n d i j k)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTripleSpecMap_overlapInvJL
statement:
theorem coordinateTripleSpecMap_overlapInvJL
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let eV
proof:
:= Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k) (by omega)
    let eW := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k)
      (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R n i j k) (by omega)
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k)) ≫ eV.inv =
      eW.inv ≫ (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).homOfLE
        (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k) := by
  dsimp only
  let hmul : coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k =
      coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k * coordinate R n i := by
    simp only [coordinateTripleEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation]
    ac_rfl
  have hmap : coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k =
      HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) hmul := by
    rfl
  have hle :
      (Proj.basicOpen (grading R n)
          (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k) :
        (Proj (grading R n)).Opens) ≤
        Proj.basicOpen (grading R n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k) := by
    exact Proj.basicOpen_mono (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k)
      (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k)
      ⟨coordinate R n i, hmul⟩
  rw [hmap]
  change
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) hmul)) ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k) (by omega)).inv =
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
        (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k)
        (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R n i j k) (by omega)).inv ≫
        (Proj (grading R n)).homOfLE hle
  apply (cancel_mono
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k) (by omega)).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom]
  rw [← Proj.basicOpenToSpec_SpecMap_awayMap (grading R n)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) hmul]
  rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom (grading R n)
    (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k)
    (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R n i j k) (by omega)]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineNativeSectionsAddEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineNativeSectionsAddEquiv_apply
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (z : Γ(projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineModel R n M i j k, ⊤)) :
    let W
proof:
:= coordinateTripleOpen R n i j k
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj M
    let eW : W.toScheme ≅
        Spec (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k)) :=
      Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
        (coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k)
        (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R n i j k) (by omega)
    let h : eW.inv ''ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k))).Opens) =
        (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
        Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i j k z =
      restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv M W
        (AddEquiv.cast
          (congrArg (fun U : W.toScheme.Opens => Γ(P, U)) h) z) := by
  dsimp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineNativeSectionsAddEquiv,
    projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineModel]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap_eq_stage0
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap_eq_stage0
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (z : projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsBase R n M j k) :
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
        R n M i j k hij z =
      projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage0

proof:
:= by
  let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k))
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization.Away
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationAway R n i j k hij
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q :=
    IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
  let N := projectiveCoordinateOverlapAffineModel R n M j k
  have himage : q ''ᵁ
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k))).Opens) =
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
        (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩)) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact opensRange_specMap_of_isLocalizationAway_eq_basicOpen
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
  change (localizedModuleSpecΓOfAwayLinearEquiv
      (S := CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k)
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩)) N).symm
        (N.presheaf.map
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
            (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
              (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))).leTop.op z) =
    N.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k))).Opens) ≤
            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
              (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k))).Opens) from le_top)).op z
  rw [localizedModuleSpecΓOfAwayLinearEquiv_symm_apply]
  change N.presheaf.map (eqToIso himage).op.hom
      (N.presheaf.map
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
            (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))).leTop.op z) =
    N.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k))).Opens) ≤
            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
              (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k))).Opens) from le_top)).op z
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineModelIso_map_stage0
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineModelIso_map_stage0

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateTripleLocalizedNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateTripleLocalizedNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (z : projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsBase R n M j k) :
    projectiveCoordinateTripleLocalizedNativeSectionsAddEquiv
        R n M i j k hij
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
          R n M i j k hij z) =
      M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
        (projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv
          R n M j k z)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toAlgebra
  letI : IsLocalization.Away
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationAway R n i j k hij
  change projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineNativeSectionsAddEquiv
      R n M i j k
        (((projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineModelIso
          R n M i j k hij).hom.app ⊤).hom
          (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
            R n M i j k hij z)) =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
      (projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j k z)
  rw [projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap_eq_stage0]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineModelIso_map_stage0]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage4_eq_stage4b]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage4b]
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage4a]
  rw [restrictFunctorComp_symm_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage3]
  rw [restrictFunctorComp_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage2]
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage1]
  rw [restrictFunctorComp_symm_app_hom_app_apply]
  simp only [projectiveCoordinateTripleRestrictionTailStage0]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateTripleAffineNativeSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  rw [restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  rw [restrictTopSectionsAddEquiv_apply]
  simp only [id_eq, Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
  erw [addEquiv_cast_trans_apply]
  erw [addEquiv_cast_trans_apply]
  repeat rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  apply SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_map_cast
  · rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    exact (coordinateOverlapOpen R n j k).ι_image_top
  · rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    exact (coordinateTripleOpen R n i j k).ι_image_top

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.native_triple_compatible
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.native_triple_compatible
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j ≠ i) (hki : k ≠ i) :
    M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
          (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
            R n M j (E.component j))) =
      (M.smul (localFrameTransitionSectionJL R n (D : ℤ) i j k).1).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
          (M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
            (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
              R n M k (E.component k))))
proof:
:= by
  let W := coordinateTripleOpen R n i j k
  let ui := projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i s
  let uj := projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
    R n M j (E.component j)
  let uk := projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
    R n M k (E.component k)
  let uIJ := M.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ R n i j k)).op
    (M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op ui)
  let xIJ := M.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ R n i j k)).op
    (M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op uj)
  let uIK := M.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL R n i j k)).op
    (M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op ui)
  let yIK := M.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL R n i j k)).op
    (M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op uk)
  let xJK := M.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
    (M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op uj)
  let yJK := M.presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
    (M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op uk)
  let A := localFrameTransitionSectionIJ R n (D : ℤ) i j k
  let B := localFrameTransitionSectionJL R n (D : ℤ) i j k
  let C := localFrameTransitionSectionIL R n (D : ℤ) i j k
  have hIJ := congrArg
    (fun z => M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ R n i j k)).op z)
    (ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.native_compatible
      R n M D i s E j hji)
  change uIJ =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ R n i j k)).op
        ((twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j).1 •
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
            uj) at hIJ
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul] at hIJ
  have hIJ' : uIJ = (A.1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, W)) • xIJ := by
    exact hIJ
  have hIK := congrArg
    (fun z => M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL R n i j k)).op z)
    (ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.native_compatible
      R n M D i s E k hki)
  change uIK =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL R n i j k)).op
        ((twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i k).1 •
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
            uk) at hIK
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul] at hIK
  have hIK' : uIK = (C.1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, W)) • yIK := by
    exact hIK
  have hu : uIJ = uIK := by
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.presheaf_map_homOfLE_comp_eq M
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)
      (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ R n i j k)
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i k).le.trans inf_le_left)
      (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL R n i j k) ui
  have hx : xIJ = xJK := by
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.presheaf_map_homOfLE_comp_eq M
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)
      (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ R n i j k)
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)
      (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k) uj
  have hy : yIK = yJK := by
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.presheaf_map_homOfLE_comp_eq M
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i k).le.trans inf_le_right)
      (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL R n i j k)
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)
      (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k) uk
  have hABC : A * B = C :=
    localFrameTransitionSection_mul_cocycle R n (D : ℤ) i j k
  have hunit : A⁻¹ * C = B := by
    rw [← hABC]
    simp
  change xJK = (B.1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, W)) • yJK
  calc
    xJK = xIJ := hx.symm
    _ = (A⁻¹).1 • (A.1 • xIJ) := by
      rw [← mul_smul]
      simp
    _ = (A⁻¹).1 • uIJ := by rw [← hIJ']
    _ = (A⁻¹).1 • uIK := by rw [hu]
    _ = (A⁻¹).1 • (C.1 • yIK) := by rw [hIK']
    _ = (A⁻¹ * C).1 • yIK :=
      (mul_smul (A⁻¹).1 C.1 yIK).symm
    _ = B.1 • yIK := by rw [hunit]
    _ = B.1 • yJK := by rw [hy]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.pairwise_triple_compatible
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.pairwise_triple_compatible
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hji : j ≠ i) (hki : k ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j) :
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
        R n M i j k hji.symm (E.pairwiseLeft R n M D i s j k hkj) =
      projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
        R n M i j k hji.symm (E.pairwiseRight R n M D i s j k hkj)
proof:
:= by
  apply (projectiveCoordinateTripleLocalizedNativeSectionsAddEquiv
    R n M i j k hji.symm).injective
  rw [projectiveCoordinateTripleLocalizedNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateTripleLocalizedNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap]
  simp only [ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.pairwiseLeft,
    ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.pairwiseRight]
  rw [overlapNative_smul]
  have hLeft :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap
      R n M j k hkj (E.component j)
  change projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j k
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv R n M j k hkj
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
          R n M j k hkj (E.component j))) =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
      (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
        R n M j (E.component j)) at hLeft
  rw [hLeft]
  have hRight :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap
      R n M j k hkj.symm (E.component k)
  change projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j k
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
        R n M j k hkj.symm
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M j k hkj.symm (E.component k))) =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
      (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
        R n M k (E.component k)) at hRight
  rw [hRight]
  change M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
      (M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
          R n M j (E.component j))) =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL R n i j k)).op
      ((twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (D : ℤ) j k).1 •
        M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
          (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv
            R n M k (E.component k)))
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  exact E.native_triple_compatible R n M D i s j k hji hki

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData_exists_uniform_pairwise_power
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData_exists_uniform_pairwise_power
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (D : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (s : ι → (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ∀ a, ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i (s a)) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, ∀ p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i, ∀ a,
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1
            (coordinateRatio R n p.1.1.1 ⟨i, p.1.1.2.symm⟩) ^ e •
          (E a).pairwiseLeft R n M D i (s a)
            p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm =
        coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1
            (coordinateRatio R n p.1.1.1 ⟨i, p.1.1.2.symm⟩) ^ e •
          (E a).pairwiseRight R n M D i (s a)
            p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let h := fun p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i =>
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_on_triple_finite_family
      R n M i p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.1.2.symm
      (fun a => (E a).pairwiseLeft R n M D i (s a)
        p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm)
      (fun a => (E a).pairwiseRight R n M D i (s a)
        p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm)
      (fun a => (E a).pairwise_triple_compatible R n M D i (s a)
        p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2.2 p.2.symm)
  let d := fun p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i => (h p).choose
  have hd (p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i) (a : ι) :
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1
            (coordinateRatio R n p.1.1.1 ⟨i, p.1.1.2.symm⟩) ^ d p •
          (E a).pairwiseLeft R n M D i (s a)
            p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm =
        coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1
            (coordinateRatio R n p.1.1.1 ⟨i, p.1.1.2.symm⟩) ^ d p •
          (E a).pairwiseRight R n M D i (s a)
            p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm :=
    (h p).choose_spec a
  let e := Finset.univ.sup d
  refine ⟨e, fun p a => ?_⟩
  have hpe : d p ≤ e := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ p)
  rw [show e = (e - d p) + d p by omega, pow_add,
    mul_smul, mul_smul, hd]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_pairwise_power
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_pairwise_power
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ D e : ℕ,
      ∃ E : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
          ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i
          (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a),
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∀ p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i,
        ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1
              (coordinateRatio R n p.1.1.1 ⟨i, p.1.1.2.symm⟩) ^ e •
            (E i a).pairwiseLeft R n M D i
              (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
              p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm =
          coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1
              (coordinateRatio R n p.1.1.1 ⟨i, p.1.1.2.symm⟩) ^ e •
            (E i a).pairwiseRight R n M D i
              (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
              p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_twistExtensionData R n M
  let E : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
      ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i
        (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) :=
    fun i a => (hD i a).some
  let h := fun i : Fin (n + 1) => by
    let G := projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i
    letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
    exact projectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData_exists_uniform_pairwise_power
      R n M D i
      (fun a : G.I => projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
      (fun a : G.I => E i a)
  let d := fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (h i).choose
  let e := Finset.univ.sup d
  refine ⟨D, e, E, fun i p a => ?_⟩
  have hie : d i ≤ e := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hi := (h i).choose_spec p a
  rw [show e = (e - d i) + d i by omega, pow_add,
    mul_smul, mul_smul, hi]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingHigherTerm_π_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingHigherTerm_π_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom (c • x) =
      c •
        (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))
  let hPi := Limits.productIsProduct' (Discrete.functor f)
  let hRaw := (AddCommGrpCat.HasLimit.productLimitCone f).isLimit
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiIso R n d p
  have he :
      e.hom ≫
          AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
            (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun b ↦ f b) a) =
        Pi.π f a := by
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp hPi hRaw ⟨a⟩
  have hs : e.hom (c • x) = c • e.hom x := by
    change e.hom (e.inv (c • e.hom x)) = _
    simp
  rw [← he]
  change (e.hom (c • x)) a = c • (e.hom x) a
  rw [hs]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_map_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_map_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p) :
    coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d p (c • x) =
      c • coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d p x
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  let πa := Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a
  calc
    (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d p (c • x)) a =
        coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv R n d p a
          (πa.hom (c • x)) :=
      coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply R n d p (c • x) a
    _ = coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv R n d p a
          (c • πa.hom x) := by
      rw [coordinateCechTwistingHigherTerm_π_smul]
    _ = c • coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv R n d p a
          (πa.hom x) :=
      coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_smul
        R n d p a c _
    _ = c • (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv
          R n d p x) a := by
      rw [coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply]
    _ = (c • coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv
          R n d p x) a := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_sections_baseChange
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_sections_baseChange
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
    IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageSections_baseChangeMap
        f M (show PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  letI : IsAffine U.toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a
  letI : IsAffineHom f := isAffineHom_of_isAffine f
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent :=
    projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isQuasicoherent R n d p a
  exact
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalSectionsBaseChange_of_isAffineHom
      f M (show PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
      (IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g)
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveMap_globalSec
statement:
theorem projectiveMap_globalSec
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (c : R) :
    (map φ n).appTop.hom
        (globalSec (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) c) =
      globalSec (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) (φ c)
proof:
:= by
  let m := map φ n
  let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  have hmap := map_toSpec φ n
  have happ :
      (toSpec R n).appTop ≫ m.appTop =
        b.appTop ≫ (toSpec S n).appTop := by
    simpa only [m, b, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] using
      congrArg Scheme.Hom.appTop hmap
  have hspec :
      CommRingCat.ofHom φ ≫
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ b.appTop :=
    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  change
    (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
        (toSpec R n).appTop ≫ m.appTop).hom c) =
      (((CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv ≫
          (toSpec S n).appTop).hom c)
  rw [happ]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← hspec]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveMap_structureRingHom_local
statement:
theorem projectiveMap_structureRingHom_local
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ)
    [IsOpenImmersion (map φ n)]
    (UR : (space R n).Opens) (US : (space S n).Opens)
    (h : (map φ n) ''ᵁ US ≤ UR) (c : R) :
    (space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c) =
      ((map φ n).appIso US).inv
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) US (φ c))
proof:
:= by
  apply ((map φ n).appIso US).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  change
    ((map φ n).appIso US).hom
        ((space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c)) =
      ((map φ n).appIso US).hom
        (((map φ n).appIso US).inv
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) US (φ c)))
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  let m := map φ n
  have hres :
      (space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c) =
        structureRingHom
          (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) (m ''ᵁ US) c := by
    simpa only [m] using
      (structureRingHom_naturality
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) (homOfLE h) c)
  rw [hres]
  have hn :
      (space R n).presheaf.map (m ''ᵁ US).leTop.op ≫
          (m.appIso US).hom =
        m.appTop ≫ (space S n).presheaf.map US.leTop.op := by
    rw [m.appIso_hom]
    rw [m.naturality_assoc]
    rw [← (space S n).presheaf.map_comp]
    congr 1
  change
    (m.appIso US).hom
        ((space R n).presheaf.map (m ''ᵁ US).leTop.op
          (globalSec (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) c)) =
      (space S n).presheaf.map US.leTop.op
        (globalSec (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) (φ c))
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hn, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [projectiveMap_globalSec]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_eq
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_eq
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) ''ᵁ
        (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a) =
      (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) ⊓
        coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
    (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n p a]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
  rw [map_localization_opensRange]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) ''ᵁ
        (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a) ≤
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
proof:
:= by
  change
    (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
        (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a) ≤
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  exact localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le R g n p a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction_map_smul
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction_map_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (c : R)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)))) :
    (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction
        R g n d p a).hom (c • x) =
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) c) •
        (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction
          R g n d p a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let m := map (algebraMap R S) n
  let UR := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let US := coordinateCechIntersection S n p a
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let e := localizationProjectiveTwistingSheafRestrictIso R g n d
  change
    e.hom.app US
        ((F.restrictAppIso m US).inv
          (F.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
                R g n p a)).op
            (structureRingHom
              (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c • x))) =
      structureRingHom
          (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) US
          (algebraMap R S c) •
        e.hom.app US
          ((F.restrictAppIso m US).inv
            (F.presheaf.map
              (homOfLE
                (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
                  R g n p a)).op x))
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  have hscalar :
      (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
              R g n p a)).op
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c) =
        (m.appIso US).inv
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) US
              (algebraMap R S c)) := by
    simpa only [m] using
      (projectiveMap_structureRingHom_local
        (algebraMap R S) n UR US
        (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
          R g n p a) c)
  rw [hscalar]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPreimage_image_eq_localizationImage
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPreimage_image_eq_localizationImage
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    U.ι ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) =
      (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) ''ᵁ
        (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  change
    U.ι ''ᵁ
        (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)) =
      (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) ''ᵁ
        (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a)
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
  rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  rw [localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_eq]
  exact inf_comm _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPushforward_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPushforward_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (U.ι ≫ toSpec R n)).obj M
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  letI : IsAffine U.toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a
  letI : IsAffineHom f := isAffineHom_of_isAffine f
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent :=
    projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isQuasicoherent R n d p a
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom f M
  exact
    (Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ N).mp
      (inferInstance : N.IsQuasicoherent) g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveStructureRingHom_open_topIso
statement:
theorem projectiveStructureRingHom_open_topIso
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (U : (space R n).Opens) :
    CommRingCat.ofHom
        (structureRingHom (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U) ≫
      U.topIso.inv =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
          (U.ι ≫ toSpec R n).appTop
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureRingHom globalSec
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  change
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
        (toSpec R n).appTop ≫
          (space R n).presheaf.map U.leTop.op ≫ U.topIso.inv =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
        (toSpec R n).appTop ≫ U.ι.appTop
  rw [show
    (space R n).presheaf.map U.leTop.op ≫ U.topIso.inv =
      U.ι.appTop by
    ext x
    rfl]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.spec_globalSec
statement:
theorem spec_globalSec
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (c : R) :
    globalSec
        (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) c =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv c
proof:
:= by
  unfold globalSec
  have hover :
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) = 𝟙 _ :=
    rfl
  rw [hover, Scheme.Hom.id_appTop, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.spec_structureRingHom_top
statement:
theorem spec_structureRingHom_top
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (c : R) :
    structureRingHom
        (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) c =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv c
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureRingHom globalSec
  have hmor :
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens).leTop.op = 𝟙 _ :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hmor]
  rw [(Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map_id]
  have hover :
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) = 𝟙 _ :=
    rfl
  rw [hover, Scheme.Hom.id_appTop, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec_structureRingHom
statement:
theorem toSpec_structureRingHom
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) (c : R) :
    (toSpec R n).app V
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V c) =
      structureRingHom
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply]
  rw [spec_globalSec R c]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [(toSpec R n).naturality]
  change
    ((toSpec R n).appTop ≫
      (space R n).presheaf.map
        ((Opens.map (toSpec R n).base).map V.leTop).op).hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv c) =
      (space R n).presheaf.map
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V).leTop.op
        (globalSec (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) c)
  unfold globalSec
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveOpen_preimage_structureRingHom
statement:
theorem projectiveOpen_preimage_structureRingHom
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (U : (space R n).Opens)
    (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) (c : R) :
    let f
proof:
:= U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    (U.ι.appIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv
        (f.app V
          (structureRingHom
            (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V c)) =
      structureRingHom
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (U.ι ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) c := by
  dsimp only
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [toSpec_structureRingHom R n V c]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change
    (U.ι.app (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≫
        (U.ι.appIso (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V))).inv).hom
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V) c) =
      structureRingHom
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V))) c
  rw [Scheme.Hom.app_appIso_inv]
  exact
    structureRingHom_naturality
      (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
      (homOfLE (Set.image_preimage_subset U.ι
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ V).1)) c

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction_f_π
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction_f_π
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
        R g n d).f p ≫
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf (Localization.Away g) n d).presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection
            (Localization.Away g) n p b))) a =
    Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a ≫
      localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction
        R g n d p a
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let FR : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace :=
    (Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  let FP : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space S n).toPresheafedSpace :=
    (map (algebraMap R S) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
      AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj FR
  let FS : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space S n).toPresheafedSpace :=
    (Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d)
  let β : FP ⟶ FS :=
    (localizationProjectiveTwistingAbSheafIso R g n d).hom
  change
    (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n FR ≫
      (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor S n).map β).f p ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          FS.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection S n p b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        FR.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a ≫
        localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction
          R g n d p a
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π]
  change localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p FR ≫ _ = _
  simp only [S]
  have hπ :=
    localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π R g n p FR a
  calc
    _ = (_ ≫ _) ≫
        β.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection
          (Localization.Away g) n p a)) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (_ ≫ _) ≫
        β.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection
          (Localization.Away g) n p a)) :=
      congrArg
        (fun k ↦ k ≫
          β.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection
            (Localization.Away g) n p a))) hπ
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Category.assoc]
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingHigherTerm_ext
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingHigherTerm_ext
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    {x y : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p}
    (h : ∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
      (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x =
      (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))
  let hPi := Limits.productIsProduct' (Discrete.functor f)
  let hRaw := (AddCommGrpCat.HasLimit.productLimitCone f).isLimit
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiIso R n d p
  apply e.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.injective
  funext a
  have he :
      e.hom ≫
          AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
            (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun b ↦ f b) a) =
        Pi.π f a := by
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp hPi hRaw ⟨a⟩
  change (e.hom x) a = (e.hom y) a
  have hx :=
    congrArg (fun k : _ ⟶ f a ↦ k.hom x) he
  have hy :=
    congrArg (fun k : _ ⟶ f a ↦ k.hom y) he
  exact hx.trans ((h a).trans hy.symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d p x) a =
      (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))
  let hPi := Limits.productIsProduct' (Discrete.functor f)
  let hRaw := (AddCommGrpCat.HasLimit.productLimitCone f).isLimit
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiIso R n d p
  have he :
      e.hom ≫
          AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
            (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun b ↦ f b) a) =
        Pi.π f a := by
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp hPi hRaw ⟨a⟩
  exact congrArg (fun k : _ ⟶ f a ↦ k.hom x) he

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
    let hpre :
        f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) =
          (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) :=
      Scheme.Hom.preimage_top f
    let himageTop :
        U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) = U :=
      U.ι_image_top
    ∀ x : Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)),
      coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n d p a x =
        F.presheaf.map (eqToHom himageTop.symm).op
          ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom
            (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpre.symm).op x)) := by
  dsimp only
  intro x
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let hpre :
      f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) =
        (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) :=
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_top f
  let himageTop :
      U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) = U :=
    U.ι_image_top
  let e0 : Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) ≃+ Γ(M, ⊤) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg (fun W : U.toScheme.Opens => Γ(M, W)) hpre)
  let e1 := (F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  let e2 : Γ(F, U.ι ''ᵁ
      (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) ≃+ Γ(F, U) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg
        (fun W : (space R n).Opens => Γ(F, W)) himageTop)
  change e2 (e1 (e0 x)) = _
  have he0 :
      e0 x = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpre.symm).op x :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
      M.presheaf hpre x
  rw [he0]
  have he2 (y : Γ(F, U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))) :
      e2 y = F.presheaf.map (eqToHom himageTop.symm).op y :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
      F.presheaf himageTop y
  rw [he2]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_presheaf_map_to_top
statement:
theorem pushforward_presheaf_map_to_top
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (V : Y.Opens)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj M, ⊤)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj M).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op x =
      M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            (show q ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens) from le_top)).op
        (M.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top q).symm).op x)
proof:
:= by
  change M.presheaf.map _ x =
    M.presheaf.map _ (M.presheaf.map _ x)
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.presheaf_map_image_to_top
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_image_to_top
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (M : Y.Modules) (T : X.Opens) (W U : Y.Opens)
    (himage : i ''ᵁ T = W) (himageTop : i ''ᵁ ⊤ = U)
    (hle : W ≤ U) (z : Γ(M, i ''ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens))) :
    M.presheaf.map (eqToHom himage.symm).op
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono i le_top)).op z) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
        (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom himageTop.symm).op z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPushforwardRestriction_comm
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPushforwardRestriction_comm
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    ∀ x : Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)),
      coordinateCechPushforwardBasicOpenLinearEquiv R g n d p a
          ((Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) x) =
        localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
          R g n d p a
          (coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n d p a x) := by
  dsimp only
  intro x
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  let T := f ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let m := map (algebraMap R S) n
  let US := coordinateCechIntersection S n p a
  let e := localizationProjectiveTwistingSheafRestrictIso R g n d
  have himage : U.ι ''ᵁ T = m ''ᵁ US :=
    coordinateCechPreimage_image_eq_localizationImage R g n p a
  let hle :=
    localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le R g n p a
  let hpre :
      f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) =
        (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) :=
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_top f
  let himageTop :
      U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) = U :=
    U.ι_image_top
  change
    (e.hom.app US).hom
        ((F.restrictAppIso m US).inv
          (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom himage.symm).op
            ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι T).hom
              ((Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
                N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) x)))) =
      (e.hom.app US).hom
        ((F.restrictAppIso m US).inv
          (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
            (coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n d p a x)))
  rw [coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv_apply
    R n d p a x]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  let y : Γ(M, (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) :=
    M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpre.symm).op x
  have hn :
      (Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) x =
        M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show T ≤ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) from le_top)).op
          y := by
    exact pushforward_presheaf_map_to_top
      f M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) x
  rw [hn]
  have hnat :
      (F.restrictAppIso U.ι T).hom
          (M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show T ≤ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) from le_top)).op y) =
        F.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.ι le_top)).op
          ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom y) := by
    have h := Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom
      (f := U.ι) F
      (homOfLE (show T ≤ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) from le_top)).op
    exact congrArg (fun k => k.hom y) h
  rw [hnat]
  exact presheaf_map_image_to_top U.ι F T (m ''ᵁ US) U
    himage himageTop hle ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom y)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p a)
proof:
:= by
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  letI : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
    Module.compHom _
      (structureRingHom
        (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
  letI : Module R Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) :=
    Module.compHom _
      (structureRingHom
        (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
  let res :=
    Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
      N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop
  let eTop := coordinateCechPushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n d p a
  let eBasic :=
    coordinateCechPushforwardBasicOpenLinearEquiv R g n d p a
  let component :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
      R g n d p a
  have hres : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g) res := by
    simpa only [res, N, M, f, U] using
      coordinateCechPushforward_isLocalizedModule R g n d p a
  have hleft :
      IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
        (eBasic.toLinearMap ∘ₗ res) := by
    exact IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv
      (Submonoid.powers g) res eBasic
  have heq :
      eBasic.toLinearMap ∘ₗ res =
        component ∘ₗ eTop.toLinearMap := by
    ext x
    exact coordinateCechPushforwardRestriction_comm
      R g n d p a x
  rw [heq] at hleft
  exact
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_right
      (Submonoid.powers g) eTop.toLinearMap eTop.bijective).mp hleft

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentPi_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentPi_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentPiLinearMap
        R g n d p)
proof:
:= by
  letI (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
      IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
        (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
          R g n d p a) :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestriction_isLocalizedModule
      R g n d p a
  exact IsLocalizedModule.pi (Submonoid.powers g) fun a ↦
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
      R g n d p a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestriction_pi_comm
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestriction_pi_comm
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (localizedCoordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
          R g n d p).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestrictionLinear
          R g n d p =
      localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentPiLinearMap
          R g n d p ∘ₗ
        (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
          R n d p).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext x a
  change
    (localizedCoordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
      R g n d p
      (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p x)) a =
      localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p a
        ((coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d p x) a)
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  change
    (coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
      (Localization.Away g) n d p
      (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p x)) a =
      localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p a
        ((Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x)
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  have hπ :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction_f_π
      R g n d p a
  exact congrArg (fun k => k.hom x) hπ

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestriction_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestriction_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p)
proof:
:= by
  let eR := coordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n d p
  let eS :=
    localizedCoordinateCechTwistingHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R g n d p
  let raw :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentPiLinearMap
      R g n d p
  let term :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestrictionLinear
      R g n d p
  letI : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g) raw :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComponentPi_isLocalizedModule
      R g n d p
  have hcomp :
      IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
        (raw ∘ₗ eR.toLinearMap) := by
    exact IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right
      (Submonoid.powers g) raw eR
  have heq : eS.toLinearMap ∘ₗ term =
      raw ∘ₗ eR.toLinearMap := by
    exact
      localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechTermRestriction_pi_comm
        R g n d p
  rw [← heq] at hcomp
  exact
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left
      (Submonoid.powers g) eS.toLinearMap eS.bijective).mp hcomp

    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

theorem termBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.termRestrictionLinear_differential_apply
statement:
theorem termRestrictionLinear_differential_apply

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.termBaseChangeIso_differential
statement:
theorem termBaseChangeIso_differential
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferentialLinear
            R n d p)) ≫
      (termBaseChangeIso R g n d (p + 1)).hom =
    (termBaseChangeIso R g n d p).hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom
        (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferentialLinear
          (Localization.Away g) n d p)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
  rw [termBaseChangeIso_hom_tmul,
    termBaseChangeIso_hom_tmul]
  simp only [one_smul]
  exact termRestrictionLinear_differential_apply
    R g n d p x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleHomology_smul_eq_map
statement:
theorem moduleHomology_smul_eq_map
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex
      R n d).homology p)) :
    c • x =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (c • 𝟙 (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d))
        p).hom x
proof:
:= by
  rw [show c • 𝟙 (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d) =
      c • 𝟙 (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d) from rfl]
  change c • x =
    (ShortComplex.homologyMap
      (c • 𝟙 ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex
        R n d).sc p))).hom x
  rw [ShortComplex.homologyMap_smul, ShortComplex.homologyMap_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingComplex_smul_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingComplex_smul_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p) :
    ((((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) c)).f p).hom x) =
      c • x
proof:
:= by
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d p
  apply e.injective
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_smul,
    coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_map_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.forgetModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality
statement:
theorem forgetModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (c : R) :
    let C
proof:
:= projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d
    let F :=
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat R) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let φ :=
      (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) c)
    F.map (c • 𝟙 C) ≫
        (forgetModuleComplexIso R n d).hom =
      (forgetModuleComplexIso R n d).hom ≫ φ := by
  dsimp only
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro p
  ext x
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_map_f,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  exact (coordinateCechTwistingComplex_smul_apply
    R n d p c x).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem moduleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : R)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex
      R n d).homology p)) :
    moduleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n d p (c • x) =
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n p).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) c)).hom
        (moduleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n d p x)
proof:
:= by
  let C := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d
  let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat R) AddCommGrpCat
  let G := F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let e := forgetModuleComplexIso R n d
  let α : C ⟶ C := c • 𝟙 C
  let φ :=
    (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) c)
  let e₁ := ((C.sc p).mapHomologyIso F).symm
  let e₂ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (iso := e) p
  have hx := moduleHomology_smul_eq_map R n d p c x
  change e₂.hom (e₁.hom (c • x)) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ p).hom
      (e₂.hom (e₁.hom x))
  rw [hx]
  let αsc := ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
    (ModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map α)
  have h₁ := ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality αsc F
  have h₁x := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₁ x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h₁x
  change e₁.hom
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α p).hom x) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map α) p).hom
      (e₁.hom x) at h₁x
  rw [h₁x]
  have hsquare :
      G.map α ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ φ :=
    forgetModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality R n d c
  have h₂ :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map α) p ≫ e₂.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ p := by
    change
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map α) p ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom p =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom p ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ p
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      ← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp, hsquare]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₂ (e₁.hom x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.leftHomologyData_map_extendScalars_forget_homologyIso
statement:
theorem leftHomologyData_map_extendScalars_forget_homologyIso
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    let T
proof:
:= projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d |>.sc p
    let E :=
      ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
    let U :=
      forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
      ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
        (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
          (Localization.Away g) g)
    letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
    let h₁ := T.homologyData.left.map (E ⋙ U)
    let h₂ := (T.homologyData.left.map E).map U
    let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
    let eH : h₁.H ≅ h₂.H := Iso.refl _
    h₁.homologyIso =
      ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫
        h₂.homologyIso ≪≫ eH.symm := by
  let T := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d |>.sc p
  let E :=
    ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
  let U :=
    forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
        (Localization.Away g) g)
  letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
  let h₁ := T.homologyData.left.map (E ⋙ U)
  let h₂ := (T.homologyData.left.map E).map U
  let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
  let eK : h₁.K ≅ h₂.K := Iso.refl _
  let eH : h₁.H ≅ h₂.H := Iso.refl _
  change h₁.homologyIso =
    ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫ h₂.homologyIso ≪≫ eH.symm
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [← cancel_epi (T.map (E ⋙ U)).homologyπ]
  rw [h₁.homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  dsimp only [ShortComplex.homologyMapIso]
  rw [ShortComplex.homologyπ_naturality_assoc]
  rw [h₂.homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom_assoc]
  have hcycles :
      h₁.cyclesIso.hom =
        ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          h₂.cyclesIso.hom ≫ eK.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono h₁.i).1
    rw [h₁.cyclesIso_hom_comp_i]
    symm
    calc
      _ = ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          h₂.cyclesIso.hom ≫ (eK.inv ≫ h₁.i) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          h₂.cyclesIso.hom ≫ h₂.i := by
        rw [show eK.inv ≫ h₁.i = h₂.i from rfl]
      _ = ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          ((T.map E).map U).iCycles := by
        rw [h₂.cyclesIso_hom_comp_i]
      _ = (T.map (E ⋙ U)).iCycles ≫ eComp.hom.τ₂ :=
        ShortComplex.cyclesMap_i eComp.hom
      _ = (T.map (E ⋙ U)).iCycles := by rfl
  rw [hcycles]
  have hπ : eK.inv ≫ h₁.π = h₂.π ≫ eH.inv := by
    rfl
  simp only [Category.assoc, hπ]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mapHomologyIso_extendScalars_forget
statement:
theorem mapHomologyIso_extendScalars_forget
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    let T
proof:
:= projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d |>.sc p
    let E :=
      ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
    let U :=
      forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
      ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
        (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
          (Localization.Away g) g)
    letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
    let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
    T.mapHomologyIso (E ⋙ U) =
      ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫
        ((T.map E).mapHomologyIso U) ≪≫
          U.mapIso (T.mapHomologyIso E) := by
  let T := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d |>.sc p
  let E :=
    ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
  let U :=
    forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
        (Localization.Away g) g)
  letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
  let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
  change T.mapHomologyIso (E ⋙ U) =
    ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫
      ((T.map E).mapHomologyIso U) ≪≫
        U.mapIso (T.mapHomologyIso E)
  let hl := T.homologyData.left
  rw [hl.mapHomologyIso_eq (F := E ⋙ U)]
  rw [(hl.map E).mapHomologyIso_eq (F := U)]
  rw [hl.mapHomologyIso_eq (F := E)]
  rw [leftHomologyData_map_extendScalars_forget_homologyIso
    R g n d p]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [cancel_epi, cancel_epi]
  change U.map (E.map hl.homologyIso.inv) =
    U.map (hl.map E).homologyIso.inv ≫
      U.map ((hl.map E).homologyIso.hom ≫
        E.map hl.homologyIso.inv)
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change U.map (E.map hl.homologyIso.inv) =
    (U.mapIso (hl.map E).homologyIso).inv ≫
      (U.mapIso (hl.map E).homologyIso).hom ≫
        U.map (E.map hl.homologyIso.inv)
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
