name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.homologyBaseChangeIso_unit_naturality
statement:
theorem homologyBaseChangeIso_unit_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (q : ℕ) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away g
    let C := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d
    let D := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex S n d
    let T := C.sc q
    let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)
    let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let τ :=
      extendScalarsForgetUnitNatTrans R S (algebraMap R S)
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
      ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
        (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway S g)
    letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
    (T.mapHomologyIso V).inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetBaseChangeComplexHom R g n d) q =
      τ.app T.homology ≫
        U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫
          ((D.sc q).mapHomologyIso U).inv := by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let C := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d
  let D := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex S n d
  let T := C.sc q
  let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let τ :=
    extendScalarsForgetUnitNatTrans R S (algebraMap R S)
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway S g)
  letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
  let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
  let eBC := complexBaseChangeIso R g n d
  let compIsoHC :
      (E ⋙ U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ≅
        E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⋙
          U.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) :=
    (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
      (F := E) (G := U) (Iso.refl (E ⋙ U))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).symm
  let eCompHC :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
      AddCommGrpCat (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapIso
        (compIsoHC.app C))
  let eBCscRaw :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
      (ModuleCat S) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapIso eBC)
  let eMap :
      T.map E ≅
        (HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
          (ModuleCat S) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).obj
            ((E.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj C) :=
    ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
  let eBCsc : T.map E ≅ D.sc q :=
    eMap ≪≫ eBCscRaw
  let mV := T.mapHomologyIso V
  let mE := T.mapHomologyIso E
  let mU := (T.map E).mapHomologyIso U
  let mG := T.mapHomologyIso (E ⋙ U)
  let mUS := (D.sc q).mapHomologyIso U
  have htest :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetBaseChangeComplexHom R g n d) q =
        ShortComplex.homologyMap (T.mapNatTrans τ) ≫
          (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
            ShortComplex.homologyMap
              (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom) := by
    dsimp only [forgetBaseChangeComplexHom]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp]
    rfl
  have heComp : eCompHC = eComp := by
    ext <;> rfl
  have hunit := ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans T τ
  have hcomp :
      mG = ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC ≪≫
        mU ≪≫ U.mapIso mE := by
    simpa only [heComp] using
      (mapHomologyIso_extendScalars_forget R g n d q)
  have hU :=
    ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality eBCsc.hom U
  change mV.inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (forgetBaseChangeComplexHom R g n d) q =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫ mUS.inv
  rw [htest, hunit]
  change mV.inv ≫
      (mV.hom ≫ τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv) ≫
        (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
          ShortComplex.homologyMap
            (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom) =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫ mUS.inv
  have hcancel :
      mV.inv ≫ (mV.hom ≫
        (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv)) =
        τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv := by
    calc
      _ = (mV.inv ≫ mV.hom) ≫
          (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [mV.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  let rest :=
    (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
      ShortComplex.homologyMap
        (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom)
  have hcancelRest :
      (mV.inv ≫ (mV.hom ≫
        (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv))) ≫ rest =
        (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv) ≫ rest :=
    congrArg (fun k => k ≫ rest) hcancel
  change (mV.inv ≫ (mV.hom ≫
      (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv))) ≫ rest =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫ mUS.inv
  rw [hcancelRest]
  change τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv ≫
      (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
        ShortComplex.homologyMap
          (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom) =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫ mUS.inv
  rw [hcomp]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← hU]
  change τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map mE.inv ≫
        U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) ≫ mUS.inv =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫ mUS.inv
  have hmap :
      U.map mE.inv ≫
          U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) =
        U.map (mE.inv ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) :=
    (U.map_comp _ _).symm
  let tail := mUS.inv
  have hmapTail :
      (U.map mE.inv ≫
          U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q)) ≫ tail =
        U.map (mE.inv ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) ≫ tail :=
    congrArg (fun k => k ≫ tail) hmap
  change τ.app T.homology ≫
      ((U.map mE.inv ≫
        U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q)) ≫ tail) =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d q).hom ≫ tail
  rw [hmapTail]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.modulePositiveBaseChange_unit_compat
statement:
theorem modulePositiveBaseChange_unit_compat
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (y : ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex
      R n d).homology (p + 1))) :
    moduleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv
        (Localization.Away g) n d p
        ((homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d (p + 1)).hom
          ((1 : Localization.Away g) ⊗ₜ[
            R, algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)] y)) =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
          R g n d) (p + 1)).hom
        (moduleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv R n d p y)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (homologyBaseChangeIso_unit_naturality
        R g n d (p + 1)) y
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  change
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (forgetBaseChangeComplexHom R g n d) (p + 1))
        ((((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d).sc (p + 1)).mapHomologyIso
            (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv y) =
      (((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex (Localization.Away g) n d).sc
          (p + 1)).mapHomologyIso (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away g))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv ((homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d (p + 1)).hom
        ((1 : (Localization.Away g)) ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)] y)) at hnat
  have hsquare :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetBaseChangeComplexHom R g n d) (p + 1) ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (iso := forgetModuleComplexIso (Localization.Away g) n d)
            (p + 1)).hom =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (iso := forgetModuleComplexIso R n d) (p + 1)).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
            R g n d) (p + 1) := by
    change
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetBaseChangeComplexHom R g n d) (p + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetModuleComplexIso (Localization.Away g) n d).hom (p + 1) =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetModuleComplexIso R n d).hom (p + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
            R g n d) (p + 1)
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      ← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      forgetBaseChangeComplexHom_raw_comm]
  have hsquarey :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hsquare ((((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d).sc
        (p + 1)).mapHomologyIso (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv y)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hsquarey
  change (HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (iso := forgetModuleComplexIso (Localization.Away g) n
      d) (p + 1)).hom
      ((((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex (Localization.Away g) n d).sc
          (p + 1)).mapHomologyIso (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away g))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv ((homologyBaseChangeIso R g n d (p + 1)).hom
        ((1 : (Localization.Away g)) ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)] y))) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
        R g n d) (p + 1)).hom ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso
            (iso := forgetModuleComplexIso R n d) (p + 1)).hom
            ((((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d).sc (p + 1)).mapHomologyIso
            (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv y))
  rw [← hnat]
  exact hsquarey

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinatePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_one
statement:
theorem coordinatePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_one
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex
      R n d).homology (p + 1))) :
    coordinatePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n d p
        ((1 : Localization.Away g) ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
          R g n d) (p + 1)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let q := p + 1
  let C := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechModuleComplex R n d
  let eR := moduleHomologyRawPositiveLinearEquiv R n d p
  let y := eR.symm x
  dsimp only [coordinatePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv,
    LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [AlgebraTensorModule.congr_tmul]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.refl_apply]
  rw [← extendScalarsTensorLinearEquiv_tmul
    R S ↑(C.homology q) (1 : S) y]
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simp only [Iso.toLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [modulePositiveBaseChange_unit_compat R g n d p y]
  rw [show eR y = x from eR.apply_symm_apply x]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechPositiveRestrictionLinear_apply

        R g n d p x =

        (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveRestrictionLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveTwistingPositiveRestrictionLinear_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) (p + 1)) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away g
    let N :=
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf S n d)) (p + 1)
    let _ : Module R N := Module.compHom N (algebraMap R S)
    let _ : IsScalarTower R S N :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    projectiveTwistingPositiveRestrictionLinear
        R g n d p x =
      projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom
        R g n d (p + 1) x := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let eR :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv
      R n d p
  let eS :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv
      S n d p
  let y := eR.symm x
  change eS
      (coordinatePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n d p
        ((AlgebraTensorModule.congr
          (LinearEquiv.refl S S) eR.symm)
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] x))) =
    projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom
      R g n d (p + 1) x
  rw [AlgebraTensorModule.congr_tmul]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.refl_apply]
  rw [coordinatePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_one]
  have hloc :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechLocalization_positive
      R g n d p y
  change eS
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
          R g n d) (p + 1)).hom y) =
    projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom
      R g n d (p + 1) (eR y) at hloc
  rw [show eR y = x from eR.apply_symm_apply x] at hloc
  exact hloc

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_smul_of_map_smulEnd
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_smul_of_map_smulEnd
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {R S : CommRingCat}
    [Y.Over (Spec R)] [X.Over (Spec S)]
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g] (N : Y.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (r : R) (s : S)
    (hp :
      (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
          (smulEnd (R := R) N r) =
        smulEnd (R := S) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj N) s)
    (x : N.H i) :
    openRestrictionHAddHom g N i (r • x) =
      s • openRestrictionHAddHom g N i x
proof:
:= by
  let F := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let hExtY : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u}
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y) :=
    fun A B a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let hExtX : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u}
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
    fun A B a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let hLim : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  let hColim : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  let hAdd : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive g
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := hLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := hColim
  letI : F.Additive := hAdd
  let A := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  let p : A ⟶ A := smulEnd (R := R) N r
  let q : F.obj A ⟶ F.obj A :=
    smulEnd (R := S) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj N) s
  let e := (openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  have hp' : F.map p = q := hp
  rw [smul_eq_H_map, smul_eq_H_map]
  simp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, Sheaf.H.map_apply]
  dsimp only [q] at hp'
  rw [← hp']
  exact (@extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality _ _ _ _ _ _
    hExtY hExtX F hAdd hLim hColim _ _ e _ _ p i x).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectivePreimageTop_globalSec
statement:
theorem projectivePreimageTop_globalSec
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
    U.ι.appTop (globalSec (X := space R n)
      (R := CommRingCat.of R) r) =
      globalSec (X := U.toScheme)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
  apply U.topIso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  change U.topIso.hom
      (U.ι.appTop (globalSec (X := space R n)
        (R := CommRingCat.of R) r)) =
    U.topIso.hom
      (globalSec (X := U.toScheme)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r))
  rw [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageTopIso_globalSec f ⊤]
  let s := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r
  change U.topIso.hom ((U.ι ≫ f).appTop s) = f.app ⊤ s
  have hc := congrArg (fun q => q.hom r)
    (projectiveStructureRingHom_open_topIso R n U)
  change U.topIso.inv
      (structureRingHom
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U r) =
    (U.ι ≫ f).appTop s at hc
  rw [← hc, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  rw [← toSpec_structureRingHom R n ⊤ r,
    spec_structureRingHom_top R r]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectivePreimageTop_structureRingHom
statement:
theorem projectivePreimageTop_structureRingHom
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (T : (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)).toScheme.Opens)
    (r : R) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
    (U.ι.appIso T).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := U.toScheme) T
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r)) =
      structureRingHom
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (U.ι ''ᵁ T) r := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply]
  rw [← projectivePreimageTop_globalSec R n r]
  change (U.ι.appIso T).inv
      (U.ι.appLE (⊤ : (space R n).Opens) T le_top
        (globalSec (X := space R n)
          (R := CommRingCat.of R) r)) =
    (space R n).presheaf.map (U.ι ''ᵁ T).leTop.op
      (globalSec (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) r)
  have hg := Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv U.ι
    (U := (⊤ : (space R n).Opens)) (V := T) le_top
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hg]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectivePreimageTop_sheafPullback_map_smulEnd
statement:
theorem projectivePreimageTop_sheafPullback_map_smulEnd
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (r : R) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
    (U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M r) =
      smulEnd
        (R := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤))
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := toSpec R n
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext T x
  change (M.smul
      (structureRingHom
        (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        (U.ι ''ᵁ T.unop) r)).hom x =
    (M.smul
      ((U.ι.appIso T.unop).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := U.toScheme) T.unop
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r)))).hom x
  rw [projectivePreimageTop_structureRingHom R n T.unop r]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_isEquivalence_of_iso
statement:
theorem openSheafPullback_isEquivalence_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    (e.hom.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  let et := Scheme.forgetToTop.mapIso e
  let P := TopCat.Sheaf.pullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} e.hom.base
  let Q := TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} e.hom.base
  letI : Q.IsEquivalence := by
    change (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} et.hom).IsEquivalence
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafPushforward_isEquivalence_of_iso et
  letI : P.IsEquivalence :=
    (TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      AddCommGrpCat.{u} e.hom.base).isEquivalence_left_of_isEquivalence_right
  exact Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso
    (e.hom.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u})

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_bijective_of_iso
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_bijective_of_iso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (N : Y.Modules) (i : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (openRestrictionHAddHom e.hom N i)
proof:
:= by
  let F := e.hom.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  letI : F.IsEquivalence := openSheafPullback_isEquivalence_of_iso e
  letI : F.Full := inferInstance
  letI : F.Faithful := inferInstance
  letI : F.PreservesInjectiveObjects := inferInstance
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits e.hom
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits e.hom
  letI : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive e.hom
  let C := (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
    (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  let D := (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
    (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  let A := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  let c : F.obj C ≅ D :=
    (openPullbackConstantIso e.hom).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  let phi := F.mapExtAddHom C A i
  let psi : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext (F.obj C) (F.obj A) i →
      CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext D (F.obj A) i :=
    fun z ↦ (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ c.inv).comp z (zero_add i)
  have hphi : Function.Bijective phi :=
    F.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesInjectiveObjects C A i
  have hpsi : Function.Bijective psi := by
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      have hxy' := congrArg (fun z =>
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ c.hom).comp z (zero_add i)) hxy
      simpa only [psi, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc,
        Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp] using hxy'
    · intro y
      refine ⟨(CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ c.hom).comp y (zero_add i), ?_⟩
      simp only [psi, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc,
        Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp]
  dsimp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso]
  exact hpsi.comp hphi

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageTopIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem preimageTopIso_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (preimageTopIso f).hom = (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)).ι
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_top_global
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_top_global
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (V : Y.Opens) (x : M.H i) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
        (globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv f M i x) =
      openRestrictionHAddHom (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι M i x
proof:
:= by
  let g := preimageHomOfLE f (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
  let h := (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)).ι
  have p : g ≫ h = (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι := by
    simp [g, h, preimageHomOfLE]
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_map, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv, AddEquiv.ofBijective_apply]
  dsimp only [restrictToPreimage_compIso]
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.map_comp, Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply]
  have hcomp := openRestrictionHAddHom_comp g h M i x
  have hcomp' :
      Sheaf.H.map
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
              (preimageHomOfLE f (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top))
              (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)).ι).symm.app M).hom) i
          (openRestrictionHAddHom
            (preimageHomOfLE f (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top))
            (restrictToPreimage f M (⊤ : Y.Opens)) i
            (openRestrictionHAddHom
              (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)).ι M i x)) =
        openRestrictionHAddHom (g ≫ h) M i x := by
    exact hcomp
  have houter := congrArg (fun y =>
    Sheaf.H.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr p).hom.app M)) i y) hcomp'
  exact houter.trans (openRestrictionHAddHom_congr p M i x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (i : ℕ)
    (y : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))) i) :
    projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n d i y =
      Sheaf.H.map
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space (Localization.Away g) n)).map
          (projectiveTwistingBasicOpenCanonicalRestrictIso R g n d).hom) i
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom
          (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι).obj
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) i y)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_restriction
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_restriction
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (i : ℕ)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) i) :
    projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n d i
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) i x) =
      projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom
        R g n d i x
proof:
:= by
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  have p : e.hom ≫ V.ι = m := localizationOpenIso_hom_ι R g n
  rw [projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_apply]
  simp only [projectiveTwistingBasicOpenCanonicalRestrictIso,
    projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom,
    AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.map_comp,
    Functor.map_comp, Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply]
  have hcomp :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_comp
      e.hom V.ι M i x
  have hcongr :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_congr
      p M i x
  have hinner := congrArg (fun y =>
    Sheaf.H.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (space (Localization.Away g) n).ringCatSheaf).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr p).hom.app M)) i y) hcomp
  rw [hcongr] at hinner
  exact congrArg (fun y =>
    Sheaf.H.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (space (Localization.Away g) n).ringCatSheaf).map
        (localizationProjectiveTwistingSheafRestrictIso R g n d).hom) i y) hinner

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingAffineLocalMapCanonical
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingAffineLocalMapCanonical
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (i : ℕ)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) i) :
    projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n d i
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
          (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) i
          (show PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv
            (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) i x)) =
      projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom
        R g n d i x
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_top_global
      (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) i
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) x
  have houter := congrArg
    (projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n d i) hmap
  exact houter.trans
    (projectiveTwistingBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_restriction
      R g n d i x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveGlobalHPreimageTopAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveGlobalHPreimageTopAddEquiv_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (i : ℕ) (r : R) (x : M.H i) :
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv
        (toSpec R n) M i (r • x) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r •
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv
          (toSpec R n) M i x
proof:
:= by
  change SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom
      (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)).ι M i (r • x) =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv r •
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)).ι M i x
  apply SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_smul_of_map_smulEnd
  exact projectivePreimageTop_sheafPullback_map_smulEnd R n M r

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionCategorical_eq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictionCategorical_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    pushedUnitRestrictionCategorical hVU = pushedUnitRestriction hVU
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply]
  simp only [pushedUnitRestrictionCategorical, unitRestriction,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  have hcomp :
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (X.homOfLE hVU) U.ι).app
        (unitModules V.toScheme)).hom).app W = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  erw [hcomp]
  have hunit :
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (X.homOfLE hVU)).unit.app
        (unitModules U.toScheme)).app (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) =
        (unitModules U.toScheme).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE ((X.homOfLE hVU).image_preimage_le
            (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op := rfl
  erw [hunit]
  have hmap :
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (X.homOfLE hVU)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (X.homOfLE hVU)).hom).app
          (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (X.homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
          ((X.homOfLE hVU) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) := rfl
  erw [hmap]
  let A := (X.homOfLE hVU) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  have hrestrict :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (X.homOfLE hVU)).hom.app A =
        ((forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat Ab).mapIso
          ((X.homOfLE hVU).appIso A)).hom := rfl
  erw [hrestrict]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change V.toScheme.presheaf.map _
      ((ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat Ab).mapIso
          ((X.homOfLE hVU).appIso A)).hom)
        (U.toScheme.presheaf.map _ x)) =
    X.presheaf.map _ x
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.toScheme_presheaf_map,
    Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, Scheme.homOfLE_app,
    Functor.mapIso_hom]
  change X.presheaf.map _
      (X.presheaf.map _
        (X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ x))) =
    X.presheaf.map _ x
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.opensRange_morphismRestrict_ι
statement:
theorem opensRange_morphismRestrict_ι
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (V U : X.Opens) :
    (U.ι ∣_ V).opensRange = V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
proof:
:= by
  apply V.ι.image_injective
  calc
    V.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ∣_ V).opensRange =
        ((U.ι ∣_ V) ≫ V.ι).opensRange :=
      (Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp (U.ι ∣_ V) V.ι).symm
    _ = ((U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ U.ι).opensRange := by
      simp only [morphismRestrict_ι]
    _ = U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.opensRange :=
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι U.ι
    _ = U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) := by rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    _ = U ⊓ V := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    _ = V ⊓ U := inf_comm _ _
    _ = V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_naturality
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    {W Z : Y.Opens} (f : op W ⟶ op Z) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj
        (pushedUnit X (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U))).presheaf.map f ≫
        (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U Z).hom =
      (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom ≫
        (pushedUnit Y U).presheaf.map f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let AW := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  let AZ := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ Z))
  let BW := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let BZ := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z)
  let hW : e.hom ''ᵁ AW = BW :=
    pushedUnitPushforward_open_eq e U W
  let hZ : e.hom ''ᵁ AZ = BZ :=
    pushedUnitPushforward_open_eq e U Z
  let αW : op (e.hom ''ᵁ AW) ⟶ op BW :=
    (eqToIso hW).symm.op.hom
  let αZ : op (e.hom ''ᵁ AZ) ⟶ op BZ :=
    (eqToIso hZ).symm.op.hom
  have hZW : Z ≤ W := leOfHom f.unop
  let i : op AW ⟶ op AZ :=
    (homOfLE ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.image_mono
      ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.preimage_mono
        (e.hom.preimage_mono hZW)))).op
  let j : op BW ⟶ op BZ :=
    (homOfLE (U.ι.image_mono (U.ι.preimage_mono hZW))).op
  let xAW : Γ(X, AW) := x
  change Y.presheaf.map αZ
      ((e.hom.appIso AZ).inv (X.presheaf.map i xAW)) =
    Y.presheaf.map j
      (Y.presheaf.map αW ((e.hom.appIso AW).inv xAW))
  have hn :
      (e.hom.appIso AZ).inv (X.presheaf.map i xAW) =
        Y.presheaf.map ((e.hom.opensFunctor).op.map i)
          ((e.hom.appIso AW).inv xAW) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (e.hom.appIso_inv_naturality i) xAW
  rw [hn]
  let y : Γ(Y, e.hom ''ᵁ AW) := (e.hom.appIso AW).inv xAW
  change Y.presheaf.map αZ
      (Y.presheaf.map ((e.hom.opensFunctor).op.map i) y) =
    Y.presheaf.map j (Y.presheaf.map αW y)
  have hmorph :
      Y.presheaf.map ((e.hom.opensFunctor).op.map i) ≫
          Y.presheaf.map αZ =
        Y.presheaf.map αW ≫ Y.presheaf.map j := by
    rw [← Y.presheaf.map_comp, ← Y.presheaf.map_comp]
    congr 1
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hmorph y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPushforwardIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPushforwardIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) {U U' : Y.Opens} (h : U' ≤ U) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).map
          (pushedUnitRestriction (e.hom.preimage_mono h)) ≫
        (pushedUnitPushforwardIso e U').hom =
      (pushedUnitPushforwardIso e U).hom ≫
        pushedUnitRestriction h
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  change (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U' W).hom
      ((pushedUnitRestriction (e.hom.preimage_mono h)).app
        (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W) x) =
    (pushedUnitRestriction h).app W
      ((pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom x)
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply]
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let AU := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  let AU' := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U').ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U').ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  let BU := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let BU' := U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let hU : e.hom ''ᵁ AU = BU :=
    pushedUnitPushforward_open_eq e U W
  let hU' : e.hom ''ᵁ AU' = BU' :=
    pushedUnitPushforward_open_eq e U' W
  let αU : op (e.hom ''ᵁ AU) ⟶ op BU :=
    (eqToIso hU).symm.op.hom
  let αU' : op (e.hom ''ᵁ AU') ⟶ op BU' :=
    (eqToIso hU').symm.op.hom
  let i : op AU ⟶ op AU' :=
    (homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen
      (e.hom.preimage_mono h) (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op
  let j : op BU ⟶ op BU' :=
    (homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen h W)).op
  let xAU : Γ(X, AU) := x
  change Y.presheaf.map αU'
      ((e.hom.appIso AU').inv (X.presheaf.map i xAU)) =
    Y.presheaf.map j
      (Y.presheaf.map αU ((e.hom.appIso AU).inv xAU))
  have hn :
      (e.hom.appIso AU').inv (X.presheaf.map i xAU) =
        Y.presheaf.map ((e.hom.opensFunctor).op.map i)
          ((e.hom.appIso AU).inv xAU) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (e.hom.appIso_inv_naturality i) xAU
  rw [hn]
  let y : Γ(Y, e.hom ''ᵁ AU) := (e.hom.appIso AU).inv xAU
  change Y.presheaf.map αU'
      (Y.presheaf.map ((e.hom.opensFunctor).op.map i) y) =
    Y.presheaf.map j (Y.presheaf.map αU y)
  have hmorph :
      Y.presheaf.map ((e.hom.opensFunctor).op.map i) ≫
          Y.presheaf.map αU' =
        Y.presheaf.map αU ≫ Y.presheaf.map j := by
    rw [← Y.presheaf.map_comp, ← Y.presheaf.map_comp]
    congr 1
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hmorph y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateDescentLeftRestrictIso_naturality

    coordinateChartCochainsRestrictIso, pushedUnitPiRestrictIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom, piComparison_comp_π_assoc,

  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]

statement:
private theorem localizationCoordinateDescentLeft_preimage_pushforward_naturality

    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (localizationCoordinateDescentLeftPreimage R g n) ≫
        (pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso (localizationOpenIso R g n)
          (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
            (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              coordinateOverlapOpen R n ij.1 ij.2)).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso (localizationOpenIso R g n)
        (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            coordinateOpen R n i)).hom ≫
        coordinateDescentLeftRestricted R n
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ij
  simp only [pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Category.assoc, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
    localizationCoordinateDescentLeftPreimage,
    coordinateDescentLeftRestricted, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitPushforwardIso_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateDescentLeftPushforwardIso_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateDescentLeftPushforwardIso_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft (Localization.Away g) n) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsPushforwardIso R g n).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartCochainsPushforwardIso R g n).hom ≫
        coordinateDescentLeftRestricted R n
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsPushforwardIso,
    localizationCoordinateChartCochainsPushforwardIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft (Localization.Away g) n) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (Pi.mapIso
            (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitIso R g n)).hom ≫
          (pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso (localizationOpenIso R g n)
            (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
              (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                coordinateOverlapOpen R n ij.1 ij.2)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (Pi.mapIso
            (localizationCoordinateChartPushedUnitIso R g n)).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso (localizationOpenIso R g n)
          (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              coordinateOpen R n i)).hom ≫
          coordinateDescentLeftRestricted R n
            (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [localizationCoordinateDescentLeft_transport_naturality]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [localizationCoordinateDescentLeft_preimage_pushforward_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateDescentLeft_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateDescentLeft_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft R n) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft (Localization.Away g) n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono
    (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsPushforwardIso R g n).hom).1
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsBaseChangeIso,
    localizationCoordinateChartCochainsBaseChangeIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [coordinateDescentLeftRestrictIso_naturality]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    localizationCoordinateDescentLeftPushforwardIso_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv
statement:
private theorem restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ)
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens) :
    (restrictTopUnit
      (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) V).1 =
      (show Γ(U.toScheme, V) from
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le V)).op a.1)
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ a.1) =
    X.presheaf.map _ a.1
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_restrict_app
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_restrict_app
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (U W : Y.Opens)
    (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le
          ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))).op
        (e.hom.app U x)) =
      Y.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let A := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  let B := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let hEq : e.hom ''ᵁ A = B := by
    dsimp only [A, B]
    rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
      Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
      ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso, top_inf_eq]
  let α : op (e.hom ''ᵁ A) ⟶ op B :=
    (eqToIso hEq).symm.op.hom
  let i : op (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⟶ op A :=
    (homOfLE ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le
      ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))).op
  let j : op U ⟶ op B :=
    (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op
  change Y.presheaf.map α
      ((e.hom.appIso A).inv
        (X.presheaf.map i (e.hom.app U x))) =
    Y.presheaf.map j x
  have hAU : A ≤ e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    exact (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le _
  have hi : i = (homOfLE hAU).op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hi]
  change Y.presheaf.map α
      ((e.hom.appIso A).inv
        ((e.hom.appLE U A hAU) x)) =
    Y.presheaf.map j x
  have happ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv e.hom hAU) x
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at happ
  rw [happ]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_map_pushedUnit_eqToIso_app_restrict_heq
statement:
private theorem pushforward_map_pushedUnit_eqToIso_app_restrict_heq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {U U' : X.Opens}
    (h : U = U') (W : Y.Opens) (t : Γ(X, U)) (t' : Γ(X, U'))
    (ht : HEq t t') :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
      (eqToIso (congrArg (pushedUnit X) h)).hom).app W)
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)))).op t) =
      X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (U'.ι_image_le (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)))).op t'
proof:
:= by
  subst U'
  have htt : t = t' := eq_of_heq ht
  subst t'
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso_hom_restrict_app
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso_hom_restrict_app
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (V U : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens)
    (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V U W).hom
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le
          (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ''ᵁ W)))).op x) =
      V.toScheme.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le
          ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op
        (V.ι.app U x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso,
    Functor.mapIso_hom]
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ x) =
    X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ x)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_app_apply
statement:
private theorem pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_app_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space R n).Opens)
    (x : Γ(pushedUnit (space R n)
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j), W)) :
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d i j).app W x =
      (show Γ(pushedUnit (space R n)
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j), W) from
        (restrictTopUnit
          (Units.map
            (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
            (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j))
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) :
            Γ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).toScheme,
              (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) *
          (show Γ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).toScheme,
            (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) from x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_map_pushedUnit_eqToIso_map_mul
statement:
private theorem pushforward_map_pushedUnit_eqToIso_map_mul
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {U U' : X.Opens}
    (h : U = U') (W : Y.Opens)
    (x y : Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)))) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
      (eqToIso (congrArg (pushedUnit X) h)).hom).app W) (x * y) =
      (show Γ(X, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (show Γ(X, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
          (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
            (eqToIso (congrArg (pushedUnit X) h)).hom).app W) x) *
        (show Γ(X, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
          (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
            (eqToIso (congrArg (pushedUnit X) h)).hom).app W) y))
proof:
:= by
  subst U'
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso_hom_map_mul
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso_hom_map_mul
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (V U : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens)
    (x y : Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ''ᵁ W)))) :
    (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V U W).hom (x * y) =
      (show Γ(X, V.ι ''ᵁ
          ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V U W).hom x) *
      (show Γ(X, V.ι ''ᵁ
          ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V U W).hom y)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  change X.presheaf.map _ (x * y) =
    X.presheaf.map _ x * X.presheaf.map _ y
  rw [map_mul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_hom_app_map_mul
statement:
private theorem
    localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_hom_app_map_mul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (W : (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme.Opens)
    (x y : Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n,
      (coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ''ᵁ
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))) :
    (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
        R g n i j).hom.app W (x * y) =
      (show Γ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme,
          (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
              (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n i j).hom.app W x) *
      (show Γ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme,
          (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
              (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n i j).hom.app W y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let E := pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso (localizationOpenIso R g n)
    ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
      coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W
  let T :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
      (eqToIso (congrArg
        (pushedUnit (space (Localization.Away g) n))
        (localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
          R g n i j).symm)).hom
  let B :=
    ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
      coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
        (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  change E.hom (T.app W (x * y)) =
    (show Γ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme, B) from
      E.hom (T.app W x)) *
    (show Γ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme, B) from
      E.hom (T.app W y))
  rw [pushforward_map_pushedUnit_eqToIso_map_mul
    (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom
    (localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
      R g n i j).symm W x y]
  dsimp only [E]
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Functor.mapIso_hom]
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let U := V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j
  let A := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  let C := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let hEq : e.hom ''ᵁ A = C := by
    dsimp only [A, C]
    rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
      Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
      ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso, top_inf_eq]
  let α : op (e.hom ''ᵁ A) ⟶ op C :=
    (eqToIso hEq).symm.op.hom
  let tx : Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n, A) := T.app W x
  let ty : Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n, A) := T.app W y
  change V.toScheme.presheaf.map α
      ((e.hom.appIso A).inv (tx * ty)) =
    V.toScheme.presheaf.map α ((e.hom.appIso A).inv tx) *
      V.toScheme.presheaf.map α ((e.hom.appIso A).inv ty)
  rw [map_mul, map_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_localTransition_app
statement:
private theorem
    localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_localTransition_app
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (W : (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme.Opens)
    (x : Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n,
      (coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ''ᵁ
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))) :
    (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
        R g n i j).hom.app W
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition
            (Localization.Away g) n d i j)).app W) x) =
      (show Γ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme,
          (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
              (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n i j).hom.app W
            (show Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n,
              (coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ''ᵁ
                ((coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                  ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
              (restrictTopUnit
                (Units.map
                  (coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n
                    i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
                  (twistTransitionSectionUnit
                    (Localization.Away g) n d i j))
                ((coordinateOverlapOpen
                  (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                    (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1)) *
      (show Γ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme,
          (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
              (((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n i j).hom.app W x)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition
            (Localization.Away g) n d i j)).app W) x) =
        (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition
          (Localization.Away g) n d i j).app
            ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W) x := rfl
  rw [hleft, pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_app_apply]
  exact localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_hom_app_map_mul
    R g n i j W _ x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedCoordinateOverlapTransitionRestricted_app_apply
statement:
private theorem pushedCoordinateOverlapTransitionRestricted_app_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (V : (space R n).Opens) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (W : V.toScheme.Opens)
    (z : Γ(V.toScheme,
      (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
        ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) :
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransitionRestricted
        R n d V i j).app W z =
      (show Γ(V.toScheme,
          (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom
            (show Γ(space R n,
              (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
                ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                  (V.ι ''ᵁ W))) from
              (restrictTopUnit
                (Units.map
                  (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
                  (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j))
                ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                  (V.ι ''ᵁ W))).1)) *
      z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushedCoordinateOverlapTransitionRestricted,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change
    (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
        (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d i j)).app W)
        ((pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).inv z)) = _
  have hright :
      ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
        (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d i j)).app W)
        ((pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).inv z)) =
      (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d i j).app
        (V.ι ''ᵁ W)
        ((pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).inv z) := rfl
  rw [hright, pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_app_apply]
  let a : Γ(space R n,
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (V.ι ''ᵁ W))) :=
    (restrictTopUnit
      (Units.map
        (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j))
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        (V.ι ''ᵁ W))).1
  let y : Γ(space R n,
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          (V.ι ''ᵁ W))) :=
    (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).inv z
  change
    (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom (a * y) =
      (show Γ(V.toScheme,
          (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso V
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom a) * z
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso_hom_map_mul]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localization_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_coefficient
statement:
private theorem
    localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso_coefficient
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (W : (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).toScheme.Opens) :
    (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
        R g n i j).hom.app W
      (show Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n,
        (coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ''ᵁ
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
        (restrictTopUnit
          (Units.map
            (coordinateOverlapOpen
              (Localization.Away g) n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
            (twistTransitionSectionUnit
              (Localization.Away g) n d i j))
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen
            (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1) =
      (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
        (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom
        (show Γ(space R n,
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ''ᵁ W))) from
          (restrictTopUnit
            (Units.map
              (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
              (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j))
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ''ᵁ W)).1)
proof:
:= by
  have htransition :=
    localization_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq R g n d i j
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change
    (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso (localizationOpenIso R g n)
      ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (eqToIso (congrArg
            (pushedUnit (space (Localization.Away g) n))
            (localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
              R g n i j).symm)).hom).app W
        (show Γ(space (Localization.Away g) n,
          (coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))) from
          (restrictTopUnit
            (Units.map
              (coordinateOverlapOpen
                (Localization.Away g) n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
              (twistTransitionSectionUnit
                (Localization.Away g) n d i j))
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen
              (Localization.Away g) n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1)) =
      (pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
        (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W).hom
        (show Γ(space R n,
          (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ''ᵁ W))) from
          (restrictTopUnit
            (Units.map
              (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
              (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j))
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ''ᵁ W)).1)
  rw [restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv, restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv]
  rw [pushforward_map_pushedUnit_eqToIso_app_restrict_heq
    (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom
    (localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
      R g n i j).symm W
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit
      (Localization.Away g) n d i j).1
    ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom.app
      ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
      ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι.app
        (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1))
    htransition.symm]
  rw [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_restrict_app
    (localizationOpenIso R g n)
    ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
      coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W
    ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι.app
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
      (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1)]
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictSectionIso_hom_restrict_app
    (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
    (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) W
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationPushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_naturality

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinatePushedUnitRestriction_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinatePushedUnitRestriction_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf
              (Localization.Away g) n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n i j).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n j).hom ≫
        pushedUnitRestriction
          ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι.preimage_mono
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans
              inf_le_right))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso,
    localizationCoordinateChartPushedUnitPushforwardIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
    (localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateOpen R g n j).symm
    (localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
      R g n i j).symm
    ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf
      (Localization.Away g) n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)
    ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom.preimage_mono
      ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι.preimage_mono
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans
          inf_le_right)))]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateDescentRightPushforwardIso_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateDescentRightPushforwardIso_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentRight (Localization.Away g) n d) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsPushforwardIso R g n).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartCochainsPushforwardIso R g n).hom ≫
        coordinateDescentRightRestricted R n d
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ij
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsPushforwardIso,
    localizationCoordinateChartCochainsPushforwardIso,
    pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
    coordinateDescentRightRestricted, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, coordinateDescentRight_π]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  slice_rhs 1 2 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (space (Localization.Away g) n)
              (coordinateOpen (Localization.Away g) n a)) ij.2) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf
              (Localization.Away g) n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans
                inf_le_right)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
            (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition
              (Localization.Away g) n d ij.1 ij.2) ≫
          (localizationCoordinateOverlapPushedUnitPushforwardIso
            R g n ij.1 ij.2).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (space (Localization.Away g) n)
              (coordinateOpen (Localization.Away g) n a)) ij.2) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateChartPushedUnitPushforwardIso
          R g n ij.2).hom ≫
          pushedUnitRestriction
            ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι.preimage_mono
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf
                R n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_right)) ≫
            pushedCoordinateOverlapTransitionRestricted R n d
              (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)
                ij.1 ij.2
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [localizationPushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_naturality]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [localizationCoordinatePushedUnitRestriction_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateDescentRight_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateDescentRight_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι).map
          (coordinateDescentRight R n d) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentRight (Localization.Away g) n d)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono
    (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsPushforwardIso R g n).hom).1
  simp only [localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsBaseChangeIso,
    localizationCoordinateChartCochainsBaseChangeIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [coordinateDescentRightRestrictIso_naturality]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    localizationCoordinateDescentRightPushforwardIso_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateDescent_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateDescent_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft R n - coordinateDescentRight R n d) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft (Localization.Away g) n -
            coordinateDescentRight (Localization.Away g) n d)
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
    (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N f h
    rfl
  letI : P.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N f h
    rfl
  change
    F.map (coordinateDescentLeft R n - coordinateDescentRight R n d) ≫
        (localizationCoordinateOverlapCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom =
      (localizationCoordinateChartCochainsBaseChangeIso R g n).hom ≫
        P.map (coordinateDescentLeft (Localization.Away g) n -
          coordinateDescentRight (Localization.Away g) n d)
  rw [Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_sub]
  rw [localizationCoordinateDescentLeft_naturality,
    localizationCoordinateDescentRight_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwisting_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton
statement:
theorem projectiveTwisting_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (i : ℕ) (g : R) :
    Subsingleton
      ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (i + 1)).obj
        (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf (Localization.Away g) n d
  have hF : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space (Localization.Away g) n)).obj F)
        (i + 1))) :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero
      (Localization.Away g) n d hd i
  have hpush : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb V.toScheme).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F))
        (i + 1))) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_pushforward_iso
      e F (i + 1) hF
  have hrestrict : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb V.toScheme).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)))
        (i + 1))) :=
    IsZero.of_iso hpush
      ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ (i + 1)).mapIso
        ((Modules.toSheafAb V.toScheme).mapIso
          (localizationProjectiveTwistingSheafBaseChangeIso R g n d)))
  exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hrestrict

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_twistExtensionData
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_twistExtensionData
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        Nonempty (ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i
          (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_twist_compatible_extensions R n M
  refine ⟨D, fun i a => ⟨?_⟩⟩
  let s := projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a
  let t : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
        (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤) :=
    fun j => if hji : j = i then by
      subst j
      exact s
    else
      (hD i ⟨j, hji⟩ a).choose
  refine
    { component := t
      component_self := ?_
      compatible := fun j hji => ?_ }
  · simp only [t, s, ↓reduceDIte]
  · have htj : t j = (hD i ⟨j, hji⟩ a).choose := by
      dsimp only [t]
      rw [dif_neg hji]
    rw [htj]
    simpa only [s] using (hD i ⟨j, hji⟩ a).choose_spec
