name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor_zero
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (n : ℕ)
    (P : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace ⥤
      TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space S n).toPresheafedSpace)
    [P.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (e : P.obj
        ((constantSheaf
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space R n)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) ≅
      ((constantSheaf
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space S n)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))))
    (α : coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n ⟶
      P ⋙ coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor S n)
    (hflasque : ∀ A,
      (P.obj (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n A)).IsFlasque)
    (hzero : ∀ (A) (x :
        ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n 0).obj A)),
      ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso S n).hom.app (P.obj A)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app A) 0).hom x) =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e A 0
          (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x))
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n F)
    (hPF : CoordinateCechAcyclic S n (P.obj F))
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (0 + 1)).obj F)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv S n (P.obj F) hPF 0
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (0 + 1)).hom x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e F (0 + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF 0 x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
    coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_surjective R n F hF x
  let T := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex R n F
  let hT := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact R n F
  let PT := T.map P
  let hPT := hT.map_of_exact P
  let Q := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient R n F
  letI : PT.X₂.IsFlasque := by
    change (P.obj (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n F)).IsFlasque
    exact hflasque F
  let hPQ : CoordinateCechAcyclic S n (P.obj Q) :=
    hPF.X3_of_shortExact S n PT hPT
  have hCT : (T.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n)).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
      R n T hT hF
  have hCPT :
      (PT.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor S n)).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
      S n PT hPT hPF
  have hδC := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    (T.mapNatTrans α) hCT hCPT 0 1 rfl
  have hCech :
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) 1).hom
          (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom R n F hF y) =
        (hCPT.δ 0 1 rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app Q) 0).hom y) := by
    change hCT.δ 0 1 rfl ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) 1 =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app Q) 0 ≫
        hCPT.δ 0 1 rfl at hδC
    have hy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hδC y
    change
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) 1).hom
          ((hCT.δ 0 1 rfl).hom y) =
        (hCPT.δ 0 1 rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app Q) 0).hom y) at hy
    exact hy
  rw [hCech]
  rw [coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv_zero_apply,
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv_zero_apply]
  erw [coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta_of_shortExact
      S n PT hPT hPF]
  erw [hzero Q y]
  rw [coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta R n F hF]
  exact (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta
    P e T hT 0 1 rfl
      (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso R n).hom.app Q).hom y)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor_succ
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor_succ
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (n : ℕ)
    (P : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace ⥤
      TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space S n).toPresheafedSpace)
    [P.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (e : P.obj
        ((constantSheaf
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space R n)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) ≅
      ((constantSheaf
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space S n)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))))
    (α : coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n ⟶
      P ⋙ coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor S n)
    (hflasque : ∀ A,
      (P.obj (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n A)).IsFlasque)
    (hzero : ∀ (A) (x :
        ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n 0).obj A)),
      ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso S n).hom.app (P.obj A)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app A) 0).hom x) =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e A 0
          (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x))
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n F)
    (hPF : CoordinateCechAcyclic S n (P.obj F))
    (q : ℕ)
    (ih : ∀ (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
      (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n F) (hPF : CoordinateCechAcyclic S n (P.obj F))
      (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (q + 1)).obj F)),
      coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv S n (P.obj F) hPF q
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (q + 1)).hom x) =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e F (q + 1)
          (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF q x))
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (q + 1 + 1)).obj F)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv S n (P.obj F) hPF (q + 1)
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (q + 1 + 1)).hom x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e F (q + 1 + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF (q + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
    (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv R n F hF q).surjective x
  let T := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex R n F
  let hT := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact R n F
  let PT := T.map P
  let hPT := hT.map_of_exact P
  let Q := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient R n F
  let hQ := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient_acyclic R n F hF
  letI : PT.X₂.IsFlasque := by
    change (P.obj (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n F)).IsFlasque
    exact hflasque F
  let hPQ : CoordinateCechAcyclic S n (P.obj Q) :=
    hPF.X3_of_shortExact S n PT hPT
  have hCT : (T.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n)).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
      R n T hT hF
  have hCPT :
      (PT.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor S n)).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
      S n PT hPT hPF
  have hδC := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    (T.mapNatTrans α) hCT hCPT (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
  have hCech :
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (q + 2)).hom
          (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv R n F hF q y) =
        (hCPT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (α.app Q) (q + 1)).hom y) := by
    change hCT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (q + 2) =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app Q) (q + 1) ≫
        hCPT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl at hδC
    have hy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hδC y
    change
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (q + 2)).hom
          ((hCT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom y) =
        (hCPT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (α.app Q) (q + 1)).hom y) at hy
    exact hy
  rw [hCech]
  change coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
      S n PT.X₁ hPF (q + 1)
        ((hCPT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (α.app Q) (q + 1)).hom y)) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e F (q + 2)
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv R n F hF q y))
  rw [coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta_of_shortExact
      S n PT hPT hPF hPQ q]
  change CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hPT (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
        S n (P.obj Q) hPQ q
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (α.app Q) (q + 1)).hom y)) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e F (q + 2)
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv R n F hF q y))
  rw [ih Q hQ hPQ y]
  rw [coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta R n F hF q]
  exact (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta
    P e T hT (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
        R n Q hQ q y)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (n : ℕ)
    (P : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace ⥤
      TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space S n).toPresheafedSpace)
    [P.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (e : P.obj
        ((constantSheaf
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space R n)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) ≅
      ((constantSheaf
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space S n)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))))
    (α : coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n ⟶
      P ⋙ coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor S n)
    (hflasque : ∀ A,
      (P.obj (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n A)).IsFlasque)
    (hzero : ∀ (A) (x :
        ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n 0).obj A)),
      ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso S n).hom.app (P.obj A)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app A) 0).hom x) =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e A 0
          (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x))
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n F)
    (hPF : CoordinateCechAcyclic S n (P.obj F))
    (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (q + 1)).obj F)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv S n (P.obj F) hPF q
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (α.app F) (q + 1)).hom x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e F (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF q x)
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing F with
  | zero =>
      exact coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor_zero n P e α hflasque hzero F hF hPF x
  | succ q ih =>
      exact coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor_succ n P e α hflasque hzero F hF hPF q ih x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
statement:
theorem preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    map f n ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateCechIntersection R n p a =
      coordinateCechIntersection S n p a
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [coordinateCechIntersection,
    CategoryTheory.Limits.CompleteLattice.limit_eq_iInf,
    Opens.coe_iInf, Set.mem_iInter]
  change map f n x ∈
      iInf (Discrete.functor
        (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover R n (a t))).obj ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro hx i
    change x ∈ coordinateOpen S n (a i.as)
    rw [← preimage_coordinateOpen f n (a i.as)]
    apply (Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage (f := map f n)).2
    change map f n x ∈
      (↑(⨅ j : Discrete (Fin (p + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n (a j.as)) : Set (space R n)) at hx
    rw [Opens.coe_iInf] at hx
    exact Set.mem_iInter.mp hx i
  · intro hx
    change map f n x ∈
      (↑(⨅ j : Discrete (Fin (p + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n (a j.as)) : Set (space R n))
    rw [Opens.coe_iInf]
    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    apply (Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage (f := map f n)).1
    show x ∈ map f n ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen R n (a i.as)
    rw [preimage_coordinateOpen]
    exact hx i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
        (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a) ≤
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
    (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n p a]
  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.functor_obj_map_obj]
  exact inf_le_right

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p F ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          ((map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.obj
              (op (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a ≫
          F.1.map (homOfLE
            (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
              R g n p a)).op
proof:
:= by
  change id (Pi.lift _) ≫ Pi.π _ a = _
  simp only [id_eq, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSheafCoface_component
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSheafCoface_component
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechSheafCosimplicialObject R n F).δ r ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) ≫
        F.1.map
          (Pi.lift
            (P := coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) a)
            (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
              Pi.π
                (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover R n (a s))
                (r.succAbove t))).op
proof:
:= by
  have hcech :
      (((Functor.rightOp
        (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover R n)).cech).map
          (SimplexCategory.δ r)).unop) =
        (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover R n)).mapPower
          r.succAbove := by
    rfl
  change (Pi.lift _ ≫ Pi.π _ a) = _
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [hcech]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.openEmbeddingSheafPullback_map
statement:
theorem openEmbeddingSheafPullback_map
    {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : Topology.IsOpenEmbedding f)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y)
    {U V : Opens X} (q : op U ⟶ op V) :
    ((hf.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F).1.map q =
      F.1.map (hf.functor.op.map q)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_coface
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_coface
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    (coordinateCechSheafCosimplicialObject R n F).δ r ≫
        localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n (p + 1) F =
      localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p F ≫
        (coordinateCechSheafCosimplicialObject
          (Localization.Away g) n
          ((map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F)).δ r
proof:
:= by
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
  change
    ((coordinateCechSheafCosimplicialObject R n F).δ r ≫
        localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n (p + 1) F) ≫
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection
            (Localization.Away g) n (p + 1) b))) a =
    (localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p F ≫
        (coordinateCechSheafCosimplicialObject
          (Localization.Away g) n
          (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F)).δ r) ≫
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection
            (Localization.Away g) n (p + 1) b))) a
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [coordinateCechSheafCoface_component R n F p r a]
  slice_rhs 2 3 =>
    rw [coordinateCechSheafCoface_component
      (Localization.Away g) n
        (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F) p r a]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [openEmbeddingSheafPullback_map]
  congr 1
  calc
    F.1.map
        (Pi.lift
          (P := coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) a)
          (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
            Pi.π
              (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover R n (a s))
              (r.succAbove t))).op ≫
        F.1.map
          (homOfLE
            (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
              R g n (p + 1) a)).op =
      F.1.map
        ((Pi.lift
          (P := coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) a)
          (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
            Pi.π
              (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover R n (a s))
              (r.succAbove t))).op ≫
          (homOfLE
            (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
              R g n (p + 1) a)).op) :=
      (F.1.map_comp _ _).symm
    _ = F.1.map
        ((homOfLE
          (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
            R g n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).op ≫
          m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.map
            (Pi.lift
              (P := coordinateCechIntersection
                (Localization.Away g) n (p + 1) a)
              (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
                Pi.π
                  (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦
                    coordinateCechCover (Localization.Away g) n (a s))
                  (r.succAbove t))).op) :=
      F.1.congr_map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    _ = _ := F.1.map_comp _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n p : ℕ)
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map φ).f p ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          G.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a ≫
        φ.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
proof:
:= by
  change CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        φ.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) ≫
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        G.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a = _
  rw [Pi.map_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) :
    ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map φ).f p ≫
        localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p G =
      localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p F ≫
        ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor (Localization.Away g) n).map
          ((map
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
              AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.map φ)).f p
proof:
:= by
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
  change
    (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map φ).f p ≫
        localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p G) ≫
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj G).1.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p b))) a =
    (localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p F ≫
        ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor (Localization.Away g) n).map
          (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.map φ)).f p) ≫
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        (m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj G).1.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p b))) a
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π]
  slice_rhs 2 3 =>
    rw [coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (φ.1.naturality
    (homOfLE
      (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
        R g n p a)).op).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_inv_restrict
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_inv_restrict
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso R n F).inv ≫
        (constantIntSheafHomSectionsIso
          (space R n).toPresheafedSpace F).hom ≫
        F.1.map (homOfLE (show
          coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op =
      (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplex R n F).iCycles 0 ≫
        ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexToCechNatIso R n).app F).hom.f 0 ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 b))) a
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso R n F).hom).1
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_hom_iCycles]
  simp only [Category.id_comp]
  let X := (space R n).toPresheafedSpace
  let U := coordinateCechFormalCoproduct R n
  let Y := U.cech.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))
  have hmap :
      ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexNatIso R n).app F).hom.f 0 =
        𝟙 _ := by
    rfl
  have hsections :
      ((coordinateCechFreeAbSheafHomComplexNatIso R n).app F).hom.f 0 =
        (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X F Y).hom := by
    rfl
  have hmap' :
      ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexNatIso R n).hom.app F).f 0 =
        𝟙 _ :=
    hmap
  have hsections' :
      ((coordinateCechFreeAbSheafHomComplexNatIso R n).hom.app F).f 0 =
        (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X F Y).hom :=
    hsections
  simp only [coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexToCechNatIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    hmap', hsections', Category.id_comp]
  apply AddCommGrpCat.ext
  intro h
  let ιa := Sigma.ι
    (fun b : Y.I ↦
      (freeAbSheafFunctor X).obj (Y.obj b)) a
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change F.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op
      (constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X F h) = _
  change _ =
    (Pi.π (fun b : Y.I ↦ F.1.obj (op (Y.obj b))) a).hom
      (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X F Y
        ((coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomShortComplex R n F).f.hom h))
  rw [formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv_apply_π]
  change _ =
    freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (Y.obj a) F
      (ιa ≫ (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentation R n).f 0 ≫ h)
  let eFree := coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointFreeIso R n
  let eConst := freeAbTopIsoConstantInt X
  let q := (U.cech.augmentOfIsTerminal
    (FormalCoproduct.isTerminalIncl (⊤ : Opens X)
      Limits.isTerminalTop)).hom.app (op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))
  have hι :
      ιa ≫ (formalFreeAbSheafFunctor X).map q =
        TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap (q.φ a) ≫ eFree.inv := by
    dsimp only [eFree]
    change Sigma.ι _ a ≫ Sigma.desc _ = _
    rw [Sigma.ι_desc]
    rfl
  have haug :
      (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentation R n).f 0 =
        (formalFreeAbSheafFunctor X).map q ≫ eFree.hom ≫ eConst.hom := by
    rfl
  have hpath :
      ιa ≫ (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentation R n).f 0 ≫ h =
        TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap (q.φ a) ≫ eConst.hom ≫ h := by
    rw [haug]
    simp only [← Category.assoc]
    rw [hι]
    simp
  have heApp :
      (preadditiveCoyoneda.map eConst.hom.op).app F ≫
          (freeAbTopHomSectionsNatIso X).hom.app F =
        (constantIntSheafHomSectionsNatIso X).hom.app F := by
    simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app] using
      congrArg (fun η ↦ η.app F)
        (freeAbTopIsoConstantInt_sectionsNatTrans X)
  have he := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom heApp h
  change freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X ⊤ F (eConst.hom ≫ h) =
    constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X F h at he
  calc
    F.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op
          (constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X F h) =
        F.1.map (q.φ a).op
          (constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X F h) := by
      congr 2
    _ = F.1.map (q.φ a).op
          (freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X ⊤ F (eConst.hom ≫ h)) := by
      rw [he]
    _ = freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (Y.obj a) F
          (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap (q.φ a) ≫
            (eConst.hom ≫ h)) := by
      symm
      exact TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv_naturality
        (q.φ a) F _
    _ = freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (Y.obj a) F
          (ιa ≫ (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentation R n).f 0 ≫ h) := by
      rw [hpath]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso_hom_comp_restrict
statement:
theorem coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso_hom_comp_restrict
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F ≫
        F.1.map (homOfLE (show
          coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op =
      ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).isoHomologyπ₀.inv ≫
        ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).iCycles 0 ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 b))) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom]
  dsimp [constantIntSheafHomCoordinateCechH0NatIso,
    coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpH0ToCechH0NatIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.app_inv, NatTrans.comp_app, Category.assoc]
  let K := coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplex R n F
  let L := (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F
  let e := (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexToCechNatIso R n).app F
  have hWhisker :
      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight
        (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexToCechNatIso R n)
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor
          AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0)).inv.app F =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.inv 0 := by
    rfl
  have hMappedInv :
      (constantIntSheafHomMappedOpH0NatIso R n).inv.app F =
        K.isoHomologyπ₀.inv ≫
          (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso R n F).inv := by
    rfl
  have hSections :
      (constantIntSheafHomSectionsNatIso
        (space R n).toPresheafedSpace).hom.app F =
        (constantIntSheafHomSectionsIso
          (space R n).toPresheafedSpace F).hom := by
    rfl
  rw [hWhisker, hMappedInv, hSections]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_inv_restrict]
  rw [CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality_assoc]
  rw [HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i_assoc]
  have hEhom :
      ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexToCechNatIso R n).hom.app F).f 0 =
        e.hom.f 0 := by
    rfl
  have hEhom' :
      ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexToCechNatIso R n).app F).hom.f 0 =
        e.hom.f 0 :=
    hEhom
  rw [hEhom']
  have hcomp : e.inv.f 0 ≫ e.hom.f 0 = 𝟙 _ := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.f 0) e.inv_hom_id
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [hcomp]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechRestriction_h0_sections
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechRestriction_h0_sections
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n F) 0 ≫
        (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
          ((map
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
              AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F) =
      (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F ≫
        F.1.map (homOfLE (show
          (map
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
              (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n)) ≤
            (⊤ : Opens (space R n)) from le_top)).op
proof:
:= by
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  let G :=
    (map
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
        AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F
  let α := localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n F
  let V : Fin (n + 1) → Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n) := fun i ↦
    coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n 0 (fun _ ↦ i)
  have hV (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      V i = coordinateCechCover (Localization.Away g) n i := by
    change (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
      coordinateCechCover (Localization.Away g) n i) = _
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (productUniqueIso
        (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
          coordinateCechCover (Localization.Away g) n i)).hom.le
    · exact (productUniqueIso
        (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
          coordinateCechCover (Localization.Away g) n i)).inv.le
  have hcover :
      (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n)) ≤ ⨆ i, V i := by
    have hs : (⨆ i, V i) =
        (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n)) := by
      rw [show V = coordinateCechCover (Localization.Away g) n
        from funext hV]
      exact coordinateCechCover_isOpenCover (Localization.Away g) n
    rw [hs]
  apply AddCommGrpCat.ext
  intro x
  apply G.eq_of_locally_eq' (U := V) ⊤ (fun _ ↦ homOfLE le_top) hcover
  intro i
  let a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) := fun _ ↦ i
  have htarget :=
    coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso_hom_comp_restrict
      (Localization.Away g) n
        ((map
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F) a
  have hsource :=
    coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso_hom_comp_restrict R n F a
  let β :
      (coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n 0).obj F ⟶
        (coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor
          (Localization.Away g) n 0).obj
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F) :=
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n F) 0
  have hchart :
      β ≫
          (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso
            (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
              ((map
                (algebraMap R
                  (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                    AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F) ≫
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.map
                    (homOfLE (show
                      coordinateCechIntersection
                        (Localization.Away g) n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op =
        (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F ≫
          F.1.map (homOfLE (show m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
            (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n)) ≤
              (⊤ : Opens (space R n)) from le_top)).op ≫
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.map
                    (homOfLE (show
                      coordinateCechIntersection
                        (Localization.Away g) n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op := by
    slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [htarget]
    rw [show β =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        α 0 from rfl]
    let t :=
      ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor
        (Localization.Away g) n).obj
          ((map
            (algebraMap R
              (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F)).iCycles 0 ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          ((map
            (algebraMap R
              (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.obj
                  (op (coordinateCechIntersection
                    (Localization.Away g) n 0 b))) a
    have hπ :
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α 0 ≫
            ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor
              (Localization.Away g) n).obj
                ((map
                  (algebraMap R
                    (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                      AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F)).isoHomologyπ₀.inv =
          ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).isoHomologyπ₀.inv ≫
            HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap α 0 :=
      by
        simpa using
          (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality (φ := α))
    change HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α 0 ≫
        ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor
          (Localization.Away g) n).obj
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F)).isoHomologyπ₀.inv ≫ t = _
    rw [← Category.assoc
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α 0)
      (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor
        (Localization.Away g) n).obj
          ((map
            (algebraMap R
              (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F)).isoHomologyπ₀.inv) t]
    rw [hπ]
    rw [Category.assoc
      (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).isoHomologyπ₀.inv)
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap α 0)
      t]
    dsimp only [t]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i_assoc]
    rw [show α.f 0 =
      localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n 0 F from rfl]
    rw [localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π]
    let s := F.1.map (homOfLE
      (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
        R g n 0 a)).op
    have hsourceS :
        ((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F ≫
            F.1.map (homOfLE (show
              coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op) ≫ s =
          (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).isoHomologyπ₀.inv ≫
            ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).iCycles 0 ≫
              Pi.π (fun b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
                F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 b))) a) ≫ s :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ s) hsource
    change
      (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).isoHomologyπ₀.inv ≫
          ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).obj F).iCycles 0 ≫
            Pi.π (fun b : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              F.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 b))) a) ≫ s =
        _
    rw [← hsourceS]
    rw [Category.assoc
      ((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F)
      (F.1.map (homOfLE (show
        coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op) s]
    change
      (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F ≫
          (F.1.map (homOfLE (show
            coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op ≫ s) =
        (coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F ≫
          (F.1.map (homOfLE (show
            m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
              (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n)) ≤
                (⊤ : Opens (space R n)) from le_top)).op ≫
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj F).1.map
                    (homOfLE (show
                      coordinateCechIntersection
                        (Localization.Away g) n 0 a ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op)
    apply (cancel_epi
      ((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app F)).2
    rw [openEmbeddingSheafPullback_map]
    dsimp only [s]
    let q₁ : op (⊤ : Opens (space R n)) ⟶
        op (coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a) :=
      (homOfLE le_top).op
    let q₂ : op (coordinateCechIntersection R n 0 a) ⟶
        op (m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
          (coordinateCechIntersection
            (Localization.Away g) n 0 a)) :=
      (homOfLE
        (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_image_le
          R g n 0 a)).op
    let q₃ : op (⊤ : Opens (space R n)) ⟶
        op (m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
          (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n))) :=
      (homOfLE le_top).op
    let q₄ : op (m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
          (⊤ : Opens (space (Localization.Away g) n))) ⟶
        op (m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
          (coordinateCechIntersection
            (Localization.Away g) n 0 a)) :=
      m.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.map (homOfLE le_top).op
    change F.1.map q₁ ≫ F.1.map q₂ =
      F.1.map q₃ ≫ F.1.map q₄
    calc
      F.1.map q₁ ≫ F.1.map q₂ = F.1.map (q₁ ≫ q₂) :=
        (F.1.map_comp q₁ q₂).symm
      _ = F.1.map (q₃ ≫ q₄) :=
        F.1.congr_map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      _ = F.1.map q₃ ≫ F.1.map q₄ :=
        F.1.map_comp q₃ q₄
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hchart x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechRestriction_h0_sheafH0
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechRestriction_h0_sheafH0
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ)
    (A : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n 0).obj A)) :
    ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
      ((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj A)).hom
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n A) 0).hom x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom
        (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) A 0
          (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  let e :=
    (TopCat.Sheaf.H0EvalTopNatIso
      (space (Localization.Away g) n).toPresheafedSpace).app
        ((map
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj A)
  let eR :=
    (TopCat.Sheaf.H0EvalTopNatIso
      (space R n).toPresheafedSpace).app A
  apply e.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.injective
  have hcech := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction_h0_sections R g n A) x
  change e.hom.hom
      (e.inv.hom
        (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso
          (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj A)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n A) 0).hom x))) =
    e.hom.hom
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom m A 0
        (eR.inv.hom
          (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x)))
  have heCancel :
      e.hom.hom
        (e.inv.hom
          (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso
            (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
              ((map
                (algebraMap R
                  (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                    AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj A)).hom
            ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
              (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n A) 0).hom x))) =
        (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso
          (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
            ((map
              (algebraMap R
                (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
                  AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj A)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n A) 0).hom x)) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom e.inv_hom_id _
  rw [heCancel]
  have hext :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom_zero_sections
      m A
        (eR.inv.hom
          (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x))
  change e.hom.hom
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom m A 0
        (eR.inv.hom
          (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x))) =
    A.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op
      (eR.hom.hom
        (eR.inv.hom
          (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x))) at hext
  have heRCancel :
      eR.hom.hom
          (eR.inv.hom
            (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x)) =
        ((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom eR.inv_hom_id _
  rw [heRCancel] at hext
  change
    ((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso
      (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app
        ((map
          (algebraMap R
            (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
              AddCommGrpCat.{u} |>.obj A)).hom
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n A) 0).hom x) =
      A.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op
        (((coordinateCechH0SectionsNatIso R n).hom.app A).hom x) at hcech
  exact hcech.trans hext.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_localizationRestriction
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_localizationRestriction
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space R n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n F)
    (hPF : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F))
    (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (q + 1)).obj F)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
        (Localization.Away g) n
        (((map
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F) hPF q
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n F) (q + 1)).hom x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom
        (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) F (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n F hF q x)
proof:
:= by
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  let P := m.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits m
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits P :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits m
  letI : P.Additive :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_additive m
  let e :=
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackConstantIso m).app
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  have hflasque : ∀ A,
      (P.obj (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n A)).IsFlasque := by
    intro A
    letI : (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n A).IsFlasque :=
      inferInstance
    exact TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.sheafPullback_isFlasque
      m.toLRSHom.base m.isOpenEmbedding (coordinateCechChosenInjective R n A)
  have hzero : ∀ (A) (y :
      ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n 0).obj A)),
      ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso
        (Localization.Away g) n).hom.app (P.obj A)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((localizationCoordinateCechRestrictionNatTrans R g n).app A)
              0).hom y) =
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso P e A 0
          (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso R n).hom.app A).hom y) := by
    intro A y
    have hz :=
      localizationCoordinateCechRestriction_h0_sheafH0 R g n A y
    simp only [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom] at hz
    convert hz using 1
    simp only [P, m, localizationCoordinateCechRestrictionNatTrans]
    rfl
  have h :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_mapExactFunctor
      (R := R) (S := Localization.Away g) n P e
      (localizationCoordinateCechRestrictionNatTrans R g n)
      hflasque hzero F hF hPF q x
  simp only [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom]
  convert h using 1
  simp only [P, m, localizationCoordinateCechRestrictionNatTrans]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
statement:
theorem localizationOpenIso_preimage_coordinateCechIntersection
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) =
      coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a
proof:
:= by
  change ((localizationOpenIso R g n).hom ≫
      (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι) ⁻¹ᵁ
        coordinateCechIntersection R n p a = _
  rw [localizationOpenIso_hom_ι, preimage_coordinateCechIntersection]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveTwistingPullback_coordinateCechAcyclic
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveTwistingPullback_coordinateCechAcyclic
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)))
proof:
:= by
  intro p a q
  let j :=
    (coordinateCechIntersection (Localization.Away g) n p a).ι
  let P := j.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let e := localizationProjectiveTwistingAbSheafIso R g n d
  exact IsZero.of_iso
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic
      (Localization.Away g) n d p a q)
    ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ (q + 1)).mapIso (P.mapIso e))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechLocalization_positive
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechLocalization_positive
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n (q + 1)).obj
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)))) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
        (Localization.Away g) n
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space (Localization.Away g) n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf (Localization.Away g) n d))
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic
          (Localization.Away g) n d) q
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction
            R g n d) (q + 1)).hom x) =
      projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom
        R g n d (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv R n
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic R n d) q x)
proof:
:= by
  let FR :=
    (Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  let FP :=
    ((map
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj FR
  let FS :=
    (Modules.toSheafAb (space (Localization.Away g) n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf (Localization.Away g) n d)
  let α := localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n FR
  let e := localizationProjectiveTwistingAbSheafIso R g n d
  let β := e.hom
  let hR := projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic R n d
  let hP :=
    localizationProjectiveTwistingPullback_coordinateCechAcyclic
      R g n d
  let hS :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic
      (Localization.Away g) n d
  have hloc :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_localizationRestriction
      R g n FR hR hP q x
  have hnat :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality
      (Localization.Away g) n hP hS β q
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α (q + 1)).hom x)
  rw [hloc] at hnat
  simp only [localizationProjectiveTwistingCoordinateCechRestriction,
    projectiveTwistingLocalizationRestrictionHAddHom,
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom,
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp]
  convert hnat using 1
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: B6.W_le_GqA
statement: theorem W_le_GqA {p q : ℕ} (h : p ≤ q) : W q ≤ GqA W p
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun r : {r : ℕ // p ≤ r} => W r.1) ⟨q, h⟩

name: B6.GqA_antitone
statement: theorem GqA_antitone {p p' : ℕ} (h : p ≤ p') : GqA W p' ≤ GqA W p
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun q => W_le_GqA (le_trans h q.2)

name: B6.GqA_mul
statement:
theorem GqA_mul (hW : ∀ p q : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ W p, ∀ y ∈ W q, x * y ∈ W (p + q)) {a b : ℕ} {u v : K}
    (hu : u ∈ GqA W a) (hv : v ∈ GqA W b) : u * v ∈ GqA W (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun r : {r : ℕ // a ≤ r} => W r.1)
    (motive := fun u => ∀ v ∈ GqA W b, u * v ∈ GqA W (a + b)) hu ?_ ?_ ?_ v hv
  · intro r x hx v hv
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun s : {s : ℕ // b ≤ s} => W s.1)
      (motive := fun v => x * v ∈ GqA W (a + b)) hv ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s y hy
      exact W_le_GqA (Nat.add_le_add r.2 s.2) (hW _ _ x hx y hy)
    · simp
    · intro y z hy hz
      rw [mul_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  · intro v hv
    simp
  · intro x y hx hy v hv
    rw [add_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hx v hv) (hy v hv)

name: B6.Phi_psi_z
statement:
theorem Phi_psi_z (w : K) :
    B5.Phi F τi (CK.Ψ j w) = ((j : ℚ) ^ d) • CL.Ψ j (B5.Phi F τi w)
proof:
:= by
  have e : (((j : ℚ) ^ d) • t) * CK.Ψ j τi = τi :=
    RG6B.s_mul_psi_inv (psi := (CK.Ψ j : K →+* K)) hτ hi
  rw [B5.Phi_apply, B5.Phi_apply, hARR, ← map_smul]
  congr 1
  calc τi * CK.Ψ j w = CK.Ψ j w * ((((j : ℚ) ^ d) • t) * CK.Ψ j τi) := by rw [e]; ring
    _ = ((j : ℚ) ^ d) • (t * CK.Ψ j (τi * w)) := by
        rw [map_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]; congr 1; ring

name: B6.zpow_ne_zero_j
statement: theorem zpow_ne_zero_j (hj : 2 ≤ j) (n : ℤ) : (j : ℚ) ^ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : (2 : ℚ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  exact zpow_ne_zero _ (by linarith)

name: B6.Phi_eigen
statement:
theorem Phi_eigen {p : ℕ} {w : K} (hw : w ∈ W CK.Ψ j p) :
    CL.Ψ j (B5.Phi F τi w) = ((j : ℚ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - d)) • B5.Phi F τi w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Phi_psi_z CK CL F t hARR d hτ hi w
  rw [mem_W.mp hw, map_smul] at h1
  have hjne : (j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℚ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linarith
  calc CL.Ψ j (B5.Phi F τi w)
      = (((j : ℚ) ^ d)⁻¹) • (((j : ℚ) ^ d) • CL.Ψ j (B5.Phi F τi w)) := by
        rw [inv_smul_smul₀ (zpow_ne_zero_j hj d)]
    _ = (((j : ℚ) ^ d)⁻¹) • (((j : ℚ) ^ p) • B5.Phi F τi w) := by rw [← h1]
    _ = ((j : ℚ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - d)) • B5.Phi F τi w := by
        rw [smul_smul]
        congr 1
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_add₀ hjne]
        congr 1
        ring

name: B6.Phi_mem_W
statement:
theorem Phi_mem_W {p m : ℕ} {w : K} (hw : w ∈ W CK.Ψ j p) (hpm : (p : ℤ) - d = m) :
    B5.Phi F τi w ∈ W CL.Ψ j m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_W, Phi_eigen CK CL hj F t hARR d hτ hi hw, hpm, zpow_natCast]

name: B6.Phi_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Phi_eq_zero {p : ℕ} {w : K} (hw : w ∈ W CK.Ψ j p) (hpd : (p : ℤ) < d) :
    B5.Phi F τi w = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine CL.eq_zero_of_eigen hj (μ := (j : ℚ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - d)) (fun q hq => ?_)
    (Phi_eigen CK CL hj F t hARR d hτ hi hw)
  have h2 : (1 : ℚ) < j := by
    have : (2 : ℚ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linarith
  rw [← zpow_natCast] at hq
  have := zpow_right_injective₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < j) (ne_of_gt h2) hq
  omega

name: B6.Phi_mem_GqA
statement:
theorem Phi_mem_GqA {p : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ GqA (W CK.Ψ j) p) :
    B5.Phi F τi x ∈ GqA (W CL.Ψ j) (((p : ℤ) - d).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have key : GqA (W CK.Ψ j) p ≤ Submodule.comap (B5.Phi F τi) (GqA (W CL.Ψ j) (((p : ℤ) - d).toNat)) :=
    iSup_le fun q w hw => by
      have hpq : p ≤ q.1 := q.2
      refine Submodule.mem_comap.2 ?_
      by_cases hqd : (q.1 : ℤ) < d
      · rw [Phi_eq_zero CK CL hj F t hARR d hτ hi hw hqd]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · have hqd := not_lt.mp hqd
        have hm : (q.1 : ℤ) - d = ((q.1 : ℤ) - d).toNat := (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)).symm
        refine W_le_GqA ?_ (Phi_mem_W CK CL hj F t hARR d hτ hi hw hm)
        omega
  exact key hx

name: B6.W_mul_mem_ctx
statement: theorem W_mul_mem_ctx : ∀ p q : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ W CK.Ψ j p, ∀ y ∈ W CK.Ψ j q, x * y ∈ W CK.Ψ j (p + q)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ hx _ hy => W_mul_mem j hx hy

name: B6.mem_GqA_one_of_pr_zero
statement: theorem mem_GqA_one_of_pr_zero {x : K} (h : CK.pr hj 0 x = 0) : x ∈ GqA (W CK.Ψ j) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd, rfl⟩ := (by letI := CK.gr hj; exact sum_expand (W := W CK.Ψ j) x :
    ∃ (s : Finset ℕ) (d : ℕ → K), (∀ q, d q ∈ W CK.Ψ j q) ∧ x = ∑ q ∈ s, d q)
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun q hq => ?_
  by_cases hq0 : q = 0
  · subst hq0
    have : d 0 = 0 := by
      have h' := h
      rw [map_sum] at h'
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem 0 hq] at h'
      · rwa [CK.pr_of_mem_same hj (hd 0)] at h'
      · intro r _ hr
        exact CK.pr_of_mem_ne hj (hd r) (Ne.symm hr)
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · exact W_le_GqA (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hq0) (hd q)

name: B6.F_eq_Phi
statement:
theorem F_eq_Phi {K L : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K] [CommRing L] [Algebra ℚ L]
    (F : K →ₗ[ℚ] L) {τ τi : K} (hi : τ * τi = 1) (x : K) : F x = B5.Phi F τi (τ * x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [B5.Phi_apply, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm τi τ, hi, one_mul]

name: B6.tau_mul_mem_GqA
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : τ - 1 ∈ GqA (W CK.Ψ j) 1 := by
    apply mem_GqA_one_of_pr_zero CK hj
    rw [map_sub, hτ0, CK.pr_one_zero hj, sub_self]
  have h2 := GqA_mul (W_mul_mem_ctx CK) h1 hx
  have h3 : τ * x = x + (τ - 1) * x := by ring
  rw [h3]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx (GqA_antitone (by omega) h2)

name: B6.F_mem_GqA
statement:
theorem F_mem_GqA {p : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ GqA (W CK.Ψ j) p) :
    F x ∈ GqA (W CL.Ψ j) (((p : ℤ) - d).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F_eq_Phi F hi x]
  exact Phi_mem_GqA CK CL hj F t hARR d hτ hi (tau_mul_mem_GqA CK hj hτ0 hx)

name: B6.F_sub_Phi_mem
statement:
theorem F_sub_Phi_mem {p : ℕ} {w : K} (hw : w ∈ W CK.Ψ j p) :
    F w - B5.Phi F τi w ∈ GqA (W CL.Ψ j) ((((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - d).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : τ - 1 ∈ GqA (W CK.Ψ j) 1 := by
    apply mem_GqA_one_of_pr_zero CK hj
    rw [map_sub, hτ0, CK.pr_one_zero hj, sub_self]
  have h2 := GqA_mul (W_mul_mem_ctx CK) h1 (W_le_GqA le_rfl hw)
  have h3 : F w - B5.Phi F τi w = B5.Phi F τi ((τ - 1) * w) := by
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, ← F_eq_Phi F hi w]
  rw [h3]
  have := Phi_mem_GqA CK CL hj F t hARR d hτ hi h2
  rwa [show (1 + p) = p + 1 from by omega] at this

theorem fShriekG0_classOf (g : Y ⟶ D35.Yk k) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i] (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) :
    fShriekG0 g hn i (g0ClassOf X E hE) =
      piShriek g hn (g0ClassOf _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)
        (finitePushObject i ⟨E, hE⟩).2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N5.piShriek_classOf

      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
        (cover_rank g hn) (g0ClassOf _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (coverIso g n).inv).obj M)
          (finitePushObject (coverIso g n).inv ⟨M, hM⟩).2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N5.res_flatPullback_comm
statement:
theorem res_flatPullback_comm (g : Y ⟶ D35.Yk k) (n : ℕ)
    (resP : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (y : G0 Y) :
    resP.res (flatPullbackG0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y) =
      pullbackK0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) (resY.res y)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) := by
    intro a b h
    have := congrArg resP.res h
    simpa [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, resP.left] using this
  apply hinj
  rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
  have h1 : k0ToG0 (pullback g (toSpec k n)) (resP.res (flatPullbackG0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y))
      = flatPullbackG0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y :=
    congrArg (fun φ : G0 _ →+ G0 _ => φ (flatPullbackG0 (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) y)) resP.right
  have h2 : k0ToG0 Y (resY.res y) = y :=
    congrArg (fun φ : G0 Y →+ G0 Y => φ y) resY.right
  rw [h1, h2]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF5.rank_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem rank_add_of_exact {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Nontrivial B] {N M Q : Type u}
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module B Q]
    [Module.Free B N] [Module.Free B Q] (f : N →ₗ[B] M) (g : M →ₗ[B] Q) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hex : Function.Exact f g) :
    Module.rank B M = Module.rank B N + Module.rank B Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property g LinearMap.id hg
  have hgs : ∀ q, g (s q) = q := fun q => LinearMap.congr_fun hs q
  let φ : N × Q →ₗ[B] M := f.coprod s
  have hφ : Function.Bijective φ := by
    constructor
    · rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
      rintro ⟨n, q⟩ h
      have h1 : f n + s q = 0 := h
      have h2 : g (f n) = 0 := (hex (f n)).mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩
      have hq : q = 0 := by
        have := congrArg g h1
        rw [map_add, h2, hgs, zero_add, map_zero] at this
        exact this
      subst hq
      simp only [map_zero, add_zero] at h1
      have : n = 0 := hf (by rw [h1, map_zero])
      simp [this]
    · intro x
      have : x - s (g x) ∈ LinearMap.range f := by
        rw [← hex.linearMap_ker_eq]
        simp [hgs]
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this
      exact ⟨(n, g x), by simp [φ, hn]⟩
  have := LinearEquiv.rank_eq (LinearEquiv.ofBijective φ hφ)
  rw [← this, rank_prod']

name: SchemeKTheory.TF5.kerCotangentToTensor_injective_of_formallySmooth

theorem kerCotangentToTensor_injective_of_formallySmooth
    (hf : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B)) [Algebra.FormallySmooth k A]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF5.rank_conormal_add
statement:
theorem rank_conormal_add [Nontrivial B] (hf : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B))
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth k A] [Algebra.FormallySmooth k B]
    (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module B N] [IsScalarTower A B N]
    (e : N ≃ₗ[A] (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B)).Cotangent)
    [Module.Free B N] [Module.Free B Ω[B⁄k]] {r m d : ℕ}
    (hr : Module.rank B N = r) (hm : Module.rank B (B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k]) = m)
    (hd : Module.rank B Ω[B⁄k] = d) : r + d = m
proof:
:= by
  let f : N →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k] :=
    ((kerCotangentToTensor k A B).comp e.toLinearMap).extendScalarsOfSurjective hf
  have hfi : Function.Injective f :=
    (kerCotangentToTensor_injective_of_formallySmooth k A B hf).comp e.injective
  have hex : Function.Exact f (mapBaseChange k A B) := by
    intro x
    rw [KaehlerDifferential.exact_kerCotangentToTensor_mapBaseChange k A B hf x]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e.symm c, by simp [f]⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e n, rfl⟩
  have := rank_add_of_exact f (mapBaseChange k A B) hfi
    (mapBaseChange_surjective k A B hf) hex
  rw [hr, hm, hd] at this
  exact_mod_cast this.symm

name: B6.qQ_adams
statement:
theorem qQ_adams {Z W : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian W]
    (hZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hW : ConstantRankGenerators W) (q : K0 Z →+* K0 W)
    (hq : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : K0 Z), q (adamsRingHom hZ j x) = adamsRingHom hW j (q x)) (j : ℕ)
    (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] K0 Z) : qQ q (adamsQ hZ j x) = adamsQ hW j (qQ q x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c r => simp [adamsQ, psiQ_tmul, qQ_tmul, hq]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: B6.pullLoc_algebraMap
statement:
theorem pullLoc_algebraMap {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (q : K0 Z →+* K0 W) (j : ℕ) (a : K0 Z) :

name: B6.qQ_locToQ
statement:
theorem qQ_locToQ {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (q : K0 Z →+* K0 W) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (z : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z)) :
    qQ q (B5.locToQ j hj Z z) = B5.locToQ j hj W (pullLoc q j z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((qQ q).toRingHom).comp (B5.locToQ j hj Z) = (B5.locToQ j hj W).comp (pullLoc q j) := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, B5.locToQ_algebraMap, pullLoc_algebraMap,
      B5.toKQ_apply]
    simp [qQ_tmul]
  exact congrArg (fun f : _ →+* _ => f z) h

name: B6.bott_split
statement:
theorem bott_split {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian T] (j : ℕ) (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators T)
    (hnil : LambdaNilpotent T) {a b : ℕ} (Lm : Fin a → T.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank T (Lm i) 1) (Mm : Fin b → T.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ k, HasConstantRank T (Mm k) 1) :
    ((bott j T hrank hnil (Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (∑ i, k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree -
          ∑ k, k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
        (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T)) *
      ∏ k, algebraMap _ _ (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) =
    ∏ i, algebraMap _ _ (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
      (k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set B := bott j T hrank hnil with hB
  have e1 : Multiplicative.ofAdd (∑ i, k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree -
      ∑ k, k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      (∏ i, Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree)) /
        ∏ k, Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    rw [ofAdd_sub, ofAdd_sum, ofAdd_sum]
  have e2 : (B (Multiplicative.ofAdd (∑ i, k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree -
      ∑ k, k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree))) *
      ∏ k, B (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      ∏ i, B (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree)) := by
    rw [e1, map_div, map_prod, map_prod, div_mul_cancel]
  have e3 := congrArg (fun u : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T))ˣ =>
    (u : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T))) e2
  simp only [Units.val_mul, Units.coe_prod] at e3
  have hM' : ∀ k, ((B (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
      (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) := fun k =>
    bott_line j T hrank hnil _ (hM k)
  have hL' : ∀ i, ((B (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
      (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 T)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
        (k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ r) := fun i =>
    bott_line j T hrank hnil _ (hL i)
  simp only [hM', hL'] at e3
  exact e3

name: B6.exists_tower
statement:
theorem exists_tower {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] (hXrn : RankZeroNilpotent X)
    {E F : X.Modules} {a b : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E a) (hF : HasConstantRank X F b) :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsNoetherian T) (_ : IsIntegral T) (_ : ConstantRankGenerators T)
      (_ : TowerHypSTEPW T) (f : T ⟶ X) (Lm : Fin a → T.Modules) (Mm : Fin b → T.Modules)
      (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank T (Lm i) 1) (hM : ∀ k, HasConstantRank T (Mm k) 1),
      LambdaNilpotent T ∧ Function.Injective (pullbackK0RingHom f) ∧
      pullbackK0RingHom f (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
        ∑ i, k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      pullbackK0RingHom f (k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
        ∑ k, k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      (∀ i, IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf T (Lm i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree - 1)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf T (Mm k) (hM k).isFiniteLocallyFree - 1)) ∧ Nonempty T
proof:
:= by
  let T₁ := flagTower a E hE
  haveI : IsIntegral T₁.Y := TOWERW.flagTower_isIntegral a E hE
  haveI : IsNoetherian T₁.Y := TOWERW.flagTower_isNoetherian a E hE
  have hrn₁ : RankZeroNilpotent T₁.Y := TOWERW.flagTower_rankZeroNilpotent a hXrn E hE
  let F' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback T₁.q).obj F
  have hF' : HasConstantRank T₁.Y F' b := hasConstantRank_pullback T₁.Y T₁.q F b hF
  let T₂ := flagTower b F' hF'
  haveI : IsIntegral T₂.Y := TOWERW.flagTower_isIntegral b F' hF'
  haveI : IsNoetherian T₂.Y := TOWERW.flagTower_isNoetherian b F' hF'
  have hrn₂ : RankZeroNilpotent T₂.Y := TOWERW.flagTower_rankZeroNilpotent b hrn₁ F' hF'
  let Tow := T₁.comp T₂.q (fun hinj hX => by
    haveI := hX
    exact T₂.injective hinj (isNoetherian_of_isProper T₁.q))
  have hpf : ∀ x : K0 X, pullbackK0RingHom Tow.q x = flatPullbackK0 Tow.q x := fun x => by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]; rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (pullbackK0RingHom Tow.q) := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [hpf, hpf] at hxy
    exact Tow.injective pbInjectiveHyp inferInstance hxy
  refine ⟨T₂.Y, inferInstance, inferInstance, TOWERW.flagTower_constantRankGenerators b F' hF',
    TOWERW.towerHyp_flagTower hrn₁ b F' hF', Tow.q, Tow.L, T₂.L, Tow.rankOne, T₂.rankOne,
    lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent hrn₂, hinj, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    TOWERW.flagTower_nonempty b F' hF'⟩
  · exact (hpf _).trans (Tow.pullback_class_eq_sum hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
  · refine (hpf _).trans ?_
    have h1 : flatPullbackK0 Tow.q (k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
        flatPullbackK0 T₂.q (flatPullbackK0 T₁.q (k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree)) := by
      have := flatPullbackK0_comp T₂.q T₁.q
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun this _).symm
    rw [h1, flatPullbackK0_classOf T₁.q F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree]
    exact T₂.pullback_class_eq_sum hF'.isFiniteLocallyFree
  · intro i
    have h1 : k0ClassOf T₂.Y (Tow.L i) (Tow.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree =
        pullbackK0RingHom T₂.q (k0ClassOf T₁.Y (T₁.L i) (T₁.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
      rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
      rfl
    rw [h1, ← map_one (pullbackK0RingHom T₂.q), ← map_sub]
    exact (TOWERW.lineSub_one_isNilpotent T₁ hrn₁ i).map _
  · intro k
    exact TOWERW.lineSub_one_isNilpotent T₂ hrn₂ k

name: HnilPARRK2P.rankZeroNilpotent_of_closedImmersion
statement: theorem rankZeroNilpotent_of_closedImmersion [IsIntegral X] : RankZeroNilpotent X
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  haveI : IsNoetherian X := SchemeProjectiveBundle.isNoetherian_of_isProper i
  haveI : Nonempty X := inferInstance
  refine rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_isNilpotent_sub_rank (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) ?_
  intro F r hF
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  obtain ⟨m, hgg⟩ := HnilXF18.exists_isGG_tensor_twist K n i F
  have hO := AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m
  have hN := hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 hO
  have hFN : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X F
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))) r := by
    simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hF hN
  have ih := isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG r hFN hgg
  have hmul : k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))
        hN.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X F ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))) hFN.isFiniteLocallyFree :=
    k0ClassOf_mul X ⟨_, hF.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨_, hN.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩
  rw [← hmul] at ih
  have hu := HnilXF18.isNilpotent_pullbackTwist_sub_one K n i m
  have := isNilpotent_sub_of_mul (R := K0 X)
    (e := k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (l := k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))
      hN.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (r := (r : K0 X)) ((nil_iff _ _).1 ih) ((nil_iff _ _).1 hu)
  exact (nil_iff _ _).2 this

      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (J.subschemeι ≫ (A ↘ Spk k)))
    haveI : IsNoetherian J.subscheme :=
      { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι

    ProjectiveIntegralK k J.subscheme := by

name: KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_E

    letI
proof:
:= zOver (k := k) J
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (J.subscheme ↘ Spk k) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (J.subschemeι ≫ (A ↘ Spk k)))
    haveI : IsNoetherian J.subscheme :=
      { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
        __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace J.subschemeι }
    letI := componentOver (k := k) J
    haveI := component_lft J (coverJ J hAreg hZ) (projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
    haveI := component_isNoetherian J (coverJ J hAreg hZ) (projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (component A J) := by
  letI := zOver (k := k) J
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (J.subscheme ↘ Spk k) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (J.subschemeι ≫ (A ↘ Spk k)))
  haveI : IsNoetherian J.subscheme :=
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
      __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace J.subschemeι }
  exact projectiveIntegralK_component J (coverJ J hAreg hZ) (projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)

name: KG2B.isNoetherian_E

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_naturality
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (i : ℕ)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).map
          (affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i W) ≫
        affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f N i h =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h ≫
        affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i V
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  change affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f N i h
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (baseOpenRestriction h).hom).map
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i W)
        ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x)) =
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_coefficientMap f φ i V
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h
        ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W), (baseOpenRestriction h).hom] x))
  rw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_one_tmul]
  exact affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_coefficient_naturality f φ i h x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_of_isIso
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_of_isIso
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) [IsIso φ] (i : ℕ)

proof:
:= by
  intro V W h hV hW
  letI : IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i h) := hM h hV hW
  have hnat := affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_naturality f φ i h
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_fac_left hnat

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalBaseChange_iff_of_iso
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_mul
statement:
theorem unitMulSheafIso_mul {X : Scheme.{u}} (a b : Γ(X, ⊤)ˣ) :
    unitMulSheafIso (a * b) = unitMulSheafIso b ≪≫ unitMulSheafIso a
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  let x' : Γ(X, U.unop) := x
  change
    ((restrictTopUnit (a * b) U.unop : Γ(X, U.unop)) : Γ(X, U.unop)) * x' =
      ((restrictTopUnit a U.unop : Γ(X, U.unop)) : Γ(X, U.unop)) *
        (((restrictTopUnit b U.unop : Γ(X, U.unop)) : Γ(X, U.unop)) * x')
  simp only [restrictTopUnit, map_mul, Units.val_mul]
  exact mul_assoc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul
statement:
lemma affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul
    (phi : R →+* S) (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules)
    (x : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) :
    affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap phi E ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, phi] x) =
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).unit.app E) ≫
        (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E)).hom) x
proof:
:= by
  change (ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars phi _)
      ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, phi] x) = _
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars_hom_apply]
  change (1 : S) •
      (((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).unit.app E) ≫
        (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E)).hom) x) = _
  rw [one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_eq_iso_hom
statement:
theorem affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_eq_iso_hom
    (phi : R →+* S) (E : AffineQuasicoherent (.of R)) :
    affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap phi E.obj =
      (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso phi E).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  rw [affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul]
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)
  let adjPull := (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).comp
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)
  let adjExtend := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj phi).comp
    (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S))
  let adjPull' := adjPull.ofNatIsoRight
    (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))
  let N := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R)).obj E.obj
  let q := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
    (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E.obj)
  let k := ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S) ⋙
    ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).map q)
  have huniq := Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_assoc
    adjExtend adjPull' N k
  have huniqx := CategoryTheory.congr_fun huniq x
  have hright : adjPull'.unit.app N ≫ k =
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E.obj) ≫
        (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E.obj) := by
    let c := Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E.obj
    have hunit :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.naturality c).symm
    simp only [adjPull', Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight_unit, NatTrans.comp_app,
      adjPull, Adjunction.comp_unit_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
      N, k, Category.assoc]
    slice_lhs 3 4 =>
      erw [← (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso
        (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)).hom.naturality q]
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    dsimp only [q]
    dsimp only [c] at hunit
    erw [hunit]
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    slice_lhs 1 2 =>
      erw [(tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).right_triangle_components]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (Category.id_comp _)
  have hinv :
      (adjPull'.leftAdjointUniq adjExtend).inv.app N =
        (adjExtend.leftAdjointUniq adjPull').hom.app N :=
    Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_inv_app adjPull' adjExtend N
  have hinv' :
      (tildePullbackSpecMapIso phi).inv.app
          ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E.obj) =
        (adjExtend.leftAdjointUniq adjPull').hom.app N := by
    change (adjPull'.leftAdjointUniq adjExtend).inv.app N = _
    exact hinv
  have hleftx :
      (ConcreteCategory.hom
        (adjExtend.unit.app N ≫
          (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S) ⋙
            ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).map
              ((adjExtend.leftAdjointUniq adjPull').hom.app N) ≫
            k)) x =
      (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso phi E).hom
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, phi] x) := by
    simp [affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso, affineQCPullbackObjIso,
      adjExtend, N, q, k, Adjunction.comp_unit_app, hinv']
    rfl
  exact (CategoryTheory.congr_fun hright x).symm |>.trans
    (huniqx.symm.trans hleftx)

name: IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj_finite_family
statement:
theorem surj_finite_family [IsLocalizedModule.Away r f]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (y : ι → N) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ i, ∃ x : M, r ^ d • y i = f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let h := fun i ↦ IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj f r (y i)
  let e := fun i ↦ (h i).choose
  let x := fun i ↦ (h i).choose_spec.choose
  have hx (i : ι) : r ^ e i • y i = f (x i) :=
    (h i).choose_spec.choose_spec
  let d := Finset.univ.sup e
  refine ⟨d, fun i ↦ ⟨r ^ (d - e i) • x i, ?_⟩⟩
  have hei : e i ≤ d := by
    exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i)
  calc
    r ^ d • y i =
        r ^ ((d - e i) + e i) • y i := by
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hei]
    _ = r ^ (d - e i) • (r ^ e i • y i) := by
      rw [pow_add, mul_smul]
    _ = r ^ (d - e i) • f (x i) := by rw [hx]
    _ = f (r ^ (d - e i) • x i) :=
      (f.map_smul (r ^ (d - e i)) (x i)).symm

name: IsLocalizedModule.Away.exists_of_eq_finite_family
statement:
theorem exists_of_eq_finite_family [IsLocalizedModule.Away r f]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x y : ι → M)
    (hxy : ∀ i, f (x i) = f (y i)) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ i, r ^ d • x i = r ^ d • y i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let h := fun i ↦ IsLocalizedModule.Away.exists_of_eq r (hxy i)
  let e := fun i ↦ (h i).choose
  have hx (i : ι) : r ^ e i • x i = r ^ e i • y i :=
    (h i).choose_spec
  let d := Finset.univ.sup e
  refine ⟨d, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have hei : e i ≤ d := by
    exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [show d = (d - e i) + e i by omega, pow_add,
    mul_smul, mul_smul, hx]

    (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules) [T.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ e : SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf)
