name: TwistFreeCoverF18.exists_iso_free_spec_field
statement:
theorem exists_iso_free_spec_field (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules) (hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ T) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, Nonempty (T ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf)
      (ULift.{u} (Fin N)))
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (CommRingCat.of K)
  let x₀ : X := IsLocalRing.closedPoint K
  have hx₀ : ∀ U : X.Opens, x₀ ∈ U → U = ⊤ := fun U hU ↦ by
    refine eq_top_iff.2 fun p _ ↦ ?_
    exact ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes (show PrimeSpectrum K from p)
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)).1 (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal p.2.ne_top)).mem_open U.isOpen hU
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hT.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x₀
  have hU : q.X i = ⊤ := hx₀ _ hi
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite (q.generators i).I := inferInstance
  let g := (localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i
  have hg : IsIso g := by
    rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
    refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun x ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    have hx : x ∈ q.X i := hU ▸ trivial
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  let e : T ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (q.generators i).I :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app T).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (IsIso.inv_hom_id g)).app T).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (inv g) g).app T).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (inv g)).mapIso
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app T).symm ≪≫
          localGeneratorsOpenCoverIso q i) ≪≫
      AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso (inv g) _
  refine ⟨Nat.card (q.generators i).I, ⟨e ≪≫
    (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
      (((Finite.equivFin _).trans Equiv.ulift.symm).toIso)⟩⟩

name: TwistFreeCoverF18.exists_epi_twist_gg
statement:
theorem exists_epi_twist_gg (G : (space K n).Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (P : (space K n).Modules) (N : ℕ),
      Nonempty (P ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := (space K n).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N))) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree _ P ∧
      ∃ e : tensorSheaf (space K n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n (-m)) P ⟶ G, Epi e
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular_twist K n G
  let G' := moduleTwist K n G m
  haveI hG' : G'.IsFinitePresentation := CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation K n G m
  haveI := CohQ.ε_epi K n G' hm
  haveI := pushforward_isFinitePresentation K n G'
  obtain ⟨N, e1, he1⟩ := exists_epi_free_spec K ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec K n)).obj G')
  haveI := he1
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)).obj
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N)))
  have hPgg : Nonempty (P ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := (space K n).ringCatSheaf)
      (ULift.{u} (Fin N))) := ⟨pullbackFreeIso (toSpec K n) _⟩
  have hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ P :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ hPgg.some.symm (free_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _)
  let L := projectiveTwistingSheaf K n (-m)
  have hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space K n) L := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree K n _
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor (space K n) L
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space K n) L hL
  haveI : T.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape T
  let e0 : T.obj G' ≅ G :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space K n) L G' ≪≫
      moduleTwistTwistIso K n G m (-m) 0 (by ring) ≪≫ Quillen.twistZeroIso K n G
  refine ⟨m, P, N, hPgg, hP, T.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)).map e1 ≫ quillenCounit K n G') ≫ e0.hom, ?_⟩
  have hPE : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec K n))
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)).map e1) :=
    @Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)) hPE _ _ e1 he1
  have hε : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)).map e1 ≫ quillenCounit K n G') :=
    inferInstance
  have hTε : Epi (T.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec K n)).map e1 ≫ quillenCounit K n G')) :=
    Functor.map_epi T _
  exact epi_comp' hTε (inferInstance : Epi e0.hom)

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionObject_exact

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineG0Pushforward_openBaseChange
statement:
theorem finiteAffineG0Pushforward_openBaseChange (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (U : Y.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] [IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)] :
    (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι).comp
        (finiteAffineG0Pushforward f) =
      (finiteAffineG0Pushforward (f ∣_ U)).comp
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  change SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι
      (finiteAffineG0Pushforward f (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)) =
    finiteAffineG0Pushforward (f ∣_ U)
      (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2))
  rw [finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf,
    SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0_classOf,
    SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0_classOf,
    finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf]
  exact SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso _ _
    (restrictPushforwardIso f U E.1)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_openBaseChange
statement:
theorem finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_openBaseChange (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (U : Y.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] [IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)]
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
          (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage f)
          (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent f) E i) =
      SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage (f ∣_ U))
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent (f ∣_ U))
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionObject (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι E) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_eq,
    finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_eq]
  have h := congrArg
    (fun k : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 U.toScheme ↦
      k (GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass E i))
    (finiteAffineG0Pushforward_openBaseChange f U)
  simpa only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0_identityHigherClass] using h

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineDerivedPushforward_openBaseChange
statement:
theorem finiteAffineDerivedPushforward_openBaseChange (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (U : Y.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] [IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)] :
    (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι).comp
        (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward f) =
      (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward (f ∣_ U)).comp
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_baseChange_of_degreewise 0
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage f)
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent f)
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImageLongExact f)
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage (f ∣_ U))
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent (f ∣_ U))
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImageLongExact (f ∣_ U))
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionObject (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionObject_exact (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι)
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_openBaseChange f U)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineFamilyEuler_openBaseChange
statement:
theorem finiteAffineFamilyEuler_openBaseChange (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (U : Y.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] [IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)]
    (rank : SchemeKTheory.G0 Y →+ ℤ)
    (rankU : SchemeKTheory.G0 U.toScheme →+ ℤ)
    (hrank : rankU.comp (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι) = rank) :
    familyEuler (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward f) rank =
      (familyEuler (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward (f ∣_ U)) rankU).comp
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
proof:
:= by
  exact familyEuler_baseChange
    (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward f)
    (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward (f ∣_ U))
    (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
    (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0 U.ι) rank rankU
    (finiteAffineDerivedPushforward_openBaseChange f U) hrank

name: SchemeKTheory.TF5.isIso_of_epi_of_rank
statement:
theorem isIso_of_epi_of_rank {W : Scheme.{u}} {M N : W.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hM : HasConstantRank W M r) (hN : HasConstantRank W N r) (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f] : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have hK : IsZero (kernel f) := by
    refine AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ ?_
    have := hasConstantRank_kernel W hM hN f
    rwa [Nat.sub_self] at this
  haveI : Mono f := Preadditive.mono_of_kernel_zero (hK.eq_of_src _ _)
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi f

name: SchemeKTheory.TF5.mono_of_exact_of_rank
statement:
theorem mono_of_exact_of_rank {W : Scheme.{u}} {N M Q : W.Modules} {r m d : ℕ}
    (hN : HasConstantRank W N r) (hM : HasConstantRank W M m) (hQ : HasConstantRank W Q d)
    (hrmd : r + d = m) (c : N ⟶ M) (p : M ⟶ Q) [Epi p] (w : c ≫ p = 0)
    (hex : (ShortComplex.mk c p w).Exact) : Mono c
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (kernel.lift p c w) := hex.epi_kernelLift
  have hK : HasConstantRank W (kernel p) r := by
    have := hasConstantRank_kernel W hM hQ p
    rwa [show m - d = r by omega] at this
  haveI := isIso_of_epi_of_rank hN hK (kernel.lift p c w)
  have : c = kernel.lift p c w ≫ kernel.ι p := by simp
  rw [this]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_pA_over
statement:
theorem isIso_pA_over (a : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((pA R n a d).over (coordinateOpen R n a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso]
  let cu := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (coordinateOpen R n a).ι).app
    (unitModules (coordinateOpen R n a).toScheme)
  have hlf : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n a).ι).map (pA R n a d) ≫
      cu.hom = localFrameProjection R n d a := by
    simp [pA, localFrameProjection, Functor.map_comp, Koszul.ι, cu]
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen R n a).ι).map (pA R n a d) ≫
      cu.hom) := by
    rw [hlf]; exact (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d a).isIso_inv
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ cu.hom

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.contraction_pA
statement:
theorem contraction_pA (a j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    eulerContraction R n j ≫ pA R n a (-1) = overToPushed (eulerChartMap R n a j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pA, ← Category.assoc, eulerContraction_ι, eulerChartCochain, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.contraction_over_tau
statement:
theorem contraction_over_tau (a j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (eulerContraction R n j).over (coordinateOpen R n a) ≫ (tauIso R n a (-1)).hom =
      eulerChartMap R n a j
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_pA_over R n a (-1)
  haveI := isIso_qUnit_over (X := space R n) (U := coordinateOpen R n a)
  simp only [tauIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, asIso_inv, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  change ((eulerContraction R n j ≫ pA R n a (-1)).over (coordinateOpen R n a)) ≫ _ = _
  rw [contraction_pA, overToPushed_over, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.span_subtype_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem span_subtype_eq_top_iff (s : Set R) (hs : s ⊆ maximalIdeal R) :
    Submodule.span R {x : maximalIdeal R | (x : R) ∈ s} = ⊤ ↔
      Ideal.span s = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have himg : (Submodule.subtype (maximalIdeal R)) '' {x : maximalIdeal R | (x : R) ∈ s} = s := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hx
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨⟨y, hs hy⟩, hy, rfl⟩
  have key : Submodule.map (Submodule.subtype (maximalIdeal R))
      (Submodule.span R {x : maximalIdeal R | (x : R) ∈ s}) = Ideal.span s := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span, himg]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← key, h, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  · intro h
    apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (Submodule.injective_subtype (maximalIdeal R))
    rw [key, h, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_subfinset_span_eq_spanFinrank
statement:
theorem exists_subfinset_span_eq_spanFinrank (s : Finset R)
    (hsm : (s : Set R) ⊆ maximalIdeal R) (hs : Ideal.span (s : Set R) = maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ s' : Finset R, s' ⊆ s ∧ Ideal.span (s' : Set R) = maximalIdeal R ∧
      s'.card = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set κ := ResidueField R
  let v : s → CotangentSpace R := fun x => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨x.1, hsm x.2⟩
  obtain ⟨κ', a, ha, hspan, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' κ v
  haveI : Finite κ' := Finite.of_injective a ha
  letI : Fintype κ' := Fintype.ofFinite κ'
  let s' : Finset R := Finset.univ.image (fun k => (a k).1)
  have hsub : s' ⊆ s := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact (a k).2
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k => (a k).1) := fun k l h => ha (Subtype.ext h)
  have hcard : s'.card = Fintype.card κ' := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
    simp
  have hrange : Set.range v = (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ''
      {x : maximalIdeal R | (x : R) ∈ (s : Set R)} := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x.1, hsm x.2⟩, x.2, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x.1, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  have htop : Submodule.span κ (Set.range (v ∘ a)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hspan, hrange]
    exact (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)).mpr
      ((span_subtype_eq_top_iff _ hsm).mpr hs)
  have hfin : Module.finrank κ (CotangentSpace R) = Fintype.card κ' := by
    have := finrank_span_eq_card hli
    rwa [htop, finrank_top] at this
  have hs'm : (s' : Set R) ⊆ maximalIdeal R := fun x hx => hsm (hsub hx)
  refine ⟨s', hsub, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← span_subtype_eq_top_iff _ hs'm, ← CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R),
      eq_top_iff, ← htop, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨(a k).1, hsm (a k).2⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  · rw [hcard, ← hfin, spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace]

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.isWeaklyRegular_iff_forall_mem
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_iff_forall_mem {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (ys : List S) :
    IsWeaklyRegular S ys ↔ ∀ i (hi : i < ys.length), ∀ a : S,
      ys[i] * a ∈ Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) → a ∈ Ideal.ofList (ys.take i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isWeaklyRegular_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun i => forall_congr' fun hi => ?_
  have h : (Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) • (⊤ : Submodule S S)) = Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  have hmem : ∀ a : S, a ∈ (Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) • (⊤ : Submodule S S)) ↔
      a ∈ Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) := fun a => by rw [h]
  rw [isSMulRegular_iff_right_eq_zero_of_smul]
  constructor
  · intro H a ha
    have h1 : ys[i] • (Submodule.Quotient.mk a :
        S ⧸ (Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) • (⊤ : Submodule S S))) = 0 := by
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hmem]
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    have := H _ h1
    rwa [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hmem] at this
  · intro H x hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hmem] at hx
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hmem]
    exact H a (by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hx)

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.mem_map_algebraMap_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_map_algebraMap_iff_exists {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (M : Submonoid R)
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsLocalization M S] (J : Ideal R) (b : R) :
    algebraMap R S b ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) ↔ ∃ c ∈ M, c * b ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨x1, x2⟩, hx⟩ := (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff M S).mp h
    have hx' : algebraMap R S (b * x2) = algebraMap R S x1 := by
      simpa [map_mul] using hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists M S).mp hx'
    refine ⟨c * x2, M.mul_mem c.2 x2.2, ?_⟩
    have : (c : R) * x2 * b = c * x1 := by linear_combination hc
    rw [this]
    exact J.mul_mem_left _ x1.2
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S c) := IsLocalization.map_units S ⟨c, hc⟩
    have : algebraMap R S (c * b) ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hcb
    rw [map_mul] at this
    obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
    have h2 : algebraMap R S b = ↑u⁻¹ * (algebraMap R S c * algebraMap R S b) := by
      rw [← hu', ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
    rw [h2]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ this

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_away_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem exists_away_isWeaklyRegular {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A p]
    (ys : List R)
    (hreg : IsWeaklyRegular A (ys.map (algebraMap R A))) :
    ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧ ∀ (M : Submonoid R) (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
      [IsLocalization M S], IsUnit (algebraMap R S g) →
      IsWeaklyRegular S (ys.map (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hidx : ∀ i (hi : i < ys.length), ∃ t : R, t ∉ p ∧ ∀ a : R,
      ys[i] * a ∈ Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) → t * a ∈ Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) := by
    intro i hi
    set J := Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) with hJ
    let φ : R →ₗ[R] R ⧸ J := (Submodule.mkQ J).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft R ys[i])
    let K : Ideal R := LinearMap.ker φ
    have hK : ∀ a, a ∈ K ↔ ys[i] * a ∈ J := fun a => by
      simp only [K, φ, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
        LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
      exact Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero J
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (IsNoetherian.noetherian K)
    have hloc : ∀ a ∈ K, ∃ t : R, t ∉ p ∧ t * a ∈ J := by
      intro a ha
      have ha' := (hK a).mp ha
      have hcrit := (isWeaklyRegular_iff_forall_mem _).mp hreg i (by simpa using hi)
        (algebraMap R A a) (by
          have : (ys.map (algebraMap R A))[i]'(by simpa using hi) *
              algebraMap R A a =
              algebraMap R A (ys[i] * a) := by
            simp [map_mul]
          rw [this, List.map_take.symm, ← Ideal.map_ofList]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha')
      rw [← List.map_take, ← Ideal.map_ofList] at hcrit
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hca⟩ := (mem_map_algebraMap_iff_exists p.primeCompl
        A J a).mp hcrit
      exact ⟨c, hc, hca⟩
    choose! tt htt ht using hloc
    refine ⟨∏ a ∈ s, tt a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hmem
      obtain ⟨a, has, hap⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff).mp hmem
      exact htt a (hs ▸ Submodule.subset_span has) hap
    · have key : ∀ b ∈ K, (∏ a ∈ s, tt a) * b ∈ J := by
        intro b hbK
        rw [← hs] at hbK
        induction hbK using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem a has =>
          have haK : a ∈ K := hs ▸ Submodule.subset_span has
          obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem tt has
          rw [hc, show tt a * c * a = c * (tt a * a) by ring]
          exact J.mul_mem_left _ (ht a haK)
        | zero => simp
        | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact J.add_mem hx hy
        | smul r x _ hx =>
          rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
          exact J.mul_mem_left _ hx
      intro b hb
      exact key b ((hK b).mpr hb)
  choose! T hTp hT using hidx
  have hgp : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range ys.length, T i) ∉ p := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hip⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff).mp hmem
    exact hTp i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hip
  refine ⟨∏ i ∈ Finset.range ys.length, T i, hgp, ?_⟩
  intro M S _ _ _ hgu
  set g := ∏ i ∈ Finset.range ys.length, T i with hg
  rw [isWeaklyRegular_iff_forall_mem]
  intro i hi a ha
  have hi' : i < ys.length := by simpa using hi
  set J := Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) with hJ
  have hmap : Ideal.ofList ((ys.map (algebraMap R S)).take i) = J.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    rw [← List.map_take, Ideal.map_ofList]
  rw [hmap] at ha ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨a0, gk⟩, hx⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M a
  have hgku : IsUnit (algebraMap R S gk) := IsLocalization.map_units S gk
  have h1 : algebraMap R S (ys[i] * a0) ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    have : (ys.map (algebraMap R S))[i]'hi * a * algebraMap R S gk ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) :=
      Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ha
    rw [mul_assoc, hx] at this
    simpa [List.getElem_map, map_mul] using this
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hca⟩ := (mem_map_algebraMap_iff_exists M S J (ys[i] * a0)).mp h1
  have h2 : ys[i] * (c * a0) ∈ J := by
    have : c * (ys[i] * a0) = ys[i] * (c * a0) := by ring
    rwa [this] at hca
  have h3 := hT i hi' (c * a0) h2
  have h4 : algebraMap R S (T i * (c * a0)) ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h3
  have hTu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S (T i)) := by
    have hdvd : T i ∣ g := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem T (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi')
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hdvd
    have : IsUnit (algebraMap R S (T i) * algebraMap R S e) := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← he]; exact hgu
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left this
  have hcu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S c) := by
    exact IsLocalization.map_units S ⟨c, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hTu.mul hcu
  have h5 : algebraMap R S a0 ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    have h4' : (algebraMap R S (T i) * algebraMap R S c) * algebraMap R S a0 ∈
        J.map (algebraMap R S) := by
      have : algebraMap R S (T i * (c * a0)) =
          (algebraMap R S (T i) * algebraMap R S c) * algebraMap R S a0 := by
        simp [map_mul, mul_assoc]
      rwa [this] at h4
    rw [← hu] at h4'
    have : algebraMap R S a0 = ↑u⁻¹ * (↑u * algebraMap R S a0) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h4'
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hgku
  have h6 : a * algebraMap R S gk ∈ J.map (algebraMap R S) := by rw [hx]; exact h5
  rw [← hv] at h6
  have : a = (a * ↑v) * ↑v⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ h6

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.ofList_eq_of_forall₂_unit
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hab _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hab
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons, ih, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit u.isUnit]

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.isWeaklyRegular_of_forall₂_unit
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : ls.length = ys.length := h.length_eq
  rw [isWeaklyRegular_iff_forall_mem] at hl ⊢
  intro i hi a ha
  have hi' : i < ls.length := hlen ▸ hi
  have hrel := (List.forall₂_iff_get.mp h).2 i hi' hi
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hrel
  have htake : Ideal.ofList (ys.take i) = Ideal.ofList (ls.take i) :=
    (ofList_eq_of_forall₂_unit (List.forall₂_take i h)).symm
  rw [htake] at ha ⊢
  have hya : ys[i] = u * ls[i] := by simpa using hu
  have h1 : ls[i] * (↑u * a) ∈ Ideal.ofList (ls.take i) := by
    have : ls[i] * (↑u * a) = ys[i] * a := by rw [hya]; ring
    rw [this]; exact ha
  have h2 := hl i hi' _ h1
  have : a = ↑u⁻¹ * (↑u * a) := by rw [← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h2

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_mul_mem_of_map_le
statement:
theorem exists_mul_mem_of_map_le {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A p]
    (J Y : Ideal R) (hle : J.map (algebraMap R A) ≤ Y.map (algebraMap R A)) :
    ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧ ∀ a ∈ J, g * a ∈ Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (IsNoetherian.noetherian J)
  have hloc : ∀ a ∈ J, ∃ t : R, t ∉ p ∧ t * a ∈ Y := by
    intro a ha
    have := hle (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hca⟩ := (mem_map_algebraMap_iff_exists p.primeCompl A Y a).mp this
    exact ⟨c, hc, hca⟩
  choose! tt htt ht using hloc
  refine ⟨∏ a ∈ s, tt a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hmem
    obtain ⟨a, has, hap⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff).mp hmem
    exact htt a (hs ▸ Submodule.subset_span has) hap
  · intro b hbJ
    rw [← hs] at hbJ
    induction hbJ using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a has =>
      have haK : a ∈ J := hs ▸ Submodule.subset_span has
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem tt has
      rw [hc, show tt a * c * a = c * (tt a * a) by ring]
      exact Y.mul_mem_left _ (ht a haK)
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact Y.add_mem hx hy
    | smul r x _ hx =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
      exact Y.mul_mem_left _ hx

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_away_map_eq_ofList
statement:
theorem exists_away_map_eq_ofList {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A p]
    (J : Ideal R) (ys : List R)
    (h : J.map (algebraMap R A) = Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap R A))) :
    ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧ ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S],
      IsUnit (algebraMap R S g) →
      J.map (algebraMap R S) = Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmapY : ∀ (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T],
      Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap R T)) = (Ideal.ofList ys).map (algebraMap R T) :=
    fun T _ _ => (Ideal.map_ofList _ _).symm
  rw [hmapY] at h
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1, h1⟩ := exists_mul_mem_of_map_le p A J (Ideal.ofList ys) h.le
  obtain ⟨g2, hg2, h2⟩ := exists_mul_mem_of_map_le p A (Ideal.ofList ys) J h.ge
  refine ⟨g1 * g2, p.primeCompl.mul_mem hg1 hg2, ?_⟩
  intro S _ _ hgu
  rw [hmapY]
  rw [map_mul] at hgu
  have hu1 : IsUnit (algebraMap R S g1) := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hgu
  have hu2 : IsUnit (algebraMap R S g2) := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hgu
  have key : ∀ (K L : Ideal R) (g : R), IsUnit (algebraMap R S g) → (∀ a ∈ K, g * a ∈ L) →
      K.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ L.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    intro K L g hu hKL
    refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr fun a ha => ?_
    have : algebraMap R S (g * a) ∈ L.map (algebraMap R S) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hKL a ha)
    rw [map_mul] at this
    obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
    have h2 : algebraMap R S a = ↑u⁻¹ * (algebraMap R S g * algebraMap R S a) := by
      rw [← hu', ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
    rw [h2]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ this
  exact le_antisymm (key J _ g1 hu1 h1) (key _ J g2 hu2 h2)

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_isWeaklyRegular_list_of_quotient_regular
statement:
theorem exists_isWeaklyRegular_list_of_quotient_regular
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal A) [IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ I)] :
    ∃ rs : List A, Ideal.ofList rs = I ∧
      rs.length + (maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I)).spanFinrank = (maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank ∧
      IsWeaklyRegular A rs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let π : A →+* A ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hπs : Function.Surjective π := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal A).map π = maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I) :=
    map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective π hπs
  obtain ⟨T, hTcard, hTspan⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
    (maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  have hTspan' : Ideal.span (T : Set A) = maximalIdeal A := hTspan
  set d := (maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I)).spanFinrank with hd
  have hTm : (T : Set A) ⊆ maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← hTspan']
    exact Ideal.subset_span
  have hSm : ((T.image π : Finset (A ⧸ I)) : Set (A ⧸ I)) ⊆ maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    rw [← hmap]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem π (hTm ht)
  have hSspan : Ideal.span ((T.image π : Finset (A ⧸ I)) : Set (A ⧸ I)) =
      maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I) := by
    rw [← hmap, ← hTspan', Ideal.map_span, Finset.coe_image]
  obtain ⟨S', hS'sub, hS'span, hS'card⟩ := exists_subfinset_span_eq_spanFinrank _ hSm hSspan
  have hg : ∀ y ∈ S', ∃ t ∈ T, π t = y := fun y hy => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (hS'sub hy)
    exact ⟨t, ht, h⟩
  choose! g hgT hgπ using hg
  let T' : Finset A := S'.image g
  have hT'T : T' ⊆ T := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
    exact hgT y hy
  have hT'card : T'.card = d := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn, hS'card]
    intro y hy z hz h
    rw [← hgπ y hy, ← hgπ z hz]
    exact congrArg π h
  have hT'img : T'.image π = S' := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
      rw [hgπ z hz]
      exact hz
    · intro hy
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨g y, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hgπ y hy⟩
  have hw : ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ w ∈ Ideal.span (T' : Set A), t - w ∈ I := by
    intro t ht
    have hmem : π t ∈ Ideal.map π (Ideal.span (T' : Set A)) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Finset.coe_image, hT'img, hS'span, ← hmap]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem π (hTm ht)
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwπ⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective π hπs).mp hmem
    exact ⟨w, hw, Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hwπ.symm⟩
  choose! w hwT hwI using hw
  let rs : List A := (T \ T').toList.map (fun t => t - w t)
  have hrs_len : rs.length = T.card - d := by
    simp [rs, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hT'T, hT'card]
  have hrs_mem : ∀ x ∈ rs, ∃ t ∈ T, t ∉ T' ∧ x = t - w t := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    have := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_toList.mp ht)
    exact ⟨t, this.1, this.2, rfl⟩
  set J : Ideal A := Ideal.ofList rs with hJdef
  have hJI : J ≤ I := by
    refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, _, rfl⟩ := hrs_mem x hx
    exact hwI t ht
  have hJm : J ≤ maximalIdeal A := hJI.trans hI
  have hmJ : maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span (T' : Set A) ⊔ J := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← hTspan', Ideal.span_le]
      intro t ht
      by_cases htT' : t ∈ T'
      · exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span htT')
      · have hmemJ : t - w t ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span
          (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨t, Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨ht, htT'⟩), rfl⟩)
        have : t = w t + (t - w t) := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left (hwT t ht)) (Ideal.mem_sup_right hmemJ)
    · exact sup_le (Ideal.span_le.mpr fun x hx => hTm (hT'T hx)) hJm
  haveI : Nontrivial (A ⧸ J) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
      (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A).ne_top hJm)
  haveI : IsLocalRing (A ⧸ J) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing (A ⧸ J) := Ideal.Quotient.isNoetherianRing J
  let ρ : A →+* A ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  have hmapC : (maximalIdeal A).map ρ = maximalIdeal (A ⧸ J) :=
    map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective ρ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmC : maximalIdeal (A ⧸ J) = Ideal.span (ρ '' (T' : Set A)) := by
    rw [← hmapC, hmJ, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span]
    have : J.map ρ = ⊥ := by
      rw [Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker, Ideal.mk_ker]
    rw [this, sup_bot_eq]
  have hrankC : (maximalIdeal (A ⧸ J)).spanFinrank ≤ d := by
    rw [hmC]
    refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (T'.finite_toSet.image _)).trans ?_
    calc Set.ncard (ρ '' (T' : Set A)) ≤ Set.ncard (T' : Set A) :=
          Set.ncard_image_le T'.finite_toSet
      _ = d := by rw [Set.ncard_coe_finset, hT'card]
  have hdimB : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ I) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := A ⧸ I)).symm
  have hdimC_le : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ J) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    (ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (A ⧸ J)).trans (by exact_mod_cast hrankC)
  let f : A ⧸ J →+* A ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.factor hJI
  have hfρ : ∀ a, f (ρ a) = π a := fun a => rfl
  have hfs : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    exact ⟨ρ a, hfρ a⟩
  have hdimC_ge : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (A ⧸ J) := by
    have := ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective f hfs
    rwa [hdimB] at this
  haveI hCreg : IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ J) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le _
      (le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hrankC) hdimC_ge)
  haveI : IsDomain (A ⧸ J) := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing _
  have hJeq : J = I := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : J < I := lt_of_le_of_ne hJI hne
    obtain ⟨-, a, haI, haJ⟩ := SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp hlt
    have hc0 : ρ a ≠ 0 := fun h => haJ (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)
    have hcm : ρ a ∈ maximalIdeal (A ⧸ J) := by
      rw [← hmapC]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem ρ (hI haI)
    have hcnz : ρ a ∈ nonZeroDivisors (A ⧸ J) := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hc0
    have hdim1 :=
      ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hcnz hcm
    have hfc : f (ρ a) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr haI
    let g : (A ⧸ J) ⧸ Ideal.span {ρ a} →+* A ⧸ I :=
      Ideal.Quotient.lift (Ideal.span {ρ a}) f (by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
        rw [map_mul, hfc, zero_mul])
    have hgs : Function.Surjective g := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
      exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (ρ a'), rfl⟩
    have h1 := ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective g hgs
    rw [hdimB] at h1
    have hCd : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ J) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := le_antisymm hdimC_le hdimC_ge
    rw [hCd] at hdim1
    have h2 : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      calc (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1
          ≤ ringKrullDim ((A ⧸ J) ⧸ Ideal.span {ρ a}) + 1 := add_le_add_left h1 1
        _ = d := hdim1
    have h3 : d + 1 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega
  have hdle : d ≤ T.card := by
    rw [← hT'card]
    exact Finset.card_le_card hT'T
  have hlen : rs.length + d = (maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank := by
    rw [hrs_len, ← hTcard]
    omega
  refine ⟨rs, hJeq, hlen, ?_⟩
  letI : ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing A :=
    ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_unconditional A
  have hdimA : ringKrullDim A = ((maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := A)).symm
  haveI : FiniteRingKrullDim A := by
    rw [finiteRingKrullDim_iff_ne_bot_and_top, hdimA]
    refine ⟨WithBot.coe_ne_bot, ?_⟩
    intro h
    generalize (maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank = n at h
    have h2 : ((n : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by simpa using h
    exact ENat.coe_ne_top n (WithBot.coe_injective h2)
  apply ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isWeaklyRegular_of_ringKrullDim_add_length A rs
  have e : (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) ≃+* (A ⧸ I) := Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hJeq
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, hdimB, hdimA]
  exact_mod_cast (by omega : d + rs.length = (maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank)

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_regularGenerators_of_quotient_regular
statement:
theorem exists_regularGenerators_of_quotient_regular
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal A) [IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ I)] :
    ∃ x : RegularGenerators A I,
      x.length + (maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I)).spanFinrank = (maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hlen, hreg⟩ := exists_isWeaklyRegular_list_of_quotient_regular I hI
  refine ⟨{ length := rs.length
            gen := fun i => rs.get i
            isWeaklyRegular := by simpa [List.ofFn_get] using hreg
            span_eq := ?_ }, hlen⟩
  rw [← hrs]
  unfold Ideal.ofList
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [List.mem_iff_get]

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_chart_regular_generators
statement:
theorem exists_chart_regular_generators {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [IsLocalization.AtPrime A p] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (J : Ideal R)
    (hle : J.map (algebraMap R A) ≤ maximalIdeal A)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R A))] :
    ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧ ∃ ys : List R,
      ys.length + (maximalIdeal (A ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R A))).spanFinrank =
        (maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank ∧
      ∀ (M : Submonoid R) (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsLocalization M S],
        IsUnit (algebraMap R S g) →
        J.map (algebraMap R S) = Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap R S)) ∧
        IsWeaklyRegular S (ys.map (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ls, hls, hlen, hreg⟩ := exists_isWeaklyRegular_list_of_quotient_regular
    (J.map (algebraMap R A)) hle
  choose x hx using fun l : A => IsLocalization.surj p.primeCompl l
  let ys : List R := ls.map (fun l => (x l).1)
  have hysA : ys.map (algebraMap R A) = ls.map (fun l => algebraMap R A (x l).1) := by
    simp [ys, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  have hrel : List.Forall₂ (fun l y => ∃ u : Aˣ, y = (u : A) * l) ls
      (ys.map (algebraMap R A)) := by
    rw [hysA, List.forall₂_map_right_iff]
    refine List.forall₂_same.mpr fun l _ => ?_
    refine ⟨(IsLocalization.map_units A (x l).2).unit, ?_⟩
    rw [← hx l]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hregA : IsWeaklyRegular A (ys.map (algebraMap R A)) :=
    isWeaklyRegular_of_forall₂_unit hrel hreg
  have hidA : J.map (algebraMap R A) = Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap R A)) := by
    rw [← hls]; exact ofList_eq_of_forall₂_unit hrel
  obtain ⟨g1, hg1, h1⟩ := exists_away_isWeaklyRegular p A ys hregA
  obtain ⟨g2, hg2, h2⟩ := exists_away_map_eq_ofList p A J ys hidA
  refine ⟨g1 * g2, p.primeCompl.mul_mem hg1 hg2, ys, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [ys] using hlen
  · intro M S _ _ _ hgu
    rw [map_mul] at hgu
    have hu1 : IsUnit (algebraMap R S g1) := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hgu
    have hu2 : IsUnit (algebraMap R S g2) := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hgu
    exact ⟨h2 S hu2, h1 M S hu1⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_map
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_map {P : Scheme.{u}} {U : P.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x ξ : U) (h : (ξ : P) ⤳ (x : P)) :
    Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h =
      Ideal.map (algebraMap Γ(P, U) (P.presheaf.stalk (x : P)))
        (hU.primeIdealOf ξ).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk x
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk ξ
  have hcomp : (P.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom.comp
      (algebraMap Γ(P, U) (P.presheaf.stalk (x : P))) =
      algebraMap Γ(P, U) (P.presheaf.stalk (ξ : P)) := by
    ext a
    exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom a) (P.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes x.2 h)
  have hq : (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap
      (algebraMap Γ(P, U) (P.presheaf.stalk (x : P))) = (hU.primeIdealOf ξ).asIdeal := by
    unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
    rw [Ideal.comap_comap, hcomp]
    exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (P.presheaf.stalk (ξ : P)) _
  rw [← hq, IsLocalization.map_under (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.primeCompl]

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.length_eq_coheight
statement:
theorem length_eq_coheight (U : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).affineOpens)
    (hη : i (genericPoint X) ∈ U.1)
    (x : QuasiregularGenerators Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U) (i.ker.ideal U)) :
    (x.length : ℕ∞) = coheight (i (genericPoint X))
proof:
:= by
  have hU := U.2
  haveI : Nonempty U.1 := ⟨⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩⟩
  letI : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n))
  letI := (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kSec k _ U.1).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U.1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finiteType_kSec k _ hU
  have hp := SchemeKTheory.F12.ideal_eq_primeIdealOf k n i U hη
  haveI : (i.ker.ideal U).IsPrime := by
    rw [hp]; exact (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).isPrime
  have hlen0 := SchemeKTheory.F12.length_eq_height k x
  have hlen : (x.length : ℕ∞) =
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨i (genericPoint X), hη⟩).asIdeal.height := by
    rw [← hp]; exact hlen0
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf _ hU (i (genericPoint X)) hη]
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight] at *
  exact hlen

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.exists_regular_chart
statement:
theorem exists_regular_chart (z0 : X) :
    ∃ (U : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).affineOpens) (_ : i z0 ∈ U.1)
      (rs : List Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U)),
      i.ker.ideal U = Ideal.ofList rs ∧ IsWeaklyRegular Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U) rs ∧
      rs.length = (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  set η := genericPoint X with hηdef
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp 𝐏.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show i z0 ∈ (⊤ : 𝐏.Opens) from trivial)
  let Vaff : 𝐏.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  have hηx : i η ⤳ i z0 :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial : η ⤳ z0).map i.continuous
  have hηV : i η ∈ V := hηx.mem_open V.isOpen hxV
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(𝐏, V) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian Vaff
  let x : V := ⟨i z0, hxV⟩
  let ξ : V := ⟨i η, hηV⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(𝐏, V) (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk 𝐏.presheaf x
  haveI hlocx := hV.isLocalization_stalk x
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏)) := hP (i z0)
  set J : Ideal Γ(𝐏, V) := (hV.primeIdealOf ξ).asIdeal with hJdef
  have hJ : i.ker.ideal Vaff = J := SchemeKTheory.F12.ideal_eq_primeIdealOf k n i Vaff hηV
  have hQ : J.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏))) =
      RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z0).hom := by
    rw [← stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_map hV x ξ hηx]
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrime i z0).symm
  have hprime : (J.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏)))).IsPrime := by
    rw [← stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_map hV x ξ hηx]
    infer_instance
  have hle : J.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏))) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏)) :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hprime.ne_top
  haveI hregq : IsRegularLocalRing
      (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏) ⧸ J.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏)))) := by
    haveI := hX z0
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
      (((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hQ).trans
        (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (i.stalkMap_surjective z0))).symm)
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, ys, -, hys⟩ := exists_chart_regular_generators
    (hV.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏)) J hle
  have hD : IsAffineOpen (𝐏.basicOpen g) := hV.basicOpen g
  let Daff : 𝐏.affineOpens := 𝐏.affineBasicOpen (U := Vaff) g
  haveI hlocD := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  obtain ⟨hJS, hregS⟩ := hys (Submonoid.powers g) Γ(𝐏, 𝐏.basicOpen g)
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit g)
  have hxD : i z0 ∈ 𝐏.basicOpen g := by
    rw [Scheme.mem_basicOpen' (X := 𝐏) g x]
    exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (𝐏.presheaf.stalk (x : 𝐏))
      (hV.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal g).mpr hgp
  have hker : i.ker.ideal Daff =
      Ideal.ofList (ys.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) Γ(𝐏, 𝐏.basicOpen g))) := by
    have := i.ker.map_ideal_basicOpen Vaff g
    rw [← this, hJ]
    exact hJS
  refine ⟨Daff, hxD, ys.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) Γ(𝐏, 𝐏.basicOpen g)), hker, hregS, ?_⟩
  have hξD : i η ∈ 𝐏.basicOpen g := hηx.mem_open (𝐏.basicOpen g).isOpen hxD
  let gens := regularGeneratorsOfList (i.ker.ideal Daff) _ hker hregS
  have hl := length_eq_coheight k n i Daff hξD gens.toQuasiregular
  have hl' : ((ys.map (algebraMap Γ(𝐏, V) Γ(𝐏, 𝐏.basicOpen g))).length : ℕ∞) = coheight (i η) :=
    hl
  rw [← hl']
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productFst_smooth

    (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension m) H inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productStructure_smooth

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productCotangentMap_epi
statement: lemma productCotangentMap_epi : Epi (productCotangentMap f g p q H)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productCotangent_source_rank
statement:
lemma productCotangent_source_rank :
    HasConstantRank T
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf g) ⊞
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj (Cotangent.relativeSheaf f)) (n + m)
proof:
:=
  SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_biprod_E13
    (hasConstantRank_pullback T p _ n (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank g n))
    (hasConstantRank_pullback T q _ m (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank f m))

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productCotangent_target_rank
statement:
lemma productCotangent_target_rank :
    HasConstantRank T (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (p ≫ g)) (m + n)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productCotangentMap_isIso
statement: lemma productCotangentMap_isIso : IsIso (productCotangentMap f g p q H)
proof:
:= by
  letI := productCotangentMap_epi f g p q H
  exact TF1.isIso_of_epi_of_rank (productCotangent_source_rank f g p q n m)
    (by rw [Nat.add_comm]; exact productCotangent_target_rank f g p q H n m) _

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.productCotangent_class
statement:
theorem productCotangent_class :
    k0ClassOf T (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (p ≫ g))
        (productCotangent_target_rank f g p q H n m).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      pullbackK0RingHom p (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf g)
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree g n)) +
      pullbackK0RingHom q (k0ClassOf Z (Cotangent.relativeSheaf f)
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree f m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact (k0ClassOf_iso T (productCotangent_source_rank f g p q n m).isFiniteLocallyFree
    (productCotangent_target_rank f g p q H n m).isFiniteLocallyFree
    (productCotangentIso f g p q H n m)).symm.trans
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.k0ClassOf_biprod _ _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.projectiveProductStructure_smooth
statement:
lemma projectiveProductStructure_smooth :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension (m + n) (projectiveProductStructure R n m)
proof:
:=
  productStructure_smooth (toSpec R m) (toSpec R n)
    (pullback.fst (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m)) (pullback.snd (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m))
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m)).flip n m

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.projectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree
statement:
lemma projectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (projectiveProduct R n m)
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (projectiveProductStructure R n m))
proof:
:= by

  exact Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (projectiveProductStructure R n m) (m + n)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.projectiveProductCotangent_class
statement:
theorem projectiveProductCotangent_class :
    k0ClassOf (projectiveProduct R n m) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (projectiveProductStructure R n m))
        (projectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree R n m) =
      pullbackK0RingHom (pullback.fst (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m))
        (k0ClassOf (space R n) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R n) n)) +
      pullbackK0RingHom (pullback.snd (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m))
        (k0ClassOf (space R m) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R m))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R m) m))
proof:
:=
  productCotangent_class (toSpec R m) (toSpec R n)
    (pullback.fst (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m)) (pullback.snd (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m))
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m)).flip n m

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.baseChangedProjectiveProduct_smooth
statement: lemma baseChangedProjectiveProduct_smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (m + n) p
proof:
:= by
  letI := projectiveProductStructure_smooth R n m
  letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange (m + n)
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
    (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension (m + n)) H inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree
statement:
lemma baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree T (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
proof:
:= by
  letI := baseChangedProjectiveProduct_smooth R n m g p q H
  exact Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree p (m + n)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectiveProductCotangentH2.baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_class
statement:
theorem baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_class :
    k0ClassOf T (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
        (baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree R n m g p q H) =
      pullbackK0RingHom (q ≫ pullback.fst (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m))
        (k0ClassOf (space R n) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R n) n)) +
      pullbackK0RingHom (q ≫ pullback.snd (toSpec R n) (toSpec R m))
        (k0ClassOf (space R m) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R m))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R m) m))
proof:
:= by
  have hbc : k0ClassOf T (Cotangent.relativeSheaf p)
      (baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree R n m g p q H) =
    pullbackK0RingHom q (k0ClassOf (projectiveProduct R n m)
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (projectiveProductStructure R n m))
        (projectiveProductCotangent_finiteLocallyFree R n m)) := by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact (k0ClassOf_iso T _ _ (baseChangedProjectiveProductCotangentIso R n m g p q H)).symm
  rw [hbc, projectiveProductCotangent_class, map_add]
  simp only [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.Esec_eq
statement: theorem Esec_eq (W : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, W)) : Esec πP W a = (EDer πP).d (X := op W) a
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.Esec_add
statement:
theorem Esec_add (W : P.Opens) (a b : Γ(P, W)) :
    Esec πP W (a + b) = Esec πP W a + Esec πP W b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Esec_eq, Esec_eq, Esec_eq]
  exact map_add (EDer πP).d a b

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.Esec_zero
statement: theorem Esec_zero (W : P.Opens) : Esec πP W (0 : Γ(P, W)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Esec_eq]
  exact map_zero (EDer πP).d

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.Esec_mul
statement:
theorem Esec_mul (W : P.Opens) (a b : Γ(P, W)) :
    Esec πP W (a * b) = a • Esec πP W b + b • Esec πP W a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Esec_eq, Esec_eq, Esec_eq]
  exact (EDer πP).d_mul a b

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.Esec_res
statement:
theorem Esec_res {V V' : P.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    (relativeSheaf πP).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (Esec πP V a) =
      Esec πP V' (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Esec_eq, Esec_eq]
  exact ((EDer πP).d_map (homOfLE h).op a).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.theta_mul
statement:
theorem theta_mul (h' : relativeSheaf πP ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj N) (V : P.Opens)
    (a b : Γ(P, V)) :
    theta i N h' V (a * b) = (i.app V a) • theta i N h' V b + (i.app V b) • theta i N h' V a
proof:
:= by
  show h'.app V (Esec πP V (a * b)) = _
  rw [Esec_mul]
  refine ((h'.app V).hom.map_add _ _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul h' a _)
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul h' b _)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.theta_res
statement:
theorem theta_res (h' : relativeSheaf πP ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj N)
    {V V' : P.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    resN N (show i ⁻¹ᵁ V' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V from fun _ hx => h hx) (theta i N h' V a) =
      theta i N h' V' (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a)
proof:
:= by
  have := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply h'.val (homOfLE h).op (Esec πP V a)
  have e := congrArg (fun z => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (h'.val.app (op V')) z) (Esec_res πP h a)
  exact this.symm.trans e |>.symm.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.Esec_base
statement:
theorem Esec_base {V : S.Opens} {U : P.Opens} (h : U ≤ πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) (b : Γ(S, V)) :
    Esec πP U (πP.appLE V U h b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Esec_eq]
  exact (EDer πP).d_app (X := op U) (⟨πP.appLE V U h b, appLE_mem_baseSubring πP h b⟩ :
    (basePresheaf πP).obj (op U))

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.extD_base
statement:
theorem extD_base (h' : relativeSheaf πP ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj N)
    (hker : ∀ (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)), i.app V a = 0 → theta i N h' V a = 0)
    (W : X.Opens) (c : Γ(X, W)) (hc : c ∈ baseSubring (i ≫ πP) W) :
    extD (localDer i N h' hker) W c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hone : extD (localDer i N h' hker) W 1 = 0 := by
    have := extD_mul (localDer i N h' hker) W 1 1
    rw [mul_one, one_smul] at this
    exact left_eq_add.mp this
  induction hc using Subring.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨V, hV, b, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hV' : W ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) := hV
    have e : (i ≫ πP).appLE V W hV b =
        (i.appLE (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) W hV').hom (πP.appLE V (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl b) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE i πP V (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) W le_rfl hV']
      rfl
    rw [e, appLE_apply_eq_resX, ← extD_res, extD_lift]
    have h0 : theta i N h' (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) (πP.appLE V (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl b) = 0 := by
      show h'.app _ (Esec πP _ (πP.appLE V (πP ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl b)) = 0
      rw [Esec_base]
      exact map_zero (h'.app _).hom
    exact (congrArg (resN N hV') h0).trans (map_zero _)
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | one => exact hone
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, hx, neg_zero]
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [extD_mul, hx, hy, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.descG_Esec
statement:
theorem descG_Esec (h' : relativeSheaf πP ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj N)
    (hker : ∀ (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)), i.app V a = 0 → theta i N h' V a = 0)
    (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
    (descG i N h' hker).app W (Esec (i ≫ πP) W s) = extD (localDer i N h' hker) W s
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf (i ≫ πP)) ≫
      (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (descG i N h' hker) =
      (PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.isUniversal' (baseMap (i ≫ πP))).desc
        (derivN i N h' hker) :=
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv_unit (f := descG i N h' hker)).symm.trans
      (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)
  have e2 := congrArg (fun d => d.d (X := op W) s)
    ((PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.isUniversal' (baseMap (i ≫ πP))).fac
      (derivN i N h' hker))
  have e3 := congrArg (fun φ => (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.app (op W)))
    (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := (baseMap (i ≫ πP)).app (op W)) s)) e1
  exact e3.trans e2

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.hom_ext_Esec
statement:
theorem hom_ext_Esec {M : P.Modules} (f g : relativeSheaf πP ⟶ M)
    (H : ∀ (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)), f.app V (Esec πP V a) = g.app V (Esec πP V a)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).homEquiv _ _).injective ?_
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply, Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext
  intro b
  exact H W.unop b

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.cmp1_Esec
statement:
theorem cmp1_Esec (w : (i ≫ πP) ≫ 𝟙 S = i ≫ πP) (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    (cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i w).val.app (op V) (Esec πP V a) =
      Esec (i ≫ πP) (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V a)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := cmp0_d πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i w (W := op V) a
  have h5 : ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i w).val.app (op V))
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).unit.app (relativePresheaf πP)).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i w).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) :=
    congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.app (op V)) (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a))
      (unit_cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i w)
  show ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i w).val.app (op V))
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).unit.app (relativePresheaf πP)).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) = _
  rw [h5, h3]; rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.psi_desc
statement:
theorem psi_desc (h : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (relativeSheaf πP) ⟶ N)
    (hker : ∀ (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)), i.app V a = 0 →
      theta i N ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h) V a = 0) :
    psi πP (i ≫ πP) i rfl ≫
      descG i N ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h) hker = h
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _).injective ?_
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_comp]
  have hu : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (relativeSheaf πP) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (psi πP (i ≫ πP) i rfl) = cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i (by simp) :=
    unit_cmp πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i (by simp)
  refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun φ => φ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map
      (descG i N ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h) hker)) hu)).trans ?_
  apply hom_ext_Esec
  intro V a
  show (descG i N ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h) hker).app
      (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) (i ≫ πP) i (by simp)).val.app (op V) (Esec πP V a)) =
    theta i N ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h) V a
  rw [cmp1_Esec, descG_Esec, extD_lift]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.exact_of_gen
statement:
theorem exact_of_gen {Nv : X.Modules} (πX : X ⟶ S) (hi : i ≫ πP = πX)
    (c : Nv ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (relativeSheaf πP))
    (hz : c ≫ psi πP πX i hi = 0)
    (hgen : ∀ (M : X.Modules) (h : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (relativeSheaf πP) ⟶ M),
      c ≫ h = 0 → ∀ (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)), i.app V a = 0 →
        theta i M ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h) V a = 0) :
    (ShortComplex.mk c (psi πP πX i hi) hz).Exact
proof:
:= by
  subst hi
  refine ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ ?_
  refine CokernelCofork.IsColimit.ofπ _ _
    (fun {M} h hh => descG i M ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _ h)
      (hgen M h hh)) ?_ ?_
  · intro M h hh
    exact psi_desc i M h (hgen M h hh)
  · intro M h hh m hm
    have e := psi_desc i M h (hgen M h hh)
    exact (cancel_epi (psi πP (i ≫ πP) i rfl)).1 (hm.trans e.symm)

name: GRRKG4.res_eq
statement:
theorem res_eq {Z : Scheme.{u}} (R₁ R₂ : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Z) :
    R₁.res = R₂.res
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun g => ?_
  have h1 : k0ToG0 Z (R₂.res g) = g := DFunLike.congr_fun R₂.right g
  have h2 : R₁.res (k0ToG0 Z (R₂.res g)) = R₂.res g := DFunLike.congr_fun R₁.left (R₂.res g)
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact h2

name: GRRKG4.finitePushforward_iso
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_iso (hi : e.hom ≫ ι = i) (x : K0 X) :
    finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x) =
      finitePushforward ι (k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0RingHom e.inv x))
proof:
:= by
  subst hi
  rw [finitePushforward_comp e.hom ι, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
  congr 1
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv e.symm)
    (k0ToG0 X x)).symm

name: GRRKG4.pushLocF3_iso
statement:
theorem pushLocF3_iso (j : ℕ) (res : G0 P →+ K0 P) (hi : e.hom ≫ ι = i) :
    pushLocF3 j i res = (pushLocF3 j ι res).comp (pullLocF3 j e.inv).toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  apply loc_addHom_ext
  intro a
  show pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a) =
    pushLocF3 j ι res (pullLocF3 j e.inv (algebraMap _ _ a))
  rw [pullLocF3_alg]
  unfold pushLocF3
  rw [locAddHom_algebraMap, locAddHom_algebraMap]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [finitePushforward_iso e ι i hi]

name: GRRKG4.pullLocF3_eq
statement:
theorem pullLocF3_eq {S T : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ T) (j : ℕ) :
    pullLocF3 j i = locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom i)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 T))
  ext a
  simp [pullLocF3_alg, locMap_algebraMap]

name: GRRKG4.hψnat'
statement:
theorem hψnat' {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian T] (f : S ⟶ T)
    (hrS : ConstantRankGenerators S) (hrT : ConstantRankGenerators T) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    (pullbackK0RingHom f).comp (adamsRingHom hrT j) =
      (adamsRingHom hrS j).comp (pullbackK0RingHom f)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun x => adamsRingHom_pullbackK0 f hrS hrT hj x

name: GRRKG4.iZ_phiX
statement: theorem iZ_phiX (x : X) : ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker ((phiX i).hom x) = i x

name: GRRKG4.range_ker
statement: theorem range_ker : Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) = Set.range i
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.surjective (phiX i).hom z
    exact ⟨x, (iZ_phiX i x).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(phiX i).hom x, iZ_phiX i x⟩

name: GRRKG4.codim_pos_of_ne
statement:
theorem codim_pos_of_ne [IsIntegral X] (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range i) :
    0 < ARRKG2A.codim i.ker
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  rw [← range_ker i] at hy
  set c := ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker (genericPoint i.ker.subscheme) with hc
  have hcne : c ≠ genericPoint A := by
    intro h
    apply hy
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker)) :=
      (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hmem : genericPoint A ∈ Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) := ⟨_, h⟩
    have hsp : y ∈ closure ({genericPoint A} : Set A) := by
      rw [(genericPoint_spec A).def]; trivial
    exact closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem) hcl hsp
  have hle : c ≤ genericPoint A :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec A).specializes trivial)
  have hlt : c < genericPoint A := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge => hcne
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Order.coheight c :=
    le_trans le_add_self (Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt)
  have hfin : Order.coheight c ≠ ⊤ := by
    obtain ⟨-, N, jA, hjA, -⟩ := hA
    haveI := hjA
    have h := ARRASM.ringKrullDim_stalk_le jA c
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at h
    intro htop
    rw [htop] at h
    have h2 : ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        (((N + M1.FiniteDimBase.d k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := h
    exact ENat.coe_ne_top _ (top_le_iff.mp (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h2))
  unfold ARRKG2A.codim
  rw [← hc]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hfin
  rw [← hm] at h1 ⊢
  have : 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast h1
  simp only [ENat.toNat_coe]
  omega

name: GRRKG4.conormalClass_phiX
statement:
theorem conormalClass_phiX {r r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r)
    (hNr : HasConstantRank i.ker.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal i.ker) r') :
    pullbackK0RingHom (phiX i).inv N.conormalClass =
      k0ClassOf i.ker.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal i.ker) hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : N.conormalClass = pullbackK0RingHom (phiX i).hom
      (k0ClassOf i.ker.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal i.ker) hNr.isFiniteLocallyFree) :=
    (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf (phiX i).hom _ _).symm
  rw [h1, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pullbackK0RingHom_id]
  rfl

name: GRRKG4.pullLoc_bott
statement:
theorem pullLoc_bott (j : ℕ) (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X)
    (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent i.ker.subscheme) {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r)
    (c : K0 i.ker.subscheme) (hc : pullbackK0RingHom (phiX i).inv N.conormalClass = c) :
    pullLocF3 j (phiX i).inv
        ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.bott j i.ker.subscheme (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _) hnilZ
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd c) : (KLoc j i.ker.subscheme)ˣ) : KLoc j i.ker.subscheme)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullLocF3_eq, ← hc]
  exact bott_pullbackK0 (j := j) (phiX i).inv (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _)
    hnilZ (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX _

name: GRRKG4.closedImmersion_field
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_field (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A)
    (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) (hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X)
    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range i) (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X)
    {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j A)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral A) j
          ((KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j i (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
            (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X))
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_ker_subscheme i hX
  have hne' : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) := by
    rw [range_ker]; exact hne
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_total i.ker hA
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W i.ker hA
  have hd := codim_pos_of_ne i hA hne
  have h := ARRKG2A.arr_caseII_ambient i.ker hA hAreg hZ (phiK (A := A)) hd hne' hj
    (algebraMap _ _ (pullbackK0RingHom (phiX i).inv x))
  have e1 : ∀ z : K0 i.ker.subscheme,
      pushLocF3 j (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (algebraMap _ (KLoc j i.ker.subscheme) z) =
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j A) ((KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (finitePushforward
        (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme z))) := by
    intro z
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    rfl
  rw [e1, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, mul_comm] at h
  rw [finitePushforward_iso (phiX i) (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) i (phiX_comp i) x]
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (pushLocF3_iso (phiX i) (ARRKG2A.iZ A i.ker) i j
    (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res (phiX_comp i)), AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  show _ = pullLocF3 j (phiX i).inv _
  rw [map_mul, pullLocF3_alg]
  have hcl := conormalClass_phiX i N (ConormalSheaf.conormal_hasConstantRank i.ker
    (KG2B.coverJ i.ker hAreg hZ))
  have hbot := pullLoc_bott i j hnilX (ARRKG2A.hnilZ' (ARRKG2A.inputsOfKG2B i.ker hA hAreg hZ)) N _
    hcl
  rw [hbot]
  unfold ARRKG2A.thetaZ
  congr 2
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (hψnat' (phiX i).inv (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _)
    (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hj) x).symm

name: GRRKG4.lambdaNilpotent_X
statement:
theorem lambdaNilpotent_X (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (i : X ⟶ (PY k Y n)) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    LambdaNilpotent X
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  have hA := T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n
  exact AR11.lambdaNilpotent_of_projEmb (AR11.ProjEmb.of_closedImmersion i (KG2B.projEmb_A hA))

name: GRRKG4.lambdaNilpotent_P
statement: theorem lambdaNilpotent_P (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n)
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have hA := T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n
  exact AR11.lambdaNilpotent_of_projEmb (KG2B.projEmb_A hA)

name: GRRKG4.adamsRR_generalBase_of_data
statement:
theorem adamsRR_generalBase_of_data (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (hX : RegStalks X) (hne : ∃ y : ↥(PY k Y n), y ∉ Set.range i) (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X)
    {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hnilX
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have hA := T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n
  have hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (PY k Y n) := prod_regStalks hreg n
  have hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (PY k Y n) := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _
  have hrankX : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hrankY : ConstantRankGenerators Y := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n) := lambdaNilpotent_P n hY
  let resY := resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg
  let resP := resProd hY hreg n
  have hres : (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res = resP.res := res_eq _ _
  
  have hII : ∀ x : K0 X,
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (PY k Y n))
          (adamsRingHom hrankP j (resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
        pushLocF3 j i resP.res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankX j x) *
            ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)) := by
    intro x
    have h := closedImmersion_field i hA hAreg hX hne hnilX N (j := j) (by omega) x
    rw [hres] at h
    exact h
  
  have hI := adamsRR_caseI_prod_lib (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY j hj hrankP hrankY hnilP
  
  have hu : Units.map (pullLocF3 j i).toMonoidHom
      (SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n))) =
      SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n))) :=
    Units.ext (by
      rw [Units.coe_map, bott_pull j i (pullbackK0RingHom i) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i)
        (pullLocF3 j i) (pullLocF3_alg j i) hrankX hnilX hrankP hnilP]
      rfl)
  have htw : (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
          N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd N.conormalClass) :
          (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) *
        pullLocF3 j i (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j (PY k Y n))ˣ) :
            KLoc j (PY k Y n)) := by
    rw [ofAdd_sub, map_div, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Units.val_mul, ← hu, ← map_inv,
      Units.coe_map]
    rfl
  let iG : K0 X →+ K0 (PY k Y n) := resP.res.comp ((finitePushforward i).comp (k0ToG0 X))
  let πG : K0 (PY k Y n) →+ K0 Y := piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY
  have hcomp : πG (iG x) = fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x := by
    have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun resP.right (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at hr
    simp only [πG, iG, piK0, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
    rfl
  rw [← hcomp, htw]
  exact GRRKG1.twisted_comp iG πG
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankX j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankP j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (adamsRingHom hrankY j).toAddMonoidHom)
    (pushLocF3 j i resP.res) (locAddHom j πG) (pullLocF3 j i) _ _
    (projFormulaLoc j i resP.res resP.left resP.right) hII hI x

name: GRRKG4.adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_generalBase (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (hX : RegStalks X) (hne : ∃ y : ↥(PY k Y n), y ∉ Set.range i) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hreg n i hX).some.conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRR_generalBase_of_data n i hY hreg hX hne (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
    (conormalDataOfRegular_prod hY hreg n i hX).some hj x

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.i_app_ιapp
statement:
theorem i_app_ιapp (V : P.Opens) (s : Γ(idealOf i, V)) :
    i.app V (ιapp i V s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  open SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf in
  have h0 : (structureMap i.ker).app V (ιapp i V s) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.app V s) (kernel.condition (structureMap i.ker))
    exact this
  have h1 : i.ker.subschemeι.app V (ιapp i V s) = 0 := h0
  have h2 := Scheme.Hom.congr_app i.toImage_imageι.symm V
  rw [h2, Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  have h4 : (i.imageι.app V).hom (ιapp i V s) = 0 := h1
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp)).op).hom z) ?_).trans (map_zero _)
  change (i.toImage.app (i.imageι ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom ((i.imageι.app V).hom (ιapp i V s)) = 0
  rw [h4, map_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.Esec_add
statement:
theorem Esec_add (W : Q.Opens) (a b : Γ(Q, W)) :
    Esec π W (a + b) = Esec π W a + Esec π W b
proof:
:= by
  unfold Esec
  have h := ModuleCat.Derivation.d_add (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap π).app (op W))) a b
  refine (congrArg _ h).trans ?_
  exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_add _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.Esec_mul
statement:
theorem Esec_mul (W : Q.Opens) (a b : Γ(Q, W)) :
    Esec π W (a * b) = a • Esec π W b + b • Esec π W a
proof:
:= by
  unfold Esec
  have h := ModuleCat.Derivation.d_mul (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.D ((baseMap π).app (op W))) a b
  refine (congrArg _ h).trans ?_
  refine ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_add _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_)
  · exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _
  · exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.Esec_zero
statement: theorem Esec_zero (W : Q.Opens) : Esec π W 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Esec_add Q π W 0 0
  rw [add_zero] at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => z - Esec π W 0) h
  simpa using h'.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.ιapp_add
statement:
theorem ιapp_add (V : P.Opens) (a b : Γ(idealOf i, V)) :
    ιapp i V (a + b) = ιapp i V a + ιapp i V b
proof: := map_add _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.dFun_add
statement:
theorem dFun_add (V : P.Opens) (a b : Γ(idealOf i, V)) :
    dFun πP i V (a + b) = dFun πP i V a + dFun πP i V b
proof:
:= by
  unfold dFun
  rw [ιapp_add, Esec_add]
  exact map_add _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.Gi_smul
statement:
theorem Gi_smul (V : P.Opens) (r : Γ(P, V)) (m : Γ(Gi πP i, V)) :
    r • m = (i.app V).hom r • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (relativeSheaf πP), i ⁻¹ᵁ V) from m)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.ιapp_smul
statement:
theorem ιapp_smul (V : P.Opens) (r : Γ(P, V)) (s : Γ(idealOf i, V)) :
    ιapp i V (r • s) = r * ιapp i V s
proof:
:= by
  unfold ιapp
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  exact smul_eq_mul _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.dFun_smul
statement:
theorem dFun_smul (V : P.Opens) (r : Γ(P, V)) (s : Γ(idealOf i, V)) :
    dFun πP i V (r • s) = r • dFun πP i V s
proof:
:= by
  unfold dFun
  rw [ιapp_smul, Esec_mul]
  refine (map_add _ _ _).trans ?_
  have h : (unitΩ πP i).app V (ιapp i V s • Esec πP V r) = 0 := by
    refine (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul (unitΩ πP i) (ιapp i V s) (Esec πP V r)).trans ?_
    rw [Gi_smul, i_app_ιapp]
    exact zero_smul Γ(X, i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (_ : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (relativeSheaf πP), i ⁻¹ᵁ V))
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul (unitΩ πP i) r (Esec πP V (ιapp i V s))) h).trans
    (add_zero _)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.dFun_map
statement:
theorem dFun_map {V₁ V₂ : P.Opens} (h : V₂ ≤ V₁) (s : Γ(idealOf i, V₁)) :
    dFun πP i V₂ ((idealOf i).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
      (Gi πP i).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (dFun πP i V₁ s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dFun
  have e1 : ιapp i V₂ ((idealOf i).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
      P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (ιapp i V₁ s) :=
    congrArg (fun φ => φ s) (congr_arg (fun f => ConcreteCategory.hom f)
      ((SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι i.ker).mapPresheaf.naturality
        (homOfLE h).op))
  rw [e1]
  have e2 := Esec_map πP h (ιapp i V₁ s)
  have e3 := congrArg (fun φ => φ (Esec πP V₁ (ιapp i V₁ s))) (congr_arg (fun f => ConcreteCategory.hom f)
      ((unitΩ πP i).mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h).op))
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg ((unitΩ πP i).app V₂) e2) ?_
  exact e3

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.dI_app
statement:
theorem dI_app (V : P.Opens) (s : Γ(idealOf i, V)) :
    (dI πP i).app V s =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (relativeSheaf πP)).app V
        (Esec πP V (ιapp i V s))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.unit_comp_pushforward_c
statement:
theorem unit_comp_pushforward_c :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (idealOf i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((conormalIso i).inv ≫ c πP i) = dI πP i
proof:
:= by
  unfold c
  rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv_unit
    (f := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _).symm (dI πP i))).symm.trans
    (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.cmp1_Esec
statement:
theorem cmp1_Esec (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])).val.app (op V)) (Esec πP V a) =
      Esec πX (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V a)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := cmp0_d πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi]) (W := op V) a
  have h5 : ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])).val.app (op V))
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).unit.app (relativePresheaf πP)).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) :=
    congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.app (op V)) (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a))
      (unit_cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi]))
  exact h5.trans (h3.trans rfl)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.dI_comp_psi
statement:
theorem dI_comp_psi :
    dI πP i ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (psi πP πX i hi) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext V s
  have e1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.val.app (op V) (Esec πP V (ιapp i V s)))
    (unit_cmp πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi]))
  have e2 := cmp1_Esec πP i πX hi V (ιapp i V s)
  have e3 : Esec πX (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V (ιapp i V s)) = 0 := by
    rw [i_app_ιapp]; exact Esec_zero X πX _
  exact e1.trans (e2.trans e3)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF3.c_comp_psi
statement: theorem c_comp_psi : c πP i ≫ psi πP πX i hi = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold c
  rw [Category.assoc]
  have : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _).symm (dI πP i) ≫
      psi πP πX i hi = 0 := by
    rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm, dI_comp_psi πP i πX hi]
    simp
  rw [this]; simp
