name: KG5.generic_not_mem_range
statement: theorem generic_not_mem_range : genericPoint (space ℚ 1) ∉ Set.range (iZ ℚ 1 J)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hmem : genericPoint (space ℚ 1) ∈ (chart ℚ 1).opensRange := by
    show genericPoint (space ℚ 1) ∈ (((chart ℚ 1).opensRange : TopologicalSpace.Opens _) : Set _)
    rw [(genericPoint_spec (space ℚ 1)).mem_open_set_iff (chart ℚ 1).opensRange.isOpen]
    exact ⟨chart ℚ 1 (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℚ[X]))),
      ⟨trivial, Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  let e : Zs ℚ 1 J ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℚ) := (asIso pt.toImage).symm
  have hz' : ∀ y, iZ ℚ 1 J (pt.toImage y) = pt y := fun y => by
    have := Scheme.Hom.comp_apply pt.toImage pt.imageι y
    rw [Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hez : pt.toImage (e.hom z) = z := by
    have h : (e.hom ≫ pt.toImage) = 𝟙 _ := Iso.inv_hom_id (asIso pt.toImage)
    calc pt.toImage (e.hom z) = (e.hom ≫ pt.toImage) z := (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
      _ = z := by rw [h]; rfl
  have hin := pointInf_not_mem ℚ (e.hom z)
  rw [chartOpen_val] at hin
  have hpt : pt (e.hom z) = genericPoint (space ℚ 1) := by
    rw [← hz', hez]; exact hz
  rw [← hpt] at hmem
  exact hin hmem

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.shortExact_HMap_zero_injective
statement:
theorem shortExact_HMap_zero_injective
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    Function.Injective
      (Sheaf.H.map ((Modules.toSheafAb X).map S.f) 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hzero :
      Sheaf.H.map ((Modules.toSheafAb X).map S.f) 0 (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  have hcomp : Ext.addEquiv₀ (x - y) ≫
      (S.map (Modules.toSheafAb X)).f = 0 := by
    have hzero' :
        Sheaf.H.map (S.map (Modules.toSheafAb X)).f 0 (x - y) = 0 :=
      hzero
    have e := Sheaf.H.addEquiv₀_map ((S.map (Modules.toSheafAb X)).f) (x - y)
    rw [hzero', map_zero] at e
    exact e.symm
  have hmono : Mono ((S.map (Modules.toSheafAb X)).f) :=
    (shortExact_map_toSheaf hS).mono_f
  have hext : Ext.addEquiv₀ (x - y) = 0 :=
    hmono.right_cancellation (Ext.addEquiv₀ (x - y)) 0
      (hcomp.trans (Limits.zero_comp).symm)
  have hsub : x - y = 0 :=
    (map_eq_zero_iff _ Ext.addEquiv₀.injective).mp hext
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalLongExactPresheaf_left_mono

name: ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.projLoc_of_projection
statement:
theorem projLoc_of_projection (j : ℕ) (push : A →+ B) (φ : B →+* A)
    (hproj : ∀ y x, push (φ y * x) = y * push x)
    (φL : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : B) →+* Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : A))
    (hφL : ∀ b, φL (algebraMap _ _ b) = algebraMap _ _ (φ b))
    (y : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : B)) (x : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : A)) :
    locAddHom j push (φL y * x) = y * locAddHom j push x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ (y₀ : B) (x : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : A)),
      locAddHom j push (φL (algebraMap _ _ y₀) * x) =
        algebraMap _ _ y₀ * locAddHom j push x := by
    intro y₀
    have key := loc_addHom_ext j
      ((locAddHom j push).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (φL (algebraMap _ _ y₀))))
      ((AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : B)) y₀)).comp
        (locAddHom j push))
      (fun x₀ => by
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft]
        rw [hφL, ← map_mul, locAddHom_algebraMap, locAddHom_algebraMap, hproj, map_mul])
    intro x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun key x
  have key := loc_addHom_ext j
    ((locAddHom j push).comp ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight x).comp φL.toAddMonoidHom))
    (AddMonoidHom.mulRight (locAddHom j push x))
    (fun y₀ => h1 y₀ x)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key y

name: ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.projLoc_of_projection_K0
statement:
theorem projLoc_of_projection_K0 {S T : Scheme.{u}} (j : ℕ) (push : K0 S →+ K0 T)
    (φ : K0 T →+* K0 S) (hproj : ∀ y x, push (φ y * x) = y * push x)
    (y : KLoc j T) (x : KLoc j S) :
    locAddHom j push (locMap (j := j) φ y * x) = y * locAddHom j push x
proof:
:=
  projLoc_of_projection j push φ hproj (locMap (j := j) φ) (fun b => locMap_algebraMap φ b) y x

name: ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush_congr
statement:
theorem liftPush_congr {d d' : ℕ}
    (hpd : ∀ V : S.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree S V →
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h d ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V))
    (hpd' : ∀ V : S.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree S V →
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h d' ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)) :
    liftPush ι h d hpd = liftPush ι h d' hpd'
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
  change liftPush ι h d hpd (k0ClassOf S V.1 V.2) = liftPush ι h d' hpd' (k0ClassOf S V.1 V.2)
  rw [liftPush_k0ClassOf, liftPush_k0ClassOf]

proof:

    finitePushforward ι (k0ToG0 S (k0ClassOf S V.1 V.2))

name: ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush_projection
statement:
theorem liftPush_projection (d : ℕ)
    (hpd : ∀ V : S.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree S V →
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h d ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)) (y : K0 T) (x : K0 S) :
    liftPush ι h d hpd (pullbackK0RingHom ι y * x) = y * liftPush ι h d hpd x
proof:
:= by
  let Lh : K0 T →+ (K0 S →+ K0 T) :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ (liftPush ι h d hpd).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (pullbackK0RingHom ι y))
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp [add_mul] }
  let Rh : K0 T →+ (K0 S →+ K0 T) :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft y).comp (liftPush ι h d hpd)
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp [add_mul] }
  have hLR : Lh = Rh := by
    refine @ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (K0 S →+ K0 T)
      (@AddMonoidHom.instAddCommGroup _ _ _ (instCommRingK0 T).toAddCommGroup) Lh Rh ?_
    rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
    refine @ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (K0 T) (instCommRingK0 T).toAddCommGroup _ _ ?_
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    change liftPush ι h d hpd (pullbackK0RingHom ι (k0ClassOf T E hE) * k0ClassOf S V hV) =
      k0ClassOf T E hE * liftPush ι h d hpd (k0ClassOf S V hV)
    have hEV : IsFiniteLocallyFree S (tensorSheaf S ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj E) V) :=
      tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree S _ V (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι E hE) hV
    have hmul : pullbackK0RingHom ι (k0ClassOf T E hE) * k0ClassOf S V hV =
        k0ClassOf S (tensorSheaf S ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj E) V) hEV := by
      rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
      exact k0ClassOf_mul S ⟨_, pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι E hE⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩
    rw [hmul, liftPush_k0ClassOf, liftPush_k0ClassOf]
    let e := projectionFormulaIso ι E hE V
    have hcoh : IsCoherentLike T ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V) :=
      (finitePushObject ι ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
    have hF' : IsCoherentLike T (tensorSheaf T E ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)) :=
      tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike T E _ hE hcoh
    have hd' : PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h d
        (tensorSheaf T E ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)) :=
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.pdLE_iso h e.symm (hpd _ hEV)
    rw [← RegularPushK0LCI.tensorRule h E hE _ hcoh (hpd V hV) hF' hd']
    exact PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_iso h e.symm _ _ _ _
  exact congrArg (fun g : K0 T →+ (K0 S →+ K0 T) ↦ g y x) hLR

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_natIso
statement:
lemma LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_natIso
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    {M : Type w} [AddMonoid M] [HasShift C M] [HasShift D M]
    {W₁ : MorphismProperty C} {W₂ : MorphismProperty D}
    [W₁.IsCompatibleWithShift M] [W₂.IsCompatibleWithShift M]
    (Phi Psi : LocalizerMorphism W₁ W₂)
    [Phi.functor.CommShift M] [Psi.functor.CommShift M]
    (e : Phi.functor ≅ Psi.functor) [NatTrans.CommShift e.hom M]
    {X Y : C} {X₂ Y₂ : D} {m : M}
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₁ M X Y]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ X₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ Y₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M Y₂ Y₂]
    (ePhiX : Phi.functor.obj X ≅ X₂) (ePhiY : Phi.functor.obj Y ≅ Y₂)
    (ePsiX : Psi.functor.obj X ≅ X₂) (ePsiY : Psi.functor.obj Y ≅ Y₂)
    (hX : ePhiX = e.app X ≪≫ ePsiX) (hY : ePhiY = e.app Y ≪≫ ePsiY)
    (f : SmallShiftedHom W₁ X Y m) :
    Phi.smallShiftedHomMap ePhiX ePhiY f =
      Psi.smallShiftedHomMap ePsiX ePsiY f
proof:
:= by
  apply (SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₂ W₂.Q).injective
  let G := Phi.localizedFunctor W₁.Q W₂.Q
  let cPhi := CatCommSq.iso Phi.functor W₁.Q W₂.Q G
  let cPsi : Psi.functor ⋙ W₂.Q ≅ W₁.Q ⋙ G :=
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight e.symm W₂.Q ≪≫ cPhi
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift cPhi.hom M := inferInstance
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift cPsi.hom M := by
    dsimp [cPsi]
    infer_instance
  rw [Phi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₂.Q ePhiX ePhiY G cPhi,
    Psi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₂.Q ePsiX ePsiY G cPsi]
  subst ePhiX
  subst ePhiY
  simp [cPsi, cPhi]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_trans
statement:
lemma LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_trans
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    {M : Type w} [AddMonoid M] [HasShift C M] [HasShift D M]
    {W₁ : MorphismProperty C} {W₂ : MorphismProperty D}
    [W₁.IsCompatibleWithShift M] [W₂.IsCompatibleWithShift M]
    (Phi : LocalizerMorphism W₁ W₂) [Phi.functor.CommShift M]
    {X Y : C} {X₂ Y₂ X₃ Y₃ : D} {m : M}
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₁ M X Y]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ X₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ Y₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M Y₂ Y₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₃ X₃]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₃ Y₃]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M Y₃ Y₃]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₃ X₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₃ Y₂]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M Y₂ Y₃]
    [HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom W₂ M X₂ Y₃]
    (eX : Phi.functor.obj X ≅ X₂) (eY : Phi.functor.obj Y ≅ Y₂)
    (dX : X₂ ≅ X₃) (dY : Y₂ ≅ Y₃)
    (f : SmallShiftedHom W₁ X Y m) :
    ((SmallShiftedHom.mk₀ W₂ 0 rfl dX.inv).comp
        (Phi.smallShiftedHomMap eX eY f) (add_zero m)).comp
          (SmallShiftedHom.mk₀ W₂ 0 rfl dY.hom) (zero_add m) =
      Phi.smallShiftedHomMap (eX ≪≫ dX) (eY ≪≫ dY) f
proof:
:= by
  apply (SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₂ W₂.Q).injective
  let G := Phi.localizedFunctor W₁.Q W₂.Q
  let c := CatCommSq.iso Phi.functor W₁.Q W₂.Q G
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift c.hom M := inferInstance
  rw [SmallShiftedHom.equiv_comp, SmallShiftedHom.equiv_comp,
    SmallShiftedHom.equiv_mk₀, SmallShiftedHom.equiv_mk₀,
    Phi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₂.Q eX eY G c,
    Phi.equiv_smallShiftedHomMap W₁.Q W₂.Q (eX ≪≫ dX) (eY ≪≫ dY) G c]
  rw [ShiftedHom.comp_assoc _ _ _ (add_zero m) (zero_add m) (by simp)]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using shiftedHom_framed
    (W₂.Q.map dX.inv)
    (W₂.Q.map eX.inv ≫ c.hom.app X)
    ((SmallShiftedHom.equiv W₁ W₁.Q f).map G)
    (c.inv.app Y ≫ W₂.Q.map eY.hom)
    (W₂.Q.map dY.hom)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor_natIso
statement:
lemma mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor_natIso
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    (F G : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (e : F ≅ G) (X : C) :
    (F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X ≪≫
        (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).mapIso (e.app X) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).app
          ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X) ≪≫
        (G.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp [Functor.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor]
    dsimp [CochainComplex.singleFunctor, CochainComplex.singleFunctors]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.single_map_f_self]
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    exact e.hom.naturality_assoc _ _
  · simp [Functor.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor, hi]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extSmallShiftedHomMap_natIso
statement:
lemma extSmallShiftedHomMap_natIso
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D]
    (F G : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (e : F ≅ G) {X Y : C} {n : ℕ}
    (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X Y n) :
    let Phi
proof:
:= F.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let Psi := G.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    Phi.smallShiftedHomMap
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X ≪≫
          (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).mapIso (e.app X))
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y ≪≫
          (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).mapIso (e.app Y)) x =
      Psi.smallShiftedHomMap
        ((G.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X)
        ((G.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y) x := by
  dsimp only
  let Phi := F.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
  let Psi := G.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
  let eC := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
  letI : NatTrans.CommShift eC.hom ℤ := by
    constructor
    intro a
    ext K i
    dsimp [eC]
    simp
  apply LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_natIso Phi Psi eC
  · exact mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor_natIso F G e X
  · exact mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor_natIso F G e Y

statement:
theorem CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_natIso
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D]

    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (e : F ≅ G) {X Y : C} {n : ℕ}
    (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X Y n) :
    ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (e.inv.app X)).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add n)).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (e.hom.app Y)) (add_zero n) =
      x.mapExactFunctor G
proof:
:= by
  letI : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso D (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj X))
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X)) :=
    (inferInstance : HasExt.{u} D) (G.obj X) (F.obj X)
  letI : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso D (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj X))
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y)) :=
    (inferInstance : HasExt.{u} D) (G.obj X) (F.obj Y)
  letI : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso D (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y))
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj Y)) :=
    (inferInstance : HasExt.{u} D) (F.obj Y) (G.obj Y)
  letI : HasSmallLocalizedShiftedHom
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso D (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X))
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj Y)) :=
    (inferInstance : HasExt.{u} D) (F.obj X) (G.obj Y)
  let Phi := F.mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
  let eFX : Phi.functor.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj X) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X) :=
    (F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app X
  let eFY : Phi.functor.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y) :=
    (F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app Y
  let dX : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj X) :=
    (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).mapIso (e.app X)
  let dY : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y) ≅
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj Y) :=
    (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).mapIso (e.app Y)
  exact (LocalizerMorphism.smallShiftedHomMap_trans
    (X₂ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj X))
    (Y₂ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj Y))
    (X₃ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj X))
    (Y₃ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor D 0).obj (G.obj Y)) Phi
    eFX eFY dX dY x).trans (extSmallShiftedHomMap_natIso F G e x)

name: IsLocalization.Away.of_pow
statement:
theorem of_pow {A S : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (r : A) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) [IsLocalization.Away (r ^ m) S] :
    IsLocalization.Away r S
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.Away.mk r
  · exact isUnit_of_dvd_unit
      (map_dvd (algebraMap A S) (dvd_pow_self r hm))
      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (r ^ m))
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨q, a, ha⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (r ^ m) s
    refine ⟨m * q, a, ?_⟩
    simpa only [map_pow, pow_mul] using ha
  · intro a b h
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.exists_of_eq (r ^ m) h
    refine ⟨m * q, ?_⟩
    simpa only [pow_mul] using hq

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationElem
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationElem
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)
        (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k)
proof:
:=
      (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i))
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) := by
  let hmul : coordinateTripleEquation R n i j k =
      coordinateOverlapEquation R n j k * coordinate R n i := by
    simp only [coordinateTripleEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation]
    ring
  have hmap : coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k =
      HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) hmul := by
    rfl
  rw [hmap]
  exact HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalization_mul
    (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) hmul (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_localizationElem_associated_coordinateRatio_sq
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_localizationElem_associated_coordinateRatio_sq
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Associated
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩) ^ 2)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i))
proof:
:= by
  let u : (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)ˣ :=
    (coordinateOverlapRatioUnit R n j k)⁻¹
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  change coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩) ^ 2 *
      coordinateOverlapRatioInv R n j k =
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [coordinateChartToOverlapLeft, coordinateRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    coordinateOverlapRatioInv, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem,
    Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one,
    SubmonoidClass.coe_pow]
  simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationAway
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationAway
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    letI : Algebra (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)
        (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k)
proof:
:=
      (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) := by
  letI : Algebra (CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k)
      (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL R n i j k).toAlgebra
  let r := coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
    (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩)
  let q := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
    (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n j k)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)
  letI : IsLocalization.Away q (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_isLocalizationElem R n i j k
  letI : IsLocalization.Away (r ^ 2) (CoordinateTripleRing R n i j k) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.of_associated
      (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_localizationElem_associated_coordinateRatio_sq
        R n i j k hij).symm
  exact IsLocalization.Away.of_pow r 2 (by omega)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.resN_trans
statement:
theorem resN_trans (N : X.Modules) {W W' W'' : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ W') (h' : W' ≤ W'')
    (x : Γ(N, W'')) : resN N h (resN N h' x) = resN N (h.trans h') x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resN]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← N.presheaf.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.resX_trans
statement:
theorem resX_trans {W W' W'' : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ W') (h' : W' ≤ W'')
    (x : Γ(X, W'')) : resX h (resX h' x) = resX (h.trans h') x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resX]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.resN_smul
statement:
theorem resN_smul (N : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ W') (r : Γ(X, W')) (x : Γ(N, W')) :
    resN N h (r • x) = resX h r • resN N h x
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.map_smul N (homOfLE h) r x

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.exists_open_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem exists_open_preimage_eq [IsClosedImmersion i] (W' : X.Opens) :
    ∃ V'' : P.Opens, i ⁻¹ᵁ V'' = W'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, e⟩ := i.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1 W'.2
  exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, Opens.ext e⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.appLE_apply_eq_resX
statement:
theorem appLE_apply_eq_resX {V : P.Opens} {W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    (i.appLE V W h).hom a = resX h (i.app V a)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.app_res
statement:
theorem app_res {V V' : P.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    i.app V' (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a) =
      resX (show i ⁻¹ᵁ V' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V from fun _ hx => h hx) (i.app V a)
proof:
:= by
  have := Scheme.Hom.naturality i (homOfLE h).op
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom this a

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.wd0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V'', hV''⟩ := exists_open_preimage_eq (i := i) W'
  set V3 : P.Opens := V'' ⊓ V with hV3
  have heq : i ⁻¹ᵁ V3 = W' := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      rw [← hV'']
      exact hx.1
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨by rw [← hV''] at hx; exact hx, h hx⟩
  have hle : V3 ≤ V := inf_le_right
  have hle' : i ⁻¹ᵁ V3 ≤ W' := heq.le
  have hge : W' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V3 := heq.ge
  have h0 : i.app V3 (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op a) = 0 := by
    rw [app_res hle a]
    have : resX (show i ⁻¹ᵁ V3 ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V from fun _ hx => hle hx) = (resX hle').comp (resX h) := by
      ext x; exact (resX_trans hle' h x).symm
    rw [this]
    simp [ha]
  have h1 := D.ker V3 _ h0
  rw [← D.res hle a] at h1
  have : resN N h (D.θ V a) = resN N hge (resN N (show i ⁻¹ᵁ V3 ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V from fun _ hx => hle hx) (D.θ V a)) := by
    rw [resN_trans]
  rw [this, h1, map_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.wd
statement:
theorem wd [IsClosedImmersion i] (D : LocalDer i N) {V1 V2 : P.Opens} {W' : X.Opens}
    (h1 : W' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V1) (h2 : W' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V2) (a1 : Γ(P, V1)) (a2 : Γ(P, V2))
    (e : resX h1 (i.app V1 a1) = resX h2 (i.app V2 a2)) :
    resN N h1 (D.θ V1 a1) = resN N h2 (D.θ V2 a2)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : W' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (V1 ⊓ V2) := fun _ hx => ⟨h1 hx, h2 hx⟩
  set b1 := P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V1 ⊓ V2 ≤ V1)).op a1 with hb1
  set b2 := P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V1 ⊓ V2 ≤ V2)).op a2 with hb2
  have A1 : resN N h1 (D.θ V1 a1) = resN N hW (D.θ (V1 ⊓ V2) b1) := by
    rw [← D.res inf_le_left a1, resN_trans]
  have A2 : resN N h2 (D.θ V2 a2) = resN N hW (D.θ (V1 ⊓ V2) b2) := by
    rw [← D.res inf_le_right a2, resN_trans]
  rw [A1, A2, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← map_sub]
  apply wd0 D hW
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, hb1, hb2, app_res, app_res, resX_trans, resX_trans, e, sub_self]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.unique
statement:
theorem IsVal.unique [IsClosedImmersion i] {D : LocalDer i N} {W : X.Opens} {s : Γ(X, W)}
    {t t' : Γ(N, W)} (h : IsVal D W s t) (h' : IsVal D W s t') : t = t'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  choose V a W1 hx1 h1 h2 e1 using fun x : W => h x.1 x.2
  choose V' a' W2 hx2 h1' h2' e2 using fun x : W => h' x.1 x.2
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E22.sections_eq_zero_of_locally (C := N)
    (fun x : W => W1 x ⊓ W2 x) (fun x => inf_le_left.trans (h1 x)) ?_ _ ?_
  · intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hx1 ⟨x, hx⟩, hx2 ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  · intro x
    change resN N _ (t - t') = 0
    have k1 : resN N ((inf_le_left : W1 x ⊓ W2 x ≤ W1 x).trans (h1 x)) t =
        resN N (show W1 x ⊓ W2 x ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (V x) from inf_le_left.trans (h2 x)) (D.θ (V x) (a x)) := by
      rw [← resN_trans N inf_le_left (h1 x), (e1 x).2, resN_trans]
    have k2 : resN N ((inf_le_right : W1 x ⊓ W2 x ≤ W2 x).trans (h1' x)) t' =
        resN N (show W1 x ⊓ W2 x ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (V' x) from inf_le_right.trans (h2' x))
          (D.θ (V' x) (a' x)) := by
      rw [← resN_trans N inf_le_right (h1' x), (e2 x).2, resN_trans]
    have k3 : resX (show W1 x ⊓ W2 x ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (V x) from inf_le_left.trans (h2 x))
        (i.app (V x) (a x)) =
        resX (show W1 x ⊓ W2 x ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (V' x) from inf_le_right.trans (h2' x))
          (i.app (V' x) (a' x)) := by
      rw [← resX_trans inf_le_left (h2 x), ← (e1 x).1, resX_trans,
        ← resX_trans inf_le_right (h2' x), ← (e2 x).1, resX_trans]
    have := wd D _ _ _ _ k3
    rw [map_sub, k1, k2, this, sub_self]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.lift_transport
statement:
theorem lift_transport (D : LocalDer i N) {V V3 : P.Opens} (hV : V3 ≤ V) {W1 W3 : X.Opens}
    (h2 : W1 ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hW : W3 ≤ W1) (hW3 : W3 ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V3) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    resX hW3 (i.app V3 (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op a)) = resX hW (resX h2 (i.app V a)) ∧
    resN N hW3 (D.θ V3 (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op a)) = resN N hW (resN N h2 (D.θ V a))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [app_res, resX_trans, resX_trans]
  · rw [← D.res hV a, resN_trans, resN_trans]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.common
statement:
theorem IsVal.common {D : LocalDer i N} {W : X.Opens} {s s' : Γ(X, W)} {t t' : Γ(N, W)}
    (h : IsVal D W s t) (h' : IsVal D W s' t') : ∀ x ∈ W, ∃ (V : P.Opens) (a a' : Γ(P, V))
    (W' : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ W') (h1 : W' ≤ W) (h2 : W' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V),
    resX h1 s = resX h2 (i.app V a) ∧ resN N h1 t = resN N h2 (D.θ V a) ∧
    resX h1 s' = resX h2 (i.app V a') ∧ resN N h1 t' = resN N h2 (D.θ V a')
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, a, W1, hx1, h1, h2, e1, f1⟩ := h x hx
  obtain ⟨V', a', W2, hx2, h1', h2', e2, f2⟩ := h' x hx
  have hW3 : W1 ⊓ W2 ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ (V ⊓ V') := fun _ hy => ⟨h2 hy.1, h2' hy.2⟩
  obtain ⟨l1, l2⟩ := lift_transport D (inf_le_left : V ⊓ V' ≤ V) h2 inf_le_left hW3 a
  obtain ⟨l1', l2'⟩ := lift_transport D (inf_le_right : V ⊓ V' ≤ V') h2' inf_le_right hW3 a'
  refine ⟨V ⊓ V', P.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op a,
    P.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op a', W1 ⊓ W2, ⟨hx1, hx2⟩,
    inf_le_left.trans h1, hW3, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [l1, ← e1, resX_trans]
  · rw [l2, ← f1, resN_trans]
  · rw [l1', ← e2, resX_trans]
  · rw [l2', ← f2, resN_trans]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.add
statement:
theorem IsVal.add {D : LocalDer i N} {W : X.Opens} {s s' : Γ(X, W)} {t t' : Γ(N, W)}
    (h : IsVal D W s t) (h' : IsVal D W s' t') : IsVal D W (s + s') (t + t')
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, a, a', W', hx', h1, h2, e1, f1, e2, f2⟩ := h.common h' x hx
  exact ⟨V, a + a', W', hx', h1, h2, by rw [map_add, map_add, e1, e2, map_add],
    by rw [map_add, map_add, f1, f2, map_add]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.mul
statement:
theorem IsVal.mul {D : LocalDer i N} {W : X.Opens} {s s' : Γ(X, W)} {t t' : Γ(N, W)}
    (h : IsVal D W s t) (h' : IsVal D W s' t') : IsVal D W (s * s') (s • t' + s' • t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, a, a', W', hx', h1, h2, e1, f1, e2, f2⟩ := h.common h' x hx
  refine ⟨V, a * a', W', hx', h1, h2, by simp only [map_mul, e1, e2], ?_⟩
  simp only [D.mul, map_add, resN_smul, e1, e2, f1, f2]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.resX_refl
statement: theorem resX_refl (W : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, W)) : resX (le_refl W) x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [resX]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.resN_refl
statement: theorem resN_refl (W : X.Opens) (x : Γ(N, W)) : resN N (le_refl W) x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [resN]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.of_lift
statement:
theorem IsVal.of_lift (D : LocalDer i N) (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    IsVal D (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V a) (D.θ V a)
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  ⟨V, a, i ⁻¹ᵁ V, hx, le_rfl, le_rfl, by rw [resX_refl], by rw [resN_refl]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.zero
statement: theorem IsVal.zero (D : LocalDer i N) (W : X.Opens) : IsVal D W 0 0
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  ⟨⊤, 0, W, hx, le_rfl, fun _ _ => trivial, by rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero], by rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.IsVal.restrict
statement:
theorem IsVal.restrict {D : LocalDer i N} {W W₂ : X.Opens} {s : Γ(X, W)} {t : Γ(N, W)}
    (h : IsVal D W s t) (hW : W₂ ≤ W) : IsVal D W₂ (resX hW s) (resN N hW t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, a, W1, hx1, h1, h2, e1, f1⟩ := h x (hW hx)
  refine ⟨V, a, W1 ⊓ W₂, ⟨hx1, hx⟩, inf_le_right, inf_le_left.trans h2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [resX_trans, ← resX_trans inf_le_left h2, ← e1, resX_trans]
  · rw [resN_trans, ← resN_trans N inf_le_left h2, ← f1, resN_trans]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.exists_val
statement:
theorem exists_val [IsClosedImmersion i] (D : LocalDer i N) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
    ∃ t, IsVal D W s t
proof:
:= by
  choose V a W' hxW' h1 h2 hs using fun x : W => TF2.exists_local_lift i s x.1 x.2
  let sf : ∀ x : W, Γ(N, W' x) := fun x => resN N (h2 x) (D.θ (V x) (a x))
  have comp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible N.presheaf (fun x : W => W' x) sf := by
    intro x y
    show resN N inf_le_left (sf x) = resN N inf_le_right (sf y)
    simp only [sf, resN_trans]
    refine wd D _ _ _ _ ?_
    rw [← resX_trans inf_le_left (h2 x), ← resX_trans inf_le_right (h2 y)]
    have hx := hs x
    have hy := hs y
    change resX (h1 x) s = resX (h2 x) (i.app (V x) (a x)) at hx
    change resX (h1 y) s = resX (h2 y) (i.app (V y) (a y)) at hy
    rw [← hx, ← hy, resX_trans, resX_trans]
  have cov : W ≤ ⨆ x : W, W' x := by
    intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxW' ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
    (⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X) (fun x : W => W' x) W
    (fun x => homOfLE (h1 x)) cov sf comp
  exact ⟨t, fun y hy => ⟨V ⟨y, hy⟩, a ⟨y, hy⟩, W' ⟨y, hy⟩, hxW' ⟨y, hy⟩, h1 ⟨y, hy⟩,
    h2 ⟨y, hy⟩, hs ⟨y, hy⟩, ht ⟨y, hy⟩⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.extD_isVal
statement:
theorem extD_isVal (D : LocalDer i N) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
    IsVal D W s (extD D W s)
proof: := (exists_val D W s).choose_spec

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.extD_mul
statement:
theorem extD_mul (D : LocalDer i N) (W : X.Opens) (s s' : Γ(X, W)) :
    extD D W (s * s') = s • extD D W s' + s' • extD D W s
proof:
:=
  (extD_isVal D W (s * s')).unique ((extD_isVal D W s).mul (extD_isVal D W s'))

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.extD_res
statement:
theorem extD_res (D : LocalDer i N) {W W₂ : X.Opens} (h : W₂ ≤ W) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
    resN N h (extD D W s) = extD D W₂ (resX h s)
proof:
:=
  (extD_isVal D W₂ (resX h s)).unique ((extD_isVal D W s).restrict h) |>.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TF4.extD_lift
statement:
theorem extD_lift (D : LocalDer i N) (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    extD D (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V a) = D.θ V a
proof:
:=
  (extD_isVal D _ _).unique (IsVal.of_lift D V a)

name: GRRKG1.twisted_comp
statement:
theorem twisted_comp (iG : GX →+ GP) (πG : GP →+ GY)
    (τX : GX →+ CX) (τP : GP →+ CP) (τY : GY →+ CY)
    (pushI : CX →+ CP) (pushPi : CP →+ CY) (pullI : CP →+* CX) (tI : CX) (tPi : CP)
    (hproj : ∀ a b, pushI (a * pullI b) = pushI a * b)
    (hi : ∀ x, τP (iG x) = pushI (τX x * tI))
    (hπ : ∀ y, τY (πG y) = pushPi (τP y * tPi)) (x : GX) :
    τY (πG (iG x)) = pushPi (pushI (τX x * (tI * pullI tPi)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hπ, hi, ← hproj, mul_assoc]

name: GRRKG1.fG_eq
statement:
theorem fG_eq :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn).comp (finitePushforward i) =
      fG R n hn i
proof:
:=
  SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward_comp_closedImmersion R n hn i

name: GRRKG1.adamsRiemannRoch_of_inputs
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_of_inputs {r : ℕ} (h : AdamsRRInputs R n hn i j r) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (h.ψY.adams j (h.resY.res (fG R n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      h.pushPi (h.pushI (algebraMap _ _ (h.ψX.adams j x) *
        (((h.θX.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (h.pullK (adamsCotangentClass R n) -
          h.N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  let iK : K0 X →+ K0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n) :=
    h.resP.res.comp ((finitePushforward i).comp (k0ToG0 X))
  let πK : K0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
    h.resY.res.comp ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn).comp
      (k0ToG0 _))
  have hcomp : πK (iK x) = h.resY.res (fG R n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)) := by
    have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun h.resP.right (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at hr
    simp only [πK, iK, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
    rw [← fG_eq]
    rfl
  have htw : (((h.θX.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (h.pullK (adamsCotangentClass R n) -
      h.N.conormalClass)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      ((h.θX.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd h.N.conormalClass) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) *
        h.pullLoc (((h.θP.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
          (KLoc j _)ˣ) : KLoc j _) := by
    have hu : Units.map h.pullLoc.toMonoidHom
        (h.θP.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n))) =
        h.θX.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (h.pullK (adamsCotangentClass R n))) :=
      Units.ext (by rw [Units.coe_map, h.bott_pull]; rfl)
    rw [ofAdd_sub, map_div, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Units.val_mul, ← hu, ← map_inv,
      Units.coe_map]
    rfl
  rw [← hcomp, htw]
  exact twisted_comp iK πK
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (h.ψX.adams j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (h.ψP.adams j).toAddMonoidHom)
    ((algebraMap _ _).toAddMonoidHom.comp (h.ψY.adams j).toAddMonoidHom)
    h.pushI h.pushPi h.pullLoc _ _ h.projFormula h.closedImmersion h.projection x

name: GRRKG1.projection_of_data
statement:
theorem projection_of_data (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (ψP : AdamsData (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)) (ψY : AdamsData (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (θP : BottData j (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n))
    (pushPi : KLoc j (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n) →+ KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) =
      algebraMap _ _ (resY.res (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn
        (k0ToG0 _ a))))
    (y : K0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (ψY.adams j (resY.res (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn
          (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      pushPi (algebraMap _ _ (ψP.adams j y) *
        (((θP.bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j _)ˣ) :
          KLoc j _))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace_blueprint R n hn j hj resY.res resY.left ψP.adams ψP.newton
    ψY.adams ψY.newton θP.bott θP.bott_line pushPi pushPi_alg y

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseChange_hom_eq_of_coherentSheaf_classes
statement:
theorem baseChange_hom_eq_of_coherentSheaf_classes
    (pushforward : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S)
    (pushforward' : SchemeKTheory.G0 X' →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (pullTotal : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 X')
    (pullBase : SchemeKTheory.G0 S →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (hsheaf : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M},
      pullBase (pushforward
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E)) =
        pushforward' (pullTotal
          (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
            (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E))) :
    pullBase.comp pushforward = pushforward'.comp pullTotal
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  exact hsheaf

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseChange_indexClass_of_coherentSheaf_classes
statement:
theorem baseChange_indexClass_of_coherentSheaf_classes
    (pushforward : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S)
    (pushforward' : SchemeKTheory.G0 X' →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (pullTotal : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 X')
    (pullBase : SchemeKTheory.G0 S →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (hsheaf : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M},
      pullBase (pushforward
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E)) =
        pushforward' (pullTotal
          (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
            (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E)))
    (z : SchemeKTheory.G0 X) :
    pullBase (indexClass pushforward z) =
      indexClass pushforward' (pullTotal z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S' => f z)
    (baseChange_hom_eq_of_coherentSheaf_classes pushforward pushforward' pullTotal pullBase hsheaf)
  exact h

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_identityHigherDirectImages
statement:
@[simp]
theorem familyEuler_identityHigherDirectImages
    (rank : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ ℤ) :
    familyEuler
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages 0
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage_coherent
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImageLongExact)
        rank = rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfIdentityHigherDirectImages_eq_id]
