name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_identityHigherDirectImages_baseChange
statement:
theorem familyEuler_identityHigherDirectImages_baseChange
    (pullObject :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} →
        {M : X'.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X' M})
    (hpull : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X'.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X')
          (pullObject A) (pullObject B) (pullObject C))
    (rank : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ ℤ) (rank' : SchemeKTheory.G0 X' →+ ℤ)
    (hrank : rank'.comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull) = rank) :
    familyEuler
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages 0
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage_coherent
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImageLongExact)
        rank =
      (familyEuler
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages 0
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage_coherent
          SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImageLongExact)
        rank').comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull)
proof:
:= by
  rw [familyEuler_identityHigherDirectImages, familyEuler_identityHigherDirectImages]
  exact hrank.symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_baseChange
statement:
theorem familyEuler_baseChange
    (pushforward : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S)
    (pushforward' : SchemeKTheory.G0 X' →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (pullTotal : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 X')
    (pullBase : SchemeKTheory.G0 S →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (rank : SchemeKTheory.G0 S →+ ℤ) (rank' : SchemeKTheory.G0 S' →+ ℤ)
    (hindex : pullBase.comp pushforward = pushforward'.comp pullTotal)
    (hrank : rank'.comp pullBase = rank) :
    familyEuler pushforward rank = (familyEuler pushforward' rank').comp pullTotal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hrank]
  change (rank'.comp pullBase).comp pushforward =
    (rank'.comp pushforward').comp pullTotal
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hindex]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.familyEuler_baseChange_of_higherDirectImages
statement:
theorem familyEuler_baseChange_of_higherDirectImages
    (n : ℕ)
    (higherDirectImage :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → S.Modules)
    (hcoherent : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike S (higherDirectImage E i))
    (hlong : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness n
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage hcoherent A)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage hcoherent B)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage hcoherent C))
    (higherDirectImage' :
      {M : X'.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X' M} → ℕ → S'.Modules)
    (hcoherent' : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike S' (higherDirectImage' E i))
    (hlong' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X'.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X') A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness n
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage' hcoherent' A)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage' hcoherent' B)
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage' hcoherent' C))
    (pullObject :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} →
        {M : X'.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X' M})
    (hpull : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X'.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X')
          (pullObject A) (pullObject B) (pullObject C))
    (pullBase : SchemeKTheory.G0 S →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 S')
    (hdegree : ∀ E i,
      pullBase
          (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
            higherDirectImage hcoherent E i) =
        SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
          higherDirectImage' hcoherent' (pullObject E) i)
    (rank : SchemeKTheory.G0 S →+ ℤ) (rank' : SchemeKTheory.G0 S' →+ ℤ)
    (hrank : rank'.comp pullBase = rank) :
    familyEuler
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n
          higherDirectImage hcoherent hlong) rank =
      (familyEuler
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n
          higherDirectImage' hcoherent' hlong') rank').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull)
proof:
:=
  familyEuler_baseChange
    (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n
      higherDirectImage hcoherent hlong)
    (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n
      higherDirectImage' hcoherent' hlong')
    (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull) pullBase rank rank'
    (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_baseChange_of_degreewise n
        higherDirectImage hcoherent hlong higherDirectImage' hcoherent' hlong'
        pullObject hpull pullBase hdegree)
    hrank

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.StdOn.basicOpen
statement:
theorem StdOn.basicOpen {T : Y.Opens} (hT : IsAffineOpen T) (h : StdOn f n T) (g : Γ(Y, T)) :
    StdOn f n (Y.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
  refine ⟨(Y.basicOpen_le g).trans e, ?_⟩
  haveI := hT.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  have := (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_stableUnderCompositionWithLocalizationAway
    n).right Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen g) g (f.appLE ⊤ T e).hom he
  have h2 : f.appLE ⊤ (Y.basicOpen g) ((Y.basicOpen_le g).trans e) =
      f.appLE ⊤ T e ≫ Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le g)).op :=
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map f e (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le g)).op).symm
  rw [h2, CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  exact this

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.exists_stdOn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀, U, hU, hyU, e, hsm⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (n := n) (f := f) y
  have : V₀ = ⊤ := hS V₀ ⟨⟨f y, e hyU⟩⟩
  subst this
  exact ⟨U, hyU, hU, e, hsm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.RegOn.basicOpen
statement:
theorem RegOn.basicOpen {T : P.Opens} (h : RegOn i r T) (g : Γ(P, T)) :
    RegOn i r (P.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hT, rs, hI, hreg, hlen⟩ := h
  haveI := hT.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  refine ⟨hT.basicOpen g, rs.map (algebraMap Γ(P, T) Γ(P, P.basicOpen g)), ?_,
    IsWeaklyRegular.of_isLocalization Γ(P, P.basicOpen g) (Submonoid.powers g) hreg, by simp [hlen]⟩
  have := i.ker.map_ideal_basicOpen ⟨T, hT⟩ g
  rw [hI, Ideal.map_ofList] at this
  exact this.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.app_surjective
statement: theorem app_surjective (T : P.affineOpens) : Function.Surjective (i.app T.1).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι i
  rw [Scheme.Hom.congr_app h.symm T.1, Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  have s1 := i.ker.subschemeι_app_surjective T
  have s2 := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (i.toImage.app (i.imageι ⁻¹ᵁ T.1))).2
  have s3 := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show (i.toImage ≫ i.imageι) ⁻¹ᵁ T.1 = i ⁻¹ᵁ T.1 by rw [h])).op)).2
  exact s3.comp (s2.comp s1)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.exists_chart
statement:
theorem exists_chart {S X P : Scheme.{u}} (hS : ∀ V : S.Opens, Nonempty V → V = ⊤)
    (πP : P ⟶ S) (πX : X ⟶ S) (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] {m d r : ℕ}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension m πP] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d πX]
    (hreg : ∀ z0 : X, ∃ (U : P.affineOpens) (_ : i z0 ∈ U.1) (rs : List Γ(P, U)),
      i.ker.ideal U = Ideal.ofList rs ∧ IsWeaklyRegular Γ(P, U) rs ∧ rs.length = r) (x : X) :
    ∃ T : P.Opens, i x ∈ T ∧ IsAffineOpen T ∧ StdOn πP m T ∧ StdOn πX d (i ⁻¹ᵁ T) ∧
      RegOn i r T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ta, hpTa, hTa, hStdTa⟩ := exists_stdOn (f := πP) m hS (i x)
  obtain ⟨Wa, hxWa, hWa, hStdWa⟩ := exists_stdOn (f := πX) d hS x
  obtain ⟨U, hpU, rs, hI, hregs, hlen⟩ := hreg x
  have hReg : RegOn i r U.1 := ⟨U.2, rs, hI, hregs, hlen⟩
  obtain ⟨f1, g1, he, hp⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter hTa U.2 (i x) ⟨hpTa, hpU⟩
  have hT2 : IsAffineOpen (P.basicOpen f1) := hTa.basicOpen f1
  have hStd2 : StdOn πP m (P.basicOpen f1) := hStdTa.basicOpen hTa f1
  have hReg2 : RegOn i r (P.basicOpen f1) := by
    rw [he]; exact hReg.basicOpen g1
  have hQ : IsAffineOpen (i ⁻¹ᵁ P.basicOpen f1) := hT2.preimage i
  obtain ⟨b, w, hbw, hxb⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter hQ hWa x ⟨hp, hxWa⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := app_surjective (i := i) ⟨P.basicOpen f1, hT2⟩ b
  have hpre : i ⁻¹ᵁ P.basicOpen a = X.basicOpen w := by
    rw [Scheme.preimage_basicOpen]
    have : (i.app (P.basicOpen f1)) a = b := ha
    rw [this, hbw]
  refine ⟨P.basicOpen a, ?_, hT2.basicOpen a, hStd2.basicOpen hT2 a, ?_, hReg2.basicOpen a⟩
  · have : x ∈ i ⁻¹ᵁ P.basicOpen a := by
      rw [hpre, ← hbw]; exact hxb
    exact this
  · rw [hpre]; exact hStdWa.basicOpen hWa w

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.rank_add_of_chart
statement:
theorem rank_add_of_chart {S X P : Scheme.{u}} (πP : P ⟶ S) (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    {m d r : ℕ} {T : P.Opens} (hT : IsAffineOpen T) (hne : Nonempty (i ⁻¹ᵁ T))
    (hStdP : StdOn πP m T) (hStdX : StdOn (i ≫ πP) d (i ⁻¹ᵁ T)) (hReg : RegOn i r T) :
    r + d = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨eP, hP⟩ := hStdP
  obtain ⟨eX, hX⟩ := hStdX
  obtain ⟨hT', rs, hI, hreg, hlen⟩ := hReg
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(P, T) := (πP.appLE ⊤ T eP).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(P, T) := hP
  have hsurj := app_surjective (i := i) ⟨T, hT⟩
  have hker : i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩ = RingHom.ker (i.app T).hom := Scheme.Hom.ker_apply i ⟨T, hT⟩
  let ψ : Γ(P, T) ⧸ i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩ ≃+* Γ(X, i ⁻¹ᵁ T) :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)
  have hd : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d Γ(S, ⊤)
      (Γ(P, T) ⧸ i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩) := by
    have h1 := (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso (n := d)).left _ ψ.symm hX
    have key : algebraMap Γ(S, ⊤) (Γ(P, T) ⧸ i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩) =
        (ψ.symm : Γ(X, i ⁻¹ᵁ T) →+* _).comp ((i ≫ πP).appLE ⊤ (i ⁻¹ᵁ T) eX).hom := by
      ext r0
      refine (ψ.toEquiv.eq_symm_apply).mpr ?_
      have hc := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE i πP ⊤ T (i ⁻¹ᵁ T) eP le_rfl
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] at hc
      have hc2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom r0) hc
      simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at hc2
      exact hc2
    have h2 : (algebraMap Γ(S, ⊤) (Γ(P, T) ⧸ i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩)).IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d := by
      rw [key]; exact h1
    exact (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap (n := d)).mp h2
  haveI : Nontrivial (Γ(P, T) ⧸ i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩) := ψ.toEquiv.nontrivial
  have := rank_add_of_quasiregular Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(P, T) (i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩)
    (SchemeKTheory.F14.regularGeneratorsOfList (i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩) rs hI hreg).toQuasiregular (m := m) (d := d)
  have hl : (SchemeKTheory.F14.regularGeneratorsOfList (i.ker.ideal ⟨T, hT⟩) rs hI
      hreg).toQuasiregular.length = r := hlen
  rw [hl] at this
  exact this

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.rank_add_eq
statement:
theorem rank_add_eq {S X P : Scheme.{u}} (hS : ∀ V : S.Opens, Nonempty V → V = ⊤)
    (πP : P ⟶ S) (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] {m d r : ℕ} [Nonempty X]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension m πP] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (i ≫ πP)]
    (hreg : ∀ z0 : X, ∃ (U : P.affineOpens) (_ : i z0 ∈ U.1) (rs : List Γ(P, U)),
      i.ker.ideal U = Ideal.ofList rs ∧ IsWeaklyRegular Γ(P, U) rs ∧ rs.length = r) :
    r + d = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  obtain ⟨T, hxT, hT, hP, hX, hR⟩ := exists_chart hS πP (i ≫ πP) i (d := d) (m := m) hreg x
  exact rank_add_of_chart πP i hT ⟨⟨x, hxT⟩⟩ hP hX hR

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.nativeTensorMap_one_tmul
statement:
theorem nativeTensorMap_one_tmul {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (M : (Spec (.of R)).Modules)
    (s : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj M) :
    cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap φ M ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R,φ] s) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app M).app ⊤ s
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f s)
    (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply
      (cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap φ M))
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.nativePullbackUnit_surjective
statement:
theorem nativePullbackUnit_surjective {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (M : (Spec (.of R)).Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] : Function.Surjective
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app M).app ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := φ.toAlgebra
  intro t
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap_surjective φ M t
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := TensorProduct.mk_surjective R
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj M) S hφ z
  refine ⟨s, (nativeTensorMap_one_tmul φ M s).symm.trans ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg (cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap φ M) hs).trans hz

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorObject_eqToIso_apply
statement:
theorem tensorObject_eqToIso_apply {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (M : ModuleCat A) (a a' : Algebra A B) (h : a = a') (b : B) (m : M) :
    (eqToIso (congrArg (tensorObject M) h)).hom (tensorElement M a b m) =
      tensorElement M a' b m
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.algebraTensorIso_apply
statement:
theorem algebraTensorIso_apply {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (M : ModuleCat A) (b : B) (m : M) :
    (algebraTensorIso (B := B) M).hom (b ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A B] m) = b ⊗ₜ[A] m
proof:
:=
  tensorObject_eqToIso_apply M _ _ toAlgebra_algebraMap b m

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.extendCotangentIso_apply
statement:
theorem extendCotangentIso_apply (b : B) (x : P.ker) :
    (extendCotangentIso P).hom (b ⊗ₜ[P.Ring,algebraMap P.Ring B] x) =
      b • Extension.Cotangent.mk x
proof:
:= by
  change P.cotangentEquiv
    ((algebraTensorIso (ModuleCat.of P.Ring P.ker)).hom
      (b ⊗ₜ[P.Ring,algebraMap P.Ring B] x)) = _
  exact (congrArg P.cotangentEquiv (algebraTensorIso_apply (A := P.Ring) (B := B)
      (ModuleCat.of P.Ring P.ker) b x)).trans
    (P.contangentEquiv_tmul b x)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso_unit
statement:
theorem pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso_unit
    (s : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of P.Ring)).obj
      (TF3.idealOf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))))) :
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso P).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))))).app ⊤ s) =
    Extension.Cotangent.mk
      (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)) s)
proof:
:= by
  let I := TF3.idealOf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))
  letI : I.IsQuasicoherent := specIdeal_isQuasicoherent _
  let t := cosectionSpecNativeTensorIso (algebraMap P.Ring B) I
  let η := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B)))).unit.app I).app ⊤
  have ht : t.inv (η s) = (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.Ring,algebraMap P.Ring B] s :=
    (congrArg (fun x => t.inv x) (nativeTensorMap_one_tmul (algebraMap P.Ring B) I s)).symm.trans
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom t.hom_inv_id _)
  change (extendCotangentIso P).hom
    ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap P.Ring B)).map
      (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).toModuleIso.hom
      (t.inv (η s))) = _
  let e : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of P.Ring)).obj I ≅
      ModuleCat.of P.Ring P.ker :=
    (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.Ring B))).toModuleIso
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun x => (extendCotangentIso P).hom
    ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap P.Ring B)).map e.hom x)) ht
  have h₂ := congrArg ((extendCotangentIso P).hom)
    (ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul (algebraMap P.Ring B) e.hom (1 : B) s)
  have h₃ := extendCotangentIso_apply P (1 : B) (e.hom s)
  exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans (h₃.trans (one_smul B _)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorCoefficientMap_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorCoefficientMap_tmul (b : B) (x : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R B)) :
    tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) (b ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      b ⊗ₜ[A] kernelToAmbient (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorCoefficientMap, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, LinearMap.coe_comp,
    LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply,
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.cotangentEquiv_tensorCoefficientMap
statement:
theorem cotangentEquiv_tensorCoefficientMap (z : B ⊗[R] (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R B))) :
    (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) z) =
      conormalMap (A := A) hf ((baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    have hl := (congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv
      (map_zero (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)))).trans
        (map_zero (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv)
    have hr := (congrArg (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
      (map_zero (baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv)).trans
        (map_zero (conormalMap (A := A) hf))
    exact hl.trans hr.symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    have hl := (congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv
      (map_add (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)) x y)).trans
        (map_add (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv _ _)
    have hr := (congrArg (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
      (map_add (baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv x y)).trans
        (map_add (conormalMap (A := A) hf) _ _)
    exact hl.trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy).trans hr.symm)
  | tmul b x =>
    have ht := tensorCoefficientMap_tmul (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) b x
    have ha := (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).contangentEquiv_tmul b
      (kernelToAmbient (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x)
    have hb := (baseExtension hf).contangentEquiv_tmul b x
    have hm : conormalMap (A := A) hf (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) =
        Extension.Cotangent.mk (kernelToAmbient (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) x) := rfl
    exact ((congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv ht).trans ha).trans
      ((congrArg (fun y => b • y) hm).symm.trans
        ((map_smul (conormalMap (A := A) hf) b (Extension.Cotangent.mk x)).symm.trans
          (congrArg (conormalMap (A := A) hf) hb).symm))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorCoefficientMap_injective
statement:
theorem tensorCoefficientMap_injective [FormallySmooth R A] :
    Function.Injective (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply (baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv.injective
  apply conormalMap_injective (A := A) hf
  exact (cotangentEquiv_tensorCoefficientMap (A := A) hf x).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv h).trans
      (cotangentEquiv_tensorCoefficientMap (A := A) hf y))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorDifferential_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorDifferential_tmul (b : B) (x : RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B)) :
    tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) (b ⊗ₜ[A] x) =
      b • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D R A x.val)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorDifferential_eq_cotangentComplex
statement:
theorem tensorDifferential_eq_cotangentComplex (z : B ⊗[A] (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B))) :
    tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) z =
      (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
        ((ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    have hl := map_zero (tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
    have hr := (congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
      (map_zero (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv)).trans
        (map_zero (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex)
    exact hl.trans hr.symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    have hl := map_add (tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)) x y
    have hr := (congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
      (map_add (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv x y)).trans
        (map_add (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex _ _)
    exact hl.trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy).trans hr.symm)
  | tmul b x =>
    have he := (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).contangentEquiv_tmul b x
    have hd : (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) =
        (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D R A x.val := rfl
    have hr := (congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex he).trans
      ((map_smul (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex b _).trans
        (congrArg (fun y => b • y) hd))
    exact (tensorDifferential_tmul (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) b x).trans hr.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorPair_exact
statement:
theorem tensorPair_exact [FormallySmooth R A] :
    Function.Exact (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
      (tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hcomp : (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
        ((ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv z) = 0 :=
      (tensorDifferential_eq_cotangentComplex (A := A) hf z).symm.trans hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (conormalMap_exact (A := A) hf _).mp hcomp
    refine ⟨(baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv.symm x, ?_⟩
    apply (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv.injective
    exact (cotangentEquiv_tensorCoefficientMap (A := A) hf _).trans
      ((congrArg (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
        ((baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv.apply_symm_apply x)).trans hx)
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (tensorDifferential_eq_cotangentComplex (A := A) hf _).trans
      ((congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
        (cotangentEquiv_tensorCoefficientMap (A := A) hf x)).trans
          ((conormalMap_exact (A := A) hf _).mpr
            ⟨(baseExtension hf).cotangentEquiv x, rfl⟩))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorDifferential_surjective
statement:
theorem tensorDifferential_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))
proof:
:= by
  intro ω
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := conormalDifferential_surjective (A := A) hf ω
  refine ⟨(ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv.symm x, ?_⟩
  exact (tensorDifferential_eq_cotangentComplex (A := A) hf _).trans
    ((congrArg (ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentComplex
      ((ambientExtension (A := A) hf).cotangentEquiv.apply_symm_apply x)).trans hx)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorPair_comp_zero
statement:
theorem tensorPair_comp_zero [FormallySmooth R A] :
    (tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).comp
      (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact (tensorPair_exact (A := A) hf _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalTensorH2.tensorSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem tensorSequence_shortExact [FormallySmooth R A] :
    (tensorSequence (A := A) hf).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [tensorSequence]
  haveI : Mono (ModuleCat.ofHom (tensorCoefficientMap (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))) :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr (tensorCoefficientMap_injective (A := A) hf)
  haveI : Epi (ModuleCat.ofHom (tensorDifferential (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))) :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr (tensorDifferential_surjective (A := A) hf)
  exact ⟨(ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mpr
    (tensorPair_exact (A := A) hf)⟩

name: RG6B.pr_mem
statement: theorem pr_mem (p : ℕ) (x : K) : pr W p x ∈ W p
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply]
  exact (DirectSum.decompose W x p).2

name: RG6B.pr_of_mem_same
statement: theorem pr_of_mem_same {p : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ W p) : pr W p x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same W hx]

name: RG6B.pr_of_mem_ne
statement: theorem pr_of_mem_ne {p q : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ W q) (h : p ≠ q) : pr W p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply]
  exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne W hx (Ne.symm h)

name: RG6B.pr_one_zero
statement: theorem pr_one_zero : pr W 0 (1 : K) = 1
proof:
:=
  pr_of_mem_same (SetLike.one_mem_graded W)

name: RG6B.pr_one_ne
statement: theorem pr_one_ne {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) : pr W p (1 : K) = 0
proof:
:=
  pr_of_mem_ne (SetLike.one_mem_graded W) hp

name: RG6B.pr_eq_zero_of_bound
statement:
theorem pr_eq_zero_of_bound (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {p : ℕ} (hp : D < p) (x : K) :
    pr W p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := pr_mem (W := W) p x
  rw [H.bound hp] at this
  simpa using this

name: RG6B.sum_pr
statement:
theorem sum_pr (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) :
    x = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), pr W p x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc x = ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose W x).support, (DirectSum.decompose W x i : K) :=
        (DirectSum.sum_support_decompose W x).symm
    _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), (DirectSum.decompose W x p : K) := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset
        · intro p hp
          rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
          by_contra hlt
          have hlt : D < p := by omega
          have h0 : pr W p x = 0 := pr_eq_zero_of_bound H hlt x
          rw [pr, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply] at h0
          have : DirectSum.decompose W x p = 0 := Subtype.ext h0
          exact (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff).1 hp this
        · intro p _ hp
          by_contra hne
          exact hp ((DFinsupp.mem_support_iff).2 fun h => hne (by simp [h]))
    _ = _ := by simp [pr, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply]

name: RG6B.eq_of_pr_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_pr_eq (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {x y : K} (h : ∀ p, pr W p x = pr W p y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_pr H x, sum_pr H y]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => h p

name: RG6B.pr_psi
statement:
theorem pr_psi (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (p : ℕ) (x : K) :
    pr W p (psi x) = (j : ℚ) ^ p • pr W p x
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [sum_pr H x]
  rw [map_sum, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · rw [H.psi_eq (pr_mem p x), map_smul, pr_of_mem_same (pr_mem p x)]
  · intro q _ hqp
    rw [H.psi_eq (pr_mem q x), map_smul, pr_of_mem_ne (pr_mem q x) (Ne.symm hqp), smul_zero]
  · intro hp
    have hp' : D < p := by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hp
    rw [pr_eq_zero_of_bound H hp' x]
    simp

name: RG6B.mem_Fil
statement: theorem mem_Fil {m : ℕ} {x : K} : x ∈ Fil W m ↔ ∀ p < m, pr W p x = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: RG6B.Fil_zero_all
statement: theorem Fil_zero_all (x : K) : x ∈ Fil W 0
proof: := fun p hp => absurd hp (by omega)

name: RG6B.Fil_mono
statement: theorem Fil_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Fil W n) : x ∈ Fil W m
proof:
:=
  fun p hp => hx p (lt_of_lt_of_le hp h)

name: RG6B.Fil_one_iff
statement: theorem Fil_one_iff {x : K} : x ∈ Fil W 1 ↔ pr W 0 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact h 0 (by omega)
  · intro h p hp
    have : p = 0 := by omega
    subst this; exact h

name: RG6B.Fil_of_mem
statement: theorem Fil_of_mem {m p : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ W p) (h : m ≤ p) : x ∈ Fil W m
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  exact pr_of_mem_ne hx (by omega)

name: RG6B.Fil_bot
statement:
theorem Fil_bot (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {m : ℕ} (hm : D + 1 ≤ m) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Fil W m) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_pr H x]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp => hx p (by simp at hp; omega)

name: RG6B.Fil_mul
statement:
theorem Fil_mul (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {m n : ℕ} {x y : K} (hx : x ∈ Fil W m)
    (hy : y ∈ Fil W n) : x * y ∈ Fil W (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [sum_pr H x, sum_pr H y, Finset.sum_mul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a _ => ?_
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
  by_cases ha : a < m
  · rw [hx a ha, zero_mul, map_zero]
  by_cases hb : b < n
  · rw [hy b hb, mul_zero, map_zero]
  exact pr_of_mem_ne (SetLike.mul_mem_graded (pr_mem a x) (pr_mem b y)) (by omega)

name: RG6B.Fil_pow
statement:
theorem Fil_pow (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Fil W 1) (k : ℕ) :
    x ^ k ∈ Fil W k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Fil_zero_all _
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact Fil_mul H ih hx

name: RG6B.isUnit_of_pr_zero
statement: theorem isUnit_of_pr_zero (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (h : pr W 0 a = 1) : IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  have hn : a - 1 ∈ Fil W 1 := by
    rw [Fil_one_iff, map_sub, h, pr_one_zero, sub_self]
  have hnil : IsNilpotent (a - 1) := ⟨D + 1, Fil_bot H le_rfl (Fil_pow H hn (D + 1))⟩
  simpa using hnil.isUnit_add_one

name: RG6B.pr_Rop
statement:
theorem pr_Rop (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (p : ℕ) (x : K) :
    pr W p (Rop W j D x) = (((j : ℚ) ^ p - 1)⁻¹) • pr W p x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Rop
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
    rw [pr_of_mem_same (pr_mem p x)]
  · intro q _ hqp
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
    rw [pr_of_mem_ne (pr_mem q x) (Ne.symm hqp), smul_zero]
  · intro hp
    have hp' : D < p := by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hp
    simp [pr_eq_zero_of_bound H hp' x]

name: RG6B.Rop_mem_Fil
statement:
theorem Rop_mem_Fil (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {m : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ Fil W m) :
    Rop W j D x ∈ Fil W m
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [pr_Rop H, hx p hp, smul_zero]

name: RG6B.Rop_mem_Fil_one
statement: theorem Rop_mem_Fil_one (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) : Rop W j D x ∈ Fil W 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fil_one_iff, pr_Rop H]
  simp

name: RG6B.one_lt_pow_cast
statement: theorem one_lt_pow_cast (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) : (1 : ℚ) < (j : ℚ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have : (1 : ℚ) < j := by exact_mod_cast H.hj
  exact one_lt_pow₀ this hp

name: RG6B.psi_Rop_sub
statement:
theorem psi_Rop_sub (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x : K) :
    psi (Rop W j D x) - Rop W j D x = x - pr W 0 x
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_pr_eq H
  intro p
  rw [map_sub, pr_psi H, pr_Rop H, map_sub]
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst hp
    simp
  · have hne : (j : ℚ) ^ p - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have := one_lt_pow_cast H hp
      linarith
    rw [pr_of_mem_ne (pr_mem 0 x) hp, sub_zero, smul_smul, ← sub_smul,
      show ((j : ℚ) ^ p * ((j : ℚ) ^ p - 1)⁻¹ - ((j : ℚ) ^ p - 1)⁻¹) = 1 by field_simp, one_smul]

name: RG6B.Rop_psi_sub
statement:
theorem Rop_psi_sub (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {v : K} (hv : v ∈ Fil W 1) :
    Rop W j D (psi v - v) = v
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_pr_eq H
  intro p
  rw [pr_Rop H, map_sub, pr_psi H]
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst hp
    have : pr W 0 v = 0 := Fil_one_iff.1 hv
    simp [this]
  · have hne : (j : ℚ) ^ p - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have := one_lt_pow_cast H hp
      linarith
    rw [show ((j : ℚ) ^ p • pr W p v - pr W p v) = ((j : ℚ) ^ p - 1) • pr W p v by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul], smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]

name: RG6B.Aop_apply
statement: theorem Aop_apply (s y : K) : Aop W j D s y = Rop W j D ((s - 1) * y)
proof: := rfl

name: RG6B.Aop_mem
statement:
theorem Aop_mem (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {s : K} (hs : s - 1 ∈ Fil W 1) {m : ℕ} {y : K}
    (hy : y ∈ Fil W m) : Aop W j D s y ∈ Fil W (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Aop_apply]
  have := Fil_mul H hs hy
  rw [add_comm] at this
  exact Rop_mem_Fil H this

name: RG6B.Aop_pow_mem
statement:
theorem Aop_pow_mem (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {s : K} (hs : s - 1 ∈ Fil W 1) {m : ℕ} {y : K}
    (hy : y ∈ Fil W m) (k : ℕ) : ((Aop W j D s) ^ k) y ∈ Fil W (m + k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hy
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact Aop_mem H hs ih

name: RG6B.sub_one_mem_Fil
statement: theorem sub_one_mem_Fil {s : K} (hs : pr W 0 s = 1) : s - 1 ∈ Fil W 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fil_one_iff, map_sub, hs, pr_one_zero, sub_self]

name: RG6B.exists_tau
statement:
theorem exists_tau (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {s : K} (hs : pr W 0 s = 1) :
    ∃ τ : K, pr W 0 τ = 1 ∧ psi τ = s * τ
proof:
:= by
  have hs1 := sub_one_mem_Fil (W := W) hs
  have hw0 : Rop W j D (s - 1) ∈ Fil W 1 := Rop_mem_Fil_one H _
  have hAw : ((Aop W j D s) ^ (D + 1)) (Rop W j D (s - 1)) = 0 :=
    Fil_bot H (m := 1 + (D + 1)) (by omega) (Aop_pow_mem H hs1 hw0 (D + 1))
  obtain ⟨u, hu1, hfix⟩ : ∃ u : K, u ∈ Fil W 1 ∧
      u - Aop W j D s u = Rop W j D (s - 1) := by
    refine ⟨(∑ k ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), (Aop W j D s) ^ k) (Rop W j D (s - 1)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Fil_mono (by omega) (Aop_pow_mem H hs1 hw0 k)
    · have h := congrArg (fun T : Module.End ℚ K => T (Rop W j D (s - 1)))
        (mul_neg_geom_sum (Aop W j D s) (D + 1))
      simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, hAw,
        sub_zero] at h
      exact h
  have hu_eq : u = Rop W j D ((s - 1) * (1 + u)) := by
    rw [mul_add, mul_one, map_add]
    change u = Rop W j D (s - 1) + Aop W j D s u
    rw [← hfix]; abel
  have hy : (s - 1) * (1 + u) ∈ Fil W 1 := by
    have := Fil_mul H hs1 (Fil_zero_all (W := W) (1 + u))
    simpa using this
  have key := psi_Rop_sub H ((s - 1) * (1 + u))
  rw [← hu_eq, Fil_one_iff.1 hy, sub_zero] at key
  refine ⟨1 + u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_add, pr_one_zero, Fil_one_iff.1 hu1, add_zero]
  · rw [map_add, map_one]
    linear_combination key

name: RG6B.tau_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hs1 := sub_one_mem_Fil (W := W) hs
  have hv : τ - τ' ∈ Fil W 1 := by rw [Fil_one_iff, map_sub, h1, h1', sub_self]
  have hA : Aop W j D s (τ - τ') = τ - τ' := by
    have hpsi : psi (τ - τ') - (τ - τ') = (s - 1) * (τ - τ') := by
      rw [map_sub, h2, h2']; ring
    rw [Aop_apply, ← hpsi]
    exact Rop_psi_sub H hv
  have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, ((Aop W j D s) ^ k) (τ - τ') = τ - τ' := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, hA]
  have := Fil_bot H (m := 1 + (D + 1)) (by omega) (Aop_pow_mem H hs1 hv (D + 1))
  rw [hk] at this
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 this

name: RG6B.s_mul_psi_inv
statement:
theorem s_mul_psi_inv {s τ τi : K} (hτ : psi τ = s * τ) (hi : τ * τi = 1) :
    s * psi τi = τi
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : psi τ * psi τi = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, hi, map_one]
  calc s * psi τi = (τ * τi) * (s * psi τi) := by rw [hi, one_mul]
    _ = τi * (s * τ * psi τi) := by ring
    _ = τi := by rw [← hτ, h1, mul_one]

name: RG6B.nu_psi
statement:
theorem nu_psi (chi : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) {t s τ τi : K} {d : ℕ} (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t)
    (hE1 : ∀ x, chi x = chi (t * psi x)) (hτ : psi τ = s * τ) (hi : τ * τi = 1) (w : K) :
    chi (psi w * τi) = (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi (w * τi)
proof:
:= by
  have e := s_mul_psi_inv hτ hi
  have h := hE1 (w * τi)
  rw [RingHom.map_mul] at h
  have h2 : (j : ℚ) ^ d • (t * (psi w * psi τi)) = psi w * τi :=
    calc (j : ℚ) ^ d • (t * (psi w * psi τi)) = psi w * (((j : ℚ) ^ d • t) * psi τi) := by
          rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]; congr 1; ring
      _ = psi w * (s * psi τi) := by rw [hs]
      _ = psi w * τi := by rw [e]
  rw [← h2, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← h]

name: RG6B.E1_of_nu_psi
statement:
theorem E1_of_nu_psi (chi : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) {t s τ τi : K} {d : ℕ} (hjd : (j : ℚ) ^ d ≠ 0)
    (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t) (hτ : psi τ = s * τ) (hi : τ * τi = 1)
    (hν : ∀ w, chi (psi w * τi) = (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi (w * τi)) (x : K) :
    chi x = chi (t * psi x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = (x * τ) * τi := by rw [mul_assoc, hi, mul_one]
  have e := s_mul_psi_inv hτ hi
  have h2 : (j : ℚ) ^ d • (t * psi x) = psi (x * τ) * τi := by
    have hpx : psi x = psi (x * τ) * psi τi := by
      rw [← RingHom.map_mul, mul_assoc, hi, mul_one]
    calc (j : ℚ) ^ d • (t * psi x) = psi (x * τ) * (((j : ℚ) ^ d • t) * psi τi) := by
          rw [hpx, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]; congr 1; ring
      _ = psi (x * τ) * (s * psi τi) := by rw [hs]
      _ = psi (x * τ) * τi := by rw [e]
  have h3 : (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi (t * psi x) = (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi x := by
    rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul, h2, hν, ← hx]
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hjd h3).symm

name: RG6B.nu_eq_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have h := nu_psi chi hs hE1 hτ hi w
  rw [H.psi_eq hw, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  have hne : (j : ℚ) ^ p ≠ (j : ℚ) ^ d := fun h' =>
    hp (Nat.pow_right_injective H.hj (by exact_mod_cast h'))
  have h4 : ((j : ℚ) ^ p - (j : ℚ) ^ d) * chi (w * τi) = 0 := by rw [sub_mul]; linarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h4 with h5 | h5
  · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.1 h5) hne
  · exact h5

name: RG6B.chi_eq_proj
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : x = (x * τ) * τi := by rw [mul_assoc, hi, mul_one]
  calc chi x = chi ((x * τ) * τi) := by rw [← h1]
    _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), chi (pr W p (x * τ) * τi) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [sum_pr H (x * τ)]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
    _ = chi (pr W d (x * τ) * τi) := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_single d (fun p _ hp => ?_) (fun hd => ?_)
        · exact nu_eq_zero_of_mem H chi hs hE1 hτ hi (pr_mem p _) hp
        · have hd' : D < d := by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hd
          rw [pr_eq_zero_of_bound H hd', zero_mul, map_zero]

name: RG6B.chi_eq_zero_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi_eq_proj H chi hs hE1 hτ hi x, pr_eq_zero_of_bound H hd, zero_mul, map_zero]

name: RG6B.E1_to_E2
statement:
theorem E1_to_E2 (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (chi : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) {t s : K} {d : ℕ}
    (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t) (hs0 : pr W 0 s = 1) (hE1 : ∀ x, chi x = chi (t * psi x)) :
    ∃ τ τi : K, pr W 0 τ = 1 ∧ psi τ = s * τ ∧ τ * τi = 1 ∧
      (∀ {p : ℕ} {w : K}, w ∈ W p → p ≠ d → chi (w * τi) = 0) ∧
      (∀ w, chi (psi w * τi) = (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi (w * τi)) ∧
      (∀ x, chi x = chi (pr W d (x * τ) * τi))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, h0, hτ⟩ := exists_tau H hs0
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := isUnit_of_pr_zero H h0
  refine ⟨τ, ↑u⁻¹, h0, hτ, ?_, ?_, nu_psi chi hs hE1 hτ ?_, chi_eq_proj H chi hs hE1 hτ ?_⟩
  · rw [← hu]; exact u.mul_inv
  · intro p w hw hp
    exact nu_eq_zero_of_mem H chi hs hE1 hτ (by rw [← hu]; exact u.mul_inv) hw hp
  · rw [← hu]; exact u.mul_inv
  · rw [← hu]; exact u.mul_inv

name: LambdaNilpotentAR2.lambdaNilpotent_of_ampleGG
statement:
theorem lambdaNilpotent_of_ampleGG [IsNoetherian X] [Nonempty X]
    (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (h : AmpleGG X) : LambdaNilpotent X
proof:
:= by
  refine lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent
    (rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_isNilpotent_sub_rank hrank ?_)
  intro E r hE
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hgL, hgLE⟩ := h E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hLE : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L E) r := by
    simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hE
  have h1 := isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG r hLE hgLE
  have hl : IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - (1 : K0 X)) := by
    have := isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG 1 hL hgL
    simpa using this
  have hmul : k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X L E) hLE.isFiniteLocallyFree :=
    k0ClassOf_mul X ⟨_, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨_, hE.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩
  rw [← hmul, mul_comm] at h1
  exact (nil_iff _ _).2 (isNilpotent_sub_of_mul (R := K0 X)
    (e := k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) (l := k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (r := (r : K0 X)) ((nil_iff _ _).1 h1) ((nil_iff _ _).1 hl))

name: LambdaNilpotentAR2.isGG_pullback
statement: theorem isGG_pullback {E : Y.Modules} (h : IsGG E) : IsGG ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, V, ⟨e⟩, g, hg⟩ := h
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map g) := Functor.map_epi _ g
  exact ⟨N, (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj V,
    ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback i).mapIso e ≪≫ pullbackFreeIso i _⟩, (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map g,
    inferInstance⟩

name: LambdaNilpotentAR2.isGG_of_epi
statement: theorem isGG_of_epi {E F : X.Modules} (h : IsGG E) (g : E ⟶ F) [Epi g] : IsGG F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, V, he, p, hp⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N, V, he, p ≫ g, epi_comp _ _⟩

name: LambdaNilpotentAR2.isGG_of_iso
statement: theorem isGG_of_iso {E F : X.Modules} (h : IsGG E) (g : E ≅ F) : IsGG F
proof:
:=
  isGG_of_epi h g.hom

name: LambdaNilpotentAR2.ampleGG_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem ampleGG_of_closedImmersion [IsNoetherian Y] (hc : ResolutionAmbientAR2.HasCovers Y)
    (h : AmpleGG Y) : AmpleGG X
proof:
:= by
  intro E hE
  haveI : IsNoetherian Y := inferInstance
  haveI := hE.isFinitePresentation
  have hfp : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite i E
  obtain ⟨V, hV, g, hg⟩ := hc ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E) hfp
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hgL, hgLV⟩ := h V hV
  haveI := hg
  haveI := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi i E
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj V ⟶ E :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map g ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom i E
  haveI : Epi e := epi_comp _ _
  have hL' : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X i L 1 hL
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L, hL', isGG_pullback i hgL, ?_⟩
  haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom i L V) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree i L V hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hV
  have h1 : IsGG ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (tensorSheaf Y L V)) := isGG_pullback i hgLV
  have h2 : IsGG (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj V)) :=
    isGG_of_epi h1 (pullbackTensorSheafHom i L V)
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X _ hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : T.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape T
  have hTe : Epi (T.map e) := Functor.map_epi T e
  exact @isGG_of_epi X _ _ h2 (T.map e) hTe

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineHom_ι_of_cover
statement:
lemma isAffineHom_ι_of_cover {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) {ι : Type*} (T : ι → X.Opens)
    (hcover : (⨆ i, T i) = ⊤) (hT : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (T i))
    (hUT : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U ⊓ T i)) : IsAffineHom U.ι
proof:
:= by
  apply isAffineHom_of_forall_exists_isAffineOpen
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ (⨆ i, T i) := by rw [hcover]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  refine ⟨T i, hi, hT i, ?_⟩
  refine (Scheme.Hom.isAffineOpen_iff_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι).mp ?_
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage]
  exact hUT i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineHom_ι_of_isAffineOpen
proof:
:= by
  apply isAffineHom_of_forall_exists_isAffineOpen
  intro x
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩, hxT, -⟩ := X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  refine ⟨T, hxT, hT, ?_⟩
  refine (Scheme.Hom.isAffineOpen_iff_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι).mp ?_
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage]
  exact hU.inf hT

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverExtend_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem coverExtend_isQuasicoherent [F.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens) [IsAffineHom U.ι] :
    (coverExtend F U).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom U.ι (F.restrict U.ι)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverPieceHom₂_appₗ
statement:
lemma coverPieceHom₂_appₗ (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (x : Γ(coverPiece π F U₂, V)) :
    Scheme.Modules.appₗ (coverPieceHom₂ π F U₁ U₂) V x
      = (coverExtendHom F U₁).app (U₂.ι ''ᵁ (U₂.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (π ⁻¹ᵁ V))) x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverPieceHom_appₗ'
statement:
lemma coverPieceHom_appₗ' (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (x : Γ(coverPiece π F U₁, V)) :
    Scheme.Modules.appₗ (coverPieceHom π (coverExtend F U₁) U₂) V x
      = (coverExtendHom (coverExtend F U₁) U₂).app (π ⁻¹ᵁ V) x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderU_apply
statement:
lemma coverLadderU_apply (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F, V)) (i : ι) :
    coverLadderU π F U V x i = Scheme.Modules.appₗ (coverPieceHom π F (U i)) V x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderD_apply
statement:
lemma coverLadderD_apply (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (s : ∀ i, Γ(coverPiece π F (U i), V)) (p : ι × ι) :
    coverLadderD π F U V s p
      = Scheme.Modules.appₗ (coverPieceHom π (coverExtend F (U p.1)) (U p.2)) V (s p.1)
        - Scheme.Modules.appₗ (coverPieceHom₂ π F (U p.1) (U p.2)) V (s p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderU_mapₗ
statement:
lemma coverLadderU_mapₗ {V W : (Spec R).Opens} (h : W ⟶ V)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F, V)) (i : ι) :
    coverLadderU π F U W (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F).mapₗ h x) i
      = (coverPiece π F (U i)).mapₗ h (coverLadderU π F U V x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverLadderU_apply, coverLadderU_apply]
  exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ _ h x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderD_mapₗ
statement:
lemma coverLadderD_mapₗ {V W : (Spec R).Opens} (h : W ⟶ V)
    (s : ∀ i, Γ(coverPiece π F (U i), V)) (p : ι × ι) :
    coverLadderD π F U W (fun i => (coverPiece π F (U i)).mapₗ h (s i)) p
      = (coverPiece π (coverExtend F (U p.1)) (U p.2)).mapₗ h (coverLadderD π F U V s p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverLadderD_apply, coverLadderD_apply, map_sub,
    Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ _ h (s p.1), Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ _ h (s p.2)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverOpen_eq
statement:
lemma coverOpen_eq (U : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    coverOpen π U V = U ⊓ π ⁻¹ᵁ V
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage U (π ⁻¹ᵁ V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverOpen_le
statement: lemma coverOpen_le (U : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) : coverOpen π U V ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverOpen_eq]
  exact inf_le_right

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverOpen₂_eq_inf
statement:
lemma coverOpen₂_eq_inf (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    coverOpen₂ π U₁ U₂ V = coverOpen π U₁ V ⊓ coverOpen π U₂ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverOpen₂, Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage, coverOpen_eq, coverOpen_eq]
  ext x
  simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_inf, SetLike.mem_coe]
  tauto

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverOpen₂_le_left
statement:
lemma coverOpen₂_le_left (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    coverOpen₂ π U₁ U₂ V ≤ coverOpen π U₁ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverOpen₂_eq_inf]
  exact inf_le_left

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverOpen₂_le_right
statement:
lemma coverOpen₂_le_right (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    coverOpen₂ π U₁ U₂ V ≤ coverOpen π U₂ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverOpen₂_eq_inf]
  exact inf_le_right

name: AlgebraicGeometry.sections_coverPiece
statement:
lemma sections_coverPiece (U : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    Γ(coverPiece π F U, V) = Γ(F, coverOpen π U V)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.sections_coverPiece₂
statement:
lemma sections_coverPiece₂ (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    Γ(coverPiece π (coverExtend F U₁) U₂, V) = Γ(F, coverOpen₂ π U₁ U₂ V)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.preimage_le_iSup_coverOpen
statement:
lemma preimage_le_iSup_coverOpen (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    (π ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≤ ⨆ i, coverOpen π (U i) V
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ (⨆ i, U i) := by rw [hcover]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx'
  refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
  rw [coverOpen_eq]
  exact ⟨hi, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderU_eq_res
statement:
lemma coverLadderU_eq_res (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F, V)) (i : ι) :
    coverLadderU π F U V x i
      = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen_le π (U i) V)).op x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderD_eq_res
statement:
lemma coverLadderD_eq_res (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (s : ∀ i, Γ(coverPiece π F (U i), V)) (p : ι × ι) :
    coverLadderD π F U V s p
      = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen₂_le_left π (U p.1) (U p.2) V)).op (s p.1)
        - F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen₂_le_right π (U p.1) (U p.2) V)).op (s p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadderU_injective
statement:
lemma coverLadderU_injective (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    Function.Injective (coverLadderU π F U V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨F.presheaf, F.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X)
    (fun i => coverOpen π (U i) V) (π ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (fun i => homOfLE (coverOpen_le π (U i) V))
    (preimage_le_iSup_coverOpen π U hcover V) x y (fun i => ?_)
  have h := congrFun hxy i
  rw [coverLadderU_eq_res, coverLadderU_eq_res] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coverLadder_exact
statement:
lemma coverLadder_exact (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤) (V : (Spec R).Opens) :
    Function.Exact (coverLadderU π F U V) (coverLadderD π F U V)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible F.presheaf (fun i => coverOpen π (U i) V) s := by
      intro i j
      have h0 : F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen₂_le_left π (U i) (U j) V)).op (s i)
          = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen₂_le_right π (U i) (U j) V)).op (s j) :=
        sub_eq_zero.mp (congrFun hs (i, j))
      have hle : (coverOpen π (U i) V ⊓ coverOpen π (U j) V) ≤ coverOpen₂ π (U i) (U j) V :=
        le_of_eq (coverOpen₂_eq_inf π (U i) (U j) V).symm
      have h1 := congrArg (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op) h0
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
        ← F.presheaf.map_comp, ← F.presheaf.map_comp] at h1
      exact h1
    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
      (⟨F.presheaf, F.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X)
      (fun i => coverOpen π (U i) V) (π ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (fun i => homOfLE (coverOpen_le π (U i) V))
      (preimage_le_iSup_coverOpen π U hcover V) s hcompat
    exact ⟨x, funext fun i => hx i⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    funext p
    show F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen₂_le_left π (U p.1) (U p.2) V)).op
          (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen_le π (U p.1) V)).op x)
        - F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen₂_le_right π (U p.1) (U p.2) V)).op
          (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (coverOpen_le π (U p.2) V)).op x) = 0
    rw [sub_eq_zero, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ← F.presheaf.map_comp, ← F.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_affine_cover
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_affine_cover [F.IsQuasicoherent] [Finite ι]
    (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (hUaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hUhom : ∀ i, IsAffineHom (U i).ι) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hUhom
  haveI hqc : ∀ i, (coverExtend F (U i)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    fun i => coverExtend_isQuasicoherent F (U i)
  exact Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_exact_ladder _
    (fun i => coverPiece π F (U i))
    (fun p : ι × ι => coverPiece π (coverExtend F (U p.1)) (U p.2))
    (fun i => coverPiece_isQuasicoherent π F (U i) (hUaff i))
    (fun p => coverPiece_isQuasicoherent π (coverExtend F (U p.1)) (U p.2) (hUaff p.2))
    (coverLadderU π F U) (coverLadderD π F U)
    (fun h x i => coverLadderU_mapₗ π F U h x i)
    (fun h s p => coverLadderD_mapₗ π F U h s p)
    (fun V => coverLadderU_injective π F U hcover V)
    (fun V => coverLadder_exact π F U hcover V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_compactSpace
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_compactSpace [CompactSpace X]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))] [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Us, hUs, hUf, hEq⟩ := X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_finite_of_isCompact
    (U := (⊤ : X.Opens)) (by simpa using isCompact_univ)
  haveI : Finite ↥Us := hUf
  refine isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_affine_cover π F (fun V : ↥Us => (V : X.Opens)) ?_
    (fun V => hUs V.2) (fun V => isAffineHom_ι_of_isAffineOpen (hUs V.2))
  rw [← sSup_eq_iSup']
  exact hEq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.Phi_Psi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.Phi_twistNeg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.Phi_pbP
statement:
theorem Phi_pbP (a : K0 Y) :
    Phi g n (pbP g n a) = (cover g n).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (cover_hpos g n) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveBundlePullbackK0_cover_apply]
  simp only [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]

  have h : (coverIso g n).hom ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n) = (cover g n).toBase :=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.canon_neg_one_pow
statement:
theorem canon_neg_one_pow (m : ℕ) :
    ((cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) ^ m =
      (cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul
      _ (cover_hpos g n)]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.rel_cover
statement:
theorem rel_cover :
    (1 + -(cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) ^ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set C := cover g n with hC
  have hpos := cover_hpos g n
  have hE := cover_hasConstantRank (Y := Y) n
  have hk := C.k0_relation_koszul hpos (Nat.succ_pos n) hE
  have hc : Nat.card (J.{u} n) = n + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr Equiv.ulift]; simp
  have hl : ∀ r : ℕ, lambdaClass Y (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.FreeM Y (J.{u} n))
      hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r = (((n + 1).choose r : ℕ) : K0 Y) := by
    intro r
    have h := lambdaClass_free Y (J.{u} n) hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r
    rw [hc] at h
    exact h
  simp only [hl, map_natCast] at hk
  set z := C.tautologicalK0Class with hz
  set w := C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1) with hw
  have hzw : z * w = 1 := by
    rw [hz, SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautologicalK0Class, hw,
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul C hpos,
      show (1 : ℤ) + -1 = 0 by norm_num,
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero]
  calc (1 + -w) ^ (n + 1)
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1),
          (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ m * (((n + 1).choose m : ℕ) : K0 C.scheme) * z ^ (n + 1 - m) *
            w ^ (n + 1) := by
        rw [add_comm, add_pow]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
        have hm' : m ≤ n + 1 := by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hm; omega
        have h2 : z ^ (n + 1 - m) * w ^ (n + 1) = w ^ m := by
          rw [show n + 1 = (n + 1 - m) + m by omega, pow_add]
          have h3 : (z * w) ^ (n + 1 - m) = 1 := by rw [hzw, one_pow]
          rw [show n + 1 - m + m - m = n + 1 - m by omega]
          rw [show z ^ (n + 1 - m) * (w ^ (n + 1 - m) * w ^ m) =
            (z * w) ^ (n + 1 - m) * w ^ m by rw [mul_pow]; ring, h3, one_mul]
        rw [neg_pow, one_pow, mul_one, mul_assoc _ (z ^ (n + 1 - m)) (w ^ (n + 1)), h2]
        exact mul_right_comm _ _ _
    _ = 0 := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hk, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.span_cover
statement:
theorem span_cover (y : K0 (cover g n).scheme) :
    ∃ gg : Fin (n + 1) → K0 Y, y = ∑ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (cover g n).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (cover_hpos g n) (gg i) *
        ((cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1)) ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let C := cover g n
  have hpos := cover_hpos g n
  have hE := cover_hasConstantRank (Y := Y) n
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  let U := C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos
  let w : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ := U⁻¹
  have hwval : (w : K0 C.scheme) = C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-1) := rfl
  let a : Fin (n + 1) → K0 Y := fun i ↦
    (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (n + 1 - (i : ℕ)) * (((n + 1).choose (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : K0 Y)
  have hrel := KoszulK0.aeval_relation (A := K0 Y) (B := K0 C.scheme) (w : K0 C.scheme) n
    (by rw [hwval]; exact rel_cover g n)
  have ha : IsUnit (a ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩) := by
    show IsUnit ((-1 : K0 Y) ^ (n + 1 - 0) * (((n + 1).choose 0 : ℕ) : K0 Y))
    rw [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    exact isUnit_one.neg.pow _
  have hz : ∀ e : ℤ, ((w ^ e : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) : K0 C.scheme) ∈
      Submodule.span (K0 Y) (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ (w : K0 C.scheme) ^ (i : ℕ)) :=
    fun e ↦ SchemeProjectiveBundle.zpow_mem_span_of_relation (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) a w hrel
      ha e
  have htop := C.span_eq_top hpos (Nat.succ_pos n) hE
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span (K0 Y)
      (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ (w : K0 C.scheme) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
    have hy0 := htop (Submodule.mem_top (x := y))
    refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) hy0
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have h1 := hz (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ))
    have e : ((w ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) : K0 C.scheme) =
        C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      rw [show w = U⁻¹ from rfl, inv_zpow', neg_neg, zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
      rfl
    rw [e] at h1
    exact h1
  obtain ⟨gg, hg⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).1 hy
  refine ⟨gg, ?_⟩
  rw [← hg]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.piShriek_k0
statement:
theorem piShriek_k0 {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    piShriek g hn (k0ToG0 _ x) =
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
        (cover_rank g hn) (k0ToG0 _ (Phi g n x))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat (coverIso g n).hom := inferInstance
  change SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
    (cover_rank g hn) (finitePushforward (coverIso g n).inv (k0ToG0 _ x)) = _
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0,
    ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.piShriek_pb_mul_canonical
statement:
theorem piShriek_pb_mul_canonical {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : 1 - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ t) (b : K0 Y) :
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
        (cover_rank g hn)
        (k0ToG0 (cover g n).scheme
          ((cover g n).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (cover_hpos g n) b *
            (cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t)) =
      k0ToG0 Y (b * SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist (cover g n) t)
proof:
:= by
  set C := cover g n with hC
  have hpos := cover_hpos g n
  have hE := cover_hasConstantRank (Y := Y) n
  have hrank := cover_rank g hn
  let L : K0 Y →+ G0 Y :=
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank).comp
      ((k0ToG0 C.scheme).comp ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t)).comp
        (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos).toAddMonoidHom))
  let R : K0 Y →+ G0 Y :=
    (k0ToG0 Y).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulRight
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist C t))
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    have hO := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree t
    have hOpush := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushforward_canonical_isFiniteLocallyFree
      C hpos hE t ht
    have hOacyc := canonical_acyclic C hpos hE t ht
    change SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf Y V hV) *
          k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t) hO)) =
      k0ToG0 Y (k0ClassOf Y V hV *
        SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist C t)
    rw [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pb_mul_classOf C hpos V hV _ hO,
      k0ToG0_classOf,
      derivedPushforward_acyclic C hpos hrank
        (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t))
        (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) hO)
        (fun q ↦ SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pullback_twist_acyclic C hpos hE
          V hV t ht q),
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_pullback_tensor C V hV _ hOpush]
    rfl
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 Y →+ G0 Y ↦ f b) hLR

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.finitePushforward_id_kg3
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_id_kg3 (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    finitePushforward (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro x
  change finitePushforward (𝟙 X) (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2) = g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).app x.1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.piK0_pb_zero
statement:
theorem piK0_pb_zero (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (a : K0 Y) :
    piK0 g 0 resY (pbP g 0 a) = a
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst g (toSpec k 0)) := inferInstance
  let e : pullback g (toSpec k 0) ≅ Y := asIso (pullback.fst g (toSpec k 0))
  haveI : Flat e.hom := by
    change Flat (pullback.fst g (toSpec k 0)); infer_instance
  have h1 : k0ToG0 _ (pbP g 0 a) = finitePushforward e.inv (k0ToG0 Y a) := by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 e.hom a) = _
    rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv e) _
  have h2 : piShriekAll g 0 (finitePushforward e.inv (k0ToG0 Y a)) = k0ToG0 Y a := by
    change finitePushforward e.hom (finitePushforward e.inv (k0ToG0 Y a)) = _
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, ← ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp,
      ARRG45C.finitePushforward_congr e.inv_hom_id, finitePushforward_id_kg3]
    rfl
  change resY.res (piShriekAll g 0 (k0ToG0 _ (pbP g 0 a))) = a
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun resY.left a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.piK0_pb_mul_pow
statement:
theorem piK0_pb_mul_pow (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (a : K0 Y) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ n) :
    piK0 g n resY (pbP g n a * twistNeg g n ^ m) = if m = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n
  · have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
    subst hm0
    rw [pow_zero, mul_one, if_pos rfl]
    exact piK0_pb_zero g resY a
  · have hPhi : Phi g (n + 1) (pbP g (n + 1) a * twistNeg g (n + 1) ^ m) =
        (cover g (n + 1)).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (cover_hpos g (n + 1)) a *
          (cover g (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(m : ℤ)) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, Phi_pbP, Phi_twistNeg, canon_neg_one_pow]
    have hstep : piK0 g (n + 1) resY (pbP g (n + 1) a * twistNeg g (n + 1) ^ m) =
        resY.res (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
          (cover_rank g (Nat.succ_pos n))
          (k0ToG0 _ ((cover g (n + 1)).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (cover_hpos g (n + 1)) a *
            (cover g (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(m : ℤ))))) := by
      change resY.res (piShriek g (Nat.succ_pos n) (k0ToG0 _ _)) = _
      rw [piShriek_k0, hPhi]
    rw [hstep, piShriek_pb_mul_canonical g (Nat.succ_pos n) (-(m : ℤ)) (by omega) a]
    have hres : ∀ x : K0 Y, resY.res (k0ToG0 Y x) = x := fun x ↦
      DFunLike.congr_fun resY.left x
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0
    · rw [if_pos rfl, hres]
      have : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist (cover g (n + 1))
          (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
        exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist_zero _
          (cover_hpos g (n + 1))
      rw [this, mul_one]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      have hz : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist (cover g (n + 1))
          (-(m : ℤ)) = 0 :=
        SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_of_isZero _
          (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushforward_canonical_isZero_of_neg
            _ (cover_hpos g (n + 1)) (cover_hasConstantRank (Y := Y) (n + 1)) _
            (by push_cast; omega) (by omega))
      rw [hz, mul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.rel_prod
statement: theorem rel_prod : (1 + -twistNeg g n) ^ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Phi_injective g n
  rw [map_pow, map_add, map_neg, map_one, Phi_twistNeg, rel_cover, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.span_prod
statement:
theorem span_prod (y : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    ∃ gg : Fin (n + 1) → K0 Y, y = ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), pbP g n (gg i) * twistNeg g n ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gg, hgg⟩ := span_cover g n (Phi g n y)
  refine ⟨gg, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (Psi g n) hgg
  rw [Psi_Phi, map_sum] at this
  rw [this]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, Psi_pb]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.adamsRR_caseI_prod
statement:
theorem adamsRR_caseI_prod (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ψP : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n)) →+* K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) (ψY : K0 Y →+* K0 Y)
    (hψ_line : ψP (twistNeg g n) = twistNeg g n ^ j)
    (hψ_pb : ∀ a, ψP (pbP g n a) = pbP g n (ψY a))
    (bott : Multiplicative (K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) →*
      (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ)
    (hbott_one : ((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) : (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ) :
        adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, (1 : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) ^ a))
    (hbott_line : ((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (twistNeg g n)) :
        (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, twistNeg g n ^ a))
    (pushPi : adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)) →+ adamsKLoc j Y)
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ (piK0 g n resY a))
    (y : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j Y) (ψY (piK0 g n resY y)) =
      pushPi (algebraMap _ _ (ψP y) *
        (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass g n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ) :
            adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))))
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, IsUnit ((j : adamsKLoc j Z)) := fun Z ↦ by
    have := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := adamsKLoc j Z) ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z)
    simpa using this
  have hcot : Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass g n) =
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (twistNeg g n)) ^ (n + 1) /
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) := by
    rw [cotangentClass, ofAdd_sub, ofAdd_nsmul]
  have hθ : (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass g n)))⁻¹ :
      (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))) *
      algebraMap (K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, twistNeg g n ^ a) ^ (n + 1) = j := by
    rw [← hbott_line, hcot, map_div, map_pow, inv_div, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
      ← Units.val_mul, div_mul_cancel, hbott_one]
    simp
  have hpush : ∀ x, pushPi (algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))) x) =
      algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j Y) (piK0 g n resY x) := fun x ↦ pushPi_alg x
  exact AdamsProjection.adams_projection_abstract (KP := K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (KY := K0 Y) (BP := adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))) (BY := adamsKLoc j Y)
    (pbP g n) (piK0 g n resY) (twistNeg g n) n j (by omega) (hunit _) (hunit _)
    (by change (1 + -twistNeg g n) ^ (n + 1) = 0; exact rel_prod g n)
    (fun a m hm ↦ by simpa using piK0_pb_mul_pow g n resY a m hm) ψP ψY
    hψ_line hψ_pb _ hθ pushPi hpush y (span_prod g n y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.twistSheaf_rank
statement: theorem twistSheaf_rank : HasConstantRank (pullback g (toSpec k n)) (twistSheaf g n) 1
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_pullback _ (coverIso g n).inv _ 1
    ((cover g n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.twistNeg_eq
statement:
theorem twistNeg_eq : twistNeg g n =
    k0ClassOf _ (twistSheaf g n) (twistSheaf_rank g n).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  change pullbackK0RingHom (coverIso g n).inv
    (k0ClassOf _ ((cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
      ((cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (-1))) = _
  exact pullbackK0RingHom_classOf _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.adamsRR_caseI_prod_blueprint
statement:
theorem adamsRR_caseI_prod_blueprint (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ψP : ℕ → K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n)) →+* K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (hψP : IsNewton ψP) (ψY : ℕ → K0 Y →+* K0 Y) (hψY : IsNewton ψY)
    (bott : Multiplicative (K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) →*
      (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ)
    (hbott : IsBottLine j bott)
    (pushPi : adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)) →+ adamsKLoc j Y)
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ (piK0 g n resY a))
    (y : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j Y) (ψY j (piK0 g n resY y)) =
      pushPi (algebraMap _ _ (ψP j y) *
        (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass g n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ) :
            adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))))
proof:
:= by
  refine adamsRR_caseI_prod g n resY j hj (ψP j) (ψY j) ?_ ?_ bott hbott.one ?_ pushPi
    pushPi_alg y
  · rw [twistNeg_eq]
    exact hψP.rankOne _ (twistSheaf_rank g n) j (by omega)
  · intro a
    exact IsNewton.natural (pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) (pbP g n)
      (fun E hE ↦ pullbackK0RingHom_classOf _ E hE) hψY hψP j (by omega) a
  · rw [twistNeg_eq]
    exact hbott _ (twistSheaf_rank g n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1KG3.adamsRR_caseI_prod_lib
statement:
theorem adamsRR_caseI_prod_lib (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) [IsNoetherian (pullback g (toSpec k n))]
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (hrankY : ConstantRankGenerators Y) (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (pullback g (toSpec k n)))
    (y : K0 (pullback g (toSpec k n))) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j Y) (adamsRingHom hrankY j (piK0 g n resY y)) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 g n resY) (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankP j y) *
        (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (pullback g (toSpec k n)) hrankP hnilP
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (cotangentClass g n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n)))ˣ) :
            adamsKLoc j (pullback g (toSpec k n))))
proof:
:=
  adamsRR_caseI_prod_blueprint g n resY j hj _ (adamsRingHom_newton hrankP) _
    (adamsRingHom_newton hrankY) _ (bott_line j (pullback g (toSpec k n)) hrankP hnilP)
    (locAddHom j (piK0 g n resY)) (fun a ↦ locAddHom_algebraMap j _ a) y

theorem isRegularScheme_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (h : IsRegularScheme Y) :

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_space
statement: theorem isRegularScheme_space (k : Type u) [CommRing k] [IsRegularRing k] (n : ℕ) : IsRegularScheme (space k n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i := by
    have : x ∈ (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i) := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using this
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n i) := by
    haveI : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) k) :=
      isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular k _
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k n i).symm
  have hU := coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n i) := inferInstance
  have hreg : IsRegularScheme (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme :=
    isRegularScheme_of_iso hU.isoSpec
      (isRegularScheme_spec (Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n i)))
  exact isRegularAt_of_openImmersion (coordinateOpen k n i).ι ⟨x, hi⟩ (hreg ⟨x, hi⟩)

name: BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_totalGlobal_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_totalGlobal_of_closedImmersion (k : Type u) [CommRing k]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC4.preimage_hom_inv
statement: theorem preimage_hom_inv (U : A.Opens) : e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U = U
proof:
:= by
  change (e.hom ≫ e.inv) ⁻¹ᵁ U = U
  rw [e.hom_inv_id]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC4.ideal_ker_comp_iso
statement:
theorem ideal_ker_comp_iso [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : A.affineOpens) :
    (i.ker.ideal U).map (chartRingEquiv e U : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A', e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) =
      (i ≫ e.hom).ker.ideal (chartIso e U)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = U.1 := preimage_hom_inv e U.1
  have hle : (⟨e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, (U.2.preimage_of_isIso e.inv).preimage_of_isIso e.hom⟩ :
      A.affineOpens) ≤ U := hW.le
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_map_of_isAffineHom]
  change _ = Ideal.comap (e.hom.app (e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).hom
    (i.ker.ideal ⟨e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, (U.2.preimage_of_isIso e.inv).preimage_of_isIso e.hom⟩)
  rw [← i.ker.map_ideal hle]
  have hρ : A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op = e.inv.app U.1 ≫ e.hom.app (e.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Hom.congr_app e.hom_inv_id U.1]
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.id_app]
    rfl
  rw [hρ, CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← Ideal.map_map,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC4.covers_comp_iso
statement:
theorem covers_comp_iso [IsClosedImmersion i] {r : ℕ} (C : G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) :
    ∀ z : (i ≫ e.hom).ker.subscheme, ∃ j, (i ≫ e.hom).ker.subschemeι z ∈ (chartIso e (C.U j)).1
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz : (i ≫ e.hom).ker.subschemeι z ∈ Set.range (i ≫ e.hom) := by
    have h := Set.mem_range_self (f := (i ≫ e.hom).ker.subschemeι) z
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Scheme.Hom.support_ker,
      (i ≫ e.hom).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := C.covers (i.toImage x)
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx]
  change e.inv ((i ≫ e.hom) x) ∈ (C.U j).1
  have h1 : e.inv ((i ≫ e.hom) x) = i x := by
    change (i ≫ e.hom ≫ e.inv) x = i x
    rw [e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h2 : i.ker.subschemeι (i.toImage x) = i x := by
    change (i.toImage ≫ i.imageι) x = i x
    rw [Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι]
  rw [h1, ← h2]
  exact hj
