name: ARRRIG.pullbackK0_taut_literal
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_taut_literal {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i) {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (t : S ⟶ (C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme) :
    pullbackK0RingHom (t ≫ (C.literalLinearOpen ij).ι ≫ C.chartι ij.1)
      C.tautologicalK0Class = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  have h1 : pullbackK0RingHom ((C.literalLinearOpen ij).ι ≫ C.chartι ij.1)
      C.tautologicalK0Class = 1 := by
    rw [AffineFrameCover.tautologicalK0Class, AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class,
      pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    exact KSpecialization.CIIL3.pullbackK0_classOf_eq_one _ _ _
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback _).app _).symm ≪≫
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ij)
  rw [h1, map_one]

name: ARRRIG.range_chart_subset
statement:
theorem range_chart_subset (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (i : Fin 2) :
    Set.range (ProjectiveLine.chart R i) ⊆
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R 1 i : Set (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  have h2 : Set.range (Proj.awayι (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R 1)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R 1 i) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate_mem_degree_one R 1 i)
    Nat.zero_lt_one) = (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R 1 i : Set (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R 1)) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange, Proj.opensRange_awayι]
    rfl
  rw [← h2]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: ARRRIG.preimage_rho0
statement:
theorem preimage_rho0 (a : Fin 2) :
    rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u} ⁻¹ᵁ SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R0.{u} 1 a =
      Cs.{u}.chartι i0.{u} ''ᵁ Cs.{u}.literalLinearOpen ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_chartι (k := R0.{u}) J2.{u}
  unfold rho0
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.preimage_coordinateOpen, intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen]
  have h := Scheme.Hom.inv_image (asIso (Cs.{u}.chartι i0.{u})).symm
    (linearOpen _ _ ((singleBasis (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u}) a))
  have hl : Cs.{u}.literalLinearOpen ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩ =
      linearOpen _ _ ((singleBasis (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u}) a) := by
    unfold AffineFrameCover.literalLinearOpen singleBasis
    rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hl]
  exact h.symm

name: ARRRIG.chart_factor
statement:
theorem chart_factor (a : Fin 2) :
    ∃ κ : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial R0.{u})) ⟶
        (Cs.{u}.literalLinearOpen ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩).toScheme,
      κ ≫ (Cs.{u}.literalLinearOpen ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩).ι ≫ Cs.{u}.chartι i0.{u} =
        ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a ≫ inv (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_chartι (k := R0.{u}) J2.{u}
  have H : Set.range (ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a ≫ inv (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})) ⊆
      Set.range ((Cs.{u}.literalLinearOpen ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩).ι ≫ Cs.{u}.chartι i0.{u}) := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have h1 : (ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a ≫ inv (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})) y ∈
        rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u} ⁻¹ᵁ SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R0.{u} 1 a := by
      have h0 : rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u} ((ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a ≫ inv (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})) y) =
          ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a y := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      show rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u} ((ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a ≫ inv (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})) y) ∈
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R0.{u} 1 a : Set (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R0.{u} 1))
      rw [h0]
      exact range_chart_subset R0.{u} a ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [preimage_rho0] at h1
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := h1
    exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpe⟩
  refine ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift _ _ H, ?_⟩
  simp

name: ARRRIG.taut_pullbackFrameCover
statement:
theorem taut_pullbackFrameCover {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {E : Y.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover Y E)
    (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).tautologicalK0Class =
      pullbackK0RingHom (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.tautologicalK0Class
proof:
:= by
  unfold AffineFrameCover.tautologicalK0Class AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (C.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso g)

name: ARRRIG.isPullback_pulled
statement:
theorem isPullback_pulled {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Yr R0.{u}) :
    IsPullback (Cs.{u}.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})
      (Cs.{u}.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R0.{u} 1) g
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u}) := inferInstance
  have hp0 : IsPullback (Cs.{u}.pullbackProjectiveMap g) (Cs.{u}.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase
      Cs.{u}.toBase g := Cs.{u}.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g
  refine hp0.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (asIso (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u})) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp [rho0_toSpec]
  · simp

name: ARRRIG.rigid_core
statement:
theorem rigid_core {Z W : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (g : Z ⟶ Yr R0.{u}) (wZ : W ⟶ Z)
    (wP : W ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R0.{u} 1)
    (hW : IsPullback wZ wP g (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R0.{u} 1))
    (σ₀ σ₁ : Z ⟶ W) (h₀ : σ₀ ≫ wZ = 𝟙 Z) (h₁ : σ₁ ≫ wZ = 𝟙 Z) (a₀ a₁ : Fin 2)
    (u₀ u₁ : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial R0.{u})))
    (e₀ : σ₀ ≫ wP = u₀ ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a₀)
    (e₁ : σ₁ ≫ wP = u₁ ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a₁) :
    pullbackK0RingHom σ₀ = pullbackK0RingHom σ₁
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_chartι (k := R0.{u}) J2.{u}
  let D := Cs.{u}.pullbackFrameCover g
  let q := Cs.{u}.pullbackProjectiveMap g
  have hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (Cs.{u}.basisIndex i) = 2 := fun _ => by
    change Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) = 2
    simp
  have hrank : ∀ j, Nat.card (D.basisIndex j) = 2 := Cs.{u}.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  have hE : HasConstantRank Z ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.FreeM (Yr R0.{u}) J2.{u})) 2 :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover D hrank
  have hpos : ∀ j, Nonempty (D.basisIndex j) := fun j => ⟨⟨0⟩⟩
  let Φ : W ≅ D.scheme := hW.flip.isoIsPullback _ _ (isPullback_pulled g)
  have hΦq' : Φ.hom ≫ (q ≫ rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u}) = wP :=
    hW.flip.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ (isPullback_pulled g)
  have hΦb : Φ.hom ≫ D.toBase = wZ := hW.flip.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ (isPullback_pulled g)
  have hΦq : Φ.hom ≫ q = wP ≫ inv (rho0 (k := R0.{u}) eJ.{u}) := by
    rw [← hΦq']; simp
  letI : Flat D.toBase := D.toBase_flat hpos
  have key : ∀ (σ : Z ⟶ W) (a : Fin 2) (u : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial R0.{u})))
      (hσ : σ ≫ wZ = 𝟙 Z) (e : σ ≫ wP = u ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart R0.{u} a),
      (∀ x, pullbackK0RingHom (σ ≫ Φ.hom) (D.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos x) = x) ∧
        pullbackK0RingHom (σ ≫ Φ.hom) D.tautologicalK0Class = 1 := by
    intro σ a u hσ e
    constructor
    · intro x
      unfold AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundlePullbackK0
      rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_eq_flatPullbackK0RingHom, ← RingHom.comp_apply,
        pullbackK0RingHom_comp, Category.assoc, hΦb, hσ, pullbackK0RingHom_id]
      rfl
    · rw [taut_pullbackFrameCover, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp]
      obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := chart_factor a
      have : (σ ≫ Φ.hom) ≫ q = (u ≫ κ) ≫ (Cs.{u}.literalLinearOpen ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩).ι ≫
          Cs.{u}.chartι i0.{u} := by
        rw [Category.assoc, hΦq, ← Category.assoc σ wP, e, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← hκ]
      rw [this]
      exact pullbackK0_taut_literal Cs.{u} ⟨i0.{u}, eJ.{u}.symm a⟩ _
  obtain ⟨k0a, k0b⟩ := key σ₀ a₀ u₀ h₀ e₀
  obtain ⟨k1a, k1b⟩ := key σ₁ a₁ u₁ h₁ e₁
  have hrig := D.fibre_restrictions_eq_of_rank_two hpos hE
    (pullbackK0RingHom (σ₀ ≫ Φ.hom)) (pullbackK0RingHom (σ₁ ≫ Φ.hom)) k0a k1a k0b k1b
  have hσ : ∀ σ : Z ⟶ W, pullbackK0RingHom σ =
      (pullbackK0RingHom (σ ≫ Φ.hom)).comp (pullbackK0RingHom Φ.inv) := by
    intro σ
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [hσ σ₀, hσ σ₁, hrig]

name: ARRRIG.rigid_deformation
statement:
theorem rigid_deformation (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    (φ : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) [IsNoetherian J.subscheme] :
    pullbackK0RingHom (KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS Y J k φ ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J) =
      pullbackK0RingHom (secInfG Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine rigid_core (closedBaseToInteger Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
    (SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J) (isPullback_totalIntegerP1 Y J) _ _ ?_ ?_ 1 0
    (KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS Y J k φ ≫ polynomialToIntegerLine Y J)
    (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) ?_ ?_
  · rw [Category.assoc, subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase,
      KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS_polynomialToClosedBase]
  · rw [secInfG, Category.assoc, ← totalIsoIntegerP1Product_fst, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    exact prod.lift_fst _ _
  · rw [Category.assoc, subschemeTι_totalToIntegerP1, Category.assoc]
  · have h : (totalIsoIntegerP1Product Y J).inv ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
        prod.snd := by
      rw [← totalIsoIntegerP1Product_snd, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [secInfG, Category.assoc, h, prod.lift_snd]
    rfl

name: ModuleCat.extendScalarsCompOfEq_hom_one_tmul
statement:
lemma extendScalarsCompOfEq_hom_one_tmul
    (f₁₂ : R₁ →+* R₂) (f₂₃ : R₂ →+* R₃) (f₁₃ : R₁ →+* R₃)
    (h : f₂₃.comp f₁₂ = f₁₃) (M : ModuleCat R₁) (m : M) :
    (extendScalarsCompOfEq f₁₂ f₂₃ f₁₃ h M).hom
        ((1 : R₃) ⊗ₜ[R₁, f₁₃] m) =
      ((1 : R₃) ⊗ₜ[R₂, f₂₃] ((1 : R₂) ⊗ₜ[R₁, f₁₂] m))
proof:
:= by
  subst f₁₃
  exact extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul f₁₂ f₂₃ M m

    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom.comp (baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom =
      (baseOpenRestriction (hUV.trans hVW)).hom

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_one_tmul
statement:
lemma baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_one_tmul {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) (P : ModuleCat Γ(Y, W)) (x : P) :
    (baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW P).hom
        ((1 : Γ(Y, U)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W),
          (baseOpenRestriction (hUV.trans hVW)).hom] x) =
      ((1 : Γ(Y, U)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, V), (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom]
        ((1 : Γ(Y, V)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W),
          (baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom] x))
proof:
:= by
  exact ModuleCat.extendScalarsCompOfEq_hom_one_tmul
    (baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom
    (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom
    (baseOpenRestriction (hUV.trans hVW)).hom
    (baseOpenRestriction_hom_comp hUV hVW) P x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_naturality
statement:
lemma baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_naturality {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) {P Q : ModuleCat Γ(Y, W)}
    (l : P ⟶ Q) :
    (baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW P).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map
          ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
            (baseOpenRestriction hVW).hom).map l) =
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (baseOpenRestriction (hUV.trans hVW)).hom).map l ≫
        (baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW Q).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_one_tmul,
    ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_one_tmul]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp
statement:
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    (baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i W)).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map
          (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hVW) ≫
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hUV =
        affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          f M i (hUV.trans hVW)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso_hom_one_tmul,
    ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp_one_tmul]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_isIso_of_comp
statement:
lemma affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_isIso_of_comp
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W)
    [IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hVW)]
    [IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i (hUV.trans hVW))] :
    IsIso (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hUV)
proof:
:= by
  let preMap :=
    (baseOpenExtendScalarsCompIso hUV hVW
      (affineLocalCohomologyModule f M i W)).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (baseOpenRestriction hUV).hom).map
          (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hVW)
  letI : IsIso preMap := by
    dsimp only [preMap]
    infer_instance
  have hcomp :
      preMap ≫ affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hUV =
        affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          f M i (hUV.trans hVW) := by
    exact affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap_comp f M i hUV hVW
  haveI :
      IsIso
        (preMap ≫ affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hUV) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left
    preMap (affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap f M i hUV)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_delta
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_delta
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i : ℕ) (x : S.X₃.H i) :
    openRestrictionHAddHom g S.X₁ (i + 1)
        (Sheaf.H.δ (shortExact_map_toSheaf hS) i (i + 1) rfl x) =
      Sheaf.H.δ
        (shortExact_map_toSheaf
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact g S hS))
        i (i + 1) rfl
        (openRestrictionHAddHom g S.X₃ i x)
proof:
:= by
  let hExtY : HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y) :=
    fun A B a b => IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let hExtX : HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
    fun A B a b => IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let F := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let hLim : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  let hColim : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  let hAdd : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive g
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := hLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := hColim
  letI : F.Additive := hAdd
  let e := (openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  change extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e
        ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj S.X₁) (i + 1)
        ((shortExact_map_toSheaf hS).extClass.postcomp _ rfl x) =
      ((shortExact_map_toSheaf
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact g S hS)).extClass.postcomp _ rfl)
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e
          ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj S.X₃) i x)
  exact @extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta _ _ _ _ _ _ hExtY hExtX
    F hAdd hLim hColim _ _ e _ (shortExact_map_toSheaf hS)
      i (i + 1) rfl x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalConnectingMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma affineLocalConnectingMap_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens) (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f S.X₃ i V) :

      Sheaf.H.δ (affineLocalShortComplex_toSheaf_shortExact f S hS V)
        i (i + 1) rfl x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_delta_naturality
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_delta_naturality
    {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : X' ⟶ Y') [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (SW : ShortComplex Y'.Modules) (hSW : SW.ShortExact)
    (SV : ShortComplex X'.Modules) (hSV : SV.ShortExact)
    (τ : SW.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g) ⟶ SV) (i : ℕ) (x : SW.X₃.H i) :
    Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X'.ringCatSheaf).map τ.τ₁) (i + 1)
        (openRestrictionHAddHom g SW.X₁ (i + 1)
          (Sheaf.H.δ (shortExact_map_toSheaf hSW) i (i + 1) rfl x)) =
      Sheaf.H.δ (shortExact_map_toSheaf hSV) i (i + 1) rfl
        (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X'.ringCatSheaf).map τ.τ₃) i
          (openRestrictionHAddHom g SW.X₃ i x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [openRestrictionHAddHom_delta g SW hSW i x]
  exact (Sheaf.H.δ_naturality i (i + 1) rfl
    (shortExact_map_toSheaf (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact g SW hSW))
    (shortExact_map_toSheaf hSV)
    ((Modules.toSheafAb X').mapShortComplex.map τ)
    (openRestrictionHAddHom g SW.X₃ i x)).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalConnectingMap_restriction_naturality
statement:
theorem affineLocalConnectingMap_restriction_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i : ℕ) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : affineLocalCohomologyModule f S.X₃ i W) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f S.X₁ (i + 1) h
        (affineLocalConnectingMap f S hS i W x) =
      affineLocalConnectingMap f S hS i V
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f S.X₃ i h x)
proof:
:= by
  let g := preimageHomOfLE f h
  let SW := affineLocalShortComplex f S W
  let hSW : SW.ShortExact := affineLocalShortComplex_shortExact f S hS W
  let hSWg : (SW.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g)).ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact g SW hSW
  let SV := affineLocalShortComplex f S V
  let hSV : SV.ShortExact := affineLocalShortComplex_shortExact f S hS V
  let τ : SW.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g) ⟶ SV :=
    affineLocalShortComplexRestrictionHom f S h
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_map, affineLocalConnectingMap_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  exact openRestrictionHAddHom_delta_naturality g SW hSW SV hSV τ i x

lemma affineLocalConnectingPresheafMap_app_apply

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_kernelLift_of_split
statement:
theorem isIso_kernelLift_of_split {A B Q : D} (ψ : A ⟶ B) (d : B ⟶ Q) (ρ : B ⟶ A)
    [HasKernel d] (hψd : ψ ≫ d = 0) (hψρ : ψ ≫ ρ = 𝟙 A)
    (hρ : ∀ {T : D} (f : T ⟶ B), f ≫ d = 0 → f ≫ ρ ≫ ψ = f) :
    IsIso (kernel.lift d ψ hψd)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨kernel.ι d ≫ ρ, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← Category.assoc]
    have : kernel.lift d ψ hψd ≫ kernel.ι d = ψ := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
    rw [this, hψρ]
  · apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι d)).1
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.id_comp, kernel.lift_ι]
    exact hρ (kernel.ι d) (kernel.condition d)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.sum_range_split
statement:
theorem sum_range_split {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (m a : ℕ) (ha : a < m) (e : I → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, e k < m) (hea : ∀ k, e k ≠ a)
    (hinj : Function.Injective e) (hsurj : ∀ j, j < m → j ≠ a → ∃ k, e k = j) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, F j = F a + ∑ k : I, F (e k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_range.2 ha)]
  congr 1
  have h : (Finset.range m).erase a = Finset.univ.image e := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hja, hjm⟩
      exact hsurj j hjm hja
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hea k, he k⟩
  rw [h, Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h ↦ hinj h)]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_kernelLift_chart
statement:
theorem isIso_kernelLift_chart {Om B Lm Lm' Q Un : D} {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (m a : ℕ) (ha : a < m) (e : I → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, e k < m) (hea : ∀ k, e k ≠ a)
    (hinj : Function.Injective e) (hsurj : ∀ j, j < m → j ≠ a → ∃ k, e k = j)
    (pr : ℕ → (B ⟶ Lm)) (inj : ℕ → (Lm ⟶ B))
    (hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, pr j ≫ inj j = 𝟙 B)
    (ψ : Om ⟶ B) (τ : Lm ≅ Un) (co : I → (Om ⟶ Un)) (fr : I → (Un ⟶ Om))
    (hfr : ∀ i j, fr i ≫ co j = if i = j then 𝟙 Un else 0)
    (hco : ∑ k, co k ≫ fr k = 𝟙 Om)
    (hbr : ∀ k, ψ ≫ pr (e k) ≫ τ.hom = co k)
    (x : ℕ → (Lm ⟶ Lm')) (heuler : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (ψ ≫ pr j) ≫ x j = 0)
    (hxa : IsIso (x a))
    (d : B ⟶ Q) (w : Q ≅ Lm') (hd : d ≫ w.hom = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, pr j ≫ x j)
    [HasKernel d] (hψd : ψ ≫ d = 0) :
    IsIso (kernel.lift d ψ hψd)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : B ⟶ Om, ρ = ∑ k, pr (e k) ≫ τ.hom ≫ fr k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA : ∀ k, ρ ≫ ψ ≫ pr (e k) = pr (e k) := by
    intro k
    have h1 : ψ ≫ pr (e k) = co k ≫ τ.inv := by
      rw [← hbr k]; simp
    rw [h1, hρdef, Preadditive.sum_comp]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (fr k), hfr k k]
      simp
    · intro k' _ hk'
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (fr k'), hfr k' k, if_neg hk']
      simp
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ k) h
  have hψρ : ψ ≫ ρ = 𝟙 Om := by
    calc ψ ≫ ρ = ∑ k, co k ≫ fr k := by
          rw [hρdef, Preadditive.comp_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ ↦ ?_)
          rw [← hbr k]; simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = 𝟙 Om := hco
  refine isIso_kernelLift_of_split ψ d ρ hψd hψρ (fun {T} f hf ↦ ?_)
  have hsumf : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (f ≫ pr j) ≫ x j = 0 := by
    have h1 : f ≫ d ≫ w.hom = f ≫ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, pr j ≫ x j := by rw [hd]
    rw [← Category.assoc, hf, zero_comp, Preadditive.comp_sum] at h1
    simp only [← Category.assoc] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  rw [sum_range_split m a ha e he hea hinj hsurj] at hsumf heuler
  have key : ∀ i, i < m → (f ≫ ρ ≫ ψ) ≫ pr i = f ≫ pr i := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hia : i = a
    · subst hia
      haveI := hxa
      refine (cancel_mono (x i)).1 ?_
      have h2 : (f ≫ ρ) ≫ ((ψ ≫ pr i) ≫ x i + ∑ k : I, (ψ ≫ pr (e k)) ≫ x (e k)) = 0 := by
        rw [heuler, comp_zero]
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_sum] at h2
      have h3 : ∀ k : I, (f ≫ ρ) ≫ (ψ ≫ pr (e k)) ≫ x (e k) = (f ≫ pr (e k)) ≫ x (e k) := by
        intro k
        calc (f ≫ ρ) ≫ (ψ ≫ pr (e k)) ≫ x (e k) = f ≫ (ρ ≫ ψ ≫ pr (e k)) ≫ x (e k) := by
              simp only [Category.assoc]
          _ = (f ≫ pr (e k)) ≫ x (e k) := by rw [hA k, Category.assoc]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ ↦ h3 k)] at h2
      simp only [Category.assoc] at h2 hsumf ⊢
      have h4 := h2.trans hsumf.symm
      exact add_right_cancel h4
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, e k = i := hsurj i hi hia
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc ρ ψ, hA k]
  have hf' : f = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (f ≫ pr j) ≫ inj j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Category.comp_id f, ← hsum]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  conv_rhs => rw [hf']
  conv_lhs => rw [← Category.comp_id (f ≫ ρ ≫ ψ), ← hsum]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj ↦ ?_)
  rw [← Category.assoc, key j (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction_eq
statement:
lemma baseOpenRestriction_eq {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    baseOpenRestriction h = Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
proof:
:= by
  unfold baseOpenRestriction Scheme.Hom.appLE
  change (𝟙 Γ(Y, W)) ≫ Y.presheaf.map _ = Y.presheaf.map _
  rw [Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseOpenRestriction_id (V : Y.Opens) :
    baseOpenRestriction (le_refl V) = 𝟙 Γ(Y, V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseOpenRestriction_eq]
  have hmor : (homOfLE (le_refl V)).op = 𝟙 (op V) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hmor]
  exact Y.presheaf.map_id (op V)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction_comp
statement:
lemma baseOpenRestriction_comp {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    baseOpenRestriction hVW ≫ baseOpenRestriction hUV =
      baseOpenRestriction (hUV.trans hVW)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseOpenRestriction_eq, baseOpenRestriction_eq, baseOpenRestriction_eq]
  have hmor : (homOfLE (hUV.trans hVW)).op =
      (homOfLE hVW).op ≫ (homOfLE hUV).op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hmor]
  exact (Y.presheaf.map_comp (homOfLE hVW).op (homOfLE hUV).op).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageToSpec_naturality
statement:
lemma preimageToSpec_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) :
    preimageToSpec f V ≫ Spec.map (baseOpenRestriction h) =
      preimageHomOfLE f h ≫ preimageToSpec f W
proof:
:= by
  simp only [preimageToSpec, preimageHomOfLE, Category.assoc,
    baseOpenRestriction, Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE, Scheme.Hom.resLE_id]
  exact morphismRestrict_homOfLE_assoc f V W h W.toSpecΓ

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageGlobalSec_naturality
statement:
lemma preimageGlobalSec_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (r : Γ(Y, W)) :
    (preimageHomOfLE f h).appTop
        (globalSec (X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme) r) =
      globalSec (X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) ((baseOpenRestriction h).hom r)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (Spec.map (baseOpenRestriction h)).appTop ≫
      (preimageToSpec f V).appTop =
      (preimageToSpec f W).appTop ≫ (preimageHomOfLE f h).appTop := by
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_app, TopologicalSpace.Opens.map_top] using
      congrArg (fun q : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ⟶ Spec Γ(Y, W) => q.appTop)
        (preimageToSpec_naturality f h)
  have hmor : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, W)).inv ≫
        (preimageToSpec f W).appTop ≫ (preimageHomOfLE f h).appTop =
      baseOpenRestriction h ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv ≫
        (preimageToSpec f V).appTop := by
    calc
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, W)).inv ≫ (preimageToSpec f W).appTop) ≫
          (preimageHomOfLE f h).appTop =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, W)).inv ≫
          ((preimageToSpec f W).appTop ≫ (preimageHomOfLE f h).appTop) :=
            Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, W)).inv ≫
          ((Spec.map (baseOpenRestriction h)).appTop ≫
            (preimageToSpec f V).appTop) := congrArg _ hd.symm
      _ = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, W)).inv ≫
          (Spec.map (baseOpenRestriction h)).appTop) ≫
            (preimageToSpec f V).appTop := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (baseOpenRestriction h ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv) ≫
          (preimageToSpec f V).appTop := congrArg
            (fun q => q ≫ (preimageToSpec f V).appTop)
            (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (baseOpenRestriction h)).symm
  exact congrArg (fun q => q.hom r) hmor

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageStructureRingHom_naturality
statement:
lemma preimageStructureRingHom_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (T : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Opens) (r : Γ(Y, W)) :
    ((preimageHomOfLE f h).appIso T).inv
        (structureRingHom T ((baseOpenRestriction h).hom r)) =
      structureRingHom ((preimageHomOfLE f h) ''ᵁ T) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply]
  rw [← preimageGlobalSec_naturality f h r]
  change ((preimageHomOfLE f h).appIso T).inv
      ((preimageHomOfLE f h).appLE (⊤ : (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.Opens) T le_top
        (globalSec (X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme) r)) =
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.presheaf.map
      ((preimageHomOfLE f h) ''ᵁ T).leTop.op
        (globalSec (X := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme) r)
  have hg := Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv (preimageHomOfLE f h)
    (U := (⊤ : (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.Opens)) (V := T) le_top
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hg]
  congr 1

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_map_smulEnd
statement:
lemma openSheafPullback_map_smulEnd (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (r : Γ(Y, W)) :
    let g
proof:
:= preimageHomOfLE f h
    let N := restrictToPreimage f M W
    (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        (smulEnd (R := Γ(Y, W)) N r) =
      smulEnd (R := Γ(Y, V)) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj N)
        ((baseOpenRestriction h).hom r) := by
  dsimp only
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext T x
  change ((restrictToPreimage f M W).smul
      (structureRingHom ((preimageHomOfLE f h) ''ᵁ T.unop) r)).hom x =
    ((restrictToPreimage f M W).smul
      (((preimageHomOfLE f h).appIso T.unop).inv
        (structureRingHom T.unop ((baseOpenRestriction h).hom r)))).hom x
  rw [preimageStructureRingHom_naturality f h T.unop r]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality_comp
statement:
theorem extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality_comp
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    {C₀ : C} {D₀ : D} (e : F.obj C₀ ≅ D₀) {A B : C} (p : A ⟶ B)
    (i : ℕ) (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext C₀ A i) :
    extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e B i
        (x.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ p) (add_zero i)) =
      (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A i x).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (F.map p)) (add_zero i)
proof:
:=
  (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality F e p i x).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_smul
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_smul (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (r : Γ(Y, W))
    (x : (restrictToPreimage f M W).H i) :
    openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f h) (restrictToPreimage f M W) i (r • x) =
      (baseOpenRestriction h).hom r •
        openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f h) (restrictToPreimage f M W) i x
proof:
:= by
  let ZW := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
  let ZV := (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme
  let g : ZV ⟶ ZW := preimageHomOfLE f h
  let N : ZW.Modules := restrictToPreimage f M W
  let F := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let hExtW : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} ZW) :=
    fun A B a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let hExtV : CategoryTheory.HasExt.{u} (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} ZV) :=
    fun A B a b => CategoryTheory.IsGrothendieckAbelian.hasExt _ A B a b
  let hLim : PreservesFiniteLimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  let hColim : PreservesFiniteColimits F := openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  let hAdd : F.Additive := openSheafPullback_additive g
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := hLim
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := hColim
  letI : F.Additive := hAdd
  let A := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf ZW.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  let p : A ⟶ A := smulEnd (R := Γ(Y, W)) N r
  let q : F.obj A ⟶ F.obj A :=
    smulEnd (R := Γ(Y, V)) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj N)
      ((baseOpenRestriction h).hom r)
  let e := (openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
  have hp : F.map p = q := openSheafPullback_map_smulEnd f M h r
  rw [smul_eq_H_map, smul_eq_H_map]
  simp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, Sheaf.H.map_apply]
  dsimp only [q] at hp
  rw [← hp]
  exact @extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hExtW hExtV
    F hAdd hLim hColim _ _ e _ _ p i x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_smul
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_smul (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (r : Γ(Y, W))
    (x : (restrictToPreimage f M W).H i) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i h (r • x) =
      (baseOpenRestriction h).hom r • affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i h x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_map, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [openRestrictionHAddHom_smul f M i h r x]
  exact (HMapₗ (R := Γ(Y, V)) (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom i).map_smul
    ((baseOpenRestriction h).hom r)
    (openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f h) (restrictToPreimage f M W) i x)

proof:

    FpL J hA C (k0ClassOf _ V hV) =
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0 (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total J hA)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)).obj V)
        (finitePushObject (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J) ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
        (DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.pdLE_pushforward_of_regularCover

          (G2C1.hErankC C.toQuasiregular))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection).obj V)
        (finitePushObject (Cov CN).zeroSection ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
        (ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.pdLE_zeroSection CN _ (G2C1.hErankC C.toQuasiregular) V hV) := by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_adaptedCover_Z J hA CN

name: AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.hbcPGate_proved
statement:
theorem hbcPGate_proved [IsIntegral A] [IsIntegral J.subscheme] (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) : HbcPGate J hA C CN
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W J hA
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_W J hA
  let Cq := C.toQuasiregular
  have hE := G2C1.hErankC Cq
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_adaptedCover_Z J hA CN hE
  have hM := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total J hA
  have hEc := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_adaptedCover_Z J hA CN hE
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
  let ε := εL J C CN
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ε := by
    change IsClosedImmersion (G2C1.EιOfIsoC Cq CN)
    unfold G2C1.EιOfIsoC
    infer_instance
  let GP := oeGate A φ J
  haveI := GP.qc
  haveI := GP.fp
  let I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf GP.σ
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
  have hker1 : I.subschemeι.ker = (componentToTotal A J).ker := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact GP.hid
  have hkerE : ε.ker = I.subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [hker1]
    exact Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso _ _
  have hD : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers I.subscheme := by
    obtain ⟨m, jM, hjM⟩ := KG2B.projEmb_total J hA
    haveI := hjM
    exact BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_of_projEmb (R := k)
      ⟨m, I.subschemeι ≫ jM, inferInstance⟩
  let κ := G2GC1.kappa GP.σ ε hkerE
  have hκ : κ ≫ I.subschemeι = ε := G2GC1.kappa_fac GP.σ ε hkerE
  haveI : IsIso κ := G2GC1.kappa_isIso GP.σ ε hkerE
  haveI := G2GC1.isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf A J GP.σ hker1.symm
  let ρ := asIso (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase A J)
  have hsec : ρ.inv ≫ pullback.fst F I.subschemeι = secInf A J :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf A J I.subschemeι hker1
  have hzs : (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ ε = secInf A J ≫ F := G2C1.hzsC Cq CN
  have hzsκ : (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ κ = ρ.inv ≫ pullback.snd F I.subschemeι := by
    rw [← cancel_mono I.subschemeι, Category.assoc, hκ, hzs, Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition,
      ← Category.assoc, hsec]
  have hzs' : ρ.inv ≫ pullback.snd F I.subschemeι ≫ inv κ = (Cov CN).zeroSection := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hzsκ]
    simp
  
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame GP.L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one GP.hL
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank _ (lineBundleDual _ GP.L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank GP.L GP.hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ (lineBundleDual _ GP.L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual _ GP.L)) :=
    (SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback _ F _ 1 hΛ1).isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ hΛW
  haveI hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval GP.σ)) :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional A J GP.σ k φ GP.hL GP.hreg GP.hid
  haveI : Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual _ GP.L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval GP.σ))) V) :=
    CIIL3B.mono_sigmaT_app (pullbackSection F (dualEval GP.σ)) V hV
  have hm : Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor _ (lineBundleDual _ GP.L))
      (sigmaT (lineBundleDual _ GP.L) (dualEval GP.σ)) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V)) := by
    rw [(pushCompat F (dualEval GP.σ) hΛ).ap_eq V]
    infer_instance
  have hbund : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E → Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor _ (lineBundleDual _ GP.L))
      (sigmaT (lineBundleDual _ GP.L) (dualEval GP.σ)) E) :=
    fun E hE => CIIL3B.hmono_of_sectionIsRegular GP.σ hline GP.hreg E hE
  
  have hG : IsCoherentLike _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V) :=
    (finitePushObject F ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
  have hdG := DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.pdLE_pushforward_of_regularCover hM C V hV
  have hdD := PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_cartier GP.σ hM hD GP.hL hbund hG hm hdG
  have hGD := PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.isCoherentLike_pullback I.subschemeι hG
  have step1 := PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_cartier_of_regular GP.σ hM hD GP.hL
    GP.hreg _ hG hm hdG hGD hdD
  have hGE := PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.isCoherentLike_pullback κ hGD
  have hdE := PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_of_flat hEc hD κ hGD hdD
  have step2 := PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_of_flat hEc hD κ _ hGD hdD hGE hdE
  have hV' : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (secInf A J)).obj V) :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ V hV
  
  let η := pullback.fst F I.subschemeι
  let Fz := pullback.snd F I.subschemeι
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback η).obj V
  have eR : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ρ.inv).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ρ.inv).obj N) ≅ N :=
    (pushforwardHomNatIsoPullbackInv ρ.symm).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ρ.hom ρ.inv).app N ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr ρ.hom_inv_id).app N ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).app N
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V)) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (secInf A J)).obj V) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).mapIso (pullbackPushIso GP.σ F GP.hL V hV.isFinitePresentation) ≪≫
      (pullbackInvNatIsoPushforwardHom (asIso κ).symm).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp Fz (inv κ)).app N ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Fz ≫ inv κ)).mapIso eR.symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Fz ≫ inv κ)).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ρ.inv).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ρ.inv η).app V)) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp ρ.inv (Fz ≫ inv κ)).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hzs').app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Cov CN).zeroSection).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hsec).app V)
  have hε : ∀ y, pullbackK0 ε y = pullbackK0 κ (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι y) := fun y => by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply, hκ]
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf, FpL_k0ClassOf, spL_k0ClassOf, hε, step1, step2]
  exact PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_iso hEc e _ _ _ _

name: AdamsRRCaseIILciLCI.arr_caseII_ambient_lci_of_htw
statement:
theorem arr_caseII_ambient_lci_of_htw (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤)) (hd : 0 < r)
    (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    (htw : ∃ G₀ : ZeroGate A J k φ, HtwOf J hA G₀ (oeGate A φ J))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (Zs A J)) :
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j)
        (pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (thetaL J hA C j * locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) x)
proof:

    ⟨CN, hCN, hbcPGate_proved J hA C φ CN⟩ hj x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapSpecMap_chartInv
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapSpecMap_chartInv
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let eU
proof:
:= Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
    let eV := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n i j)) ≫ eU.inv =
      eV.inv ≫ (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_left) := by
  dsimp only
  apply (cancel_mono (coordinateOpen R n i).ι).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι,
      Scheme.homOfLE_ι, coordinateOpen, coordinateOverlapOpen,
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft, ProjectiveTwistSpace, space] using
    (Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι (grading R n)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j)
      (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j =
        coordinate R n i * coordinate R n j by rfl))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapSpecMap_chartInv_right
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapSpecMap_chartInv_right
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let eU
proof:
:= Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n j)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j) Nat.zero_lt_one
    let eV := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n i j)) ≫ eU.inv =
      eV.inv ≫ (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n i j).le.trans inf_le_right) := by
  dsimp only
  apply (cancel_mono (coordinateOpen R n j).ι).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_ι,
      Scheme.homOfLE_ι, coordinateOpen, coordinateOverlapOpen,
      coordinateChartToOverlapRight, ProjectiveTwistSpace, space] using
    (Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι (grading R n)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j) Nat.zero_lt_one
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)
      (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j =
        coordinate R n j * coordinate R n i by
          simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
          ring))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_on_triple_finite_family
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_on_triple_finite_family
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (x y : ι → projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsBase R n M j k)
    (hxy : ∀ a,
      projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
          R n M i j k hij (x a) =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
          R n M i j k hij (y a)) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, ∀ a,
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩) ^ e • x a =
        coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩) ^ e • y a
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩))
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap
        R n M i j k hij) :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapToTripleLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
      R n M i j k hij
  exact IsLocalizedModule.Away.exists_of_eq_finite_family x y hxy

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.gammaSub_eq_X_mul
statement: lemma gammaSub_eq_X_mul : (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = X * PowerSeries.mk (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp
  · simp [coeff_succ_X_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.coeff_zero_gammaSub_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_zero_gammaSub_pow (d : ℕ) :
    coeff 0 ((gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d) = if d = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_pow, constantCoeff_gammaSub]
  rcases d with _ | d <;> simp

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.coeff_gammaSub_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_gammaSub_pow_eq_zero {d n : ℕ} (h : n < d) :
    coeff n ((gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSub_eq_X_mul, mul_pow, coeff_X_pow_mul']
  simp [Nat.not_le.2 h]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.coeff_gammaSub_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_gammaSub_mul (F : A⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n ((gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) * F) = ∑ a ∈ range n, coeff a F
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSub_eq_X_mul, mul_assoc]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, mul_comm, coeff_mul,
      Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ (fun i j => coeff i F * coeff j (PowerSeries.mk (fun _ => (1 : A))))]
    simp

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.sum_range_choose_hockey
statement: lemma sum_range_choose_hockey (d n : ℕ) : ∑ a ∈ range n, a.choose d = n.choose (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih, Nat.choose_succ_succ' n d]
    ring

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.coeff_gammaSub_pow_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_gammaSub_pow_mul (d n : ℕ) :
    coeff n ((gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d * (1 + gammaSub)) = (n.choose d : A)
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, map_add, coeff_one]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn; simp
    · simp [hn]
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, mul_comm (gammaSub ^ d) gammaSub, mul_assoc, coeff_gammaSub_mul]
    simp_rw [ih]
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, sum_range_choose_hockey]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.gammaSub_pow_eq
statement:
lemma gammaSub_pow_eq (d : ℕ) :
    (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d = (1 - X) * (gammaSub ^ d * (1 + gammaSub))
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_add_gammaSub_mul_one_sub (A := A)
  calc (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d = gammaSub ^ d * ((1 + gammaSub) * (1 - X)) := by rw [h, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.coeff_succ_gammaSub_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_succ_gammaSub_pow (d n : ℕ) :
    coeff (n + 1) ((gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d) = ((n + 1).choose d : A) - (n.choose d : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSub_pow_eq, sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_gammaSub_pow_mul,
    coeff_gammaSub_pow_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.coeff_subst_gammaSub
statement:
lemma coeff_subst_gammaSub (f : A⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (f.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)) =
      ∑ d ∈ range (n + 1), coeff d f * coeff n ((gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) ^ d)
proof:
:= by
  have h := coeff_subst' (hasSubst_gammaSub (A := A)) f n
  change coeff n (f.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)) = _ at h
  rw [h, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := range (n + 1))]
  · simp [smul_eq_mul]
  · intro d hd
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hd
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
    by_contra hlt
    apply hd
    rw [coeff_gammaSub_pow_eq_zero (by omega), smul_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.subst_eq_mul_qSer
statement:
lemma subst_eq_mul_qSer (S : A⟦X⟧) :
    S.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = (1 - X) * qSer (fun m => coeff m S)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [coeff_subst_gammaSub, sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, qSer, coeff_mk]
    simp [qSeq, coeff_zero_gammaSub_pow]
  · rw [coeff_subst_gammaSub, sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, coeff_succ_X_mul, qSer, coeff_mk,
      coeff_mk, qSeq, qSeq]
    simp_rw [coeff_succ_gammaSub_pow, mul_sub]
    rw [sum_sub_distrib, sum_range_succ (fun x => coeff x S * (n.choose x : A)) (n + 1),
      Nat.choose_succ_self]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    congr 1 <;> exact sum_congr rfl fun d _ => mul_comm _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB3.gamma_newton_abstract
statement:
theorem gamma_newton_abstract (Λ S : A⟦X⟧) (hS : S * Λ = X * d⁄dX A Λ) (hc0 : coeff 0 S = 0)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (n : A) * coeff n (gammaSubst Λ) =
      ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, qSeq (fun m => coeff m S) p.1 * coeff p.2 (gammaSubst Λ)
proof:
:= by
  set s : A⟦X⟧ := gammaSub with hsdef
  set G : A⟦X⟧ := gammaSubst Λ with hG
  set E : A⟦X⟧ := qSer (fun m => coeff m S) with hE
  have hs : HasSubst s := hasSubst_gammaSub
  
  have h1 : gammaSubst S * G = s * gammaSubst (d⁄dX A Λ) := by
    have := congrArg (gammaSubst (A := A)) hS
    rwa [map_mul, map_mul, gammaSubst_X] at this
  
  have hdG : d⁄dX A G = gammaSubst (d⁄dX A Λ) * d⁄dX A s := by
    rw [hG, gammaSubst_apply, gammaSubst_apply, derivative_subst A hs]
  
  have hs1 : s * (1 - X) = X := by
    have := gammaSub_mul_X (A := A)
    linear_combination (-1 : A⟦X⟧) * this
  have hs' : d⁄dX A s * (1 - X) = 1 + s := by
    have := congrArg (d⁄dX A) hs1
    rw [Derivation.leibniz] at this
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_sub, derivative_X, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero] at this
    linear_combination this
  have hXs : X * (1 + s) = s := by
    have := gammaSub_mul_X (A := A)
    linear_combination this
  have hunit : (1 + s) * (1 - X) = 1 := one_add_gammaSub_mul_one_sub
  have hSE : gammaSubst S = (1 - X) * E := by
    rw [gammaSubst_apply]; exact subst_eq_mul_qSer S
  set D : A⟦X⟧ := gammaSubst (d⁄dX A Λ) with hD
  have key : (1 - X) * (X * d⁄dX A G) = (1 - X) * (E * G) := by
    have h2 : (1 - X) * (E * G) = s * D := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← hSE, h1]
    rw [h2, hdG]
    linear_combination (X * D) * hs' + D * hXs
  have key2 : X * d⁄dX A G = E * G := by
    linear_combination (1 + s) * key - (X * d⁄dX A G - E * G) * hunit
  have hcoef := congrArg (coeff n) key2
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp [qSeq, hc0]
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, coeff_mul] at hcoef
    rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : A) * coeff (n + 1) G = coeff (n + 1) G * ((n : A) + 1) by
      push_cast; ring, hcoef]
    simp only [hE, qSer, coeff_mk]

name: SchemeKTheory.qOp_zero
statement: lemma qOp_zero (x : K0 Y) : qOp Y 0 x = 0
proof: := by simp [qOp]

name: SchemeKTheory.coeff_zero_adamsSeries
statement: lemma coeff_zero_adamsSeries (x : K0 Y) : coeff 0 (adamsSeries Y x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change coeff 0 (logDeriv _) = 0
  simp only [logDeriv, mul_assoc, coeff_zero_X_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.qSeq_adamsSeries
statement:
lemma qSeq_adamsSeries (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Y) :
    qSeq (fun m => coeff m (adamsSeries Y x)) k = qOp Y k x
proof:
:= by
  rw [qSeq, qOp, range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (Nat.succ_pos k),
    Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, coeff_zero_adamsSeries, zero_add]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [coeff_adamsSeries]
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_newton
statement:
theorem gammaOp_newton (n : ℕ) (x : K0 Y) :
    (n : K0 Y) * gammaOp Y n x = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, qOp Y p.1 x * gammaOp Y p.2 x
proof:
:= by
  have h := gamma_newton_abstract
    ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧) (adamsSeries Y x)
    (adamsSeries_mul_lambda Y x) (coeff_zero_adamsSeries Y x) n
  simp only [qSeq_adamsSeries] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.qOp_add_sum_eq
statement:
lemma qOp_add_sum_eq (n : ℕ) (x : K0 Y) :
    qOp Y n x + ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal n).erase (n, 0), qOp Y p.1 x * gammaOp Y p.2 x =
      (n : K0 Y) * gammaOp Y n x
proof:
:= by
  have h := gammaOp_newton Y n x
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (show (n, 0) ∈ antidiagonal n by simp), gammaOp_zero,
    mul_one] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.qOp_mem_FilGamma
statement:
theorem qOp_mem_FilGamma {x : K0 Y} (hx : x ∈ rankZeroIdeal Y) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → qOp Y k x ∈ FilGamma Y k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    have hS : ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal n).erase (n, 0), qOp Y p.1 x * gammaOp Y p.2 x ∈
        FilGamma Y n := by
      refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun p hp => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      obtain ⟨hne, hsum⟩ := hp
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.1 with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0, qOp_zero, zero_mul]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
      · have hp2 : p.2 ≠ 0 := by
          intro h2
          apply hne
          ext
          · simp only; omega
          · exact h2
        have hp1 : p.1 < n := by omega
        have h1 := ih p.1 hp1 h0
        have h2 : gammaOp Y p.2 x ∈ FilGamma Y p.2 :=
          Ideal.subset_span ⟨[(p.2, x)], by simpa using hx, by simp, by simp⟩
        have := FilGamma_mul_mem h1 h2
        rwa [show p.1 + p.2 = n from hsum] at this
    have hn' : (n : K0 Y) * gammaOp Y n x ∈ FilGamma Y n := by
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ?_)
      exact ⟨[(n, x)], by simpa using hx, by simp, by simp⟩
    rw [← qOp_add_sum_eq Y n x] at hn'
    exact (Ideal.add_mem_iff_left _ hS).1 hn'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_overEquiv_functor
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_overEquiv_functor (U : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.instIsDenseSubsiteSubtypeMemOverGrothendieckTopologyOverInverseOverEquivalence
  let F := U.overEquivalence.symm.functor
  letI : F.IsDenseSubsite (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier)
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) := by
    change U.overEquivalence.inverse.IsDenseSubsite
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier) ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
    infer_instance
  letI : ∀ V, (Over.post F).IsContinuous
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier).over V)
      (((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).over (F.obj V)) :=
    fun V ↦ Functor.isContinuous_of_coverPreserving
      (compatiblePreservingOfFlat _ _)
      (CoverPreserving.overPost V (Functor.IsDenseSubsite.coverPreserving _ _ F))
  change ((SheafOfModules.pushforward
    (U.overPullbackSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
  exact SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint
    U.overEquivalence.symm.functor
    (U.overPullbackSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit U X.ringCatSheaf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_overEquiv_inverse
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_overEquiv_inverse (U : X.Opens)
    (M : U.toScheme.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).inverse.obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.instIsDenseSubsiteSubtypeMemOverGrothendieckTopologyOverInverseOverEquivalence
  let F := U.overEquivalence.functor
  letI : F.IsDenseSubsite ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier) := by
    change U.overEquivalence.functor.IsDenseSubsite
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier)
    infer_instance
  letI : ∀ V, (Over.post F).IsContinuous
      (((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).over V)
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier).over (F.obj V)) :=
    fun V ↦ Functor.isContinuous_of_coverPreserving
      (compatiblePreservingOfFlat _ _)
      (CoverPreserving.overPost V (Functor.IsDenseSubsite.coverPreserving _ _ F))
  let M' : SheafOfModules.{u} (U.sheafRestrict.obj X.ringCatSheaf) := M
  letI : M'.IsQuasicoherent := by
    dsimp [M']
    infer_instance
  change ((SheafOfModules.pushforward
    (U.sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv).obj M').IsQuasicoherent
  exact SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint
    U.overEquivalence.functor
    (U.sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverInverseUnit U X.ringCatSheaf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_affine_open_restrictions
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_affine_open_restrictions
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ (U : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M)).IsQuasicoherent) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  let C := Y.affineOpenCover.openCover
  let U : C.I₀ → Y.Opens := fun i ↦ (C.f i).opensRange
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 C.isOpenCover_opensRange
  letI : ∀ i, (P.over (U i)).IsQuasicoherent := fun i ↦ by
    have hAffine : IsAffineOpen (U i) := isAffineOpen_opensRange (C.f i)
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ (U i))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι).obj M)
    letI : Q.IsQuasicoherent := h (U i) hAffine
    let R := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj P
    letI : R.IsQuasicoherent :=
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        (restrictPushforwardIso f (U i) M).symm inferInstance
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj R
    letI : N.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_overEquiv_inverse (U i) R
    let e : P.over (U i) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (P.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app P)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso
      e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop P U hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  apply isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_affine_open_restrictions f M
  intro U hU
  letI : IsAffine U.toScheme := hU
  letI : IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme := hU.preimage f
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  exact isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine (f ∣_ U) N

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalSectionsBaseChange_of_isAffineHom
statement:
theorem affineLocalSectionsBaseChange_of_isAffineHom
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    AffineLocalSectionsBaseChange f M
proof:
:= by
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom f M
  intro V W h hV hW
  exact affineLocalSectionsBaseChange_of_pushforward_isQuasicoherent
    f M h hV hW

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_zero_of_isAffineHom

theorem affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_zero_of_isAffineHom
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f] (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso_hom_app (M : P.Modules) :
    (pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp).hom.app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M) ≫
        (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map
          ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp).hom.app M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M)
  let b := (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)
  let c := (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp).hom.app M)
  let d := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).obj M)
  change a ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ b ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ c ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ d = a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ d
  exact (congrArg (fun k => a ≫ k) (Category.id_comp (b ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ c ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ d))).trans
    ((congrArg (fun k => a ≫ b ≫ k) (Category.id_comp (c ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ d))).trans
      (congrArg (fun k => a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ k) (Category.id_comp d)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso_comp_inv
statement:
theorem pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso_comp_inv (M : P.Modules) :
    (pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').inv.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).obj M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M) ≫
        (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map
          ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp).hom.app M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso_hom_app]
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M)
  let b := (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)
  let c := (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp).hom.app M)
  let d := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).obj M)
  change (a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ d.hom) ≫ d.inv = a ≫ b ≫ c
  exact (Category.assoc a (b ≫ c ≫ d.hom) d.inv).trans
    ((congrArg (fun k => a ≫ k) (Category.assoc b (c ≫ d.hom) d.inv)).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => a ≫ b ≫ k) (Category.assoc c d.hom d.inv)).trans
        ((congrArg (fun k => a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ k) d.hom_inv_id).trans
          (congrArg (fun k => a ≫ b ≫ k) (Category.comp_id c)))))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.pulledMap_restrict_square
statement:
theorem pulledMap_restrict_square {M : P.Modules} {N : Q.Modules}
    {M' : P'.Modules} {N' : Q'.Modules}
    (k : (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M ⟶ N)
    (k' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback p').obj M' ⟶ N')
    (bM : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).obj M ⟶ M')
    (bN : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).obj N ⟶ N')
    (hk : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map k ≫ bN =
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback p').map bM ≫ k') :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map k) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj).hom.app N ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map bN =
    (pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (j' ≫ p')).map bM ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').inv.app M' ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback j').map k'
proof:
:= by
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qX
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback j'
  let Cj := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j qX qQ j' hj
  let Cp := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p qQ qP p' hp
  let a := R.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M)
  let b := Cj.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)
  let c := F.map (Cp.hom.app M)
  let d := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').inv.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qP).obj M)
  let x := R.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map k)
  let y := Cj.hom.app N
  let z := F.map bN
  let m := F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map k)
  let n := F.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p').map bM)
  let l := F.map k'
  let t := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (j' ≫ p')).map bM
  let v := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').inv.app M'
  let P := (pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp).hom.app M
  have hn : x ≫ y = b ≫ m := Cj.hom.naturality k
  have hc : m ≫ z = c ≫ n ≫ l :=
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp F ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor qQ).map k) bN).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => F.map f) hk).trans
        ((CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp F (Cp.hom.app M)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p').map bM ≫ k')).trans
            (congrArg (fun f => c ≫ f)
              (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp F ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p').map bM) k'))))
  have ht : t ≫ v = d ≫ n := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j' p').inv.naturality bM
  have hP : P ≫ d = a ≫ b ≫ c :=
    pastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso_comp_inv j p j' p' qX qQ qP hj hp M
  have hl : R.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map k) ≫ y ≫ z = a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ n ≫ l :=
    (congrArg (fun f => f ≫ y ≫ z)
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp R ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app M)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map k))).trans
      ((Category.assoc a x (y ≫ z)).trans
        ((congrArg (fun f => a ≫ f) (Category.assoc x y z).symm).trans
          ((congrArg (fun f => a ≫ f ≫ z) hn).trans
            ((congrArg (fun f => a ≫ f) (Category.assoc b m z)).trans
              (congrArg (fun f => a ≫ b ≫ f) hc)))))
  have hr : P ≫ t ≫ v ≫ l = a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ n ≫ l :=
    (congrArg (fun f => P ≫ f) (Category.assoc t v l).symm).trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => P ≫ f ≫ l) ht).trans
        ((congrArg (fun f => P ≫ f) (Category.assoc d n l)).trans
          ((Category.assoc P d (n ≫ l)).symm.trans
            ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ n ≫ l) hP).trans
              ((Category.assoc a (b ≫ c) (n ≫ l)).trans
                (congrArg (fun f => a ≫ f) (Category.assoc b c (n ≫ l))))))))
  exact hl.trans hr.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.isoConjugatedMap_restrict
statement:
theorem isoConjugatedMap_restrict {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] (F : C ⥤ D)
    {OA OB A B : C} {OA' OB' A' B' : D}
    (eA : OA ≅ A) (eB : OB ≅ B) (eA' : OA' ≅ A') (eB' : OB' ≅ B')
    (a : F.obj A ≅ A') (b : F.obj B ≅ B') (k : A ⟶ B) (k' : A' ⟶ B')
    (hs : F.map k ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ k') :
    F.map (eA.hom ≫ k ≫ eB.inv) ≫ (F.mapIso eB ≪≫ b ≪≫ eB'.symm).hom =
      (F.mapIso eA ≪≫ a ≪≫ eA'.symm).hom ≫ (eA'.hom ≫ k' ≫ eB'.inv)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  change (F.mapIso eA).hom ≫ F.map k ≫ (F.mapIso eB).inv ≫
    (F.mapIso eB).hom ≫ b.hom ≫ eB'.inv =
    (F.mapIso eA).hom ≫ a.hom ≫ k' ≫ eB'.inv
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc (F.map k) b.hom eB'.inv, hs]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.conormalComparison_eq_nativePulled
statement:
theorem conormalComparison_eq_nativePulled {X Q P : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion (j ≫ p)] :
    ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison j p =
      (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom ≫ nativePulledIdealComparison j p ≫
        (TF3.conormalIso j).inv
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom ≫ f)
    (Category.assoc ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j p).inv.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p))
      (TF3.conormalIso j).inv).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.nativePulledIdealComparison_restrict
statement:
theorem nativePulledIdealComparison_restrict :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
        (nativePulledIdealComparison j p) ≫ (chartPullbackIdealIso j p U V hW heq).hom =
      (chartCompositePullbackIdealIso j p U V e hW).hom ≫
        chartNativePulledIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq
proof:
:= by
  let j' := j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW
  let p' := p.resLE U V e
  have hk := pulledMap_restrict_square j p j' p' ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι V.ι U.ι
    (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι j hW).symm (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p) (chartIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq)
    (chartCompositeIdealIso j p U V e hW).hom (chartIdealIso j p U V hW heq).hom
    (originalIdealComparison_restrict j p U V e hW heq)
  exact hk.trans (Category.assoc
    ((chartPastedPullbackRestrictSquareNatIso j p U V e hW).hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (j' ≫ p')).map (chartCompositeIdealIso j p U V e hW).hom)
    (chartNativePulledIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.chartConormalComparison_eq_nativePulled
statement:
theorem chartConormalComparison_eq_nativePulled :
    chartConormalComparison j p U V e hW heq =
      (TF3.conormalIso (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e)).hom ≫
        chartNativePulledIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq ≫
          (TF3.conormalIso (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW)).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.closed_resLE_of_preimage_eq j V _ heq hW
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_resLE_compositeClosed j p U V e hW
  exact conormalComparison_eq_nativePulled _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalPastingH2.originalConormalComparison_restrict
statement:
theorem originalConormalComparison_restrict :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
        (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalComparison j p) ≫
        (chartConormalIso j p U V hW heq).hom =
      (chartCompositeConormalIso j p U V e hW).hom ≫
        chartConormalComparison j p U V e hW heq
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalComparison_eq_nativePulled, chartConormalComparison_eq_nativePulled]
  exact isoConjugatedMap_restrict (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
    (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)) (TF3.conormalIso j)
    (TF3.conormalIso (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e))
    (TF3.conormalIso (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW))
    (chartCompositePullbackIdealIso j p U V e hW) (chartPullbackIdealIso j p U V hW heq)
    (nativePulledIdealComparison j p) (chartNativePulledIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq)
    (nativePulledIdealComparison_restrict j p U V e hW heq)

name: M1.LCI.tveeLci_independent
statement:
theorem tveeLci_independent (n m : ℕ)
    (i₁ : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n)) [IsClosedImmersion i₁]
    (i₂ : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R m)) [IsClosedImmersion i₂]
    (h : i₁ ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R n) = i₂ ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk R) (toSpec R m))
    (hN₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i₁))
    (hN₂ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i₂)) :
    tveeLci n i₁ hN₁ = tveeLci m i₂ hN₂
proof:
:= by
  letI := ProjectiveCommonAmbientH2.pi_smooth (Y ↘ Spk R) n

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.appLE_congr_hom
statement:
theorem appLE_congr_hom {φ ψ : X ⟶ S} (e : φ = ψ) (V : S.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (h1 : U ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (h2 : U ≤ ψ ⁻¹ᵁ V) : φ.appLE V U h1 = ψ.appLE V U h2
proof:
:= by
  subst e; rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.q_mem
statement:
theorem q_mem (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) {W : X.Opens} {c : Γ(X, W)} (hc : c ∈ baseSubring f W) :
    q.app W c ∈ baseSubring p (q ⁻¹ᵁ W)
proof:
:= by
  have : baseSubring f W ≤ (baseSubring p (q ⁻¹ᵁ W)).comap (q.app W).hom := by
    rw [baseSubring, Subring.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨V, h, a, rfl⟩
    show ((f.appLE V W h) ≫ q.app W) a ∈ baseSubring p (q ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    have hq : q ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ (q ≫ f) ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]; exact q.preimage_mono h
    have hq' : q ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ (p ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
      rw [w]; exact hq
    have hq2 : q ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, w]; exact hq
    have h1 : f.appLE V W h ≫ q.appLE W (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl =
        (q ≫ f).appLE V (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) hq := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
    have h3 : g.appLE V (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ p.appLE (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) hq2 =
        (p ≫ g).appLE V (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) hq' := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
    have e : f.appLE V W h ≫ q.app W = g.appLE V (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫
        p.appLE (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (q ⁻¹ᵁ W) hq2 := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE q, h1, h3]
      have hc : p ≫ g = q ≫ f := w
      exact appLE_congr_hom hc.symm V _ hq hq'
    rw [e]
    exact appLE_mem_baseSubring p hq2 _
  exact this hc

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.dAdd_apply
statement:
theorem dAdd_apply (W : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, W)) : dAdd p q W x = (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ W))))
      ((DD p q W).d (q.app W x))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.dAdd_mul
statement:
theorem dAdd_mul (W : X.Opens) (a b : Γ(X, W)) :
    dAdd p q W (a * b) = a • dAdd p q W b + b • dAdd p q W a
proof:
:= by
  rw [dAdd_apply]
  simp only [map_mul, ModuleCat.Derivation.d_mul]
  refine ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_add _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_)
  · exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _
  · exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_smul _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.dAdd_map
statement:
theorem dAdd_map {W₁ W₂ : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : W₁ ⟶ W₂) (x : Γ(X, W₁.unop)) :
    dAdd p q W₂.unop (X.presheaf.map i x) = (Gpre p q).map i (dAdd p q W₁.unop x)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q.app W₂.unop (X.presheaf.map i x) =
      T.presheaf.map ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map q.base).map i.unop).op (q.app W₁.unop x) := by
    have := q.naturality i
    exact congrArg (fun φ => φ x) this
  rw [dAdd_apply, dAdd_apply, hq]
  have h1 := PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
    (baseMap p) ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map q.base).map i.unop).op (q.app W₁.unop x)
  have h2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (etaN p) ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map q.base).map i.unop).op
    ((DD p q W₁.unop).d (q.app W₁.unop x))
  exact (congrArg (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((etaN p).app _)) h1.symm).trans h2

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.dAdd_base
statement:
theorem dAdd_base (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) {W : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (a : (basePresheaf f).obj W) :
    dAdd p q W.unop ((baseMap f).app W a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dAdd_apply]
  have h := ModuleCat.Derivation.d_map (DD p q W.unop)
    (⟨q.app W.unop a.1, q_mem f g p q w a.2⟩ : (basePresheaf p).obj (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ W.unop)))
  have e : q.app W.unop ((baseMap f).app W a) =
      ((baseMap p).app (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ W.unop))) ⟨q.app W.unop a.1, q_mem f g p q w a.2⟩ := rfl
  rw [e, h]
  exact (ModuleCat.Hom.hom _).map_zero

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.cmp0_d
statement:
theorem cmp0_d (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) {W : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (x : Γ(X, W.unop)) :
    (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 f g p q w).app W))
      (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := (baseMap f).app W) x) = dAdd p q W.unop x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun d => d.d (X := W) x)
    ((PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.isUniversal' (baseMap f)).fac (cmpDeriv f g p q w))
  exact this

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.unit_cmp1
statement:
theorem unit_cmp1 (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) : (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f) ≫
    (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (cmp1 f g p q w) = cmp0 f g p q w
proof:
:= by
  exact ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv_unit (f := cmp1 f g p q w)).symm.trans
    (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.unit_cmp
statement:
theorem unit_cmp (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app (relativeSheaf f) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (cmp f g p q w) = cmp1 f g p q w
proof:
:= by
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).homEquiv_unit (f := cmp f g p q w)).symm.trans
    (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.OMGB.cmp_sectionMap
statement:
theorem cmp_sectionMap (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ f) (U : X.Opens) (V : T.Opens) (h : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (s : (relativeSheaf f).val.obj (op U)) :
    (cmp f g p q w).val.app (op V) (sectionMap q (relativeSheaf f) U V h s) =
      (Nsh p).val.map (homOfLE h).op ((cmp1 f g p q w).val.app (op U) s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (cmp f g p q w).val (homOfLE h).op
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app (relativeSheaf f)).val.app (op U) s)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ => (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.val.app (op U))) s) (unit_cmp f g p q w)
  exact h1.trans (congrArg _ h2)

name: G0SupportLocLCI.gLocMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gLocMap_mk {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : G0 X →+ G0 Y) (m : G0 X)
    (s : Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ)) :
    gLocMap (j := j) f (LocalizedModule.mk m s) = LocalizedModule.mk (f m) s
proof:
:= by
  simp [gLocMap, LocalizedModule.map_mk]

name: G0SupportLocLCI.gLocMap_comp
statement:
theorem gLocMap_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : G0 X →+ G0 Y) (g : G0 Y →+ G0 Z) (x : GLoc j X) :
    gLocMap (j := j) (g.comp f) x = gLocMap (j := j) g (gLocMap (j := j) f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s => simp

name: G0SupportLocLCI.exists_pushforward_of_restrict_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pushforward_of_restrict_eq_zero (ι : W ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] (U : M.Opens)
    (hU : Set.range ι = (U : Set M)ᶜ) (γ : GLoc j M)
    (hγ : gLocMap (j := j) (flatPullbackG0 U.ι) γ = 0) :
    ∃ g : GLoc j W, gLocMap (j := j) (finitePushforward ι) g = γ
proof:
:= by
  induction γ using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s =>
  rw [gLocMap_mk, ← LocalizedModule.zero_mk s, LocalizedModule.mk_eq] at hγ
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hγ
  have hres : flatPullbackG0 U.ι ((t * s) • m) = 0 := by
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def, map_zsmul, ← Submonoid.smul_def, mul_smul]
    simpa using ht
  have hker : (t * s) • m ∈ (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).ker := hres
  rw [KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_closedImmersion
    ι U hU] at hker
  obtain ⟨g0, hg0⟩ := hker
  refine ⟨LocalizedModule.mk g0 ((t * s) * s), ?_⟩
  rw [gLocMap_mk, hg0, LocalizedModule.mk_cancel_common_left]

name: G0SupportLocLCI.ker_gLocMap_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_gLocMap_eq_range (ι : W ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] (U : M.Opens)
    (hU : Set.range ι = (U : Set M)ᶜ) :
    (gLocMap (j := j) (flatPullbackG0 U.ι)).ker =
      (gLocMap (j := j) (finitePushforward ι)).range
proof:
:= by
  ext γ
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    exact exists_pushforward_of_restrict_eq_zero ι U hU γ hγ
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    change gLocMap (j := j) (flatPullbackG0 U.ι) (gLocMap (j := j) (finitePushforward ι) g) = 0
    rw [← gLocMap_comp]
    have h0 : (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).comp (finitePushforward ι) = 0 := by
      refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
      have : finitePushforward ι x ∈ (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).ker := by
        rw [KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_closedImmersion
          ι U hU]
        exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact this
    rw [h0]
    induction g using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
    | h m s => simp

name: G0SupportLocLCI.gLocMap_flatPullbackG0_surjective
statement:
theorem gLocMap_flatPullbackG0_surjective (U : M.Opens) :
    Function.Surjective (gLocMap (j := j) (flatPullbackG0 U.ι))
proof:
:= by
  intro γ
  induction γ using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s =>
  obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ := KSpecialization.AR5R.flatPullbackG0_surjective U m
  exact ⟨LocalizedModule.mk m' s, gLocMap_mk _ _ _⟩

name: G0SupportLocLCI.k0ToG0Loc_mk'
statement:
theorem k0ToG0Loc_mk' (X : Scheme.{u}) (b : K0 X) (N : ℕ) :
    k0ToG0Loc j X (IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j X) b (ARRKG.pe j X N)) =
      LocalizedModule.mk (k0ToG0 X b) ⟨(j : ℤ) ^ N, ARRKG.powers_mem j N⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h : (IsLocalizedModule.iso (Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ)) (ARRKG.locLin j X)).symm
      (IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j X) b (ARRKG.pe j X N)) =
        LocalizedModule.mk b ⟨(j : ℤ) ^ N, ARRKG.powers_mem j N⟩ := by
    refine IsLocalizedModule.iso_symm_apply' _ _ _ _ _ ?_
    change ((j : ℤ) ^ N) • (IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j X) b (ARRKG.pe j X N)) =
      ARRKG.locLin j X b
    rw [ARRKG.zpow_smul_eq, mul_comm, ARRKG.locLin_apply]
    exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec (KLoc j X) b (ARRKG.pe j X N)
  rw [k0ToG0Loc, AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply, h, LocalizedModule.map_mk]
  rfl

name: G0SupportLocLCI.k0ToG0Loc_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0ToG0Loc_algebraMap (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : K0 X) :
    k0ToG0Loc j X (algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X) x) = LocalizedModule.mk (k0ToG0 X x) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ARRKG.pe j X 0 = 1 := Subtype.ext (pow_zero _)
  have h2 : (⟨(j : ℤ) ^ 0, ARRKG.powers_mem j 0⟩ : Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ)) = 1 :=
    Subtype.ext (pow_zero _)
  have := k0ToG0Loc_mk' (j := j) X x 0
  rw [h1, IsLocalization.mk'_one, h2] at this
  exact this

name: G0SupportLocLCI.k0ToG0Loc_locMap_pullback
statement:
theorem k0ToG0Loc_locMap_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (y : KLoc j Y) :
    k0ToG0Loc j X (locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom f) y) =
      gLocMap (j := j) (flatPullbackG0 f) (k0ToG0Loc j Y y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Y)) y
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := s.2
  have hs : s = ARRKG.pe j Y n := Subtype.ext hn.symm
  subst hs
  have key : locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom f)
      (IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j Y) a (ARRKG.pe j Y n)) =
        IsLocalization.mk' (KLoc j X) (pullbackK0RingHom f a) (ARRKG.pe j X n) := by
    rw [locMap, IsLocalization.map_mk']
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (by
      change pullbackK0RingHom f (((j : ℕ) : K0 Y) ^ n) = ((j : ℕ) : K0 X) ^ n
      rw [map_pow, map_natCast])
  rw [key, k0ToG0Loc_mk', k0ToG0Loc_mk', gLocMap_mk, pullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
