name: RT.exists_factorisation
statement:
theorem exists_factorisation (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n), IsClosedImmersion i ∧
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hX
  haveI := isSeparated_of_projectiveIntegralK hY
  refine ⟨N, pullback.lift f j (by rw [hf, hjk]), ?_, pullback.lift_fst _ _ _⟩
  have h2 : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift f j (by rw [hf, hjk]) ≫
      pullback.snd (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k N)) := by
    rw [pullback.lift_snd]; exact hj
  exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ (pullback.snd (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k N))

name: RT.adamsRiemannRoch_top
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_top (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) (hi : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f ∧
      haveI : IsClosedImmersion i
proof:
:= hi
      haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
      ∀ (j : ℕ), 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 X, ARR hY hYreg n i hXreg j x := by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hfi⟩ := exists_factorisation hX hY f hf
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  refine ⟨n, i, hi, hfi, ?_⟩
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
  intro j hj x
  exact arr_of_closedImmersion hY hYreg n i hXreg hj x

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fShriek_restricted
statement:
theorem fShriek_restricted (y : K0 (Amb k)) :
    fShriekK0PI (yk_projectiveIntegralK k) (yk_regStalks k) 2 (iota k)
        (pullbackK0RingHom (iota k) y) =
      piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) (y * (1 - classE k))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) (Yk k) 2
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Yk k ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 2) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft 2
  let resP := resProd (yk_projectiveIntegralK k) (yk_regStalks k) 2
  have hkos : finitePushforward (iota k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1) =
      k0ToG0 (Amb k) (1 - classE k) := by
    rw [CIK1A.finitePushforward_one_eq_cosection (Eb k) (sigma k) (iota k) (eb_hasConstantRank k)
      (sigma_frames k) (ker_iota k), CIK1A.lambdaMinusOne_rankOne]
  have hcomp : ∀ x : K0 (Xc k), piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k)
      (resP.res (finitePushforward (iota k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) x))) =
        fShriekK0PI (yk_projectiveIntegralK k) (yk_regStalks k) 2 (iota k) x := by
    intro x
    have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun resP.right (finitePushforward (iota k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) x))
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at hr
    simp only [piK0, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
    rfl
  have hiG : resP.res (finitePushforward (iota k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) (pullbackK0RingHom (iota k) y))) =
      y * (1 - classE k) := by
    rw [← one_mul (pullbackK0RingHom (iota k) y), finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback, hkos,
      ← k0ToG0_mul]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun resP.left (y * (1 - classE k))
  rw [← hcomp, hiG]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.classE_eq
statement: theorem classE_eq : classE k = pullbackK0RingHom (psi k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (-3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveTwistingK0Class, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (psi k)).app _)

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.hypC_of_snd_eq
statement:
theorem hypC_of_snd_eq (h : (T1N5.coverIso (gY k) 2).hom ≫ pullback.snd (gY k) (toSpec k 2) =
    OMGC.q0 (gY k) 2) : HypC k
proof:
:=
  OMGC.twist_comparison_of_snd_eq (gY k) 2 h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.classE_eq_cube
statement: theorem classE_eq_cube (hC : HypC k) : classE k = tN k ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [classE_eq, ← hC, ← map_pow, pow_succ, pow_two, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul,
    projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul]
  norm_num

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.piK0_one
statement: theorem piK0_one : piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := piK0_pb_mul_pow (gY k) 2 (resY k) 1 0 (by norm_num)
  rwa [pow_zero, mul_one, map_one, if_pos rfl] at h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.piK0_tN_pow
statement:
theorem piK0_tN_pow (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ 2) (hm0 : m ≠ 0) :
    piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) (tN k ^ m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := piK0_pb_mul_pow (gY k) 2 (resY k) 1 m hm
  rwa [map_one, one_mul, if_neg hm0] at h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.alg_one
statement:
theorem alg_one {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (t : A) (h : (1 + -t) ^ (2 + 1) = 0) :
    1 + -t ^ 3 = (t + t + t) + -(t ^ 2 + t ^ 2 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.alg_two
statement:
theorem alg_two {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (t y : A) (h : (1 + -t) ^ (2 + 1) = 0)
    (hi : y * t = 1) : y * (1 + -t ^ 3) = (1 + 1 + 1) + -(t + t + t)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination y * h + (3 - 3 * t) * hi

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.three_eq
statement: theorem three_eq {A : Type*} [CommRing A] : (1 + 1 + 1 : A) = 3
proof: := by norm_num

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fShriek_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fShriek_one_eq_zero (hC : HypC k) :
    fShriekK0PI (yk_projectiveIntegralK k) (yk_regStalks k) 2 (iota k) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := fShriek_restricted k 1
  rw [map_one] at h
  rw [h, one_mul, classE_eq_cube k hC]
  have hrel : (1 + -tN k) ^ (2 + 1) = 0 := rel_prod (gY k) 2
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  have e : piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) (1 + -tN k ^ 3) =
      piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) ((tN k + tN k + tN k) + -(tN k ^ 2 + tN k ^ 2 + tN k ^ 2)) :=
    congrArg _ (alg_one _ hrel)
  have h1 := piK0_tN_pow k 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h2 := piK0_tN_pow k 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [pow_one] at h1
  rw [e, map_add, map_neg, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, h1, h2]
  simp

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.fShriek_twist_one_eq_three
statement:
theorem fShriek_twist_one_eq_three (hC : HypC k) :
    fShriekK0PI (yk_projectiveIntegralK k) (yk_regStalks k) 2 (iota k)
        (pullbackK0RingHom (iota k) (y1 k)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [fShriek_restricted, classE_eq_cube k hC]
  have hrel : (1 + -tN k) ^ (2 + 1) = 0 := rel_prod (gY k) 2
  have hinv : y1 k * tN k = 1 := by
    rw [y1, ← hC, ← map_mul, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul, show (1 : ℤ) + -1 = 0 by norm_num,
      projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero, map_one]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  have e : piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) (y1 k * (1 + -tN k ^ 3)) =
      piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) ((1 + 1 + 1) + -(tN k + tN k + tN k)) :=
    congrArg _ (alg_two _ _ hrel hinv)
  have h1 := piK0_tN_pow k 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [pow_one] at h1
  rw [e, map_add, map_neg, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, h1, piK0_one]
  simp only [add_zero, neg_zero]
  exact three_eq

name: RG6B.constantCoeff_Pser
statement: theorem constantCoeff_Pser : constantCoeff Pser = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Pser, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]

name: RG6B.coeff_expNeg
statement: theorem coeff_expNeg (n : ℕ) : coeff n expNeg = (-1 : ℚ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [expNeg, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RG6B.constantCoeff_expNeg
statement: theorem constantCoeff_expNeg : constantCoeff expNeg = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_expNeg]; simp

name: RG6B.X_mul_Pser
statement: theorem X_mul_Pser : X * Pser = 1 - expNeg
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [coeff_zero_X_mul, map_sub, coeff_zero_one, coeff_expNeg]; simp
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, map_sub, coeff_one, coeff_expNeg]
    simp only [Pser, coeff_mk, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, zero_sub]
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring

name: RG6B.rescale_expNeg
statement: theorem rescale_expNeg (j : ℕ) : rescale (j : ℚ) expNeg = expNeg ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : expNeg ^ j = rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ ^ j) := by rw [expNeg, map_pow]
  rw [h1, exp_pow_eq_rescale_exp, expNeg]
  rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, ← rescale_mul, ← RingHom.comp_apply, ← rescale_mul, mul_comm]

name: RG6B.Pser_scale
statement: theorem Pser_scale (j : ℕ) : C (j : ℚ) * rescale (j : ℚ) Pser = Pser * Theta j
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (X_ne_zero (R := ℚ))
  have e1 : X * (C (j : ℚ) * rescale (j : ℚ) Pser) = 1 - expNeg ^ j := by
    have := congrArg (rescale (j : ℚ)) X_mul_Pser
    rw [map_mul, rescale_X, map_sub, map_one, rescale_expNeg] at this
    rw [← this]; ring
  have e2 : X * (Pser * Theta j) = 1 - expNeg ^ j := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, X_mul_Pser, Theta, mul_neg_geom_sum]
  rw [e1, e2]

name: RG6B.Pser_mul_Tdser
statement: theorem Pser_mul_Tdser : Pser * Tdser = 1
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ (by rw [constantCoeff_Pser]; exact one_ne_zero)

name: RG6B.constantCoeff_Tdser
statement: theorem constantCoeff_Tdser : constantCoeff Tdser = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg constantCoeff Pser_mul_Tdser
  rwa [map_mul, constantCoeff_Pser, one_mul, map_one] at this

name: RG6B.Theta_mul_rescale_Tdser
statement:
theorem Theta_mul_rescale_Tdser (j : ℕ) :
    Theta j * rescale (j : ℚ) Tdser = C (j : ℚ) * Tdser
proof:
:= by
  have h4 := Pser_scale j
  have hPT := Pser_mul_Tdser
  have hRR : rescale (j : ℚ) Pser * rescale (j : ℚ) Tdser = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, hPT, map_one]
  linear_combination (-(Theta j * rescale (j : ℚ) Tdser)) * hPT +
    (-(Tdser * rescale (j : ℚ) Tdser)) * h4 + (C (j : ℚ) * Tdser) * hRR

name: RG6B.constantCoeff_Theta
statement: theorem constantCoeff_Theta (j : ℕ) : constantCoeff (Theta j) = (j : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Theta, map_sum, constantCoeff_expNeg]

name: RG6B.ev_eq_sum
statement:
theorem ev_eq_sum (D : ℕ) (a : K) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    ev D a f = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), coeff i f • a ^ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold ev
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range' (n := D + 1) (natDegree_trunc_lt f D)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [coeff_trunc, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)]

name: RG6B.ev_add
statement: theorem ev_add (D : ℕ) (a : K) (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) : ev D a (f + g) = ev D a f + ev D a g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ev_eq_sum, map_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: RG6B.ev_zero
statement: theorem ev_zero (D : ℕ) (a : K) : ev D a (0 : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 0
proof: := by simp [ev_eq_sum]

name: RG6B.ev_one
statement: theorem ev_one (D : ℕ) (a : K) : ev D a (1 : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev, trunc_one, map_one]

name: RG6B.aeval_trunc_coe
statement:
theorem aeval_trunc_coe {N : ℕ} {a : K} (ha : a ^ N = 0) (r : Polynomial ℚ) :
    Polynomial.aeval a (trunc N (r : ℚ⟦X⟧)) = Polynomial.aeval a r
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ N ∣ r - trunc N (r : ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
    rw [Polynomial.X_pow_dvd_iff]
    intro d hd
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, coeff_trunc, if_pos hd, Polynomial.coeff_coe, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdvd
  have := congrArg (Polynomial.aeval a) hq
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, ha, zero_mul] at this
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm

name: RG6B.ev_mul
statement:
theorem ev_mul {D : ℕ} {a : K} (ha : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    ev D a (f * g) = ev D a f * ev D a g
proof:
:= by
  unfold ev
  rw [← trunc_trunc_mul_trunc, ← Polynomial.coe_mul, aeval_trunc_coe ha, map_mul]

name: RG6B.ev_C
statement: theorem ev_C (D : ℕ) (a : K) (c : ℚ) : ev D a (C c) = algebraMap ℚ K c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev, trunc_C, Polynomial.aeval_C]

name: RG6B.psi_ev
statement:
theorem psi_ev (psi : K →+* K) {a : K} (j D : ℕ) (hpsi : psi a = (j : ℚ) • a) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    psi (ev D a f) = ev D a (rescale (j : ℚ) f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_eq_sum, ev_eq_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_rat_smul, map_pow, hpsi, smul_pow, coeff_rescale, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: RG6B.pow_succ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pow_succ_eq_zero (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ Fil W 1) :
    a ^ (D + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  Fil_bot H le_rfl (Fil_pow H ha (D + 1))

name: RG6B.pr_zero_ev
statement:
theorem pr_zero_ev (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ Fil W 1) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    pr W 0 (ev D a f) = constantCoeff f • (1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_eq_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · rw [map_smul, pow_zero, pr_one_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  · intro i _ hi
    rw [map_smul, Fil_one_iff.1 (Fil_mono (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hi) (Fil_pow H ha i)),
      smul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.succ_pos D)) h

name: RG6B.isUnit_ev
statement:
theorem isUnit_ev (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ Fil W 1) {f : ℚ⟦X⟧}
    (hf : constantCoeff f ≠ 0) : IsUnit (ev D a f)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pr W 0 ((constantCoeff f)⁻¹ • ev D a f) = 1 := by
    rw [map_smul, pr_zero_ev H ha, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hf, one_smul]
  have h2 := isUnit_of_pr_zero H h1
  have h3 : ev D a f = algebraMap ℚ K (constantCoeff f) * ((constantCoeff f)⁻¹ • ev D a f) := by
    rw [← Algebra.smul_def, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf, one_smul]
  rw [h3]
  exact ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hf).map (algebraMap ℚ K)).mul h2

name: RG6B.pr_zero_mul
statement:
theorem pr_zero_mul (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (x y : K) :
    pr W 0 (x * y) = pr W 0 x * pr W 0 y
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x - pr W 0 x ∈ Fil W 1 := by
    rw [Fil_one_iff, map_sub, pr_of_mem_same (pr_mem 0 x), sub_self]
  have hy' : y - pr W 0 y ∈ Fil W 1 := by
    rw [Fil_one_iff, map_sub, pr_of_mem_same (pr_mem 0 y), sub_self]
  have e : x * y = pr W 0 x * pr W 0 y +
      (pr W 0 x * (y - pr W 0 y) + (x - pr W 0 x) * y) := by ring
  have h1 : pr W 0 x * (y - pr W 0 y) ∈ Fil W 1 := by
    simpa using Fil_mul H (Fil_zero_all (W := W) (pr W 0 x)) hy'
  have h2 : (x - pr W 0 x) * y ∈ Fil W 1 := by
    simpa using Fil_mul H hx' (Fil_zero_all (W := W) y)
  have h3 : pr W 0 x * pr W 0 y ∈ W 0 := by
    simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded (pr_mem (W := W) 0 x) (pr_mem (W := W) 0 y)
  rw [e, map_add, pr_of_mem_same h3, Fil_one_iff.1 (add_mem h1 h2), add_zero]

name: RG6B.pr_zero_Td
statement:
theorem pr_zero_Td (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ Fil W 1) :
    pr W 0 (Td D a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Td, pr_zero_ev H ha, constantCoeff_Tdser, one_smul]

name: RG6B.isUnit_Td
statement: theorem isUnit_Td (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ Fil W 1) : IsUnit (Td D a)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_pr_zero H (pr_zero_Td H ha)

name: RG6B.isUnit_th
statement: theorem isUnit_th (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ Fil W 1) : IsUnit (th j D a)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_ev H ha (by rw [constantCoeff_Theta]; exact_mod_cast (by have := H.hj; omega))

name: RG6B.th_mul_psi_Td
statement:
theorem th_mul_psi_Td (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) {a : K} (ha : a ∈ W 1) :
    th j D a * psi (Td D a) = algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) * Td D a
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : a ∈ Fil W 1 := Fil_of_mem ha le_rfl
  have hn := pow_succ_eq_zero H ha1
  have hpsi : psi a = (j : ℚ) • a := by rw [H.psi_eq ha, pow_one]
  have h := congrArg (evHom D a hn) (Theta_mul_rescale_Tdser j)
  change ev D a (Theta j * rescale (j : ℚ) Tdser) = ev D a (C (j : ℚ) * Tdser) at h
  rw [ev_mul hn, ev_mul hn, ev_C, ← psi_ev psi j D hpsi] at h
  exact h

name: RG6B.isUnit_prod'
statement:
theorem isUnit_prod' {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → R)
    (h : ∀ i, IsUnit (f i)) : IsUnit (∏ i, f i)
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_induction f IsUnit (fun _ _ => IsUnit.mul) isUnit_one (fun i _ => h i)

name: RG6B.prod_th_psi_Td
statement:
theorem prod_th_psi_Td (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) :
    (∏ i, th j D (a i)) * psi (∏ i, Td D (a i)) =
      algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ Fintype.card ι * ∏ i, Td D (a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => th_mul_psi_Td H (ha i)), Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ]

name: RG6B.pr_zero_prod_Td
statement:
theorem pr_zero_prod_Td (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) :
    pr W 0 (∏ i, Td D (a i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : pr W 0 (∏ i, Td D (a i)) = ∏ i, pr W 0 (Td D (a i)) :=
    map_prod (pr0Hom H) (fun i => Td D (a i)) Finset.univ
  rw [this]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_one fun i _ => pr_zero_Td H (Fil_of_mem (ha i) le_rfl)

name: RG6B.tau_mul_prod_Td
statement:
theorem tau_mul_prod_Td (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) (hb : ∀ k, b k ∈ W 1) {t s : K} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : Fintype.card ι = d + Fintype.card κ)
    (ht : t * ∏ i, th j D (a i) = ∏ k, th j D (b k))
    (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t) (hs0 : pr W 0 s = 1)
    {τ : K} (h0 : pr W 0 τ = 1) (hτ : psi τ = s * τ) :
    τ * ∏ k, Td D (b k) = ∏ i, Td D (a i)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := prod_th_psi_Td H a ha
  have hU := prod_th_psi_Td H b hb
  rw [hd, pow_add] at hV
  have hUu : IsUnit (∏ k, Td D (b k)) :=
    isUnit_prod' _ fun k => isUnit_Td H (Fil_of_mem (hb k) le_rfl)
  have hTp : IsUnit (∏ i, th j D (a i)) :=
    isUnit_prod' _ fun i => isUnit_th H (Fil_of_mem (ha i) le_rfl)
  have hTm : IsUnit (∏ k, th j D (b k)) :=
    isUnit_prod' _ fun k => isUnit_th H (Fil_of_mem (hb k) le_rfl)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hUu
  have hUi : (∏ k, Td D (b k)) * ↑u⁻¹ = 1 := by rw [← hu]; exact u.mul_inv
  have hpsiUUi : psi (∏ k, Td D (b k)) * psi ↑u⁻¹ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, hUi, map_one]
  have hs' : s = algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ d * t := by
    rw [hs, Algebra.smul_def, map_pow]
  have hpr_Ui : pr W 0 (↑u⁻¹ : K) = 1 := by
    have h1 := pr_zero_mul H (∏ k, Td D (b k)) ↑u⁻¹
    rw [hUi, pr_one_zero, pr_zero_prod_Td H b hb, one_mul] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hτ' : psi ((∏ i, Td D (a i)) * ↑u⁻¹) = s * ((∏ i, Td D (a i)) * ↑u⁻¹) := by
    have hQ : IsUnit ((∏ i, th j D (a i)) * (∏ k, th j D (b k)) *
        psi (∏ k, Td D (b k))) :=
      (hTp.mul hTm).mul ((hu ▸ u.isUnit).map psi)
    refine hQ.mul_left_cancel ?_
    rw [map_mul, hs']
    linear_combination
      ((∏ k, th j D (b k)) * psi (∏ k, Td D (b k)) * psi ↑u⁻¹) * hV +
      ((∏ k, th j D (b k)) * (algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ d * algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^
        Fintype.card κ) * (∏ i, Td D (a i))) * hpsiUUi -
      ((∏ k, th j D (b k)) * psi (∏ k, Td D (b k)) * algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ d *
        (∏ i, Td D (a i)) * ↑u⁻¹) * ht -
      ((∏ k, th j D (b k)) * algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ d * (∏ i, Td D (a i)) * ↑u⁻¹) * hU -
      ((∏ k, th j D (b k)) * (algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^ d * algebraMap ℚ K (j : ℚ) ^
        Fintype.card κ) * (∏ i, Td D (a i))) * hUi
  have hpr' : pr W 0 ((∏ i, Td D (a i)) * ↑u⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [pr_zero_mul H, pr_zero_prod_Td H a ha, hpr_Ui, one_mul]
  have := tau_unique H hs0 h0 hτ hpr' hτ'
  rw [this, mul_assoc, mul_comm (↑u⁻¹ : K), hUi, mul_one]

name: RG6B.E1_to_E2_todd
statement:
theorem E1_to_E2_todd (H : WeightHyp W psi j D) (chi : K →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ W 1) (hb : ∀ k, b k ∈ W 1) {t s : K} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : Fintype.card ι = d + Fintype.card κ)
    (ht : t * ∏ i, th j D (a i) = ∏ k, th j D (b k))
    (hs : s = (j : ℚ) ^ d • t) (hs0 : pr W 0 s = 1)
    (hE1 : ∀ x, chi x = chi (t * psi x)) :
    ∃ τ τi : K, τ * ∏ k, Td D (b k) = ∏ i, Td D (a i) ∧ pr W 0 τ = 1 ∧ psi τ = s * τ ∧
      τ * τi = 1 ∧ (∀ {p : ℕ} {w : K}, w ∈ W p → p ≠ d → chi (w * τi) = 0) ∧
      (∀ w, chi (psi w * τi) = (j : ℚ) ^ d * chi (w * τi)) ∧
      (∀ x, chi x = chi (pr W d (x * τ) * τi))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, τi, h0, hτ, hi, h1, h2, h3⟩ := E1_to_E2 H chi hs hs0 hE1
  exact ⟨τ, τi, tau_mul_prod_Td H a b ha hb hd ht hs hs0 h0 hτ, h0, hτ, hi, h1, h2, h3⟩

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_toSheafify_comp
statement:
lemma modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_toSheafify_comp
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (g : P ⟶ (SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) :
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) P.presheaf ≫
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).map
        (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g)).1 =
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g
proof:
:= by
  let L := modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g
  change
    CategoryTheory.toSheafify
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) P.presheaf ≫
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map L.val =
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf_map_sheafificationHomEquiv_def
    (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj) L]
  have hL :
      PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv
          (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj) L = g := by
    dsimp only [L, modulePresheafSheafificationComparison]
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ g
  rw [hL]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafComparison_stalk_isIso_of_basis_bijective
statement:
lemma modulePresheafComparison_stalk_isIso_of_basis_bijective
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (g : P ⟶ (SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N)
    (B : Set Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hbij : ∀ U ∈ B, Function.Bijective
      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g).app (op U)))
    (x : Y) :
    IsIso
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let FP := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).obj P
  let FN := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).obj
    ((SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N)
  let α : FP ⟶ FN :=
    (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g
  constructor
  · apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_isBasis hB
    intro U hU
    exact (hbij U hU).1
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, s, hs⟩ :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis hB FN x t
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (hbij U hU).2 s
    refine ⟨TopCat.Presheaf.germ FP U x hxU q, ?_⟩
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply, hq, hs]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_isIso_of_basis_bijective
statement:
theorem modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_isIso_of_basis_bijective
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (g : P ⟶ (SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N)
    (B : Set Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hbij : ∀ U ∈ B, Function.Bijective
      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g).app (op U))) :
    IsIso (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g)
proof:
:= by
  let L := modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g
  let T := SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf
  let ℓ := T.map L
  letI (x : Y) :
      IsIso
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map ℓ.hom) := by
    let S := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x
    let η :=
      CategoryTheory.toSheafify
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) P.presheaf
    let α := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g
    letI : IsIso (S.map α) :=
      modulePresheafComparison_stalk_isIso_of_basis_bijective
        P N g B hB hbij x
    letI : IsIso (S.map η) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso
        x AddCommGrpCat.{u} P.presheaf
    have hcomp :
        S.map η ≫ S.map ℓ.hom = S.map α := by
      rw [← S.map_comp]
      exact congrArg S.map
        (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_toSheafify_comp P N g)
    letI : IsIso (S.map η ≫ S.map ℓ.hom) := by
      rw [hcomp]
      infer_instance
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (S.map η) (S.map ℓ.hom)
  haveI : IsIso ℓ :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso ℓ
  haveI : IsIso ℓ.hom := by
    exact Functor.map_isIso
      (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y) ℓ
  have hToPresheaf :
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map L.val =
        ℓ.hom := rfl
  letI : IsIso
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map L.val) := by
    rw [hToPresheaf]
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso L.val := by
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso L.val
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  have hForget :
      (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf).map L =
        L.val := rfl
  letI : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf).map L) := by
    rw [hForget]
    infer_instance
  exact isIso_of_fully_faithful
    (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) L

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison_app
statement:
lemma modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison_app
    {ι : Type u} (b : ι → Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range b))
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (αB :
      (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ P.presheaf ⟶
        (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ N.presheaf)
    (j : ι) :
    (modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison b hB P N αB).app (op (b j)) =
      αB.app (op j)
proof:
:= by
  exact TopCat.Sheaf.extend_hom_app P.presheaf
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) hB αB j

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison_map_smul
statement:
lemma modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison_map_smul
    {ι : Type u} (b : ι → Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range b))
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (αB :
      (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ P.presheaf ⟶
        (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ N.presheaf)
    (hlinear : ∀ (j : ι) (s : Γ(Y, b j))
      (m : P.obj (op (b j))),
      αB.app (op j) (((P.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom m) =
        ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom (αB.app (op j) m))
    (U : Y.Opens) (r : Γ(Y, U)) (m : P.obj (op U)) :
    (modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison b hB P N αB).app
        (op U) (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m) =
      ((N.val.obj (op U)).smul r).hom
        ((modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison b hB P N αB).app
          (op U) m)
proof:
:= by
  let α := modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison b hB P N αB
  let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext F U
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨D, hDB, rfl⟩, hxD, hDU⟩ :=
    hB.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx U.2
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hDB
  have hres :
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
          (α.app (op U) (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m)) =
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
          (((N.val.obj (op U)).smul r).hom (α.app (op U) m)) := by
    calc
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
          (α.app (op U) (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m)) =
          α.app (op (b j))
            (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
              (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m)) := by
        exact (α.naturality_apply (homOfLE hDU).op
          (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m)).symm
      _ = α.app (op (b j))
            (((P.obj (op (b j))).smul
              ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op).hom r)).hom
                (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m)) := by
        exact congrArg (fun z => α.app (op (b j)) z)
          (P.map_smul (homOfLE hDU).op r m)
      _ = ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul
              ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op).hom r)).hom
            (α.app (op (b j))
              (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m)) := by
        rw [modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison_app]
        exact hlinear j
          ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op).hom r)
          (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op m)
      _ = ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul
              ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op).hom r)).hom
            (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op (α.app (op U) m)) := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun z : Γ(N, b j) =>
            ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul
              ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op).hom r)).hom z)
          (α.naturality_apply (homOfLE hDU).op m)
      _ = N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
            (((N.val.obj (op U)).smul r).hom (α.app (op U) m)) := by
        exact (N.map_smul (homOfLE hDU) r (α.app (op U) m)).symm
  calc
    N.presheaf.germ U x hx
        (α.app (op U) (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m)) =
        N.presheaf.germ (b j) x hxD
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
            (α.app (op U) (((P.obj (op U)).smul r).hom m))) :=
      (N.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hDU) x hxD _).symm
    _ = N.presheaf.germ (b j) x hxD
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op
            (((N.val.obj (op U)).smul r).hom (α.app (op U) m))) := by
      rw [hres]
    _ = N.presheaf.germ U x hx
          (((N.val.obj (op U)).smul r).hom (α.app (op U) m)) :=
      N.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hDU) x hxD _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafBasisSheafificationComparison_isIso
statement:
theorem modulePresheafBasisSheafificationComparison_isIso
    {ι : Type u} (b : ι → Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range b))
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (αB :
      (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ P.presheaf ⟶
        (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ N.presheaf)
    (hlinear : ∀ (j : ι) (s : Γ(Y, b j))
      (m : P.obj (op (b j))),
      αB.app (op j) (((P.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom m) =
        ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom (αB.app (op j) m))
    (hbij : ∀ j, Function.Bijective (αB.app (op j))) :
    IsIso (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N
      (modulePresheafBasisComparison b hB P N αB hlinear))
proof:
:= by
  apply modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_isIso_of_basis_bijective
    P N (modulePresheafBasisComparison b hB P N αB hlinear)
    (Set.range b) hB
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hU
  change Function.Bijective
    ((modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison b hB P N αB).app (op (b j)))
  rw [modulePresheafBasisPresheafComparison_app]
  exact hbij j

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafBasisSheafification_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem modulePresheafBasisSheafification_isQuasicoherent
    {ι : Type u} (b : ι → Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range b))
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (αB :
      (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ P.presheaf ⟶
        (inducedFunctor b).op ⋙ N.presheaf)
    (hlinear : ∀ (j : ι) (s : Γ(Y, b j))
      (m : P.obj (op (b j))),
      αB.app (op j) (((P.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom m) =
        ((N.val.obj (op (b j))).smul s).hom (αB.app (op j) m))
    (hbij : ∀ j, Function.Bijective (αB.app (op j))) :
    ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
      (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj P).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let g := modulePresheafBasisComparison b hB P N αB hlinear
  letI : IsIso (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g) :=
    modulePresheafBasisSheafificationComparison_isIso
      b hB P N αB hlinear hbij
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (asIso (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g)).symm
    inferInstance

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.modulePresheafSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basis_bijective
statement:
theorem modulePresheafSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_basis_bijective
    (P : Y.PresheafOfModules) (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (g : P ⟶ (SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N)
    (B : Set Y.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (hbij : ∀ U ∈ B, Function.Bijective
      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map g).app (op U))) :
    ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
      (𝟙 Y.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj P).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g) :=
    modulePresheafSheafificationComparison_isIso_of_basis_bijective
      P N g B hB hbij
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (asIso (modulePresheafSheafificationComparison P N g)).symm
    inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.k0ClassOf_biprod

    (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X _ N (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X I) hN)

statement: theorem TwFree.of_isZero (N : X.Modules) {Y : X.Modules} (hY : IsZero Y) : TwFree N Y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.TwFree.biprod
statement:
theorem TwFree.biprod {N A B : X.Modules} (hA : TwFree N A) (hB : TwFree N B) :
    TwFree N (A ⊞ B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨J, _, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hB
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N) :=
    preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts _
  exact ⟨I ⊕ J, inferInstance, ⟨biprod.mapIso e e' ≪≫
    ((tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).mapBiprod _ _).symm ≪≫
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).mapIso (freeBinaryIso X I J)⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.TwFree.self
statement: theorem TwFree.self (N : X.Modules) : TwFree N N
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PUnit.{u + 1}, inferInstance, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have e1 : (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≅
      tensorSheaf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) N := Iso.refl _
  have e2 : (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.{u + 1}) ≅
      (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X) :=
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).mapIso (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf))
  exact (e2 ≪≫ e1 ≪≫ tensorSheafLeftUnitor X N).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.kos_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem kos_isFiniteLocallyFree (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (((kos R n m).K d).X k)
proof:
:=
  TwFree.isFiniteLocallyFree (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (d + m - k))
    (Koszul.KData.kos_good _ _ _ m d k _ rfl _ (fun _ h ↦ TwFree.of_isZero _ h)
      (fun _ _ h h' ↦ h.biprod h') (TwFree.self _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.kos_classOf
statement:
theorem kos_classOf (m : ℕ) : ∀ (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
    k0ClassOf _ (((kos R n m).K d).X k) (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m d k) =
      (m.choose k : K0 (space R n)) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (d + m - k)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro d k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := Koszul.KData.kos_X0 (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
        (Koszul.x_comm R n) 0 d
      rw [k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _) e]
      simp [projectiveTwistingK0Class]
    | succ k =>
      rw [k0ClassOf_of_isZero _ (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ 0 d (k + 1) (by omega)),
        Nat.choose_zero_succ, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro d k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      refine (k0ClassOf_biprod (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m (d + 1) 0)
        (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree _ :
          IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Koszul.sh ((kos R n m).K d) 0)) _).trans ?_
      rw [ih (d + 1) 0, k0ClassOf_zero, add_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_zero_right]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    | succ k =>
      refine (k0ClassOf_biprod (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m (d + 1) (k + 1))
        (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m d k) _).trans ?_
      rw [ih (d + 1) (k + 1), ih d k]
      have e1 : d + 1 + ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      have e2 : d + ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e1, e2, Nat.choose_succ_succ']
      push_cast
      ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.ι_liftK
statement: theorem ι_liftK (k : ℕ) : kernel.ι ((KC R n d).d (k + 2) (k + 1)) ≫ liftK R n d k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (kernel.ι ((KC R n d).d (k + 1) k))]
  simp [liftK]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.shortExact
statement:
theorem shortExact (i : ℕ) : ∃ (f : Zs R n d (i + 1) ⟶ (KC R n d).X (i + 1))
    (g : (KC R n d).X (i + 1) ⟶ Zs R n d i) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
    (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, hk⟩ := projectiveKoszulData_exact R n d
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨kernel.ι ((KC R n d).d 1 0), (KC R n d).d 1 0, kernel.condition _,
      { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel _
        mono_f := (inferInstance : Mono (kernel.ι ((KC R n d).d 1 0)))
        epi_g := h0 }⟩
  | succ k =>
    exact ⟨kernel.ι ((KC R n d).d (k + 2) (k + 1)), liftK R n d k, ι_liftK R n d k,
      { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (liftK_isKernel R n d k)
        mono_f := (inferInstance : Mono (kernel.ι ((KC R n d).d (k + 2) (k + 1))))
        epi_g := hk k }⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.Zs_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem Zs_isFiniteLocallyFree : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Zs R n d i)
  | 0 => kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) d 0
  | 1 => by
      haveI
proof:
:= (projectiveKoszulData_exact R n d).1
      exact isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel _ (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) d 1)
        (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) d 0) ((KC R n d).d 1 0)
  | k + 2 => by
      haveI : Epi (liftK R n d k) := (projectiveKoszulData_exact R n d).2 k
      have h := @isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel (space R n) _ _
        (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) d (k + 2))
        (Zs_isFiniteLocallyFree (k + 1) :
          IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (kernel ((KC R n d).d (k + 1) k))) (liftK R n d k)
        this
      have e : kernel (liftK R n d k) ≅ kernel ((KC R n d).d (k + 2) (k + 1)) :=
        IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (kernelIsKernel (liftK R n d k)) (liftK_isKernel R n d k)
      exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ e h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.Zs_isZero
statement: theorem Zs_isZero : IsZero (Zs R n d (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (liftK R n d n) := (projectiveKoszulData_exact R n d).2 n
  have hX : IsZero ((KC R n d).X (n + 2)) :=
    Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ (n + 1) d (n + 2) (by omega)
  show IsZero (kernel ((KC R n d).d (n + 1) n))
  refine (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).2 ((cancel_epi (liftK R n d n)).1 ?_)
  rw [Category.comp_id, comp_zero]
  exact hX.eq_of_src _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.classOf_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem classOf_eq_alternating_sum :
    k0ClassOf _ (Zs R n d 0) (Zs_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : K0 (space R n)) ^ i *
        k0ClassOf _ ((KC R n d).X (i + 1)) (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) d (i + 1))
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_eq_alternating_sum (space R n) (fun i ↦ (KC R n d).X (i + 1)) (Zs R n d)
    (fun i ↦ kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) d (i + 1)) (Zs_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d)
    (n + 1) (fun i _ ↦ shortExact R n d i) (Zs_isZero R n d)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.alg_relation
statement:
theorem KoszulK0.alg_relation {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (w : A) (n : ℕ)
    (key : 1 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (-1 : A) ^ i * (((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : A) * w ^ (i + 1))) :
    (1 + -w) ^ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, add_pow, Finset.sum_range_succ']
  have hS : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-w) ^ (m + 1) * (1 : A) ^ (n + 1 - (m + 1)) *
      ((n + 1).choose (m + 1) : A) =
      -1 * ((-1 : A) ^ m * (((n + 1).choose (m + 1) : A) * w ^ (m + 1))) := by
    intro m _
    rw [one_pow, mul_one, neg_pow]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hS, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← key]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.aeval_relation
statement:
theorem KoszulK0.aeval_relation {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (w : B)
    (n : ℕ) (h : (1 + -w) ^ (n + 1) = 0) :
    Polynomial.aeval w (SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A (n + 1)
      (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ (-1 : A) ^ (n + 1 - (i : ℕ)) * ((n + 1).choose (i : ℕ) : A))) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial,
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationLower, map_add, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X,
    map_sum, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C]
  have e : (w + -1) ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by
    have h1 : w + -1 = -(1 + -w) := by ring
    rw [h1, neg_pow, h, mul_zero]
  rw [add_pow, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one,
    mul_one, mul_one] at e
  rw [← e, add_comm, Finset.sum_range]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_neg, map_one, map_natCast]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSpace_k0_relation_add_neg
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_k0_relation_add_neg :
    (1 + -projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)) ^ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := classOf_eq_alternating_sum R n (-((n : ℤ) + 1))
  have h0 : k0ClassOf _ (Zs R n (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) 0)
      (Zs_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) 0) = 1 := by
    refine (kos_classOf R n (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) 0).trans ?_
    rw [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, ← projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero R n]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hi : ∀ i : ℕ, k0ClassOf _ ((KC R n (-((n : ℤ) + 1))).X (i + 1))
      (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (i + 1)) =
      ((n + 1).choose (i + 1) : K0 (space R n)) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ (i + 1) := by
    intro i
    rw [kos_classOf, projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h0, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ by rw [hi i])] at key
  exact KoszulK0.alg_relation _ n key

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSpace_k0_relation
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_k0_relation :
    (1 - projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)) ^ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact projectiveSpace_k0_relation_add_neg R n

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_twist_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_twist_mem_span (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F) :
    letI
proof:
:= (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
    ∃ m : ℤ, k0ClassOf _ F hF * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n m ∈
      Submodule.span (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Quillen.O R n (-(i : ℤ))) := by
  letI := (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFinitePresentation
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Regularity.chart_exists_isMumfordRegular R n
    (fun M _ ↦ projectiveTwistGenerated R n M) F
  have hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n F m) 0 := fun q hq ↦ by
    have h := Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _) q (hm q hq)
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m (0 - q) (m - q) (by ring)).symm q h
  have hFm : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m) :=
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _ hF (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m)
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hmul : k0ClassOf _ F hF * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n m =
      k0ClassOf _ (moduleTwist R n F m) hFm :=
    k0ClassOf_mul (space R n) ⟨F, hF⟩ ⟨_, projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m⟩
  rw [hmul]
  exact k0ClassOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular R n _ hFm hreg

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSpace_k0_span
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_k0_span (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    ∃ g : Fin (n + 1) → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)),
      y = ∑ i, EulerIndependence.pb R n (g i) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
  let w : (K0 (space R n))ˣ := projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit R n (-1)
  let V : Submodule (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (K0 (space R n)) :=
    Submodule.span _ (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ (w : K0 (space R n)) ^ (i : ℕ))
  let a : Fin (n + 1) → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) := fun i ↦
    (-1 : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) ^ (n + 1 - (i : ℕ)) *
      ((n + 1).choose (i : ℕ) : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
  
  have hrel : Polynomial.aeval (w : K0 (space R n))
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (n + 1) a) = 0 :=
    KoszulK0.aeval_relation (w : K0 (space R n)) n (projectiveSpace_k0_relation_add_neg R n)
  have ha : IsUnit (a ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩) := by
    show IsUnit ((-1 : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) ^ (n + 1 - 0) *
      ((n + 1).choose 0 : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))))
    rw [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    exact isUnit_one.neg.pow _
  have hwz : ∀ j : ℤ, ((w ^ j : (K0 (space R n))ˣ) : K0 (space R n)) =
      projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-j) := by
    intro j
    have hw1 : w = projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit R n 1 ^ (-1 : ℤ) :=
      (EulerIndependence.unit_zpow R n (-1)).symm
    rw [hw1, ← zpow_mul, EulerIndependence.unit_zpow, projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit_val,
      neg_one_mul]
  have hz : ∀ e : ℤ, projectiveTwistingK0Class R n e ∈ V := by
    intro e
    have h := SchemeProjectiveBundle.zpow_mem_span_of_relation (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) a w
      hrel ha (-e)
    rwa [hwz, neg_neg] at h
  have hmulz : ∀ e : ℤ, ∀ x ∈ V, projectiveTwistingK0Class R n e * x ∈ V := by
    intro e x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      show projectiveTwistingK0Class R n e * (w : K0 (space R n)) ^ (i : ℕ) ∈ V
      have hi : (w : K0 (space R n)) ^ (i : ℕ) = projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
        projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow R n i
      rw [hi, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul]
      exact hz _
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact V.zero_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact V.add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact V.smul_mem c hx
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
      (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Quillen.O R n (-(i : ℤ))), x ∈ V := by
    intro x hx
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ hx
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hz _
  have hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V := by
    refine k0_induction (space R n) (· ∈ V) V.zero_mem (fun a b ha hb ↦ V.add_mem ha hb)
      (fun a ha ↦ by
        
        have h := V.smul_mem (-1 : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (show a ∈ V from ha)
        rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_neg, map_one, neg_one_mul] at h
        exact h) ?_
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_twist_mem_span R n F hF
    have h := hmulz (-m) _ (hsub _ hm)
    rwa [mul_comm, mul_assoc, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul, add_neg_cancel,
      projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero, mul_one] at h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).1 (hV y)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  rw [← hg]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace'
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace'
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hres : ∀ a, res (k0ToG0 _ a) = a)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ψP : K0 (space R n) →+* K0 (space R n))
    (ψY : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+* K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hψ_line : ψP (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)) = projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ j)
    (hψ_pb : ∀ a, ψP (EulerIndependence.pb R n a) = EulerIndependence.pb R n (ψY a))
    (bott : Multiplicative (K0 (space R n)) →* (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ)
    (hbott_one : ((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) : (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) :
        adamsKLoc j (space R n)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, (1 : K0 (space R n)) ^ a))
    (hbott_line : ((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1))) :
        (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ a))
    (pushPi : adamsKLoc j (space R n) →+ adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) =
      algebraMap _ _ (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ a))))
    (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (ψY (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      pushPi (algebraMap _ _ (ψP y) *
        (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace R n hn res hres j hj ψP ψY hψ_line hψ_pb bott hbott_one
    hbott_line (projectiveSpace_k0_relation R n) (projectiveSpace_k0_span R n) pushPi pushPi_alg y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseBasicOpen_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem projectiveBaseBasicOpen_eq_basicOpen (g : R) :
    (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).basicOpen
        (projectiveBaseTopElement R g) =
      projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
proof:
:= by
  change (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).basicOpen
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv g) =
    PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  exact basicOpen_eq_of_affine (R := CommRingCat.of R) g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseBasicOpenIsLocalizationFromTop
statement:
theorem projectiveBaseBasicOpenIsLocalizationFromTop
    (g : R) :
    let Y
proof:
:= Spec (CommRingCat.of R)
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let h : D ≤ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := le_top
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y, D) :=
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
    IsLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers (projectiveBaseTopElement R g))
      Γ(Y, D) := by
  dsimp only
  let Y := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)
  let r := projectiveBaseTopElement R g
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let h : D ≤ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := le_top
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y, D) :=
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
  rw [← projectiveBaseBasicOpen_eq_basicOpen R g]
  exact (isAffineOpen_top Y).isLocalization_basicOpen r

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange.middle_positive
statement:
theorem ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange.middle_positive
    (n : ℕ)
    (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₁)
    (h₃ : ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₃)
    (g : R) (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) S.X₂ i
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top))
proof:
:= by
  let Y := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let h : D ≤ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := le_top
  let T := Submonoid.powers (projectiveBaseTopElement R g)
  have hT :
      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y, D) :=
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
      IsLocalization T Γ(Y, D) :=
    projectiveBaseBasicOpenIsLocalizationFromTop R g
  have h₁loc : ∀ j,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization
        T (toSpec R n) S.X₁ j h := by
    intro j
    letI : IsIso
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) S.X₁ j h) := h₁ g j
    exact
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso
        T (toSpec R n) S.X₁ j h hT
  have h₃loc : ∀ j,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization
        T (toSpec R n) S.X₃ j h := by
    intro j
    letI : IsIso
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) S.X₃ j h) := h₃ g j
    exact
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso
        T (toSpec R n) S.X₃ j h hT
  have h₂loc :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.middle_positive
      T (toSpec R n) S hS h h₁loc h₃loc i hi
  exact
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.baseChangeMap_isIso
      T (toSpec R n) S.X₂ i h hT h₂loc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange.middle
statement:
theorem ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange.middle
    (n : ℕ)
    (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h₁ : ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₁)
    (h₃ : ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₃) :
    ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₂
proof:
:= by
  intro g i
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      letI :
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₂).IsQuasicoherent :=
        isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n S.X₂
      exact
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyBaseChange_zero_of_pushforward_isQuasicoherent
          (toSpec R n) S.X₂
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
            (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)
          (IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen (R := CommRingCat.of R) g)
          (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
  | succ i =>
      exact ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange.middle_positive
        R n S hS h₁ h₃ g (i + 1) (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_middle
statement:
theorem affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_middle
    (n : ℕ)
    (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h₁ : ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₁)
    (h₃ : ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n S.X₃)
    (p : ℕ) :
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n) S.X₂ (p + 1)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  apply
    affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isQuasicoherent_of_projectiveModule
      R n S.X₂ p
  intro g
  exact ProjectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange.middle
    R n S hS h₁ h₃ g (p + 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationProjectiveModulePullback_coordinateCechAcyclic
statement:
theorem localizationProjectiveModulePullback_coordinateCechAcyclic
    [IsNoetherianRing R]

name: SchemeKTheory.TF7.tangent_virtual_PY
statement:
theorem tangent_virtual_PY (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ)
    (i : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f)
    (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) :
    letI
proof:
:= T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
    haveI : IsNoetherian (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) := T1CL.prod_isNoetherian n
    haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
    haveI : IsIntegral (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) :=
      (T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n).1
    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n + dY) (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := by
      haveI := smooth_p (TF1.isPullback_prod (Y ↘ Spk k) n)
      change SmoothOfRelativeDimension _ (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k)
      infer_instance
    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (i ≫ (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k)) := by
      have e : i ≫ (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k := by
        change i ≫ (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k) = _
        rw [← Category.assoc, hi, hf]
      rw [e]; infer_instance
    pullbackK0RingHom i (T1KG3.OMG.kahlerClass (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
        k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb i)
          (TF6.hasConstantRank_libConormalAmb_sub k i
            (prod_regStalks (k := k) hYreg n) hXreg (m := n + dY) (d := dX)).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      kahlerVirtual k dX dY f := by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsNoetherian (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) := T1CL.prod_isNoetherian n
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) :=
    (T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n).1
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n + dY) (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := by
    haveI := smooth_p (TF1.isPullback_prod (Y ↘ Spk k) n)
    change SmoothOfRelativeDimension _ (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  have e : i ≫ (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k := by
    change i ≫ (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, hi, hf]
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (i ≫ (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k)) := by
    rw [e]; infer_instance
  have hZ := prod_regStalks (k := k) hYreg n
  have h1 := kahlerClass_conormal k i hZ hXreg (n + dY) dX
  have h2 := TF1.kahlerClass_composite_PY (k := k) (Y := Y) n dY
  have h3 := k0ClassOf_relativeSheaf_congr e
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank
      (i ≫ (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k)) dX).isFiniteLocallyFree
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (X ↘ Spk k) dX).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h4 : pullbackK0RingHom i (pullbackK0RingHom (pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
      (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Y ↘ Spk k) dY).isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      pullbackK0RingHom f (k0ClassOf Y (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (Y ↘ Spk k))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (Y ↘ Spk k) dY).isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hi]
  unfold kahlerVirtual
  have h5 := congrArg (pullbackK0RingHom i) h2
  rw [map_add, h4] at h5
  rw [← h3]
  exact sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.2
    ((add_comm _ _).trans ((h1.symm.trans h5).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.eulerLift_pr

theorem eulerLift_pr (j : Fin (n + 1)) :

      (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n) = eulerContraction R n j
proof:

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.eulerLift_comp_eulerMap
statement: theorem eulerLift_comp_eulerMap : eulerLift R n ≫ eulerMap R n = 0
proof:

  refine comp_d_eq_zero (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) (n + 1)
    (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n) (hE3 n) (eulerLift R n) ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj ↦ by
    rw [show (eulerLift R n ≫ pr (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) j (n + 1)
      (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n)) = contr R n j from
      lift_pr (Ltw R n) (Koszul.x R n) (Koszul.x_comm R n) (-1) (contr R n) j (n + 1)
        (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) (hE1 n) (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)])]
  exact sum_contr_x R n

theorem overToPushed_over {M : X.Modules} (ξ : M.over U ⟶ (LineBundleDual.unitMod X).over U) :

proof:
:= by

  intro W

  intro m
  let g : pushedOver (U := U) W.unop.left ⟶ W.unop := Over.homMk (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W.unop.left))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.OMG.isIso_qUnit_over
statement: theorem isIso_qUnit_over : IsIso ((qUnit U).over U)
proof:
:= by
  refine LineBundleDual.isIso_of_bijective _ (fun W ↦ ?_)
  have hW : W.unop.left ≤ U := leOfHom W.unop.hom
  have h1 : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W.unop.left) ≤ W.unop.left := pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W.unop.left
  have h2 : W.unop.left ≤ U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W.unop.left) := (pushedOpen_eq W.unop.left hW).symm.le
  haveI : IsIso (homOfLE h1) := ⟨⟨homOfLE h2, Subsingleton.elim _ _, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
  have hb : Function.Bijective (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op) :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op)
  exact hb

name: STEPW.exists_finite_stable_subalgebra
statement:
theorem exists_finite_stable_subalgebra (xs : Finset K) :
    ∃ S : Subalgebra ℚ K, Module.Finite ℚ S ∧ StableSub Ψ S ∧ ∀ x ∈ xs, x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := gradedAlgebra (Ψ := Ψ) (ρ := ρ) 2 H le_rfl
  let comp : K → ℕ → K := fun x p ↦ (DirectSum.decompose (W Ψ 2) x p : K)
  let G : Set K := ⋃ x ∈ xs, (fun p ↦ comp x p) '' ((DirectSum.decompose (W Ψ 2) x).support : Set ℕ)
  have hGfin : G.Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.biUnion xs.finite_toSet fun x _ ↦ Set.Finite.image _ (Finset.finite_toSet _)
  have hGW : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ p, g ∈ W Ψ 2 p := by
    intro g hg
    simp only [G, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image] at hg
    obtain ⟨x, _, p, _, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨p, (DirectSum.decompose (W Ψ 2) x p).2⟩
  have hGint : ∀ g ∈ G, IsIntegral ℚ g := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hGW g hg
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p with rfl | hp0
    · rw [W_zero_eq_span 2 H le_rfl] at hp
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hp
      rw [← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
      exact isIntegral_algebraMap
    · obtain ⟨-, n, hn⟩ := rank_eq_zero_of_mem_W 2 H le_rfl hp0 hp
      exact ⟨Polynomial.X ^ n, Polynomial.monic_X_pow n, by simpa using hn⟩
  refine ⟨Algebra.adjoin ℚ G, Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral hGfin hGint, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj x hx
    have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℚ G ≤ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ G).comap (Ψ j) := by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
      intro g hg
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hGW g hg
      have hp' : g ∈ W Ψ j p := by rwa [← W_eq Ψ ρ H hcomm (le_refl 2) hj p]
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subalgebra.mem_comap, mem_W.mp hp']
      exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin hg) _
    exact hle hx
  · intro x hx
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (W Ψ 2) x]
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun p hp ↦ Algebra.subset_adjoin ?_
    simp only [G, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image]
    exact ⟨x, hx, p, by simpa using hp, rfl⟩

name: STEPW.subalg_weightHyp
statement:
theorem subalg_weightHyp (S : Subalgebra ℚ K) [Module.Finite ℚ S] (hS : StableSub Ψ S) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, letI
proof:
:= gradedAlgebra j (subalg_hasFilt H S hS) hj
      RG6B.WeightHyp (W (subPsi S hS) j) (subPsi S hS j : S →+* S) j D := by
  have hfin := WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep (iSupIndep_W (Ψ := subPsi S hS) j hj)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hfin.bddAbove
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  letI := gradedAlgebra j (subalg_hasFilt H S hS) hj
  refine ⟨hj, fun {p x} hx ↦ mem_W.mp hx, fun {p} hp ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hne
  exact absurd (hD hne) (by omega)

name: ARRKG.hsupp_deformation
statement:
theorem hsupp_deformation (j : ℕ) (hP : AR11.ProjEmb k (totalGlobal (space k n) J))
    (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme J.subscheme)
    [IsNoetherian (totalGlobal (space k n) J)] [IsNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k n) J)] :
    ∀ m : KLoc j (totalGlobal (space k n) J),
      SchemeKTheory.locMap (j := j)
        (pullbackK0RingHom (openComplementW k n J).ι) m = 0 →
      ∃ w : KLoc j (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k n) J),
        Floc j (ARRL1C.Fp (resolutionM k n J hP hZ) (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J)) w = m
proof:
:=
  hsupp_loc_of_resolution j (resolutionM k n J hP hZ) (resolutionW k n J hZ)
    (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J) (openComplementW k n J) (by
      ext x
      simp [openComplementW])

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModulePushforward_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModulePushforward_isFinitePresentation
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n
        (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let M := projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj M
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R Q
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent := by
    dsimp only [M]
    exact projectiveTwistingBaseModule_isQuasicoherent
      R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n M
  let e : M.H 0 ≃ₗ[R]
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj N := by
    change M.H 0 ≃ₗ[R] Γ(M, ⊤)
    exact projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n M
  letI : Module.Finite R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj N) := by
    letI : Module.Finite R (M.H 0) := by
      dsimp only [M]
      exact projectiveTwistingBaseModuleZeroCohomology_finite
        R Q n hn d
    exact Module.Finite.equiv e
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj N) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  exact isFinitePresentation_of_moduleSpecΓ N

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafificationZero_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafificationZero_isFinitePresentation
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) :
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n)
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)
      0).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:=
  SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZero_isFinitePresentation
    (toSpec R n)
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModulePushforward_isFinitePresentation

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafification_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem
    projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafification_isFinitePresentation
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (toSpec R n)
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)
      (p + 1)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let M := projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d
  letI : Module.Finite R (M.H (p + 1)) := by
    dsimp only [M]
    exact projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveCohomology_finite
      R Q n d p
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (M.H (p + 1)) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  apply
    affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isFinitePresentation_of_projectiveModule
      R n M p
  intro g
  dsimp only [M]
  exact projectiveTwistingBaseModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso
    R Q g n d p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem
    projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n)
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)
        (p + 1))
proof:
:=
  projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafification_isFinitePresentation
    R Q n d p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec R n)
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)
        i)
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      exact
        projectiveTwistingBaseModuleHigherDirectImageSheafificationZero_isFinitePresentation
          R Q n hn d
  | succ p =>
      exact
        projectiveTwistingBaseModulePositiveHigherDirectImageSheafification_isCoherentLike
          R Q n d p

name: SchemeKTheory.TF2.Esec_map
statement:
theorem Esec_map {W₁ W₂ : X.Opens} (h : W₂ ≤ W₁) (s : Γ(X, W₁)) :
    Esec πX W₂ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
      (relativeSheaf πX).val.map (homOfLE h).op (Esec πX W₁ s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
    (baseMap πX) (homOfLE h).op s
  have h2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf πX)) (homOfLE h).op
    (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d s)
  exact (congrArg (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf πX)).app (op W₂))) h1.symm).trans h2

name: SchemeKTheory.TF2.cmp1_comp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cmp1_comp_eq_zero (N : X.Modules) (h : relativeSheaf πX ⟶ N)
    (hh : psi πP πX i hi ≫ h = 0) :
    cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi]) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (psi πP πX i hi ≫ h) = 0 := by
    rw [hh]; simp
  rw [Functor.map_comp] at e
  have e' : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (OMGB.cmp πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map h = 0 := e
  rw [← unit_cmp πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun φ => (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app _ ≫ φ) e').trans
      Limits.comp_zero)

name: SchemeKTheory.TF2.h_Esec_comp
statement:
theorem h_Esec_comp (N : X.Modules) (h : relativeSheaf πX ⟶ N)
    (hh : psi πP πX i hi ≫ h = 0) (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) :
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (h.val.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ V))) (Esec πX (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := cmp1_comp_eq_zero πP πX i hi N h hh
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.val.app (op V))
    (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).unit.app (relativePresheaf πP)).app (op V))
      (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a))) h1
  have h3 := cmp0_d πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi]) (W := op V) a
  have h5 : ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])).val.app (op V))
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).unit.app (relativePresheaf πP)).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp0 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) :=
    congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (φ.app (op V)) (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a))
      (unit_cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi]))
  have h6 : Esec πX (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i.app V a) =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((cmp1 πP (𝟙 S) πX i (by simp [hi])).val.app (op V))
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).unit.app (relativePresheaf πP)).app (op V))
        (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a)) := by
    rw [h5, h3]; rfl
  rw [h6]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (h2.trans ?_)
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.TF2.exists_local_lift
statement:
theorem exists_local_lift [IsClosedImmersion i] {W : X.Opens} (s : Γ(X, W)) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ (V : P.Opens) (a : Γ(P, V)) (W' : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ W') (h1 : W' ≤ W)
      (h2 : W' ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V),
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op s = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (i.app V a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := i.stalkMap_surjective x (X.presheaf.germ W x hx s)
  obtain ⟨V, mV, a, rfl⟩ := P.presheaf.exists_germ_eq t
  have hg : X.presheaf.germ (i ⁻¹ᵁ V) x mV (i.app V a) =
      X.presheaf.germ W x hx s := by
    rw [← ht]
    have := Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap i V x mV
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom this a).symm
  obtain ⟨W', hW', iU, iV, h⟩ := X.presheaf.germ_eq x hx mV s (i.app V a) hg.symm
  exact ⟨V, a, W', hW', iU.le, iV.le, h⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF2.h_Esec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem h_Esec_eq_zero [IsClosedImmersion i] (N : X.Modules) (h : relativeSheaf πX ⟶ N)
    (hh : psi πP πX i hi ≫ h = 0) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (h.val.app (op W)) (Esec πX W s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  choose V a W' hxW' h1 h2 hs using fun x : W => exists_local_lift i s x.1 x.2
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E22.sections_eq_zero_of_locally (C := N) (fun x : W => W' x) h1 ?_ _ ?_
  · intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxW' ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  · intro x
    have n1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply h.val (homOfLE (h1 x)).op (Esec πX W s)
    have n2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply h.val (homOfLE (h2 x)).op
      (Esec πX (i ⁻¹ᵁ V x) (i.app (V x) (a x)))
    rw [← Esec_map πX (h1 x) s, hs x, Esec_map πX (h2 x)] at n1
    have n3 := h_Esec_comp πP πX i hi N h hh (V x) (a x)
    rw [n3] at n2
    exact n1.symm.trans (n2.trans (map_zero _))

name: SchemeKTheory.TF2.eq_zero_of_psi_comp
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_psi_comp [IsClosedImmersion i] (N : X.Modules) (h : relativeSheaf πX ⟶ N)
    (hh : psi πP πX i hi ≫ h = 0) : h = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _).injective ?_
  have hz : ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _) (0 : relativeSheaf πX ⟶ N) = 0 := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
    have : (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (0 : relativeSheaf πX ⟶ N) = 0 := by simp
    exact (congrArg (fun φ => (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf πX) ≫ φ) this).trans Limits.comp_zero
  rw [hz, Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.ext
  intro b
  exact h_Esec_eq_zero πP πX i hi N h hh W.unop b

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.coeff_gammaSub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_gammaSub (n : ℕ) : coeff n (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = if n = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.constantCoeff_gammaSub
statement: lemma constantCoeff_gammaSub : constantCoeff (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : coeff 0 (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = 0 := by simp
  rwa [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at h

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.hasSubst_gammaSub
statement: lemma hasSubst_gammaSub : HasSubst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)
proof:
:=
  HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' constantCoeff_gammaSub

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.gammaSub_mul_X
statement: lemma gammaSub_mul_X : (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) * X = gammaSub - X
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | _ | n
  · simp [constantCoeff_gammaSub]
  · simp
  · simp [coeff_succ_mul_X, coeff_X]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.one_add_gammaSub_mul_one_sub
statement: lemma one_add_gammaSub_mul_one_sub : (1 + gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) * (1 - X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := gammaSub_mul_X (A := A)
  linear_combination (-1 : A⟦X⟧) * h

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.gammaSubst_apply
statement: lemma gammaSubst_apply (f : A⟦X⟧) : gammaSubst f = f.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)
proof:
:=
  congrFun (coe_substAlgHom (R := A) (hasSubst_gammaSub (A := A))) f

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.gammaSubst_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gammaSubst_X : gammaSubst (X : A⟦X⟧) = gammaSub
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSubst_apply]
  exact subst_X hasSubst_gammaSub

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.gammaSubst_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma gammaSubst_C (a : A) : gammaSubst (C a : A⟦X⟧) = C a
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSubst_apply, subst_C]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.gammaSubst_one_add_C_mul_X
statement:
lemma gammaSubst_one_add_C_mul_X (a : A) :
    gammaSubst (1 + C a * X : A⟦X⟧) = 1 + C a * gammaSub
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.eq_one_add_of_mul_gammaSub
statement:
lemma eq_one_add_of_mul_gammaSub {q : A⟦X⟧} {a a' : A} (ha : a = a' + 1)
    (h : q * (1 + gammaSub) = 1 + C a * gammaSub) : q = 1 + C a' * X
proof:
:= by
  subst ha
  have h1 := one_add_gammaSub_mul_one_sub (A := A)
  have h2 := gammaSub_mul_X (A := A)
  have e : q = (1 + C (a' + 1) * gammaSub) * (1 - X) := by
    calc q = q * ((1 + gammaSub) * (1 - X)) := (mul_one _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z => q * z) h1.symm)
      _ = (q * (1 + gammaSub)) * (1 - X) := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [h]
  rw [e, map_add, map_one]
  linear_combination (-(C a' + 1)) * h2

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.coeff_succ_of_mul_line
statement:
lemma coeff_succ_of_mul_line {q : A⟦X⟧} {x y d : A} (hd : d + y = x)
    (hq0 : constantCoeff q = 1)
    (h : q * (1 + C y * X) = 1 + C x * X) (n : ℕ) : coeff (n + 1) q = (-y) ^ n * d
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : q * (1 + C y * X) = q + C y * (q * X) := by ring
  have h0 : coeff 0 q = 1 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hq0]
  have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, coeff (k + 1) q + y * coeff k q = coeff (k + 1) (1 + C x * X : A⟦X⟧) := by
    intro k
    have := congrArg (coeff (k + 1)) h
    rw [e1, map_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_mul_X] at this
    exact this
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have := hstep 0
    rw [h0] at this
    simp only [map_add, coeff_one, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X] at this
    simp only [zero_add, pow_zero, one_mul]
    simp at this
    linear_combination this - hd
  | succ m ih =>
    have := hstep (m + 1)
    rw [ih] at this
    simp only [map_add, coeff_one, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X] at this
    simp at this
    have h3 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
    rw [h3, pow_succ]
    ring

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.constantCoeff_gammaSubst
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_gammaSubst (f : A⟦X⟧) :
    constantCoeff (gammaSubst f) = constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSubst_apply, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  have h := coeff_subst' (hasSubst_gammaSub (A := A)) f 0
  change coeff 0 (f.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)) = _ at h
  rw [h, finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp
  · intro d hd
    simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_pow, constantCoeff_gammaSub, zero_pow hd]

name: SchemeKTheory.GammaB12.coeff_one_gammaSubst
statement: lemma coeff_one_gammaSubst (f : A⟦X⟧) : coeff 1 (gammaSubst f) = coeff 1 f
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSubst_apply]
  have h := coeff_subst' (hasSubst_gammaSub (A := A)) f 1
  change coeff 1 (f.subst (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧)) = _ at h
  rw [h, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := Finset.range 2)]
  · simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  · intro d hd
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hd
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
    by_contra hlt
    apply hd
    have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
    have : (gammaSub : A⟦X⟧) = X * PowerSeries.mk (fun _ => 1) := by
      ext n
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp
      · simp [coeff_succ_X_mul]
    rw [this, mul_pow, coeff_X_pow_mul']
    simp [show ¬ d ≤ 1 by omega]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaT_apply
statement:
lemma gammaT_apply (x : K0 Y) :
    ((Additive.toMul (gammaT Y x) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧) = gammaSeries Y x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_add
statement:
theorem gammaSeries_add (x y : K0 Y) :
    gammaSeries Y (x + y) = gammaSeries Y x * gammaSeries Y y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gammaT_apply, ← gammaT_apply, ← gammaT_apply, map_add, toMul_add, Units.val_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_zero
statement: lemma gammaSeries_zero : gammaSeries Y 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gammaT_apply, map_zero]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_neg_mul
statement: lemma gammaSeries_neg_mul (x : K0 Y) : gammaSeries Y (-x) * gammaSeries Y x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gammaSeries_add, neg_add_cancel, gammaSeries_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_sub
statement:
lemma gammaSeries_sub (x y : K0 Y) :
    gammaSeries Y (x - y) * gammaSeries Y y = gammaSeries Y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gammaSeries_add, sub_add_cancel]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_eq
statement:
lemma gammaSeries_eq (x : K0 Y) :
    gammaSeries Y x = (((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧ˣ) : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)).subst
      (gammaSub : (K0 Y)⟦X⟧)
proof: := gammaSubst_apply _

name: SchemeKTheory.constantCoeff_gammaSeries
statement: lemma constantCoeff_gammaSeries (x : K0 Y) : constantCoeff (gammaSeries Y x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSeries, constantCoeff_gammaSubst]
  exact constantCoeff_lambdaT Y x

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_zero
statement: lemma gammaOp_zero (x : K0 Y) : gammaOp Y 0 x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaOp, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_gammaSeries]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_one
statement: lemma gammaOp_one (x : K0 Y) : gammaOp Y 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaOp, gammaSeries, coeff_one_gammaSubst]
  exact lambdaOp_one Y x

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_add
statement:
lemma gammaOp_add (n : ℕ) (x y : K0 Y) :
    gammaOp Y n (x + y) = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, gammaOp Y p.1 x * gammaOp Y p.2 y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gammaOp, gammaSeries_add, coeff_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaOp_zero_arg
statement: lemma gammaOp_zero_arg (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : gammaOp Y n 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaOp, gammaSeries_zero, coeff_one, if_neg (by omega)]

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_rankOne
statement:
theorem gammaSeries_rankOne (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) :
    gammaSeries Y (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      1 + C (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) * gammaSub
proof:
:= by
  rw [gammaSeries, lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit,
    lambdaSeries_rankOne Y L hL]
  exact gammaSubst_one_add_C_mul_X _

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_one
statement: theorem gammaSeries_one : gammaSeries Y 1 = 1 + gammaSub
proof:
:= by
  have h := gammaSeries_rankOne Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y) hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  rw [← one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf] at h
  simpa using h

name: SchemeKTheory.gammaSeries_rankOne_sub_one
statement:
theorem gammaSeries_rankOne_sub_one (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) :
    gammaSeries Y (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) =
      1 + C (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) * X
proof:
:= by
  have h := gammaSeries_sub Y (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) 1
  rw [gammaSeries_rankOne Y L hL, gammaSeries_one] at h
  exact eq_one_add_of_mul_gammaSub (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm h
