name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_zero
statement:
theorem extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_zero
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    {C₀ : C} {D₀ : D} (e : F.obj C₀ ≅ D₀) (A : C)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext C₀ A 0) :
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A 0 x) =
      e.inv ≫ F.map (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).injective
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply,
    ← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
  change (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add 0) = _
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply x,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀]
  simp only [← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀_symm_apply,
    AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullback_hsections
statement:
private theorem openPullback_hsections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (A : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y.toPresheafedSpace) :
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom_zero_sections
statement:
theorem openPullbackExtAddHom_zero_sections
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (A : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y.toPresheafedSpace)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H A 0) :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
        ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj A)
        isTerminalTop
        (openPullbackExtAddHom g A 0 x) =
      A.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ A isTerminalTop x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits
      (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits
      (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  letI : (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).Additive :=
    openSheafPullback_additive g
  have hextF := extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_zero
    (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    ((openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))
    A x
  change
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
        ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj A)
        isTerminalTop
        (openPullbackExtAddHom g A 0 x) =
      A.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ A isTerminalTop x)
  simp only [openPullbackExtAddHom,
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  erw [hextF]
  simp only [Adjunction.homAddEquiv_apply]
  change _ =
    (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (A.1.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom) _
  erw [uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv_naturality]
  congr 1
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  simp only [openPullbackConstantIso]
  have hinv := openPullback_hinv g
  rw [hinv]
  have huniq := openPullback_huniq g
  rw [huniq]
  rw [Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hmap :
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (op ⊤)).map
          ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
            (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x)) =
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u}
              g.toLRSHom.toHom.base).map
                ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
                  (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))) := by
    rfl
  rw [hmap]
  have hcombine :
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app
              ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
                (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))) ≫
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u}
              g.toLRSHom.toHom.base).map
                ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
                  (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))) =
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x) ≫
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app A) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg
      (fun q ↦ ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤)).map q)
      ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit_naturality
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [hcombine]
  have hsections := openPullback_hsections g A
  rw [hsections]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_map_cast
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_cast
    {T : TopCat.{u}} (P : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {U V U' V' : Opens T} (eU : U' = U) (eV : V' = V)
    (q : op U' ⟶ op V') (r : op U ⟶ op V)
    (x : P.obj (op U')) :
    AddEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun W ↦ ↑(P.obj (op W))) eV) (P.map q x) =
      P.map r (AddEquiv.cast
        (congrArg (fun W ↦ ↑(P.obj (op W))) eU) x)
proof:
:= by
  cases eU
  cases eV
  rw [Subsingleton.elim q r]
  change P.map r x = P.map r x
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_zero_compatibility
statement:
theorem openRestrictionHAddHom_zero_compatibility
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (N : Y.Modules) (x : N.H 0) :
    (N.restrictAppIso g ⊤).hom
        (Sheaf.H.equiv₀
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj N)) isTerminalTop
          (openRestrictionHAddHom g N 0 x)) =
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
        (Sheaf.H.equiv₀
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) isTerminalTop x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits
      (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits g
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits
      (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteColimits g
  letI : (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).Additive :=
    openSheafPullback_additive g
  have hextF := extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_zero
    (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    ((openPullbackConstantIso g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) x
  simp only [openRestrictionHAddHom, Sheaf.H.equiv₀, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  erw [hextF]
  simp only [Adjunction.homAddEquiv_apply]
  change
    (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (N.restrictAppIso g ⊤).hom.hom) _ =
      (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom) _
  erw [uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv_naturality,
    uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv_naturality]
  congr 1
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  simp only [openPullbackConstantIso]
  have hinv :
      ((((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop).comp (openSheafPullbackAdjunction g)).leftAdjointUniq
          (constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))).inv =
        (((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop).leftAdjointUniq
          ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop).comp (openSheafPullbackAdjunction g))).hom.app
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) := by
    exact Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_inv_app _ _ _
  rw [hinv]
  have huniq :
      (constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          isTerminalTop).homEquiv
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))
        ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))))
        (((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop).leftAdjointUniq
          ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop).comp (openSheafPullbackAdjunction g))).hom.app
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) =
        ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            isTerminalTop).comp (openSheafPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)) := by
    exact Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app _ _ _
  rw [huniq]
  rw [Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hmap :
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (op ⊤)).map
          ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
            (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x)) =
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u}
              g.toLRSHom.toHom.base).map
                ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
                  (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))) := by
    rfl
  rw [hmap]
  have hcombine :
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app
              ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
                (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))) ≫
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u}
              g.toLRSHom.toHom.base).map
                ((g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
                  (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))) =
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x) ≫
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N)) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg
      (fun q ↦ ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤)).map q)
      ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit_naturality
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x))
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [hcombine]
  have hsections :
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op ⊤)).map
            ((openSheafPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (N.restrictAppIso g ⊤).hom.hom =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom := by
    rfl
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [hsections]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_zero_compatibility
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_zero_compatibility
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W)
    (x : (restrictToPreimage f M W).H 0) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv f M V
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M 0 h x) =
      preimageSections_map f M h
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv f M W x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineLocalCohomologyModule_map,
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv, AddEquiv.trans_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  erw [← Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality (hT := isTerminalTop)]
  have hpapp :
      (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
        (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom).hom.app (op ⊤)) =
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          (((restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom.app ⊤).hom) := by
    rfl
  rw [hpapp]
  have hopen := openRestrictionHAddHom_zero_compatibility
    (preimageHomOfLE f h) (restrictToPreimage f M W) x
  have hopen' := hopen
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso, Iso.refl_hom] at hopen'
  simp only [preimageSections_map, restrictToPreimage_sections_addEquiv,
    restrictToPreimage_compIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app]
  erw [hopen']
  simp only [restrictToPreimage, Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
  erw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
  simp only [addCommGrpCat_ofHom_hom]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  apply presheaf_map_cast M.presheaf
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι_image_top (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι_image_top

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.KG.coeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem KG.coeff_eq_zero (p : A →+* B) (t : ℤ → B) (ht : ∀ a b, t a * t b = t (a + b))
    (χ : B →+ G) (κ : A →+ G) (hκ : Function.Injective κ) (N : ℕ)
    (hvan : ∀ (a : A) (d : ℤ), -(N : ℤ) ≤ d → d < 0 → χ (t d * p a) = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ a : A, χ (t 0 * p a) = κ a)
    (g : Fin (N + 1) → A)
    (hx : ∀ j : Fin (N + 1), χ ((∑ i, p (g i) * t (-(i : ℤ))) * t j) = 0) :
    ∀ i, g i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), (i : ℕ) < k → g i = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro i hi; omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro j hj
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj | hj
      · exact ih j hj
      · have h := hx j
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum] at h
        have hterm : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), p (g i) * t (-(i : ℤ)) * t j =
            t ((j : ℤ) - i) * p (g i) := by
          intro i
          rw [mul_assoc, ht, mul_comm]
          congr 2
          ring
        simp only [hterm] at h
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j] at h
        · rw [sub_self, hdiag] at h
          exact hκ (by rw [h, map_zero])
        · intro i _ hij
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
          · rw [ih i (by have : (i : ℕ) < j := hlt; omega), map_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
          · apply hvan
            · have := i.2; have := j.2; omega
            · have : (j : ℕ) < i := hgt
              omega
        · intro h'; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h'
  exact fun i ↦ hk (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_mul_twist
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_mul_twist (d : ℤ) (x : K0 (space R n)) :
    k0ToG0 (space R n) (x * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d) =
      g0Twist R n d (k0ToG0 (space R n) x)
proof:
:= by
  let f₁ : K0 (space R n) →+ G0 (space R n) :=
    (k0ToG0 (space R n)).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulRight (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d))
  let f₂ : K0 (space R n) →+ G0 (space R n) := (g0Twist R n d).comp (k0ToG0 (space R n))
  have hf : f₁ = f₂ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
    change k0ToG0 (space R n) (k0ClassOf _ V hV * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d) =
      g0Twist R n d (k0ToG0 (space R n) (k0ClassOf _ V hV))
    have hmul : k0ClassOf _ V hV * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d =
        k0ClassOf _ (tensorSheaf _ V (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))
          (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _ hV
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d)) :=
      k0ClassOf_mul (space R n) ⟨V, hV⟩ ⟨_, projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d⟩
    rw [hmul, k0ToG0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf, g0Twist_classOf]
    rfl
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.g0Twist_mem_range
statement:
theorem g0Twist_mem_range (d : ℤ) {y : G0 (space R n)} (hy : y ∈ (k0ToG0 (space R n)).range) :
    g0Twist R n d y ∈ (k0ToG0 (space R n)).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨x * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d, k0ToG0_mul_twist R n d x⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.flatPullbackG0_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_k0ToG0 {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (a : K0 Y) :
    flatPullbackG0 f (k0ToG0 Y a) = k0ToG0 X (flatPullbackK0 f a)
proof:
:= by
  let f₁ : K0 Y →+ G0 X := (flatPullbackG0 f).comp (k0ToG0 Y)
  let f₂ : K0 Y →+ G0 X := (k0ToG0 X).comp (flatPullbackK0 f)
  have hf : f₁ = f₂ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
    change flatPullbackG0 f (k0ToG0 Y (k0ClassOf _ V hV)) =
      k0ToG0 X (flatPullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf _ V hV))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf, flatPullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_isMumfordRegular_twist
statement:
theorem exists_isMumfordRegular_twist (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n F m) 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Regularity.chart_exists_isMumfordRegular R n
    (fun M _ ↦ projectiveTwistGenerated R n M) F
  refine ⟨m, fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _) q (hm q hq)
  exact Quillen.R_iso R n (moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m (0 - q) (m - q) (by ring)).symm q h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_surjective_of_base
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_surjective_of_base
    (hbase : Function.Surjective (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))) :
    Function.Surjective (k0ToG0 (space R n))
proof:
:= by
  let S := (k0ToG0 (space R n)).range
  
  have hterm : ∀ (T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules), T.IsFinitePresentation → ∀ (d : ℤ)
      (h : IsCoherentLike (space R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))),
      g0ClassOf (space R n) (tensorSheaf (space R n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)) h ∈ S := by
    intro T hT d h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hbase (g0ClassOf _ T hT)
    have hpb : g0ClassOf (space R n) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj T)
        (by haveI := hT; exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (toSpec R n) T) ∈ S := by
      refine ⟨flatPullbackK0 (toSpec R n) a, ?_⟩
      rw [← flatPullbackG0_k0ToG0, ha, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
    have := g0Twist_mem_range R n d hpb
    rwa [g0Twist_classOf R n d _ _ h] at this
  
  have hall : ∀ (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space R n) F),
      g0ClassOf _ F hF ∈ S := by
    intro F hF
    haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular_twist R n F
    have hFm : (moduleTwist R n F m).IsFinitePresentation :=
      CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n F m
    have h1 := CohQ.g0ClassOf_mem_of_isMumfordRegular R n S hterm _ hFm hm
    have h2 := g0Twist_mem_range R n (-m) h1
    haveI := hFm
    rw [g0Twist_classOf R n (-m) _ _ (CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n _ (-m))] at h2
    have e : moduleTwist R n (moduleTwist R n F m) (-m) ≅ F :=
      moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m (-m) 0 (by ring) ≪≫ Quillen.twistZeroIso R n F
    rwa [CohQ.cls_iso _ hF e] at h2
  
  intro y
  have hq : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' S : G0 (space R n) →+ G0 (space R n) ⧸ S) = 0 :=
    ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (A := G0 (space R n) ⧸ S) (fun E ↦ by
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
      exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 (hall V hV))
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff y).1 (DFunLike.congr_fun hq y)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem exists_isMumfordRegular (F : (space R n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsMumfordRegular R n F m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Regularity.chart_exists_isMumfordRegular R n
    (fun M _ ↦ projectiveTwistGenerated R n M) F
  exact ⟨m, fun q hq ↦ Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _) q (hm q hq)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isMumfordRegular_twist_zero
statement:
theorem isMumfordRegular_twist_zero (F : (space R n).Modules) (m : ℤ)
    (h : IsMumfordRegular R n F m) : IsMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n F m) 0
proof:
:= fun q hq ↦
  Quillen.R_iso R n (moduleTwistTwistIso R n F m (0 - q) (m - q) (by ring)).symm q (h q hq)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_injective_of_base
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_injective_of_base (hn : 0 < n)
    (hbase : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))) :
    Function.Injective (k0ToG0 (space R n))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (EulerIndependence.pb R n).toAlgebra
  let L := projectiveHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem R n hn
  have hL := EulerIndependence.projectiveSystem_isAffineLocal R n hn
  let z : ℤ → K0 (space R n) := projectiveTwistingK0Class R n
  let V : Submodule (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (K0 (space R n)) :=
    Submodule.span _ (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Quillen.O R n (-(i : ℤ)))
  let P : AddSubgroup (K0 (space R n)) :=
    { carrier := {x | ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m, m₀ ≤ m → x * z m ∈ V}
      add_mem' := fun {a b} ⟨ma, ha⟩ ⟨mb, hb⟩ ↦ ⟨max ma mb, fun m hm ↦ by
        rw [add_mul]
        exact V.add_mem (ha m (le_of_max_le_left hm)) (hb m (le_of_max_le_right hm))⟩
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, fun m _ ↦ by rw [zero_mul]; exact V.zero_mem⟩
      neg_mem' := fun {a} ⟨ma, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨ma, fun m hm ↦ by
        have h := V.smul_mem (-1 : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (ha m hm)
        rwa [Algebra.smul_def, map_neg, map_one, neg_one_mul, ← neg_mul] at h⟩ }
  have hgen : ∀ (F : (space R n).Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) F),
      k0ClassOf _ F hF ∈ P := by
    intro F hF
    haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFinitePresentation
    obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular R n F
    refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
    have hreg := isMumfordRegular_twist_zero R n F m (CohReg.isMumfordRegular_of_le R n F hm h)
    have hFm : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (moduleTwist R n F m) :=
      tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _ hF (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m)
    have hmem := k0ClassOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular R n (moduleTwist R n F m) hFm hreg
    have hmul : k0ClassOf _ F hF * z m = k0ClassOf _ (moduleTwist R n F m) hFm :=
      k0ClassOf_mul (space R n) ⟨F, hF⟩ ⟨_, projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m⟩
    rw [hmul]
    exact hmem
  have hP : ∀ x, x ∈ P := by
    have hq : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' P : K0 (space R n) →+ K0 (space R n) ⧸ P) = 0 :=
      ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (A := K0 (space R n) ⧸ P) (fun E ↦ by
        obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := E
        exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 (hgen F hF))
    exact fun x ↦ (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff x).1 (DFunLike.congr_fun hq x)
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hP x
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).1 (hm₀ m₀ le_rfl)
  have hsum : ∑ i, EulerIndependence.pb R n (g i) * z (-(i : ℤ)) = x * z m₀ := by
    rw [← hg]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    rfl
  have hx' : k0ToG0 (space R n) (x * z m₀) = 0 := by
    rw [k0ToG0_mul_twist, hx, map_zero]
  have hcoef := KG.coeff_eq_zero (EulerIndependence.pb R n) z (projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul R n)
    (EulerIndependence.euler R n L) (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) hbase n
    (fun a d hd₁ hd₂ ↦ EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero R n hn L hL d hd₁ hd₂ a)
    (fun a ↦ by
      rw [show z 0 = 1 from projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero R n, one_mul]
      exact EulerIndependence.euler_pb R n hn L hL a)
    g (fun j ↦ by
      rw [hsum]
      simp only [EulerIndependence.euler, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
      rw [k0ToG0_mul_twist, hx', map_zero, map_zero])
  have h0 : x * z m₀ = 0 := by
    rw [← hsum]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ by rw [hcoef i, map_zero, zero_mul]
  calc x = x * (z m₀ * z (-m₀)) := by
        rw [projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul, add_neg_cancel, projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero, mul_one]
    _ = 0 := by rw [← mul_assoc, h0, zero_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_bijective_of_base
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_of_base (hn : 0 < n)
    (hbase : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (space R n))
proof:
:=
  ⟨k0ToG0_injective_of_base R n hn hbase.1, k0ToG0_surjective_of_base R n hbase.2⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_bijective_of_forall_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_of_forall_isFiniteLocallyFree (X : Scheme.{u})
    (h : ∀ E : X.Modules, IsCoherentLike X E → IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 X)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : G0 X →+ K0 X := ExactGrothendieck.map
    (fun E : {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M} ↦ (⟨E.1, h E.1 E.2⟩ :
      {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})) (fun _ _ _ hex ↦ hex)
  have h1 : ψ.comp (k0ToG0 X) = AddMonoidHom.id _ :=
    ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (fun E ↦ by
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
      change ψ (k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X V hV)) = k0ClassOf X V hV
      rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
      exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ _)
  have h2 : (k0ToG0 X).comp ψ = AddMonoidHom.id _ :=
    ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (fun E ↦ by
      obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := E
      change k0ToG0 X (ψ (g0ClassOf X V hV)) = g0ClassOf X V hV
      have : ψ (g0ClassOf X V hV) = k0ClassOf X V (h V hV) :=
        ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ _
      rw [this, k0ToG0_classOf])
  refine ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ⟨ψ y, DFunLike.congr_fun h2 y⟩⟩
  have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun h1 a
  have hb := DFunLike.congr_fun h1 b
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at ha hb
  rw [← ha, ← hb, hab]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isCoherentLike_field
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isCoherentLike_field (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (E : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike _ E) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E
proof:
:= by
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
  haveI : E.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation K ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of K)).obj E) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation E
  haveI : Module.Finite K ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of K)).obj E) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Projective K ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of K)).obj E) :=
    inferInstance
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_globalSections_projective E

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_bijective_spec_field
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_spec_field (K : Type u) [Field K] :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
proof:
:=
  k0ToG0_bijective_of_forall_isFiniteLocallyFree _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isCoherentLike_field K)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.k0ToG0_bijective_field
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_field (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (space K n))
proof:
:=
  k0ToG0_bijective_of_base K n hn (k0ToG0_bijective_spec_field K)

name: TOWERW.ev_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem ev_eq_of_le {D D' : ℕ} {a : K} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) (hD : D ≤ D') (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    RG6B.ev D' a f = RG6B.ev D a f
proof:
:= by
  rw [RG6B.ev_eq_sum, RG6B.ev_eq_sum]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 (by omega)) fun i _ hi => ?_
  have : D + 1 ≤ i := by simpa using hi
  rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le this h, smul_zero]

name: TOWERW.ev_X
statement: theorem ev_X {D : ℕ} {a : K} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) : RG6B.ev D a (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [RG6B.ev_eq_sum]
  rcases D with _ | D
  · simp at h
    simp [h]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
    · simp
    · intro i _ hi
      simp [coeff_X, hi]
    · intro h1; simp at h1

name: TOWERW.ev_X_pow
statement:
theorem ev_X_pow {D : ℕ} {a : K} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    RG6B.ev D a ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ^ n) = a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have e := map_pow (RG6B.evHom D a h) (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) n
  change RG6B.ev D a ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ^ n) = (RG6B.ev D a X) ^ n at e
  rw [ev_X h] at e
  exact e

name: TOWERW.ev_sub
statement:
theorem ev_sub {D : ℕ} {a : K} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    RG6B.ev D a (f - g) = RG6B.ev D a f - RG6B.ev D a g
proof:
:=
  map_sub (RG6B.evHom D a h) f g

name: TOWERW.pow_ev_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pow_ev_eq_zero {D : ℕ} {a : K} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) {g : ℚ⟦X⟧}
    (hg : constantCoeff g = 0) : (RG6B.ev D a g) ^ (D + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (X_dvd_iff.2 hg : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ∣ g)
  have e := map_pow (RG6B.evHom D a h) (X * u) (D + 1)
  change RG6B.ev D a ((X * u) ^ (D + 1)) = (RG6B.ev D a (X * u)) ^ (D + 1) at e
  rw [← e, mul_pow, RG6B.ev_mul h, ev_X_pow h, h, zero_mul]

name: TOWERW.ring_hom_eq_aeval_trunc
statement:
theorem ring_hom_eq_aeval_trunc {D : ℕ} (ψ : ℚ⟦X⟧ →+* K)
    (hC : ∀ c : ℚ, ψ (C c) = algebraMap ℚ K c) (hX : ψ (X ^ (D + 1)) = 0) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    ψ f = Polynomial.aeval (ψ X) (trunc (D + 1) f)
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ^ (D + 1) ∣ f - (trunc (D + 1) f : ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
    rw [X_pow_dvd_iff]
    intro m hm
    rw [map_sub, coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt hm, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hdvd
  have h1 : ψ f = ψ (trunc (D + 1) f : ℚ⟦X⟧) := by
    have : f = (trunc (D + 1) f : ℚ⟦X⟧) + X ^ (D + 1) * h := by rw [← hh]; ring
    conv_lhs => rw [this]
    rw [map_add, map_mul, hX, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (ψ.comp (Polynomial.coeToPowerSeries.ringHom)) =
      (Polynomial.aeval (ψ X)).toRingHom := by
    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp [hC, Polynomial.coe_C]
    · simp
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h2 (trunc (D + 1) f)

name: TOWERW.ev_subst
statement:
theorem ev_subst {D : ℕ} {a : K} (ha : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) {g : ℚ⟦X⟧} (hg : constantCoeff g = 0)
    (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    RG6B.ev D a (f.subst g) = RG6B.ev D (RG6B.ev D a g) f
proof:
:= by
  have hs : HasSubst g := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hg
  have hb := pow_ev_eq_zero ha hg
  let φ1 : ℚ⟦X⟧ →+* K := (RG6B.evHom D a ha).comp (substAlgHom hs : ℚ⟦X⟧ →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ⟦X⟧).toRingHom
  have e1 : ∀ f : ℚ⟦X⟧, φ1 f = RG6B.ev D a (f.subst g) := fun f => by
    change RG6B.ev D a ((substAlgHom hs : ℚ⟦X⟧ →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ⟦X⟧) f) = _
    rw [coe_substAlgHom]
  let φ2 : ℚ⟦X⟧ →+* K := RG6B.evHom D (RG6B.ev D a g) hb
  have hC1 : ∀ c : ℚ, φ1 (C c) = algebraMap ℚ K c := fun c => by
    rw [e1, subst_C]; exact RG6B.ev_C D a c
  have hX1 : φ1 (X ^ (D + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [e1, subst_pow hs, subst_X hs]
    exact (map_pow (RG6B.evHom D a ha) g (D + 1)).trans hb
  have hC2 : ∀ c : ℚ, φ2 (C c) = algebraMap ℚ K c := fun c => RG6B.ev_C D _ c
  have hX2 : φ2 (X ^ (D + 1)) = 0 := by
    change RG6B.ev D (RG6B.ev D a g) ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ^ (D + 1)) = 0
    rw [ev_X_pow hb]; exact hb
  have hX : φ1 X = φ2 X := by
    rw [e1, subst_X hs]; exact (ev_X hb).symm
  calc RG6B.ev D a (f.subst g) = φ1 f := (e1 f).symm
    _ = Polynomial.aeval (φ1 X) (trunc (D + 1) f) := ring_hom_eq_aeval_trunc φ1 hC1 hX1 f
    _ = Polynomial.aeval (φ2 X) (trunc (D + 1) f) := by rw [hX]
    _ = φ2 f := (ring_hom_eq_aeval_trunc φ2 hC2 hX2 f).symm

name: TOWERW.ode_uniq
statement: theorem ode_uniq {u : ℚ⟦X⟧} (h : (1 + X) * d⁄dX ℚ u = u) (h0 : constantCoeff u = 0) : u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n, coeff n u = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rwa [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
    | succ m ih =>
      have e := congrArg (coeff m) h
      rw [add_mul, one_mul, map_add] at e
      rcases m with _ | m
      · rw [coeff_zero_X_mul, coeff_derivative, ih] at e
        simpa using e
      · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, coeff_derivative, ih] at e
        simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at e
        have hne : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 e).resolve_right hne
  ext n; simpa using key n

name: TOWERW.constantCoeff_subst_of_zero
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_subst_of_zero {a : ℚ⟦X⟧} (ha : constantCoeff a = 0) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    constantCoeff (f.subst a) = constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  have hs : HasSubst a := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' ha
  have := constantCoeff_subst hs f
  change constantCoeff (f.subst a) = _ at this
  rw [this, finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  · intro d hd
    have ha' : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff a = 0 := ha
    simp [ha', hd]

name: TOWERW.exp_subst_log
statement: theorem exp_subst_log : (exp ℚ).subst (log ℚ) = 1 + X
proof:
:= by
  have hs : HasSubst (log ℚ) := HasSubst.log
  set f : ℚ⟦X⟧ := (exp ℚ).subst (log ℚ) with hf
  have hG : (1 + X) * (d⁄dX ℚ (log ℚ)) = 1 := by
    rw [deriv_log]
    ext n
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
    · rw [add_mul, one_mul, map_add]
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp
      · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul]; simp [coeff_one, pow_succ]
  have hd : d⁄dX ℚ f = f * d⁄dX ℚ (log ℚ) := by
    rw [hf, derivative_subst ℚ hs, derivative_exp]
  have hc : constantCoeff f = 1 := by
    rw [hf, constantCoeff_subst_of_zero constantCoeff_log, constantCoeff_exp]
  have hu : (1 + X) * d⁄dX ℚ (f - (1 + X)) = f - (1 + X) := by
    have h1 : d⁄dX ℚ (1 + X : ℚ⟦X⟧) = 1 := by simp
    rw [map_sub, h1, hd]
    linear_combination f * hG
  have := ode_uniq hu (by rw [map_sub, hc]; simp)
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 this

name: TOWERW.log_subst_exp_sub_one
statement: theorem log_subst_exp_sub_one : (log ℚ).subst (exp ℚ - 1) = X
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : constantCoeff (exp ℚ - 1) = 0 := by simp [constantCoeff_exp]
  have hs : HasSubst (exp ℚ - 1) := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hc0
  have hG : (1 + X) * (d⁄dX ℚ (log ℚ)) = 1 := by
    rw [deriv_log]
    ext n
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
    · rw [add_mul, one_mul, map_add]
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp
      · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul]; simp [coeff_one, pow_succ]
  apply derivative.ext
  · rw [derivative_subst ℚ hs, derivative_X]
    have h2 : (exp ℚ) * (d⁄dX ℚ (log ℚ)).subst (exp ℚ - 1) = 1 := by
      have this : ((1 + X) * d⁄dX ℚ (log ℚ)).subst (exp ℚ - 1) = (1 : ℚ⟦X⟧).subst (exp ℚ - 1) :=
        congrArg (fun p : ℚ⟦X⟧ => p.subst (exp ℚ - 1)) hG
      have h1 : (1 : ℚ⟦X⟧).subst (exp ℚ - 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← coe_substAlgHom hs]; exact map_one _
      rw [subst_mul hs, subst_add hs, subst_X hs, h1] at this
      have e : (1 : ℚ⟦X⟧) + (exp ℚ - 1) = exp ℚ := by ring
      rw [e] at this
      exact this
    have h3 : d⁄dX ℚ (exp ℚ - 1) = exp ℚ := by simp [derivative_exp]
    rw [h3]
    linear_combination h2
  · rw [constantCoeff_subst_of_zero hc0]; simp

name: TOWERW.logOnePlus_eq_sum
statement:
theorem logOnePlus_eq_sum {x : K} {k : ℕ} (h : x ^ k = 0) :
    logOnePlus x = ∑ i ∈ range k, (((-1 : ℚ) ^ (i + 1) / i : ℚ)) • x ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ∑ i ∈ range k, (((-1 : ℚ) ^ (i + 1) / i : ℚ)) • x ^ i =
      ∑ i ∈ range (nilpotencyClass x), (((-1 : ℚ) ^ (i + 1) / i : ℚ)) • x ^ i +
        ∑ i ∈ Ico (nilpotencyClass x) k, (((-1 : ℚ) ^ (i + 1) / i : ℚ)) • x ^ i :=
    (sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (csInf_le' h)).symm
  suffices ∑ i ∈ Ico (nilpotencyClass x) k, (((-1 : ℚ) ^ (i + 1) / i : ℚ)) • x ^ i = 0 by
    dsimp [logOnePlus]
    rw [h₁, this, add_zero]
  exact sum_eq_zero fun _ h₂ => by
    rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le (mem_Ico.1 h₂).1 (pow_nilpotencyClass ⟨k, h⟩), smul_zero]

name: TOWERW.logOnePlus_eq_ev
statement:
theorem logOnePlus_eq_ev {x : K} {D : ℕ} (h : x ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    logOnePlus x = RG6B.ev D x (log ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logOnePlus_eq_sum h, RG6B.ev_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [coeff_log]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi
  · simp
  · rw [if_neg hi.ne']; rfl

name: TOWERW.exp_eq_ev
statement:
theorem exp_eq_ev {a : K} {D : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    IsNilpotent.exp a = RG6B.ev D a (exp ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsNilpotent.exp_eq_sum h, RG6B.ev_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [coeff_exp]
  simp

name: TOWERW.pow_logOnePlus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pow_logOnePlus_eq_zero {x : K} {D : ℕ} (h : x ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    (logOnePlus x) ^ (D + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [logOnePlus_eq_ev h]
  exact pow_ev_eq_zero h constantCoeff_log

name: TOWERW.isNilpotent_logOnePlus
statement: theorem isNilpotent_logOnePlus {x : K} (hx : IsNilpotent x) : IsNilpotent (logOnePlus x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨n + 1, pow_logOnePlus_eq_zero (D := n) (by rw [pow_succ, hn, zero_mul])⟩

name: TOWERW.exp_logOnePlus
statement:
theorem exp_logOnePlus {x : K} (hx : IsNilpotent x) :
    IsNilpotent.exp (logOnePlus x) = 1 + x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
  have h : x ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by rw [pow_succ, hn, zero_mul]
  have hl := pow_logOnePlus_eq_zero h
  rw [exp_eq_ev hl, logOnePlus_eq_ev h, ← ev_subst h constantCoeff_log, exp_subst_log,
    RG6B.ev_add, RG6B.ev_one, ev_X h]

name: TOWERW.logOnePlus_exp_sub_one
statement:
theorem logOnePlus_exp_sub_one {y : K} (hy : IsNilpotent y) :
    logOnePlus (IsNilpotent.exp y - 1) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hy
  have h : y ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by rw [pow_succ, hn, zero_mul]
  have hc0 : constantCoeff (exp ℚ - 1) = 0 := by simp [constantCoeff_exp]
  have e : IsNilpotent.exp y - 1 = RG6B.ev n y (exp ℚ - 1) := by
    rw [ev_sub h, ← exp_eq_ev h, RG6B.ev_one]
  have hz : (IsNilpotent.exp y - 1) ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [e]; exact pow_ev_eq_zero h hc0
  rw [logOnePlus_eq_ev hz, e, ← ev_subst h hc0, log_subst_exp_sub_one, ev_X h]

name: TOWERW.isNilpotent_nsmul
statement: theorem isNilpotent_nsmul {a : K} (ha : IsNilpotent a) (j : ℕ) : IsNilpotent (j • a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]; exact Commute.isNilpotent_mul_left (Commute.all _ _) ha

name: TOWERW.exp_nsmul
statement:
theorem exp_nsmul {a : K} (ha : IsNilpotent a) (j : ℕ) :
    IsNilpotent.exp (j • a) = IsNilpotent.exp a ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [succ_nsmul, IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) (isNilpotent_nsmul ha j) ha,
      ih, pow_succ]

name: TOWERW.logOnePlus_pow
statement:
theorem logOnePlus_pow {x : K} (hx : IsNilpotent x) (j : ℕ) :
    logOnePlus ((1 + x) ^ j - 1) = j • logOnePlus x
proof:
:= by
  have ha := isNilpotent_logOnePlus hx
  have : (1 + x) ^ j - 1 = IsNilpotent.exp (j • logOnePlus x) - 1 := by
    rw [exp_nsmul ha, exp_logOnePlus hx]
  rw [this, logOnePlus_exp_sub_one (isNilpotent_nsmul ha j)]

name: TOWERW.logOnePlus_mul
statement:
theorem logOnePlus_mul {x y : K} (hx : IsNilpotent x) (hy : IsNilpotent y) :
    logOnePlus ((1 + x) * (1 + y) - 1) = logOnePlus x + logOnePlus y
proof:
:= by
  have ha := isNilpotent_logOnePlus hx
  have hb := isNilpotent_logOnePlus hy
  have : (1 + x) * (1 + y) - 1 =
      IsNilpotent.exp (logOnePlus x + logOnePlus y) - 1 := by
    rw [IsNilpotent.exp_add_of_commute (Commute.all _ _) ha hb, exp_logOnePlus hx,
      exp_logOnePlus hy]
  rw [this, logOnePlus_exp_sub_one (Commute.isNilpotent_add (Commute.all _ _) ha hb)]

name: TOWERW.map_logOnePlus
statement:
theorem map_logOnePlus {F L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra ℚ L] [FunLike F K L]
    [RingHomClass F K L] {x : K} (hx : IsNilpotent x) (f : F) :
    f (logOnePlus x) = logOnePlus (f x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx
  have hk' : (f x) ^ k = 0 := by rw [← map_pow, hk, map_zero]
  rw [logOnePlus_eq_sum hk, logOnePlus_eq_sum hk', map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_rat_smul, map_pow]

name: TOWERW.psi_logOnePlus
statement:
theorem psi_logOnePlus {x : K} (hx : IsNilpotent x) (psi : K →+* K) (j : ℕ)
    (h : psi x = (1 + x) ^ j - 1) : psi (logOnePlus x) = (j : ℚ) • logOnePlus x
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_logOnePlus hx psi, h, logOnePlus_pow hx, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: TOWERW.ev_rescale
statement:
theorem ev_rescale (D : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (a : K) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    RG6B.ev D a (rescale c f) = RG6B.ev D (c • a) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [RG6B.ev_eq_sum, RG6B.ev_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [smul_pow, coeff_rescale, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: TOWERW.ev_expNeg
statement:
theorem ev_expNeg {D : ℕ} {a : K} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    RG6B.ev D a RG6B.expNeg = IsNilpotent.exp (-a)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (-a) ^ (D + 1) = 0 := by rw [neg_pow, h, mul_zero]
  rw [RG6B.expNeg, ev_rescale, neg_smul, one_smul, exp_eq_ev h']

name: TOWERW.Td_mul_one_sub_exp_neg
statement:
theorem Td_mul_one_sub_exp_neg {a : K} {D : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    RG6B.Td D a * (1 - IsNilpotent.exp (-a)) = a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 - IsNilpotent.exp (-a) = RG6B.ev D a (1 - RG6B.expNeg) := by
    rw [ev_sub h, RG6B.ev_one, ev_expNeg h]
  have h2 : RG6B.ev D a (RG6B.Pser * RG6B.Tdser) = 1 := by
    rw [RG6B.Pser_mul_Tdser, RG6B.ev_one]
  rw [h1, ← RG6B.X_mul_Pser, RG6B.ev_mul h, ev_X h, RG6B.Td]
  rw [RG6B.ev_mul h] at h2
  linear_combination a * h2

name: TOWERW.Td_indep
statement:
theorem Td_indep {a : K} {D D' : ℕ} (h : a ^ (D + 1) = 0) (hD : D ≤ D') :
    RG6B.Td D' a = RG6B.Td D a
proof:
:=
  ev_eq_of_le h hD _

name: TOWERW.map_ev
statement:
theorem map_ev {L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra ℚ L] (f : K →+* L) (D : ℕ) (a : K)
    (g : ℚ⟦X⟧) : f (RG6B.ev D a g) = RG6B.ev D (f a) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [RG6B.ev_eq_sum, RG6B.ev_eq_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_rat_smul, map_pow]

name: TOWERW.map_Td
statement:
theorem map_Td {L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra ℚ L] (f : K →+* L) (D : ℕ) (a : K) :
    f (RG6B.Td D a) = RG6B.Td D (f a)
proof:
:=
  map_ev f D a _

name: TOWERW.map_th
statement:
theorem map_th {L : Type*} [CommRing L] [Algebra ℚ L] (f : K →+* L) (j D : ℕ) (a : K) :
    f (RG6B.th j D a) = RG6B.th j D (f a)
proof:
:=
  map_ev f D a _

name: TOWERW.Td_logOnePlus
statement:
theorem Td_logOnePlus {x : K} {D : ℕ} (h : x ^ (D + 1) = 0) :
    RG6B.Td D (logOnePlus x) = RG6B.ev D x (RG6B.Tdser.subst (log ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RG6B.Td, logOnePlus_eq_ev h, ev_subst h constantCoeff_log]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv_base
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : CoordinateChartRing R n i) :
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i
        (coordinateAwayMapNormalized
          (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n i x) =
      (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i x, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord :
      awayCoordinateEquiv (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i
          (coordinateAwayMapNormalized
            (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n i x) =
        MvPolynomial.map (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q)
          (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i x) := by
    apply
      (awayCoordinateEquiv
        (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i).symm.injective
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change
      coordinateAwayMapNormalized
          (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n i x =
        awayCoordinateHom (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i
          (MvPolynomial.map (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q)
            (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i x))
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply,
      ← coordinateAwayMapNormalized_comp_awayCoordinateHom]
    change
      coordinateAwayMapNormalized
          (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n i x =
        coordinateAwayMapNormalized
          (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n i
          ((awayCoordinateEquiv R n i).symm
            (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i x))
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquivOverBase R Q (AffineChartIndex n i)
        (awayCoordinateEquiv (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i
          (coordinateAwayMapNormalized
            (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) n i x)) =
      (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i x, 0)
  rw [hcoord]
  exact
    squareZeroMvPolynomialLinearEquiv_map_inl R Q
      (AffineChartIndex n i) (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)
    (x : CoordinateChartRing (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i) :
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i
        ((awayCoordinateEquiv
          (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i).symm
          (MvPolynomial.map (projectiveSquareZeroInlRingHom R Q) p) * x) =
      p • projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i x
proof:
:=
  (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i).map_smul p x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (A : Type w) [CommSemiring A]
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R) A]
    (a : A) (x : CoordinateChartRing (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i) :
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeLinearEquiv R Q n i A
        (a ⊗ₜ[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R] x) =
      a ⊗ₜ[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R]
        projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i x
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.lTensor_tmul A
    (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i) a x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv_tmul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (A : Type w) [CommSemiring A]
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R) A]
    (a : A) (x : CoordinateChartRing (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i) :
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv R Q n i A
        (a ⊗ₜ[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R] x) =
      (a ⊗ₜ[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R]
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i x).1,
        a ⊗ₜ[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R]
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartPolynomialLinearEquiv R Q n i x).2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv,
    tensorProductProdLinearEquiv, TensorProduct.map_tmul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (A B : Type w) [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B]
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R) A]
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R) B]
    (φ : A →ₐ[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R] B)
    (z : A ⊗[MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R]
      CoordinateChartRing (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i) :
    projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv R Q n i B
        (TensorProduct.map φ.toLinearMap
          (LinearMap.id (R := MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)
            (M := CoordinateChartRing
              (projectiveSquareZeroRing R Q) n i)) z) =
      (TensorProduct.map φ.toLinearMap
          (LinearMap.id (R := MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)
            (M := MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R))
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv
            R Q n i A z).1,
        TensorProduct.map φ.toLinearMap
          (LinearMap.id (R := MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)
            (M := MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R ⊗[R] Q))
          (projectiveSquareZeroCoordinateChartBaseChangeSplitLinearEquiv
            R Q n i A z).2)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      apply Prod.ext <;> simp
  | tmul a x =>
      simp [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hz₁, hz₂]
      apply Prod.ext <;> simp

name: RD.isRegularRing_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_subsingleton (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Subsingleton A] :
    IsRegularRing A
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite A := Finite.of_subsingleton
  exact
    { isRegularLocalRing_localization := fun p hp =>
        absurd ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one p).mpr (by
          rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : A) 0]; exact p.zero_mem)) hp.ne_top }

name: RD.isRegularRing_of_surj_ker_X
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_surj_ker_X (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type} [Finite σ] (j : σ)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (θ : MvPolynomial σ k →+* A) (hθ : Function.Surjective θ)
    (hk : RingHom.ker θ = Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ k)}) :
    IsRegularRing A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let σ' := {x : σ // x ≠ j}
  let e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ' k) :=
    (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv k (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe j).symm).trans
      (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft k σ')
  have hXj : e (MvPolynomial.X j) = Polynomial.X := by
    simp [e]
  let ev : MvPolynomial σ k →+* MvPolynomial σ' k :=
    (Polynomial.evalRingHom 0).comp e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  have hev : Function.Surjective ev := fun b => ⟨e.symm (Polynomial.C b), by simp [ev]⟩
  have hkev : RingHom.ker ev = Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ k)} := by
    have h1 : RingHom.ker ev = (RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : MvPolynomial σ' k))).comap
        e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
      rw [RingHom.comap_ker]
    rw [h1, Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom]
    ext p
    simp only [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, map_zero, sub_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨e.symm c, e.injective ?_⟩
      simpa [hXj] using hc
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e c, by simp [hXj]⟩
  haveI : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial σ' k) := BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular k σ'
  exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (equivOfKerEq ev θ hev hθ (hkev.trans hk.symm))

name: RD.awayCoordinate_chartEquation_ne
statement:
theorem awayCoordinate_chartEquation_ne {a : Fin (n + 1)} (h0 : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ a) :
    awayCoordinateEquiv k n a (hyperplaneChartEquation k n (s0 k n) a) =
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, h0⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h : hyperplaneChartEquation k n (s0 k n) a =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n 0) := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp [hyperplaneChartEquation, GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, s0,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [h]
  unfold awayCoordinateEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change _ = awayCoordinateHom k n a (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, h0⟩)
  rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]

    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp [hyperplaneChartEquation, GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, s0,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, coordinate]
    first | rfl | exact HomogeneousLocalization.val_one.symm
  rw [h, map_one]

name: RD.isRegularRing_away
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_away (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsRegularRing (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n a)))
proof:
:= by
  let φ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (q k n) (coordinate k n a)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ :=
    GradedIdealQuotient.awayMap_surjective (grading k n) _ (coordinate k n a)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n a)
  let e := awayCoordinateEquiv k n a
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hker⟩ : ∃ θ : MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) k →+*
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n a)),
      Function.Surjective θ ∧
        RingHom.ker θ = Ideal.span {e (hyperplaneChartEquation k n (s0 k n) a)} := by
    refine ⟨φ.comp e.symm.toRingHom, hφ.comp e.symm.surjective, ?_⟩
    have h1 : RingHom.ker (φ.comp e.symm.toRingHom) = (RingHom.ker φ).comap e.symm := by
      ext x
      exact Iff.rfl
    rw [h1, ker_hyperplaneChartMap, Ideal.comap_symm, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  by_cases ha : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) = a
  · subst ha
    rw [awayCoordinate_chartEquation_zero] at hker
    haveI : Subsingleton (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n 0))) := by
      refine subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one ?_
      have h1 : (1 : MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) k) ∈ RingHom.ker θ := by
        rw [hker]; simp
      have h2 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp h1
      rw [map_one] at h2
      exact h2.symm
    exact @isRegularRing_of_subsingleton _ _ this
  · rw [awayCoordinate_chartEquation_ne k n ha] at hker
    exact isRegularRing_of_surj_ker_X k (σ := AffineChartIndex n a) ⟨0, ha⟩ θ hθ hker

name: RD.isRegularScheme_hyperplane
statement:
theorem isRegularScheme_hyperplane :
    BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (hyperplane k n (s0 k n))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, hyperplaneι k n (s0 k n) x ∈ coordinateOpen k n a := by
    have : hyperplaneι k n (s0 k n) x ∈ (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i) := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using this
  let x' : Proj (Q k n) := x
  have hxV : x' ∈ Proj.basicOpen (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n a)) := by
    rw [Proj.mem_basicOpen]
    intro hmem
    exact (Proj.mem_basicOpen (grading k n) _ _).mp ha hmem
  let V := Proj.basicOpen (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n a))
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V :=
    Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen (Q k n) _ ((q k n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n a))
      Nat.zero_lt_one
  let eB : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n a)) ≃+*
      Γ(hyperplane k n (s0 k n), V) :=
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (Q k n) (q k n (coordinate k n a))
      ((q k n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n a)) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  haveI := isRegularRing_away k n a
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(hyperplane k n (s0 k n), V) := IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv eB
  have hreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme V.toScheme :=
    BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_of_iso hV.isoSpec
      (BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularScheme_spec Γ(hyperplane k n (s0 k n), V))
  exact BlowupRegularAR12.isRegularAt_of_openImmersion V.ι ⟨x', hxV⟩ (hreg ⟨x', hxV⟩)

name: RD.genPt_not_mem_range
statement: theorem genPt_not_mem_range : genPt ∉ Set.range (iZ ℚ 2 J)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  let e : Zs ℚ 2 J ≅ hyperplane ℚ 2 (s0 ℚ 2) := (asIso ι.toImage).symm
  have hez : ι.toImage (e.hom z) = z := by
    have h : (e.hom ≫ ι.toImage) = 𝟙 _ := Iso.inv_hom_id (asIso ι.toImage)
    calc ι.toImage (e.hom z) = (e.hom ≫ ι.toImage) z := (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
      _ = z := by rw [h]; rfl
  have hmem : genPt ∈ Set.range ι := ⟨e.hom z, by rw [← iZ_toImage, hez]; exact hz⟩
  rw [mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff] at hmem
  exact MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 3) (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem)

name: RD.hd
statement: theorem hd : 0 < codim ℚ 2 J
proof:
:= by
  let e : Zs ℚ 2 J ≅ hyperplane ℚ 2 (s0 ℚ 2) := (asIso ι.toImage).symm
  have hez : ∀ z, ι.toImage (e.hom z) = z := fun z => by
    have h : (e.hom ≫ ι.toImage) = 𝟙 _ := Iso.inv_hom_id (asIso ι.toImage)
    calc ι.toImage (e.hom z) = (e.hom ≫ ι.toImage) z := (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
      _ = z := by rw [h]; rfl
  set g := genericPoint (Zs ℚ 2 J) with hg
  set h := e.hom g with hhdef
  have hh : ι.toImage h = g := hez g
  have hmax : IsMax h := by
    intro b hb
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hb ⊢
    have hsp : ι.toImage h ⤳ ι.toImage b := by
      rw [hh]; exact (genericPoint_spec (Zs ℚ 2 J)).specializes trivial
    exact (ι.toImage.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff).mp hsp
  have h1 : Order.coheight (ι h) = 1 :=
    coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one ℚ 2 (s0 ℚ 2) (s0_ne ℚ 2) h
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_genericPoints_of_isMax hmax)
  show 0 < (Order.coheight (iZ ℚ 2 J g)).toNat
  rw [← hh, iZ_toImage, h1]
  decide

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits
statement:
theorem openSheafPullback_preservesFiniteLimits {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u})
proof:
:= by
  letI := Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.functor_isContinuous g.isOpenEmbedding
  let F := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let G := TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X
  let H := TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} Y
  let K := (CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
    g.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op
  let e :=
    g.isOpenEmbedding.functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousCompSheafToPresheafIso
      AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
  let hH : PreservesFiniteLimits H := by dsimp [H]; infer_instance
  let hK : PreservesFiniteLimits K := by dsimp [K]; infer_instance
  let hcomp : PreservesFiniteLimits (H ⋙ K) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ _ _ _ _ H K hH hK
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G) := by
    exact @preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso _ _ _ _ _ _ e.symm hcomp
  exact preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves F G

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openSheafPullback_additive
statement:
theorem openSheafPullback_additive {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).Additive
proof:
:= by
  let F := g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}

    (g.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u})

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_comp
statement:
theorem extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_comp
    {C D E : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Category.{u} E]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [Abelian E]
    [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D] [HasExt.{u} E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    {C₀ : C} {D₀ : D} {E₀ : E}
    (e₁ : F.obj C₀ ≅ D₀) (e₂ : G.obj D₀ ≅ E₀)
    (A : C) (i : ℕ) (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext C₀ A i) :
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G)
proof:
:=
      @comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ G) :=
      @comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
    extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso G e₂ (F.obj A) i
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e₁ A i x) =
      extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso (F ⋙ G)
        (functorCompEndpointIso F G e₁ e₂) A i x := by
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ G) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ G) :=
    @comp_preservesFiniteColimits _ _ _ _ _ _ F G inferInstance inferInstance
  change (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e₂.inv).comp
      (((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e₁.inv).comp
        (x.mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add i)).mapExactFunctor G) (zero_add i) = _
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀,
    extMapExactFunctor_comp,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
  congr 2

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality
statement:
theorem extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    {C₀ : C} {D₀ : D} (e : F.obj C₀ ≅ D₀) {A B : C} (p : A ⟶ B)
    (i : ℕ) (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext C₀ A i) :
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (F.map p)).postcomp D₀ (add_zero i)
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A i x) =
      extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e B i
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ p).postcomp C₀ (add_zero i) x)
proof:
:= by
  change ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add i)).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (F.map p)) (add_zero i) =
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      ((x.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ p) (add_zero i)).mapExactFunctor F)
      (zero_add i)
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀]
  exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv)
    (x.mapExactFunctor F)
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (F.map p))
    (zero_add i)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta
statement:
theorem extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{u} C] [HasExt.{u} D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    {C₀ : C} {D₀ : D} (e : F.obj C₀ ≅ D₀)
    (S : ShortComplex C) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i + 1 = j)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext C₀ S.X₃ i) :
    extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e S.X₁ j
        (hS.extClass.postcomp C₀ hij x) =
      (hS.map_of_exact F).extClass.postcomp D₀ hij
        (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e S.X₃ i x)
proof:
:= by
  change (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      ((x.comp hS.extClass hij).mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add j) =
    ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ e.inv).comp
      (x.mapExactFunctor F) (zero_add i)).comp
        (hS.map_of_exact F).extClass hij
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_extClass]
  symm
  apply CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc
  omega

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv_map_smul
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_addEquiv_map_smul
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (V : Y.Opens)
    (r : Γ(Y, V)) (x : (restrictToPreimage f M V).H 0) :

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocal_degreeZero_sections
statement:
theorem affineLocal_degreeZero_sections
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (V : Y.Opens) :
    Nonempty (((restrictToPreimage f M V).H 0) ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M, V))
proof:
:=
  ⟨affineLocalCohomologyModule_zero_pushforward_addEquiv f M V⟩

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffinePushforward_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem finiteAffinePushforward_isCoherentLike (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X E) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj E)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffinePushforwardObject_exact
statement:
theorem finiteAffinePushforwardObject_exact (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (A B C : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
      (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules
      (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y)
      (finiteAffinePushforwardObject f A)
      (finiteAffinePushforwardObject f B)
      (finiteAffinePushforwardObject f C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  let T : ShortComplex X.Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2
  refine ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero, ?_⟩
  exact pushforward_map_shortExact_of_isAffine f T hshort

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X E) :
    finiteAffineG0Pushforward f (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E hE) =
      SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj E)
        (finiteAffinePushforward_isCoherentLike f E hE)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent
statement:
theorem finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage f E i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · simpa [finiteAffineHigherDirectImage, hi] using
      finiteAffinePushforward_isCoherentLike f E.1 E.2
  · simp only [finiteAffineHigherDirectImage, hi, if_false]
    show (0 : Y.Modules).IsFinitePresentation
    infer_instance

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_zero (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M})
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≠ 0) : finiteAffineHigherDirectImage f E i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteAffineHigherDirectImage, hi]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_eq
statement:
theorem finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_eq (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage f)
        (finiteAffineHigherDirectImage_coherent f) E i =
      finiteAffineG0Pushforward f
        (GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass E i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    change SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj E.1) _ =
      finiteAffineG0Pushforward f (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)
    exact (finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf f E.1 E.2).symm
  · rw [show GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass E i = 0 by
      simp [GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass, hi]]
    rw [map_zero]
    simp only [SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass,
      finiteAffineHigherDirectImage, hi, if_false]
    apply SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_zero Y

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineDerivedPushforward_eq
statement:
theorem finiteAffineDerivedPushforward_eq (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)] :
    finiteAffineDerivedPushforward f = finiteAffineG0Pushforward f
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  change finiteAffineDerivedPushforward f
      (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) =
    finiteAffineG0Pushforward f (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)
  dsimp only [finiteAffineDerivedPushforward]
  rw [SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_classOf]
  simp [GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum,
    finiteAffineHigherDirectImageClass_eq]
  change finiteAffineG0Pushforward f (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) =
    SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj E.1) _
  exact finiteAffineG0Pushforward_classOf f E.1 E.2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_zero
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n 0 i j Z hZi hZj =
      Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply LineBundleLocalData.globalUnitOverHom_ext
  let oneZ : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) := 1
  change
    (show Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) from
      (projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso
        R n 0 i j Z hZi hZj).hom.val.app
          (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z))) oneZ) =
      oneZ
  rw [projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one]
  exact coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_zero R n i j Z _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_restrict_eq
    (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) hZi
        (show (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 0).over
            (coordinateOpen R n i) ⟶
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).over (coordinateOpen R n i) from
          (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n 0 i).hom) =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) hZj
        (show (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 0).over
            (coordinateOpen R n j) ⟶
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).over (coordinateOpen R n j) from
          (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n 0 j).hom)
proof:
:= by
  let Ci := projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n 0 i Z hZi
  let Cj := projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n 0 j Z hZj
  change Ci.hom = Cj.hom
  apply (cancel_epi Ci.inv).1
  rw [Ci.inv_hom_id]
  have h := congrArg Iso.hom
    (projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_zero
      R n i j Z hZi hZj)
  change Ci.inv ≫ Cj.hom = 𝟙 _ at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_compatible
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_compatible :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) ↦
        Scheme.Modules.localHomSection
          (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (coordinateOpen R n i.down)
          (show (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 0).over
                (coordinateOpen R n i.down) ⟶
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf
                (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).over
                  (coordinateOpen R n i.down) from
            (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
              R n 0 i.down).hom))
proof:
:= by
  intro Z i j f g
  have hZi : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n i.down := f.le
  have hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j.down := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hZi from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hZj from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  apply congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over Z)).map
  exact projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_restrict_eq
    R n i.down j.down Z hZi hZj

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingZeroHom_isIso
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingZeroHom_isIso :
    IsIso (projectiveTwistingZeroHom R n)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens :=
    fun i ↦ coordinateOpen R n i.down
  let hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2 (by
      change ⨆ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)),
        coordinateOpen R n i.down = ⊤
      simpa only [U, iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n)
  change IsIso (Scheme.Modules.glueHom X U hU
    (fun i ↦
      (show (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 0).over (U i) ⟶
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).over (U i) from
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n 0 i.down).hom))
    (projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_compatible R n))
  exact Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso X U hU
    (fun i ↦
      (show (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 0).over (U i) ⟶
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).over (U i) from
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n 0 i.down).hom))
    (projectiveTwistingZeroCoordinateIso_compatible R n)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: B7.dual_tvee_split
statement:
theorem dual_tvee_split :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsNoetherian T) (hTc : ConstantRankGenerators T) (g : T ⟶ X)
      (Lm : Fin n → T.Modules) (Mm : Fin (rN i) → T.Modules)
      (hL : ∀ a, HasConstantRank T (Lm a) 1) (hM : ∀ b, HasConstantRank T (Mm b) 1),
      Function.Injective (qQ (pullbackK0RingHom g)) ∧
      pullbackK0RingHom g (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i) =
        ∑ a, k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree -
          ∑ b, k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      qQ (pullbackK0RingHom g) ((ctxOf hX).dual (le_refl 2) (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i))) =
        ∑ a, B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (lineBundleDual T (Lm a))
            (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (Lm a) (hL a)).isFiniteLocallyFree) -
          ∑ b, B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (lineBundleDual T (Mm b))
            (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (Mm b) (hM b)).isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  have hXc : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hXrn := rankZeroNilpotent_of_projective hX
  obtain ⟨T, hTn, hTi, hTc, hTT, g, Lm, Mm, hL, hM, hnilT, hinj, hEaq, hEbq, hnilL, hnilM, ⟨t0⟩⟩ :=
    exists_tower hXrn (hEa i) (hEb hXreg hY hYreg i)
  haveI := hTn
  let CK := ctxOf hX
  let CT := ctxK0 hTc hTT t0
  let φ := pullbackK0RingHom g
  have hφ : ∀ (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E),
      φ (k0ClassOf X E hE) = k0ClassOf T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) := fun E hE =>
    pullbackK0RingHom_classOf g E hE
  have hcomm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : K0 X), φ (adamsRingHom hXc m x) = adamsRingHom hTc m (φ x) := by
    intro m x
    cases m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m =>
      rw [adamsRingHom_apply hXc (by omega), adamsRingHom_apply hTc (by omega)]
      exact adams_pullback g φ hφ (m + 1) x
  have hq : Function.Injective (qQ φ) := qQ_injective φ hinj
  have hqΨ : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ x, qQ φ (CK.Ψ m x) = CT.Ψ m (qQ φ x) :=
    fun m _ x => qQ_adams hXc hTc φ hcomm m x
  have htvee := tvee_eq hXreg hY hYreg i
  have hφtv : φ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i) =
      ∑ a, k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree -
        ∑ b, k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree := by
    rw [htvee, map_sub, hEaq, hEbq]
  have hℓ : ∀ a, IsNilpotent (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree) - 1) := by
    intro a
    have := (hnilL a).map (B5.toKQ T)
    rwa [map_sub, map_one] at this
  have hm : ∀ b, IsNilpotent (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree) - 1) := by
    intro b
    have := (hnilM b).map (B5.toKQ T)
    rwa [map_sub, map_one] at this
  have hadams : ∀ c : K0 T, CT.Ψ 2 (B5.toKQ T c) = B5.toKQ T (adamsRingHom hTc 2 c) := by
    intro c
    show adamsQ hTc 2 ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c) = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] adamsRingHom hTc 2 c
    simp [adamsQ, psiQ_tmul]
  have hℓψ : ∀ a, CT.Ψ 2 (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ 2 := by
    intro a
    rw [hadams, adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hTc (Lm a) (hL a) (by omega), map_pow]
  have hmψ : ∀ b, CT.Ψ 2 (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      (B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree)) ^ 2 := by
    intro b
    rw [hadams, adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne hTc (Mm b) (hM b) (by omega), map_pow]
  have hinvL : ∀ a, B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree) *
      B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (lineBundleDual T (Lm a))
        (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (Lm a) (hL a)).isFiniteLocallyFree) = 1 := by
    intro a
    rw [← map_mul, k0Class_mul_lineBundleDual (Lm a) (hL a), map_one]
  have hinvM : ∀ b, B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree) *
      B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (lineBundleDual T (Mm b))
        (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (Mm b) (hM b)).isFiniteLocallyFree) = 1 := by
    intro b
    rw [← map_mul, k0Class_mul_lineBundleDual (Mm b) (hM b), map_one]
  have htv : qQ φ (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) =
      ∑ a, B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree) -
        ∑ b, B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    have e : qQ φ (B5.toKQ X (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) =
        B5.toKQ T (φ (B5.tvee hY hYreg hXreg n i)) := by
      simp [B5.toKQ_apply, qQ_tmul]
    rw [e, hφtv, map_sub, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine ⟨T, hTn, hTc, g, Lm, Mm, hL, hM, hq, hφtv, ?_⟩
  exact dual_split (le_refl 2) CK CT (qQ φ) hqΨ
    (fun a => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Lm a) (hL a).isFiniteLocallyFree))
    (fun a => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (lineBundleDual T (Lm a))
      (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (Lm a) (hL a)).isFiniteLocallyFree))
    (fun b => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (Mm b) (hM b).isFiniteLocallyFree))
    (fun b => B5.toKQ T (k0ClassOf T (lineBundleDual T (Mm b))
      (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (Mm b) (hM b)).isFiniteLocallyFree))
    hℓ hm hℓψ hmψ hinvL hinvM _ htv

name: RB2.arr_caseII
statement:
theorem arr_caseII (J : A.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral J.subscheme]
    (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A)
    (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme J.subscheme) (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤))
    (hd : 0 < ARRKG2A.codim J) (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (ARRKG2A.iZ A J))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (ARRKG2A.Zs A J)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= KG2B.isNoetherian_total J hA
    haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W J hA
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (ARRKG2A.rankA A) j)
        (pushLocF3 j (ARRKG2A.iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (ARRKG2A.iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (ARRKG2A.thetaZ (ARRKG2A.inputsOfKG2B J hA hAreg hZ) j *
          locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (ARRKG2A.rankZ A J) j) x) :=
  ARRKG2A.arr_caseII_ambient J hA hAreg hZ φ hd hne hj x

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeConormalExactH2.specConormal_isQuasicoherent
statement:

statement:

    (Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb (j ≫ p)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI : (Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))).IsQuasicoherent :=
    specConormal_isQuasicoherent _
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Spec (.of B)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeConormalExactH2.nativeMiddle_isQuasicoherent

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeConormalExactH2.nativeTarget_isQuasicoherent
statement:

proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeConormalExactH2.nativeSpecSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem nativeSpecSequence_shortExact :
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence j p).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let T := ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence j p
  letI : T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change (Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb (j ≫ p)).IsQuasicoherent
    exact nativeSource_isQuasicoherent (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
  letI : T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change (Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb j).IsQuasicoherent
    exact nativeMiddle_isQuasicoherent (A := A) (B := B)

    change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (relativeSheaf p)).IsQuasicoherent
    exact nativeTarget_isQuasicoherent (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
  exact (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff
    T).mp
