name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection_res
statement:
theorem tensorSheafPureTensorSection_res
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M N : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (m : Γ(M, U)) (x : Γ(N, U)) :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N U m x) =
      tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N V
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op m)
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x)
proof:
:= by
  let P :=
    SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X M ⊗
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X N
  let η := (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P
  have hnat := η.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op
  have hnatx := CategoryTheory.congr_fun hnat
    (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] x)
  have hP :
      P.map (homOfLE hVU).op (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] x) =
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op m) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V)]
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x) := by
    exact PresheafOfModules.Monoidal.tensorObj_map_tmul
      (R := X.presheaf)
      (M₁ := SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X M)
      (M₂ := SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X N)
      (homOfLE hVU).op m x
  change
    (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification X ⋙
        SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj P).map
          (homOfLE hVU).op)
        (η.app (Opposite.op U) (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] x)) =
      η.app (Opposite.op V)
        ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op m) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V)]
          (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x))
  rw [← hP]
  exact hnatx.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafOverCoordinate_pure
statement:
theorem tensorSheafOverCoordinate_pure
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U₀ : Y.Opens) (W : Over U₀)
    (M N : Y.Modules)
    (eM : M.over U₀ ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀))
    (m : Γ(M, W.left)) (z : Γ(N, W.left)) :
    let P
proof:
:=
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf Y M ⊗
        SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf Y N
    let η := (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P
    let e :=
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U₀ M N).symm ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U₀ eM (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor Y U₀ (N.over U₀)
    let eApp := (SheafOfModules.evaluation
      (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀) (op W)).mapIso e
    eApp.hom (η.app (op W.left) (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W.left)] z)) =
      (eM.hom.val.app (op W)).hom
          (show (M.over U₀).val.obj (op W) from m) •
        (show (N.over U₀).val.obj (op W) from z) := by
  dsimp only
  let P :=
    SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf Y M ⊗
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf Y N
  let adj := SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y
  let η := adj.unit.app P
  let restr := SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf U₀
  let localAdj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj)
  let localRight :=
    SheafOfModules.forget (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀) ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (𝟙 (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj)
  let R' := (((Over.forget U₀).op ⋙ Y.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (PresheafOfModules.{u} (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  let eLocal :=
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U₀ M N).symm ≪≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U₀ eM (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor Y U₀ (N.over U₀)
  let rη := restr.map η
  let μ := Functor.Monoidal.μIso
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
      (Over.forget U₀) Y.presheaf) M.val N.val
  let S := N.over U₀
  let k : restr.obj P ⟶ S.val :=
    μ.inv ≫ (eM.hom.val ⊗ₘ 𝟙 S.val) ≫
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom
  have hcomp :
      rη ≫ localRight.map eLocal.hom = k := by
    let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf U₀
    let eP := SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationOverIso Y U₀ P
    let de := eM.hom.val ⊗ₘ 𝟙 S.val
    let l := MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val
    let q : A.obj (restr.obj P) ⟶ S :=
      A.map μ.inv ≫ A.map de ≫ A.map l.hom ≫
        localAdj.counit.app S
    have heLocal : eLocal.hom = eP.inv ≫ q := by
      dsimp only [eLocal, eP, q]
      unfold SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor
      dsimp only [P, SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf]
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
        tensorIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.assoc]
      dsimp only [A, μ, de, l, S, localAdj]
      rfl
    have heP :
        localAdj.homEquiv _ _ eP.hom = rη := by
      let T := ((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification Y).obj P).over U₀
      have hc :
          localAdj.homEquiv
              ((SheafOfModules.forget
                (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀)).obj T) T
              (localAdj.counit.app T) =
            𝟙 _ := by
        rw [← localAdj.homEquiv_symm_id T]
        exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
      calc
        localAdj.homEquiv _ _
            (A.map rη ≫ localAdj.counit.app T) =
          rη ≫ localAdj.homEquiv
            ((SheafOfModules.forget
              (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀)).obj T) T
              (localAdj.counit.app T) := by
            change localAdj.homEquiv _ _
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
                (𝟙 (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj)).map rη ≫ _) = _
            exact localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_left rη _
        _ = rη := by
          rw [hc]
          exact Category.comp_id rη
    have hq :
        localAdj.homEquiv _ _ q = k := by
      dsimp only [q]
      calc
        localAdj.homEquiv _ _
            (A.map μ.inv ≫ A.map de ≫ A.map l.hom ≫
              localAdj.counit.app S) =
          μ.inv ≫ localAdj.homEquiv _ _
            (A.map de ≫ A.map l.hom ≫
              localAdj.counit.app S) := by
            change localAdj.homEquiv _ _
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
                (𝟙 (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj)).map μ.inv ≫ _) = _
            exact localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_left μ.inv _
        _ = μ.inv ≫ de ≫ localAdj.homEquiv _ _
            (A.map l.hom ≫ localAdj.counit.app S) := by
          have h := localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_left de
            (A.map l.hom ≫ localAdj.counit.app S)
          exact congrArg (fun z ↦ μ.inv ≫ z) h
        _ = μ.inv ≫ de ≫ l.hom := by
          have hl := localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_left l.hom
            (localAdj.counit.app S)
          have hc :
              localAdj.homEquiv S.val S
                  (localAdj.counit.app S) =
                𝟙 S.val := by
            rw [← localAdj.homEquiv_symm_id S]
            exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
          have hlast :
              localAdj.homEquiv _ _
                  (A.map l.hom ≫ localAdj.counit.app S) =
                l.hom := by
            calc
              localAdj.homEquiv _ _
                  (A.map l.hom ≫ localAdj.counit.app S) =
                l.hom ≫ localAdj.homEquiv S.val S
                  (localAdj.counit.app S) := by
                    change localAdj.homEquiv _ _
                      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
                        (𝟙 (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj)).map l.hom ≫ _) = _
                    exact hl
              _ = l.hom ≫ 𝟙 S.val :=
                congrArg (fun z ↦ l.hom ≫ z) hc
              _ = l.hom := Category.comp_id l.hom
          exact congrArg (fun z ↦ μ.inv ≫ de ≫ z) hlast
        _ = k := rfl
    calc
      rη ≫ localRight.map eLocal.hom =
          localAdj.homEquiv _ _ eP.hom ≫
            localRight.map eLocal.hom := by rw [heP]
      _ = localAdj.homEquiv _ _ (eP.hom ≫ eLocal.hom) := by
        rw [localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_right]
      _ = localAdj.homEquiv _ _ q := by
        rw [heLocal, eP.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      _ = k := hq
  have hW := congrArg (fun α => α.app (op W)) hcomp
  have hx := CategoryTheory.congr_fun hW
    (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W.left)] z)
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
      (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀) (op W)).map eLocal.hom)
        (η.app (op W.left) (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W.left)] z)) =
      k.app (op W) (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W.left)] z) at hx
  have hk :
      k.app (op W) (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, W.left)] z) =
        (eM.hom.val.app (op W)).hom
            (show (M.over U₀).val.obj (op W) from m) •
          (show (N.over U₀).val.obj (op W) from z) := by
    dsimp only [k, μ]
    letI : CommRing
        ((Y.ringCatSheaf.over U₀).obj.obj (op W)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (CommRing (Y.presheaf.obj (op W.left)))
    let c : Γ(Y, W.left) := (eM.hom.val.app (op W)).hom m
    change
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
        ((N.over U₀).val.obj (op W))).hom
          (c ⊗ₜ
            (show (N.over U₀).val.obj (op W) from z)) =
        c • z
    rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_hom_apply]
  exact hx.trans hk

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_res_coefficient
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_res_coefficient
    (d : ℤ) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (Z : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)
    (hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j) :
    (projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n d j Z hZj).hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z)))
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hZj).op
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j)) =
      (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z))
proof:
:= by
  let U := coordinateOpen R n j
  let C := projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation
    ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over U)
    (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
  have hone : E.map C.hom
      (E.map C.inv (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U))) =
        (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U)) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, C.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  let W : Over U := Over.mk (homOfLE hZj)
  let q : W ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) :=
    Over.homMk (homOfLE hZj) (by rfl)
  have hnat := C.hom.val.naturality q.op
  have hnatx := CategoryTheory.congr_fun hnat
    (E.map C.inv (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U)))
  change
    C.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hZj)))
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hZj).op
          (E.map C.inv (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U)))) =
      (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z))
  change
    C.hom.val.app (Opposite.op (Over.mk (homOfLE hZj)))
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hZj).op
          (E.map C.inv (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U)))) =
      (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE hZj).op
        (E.map C.hom
          (E.map C.inv (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U)))) at hnatx
  have hrhs := congrArg
    (fun z : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U) =>
      (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE hZj).op z) hone
  have hmapOne :
      (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE hZj).op
          (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, U)) =
        (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)) :=
    map_one _
  exact hnatx.trans (hrhs.trans hmapOne)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_transition
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_transition
    (d : ℤ) (j k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let Z
proof:
:= coordinateOverlapOpen R n j k
    let hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j :=
      (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left
    let hZk : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n k :=
      (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 •
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hZj).op
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE hZk).op
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d k) := by
  dsimp only
  let Z := coordinateOverlapOpen R n j k
  let hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j :=
    (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left
  let hZk : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n k :=
    (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right
  let Cj := projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n d j Z hZj
  let Ck := projectiveTwistingCoefficientOverIso R n d k Z hZk
  let A := projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso R n d j k Z hZj hZk
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation
    ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over Z)
    (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z)))
  let yj : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z) :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE hZj).op
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j)
  let yk : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z) :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE hZk).op
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d k)
  let rd : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) :=
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n d j k Z le_rfl
  let ri : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z) :=
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (-d) j k Z le_rfl
  have hCj : E.map Cj.hom yj = (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)) := by
    exact projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_res_coefficient
      R n d j Z hZj
  have hCk : E.map Ck.hom yk = (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)) := by
    exact projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_res_coefficient
      R n d k Z hZk
  have hA : E.map A.hom (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)) = ri := by
    dsimp only [A, ri]
    exact projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso_hom_app_one
      R n d j k Z hZj hZk
  have hcomp : Cj.hom ≫ A.hom = Ck.hom := by
    dsimp only [A, Cj, Ck, projectiveTwistingCoefficientChangeIso]
    simp
  have hCkj : E.map Ck.hom yj = ri := by
    calc
      E.map Ck.hom yj = E.map (Cj.hom ≫ A.hom) yj := by rw [hcomp]
      _ = E.map A.hom (E.map Cj.hom yj) := by
        rw [Functor.map_comp]
        rfl
      _ = E.map A.hom (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)) := by rw [hCj]
      _ = ri := hA
  have hrd :
      rd = (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 := by
    dsimp only [rd]
    rw [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict]
    rw [show (homOfLE (le_refl Z)).op =
        𝟙 (Opposite.op Z) from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
      Functor.map_id_apply]
  have hrdi : rd * ri = (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)) := by
    calc
      rd * ri =
          coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n (d + -d) j k Z le_rfl := by
        rw [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_add]
      _ = coordinateOverlapTransitionSection R n 0 j k Z le_rfl := by
        rw [add_neg_cancel]
      _ = 1 := coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_zero R n j k Z le_rfl
  apply (E.mapIso Ck).toLinearEquiv.injective
  change E.map Ck.hom
      ((twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 • yj) =
    E.map Ck.hom yk
  have hlinear := (E.map Ck.hom).hom.map_smul
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 yj
  rw [hlinear, hCkj, hCk, ← hrd]
  change rd * ri = (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z))
  exact hrdi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate_compatible_of_transition
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate_compatible_of_transition
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (d : ℤ) (j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (sj : Γ(M, coordinateOpen R n j))
    (sk : Γ(M, coordinateOpen R n k))
    (h :
      M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op sj =
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 •
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op sk) :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
          (projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate R n M d j sj) =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
          (projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate R n M d k sk)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := coordinateOverlapOpen R n j k
  let hZj : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n j :=
    (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left
  let hZk : Z ≤ coordinateOpen R n k :=
    (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right
  change
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hZj).op
          (tensorSheafPureTensorSection
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M
            (coordinateOpen R n j)
            (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) sj) =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hZk).op
          (tensorSheafPureTensorSection
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M
            (coordinateOpen R n k)
            (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d k) sk)
  rw [tensorSheafPureTensorSection_res, tensorSheafPureTensorSection_res]
  let P :=
    SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) ⊗
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) M
  let η := (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction
    (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)).unit.app P
  let yj : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z) :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map (homOfLE hZj).op
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j)
  let yk : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z) :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map (homOfLE hZk).op
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d k)
  let xj : Γ(M, Z) := M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hZj).op sj
  let xk : Γ(M, Z) := M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hZk).op sk
  change η.app (Opposite.op Z) (yj ⊗ₜ[Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)] xj) =
    η.app (Opposite.op Z) (yk ⊗ₜ[Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)] xk)
  apply congrArg (η.app (Opposite.op Z))
  have hx :
      xj = (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 • xk := h
  rw [hx, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  have hy :
      (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d j k).1 • yj = yk :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection_transition R n d j k
  exact congrArg
    (fun y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, Z) =>
      y ⊗ₜ[Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n, Z)] xk) hy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleSections_pairwise_compatible_symm
statement:
theorem moduleSections_pairwise_compatible_symm
    (N : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (sj : Γ(N, coordinateOpen R n j))
    (sk : Γ(N, coordinateOpen R n k))
    (h :
      N.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op sj =
        N.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op sk) :
    N.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n k j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op sk =
      N.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n k j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op sj
proof:
:= by
  let Zij := coordinateOverlapOpen R n j k
  let Zji := coordinateOverlapOpen R n k j
  let e : Zji = Zij := by
    dsimp only [Zji, Zij]
    rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf, coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf, inf_comm]
  let bij : Opposite.op (coordinateOpen R n j) ⟶ Opposite.op Zij :=
    (homOfLE
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
  let bkj : Opposite.op (coordinateOpen R n k) ⟶ Opposite.op Zij :=
    (homOfLE
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
  let bki : Opposite.op (coordinateOpen R n k) ⟶ Opposite.op Zji :=
    (homOfLE
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n k j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
  let bji : Opposite.op (coordinateOpen R n j) ⟶ Opposite.op Zji :=
    (homOfLE
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n k j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
  let q : Opposite.op Zij ⟶ Opposite.op Zji := (eqToHom e).op
  have hh := congrArg (fun x => N.presheaf.map q x) h.symm
  have hk : bkj ≫ q = bki := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hj : bij ≫ q = bji := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change N.presheaf.map bki sk = N.presheaf.map bji sj
  rw [← hk, ← hj, Functor.map_comp_apply, Functor.map_comp_apply]
  exact hh

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCech_exists_global_section_of_pairwise_compatible
statement:
theorem coordinateCech_exists_global_section_of_pairwise_compatible
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (N : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (s : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), Γ(N, coordinateOpen R n j))
    (hs : ∀ j k : Fin (n + 1),
      N.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
          (s j) =
        N.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
          (s k)) :
    ∃ t : Γ(N, (⊤ : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)),
      ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
        N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t = s j
proof:
:= by
  let charts := fun j : Fin (n + 1) =>
    N.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op (coordinateOpen R n j))
  let overlaps := fun jk : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) =>
    N.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n jk.1 jk.2))
  let x : ToType (∏ᶜ charts) :=
    (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv charts).symm s
  have hx :
      (coordinateCechSectionRightRes R n N -
        coordinateCechSectionLeftRes R n N) x = 0 := by
    apply (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv overlaps).injective
    funext jk
    rw [Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply,
      Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Preadditive.sub_comp,
      coordinateCechSectionRightRes_π,
      coordinateCechSectionLeftRes_π, map_zero]
    change
      N.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n jk.1 jk.2).le.trans
              inf_le_right)).op
          ((Limits.Pi.π charts jk.2).hom x) -
        N.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n jk.1 jk.2).le.trans
              inf_le_left)).op
          ((Limits.Pi.π charts jk.1).hom x) = 0
    have hxj : (Limits.Pi.π charts jk.1).hom x = s jk.1 := by
      rw [← Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
      simp only [x, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hxk : (Limits.Pi.π charts jk.2).hom x = s jk.2 := by
      rw [← Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
      simp only [x, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hxj, hxk]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hs jk.1 jk.2).symm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
    (coordinateCechSectionRes_exact R n N x).1 hx
  refine ⟨t, fun j => ?_⟩
  have hj := congrArg
    (fun z => (Limits.Pi.π charts j).hom z) ht
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, coordinateCechSectionRes_π] at hj
  change N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t = s j
  rw [← Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply] at hj
  simpa only [x, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hj

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.nativeComponent_self
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateNative_pairwise_compatible_of_base
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateNative_pairwise_compatible_of_base
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (d : ℕ) (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (sj : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (sk : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M k)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (hbase :
      projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv R n M j k hkj
          (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M j k hkj sj) =
        (twistTransitionUnit R n (d : ℤ) j k :
            CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k) •
          projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
            R n M j k hkj.symm
            (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
              R n M j k hkj.symm sk)) :
    M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j sj) =
      (M.smul (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (d : ℤ) j k).1).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
          (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M k sk))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j k) hbase
  rw [overlapNative_smul] at h
  have hLeft :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap
      R n M j k hkj sj
  change projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j k
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv R n M j k hkj
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
          R n M j k hkj sj)) =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
      (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j sj) at hLeft
  have hRight :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapRightNativeSectionsAddEquiv_localizationMap
      R n M j k hkj.symm sk
  change projectiveCoordinateOverlapNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M j k
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
        R n M j k hkj.symm
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M j k hkj.symm sk)) =
    M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
      (projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M k sk) at hRight
  rw [hLeft, hRight] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.tensorCandidate_pairwise_compatible
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.tensorCandidate_pairwise_compatible
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (hpair :
      ∀ p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i,
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv
              R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
            (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
              R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
              (E.component p.1.1.1)) =
          (twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 :
              CoordinateOverlapRing R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1) •
            projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
              R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2
              (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
                R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2
                (E.component p.1.2.1)))
    (j k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    let T
proof:
:= SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
      (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M
    T.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (E.tensorCandidate R n M D i s j) =
      T.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n j k).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
        (E.tensorCandidate R n M D i s k) := by
  dsimp only
  let T := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
    (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst k
    congr 1
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    have hki : k ≠ i := fun h => hjk h.symm
    have hn := E.native_compatible R n M D i s k hki
    apply projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate_compatible_of_transition
      R n M (D : ℤ) i k
        (E.nativeComponent R n M D i s i)
        (E.nativeComponent R n M D i s k)
    simpa only [ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.nativeComponent,
      E.component_self,
      Scheme.Modules.smul_apply] using hn
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst k
    have hn := E.native_compatible R n M D i s j hji
    have hfwd :=
      projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate_compatible_of_transition
        R n M (D : ℤ) i j
          (E.nativeComponent R n M D i s i)
          (E.nativeComponent R n M D i s j)
          (by
            simpa only [ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.nativeComponent,
              E.component_self,
              Scheme.Modules.smul_apply] using hn)
    exact moduleSections_pairwise_compatible_symm R n T i j
      (E.tensorCandidate R n M D i s i)
      (E.tensorCandidate R n M D i s j) hfwd
  let p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i :=
    ⟨(⟨j, hji⟩, ⟨k, hki⟩), hjk⟩
  have hn := projectiveCoordinateNative_pairwise_compatible_of_base
    R n M (D : ℕ) j k (Ne.symm hjk)
      (E.component j) (E.component k) (hpair p)
  apply projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate_compatible_of_transition
    R n M (D : ℤ) j k
      (E.nativeComponent R n M D i s j)
      (E.nativeComponent R n M D i s k)
  simpa only [ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.nativeComponent,
    Scheme.Modules.smul_apply] using hn

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_tensor_sections
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_tensor_sections
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ D : ℕ,
      ∃ E : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
          ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i
          (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a),
      ∃ t : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
          ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        Γ(SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M,
          (⊤ : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)),
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
          ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a) =
          (E i a).tensorCandidate R n M D i
            (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, E, hpair⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_raised_candidates R n M
  let T := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
    (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M
  have hex :
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
          ∃ t : Γ(T, (⊤ : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)),
            ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
              T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t =
                (E i a).tensorCandidate R n M D i
                  (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) j := by
    intro i a
    apply coordinateCech_exists_global_section_of_pairwise_compatible
      R n T
      (fun j => (E i a).tensorCandidate R n M D i
        (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) j)
    exact (E i a).tensorCandidate_pairwise_compatible
      R n M D i (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
      (fun p => hpair i p a)
  choose t ht using hex
  exact ⟨D, E, t, ht⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateSectionsAddEquiv_candidate
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateSectionsAddEquiv_candidate
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (d : ℤ) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Γ(M, coordinateOpen R n j)) :
    projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateSectionsAddEquiv R n M d j
        (projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate R n M d j s) =
      s
proof:
:= by
  have hpure :
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
          ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
            (coordinateOpen R n j))
          (Opposite.op
            (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).mapIso
        (projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateIso R n M d j)).hom
          (tensorSheafPureTensorSection
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M
            (coordinateOpen R n j)
            (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) s) =
        ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j).hom.val.app
          (Opposite.op
            (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).hom
              (show
                ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).over
                  (coordinateOpen R n j)).val.obj
                    (Opposite.op
                      (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from
                projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) •
          (show
            (M.over (coordinateOpen R n j)).val.obj
              (Opposite.op
                (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from s) := by
    simpa only [projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateIso,
      tensorSheafPureTensorSection, Over.mk,
      CostructuredArrow.mk] using
      (tensorSheafOverCoordinate_pure
        (Y := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
        (coordinateOpen R n j)
        (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j)
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) s)
  have hone :
      ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j).hom.val.app
        (Opposite.op
          (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).hom
            (show
              ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).over
                (coordinateOpen R n j)).val.obj
                  (Opposite.op
                    (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from
              projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) =
        (show
          (SheafOfModules.unit
              ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
                (coordinateOpen R n j))).val.obj
                  (Opposite.op
                    (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from
          (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
            coordinateOpen R n j))) := by
    change
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
          ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
            (coordinateOpen R n j))
          (Opposite.op
            (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).mapIso
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j)).hom
          (((SheafOfModules.evaluation
              ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
                (coordinateOpen R n j))
              (Opposite.op
                (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).mapIso
            (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j)).inv
              (show
                (SheafOfModules.unit
                    ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
                      (coordinateOpen R n j))).val.obj
                        (Opposite.op
                          (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from
                (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                  coordinateOpen R n j)))) =
        (show
          (SheafOfModules.unit
              ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
                (coordinateOpen R n j))).val.obj
                  (Opposite.op
                    (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from
          (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
            coordinateOpen R n j)))
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id_apply
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
          ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
            (coordinateOpen R n j))
          (Opposite.op
            (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).mapIso
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j))
      (show
        (SheafOfModules.unit
            ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
              (coordinateOpen R n j))).val.obj
                (Opposite.op
                  (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j)))) from
        (1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
          coordinateOpen R n j)))
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
        ((ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).ringCatSheaf.over
          (coordinateOpen R n j))
        (Opposite.op
          (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n j))))).mapIso
      (projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateIso R n M d j)).hom
        (tensorSheafPureTensorSection
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) M
          (coordinateOpen R n j)
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateFrameSection R n d j) s) = s
  rw [hpure, hone, one_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections_eval_terminal
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections_eval_terminal
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I) :
    ((projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections R n M i).s a).eval
        (Opposite.op
          (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n i)))) =
      projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i
        (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator] using
    ((projectiveCoordinateChartNativeSectionsAddEquiv R n M i).apply_symm_apply
      (((projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections R n M i).s a).eval
        (Opposite.op
          (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n i)))))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSection_recovers_generator
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSection_recovers_generator
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (D : ℕ)
    (E : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i
          (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a))
    (t : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        Γ(SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M,
          (⊤ : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)))
    (ht : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
              (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
              (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a) =
            (E i a).tensorCandidate R n M D i
              (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) j)
    (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I) :
    projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateSectionsAddEquiv R n M (D : ℤ) i
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a)) =
      ((projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections R n M i).s a).eval
        (Opposite.op
          (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n i))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht i a i]
  change
    projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateSectionsAddEquiv R n M (D : ℤ) i
        (projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateCandidate R n M (D : ℤ) i
          ((E i a).nativeComponent R n M D i
            (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) i)) = _
  rw [projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateSectionsAddEquiv_candidate]
  rw [(E i a).nativeComponent_self]
  exact (projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections_eval_terminal
    R n M i a).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.epi_of_projectiveCoordinate_over_epi
statement:
theorem epi_of_projectiveCoordinate_over_epi
    {A B : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hf : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), Epi (f.over (coordinateOpen R n i))) :
    Epi f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro Z g h hcomp
  have hlocal :
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        g.over (coordinateOpen R n i) =
          h.over (coordinateOpen R n i) := by
    intro i
    letI : Epi (f.over (coordinateOpen R n i)) := hf i
    rw [← cancel_epi (f.over (coordinateOpen R n i))]
    exact congrArg
      (fun q => q.over (coordinateOpen R n i)) hcomp
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro b
  let U : Fin (n + 1) → (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens :=
    fun i => V.unop ⊓ coordinateOpen R n i
  have hcover : V.unop ≤ ⨆ i, U i := by
    dsimp only [U]
    rw [← inf_iSup_eq]
    simpa only [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top R n, inf_top_eq] using
      (le_refl V.unop)
  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq'
    (⟨Z.presheaf, Z.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n))
    U V.unop (fun i => homOfLE inf_le_left) hcover
  intro i
  change
    Z.val.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (g.val.app V b) =
      Z.val.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (h.val.app V b)
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply g.val]
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply h.val]
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun q => q.val.app
      (Opposite.op
        (Over.mk
          (homOfLE
            (show U i ≤ coordinateOpen R n i from inf_le_right)))))
    (hlocal i)
  exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun hi
    (B.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op b)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overSectionOfElement_terminal
statement:
theorem overSectionOfElement_terminal
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : (M.over U).sections) :
    Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X M U
        (s.eval (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
      s
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro W
  let q : W.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) :=
    Over.homMk W.unop.hom (by rfl)
  change
    M.val.map W.unop.hom.op
        (s.eval (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
      s.eval W
  exact PresheafOfModules.sections_property s q.op

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overSections_eq_of_terminal_eval_eq
statement:
theorem overSections_eq_of_terminal_eval_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    {s t : (M.over U).sections}
    (h : s.eval (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) =
      t.eval (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro W
  let q : W.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) :=
    Over.homMk W.unop.hom (by rfl)
  have hs := PresheafOfModules.sections_property s q.op
  have ht := PresheafOfModules.sections_property t q.op
  have hs' :
      (M.over U).val.map q.op
          (s.eval (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
        s.eval W := by
    simpa using hs
  have ht' :
      (M.over U).val.map q.op
          (t.eval (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
        t.eval W := by
    simpa using ht
  change s.eval W = t.eval W
  rw [← hs', ← ht']
  exact congrArg (fun z => (M.over U).val.map q.op z) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSections_generate
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSections_generate
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (D : ℕ)
    (E : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i
          (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a))
    (t : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        Γ(SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
            (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M,
          (⊤ : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens)))
    (ht : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
              (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
              (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a) =
            (E i a).tensorCandidate R n M D i
              (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) j) :
    ∃ G : (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
        (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M).GeneratingSections,
      G.IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let T := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M
  let I := Σ i : Fin (n + 1),
    (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I
  let s : I → T.sections :=
    fun p => sectionsOfTop T (t p.1 p.2)
  let f : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ T :=
    T.freeHomEquiv.symm s
  have hlocal :
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        Epi (f.over (coordinateOpen R n i)) := by
    intro i
    let U := coordinateOpen R n i
    let Gi := projectiveCoordinateOverGeneratingSections R n M i
    let inc : Gi.I → I := fun a => ⟨i, a⟩
    let e := projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateIso R n M (D : ℤ) i
    let q : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) Gi.I ⟶
        M.over U :=
      SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) inc ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom ≫
          f.over U ≫ e.hom
    have heval (a : Gi.I) :
        f.val.app (Opposite.op U)
            ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (inc a)).eval
              (Opposite.op U)) =
          T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a) := by
      change
        f.val.app (Opposite.op U)
            ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (inc a)).eval
              (Opposite.op U)) =
          (s (inc a)).eval (Opposite.op U)
      exact congrArg
        (fun z => z.eval (Opposite.op U))
        (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection
          s (inc a))
    have hcoord (a : Gi.I) :
        e.hom.val.app
            (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
            (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a)) =
          (Gi.s a).eval
            (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) := by
      have h :=
        projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSection_recovers_generator
          R n M D E t ht i a
      change
        e.hom.val.app
            (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
            (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a)) =
          (Gi.s a).eval
            (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) at h
      exact h
    have hq : q = Gi.π := by
      apply (M.over U).freeHomEquiv.injective
      funext a
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply]
      rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_freeMap]
      rw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
      rw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
      have hGi : (M.over U).freeHomEquiv Gi.π a = Gi.s a := by
        exact congrFun ((M.over U).freeHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply Gi.s) a
      rw [hGi]
      change
        SheafOfModules.sectionsMap e.hom
          (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (f.over U)
            (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
              (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom
              (SheafOfModules.freeSection (inc a)))) =
          Gi.s a
      rw [Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection]
      rw [Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overSectionOfElement]
      rw [heval]
      apply overSections_eq_of_terminal_eval_eq M U
      change
        e.hom.val.app
            (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
            (T.val.map (𝟙 U).op
              (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a))) =
          (Gi.s a).eval
            (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      rw [show (𝟙 U).op = 𝟙 (Opposite.op U) by rfl]
      have hid :
          T.val.map (𝟙 (Opposite.op U))
              (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a)) =
            T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a) :=
        Functor.map_id_apply T.val.presheaf (Opposite.op U)
          (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (t i a))
      exact (congrArg
        (fun z => e.hom.val.app
          (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) z) hid).trans (hcoord a)
    haveI : Epi q := hq ▸ Gi.epi
    have hqe : Epi (q ≫ e.inv) :=
      epi_comp' (inferInstanceAs (Epi q))
        (inferInstanceAs (Epi e.inv))
    have hpre : Epi
        ((SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) inc ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom) ≫
          f.over U) := by
      rw [← Category.comp_id
        ((SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) inc ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom) ≫
          f.over U)]
      rw [← e.hom_inv_id]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact hqe
    letI := hpre
    exact epi_of_epi
      (SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) inc ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom)
      (f.over U)
  have hf : Epi f :=
    epi_of_projectiveCoordinate_over_epi R n f hlocal
  let G : T.GeneratingSections :=
    { I := I
      s := s
      epi := hf }
  have hfinite : G.IsFiniteType := by
    constructor
    dsimp only [G, I]
    infer_instance
  exact ⟨G, hfinite⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistGenerated
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistGenerated
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, E, t, ht⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_tensor_sections R n M
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGlobalTensorSections_generate R n M D E t ht
  let Tneg := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
    (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-(-(D : ℤ)))) M
  let e :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf
          (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ)) M ≅ Tneg :=
    eqToIso (by simp only [Tneg, neg_neg])
  letI : G.IsFiniteType := hG
  let G' : Tneg.GeneratingSections :=
    SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso e G
  have hG' : G'.IsFiniteType := by
    dsimp only [G']
    infer_instance
  exact ⟨
    { d := -(D : ℤ)
      G := G'
      isFiniteType := hG' }⟩

name: RegularSyzygyF7.IsSyzygy.hasPDLE_zero
statement:
theorem IsSyzygy.hasPDLE_zero (m : ℕ) : ∀ {K M : ModuleCat.{u} R}, IsSyzygy K M m →
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M m → HasProjectiveDimensionLE K 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rintro K M ⟨e⟩ _
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.symm 1
  | succ m ih =>
    rintro K M ⟨P, _, _, f, hf, hK⟩ h
    exact ih hK (RegularResolution.hasPDLE_ker_of_succ (R := R) (F := P) (N := M) f.hom hf m h)

name: RegularSyzygyF7.IsSyzygy.projective
statement:
theorem IsSyzygy.projective {K M : ModuleCat.{u} R} {m : ℕ} (hK : IsSyzygy K M m)
    (h : HasProjectiveDimensionLE M m) : Module.Projective R K
proof:
:= by
  have := hK.hasPDLE_zero m h
  rw [← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero] at this
  exact ModuleCat.projective_of_module_projective K

name: RegularSyzygyF7.IsSyzygy.finite
statement:
theorem IsSyzygy.finite [IsNoetherianRing R] (m : ℕ) : ∀ {K M : ModuleCat.{u} R},
    IsSyzygy K M m → Module.Finite R M → Module.Finite R K
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rintro K M ⟨e⟩ hM
    exact Module.Finite.equiv (Iso.toLinearEquiv e.symm)
  | succ m ih =>
    rintro K M ⟨P, _, hP, f, hf, hK⟩ hM
    haveI : Module.Finite R P := hP
    exact ih hK inferInstance

name: RegularSyzygyF7.exists_isSyzygy
statement:
theorem exists_isSyzygy [IsNoetherianRing R] (m : ℕ) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.Finite R M] : ∃ K : ModuleCat.{u} R, IsSyzygy K M m
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing M with
  | zero => exact ⟨M, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, g, hg⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R M
    haveI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker g) := inferInstance
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := ih (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker g))
    exact ⟨K, ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R), inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective R (Fin n → R)),
      inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite R (Fin n → R)), ModuleCat.ofHom g, hg, hK⟩

name: RegularSyzygyF7.IsSyzygy.projective_of_isRegularRing
statement:
theorem IsSyzygy.projective_of_isRegularRing [IsRegularRing R] (d : ℕ) (hd : ringKrullDim R ≤ d)
    {K M : ModuleCat.{u} R} [Module.Finite R M] (hK : IsSyzygy K M d) : Module.Projective R K
proof:
:=
  hK.projective (IsRegularRing.hasProjectiveDimensionLE d hd M)
