name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C6.commonConormal_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem commonConormal_isFiniteLocallyFree (h : i₁ ≫ π₁ = i₂ ≫ π₂)
    (hN₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i₁)) :
    letI : IsSeparated (pullback.fst π₁ π₂)
proof:
:=
      MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback (P := @IsSeparated)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π₁ π₂).flip inferInstance
    letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := by
      rw [pullback.lift_fst]; infer_instance
    letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h) :=
      IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ (pullback.fst π₁ π₂)
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h)) := by
  have sq : IsPullback (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) π₂ π₁ :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π₁ π₂).flip
  letI : IsSeparated (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback (P := @IsSeparated) sq inferInstance
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension b (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := by
    letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange b
    exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension b) sq inferInstance
  letI : Smooth (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth b _
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := by
    rw [pullback.lift_fst]; infer_instance
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ (pullback.fst π₁ π₂)
  have h0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.fst π₁ π₂)) :=
    libConormalAmb_isFiniteLocallyFree_congr (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) hN₁
  have h3 : IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h)).obj
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (pullback.fst π₁ π₂))) :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _
      (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) b)
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_middle_E9
    (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.conormalSequence (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h) (pullback.fst π₁ π₂))
    (ConormalSequenceTransportH2.originalConormalSequence_shortExact _ _) h0 h3

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C6.virtual_eq_of_smooth
statement:
theorem virtual_eq_of_smooth (h : i₁ ≫ π₁ = i₂ ≫ π₂)
    (hN₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i₁))
    (hN₂ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb i₂))
    (hΩ₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree T₁ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf π₁))
    (hΩ₂ : IsFiniteLocallyFree T₂ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf π₂)) :
    pullbackK0RingHom i₁ (k0ClassOf T₁ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf π₁) hΩ₁) -
        k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb i₁) hN₁ =
      pullbackK0RingHom i₂ (k0ClassOf T₂ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf π₂) hΩ₂) -
        k0ClassOf X (libConormalAmb i₂) hN₂
proof:
:= by
  have sq : IsPullback (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) π₂ π₁ :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π₁ π₂).flip
  have sq' : IsPullback (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) π₁ π₂ :=
    IsPullback.of_hasPullback π₁ π₂
  letI : IsSeparated (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback (P := @IsSeparated) sq inferInstance
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension b (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := by
    letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange b
    exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension b) sq inferInstance
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension a (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) := by
    letI := smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange a
    exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension a) sq' inferInstance
  letI : Smooth (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth b _
  letI : Smooth (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth a _
  have hj₁ : pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.fst π₁ π₂ = i₁ := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hj₂ : pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.snd π₁ π₂ = i₂ := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.fst π₁ π₂) := by
    rw [hj₁]; infer_instance
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.snd π₁ π₂) := by
    rw [hj₂]; infer_instance
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ (pullback.fst π₁ π₂)
  have h0₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X
      (libConormalAmb (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.fst π₁ π₂)) :=
    libConormalAmb_isFiniteLocallyFree_congr hj₁ hN₁
  have h0₂ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X
      (libConormalAmb (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h ≫ pullback.snd π₁ π₂)) :=
    libConormalAmb_isFiniteLocallyFree_congr hj₂ hN₂
  have hCj : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (libConormalAmb (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h)) :=
    commonConormal_isFiniteLocallyFree π₁ π₂ b i₁ i₂ h hN₁
  have hp₁ := Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) b
  have hp₂ := Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) a
  
  have e₁ := ConormalK0H2.conormalClass_add_pullback (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h)
    (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) h0₁ hCj hp₁
  have e₂ := ConormalK0H2.conormalClass_add_pullback (pullback.lift i₁ i₂ h)
    (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) h0₂ hCj hp₂
  
  have k₁ : k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (pullback.fst π₁ π₂)) hp₁ =
      pullbackK0RingHom (pullback.snd π₁ π₂) (k0ClassOf T₂ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf π₂) hΩ₂) := by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (OMGB.kahlerBaseChangeIso π₂ b sq)).symm
  have k₂ : k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (pullback.snd π₁ π₂)) hp₂ =
      pullbackK0RingHom (pullback.fst π₁ π₂) (k0ClassOf T₁ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf π₁) hΩ₁) := by
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
    exact (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (OMGB.kahlerBaseChangeIso π₁ a sq')).symm
  rw [k₁, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hj₂,
    libConormalAmb_class_congr hj₁ h0₁ hN₁] at e₁
  rw [k₂, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hj₁,
    libConormalAmb_class_congr hj₂ h0₂ hN₂] at e₂
  rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, add_comm, ← e₂, e₁, add_comm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C6.coverToBase_isSeparated
statement: theorem coverToBase_isSeparated (n : ℕ) : IsSeparated (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase
proof:
:=
  MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback (P := @IsSeparated)
    (OMGC.isPullback_q0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n) inferInstance

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C6.relCotangentVirtual_independent
statement:
theorem relCotangentVirtual_independent {n m : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (i' : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (m + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (h : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (m + 1)).toBase)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (conormalSheaf i))
    (hN' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (conormalSheaf i')) :
    TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i hN = TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i' hN'
proof:
:= by
  haveI := coverToBase_isSeparated k (Y := Y) (m + 1)
  exact virtual_eq_of_smooth _ _ (n + 1) (m + 1) i i' h hN hN' _ _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2C6.relCotangentVirtual_independent_f
statement:
theorem relCotangentVirtual_independent_f (f : X ⟶ Y) {n m : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (i' : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (m + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f)
    (hi' : i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (m + 1)).toBase = f)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (conormalSheaf i))
    (hN' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (conormalSheaf i')) :
    TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i hN = TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i' hN'
proof:
:=
  relCotangentVirtual_independent k i i' (hi.trans hi'.symm) hN hN'

name: HnilXF18.epi_tensorSheafMap_id
statement:
theorem epi_tensorSheafMap_id {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (ε : A ⟶ B) [Epi ε]
    (N : Z.Modules) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z N) : Epi (tensorSheafMap Z ε (𝟙 N))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Z N hN
  haveI : (tensorSheafRightFunctor Z N).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape _
  exact inferInstanceAs (Epi ((tensorSheafRightFunctor Z N).map ε))

name: HnilXF18.exists_isGG_tensor_twist
statement:
theorem exists_isGG_tensor_twist (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsGG (tensorSheaf X F
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite i F
  obtain ⟨m, P, N, ⟨eP⟩, hPfl, e, he⟩ :=
    TwistFreeCoverF18.exists_epi_twist_gg K n ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F)
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hP : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  have hpe : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map e) := Functor.map_epi _ e
  have hc : Epi (ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom i F) := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi i F
  have hε : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map e ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom i F) :=
    epi_comp' hpe hc
  have hN' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m)) :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global i _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree K n _)
  have hg := @epi_tensorSheafMap_id X _ _ _ hε _ hN'
  exact @isGG_of_finite X _ _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) _ (twistFreeIso K n i m P N eP hPfl) _ hg

name: HnilXF18.nil_rsub
statement:
theorem nil_rsub {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a b : K0 Z) : IsNilpotent (a - b : K0 Z) ↔
    IsNilpotent (rsub a b)
proof: := nil_iff a b

name: HnilXF18.map_rsub
statement:
theorem map_rsub {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (φ : K0 Z →+* K0 W) (a b : K0 Z) :
    φ (rsub a b) = rsub (φ a) (φ b)
proof: := φ.map_sub a b

name: HnilXF18.map_rsub_int
statement:
theorem map_rsub_int {Z : Scheme.{u}} (φ : K0 Z →+* ℤ) (a b : K0 Z) :
    φ (rsub a b) = φ a - φ b
proof: := φ.map_sub a b

name: HnilXF18.isNilpotent_pullbackTwist_sub_one
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_pullbackTwist_sub_one [Nonempty X] (m : ℤ) :
    IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global i _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree K n _))
      - 1 : K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y0⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  have hO := AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m
  let c := k0ClassOf (space K n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m) hO.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hpc := pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i _ hO.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have ha : rankAtRingHom y0 (pullbackK0RingHom i (rsub c 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [rankAtRingHom_pullbackK0RingHom, map_rsub_int, map_one, rankAtRingHom_classOf,
      rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hO]
    simp
  have h1 := isNilpotent_pullbackK0RingHom_space_domain K n i y0 (rsub c 1) ha
  rw [map_rsub, map_one, hpc] at h1
  exact (nil_rsub _ _).2 h1

name: HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion
statement: theorem lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion [IsIntegral X] : LambdaNilpotent X
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  haveI : IsNoetherian X := SchemeProjectiveBundle.isNoetherian_of_isProper i
  haveI : Nonempty X := inferInstance
  refine lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent
    (rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_isNilpotent_sub_rank (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) ?_)
  intro F r hF
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  obtain ⟨m, hgg⟩ := exists_isGG_tensor_twist K n i F
  have hO := AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m
  have hN := hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 hO
  have hFN : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X F
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))) r := by
    simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hF hN
  have ih := isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG r hFN hgg
  have hmul : k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))
        hN.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X F ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))) hFN.isFiniteLocallyFree :=
    k0ClassOf_mul X ⟨_, hF.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨_, hN.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩
  rw [← hmul] at ih
  have hu := isNilpotent_pullbackTwist_sub_one K n i m
  have := isNilpotent_sub_of_mul (R := K0 X)
    (e := k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (l := k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf K n m))
      hN.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (r := (r : K0 X)) ((nil_iff _ _).1 ih) ((nil_iff _ _).1 hu)
  exact (nil_iff _ _).2 this

name: B7.thetaFun_of_mem
statement:
theorem thetaFun_of_mem (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) {a : ℕ} {w : R}
    (hw : w ∈ W a) : thetaFun hW D w = gcl D a ⟨w, hW a w hw⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold thetaFun
  by_cases ha : a ≤ D
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a]
    · exact gcl_congr D a (pr_of_mem_same hw)
    · intro p _ hp
      have : (⟨pr W p w, hW p _ (pr_mem p w)⟩ : Φ.F p) = 0 :=
        Subtype.ext (pr_of_mem_ne hw hp)
      rw [this, gcl_zero]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)) h
  · rw [gcl_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp => ?_
    have hp' : p ≠ a := by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hp; omega
    have : (⟨pr W p w, hW p _ (pr_mem p w)⟩ : Φ.F p) = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (pr_of_mem_ne hw hp')
    rw [this, gcl_zero]

name: B7.thetaFun_add
statement:
theorem thetaFun_add (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    thetaFun hW D (x + y) = thetaFun hW D x + thetaFun hW D y
proof:
:= by
  unfold thetaFun
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  rw [← gcl_add]
  exact gcl_congr D p (by simp)

name: B7.thetaFun_smul
statement:
theorem thetaFun_smul (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (x : R) :
    thetaFun hW D (c • x) = c • thetaFun hW D x
proof:
:= by
  unfold thetaFun
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  rw [← gcl_qsmul]
  refine gcl_congr D p ?_
  show pr W p (c • x) = algebraMap ℚ R c * pr W p x
  rw [map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]

name: B7.thetaFun_zero
statement:
theorem thetaFun_zero (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) :
    thetaFun hW D (0 : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := thetaFun_smul hW D 0 (0 : R)
  simpa using this

name: B7.thetaFun_mul
statement:
theorem thetaFun_mul (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    thetaFun hW D (x * y) = thetaFun hW D x * thetaFun hW D y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn W with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, thetaFun_zero, zero_mul]
  | homogeneous m =>
    induction y using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn W with
    | zero => rw [mul_zero, thetaFun_zero, mul_zero]
    | homogeneous n =>
      have hm := m.2
      have hn := n.2
      have hmn : (m : R) * n ∈ W (_ + _) := SetLike.mul_mem_graded hm hn
      rw [thetaFun_of_mem hW D hm, thetaFun_of_mem hW D hn, thetaFun_of_mem hW D hmn, gcl_mul]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, thetaFun_add, thetaFun_add, hy, hy', mul_add]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, thetaFun_add, thetaFun_add, hx, hx', add_mul]

name: B7.thetaFun_one
statement:
theorem thetaFun_one (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) :
    thetaFun hW D (1 : R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [thetaFun_of_mem hW D (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem : (1 : R) ∈ W 0)]
  exact gcl_zero_one D

name: B7.theta_apply
statement:
theorem theta_apply (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) (x : R) :
    theta hW D x = thetaFun hW D x
proof: := rfl

name: B7.theta_of_mem
statement:
theorem theta_of_mem (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) {a : ℕ} {w : R}
    (hw : w ∈ W a) : theta hW D w = gcl D a ⟨w, hW a w hw⟩
proof:
:=
  thetaFun_of_mem hW D hw

name: B7.theta_addCharW
statement:
theorem theta_addCharW (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (u : R)
    (P : ∀ k, Φ.F k) (hP : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → ((k.factorial : ℚ) • pr W k u) - (P k : R) ∈ Φ.F (k + 1)) :
    theta hW D (addCharW W D f u) = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 D, gcl D k (qsmul (coeff k f) (P k))
proof:
:= by
  unfold addCharW
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk).1
  rw [gcl_qsmul, map_smul]
  have hmem : powSumW W k u ∈ W k := by
    unfold powSumW
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pr_mem k u)
  rw [theta_of_mem hW D hmem]
  congr 1
  exact gcl_eq_of_sub_mem D k (hP k hk1)

name: B7.theta_exp
statement:
theorem theta_exp (hW : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ W p, w ∈ Φ.F p) (D : ℕ) {a : R} (ha : IsNilpotent a) :
    theta hW D (IsNilpotent.exp a) = IsNilpotent.exp (theta hW D a)
proof:
:=
  IsNilpotent.map_exp ha (theta hW D)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafIso_inv_surjective
statement:
theorem sheafIso_inv_surjective {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ N) (V : X.Opens) : Function.Surjective (e.inv.app V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact ⟨e.hom.app V x, congrArg (fun f => f.app V x) e.hom_inv_id⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafIso_hom_injective
statement:
theorem sheafIso_hom_injective {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ N) (V : X.Opens) : Function.Injective (e.hom.app V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.app V x) e.hom_inv_id).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun z => e.inv.app V z) hxy).trans
      (congrArg (fun f => f.app V y) e.hom_inv_id))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafIso_hom_inv_apply
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.app V x) e.inv_hom_id

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafIso_eq_of_generators
statement:
theorem sheafIso_eq_of_generators {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    {S T : Type*} (e : M ≅ N) (V : X.Opens) (a : S → Γ(N, V))
    (ha : Function.Surjective a) (b : Γ(M, V) → T) (c : Γ(N, V) → T)
    (hgen : ∀ s, b (e.inv.app V (a s)) = c (a s)) (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    b x = c (e.hom.app V x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ha (e.hom.app V x)
  have hx : e.inv.app V (a s) = x :=
    (congrArg (fun z => e.inv.app V z) hs).trans
      (congrArg (fun f => f.app V x) e.hom_inv_id)
  exact (congrArg b hx).symm.trans ((hgen s).trans (congrArg c hs))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafSquare_injective
statement:
theorem sheafSquare_injective {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N P Q : X.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ P) (t : N ≅ Q) (f : M ⟶ N) (g : P ⟶ Q)
    (hs : f ≫ t.hom = e.hom ≫ g) (V : X.Opens)
    (hg : Function.Injective (g.app V)) : Function.Injective (f.app V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sheafIso_hom_injective e V
  apply hg
  exact (congrArg (fun k => k.app V x) hs).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun z => t.hom.app V z) hxy).trans
      (congrArg (fun k => k.app V y) hs))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sheafSquare_sections
statement:
theorem sheafSquare_sections {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N P Q : X.Modules} {T : Type*}
    (e : M ≅ P) (t : N ≅ Q) (f : M ⟶ N) (g : P ⟶ Q)
    (hs : f ≫ t.hom = e.hom ≫ g) (V : X.Opens)
    (a : Γ(Q, V) → T) (b : Γ(P, V) → T)
    (hb : ∀ z, a (g.app V z) = b z) (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    a (t.hom.app V (f.app V x)) = b (e.hom.app V x)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg a (congrArg (fun k => k.app V x) hs)).trans (hb (e.hom.app V x))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.affineIso_comp_inv_apply
statement:
theorem affineIso_comp_inv_apply {S : CommRingCat.{u}} {M N : (Spec S).Modules}
    {L : ModuleCat S} (e : M ≅ N)
    (f : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S).obj N ≅ L)
    (x : Γ(N, ⊤)) :
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S).mapIso e ≪≫ f).hom (e.inv.app ⊤ x) = f.hom x
proof:
:= by
  change f.hom (e.hom.app ⊤ (e.inv.app ⊤ x)) = _
  exact congrArg f.hom.hom (congrArg (fun g => g.app ⊤ x) e.inv_hom_id)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.idealCongr_inv_inclusion
statement:
theorem idealCongr_inv_inclusion (h : i = i') (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i', ⊤)) :
    TF3.ιapp i ⊤ ((idealCongr h).inv.app ⊤ s) = TF3.ιapp i' ⊤ s
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.pulledIdealCongr_inv_unit
statement:
theorem pulledIdealCongr_inv_unit (h : i = i') (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i', ⊤)) :
    (pulledIdealCongr h).inv.app ⊤
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i').unit.app (TF3.idealOf i')).app ⊤ s) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤
      ((idealCongr h).inv.app ⊤ s)
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.pulledComparison_unit
statement:
theorem pulledComparison_unit (V : P.Opens) (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p), V)) :
    (pulledComparison j p).app ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (j ≫ p)).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))).app V s) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app (TF3.idealOf j)).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((idealComparison j p).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))).app V s))
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (fun x => ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map (idealComparison j p)).app
    ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ V) x) (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackComp_inv_unit j p _ V s)).trans
      (Chow.C1Cap.pullback_map_unit j (idealComparison j p) (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.conormalComparison_pulled
statement:
theorem conormalComparison_pulled :
    conormalComparison j p ≫ (TF3.conormalIso j).hom =
      (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom ≫ pulledComparison j p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conormalComparison, pulledComparison, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.specTower_comp
statement:
theorem specTower_comp :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R A B).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativeIdeal_kernel_value
statement:
theorem nativeIdeal_kernel_value
    (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))), ⊤)) :
    specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
      ((idealComparison (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))).app ⊤
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))).unit.app
            (TF3.idealOf (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))))).app ⊤
          ((idealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).inv.app ⊤ s))) =
    kernelToAmbient (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
      (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) s)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hi := idealComparison_app_inclusion
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))) ⊤
    ((idealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).inv.app ⊤ s)
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
    (TF3.ιapp (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))) ⊤
        ((idealCongr (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))).inv.app ⊤ s))
  exact (congrArg ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom) hi).trans
    (hn.trans (congrArg (fun x => algebraMap R A ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom x))
      (idealCongr_inv_inclusion (specTower_comp (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)) s)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativePulledComparison_unit
statement:
theorem nativePulledComparison_unit
    (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i, ⊤)) :
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((pulledComparison j p).app ⊤ ((pulledIdealCongr h).inv.app ⊤
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤ s))) =
    conormalMap (A := A) hf ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤ s))
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun x => (pulledComparison j p).app ⊤ x)
    (pulledIdealCongr_inv_unit h s)
  have h₂ := pulledComparison_unit j p ⊤ ((idealCongr h).inv.app ⊤ s)
  have h₃ := pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso_unit (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)
    ((idealComparison j p).app ⊤
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))).app ⊤ ((idealCongr h).inv.app ⊤ s)))
  have h₄ := congrArg (Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := ambientExtension (A := A) hf))
    (nativeIdeal_kernel_value (A := A) s)
  have hm : conormalMap (A := A) hf
      (Extension.Cotangent.mk (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) s)) =
      Extension.Cotangent.mk (kernelToAmbient (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)
        (specIdealSectionsEquiv (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) s)) := rfl
  exact (congrArg (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom.hom
    (h₁.trans h₂)).trans (h₃.trans (h₄.trans (hm.symm.trans
      (congrArg (conormalMap (A := A) hf)
        (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso_unit (baseExtension hf) s)).symm)))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativeCompositeUnit_surjective
statement:
theorem nativeCompositeUnit_surjective : Function.Surjective
    (fun s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i, ⊤) => (pulledIdealCongr h).inv.app ⊤
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤ s))
proof:
:= by
  letI : (TF3.idealOf i).IsQuasicoherent := specIdeal_isQuasicoherent _
  exact (sheafIso_inv_surjective (pulledIdealCongr h) ⊤).comp
    (nativePullbackUnit_surjective (algebraMap R B) hf (TF3.idealOf i))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.sourcePulledSectionsIso_inv_unit
statement:
theorem sourcePulledSectionsIso_inv_unit (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i, ⊤)) :
    (sourcePulledSectionsIso (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)).hom
      ((pulledIdealCongr h).inv.app ⊤
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤ s)) =
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app
        (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤ s)
proof:
:=
  affineIso_comp_inv_apply (pulledIdealCongr h)
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)) _

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativePulledComparison_sections
statement:
theorem nativePulledComparison_sections
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (j ≫ p)).obj (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)), ⊤)) :
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((pulledComparison j p).app ⊤ x) =
    conormalMap (A := A) hf ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
      ((pulledIdealCongr h).hom.app ⊤ x))
proof:
:= by
  letI : (TF3.idealOf i).IsQuasicoherent := specIdeal_isQuasicoherent _
  exact sheafIso_eq_of_generators (pulledIdealCongr h) ⊤
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (TF3.idealOf i)).app ⊤)
    (nativePullbackUnit_surjective (algebraMap R B) hf (TF3.idealOf i))
    (fun q => (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((pulledComparison j p).app ⊤ q))
    (fun q => conormalMap (A := A) hf ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom q))
    (nativePulledComparison_unit (A := A)) x

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativePulledComparison_injective
statement:
theorem nativePulledComparison_injective [FormallySmooth R A] :
    Function.Injective ((pulledComparison j p).app ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sheafIso_hom_injective (pulledIdealCongr h) ⊤
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom).injective
  apply conormalMap_injective (A := A) hf
  exact (nativePulledComparison_sections (A := A) x).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun q => (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom q)
      hxy).trans (nativePulledComparison_sections (A := A) y))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativeConormalComparison_sections
statement:
theorem nativeConormalComparison_sections
    (x : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.libConormalAmb (j ≫ p), ⊤)) :
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom
      ((TF3.conormalIso j).hom.app ⊤ ((conormalComparison j p).app ⊤ x)) =
    conormalMap (A := A) hf ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
      ((pulledIdealCongr h).hom.app ⊤ ((TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)).hom.app ⊤ x)))
proof:
:= by
  exact sheafSquare_sections (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)) (TF3.conormalIso j)
    (conormalComparison j p) (pulledComparison j p) (conormalComparison_pulled j p) ⊤
    (pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (ambientExtension (A := A) hf)).hom.hom
    (fun q => conormalMap (A := A) hf ((pulledIdealCotangentSectionsIso (baseExtension hf)).hom
      ((pulledIdealCongr h).hom.app ⊤ q)))
    (nativePulledComparison_sections (R := R) (A := A) (B := B)) x

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalNativeMapH2.nativeConormalComparison_injective
statement:
theorem nativeConormalComparison_injective [FormallySmooth R A] :
    Function.Injective ((conormalComparison j p).app ⊤)
proof:
:=
  sheafSquare_injective (TF3.conormalIso (j ≫ p)) (TF3.conormalIso j)
    (conormalComparison j p) (pulledComparison j p) (conormalComparison_pulled j p) ⊤
    (nativePulledComparison_injective (R := R) (A := A) (B := B))

name: B6.pr_eq_decompose
statement: theorem pr_eq_decompose (p : ℕ) (x : K) : pr W p x = (DirectSum.decompose W x p : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply]

name: B6.sum_expand
statement: theorem sum_expand (x : K) : ∃ (s : Finset ℕ) (d : ℕ → K), (∀ q, d q ∈ W q) ∧ x = ∑ q ∈ s, d q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨(DirectSum.decompose W x).support, fun q => (DirectSum.decompose W x q : K),
    fun q => (DirectSum.decompose W x q).2, (DirectSum.sum_support_decompose W x).symm⟩

name: B6.ext_pr
statement: theorem ext_pr {x y : K} (h : ∀ p, pr W p x = pr W p y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have : DirectSum.decompose W x = DirectSum.decompose W y := by
    refine DFinsupp.ext fun p => Subtype.ext ?_
    have := h p
    rwa [pr_eq_decompose, pr_eq_decompose] at this
  exact (DirectSum.decompose W).injective this

name: B6.pr_psi_glob
statement:
theorem pr_psi_glob {ψ : K →ₐ[ℚ] K} {c : ℚ} (hψ : ∀ {p : ℕ} {x : K}, x ∈ W p → ψ x = c ^ p • x)
    (p : ℕ) (x : K) : pr W p (ψ x) = c ^ p • pr W p x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd, rfl⟩ := sum_expand (W := W) x
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  rw [hψ (hd q), map_smul]
  by_cases h : q = p
  · subst h; rw [pr_of_mem_same (hd q)]
  · rw [pr_of_mem_ne (hd q) (Ne.symm h), smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: B6.eq_zero_of_eigen
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_eigen {ψ : K →ₐ[ℚ] K} {c : ℚ} (hψ : ∀ {p : ℕ} {x : K}, x ∈ W p → ψ x = c ^ p • x)
    {μ : ℚ} (hμ : ∀ p : ℕ, μ ≠ c ^ p) {v : K} (hv : ψ v = μ • v) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ p, pr W p v = 0 := by
    intro p
    have h1 := pr_psi_glob hψ p v
    rw [hv, map_smul] at h1
    have hne : μ - c ^ p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (hμ p)
    have h2 : (μ - c ^ p) • pr W p v = 0 := by rw [sub_smul, h1, sub_self]
    calc pr W p v = (μ - c ^ p)⁻¹ • ((μ - c ^ p) • pr W p v) := by rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hne]
      _ = 0 := by rw [h2, smul_zero]
  exact ext_pr fun p => by rw [key p, map_zero]

name: B6.rho_pr_zero
statement:
theorem rho_pr_zero (ρ : K →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ) (hρ : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ W p, ρ x = 0) (x : K) :
    ρ (pr W 0 x) = ρ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd, rfl⟩ := sum_expand (W := W) x
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  by_cases h : q = 0
  · subst h; rw [pr_of_mem_same (hd 0)]
  · rw [pr_of_mem_ne (hd q) (Ne.symm h), map_zero, hρ q (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 h) _ (hd q)]

name: B6.pr_zero_eq_rank
statement:
theorem pr_zero_eq_rank (ρ : K →ₐ[ℚ] ℚ) (h0 : W 0 = Submodule.span ℚ {(1 : K)})
    (hρ : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ W p, ρ x = 0) (x : K) : pr W 0 x = ρ x • (1 : K)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : pr W 0 x ∈ W 0 := pr_mem 0 x
  rw [h0] at hm
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hm
  have e : ρ x = c := by
    rw [← rho_pr_zero ρ hρ x, ← hc, map_smul, map_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [e, hc]

name: B6.pr_map
statement: theorem pr_map (p : ℕ) (x : K) : pr W' p (g x) = g (pr W p x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd, rfl⟩ := sum_expand (W := W) x
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  by_cases h : q = p
  · subst h; rw [pr_of_mem_same (hd q), pr_of_mem_same (hg _ _ (hd q))]
  · rw [pr_of_mem_ne (hd q) (Ne.symm h), pr_of_mem_ne (hg _ _ (hd q)) (Ne.symm h), map_zero]

name: B6.powSumW_map
statement: theorem powSumW_map (k : ℕ) (x : K) : B4.powSumW W' k (g x) = g (B4.powSumW W k x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [B4.powSumW, map_smul, pr_map g hg]

name: B6.addCharW_map
statement:
theorem addCharW_map (D : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℚ) (x : K) :
    B4.addCharW W' D f (g x) = g (B4.addCharW W D f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [B4.addCharW, map_sum, map_smul, powSumW_map g hg]

name: B6.ToddW_map
statement:
theorem ToddW_map (D : ℕ) (x : K) (hn : IsNilpotent (B4.addCharW W D B4.logTd x)) :
    B4.ToddW W' D (g x) = g (B4.ToddW W D x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold B4.ToddW
  rw [addCharW_map g hg, IsNilpotent.map_exp hn g]

name: B6.ThetaNormW_map
statement:
theorem ThetaNormW_map (j D : ℕ) (x : K)
    (hn : IsNilpotent (B4.addCharW W D (B4.logTd - PowerSeries.rescale (j : ℚ) B4.logTd) x)) :
    B4.ThetaNormW W' j D (g x) = g (B4.ThetaNormW W j D x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold B4.ThetaNormW
  rw [addCharW_map g hg, IsNilpotent.map_exp hn g]

name: B6.addCharW_stable
proof:
:= by
  unfold B4.addCharW
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hDD) fun k hk hk' => ?_
  have hDk : D < k := by
    have := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hk
    by_contra hcon
    exact hk' (Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨this.1, not_lt.1 hcon⟩)
  rw [B4.powSumW, hx k hDk, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: B6.exists_weight_bound
statement: theorem exists_weight_bound (x : K) : ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ p, D < p → pr W p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd, rfl⟩ := sum_expand (W := W) x
  refine ⟨s.sup id, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hq => ?_
  have hqp : q ≠ p := by
    have : q ≤ s.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hq
    omega
  exact pr_of_mem_ne (hd q) (Ne.symm hqp)

name: B6.pr_dualW
statement: theorem pr_dualW (p : ℕ) (x : K) : pr W p (dualW W x) = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ p) • pr W p x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold dualW
  conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose W x]
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, map_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  have hq := (DirectSum.decompose W x q).2
  by_cases h : q = p
  · subst h; rw [pr_of_mem_same hq]
  · rw [pr_of_mem_ne hq (Ne.symm h), smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: B6.dualW_eq_of_pr
statement:
theorem dualW_eq_of_pr {x y : K} (h : ∀ p, pr W p y = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ p) • pr W p x) :
    y = dualW W x
proof:
:=
  ext_pr fun p => by rw [pr_dualW, h p]

name: B6.dualW_add
statement: theorem dualW_add (x y : K) : dualW W (x + y) = dualW W x + dualW W y
proof:
:=
  (dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => by
    rw [map_add, map_add, pr_dualW, pr_dualW, smul_add]).symm

name: B6.dualW_neg
statement: theorem dualW_neg (x : K) : dualW W (-x) = -dualW W x
proof:
:=
  (dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => by rw [map_neg, map_neg, pr_dualW, smul_neg]).symm

name: B6.dualW_sub
statement: theorem dualW_sub (x y : K) : dualW W (x - y) = dualW W x - dualW W y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, dualW_add, dualW_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: B6.dualW_sum
statement:
theorem dualW_sum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → K) :
    dualW W (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, dualW W (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
    exact (dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => by simp [map_zero]).symm
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, dualW_add, ih]

name: B6.pr_exp_glob
statement:
theorem pr_exp_glob {a : K} (ha : a ∈ W 1) (hn : IsNilpotent a) (p : ℕ) :
    pr W p (IsNilpotent.exp a) = ((p.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • a ^ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hn
  rw [IsNilpotent.exp_eq_sum hN, map_sum]
  by_cases hp : p < N
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
    · rw [map_smul, pr_of_mem_same (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded p ha)]
    · intro q _ hq
      rw [map_smul, pr_of_mem_ne (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded q ha) (Ne.symm hq),
        smul_zero]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 hp) h
  · have hz : a ^ p = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le (not_lt.1 hp) hN
    rw [hz, smul_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hq => ?_
    have hqp : q ≠ p := by have := Finset.mem_range.1 hq; omega
    rw [map_smul, pr_of_mem_ne (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded q ha) (Ne.symm hqp),
      smul_zero]

name: B6.dualW_exp
statement:
theorem dualW_exp {a : K} (ha : a ∈ W 1) (hn : IsNilpotent a) :
    dualW W (IsNilpotent.exp a) = IsNilpotent.exp (-a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : -a ∈ W 1 := Submodule.neg_mem _ ha
  refine (dualW_eq_of_pr fun p => ?_).symm
  rw [pr_exp_glob ha' hn.neg, pr_exp_glob ha hn, neg_pow, smul_comm, Algebra.smul_def,
    Algebra.smul_def]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_surj_finite_family
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_surj_finite_family
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : j ≠ i)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (y : ι → projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSections R n M i j hij) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ a, ∃ x :
        (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
          (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤),
      coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hij⟩ ^ d • y a =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hij x
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hij⟩)
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hij) :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
      R n M i j hij
  exact IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj_finite_family y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_finite_family
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_finite_family
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : j ≠ i)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (x y : ι →
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
        (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (hxy : ∀ a,
      projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hij (x a) =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hij (y a)) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ a,
      coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hij⟩ ^ d • x a =
        coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hij⟩ ^ d • y a
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away (coordinateRatio R n i ⟨j, hij⟩)
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hij) :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap_isLocalizedModule
      R n M i j hij
  exact IsLocalizedModule.Away.exists_of_eq_finite_family x y hxy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_surj_finite_family_right
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_surj_finite_family_right
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (y : ι → projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRight R n M i j hij) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ a, ∃ x :
        (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
          (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤),
      coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ d • y a =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight R n M i j hij x
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩)
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight R n M i j hij) :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight_isLocalizedModule
      R n M i j hij
  exact IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj_finite_family y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_finite_family_right
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateActualOverlap_exists_of_eq_finite_family_right
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (x y : ι →
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
        (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M j)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (hxy : ∀ a,
      projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight R n M i j hij (x a) =
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight R n M i j hij (y a)) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ a,
      coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ d • x a =
        coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ d • y a
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩)
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight R n M i j hij) :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight_isLocalizedModule
      R n M i j hij
  exact IsLocalizedModule.Away.exists_of_eq_finite_family x y hxy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap_coface
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).δ r ≫
      projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap R Q n d (p + 1) =
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap R Q n d p ≫
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)).δ r
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
  change
    ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).δ r ≫
      projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap R Q n d (p + 1)) ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) b))) a =
    (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap R Q n d p ≫
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)).δ r) ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) b))) a
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap_π]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d) p r a]
  slice_rhs 2 3 =>
    rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) p r a]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleFstTermMap_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
  intro x
  exact congrArg Prod.fst
    (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleAddEquiv_coface
      R Q n d p r a
        (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) x))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap_coface
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :

      projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap R Q n d (p + 1) =
    projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap R Q n d p ≫
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
  change
    ((coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d)).δ r ≫
      projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap R Q n d (p + 1)) ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) b))) a =
    (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap R Q n d p ≫
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject R n
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d)).δ r) ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n (p + 1) b))) a
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap_π]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n
      (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d) p r a]
  slice_rhs 2 3 =>
    rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component R n
      (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d) p r a]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleSndTermMap_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
  intro x
  let xx : Γ(projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :=
    Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) x
  have h := congrArg Prod.snd
    (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleAddEquiv_coface
      R Q n d p r a xx)
  rw [cofaceBaseModule_snd_eq] at h
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, AddCommGrpCat.hom_ofHom, AddMonoidHom.coe_snd]
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationOpenIso_restrictedModule_sheafPullback_map_smulEnd
statement:
theorem localizationOpenIso_restrictedModule_sheafPullback_map_smulEnd
    (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (t : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)) :
    let V
proof:
:= toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let S := Localization.Away g
    let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)
    let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T :=
      projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
    let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
    let N := M.restrict V.ι
    (e.hom.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        (smulEnd (R := T) N t) =
      smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of S)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).obj N)
        (φ.symm t) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g)
  let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)] T :=
    projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let N := M.restrict V.ι
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext U x
  change (N.smul
      (structureRingHom (X := V.toScheme) (R := T)
        (e.hom ''ᵁ U.unop) t)).hom x =
    (N.smul
      ((e.hom.appIso U.unop).inv
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S)
          U.unop (φ.symm t)))).hom x
  rw [localizationOpenIso_structureRingHom R g n U.unop t]

proof:

      projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g
    projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n M i (t • y) =
      φ.symm t •
        projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n M i y := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let φ : S ≃ₐ[(CommRingCat.of R)]
      Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g) :=
    projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_restriction
statement:
theorem projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_restriction
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (i : ℕ) (x : M.H i) :
    projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n M i
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom
          (toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι M i x) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom
        (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) M i x
proof:
:= by
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let m := map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n
  have p : e.hom ≫ V.ι = m := localizationOpenIso_hom_ι R g n
  rw [projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_apply]
  simp only [projectiveModuleBasicOpenCanonicalRestrictIso]
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.map_comp, Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply]
  have hcomp :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_comp
      e.hom V.ι M i x
  have hcongr :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_congr
      p M i x
  have houter := congrArg (fun y =>
    Sheaf.H.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf
        (space (Localization.Away g) n).ringCatSheaf).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr p).hom.app M)) i y) hcomp
  rw [hcongr] at houter
  exact houter

        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
          (toSpec R n) M i
          (show PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv
            (toSpec R n) M i x)) =

        (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n) M i x
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_top_global
      (toSpec R n) M i (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) x
  have houter := congrArg
    (projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv R g n M i) hmap
  exact houter.trans
    (projectiveModuleBasicOpenHCanonicalAddEquiv_restriction
      R g n M i x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv_tmul
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (a : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g))
    (x : (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.restrictToPreimage
      (toSpec R n) M (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)).H i) :

proof:
:= Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
    let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
    letI : Algebra A T :=
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
    projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv R g n M i
        (TensorProduct.tmul A a x) =
      TensorProduct.tmul R
        ((projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g).symm a)
        ((projectiveGlobalHPreimageTopSemilinearEquiv R n M i).symm x) := by
  dsimp only
  let A := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
  let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
  let T := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), D)
  let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
  letI : Algebra A T :=
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom.toAlgebra
  change (TensorProduct.congr
      (projectiveBasicOpenRingSemilinearEquiv R g)
      (projectiveGlobalHPreimageTopSemilinearEquiv R n M i).symm)
        (TensorProduct.tmul A a x) =
    TensorProduct.tmul R
      ((projectiveBasicOpenLocalizationAlgEquiv R g).symm a)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_generator

    [IsNoetherianRing R]

      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))

      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback

        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)
          (projectiveGlobalHPreimageTopSemilinearEquiv R n M (p + 1) x₀)) =
      localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n p M hM hG
        ((1 : Localization.Away g) ⊗ₜ[R] x₀)

  have hknown :=
    localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear_apply
      R g n p M hM hG x₀

      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top)
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.globalHPreimageTopAddEquiv
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) x₀)) =
    localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear R g n p M hM hG x₀

      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)))
    (p : ℕ)
    (x y : (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
            from le_top)).hom).obj
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) ⊤)) :
    projectiveModuleBasicOpenHSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1)
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
            from le_top) (x + y)) =
      projectiveModuleBasicOpenHSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1)
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
            from le_top) x) +
        projectiveModuleBasicOpenHSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1)
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
            from le_top) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.map_add, LinearEquiv.map_add]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_rhs_add
statement:
theorem projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_rhs_add
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)))
    (p : ℕ)
    (x y : (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
            from le_top)).hom).obj
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) ⊤)) :
    localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n p M hM hG
        (projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1) (x + y)) =
      localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n p M hM hG
          (projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1) x) +
        localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv R g n p M hM hG
          (projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_add, LinearEquiv.map_add]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_add
statement:
theorem projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_add
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)))
    (p : ℕ)
    (x y : (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction
          (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)
            from le_top)).hom).obj
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
          (toSpec R n) M (p + 1) ⊤))
    (hx : projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMapTransportProp R g n M hM hG p x)
    (hy : projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMapTransportProp R g n M hM hG p y) :
    projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMapTransportProp R g n M hM hG p (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMapTransportProp at hx hy ⊢
  exact (projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_lhs_add R g n M hM hG p x y).trans
    ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy).trans
      (projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_rhs_add R g n M hM hG p x y).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
statement:
theorem projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)))
    (p : ℕ)
    (z :
      let f := toSpec R n
      let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
      let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.baseOpenRestriction h).hom).obj
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule
          f M (p + 1) ⊤)) :
    let f
proof:
:= toSpec R n
    let D := projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g
    let h : D ≤ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := le_top
    projectiveModuleBasicOpenHSemilinearEquiv R g n M (p + 1)
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
          f M (p + 1) h z) =
      localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv
        R g n p M hM hG
        (projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv
          R g n M (p + 1) z) := by
  dsimp only
  change projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMapTransportProp R g n M hM hG p z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_zero R g n M hM hG p
  | add x y hx hy => exact projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_add R g n M hM hG p x y hx hy
  | tmul a x => exact projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_tmul R g n M hM hG p a x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_isIso
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)))
    (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_baseChangeMap
        (toSpec R n) M (p + 1)
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) from le_top))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let eD := projectiveModuleAffineLocalTensorSemilinearEquiv
    R g n M (p + 1)
  let eC := projectiveModuleBasicOpenHSemilinearEquiv
    R g n M (p + 1)
  let G := localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv
    R g n p M hM hG
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply eD.injective
    apply G.injective
    rw [← projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
        R g n M hM hG p x,
      ← projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
        R g n M hM hG p y,
      hxy]
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := G.surjective (eC y)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := eD.surjective t
    refine ⟨x, eC.injective ?_⟩
    rw [projectiveModuleAffineLocalBaseChangeMap_transport
        R g n M hM hG p x,
      hx, ht]

name: INDB.g0ClassOf_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_eq_zero_of_isZero {Z : Scheme.{u}} {F : Z.Modules} (hF : IsCoherentLike Z F)
    (h : IsZero F) : g0ClassOf Z F hF = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← g0ClassOf_zero Z (show IsCoherentLike Z (0 : Z.Modules) from inferInstanceAs
    (0 : Z.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso Z hF _ (h.isoZero)

name: INDB.isCoherentLike_of_iso
statement:
theorem isCoherentLike_of_iso {Z : Scheme.{u}} {F F' : Z.Modules} (e : F ≅ F')
    (h : IsCoherentLike Z F) : IsCoherentLike Z F'
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation Z.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e h

name: INDB.isCoherentLike_of_isZero
statement:
theorem isCoherentLike_of_isZero {Z : Scheme.{u}} {F : Z.Modules} (h : IsZero F) :
    IsCoherentLike Z F
proof:
:=
  isCoherentLike_of_iso (h.isoZero.symm)
    (show IsCoherentLike Z (0 : Z.Modules) from inferInstanceAs
      (0 : Z.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)

name: INDB.computes_unique
statement:
theorem computes_unique {f : X ⟶ Y} {φ ψ : G0 X →+ G0 Y} (h1 : Computes f φ)
    (h2 : Computes f ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  obtain ⟨N1, hc1, hz1, e1⟩ := h1 E.1 E.2
  obtain ⟨N2, hc2, hz2, e2⟩ := h2 E.1 E.2
  change φ (g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) = ψ (g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)
  rw [e1, e2]
  have key : ∀ q, N1 < q → g0ClassOf Y (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E.1 q)
      (hc1 q) = 0 := fun q hq ↦ g0ClassOf_eq_zero_of_isZero _ (hz1 q hq)
  have key2 : ∀ q, N2 < q → g0ClassOf Y (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E.1 q)
      (hc1 q) = 0 := fun q hq ↦ g0ClassOf_eq_zero_of_isZero _ (hz2 q hq)
  exact alternatingSum_eq_of_vanish
    (fun q ↦ g0ClassOf Y (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E.1 q) (hc1 q)) key key2

name: INDB.higher_isZero_of_isAffineHom
statement:
theorem higher_isZero_of_isAffineHom [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (a : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom a]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification a F (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens ?_
  intro U hU
  haveI : IsAffine (a ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme := hU.preimage a
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ((a ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, ⊤) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  haveI : (restrictToPreimage a F U).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor _ _
  have hz := KSpecialization.affine_H_isZero _ (restrictToPreimage a F U) q
  exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz

name: INDB.computes_projectiveBundle
statement:
theorem computes_projectiveBundle {E : Y.Modules} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover Y E) {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) :
    Computes C.toBase (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
      hrank)
proof:
:= by
  intro M hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
  refine ⟨N, fun q ↦
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem
      hrank).higher_mem ⟨M, hM⟩ q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q hq
    exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_lt hrank M q hq
  · exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf
      hrank M hM

name: INDB.computes_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem computes_finitePushforward [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (a : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite a] : Computes a (finitePushforward a)
proof:
:= by
  intro M hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
  have hz : ∀ q, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification a M (q + 1)) :=
    fun q ↦ higher_isZero_of_isAffineHom a M q
  have hc : ∀ q, IsCoherentLike Y (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification a M q) := by
    intro q
    cases q with
    | zero =>
      exact isCoherentLike_of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso a M).symm
        (finitePushObject a ⟨M, hM⟩).2
    | succ q => exact isCoherentLike_of_isZero (hz q)
  refine ⟨0, hc, fun q hq ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    exact hz q'
  · rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
    simp only [alternatingSum, zero_add, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, pow_zero,
      one_smul]
    exact g0ClassOf_iso Y _ _ (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso a M).symm

name: INDB.computes_comp_finite
proof:
:= by
  intro M hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
  obtain ⟨N, hc, hz, e⟩ := h _ (finitePushObject a ⟨M, hM⟩).2
  have hacyc : ∀ q, 0 < q → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification a M q) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    exact higher_isZero_of_isAffineHom a M q'
  have iso : ∀ q, affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (a ≫ g) M q ≅
      affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward a).obj M) q :=
    fun q ↦
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_comp_of_acyclic a g M hacyc q).some ≪≫
        (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor g q).mapIso
          (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso a M)
  refine ⟨N, fun q ↦ isCoherentLike_of_iso (iso q).symm (hc q), fun q hq ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hz q hq).of_iso (iso q)
  · have e' : φ (g0ClassOf X' ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward a).obj M)
        (finitePushObject a ⟨M, hM⟩).2) =
        alternatingSum N (fun q ↦ g0ClassOf Y
          (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward a).obj M) q)
          (hc q)) := e
    rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, finitePushforward_classOf, e']
    congr 1
    funext q
    exact (g0ClassOf_iso Y _ _ (iso q)).symm

name: INDB.fShriekG0All_computes
statement:
theorem fShriekG0All_computes (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    Computes (i ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n)) (fShriekG0All g n i)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    exact computes_comp_finite i (pullback.fst g (toSpec k 0))
      (computes_finitePushforward (pullback.fst g (toSpec k 0)))
  | succ m =>
    have h1 := computes_projectiveBundle (cover g (m + 1)) (cover_rank g (Nat.succ_pos m))
    have h2 := computes_comp_finite (coverIso g (m + 1)).inv _ h1
    have h3 := computes_comp_finite i _ h2
    rw [coverIso_inv_toBase] at h3
    exact h3

name: INDB.fShriekG0All_independent
statement:
theorem fShriekG0All_independent {n n' : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n))
    (i' : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n')) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (h : i ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n) = i' ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n')) :
    fShriekG0All g n i = fShriekG0All g n' i'
proof:
:= by
  refine computes_unique (fShriekG0All_computes g n i) ?_
  rw [h]
  exact fShriekG0All_computes g n' i'

name: INDB.fShriekK0All_independent
statement:
theorem fShriekK0All_independent (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) {n n' : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n)) (i' : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k n'))
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (h : i ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n) = i' ≫ pullback.fst g (toSpec k n')) :
    fShriekK0All g resY n i = fShriekK0All g resY n' i'
proof:
:= by
  unfold fShriekK0All
  rw [fShriekG0All_independent g i i' h]

name: INDB.fShriek_independent
statement:
theorem fShriek_independent (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {n n' : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
    (i' : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n'))
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f)
    (hi' : i' ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n') = f) :
    fShriekG0All (Y ↘ Spk k) n i = fShriekG0All (Y ↘ Spk k) n' i' ∧
      fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i = fShriekK0PI hY hreg n' i'
proof:
:= by
  have h : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) =
      i' ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n') := hi.trans hi'.symm
  exact ⟨fShriekG0All_independent _ i i' h, fShriekK0All_independent _ _ i i' h⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.idealSectionsToKernel_bijective
statement: theorem idealSectionsToKernel_bijective : Function.Bijective (idealSectionsToKernel i V)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι_app_injective i.ker V
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := TF4.exists_ideal_section i V x.val x.property

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.idealComparison_kernel_value
statement:
theorem idealComparison_kernel_value (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p), V)) :
    idealSectionsEquiv j (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app
          (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p))).app V s)) =
    kernelCoefficientMap V j p (idealSectionsEquiv (j ≫ p) V s)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.idealSectionsEquiv_restrict_val
statement:
theorem idealSectionsEquiv_restrict_val {W : P.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf i, V)) :
    (idealSectionsEquiv i W ((TF3.idealOf i).presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op s)).val =
      P.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op (idealSectionsEquiv i V s).val

    ((ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι i.ker).mapPresheaf.naturality
      (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op) s

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.specIdealSectionsToRing_mem_kernel
statement:
theorem specIdealSectionsToRing_mem_kernel
    (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf (Spec.map φ), ⊤)) : φ (specIdealSectionsToRing φ s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality φ)
    (TF3.ιapp (Spec.map φ) ⊤ s)
  exact hn.symm.trans ((congrArg ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).hom)
    (TF3.i_app_ιapp (Spec.map φ) ⊤ s)).trans (map_zero _))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.specIdealSectionsToKernel_bijective
statement:
theorem specIdealSectionsToKernel_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (specIdealSectionsToKernel φ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s t h
    apply ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι_app_injective (Spec.map φ).ker ⊤
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom).injective
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro r
    have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ) r.val
    have hz : (Spec.map φ).app ⊤ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r.val) = 0 := by
      exact hn.symm.trans ((congrArg ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv) r.property).trans (map_zero _))
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := TF4.exists_ideal_section (Spec.map φ) ⊤
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r.val) hz
    refine ⟨s, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom) hs).trans
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Iso.inv_hom_id (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R)) r.val)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.specIdealSectionsEquiv_val
statement:
theorem specIdealSectionsEquiv_val (s : Γ(TF3.idealOf (Spec.map φ), ⊤)) :
    (specIdealSectionsEquiv φ s).val =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom (TF3.ιapp (Spec.map φ) ⊤ s)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.specIdeal_isQuasicoherent
statement: theorem specIdeal_isQuasicoherent : (TF3.idealOf (Spec.map φ)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let I := (Spec.map φ).ker
  let B : PUnit.{u + 1} → (Spec R).Modules := fun _ => ConormalSheaf.unitX (Spec R)
  let C : PUnit.{u + 1} → (Spec R).Modules := fun _ =>
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (ConormalSheaf.unitX _)
  let f : ∀ U : (Spec R).Opens, Γ(TF3.idealOf (Spec.map φ), U) →ₗ[R]
      (∀ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, Γ(ConormalSheaf.unitX (Spec R), U)) :=
    fun U => LinearMap.pi fun _ => Scheme.Modules.appₗ (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι I) U
  let g : ∀ U : (Spec R).Opens,
      (∀ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, Γ(ConormalSheaf.unitX (Spec R), U)) →ₗ[R]
      (∀ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj
        (ConormalSheaf.unitX _), U)) :=
    fun U => LinearMap.pi fun _ =>
      (Scheme.Modules.appₗ (ConormalSheaf.structureMap I) U).comp (LinearMap.proj PUnit.unit)
  refine Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_exact_ladder
    (TF3.idealOf (Spec.map φ)) B C (fun _ => inferInstance) (fun _ => inferInstance)
    f g ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U V h s k
    exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι I) h s
  · intro U V h s k
    exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ (ConormalSheaf.structureMap I) h (s PUnit.unit)
  · intro U s t h
    exact ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι_app_injective I U (congrFun h PUnit.unit)
  · intro U t
    have hex := ConormalSheaf.idealModule_exact I U
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (hex (t PUnit.unit)).mp (congrFun h PUnit.unit)
      exact ⟨s, funext (fun _ => hs)⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
      exact funext (fun _ => (hex _).mpr ⟨s, rfl⟩)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.tildeUnit_coefficient_apply
statement:
theorem tildeUnit_coefficient_apply (r : R) :
