name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.specIdealSections_inclusion
statement:
theorem specIdealSections_inclusion :
    (specIdealSectionsEquiv φ).toModuleIso.hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (RingHom.ker φ.hom).subtype ≫
      (tilde.isoTop (R := R) (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom =
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).map
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (Spec.map φ).ker)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom
    (TF3.ιapp (Spec.map φ) ⊤ s)) = TF3.ιapp (Spec.map φ) ⊤ s
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Iso.hom_inv_id (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R)) _

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.fromTildeΓ_unit
statement:
theorem fromTildeΓ_unit :
    Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := R) (tilde (ModuleCat.of R R)) =
      (tilde.functor R).map (tilde.isoTop (R := R) (ModuleCat.of R R)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := (tilde.adjunction (R := R)).left_triangle_components (ModuleCat.of R R)
  change (tilde.functor R).map (tilde.isoTop (R := R) (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom ≫
    Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := R) (tilde (ModuleCat.of R R)) = 𝟙 _ at h
  apply (cancel_epi ((tilde.functor R).map
    (tilde.isoTop (R := R) (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom)).mp
  exact h.trans ((tilde.functor R).mapIso
    (tilde.isoTop (R := R) (ModuleCat.of R R))).hom_inv_id.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.counitTransport_map
statement:
theorem counitTransport_map {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C) (a : F ⊣ G)
    {M : D} {K N : C} (e : G.obj M ≅ K) (t : N ≅ G.obj (F.obj N))
    (u : K ⟶ N) (f : M ⟶ F.obj N)
    [IsIso (a.counit.app M)]
    (ht : a.counit.app (F.obj N) = F.map t.inv)
    (hs : e.hom ≫ u ≫ t.hom = G.map f) :
    (asIso (a.counit.app M)).inv ≫ F.map e.hom ≫ F.map u = f
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (asIso (a.counit.app M)).hom).mp
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
  change F.map e.hom ≫ F.map u = a.counit.app M ≫ f
  have h₁ : F.map e.hom ≫ F.map u =
      F.map (e.hom ≫ u ≫ t.hom) ≫ F.map t.inv := by
    simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h₂ : F.map (e.hom ≫ u ≫ t.hom) ≫ F.map t.inv =
      F.map (G.map f) ≫ a.counit.app (F.obj N) :=
    (congrArg (fun k => F.map k ≫ F.map t.inv) hs).trans
      (congrArg (fun k => F.map (G.map f) ≫ k) ht.symm)
  have h₃ : F.map (G.map f) ≫ a.counit.app (F.obj N) = a.counit.app M ≫ f :=
    a.counit.naturality f
  exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalSectionsH2.specIdealIsoTilde_inclusion
statement:
theorem specIdealIsoTilde_inclusion :
    (specIdealIsoTilde φ).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor R).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (RingHom.ker φ.hom).subtype) =
    ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (Spec.map φ).ker
proof:
:= by
  let M := TF3.idealOf (Spec.map φ)
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent := specIdeal_isQuasicoherent φ
  letI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := R) M) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  letI : IsIso ((tilde.adjunction (R := R)).counit.app M) := by
    change IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := R) M)
    infer_instance
  exact counitTransport_map (tilde.functor R) (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R))
    (tilde.adjunction (R := R)) (specIdealSectionsEquiv φ).toModuleIso
    (tilde.isoTop (R := R) (ModuleCat.of R R))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (RingHom.ker φ.hom).subtype)
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (Spec.map φ).ker)
    fromTildeΓ_unit (specIdealSections_inclusion φ)

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_quotient_of_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_quotient_of_isWeaklyRegular :
    ∀ (f : List R) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M], IsWeaklyRegular M f →
      ∀ n : ℕ, HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R M) n →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLT
          (ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ (Ideal.ofList f • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))) (n + f.length)
  | [], M, _, _, _, n, h => by
    have e : M ≃ₗ[R] M ⧸ (Ideal.ofList ([] : List R) • (⊤ : Submodule R M))
proof:
:=
      (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot _ (by rw [Ideal.ofList_nil, Submodule.bot_smul])).symm
    simpa using hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.toModuleIso n
  | x :: f, M, _, _, reg, n, h => by
    rw [isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff] at reg
    haveI := h
    have hS := IsSMulRegular.smulShortComplex_shortExact (M := ModuleCat.of R M) reg.1
    have h₂ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R M) (n + 1) :=
      hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ n (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ n)
    have h₃ := hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ n h h₂
    have ih := hasProjectiveDimensionLT_quotient_of_isWeaklyRegular f (QuotSMulTop x M) reg.2
      (n + 1) h₃
    have e := (Submodule.quotOfListConsSMulTopEquivQuotSMulTopInner M x f).symm
    haveI := ih
    rw [show n + (x :: f).length = n + 1 + f.length by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega]
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.toModuleIso _

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.isWeaklyRegular_of_flat
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_of_flat (f : List R) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular R f)
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Flat R M] : IsWeaklyRegular M f
proof:
:=
  ((TensorProduct.rid R M).isWeaklyRegular_congr f).mp hf.isWeaklyRegular_lTensor

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_finsupp_quotient
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_finsupp_quotient (f : List R) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular R f)
    (ι : Type u) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (ι →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)) f.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Projective (ModuleCat.of R (ι →₀ R)) :=
    (IsProjective.iff_projective (ι →₀ R)).mp inferInstance
  have h := hasProjectiveDimensionLT_quotient_of_isWeaklyRegular f (ι →₀ R)
    (isWeaklyRegular_of_flat f hf (ι →₀ R)) 1 inferInstance
  let e : ((ι →₀ R) ⧸ (Ideal.ofList f • (⊤ : Submodule R (ι →₀ R)))) ≃ₗ[R]
      (ι →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) :=
    (TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul (ι →₀ R) (Ideal.ofList f)).symm ≪≫ₗ
      TensorProduct.finsuppScalarRight R R (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) ι
  haveI := h
  rw [HasProjectiveDimensionLE, Nat.add_comm]
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.toModuleIso _

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient (f : List R) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular R f)
    (P : Type u) [AddCommGroup P] [Module (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) P] [Module R P]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) P] [Module.Projective (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) P] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R P) f.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_def'.mp ‹Module.Projective (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) P›
  haveI := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_finsupp_quotient f hf P
  let ret : Retract (ModuleCat.of R P) (ModuleCat.of R (P →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)) :=
    { i := ModuleCat.ofHom (s.restrictScalars R)
      r := ModuleCat.ofHom ((Finsupp.linearCombination (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) id).restrictScalars R)
      retract := by
        ext x
        simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun hs x }
  exact ret.hasProjectiveDimensionLT _

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_quotient_ofList
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_quotient_ofList (f : List R) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular R f) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)) f.length
proof:
:=
  hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient f hf (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotient
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotient (f : List R) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular R f) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) N] [Module R N]
      [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) N],
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) N) n →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R N) (n + f.length)
  | 0, N, _, _, _, _, h => by
    rw [← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero, ← IsProjective.iff_projective] at h
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient f hf N
  | n + 1, N, _, _, _, _, h => by
    let π
proof:
:= Finsupp.linearCombination (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (id : N → N)
    have surj : Function.Surjective π :=
      Finsupp.linearCombination_surjective _ Function.surjective_id
    have hSA := LinearMap.shortExact_shortComplexKer surj
    haveI : Projective (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (N →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)) :=
      (IsProjective.iff_projective _).mp inferInstance
    have hX₂ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
        (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (N →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)) (n + 1) :=
      hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 (n + 1) (by omega)
    have hK : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
        (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (LinearMap.ker π)) (n + 1) :=
      hSA.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (n + 1) hX₂ h
    have ihK := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotient f hf n (LinearMap.ker π) hK
    let ι : LinearMap.ker π →ₗ[R] (N →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) :=
      (LinearMap.ker π).subtype.restrictScalars R
    let SR := ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero (M := LinearMap.ker π) ι (π.restrictScalars R)
      (LinearMap.ext fun x => by simp [ι])
    have hSR : SR.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact SR
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map π) (LinearMap.ker π).injective_subtype surj
    have hX₂R : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R (N →₀ R ⧸ Ideal.ofList f))
        (n + f.length + 1 + 1) :=
      haveI := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_finsupp_quotient f hf N
      hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ (f.length + 1) _ (by omega)
    have := hSR.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ (n + f.length + 1) ihK hX₂R
    rw [HasProjectiveDimensionLE, show n + 1 + f.length + 1 = n + f.length + 1 + 1 by omega]
    exact this

name: KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotSMulTop_local
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotSMulTop_local [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (t : R) (ht : IsSMulRegular R t) (htm : t ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (F : Type u) [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [Module.Finite R F] (hF : IsSMulRegular F t)
    (n : ℕ)
    (h : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList [t])
      (F ⧸ (Ideal.ofList [t] • (⊤ : Submodule R F)))) n) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R F) n
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsWeaklyRegular R [t] := (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R t []).mpr ⟨ht, .nil _ _⟩
  have h1 := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_quotient [t] hreg n _ h
  have hq : (Ideal.ofList [t] • (⊤ : Submodule R F)) = t • (⊤ : Submodule R F) := by
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons_smul, Ideal.ofList_nil, Submodule.bot_smul, sup_bot_eq]
  let e : (F ⧸ (Ideal.ofList [t] • (⊤ : Submodule R F))) ≃ₗ[R] QuotSMulTop t F :=
    Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hq
  haveI := h1
  have h2 : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop t F)) (n + 1) :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.toModuleIso _
  have h3 := (projectiveDimension_le_iff _ _).mpr h2
  rw [ModuleCat.projectiveDimension_quotSMulTop_eq_succ_of_isSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of R F) t hF
    htm] at h3
  rw [← projectiveDimension_le_iff]
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h3
  exact ENat.WithBot.add_le_add_one_right_iff.mp h3

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quasicoherent_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i : ℕ) (hni : n + 1 ≤ i + 1) (g : R) :
    Subsingleton
      ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf
        (toSpec R n) M (i + 1)).obj
        (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj M
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent :=
    Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor _ _
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).obj N
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).obj N).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor _ _
  letI : F.IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (space (Localization.Away g) n).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback e.hom).app N) inferInstance
  have hF : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space (Localization.Away g) n)).obj F)
        (i + 1))) :=
    quasicoherent_sheafH_isZero_of_dimension
      (Localization.Away g) n F i (by omega)
  have hN : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb V.toScheme).obj N)
        (i + 1))) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_of_pullback_inverse_iso
      e.symm N (i + 1) hF
  exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hN

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_higherDirectImage_isZero_of_dimension_lt
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quasicoherent_affineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove_dimension
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_affineLocalHigherDirectImageVanishesAbove_dimension
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.indexClass_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indexClass_classOf (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (E : Total) :
    indexClass push hpush (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Total ExactTotal E) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base ExactBase (push E)
proof:
:= by
  simp [indexClass]

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.baseChange_hom_eq_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem baseChange_hom_eq_of_object_classes
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (hobject : ∀ E : Total,
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (pullBase (push E)) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (push' (pullTotal E))) :
    (ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase).comp (indexClass push hpush) =
      (indexClass push' hpush').comp (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext Total ExactTotal
  intro E
  simpa [indexClass] using hobject E

name: RelativeRiemannRoch.baseChange_indexClass_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem baseChange_indexClass_of_object_classes
    (push : Total → Base)
    (hpush : ∀ A B C, ExactTotal A B C → ExactBase (push A) (push B) (push C))
    (push' : Total' → Base')
    (hpush' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal' A B C → ExactBase' (push' A) (push' B) (push' C))
    (pullTotal : Total → Total')
    (hpullTotal : ∀ A B C,
      ExactTotal A B C → ExactTotal' (pullTotal A) (pullTotal B) (pullTotal C))
    (pullBase : Base → Base')
    (hpullBase : ∀ A B C,
      ExactBase A B C → ExactBase' (pullBase A) (pullBase B) (pullBase C))
    (hobject : ∀ E : Total,
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (pullBase (push E)) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf Base' ExactBase' (push' (pullTotal E)))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group Total ExactTotal) :
    ExactGrothendieck.map pullBase hpullBase (indexClass push hpush z) =
      indexClass push' hpush' (ExactGrothendieck.map pullTotal hpullTotal z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun f : ExactGrothendieck.Group Total ExactTotal →+
        ExactGrothendieck.Group Base' ExactBase' => f z)
    (baseChange_hom_eq_of_object_classes push hpush push' hpush' pullTotal hpullTotal
      pullBase hpullBase hobject)
  exact h

name: CAN.fShriekCan_eq
statement:
theorem fShriekCan_eq (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) :
    fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf = fShriekK0PI hY hYreg n i
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (RT.exists_factorisation hX hY f hf))
  haveI := hs.1
  exact (INDB.fShriek_independent hY hYreg f _ i hs.2 hi).2

name: CAN.arr_iff_arrw

    [IsIntegral X] (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hXreg : RegStalks X) (j : ℕ)
    (x : K0 X) : RT.ARR hY hreg n i hXreg j x ↔ ARRw hY hreg n i hXreg j x (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x)

name: CAN.adamsRiemannRoch_forall
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_forall (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    ARRw hY hYreg n i hXreg j x (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  rw [fShriekCan_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi]
  exact RT.arr_of_closedImmersion hY hYreg n i hXreg hj x

name: CAN.k0ToG0_fShriekCan
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_fShriekCan (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) (x : K0 X) :
    k0ToG0 Y (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) = fShriekG0All (Y ↘ Spk k) n i (k0ToG0 X x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fShriekCan_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi]
  have h1 : ∀ v : G0 Y, k0ToG0 Y ((resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hYreg).res v) = v :=
    fun v ↦ congrArg (fun φ : G0 Y →+ G0 Y => φ v)
      (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hYreg).right
  exact h1 _

name: CAN.k0ToG0_fShriekCan_cover
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_fShriekCan_cover (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) (x : K0 X) :
    k0ToG0 Y (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) =
      projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward (cover_rank (Y ↘ Spk k) (Nat.succ_pos n))
        (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hom ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k (n + 1)) =
      (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase := by
    rw [← coverIso_inv_toBase, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have h : (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hom) ≫
      pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k (n + 1)) = f := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hh, hi]
  rw [k0ToG0_fShriekCan k hX hY hYreg f hf (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hom) h]
  have h1 := INDB.computes_projectiveBundle (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1))
    (cover_rank (Y ↘ Spk k) (Nat.succ_pos n))
  have h3 := INDB.computes_comp_finite i _ h1
  have h4 := INDB.fShriekG0All_computes (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
    (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hom)
  rw [h] at h4
  rw [← hi] at h4
  exact congrArg (fun φ => φ (k0ToG0 X x)) (INDB.computes_unique h4 h3)

name: CAN.ch_fShriekCan
statement:
theorem ch_fShriekCan (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X),
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) (fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf x) (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
                (n + 1 + 1)) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x)) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ x
  exact RT2.grrOn_of_closedImmersion k hY hYreg hXreg i x _
    (k0ToG0_fShriekCan_cover k hX hY hYreg f hf i hi x)

name: CAN.rhs_independent
statement:
theorem rhs_independent (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n n' : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f)
    (i' : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (hi' : i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).toBase = f) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    haveI := factY k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
    haveI := factCover (n := n' + 1) k hY
    ∀ [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)]
      [i'.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)]
      (x : K0 X),
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
                (n + 1 + 1)) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x)) =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i' ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).toBase)
          (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i').obj
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X i' _ 1
              ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n' + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^
                (n' + 1 + 1)) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i' x)) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n' + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ _ _ x
  rw [← ch_fShriekCan k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i hi x,
    ← ch_fShriekCan k hX hXreg hY hYreg f hf i' hi' x]

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.finitePushforward_comp
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ W) [IsFinite f] [IsFinite g] :
    finitePushforward (f ≫ g) = (finitePushforward g).comp (finitePushforward f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M}
    (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)) (A := G0 W) ?_
  intro x
  change finitePushforward (f ≫ g) (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2) =
    finitePushforward g (finitePushforward f (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2))
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso W.Modules (IsCoherentLike W) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike W (0 : W.Modules) from inferInstanceAs (0 : W.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    (isZero_zero _) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app x.1).symm

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.finitePushforward_congr
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_congr {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) [IsFinite f] [IsFinite g] :
    finitePushforward f = finitePushforward g
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.nilpotentSupport

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward
statement:

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.flatPullbackG0_surjective
statement: theorem flatPullbackG0_surjective (U : X.Opens) : Function.Surjective (flatPullbackG0 U.ι)
proof:
:=
  LocalisationExactAR5.flatPullbackG0_opens_ι_surjective U

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_closedImmersion
proof:
:= by
  let I : X.IdealSheafData := i.ker
  have hsupp : (I.support : Set X) = Set.range i := by
    change ((i.ker.support : Closeds X) : Set X) = _
    rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
    exact i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq
  have hUI : complSupport I = U := by
    ext x
    change x ∈ (I.support : Set X)ᶜ ↔ x ∈ (U : Set X)
    rw [hsupp, hU, compl_compl]
  have h1 := ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward I
  rw [hUI] at h1
  rw [h1]
  
  let e : Z ≅ I.subscheme := asIso i.toImage
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian I.subschemeι
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Z := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i
  have hi : i = e.hom ≫ I.subschemeι := (Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι i).symm
  have hj : I.subschemeι = e.inv ≫ i := by rw [hi]; simp
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [finitePushforward_congr hj, finitePushforward_comp]
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · rw [finitePushforward_congr hi, finitePushforward_comp]
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.hS_spec_field
statement:
theorem hS_spec_field (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∀ V : (Spk k).Opens, Nonempty V → V = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro V ⟨v⟩
  have : Subsingleton (Spk k) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun y _ => ?_
  rw [Subsingleton.elim y v.1]; exact v.2

statement:

    (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat + d = m

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.hasConstantRank_libConormalAmb_sub
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_libConormalAmb_sub :
    SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank X (libConormalAmb i) (m - d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N⟩ := conormalDataOfRegularAmb i hZ hX
  have h := conormalRank_add k i hZ hX (m := m) (d := d)
  have : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = m - d := by omega

name: SchemeKTheory.TF6.rank_add_of_conormalDataAmb
statement: theorem rank_add_of_conormalDataAmb {r : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r) : r + d = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N'⟩ := conormalDataOfRegularAmb i hZ hX

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.subsingleton_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_eq_bot (A : S.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {U : Opens S} (h : U = ⊥) :
    Subsingleton (A.obj.obj (op U))
proof:
:= by
  have ht := A.isTerminalOfEqEmpty h
  have hz : IsZero (A.obj.obj (op U)) := ht.isZero
  exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.pushforward_isLocallySurjective_of_isClosedEmbedding
statement:
theorem pushforward_isLocallySurjective_of_isClosedEmbedding (hφ : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding φ)
    {A B : S.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (g : A ⟶ B)
    (hg : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective g) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} φ).map g)
proof:
:= by
  have hg' := (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff g.hom).1 hg
  refine (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff _).2 ?_
  intro V t x hx
  by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range φ
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hxr
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, ⟨s, hs⟩, hyW⟩ := hg' ((Opens.map φ).obj V) t y hx
    obtain ⟨W', hW'o, hW'⟩ := hφ.isInducing.isOpen_iff.1 W.2
    let V' : Opens T := V ⊓ ⟨W', hW'o⟩
    have hmap : (Opens.map φ).obj V' = W := by
      ext z
      change z ∈ φ ⁻¹' (V : Set T) ∩ φ ⁻¹' W' ↔ z ∈ (W : Set S)
      rw [hW']
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨hWV h, h⟩⟩
    refine ⟨V', inf_le_left, ⟨A.obj.map (homOfLE hmap.le).op s, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · change g.hom.app _ (A.obj.map (homOfLE hmap.le).op s) =
        B.obj.map ((Opens.map φ).map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V' ≤ V))).op t
      rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, hs]
      change (B.obj.map (homOfLE hmap.le).op) (B.obj.map (homOfLE hWV).op t) = _
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
      rfl
    · refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      change φ y ∈ W'
      have : y ∈ φ ⁻¹' W' := by rw [hW']; exact hyW
      exact this
  · have hco : IsOpen (Set.range φ)ᶜ := hφ.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl
    let V' : Opens T := V ⊓ ⟨(Set.range φ)ᶜ, hco⟩
    have hmap : (Opens.map φ).obj V' = ⊥ := by
      ext z
      simp only [Opens.coe_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rintro ⟨-, hz⟩
      exact hz ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨V', inf_le_left, ⟨0, ?_⟩, ⟨hx, hxr⟩⟩
    exact @Subsingleton.elim _ (subsingleton_of_eq_bot B hmap) _ _

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.pushforward_epi_of_isClosedEmbedding
statement:
theorem pushforward_epi_of_isClosedEmbedding (hφ : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding φ)
    {A B : S.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (g : A ⟶ B) [Epi g] :
    Epi ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} φ).map g)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective g :=
    (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology S)
      (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) g).2 ‹_›
  exact (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology T)
      (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) _).1 (pushforward_isLocallySurjective_of_isClosedEmbedding φ hφ g hg)

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.pushAb_shortExact
statement:
theorem pushAb_shortExact {X : ShortComplex (AbSheaf S)} (hX : X.ShortExact) :
    (X.map (pushAb φ)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hX.mono_f
  haveI := hX.epi_g
  haveI : Epi ((pushAb φ).map X.g) := @pushforward_epi_of_isClosedEmbedding _ _ φ hφ _ _ X.g hX.epi_g
  refine { exact := ?_, mono_f := ?_, epi_g := ?_ }
  · exact ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _
      (KernelFork.mapIsLimit _ hX.fIsKernel (pushAb φ))
  · change Mono ((pushAb φ).map X.f); infer_instance
  · change Epi ((pushAb φ).map X.g); infer_instance

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.cohomologyMap_apply
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_apply (B : AbSheaf S) (n : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H B n) :
    cohomologyMap φ B n x = (Ext.mk₀ (constUnit φ)).comp (x.mapExactFunctor (pushAb φ)) (zero_add n)
proof: := rfl

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.cohomologyMap_comp_mk₀
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_comp_mk₀ {B B' : AbSheaf S} (g : B ⟶ B') (n : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H B n) :
    cohomologyMap φ B' n (x.comp (Ext.mk₀ g) (add_zero n)) =
      (cohomologyMap φ B n x).comp (Ext.mk₀ ((pushAb φ).map g)) (add_zero n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohomologyMap_apply, cohomologyMap_apply, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀,
    Ext.comp_assoc _ _ _ (zero_add n) (add_zero n) (by omega)]

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.cohomologyMap_comp_extClass
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_comp_extClass {X : ShortComplex (AbSheaf S)} (hX : X.ShortExact)
    (hX' : (X.map (pushAb φ)).ShortExact) (n : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H X.X₃ n) :
    cohomologyMap φ X.X₁ (n + 1) (x.comp hX.extClass rfl) =
      (cohomologyMap φ X.X₃ n x).comp hX'.extClass rfl
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohomologyMap_apply, cohomologyMap_apply, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp, Ext.mapExactFunctor_extClass,
    Ext.comp_assoc _ _ _ (zero_add n) rfl (by omega)]
  rfl

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.cohomologyMap_mk₀
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_mk₀ (B : AbSheaf S) (f : constZ S ⟶ B) :
    cohomologyMap φ B 0 (Ext.mk₀ f) = Ext.mk₀ ((pullPushAdj φ).homEquiv _ _ ((pullConstIso φ).hom ≫ f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohomologyMap_apply, Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  rfl

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.cohomologyMap_zero_bijective
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_zero_bijective (B : AbSheaf S) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap φ B 0)
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ : (constZ S ⟶ B) ≃ ((pullAb φ).obj (constZ T) ⟶ B) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ (pullConstIso φ).hom ≫ f
      invFun := fun g ↦ (pullConstIso φ).inv ≫ g
      left_inv := fun f ↦ by simp
      right_inv := fun g ↦ by simp }
  let e : Sheaf.H B 0 ≃ Sheaf.H ((pushAb φ).obj B) 0 :=
    Ext.homEquiv₀.trans (e₁.trans (((pullPushAdj φ).homEquiv _ _).trans Ext.homEquiv₀.symm))
  have key : ⇑(cohomologyMap φ B 0) = ⇑e := by
    funext x
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).2 x
    rw [cohomologyMap_mk₀]
    simp [e, e₁, Ext.homEquiv₀]
  rw [key]
  exact e.bijective

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.cohomologyMap_bijective
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_bijective (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ B : AbSheaf S, Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap φ B n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact cohomologyMap_zero_bijective φ
  | succ n hn =>
    intro B
    let I : InjectivePresentation B := Classical.arbitrary _
    let X := ShortComplex.mk _ _ (cokernel.condition I.f)
    have hX : X.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_cokernel I.f }
    haveI : Injective X.X₂ := I.injective
    haveI : Injective (X.map (pushAb φ)).X₂ := Injective.injective_of_adjoint (pullPushAdj φ) X.X₂
    have hX' := pushAb_shortExact φ hφ hX
    exact AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_right_exact _ _ _ _
      (cohomologyMap φ X.X₂ n) (cohomologyMap φ X.X₃ n) (cohomologyMap φ X.X₁ (n + 1))
      (by ext x; exact (cohomologyMap_comp_mk₀ φ X.g n x).symm)
      (by ext x; exact (cohomologyMap_comp_extClass φ hX hX' n x).symm)
      ((ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp
        (Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃' (constZ S) hX n (n + 1) rfl))
      ((ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp
        (Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃' (constZ T) hX' n (n + 1) rfl))
      (hn _).surjective (hn _)
      (fun x₁ ↦ Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ _ hX x₁ (by subsingleton) rfl)
      (fun y₁ ↦ Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ _ hX' y₁ (by subsingleton) rfl)

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.app_structureRingHom_of_over
statement:
theorem app_structureRingHom_of_over
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (U : Y.Opens) (r : k) :
    i.app U (structureRingHom (X := Y) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U r) =
      structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply]
  have hg : globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) r =
      i.appTop (globalSec (X := Y) (R := CommRingCat.of k) r) := by
    change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
        (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop).hom r =
      i.appTop.hom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
        (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop).hom r)
    rw [hover, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    rfl
  rw [hg, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.naturality]
  rfl

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.pushAb_map_smulEnd
statement:
theorem pushAb_map_smulEnd
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (r : k) :
    (pushAb i.base).map (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F r) =
      smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F) r
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext U x
  change (F.smul (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop) r)).hom x =
    (F.smul (i.app U.unop (structureRingHom (X := Y) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U.unop r))).hom x
  rw [app_structureRingHom_of_over i hover]

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.closedImmersion_h
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_h
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F) q = Scheme.Modules.h k F q
proof:
:=
  (closedImmersion_H_iso i hover F q).finrank_eq.symm

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.closedImmersion_eulerChar
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_eulerChar
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) :
    Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F) =
      Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k F
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.eulerChar, closedImmersion_h i hover]

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_of_closedImmersion
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules)
    (h : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h.vanishing
  refine ⟨fun q ↦ ?_, N, fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  · haveI := h.finite q
    exact Module.Finite.equiv (closedImmersion_H_iso i hover F q).symm
  · haveI := hN q hq
    exact (closedImmersion_H_iso i hover F q).toEquiv.subsingleton

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.closedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (finiteY : ∀ M : Y.Modules, M.IsFinitePresentation → M.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    ∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation → E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  intro E hE
  have hP : IsCoherentLike _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E) :=
    (finitePushObject i ⟨E, hE⟩).2
  exact hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_of_closedImmersion i hover E (finiteY _ hP)

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.closedImmersion_g0Euler
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_g0Euler
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (finiteY : ∀ M : Y.Modules, M.IsFinitePresentation → M.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (finiteX : ∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation → E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    (g0Euler k finiteY).comp (finitePushforward i) = g0Euler k finiteX
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  have hE : ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E = g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 := rfl
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hE, finitePushforward_classOf, g0Euler_g0ClassOf,
    g0Euler_g0ClassOf]
  exact closedImmersion_eulerChar i hover E.1

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_forall
statement:
theorem projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_forall :
    ∀ M : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).Modules, M.IsFinitePresentation →
      M.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= fun M hM ↦ by
  letI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k n hn M

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
statement:
theorem projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) :
    ∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation → E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:=
  closedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic i hover
    (projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_forall k n hn)

name: ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_g0Euler
statement:
theorem projectiveClosedImmersion_g0Euler
    (hover : X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = i ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n)
    (finiteX : ∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation → E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    (g0Euler k (projective_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_forall k n hn)).comp
      (finitePushforward i) = g0Euler k finiteX
proof:
:=
  closedImmersion_g0Euler i hover _ finiteX

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.spk_eq_zero_of_three_nsmul
statement: theorem spk_eq_zero_of_three_nsmul {w : K0 (Spk k)} (h : 3 • w = 0) : w = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := SPECK.spk_exists_intCast k w
  have h2 := congrArg (k0RankRatRingHom (Spk k)) h
  rw [map_nsmul, map_intCast, map_zero] at h2
  have hm : m = 0 := by
    have : (3 : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) = 0 := by simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using h2
    have : (m : ℚ) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h3 | h3
      · norm_num at h3
      · exact h3
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [hm, Int.cast_zero]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pv0
statement: theorem pv0 (a : K0 (Yk k)) : pv k a 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pv, piK0_pb_mul_pow (gY k) 2 (resY k) a 0 (by norm_num), if_pos rfl]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pv1
statement: theorem pv1 (a : K0 (Yk k)) : pv k a 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pv, piK0_pb_mul_pow (gY k) 2 (resY k) a 1 (by norm_num), if_neg (by norm_num)]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pv2
statement: theorem pv2 (a : K0 (Yk k)) : pv k a 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pv, piK0_pb_mul_pow (gY k) 2 (resY k) a 2 (by norm_num), if_neg (by norm_num)]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.hrel_tN
statement: theorem hrel_tN : (1 + -tN k) ^ (2 + 1) = 0
proof: := rel_prod (gY k) 2

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.alg3
statement:
theorem alg3 {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (a t : A) (h : (1 + -t) ^ (2 + 1) = 0) :
    a * t ^ 3 + 3 • (a * t ^ 1) = a * t ^ 0 + 3 • (a * t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (-a) * h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.alg4
statement:
theorem alg4 {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (a t : A) (h : (1 + -t) ^ (2 + 1) = 0) :
    a * t ^ 4 + 8 • (a * t ^ 1) = 3 • (a * t ^ 0) + 6 • (a * t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (-a * (t + 3)) * h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pv3
statement: theorem pv3 (a : K0 (Yk k)) : pv k a 3 = a
proof:
:= by
  have e := alg3 (pbP (gY k) 2 a) (tN k) (hrel_tN k)
  have h := congrArg (piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k)) e
  rw [map_add, map_add, map_nsmul, map_nsmul] at h
  change pv k a 3 + 3 • pv k a 1 = pv k a 0 + 3 • pv k a 2 at h
  rw [pv0, pv1, pv2] at h
  simpa using h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pv4
statement: theorem pv4 (a : K0 (Yk k)) : pv k a 4 = 3 • a
proof:
:= by
  have e := alg4 (pbP (gY k) 2 a) (tN k) (hrel_tN k)
  have h := congrArg (piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k)) e
  rw [map_add, map_add, map_nsmul, map_nsmul, map_nsmul] at h
  change pv k a 4 + 8 • pv k a 1 = 3 • pv k a 0 + 6 • pv k a 2 at h
  rw [pv0, pv1, pv2] at h
  simpa using h

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.pair
statement:
theorem pair (gg : Fin 3 → K0 (Yk k)) (j : ℕ) :
    piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k)
        ((∑ i : Fin 3, pbP (gY k) 2 (gg i) * tN k ^ (i : ℕ)) * tN k ^ j) =
      pv k (gg 0) j + pv k (gg 1) (1 + j) + pv k (gg 2) (2 + j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_two, add_mul, mul_assoc,
    ← pow_add, map_add, zero_add]

name: ExamplesLCIProjective.hypC_proved
statement: theorem hypC_proved : HypC k
proof:
:= by
  set d : K0 (Amb k) :=
    pullbackK0RingHom (psi k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (-1)) - tN k with hd
  have h3 : 3 • d = 0 := G2HYPC.nsmul_sndTwist_sub (gY k) 2
  obtain ⟨gg, hgg⟩ := span_prod (gY k) 2 d
  have hj : ∀ j : ℕ, piK0 (gY k) 2 (resY k) (d * tN k ^ j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    apply spk_eq_zero_of_three_nsmul k
    rw [← map_nsmul, ← smul_mul_assoc, h3, zero_mul, map_zero]
  have e0 := hj 0
  have e1 := hj 1
  have e2 := hj 2
  rw [hgg, pair] at e0 e1 e2
  simp only [Nat.reduceAdd] at e0 e1 e2
  rw [pv0, pv1, pv2] at e0
  rw [pv1, pv2, pv3] at e1
  rw [pv2, pv3, pv4] at e2
  simp only [add_zero, zero_add] at e0 e1 e2
  rw [e1, nsmul_zero, add_zero] at e2
  have hd0 : d = 0 := by
    rw [hgg, Fin.sum_univ_three, e0, e1, e2]
    simp
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hd0

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.exists_finite_affineOpen_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_affineOpen_cover [CompactSpace X] :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι) (W : ι → X.affineOpens), (⨆ c, (W c : X.Opens)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun W : X.affineOpens => ((W : X.Opens) : Set X)) (fun W => W.1.isOpen) (by
      intro x _
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hxW, -⟩ :=
        X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hxW⟩)
  refine ⟨t, inferInstance, fun c => c.1, eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => ?_⟩
  have hx := ht (Set.mem_univ x)
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWt, hxW⟩ := hx
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨W, hWt⟩, hxW⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.isZero_restrict_pushforward_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem isZero_restrict_pushforward_of_disjoint (i : Z ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ z, i z ∉ U) (F : Z.Modules) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  ext m
  have hpre : i ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ V.unop) = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun z hz => ?_
    exact (hU z (image_le_self U V.unop hz)).elim
  have hm : m = 0 := by
    refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨F.presheaf, F.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Z)
      (fun _ : PEmpty.{u + 1} => (⊥ : Z.Opens)) (i ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ V.unop)) (fun e => e.elim)
      (by rw [hpre]; exact bot_le) _ _ (fun e => e.elim)
  rw [hm]
  simp

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.flatPullbackG0_comp_finitePushforward_eq_zero
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_comp_finitePushforward_eq_zero (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsFinite i] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ z, i z ∉ U) :
    (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).comp (finitePushforward i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {M : Z.Modules // IsCoherentLike Z M}
    (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Z.Modules (IsCoherentLike Z)) (A := G0 (U : Scheme.{u})) ?_
  intro x
  change flatPullbackG0 U.ι (finitePushforward i (g0ClassOf Z x.1 x.2)) = 0
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  have hz : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj x.1)) :=
    (isZero_restrict_pushforward_of_disjoint i U hU x.1).of_iso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app _).symm
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules
    (IsCoherentLike (U : Scheme.{u})) _ hz

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.g0ClassOf_mem_range_of_isZero_restrict
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_mem_range_of_isZero_restrict (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : NilpotentSupport I)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E)
    (hz : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (complSupport I).ι).obj E)) :
    g0ClassOf X E hE ∈ (finitePushforward I.subschemeι).range
proof:
:= by
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
  obtain ⟨ι, hfin, W, hW⟩ := exists_finite_affineOpen_cover X
  haveI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  choose n hn using fun c => hI E hE hz (W c)
  let N : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup n
  have hN : ∀ c, KilledOnPow I (N + 1) (W c) E := fun c =>
    killedOnPow_mono_of_le (le_trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ c)) (Nat.le_succ N)) (hn c)
  exact g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOnPow I W hW N E hN

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_nilpotent
statement:
theorem ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_nilpotent (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : NilpotentSupport I) :
    (flatPullbackG0 (complSupport I).ι).ker = (finitePushforward I.subschemeι).range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [LocalisationExactAR5.ker_flatPullbackG0_opens_ι]
    apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2
    rintro z ⟨E, hE, hzero, rfl⟩
    exact g0ClassOf_mem_range_of_isZero_restrict I hI E hE hzero
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hU : ∀ z, I.subschemeι z ∉ complSupport I := by
      intro z hz
      have : I.subschemeι z ∈ (I.support : Set X) := by
        rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]
        exact Set.mem_range_self z
      exact hz this
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackG0_comp_finitePushforward_eq_zero I.subschemeι
      (complSupport I) hU) y

name: SchemeKTheory.F14.projectiveSpace_stalk_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_stalk_isRegularLocalRing (x : SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen k n i := by
    have : x ∈ (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen k n i) := by
      rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using this
  have hU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i
  let U := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen k n i
  letI : Algebra Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U)
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).presheaf ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n, U) := by
    haveI := isRegularRing_mvPolynomial k (SchemeProjectiveSpace.AffineChartIndex n i)
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k n i).symm
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal) :=
    IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization _
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal)
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).presheaf.stalk x)).toRingEquiv

statement:
theorem conormalDataOfRegular
    (hX : ∀ z : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk z)) :

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.twistG_classOf
statement:
theorem twistG_classOf (hT : ∀ E, P E → P (T.obj E)) (E : C) (hE : P E) :
    twistG hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) = subcategoryClassOf C P (T.obj E) (hT E hE)
proof:
:=
  mapOn_classOf _ _ _ E hE

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.pushDivisor_comp_cartierGysin
statement:
theorem pushDivisor_comp_cartierGysin {σ : T ⟶ 𝟭 C} (hc : Central T σ) (hP : KerCokerClosed P)
    (hT : ∀ E, P E → P (T.obj E)) :
    (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ)).comp (cartierGysin hc hP hT) =
      AddMonoidHom.id _ - twistG hT
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  change pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ) (cartierGysin hc hP hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E.1 E.2)) =
    subcategoryClassOf C P E.1 E.2 - twistG hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E.1 E.2)
  rw [pushDivisor_cartierGysin, twistG_classOf]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.pushDivisor_cartierGysin_indep
statement:
theorem pushDivisor_cartierGysin_indep {σ₀ σ₁ : T ⟶ 𝟭 C} (hc₀ : Central T σ₀)
    (hc₁ : Central T σ₁) (hP : KerCokerClosed P) (hT : ∀ E, P E → P (T.obj E)) :
    (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ₀)).comp (cartierGysin hc₀ hP hT) =
      (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ₁)).comp (cartierGysin hc₁ hP hT)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushDivisor_comp_cartierGysin, pushDivisor_comp_cartierGysin]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.rigid_abstract
statement:
theorem rigid_abstract {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {σ₀ σ₁ : T ⟶ 𝟭 C} (hc₀ : Central T σ₀)
    (hc₁ : Central T σ₁) (hP : KerCokerClosed P) (hT : ∀ E, P E → P (T.obj E))
    (πp : SubcategoryGroup C P →+ G) (s₀ s₁ : G →+ SubcategoryGroup C P)
    (r₀ r₁ : SubcategoryGroup C P →+ G)
    (hπs₀ : πp.comp s₀ = AddMonoidHom.id G) (hπs₁ : πp.comp s₁ = AddMonoidHom.id G)
    (hr₀ : s₀.comp r₀ = (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ₀)).comp (cartierGysin hc₀ hP hT))
    (hr₁ : s₁.comp r₁ = (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ₁)).comp (cartierGysin hc₁ hP hT)) :
    r₀ = r₁
proof:
:= by
  have e₀ : r₀ = πp.comp (s₀.comp r₀) := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hπs₀, AddMonoidHom.id_comp]
  have e₁ : r₁ = πp.comp (s₁.comp r₁) := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hπs₁, AddMonoidHom.id_comp]
  rw [e₀, e₁, hr₀, hr₁, pushDivisor_cartierGysin_indep hc₀ hc₁ hP hT]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.piG_comp_section
statement:
theorem piG_comp_section [IsNoetherian Z] {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (Φ : W ≅ C.scheme) [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (s : Z ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (hs : s ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z) :
    haveI
proof:
:= C.isNoetherian_scheme
    (piG hrank Φ).comp (finitePushforward s) = AddMonoidHom.id (G0 Z) := by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (s ≫ Φ.hom) := inferInstance
  rw [piG, AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, ← _root_.ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  exact KSpecialization.derivedPushforward_comp_section hrank (s ≫ Φ.hom)
    (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hs)

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.g0_rigid
statement:
theorem g0_rigid {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (Φ : W ≅ C.scheme)
    {σ₀ σ₁ : T ⟶ 𝟭 W.Modules} (hc₀ : Central T σ₀) (hc₁ : Central T σ₁)
    (hT : ∀ F, IsCoherentLike W F → IsCoherentLike W (T.obj F))
    (s₀ s₁ : Z ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion s₀] [IsClosedImmersion s₁]
    (hs₀ : s₀ ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z) (hs₁ : s₁ ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z)
    (r₀ r₁ : G0 W →+ G0 Z)
    (hr₀ : (finitePushforward s₀).comp r₀ =
      (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ₀)).comp (cartierGysin hc₀ kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT))
    (hr₁ : (finitePushforward s₁).comp r₁ =
      (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ₁)).comp (cartierGysin hc₁ kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT)) :
    r₀ = r₁
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  exact rigid_abstract hc₀ hc₁ kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT (piG hrank Φ)
    (finitePushforward s₀) (finitePushforward s₁) r₀ r₁
    (piG_comp_section hrank Φ s₀ hs₀) (piG_comp_section hrank Φ s₁ hs₁) hr₀ hr₁

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.killedIIncl_classOf
statement:
theorem killedIIncl_classOf (I : W.IdealSheafData) (F : W.Modules)
    (hF : KSpecialization.AR4.KilledI I F) :
    killedIIncl I (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (KSpecialization.AR4.KilledI I) F hF) =
      g0ClassOf W F hF.1
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (fun E : {E : W.Modules // KSpecialization.AR4.KilledI I E} =>
    (⟨E.1, E.2.1⟩ : {E : W.Modules // IsCoherentLike W E})) _ ⟨F, hF⟩

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.killedIIncl_comp_pushZero
statement:
theorem killedIIncl_comp_pushZero (I : W.IdealSheafData) :
    (killedIIncl I).comp (KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I)) =
      finitePushforward I.subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_classOf]
  change ExactGrothendieck.map _ _ (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ _) =
    finitePushforward I.subschemeι (g0ClassOf I.subscheme F.1 F.2)
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.killedIIncl_comp_killedTransport
statement:
theorem killedIIncl_comp_killedTransport {I : W.IdealSheafData} {σ : T ⟶ 𝟭 W.Modules}
    (hB : KSpecialization.AR8.AR7Bridge I T σ) :
    (killedIIncl I).comp (KSpecialization.AR8.killedTransport hB) =
      pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ) (P := IsCoherentLike W)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  change killedIIncl I (KSpecialization.AR8.killedTransport hB
      (subcategoryClassOf _ _ F.1 F.2)) = pushDivisor (subcategoryClassOf _ _ F.1 F.2)
  rw [KSpecialization.AR8.killedTransport_classOf, pushDivisor_classOf, killedIIncl_classOf]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.finitePushforward_comp_gysinFibre
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_comp_gysinFibre {I : W.IdealSheafData} {σ : T ⟶ 𝟭 W.Modules}
    (hI : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I) (hB : KSpecialization.AR8.AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (hc : Central T σ) (hT : ∀ F, IsCoherentLike W F → IsCoherentLike W (T.obj F))
    (e : Z ≅ I.subscheme) (s : Z ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : e.hom ≫ I.subschemeι = s) :
    (finitePushforward s).comp (gysinFibre hI hB hc hT e) =
      (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ)).comp (cartierGysin hc kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (finitePushforward s).comp (finitePushforward e.inv) =
      finitePushforward I.subschemeι := by
    rw [← _root_.ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
    subst hs
    congr 1
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc e _
  have h2 : (finitePushforward I.subschemeι).comp
      (KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI).toAddMonoidHom = killedIIncl I := by
    rw [← killedIIncl_comp_pushZero, AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    have : (KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I)).comp
        (KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI).toAddMonoidHom = AddMonoidHom.id _ :=
      KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_comp_pullFibre hI
    rw [this, AddMonoidHom.comp_id]
  rw [gysinFibre, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, h1, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, h2,
    ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, killedIIncl_comp_killedTransport]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.gysinFibre_rigid
statement:
theorem gysinFibre_rigid {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (Φ : W ≅ C.scheme)
    {σ₀ σ₁ : T ⟶ 𝟭 W.Modules} {I₀ I₁ : W.IdealSheafData}
    (hI₀ : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I₀) (hI₁ : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I₁)
    (hB₀ : KSpecialization.AR8.AR7Bridge I₀ T σ₀) (hB₁ : KSpecialization.AR8.AR7Bridge I₁ T σ₁)
    (hc₀ : Central T σ₀) (hc₁ : Central T σ₁)
    (hT : ∀ F, IsCoherentLike W F → IsCoherentLike W (T.obj F))
    (e₀ : Z ≅ I₀.subscheme) (e₁ : Z ≅ I₁.subscheme)
    (he₀ : (e₀.hom ≫ I₀.subschemeι) ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z)
    (he₁ : (e₁.hom ≫ I₁.subschemeι) ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z) :
    gysinFibre hI₀ hB₀ hc₀ hT e₀ = gysinFibre hI₁ hB₁ hc₁ hT e₁
proof:
:=
  g0_rigid hrank Φ hc₀ hc₁ hT (e₀.hom ≫ I₀.subschemeι) (e₁.hom ≫ I₁.subschemeι) he₀ he₁ _ _
    (finitePushforward_comp_gysinFibre hI₀ hB₀ hc₀ hT e₀ _ rfl)
    (finitePushforward_comp_gysinFibre hI₁ hB₁ hc₁ hT e₁ _ rfl)

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.gysinFibre_rigid_line
statement:
theorem gysinFibre_rigid_line {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (Φ : W ≅ C.scheme)
    {L : W.Modules} [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L)
    [(tensorSheafLeftFunctor W (lineBundleDual W L)).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W (lineBundleDual W L))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W (lineBundleDual W L))]
    [(tensorSheafLeftFunctor W (lineBundleDual W L)).PreservesMonomorphisms]
    (hT : ∀ F, IsCoherentLike W F →
      IsCoherentLike W ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W (lineBundleDual W L)).obj F))
    (σ₀ σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L)
    (e₀ : Z ≅ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subscheme)
    (e₁ : Z ≅ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁).subscheme)
    (he₀ : (e₀.hom ≫ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subschemeι) ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z)
    (he₁ : (e₁.hom ≫ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁).subschemeι) ≫ Φ.hom ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z) :
    gysinFibre (KSpecialization.AR4.locallyPrincipal_sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀ hline)
        (KSpecialization.AR7R.ar7Bridge σ₀ hline) (KSpecialization.AR7R.central_twist σ₀ hline)
        hT e₀ =
      gysinFibre (KSpecialization.AR4.locallyPrincipal_sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁ hline)
        (KSpecialization.AR7R.ar7Bridge σ₁ hline) (KSpecialization.AR7R.central_twist σ₁ hline)
        hT e₁
proof:
:=
  gysinFibre_rigid hrank Φ _ _ _ _ _ _ hT e₀ e₁ he₀ he₁
