name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.piW_comp_section
statement:
theorem piW_comp_section [IsNoetherian J.subscheme] [IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)]
    (s : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (hs : s ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 J.subscheme) :
    haveI
proof:
:= (deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
    (piW Y J).comp (finitePushforward s) = AddMonoidHom.id (G0 J.subscheme) :=
  piG_comp_section (deformationFrame_rank Y J) (deformationIso Y J) s
    (by rw [deformationIso_hom_toBase]; exact hs)

name: KSpecialization.G2GC2.gysinFibre_rigid_deformation
statement:
theorem gysinFibre_rigid_deformation [IsNoetherian J.subscheme]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)]
    {T : (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J).Modules ⥤ (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J).Modules} [T.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T] [T.PreservesMonomorphisms]
    {σ₀ σ₁ : T ⟶ 𝟭 _} {I₀ I₁ : (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J).IdealSheafData}
    (hI₀ : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I₀) (hI₁ : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I₁)
    (hB₀ : KSpecialization.AR8.AR7Bridge I₀ T σ₀) (hB₁ : KSpecialization.AR8.AR7Bridge I₁ T σ₁)
    (hc₀ : Central T σ₀) (hc₁ : Central T σ₁)
    (hT : ∀ F, IsCoherentLike _ F → IsCoherentLike _ (T.obj F))
    (e₀ : J.subscheme ≅ I₀.subscheme) (e₁ : J.subscheme ≅ I₁.subscheme)
    (he₀ : (e₀.hom ≫ I₀.subschemeι) ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 J.subscheme)
    (he₁ : (e₁.hom ≫ I₁.subschemeι) ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 J.subscheme) :
    gysinFibre hI₀ hB₀ hc₀ hT e₀ = gysinFibre hI₁ hB₁ hc₁ hT e₁
proof:
:=
  gysinFibre_rigid (deformationFrame_rank Y J) (deformationIso Y J) hI₀ hI₁ hB₀ hB₁ hc₀ hc₁ hT
    e₀ e₁ (by rw [deformationIso_hom_toBase]; exact he₀)
    (by rw [deformationIso_hom_toBase]; exact he₁)

name: RegularPushK0LCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars_of_regular
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars_of_regular (φ : A →+* B)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (f : List A) (hf : IsWeaklyRegular A f)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.ofList f) (M : ModuleCat.{u} B) (hM : Module.Projective B M) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj M) f.length
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hM
  let e : (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) ≃+* B :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφ)
  have he : ∀ a : A, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = φ a := fun a => by
    simp [e]
  letI iA : Module A (M : Type u) := Module.compHom M φ
  letI iQ : Module (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (M : Type u) :=
    Module.compHom M (e : (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) →+* B)
  haveI : IsScalarTower A (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (M : Type u) :=
    ⟨fun a q m => by
      change e (a • q) • (m : M) = φ a • (e q • (m : M))
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, mul_smul, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, he]⟩
  haveI : RingHomInvPair (e.symm : B →+* A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (e : A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f →+* B) :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e.symm
  haveI : RingHomInvPair (e : A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f →+* B) (e.symm : B →+* A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  let e₂ : @LinearEquiv B (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) _ _ (e.symm : B →+* A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)
      (e : A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f →+* B) _ _ (M : Type u) (M : Type u) _ _ _ iQ :=
    { toFun := fun m => m
      invFun := fun m => m
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun b m => by
        change b • (m : M) = e (e.symm b) • (m : M)
        rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  haveI : Module.Projective (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (M : Type u) := Module.Projective.of_equiv e₂
  exact KoszulPdBoundLCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_projective_quotient f hf (M : Type u)

name: RegularPushK0LCI.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars_of_subsingleton (φ : A →+* B) [Subsingleton B]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} B) (d : ℕ) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj M) d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton (M : Type u) := Module.subsingleton B M
  haveI : Subsingleton ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj M : Type u) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (M : Type u))
  haveI : Module.Projective A ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj M) := inferInstance
  haveI := ResolutionRegularClosedF15.hasPDLT_one_of_moduleProjective
    ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj M)
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 (d + 1) (by omega)

name: RegularPushK0LCI.regularGenerators_eq_ofList
statement:
theorem regularGenerators_eq_ofList
    {I : Ideal A} (x : SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators A I) :
    I = Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn x.gen)
proof:
:= by
  refine x.span_eq.symm.trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.ofList]
  congr 1
  ext a
  simp [List.mem_ofFn]

name: RegularPushK0LCI.chartPush_pd_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem chartPush_pd_of_disjoint (W : T.Opens) [IsAffine W.toScheme] (hW : ∀ s : S, ι s ∉ W)
    (V : S.Modules) (d : ℕ) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(W, ⊤))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.toScheme.isoSpec.inv).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)))) d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsEmpty (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme := ⟨fun s => hW s.1 s.2⟩
  haveI : Subsingleton Γ(ι ⁻¹ᵁ W, ⊤) := inferInstance
  haveI := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars_of_subsingleton (ι ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(ι ⁻¹ᵁ W, ⊤))).obj (chartSource ι W V)) d
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso (chartPushIso ι W V).symm (d + 1)

name: RegularPushK0LCI.exists_regularGenerators_congr
statement:
theorem exists_regularGenerators_congr {W W' : T.affineOpens} (h : W = W')
    (x : SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators Γ(T, W)
      (ι.ker.ideal W)) :
    ∃ y : SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators Γ(T, W')
      (ι.ker.ideal W'), y.length = x.length
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: RegularPushK0LCI.chartPush_pd_of_regular
statement:
theorem chartPush_pd_of_regular (W : T.affineOpens) {r : ℕ}
    (x : SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators Γ(T, W)
      (ι.ker.ideal W)) (hx : x.length = r)
    (V : S.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree S V) :
    haveI : IsAffine W.1.toScheme
proof:
:= W.2
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(W.1, ⊤))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.1.toScheme.isoSpec.inv).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.1.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)))) r := by
  haveI : IsAffine W.1.toScheme := W.2
  haveI : IsAffine (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).toScheme := IsAffineOpen.preimage (X := S) (Y := T) W.2 ι
  let W'' : T.affineOpens := ⟨W.1.ι ''ᵁ ⊤, by rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top]; exact W.2⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_regularGenerators_congr ι
    (W := W) (W' := W'') (Subtype.ext (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top W.1).symm) x
  
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ (chartSource ι W.1 V) :=
    SheafSyzygyF10.isFiniteLocallyFree_restrict _ _
      (SheafSyzygyF10.isFiniteLocallyFree_restrict _ _ hV)
  have hproj := RegularAffineK0G0.projective_moduleSpecΓ_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    (Γ(ι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1, ⊤) : Type u) (chartSource ι W.1 V) hN
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (ι ∣_ W.1).appTop.hom :=
    (IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine (ι ∣_ W.1)).2
  have hker : RingHom.ker (ι ∣_ W.1).appTop.hom = Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn y.gen) := by
    rw [← regularGenerators_eq_ofList y, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, morphismRestrict_appTop]
    exact RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1
  have hpd := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restrictScalars_of_regular (ι ∣_ W.1).appTop.hom hsurj
    (List.ofFn y.gen) y.isWeaklyRegular hker
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(ι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1, ⊤))).obj (chartSource ι W.1 V)) hproj
  rw [List.length_ofFn, hy, hx] at hpd
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso (chartPushIso ι W.1 V).symm (r + 1)

name: RegularPushK0LCI.koszulCharts_of_cover
statement:
theorem koszulCharts_of_cover {r : ℕ} {J : Type u} (U : J → T.affineOpens)
    (covers : ∀ z : ι.ker.subscheme, ∃ j, ι.ker.subschemeι z ∈ (U j).1)
    (gens : ∀ j, RegularGenerators Γ(T, U j) (ι.ker.ideal (U j)))
    (length_eq : ∀ j, (gens j).length = r) : KoszulCharts ι r
proof:
:= fun s => by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := covers (ι.toImage s)
  have hpt : ι.ker.subschemeι (ι.toImage s) = ι s := by
    change (ι.toImage ≫ ι.imageι) s = ι s
    rw [Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι]
  exact ⟨U j, hpt ▸ hj, gens j, length_eq j⟩

name: RegularPushK0LCI.isOpenCover_chartIndex
statement:
theorem isOpenCover_chartIndex {r : ℕ} (hK : KoszulCharts ι r) :
    TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover (fun i : ChartIndex ι r => (i.1 : T.Opens))
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun t _ => ?_
  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ht
    obtain ⟨W, hsW, hW⟩ := hK s
    exact ⟨⟨W, Or.inr hW⟩, hsW⟩
  · have hopen : IsOpen (Set.range ι)ᶜ := ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, htV, hVU⟩ :=
      T.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open ht hopen
    exact ⟨⟨⟨V, hV⟩, Or.inl fun s hs => hVU hs ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩, htV⟩

name: RegularPushK0LCI.pdLE_pushforward
statement:
theorem pdLE_pushforward (h : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers T) {r : ℕ} (hK : KoszulCharts ι r)
    (V : S.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree S V) :
    PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h r ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : IsCoherentLike T ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V) :=
    (finitePushObject ι ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
  refine SheafSyzygyPdG2.Sch.pdLE_of_chart_pd h (chartCover ι hK) (chartRing ι hK)
    (chartIso ι hK) r _ hF fun i => ?_
  haveI : IsAffine (i : ChartIndex ι r).1.1.toScheme := (i : ChartIndex ι r).1.2
  rcases (i : ChartIndex ι r).2 with hdis | ⟨x, hx⟩
  · exact chartPush_pd_of_disjoint ι _ hdis V r
  · exact chartPush_pd_of_regular ι _ x hx V hV

name: RegularPushK0LCI.pushforward_shortExact
statement:
theorem pushforward_shortExact {A B D : S.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : i ≫ g = 0)
    (hs : (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).ShortExact) (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree S A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree S B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree S D) :
    ∃ zero' : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).map i ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).map g = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).map i)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).map g) zero').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI : A.IsFinitePresentation := hA.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : B.IsFinitePresentation := hB.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : D.IsFinitePresentation := hD.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).X₁.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs A.IsQuasicoherent
  haveI : (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).X₂.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs B.IsQuasicoherent
  haveI : (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).X₃.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs D.IsQuasicoherent
  exact ⟨_, finite_pushforward_map_shortExact ι (ShortComplex.mk i g zero) hs⟩

name: RegularPushK0LCI.regPush_k0ClassOf
statement:
theorem regPush_k0ClassOf (h : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers T) {r : ℕ}
    (hK : KoszulCharts ι r) (V : S.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree S V) :
    regPush ι h hK (k0ClassOf S V hV) =
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0 h ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)
        (finitePushObject ι ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2 (pdLE_pushforward ι h hK V hV)
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.Sch.liftHom_k0ClassOf h _ r _ _ V hV

name: RegularPushK0LCI.k0ToG0_regPush
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_regPush (h : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers T) {r : ℕ} (hK : KoszulCharts ι r) :
    (k0ToG0 T).comp (regPush ι h hK) = (finitePushforward ι).comp (k0ToG0 S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
  change k0ToG0 T (regPush ι h hK (k0ClassOf S V.1 V.2)) =
    finitePushforward ι (k0ToG0 S (k0ClassOf S V.1 V.2))
  rw [k0ToG0_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact PerfectRepG2.Sch.k0ToG0_liftHom_k0ClassOf h _ r _ _ V.1 V.2

name: RegularPushK0LCI.k0ToG0_regPush_apply
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (k0ToG0_regPush ι h hK) x

name: RegularPushK0LCI.regPush_projection_of_tensorRule
proof:
:= by
  let Lh : K0 T →+ (K0 S →+ K0 T) :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ (regPush ι h hK).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (pullbackK0RingHom ι y))
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp [add_mul] }
  let Rh : K0 T →+ (K0 S →+ K0 T) :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft y).comp (regPush ι h hK)
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp [add_mul] }
  have hLR : Lh = Rh := by
    refine @ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (K0 S →+ K0 T)
      (@AddMonoidHom.instAddCommGroup _ _ _ (instCommRingK0 T).toAddCommGroup) Lh Rh ?_
    rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
    refine @ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (K0 T) (instCommRingK0 T).toAddCommGroup _ _ ?_
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    change regPush ι h hK (pullbackK0RingHom ι (k0ClassOf T E hE) * k0ClassOf S V hV) =
      k0ClassOf T E hE * regPush ι h hK (k0ClassOf S V hV)
    have hEV : IsFiniteLocallyFree S (tensorSheaf S ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj E) V) :=
      tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree S _ V (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι E hE) hV
    have hmul : pullbackK0RingHom ι (k0ClassOf T E hE) * k0ClassOf S V hV =
        k0ClassOf S (tensorSheaf S ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj E) V) hEV := by
      rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
      exact k0ClassOf_mul S ⟨_, pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι E hE⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩
    rw [hmul, regPush_k0ClassOf, regPush_k0ClassOf]
    let e := projectionFormulaIso ι E hE V
    have hcoh : IsCoherentLike T ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V) :=
      (finitePushObject ι ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
    have hF' : IsCoherentLike T (tensorSheaf T E ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)) :=
      tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike T E _ hE hcoh
    have hd' : PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h r (tensorSheaf T E ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj V)) :=
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.pdLE_iso h e.symm (pdLE_pushforward ι h hK _ hEV)
    rw [← htensor E hE _ hcoh (pdLE_pushforward ι h hK V hV) hF' hd']
    exact PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_iso h e.symm _ _ _ _
  exact congrArg (fun g : K0 T →+ (K0 S →+ K0 T) ↦ g y x) hLR

name: RegularPushK0LCI.tensorRule
statement: theorem tensorRule (h : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers T) : TensorRule h
proof:
:=
  fun _ hL _ _ F hF hd hF' hd' =>
    PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.repK0_tensor h hL F hF hd hF' hd'

name: RegularPushK0LCI.regPush_projection
proof:
:=
  regPush_projection_of_tensorRule ι h hK (tensorRule h) y x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.gedge_apply
statement:
lemma gedge_apply {A : C} {B : D} (a : A ⟶ G.obj B) (j : ℕ) (x : Ext.{u} C₀ A j) :
    gedge adj e a j x = (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A j x).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ ((adj.homEquiv A B).symm a)) (add_zero j)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.addEquiv₀_comp_mk₀
statement:
lemma addEquiv₀_comp_mk₀ {A B E : C} (y : Ext.{u} A B 0) (p : B ⟶ E) :
    Ext.addEquiv₀ (y.comp (Ext.mk₀ p) (add_zero 0)) = Ext.addEquiv₀ y ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  apply (Ext.mk₀_bijective A E).injective
  rw [Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply, ← Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, Ext.mk₀_addEquiv₀_apply]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.gedge_zero
statement:
lemma gedge_zero {A : C} {B : D} (a : A ⟶ G.obj B) (x : Ext.{u} C₀ A 0) :
    Ext.addEquiv₀ (gedge adj e a 0 x) =
      e.inv ≫ (adj.homEquiv _ B).symm (Ext.addEquiv₀ x ≫ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gedge_apply, addEquiv₀_comp_mk₀, extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_zero, Category.assoc,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.gedge_zero_bijective
statement:
lemma gedge_zero_bijective {A : C} {B : D} (a : A ⟶ G.obj B) [IsIso a] :
    Function.Bijective (gedge adj e a 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg Ext.addEquiv₀ hxy
    rw [gedge_zero, gedge_zero] at h
    have h1 := (cancel_epi e.inv).1 h
    have h2 := (adj.homEquiv _ B).symm.injective h1
    have h3 := (cancel_mono a).1 h2
    exact Ext.addEquiv₀.injective h3
  · intro z
    refine ⟨Ext.addEquiv₀.symm (adj.homEquiv _ B (e.hom ≫ Ext.addEquiv₀ z) ≫ inv a), ?_⟩
    apply Ext.addEquiv₀.injective
    rw [gedge_zero, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.gedge_naturality
statement:
lemma gedge_naturality {A A' : C} {B B' : D} (a : A ⟶ G.obj B) (a' : A' ⟶ G.obj B')
    (b : A ⟶ A') (b' : B ⟶ B') (hsq : b ≫ a' = a ≫ G.map b') (j : ℕ) (x : Ext.{u} C₀ A j) :
    gedge adj e a' j ((Ext.mk₀ b).postcomp C₀ (add_zero j) x) =
      (Ext.mk₀ b').postcomp D₀ (add_zero j) (gedge adj e a j x)
proof:
:= by
  have hε : F.map b ≫ (adj.homEquiv A' B').symm a' = (adj.homEquiv A B).symm a ≫ b' := by
    rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, hsq,
      Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm]
  change (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A' j
      ((Ext.mk₀ b).postcomp C₀ (add_zero j) x)).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ ((adj.homEquiv A' B').symm a')) (add_zero j) =
    ((extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A j x).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ ((adj.homEquiv A B).symm a)) (add_zero j)).comp (Ext.mk₀ b') (add_zero j)
  rw [← extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_naturality]
  change (((extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e A j x).comp (Ext.mk₀ (F.map b)) (add_zero j)).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ ((adj.homEquiv A' B').symm a')) (add_zero j)) = _
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero,
    Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, hε]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.gedge_delta
statement:
lemma gedge_delta {S₁ : ShortComplex C} {S₂ : ShortComplex D} (h₁ : S₁.ShortExact)
    (h₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (a₁ : S₁.X₁ ⟶ G.obj S₂.X₁) (a₂ : S₁.X₂ ⟶ G.obj S₂.X₂)
    (a₃ : S₁.X₃ ⟶ G.obj S₂.X₃) (hf : S₁.f ≫ a₂ = a₁ ≫ G.map S₂.f)
    (hg : S₁.g ≫ a₃ = a₂ ≫ G.map S₂.g) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i + 1 = j)
    (x : Ext.{u} C₀ S₁.X₃ i) :
    gedge adj e a₁ j (h₁.extClass.postcomp C₀ hij x) =
      h₂.extClass.postcomp D₀ hij (gedge adj e a₃ i x)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : S₁.map F ⟶ S₂ :=
    { τ₁ := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm a₁
      τ₂ := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm a₂
      τ₃ := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm a₃
      comm₁₂ := by
        change _ ≫ S₂.f = F.map S₁.f ≫ _
        rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, hf,
          Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm]
      comm₂₃ := by
        change _ ≫ S₂.g = F.map S₁.g ≫ _
        rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, hg,
          Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm] }
  have hnat := ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass_naturality (h₁.map_of_exact F) h₂ τ
  change (extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e S₁.X₁ j (h₁.extClass.postcomp C₀ hij x)).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ τ.τ₁) (add_zero j) =
    ((extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e S₁.X₃ i x).comp (Ext.mk₀ τ.τ₃) (add_zero i)).comp
      h₂.extClass hij
  rw [extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta F e S₁ h₁ i j hij x]
  change ((extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso F e S₁.X₃ i x).comp (h₁.map_of_exact F).extClass hij).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ τ.τ₁) (add_zero j) = _
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero]
  erw [hnat]
  rw [Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_inv_comp
statement:
lemma homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_inv_comp {E : Type*} [Category E]
    {K : E ⥤ C} {Γ : C ⥤ E} (adjK : K ⊣ Γ) {K' : E ⥤ D} (adjK' : K' ⊣ G ⋙ Γ)
    (z : E) {B : D} (k : K.obj z ⟶ G.obj B) :
    adjK'.homEquiv z B
        (((adjK.comp adj).leftAdjointUniq adjK').inv.app z ≫ (adj.homEquiv _ B).symm k) =
      adjK.homEquiv z (G.obj B) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_inv_app,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]
  exact ((adjK.comp adj).homEquiv_unit _ _ _).symm.trans (by
    rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
    exact congrArg (adjK.homEquiv z (G.obj B)) ((adj.homEquiv _ B).apply_symm_apply k))

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.H_delta_injective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₃.{u} hS (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl x hx
  rw [← hx₂, Subsingleton.elim x₂ 0, map_zero]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.H_delta_surjective
proof:
:=
  Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₁.{u} hS n (n + 1) rfl z (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.presheaf_map_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← P.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.presheaf_map_map3
statement:
lemma presheaf_map_map3 (P : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) {U₀ U₁ U₂ U₃ V₁ V₂ : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ}
    (a : U₀ ⟶ U₁) (b : U₁ ⟶ U₂) (c : U₂ ⟶ U₃) (d : U₀ ⟶ V₁) (e : V₁ ⟶ V₂) (g : V₂ ⟶ U₃)
    (x : P.obj U₀) :
    P.map c (P.map b (P.map a x)) = P.map g (P.map e (P.map d x))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← P.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.locallyZero_of_isZero_sheafify
statement:
lemma locallyZero_of_isZero_sheafify (P : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hP : IsZero ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj P))
    {W : Opens T} (x : P.obj (op W)) (y : T) (hy : y ∈ W) :
    ∃ (U : Opens T) (h : U ≤ W), y ∈ U ∧ P.map (homOfLE h).op x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsZero ((sheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) P).obj (op W)) :=
    (Functor.map_isZero (sheafToPresheaf _ _) hP).obj (op W)
  have h0 : (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) P).app (op W) x =
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) P).app (op W) 0 :=
    @Subsingleton.elim _ (AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz) _ _
  have hmem := Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem (Opens.grothendieckTopology T)
    (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) P) x 0 h0
  obtain ⟨U, f, hf, hyU⟩ := (Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology T).1 hmem y hy
  refine ⟨U, leOfHom f, hyU, ?_⟩
  have hf' : P.map f.op x = P.map f.op 0 := hf
  rw [map_zero] at hf'
  exact hf'

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.preimage_image_top
statement:
lemma preimage_image_top (f : X ⟶ Y) {V U : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((preimageHomOfLE f h) ''ᵁ ⊤) = f ⁻¹ᵁ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_image]
  simp only [preimageHomOfLE, Scheme.homOfLE_ι, Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.push_epi_of_locVan
statement:
lemma push_epi_of_locVan (f : X ⟶ Y) {S : ShortComplex (Sh X)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hB : LocVan f S.X₁) : Epi ((push f).map S.g)
proof:
:= by
  have hls : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      ((push f).map S.g).hom := by
    constructor
    intro U s
    rw [Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology]
    intro y hy
    let R := resP f U
    let hS' := hS.map_of_exact R
    let s' : (R.obj S.X₃).obj.obj (op ⊤) :=
      S.X₃.obj.map (homOfLE ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le ⊤)).op s
    let x := (Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} (R.obj S.X₃) isTerminalTop).symm s'
    obtain ⟨V, h, hyV, hρ⟩ := hB 1 one_pos U (Hd hS' 0 1 rfl x) y hy
    let j := preimageHomOfLE f h
    let Pj := j.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    have hdel := extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta Pj
      ((openPullbackConstantIso j).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) (S.map R) hS' 0 1 rfl x
    have hδ : Hd (hS'.map_of_exact Pj) 0 1 rfl (openPullbackExtAddHom j _ 0 x) = 0 :=
      hdel.symm.trans hρ
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₃.{u} (hS'.map_of_exact Pj) 0 1 rfl _ hδ
    let O : X.Opens := (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ (j ''ᵁ ⊤)
    have hOU : O ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U := (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le _
    let t₀ : S.X₂.obj.obj (op O) := Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} _ isTerminalTop z
    have key1 := Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality.{u} isTerminalTop ((S.map R).map Pj).g z
    have key2 := openPullbackExtAddHom_zero_sections j (R.obj S.X₃) x
    have hsec0 := congrArg (Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} _ isTerminalTop) hz
    have key : S.g.hom.app (op O) t₀ = S.X₃.obj.map (homOfLE hOU).op s := by
      have hx : Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} (R.obj S.X₃) isTerminalTop x = s' := AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
      have k := (key1.trans (hsec0.trans key2)).trans (congrArg _ hx)
      refine k.trans ?_
      exact presheaf_map_map S.X₃.obj _ _ _ s
    refine ⟨V, homOfLE h, ?_, hyV⟩
    refine ⟨S.X₂.obj.map (homOfLE (preimage_image_top f h).ge).op t₀, ?_⟩
    exact (NatTrans.naturality_apply S.g.hom _ t₀).trans
      ((congrArg _ key).trans (presheaf_map_map S.X₃.obj _ _ ((Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE h)).op s))
  exact Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.push_shortExact
statement:
lemma push_shortExact (f : X ⟶ Y) {S : ShortComplex (Sh X)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hB : LocVan f S.X₁) : (S.map (push f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hS.mono_f
  haveI : Epi ((push f).map S.g) := push_epi_of_locVan f hS hB
  haveI : Mono ((push f).map S.f) := inferInstance
  exact
    { exact := hS.exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel (push f) hS.mono_f inferInstance
      mono_f := by change Mono ((push f).map S.f); infer_instance
      epi_g := by change Epi ((push f).map S.g); infer_instance }

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.locVan_X₃
statement:
lemma locVan_X₃ (f : X ⟶ Y) {S : ShortComplex (Sh X)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque S.X₂] (hB : LocVan f S.X₁) : LocVan f S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq W x y hy
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  let R := resP f W
  let hS' := hS.map_of_exact R
  obtain ⟨U, h, hyU, hρ⟩ := hB (q' + 2) (by omega) W (Hd hS' (q' + 1) (q' + 2) rfl x) y hy
  refine ⟨U, h, hyU, ?_⟩
  let j := preimageHomOfLE f h
  let Pj := j.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  have hdel := extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta Pj
    ((openPullbackConstantIso j).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) (S.map R) hS'
      (q' + 1) (q' + 2) rfl x
  have hδ : Hd (hS'.map_of_exact Pj) (q' + 1) (q' + 2) rfl
      (openPullbackExtAddHom j _ (q' + 1) x) = 0 := hdel.symm.trans hρ
  haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque ((S.map R).map Pj).X₂ := by
    change TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque (Pj.obj (R.obj S.X₂))
    infer_instance
  exact H_delta_injective (hS'.map_of_exact Pj) q' _ hδ

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.locVan_of_flasque
statement: lemma locVan_of_flasque (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Sh X) [TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque I] : LocVan f I
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq W x y hy
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨W, le_rfl, hy, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.alphaIso_hom_app
statement:
lemma alphaIso_hom_app (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) (B : Sh X) (U : (Opens W)ᵒᵖ) :
    (alphaIso f W B).hom.hom.app U = B.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op
        (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f W U.unop).symm))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.alphaIso_naturality
statement:
lemma alphaIso_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) {B B' : Sh X} (b : B ⟶ B') :
    (resB W).map ((push f).map b) ≫ (alphaIso f W B').hom =
      (alphaIso f W B).hom ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (phi f W)).map ((resP f W).map b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext U : 2
  exact (b.hom.naturality _).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.edgeW_zero
statement:
lemma edgeW_zero (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) (B : Sh X)
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} ((resB W).obj ((push f).obj B)) 0) :
    Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} ((resP f W).obj B) isTerminalTop (edgeW f W B 0 x) =
      (alphaIso f W B).hom.hom.app (op ⊤)
        (Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} ((resB W).obj ((push f).obj B)) isTerminalTop x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := @gedge_zero (Sh W) (Sh (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) _ _ _ _ (topShHasExt _) (topShHasExt _) _ _
    (adj (phi f W)) _ _ _ _ _ (pbConst (phi f W)) _ _ (alphaIso f W B).hom x
  simp only [Sheaf.H.equiv₀, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  erw [h1, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_apply, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_apply]
  erw [homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_inv_comp (adj (phi f W))
    (constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology W) AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop)
    (constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop)]
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.edgeW_naturality
statement:
lemma edgeW_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) {B B' : Sh X} (b : B ⟶ B') (j : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} ((resB W).obj ((push f).obj B)) j) :
    edgeW f W B' j (Hm ((resB W).map ((push f).map b)) j x) =
      Hm ((resP f W).map b) j (edgeW f W B j x)
proof:
:=
  @gedge_naturality (Sh W) (Sh (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) _ _ _ _ (topShHasExt _) (topShHasExt _) _ _
    (adj (phi f W)) _ _ _ _ _ (pbConst (phi f W)) _ _ _ _ (alphaIso f W B).hom
    (alphaIso f W B').hom ((resB W).map ((push f).map b)) ((resP f W).map b)
    (alphaIso_naturality f W b) j x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.H_map_g_delta
proof:
:= by
  change (x.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero j)).comp hS.extClass rfl = 0
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero]
  erw [hS.comp_extClass]
  exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero x _ _ _ _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.edgeW_bijective
statement:
theorem edgeW_bijective (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (B : Sh X), LocVan f B → ∀ W : Y.Opens, Function.Bijective (edgeW f W B j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro B _ W
    exact gedge_zero_bijective _ _ _
  | succ j ih =>
    intro B hB W
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation B
    haveI := P.injective
    haveI := P.mono
    let S := ShortComplex.mk P.f (cokernel.π P.f) (cokernel.condition _)
    have hS : S.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel P.f)
    haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque S.X₂ := TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.of_injective P.J
    have hQ : LocVan f S.X₃ := locVan_X₃ f hS hB
    have hI : LocVan f S.X₂ := locVan_of_flasque f S.X₂
    let SY := (S.map (push f)).map (resB W)
    have hSY : SY.ShortExact := (push_shortExact f hS hB).map_of_exact (resB W)
    let SX := S.map (resP f W)
    have hSX : SX.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact (resP f W)
    haveI hpI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque ((push f).obj S.X₂) :=
      TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.pushforward_isFlasque S.X₂ f.base
    haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque SY.X₂ :=
      isFlasque_openPullback W.ι ((push f).obj S.X₂)
    haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque SX.X₂ :=
      isFlasque_openPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι S.X₂
    have hdelta : ∀ x : Sheaf.H.{u} SY.X₃ j, edgeW f W S.X₁ (j + 1) (Hd hSY j (j + 1) rfl x) =
        Hd hSX j (j + 1) rfl (edgeW f W S.X₃ j x) := fun x =>
      gedge_delta (adj _) (pbConst _) hSY hSX (alphaIso f W S.X₁).hom (alphaIso f W S.X₂).hom
        (alphaIso f W S.X₃).hom (alphaIso_naturality f W S.f) (alphaIso_naturality f W S.g)
        j (j + 1) rfl x
    have hmap : ∀ x : Sheaf.H.{u} SY.X₂ j, edgeW f W S.X₃ j (Hm SY.g j x) =
        Hm SX.g j (edgeW f W S.X₂ j x) := fun x =>
      edgeW_naturality f W S.g j x
    constructor
    · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := H_delta_surjective hSY j z
      rw [hdelta] at hz
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₃.{u} hSX j (j + 1) rfl _ hz
      obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := (ih _ hI W).2 t
      have hw : w = Hm SY.g j t' := (ih _ hQ W).1 (by rw [hmap, ht])
      rw [hw]
      exact H_map_g_delta hSY j t'
    · intro z
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := H_delta_surjective hSX j z
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := (ih _ hQ W).2 w
      exact ⟨Hd hSY j (j + 1) rfl w',
        (hdelta w').trans ((congrArg (Hd hSX j (j + 1) rfl) hw').trans hw)⟩

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.edgeW_delta
statement:
lemma edgeW_delta (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) {S : ShortComplex (Sh X)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hB : LocVan f S.X₁) (j : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} ((resB W).obj ((push f).obj S.X₃)) j) :
    edgeW f W S.X₁ (j + 1)
        (Hd ((push_shortExact f hS hB).map_of_exact (resB W)) j (j + 1) rfl x) =
      Hd (hS.map_of_exact (resP f W)) j (j + 1) rfl (edgeW f W S.X₃ j x)
proof:
:=
  @gedge_delta (Sh W) (Sh (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) _ _ _ _ (topShHasExt _) (topShHasExt _) _ _
    (adj (phi f W)) _ _ _ _ _ (pbConst (phi f W)) _ _
    ((push_shortExact f hS hB).map_of_exact (resB W)) (hS.map_of_exact (resP f W))
    (alphaIso f W S.X₁).hom (alphaIso f W S.X₂).hom
    (alphaIso f W S.X₃).hom (alphaIso_naturality f W S.f) (alphaIso_naturality f W S.g)
    j (j + 1) rfl x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.resH_zero
statement:
lemma resH_zero (g' : U' ⟶ U) [IsOpenImmersion g'] (A : Sh U) {A' : Sh U'}
    (κ : (g'.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj A ⟶ A')
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} A 0) :
    Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} A' isTerminalTop (resH g' A κ 0 x) =
      κ.hom.app (op ⊤) (A.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op (Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} A isTerminalTop x))
proof:
:=
  (Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality.{u} isTerminalTop κ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg _ (openPullbackExtAddHom_zero_sections g' A x))

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.resH_delta
statement:
lemma resH_delta (g' : U' ⟶ U) [IsOpenImmersion g'] {S : ShortComplex (Sh U)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) {S' : ShortComplex (Sh U')} (hS' : S'.ShortExact)
    (κ : S.map (g'.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶ S') (j : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} S.X₃ j) :
    resH g' S.X₁ κ.τ₁ (j + 1) (Hd hS j (j + 1) rfl x) =
      Hd hS' j (j + 1) rfl (resH g' S.X₃ κ.τ₃ j x)
proof:
:= by
  let P := g'.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  have hdel := extMapOfExactFunctorAndIso_delta P
    ((openPullbackConstantIso g').app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) S hS j (j + 1) rfl x
  exact (congrArg (Hm κ.τ₁ (j + 1)) hdel).trans
    (Sheaf.H.δ_naturality.{u} j (j + 1) rfl (hS.map_of_exact P) hS' κ _).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.rcHom_app
statement:
lemma rcHom_app (a : U' ⟶ U) (b : U ⟶ Xs) (c : U' ⟶ Xs) [IsOpenImmersion a]
    [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion c] (hc : a ≫ b = c) (B : Sh Xs) (T : (Opens U')ᵒᵖ) :
    (rcHom a b c hc B).hom.app T = B.obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (by
        subst hc; exact (Scheme.Hom.comp_image a b _).symm)))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.rcHom_naturality
statement:
lemma rcHom_naturality (a : U' ⟶ U) (b : U ⟶ Xs) (c : U' ⟶ Xs) [IsOpenImmersion a]
    [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion c] (hc : a ≫ b = c) {B B' : Sh Xs} (φ : B ⟶ B') :
    (a.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        ((b.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map φ) ≫ rcHom a b c hc B' =
      rcHom a b c hc B ≫ (c.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map φ
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext T : 2
  exact (φ.hom.naturality _).symm

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.homOfLE_ι_eq
statement: lemma homOfLE_ι_eq {W' W : Y.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) : Y.homOfLE hW ≫ W.ι = W'.ι
proof:
:=
  Scheme.homOfLE_ι _ _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.preimageHomOfLE_ι_eq
statement:
lemma preimageHomOfLE_ι_eq (f : X ⟶ Y) {W' W : Y.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) :
    preimageHomOfLE f hW ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = (f ⁻¹ᵁ W').ι
proof:
:= by
  simp [preimageHomOfLE]

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.edgeW_res
statement:
theorem edgeW_res (f : X ⟶ Y) {W' W : Y.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (B : Sh X), LocVan f B → ∀ x : Sheaf.H.{u} ((resB W).obj ((push f).obj B)) j,
      edgeW f W' B j (srcRes f hW B j x) = tgtRes f hW B j (edgeW f W B j x)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro B _ x
    apply (Sheaf.H.equiv₀.{u} ((resP f W').obj B) isTerminalTop).injective
    have e1 := edgeW_zero f W' B (srcRes f hW B 0 x)
    have e2 := resH_zero (Y.homOfLE hW) ((resB W).obj ((push f).obj B))
      (rcHom (Y.homOfLE hW) W.ι W'.ι (homOfLE_ι_eq hW) ((push f).obj B)) x
    have e3 := resH_zero (preimageHomOfLE f hW) ((resP f W).obj B)
      (rcHom (preimageHomOfLE f hW) (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ W').ι (preimageHomOfLE_ι_eq f hW) B)
      (edgeW f W B 0 x)
    have e4 := edgeW_zero f W B x
    refine (e1.trans ((congrArg _ e2).trans ?_)).trans
      (e3.trans (congrArg _ (congrArg _ e4))).symm
    exact presheaf_map_map3 B.obj _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  | succ j ih =>
    intro B hB z
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation B
    haveI := P.injective
    haveI := P.mono
    let S := ShortComplex.mk P.f (cokernel.π P.f) (cokernel.condition _)
    have hS : S.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel P.f)
    haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque S.X₂ := TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.of_injective P.J
    have hQ : LocVan f S.X₃ := locVan_X₃ f hS hB
    have hpush := push_shortExact f hS hB
    have hSYW := hpush.map_of_exact (resB W)
    have hSYW' := hpush.map_of_exact (resB W')
    have hSXW := hS.map_of_exact (resP f W)
    have hSXW' := hS.map_of_exact (resP f W')
    haveI hpI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque ((push f).obj S.X₂) :=
      TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.pushforward_isFlasque S.X₂ f.base
    haveI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque (((S.map (push f)).map (resB W)).X₂) :=
      isFlasque_openPullback W.ι ((push f).obj S.X₂)
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := H_delta_surjective hSYW j z
    have d1 := resH_delta (Y.homOfLE hW) hSYW hSYW'
      (rcHomSC (Y.homOfLE hW) W.ι W'.ι (homOfLE_ι_eq hW) (S.map (push f))) j w
    have d2 := edgeW_delta f W' hS hB j (srcRes f hW S.X₃ j w)
    have d3 := resH_delta (preimageHomOfLE f hW) hSXW hSXW'
      (rcHomSC (preimageHomOfLE f hW) (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ W').ι
        (preimageHomOfLE_ι_eq f hW) S) j (edgeW f W S.X₃ j w)
    have d4 := edgeW_delta f W hS hB j w
    exact ((congrArg (edgeW f W' S.X₁ (j + 1)) d1).trans
      (d2.trans ((congrArg (Hd hSXW' j (j + 1) rfl) (ih S.X₃ hQ w)).trans d3.symm))).trans
        (congrArg (tgtRes f hW S.X₁ (j + 1)) d4.symm)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.H_map_iso_injective'
statement:
lemma H_map_iso_injective' {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}] [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    {F G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (e : F ≅ G) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (Sheaf.H.map.{u} e.hom n)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have h := congrArg (Sheaf.H.map.{u} e.inv n) hab
  rw [← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, ← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, e.hom_inv_id,
    Sheaf.H.map_id_apply, Sheaf.H.map_id_apply] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.H_map_iso_injective
statement:
lemma H_map_iso_injective {T : TopCat.{u}} {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} T}
    (e : F ≅ G) (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (Hm e.hom n)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have h := congrArg (Hm e.inv n) hab
  simp only [Hm, ← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply] at h
  erw [e.hom_inv_id, Sheaf.H.map_id_apply, Sheaf.H.map_id_apply] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.openRestrictionHAddHom_eq
statement:
lemma openRestrictionHAddHom_eq {U U' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : U' ⟶ U) [IsOpenImmersion g']
    (N : U.Modules) (i : ℕ) (x : N.H i) :
    openRestrictionHAddHom g' N i x = openPullbackExtAddHom g' (tS N) i x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.lvRes_tS_eq
statement:
lemma lvRes_tS_eq (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {U W : Y.Opens} (h : U ≤ W) (q : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} ((resP f W).obj (tS M)) q) :
    lvRes f (tS M) h q x =
      openPullbackExtAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f h) (tS (restrictToPreimage f M W)) q x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.locVan_of_isZero
statement:
lemma locVan_of_isZero (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ q, 0 < q → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M q)) :
    LocVan f (tS M)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq W x y hy
  have hP : IsZero ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f M q)) := by
    rw [← affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_toSheaf]
    exact Functor.map_isZero _ (hM q hq)
  obtain ⟨U, h, hyU, hx⟩ := locallyZero_of_isZero_sheafify _ hP x y hy
  refine ⟨U, h, hyU, ?_⟩
  change affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M q h x = 0 at hx
  have key : Sheaf.H.map.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom) q
      (openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f h) (restrictToPreimage f M W) q x) = 0 := hx
  rw [openRestrictionHAddHom_eq] at key
  have inj := H_map_iso_injective' ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).mapIso (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h)) q
  have k3 := key.trans (map_zero (Sheaf.H.map.{u}
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M h).hom) q)).symm
  rw [lvRes_tS_eq]
  exact inj k3

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.toSheaf_compIso_eq
statement:
lemma toSheaf_compIso_eq (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {W' W : Y.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) :
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M hW).hom =
      rcHom (preimageHomOfLE f hW) (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ W').ι (preimageHomOfLE_ι_eq f hW)
        (tS M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext T y
  let y' : (tS M).obj.obj (op ((f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ''ᵁ ((preimageHomOfLE f hW) ''ᵁ T.unop))) := y
  change (tS M).obj.map _ ((tS M).obj.map _ y') = (tS M).obj.map _ y'
  exact presheaf_map_map (tS M).obj _ _ _ y'

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.module_map_eq
statement:
lemma module_map_eq (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) {W' W : Y.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) (j : ℕ)
    (x : (restrictToPreimage f M W).H j) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M j hW x = tgtRes f hW (tS M) j x
proof:
:= by
  change Sheaf.H.map.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M hW).hom) j
      (openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f hW) (restrictToPreimage f M W) j x) = _
  rw [openRestrictionHAddHom_eq, toSheaf_compIso_eq]
  rfl

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.preimageToSpec_comp
statement:
lemma preimageToSpec_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (V : Z.Opens) :
    preimageToSpec (f ≫ g) V = f ∣_ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≫ preimageToSpec g V
proof:
:= by
  simp only [preimageToSpec, morphismRestrict_comp]
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.structureRingHom_compat
statement:
lemma structureRingHom_compat (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (V : Z.Opens)
    (U : (g ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Opens) (r : Γ(Z, V)) :
    (f ∣_ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).app U (structureRingHom (X := (g ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) U r) =
      structureRingHom (X := ((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) ((f ∣_ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ⁻¹ᵁ U) r
proof:
:= by
  have hglob : globalSec (X := ((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) r =
      (f ∣_ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).appTop (globalSec (X := (g ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) r) := by
    change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Z, V)).inv ≫ (preimageToSpec (f ≫ g) V).appTop).hom r) =
      (f ∣_ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).appTop
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Z, V)).inv ≫ (preimageToSpec g V).appTop).hom r)
    rw [preimageToSpec_comp, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    rfl
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply, hglob]
  have hn := (f ∣_ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).naturality U.leTop.op
  exact congrArg (fun q => q.hom (globalSec (X := (g ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) r)) hn

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.smulEnd_alpha
statement:
lemma smulEnd_alpha (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (M : X.Modules) (V : Z.Opens) (r : Γ(Z, V)) :
    smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V)) (restrictToPreimage g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V) r ≫
        (alphaIso f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (tS M)).hom =
      (alphaIso f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (tS M)).hom ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (phi f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))).map
          (smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V)) (restrictToPreimage (f ≫ g) M V) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext U s
  let W := g ⁻¹ᵁ V
  let U₁ : X.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ (W.ι ''ᵁ U.unop)
  let U₂ : X.Opens := ((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ''ᵁ ((f ∣_ W) ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
  have hU : U₂ = U₁ := (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f W U.unop)
  let s' : Γ(M, U₁) := s
  rw [ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.comp_hom, ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.comp_hom,
    NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, alphaIso_hom_app]
  have e1 : ((smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V))
      (restrictToPreimage g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V) r).hom.app U) s =
      (f.app (W.ι ''ᵁ U.unop) ((W.ι.appIso U.unop).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := W.toScheme) U.unop r)) • s' : Γ(M, U₁)) := rfl
  have e2 : ∀ t : Γ(M, U₂),
      (((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (phi f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))).map
        (smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V)) (restrictToPreimage (f ≫ g) M V) r)).hom.app U) t =
      ((((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.appIso ((f ∣_ W) ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := ((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) ((f ∣_ W) ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop) r) • t :
          Γ(M, U₂)) := fun t => rfl
  refine (congrArg _ e1).trans (Eq.trans ?_ (e2 _).symm)
  let a₁ : Γ(X, U₁) := f.app (W.ι ''ᵁ U.unop) ((W.ι.appIso U.unop).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := W.toScheme) U.unop r))
  let a₂ : Γ(X, U₂) := (((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.appIso ((f ∣_ W) ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := ((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) ((f ∣_ W) ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop) r)
  have hring : X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU).op a₁ = a₂ := by
    have hc := structureRingHom_compat f g V U.unop r
    rw [morphismRestrict_app] at hc
    simp only [a₁, a₂, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
    refine Eq.trans ?_ hc
    rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rfl
  have goal : M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU).op (a₁ • s') = a₂ • M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU).op s' := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, hring]
  have hmap : ∀ t : Γ(M, U₁), (tS M).obj.map (eqToHom (congrArg op hU.symm)) t =
      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU).op t := fun t => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (eqToHom (congrArg op hU.symm)) (eqToHom hU).op]
    rfl
  exact (hmap _).trans (goal.trans (congrArg (a₂ • ·) (hmap s').symm))

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.LerayL2.edgeW_smul
statement:
lemma edgeW_smul (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (M : X.Modules) (V : Z.Opens) (j : ℕ) (r : Γ(Z, V))
    (x : Sheaf.H.{u} ((resB (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).obj ((push f).obj (tS M))) j) :
    edgeW f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (tS M) j (Hm (smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V))
        (restrictToPreimage g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V) r) j x) =
      Hm (smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V)) (restrictToPreimage (f ≫ g) M V) r) j
        (edgeW f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (tS M) j x)
proof:
:=
  @gedge_naturality (Sh (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) (Sh (f ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))) _ _ _ _ (topShHasExt _) (topShHasExt _) _ _
    (adj (phi f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))) _ _ _ _ _ (pbConst (phi f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))) _ _ _ _
    (alphaIso f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (tS M)).hom (alphaIso f (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (tS M)).hom
    (smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V)) (restrictToPreimage g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V) r)
    (smulEnd (R := Γ(Z, V)) (restrictToPreimage (f ≫ g) M V) r)
    (smulEnd_alpha f g M V r) j x

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.preimageHomOfLE_comp
statement:
lemma preimageHomOfLE_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) {U V W : Y.Opens}
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :

proof:
:= by

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.restrictToPreimage_compIso_trans
statement:
lemma restrictToPreimage_compIso_trans (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    {U V W : Y.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (preimageHomOfLE f hUV)).map
          (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M hVW).hom ≫
        (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M hUV).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
          (preimageHomOfLE f hUV) (preimageHomOfLE f hVW)).inv.app
          (restrictToPreimage f M W) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (preimageHomOfLE_comp f hUV hVW)).hom.app
            (restrictToPreimage f M W) ≫
          (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M (hUV.trans hVW)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  dsimp only [restrictToPreimage_compIso]
  change _ =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
        (preimageHomOfLE f hUV) (preimageHomOfLE f hVW)).inv.app
          (restrictToPreimage f M W)).app T ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (preimageHomOfLE_comp f hUV hVW)).hom.app
          (restrictToPreimage f M W)).app T ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
          (preimageHomOfLE f (hUV.trans hVW)) (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).inv.app M).app T ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (by
            rw [preimageHomOfLE, Scheme.homOfLE_ι])).hom.app M).app T
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Functor.map_comp, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Category.assoc,
    restrictFunctor_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app]
  simp only [restrictToPreimage, Scheme.Modules.restrict_map,
    ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_congr
statement:
lemma openRestrictionHAddHom_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {g h : X ⟶ Y}
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion h] (p : g = h)
    (N : Y.Modules) (i : ℕ) (x : N.H i) :
    Sheaf.H.map
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr p).hom.app N)) i
        (openRestrictionHAddHom g N i x) =
      openRestrictionHAddHom h N i x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hp (q : g = g) :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr q).hom.app N = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim q rfl]
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro T
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app]
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, eqToHom_refl, op_id]
    exact N.presheaf.map_id (op (g ''ᵁ T))
  rw [hp]
  change Sheaf.H.map (𝟙 _) i (openRestrictionHAddHom g N i x) = _
  exact Sheaf.H.map_id_apply _

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_comp
statement:
theorem affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    {U V W : Y.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W)
    (x : (restrictToPreimage f M W).H i) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i hUV
        (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i hVW x) =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M i (hUV.trans hVW) x
proof:
:= by
  have hN := openRestrictionHAddHom_naturality
    (preimageHomOfLE f hUV) (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M hVW).hom i
    (openRestrictionHAddHom (preimageHomOfLE f hVW) (restrictToPreimage f M W) i x)
  have hcomp := openRestrictionHAddHom_comp
    (preimageHomOfLE f hUV) (preimageHomOfLE f hVW)
    (restrictToPreimage f M W) i x
  have hcongr := openRestrictionHAddHom_congr
    (preimageHomOfLE_comp f hUV hVW) (restrictToPreimage f M W) i x
  have hinner := (congrArg (fun y => Sheaf.H.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (preimageHomOfLE_comp f hUV hVW)).hom.app
            (restrictToPreimage f M W))) i y) hcomp).trans hcongr
  refine (congrArg (Sheaf.H.map _ i) hN.symm).trans ?_
  refine (Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, restrictToPreimage_compIso_trans f M hUV hVW]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp,
    Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun y => Sheaf.H.map
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
      (restrictToPreimage_compIso f M (hUV.trans hVW)).hom) i y) hinner

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.pullbackUnitIso_congr
statement:
theorem pullbackUnitIso_congr {X P : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ P} (h : f = g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom =
      (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst g

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit {X P : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ P)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫
      (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom = (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
proof:
:=
  SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso q

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit_inv
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit_inv {X P : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ P)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom = (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom
proof:
:=
  (Iso.inv_comp_eq ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app
    (tensorUnitSheaf P))).mpr (restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit q).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.purePullbackSquare_unit
statement:
theorem purePullbackSquare_unit :
    (purePullbackSquare p q v g h).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (pullbackObjUnitIso v).hom ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom
proof:
:= by
  let c0 := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp q p).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)
  let c1 := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)
  let c2 := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g v).inv.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)
  let d := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (pullbackObjUnitIso v).hom
  let e := (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom
  have hm : c2 ≫ (d ≫ e) = (pullbackObjUnitIso (g ≫ v)).hom :=
    (Iso.inv_comp_eq ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g v).app (tensorUnitSheaf P))).mpr
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackObjUnitIso_comp_hom g v).symm
  have hc : c0 ≫ (c1 ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso (g ≫ v)).hom) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom :=
    (congrArg (fun f => c0 ≫ f) (pullbackUnitIso_congr h)).trans
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackObjUnitIso_comp_hom q p)
  change (c0 ≫ c1 ≫ c2) ≫ d ≫ e = _
  exact (Category.assoc c0 (c1 ≫ c2) (d ≫ e)).trans
    ((congrArg (fun f => c0 ≫ f) (Category.assoc c1 c2 (d ≫ e))).trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => c0 ≫ c1 ≫ f) hm).trans hc))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictSquare_unit :
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p q v g h).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
proof:
:= by
  let rq := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q
  let rv := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v
  let C := purePullbackSquare p q v g h
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback g
  have hv : F.map (rv.inv.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫
      F.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom = F.map (pullbackObjUnitIso v).hom :=
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp F (rv.inv.app (tensorUnitSheaf P))
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun f => F.map f) (restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit_inv v))
  have hp : C.hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫
        (F.map (rv.inv.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫
          F.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom :=
    (congrArg (fun f => C.hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫ f ≫
      (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom) hv).trans (purePullbackSquare_unit p q v g h)
  have hn : rq.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
        rq.hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf Q) :=
    (rq.hom.naturality (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom).symm
  have hq : rq.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
          (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom :=
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom) hn).trans
        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          (congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
            (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom ≫ f) (restrictUnitIso_pullbackUnit q))))
  change rq.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫
    (C.hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) ≫
      (F.map (rv.inv.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫
        F.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom) = _
  exact (congrArg (fun f => rq.hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj (tensorUnitSheaf P)) ≫ f) hp).trans hq

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.pulledCoefficient_restrict
statement:
theorem pulledCoefficient_restrict {M : P.Modules} (k : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf P) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map k ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom =
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p q v g h).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map k ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom) ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom
proof:
:= by
  let C := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p q v g h
  have hn :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map k) ≫
        C.hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P) =
      C.hom.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map k) := C.hom.naturality k
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map k)
  let b := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom
  let c := (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
  let d := C.hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf P)
  let e := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map k)
  let f := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso v).hom
  let t := (pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom
  let n := C.hom.app M
  have hb : b ≫ c = d ≫ f ≫ t := (pullbackRestrictSquare_unit p q v g h).symm
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  change (a ≫ b) ≫ c = n ≫ (e ≫ f) ≫ t
  exact (Category.assoc a b c).trans
    ((congrArg (fun m => a ≫ m) hb).trans
      ((Category.assoc a d (f ≫ t)).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun m => m ≫ (f ≫ t)) hn).trans
          ((Category.assoc n e (f ≫ t)).trans
            (congrArg (fun m => n ≫ m) (Category.assoc e f t).symm)))))

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.kernelPulledInclusion_eq_map_unit

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.nativeKernelCongr_inclusion

      kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap f)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.restrictNativeKernelResLEIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem restrictNativeKernelResLEIso_inclusion {X P : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ P)
    (U : P.Opens) (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ U) (heq : W = i ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    (restrictNativeKernelResLEIso i U W hW heq).hom ≫
        kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (i.resLE U W hW)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst W
  simp only [restrictNativeKernelResLEIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [nativeKernelCongr_inclusion]
  exact restrictNativeKernelIso_inclusion i U

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.chartCompositeKernelIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem chartCompositeKernelIso_inclusion :
    (chartCompositeKernelIso j p U V e hW).hom ≫ kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap
        (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
          (kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCompositeKernelIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    nativeKernelCongr_inclusion]
  exact restrictNativeKernelIso_inclusion (j ≫ p) U

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.chartKernelComparison_inclusion
statement:
theorem chartKernelComparison_inclusion :
    chartKernelComparison j p U V e hW heq ≫
        kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.resLE U V e)).map (kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap
        (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e))) ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.closed_resLE_of_preimage_eq j V _ heq hW
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_resLE_compositeClosed j p U V e hW
  exact (kernelIdealComparison_inclusion _ _).trans (kernelPulledInclusion_eq_map_unit _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.kernelIdealComparison_restrict
statement:
theorem kernelIdealComparison_restrict :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (kernelIdealComparison j p) ≫
        (restrictNativeKernelResLEIso j V _ hW heq).hom =
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p V.ι U.ι (p.resLE U V e)
        (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm).hom.app
          (kernel (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.resLE U V e)).map
          (chartCompositeKernelIso j p U V e hW).hom ≫
        chartKernelComparison j p U V e hW heq
proof:
:= by
  let C := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p V.ι U.ι (p.resLE U V e)
    (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.resLE U V e)
  let ki := kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))
  let kj' := kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW))
  let ki' := kernel.ι (nativeStructureMap
    (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e))
  let z := (chartCompositeKernelIso j p U V e hW).hom
  let y := (restrictNativeKernelResLEIso j V _ hW heq).hom
  have hz : F.map z ≫ (F.map ki' ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom) =
      F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ki ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom) ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f => F.map f ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom)
      (chartCompositeKernelIso_inclusion j p U V e hW)
  apply (cancel_mono kj').mp
  have hl : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (kernelIdealComparison j p) ≫ y) ≫ kj' =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (kernelPulledInclusion j p) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, restrictNativeKernelResLEIso_inclusion,
      ← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, kernelIdealComparison_inclusion]
  have hr : (C.hom.app (kernel (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))) ≫ F.map z ≫
      chartKernelComparison j p U V e hW heq) ≫ kj' =
      C.hom.app (kernel (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))) ≫
        F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ki ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom) ≫
          (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, chartKernelComparison_inclusion]
    exact congrArg (fun f => C.hom.app (kernel (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))) ≫ f) hz
  have hm :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (kernelPulledInclusion j p) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom =
      C.hom.app (kernel (nativeStructureMap (j ≫ p))) ≫
        F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ki ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom) ≫
          (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom := by
    rw [kernelPulledInclusion_eq_map_unit]
    exact pulledCoefficient_restrict p V.ι U.ι (p.resLE U V e)
      (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm ki
  exact hl.trans (hm.trans hr.symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.chartIdealIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem chartIdealIso_inclusion :
    (chartIdealIso j p U V hW heq).hom ≫
        idealModuleι (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW).ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (idealModuleι j.ker) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.closed_resLE_of_preimage_eq j V _ heq hW
  simp only [chartIdealIso, Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion, restrictNativeKernelResLEIso_inclusion,
    ← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.chartCompositeIdealIso_inclusion
statement:
theorem chartCompositeIdealIso_inclusion :
    (chartCompositeIdealIso j p U V e hW).hom ≫
        idealModuleι (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e).ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_resLE_compositeClosed j p U V e hW
  simp only [chartCompositeIdealIso, Iso.trans_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [idealKernelIso_inv_inclusion, chartCompositeKernelIso_inclusion,
    ← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, idealKernelIso_hom_inclusion]

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.chartIdealComparison_inclusion
statement:
theorem chartIdealComparison_inclusion :
    chartIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq ≫
        idealModuleι (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW).ker =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.resLE U V e)).map
        (idealModuleι (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e).ker) ≫
          (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.closed_resLE_of_preimage_eq j V _ heq hW
  letI := CompatibleClosedChartH2.chart_resLE_compositeClosed j p U V e hW
  exact (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_inclusion _ _).trans
    (pulledIdealInclusion_eq_map_unit _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ConormalRestrictionMapH2.originalIdealComparison_restrict
statement:
theorem originalIdealComparison_restrict :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
        (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p) ≫
        (chartIdealIso j p U V hW heq).hom =
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p V.ι U.ι (p.resLE U V e)
        (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm).hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.resLE U V e)).map
          (chartCompositeIdealIso j p U V e hW).hom ≫
        chartIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq
proof:
:= by
  let C := pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso p V.ι U.ι (p.resLE U V e)
    (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.resLE U V e)
  let ki := idealModuleι (j ≫ p).ker
  let kj' := idealModuleι (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW).ker
  let ki' := idealModuleι (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW ≫ p.resLE U V e).ker
  let z := (chartCompositeIdealIso j p U V e hW).hom
  let y := (chartIdealIso j p U V hW heq).hom
  have hz : F.map z ≫ (F.map ki' ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom) =
      F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ki ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom) ≫
        (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f => F.map f ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom)
      (chartCompositeIdealIso_inclusion j p U V e hW)
  letI : Mono kj' := by
    change Mono (kernel.ι (structureMap (j.resLE V ((j ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW).ker))
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_mono kj').mp
  have hl : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
      (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison j p) ≫ y) ≫ kj' =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
        (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion j p) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, chartIdealIso_inclusion,
      ← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
      ConormalComparisonSheafH2.idealComparison_inclusion]
  have hr : (C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫ F.map z ≫
      chartIdealComparison j p U V e hW heq) ≫ kj' =
      C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
        F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ki ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom) ≫
          (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, chartIdealComparison_inclusion]
    exact congrArg (fun f => C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫ f) hz
  have hm :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
        (ConormalComparisonSheafH2.pulledIdealInclusion j p) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom =
      C.hom.app (TF3.idealOf (j ≫ p)) ≫
        F.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ki ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom) ≫
          (pullbackObjUnitIso (p.resLE U V e)).hom := by
    rw [pulledIdealInclusion_eq_map_unit]
    exact pulledCoefficient_restrict p V.ι U.ι (p.resLE U V e)
      (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι p e).symm ki
  exact hl.trans (hm.trans hr.symm)

name: B4.RingFilt.mem_zero
statement: theorem mem_zero (a : R) : a ∈ Φ.F 0
proof: := by rw [Φ.zero]; trivial

name: B4.RingFilt.mul_mem
statement: theorem mul_mem {m n : ℕ} {a b : R} (ha : a ∈ Φ.F m) (hb : b ∈ Φ.F n) : a * b ∈ Φ.F (m + n)
proof:
:=
  Φ.mul m n (Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hb)

name: B4.RingFilt.pow_mem
statement: theorem pow_mem {a : R} (ha : a ∈ Φ.F 1) (k : ℕ) : a ^ k ∈ Φ.F k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using Φ.mem_zero 1
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact Φ.mul_mem ih ha

name: B4.coeff_mul_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_mem {r s : R⟦X⟧} (hr : ∀ n, coeff n r ∈ Φ.F n) (hs : ∀ n, coeff n s ∈ Φ.F n)
    (n : ℕ) : coeff n (r * s) ∈ Φ.F n
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun p hp => ?_
  have h := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.1 hp
  have := Φ.mul_mem (hr p.1) (hs p.2)
  rwa [h] at this

name: B4.mem_ReesPS
statement: theorem mem_ReesPS {r : R⟦X⟧} : r ∈ ReesPS Φ ↔ ∀ n, coeff n r ∈ Φ.F n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: B4.mk_gclPS_add
statement:
theorem mk_gclPS_add (D n : ℕ) (a b : Φ.F n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D) (gclPS n (a + b)) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS n a) + Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS n b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  show C ((a : R) + (b : R)) * X ^ n = C (a : R) * X ^ n + C (b : R) * X ^ n
  rw [map_add, add_mul]

name: B4.mk_gclPS_zero
statement:
theorem mk_gclPS_zero (D n : ℕ) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D) (gclPS n (0 : Φ.F n)) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_zero (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D))]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  show C ((0 : Φ.F n) : R) * X ^ n = 0
  simp

name: B4.mk_gclPS_mul
statement:
theorem mk_gclPS_mul (D : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (a : Φ.F m) (b : Φ.F n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D) (gclPS m a) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) *
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS n b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS (m + n) ⟨(a : R) * b, Φ.mul_mem a.2 b.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  show C (a : R) * X ^ m * (C (b : R) * X ^ n) = C ((a : R) * b) * X ^ (m + n)
  rw [map_mul, pow_add]; ring

name: B4.gcl_add
statement: theorem gcl_add (D n : ℕ) (a b : Φ.F n) : gcl D n (a + b) = gcl D n a + gcl D n b
proof:
:=
  mk_gclPS_add D n a b

name: B4.gcl_zero
statement: theorem gcl_zero (D n : ℕ) : gcl D n (0 : Φ.F n) = 0
proof: := mk_gclPS_zero D n

name: B4.gcl_neg
statement: theorem gcl_neg (D n : ℕ) (a : Φ.F n) : gcl D n (-a) = - gcl D n a
proof:
:= by
  have := gcl_add D n a (-a)
  rw [add_neg_cancel, gcl_zero] at this
  exact (neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero_right this.symm).symm

name: B4.gcl_sub
statement: theorem gcl_sub (D n : ℕ) (a b : Φ.F n) : gcl D n (a - b) = gcl D n a - gcl D n b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, gcl_add, gcl_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: B4.gcl_mul
statement:
theorem gcl_mul (D : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (a : Φ.F m) (b : Φ.F n) :
    gcl D m a * gcl D n b = gcl D (m + n) ⟨(a : R) * b, Φ.mul_mem a.2 b.2⟩
proof:
:=
  mk_gclPS_mul D a b

name: B4.mk_gclPS_qsmul
statement:
theorem mk_gclPS_qsmul (D n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (a : Φ.F n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D) (gclPS n (qsmul c a)) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) =
      c • (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS n a) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_smul (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℚ (ReesIdeal Φ D)) c (gclPS n a)
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h
  show Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  show C (algebraMap ℚ R c * (a : R)) * X ^ n = c • (C (a : R) * X ^ n)
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, PowerSeries.algebraMap_apply, map_mul]; ring

name: B4.gcl_qsmul
statement: theorem gcl_qsmul (D n : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (a : Φ.F n) : gcl D n (qsmul c a) = c • gcl D n a
proof:
:=
  mk_gclPS_qsmul D n c a

name: B4.gcl_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem gcl_eq_zero_of_lt {D n : ℕ} (h : D < n) (a : Φ.F n) : gcl D n a = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS n a) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) = 0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  intro m hm
  show coeff m (C (a : R) * X ^ n) ∈ _
  rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg (by omega)]
  exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: B4.gcl_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem gcl_eq_zero_iff {D n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ D) (a : Φ.F n) :
    gcl D n a = 0 ↔ (a : R) ∈ Φ.F (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  change (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (gclPS n a) : ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h n hn
    have e : coeff n ((gclPS n a : ReesPS Φ) : R⟦X⟧) = (a : R) := by
      show coeff n (C (a : R) * X ^ n) = _
      simp
    rwa [e] at this
  · intro h m hm
    show coeff m (C (a : R) * X ^ n) ∈ _
    rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
    split_ifs with hmn
    · subst hmn; exact h
    · exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: B4.gcl_congr
statement: theorem gcl_congr (D n : ℕ) {a b : Φ.F n} (h : (a : R) = b) : gcl D n a = gcl D n b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.ext h]

name: B4.mk_gclPS_one
statement:
theorem mk_gclPS_one (D : ℕ) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D) (gclPS 0 (⟨1, Φ.mem_zero 1⟩ : Φ.F 0)) :
      ReesPS Φ ⧸ ReesIdeal Φ D) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk (ReesIdeal Φ D))]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  show C (1 : R) * X ^ 0 = 1
  simp

name: B4.gcl_zero_one
statement: theorem gcl_zero_one (D : ℕ) : gcl D 0 (⟨1, Φ.mem_zero 1⟩ : Φ.F 0) = 1
proof: := mk_gclPS_one D

name: B4.gcl_one_pow
statement:
theorem gcl_one_pow (D k : ℕ) (a : Φ.F 1) :
    (gcl D 1 a) ^ k = gcl D k ⟨(a : R) ^ k, Φ.pow_mem a.2 k⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact (gcl_zero_one D).symm.trans (gcl_congr D 0 (by simp))
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, gcl_mul]
    exact gcl_congr D (k + 1) (by simp [pow_succ])

name: B4.gcl_one_pow_succ
statement: theorem gcl_one_pow_succ (D : ℕ) (a : Φ.F 1) : (gcl D 1 a) ^ (D + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gcl_one_pow]; exact gcl_eq_zero_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self D) _

name: B4.gcl_eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem gcl_eq_of_sub_mem (D n : ℕ) {a b : Φ.F n} (h : (a : R) - b ∈ Φ.F (n + 1)) :
    gcl D n a = gcl D n b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n ≤ D
  · have : gcl D n (a - b) = 0 := (gcl_eq_zero_iff hn _).2 h
    rw [gcl_sub] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
  · rw [gcl_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega), gcl_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]

name: B4.GrT.commute
statement: theorem GrT.commute {D : ℕ} (x y : GrT Φ D) : Commute x y
proof: := mul_comm x y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde_isCoherentLike
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p)
proof:
:= by
  change (projectiveTwistingPositiveHigherDirectImageTilde R n d p).IsFinitePresentation
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.affineSchemePullbackG0_identityHigherClass
statement:
theorem affineSchemePullbackG0_identityHigherClass (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (E : {M : Y.Modules // IsCoherentLike Y M}) (i : ℕ) :
    affineSchemePullbackG0 f
        (GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass E i) =
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass
        (affineSchemePullbackObject f E) i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    exact affineSchemePullbackG0_classOf f E.1 E.2
  · simp [GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass, hi]

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionG0_eq_affineSchemePullbackG0
statement:
theorem openRestrictionG0_eq_affineSchemePullbackG0 (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    openRestrictionG0 j = affineSchemePullbackG0 j
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  change openRestrictionG0 j (g0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2) =
    affineSchemePullbackG0 j (g0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2)
  rw [openRestrictionG0_classOf, affineSchemePullbackG0_classOf]
  letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2
  exact g0ClassOf_iso _ _
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback j).app E.1)

name: SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.finiteAffineG0Pushforward_flatBaseChange_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem finiteAffineG0Pushforward_flatBaseChange_of_isPullback
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsFinite f] [Flat g]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(S, ⊤)] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(S', ⊤)] :
    letI : IsAffine X'
proof:
:=
      IsAffine.of_isIso (affineCartesianTensorIso g' f' f g h).hom
    letI : IsFinite f' :=
      MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback h inferInstance
    letI : Flat g' :=
      MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback h.flip inferInstance
    (SchemeKTheory.affineSchemePullbackG0 g).comp
        (finiteAffineG0Pushforward f) =
      (finiteAffineG0Pushforward f').comp
        (SchemeKTheory.affineSchemePullbackG0 g') := by
  letI : IsAffine X' :=
    IsAffine.of_isIso (affineCartesianTensorIso g' f' f g h).hom
  letI : IsFinite f' :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback h
      (inferInstance : IsFinite f)
  letI : Flat g' :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback h.flip
      (inferInstance : Flat g)
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E

statement:
theorem arr_caseII_ambient [IsIntegral A] (J : A.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral J.subscheme]
    (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A)
    (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme J.subscheme) (φ : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤))
    (hd : 0 < codim J) (hne : ∃ y : A, y ∉ Set.range (iZ A J))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (Zs A J)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= KG2B.isNoetherian_total J hA
    haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W J hA
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankA A) j)
        (pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ A J) (KG2B.resolutionA hA hAreg).res
        (thetaZ (inputsOfKG2B J hA hAreg hZ) j *
          locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankZ A J) j) x) := by
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W J hA
  let D := inputsOfKG2B J hA hAreg hZ
  let CN := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank (hNrank D)).choose
  have hCN : ∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = codim J :=
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank (hNrank D)).choose_spec
  exact arr_caseII_final D φ CN hCN hd hne hj x

name: B7Lci.grr_weight_lci_uncond

name: CIK1A.arrw_iff_arrN
statement:
theorem arrw_iff_arrN (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ)
