name: CIK1A.arr_restricted_of_koszul
statement:
theorem arr_restricted_of_koszul (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (PY k Y n)) (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n))
    (lam c : K0 (PY k Y n))
    (hkos : finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X 1) = k0ToG0 (PY k Y n) lam)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (hψ : algebraMap _ (KLoc j (PY k Y n)) (adamsRingHom hrankP j lam) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd c) :
        (KLoc j (PY k Y n))ˣ) : KLoc j (PY k Y n)) * algebraMap _ _ lam)
    (y : K0 (PY k Y n)) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i (pullbackK0RingHom i y))) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j
              (pullbackK0RingHom i y)) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                pullbackK0RingHom i c)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  have hrankX : ConstantRankGenerators X := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X
  have hrankY : ConstantRankGenerators Y := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y
  have hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X := lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i
  have hj1 : 1 ≤ j := by omega
  let resY := resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg
  let resP := resProd hY hreg n
  set Ω : K0 (PY k Y n) := cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n with hΩ
  
  have hcomp : ∀ x : K0 X, piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY (resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))) =
      fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i x := by
    intro x
    have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun resP.right (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at hr
    simp only [piK0, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hr]
    rfl
  
  have hiG : resP.res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X (pullbackK0RingHom i y))) = y * lam := by
    rw [← one_mul (pullbackK0RingHom i y), finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback, hkos,
      ← k0ToG0_mul]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun resP.left (y * lam)
  
  have hpush1 : pushLocF3 j i resP.res 1 = algebraMap _ (KLoc j (PY k Y n)) lam := by
    rw [← map_one (algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X))]
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [hkos]
    exact congrArg _ (DFunLike.congr_fun resP.left lam)
  
  have hu : ∀ a : K0 (PY k Y n), Units.map (pullLocF3 j i).toMonoidHom
      (SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)) =
      SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i a)) :=
    fun a => Units.ext (by
      rw [Units.coe_map, bott_pull j i (pullbackK0RingHom i) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf i)
        (pullLocF3 j i) (pullLocF3_alg j i) hrankX hnilX hrankP hnilP]
      rfl)
  have hinv : ∀ a : K0 (PY k Y n),
      (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i a)))⁻¹ : (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      pullLocF3 j i (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))⁻¹ : (KLoc j (PY k Y n))ˣ) : KLoc j (PY k Y n)) := by
    intro a
    rw [← hu, ← map_inv, Units.coe_map]
    rfl
  have harg : algebraMap _ (KLoc j X) (adamsRingHom hrankX j (pullbackK0RingHom i y)) *
      (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X hrankX hnilX
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i Ω - pullbackK0RingHom i c)))⁻¹ :
          (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      1 * pullLocF3 j i (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankP j y) *
        (((SchemeKTheory.bott j (PY k Y n) hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd (Ω - c)))⁻¹ :
          (KLoc j (PY k Y n))ˣ) : KLoc j (PY k Y n))) := by
    rw [← map_sub, hinv, one_mul, map_mul, pullLocF3_alg]
    congr 2
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (hψnat' i hrankX hrankP hj1) y).symm
  
  have hI := adamsRR_caseI_prod_lib (Y ↘ Spk k) n resY j hj hrankP hrankY hnilP (y * lam)
  rw [← hcomp, hiG, hI]
  unfold pushI
  rw [harg, projFormulaLoc j i resP.res resP.left resP.right, hpush1]
  congr 1
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, hψ, ofAdd_sub, map_div, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Units.val_mul]
  ring

name: CIK1A.adamsRiemannRoch_ci_restricted
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_ci_restricted (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (E : (PY k Y n).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank _ E r)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (PY k Y n))
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames (PY k Y n) E σ)
    (hker : i.ker = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal (PY k Y n) E σ)
    {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (y : K0 (PY k Y n)) :
    ARRN hY hreg n i N j (pullbackK0RingHom i y)
      (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i (pullbackK0RingHom i y))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (PY k Y n) := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n) := lambdaNilpotent_P n hY
  unfold ARRN
  rw [conormalClass_eq_pullback E σ i hE h hker N]
  exact arr_restricted_of_koszul n i hY hreg hrankP hnilP (lambdaMinusOne E hE)
    (k0ClassOf _ E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) (finitePushforward_one_eq_cosection E σ i hE h hker) hj
    (adams_lambdaMinusOne_lib (by omega) hrankP hnilP E hE) y

name: CIK1A.adamsRiemannRoch_ci_one
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_ci_one (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (E : (PY k Y n).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank _ E r)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (PY k Y n))
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames (PY k Y n) E σ)
    (hker : i.ker = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal (PY k Y n) E σ)
    {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    ARRN hY hreg n i N j 1 (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := adamsRiemannRoch_ci_restricted n i hY hreg E hE σ h hker N hj 1
  rwa [map_one] at this

name: CIK1A.adamsRiemannRoch_ci_can
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_ci_can (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hYreg : RegStalks Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f)
    (E : (PY k Y n).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank _ E r)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (PY k Y n))
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames (PY k Y n) E σ)
    (hker : i.ker = quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal (PY k Y n) E σ)
    {r' : ℕ} (N : ConormalDataAmb i r') {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (y : K0 (PY k Y n)) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    ARRN hY hYreg n i N j (pullbackK0RingHom i y)
      (CAN.fShriekCan hX hY hYreg f hf (pullbackK0RingHom i y)) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := hY.1
  rw [CAN.fShriekCan_eq hX hY hYreg f hf i hi]
  exact adamsRiemannRoch_ci_restricted n i hY hYreg E hE σ h hker N hj y

name: CIK1A.lambdaMinusOne_rankOne
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_rankOne {Z : Scheme.{u}} (L : Z.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Z L 1) :
    lambdaMinusOne L hL = 1 - k0ClassOf Z L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, lambdaClass_zero,
    lambdaClass_one, sub_eq_add_neg]
  ring

name: CIK1A.adams_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem adams_prod_one_sub {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnil : LambdaNilpotent Z)
    (L : ℕ → Z.Modules) (hL : ∀ m, HasConstantRank Z (L m) 1) (d : ℕ) :
    algebraMap (K0 Z) (KLoc j Z) (adamsRingHom hrank j
        (∏ m ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf Z (L m) (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree))) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.bott j Z hrank hnil (Multiplicative.ofAdd
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.range d, k0ClassOf Z (L m) (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
        (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z) *
        algebraMap _ _ (∏ m ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf Z (L m) (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree))
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d ih =>
    have h1 := adams_lambdaMinusOne_lib hj hrank hnil (L d) (hL d)
    rw [lambdaMinusOne_rankOne] at h1
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, map_mul, map_mul, ih, h1, ofAdd_add,
      map_mul, Units.val_mul, map_mul]
    ring

name: CIK1A.adamsRiemannRoch_ci_sections
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_ci_sections (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hreg : RegStalks Y)
    (L : ℕ → (PY k Y n).Modules) (hL : ∀ m, HasConstantRank _ (L m) 1)
    (s : ∀ m, L m ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (PY k Y n)) (d : ℕ)
    (hregs : ∀ m < d, Mono (koszulStepMap _ (L m) (s m) (koszulQuotient _ L s m)))
    (eZ : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≅ koszulQuotient _ L s d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (y : K0 (PY k Y n)) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j Y)
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral Y) j
          (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n i (pullbackK0RingHom i y))) =
      locAddHom j (piK0 (Y ↘ Spk k) n (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg))
        (pushI n i hY hreg j
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j
              (pullbackK0RingHom i y)) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (lambdaNilpotent_X n hY i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (cotangentClass (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n) -
                pullbackK0RingHom i
                  (∑ m ∈ Finset.range d, k0ClassOf _ (L m) (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree))))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := T1CL.prod_lft n
  haveI : IsIntegral (PY k Y n) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  have hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators (PY k Y n) := constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (PY k Y n) := lambdaNilpotent_P n hY
  set P := ∏ m ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf _ (L m) (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree) with hP
  have hF := koszulQuotient_isCoherentLike (PY k Y n) L (fun m => (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree) s
  have hkos : finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X 1) = k0ToG0 (PY k Y n) P := by
    rw [k0ToG0_one, finitePushforward_classOf, g0ClassOf_iso _ _ (hF d) eZ,
      g0ClassOf_koszulChain (PY k Y n) L (fun m => (hL m).isFiniteLocallyFree)
        (koszulQuotient _ L s) (fun m => koszulStepMap _ (L m) (s m) (koszulQuotient _ L s m))
        (fun m => cokernel.π _) (fun m => cokernel.condition _) d (fun m _ => hF m)
        (fun m hm => { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel _)
                       mono_f := hregs m hm
                       epi_g := (inferInstance : Epi (cokernel.π _)) }),
      show k0ToG0 (PY k Y n) P = P • k0ToG0 (PY k Y n) 1 by rw [← k0ToG0_mul, mul_one],
      k0ToG0_one]
    rfl
  exact arr_restricted_of_koszul n i hY hreg hrankP hnilP P _ hkos hj
    (adams_prod_one_sub (by omega) hrankP hnilP L hL d) y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.constantCoeff_bottSeries

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.coeff_derivative_mul_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_derivative_mul_pow [IsDomain A] [CharZero A] (S T : A⟦X⟧) (hST : S * T = 1)
    (q : ℕ) :
    coeff q (d⁄dX A (X * S) * T ^ (q + 1)) = if q = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : d⁄dX A (X * S) = S + X * d⁄dX A S := by
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, derivative_X, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hTq : S * T ^ (q + 1) = T ^ q := by
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm S, mul_assoc, hST, mul_one]
  have hsplit : d⁄dX A (X * S) * T ^ (q + 1) = T ^ q + X * (d⁄dX A S * T ^ (q + 1)) := by
    rw [hd, add_mul, hTq]; ring
  rw [hsplit, map_add]
  rcases q with _ | p
  · simp
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero p)]
    
    have hdST : S * d⁄dX A T + T * d⁄dX A S = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (d⁄dX A) hST
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
      linear_combination h
    have hdT : d⁄dX A T = -(T ^ 2 * d⁄dX A S) := by
      linear_combination T * hdST - (d⁄dX A T) * hST
    have hpow : d⁄dX A (T ^ (p + 1)) = -(((p + 1 : ℕ) : A⟦X⟧) * (d⁄dX A S * T ^ (p + 1 + 1))) := by
      rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, hdT, Nat.add_sub_cancel, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hc := congrArg (coeff p) hpow
    rw [coeff_derivative, map_neg, ← map_natCast (C (R := A)), coeff_C_mul] at hc
    have hq : ((p : A) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero p
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq
    push_cast at hc
    linear_combination hc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.sum_coeff_eq_coeff_mul_geom
statement:
theorem sum_coeff_eq_coeff_mul_geom (G : A⟦X⟧) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), coeff l G =
      coeff m (G * ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), X ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  have : ∀ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), coeff m (G * X ^ p) = coeff (m - p) G := by
    intro p hp
    rw [coeff_mul_X_pow', if_pos (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hp))]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun l ↦ coeff l G) (m + 1)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.sum_coeff_natCast_mul_pow
statement:
theorem sum_coeff_natCast_mul_pow [IsDomain A] [CharZero A] (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (T : A⟦X⟧)
    (hT : bottSeries A j * T = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), coeff l ((j : A⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set S := bottSeries A j with hSdef
  set V : A⟦X⟧ := ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), X ^ p with hV
  set u : A⟦X⟧ := X * S with hu
  set u' : A⟦X⟧ := d⁄dX A (X * S) with hu'
  set E : A⟦X⟧ := ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), u ^ p with hE
  set P : A⟦X⟧ := (1 - X) ^ (j - 1) with hP
  have e1 : (1 - u) * E = 1 - u ^ (m + 1) := mul_neg_geom_sum u (m + 1)
  have e2 : (1 - X) * V = 1 - X ^ (m + 1) := mul_neg_geom_sum X (m + 1)
  have hjP : (1 - X : A⟦X⟧) ^ j = P * (1 - X) := by
    rw [hP, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hj]
  have e3 : u = 1 - P * (1 - X) := by rw [hu, X_mul_bottSeries, hjP]
  have e4 : u' = (j : A⟦X⟧) * P := by
    rw [hu', X_mul_bottSeries, map_sub, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, Derivation.leibniz_pow,
      map_sub, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, derivative_X, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have key : (j : A⟦X⟧) * V = u' * E - u' * X ^ (m + 1) * E + (j : A⟦X⟧) * V * u ^ (m + 1) := by
    linear_combination (-(j : A⟦X⟧) * V) * e1 + (u' * E) * e2 + (-(j : A⟦X⟧) * V * E) * e3 +
      (-(V * E * (1 - X))) * e4
  rw [sum_coeff_eq_coeff_mul_geom, ← hV]
  have hsplit : (j : A⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1) * V =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), X ^ p * (u' * T ^ (m - p + 1)) +
        X ^ (m + 1) * ((-(u' * E) + (j : A⟦X⟧) * V * S ^ (m + 1)) * T ^ (m + 1)) := by
    have hterm : ∀ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        u' * u ^ p * T ^ (m + 1) = X ^ p * (u' * T ^ (m - p + 1)) := by
      intro p hp
      have hpm : p ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hp)
      have hST : (S * T) ^ p = 1 := by rw [hT, one_pow]
      rw [show m + 1 = p + (m - p + 1) by omega, pow_add, hu]
      linear_combination (u' * X ^ p * T ^ (m - p + 1)) * hST
    have hsum : u' * E * T ^ (m + 1) =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), X ^ p * (u' * T ^ (m - p + 1)) := by
      rw [hE, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm
    have hum : u ^ (m + 1) = X ^ (m + 1) * S ^ (m + 1) := by rw [hu, mul_pow]
    rw [← hsum]
    linear_combination T ^ (m + 1) * key + (-(j : A⟦X⟧) * V * T ^ (m + 1)) * hum
  rw [hsplit, map_add, coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by omega), add_zero, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
  · rw [coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, hu']
    rw [coeff_derivative_mul_pow S T hT 0, if_pos rfl]
  · intro p hp hpm
    have hp' : p < m := lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hp)) hpm
    rw [coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos hp'.le, hu']
    rw [show m - p + 1 = (m - p) + 1 from rfl, coeff_derivative_mul_pow S T hT (m - p),
      if_neg (by omega)]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.self_mem_range_succ m) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.evalTrunc_coe
statement:
theorem evalTrunc_coe (hH : H ^ N = 0) (p : _root_.Polynomial A) :
    evalTrunc φ H N (p : A⟦X⟧) = p.eval₂ φ H
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range, evalTrunc]
  simp only [_root_.Polynomial.coeff_coe]
  have h1 : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, φ (p.coeff l) * H ^ l =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1 + N), φ (p.coeff l) * H ^ l := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) fun l hl hlN ↦ ?_
    rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le (by simpa using hlN) hH, mul_zero]
  have h2 : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), φ (p.coeff l) * H ^ l =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1 + N), φ (p.coeff l) * H ^ l := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) fun l hl hlN ↦ ?_
    rw [_root_.Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by simp at hlN; omega), map_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [h1, h2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.evalTrunc_congr
statement:
theorem evalTrunc_congr {f g : A⟦X⟧} (h : ∀ l < N, coeff l f = coeff l g) :
    evalTrunc φ H N f = evalTrunc φ H N g
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l hl ↦ by rw [h l (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.evalTrunc_mul
statement:
theorem evalTrunc_mul (hH : H ^ N = 0) (f g : A⟦X⟧) :
    evalTrunc φ H N (f * g) = evalTrunc φ H N f * evalTrunc φ H N g
proof:
:= by
  have hf : evalTrunc φ H N f = evalTrunc φ H N (trunc N f : A⟦X⟧) :=
    evalTrunc_congr fun l hl ↦ (coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt hl).symm
  have hg : evalTrunc φ H N g = evalTrunc φ H N (trunc N g : A⟦X⟧) :=
    evalTrunc_congr fun l hl ↦ (coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt hl).symm
  have hfg : evalTrunc φ H N (f * g) =
      evalTrunc φ H N ((trunc N f : A⟦X⟧) * (trunc N g : A⟦X⟧)) :=
    evalTrunc_congr fun l hl ↦ coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc f g hl
  rw [hfg, hf, hg, ← _root_.Polynomial.coe_mul, evalTrunc_coe hH, evalTrunc_coe hH,
    evalTrunc_coe hH, _root_.Polynomial.eval₂_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.evalTruncHom_X
statement:
theorem evalTruncHom_X (hH : H ^ N = 0) (hN : 0 < N) :
    evalTruncHom φ H N hH hN X = H
proof:
:= by
  change evalTrunc φ H N X = H
  rw [← _root_.Polynomial.coe_X, evalTrunc_coe hH, _root_.Polynomial.eval₂_X]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.evalTruncHom_apply
statement:
theorem evalTruncHom_apply (hH : H ^ N = 0) (hN : 0 < N) (f : A⟦X⟧) :
    evalTruncHom φ H N hH hN f = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, φ (coeff l f) * H ^ l
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.mul_pow_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mul_pow_eq_sum {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (c y : K) (i : ℕ) :
    c * y ^ i = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i + 1),
      (((-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (i.choose k : ℤ)) • (c * (1 - y) ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  have : y = -(1 - y) + 1 := by ring
  conv_lhs => rw [this, add_pow, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul, neg_pow]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.zj_le_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem zj_le_nonZeroDivisors {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) :
    Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ) ≤ nonZeroDivisors ℤ
proof:
:=
  powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors (by exact_mod_cast hj)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.zj_isDomain
statement: theorem zj_isDomain {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) : IsDomain (Zj j)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors (M := Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ)) (Zj j)
    (zj_le_nonZeroDivisors hj)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.zj_charZero
statement: theorem zj_charZero {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) : CharZero (Zj j)
proof:
:=
  charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (IsLocalization.injective (Zj j) (zj_le_nonZeroDivisors hj))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.isUnit_intCast_of_isUnit_natCast
statement:
theorem isUnit_intCast_of_isUnit_natCast {B : Type*} [CommRing B] {j : ℕ}
    (h : IsUnit (j : B)) : IsUnit ((Int.castRingHom B) (j : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.zjLift_intCast
statement:
theorem zjLift_intCast {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (j : ℕ) (h : IsUnit (j : B)) (z : ℤ) :
    zjLift j h (z : Zj j) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_intCast (algebraMap ℤ (Zj j)), zjLift, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.zjLift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem zjLift_algebraMap {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (j : ℕ) (h : IsUnit (j : B)) (t : ℤ) :
    zjLift j h (algebraMap ℤ (Zj j) t) = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [zjLift, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]; rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.map_zjLift_mul
statement:
theorem map_zjLift_mul {B C : Type*} [CommRing B] [CommRing C] (j : ℕ) (hB : IsUnit (j : B))
    (hC : IsUnit (j : C)) (F : B →+ C) (c : Zj j) (y : B) :
    F (zjLift j hB c * y) = zjLift j hC c * F y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨z, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers (j : ℤ)) c
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
  simp only at hs
  have eB := congrArg (zjLift j hB) hs
  have eC := congrArg (zjLift j hC) hs
  rw [map_mul, zjLift_algebraMap, zjLift_algebraMap, ← hk] at eB eC
  push_cast at eB eC
  have hF : ∀ (v : B) (N : ℕ), F (v * (N : B)) = F v * (N : C) := by
    intro v N; rw [← nsmul_eq_mul', map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul']
  have hFz : ∀ (v : B) (t : ℤ), F ((t : B) * v) = (t : C) * F v := by
    intro v t; rw [← zsmul_eq_mul, map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  apply (hC.pow k).mul_left_injective
  change F (zjLift j hB c * y) * (j : C) ^ k = zjLift j hC c * F y * (j : C) ^ k
  have h1 : F (zjLift j hB c * y) * (j : C) ^ k =
      F (zjLift j hB c * y * ((j ^ k : ℕ) : B)) := by
    rw [hF]; push_cast; ring
  rw [h1, show zjLift j hB c * y * ((j ^ k : ℕ) : B) = (z : B) * y by
    rw [← eB]; push_cast; ring, hFz, ← eC]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.chi_mul_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem chi_mul_one_sub_pow (pb : KY →+* KP) (χ : KP →+ KY) (w : KP) (n : ℕ)
    (hχ : ∀ a m, m ≤ n → χ (pb a * w ^ m) = if m = 0 then a else 0) (a : KY) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ n) : χ (pb a * (1 - w) ^ k) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_pow_eq_sum, map_sum]
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel, map_zsmul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · rw [hχ a 0 (Nat.zero_le _), if_pos rfl]; simp
  · intro m hm hm0
    rw [hχ a m (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hm; omega), if_neg hm0, smul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos k)) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.AdamsProjection.adams_projection_abstract
statement:
theorem adams_projection_abstract (pb : KY →+* KP) (χ : KP →+ KY) (w : KP) (n j : ℕ)
    (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjP : IsUnit (j : BP)) (hjY : IsUnit (j : BY))
    (hrel : (1 - w) ^ (n + 1) = 0)
    (hχ : ∀ a m, m ≤ n → χ (pb a * w ^ m) = if m = 0 then a else 0)
    (ψP : KP →+* KP) (ψY : KY →+* KY) (hψw : ψP w = w ^ j)
    (hψpb : ∀ a, ψP (pb a) = pb (ψY a))
    (θinv : BP) (hθ : θinv * algebraMap KP BP (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, w ^ a) ^ (n + 1) = j)
    (pushPi : BP →+ BY) (hpush : ∀ x, pushPi (algebraMap KP BP x) = algebraMap KY BY (χ x))
    (x : KP) (hx : ∃ g : Fin (n + 1) → KY, x = ∑ i, pb (g i) * w ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    algebraMap KY BY (ψY (χ x)) = pushPi (algebraMap KP BP (ψP x) * θinv)
proof:
:= by
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
  haveI := zj_isDomain hj0
  haveI := zj_charZero hj0
  let Lm : KP →+ BY :=
    (algebraMap KY BY).toAddMonoidHom.comp (ψY.toAddMonoidHom.comp χ)
  let Rm : KP →+ BY :=
    pushPi.comp ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight θinv).comp
      ((algebraMap KP BP).toAddMonoidHom.comp ψP.toAddMonoidHom))
  change Lm x = Rm x
  
  set W : BP := algebraMap KP BP w with hW
  set H : BP := 1 - W with hHdef
  have hH : H ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hHdef, hW, ← map_one (algebraMap KP BP), ← map_sub, ← map_pow, hrel, map_zero]
  let φ : Zj j →+* BP := zjLift j hjP
  let φY : Zj j →+* BY := zjLift j hjY
  let ev : (Zj j)⟦X⟧ →+* BP := evalTruncHom φ H (n + 1) hH (Nat.succ_pos n)
  have evX : ev X = H := evalTruncHom_X hH _
  set S := bottSeries (Zj j) j with hSdef
  have hSunit : IsUnit S := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, hSdef, constantCoeff_bottSeries]
    have := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := Zj j) (j : ℤ)
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hSunit
  set T : (Zj j)⟦X⟧ := ((U⁻¹ : ((Zj j)⟦X⟧)ˣ) : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) with hTdef
  have hST : S * T = 1 := by rw [← hU, hTdef, Units.mul_inv]
  set s : BP := algebraMap KP BP (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, w ^ a) with hs
  have evS : ev S = s := by
    rw [hSdef, bottSeries, map_sum, hs, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_pow, map_pow, map_sub, map_one, evX, hHdef, hW]; ring
  have evTS : ev T * s = 1 := by rw [← evS, ← map_mul, mul_comm, hST, map_one]
  have hθev : θinv = ev ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (n + 1)) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_natCast, map_pow]
    calc θinv = θinv * (ev T * s) ^ (n + 1) := by rw [evTS, one_pow, mul_one]
      _ = (θinv * s ^ (n + 1)) * ev T ^ (n + 1) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hθ]
  have hgeom : algebraMap KP BP (1 - w ^ j) = H * s := by
    rw [map_sub, map_one, map_pow, hHdef, hs, map_sum]
    simp only [map_pow]
    rw [← hW, mul_neg_geom_sum]
  
  have hpushH : ∀ (b : KY) (l : ℕ), l ≤ n →
      pushPi (algebraMap KP BP (pb b) * H ^ l) = algebraMap KY BY b := by
    intro b l hl
    rw [hHdef, hW, ← map_one (algebraMap KP BP), ← map_sub, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, hpush,
      chi_mul_one_sub_pow pb χ w n hχ b l hl]
  have hpushEv : ∀ (b : KY) (F : (Zj j)⟦X⟧),
      pushPi (algebraMap KP BP (pb b) * ev F) =
        φY (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), coeff l F) * algebraMap KY BY b := by
    intro b F
    change pushPi (algebraMap KP BP (pb b) * evalTrunc φ H (n + 1) F) = _
    rw [evalTrunc, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l hl ↦ ?_
    rw [show algebraMap KP BP (pb b) * (φ (coeff l F) * H ^ l) =
        φ (coeff l F) * (algebraMap KP BP (pb b) * H ^ l) by ring]
    rw [map_zjLift_mul j hjP hjY pushPi, hpushH b l (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl))]
  
  have step1 : ∀ (a : KY) (k : ℕ), k ≤ n → Lm (pb a * (1 - w) ^ k) = Rm (pb a * (1 - w) ^ k) := by
    intro a k hk
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = k + m := ⟨n - k, by omega⟩
    change algebraMap KY BY (ψY (χ (pb a * (1 - w) ^ k))) =
      pushPi (algebraMap KP BP (ψP (pb a * (1 - w) ^ k)) * θinv)
    rw [chi_mul_one_sub_pow pb χ w _ hχ a k hk]
    rw [map_mul ψP, map_pow ψP, map_sub ψP, map_one ψP, hψw, hψpb, map_mul (algebraMap KP BP),
      map_pow (algebraMap KP BP), hgeom, hθev]
    have hser : algebraMap KP BP (pb (ψY a)) * (H * s) ^ k *
        ev ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (k + m + 1)) =
        algebraMap KP BP (pb (ψY a)) * ev (X ^ k * ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1))) := by
      have hSTk : (S * T) ^ k = 1 := by rw [hST, one_pow]
      have : X ^ k * ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1)) =
          X ^ k * S ^ k * ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (k + m + 1)) := by
        rw [show k + m + 1 = k + (m + 1) by omega, pow_add]
        linear_combination (-(X ^ k * (j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1))) * hSTk
      rw [this]
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, evX, evS]
      ring_nf
    rw [hser, hpushEv]
    rw [show k + m + 1 = k + (m + 1) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add]
    have hlow : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range k, coeff l (X ^ k * ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1))) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l hl ↦ by
        rw [coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hl; omega)]
    have hhigh : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        coeff (k + l) (X ^ k * ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1))) =
        ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), coeff l ((j : (Zj j)⟦X⟧) * T ^ (m + 1)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ ↦ by
        rw [coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [hlow, hhigh, zero_add, sum_coeff_natCast_mul_pow j hj T hST m, map_one, one_mul]
  
  have step2 : ∀ (a : KY) (i : ℕ), i ≤ n → Lm (pb a * w ^ i) = Rm (pb a * w ^ i) := by
    intro a i hi
    rw [mul_pow_eq_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
    rw [map_zsmul, map_zsmul, step1 a k (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk; omega)]
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [map_sum, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ step2 (g i) i (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow (m : ℕ) :
    projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ m = projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveK0Pushforward_pb_mul_pow
statement:
theorem projectiveK0Pushforward_pb_mul_pow
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hres : ∀ a, res (k0ToG0 _ a) = a) (a : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ n) :
    projectiveK0Pushforward R n hn res
        (EulerIndependence.pb R n a * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ m) =
      if m = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hE : ∀ x, projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 (space R n) x) =
      EulerIndependence.euler R n (projectiveHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem R n hn) x :=
    fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hL := EulerIndependence.projectiveSystem_isAffineLocal R n hn
  simp only [projectiveK0Pushforward, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hE]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0
  · rw [pow_zero, mul_one, if_pos rfl, EulerIndependence.euler_pb R n hn _ hL a, hres]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow, mul_comm,
      EulerIndependence.euler_twist_pb_eq_zero R n hn _ hL (-(m : ℤ)) (by omega) (by omega) a,
      map_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_projectiveSpace
    (res : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+ K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hres : ∀ a, res (k0ToG0 _ a) = a)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ψP : K0 (space R n) →+* K0 (space R n))
    (ψY : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) →+* K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (hψ_line : ψP (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)) = projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ j)
    (hψ_pb : ∀ a, ψP (EulerIndependence.pb R n a) = EulerIndependence.pb R n (ψY a))
    (bott : Multiplicative (K0 (space R n)) →* (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ)
    (hbott_one : ((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) : (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) :
        adamsKLoc j (space R n)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, (1 : K0 (space R n)) ^ a))
    (hbott_line : ((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1))) :
        (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ a))
    (hrel : (1 - projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)) ^ (n + 1) = 0)
    (hspan : ∀ y : K0 (space R n), ∃ g : Fin (n + 1) → K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)),
      y = ∑ i, EulerIndependence.pb R n (g i) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ (i : ℕ))
    (pushPi : adamsKLoc j (space R n) →+ adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (pushPi_alg : ∀ a, pushPi (algebraMap _ _ a) =
      algebraMap _ _ (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ a))))
    (y : K0 (space R n)) :
    algebraMap _ (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (ψY (res (projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn (k0ToG0 _ y)))) =
      pushPi (algebraMap _ _ (ψP y) *
        (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
          (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)))
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, IsUnit ((j : adamsKLoc j Z)) := fun Z ↦ by
    have := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := adamsKLoc j Z) ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z)
    simpa using this
  have hcot : Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n) =
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1))) ^ (n + 1) /
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : K0 (space R n)) := by
    rw [adamsCotangentClass, ofAdd_sub, ofAdd_nsmul]
  have hθ : (((bott (Multiplicative.ofAdd (adamsCotangentClass R n)))⁻¹ :
      (adamsKLoc j (space R n))ˣ) : adamsKLoc j (space R n)) *
      algebraMap (K0 (space R n)) (adamsKLoc j (space R n))
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) ^ a) ^ (n + 1) = j := by
    rw [← hbott_line, hcot, map_div, map_pow, inv_div, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
      ← Units.val_mul, div_mul_cancel, hbott_one]
    simp
  have hpush : ∀ x, pushPi (algebraMap (K0 (space R n)) (adamsKLoc j (space R n)) x) =
      algebraMap (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
        (projectiveK0Pushforward R n hn res x) := fun x ↦ pushPi_alg x
  exact AdamsProjection.adams_projection_abstract (KP := K0 (space R n))
    (KY := K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (BP := adamsKLoc j (space R n))
    (BY := adamsKLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (EulerIndependence.pb R n)
    (projectiveK0Pushforward R n hn res) (projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)) n j (by omega)
    (hunit _) (hunit _)
    
    (by rw [sub_eq_add_neg] at hrel; exact hrel)
    (projectiveK0Pushforward_pb_mul_pow R n hn res hres) ψP ψY
    hψ_line hψ_pb _ hθ pushPi hpush y (hspan y)

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.isIso_adjUnit_eta
statement:
theorem isIso_adjUnit_eta (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)) (K : W.Modules)
    (hK : Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W) K) :
    IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι) K)
proof:
:= by
  letI : K.IsFinitePresentation := hK.1
  have hk := c.killed (finitePush_obj F) K hK
  have hkill : IdealKills I ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj K) :=
    hB.idealKills_of_killed _ hk.1 hk.2
  exact KSpecialization.ARRHU.isIso_adjUnit_fst F I K (fun V a ha m => hkill V a ha m)

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.pullback_eta_shortExact
statement:
theorem pullback_eta_shortExact (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)) (S : ShortComplex W.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W) S.X₁)
    (h₂ : Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W) S.X₂) :
    (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hS.mono_f
  haveI := hS.epi_g
  have ex : (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI)).Exact :=
    hS.exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel _ inferInstance inferInstance
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_eta F hB c S.X₁ h₁
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_eta F hB c S.X₂ h₂
  have hn := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_naturality ηI S.f
  have heq : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηI).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI).map S.f) =
      inv (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ηI S.X₁) ≫ S.f ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ηI S.X₂ := by
    rw [hn, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hm : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηI).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI).map S.f)) := by
    rw [heq]; infer_instance
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηI).Faithful :=
    (pushforwardFullyFaithful ηI).faithful
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI).map S.f) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηI).mono_of_mono_map hm
  exact { exact := ex, mono_f := this,
          epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI).map S.g)) }

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.etaPull_classOf
statement:
theorem etaPull_classOf (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)) (K : W.Modules)
    (hK : Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W) K) :
    etaPull F hB c (subcategoryClassOf _ _ K hK) =
      g0ClassOf _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI).obj K) (etaPullObject F ⟨K, hK⟩).2
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ _

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.pushEta_comp_etaPull
statement:
theorem pushEta_comp_etaPull (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
    (finitePushforward ηI).comp (etaPull F hB c) =
      pushDivisor (T := TW) (σ := σW) (P := IsCoherentLike W) := by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun K => ?_
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := K
  change finitePushforward ηI (etaPull F hB c (subcategoryClassOf _ _ K hK)) =
    pushDivisor (subcategoryClassOf _ _ K hK)
  rw [etaPull_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf, pushDivisor_classOf]
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_eta F hB c K hK
  exact (g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ηI K))).symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.pushEta_comp_gysinBC
statement:
theorem pushEta_comp_gysinBC (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))
    (hcW : Central TW σW) (hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W (TW.obj E)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
    (finitePushforward ηI).comp (gysinBC F hB c hcW hTW) =
      (pushDivisor (T := TW) (σ := σW)).comp
        (cartierGysin hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW) := by
  rw [gysinBC, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, pushEta_comp_etaPull]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.killedMap_compat
statement:
theorem killedMap_compat (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
    (g0KilledIEquiv hI).toAddMonoidHom.comp ((killedTransport hB).comp
        (killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F))) =
      (finitePushforward FzI).comp (etaPull F hB c) := by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun K => ?_
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := K
  change g0KilledIEquiv hI (killedTransport hB (killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
      (subcategoryClassOf _ _ K hK))) =
    finitePushforward FzI (etaPull F hB c (subcategoryClassOf _ _ K hK))
  have m1 : killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
      (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W)) K hK) =
      subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (Killed T σ (IsCoherentLike M))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj K) (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK) :=
    mapOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _
  rw [m1, killedTransport_classOf, etaPull_classOf]
  set G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηI).obj K
  have hG : IsCoherentLike _ G := (etaPullObject F ⟨K, hK⟩).2
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_eta F hB c K hK
  have h1 : subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (KilledI I) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj K)
      ⟨(c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).1, hB.idealKills_of_killed _
        (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).1 (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).2⟩ =
      KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I) (finitePushforward FzI (g0ClassOf _ G hG)) := by
    rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
    change _ = KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _
      ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward FzI).obj G, (finitePushObject FzI ⟨G, hG⟩).2⟩)
    rw [KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_classOf]
    refine ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ KSpecialization.AR4.killedI_zero
      (isZero_zero _) ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).mapIso (asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ηI K)) ≪≫ ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp ηI F).app G ≪≫ ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr pullback.condition).app G ≪≫ ?_
    exact ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp FzI I.subschemeι).app G).symm
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f : G0 I.subscheme →+ G0 I.subscheme =>
    f (finitePushforward FzI (g0ClassOf _ G hG))) (KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre_comp_pushZero hI)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h2
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.gysinI_comp_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem gysinI_comp_finitePushforward (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (hc : Central T σ) (hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike M E → IsCoherentLike M (T.obj E))
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))
    (hcW : Central TW σW) (hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W (TW.obj E)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
    (gysinI hI hB hc hT).comp (finitePushforward F) =
      (finitePushforward FzI).comp (gysinBC F hB c hcW hTW) := by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := I) F
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
  have hcomm := cartierGysin_comp_finitePushforward F c hcW hTW hc hT
    (fun E _ => KSpecialization.AR7R.isIso_kernelComparison_pushforward F _)
    (fun E hE => KSpecialization.AR7R.isIso_cokernelComparison_pushforward F _ (hTW E hE) hE)
  rw [mapOn_pushforward_eq_finitePushforward] at hcomm
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun g => ?_
  have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm g
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (killedMap_compat F hI hB c)
    (cartierGysin hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW g)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  simp only [gysinI, gysinBC, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [h1]
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.rigid_of_section
statement:
theorem rigid_of_section {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (π : G →+ H)
    (s₀ s₁ : H →+ G) (r₀ r₁ : G →+ H) (τ : G →+ G)
    (hπs₀ : π.comp s₀ = AddMonoidHom.id H) (hπs₁ : π.comp s₁ = AddMonoidHom.id H)
    (hr₀ : s₀.comp r₀ = AddMonoidHom.id G - τ) (hr₁ : s₁.comp r₁ = AddMonoidHom.id G - τ) :
    r₀ = r₁
proof:
:= by
  have e₀ : r₀ = π.comp (s₀.comp r₀) := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hπs₀, AddMonoidHom.id_comp]
  have e₁ : r₁ = π.comp (s₁.comp r₁) := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, hπs₁, AddMonoidHom.id_comp]
  rw [e₀, e₁, hr₀, hr₁]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.gysinLine_k0ToG0

    gysinLine σ hL (k0ToG0 M z) =
      k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι z)
proof:

  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
  exact gysinI_k0ToG0 _ _ _ _ (fun E hE => CIIL3B.hmono_of_sectionIsRegular σ

theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) :

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.gysinLine_comp_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem gysinLine_comp_finitePushforward (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
      CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
    (gysinLine σ hL).comp (finitePushforward F) =
      (finitePushforward (pullback.snd F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).comp
        (gysinBCLine σ F hL) := by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL)
  exact gysinI_comp_finitePushforward F _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.twistG_eq_k0ActG0
statement:
theorem twistG_eq_k0ActG0 (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1)
    [(tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L))).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits
      (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L)))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits
      (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L)))]
    [(tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L))).PreservesMonomorphisms]
    (hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L))).obj E)) :
    G2GC2.twistG hT = k0ActG0 W (pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L)
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)))
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := E
  change G2GC2.twistG hT (subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE) = _
  rw [G2GC2.twistG_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf]
  change _ = k0ActG0 W (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨_, _⟩) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨E, hE⟩)
  rw [k0ActG0_classOf, g0LeftMul_classOf]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.pushEta_comp_gysinBCLine
statement:
theorem pushEta_comp_gysinBCLine (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
    (finitePushforward (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).comp
        (gysinBCLine σ F hL) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (G0 W) - k0ActG0 W (pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL))) := by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL)
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL)
  have hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L))).obj E) :=
    fun E hE => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL) hE
  rw [← twistG_eq_k0ActG0 F hL hTW, ← G2GC2.pushDivisor_comp_cartierGysin]
  exact pushEta_comp_gysinBC F _ _ _ hTW

:= by

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.fst_pr_secOf
statement:
theorem fst_pr_secOf :
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ pr) ≫ secOf σ F pr =
      pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.secOf_comp_rLine
statement:
theorem secOf_comp_rLine (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) :
    (finitePushforward (secOf σ F pr)).comp (rLine σ F pr hL) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (G0 W) - k0ActG0 W (pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
  rw [rLine, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, ← ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_congr (fst_pr_secOf σ F pr)]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.gysinBCLine_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem gysinBCLine_k0ToG0 (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1)
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) (w : K0 W) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
    gysinBCLine σ F hL (k0ToG0 W w) = k0ToG0 _
      (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) w) := by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
  have key : (gysinBCLine σ F hL).comp (k0ToG0 W) = (k0ToG0 _).comp
      (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)) := by
    refine hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := V
    change gysinBCLine σ F hL (k0ToG0 W (k0ClassOf W V hV)) =
      k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 _ (k0ClassOf W V hV))
    haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
    haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits M _ (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL)
    haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL)
    haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackDual F hL)
    haveI : Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj
        (lineBundleDual M L))) (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V) :=
      CIIL3B.mono_sigmaT_app (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)) V hV
    haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_pullback_fst_cokernel_π σ F hL V
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
    simp only [gysinBCLine, gysinBC, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    unfold g0ClassOf
    rw [cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono, etaPull_classOf]
    exact g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).map (cokernel.π _))).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key w

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.rLine_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem rLine_k0ToG0 (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1)
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) (w : K0 W) :
    rLine σ F pr hL (k0ToG0 W w) = k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0 (secOf σ F pr) w)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
  rw [rLine, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, gysinBCLine_k0ToG0 σ F hL hs]
  have h1 : pullbackK0 (secOf σ F pr) w =
      pullbackK0 (inv (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ pr))
        (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) w) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply]; rfl
  rw [h1, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0 (inv (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ pr))]
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv
    (asIso (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ pr)).symm) _).symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.gysD_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem gysD_k0ToG0 (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ) (m : K0 M) :
    gysD σ ε hker hL (k0ToG0 M m) = k0ToG0 D (pullbackK0 ε m)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
  rw [gysD, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, gysinLine_k0ToG0 σ hL hreg]
  have hε : pullbackK0 ε m = pullbackK0 (kappa σ ε hker)
      (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι m) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply, kappa_fac]
  rw [hε, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0 (kappa σ ε hker)]
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
    (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (kappa σ ε hker))) _).symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.gysD_comp_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem gysD_comp_finitePushforward (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) (sD : Z ⟶ D) [IsFinite sD]
    (hzs : sD ≫ ε = secOf σ F pr ≫ F) :
    (gysD σ ε hker hL).comp (finitePushforward F) =
      (finitePushforward sD).comp (rLine σ F pr hL)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_fibre (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) F
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
  rw [gysD, rLine, AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, gysinLine_comp_finitePushforward,
    ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc, ← ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp,
    ← ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  congr 2
  rw [← cancel_mono ε, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hzs]
  have h1 : inv (kappa σ ε hker) ≫ ε = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι := by
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, kappa_fac]
  rw [h1, ← Category.assoc, fst_pr_secOf]
  exact pullback.condition.symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.isClosedImmersion_of_section
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_of_section (s : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)
    (hs : s ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 J.subscheme) : IsClosedImmersion s
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (s ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) := by rw [hs]; infer_instance
  exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp s (totalToClosedBase Y J)

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.inv_fst_pr_eq_of_ker_eq
statement:
theorem inv_fst_pr_eq_of_ker_eq (hker : ι.ker = ε.ker) [IsIso (pullback.fst F ε ≫ pr)]
    [IsIso (pullback.fst F ι ≫ pr)] :
    inv (pullback.fst F ι ≫ pr) ≫ pullback.fst F ι = inv (pullback.fst F ε ≫ pr) ≫ pullback.fst F ε
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : A ⟶ B := IsClosedImmersion.lift ε ι hker.symm.le
  have hψ : ψ ≫ ε = ι := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsIso ψ := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_of_ker_eq ι ε ψ hψ hker
  let k : pullback F ι ⟶ pullback F ε :=
    pullback.map F ι F ε (𝟙 W) ψ (𝟙 M) (by simp) (by rw [hψ]; simp)
  haveI : IsIso k := by
    dsimp only [k]
    infer_instance
  have hk : k ≫ pullback.fst F ε = pullback.fst F ι :=
    (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)
  rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq]
  conv_rhs => rw [← hk]
  rw [Category.assoc k, Category.assoc k, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, hk]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.lineTι_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem lineTι_toBase :
    GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥
proof:
:=
  pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.sec0_pr
statement: theorem sec0_pr : sec0 Y J k φ ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase, subS_polynomialToClosedBase]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.sec0_F
statement: theorem sec0_F : sec0 Y J k φ ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J = J.subschemeι ≫ eps0 Y J k φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι, ← Category.assoc, subS_subschemeToLine,
    Category.assoc]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.isIso_fst_pr_zero
statement:
theorem isIso_fst_pr_zero :
    IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ) ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : lineS Y k φ ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ = 𝟙 Y := lineS_lineπ Y k φ
  refine ⟨⟨fibre0Lift Y J k φ, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · apply pullback.hom_ext
    · 
      have hsq := (isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J)
      let h' : pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ) ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J := hsq.lift (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ))
        (pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ) ≫ lineS Y k φ) (by
          rw [pullback.condition, Category.assoc])
      have h1 : h' ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J = pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ) := hsq.lift_fst _ _ _
      have h2 : h' ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J = pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ) ≫ lineS Y k φ :=
        hsq.lift_snd _ _ _
      have hsl := isPullback_subschemeLine Y J
      have key : h' ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J ≫ subS Y J k φ = h' := by
        apply hsl.hom_ext
        · simp only [Category.assoc, subS_subschemeToLine]
          rw [← reassoc_of% hsl.w, reassoc_of% h2, reassoc_of% hS, h2]
        · simp only [Category.assoc, subS_polynomialToClosedBase, Category.comp_id]
      simp only [Category.assoc, fibre0Lift, pullback.lift_fst, Category.id_comp]
      rw [← h1]
      simp only [sec0, Category.assoc, subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase_assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc (polynomialToClosedBase Y J), ← Category.assoc h', ← Category.assoc h',
        Category.assoc h', key]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, fibre0Lift, pullback.lift_snd, Category.id_comp]
      rw [totalToClosedBase_subschemeι, pullback.condition_assoc]
      simp only [eps0, Category.assoc, lineTι_toBase]
      rw [hS, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [fibre0Lift, ← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
    exact sec0_pr Y J k φ

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.fibre0Lift_inv
statement:
theorem fibre0Lift_inv :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIso_fst_pr_zero Y J k φ
    inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (eps0 Y J k φ) ≫
    totalToClosedBase Y J) = fibre0Lift Y J k φ := by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_zero Y J k φ
  refine IsIso.inv_eq_of_inv_hom_id ?_
  rw [fibre0Lift, ← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
  exact sec0_pr Y J k φ

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero
statement:
theorem isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero {L : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L)
    [IsClosedImmersion (eps0 Y J k φ)]
    (hker : (eps0 Y J k φ).ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.ker) :
    IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_zero Y J k φ
  exact CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq _ _ _ (eps0 Y J k φ) hker.symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.secOf_zero
statement:
theorem secOf_zero {L : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L)
    [IsClosedImmersion (eps0 Y J k φ)]
    (hker : (eps0 Y J k φ).ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.ker) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero Y J k φ σ hker
    secOf σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) = sec0 Y J k φ := by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero Y J k φ σ hker
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_zero Y J k φ
  rw [secOf, inv_fst_pr_eq_of_ker_eq _ _ _ (eps0 Y J k φ) hker.symm, fibre0Lift_inv, fibre0Lift,
    pullback.lift_fst]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf
statement:
theorem isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf {L : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L)
    (hker : (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J).ker =
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.ker) :
    IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase Y J
  exact CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq _ _ _ _ hker.symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.secOf_inf
statement:
theorem secOf_inf {L : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L)
    (hker : (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J).ker =
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.ker) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf Y J σ hker
    secOf σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) = ARRRIG.secInfG Y J := by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf Y J σ hker
  rw [secOf]
  exact KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf Y J _ hker.symm

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.rLine_rigid
statement:
theorem rLine_rigid {L₀ L₁ : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] [L₁.IsQuasicoherent] [L₁.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ₀ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₀) (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₁)
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank _ L₀ 1) (hL₁ : HasConstantRank _ L₁ 1)
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)]
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁).subschemeι ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)]
    (htw : pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ClassOf _ (lineBundleDual _ L₀)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₀)) =
      pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ClassOf _ (lineBundleDual _ L₁)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₁))) :
    rLine σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₀ =
      rLine σ₁ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₁
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (G2GC2.deformationFrame Y J).isNoetherian_scheme
  refine rigid_of_section (G2GC2.piW Y J)
    (finitePushforward (secOf σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)))
    (finitePushforward (secOf σ₁ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J))) _ _ _
    (G2GC2.piW_comp_section Y J _ (secOf_pr _ _ _))
    (G2GC2.piW_comp_section Y J _ (secOf_pr _ _ _))
    (secOf_comp_rLine σ₀ _ _ hL₀) ?_
  rw [secOf_comp_rLine σ₁ _ _ hL₁, htw]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.htw_of_iso
statement:
theorem htw_of_iso {W M : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian M] (F : W ⟶ M) {L₀ L₁ : M.Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] [L₁.IsQuasicoherent] [L₁.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank M L₀ 1) (hL₁ : HasConstantRank M L₁ 1)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L₀) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L₁)) :
    pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L₀) (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₀)) =
      pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M L₁) (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₁))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ e

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.mixedGysin_gates
statement:
theorem mixedGysin_gates {L₀ LP : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] [LP.IsQuasicoherent] [LP.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ₀ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₀) (σP : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ LP)
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank _ L₀ 1) (hLP : HasConstantRank _ LP 1)
    (hreg₀ : SectionIsRegular σ₀) (hregP : SectionIsRegular σP)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion (eps0 Y J k φ)]
    (hker₀ : (eps0 Y J k φ).ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subschemeι.ker)
    (hkerP : (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J).ker =
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σP).subschemeι.ker)
    {E : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian E] (εE : E ⟶ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J)
    [IsClosedImmersion εE] (hkerE : εE.ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σP).subschemeι.ker)
    (sE : J.subscheme ⟶ E) [IsFinite sE]
    (hzs : sE ≫ εE = ARRRIG.secInfG Y J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero Y J k φ σ₀ hker₀
    haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf Y J σP hkerP
    (∀ m, gysD σ₀ (eps0 Y J k φ) hker₀ hL₀ (k0ToG0 _ m) = k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (eps0 Y J k φ) m)) ∧
    (∀ m, gysD σP εE hkerE hLP (k0ToG0 _ m) = k0ToG0 E (pullbackK0 εE m)) ∧
    (∀ v, gysD σ₀ (eps0 Y J k φ) hker₀ hL₀ (finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) v) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι
        (rLine σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₀ v)) ∧
    (∀ v, gysD σP εE hkerE hLP (finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) v) =
      finitePushforward sE (rLine σP (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hLP v)) ∧
    (pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ClassOf _ (lineBundleDual _ L₀)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hL₀)) =
      pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ClassOf _ (lineBundleDual _ LP)
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_dual hLP)) →
      ∀ v, rLine σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₀ v =
        rLine σP (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hLP v) := by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero Y J k φ σ₀ hker₀
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf Y J σP hkerP
  refine ⟨gysD_k0ToG0 σ₀ _ hker₀ hL₀ hreg₀, gysD_k0ToG0 σP εE hkerE hLP hregP, fun v => ?_,
    fun v => ?_, fun htw v => ?_⟩
  · have h := gysD_comp_finitePushforward σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
      (eps0 Y J k φ) hker₀ hL₀ J.subschemeι (by rw [secOf_zero Y J k φ σ₀ hker₀, sec0_F])
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h v
  · have h := gysD_comp_finitePushforward σP (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
      εE hkerE hLP sE (by rw [secOf_inf Y J σP hkerP, hzs])
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h v
  · exact DFunLike.congr_fun (rLine_rigid Y J σ₀ σP hL₀ hLP htw) v

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.hmix_zero
statement:
theorem hmix_zero {L₀ : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [L₀.IsQuasicoherent] [L₀.IsFinitePresentation] (σ₀ : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ L₀)
    (hL₀ : HasConstantRank _ L₀ 1) (hreg₀ : SectionIsRegular σ₀)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion (eps0 Y J k φ)]
    (hker₀ : (eps0 Y J k φ).ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₀).subschemeι.ker)
    (hs₀ : Mono (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (dualEval σ₀)))
    (w : K0 (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) (m : K0 (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J))
    (hm : k0ToG0 _ m = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ToG0 _ w)) :
    k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (eps0 Y J k φ) m) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι (k0ToG0 J.subscheme (pullbackK0 (sec0 Y J k φ) w))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_zero Y J k φ σ₀ hker₀
  rw [← gysD_k0ToG0 σ₀ (eps0 Y J k φ) hker₀ hL₀ hreg₀, hm]
  have h := gysD_comp_finitePushforward σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
    (eps0 Y J k φ) hker₀ hL₀ J.subschemeι (by rw [secOf_zero Y J k φ σ₀ hker₀, sec0_F])
  rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, h, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    rLine_k0ToG0 σ₀ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL₀ hs₀,
    secOf_zero Y J k φ σ₀ hker₀]

name: KSpecialization.G2GC1.hmix_inf
statement:
theorem hmix_inf {LP : (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J).Modules}
    [LP.IsQuasicoherent] [LP.IsFinitePresentation] (σP : tensorUnitSheaf _ ⟶ LP)
    (hLP : HasConstantRank _ LP 1) (hregP : SectionIsRegular σP)
    (hkerP : (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J).ker =
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σP).subschemeι.ker)
    (hsP : Mono (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (dualEval σP)))
    {E : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian E] (εE : E ⟶ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J)
    [IsClosedImmersion εE] (hkerE : εE.ker = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σP).subschemeι.ker)
    (sE : J.subscheme ⟶ E) [IsFinite sE]
    (hzs : sE ≫ εE = ARRRIG.secInfG Y J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
    (w : K0 (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) (m : K0 (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J))
    (hm : k0ToG0 _ m = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (k0ToG0 _ w)) :
    k0ToG0 E (pullbackK0 εE m) =
      finitePushforward sE (k0ToG0 J.subscheme (pullbackK0 (ARRRIG.secInfG Y J) w))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_fst_pr_of_ker_inf Y J σP hkerP
  rw [← gysD_k0ToG0 σP εE hkerE hLP hregP, hm]
  have h := gysD_comp_finitePushforward σP (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
    εE hkerE hLP sE (by rw [secOf_inf Y J σP hkerP, hzs])
  rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, h, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    rLine_k0ToG0 σP (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hLP hsP,
    secOf_inf Y J σP hkerP]

name: OpenCoverGluingF9.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_restrict
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}} (C : X.OpenCover.{u})
    (M : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree (C.X i) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj M)) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X M
proof:
:= by
  choose q hq hqfin using fun i => (h i).exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : ∀ i, (q i).IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : ∀ i, (q i).IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let E := Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.bind C (fun i => localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i))
  let I : E.I₀ → Type u := fun p => ((q p.1).generators p.2).I
  letI : ∀ p, Finite (I p) := fun p => by
    letI : ((q p.1).generators p.2).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType p.2
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_freeTrivializations E M I fun p => ?_
  exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
      ((localGeneratorsOpenCover (q p.1)).f p.2) (C.f p.1)).app M ≪≫
    localGeneratorsOpenCoverIso (q p.1) p.2

name: OpenCoverGluingF9.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso_restrict
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso_restrict {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : Y ≅ Z) (N : Z.Modules)
    (h : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).obj N)) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree Z N
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global e.inv _ h
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Z ?_ h1
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback e.inv).app _).symm ≪≫ (restrictInvHomIso e).app N

name: OpenCoverGluingF9.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_spec_projective
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_spec_projective {X : Scheme.{u}} (C : X.OpenCover.{u})
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (R : C.I₀ → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (R i)]
    (e : ∀ i, Spec (CommRingCat.of (R i)) ≅ C.X i)
    (hfin : ∀ i, Module.Finite (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj M))))
    (hproj : ∀ i, Module.Projective (R i) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (R i))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj M)))) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X M
proof:
:= by
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_restrict C M fun i => ?_
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso_restrict (e i) _ ?_
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (e i).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj M)).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := hfin i
  haveI := hproj i
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_globalSections_projective _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestriction_map_smul
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestriction_map_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (c : R) (x : Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :
    (localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestriction R g n p M a).hom (c • x) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) c •
        (localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestriction R g n p M a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let m := map (algebraMap R S) n
  let UR := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let US := coordinateCechIntersection S n p a
  change
    (M.restrictAppIso m US).inv
      (M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE
          (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
            R g n p a)).op
        (structureRingHom
          (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c • x)) =
      structureRingHom
          (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) US
          (algebraMap R S c) •
        (M.restrictAppIso m US).inv
          (M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
                R g n p a)).op x)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  have hscalar :
      (space R n).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
              R g n p a)).op
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) UR c) =
        (m.appIso US).inv
          (structureRingHom
            (X := space S n) (R := CommRingCat.of S) US
              (algebraMap R S c)) := by
    simpa only [m] using
      (projectiveMap_structureRingHom_local
        (algebraMap R S) n UR US
        (localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le
          R g n p a) c)
  rw [hscalar]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModulePushforward_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModulePushforward_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (U.ι ≫ toSpec R n)).obj M
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
        N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  letI : IsAffine U.toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a
  letI : IsAffineHom f := isAffineHom_of_isAffine f
  letI : M.IsQuasicoherent := by
    dsimp only [M]
    infer_instance
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom f M
  exact
    (Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_iff_isLocalizedModule_mapₗ N).mp
      (inferInstance : N.IsQuasicoherent) g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n p : ℕ)
    (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
    let hpre :
        f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) =
          (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) :=
      Scheme.Hom.preimage_top f
    let himageTop :
        U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) = U :=
      U.ι_image_top
    ∀ x : Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)),
      coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n p F a x =
        F.presheaf.map (eqToHom himageTop.symm).op
          ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom
            (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpre.symm).op x)) := by
  dsimp only
  intro x
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let hpre :
      f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) =
        (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) :=
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_top f
  let himageTop :
      U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) = U :=
    U.ι_image_top
  let e0 : Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ
      (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) ≃+ Γ(M, ⊤) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg (fun W : U.toScheme.Opens => Γ(M, W)) hpre)
  let e1 := (F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  let e2 : Γ(F, U.ι ''ᵁ
      (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) ≃+ Γ(F, U) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg
        (fun W : (space R n).Opens => Γ(F, W)) himageTop)
  change e2 (e1 (e0 x)) = _
  have he0 :
      e0 x = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpre.symm).op x :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
      M.presheaf hpre x
  rw [he0]
  have he2 (y : Γ(F, U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))) :
      e2 y = F.presheaf.map (eqToHom himageTop.symm).op y :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
      F.presheaf himageTop y
  rw [he2]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModulePushforwardRestriction_comm
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModulePushforwardRestriction_comm
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let U
proof:
:= coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
    let _ : Module R Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) :=
      Module.compHom _
        (structureRingHom
          (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    ∀ x : Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)),
      coordinateCechModulePushforwardBasicOpenLinearEquiv R g n p F a
          ((Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) x) =
        localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestrictionLinear R g n p F a
          (coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n p F a x) := by
  dsimp only
  intro x
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  let T := f ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let m := map (algebraMap R S) n
  let US := coordinateCechIntersection S n p a
  have himage : U.ι ''ᵁ T = m ''ᵁ US :=
    coordinateCechPreimage_image_eq_localizationImage R g n p a
  let hle :=
    localizationCoordinateCechIntersection_schemeImage_le R g n p a
  let hpre :
      f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) =
        (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) :=
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_top f
  let himageTop :
      U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) = U :=
    U.ι_image_top
  change
    (F.restrictAppIso m US).inv
      (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom himage.symm).op
        ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι T).hom
          ((Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) x))) =
      (F.restrictAppIso m US).inv
        (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
          (coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n p F a x))
  rw [coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv_apply R n p F a x]
  congr 1
  let y : Γ(M, (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) :=
    M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hpre.symm).op x
  have hn :
      (Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop) x =
        M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show T ≤ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) from le_top)).op
          y := by
    exact pushforward_presheaf_map_to_top
      f M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) x
  rw [hn]
  have hnat :
      (F.restrictAppIso U.ι T).hom
          (M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show T ≤ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) from le_top)).op y) =
        F.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.ι le_top)).op
          ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom y) := by
    have h := Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom
      (f := U.ι) F
      (homOfLE (show T ≤ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) from le_top)).op
    exact congrArg (fun k => k.hom y) h
  rw [hnat]
  exact presheaf_map_image_to_top U.ι F T (m ''ᵁ US) U
    himage himageTop hle ((F.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).hom y)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestriction_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestriction_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestrictionLinear R g n p F a)
proof:
:= by
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let f := U.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  letI : Module R Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) :=
    Module.compHom _
      (structureRingHom
        (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R) ⊤)
  letI : Module R Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) :=
    Module.compHom _
      (structureRingHom
        (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
  let res :=
    Scheme.Modules.mapₗ (R := CommRingCat.of R)
      N (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).leTop
  let eTop := coordinateCechModulePushforwardTopLinearEquiv R n p F a
  let eBasic := coordinateCechModulePushforwardBasicOpenLinearEquiv R g n p F a
  let component :=
    localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestrictionLinear R g n p F a
  have hres : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g) res := by
    simpa only [res, N, M, f, U] using
      coordinateCechModulePushforward_isLocalizedModule R g n p F a
  have hleft :
      IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
        (eBasic.toLinearMap ∘ₗ res) := by
    exact IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv
      (Submonoid.powers g) res eBasic
  have heq :
      eBasic.toLinearMap ∘ₗ res =
        component ∘ₗ eTop.toLinearMap := by
    ext x
    exact coordinateCechModulePushforwardRestriction_comm
      R g n p F a x
  rw [heq] at hleft
  exact
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_right
      (Submonoid.powers g) eTop.toLinearMap eTop.bijective).mp hleft
