name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear_apply
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n p : ℕ)
    (F : (space R n).Modules)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n F p) :
    localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear R g n p F x =
      (localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  apply (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv
    R g n p F).injective
  funext a
  simp only [localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
    (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj F
  change
    localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentRestrictionLinear R g n p F a
        (coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n F p x a) =
      coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv S n G p
        ((localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)).hom x) a
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  have hπ :=
    localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction_π
      R g n p ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F) a
  exact (congrArg (fun k => k.hom x) hπ).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestriction_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestriction_isLocalizedModule
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
      (localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear R g n p F)
proof:
:= by
  let eR := coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n F p
  let eS := localizationCoordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R g n p F
  let raw := localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentPiLinearMap R g n p F
  let term := localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear R g n p F
  letI : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g) raw :=
    localizationCoordinateCechModuleComponentPi_isLocalizedModule R g n p F
  have hcomp :
      IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g)
        (raw ∘ₗ eR.toLinearMap) :=
    IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right
      (Submonoid.powers g) raw eR
  have heq :
      eS.toLinearMap ∘ₗ term =
        raw ∘ₗ eR.toLinearMap := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change eS (eS.symm (raw (eR x))) = raw (eR x)
    exact eS.apply_symm_apply _
  rw [← heq] at hcomp
  exact
    (IsLocalizedModule.comp_iff_of_bijective_left
      (Submonoid.powers g) eS.toLinearMap eS.bijective).mp hcomp

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleLeftHomologyData_map_extendScalars_forget_homologyIso
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleLeftHomologyData_map_extendScalars_forget_homologyIso
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n q : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules) :
    let T
proof:
:= (coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F).sc q
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
    let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
      ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
        (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
          (Localization.Away g) g)
    letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
    let h₁ := T.homologyData.left.map (E ⋙ U)
    let h₂ := (T.homologyData.left.map E).map U
    let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
    let eH : h₁.H ≅ h₂.H := Iso.refl _
    h₁.homologyIso =
      ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫
        h₂.homologyIso ≪≫ eH.symm := by
  let T := (coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F).sc q
  let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars
    (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
        (Localization.Away g) g)
  letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
  let h₁ := T.homologyData.left.map (E ⋙ U)
  let h₂ := (T.homologyData.left.map E).map U
  let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
  let eK : h₁.K ≅ h₂.K := Iso.refl _
  let eH : h₁.H ≅ h₂.H := Iso.refl _
  change h₁.homologyIso =
    ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫ h₂.homologyIso ≪≫ eH.symm
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [← cancel_epi (T.map (E ⋙ U)).homologyπ]
  rw [h₁.homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  dsimp only [ShortComplex.homologyMapIso]
  rw [ShortComplex.homologyπ_naturality_assoc]
  rw [h₂.homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom_assoc]
  have hcycles :
      h₁.cyclesIso.hom =
        ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          h₂.cyclesIso.hom ≫ eK.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono h₁.i).1
    rw [h₁.cyclesIso_hom_comp_i]
    symm
    calc
      _ = ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          h₂.cyclesIso.hom ≫ (eK.inv ≫ h₁.i) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          h₂.cyclesIso.hom ≫ h₂.i := by
        rw [show eK.inv ≫ h₁.i = h₂.i from rfl]
      _ = ShortComplex.cyclesMap eComp.hom ≫
          ((T.map E).map U).iCycles := by
        rw [h₂.cyclesIso_hom_comp_i]
      _ = (T.map (E ⋙ U)).iCycles ≫ eComp.hom.τ₂ :=
        ShortComplex.cyclesMap_i eComp.hom
      _ = (T.map (E ⋙ U)).iCycles := by rfl
  rw [hcycles]
  have hπ : eK.inv ≫ h₁.π = h₂.π ≫ eH.inv := by
    rfl
  simp only [Category.assoc, hπ]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleMapHomologyIso_extendScalars_forget
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleMapHomologyIso_extendScalars_forget
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n q : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules) :
    let T
proof:
:= (coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F).sc q
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
    let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
      ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
        (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
          (Localization.Away g) g)
    letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
    let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
    T.mapHomologyIso (E ⋙ U) =
      ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫
        ((T.map E).mapHomologyIso U) ≪≫
          U.mapIso (T.mapHomologyIso E) := by
  let T := (coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F).sc q
  let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars
    (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat (Localization.Away g)) AddCommGrpCat
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway
        (Localization.Away g) g)
  letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
  let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
  change T.mapHomologyIso (E ⋙ U) =
    ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eComp ≪≫
      ((T.map E).mapHomologyIso U) ≪≫
        U.mapIso (T.mapHomologyIso E)
  let hl := T.homologyData.left
  rw [hl.mapHomologyIso_eq (F := E ⋙ U)]
  rw [(hl.map E).mapHomologyIso_eq (F := U)]
  rw [hl.mapHomologyIso_eq (F := E)]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleLeftHomologyData_map_extendScalars_forget_homologyIso
    R g n q F]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [cancel_epi, cancel_epi]
  change U.map (E.map hl.homologyIso.inv) =
    U.map (hl.map E).homologyIso.inv ≫
      U.map ((hl.map E).homologyIso.hom ≫
        E.map hl.homologyIso.inv)
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change U.map (E.map hl.homologyIso.inv) =
    (U.mapIso (hl.map E).homologyIso).inv ≫
      (U.mapIso (hl.map E).homologyIso).hom ≫
        U.map (E.map hl.homologyIso.inv)
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom_raw_comm
statement:
theorem forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom_raw_comm
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away g
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj F
    forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F ≫
        (forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso S n G).hom =
      (forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso R n F).hom ≫
        localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F) := by
  dsimp only
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro p
  ext x
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change
    (localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermBaseChangeIso R g n p F).hom
        ((1 : Localization.Away g) ⊗ₜ[
          R, algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)] x) =
      (localizationCoordinateCechTermRestriction R g n p
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)).hom x
  rw [localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermBaseChangeIso_hom_tmul, one_smul]
  exact localizationCoordinateCechModuleTermRestrictionLinear_apply R g n p F x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso_unit_naturality
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso_unit_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n q : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away g
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj F
    let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F
    let D := coordinateCechModuleComplex S n G
    let T := C.sc q
    let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)
    let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let τ := extendScalarsForgetUnitNatTrans R S (algebraMap R S)
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
      ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
        (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway S g)
    letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
    (T.mapHomologyIso V).inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F) q =
      τ.app T.homology ≫
        U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
          ((D.sc q).mapHomologyIso U).inv := by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
    (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj F
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F
  let D := coordinateCechModuleComplex S n G
  let T := C.sc q
  let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let τ := extendScalarsForgetUnitNatTrans R S (algebraMap R S)
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.Flat.holdsForLocalizationAway S g)
  letI : E.PreservesHomology := by infer_instance
  let eComp := coordinateShortComplexMapCompIso T E U
  let eBC := localizationCoordinateCechModuleComplexBaseChangeIso R g n F
  let compIsoHC :
      (E ⋙ U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ≅
        E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⋙
          U.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) :=
    (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
      (F := E) (G := U) (Iso.refl (E ⋙ U))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).symm
  let eCompHC :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
      AddCommGrpCat (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapIso
        (compIsoHC.app C))
  let eBCscRaw :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
      (ModuleCat S) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapIso eBC)
  let eMap :
      T.map E ≅
        (HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
          (ModuleCat S) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).obj
            ((E.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj C) :=
    ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
  let eBCsc : T.map E ≅ D.sc q :=
    eMap ≪≫ eBCscRaw
  let mV := T.mapHomologyIso V
  let mE := T.mapHomologyIso E
  let mU := (T.map E).mapHomologyIso U
  let mG := T.mapHomologyIso (E ⋙ U)
  let mUS := (D.sc q).mapHomologyIso U
  have htest :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F) q =
        ShortComplex.homologyMap (T.mapNatTrans τ) ≫
          (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
            ShortComplex.homologyMap
              (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom) := by
    dsimp only [forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom]
    rw [HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp]
    rfl
  have heComp : eCompHC = eComp := by
    ext <;> rfl
  have hunit := ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans T τ
  have hcomp :
      mG = ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC ≪≫
        mU ≪≫ U.mapIso mE := by
    simpa only [heComp] using
      (coordinateCechModuleMapHomologyIso_extendScalars_forget R g n q F)
  have hU :=
    ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality eBCsc.hom U
  change mV.inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F) q =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
        mUS.inv
  rw [htest, hunit]
  change mV.inv ≫
      (mV.hom ≫ τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv) ≫
        (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
          ShortComplex.homologyMap
            (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom) =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
        mUS.inv
  have hcancel :
      mV.inv ≫ (mV.hom ≫
        (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv)) =
        τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv := by
    calc
      _ = (mV.inv ≫ mV.hom) ≫
          (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [mV.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  let rest :=
    (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
      ShortComplex.homologyMap
        (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom)
  have hcancelRest :
      (mV.inv ≫ (mV.hom ≫
        (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv))) ≫ rest =
        (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv) ≫ rest :=
    congrArg (fun k => k ≫ rest) hcancel
  change (mV.inv ≫ (mV.hom ≫
      (τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv))) ≫ rest =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
        mUS.inv
  rw [hcancelRest]
  change τ.app T.homology ≫ mG.inv ≫
      (ShortComplex.homologyMapIso eCompHC).hom ≫
        ShortComplex.homologyMap
          (U.mapShortComplex.map eBCsc.hom) =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
        mUS.inv
  rw [hcomp]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← hU]
  change τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map mE.inv ≫
        U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) ≫
          mUS.inv =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
        mUS.inv
  have hmap :
      U.map mE.inv ≫
          U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) =
        U.map (mE.inv ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) :=
    (U.map_comp _ _).symm
  let tail := mUS.inv
  have hmapTail :
      (U.map mE.inv ≫
          U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q)) ≫ tail =
        U.map (mE.inv ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q) ≫ tail :=
    congrArg (fun k => k ≫ tail) hmap
  change τ.app T.homology ≫
      ((U.map mE.inv ≫
        U.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eBC.hom q)) ≫ tail) =
    τ.app T.homology ≫
      U.map (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom ≫
        tail
  rw [hmapTail]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChange_unit_raw_compat
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChange_unit_raw_compat
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n q : ℕ) (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (y : ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F).homology q)) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away g
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj F
    coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv S n G q
        ((localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F).hom
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R S] y)) =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)) q).hom
        (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n F q y) := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
    (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj F
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex R n F
  let D := coordinateCechModuleComplex S n G
  let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} S) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let eR := coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n F q
  let eS := coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv S n G q
  let eBC := localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n q F
  let mV := (C.sc q).mapHomologyIso V
  let mUS := (D.sc q).mapHomologyIso U
  let eFR :=
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso
      (iso := forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso R n F) q
  let eFS :=
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso
      (iso := forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso S n G) q
  have hnat :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso_unit_naturality
        R g n q F) y
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  change
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F) q)
        (mV.inv y) =
      mUS.inv (eBC.hom
        ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R S] y)) at hnat
  have hsquare :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F) q ≫
        eFS.hom =
      eFR.hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n
            ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)) q := by
    change
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom R g n F) q ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso S n G).hom q =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso R n F).hom q ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n
            ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)) q
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      ← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      forgetLocalizationCoordinateCechModuleBaseChangeComplexHom_raw_comm]
  have hsquarey :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hsquare (mV.inv y)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hsquarey
  change eFS.hom
      (mUS.inv (eBC.hom
        ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R S] y))) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj F)) q).hom
      (eFR.hom (mV.inv y))
  rw [← hnat]
  exact hsquarey

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleComplex_smul_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleComplex_smul_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n p : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (c : R)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm R n M p) :
    ((((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)).f p).hom x) =
      c • x
proof:
:= by
  let e := coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv R n M p
  apply e.injective
  funext a
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [e.map_smul]
  change _ = c • e x a
  rw [coordinateCechModuleHigherTermPiLinearEquiv_apply]
  have hπ :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_f_π R n p
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c) a
  have hπx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hπ x
  change
    (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      M.presheaf.obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom
        ((((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
          (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)).f p).hom x) =
      c •
        (Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection R n p b))) a).hom x at hπx
  exact hπx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleHomology_smul_eq_map
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleHomology_smul_eq_map
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n q : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (c : R)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M).homology q)) :
    c • x =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (c • 𝟙 (coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M)) q).hom x
proof:
:= by
  change c • x =
    (ShortComplex.homologyMap
      (c • 𝟙 ((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M).sc q))).hom x
  rw [ShortComplex.homologyMap_smul, ShortComplex.homologyMap_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality
statement:
theorem forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (c : R) :
    let C
proof:
:= coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M
    let V :=
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat R) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let φ :=
      (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)
    V.map (c • 𝟙 C) ≫
        (forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso R n M).hom =
      (forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso R n M).hom ≫ φ := by
  dsimp only
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro p
  ext x
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_map_f,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  exact (coordinateCechModuleComplex_smul_apply
    R n p M c x).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n q : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (c : R)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M).homology q)) :
    coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n M q (c • x) =
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n q).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)).hom
        (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n M q x)
proof:
:= by
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M
  let V := forget₂ (ModuleCat R) AddCommGrpCat
  let W := V.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let e := forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso R n M
  let α : C ⟶ C := c • 𝟙 C
  let φ :=
    (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor R n).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)
  let e₁ := ((C.sc q).mapHomologyIso V).symm
  let e₂ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (iso := e) q
  have hx :=
    coordinateCechModuleHomology_smul_eq_map R n q M c x
  change e₂.hom (e₁.hom (c • x)) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ q).hom
      (e₂.hom (e₁.hom x))
  rw [hx]
  let αsc :=
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor
      (ModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).map α)
  have h₁ := ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality αsc V
  have h₁x := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₁ x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h₁x
  change e₁.hom
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α q).hom x) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (W.map α) q).hom
      (e₁.hom x) at h₁x
  rw [h₁x]
  have hsquare :
      W.map α ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ φ :=
    forgetCoordinateCechModuleComplexIso_smul_naturality R n M c
  have h₂ :
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (W.map α) q ≫ e₂.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ q := by
    change
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (W.map α) q ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom q =
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap e.hom q ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ q
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp,
      ← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp, hsquare]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₂ (e₁.hom x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleRawHomology_smul_eq_map
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleRawHomology_smul_eq_map
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n q : ℕ)
    (M : (space R n).Modules) (c : R)
    (z : ↑(((coordinateCechComplexFunctor R n).obj M).homology q)) :
    c • z =
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor R n q).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)).hom z
proof:
:= by
  let e := coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n M q
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := e.surjective z
  have hlin :=
    (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv R n q M).map_smul c x
  change e (c • x) = c • e x at hlin
  rw [← hlin]
  exact coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv_smul R n q M c x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveAddEquiv_smul
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n p : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules)
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (c : R)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M).homology (p + 1))) :
    coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveAddEquiv R n p M hM
        (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv
          R n (p + 1) M (c • x)) =
      c • coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveAddEquiv R n p M hM
        (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv
          R n (p + 1) M x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv
    R n (p + 1) M).map_smul]
  rw [coordinateCechModuleRawHomology_smul_eq_map]
  let A := (Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M
  let y : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H A (p + 1) :=
    coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveAddEquiv R n p M hM
      (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv R n (p + 1) M x)
  have hnat :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality R n
      hM hM (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c) p
      (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawLinearEquiv
        R n (p + 1) M x)
  change _ =
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)
      (p + 1) y at hnat
  have hsmul : c • y =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of R) M c)
        (p + 1) y :=
    @smul_eq_H_map (space R n) (CommRingCat.of R)
      (projectiveSpaceOverSpec R n) M c (p + 1) y
  exact hnat.trans hsmul.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnit_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnit_isBaseChange
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))) :
    IsBaseChange (Localization.Away g)
      (localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear
        R g n p M hM hG)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsBaseChange.of_equiv
    (localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeLinearEquiv
      R g n p M hM hG)
  intro x
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear_apply
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (g : R) (n p : ℕ) (M : (space R n).Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hM : CoordinateCechAcyclic R n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M))
    (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic (Localization.Away g) n
      (((map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)))
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1)) :
    localizationCoordinateCechModulePositiveBaseChangeUnitLinear R g n p M hM hG x =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom
        (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n)
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away g
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
    (map (algebraMap R S) n)).obj M
  let C := coordinateCechModuleComplex R n M
  let eR := coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv
    R n p M hM
  let eS := coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveLinearEquiv
    S n p G hG
  let y := eR.symm x
  let z := coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv R n M (p + 1) y
  change eS
      ((localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n (p + 1) M).hom
        ((extendScalarsTensorLinearEquiv R S
          ↑(C.homology (p + 1))).symm
          ((AlgebraTensorModule.congr
            (LinearEquiv.refl S S) eR.symm)
            ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] x)))) =
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom
      (map (algebraMap R S) n)
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1) x
  rw [AlgebraTensorModule.congr_tmul]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.refl_apply]
  rw [← extendScalarsTensorLinearEquiv_tmul
    R S ↑(C.homology (p + 1)) (1 : S) y]
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hraw :=
    localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChange_unit_raw_compat
      R g n (p + 1) M y
  have hloc :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_localizationRestriction
      R g n ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)
      hM hG p z
  change
    coordinateCechModuleSheafHPositiveAddEquiv S n p G hG
      (coordinateCechModuleHomologyRawAddEquiv S n G (p + 1)
        ((localizationCoordinateCechModuleHomologyBaseChangeIso R g n (p + 1) M).hom
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, algebraMap R S] y))) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom
        (map (algebraMap R S) n)
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1) x
  rw [hraw]
  change
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv S n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space S n)).obj G) hG p
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (localizationCoordinateCechRestriction R g n
          ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M)) (p + 1)).hom z) =
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openPullbackExtAddHom
        (map (algebraMap R S) n)
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space R n)).obj M) (p + 1) x
  rw [show x = eR y from (eR.apply_symm_apply x).symm]
  exact hloc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartToOverlap_coordinateRatio_cocycle
statement:
theorem coordinateChartToOverlap_coordinateRatio_cocycle
    (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) :
    coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩) =
      coordinateOverlapRatio R n j k *
        coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n k ⟨i, hik⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateChartToOverlapLeft, coordinateChartToOverlapRight,
    coordinateRatio, coordinateOverlapRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, pow_one, coordinateOverlapEquation]
  change
    (coordinate R n j * coordinate R n k) *
          (coordinate R n j * coordinate R n k) *
        (coordinate R n i * coordinate R n k) =
      coordinate R n j * coordinate R n k *
        (coordinate R n k ^ 2 * (coordinate R n i * coordinate R n j))
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartToOverlap_coordinateRatio_pow_cocycle
statement:
theorem coordinateChartToOverlap_coordinateRatio_pow_cocycle
    (e : ℕ) (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) :
    coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
        (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hij⟩ ^ e) =
      (twistTransitionUnit R n (e : ℤ) j k :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k) *
        coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n k ⟨i, hik⟩ ^ e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_pow, map_pow,
    coordinateChartToOverlap_coordinateRatio_cocycle R n i j k hij hik,
    mul_pow, twistTransitionUnit_natCast_val]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_of_ne
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_of_ne
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D e : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s j =
      coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hji.symm⟩ ^ e • E.component j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent, dif_neg hji]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_self
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_self
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D e : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s) :
    E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s i = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent]
  simp only [↓reduceDIte, E.component_self]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_pairwiseLeft
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_pairwiseLeft
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D e : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j) :
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv R n M j k hkj
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M j k hkj
          (E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s j)) =
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hji.symm⟩ ^ e) •
        E.pairwiseLeft R n M D i s j k hkj
proof:
:= by
  rw [E.raisedComponent_of_ne R n M D e i s j hji]
  rw [map_smul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_pairwiseRightBase
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_pairwiseRightBase
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D e : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hki : k ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j) :
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv R n M j k hkj.symm
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight R n M j k hkj.symm
          (E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s k)) =
      coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n j k
          (coordinateRatio R n k ⟨i, hki.symm⟩ ^ e) •
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
          R n M j k hkj.symm
          (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
            R n M j k hkj.symm (E.component k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [E.raisedComponent_of_ne R n M D e i s k hki]
  rw [map_smul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_pairwise_compatible_of_clear
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_pairwise_compatible_of_clear
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D e : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hji : j ≠ i) (hki : k ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (hclear :
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
            (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hji.symm⟩) ^ e •
          E.pairwiseLeft R n M D i s j k hkj =
        coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
            (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hji.symm⟩) ^ e •
          E.pairwiseRight R n M D i s j k hkj) :
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv R n M j k hkj
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M j k hkj
          (E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s j)) =
      (twistTransitionUnit R n ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) j k :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k) •
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
          R n M j k hkj.symm
          (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
            R n M j k hkj.symm
            (E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [E.raisedComponent_pairwiseLeft R n M D e i s j k hji hkj]
  rw [E.raisedComponent_pairwiseRightBase R n M D e i s j k hki hkj]
  let rL := coordinateChartToOverlapLeft R n j k
    (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hji.symm⟩ ^ e)
  let rR := coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n j k
    (coordinateRatio R n k ⟨i, hki.symm⟩ ^ e)
  let A : CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k :=
    twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) j k
  let B : CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k :=
    twistTransitionUnit R n (e : ℤ) j k
  let y :=
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
      R n M j k hkj.symm
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
        R n M j k hkj.symm (E.component k))
  have hr : rL = B * rR :=
    coordinateChartToOverlap_coordinateRatio_pow_cocycle
      R n e i j k hji.symm hki.symm
  change rL • E.pairwiseLeft R n M D i s j k hkj =
    (twistTransitionUnit R n ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) j k :
      CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k) • (rR • y)
  calc
    rL • E.pairwiseLeft R n M D i s j k hkj =
        rL • E.pairwiseRight R n M D i s j k hkj := by
      simpa only [rL, map_pow] using hclear
    _ = rL • (A • y) := rfl
    _ = (rL * A) • y := (mul_smul rL A y).symm
    _ = ((A * B) * rR) • y := by rw [hr]; ring
    _ = (A * B) • (rR • y) := mul_smul (A * B) rR y
    _ = (twistTransitionUnit R n ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) j k :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n j k) • (rR • y) := by
      rw [show ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) = (D : ℤ) + (e : ℤ) by omega,
        twistTransitionUnit_add, Units.val_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_compatible
statement:
theorem ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData.raisedComponent_compatible
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules)
    (D e : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj
      (projectiveCoordinateChartAffineModel R n M i)).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (E : ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M D i s)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv R n M i j hji
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hji
          (E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s i)) =
      (twistTransitionUnit R n ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) i j :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) •
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
          R n M i j hji.symm
          (E.raisedComponent R n M D e i s j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [E.raisedComponent_self R n M D e i s]
  rw [E.raisedComponent_of_ne R n M D e i s j hji]
  rw [map_smul]
  let q := coordinateChartToOverlapRight R n i j
    (coordinateRatio R n j ⟨i, hji.symm⟩ ^ e)
  let A : CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j :=
    twistTransitionUnit R n (D : ℤ) i j
  let B : CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j :=
    twistTransitionUnit R n (e : ℤ) i j
  let y := projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
    R n M i j hji.symm (E.component j)
  have hcancel : q * B = 1 :=
    coordinateChartToOverlapRight_coordinateRatio_pow_mul_transition
      R n e i j hji.symm
  have hE := E.compatible j hji
  change projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLeftRightAddEquiv R n M i j hji
      (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap R n M i j hji s) =
    (twistTransitionUnit R n ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) i j :
      CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) • (q • y)
  rw [hE]
  rw [show ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) = (D : ℤ) + (e : ℤ) by omega,
    twistTransitionUnit_add, Units.val_mul]
  rw [← mul_smul]
  change A • y = ((A * B) * q) • y
  congr 1
  calc
    A = A * 1 := by rw [mul_one]
    _ = A * (q * B) := by rw [hcancel]
    _ = (A * B) * q := by ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_raised_candidates
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_raised_candidates
    (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ d : ℕ,
      ∃ E : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
          ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M d i
          (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a),
      ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∀ p : ProjectiveCoordinatePairIndex n i,
        ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv
              R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
            (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
              R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
              ((E i a).component p.1.1.1)) =
          (twistTransitionUnit R n (d : ℤ) p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 :
              CoordinateOverlapRing R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1) •
            projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
              R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2
              (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
                R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2
                ((E i a).component p.1.2.1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, e, E, hclear⟩ :=
    projectiveCoordinateGenerators_exists_global_uniform_pairwise_power R n M
  let E' : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ a : (projectiveCoordinateRestrictionGeneratingSections R n M i).I,
      ProjectiveCoordinateTwistExtensionData R n M (D + e) i
        (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) :=
    fun i a => (E i a).raise R n M D e i
      (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
  refine ⟨D + e, E', fun i p a => ?_⟩
  change
    projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsLeftLinearEquiv
          R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
        (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMap
          R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2.symm
          ((E i a).raisedComponent R n M D e i
            (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) p.1.1.1)) =
      (twistTransitionUnit R n ((D + e : ℕ) : ℤ) p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 :
          CoordinateOverlapRing R n p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1) •
        projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapSectionsRightLinearEquiv
          R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2
          (projectiveCoordinateActualOverlapLocalizationMapRight
            R n M p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.2
            ((E i a).raisedComponent R n M D e i
              (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a) p.1.2.1))
  exact (E i a).raisedComponent_pairwise_compatible_of_clear
    R n M D e i (projectiveCoordinateModelGenerator R n M i a)
    p.1.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.1.2 p.1.2.2 p.2.symm
    (hclear i p a)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.affineSections_smul
statement:
theorem affineSections_smul {A : CommRingCat.{u}} (M : (Spec A).Modules) (a : A)
    (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    (a • s : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor A).obj M) = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a • s
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def (M := M) (U := ⊤) a s
  have hres : (Spec A).presheaf.map (⊤ : (Spec A).Opens).leTop.op
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a) = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((Spec A).presheaf.map_id (.op ⊤)) _
  exact hs.trans (congrArg (fun c => c • s) hres)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.affineEsec_add
statement:
theorem affineEsec_add (a b : A) :
    affineEsec φ (a + b) = affineEsec φ a + affineEsec φ b
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineEsec
  rw [map_add]
  exact TF3.Esec_add (Spec A) (Spec.map φ) ⊤ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.affineEsec_mul
statement:
theorem affineEsec_mul (a b : A) :
    affineEsec φ (a * b) = a • affineEsec φ b + b • affineEsec φ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineEsec
  rw [map_mul]
  exact (TF3.Esec_mul (Spec A) (Spec.map φ) ⊤ _ _).trans
    (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (affineSections_smul _ a _).symm
      (affineSections_smul _ b _).symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.affineEsec_base
statement: theorem affineEsec_base (r : R) : affineEsec φ (φ r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ) r
  unfold affineEsec
  have he : (Spec.map φ).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv (φ r) := hn.symm
  rw [← he]
  exact ConormalNativeDifferentialH2.Esec_appLE_zero (Spec.map φ) ⊤ ⊤ le_top
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.affineDifferential_d
statement:
theorem affineDifferential_d (a : A) :
    affineDifferential φ (CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d a) =
      TF2.Esec (Spec.map φ) ⊤ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv a)
proof:
:=
  ModuleCat.Derivation.desc_d (affineEsecDerivation φ) a

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.freeSections_inv_freeMk
statement:
theorem freeSections_inv_freeMk (i : I) :
    (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).inv.app (op U) (ModuleCat.freeMk i) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)
proof:
:= by
  have h := underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval X I i (op U)
  have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (congrArg (fun f => PresheafOfModules.Hom.app f (op U))
      (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom_inv_id)
    ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U))
  exact (congrArg ((underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).inv.app (op U)) h.symm).trans hc

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.frameSectionsIso_freeMk
statement:
theorem frameSectionsIso_freeMk (i : I) :
    (frameSectionsIso x hU hx).hom (ModuleCat.freeMk i) = sheafifyUnitApp U (x i)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ (freeOverIso X U I).hom =
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) := by
    unfold freeOverIso
    erw [SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  have he := congrArg (fun f => f.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (1 : Γ(X, U))) hE
  have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (congrArg (fun f => f.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))
      (freeOverIso X U I).hom_inv_id)
    ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) i).val.app
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (1 : Γ(X, U)))
  have hinv : (freeOverIso X U I).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).eval (op U)) =
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) i).val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (1 : Γ(X, U)) :=
    (congrArg ((freeOverIso X U I).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) he.symm).trans hc
  change (overIsoFree x hU hx).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    ((freeOverIso X U I).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      ((underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).inv.app (op U) (ModuleCat.freeMk i))) = _
  rw [freeSections_inv_freeMk, hinv]
  exact overIsoFree_inv_ιFree x hU hx i

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.frameMap_self_freeMk
statement:
theorem frameMap_self_freeMk (i : I) :
    frameMap P x U le_rfl (ModuleCat.freeMk i) = x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frameMap, ModuleCat.freeMk, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
  erw [PresheafOfModules.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.frameSectionsIso_unit_comp
statement:
theorem frameSectionsIso_unit_comp :
    (frameSectionsIso x hU hx).hom.hom =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P).app (op U)).hom.comp
        (frameMap P x U le_rfl)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro i
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  change (frameSectionsIso x hU hx).hom (ModuleCat.freeMk i) =
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P).app (op U))
      (frameMap P x U le_rfl (ModuleCat.freeMk i))
  rw [frameSectionsIso_freeMk, frameMap_self_freeMk]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.sheafificationUnit_bijective_of_frames
statement:
theorem sheafificationUnit_bijective_of_frames
    (htop : Function.Bijective (frameMap P x U le_rfl)) :
    Function.Bijective (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P).app (op U))
proof:
:= by
  have he := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (frameSectionsIso x hU hx).hom
  change Function.Bijective (frameSectionsIso x hU hx).hom.hom at he
  rw [frameSectionsIso_unit_comp x hU hx] at he
  exact (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ htop).mp he

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSections_D
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSections_D (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    relativeDifferentialSections f h (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) a) =
      TF2.Esec f U a := by
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := baseAlgebra f h
  letI : Algebra (baseSubring f U) Γ(X, U) := (baseInclusion f U).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V) (baseSubring f U) Γ(X, U) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  exact congrArg
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op U))
    (KaehlerDifferential.map_D Γ(S, V) (baseSubring f U) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, U) a)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeUnit_bijective_of_basis
statement:
theorem relativeUnit_bijective_of_basis (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (b : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra;
      Module.Basis I Γ(X, U) Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V)]) :
    Function.Bijective
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op U))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  let x := fun i => compareMap f h (b i)
  have hx := relative_frameMap_bijective f hV hU h b
  have htop : frameMap (relativePresheaf f) x U le_rfl =
      (compareMap f h).comp (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) ⇑b) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro i
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    change frameMap (relativePresheaf f) x U le_rfl (ModuleCat.freeMk i) =
      (compareMap f h) ((Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) ⇑b) (ModuleCat.freeMk i))
    rw [frameMap_self_freeMk]
    simp only [ModuleCat.freeMk,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    rfl
  have hb : Function.Bijective (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) ⇑b) := by
    rw [← Module.Basis.coe_repr_symm]
    exact b.repr.symm.bijective
  apply sheafificationUnit_bijective_of_frames x hU hx
  rw [htop]
  exact (compareMap_bijective f hV hU h).comp hb

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_basis
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_basis
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (b : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra;
      Module.Basis I Γ(X, U) Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V)]) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    Function.Bijective (relativeDifferentialSections f h) := by
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  exact (relativeUnit_bijective_of_basis f h hV hU b).comp
    (compareMap_bijective f hV hU h)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSectionsIso_D
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSectionsIso_D (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (b : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra;
      Module.Basis I Γ(X, U) Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V)]) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    (relativeDifferentialSectionsIso f h hV hU b).hom
      (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) a) = TF2.Esec f U a :=
  relativeDifferentialSections_D f h a

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSectionsIso_inv_Esec
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSectionsIso_inv_Esec (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (b : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra;
      Module.Basis I Γ(X, U) Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V)]) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    (relativeDifferentialSectionsIso f h hV hU b).inv (TF2.Esec f U a) =
      KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) a := by
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  exact (congrArg (relativeDifferentialSectionsIso f h hV hU b).inv
    (relativeDifferentialSectionsIso_D f h hV hU b a).symm).trans
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (relativeDifferentialSectionsIso f h hV hU b).hom_inv_id _)

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_standardSmooth
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_standardSmooth
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hsm : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra;
      Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    Function.Bijective (relativeDifferentialSections f h) := by
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) := hsm
  exact relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_basis f h hV hU
    (Module.Free.chooseBasis Γ(X, U) Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V)])

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSectionsIsoOfStandardSmooth_D
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSectionsIsoOfStandardSmooth_D
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hsm : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra;
      Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U)) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    (relativeDifferentialSectionsIsoOfStandardSmooth f h hV hU hsm).hom
      (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) a) = TF2.Esec f U a :=
  relativeDifferentialSections_D f h a

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.relativeDifferentialSections_restrict
statement:
theorem relativeDifferentialSections_restrict {W : X.Opens} (i : W ≤ U)
    (ω : letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra; Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V)]) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (f.appLE V W (i.trans h)).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, W) := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, W) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change (f.appLE V W _).hom =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V U h).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
    (relativeSheaf f).presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op (relativeDifferentialSections f h ω) =
      relativeDifferentialSections f (i.trans h)
        (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V) Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, W) ω) := by
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := (f.appLE V W (i.trans h)).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, W) := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, W) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    change (f.appLE V W _).hom =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V U h).hom
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
  have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f))
    (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h ω)
  exact hn.symm.trans (congrArg
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op W))
    (relativePresheaf_map_compareMap f i h ω))

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.smooth_exists_nativeKahler_chart
statement:
theorem smooth_exists_nativeKahler_chart {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (y : X) :
    ∃ (V : S.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (h : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V),
      IsAffineOpen V ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ y ∈ U ∧
        letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
        Function.Bijective (relativeDifferentialSections f h) := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, U, hU, hy, h, hsm⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (n := n) (f := f) y
  letI := (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) := hsm
  have hs : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n
  exact ⟨V, U, h, hV, hU, hy,
    relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_standardSmooth f h hV hU hs⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.NativeKahlerTargetH2.smooth_exists_nativeKahler_chart_of_smooth
statement:
theorem smooth_exists_nativeKahler_chart_of_smooth {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Smooth f] (y : X) :
    ∃ (V : S.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (h : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V),
      IsAffineOpen V ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ y ∈ U ∧
        letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V U h).hom.toAlgebra
        Function.Bijective (relativeDifferentialSections f h) := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, U, hU, hy, h, hsm⟩ := Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth f y
  exact ⟨V, U, h, hV, hU, hy,
    relativeDifferentialSections_bijective_of_standardSmooth f h hV hU hsm⟩

name: ARRASM.hrigid_proved
statement:
theorem hrigid_proved (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (J : (space k n).IdealSheafData) :
    r₀K k n J = r₁K k n J
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherian_Zs k n J
  exact ARRRIG.rigid_deformation (space k n) J k (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.rhoP k n)

name: IsLocalizedModule.middle_of_exact_five_ladder
statement:
theorem middle_of_exact_five_ladder
    (d₀ : D →ₗ[R] A) (d₁ : A →ₗ[R] B) (d₂ : B →ₗ[R] C) (d₃ : C →ₗ[R] E)
    (d₀' : D' →ₗ[R] A') (d₁' : A' →ₗ[R] B') (d₂' : B' →ₗ[R] C')
    (d₃' : C' →ₗ[R] E')
    (vD : D →ₗ[R] D') (vA : A →ₗ[R] A') (vB : B →ₗ[R] B')
    (vC : C →ₗ[R] C') (vE : E →ₗ[R] E')
    (hexA : Function.Exact d₀ d₁) (hexB : Function.Exact d₁ d₂)
    (hexC : Function.Exact d₂ d₃)
    (hexA' : Function.Exact d₀' d₁') (hexB' : Function.Exact d₁' d₂')
    (hexC' : Function.Exact d₂' d₃')
    (hDA : ∀ x, d₀' (vD x) = vA (d₀ x))
    (hAB : ∀ x, d₁' (vA x) = vB (d₁ x))
    (hBC : ∀ x, d₂' (vB x) = vC (d₂ x))
    (hCE : ∀ x, d₃' (vC x) = vE (d₃ x))
    [IsLocalizedModule S vD] [IsLocalizedModule S vA]
    [IsLocalizedModule S vC] [IsLocalizedModule S vE] :
    IsLocalizedModule S vB
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    show Function.Bijective (fun x : B' => (s : R) • x)
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      change (s : R) • x = (s : R) • y at hxy
      have hsxy : (s : R) • (x - y) = 0 := by
        rw [smul_sub, hxy, sub_self]
      have hkerC : d₂' (x - y) = 0 := by
        apply injective_smul S vC s
        rw [smul_zero]
        simpa only [map_smul, map_zero] using congrArg d₂' hsxy
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hexB' (x - y)).1 hkerC
      have hkerA : d₁' ((s : R) • w) = 0 := by
        rw [map_smul, hw, hsxy]
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hexA' ((s : R) • w)).1 hkerA
      obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩ := surjective_smul S vD s v
      have hw' : w = d₀' w₀ := by
        apply injective_smul S vA s
        calc
          (s : R) • w = d₀' v := hv.symm
          _ = d₀' ((s : R) • w₀) := congrArg d₀' hw₀.symm
          _ = (s : R) • d₀' w₀ := by rw [map_smul]
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      calc
        x - y = d₁' w := hw.symm
        _ = d₁' (d₀' w₀) := congrArg d₁' hw'
        _ = 0 := hexA'.apply_apply_eq_zero w₀
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := surjective_smul S vC s (d₂' y)
      have hkerE : d₃' z = 0 := by
        apply injective_smul S vE s
        calc
          (s : R) • d₃' z = d₃' ((s : R) • z) := by rw [map_smul]
          _ = d₃' (d₂' y) := congrArg d₃' hz
          _ = 0 := hexC'.apply_apply_eq_zero y
          _ = (s : R) • 0 := by rw [smul_zero]
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hexC' z).1 hkerE
      have hkerC : d₂' (y - (s : R) • x) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sub, map_smul, hx, hz, sub_self]
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hexB' (y - (s : R) • x)).1 hkerC
      obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩ := surjective_smul S vA s w
      refine ⟨x + d₁' w₀, ?_⟩
      change (s : R) • (x + d₁' w₀) = y
      rw [smul_add, ← map_smul, hw₀, hw]
      simp
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨⟨z, s⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S vC (d₂' y)
    have hzR : (s : R) • d₂' y = vC z := by
      simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def] using hz
    have heq : vE (d₃ z) = vE 0 := by
      rw [← hCE, ← hzR, map_smul, hexC'.apply_apply_eq_zero, smul_zero, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := S) (f := vE) heq
    have htR : (t : R) • d₃ z = 0 := by
      simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def, smul_zero] using ht
    have hkerE : d₃ ((t : R) • z) = 0 := by
      rw [map_smul, htR]
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hexC ((t : R) • z)).1 hkerE
    have hkerC : d₂' (vB x - ((t * s : S) : R) • y) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hBC, hx, map_smul, map_smul]
      change (t : R) • vC z - ((t : R) * (s : R)) • d₂' y = 0
      rw [← hzR, mul_smul, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hexB' (vB x - ((t * s : S) : R) • y)).1 hkerC
    obtain ⟨⟨v, u⟩, hv⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S vA w
    have hvR : (u : R) • w = vA v := by
      simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def] using hv
    refine ⟨⟨(u : R) • x - d₁ v, u * (t * s)⟩, ?_⟩
    change (((u * (t * s) : S) : R) • y) =
      vB ((u : R) • x - d₁ v)
    symm
    calc
      vB ((u : R) • x - d₁ v) =
          (u : R) • vB x - vB (d₁ v) := by rw [map_sub, map_smul]
      _ = (u : R) • vB x - d₁' (vA v) := by rw [hAB]
      _ = (u : R) • vB x - d₁' ((u : R) • w) := by rw [hvR]
      _ = (u : R) • (vB x - d₁' w) := by rw [map_smul, smul_sub]
      _ = (u : R) • (((t * s : S) : R) • y) := by
        rw [hw]
        abel_nf
      _ = (((u * (t * s) : S) : R) • y) := by
        simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_smul]
  · intro x₁ x₂ h
    let z := x₁ - x₂
    have hvz : vB z = 0 := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]
    have heqC : vC (d₂ z) = vC 0 := by
      rw [← hBC, hvz, map_zero, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := S) (f := vC) heqC
    have hsR : (s : R) • d₂ z = 0 := by
      simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def, smul_zero] using hs
    have hkerC : d₂ ((s : R) • z) = 0 := by
      rw [map_smul, hsR]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hexB ((s : R) • z)).1 hkerC
    have hkerA' : d₁' (vA w) = 0 := by
      rw [hAB, hw, map_smul, hvz, smul_zero]
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hexA' (vA w)).1 hkerA'
    obtain ⟨⟨q, t⟩, ht⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj S vD v
    have htR : (t : R) • v = vD q := by
      simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def] using ht
    have hkerA : vA ((t : R) • w - d₀ q) = 0 := by
      calc
        vA ((t : R) • w - d₀ q) =
            (t : R) • vA w - vA (d₀ q) := by rw [map_sub, map_smul]
        _ = (t : R) • d₀' v - d₀' (vD q) := by rw [hv, hDA]
        _ = d₀' ((t : R) • v) - d₀' (vD q) := by rw [map_smul]
        _ = 0 := by rw [htR, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := S) (f := vA)
      (show vA ((t : R) • w - d₀ q) = vA 0 by simpa using hkerA)
    refine ⟨u * (t * s), ?_⟩
    have hu' : (u : R) • ((t : R) • w - d₀ q) = 0 := by
      simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def, smul_zero] using hu
    have hmap := congrArg d₁ hu'
    simp only [map_smul, map_sub, hexA.apply_apply_eq_zero, map_zero, sub_zero] at hmap
    rw [hw] at hmap
    dsimp [z] at hmap
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← smul_sub]
    simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_smul] using hmap

statement:
theorem hresF_proved (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (w : K0 (Ws k n J)) :
    pullbackK0 (ARRKG.openComplementW k n J).ι (FpK k n J hZ w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (Ms k n J) := ARRPE.isNoetherian_total k n J
  haveI : IsNoetherian (Ws k n J) := ARRPE.isNoetherian_W k n J
  have hinj := (bijective_k0ToG0_open (ARRPE.projEmb_total k n J)
    (ARRKG.isRegularScheme_M k n J hZ) (ARRKG.openComplementW k n J)).1
  apply hinj
  rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
  unfold FpK
  rw [ARRL1C.k0ToG0_Fp, map_zero]
  have hU : Set.range (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J) =
      ((ARRKG.openComplementW k n J : (Ms k n J).Opens) : Set (Ms k n J))ᶜ := by
    ext x

  have hk := KSpecialization.AR5R.ker_flatPullbackG0_eq_range_finitePushforward_of_closedImmersion
    (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J) (ARRKG.openComplementW k n J) hU
  have : finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J) (k0ToG0 (Ws k n J) w) ∈
      (flatPullbackG0 (ARRKG.openComplementW k n J).ι).ker := by
    rw [hk]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  exact this

name: ARRASM.arr_caseII
statement:
theorem arr_caseII (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J))
    (hCN : ∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = codim k n J) (hd : 0 < codim k n J)
    (hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range (iZ k n J))
    (G : ARRCaseIIGates k n J hZ CN) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : KLoc j (Zs k n J)) :
    locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankA k n) j) (pushLocF3 j (iZ k n J) (resA k n).res x) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ k n J) (resA k n).res
        (thetaZ k n J hZ j * locMap (j := j) (adamsRingHom (rankZ k n J) j) x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  haveI := (Cov k n J CN).isNoetherian_scheme
  have hrE := rankBetween k n J CN hCN hd
  have hE := hErank k n J hZ
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty ((Cov k n J CN).basisIndex i) := fun i => ⟨Sum.inr PUnit.unit⟩
  have hnilP : LambdaNilpotent (Es k n J CN) :=
    HnilPARRK2P.hnilP k n (iZ k n J) hE (Cov k n J CN) hpos
  have hEN : k0ClassOf (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (Zs k n J))
      hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = conormalClass k n J hZ + 1 := by
    rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.KoszulK0.k0ClassOf_biprod (hNrank k n J hZ).isFiniteLocallyFree
      hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree hE.isFiniteLocallyFree]
    rfl
  have hkos : spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) 1 =
      lambdaMinusOne (Cov k n J CN).tautologicalKernel
        ((Cov k n J CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) := by
    have h := RiemannRoch.KNFB.koszulProd_adaptedCover CN hE
    simp only [spK, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [h]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).left _
  have hproj : ∀ (y : KLoc j (Es k n J CN)) (x : KLoc j (Zs k n J)),
      locAddHom j (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)))
        (locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection) y * x) =
      y * locAddHom j (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN))) x := by
    intro y x
    have h := projFormulaLoc j (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).res (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).left (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).right x y
    rw [pullLocF3_eq] at h
    rw [mul_comm _ x, mul_comm y]
    exact h
  have hkoszul : ∀ z : K0 (Zs k n J),
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Es k n J CN)) (adamsRingHom (rankE_of_iso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) j (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) z)) =
      locAddHom j (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)))
        (thetaZ k n J hZ j * algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs k n J)) (adamsRingHom (rankZ k n J) j z)) := by
    intro z
    have key := SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection_noTwist_ARRM4
      (j := j) hj hE (Cov k n J CN) (rankZ k n J) (hnilZ' k n J) (rankE_of_iso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) hnilP
      (conormalClass k n J hZ) hEN (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN))) (locAddHom j (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN))))
      (fun x => locAddHom_algebraMap _ _ _) hproj hkos z
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact key
  have hπs : ∀ z, πK k n J hZ CN hrE (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) z) = z := by
    intro z
    have h7 := KSpecialization.derivedPushforward_comp_section (C := Cov k n J CN) hrE
      (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection_toBase
    have h7z := DFunLike.congr_fun h7 (k0ToG0 (Zs k n J) z)
    have h8 := DFunLike.congr_fun (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).right
      (finitePushforward (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection (k0ToG0 (Zs k n J) z))
    simp only [πK, spK, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h7z h8 ⊢
    rw [h8, h7z]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (resZ k n J hZ).left z
  refine adams_transport_loc j (FpK k n J hZ) (ipK k n J) (spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)))
    (πK k n J hZ CN hrE) (pullbackK0RingHom (ARRKG.openComplementW k n J).ι) (j₀K k n J)
    (pullbackK0RingHom (EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN))) (r₀K k n J) (r₁K k n J) (prK k n J)
    (adamsRingHom (rankM k n J) j) (adamsRingHom (rankA k n) j) (adamsRingHom (rankE_of_iso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) j)
    (adamsRingHom (rankU k n J hne) j) (adamsRingHom (rankW k n J) j)
    (adamsRingHom (rankZ k n J) j) (thetaZ k n J hZ j) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (hpr₀ k n J)
    (pr_section _ _ (secInf_pr k n J)) hkoszul hπs G.hrigid x
  · intro m hm
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ARRPE.hsupp_deformation' k n J j hZ m hm
    exact ⟨w, by rw [← Floc_eq_locAddHom]; exact hw⟩
  · exact hψnat (ARRKG.openComplementW k n J).ι (rankU k n J hne) (rankM k n J) hj
  · intro w
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    exact hresF_proved k n J hZ w
  · intro w
    have h := KSpecialization.ARRG45.hbc0_K0 (space k n) J k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.rhoP k n) (ARRPE.resolutionM k n J hZ) (resA k n) w
    simp only [j₀K, FpK, ipK, r₀K, ARRL1C.Fp, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    exact h
  · intro w
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
    exact G.hbcP w
  · exact hψnat _ (rankA k n) (rankM k n J) hj
  · exact hψnat (EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) (rankE_of_iso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) (rankM k n J) hj
  · exact hψnat _ (rankZ k n J) (rankW k n J) hj
  · exact hψnat (secInf k n J) (rankZ k n J) (rankW k n J) hj

name: ARRASM.arr_caseII_K0
statement:
theorem arr_caseII_K0 (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J))
    (hCN : ∀ i, Nat.card (CN.basisIndex i) = codim k n J) (hd : 0 < codim k n J)
    (hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range (iZ k n J))
    (G : ARRCaseIIGates k n J hZ CN) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 (Zs k n J)) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (space k n))
        (adamsRingHom (rankA k n) j ((resA k n).res (finitePushforward (iZ k n J)
          (k0ToG0 (Zs k n J) x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j (iZ k n J) (resA k n).res
        (algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs k n J)) (adamsRingHom (rankZ k n J) j x) *
          thetaZ k n J hZ j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := arr_caseII k n J hZ CN hCN hd hne G hj (algebraMap _ _ x)
  have e1 : pushLocF3 j (iZ k n J) (resA k n).res (algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Zs k n J)) x) =
      algebraMap _ (KLoc j (space k n)) ((resA k n).res (finitePushforward (iZ k n J)
        (k0ToG0 (Zs k n J) x))) := by
    unfold pushLocF3
    rw [locAddHom_algebraMap]
    rfl
  rw [e1, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, mul_comm] at h
  exact h

name: ARRASM.arr_caseII_final
statement:
theorem arr_caseII_final (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))

name: GRRKG1.finitePushforward_iso
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_iso (hi : e.hom ≫ ι = i) (x : K0 X) :
    finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x) =
      finitePushforward ι (k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0RingHom e.inv x))
proof:
:= by
  subst hi
  rw [finitePushforward_comp e.hom ι, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
  congr 1
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv e.symm)
    (k0ToG0 X x)).symm

name: GRRKG1.pushLocF3_iso
statement:
theorem pushLocF3_iso (j : ℕ) (res : G0 P →+ K0 P) (hi : e.hom ≫ ι = i) :
    pushLocF3 j i res = (pushLocF3 j ι res).comp (pullLocF3 j e.inv).toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  apply loc_addHom_ext
  intro a
  show pushLocF3 j i res (algebraMap _ _ a) =
    pushLocF3 j ι res (pullLocF3 j e.inv (algebraMap _ _ a))
  rw [pullLocF3_alg]
  unfold pushLocF3
  rw [locAddHom_algebraMap, locAddHom_algebraMap]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [finitePushforward_iso e ι i hi]

name: GRRKG1.phiX_comp
statement: theorem phiX_comp : (phiX k n i).hom ≫ i.ker.subschemeι = i
proof: := i.toImage_imageι

name: GRRKG1.iZ_phiX
statement:
theorem iZ_phiX (x : X) :
    ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker ((phiX k n i).hom x) = i x
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (phiX k n i).hom i.ker.subschemeι x).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ space k n => f x) (phiX_comp k n i))

name: GRRKG1.range_ker
statement: theorem range_ker : Set.range (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker) = Set.range i
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.surjective (phiX k n i).hom z
    exact ⟨x, (iZ_phiX k n i x).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(phiX k n i).hom x, iZ_phiX k n i x⟩

name: GRRKG1.pullLoc_bott
statement:
theorem pullLoc_bott (j : ℕ) :
    pullLocF3 j (phiX k n i).inv
        ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
          (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
          (Multiplicative.ofAdd (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass) :
            (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) =
      ARRASM.thetaZ k n i.ker (BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_ker_subscheme i hX) j
proof:
:= by
  have hc : pullbackK0RingHom (phiX k n i).inv
      (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass =
        ARRASM.conormalClass k n i.ker (BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_ker_subscheme i hX) := by
    have h1 : (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass =
        pullbackK0RingHom (phiX k n i).hom
          (ARRASM.conormalClass k n i.ker
            (BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_ker_subscheme i hX)) :=
      (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf (phiX k n i).hom _ _).symm
    rw [h1, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pullbackK0RingHom_id]
    rfl
  rw [ARRASM.pullLocF3_eq]
  unfold ARRASM.thetaZ
  rw [← hc]
  exact bott_pullbackK0 (j := j) (phiX k n i).inv (ARRASM.rankZ k n i.ker)
    (ARRASM.hnilZ' k n i.ker) (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
    (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i) _

name: GRRKG1.closedImmersion_field
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_field (hd : 0 < ARRASM.codim k n i.ker)
    (hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range i) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (space k n))
        (adamsRingHom (ARRASM.rankA k n) j ((ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
        (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
          ((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
            (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
            (Multiplicative.ofAdd
              (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass) :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X))
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_ker_subscheme i hX
  have hne' : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker) := by
    rw [range_ker]; exact hne
  have h := ARRASM.arr_caseII_K0 k n i.ker hZ (ARRASM.CN0 k n i.ker hZ)
    (ARRASM.CN0_card k n i.ker hZ) hd hne'
    (ARRASM.arrCaseIIGates_proved k n i.ker hZ (ARRASM.CN0 k n i.ker hZ)) hj
    (pullbackK0RingHom (phiX k n i).inv x)
  rw [finitePushforward_iso (phiX k n i) (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker) i (phiX_comp k n i) x]
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (pushLocF3_iso (phiX k n i) (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker) i j
    (ARRASM.resA k n).res (phiX_comp k n i)), AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  show _ = pullLocF3 j (phiX k n i).inv _
  rw [map_mul, pullLocF3_alg, pullLoc_bott k n i hX j]
  congr 2
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (ARRASM.hψnat (phiX k n i).inv (ARRASM.rankZ k n i.ker)
    (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) hj) x).symm

name: GRRKG1.codim_pos_of_ne
statement:
theorem codim_pos_of_ne (hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range i) :
    0 < ARRASM.codim k n i.ker
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  rw [← range_ker k n i] at hy
  set c := ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker (genericPoint i.ker.subscheme) with hc
  have hcne : c ≠ genericPoint (space k n) := by
    intro h
    apply hy
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker)) :=
      (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hmem : genericPoint (space k n) ∈ Set.range (ARRASM.iZ k n i.ker) := ⟨_, h⟩
    have hsp : y ∈ closure ({genericPoint (space k n)} : Set (space k n)) := by
      rw [(genericPoint_spec (space k n)).def]; trivial
    exact closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem) hcl hsp
  have hle : c ≤ genericPoint (space k n) :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec (space k n)).specializes trivial)
  have hlt : c < genericPoint (space k n) := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge => hcne
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Order.coheight c :=
    le_trans le_add_self (Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt)
  have hfin : Order.coheight c ≠ ⊤ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_ne_top k (toSpec k n) c
  unfold ARRASM.codim
  rw [← hc]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hfin
  rw [← hm] at h1 ⊢
  have : 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast h1
  simp only [ENat.toNat_coe]
  omega

name: GRRKG1.adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed (hn : 0 < n) (hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range i)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap _ (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) j
          ((resSpec k).res (fG k n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)))) =
      kLocPush j k n hn (resSpec k).res
        (pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (adamsCotangentClass k n) -
                (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:=
  adamsRiemannRoch_of_inputs (adamsRRInputsField k n i hX hn hne j hj) x

name: GRRKG1.finiteY
statement:
theorem finiteY : ∀ F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules, F.IsFinitePresentation →
