name: GRRKG1.g0_eq_euler_smul
statement:
theorem g0_eq_euler_smul (g : G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    g = g0Euler k (finiteY k) g • k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (AddMonoidHom.id (G0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) =
      (zmultiplesHom _ (k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1)).comp (g0Euler k (finiteY k)) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
    intro E
    have hE : ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E = g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2 := rfl
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.id_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [hE, g0Euler_g0ClassOf, zmultiplesHom_apply]
    exact spec_g0ClassOf_eq_eulerChar_smul k E.1 E.2
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h g

name: GRRKG1.g0Euler_fG
statement:
theorem g0Euler_fG (hn : 0 < n) (x : G0 X) :
    g0Euler k (finiteY k) (fG k n hn i x) =
      g0Euler k (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k n hn i hover) x
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := DFunLike.congr_fun (SchemeProjectiveSpace.g0Euler_comp_projectiveDerivedPushforward k n hn)
    (finitePushforward i x)
  have hi := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_g0Euler k n hn i hover
      (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k n hn i hover)) x
  rw [← fG_eq, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at hπ hi
  exact hπ.trans hi

name: GRRKG1.zsmul_one_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem zsmul_one_k0ToG0 (m : ℤ) :
    m • k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1 =
      k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (m : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : ℤ) • k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1 =
      k0ToG0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ((n : ℤ) : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, map_add, ← ih, add_zsmul, one_zsmul]
  rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg m with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
  · exact hnat n
  · rw [neg_zsmul, Int.cast_neg, map_neg, hnat n]

name: GRRKG1.res_fG_eq_intCast
statement:
theorem res_fG_eq_intCast (hn : 0 < n) (x : K0 X) :
    (resSpec k).res (fG k n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)) =
      ((g0Euler k (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k n hn i hover) (k0ToG0 X x) : ℤ) : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
proof:
:= by
  set g := fG k n hn i (k0ToG0 X x)
  have hb := k0ToG0_bijective_spec_field k
  apply hb.1
  have h1 : k0ToG0 _ ((resSpec k).res g) = g := DFunLike.congr_fun (resSpec k).right g
  rw [h1, g0_eq_euler_smul k g, g0Euler_fG k n i hover hn]
  generalize g0Euler k _ (k0ToG0 X x) = m
  exact zsmul_one_k0ToG0 k m

name: GRRKG1.adamsRiemannRoch_euler
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_euler (hn : 0 < n) (hne : ∃ y : space k n, y ∉ Set.range i)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    algebraMap (K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (KLoc j (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        ((g0Euler k (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
          k n hn i hover) (k0ToG0 X x) : ℤ) : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) =
      kLocPush j k n hn (resSpec k).res
        (pushLocF3 j i (ARRASM.resA k n).res
          (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X) j x) *
            (((SchemeKTheory.bott j X (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral X)
              (HnilXF18.lambdaNilpotent_of_closedImmersion k n i)
              (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom i (adamsCotangentClass k n) -
                (SchemeKTheory.F14.conormalDataOfRegular k n i hX).conormalClass)))⁻¹ :
              (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := adamsRiemannRoch_regularClosed k n i hX hn hne hj x
  rw [res_fG_eq_intCast k n i hover hn x, map_intCast] at h
  rw [← h]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection_res
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection_res
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) {U V : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Opens}
    (h : V ≤ U)
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d, U)) (q : Q) :
    (projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Q) d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE h).op
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection R Q n d U y q) =
      projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection R Q n d V
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE h).op y) q
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let N := projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let P :=
    SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X O ⊗
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X N
  let eQ :=
    (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app
      (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let unitPull :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).unit.app B
  let qTop := unitPull.app ⊤ (eQ.hom q)
  have hU :
      U ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := by
    simp
  have hV :
      V ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) :=
    h.trans hU
  let qU := N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op qTop
  let qV := N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op qTop
  have hq :
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op qU = qV := by
    dsimp only [qU, qV]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    congr 1
  let η := (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P
  have hnat := η.naturality (homOfLE h).op
  have hnatx := CategoryTheory.congr_fun hnat
    (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU)
  have hP :
      P.map (homOfLE h).op (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU) =
        (O.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op y) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V)] qV := by
    calc
      P.map (homOfLE h).op (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU) =
          (O.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op y) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V)]
            (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op qU) := by
        exact PresheafOfModules.Monoidal.tensorObj_map_tmul
          (R := X.presheaf)
          (M₁ := SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X O)
          (M₂ := SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X N)
          (homOfLE h).op y qU
      _ = (O.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op y) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V)] qV := by
        rw [hq]
  change
    (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification X ⋙
        SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj P).map
          (homOfLE h).op)
        (η.app (op U) (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU)) =
      η.app (op V)
        ((O.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op y) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V)] qV)
  rw [← hP]
  exact hnatx.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpen_toSpec
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpen_toSpec
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    let V
proof:
:= coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
    let φ :=
      structureRingHom
        (X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V
    V.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) =
      V.ι ≫ toSpec R n := by
  dsimp only
  unfold structureRingHom globalSec
  change
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a).toSpecΓ ≫
        Spec.map
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
            (toSpec R n).appTop ≫
            (space R n).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (show coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a ≤ ⊤
                from le_top)).op) =
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a).ι ≫ toSpec R n
  rw [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_top_assoc
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)
    (Spec.map (toSpec R n).appTop)]
  rw [← Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality (toSpec R n)]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [toSpecΓ_SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_inv, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackCoefficientAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackCoefficientAddEquiv_tmul

:=

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv_tmul
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))
    (m : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv R Q n p a
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      s • coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv R Q n p a
        ((1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
          coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)) ⊗ₜ[R] m)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
  let S := Γ(X, V)
  let φ : R →+* S :=
    structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R Q
  letI : B.IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation (R := CommRingCat.of R) (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let E : AffineQuasicoherent (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    ⟨B, inferInstance⟩
  change
    (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso φ E).hom (s ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      s • (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso φ E).hom
        ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m)
  have ht :
      (s ⊗ₜ[R, φ] m :
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj
          ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj E.obj)) =
        s • ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R, φ] m) := by
    rw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.smul_tmul, mul_one]
  rw [ht]
  exact (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso φ E).hom.hom.map_smul _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv_eq_map
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv_eq_map
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (z : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) ⊗[R]
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
          (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)))) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv R Q n p a z =
      affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap
        (structureRingHom
          (X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))
        (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)) z
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
  let S := Γ(X, V)
  let φ : R →+* S :=
    structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Q :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R Q
  letI : B.IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation (R := CommRingCat.of R) (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let E : AffineQuasicoherent (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    ⟨B, inferInstance⟩
  change
    (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsIso φ E).hom z =
      affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap φ E.obj z
  rw [affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_eq_iso_hom]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictAppIso_hom_cast_top_eq_restrictAdjunction_unit
statement:
theorem restrictAppIso_hom_cast_top_eq_restrictAdjunction_unit
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsIso i]
    (M : Y.Modules) (z : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    let h : i ''ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens) = (⊤ : Y.Opens)
proof:
:= by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange,
        Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso]
    (M.restrictAppIso i ⊤).hom
        (AddEquiv.cast
          (congrArg (fun W : Y.Opens => Γ(M, W)) h.symm) z) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction i).unit.app M).app ⊤ z := by

statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackSpecTransport_unit
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (m : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackSpecTransportAddEquiv R Q n p a
        (affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap
          (structureRingHom
            (X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R)
            (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))
          (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))
          ((1 : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
            coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)) ⊗ₜ[R] m)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        ((coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a).ι ≫ toSpec R n)).unit.app
          (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))).app ⊤ m
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
  let S := Γ(X, V)
  let φ : R →+* S :=
    structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let f : V.toScheme ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) := V.ι ≫ toSpec R n
  let PSpec := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj B
  let PV := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj B
  let hV : IsAffineOpen V := by
    change IsAffine (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a).toScheme
    rw [← coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a]
    exact coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a
  have hSpec : hV.isoSpec.hom ≫ g = f := by
    exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_toSpec R n p a
  let adjComp :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction hV.isoSpec.hom)
  let ePush :
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward hV.isoSpec.hom ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward g ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward f :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp hV.isoSpec.hom g ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hSpec
  let adjComp' := adjComp.ofNatIsoRight ePush
  let adjF := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  let eGeo :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hV.isoSpec.hom).obj PSpec ≅ PV :=
    (adjComp'.leftAdjointUniq adjF).app B

      hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) =
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens) := by
    calc
      hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) =
          hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ
            (hV.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ
              (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens)) := by
              rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
      _ = hV.isoSpec.hom.opensRange ⊓
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens) :=
        Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf hV.isoSpec.hom _
      _ = ⊤ := by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso, top_inf_eq]
  let eSpecCast :
      Γ(PSpec, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens)) ≃+
        Γ(PSpec, hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg
        (fun W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens => Γ(PSpec, W))
        himageSpec.symm)
  let eSpecRestrict :=
    (PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  let eGeoApp :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      eGeo).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv
  rw [affineQCPullbackGlobalSectionsMap_one_tmul]
  change
    eGeoApp (eSpecRestrict
      (eSpecCast
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app B).app
          ⊤ m))) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app B).app ⊤ m
  let z :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app B).app ⊤ m
  have hRestrict :
      eSpecRestrict (eSpecCast z) =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction hV.isoSpec.hom).unit.app
          PSpec).app ⊤ z := by
    exact
      restrictAppIso_hom_cast_top_eq_restrictAdjunction_unit
        hV.isoSpec.hom PSpec z
  rw [hRestrict]
  have huniq :=
    Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app adjComp' adjF B
  have htop := congrArg (fun q =>
    q.app (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) huniq
  have hm := CategoryTheory.congr_fun htop m
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_obj_obj, Opens.map_top, Functor.id_obj,
    Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight_unit, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Adjunction.comp_unit_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Category.assoc,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app, homOfLE_leOfHom,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_base, Opens.map_comp_obj, eqToHom_refl, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, adjComp', adjComp,
    ePush] at hm
  change
    eGeoApp
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction hV.isoSpec.hom).unit.app
          PSpec).app ⊤ z) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app B).app
        ⊤ m at hm
  exact hm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackProjectiveTransport_unit
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackProjectiveTransport_unit
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (m : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackProjectiveTransportAddEquiv
        R Q n p a
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          ((coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a).ι ≫ toSpec R n)).unit.app
            (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))).app ⊤ m) =
      (projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show
          coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a ≤
            toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) by
          simp)).op
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (toSpec R n)).unit.app
            (projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q))).app ⊤ m)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let t := toSpec R n
  let f : V.toScheme ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) := V.ι ≫ t
  let PV := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj B
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback t).obj B
  let K := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj F
  let adjComp :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction t).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.ι)
  let ePush :
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward t ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward f :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι t
  let adjComp' := adjComp.ofNatIsoRight ePush
  let adjF := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  let eProjective : K ≅ PV :=
    (adjComp'.leftAdjointUniq adjF).app B
  let eProjectiveApp :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      eProjective.symm).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv
  let eProjectiveRestrict :=
    ((F.restrictAppIso V.ι ⊤).symm).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  have himageV :
      V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) = V :=
    V.ι_image_top
  let eProjectiveCast :
      Γ(F, V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)) ≃+ Γ(F, V) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(F, W)) himageV)
  change
    eProjectiveCast
        (eProjectiveRestrict
          (eProjectiveApp
            (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
              B).app ⊤ m))) =
      F.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show
          V ≤ t ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) by
          simp)).op
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction t).unit.app B).app
          ⊤ m)
  let qTop :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction t).unit.app B).app ⊤ m
  let rTop :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.ι).unit.app F).app ⊤ qTop
  have huniq :=
    Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app adjComp' adjF B
  have htop := congrArg (fun q =>
    q.app (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens)) huniq
  have hm := CategoryTheory.congr_fun htop m
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_obj_obj, Opens.map_top, Functor.id_obj,
    Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight_unit, NatTrans.comp_app, Adjunction.comp_unit_app,
    Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Category.assoc, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app, Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app,
    homOfLE_leOfHom, Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp,
    AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, adjComp', adjComp, ePush] at hm
  change
    eProjective.hom.app ⊤ rTop =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app B).app
        ⊤ m at hm
  have hmInv := congrArg
    (fun x => eProjective.inv.app ⊤ x) hm
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hmInv
  have hid := congrArg (fun q => q.app (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens))
    eProjective.hom_inv_id
  change
    eProjective.hom.app ⊤ ≫ eProjective.inv.app ⊤ = 𝟙 _ at hid
  rw [hid] at hmInv
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.id_apply] at hmInv
  have hApp :
      eProjectiveApp
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app B).app
            ⊤ m) =
        rTop := by
    change
      eProjective.inv.app ⊤
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app B).app
            ⊤ m) =
        rTop
    exact hmInv.symm
  rw [hApp]
  change
    AddEquiv.cast
        (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(F, W)) himageV) rTop =
      F.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show
          V ≤ t ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) by
          simp)).op qTop
  have hcast :=
    SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
      F.presheaf himageV rTop
  rw [hcast]
  dsimp only [rTop]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  change F.presheaf.map _ (F.presheaf.map _ qTop) =
    F.presheaf.map _ qTop
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackTransport_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackTransport_smul
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))

          (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))))).obj

        R Q n p a

        R Q n p a

          R Q n p a z)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
  let S := Γ(X, V)
  let φ : R →+* S :=
    structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of R) V
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let t := toSpec R n
  let f : V.toScheme ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) := V.ι ≫ t
  let PSpec := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj B
  let PV := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj B
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback t).obj B
  let K := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj F
  let hV : IsAffineOpen V := by
    change IsAffine (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a).toScheme
    rw [← coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a]
    exact coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine R n p a
  have hSpec : hV.isoSpec.hom ≫ g = f := by
    exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_toSpec R n p a
  let adjSpecComp :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction hV.isoSpec.hom)
  let eSpecPush :
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward hV.isoSpec.hom ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward g ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward f :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp hV.isoSpec.hom g ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hSpec
  let adjSpecComp' := adjSpecComp.ofNatIsoRight eSpecPush
  let adjF := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  let eGeo :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hV.isoSpec.hom).obj PSpec ≅ PV :=
    (adjSpecComp'.leftAdjointUniq adjF).app B
  have himageSpec :
      hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) =
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens) := by
    calc
      hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) =
          hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ
            (hV.isoSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ
              (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens)) := by
              rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
      _ = hV.isoSpec.hom.opensRange ⊓
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens) :=
        Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf hV.isoSpec.hom _
      _ = ⊤ := by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso, top_inf_eq]
  let eSpecCast :
      Γ(PSpec, (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens)) ≃+
        Γ(PSpec, hV.isoSpec.hom ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg
        (fun W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).Opens => Γ(PSpec, W))
        himageSpec.symm)
  let eSpecRestrict :=
    (PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  let eGeoApp :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      eGeo).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv
  let adjProjectiveComp :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction t).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.ι)
  let eProjectivePush :
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward t ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward f :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι t
  let adjProjectiveComp' :=
    adjProjectiveComp.ofNatIsoRight eProjectivePush
  let eProjective : K ≅ PV :=
    (adjProjectiveComp'.leftAdjointUniq adjF).app B
  let eProjectiveApp :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      eProjective.symm).toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv
  let eProjectiveRestrict :=
    ((F.restrictAppIso V.ι ⊤).symm).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  have himageV :
      V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) = V :=
    V.ι_image_top
  let eProjectiveCast :
      Γ(F, V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)) ≃+ Γ(F, V) :=
    AddEquiv.cast
      (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens => Γ(F, W)) himageV)
  change
    eProjectiveCast
        (eProjectiveRestrict
          (eProjectiveApp
            (eGeoApp
              (eSpecRestrict
                (eSpecCast (s • z)))))) =
      s •
        eProjectiveCast
          (eProjectiveRestrict
            (eProjectiveApp
              (eGeoApp
                (eSpecRestrict

  have hSpecStage :
      eGeoApp (eSpecRestrict (eSpecCast (s • z))) =
        V.topIso.inv s •
          eGeoApp (eSpecRestrict (eSpecCast z)) := by
    have htopMap :
        (Spec
          Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
            coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).presheaf.map

                coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).Opens).leTop.op

          coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).presheaf.map_id]
      erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
    rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
    dsimp only [eSpecCast]
    rw [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.module_sections_cast_smul
      PSpec himageSpec.symm]
    rw [htopMap]
    have hscalarSpec :
        AddEquiv.cast
            (congrArg
              (fun W : (Spec
                Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                  coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).Opens =>
                Γ(Spec
                  Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                    coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a), W))

            (eqToHom
              (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq hV.isoSpec.hom
                (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)).symm).op =

        Subsingleton.elim _ _

      change
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso
            Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
              coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).inv ≫
          hV.isoSpec.hom.appTop).hom s) =
            V.topIso.inv s
      rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom_appTop]
      simp

    have hscalarSpecSmul :

                (fun W : (Spec
                  Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                    coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).Opens =>
                  Γ(Spec
                    Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                      coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a), W))
                himageSpec.symm)
              ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso
                Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                  coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).inv s) •
            AddEquiv.cast
              (congrArg
                (fun W : (Spec
                  Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                    coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).Opens =>
                  Γ(PSpec, W))

                (fun W : (Spec
                  Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                    coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).Opens =>

    let rCast :

          Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
            coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a),

        (congrArg
          (fun W : (Spec
            Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
              coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)).Opens =>
            Γ(Spec
              Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
                coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a), W))

      AddEquiv.cast
        (congrArg
          (fun W : (Spec
            Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,

    have hscalarSpecSmul' :
        rCast • xCast =
          (hV.isoSpec.hom.appIso ⊤).inv (V.topIso.inv s) • xCast := by
      exact hscalarSpecSmul
    dsimp only [eSpecRestrict, eGeoApp]
    change
      eGeo.hom.app ⊤
          ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom

        V.topIso.inv s •
          eGeo.hom.app ⊤
            ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
              xCast)
    calc
      _ = eGeo.hom.app ⊤
          ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
            ((hV.isoSpec.hom.appIso ⊤).inv (V.topIso.inv s) •
              xCast)) := congrArg
                (fun w =>
                  eGeo.hom.app ⊤
                    ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom w))
                hscalarSpecSmul'
      _ = V.topIso.inv s •
          eGeo.hom.app ⊤
            ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
              xCast) := by
        change
          eGeo.hom.app ⊤
              ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
                (V.topIso.inv s •
                  (show Γ(PSpec.restrict hV.isoSpec.hom, ⊤) from
                    xCast))) =
            V.topIso.inv s •
              eGeo.hom.app ⊤
                ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
                  (show Γ(PSpec.restrict hV.isoSpec.hom, ⊤) from
                    xCast))
        rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply]
        change
          eGeo.hom.app ⊤
              (V.topIso.inv s •
                (show Γ(PSpec.restrict hV.isoSpec.hom, ⊤) from
                  (PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
                    xCast)) =
            V.topIso.inv s •
              eGeo.hom.app ⊤
                ((PSpec.restrictAppIso hV.isoSpec.hom ⊤).hom
                  xCast)
        rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  have hProjectiveRestrictCast
      (y : Γ(K, ⊤)) :
      eProjectiveCast (eProjectiveRestrict y) =
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso
          F V).hom y := by
    dsimp only [eProjectiveRestrict, eProjectiveCast,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso]
    rw [SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.presheaf_cast_eq_map
      F.presheaf himageV]
    rfl
  let w := eGeoApp (eSpecRestrict (eSpecCast z))
  have hProjectiveAppSmul :
      eProjectiveApp (V.topIso.inv s • w) =
        V.topIso.inv s • eProjectiveApp w := by
    dsimp only [eProjectiveApp]
    exact Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul eProjective.inv
      (V.topIso.inv s) w
  calc
    eProjectiveCast
        (eProjectiveRestrict
          (eProjectiveApp
            (eGeoApp (eSpecRestrict (eSpecCast (s • z)))))) =
      eProjectiveCast
        (eProjectiveRestrict
          (eProjectiveApp (V.topIso.inv s • w))) := congrArg
            (fun q =>
              eProjectiveCast
                (eProjectiveRestrict (eProjectiveApp q)))
            hSpecStage
    _ = eProjectiveCast
        (eProjectiveRestrict
          (V.topIso.inv s • eProjectiveApp w)) := congrArg
            (fun q => eProjectiveCast (eProjectiveRestrict q))
            hProjectiveAppSmul
    _ = (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso
          F V).hom
        (V.topIso.inv s • eProjectiveApp w) :=
      hProjectiveRestrictCast _
    _ = V.topIso.hom (V.topIso.inv s) •
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso
          F V).hom (eProjectiveApp w) :=
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso_hom_smul
        F V (V.topIso.inv s) (eProjectiveApp w)
    _ = s •
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineOpenRestrictTopSectionsIso
          F V).hom (eProjectiveApp w) := by
      rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
    _ = s •
        eProjectiveCast
          (eProjectiveRestrict (eProjectiveApp w)) := congrArg
            (fun q => s • q)
            (hProjectiveRestrictCast (eProjectiveApp w)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAddEquiv_tmul
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Γ(ProjectiveTwistSpace R n,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))
    (q : Q) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAddEquiv R Q n p a
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] q) =
      s • projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
        R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q
proof:
:= by
  change
    coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackProjectiveTransportAddEquiv
      R Q n p a
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackSpecTransportAddEquiv
        R Q n p a
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv
          R Q n p a
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackCoefficientAddEquiv
            R Q n p a (s ⊗ₜ[R] q)))) =
      s • projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
        R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackCoefficientAddEquiv_tmul]
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv_tmul]
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackTransport_smul]
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackAffineAddEquiv_eq_map]
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackSpecTransport_unit]
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenBasePullbackProjectiveTransport_unit]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overEquiv_map_app_heq
statement:
private theorem overEquiv_map_app_heq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}

    (q : M.over U ⟶ N.over U)
    (m : (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj
      (M.over U)).val.obj (op W))) :
    HEq (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map q).val.app
      (op W) m)
      (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) m)
proof:

    TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOver

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq
proof:
:= U
    let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
    let W : S.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let hImage : f ''ᵁ W = V := by
      dsimp only [f, W]
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
        Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
      exact hVU
    let mImage : M.val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ W)) := by
      rw [hImage]
      exact m
    let mRestr : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).val.obj
        (op W) := mImage
    let qRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj N :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map q ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app N).hom
    HEq (qRestr.val.app (op W) mRestr)
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : (U : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
  let hImage : f ''ᵁ W = V := by
    dsimp only [f, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hVU
  let mImage : M.val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ W)) := by
    rw [hImage]
    exact m
  let mRestr : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).val.obj
      (op W) := mImage
  let αM := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let αN := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app N
  let t := αM.inv.val.app (op W) mRestr
  let r := ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map q).val.app
    (op W) t
  let z := αN.hom.val.app (op W) r
  change HEq z (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m)
  have hz : HEq z r :=
    overFunctorEquiv_hom_app_heq U W r
  have hr : HEq r
      (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) t) :=
    overEquiv_map_app_heq U W q t
  have ht : HEq t mRestr :=
    overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq U W mRestr
  have hm : HEq mRestr m := by
    simp [mRestr, mImage]
  have hObj : U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W =
      Over.mk (homOfLE hVU) := by
    refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ hImage ?_
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hlast : HEq
      (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) t)
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m) :=
    presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq q.val
      (congrArg op hObj) t m (ht.trans hm)
  exact hz.trans (hr.trans hlast)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app
statement:
private theorem projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a)) :
    let X
proof:
:= ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
    let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let j := coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a
    let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
    let hU : U ≤ coordinateOpen R n j := by
      dsimp only [U, j]
      rw [coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a]
      exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen R n p a
    let W : Over (coordinateOpen R n j) := Over.mk (homOfLE hU)
    let c : Γ(X, U) :=
      (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
        R n d j).hom.val.app (op W) y
    c =
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).inv
        (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv R n d p a y) := by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let j := coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a
  let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let unitX := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X
  have hU : U ≤ coordinateOpen R n j := by
    dsimp only [U, j]
    rw [coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a]
    exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen R n p a
  let W : Over (coordinateOpen R n j) := Over.mk (homOfLE hU)
  let E := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (coordinateOpen R n j)
  let eF : E.functor.obj (O.over (coordinateOpen R n j)) ≅
      E.functor.obj (unitX.over (coordinateOpen R n j)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (coordinateOpen R n j)).app O ≪≫
      (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d j).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso
        (coordinateOpen R n j).ι).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv
        (coordinateOpen R n j)).app unitX).symm
  let q : O.over (coordinateOpen R n j) ≅
      unitX.over (coordinateOpen R n j) :=
    E.unitIso.app (O.over (coordinateOpen R n j)) ≪≫
      E.inverse.mapIso eF ≪≫
      E.unitIso.symm.app (unitX.over (coordinateOpen R n j))
  have hmain := overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq hU q.hom y
  dsimp only at hmain
  have hround :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateEquiv_roundtrip (R := R) n d j
  dsimp only at hround
  rw [hround] at hmain
  dsimp only
  apply (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.injective
  refine @Eq.trans _ _ (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv
    R n d p a y) _ ?_ ?_
  · change
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
          unitX p a).hom.hom
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheafOverIso X
            (coordinateOpen R n j)).inv.val.app (op W)
          (q.hom.val.app (op W) y)) =
        (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv R n p a).symm
          ((coordinateCechTwistingFrameAppIso R n d p a).inv.hom
            (coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv R n d p a
              ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
                O p a).hom.hom y)))
    have hleft : HEq
        ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
            unitX p a).hom.hom
          ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheafOverIso X
              (coordinateOpen R n j)).inv.val.app (op W)
            (q.hom.val.app (op W) y)))
        (q.hom.val.app (op W) y) := by
      change HEq
        (X.presheaf.map
          (eqToIso
            (coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a)).op.inv
          (q.hom.val.app (op W) y))
        (q.hom.val.app (op W) y)
      exact heq_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv
        (X := X) (coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a) _
    have hpre := hleft.trans hmain.symm
    exact eq_of_heq (hpre.trans (by
      let f := (coordinateOpen R n j).ι
      let A := f ⁻¹ᵁ U
      let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
      let B := coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart R n p a
      let hUV : U = V :=
        coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a
      have hImageA : f ''ᵁ A = U := by
        dsimp only [f, A]
        rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
          Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
        exact hU
      let yA : Γ(O, f ''ᵁ A) := by
        rw [hImageA]
        exact y
      have hAB : A = B := by
        dsimp only [A, B, U, V, f, j,
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart]
        exact congrArg
          (fun T ↦ (coordinateOpen R n
            (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ⁻¹ᵁ T) hUV
      have hImageB : f ''ᵁ B = V := by
        dsimp only [f, B, V, j]
        exact coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image R n p a
      let xV : Γ(O, V) :=
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n O p a).hom.hom y
      have hxV : HEq xV y := by
        change HEq (O.presheaf.map (eqToIso hUV).op.inv y) y
        exact module_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv hUV y
      let xB : Γ(O, f ''ᵁ B) :=
        O.presheaf.map (eqToIso hImageB).op.hom xV
      have hxB : HEq xB xV :=
        heq_module_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_hom hImageB xV
      have hyA : HEq yA y := by
        change HEq
          (Eq.mpr
            (congrArg (fun T : X.Opens ↦ (Γ(O, T) : Type u)) hImageA)
            (show Γ(O, U) from y)) y
        exact cast_heq _ _
      have hsource : HEq yA xB :=
        hyA.trans (hxV.symm.trans hxB.symm)
      have hImageAB : f ''ᵁ A = f ''ᵁ B :=
        congrArg (fun T ↦ f ''ᵁ T) hAB
      let K :=
        Limits.kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft R n -
          coordinateDescentRight R n d)
      let Pj :=
        Limits.Pi.π (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n)
            (coordinateOpen R n i)) j
      let rawA := Pj.app (f ''ᵁ A) (K.app (f ''ᵁ A) yA)
      let rawB := Pj.app (f ''ᵁ B) (K.app (f ''ᵁ B) xB)
      have hK : HEq (K.app (f ''ᵁ A) yA)
          (K.app (f ''ᵁ B) xB) :=
        modules_hom_app_heq K hImageAB yA xB hsource
      have hraw : HEq rawA rawB :=
        modules_hom_app_heq Pj hImageAB
          (K.app (f ''ᵁ A) yA) (K.app (f ''ᵁ B) xB) hK
      rw [coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq,
        coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_app_eq]
      unfold coordinateCechTwistingFrameAppIso
      change HEq
        ((f.appIso A).inv
          ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso R n d j).inv.val.app
            (op A) yA)) _
      dsimp only [f]
      simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
      unfold projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso
      change HEq ((localFrameProjection R n d j).app A yA) _
      rw [localFrameProjection_app_eq R n d j A yA]
      rw [localFrameProjection_app_eq]
      have hwrapA : HEq
          ((unitModules (coordinateOpen R n j).toScheme).presheaf.map
            (eqToHom
              ((coordinateOpen R n j).ι.preimage_image_eq A).symm).op
            rawA) rawA :=
        heq_presheaf_map_eqToHom_op
          (X := (coordinateOpen R n j).toScheme) _ rawA
      let innerB :=
        (unitModules (coordinateOpen R n j).toScheme).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom
            ((coordinateOpen R n j).ι.preimage_image_eq B).symm).op
          rawB
      have hinnerB : HEq innerB rawB :=
        heq_presheaf_map_eqToHom_op
          (X := (coordinateOpen R n j).toScheme) _ rawB
      have houterB : HEq
          (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hImageB).op.inv innerB) innerB :=
        heq_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv
          (X := X) hImageB innerB
      exact hwrapA.trans
        (hraw.trans (houterB.trans hinnerB).symm)))
  · exact ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).inv_hom_id_apply _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection_eq
statement:
private theorem projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection_eq
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : Q) :
    let X
proof:
:= ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
    let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
    let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
    let N := projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q)
    let eQ :=
      (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app
        (ModuleCat.of R Q)
    let unitPull :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (toSpec R n)).unit.app B
    let qTop := unitPull.app ⊤ (eQ.hom q)
    let hUTop :
        U ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := by simp
    let qU := N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUTop).op qTop
    qU =
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n N p a).inv
        (projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
          R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q) := by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let V := coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let N := projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let eQ :=
    (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app
      (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let unitPull :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (toSpec R n)).unit.app B
  let qTop := unitPull.app ⊤ (eQ.hom q)
  have hUTop :
      U ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := by simp
  have hVTop :
      V ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := by simp
  let hEq : U = V :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a
  change
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUTop).op qTop =
      N.presheaf.map (eqToHom hEq).op
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVTop).op qTop)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechToPullbackAddEquiv_pure
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechToPullbackAddEquiv_pure
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (q : Q) :
    projectiveTwistingBaseModuleCechToPullbackAddEquiv R Q n d p a
        (projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection
          R Q n d (coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) y q) =
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
        (projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q))
        p a).inv
        (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv R n d p a y •
          projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
            R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let j := coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a
  let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let N := projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let P :=
    SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X O ⊗
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X N
  let eQ :=
    (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app
      (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let unitPull :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).unit.app B
  let qTop := unitPull.app ⊤ (eQ.hom q)
  have hUTop :
      U ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := by
    simp
  let qU := N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUTop).op qTop
  let η := (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P
  have hU : U ≤ coordinateOpen R n j := by
    dsimp only [U, j]
    rw [coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen R n p a]
    exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen R n p a
  let W : Over (coordinateOpen R n j) :=
    { left := U
      right := ⟨PUnit.unit⟩
      hom := homOfLE hU }
  have hW : W = Over.mk (homOfLE hU) := by
    refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ rfl ?_
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  let e := projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateIso R n N d j
  let eApp := (SheafOfModules.evaluation
    (X.ringCatSheaf.over (coordinateOpen R n j)) (op W)).mapIso e
  change
    eApp.hom (η.app (op U) (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU)) =
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n N p a).inv
        (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv R n d p a y •
          projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
            R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q)
  let c : Γ(X, U) :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
      R n d j).hom.val.app (op W) y
  have ht :
      eApp.hom (η.app (op U) (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU)) =
        c • qU := by
    dsimp only [eApp, e, projectiveTwistingTensorCoordinateIso, η, P, O]
    simpa only [c, W, U, X, O, P, η] using
      (tensorSheafOverCoordinate_pure
        (Y := X) (coordinateOpen R n j) W O N
          (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso R n d j) y qU)
  have hc :
      c =
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).inv
          (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv
            R n d p a y) := by
    dsimp only [c]
    have hApp : HEq
        ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
          R n d j).hom.val.app (op W) y)
        ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
          R n d j).hom.val.app
            (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hU))) y) :=
      presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
          R n d j).hom.val
        (congrArg op hW) y y (by rfl)
    have hFrame :
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso
          R n d j).hom.val.app
            (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hU))) y =
          (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).inv
            (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv
              R n d p a y) := by
      simpa only [X, U, j, O] using
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateOverIso_app
          (R := R) n d p a y)
    exact eq_of_heq (hApp.trans (heq_of_eq hFrame))
  have hq :
      qU =
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n N p a).inv
          (projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
            R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q) := by
    simpa only [qU, X, U, B, N, eQ, unitPull, qTop] using
      (projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection_eq
        (R := R) (Q := Q) n p a q)
  let unitRestr
      (s : Γ(X, coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)) : Γ(X, U) :=
    (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).inv s
  have hunit
      (s : Γ(X, coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)) :
      unitRestr s =
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) p a).inv s := by
    rfl
  have hsmul
      (s : Γ(X, coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a))
      (z : Γ(N, coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a)) :
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n N p a).inv
          (s • z) =
        unitRestr s •
          (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso R n N p a).inv z := by
    change N.val.map _ (s • z) = _
    rw [N.val.map_smul]
    rfl
  refine ht.trans ?_
  rw [hc, hq]
  rw [← hunit]
  exact (hsmul
    (coordinateCechTwistingFrameLinearEquiv R n d p a y)
    (projectiveBaseModulePullbackCoefficientSection
      R Q n (coordinateCechBasicOpen R n p a) q)).symm

statement:

    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechBaseModuleAddEquiv_coface
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))

        R Q n d p r a

proof:
:= by

    ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)).1,
      coordinateCechTwistingSectionsTensorBaseModuleAddEquiv
        R Q n d (p + 1) a
        (projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv
          R Q n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforward R Q n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechIntersectionCofaceHom R n p r a).op x)).2) =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d).presheaf.map

            R Q n d p (a ∘ r.succAbove)

  rw [projectiveSquareZeroTwistingPushforwardCechTwistSectionsTensorAddEquiv_coface]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection_smul
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (c : R)
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection R n p a))
    (q : Q) :
    projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection
        R Q n d (coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) (c • y) q =
      c • projectiveTwistingBaseModulePureTensorSection
        R Q n d (coordinateCechIntersection R n p a) y q
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let U := coordinateCechIntersection R n p a
  let O := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d
  let B := projectiveBaseModuleTilde R (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let N := projectiveBaseModulePullback R n (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let P :=
    SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X O ⊗
      SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X N
  let eQ :=
    (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app
      (ModuleCat.of R Q)
  let unitPull :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).unit.app B
  let qTop := unitPull.app ⊤ (eQ.hom q)
  have hU :
      U ≤ toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens) := by
    simp
  let qU := N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op qTop
  let η := (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P
  change
    η.app (op U)
        (((structureRingHom
          (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U c) • y) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU) =
      (structureRingHom
        (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of R) U c) •
        η.app (op U) (y ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] qU)
  rw [← (η.app (op U)).hom.map_smul]
  rfl

theorem projectiveTwisting_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

      ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf
        (toSpec R n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (i + 1)).obj
        (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  let V := toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let e := localizationOpenIso R g n
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf (Localization.Away g) n d
  have hF : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of

        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space (Localization.Away g) n)).obj F)
        (i + 1))) :=

        (i + 1))) :=

  have hrestrict : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of

        ((Modules.toSheafAb V.toScheme).obj

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.kernelMap_natural
statement:
theorem kernelMap_natural {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y)
    {T₀ T₁ T₀' T₁' : Y.Modules} {S₀ S₁ S₀' S₁' : X.Modules}
    (t : T₀ ⟶ T₁) (t' : T₀' ⟶ T₁') (s : S₀ ⟶ S₁) (s' : S₀' ⟶ S₁')
    (a : T₀ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj S₀)
    (b : T₁ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj S₁)
    (a' : T₀' ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj S₀')
    (b' : T₁' ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj S₁')
    (h : t ≫ b = a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map s)
    (h' : t' ≫ b' = a' ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map s')
    (u₀ : T₀ ⟶ T₀') (u₁ : T₁ ⟶ T₁') (v₀ : S₀ ⟶ S₀') (v₁ : S₁ ⟶ S₁')
    (hu : t ≫ u₁ = u₀ ≫ t') (hv : s ≫ v₁ = v₀ ≫ s')
    (ha : u₀ ≫ a' = a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map v₀) :
    kernel.map t t' u₀ u₁ hu ≫ SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap q t' s' a' b' h' =
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap q t s a b h ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (kernel.map s s' v₀ v₁ hv)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : kernel.map s s' v₀ v₁ hv ≫ kernel.ι s' = kernel.ι s ≫ v₀ := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
  have hk' : kernel.map t t' u₀ u₁ hu ≫ kernel.ι t' = kernel.ι t ≫ u₀ := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (kernel.ι s'))).1
  try simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap_ι, ← Functor.map_comp, hk, Functor.map_comp,
    ← Category.assoc, hk', Category.assoc, ha]
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap_ι_assoc]

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.nativeChartSelection_natural
statement:
theorem nativeChartSelection_natural :
    NativeFamily.chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) =
      nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (NativeFamily.chartSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext
  intro j
  have h1 := nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) j
  have h2 := NativeFamily.chartSelection_π 𝒜 f r j
  have h3 := nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg f (r j)
  have h4 := NativeFamily.chartSelection_π ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r j
  refine (congrArg (fun m => NativeFamily.chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ m) h1).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun m => m ≫ nativeChartPushedUnitMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) j) h2).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun m => nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f ≫ m)
    (Functor.map_comp _ _ _).symm)
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun m => nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map m) h4.symm)
  exact h3.symm

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.nativeKernelSelection_natural
statement:
theorem nativeKernelSelection_natural (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫ nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d =
      nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
proof:
:=
  kernelMap_natural (Proj.map g hg)
    (h := nativeChartCochainMap_differential 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d)
    (h' := nativeChartCochainMap_differential 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d)
    (hu := NativeFamily.selection_difference 𝒜 f r d)
    (hv := NativeFamily.selection_difference ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
    (ha := nativeChartSelection_natural 𝒜 ℬ g hg f r)

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection_natural
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection_natural (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d =
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv _ _)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫
        nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d) =
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫ nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint]
  have e2 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv _ _)
      (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
        NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d) =
      nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint]
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv _ _).injective
    (e1.trans ((nativeKernelSelection_natural 𝒜 ℬ g hg f r d).trans e2.symm))

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.projMap_comp_eq'
statement:
theorem projMap_comp_eq' (e : g'.comp g = g₃) :
    Proj.map g' hg' ≫ Proj.map g hg = Proj.map g₃ hk₃
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  exact projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk₃

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.mate_comp
statement:
theorem mate_comp (d : ℤ) (e : g'.comp g = g₃)
    [Mono (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 g₃ (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d)]
    (m : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).obj
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ⟶
      Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 => x) d)
    (hm : m ≫ NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 => x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d =
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d)
    (m' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).obj
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 => x) d) ⟶
      Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x) d)
    (hm' : m' ≫ NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x)) d =
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x) d)
    (m₃ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g₃ hk₃)).obj
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ⟶
      Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x) d)
    (hm₃ : m₃ ≫ NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 g₃ (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d =
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 g₃ hk₃ (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) :
    m₃ = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ e).symm).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ m'
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have hsel := nativeKernelSelection_comp 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x))
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d
  have hnat := nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection_natural ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d
  have s1 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
        (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
        nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d
      = (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
          (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 => x)
            (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) ≫
        nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) := by
    rw [← hm]
    exact (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg'
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) (Functor.map_comp _ _ _)).trans
      (Category.assoc _ _ _)
  have s2 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
          (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 => x)
            (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) ≫
        nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫
        (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x) d ≫
          NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x))
            (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) :=
    congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ z) hnat
  have s3 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫
        (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x) d ≫
          NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 => x))
            (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ m' ≫
        NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
          (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d := by
    rw [← hm']
    exact congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ z)
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun z => m' ≫ z) hsel))
  have key := (s1.trans s2).trans s3
  have A1 : m₃ ≫ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk₃).symm).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) :=
    hm₃.trans (nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk₃ (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d)
  have A2 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ (Eq.refl (g'.comp g))).symm).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ m')) ≫ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ (Eq.refl (g'.comp g))).symm).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ m' ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) := by
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have E : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ (Eq.refl (g'.comp g))).symm).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ (Eq.refl (g'.comp g))).symm).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map m ≫ m' ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d) := (congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ (Eq.refl (g'.comp g))).symm).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫ z) key)
  have hp : projMap_comp_eq' 𝒜 ℬ g hg 𝒞 g' hg' hk₃ (Eq.refl (g'.comp g)) = projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk₃ := rfl
  rw [← hp] at A1
  have z1 := E.trans A2.symm
  have z2 := A1.trans z1
  have z3 := (cancel_mono (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 => x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d)).1 z2
  exact z3

name: KernelRestrictionCompB4.pullbackCongr_hom_app_heq
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.b4_cong_conv
statement:
theorem b4_cong_conv {W U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : W ≤ U) (k : U ≤ V) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (nativeRestriction_scheme_comp Y J h k).symm).hom.app
        (affineNativeKernel Y J d V) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (KernelRestrictionCompB4.projMap_comp_eq'
      (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal U))
      (nativeGradedRestriction Y J k) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J k)
      (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal W)) (nativeGradedRestriction Y J h)
      (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J h) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J (h.trans k))
      (nativeRestriction_coeff_comp Y J h k)).symm).hom.app
        (InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.degreeOneSheaf (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V)) (fun x => x) d)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_heq (KernelRestrictionCompB4.pullbackCongr_hom_app_heq
    (rfl : _) (rfl : _) _ _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.nativeKernelRestrictionMate_comp
statement:
theorem nativeKernelRestrictionMate_comp {W U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : W ≤ U) (k : U ≤ V)
    (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J (h.trans k) d =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (nativeRestriction_scheme_comp Y J h k).symm).hom.app
        (affineNativeKernel Y J d V) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h) (boundaryRestriction Y J k)).inv.app
        (affineNativeKernel Y J d V) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (boundaryRestriction Y J h)).map
        (nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J k d) ≫
      nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J h d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono (NativeFamily.kernelSelection (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal W)) (fun x => x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal W))
        (nativeGradedRestriction Y J (h.trans k)) (fun x => x)) d) :=
    (inferInstance : Mono (NativeFamily.kernelSelection (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal W)) (fun x => x)
      (nativeRestrictionImageFamily Y J (h.trans k)) d))
  have hk := nativeKernelRestrictionMate_selection Y J k d
  have hh := nativeKernelRestrictionMate_selection Y J h d
  have hhk := nativeKernelRestrictionMate_selection Y J (h.trans k) d
  have z := KernelRestrictionCompB4.mate_comp (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V))
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal U))
    (nativeGradedRestriction Y J k) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J k)
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal W)) (nativeGradedRestriction Y J h)
    (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J h) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J (h.trans k))
    d (nativeRestriction_coeff_comp Y J h k)
    (nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J k d) (by b4norm at hk ⊢; exact hk)
    (nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J h d) (by b4norm at hh ⊢; exact hh)
    (nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J (h.trans k) d) (by b4norm at hhk ⊢; exact hhk)
  rw [b4_cong_conv Y J h k d]
  b4norm at z ⊢
  exact z

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.linearIndependent_conormalGen
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_conormalGen :
    LinearIndependent (R ⧸ I) x.conormalGen
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  choose a ha using fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := I) (g j)
  have hmem : ∑ j, a j * x.gen j ∈ I :=
    Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (x.gen_mem j)
  have hsum : I.toCotangent ⟨∑ j, a j * x.gen j, hmem⟩ = 0 := by
    rw [← hg]
    have : (⟨∑ j, a j * x.gen j, hmem⟩ : I) = ∑ j, a j • x.genMem j := by
      ext; simp [genMem]
    rw [this, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, ← ha j]
    rfl
  rw [Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero] at hsum
  let F : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R := ∑ j, monomial (Finsupp.single j 1) (a j)
  have hF : F.IsHomogeneous 1 := by
    refine MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.sum _ _ _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact isHomogeneous_monomial _ (by simp)
  have heval : MvPolynomial.eval x.gen F = ∑ j, a j * x.gen j := by
    simp [F, eval_monomial]
  have hcoeff := x.isQuasiregular 1 F hF (by rw [heval, x.span_eq]; simpa using hsum)
    (Finsupp.single i 1)
  rw [x.span_eq] at hcoeff
  have : F.coeff (Finsupp.single i 1) = a i := by
    simp only [F, coeff_sum, coeff_monomial]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [if_neg]
      intro h
      exact hj (Finsupp.single_left_injective one_ne_zero h)
    · simp
  rw [this] at hcoeff
  rw [← ha i]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hcoeff

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.span_conormalGen
statement:
theorem span_conormalGen :
    Submodule.span (R ⧸ I) (Set.range x.conormalGen) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro y
  obtain ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective y
  have hr' := hr
  rw [← x.span_eq] at hr'
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hr'
  have : (⟨r, hr⟩ : I) = ∑ j, c j • x.genMem j := by
    ext; simp [genMem, ← hc]
  rw [this, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  have : c j • x.conormalGen j = (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (c j)) • x.conormalGen j := rfl
  change c j • x.conormalGen j ∈ _
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.conormalComparison_bijective_of_nsToGr
statement:
theorem conormalComparison_bijective_of_nsToGr
    (h : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I)) :
    Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap A I)
proof:
:= by
  have he := AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_equiv A I
  have hf : (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap A I).comp
      (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafRingEquiv A I).toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I).toRingHom := he
  let e := AffineNormalCone.normalSheafRingEquiv A I
  have key (z : AffineNormalCone.normalSheafRing A I) :
      AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (e z) = AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I z :=
    RingHom.congr_fun hf z
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    have hk : e.symm a = e.symm b := h.injective (by
      rw [← key (e.symm a), ← key (e.symm b), e.apply_symm_apply, e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hab)
    exact e.symm.injective hk
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := h.surjective y
    exact ⟨e z, (key z).trans hz⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_ι
    (h : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I)) (m : I.Cotangent) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (m,a)) =
      Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded A I m) +
        Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom A I a) * Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map (conormalComparisonEquivOfBijective I h).toRingHom
    (symmetricPolynomialForward (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (m,a))) = _
  rw [symmetricPolynomialForward_ι, Algebra.smul_def, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply,
    Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C,
    Polynomial.map_X]
  change Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m)) +
    Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) * Polynomial.X = _
  rw [AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι, AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_base
    (h : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I)) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I h (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a) =
      Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom A I a)
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map (conormalComparisonEquivOfBijective I h).toRingHom
    (symmetricPolynomialForward (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) = _
  rw [AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply, Polynomial.map_C]
  exact congrArg Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_base A I a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_generator_grade
statement:
theorem polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_generator_grade
    (h : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I)) (m : I.Cotangent) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (m,a)) ∈
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_ι]
  apply (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I 1).add_mem
  · simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Polynomial.monomial_zero_left] using
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial I 1 0 _ (conormal_mem_grGrade_one I m)
  · rw [Polynomial.C_mul_X_eq_monomial]
    exact
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial I 0 1 _ (associatedGradedBase_mem_zero I a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_mem_grade
statement:
theorem polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_mem_grade
    (h : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I)) {n : ℕ} {p : normalBundleCompletionRing I}
    (hp : p ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) n) :
    polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I h p ∈ InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I n
proof:
:= by
  apply symmetric_map_mem_grade (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I)
    (polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I h).toRingHom ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro a
    change polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I h (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a) ∈ _
    rw [polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_base]
    simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Polynomial.monomial_zero_left] using
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial I 0 0 _ (associatedGradedBase_mem_zero I a)
  · rintro ⟨m,a⟩
    exact polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_generator_grade I h m a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.gradedComparison_inverse_comp
statement:
theorem gradedComparison_inverse_comp
    (h : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I)) :
