name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.polynomialComparison_restriction
statement:
theorem polynomialComparison_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (hA : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr A I))
    (hB : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr B J)) :
    (polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective J hB).toRingHom.comp (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h) =
      (normalBundlePolynomialRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I hA).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective J hB
      (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) =
      Polynomial.map (AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq I f J h)
        (polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I hA (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a))
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base, polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_base,
      polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_base, Polynomial.map_C, associatedGraded_base_naturality]
  | ι p =>
    rcases p with ⟨m,a⟩
    change polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective J hB
      (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (m,a))) =
      Polynomial.map (AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq I f J h)
        (polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective I hA (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (m,a)))
    rw [normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq_ι, polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_ι,
      polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective_ι, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X,
      conormal_associatedGraded_naturality, associatedGraded_base_naturality]
  | mul p q hp hq => simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg₂ (· * ·) hp hq
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hp hq

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.affineRefinement_conormalComparison_bijective
statement:
theorem affineRefinement_conormalComparison_bijective {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)

    Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialComparison_restriction
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomialComparison_restriction {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (hU : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)))
    (hV : Function.Bijective (AffineNormalCone.nsToGr Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V))) :
    (sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J U hU).toRingHom.comp
      (InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.actualPlusLineSectionsSymmetricRestriction Y J h) =
      (normalBundlePolynomialRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J V hV).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have hs := InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.conormalPlusLineChartSymmetric_naturality Y J h
  have hp := polynomialComparison_restriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
    (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) hV hU
  change (polynomialComparisonEquivOfBijective (J.ideal U) hU).toRingHom.comp
    ((symmetricCoordinateMap (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U)).toRingHom.comp _) = _
  rw [hs, ← RingHom.comp_assoc, hp, RingHom.comp_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialGradedComparison_comp_inverse

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialGradedInverse_comp_comparison

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialGradedInverse_original
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomialGradedInverse_original :
    letI
proof:
:= conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U x
    letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
    letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
    sectionPolynomialGradedInverse Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective =
      (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U).symm).comp
        (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse (J.ideal U) x) := by
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U x
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialProjIso_original
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionPolynomialProjIso_original :
    letI
proof:
:= conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U x
    letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
    letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
    (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective).hom =
      (chartSectionsProjIso Y J U x).inv ≫ (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal U) x).inv := by
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U x
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  change Proj.map (sectionPolynomialGradedInverse Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective) _ = _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.nativeSectionToComponent_original
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionToComponent_original :
    letI
proof:
:= conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x

    letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
    nativeSectionToComponent Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective = chartSectionsToComponent Y J U x := by
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x

  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialGradedRestriction_square
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomialGradedRestriction_square :
    (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J U hU).comp (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) =
      (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J V hV)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (sectionPolynomialComparison_restriction Y J h hU hV)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialGradedRestriction_route
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomialGradedRestriction_route :
    sectionGradedRestriction Y J h = (sectionPolynomialGradedInverse Y J U hU).comp
      ((InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J V hV))
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply (sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J U hU).injective
  change sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J U hU ((sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) p) =
    sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J U hU
      ((sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J U hU).symm
        ((normalBundlePolynomialRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
          (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)) (sectionPolynomialComparisonEquiv Y J V hV p)))
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (sectionPolynomialComparison_restriction Y J h hU hV) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.sectionPolynomialRestriction_irrelevant
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomialRestriction_irrelevant :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V))).map (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J V hV)
    (sectionPolynomialGradedInverse Y J V hV) (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison_comp_inverse Y J V hV)
  have hu := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (sectionPolynomialGradedInverse Y J U hU)
    (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J U hU) (sectionPolynomialGradedInverse_comp_comparison Y J U hU)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hv
    (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h))
  have hr := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ht hu
  rw [← sectionPolynomialGradedRestriction_route Y J h hU hV] at hr
  exact hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.nativeSectionProjRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionProjRestriction_comparison :
    InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) ≫ (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J V hV).inv =
      (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫ nativeSectionProjRestriction Y J h hU hV
proof:
:= by
  exact proj_map_actual_square _ _ _ _ (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h)
    (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J V hV) (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison Y J U hU)
    (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h))
    (sectionPolynomialRestriction_irrelevant Y J h hU hV)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison_comp_inverse Y J V hV))
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionPolynomialGradedComparison_comp_inverse Y J U hU))
    (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h))
    (sectionPolynomialGradedRestriction_square Y J h hU hV)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.nativeSectionProjRestriction_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionProjRestriction_toComponent :
    nativeSectionProjRestriction Y J h hU hV ≫ nativeSectionToComponent Y J V hV =
      nativeSectionToComponent Y J U hU
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J U hU).inv).mp
  change (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫
      nativeSectionProjRestriction Y J h hU hV ≫
      (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J V hV).hom ≫ InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent Y J V =
    (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫
      (sectionPolynomialProjIso Y J U hU).hom ≫ InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent Y J U
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← nativeSectionProjRestriction_comparison]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent Y J h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.affineRefinement_centreImage_le
statement:
theorem affineRefinement_centreImage_le (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    (J.subschemeCover.f U) ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := iq
  let g : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) ⟶ J.subscheme := C.chartCover.f i
  let ig : IsOpenImmersion g := C.chartCover.map_prop i
  exact @spectrumRefinementImage_le (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
    (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    J.subscheme q g iq ig (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h) (centreRefinement_toCentre Y J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.affineRefinement_sections_free
statement:
theorem affineRefinement_sections_free (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.Free (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := iq
  let W := @spectrumImageAffineOpen (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq
  have hw : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i := affineRefinement_centreImage_le Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hw
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (@spectrumImageSectionsEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq (conormalPlusLine Y J))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.affineRefinement_sections_finite
statement:
theorem affineRefinement_sections_finite (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.Finite (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := iq
  let W := @spectrumImageAffineOpen (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq
  have hw : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i := affineRefinement_centreImage_le Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hw
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective (@spectrumImageSectionsEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq (conormalPlusLine Y J)).toLinearMap (spectrumImageSectionsEquiv q (conormalPlusLine Y J)).surjective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.affineRefinement_cotangentPlusLine_free
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentDescent.affineRefinementSectionRestriction_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem affineRefinementSectionRestriction_toComponent (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    affineRefinementSectionRestriction Y J C i U h ≫ chartSectionsToComponent Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) =
      affineRefinementSectionToComponent Y J C i U h
proof:
:= by
  letI := affineRefinement_sections_free Y J C i U h
  letI := affineRefinement_sections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := affineRefinement_cotangentPlusLine_free Y J C i U h
  letI := affineRefinement_cotangentPlusLine_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  exact (congrArg (fun a => affineRefinementSectionRestriction Y J C i U h ≫ a)
    (nativeSectionToComponent_original Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).symm).trans

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.kernelSelectionNaturality
statement:
theorem kernelSelectionNaturality {𝒞 𝒟 : Type*} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] (P : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞)
    {K0 K0' C0 C0' U : 𝒞} {K1 K1' C1 C1' V : 𝒟}
    (sel0 : K0 ⟶ K0') (sel1 : K1 ⟶ K1')
    (ι0 : K0 ⟶ C0) (ι0' : K0' ⟶ C0') (ι1 : K1 ⟶ C1) (ι1' : K1' ⟶ C1')
    (π0 : C0 ⟶ U) (π0' : C0' ⟶ U) (π1 : C1 ⟶ V) (π1' : C1' ⟶ V)
    (χ : C0 ⟶ P.obj C1) (χ' : C0' ⟶ P.obj C1') (u : U ⟶ P.obj V)
    (a : K0 ⟶ P.obj K1) (a' : K0' ⟶ P.obj K1')
    (hs0 : sel0 ≫ ι0' ≫ π0' = ι0 ≫ π0) (hs1 : sel1 ≫ ι1' ≫ π1' = ι1 ≫ π1)
    (ha : a ≫ P.map ι1 = ι0 ≫ χ) (ha' : a' ≫ P.map ι1' = ι0' ≫ χ')
    (hχ : χ ≫ P.map π1 = π0 ≫ u) (hχ' : χ' ≫ P.map π1' = π0' ≫ u) :
    (sel0 ≫ a') ≫ P.map (ι1' ≫ π1') = (a ≫ P.map sel1) ≫ P.map (ι1' ≫ π1')
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (sel0 ≫ a') ≫ P.map (ι1' ≫ π1') = ι0 ≫ π0 ≫ u := by
    calc (sel0 ≫ a') ≫ P.map (ι1' ≫ π1') = sel0 ≫ (a' ≫ P.map ι1') ≫ P.map π1' := by
          simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      _ = sel0 ≫ (ι0' ≫ χ') ≫ P.map π1' := by rw [ha']
      _ = sel0 ≫ ι0' ≫ π0' ≫ u := by rw [Category.assoc, hχ']
      _ = (sel0 ≫ ι0' ≫ π0') ≫ u := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ι0 ≫ π0 ≫ u := by rw [hs0, Category.assoc]
  have e2 : (a ≫ P.map sel1) ≫ P.map (ι1' ≫ π1') = ι0 ≫ π0 ≫ u := by
    calc (a ≫ P.map sel1) ≫ P.map (ι1' ≫ π1') = a ≫ P.map (sel1 ≫ ι1' ≫ π1') := by
          simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      _ = (a ≫ P.map ι1) ≫ P.map π1 := by rw [hs1, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      _ = ι0 ≫ π0 ≫ u := by rw [ha, Category.assoc, hχ]
  exact e1.trans e2.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeKernelToPushforward_selection
statement:
theorem nativeKernelToPushforward_selection (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f0 r d ≫ nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d =
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) r d)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) d)))).1
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext
  intro j
  refine kernelSelectionNaturality (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg))
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f0 r d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) r d)
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f0 - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f0 d))
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f0 ∘ r) - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f0 ∘ r) d))
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) d))
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) d))
    (Pi.π (fun i : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f0 i))) (r j))
    (Pi.π (fun i : κ ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f0 (r i)))) j)
    (Pi.π (fun i : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj ℬ)
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 i))) (r j))
    (Pi.π (fun i : κ ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj ℬ)
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 (r i)))) j)
    (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0) (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r))
    (nativeChartPushedUnitMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 (r j))
    (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d) (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f0 r d j)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) r d j)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d)
    (nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 (r j))
    (nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) j)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection_naturality
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection_naturality (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f0 r d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d =
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) r d
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv
    (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f0 d)
    (Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) d)).injective
  have h1 : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f0 d)
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) d)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f0 r d) ≫
        nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d) =
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f0 r d ≫ nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    exact congrArg _ (nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f0 ∘ r) d)
  have h2 : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f0 d)
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0 ∘ r) d)
      (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d ≫
        NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) r d) =
      nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
          (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f0) r d) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    exact congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ _) (nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 d)
  exact h1.trans ((nativeKernelToPushforward_selection 𝒜 ℬ g hg f0 r d).trans h2.symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.allTargetComposition
statement:
theorem allTargetComposition {𝒞 𝒟 : Type*} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] (P : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞)
    {S Z Z1 Z2 : 𝒞} {V0 W W' : 𝒟}
    (cc : S ⟶ P.obj V0) (Hg : V0 ⟶ W) (Hg' : P.obj W ⟶ Z)
    (selB : W ⟶ W') (selC1 : Z ⟶ Z1) (selC2 : Z1 ⟶ Z2)
    (Hhat : V0 ⟶ W') (Hhat1 : P.obj W ⟶ Z1) (Hhat2 : P.obj W' ⟶ Z2) (Hgc : S ⟶ Z2)
    (hAB : Hg ≫ selB = Hhat) (hBC : Hg' ≫ selC1 = Hhat1)
    (hnat : P.map selB ≫ Hhat2 = Hhat1 ≫ selC2) (hcomp : cc ≫ P.map Hhat ≫ Hhat2 = Hgc) :
    (cc ≫ P.map Hg ≫ Hg') ≫ selC1 ≫ selC2 = Hgc
proof:
:= by
  calc (cc ≫ P.map Hg ≫ Hg') ≫ selC1 ≫ selC2 = cc ≫ P.map Hg ≫ (Hg' ≫ selC1) ≫ selC2 := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = cc ≫ P.map Hg ≫ Hhat1 ≫ selC2 := by rw [hBC]
    _ = cc ≫ P.map Hg ≫ P.map selB ≫ Hhat2 := by rw [hnat]
    _ = cc ≫ P.map (Hg ≫ selB) ≫ Hhat2 := by simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = Hgc := by rw [hAB, hcomp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp
statement:
theorem nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)))
    (hB : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ x)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg'))).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB =
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d hA
proof:
:= by
  haveI := allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d hA
  apply (cancel_mono (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) f) d)).1
  have hAB := inverseSelection_recovery (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d hA))
  have hBC := inverseSelection_recovery (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB))
  have hRHS := inverseSelection_recovery (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) f) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d hA))
  have hsel := InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.nativeKernelSelection_comp 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d
  have hnat := nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection_naturality ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d
  have hcomp := nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g hg g' hg' f d
  have key := allTargetComposition (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg'))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg'))).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d))
    (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d hA)
    (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 ((fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x) ∘ imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x))
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' ((fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) ∘ imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d)
    hAB hBC hnat (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hcomp)
  have key' : _ ≫ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) d ≫
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 ((fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x) ∘ imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x))
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) = _ := key
  rw [hsel] at key'
  simp only [Category.assoc] at key' ⊢
  exact key'.trans hRHS.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_congr
statement:
theorem nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_congr (G₁ G₂ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (e : G₁ = G₂)
    (h₁ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map G₁)
    (h₂ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map G₂) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 G₁ h₁ f d hA =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 𝒞 G₁ G₂ e h₁ h₂)).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫ nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 G₂ h₂ f d hA
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have hc : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (rfl : Proj.map G₁ h₁ = Proj.map G₁ h₂)).hom.app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  rw [hc, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.polynomialExceptional_sheafSquare
statement:
theorem polynomialExceptional_sheafSquare (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp
        (hf := irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (hg := irrelevant_comparison J))).hom.app
        (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map (comparisonGraded J) (irrelevant_comparison J))
        (Proj.map (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h))).inv.app
        (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map (comparisonGraded J) (irrelevant_comparison J))).map
        (polynomialNativeRestrictionHom I f J h d) ≫
      polynomialToExceptionalHom J d =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr _ _ _ _ (total_comparison_naturality I f J h)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
        (irrelevant_comparison J))
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_comparison I)
        (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
          (centreMapEquality I f J h))))).hom.app (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp
        (hf := irrelevant_comparison I) (hg := irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I)
          (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J) (centreMapEquality I f J h)))).hom.app
        (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I)
          (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J) (centreMapEquality I f J h))
          (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I)
          (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J) (centreMapEquality I f J h)))
        (Proj.map (comparisonGraded I) (irrelevant_comparison I))).inv.app
        (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I)
          (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J) (centreMapEquality I f J h))
          (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I)
          (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J) (centreMapEquality I f J h)))).map
        (polynomialToExceptionalHom I d) ≫
      exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom I f J h d)
proof:
:= by
  have P1 := nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp (totalGrade I) (totalGrade J)
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J)) (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
    (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (comparisonGraded J) (irrelevant_comparison J)
    (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d (polynomialNative_covers I) (polynomialNative_covers J)
  have P2 := nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp (totalGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J)) (comparisonGraded I) (irrelevant_comparison I)
    (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h))
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h))
    (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d (polynomialNative_covers I) (exceptionalNative_covers I)
  have C := nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_congr (totalGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J))
    (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) _ _ (total_comparison_naturality I f J h)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
        (irrelevant_comparison J))
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_comparison I)
        (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
          (centreMapEquality I f J h))) d (polynomialNative_covers I)
  exact P1.trans (C.trans (congrArg (fun t ↦ _ ≫ t) P2.symm))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_projection_taut_general_ARRM4
statement:
theorem tautChart_projection_taut_general_ARRM4 (k : ι) (m : M) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app ⊤
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) =
      ratioTop_ARRM4 R M (b k) m
proof:
:= by
  have e : (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) := by
    rw [← tautChart_app_map]
    congr 1
  rw [← e, linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq]
  have h1 : (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) k).app
      ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      ((kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1)).app
        ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b k) m) := by
    exact (tautChart_app3 _ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg
      (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M) ⟶
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k)) ↦
        f.app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))
      (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m k)).trans
      (tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ _))
  erw [h1]
  simp only [tautChart_component]
  unfold ratioTop_ARRM4
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ratioTop_restrict_isUnit_ARRM4
statement:
theorem ratioTop_restrict_isUnit_ARRM4 (k : ι) (m : M)
    (V' : (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.Opens)
    (hV' : V' ≤ (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M (b k) m) :
    IsUnit ((linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤)).op
      (ratioTop_ARRM4 R M (b k) m))
proof:
:= by
  have hWU : linearOverlapOpen R M (b k) m ≤ linearOpen R M (b k) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b k) m).le.trans inf_le_left
  have hWm : linearOverlapOpen R M (b k) m ≤ linearOpen R M m :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b k) m).le.trans inf_le_right
  have key := tautChart_ratio_key R M (b k) m m
  rw [tautChart_ratioSection_self, map_one, mul_one] at key
  have hU : IsUnit ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) m)) := by
    rw [key]
    exact (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 1 (b k) m).isUnit
  have hring := (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι.app (linearOverlapOpen R M (b k) m)
  have e : (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤)).op
      (ratioTop_ARRM4 R M (b k) m) =
      (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op
        ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι.app (linearOverlapOpen R M (b k) m)
          ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) m))) := by
    unfold ratioTop_ARRM4
    simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_app, Scheme.Opens.topIso]
    simp only [Functor.mapIso_inv]
    change (space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _ _) =
      (space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _ _))
    simp only [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [e]
  exact (hU.map _).map _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.literal_chartTautSec_ARRM4
statement:
theorem literal_chartTautSec_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩).hom.app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans
          (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k))).op (chartTautSec_ARRM4 C i m)) =
      ratioTop_ARRM4 Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k) m
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso,
    id_eq]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app]
  rw [chartTautSec_ARRM4]
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso
    Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) 1 k).inv.app ⊤ z)
      (tautQuotient_restrictionIso_taut C i k _ _ _ _)).trans ?_
  exact tautChart_projection_taut_general_ARRM4 _ _ (C.sectionBasis i) k m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.scalar_ARRM4
statement:
theorem scalar_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (a : Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).hom (C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op
        (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a)) =
      tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (⊤ : (C.chart i).Opens) ≤ (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase) ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i := by
    intro x _
    have h : (C.chartι i) x ∈ (C.chartι i) ''ᵁ ⊤ := ⟨x, trivial, rfl⟩
    rw [tautQuotient_chartι_image_top] at h
    exact h
  have hL : ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).hom (C.scheme.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a)) =
      (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase).appLE (C.U i) ⊤ hle a := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply]
    exact (tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply (C.chartι i) C.toBase _ _ _ a).symm
  have e1 : C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) ≫
        (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase]
    rfl
  rw [hL, tautQuotient_appLE_congr e1 _ _ _ (by rw [← e1]; exact hle),
    tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply]
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ (intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i))
      (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).appLE _ ⊤ (by simp) z)
      (IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply (C.isAffine i) a)) ?_
  exact tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforwardTaut_smul_ARRM4
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrict_smul_ARRM4
statement:
theorem restrict_smul_ARRM4 {Y P : Scheme.{u}} (ι : Y ⟶ P) [IsOpenImmersion ι] (F : P.Modules)
    (S : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (z : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj F).val.obj (op ⊤)) :
    S • z = ((ι.appIso ⊤).inv S) • (show Γ(F, ι ''ᵁ ⊤) from z)

:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.scal_term_ARRM4
statement:
theorem scal_term_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (a : Γ(X, C.U i))
    (y : Γ(twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) 1, ⊤)) :
    a • (show (tautQuotient_N C).val.obj (op (C.U i)) from
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).val.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).symm).op
        ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤ y)) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).val.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).symm).op
        ((((space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
            (tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a)) •
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤ y))
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
      (tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a) =
      tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a := by
    have : (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op = 𝟙 _ := rfl
    rw [this, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  rw [hS]
  have hz := restrict_smul_ARRM4 (C.chartι i) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a)
    ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤ y)
  have hsc := scalar_ARRM4 C i a
  rw [hz]
  erw [PresheafOfModules.map_smul]
  refine Eq.trans (pushforwardTaut_smul_ARRM4 C i a _) ?_
  congr 1
  have hinv : ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).inv (tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a) =
      C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a) := by
    rw [← hsc]
    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_apply ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤) _
  rw [hinv]
  change (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)) =
    (C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).symm).op)
      ((C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op)
        (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a))
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_t_eq_ARRM4
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_t_eq_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (l : C.basisIndex i) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    (tautQuotient_t C i l) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).val.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).symm).op
        ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤
          ((tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i)
            (C.sectionBasis i l)).app ⊤
            (1 : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautPH_app_eq_chartTautSec_ARRM4
statement:
theorem tautPH_app_eq_chartTautSec_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m = chartTautSec_ARRM4 C i m
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  have hk : m = ((C.sectionBasis i).repr m).sum (fun l a ↦ a • C.sectionBasis i l) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, (C.sectionBasis i).linearCombination_repr]
  rw [hk]
  rw [map_finsuppSum (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i)).hom]
  unfold chartTautSec_ARRM4
  rw [tautChart_tautHom_app_sum]
  rw [map_finsuppSum ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤).hom]
  rw [map_finsuppSum ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).val.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).symm).op).hom]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro l _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tautologicalPushforwardHom_app, tautQuotient_t_eq_ARRM4]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  exact C.scal_term_ARRM4 i _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.generating_explicit_ARRM4
statement:
theorem generating_explicit_ARRM4 {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (j : S ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (F : Y.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F ≅ SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)
    {T : Y.Opens} (hT : j.opensRange ≤ T) (t : Γ(F, T))
    (ht : φ.hom.app ⊤ (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op t) =
      (1 : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (V : S.Opens) (s : Γ(F, j ''ᵁ V)) :
    s = ((j.appIso V).inv (φ.hom.app V s)) • F.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange V).trans hT)).op t
proof:
:= by
  let x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F, V) :=
    F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange V).trans hT)).op t
  have hx : φ.hom.app V x = (1 : Γ(S, V)) := by
    have e : x = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op t) := by
      change _ = F.presheaf.map _ (F.presheaf.map _ t)
      rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    rw [e, tautChart_app_map, ht]
    exact map_one (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
  let w : Γ(S, V) := φ.hom.app V s
  change s = w • x
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (φ.hom.app V)).1
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hx]
  change w = w * 1
  rw [mul_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.pushout_inl_eq_inr
statement:
theorem pushout_inl_eq_inr {x : A} {y : B} (h : pushout.inl f g x = pushout.inr f g y) :
    ∃ z, f z = x ∧ g z = y
proof:
:= by
  have h' : colimit.ι (span f g) WalkingSpan.left x =
      colimit.ι (span f g) WalkingSpan.right y := h
  obtain ⟨k, fi, fj, z, hx, hy⟩ := (Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_eq_ι_iff (span f g)).mp h'
  rcases k with _ | _ | _
  · cases fi; cases fj
    exact ⟨z, hx, hy⟩
  · cases fj
  · cases fi

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.subGmToU_eq
statement:

    subGmToU I = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom (R ⧸ I)))
proof:
:= by

  simp only [Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, Scheme.Spec_map,

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [subGmToU_eq, subschemeToBlowup, gmToBlowup, subschemeι, genericFibreι, reduceGm,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.gm_reduceLine
statement:
theorem gm_reduceLine :
    gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I) ≫ reduceLine I = reduceGm I ≫ gmToTrivialLine R
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmToTrivialLine, gmToTrivialLine, reduceLine, reduceGm, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun p ↦ ?_)
  change Polynomial.toLaurent (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
    reduceLaurent R I (Polynomial.toLaurent p)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.subschemeHom_parameter
statement: theorem subschemeHom_parameter : subschemeHom R I (parameter R I) = Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  refine nonPosHom_injective (R ⧸ I) ?_
  rw [nonPosHom_subschemeHom, coe_parameter, ← Polynomial.monomial_one_one_eq_X,
    nonPosHom_monomial, show (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C 1 * T (-1) by simp,
    reduceLaurent_C_mul_T, map_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.mem_range_gmToTrivialLine_of_reduceLine
statement:
theorem mem_range_gmToTrivialLine_of_reduceLine {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (J : Ideal S)
    {y : Spec (.of (S ⧸ J)[X])} (h : reduceLine J y ∈ Set.range (gmToTrivialLine S)) :
    y ∈ Set.range (gmToTrivialLine (S ⧸ J))
proof:
:= by
  have h' : y ∈ reduceLine J ⁻¹ᵁ (gmToTrivialLine S).opensRange := h
  rw [opensRange_gmToTrivialLine, reduceLine, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen] at h'
  have h'' : y ∈ (gmToTrivialLine (S ⧸ J)).opensRange := by
    rw [opensRange_gmToTrivialLine]; simpa using h'
  exact h''

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.mem_range_gmToTrivialLine_of_subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_genericFibreι] at h
  have h' : y ∈ subschemeι R I ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (parameter R I) := h
  rw [subschemeι, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen] at h'
  have h'' : y ∈ (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)).opensRange := by
    rw [opensRange_gmToTrivialLine]
    simpa [subschemeHom_parameter] using h'
  exact h''

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.preimage_blowupι_opensRange
statement:
theorem preimage_blowupι_opensRange :
    subschemeTotalι I ⁻¹ᵁ (blowupι I).opensRange =
      (pushout.inl (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨subGmToU I y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · change pushout.inr (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inr_subschemeTotalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hw
      obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := pushout_inl_eq_inr (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R) hw
      obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := mem_range_gmToTrivialLine_of_reduceLine I ⟨z, hz⟩
      refine ⟨subGmToU I y', ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pushout.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨subschemeToBlowup I y, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← inl_subschemeTotalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.preimage_trivialι_opensRange
statement:
theorem preimage_trivialι_opensRange :
    subschemeTotalι I ⁻¹ᵁ (trivialι I).opensRange =
      (pushout.inr (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I) y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.snd)
    · change pushout.inl (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inl_subschemeTotalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hw
      obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := pushout_inl_eq_inr (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R) hw.symm
      have hz' : genericFibreι R I z = subschemeι R I y := by
        apply (uChartι I).isOpenEmbedding.injective
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hz
      obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := mem_range_gmToTrivialLine_of_subschemeι I ⟨z, hz'⟩
      refine ⟨gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I) ((invertIso (R ⧸ I)).inv y'), ?_⟩
      have : gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I) y' = subGmToU I ((invertIso (R ⧸ I)).inv y') := by
        rw [subGmToU, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
      rw [this]
      change (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I) ≫ pushout.inr _ _) _ = (subGmToU I ≫ pushout.inl _ _) _
      rw [pushout.condition]
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨reduceLine I y, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← inr_subschemeTotalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.isPullback_blowupι_subschemeTotalι
statement:
theorem isPullback_blowupι_subschemeTotalι :
    IsPullback (pushout.inl (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I))) (subschemeToBlowup I)

proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_one
statement:
theorem scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_one (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).app
    (ModuleCat.of _ (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).toLinearEquiv).injective
  change (((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).app
    (ModuleCat.of _ (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).hom)
    (((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).app
      (ModuleCat.of _ (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).inv
      (((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ tildeSelf.symm).hom)
        (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj
          (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤) from 1))) = _
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  change ((J.subschemeCover.f U).appIso ⊤).hom 1 =
    StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) ⊤ 1
  rw [map_one, StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ_eq_const, StructureSheaf.const_one]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.scalarLineRestriction_one
statement:
theorem scalarLineRestriction_one {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [centreChartSectionsRestriction_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.centreChartSectionsRestriction_hom
statement:
theorem centreChartSectionsRestriction_hom {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    {E F : J.subscheme.Modules} (f : E ⟶ F)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f V)).obj E, ⊤)) :
    centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h F (f.app (J.subschemeCover.f V ''ᵁ ⊤) m) =
      f.app (J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤)
        (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h E m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centreChartSectionsRestriction_apply, centreChartSectionsRestriction_apply]
  have hn := ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf J.subscheme).map f).naturality
    (homOfLE (centreChartImage_le Y J h)).op
  exact (congrArg (fun g => g.hom m) hn).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_smul_one
statement:
theorem scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_smul_one (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj
      (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤)) :
    scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U m • (1 : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤)) = m
proof:
:= by
  apply (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U).injective
  rw [map_smul, scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_one]
  exact mul_one _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f V)).obj
      (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤)) :
    scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U
      (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) m) =
    GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J V m)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := centreChartSectionsRestriction_smul Y J h (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme)
    (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J V m)
    (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f V)).obj
      (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤) from 1)
  have hm := congrArg (fun x => scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U
    (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) x))
    (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_smul_one Y J V m)
  have hs := congrArg (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U) hn
  have hl : scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U
      (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J V m) •
        centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme)
          (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f V)).obj
            (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤) from 1)) =
      GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h (scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J V m) := by
    rw [scalarLineRestriction_one, map_smul, scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_one]
    exact mul_one _
  exact hm.symm.trans (hs.trans hl)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.tildeProductIso_hom_fst
statement:
theorem tildeProductIso_hom_fst {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q] (M N : ModuleCat Q) :
    (tildeProductIso M N).hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst Q M N)) = biprod.fst
proof:
:= by
  let T := tilde.functor (.of Q)
  letI : T.Additive := AlgebraicGeometry.tildeFunctor_additive_pinned _
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproduct M N T := preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  change (T.mapBiprod M N).inv ≫ T.map (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫ T.map _ = _
  rw [← T.map_comp, biprodIsoProd_hom_fst]
  apply (cancel_epi (T.mapBiprod M N).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp,
    Functor.mapBiprod_hom, biprod.lift_fst]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.tildeProductIso_hom_snd
statement:
theorem tildeProductIso_hom_snd {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q] (M N : ModuleCat Q) :

proof:
:= by
  let T := tilde.functor (.of Q)

  change (T.mapBiprod M N).inv ≫ T.map (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫ T.map _ = _
  rw [← T.map_comp, biprodIsoProd_hom_snd]
  apply (cancel_epi (T.mapBiprod M N).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp,
    Functor.mapBiprod_hom, biprod.lift_snd]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.biprodRoute_fst
statement:
theorem biprodRoute_fst {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (M N : C) [HasBinaryBiproduct M N]
    [HasBinaryBiproduct (F.obj M) (F.obj N)] [PreservesBinaryBiproduct M N F]
    {P Q S : D} [HasBinaryBiproduct P Q] (a : F.obj M ≅ P) (b : F.obj N ≅ Q)
    (t : P ⊞ Q ⟶ S) (k : S ⟶ P) (ht : t ≫ k = biprod.fst) :
    ((F.mapBiprod M N).hom ≫ (biprod.mapIso a b).hom ≫ t) ≫ k = F.map biprod.fst ≫ a.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ht, biprod.mapIso_hom,
    biprod.map_fst, ← Category.assoc, Functor.mapBiprod_hom, biprod.lift_fst]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.biprodRoute_snd
statement:
theorem biprodRoute_snd {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (M N : C) [HasBinaryBiproduct M N]
    [HasBinaryBiproduct (F.obj M) (F.obj N)] [PreservesBinaryBiproduct M N F]
    {P Q S : D} [HasBinaryBiproduct P Q] (a : F.obj M ≅ P) (b : F.obj N ≅ Q)
    (t : P ⊞ Q ⟶ S) (k : S ⟶ Q) (ht : t ≫ k = biprod.snd) :
    ((F.mapBiprod M N).hom ≫ (biprod.mapIso a b).hom ≫ t) ≫ k = F.map biprod.snd ≫ b.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ht, biprod.mapIso_hom,
    biprod.map_snd, ← Category.assoc, Functor.mapBiprod_hom, biprod.lift_snd]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso_fst
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso_fst (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso Y J U).hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
        (idealChartTensor Y J U) (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).map biprod.fst ≫
      (conormalChartTensorIso Y J U).hom
proof:
:= by
  let Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)
  letI hF : F.Additive := { map_add := by intro M N f g; rfl }
  letI hP : PreservesBinaryBiproduct (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) F :=
    preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  rw [conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso_factor]
  exact @biprodRoute_fst J.subscheme.Modules (Spec (.of Q)).Modules
    (inferInstanceAs (Category J.subscheme.Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Category (Spec (.of Q)).Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Preadditive J.subscheme.Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Preadditive (Spec (.of Q)).Modules)) F hF
    (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) _ _ hP _ _ _ _ (conormalChartTensorIso Y J U)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ tildeSelf.symm)
    (tildeProductIso (ModuleCat.of Q (idealChartTensor Y J U)) (ModuleCat.of Q Q)).hom
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst Q (idealChartTensor Y J U) Q)))
    (tildeProductIso_hom_fst _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso_snd
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso_snd (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso Y J U).hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
        (idealChartTensor Y J U) (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).map biprod.snd ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ tildeSelf.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  let Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)
  letI hF : F.Additive := { map_add := by intro M N f g; rfl }
  letI hP : PreservesBinaryBiproduct (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) F :=
    preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  rw [conormalPlusLineChartTensorIso_factor]
  exact @biprodRoute_snd J.subscheme.Modules (Spec (.of Q)).Modules
    (inferInstanceAs (Category J.subscheme.Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Category (Spec (.of Q)).Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Preadditive J.subscheme.Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Preadditive (Spec (.of Q)).Modules)) F hF
    (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) _ _ hP
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj (ModuleCat.of Q (idealChartTensor Y J U)))
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj (ModuleCat.of Q Q))
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj (ModuleCat.of Q (idealChartTensorPlusLine Y J U)))
    _ (conormalChartTensorIso Y J U)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ (@tildeSelf (.of Q)).symm)
    (tildeProductIso (ModuleCat.of Q (idealChartTensor Y J U)) (ModuleCat.of Q Q)).hom
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd Q (idealChartTensor Y J U) Q)))
    (tildeProductIso_hom_snd _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.tildeSections_projection
statement:
theorem tildeSections_projection {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    {P E : (Spec (.of Q)).Modules} {M N : ModuleCat Q}
    (e : P ≅ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj M) (d : E ≅ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj N)
    (f : P ⟶ E) (k : M ⟶ N) (h : e.hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).map k = f ≫ d.hom) :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map e.hom ≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).inv ≫ k =
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map f ≫
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map d.hom ≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).inv.naturality k
  change (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map k) ≫
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv =
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).inv ≫ k at hn
  have hp := coordinate_terminal_paste (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)) e.hom
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map k) k
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).inv
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv hn
  have hc := congrArg (fun q => (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map q ≫
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv) h
  have hm := congrArg (fun q => q ≫ ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv)
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map_comp f d.hom)
  exact hp.symm.trans (hc.trans (hm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalPlusLineNaturality.tildeSections_projection_apply
statement:
theorem tildeSections_projection_apply {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    {P E : (Spec (.of Q)).Modules} {M N : ModuleCat Q}
    (e : P ≅ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj M) (d : E ≅ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj N)
    (f : P ⟶ E) (k : M ⟶ N) (h : e.hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).map k = f ≫ d.hom)
    (m : Γ(P,⊤)) :
    k (((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).mapIso e ≪≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).symm).toLinearEquiv m) =

statement:

      (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J) m) =
    idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J h (conormalPlusLineChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · have hn := centrePlusLineRestriction_fst Y J h m
    have ht := conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_centreRestriction_naturality Y J h
      ((biprod.fst : InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J ⟶ ConormalSheaf.conormal J).app
        (J.subschemeCover.f V ''ᵁ ⊤) m)
    have hx := congrArg (fun x => conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U x) hn
    have hv := congrArg (fun x => idealChartTensorRestriction Y J h x)
      (conormalPlusLineChartTensorSectionsEquiv_fst Y J V m).symm
    have hh := ht.trans hv
    have hk := hx.trans hh
    have hp := conormalPlusLineChartTensorSectionsEquiv_fst Y J U
      (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J) m)
    have he := hp.trans hk
    exact he.trans (idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_fst Y J h
      (conormalPlusLineChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V m)).symm
  · have hn := centreChartSectionsRestriction_hom Y J h
      (biprod.snd : InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J ⟶ ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) m
    have ht := scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_naturality Y J h
      ((biprod.snd : InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J ⟶ ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme).app
        (J.subschemeCover.f V ''ᵁ ⊤) m)
    exact (conormalPlusLineChartTensorSectionsEquiv_snd Y J U _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun x => scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U x) hn.symm).trans
        (ht.trans (congrArg (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h)
          (conormalPlusLineChartTensorSectionsEquiv_snd Y J V m).symm)))

statement:
theorem fibreVariable_mul_coefficientDivX (I : Ideal A)
    (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I))
    (he : p ∈ ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I))
    (hk : p ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I)) :
    fibreVariable I * ⟨coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X]), coefficientDivX_mem I p he⟩ = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro n
  change (Polynomial.C Polynomial.X * coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X])).coeff n = _
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, coefficientDivX_coeff]
  have hzero := (mem_evaluation_kernel_iff I p).mp hk n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeKernelIntersection.kernel_exceptional_intersection_eq_fibre
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    exact ⟨⟨coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X]), coefficientDivX_mem I p hp.2⟩,
      (fibreVariable_mul_coefficientDivX I p hp.2 hp.1).symm⟩
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro p hp
    have hp' : p = fibreVariable I := by simpa using hp
    subst p
    change fibreVariable I ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) ∧
      fibreVariable I ∈ ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I)
    constructor
    · rw [mem_evaluation_kernel_iff]
      intro n
      rw [fibreVariable_coe]
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst n; simp
      · simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, hn]
    · rw [AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff]
      intro n
      rw [fibreVariable_coe]
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst n
        simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_zero, zero_add, pow_one]
        exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
      · simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, hn]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeKernelIntersection.quotient_branch_ideals_intersection
statement:
theorem quotient_branch_ideals_intersection (I : Ideal A) :
    let F
proof:
:= Ideal.span {fibreVariable I}
    (RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk F) ⊓
      (ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk F) = ⊥ := by
  dsimp only
  let F : Ideal (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) := Ideal.span {fibreVariable I}
  let q := Ideal.Quotient.mk F
  have hF : F = RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) ⊓
      ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I) := (kernel_exceptional_intersection_eq_fibre I).symm
  have hk : RingHom.ker q = F := Ideal.mk_ker
  apply Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective q (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)
  rw [Ideal.comap_inf, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective),
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)]
  rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hk]
  rw [sup_of_le_left (hF ▸ inf_le_left), sup_of_le_left (hF ▸ inf_le_right)]
  exact hF.symm

statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_id_aux (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (h : U ≤ (𝟙 X) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap (𝟙 X) U U h =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext s
  have := pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app (𝟙 X) U U h W.unop s
  refine this.trans ?_
  simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]
  have e : ∀ (A : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ A), X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op = 𝟙 _ := fun A h => by simp
  erw [e]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryIC1.nativeKernelToPushforward_idCoeff
statement:
theorem nativeKernelToPushforward_idCoeff (g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒜)
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map g)
    (eg : g = GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (d : ℤ)
    (e : Proj.map g hg = 𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)) :
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒜 g hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d =
      pfId e (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
          (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)
            (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 g (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d)
proof:
:= by
  subst eg
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg)).map
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d)))).1
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext
  intro j
  have h1 := nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d
  have h2 := nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) j
  have h3 := NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x)) d j
  have h4 := pfId_naturality e (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) -
        Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) d) ≫
      Pi.π (fun i => SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
        (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 ((fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) i))) j)
  have h5 : nativeChartPushedUnitMap 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) j =
      pfId e (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
        (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 ((fun x : 𝒜 1 => x) j))) :=
    pushedUnitMap_pfId e _ _
  refine ((congrArg (fun t => t ≫ _) h1).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    (congrArg (fun t => kernel.ι _ ≫ t) h2))).trans ?_
  symm
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [h3]
  rw [h5]
  exact h4.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryIC1.pushforward_pfId_coherence
statement:
theorem pushforward_pfId_coherence {X C : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ C) {q : X ⟶ X} (e : q = 𝟙 X)
    (w : q ≫ j = j) (K : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).map (pfId e K) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q j).inv.app K ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr w).hom.app K = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp only [pfId, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext s
  erw [SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hA : ∀ x, (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.app K)).val.app W)) x = x := fun x => rfl
  have hB : ∀ x, (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (𝟙 X) j).inv.app K).val.app W))
      x = x := fun x => rfl
  have hC : ∀ x, (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr w).hom.app K).val.app W))
      x = x := by
    intro x
    have h0 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app (M := K) w W.unop) x
    refine h0.trans ?_
    simp only [eqToHom_op]
    erw [eqToHom_refl, K.presheaf.map_id]
    rfl
  exact (hC _).trans ((hB _).trans (hA s))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverCharts.semilinearSymmetricGradedMap_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem semilinearSymmetricGradedMap_comp_inverse {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    (φ : R ≃+* S) [RingHomInvPair φ.toRingHom φ.symm.toRingHom]
    [RingHomInvPair φ.symm.toRingHom φ.toRingHom]
    (e : LinearEquiv (σ' := φ.symm.toRingHom) φ.toRingHom M N) :
    (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap φ.toRingHom e.toLinearMap).comp
      (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap φ.symm.toRingHom e.symm.toLinearMap) = GradedRingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change symmetricSemilinearMap φ.toRingHom e.toLinearMap
      (symmetricSemilinearMap φ.symm.toRingHom e.symm.toLinearMap (algebraMap S _ a)) = _
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base, symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
    exact congrArg (algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N)) (φ.apply_symm_apply a)
  | ι m =>
    change symmetricSemilinearMap φ.toRingHom e.toLinearMap
      (symmetricSemilinearMap φ.symm.toRingHom e.symm.toLinearMap (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N m)) = _
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N) (e.apply_symm_apply m)
  | add p q hp hq => exact (map_add _ _ _).trans (by rw [hp,hq]; rfl)
  | mul p q hp hq => exact (map_mul _ _ _).trans (by rw [hp,hq]; rfl)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverCharts.spectrumRestriction_spans
statement:
theorem spectrumRestriction_spans (Z : Scheme.{u}) (E : Z.Modules)
    {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (hspan : Submodule.span Γ(Z,U.1) (Set.range (affineOpenSectionsSemilinear Z E h)) = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span Γ(Z,U.1) (Set.range (affineSpectrumSectionsSemilinear Z E h)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E).surjective m
  clear hm
  have hmem : m ∈ Submodule.span Γ(Z,U.1) (Set.range (affineOpenSectionsSemilinear Z E h)) := by
    rw [hspan]
    trivial
  induction hmem using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := hy
    have he : affineSpectrumSectionsSemilinear Z E h (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E z) =
        affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E (affineOpenSectionsSemilinear Z E h z) :=
      affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality Z E h z
    rw [← he]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E z,rfl⟩
  | zero =>
    rw [map_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy hx' hy' =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx' hy'
  | smul a x hx hx' =>
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx'

statement:

    (h : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :

      commonSpectrumToSpec Y J C i W h ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (J.subscheme.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE h : W.1 ⟶ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i).op).hom)
proof:
:= by
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W h
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W h
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := frameSpectrumSections_free D i
  letI := frameSpectrumSections_finite D i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,(D.affineOpen i).1)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(J.subscheme,(D.affineOpen i).1))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec).obj (conormalPlusLine Y J))) :=
    frameSpectrumSections_free D i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,(D.affineOpen i).1)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(J.subscheme,(D.affineOpen i).1))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec).obj (conormalPlusLine Y J))) :=
    frameSpectrumSections_finite D i
  exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec _ _
    (spectrumRestriction_spans J.subscheme (conormalPlusLine Y J)
      (show W ≤ D.affineOpen i from h) (D.restriction_spans i W.1 h))

    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hi : U ≤ C.U i) (hj : U ≤ C.U j) :
    ambientRefinementNativeToFrame Y J C i U hi ≫ (localFrameCover Y J C).chartι i =
      ambientRefinementNativeToFrame Y J C j U hj ≫ (localFrameCover Y J C).chartι j
proof:
:= by
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  have hd := D.directRestrictionChartMap_chartι i j (ambientRefinementImageOpen Y J U)
    (ambientRefinementImage_le Y J C i U hi) (ambientRefinementImage_le Y J C j U hj)
  calc
    _ = (ambientRefinementImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom ≫
        (ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C i U hi ≫ D.chartι i) :=
      (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ D.chartι i) (ambientRefinementImageChartIso_original Y J C i U hi)).trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _)
    _ = (ambientRefinementImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom ≫
        (ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ D.chartι j) :=
      congrArg (fun a => (ambientRefinementImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom ≫ a) hd
    _ = (ambientRefinementImageChartIso Y J C j U hj).hom ≫
        (ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ D.chartι j) :=
      congrArg (fun a => a ≫ (ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ D.chartι j))
        (ambientRefinementImageChartIso_hom_independent Y J C i j U hi hj)
    _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ D.chartι j) (ambientRefinementImageChartIso_original Y J C j U hj).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreSourceCover.nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_swap

theorem nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_swap (i j : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (hi : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i)

    nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C i j W hi a =
      nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C j i W hj
        (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a)
proof:

  exact (nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toScheme Y J C i j W hi a).trans
    ((ambientRefinementNativeToFrame_toScheme_independent Y J C i j a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2.1).trans
    ((nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toScheme Y J C j i W hj
      (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a)).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun f => nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C j i W hj
      (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a) ≫ f)
      (originalRestrictionSourceToScheme_independent Y J C i j W hi hj).symm)))

      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j)))) j =
    Pi.π (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) (r j)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.overlapSelection_π

      (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 (f (r ij.1)) (f (r ij.2)))) (i,j) =
    Pi.π (fun ij : ι × ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
