name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.selection_left
statement:
theorem selection_left : Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f ≫ overlapSelection 𝒜 f r =
    chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r)
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i,j⟩
  have hO := overlapSelection_π 𝒜 f r i j
  have hC := chartSelection_π 𝒜 f r i
  have hS := Native.generatorDescentLeft_π 𝒜 f (r i) (r j)
  have hT := Native.generatorDescentLeft_π 𝒜 (f ∘ r) i j
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun q ↦ Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f ≫ q) hO).trans
      (hS.trans ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((Native.generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f (r i)) (f (r j))).le.trans inf_le_left))
          hC.symm).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
            ((congrArg (fun q ↦ chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ q) hT.symm).trans
              (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.selection_right
statement:
theorem selection_right (d : ℤ) : Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d ≫ overlapSelection 𝒜 f r =
    chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i,j⟩
  have hO := overlapSelection_π 𝒜 f r i j
  have hC := chartSelection_π 𝒜 f r j
  have hS := Native.generatorDescentRight_π 𝒜 f d (r i) (r j)
  have hT := Native.generatorDescentRight_π 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d i j
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun q ↦ Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d ≫ q) hO).trans
      (hS.trans ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((Native.generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f (r i)) (f (r j))).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫
            Native.pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f (r i)) (f (r j))))
          hC.symm).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
            ((congrArg (fun q ↦ chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ q) hT.symm).trans
              (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.selection_difference
statement:
theorem selection_difference (d : ℤ) :
    (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫
      overlapSelection 𝒜 f r = chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫
      (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r) - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub]
  exact congrArg₂ (fun x y ↦ x-y) (selection_left 𝒜 f r) (selection_right 𝒜 f r d)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.kernelSelection_ι
statement:

theorem kernelSelection_ι (d : ℤ) : kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫
    kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r) - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d) =
    kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫
      chartSelection 𝒜 f r
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem kernelSelection_component (d : ℤ) (j : κ) : kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫
    kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r) - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d) ≫
    Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j)))) j =
    kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫
    Pi.π (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) (r j)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ _) (kernelSelection_ι 𝒜 f r d)).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun q ↦ _ ≫ q)
        (chartSelection_π 𝒜 f r j))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.kernelSelection_chartProjection
statement:
theorem kernelSelection_chartProjection (d : ℤ) (j : κ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).ι).map
      (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫ Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d j =
    Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 f d (r j)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).ι
  have hp := congrArg G.map (kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f r d j)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hp
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).ι).hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).toScheme)
  change G.map (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫
    (G.map (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d)) ≫
      G.map (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
        (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j)))) j) ≫ ε) =
    G.map (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
      G.map (Pi.π (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
        (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) (r j)) ≫ ε
  let a := G.map (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d)
  let b := G.map (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r) -
    Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d))
  let c := G.map (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
    (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j)))) j)
  let z := G.map (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d))
  let w := G.map (Pi.π (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
    (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) (r j))
  have h : (a ≫ b ≫ c) ≫ ε = (z ≫ w) ≫ ε :=
    congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ ε) hp
  exact (congrArg (fun q ↦ a ≫ q) (Category.assoc b c ε)).symm.trans
    ((Category.assoc a (b ≫ c) ε).symm.trans (h.trans (Category.assoc z w ε)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.kernelSelection_chart_isIso
statement:
theorem kernelSelection_chart_isIso (d : ℤ) (j : κ) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).ι).map
      (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).ι
  let p : G.obj (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d) ⟶
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).toScheme :=
    Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d j
  let q : G.obj (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ⟶
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))).toScheme :=
    Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 f d (r j)
  letI : IsIso p := (inferInstance :
    IsIso (Native.degreeOneSheafLinearOpenIso 𝒜 (f ∘ r) d j).inv)
  letI : IsIso q := (inferInstance :
    IsIso (Native.degreeOneSheafLinearOpenIso 𝒜 f d (r j)).inv)
  have hc : G.map (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫ p = q :=
    kernelSelection_chartProjection 𝒜 f r d j
  letI : IsIso (G.map (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫ p) :=
    hc.symm ▸ (inferInstance : IsIso q)
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (G.map (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d)) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.kernelSelection_isIso_of_cover
statement:
theorem kernelSelection_isIso_of_cover (d : ℤ)
    (h : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun j ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j)))) : IsIso (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d)
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeKTheory.moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d)
    (fun j ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j))) h
  intro j
  letI := kernelSelection_chart_isIso 𝒜 f r d j
  exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.overMap_isIso_of_restrictMap
    (kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f (r j)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.allDegreeOneToOriginal_component

theorem allDegreeOneToOriginal_component [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :

statement:
theorem nativeOverlap_preimage (x y : 𝒜 1) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.nativeRatioSection_map
statement:
theorem nativeRatioSection_map (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (x.val*y.val))
      (Proj.basicOpen ℬ (g (x.val*y.val))) (by rfl))
        ((Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 (x.val*y.val))
          (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x.val y.val x.property y.property)) =
    (Proj.awayToSection ℬ (g (x.val*y.val)))
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk ℬ
        (GradedRingHom.map_mem g (SetLike.mul_mem_graded x.property y.property))
        1 ((g y.val)^2)
          (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (GradedRingHom.map_mem g y.property)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE g hg
      (SetLike.mul_mem_graded x.property y.property))
    (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x.val y.val x.property y.property)
  exact h.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ (Proj.awayToSection ℬ (g (x.val*y.val))) z)
    (degreeOneOverlapRatio_map 𝒜 ℬ x.val y.val x.property y.property g))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.nativeUnitSection_map
statement:
theorem nativeUnitSection_map {n : ℕ} {s : A} (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 n)
    (z : (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 s)ˣ) :
    Units.map (Scheme.Hom.appLE (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 s)
      (Proj.basicOpen ℬ (g s)) (by rfl)).hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 s).hom.toMonoidHom z) =
    Units.map (Proj.awayToSection ℬ (g s)).hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g s).toMonoidHom z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE g hg hs) z.val

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.nativeRatioUnit_map_heq
statement:
theorem nativeRatioUnit_map_heq (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    HEq (Units.map (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g (x.val*y.val)).toMonoidHom
      (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit 𝒜 x.val y.val x.property y.property))
    (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit ℬ (g x.val) (g y.val)
      (GradedRingHom.map_mem g x.property) (GradedRingHom.map_mem g y.property))
proof:
:= by
  have hcast (p q : B) (e : p=q)
      (u : (HomogeneousLocalization.Away ℬ p)ˣ)
      (v : (HomogeneousLocalization.Away ℬ q)ˣ)
      (h : HEq u.val v.val) : HEq u v := by
    subst q
    exact heq_of_eq (Units.ext (eq_of_heq h))
  exact hcast _ _ (map_mul g x.val y.val) _ _
    (degreeOneOverlapRatio_map_heq 𝒜 ℬ x.val y.val x.property y.property g)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.nativeUnitSection_denominatorCast
statement:
theorem nativeUnitSection_denominatorCast (p q : B) (e : p=q)
    (u : (HomogeneousLocalization.Away ℬ p)ˣ)
    (v : (HomogeneousLocalization.Away ℬ q)ˣ) (h : HEq u v) (d : ℤ) :
    Units.map (Proj.awayToSection ℬ p).hom.toMonoidHom (u^d) =
    Units.map ((Proj ℬ).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (congrArg (Proj.basicOpen ℬ) e)).op).hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (Proj.awayToSection ℬ q).hom.toMonoidHom (v^d))
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  have hu : u=v := eq_of_heq h
  subst v
  apply Units.ext
  change _ = (Proj ℬ).presheaf.map (𝟙 (op (Proj.basicOpen ℬ p))) _
  rw [Functor.map_id_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.nativeTransitionSection_map
statement:
theorem nativeTransitionSection_map (x y : 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) :
    Units.map (Scheme.Hom.appLE (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (x.val*y.val))
      (Proj.basicOpen ℬ (g (x.val*y.val))) (by rfl)).hom.toMonoidHom
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit 𝒜 d x y) =
    Units.map ((Proj ℬ).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (congrArg (Proj.basicOpen ℬ) (map_mul g x.val y.val))).op).hom.toMonoidHom
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit ℬ d
        ⟨g x.val,GradedRingHom.map_mem g x.property⟩
        ⟨g y.val,GradedRingHom.map_mem g y.property⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := nativeUnitSection_map 𝒜 ℬ g hg
    (SetLike.mul_mem_graded x.property y.property)
    ((degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit 𝒜 x.val y.val x.property y.property)^d)
  have h2 := nativeUnitSection_denominatorCast ℬ (g (x.val*y.val)) (g x.val*g y.val)
    (map_mul g x.val y.val)
    (Units.map (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g (x.val*y.val)).toMonoidHom
      (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit 𝒜 x.val y.val x.property y.property))
    (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit ℬ (g x.val) (g y.val)
      (GradedRingHom.map_mem g x.property) (GradedRingHom.map_mem g y.property))
    (nativeRatioUnit_map_heq 𝒜 ℬ g x y) d
  have hpow := map_zpow
    (Units.map (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g (x.val*y.val)).toMonoidHom)
    (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit 𝒜 x.val y.val x.property y.property) d
  exact h1.trans ((congrArg
    (fun u ↦ Units.map (Proj.awayToSection ℬ (g (x.val*y.val))).hom.toMonoidHom u)
    hpow).trans h2)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeComparison.NativeFamily.imageDegreeOneFamily_covers
statement:
theorem imageDegreeOneFamily_covers {ι : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1)
    (h : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Proj ℬ) _).2
  have hSource := (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Proj 𝒜) _).1 h
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro _; exact Set.mem_univ z
  · intro _
    have hz : Proj.map g hg z ∈ ⨆ i, Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i) := by
      rw [hSource]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hz
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
    exact ⟨i,hi⟩

statement:
theorem originalBasisProjKernelChartIso_frameRecovery
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (originalBasisProjKernelChartIso ℬ g hg b d i).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Native.generatorOpen ℬ
        (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b) i)).ι).map
        (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
          (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b)) d) ≫
      Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection ℬ
        (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b)) d i =
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b) i)).ι).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).obj (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d))) ≪≫
      originalBasisProjKernelChartUnitIso ℬ g hg b d i).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact fourFactor_frameRecovery
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Native.generatorOpen ℬ
      (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b) i)).ι).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).obj (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)))
    (originalBasisProjKernelChartUnitIso ℬ g hg b d i)
    (Native.degreeOneSheafLinearOpenIso ℬ
      (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b)) d i)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Native.generatorOpen ℬ
      (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b) i)).ι).mapIso
      (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading R M) ℬ g (basisDegreeOneFamily b)) d)
          (originalBasisImageSelection_isIso ℬ g hg b d)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeGlobalUnion.exceptionalToInfinity_chart_isPullback
statement:
theorem exceptionalToInfinity_chart_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (exceptionalToAffineInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
      (exceptionalToComponent Y J U) (affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U) (componentι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : IsPullback (J.subschemeCover.f U)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))))
      J.subschemeι (affineBaseι Y U) := ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_subschemeCover Y J U
  have ho := (exceptionalToComponent_isPullback Y J U).paste_vert hJ
  have hc : exceptionalToComponent Y J U ≫ componentι Y J =
      exceptionalToAffineInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) ≫ affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U :=
    exceptionalToComponent_ι Y J U
  have hlocal : (exceptionalToCenter (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) ≫
      (centreIso Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) =
      exceptionalToAffineInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) ≫
        affineInfinityBase Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) :=
    (exceptional_affineInfinity_isPullback Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).w.symm
  rw [← component_square] at ho
  erw [hlocal] at ho
  exact (ho.of_bot hc (affineInfinity_isPullback_base Y J U)).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeGlobalUnion.original_infinity_scheme_union
statement:
theorem original_infinity_scheme_union :
    (otherToInfinity Y J).ker ⊓ (componentι Y J).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply ideal_eq_bot_of_comap_cover _ (infinityOtherTargetCover Y J)
  intro U
  change ((otherToInfinity Y J).ker ⊓ (componentι Y J).ker).comap
    (affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U) = ⊥
  rw [comap_inf_of_openImmersion, original_other_chart_kernel,
    original_component_chart_kernel]
  exact original_affine_infinity_scheme_union (J.ideal U)

    ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_inf, original_infinity_scheme_union,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_bot]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.coe_reesLift
statement:
theorem coe_reesLift (p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R) :
    ((x.reesLift p : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) = x.polyLift p
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((reesAlgebra I).val.toRingHom).comp x.reesLift = x.polyLift := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, reesLift_C, polyLift_C]
      rfl
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, reesLift_X, polyLift_X]
      change (Polynomial.monomial 1 (x.gen i) : Polynomial R) = _
      rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, pow_one]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f p) hcomp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.symLift_surjective
statement: theorem symLift_surjective : Function.Surjective x.symLift
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
      exact ⟨C r, x.symLift_C r⟩
  | ι m =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
      have hy : (y : R) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x.gen) := by
        rw [x.span_eq]
        exact y.2
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun R).1 hy
      refine ⟨∑ i, C (c i) * X i, ?_⟩
      have hy' : y = ∑ i, c i • x.genMem i := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [genMem] using hc.symm
      have hcot : I.toCotangent y
          = ∑ i, (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (c i)) • x.conormalGen i := by
        rw [hy', map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [map_smul, algebraMap_smul]
        rfl
      rw [map_sum, hcot, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_mul, symLift_C, symLift_X, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul,
        Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p * q, map_mul _ _ _⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_symLift
statement:

    (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I).comp x.symLift
      = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)).comp x.reesLift
proof:

  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, symLift_C, reesLift_C,
      normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]
    rfl
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, symLift_X, reesLift_X,
      normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι, conormalGen, conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.polyLift_coeff
statement:
theorem polyLift_coeff (p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R) (m : ℕ) :
    (x.polyLift p).coeff m = MvPolynomial.eval x.gen (homogeneousComponent m p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial β c =>
      have hprod : (β.prod fun i k => (Polynomial.C (x.gen i) * Polynomial.X) ^ k)
          = Polynomial.C (β.prod fun i k => x.gen i ^ k) * Polynomial.X ^ β.degree := by
        rw [Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.degree_apply, map_prod,
          ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [mul_pow, ← Polynomial.C_pow]
      have hL : x.polyLift (monomial β c)
          = Polynomial.C (c * β.prod fun i k => x.gen i ^ k) * Polynomial.X ^ β.degree := by
        change MvPolynomial.eval₂ Polynomial.C _ (monomial β c) = _
        rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial, hprod, Polynomial.C_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [hL, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
        homogeneousComponent_of_mem
          ((mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).2 (isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl))]
      split_ifs with h
      · simp [eval_monomial]
      · simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, hp, hq, map_add, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.symLift_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem symLift_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem {p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R}
    (hp : ∀ β, p.coeff β ∈ I) : x.symLift p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun β _ => ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq, map_mul, symLift_C,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (hp β), map_zero, zero_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.coeff_mem_of_symLift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_of_symLift_eq_zero {p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R}
    (hp : normalSheafCoordinateMap R I (x.symLift p) = 0) (β) : p.coeff β ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have happ := congrArg (fun f => f p) (normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_symLift x)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at happ
  have hmem : x.reesLift p ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← happ]
    exact hp
  have hQ : ∀ (d : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R), F.IsHomogeneous d →
      MvPolynomial.eval x.gen F ∈ I ^ (d + 1) → ∀ α, F.coeff α ∈ I := by
    intro d F hF hval α
    have hc := x.isQuasiregular d F hF (by rw [x.span_eq]; exact hval) α
    rwa [x.span_eq] at hc
  have hcomp : ∀ m, MvPolynomial.eval x.gen (homogeneousComponent m p) ∈ I ^ (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    rw [← polyLift_coeff, ← coe_reesLift]
    exact coeff_mem_pow_succ_of_mem_map_rees R I hmem m
  have hcoeff := hQ β.degree (homogeneousComponent β.degree p)
    (homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous _ _) (hcomp _) β
  rwa [coeff_homogeneousComponent, if_pos rfl] at hcoeff

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.normalSheafCoordinateMap_injective
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := x.symLift_surjective a
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := x.symLift_surjective b
  have hzero : normalSheafCoordinateMap R I (x.symLift (p - q)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have hsub := x.symLift_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem (x.coeff_mem_of_symLift_eq_zero hzero)
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hsub
  exact hsub

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators.coneToNormalSheaf_isIso
statement: theorem coneToNormalSheaf_isIso : IsIso (coneToNormalSheaf R I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.planeC_X_regular

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (r r' : A)
    (h : ∀ a : A, r' * a ∈ Ideal.span {r} → a ∈ Ideal.span {r}) :
    IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop r A) r'
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  have huv' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (r' • u) : QuotSMulTop r A) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (r' • v) := huv
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, smul_top_eq_span_singleton] at huv'
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, smul_top_eq_span_singleton]
  refine h _ ?_
  have hsub : r' * (u - v) = r' • u - r' • v := by
    simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_sub]
  rw [hsub]
  exact huv'

  · intro f g hfg
    have h : (Polynomial.X : PlaneRing k) * f = Polynomial.X * g := hfg

statement:
theorem divX_mem_centre_pow (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (p : A[X])
    (hp : p ∈ centreIdeal I ^ (n + 1)) : p.divX ∈ centreIdeal I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [CentrePowers.mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff] at hp ⊢
  intro k
  simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_divX, Nat.add_sub_add_right] using hp (k + 1)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeUnion.centre_pow_intersection_variable
statement:
theorem centre_pow_intersection_variable (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    centreIdeal I ^ (n + 1) ⊓ Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} =
      Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} * centreIdeal I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    have hd : Polynomial.X ∣ p := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hp.2
    have hzero := Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mp hd
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mpr
    refine ⟨p.divX, divX_mem_centre_pow I n p hp.1, ?_⟩
    simpa [hzero] using Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add p
  · apply Ideal.mul_le.mpr
    intro p hp q hq
    constructor
    · have hX : Polynomial.X ∈ centreIdeal I := by
        exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
      have hp' : p ∈ centreIdeal I := (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hX)) hp
      simpa [pow_succ', mul_comm] using Ideal.mul_mem_mul hp' hq
    · exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeUnion.mem_evaluation_kernel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_evaluation_kernel_iff (I : Ideal A) (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    p ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) ↔
      ∀ n, ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro h n
    have hcoe := congrArg (fun q : reesAlgebra I => (q : A[X])) h
    have hc := congrArg (fun q : A[X] => q.coeff n) hcoe
    simpa [evaluationMap, ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq_coe,
      Polynomial.coeff_map, ← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using hc
  · intro h
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext n
    simpa [evaluationMap, ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq_coe,
      Polynomial.coeff_map, ← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using h n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeUnion.mem_kernel_exceptional_intersection_iff
statement:
theorem mem_kernel_exceptional_intersection_iff (I : Ideal A)
    (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    p ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) ⊓ ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I) ↔
      ∀ n, (p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n ∈
        Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} * centreIdeal I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  change (p ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) ∧
    p ∈ ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I)) ↔ _
  rw [mem_evaluation_kernel_iff, AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hk, he⟩ n
    rw [← centre_pow_intersection_variable]
    exact ⟨he n, Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mpr (hk n))⟩
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro n
      have hn := h n
      rw [← centre_pow_intersection_variable] at hn
      exact Polynomial.X_dvd_iff.mp (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hn.2)
    · intro n
      have hn := h n
      rw [← centre_pow_intersection_variable] at hn
      exact hn.1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.isIso_restrict_pullback_snd
proof:
:= by
  have heq : b ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) = a ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h.w]
  have hr := Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE h.flip (US := U)
    (UT := f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (UX := g ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl le_rfl
    (UY := b ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)) (by rw [heq, inf_idem])
  have hi : IsIso (f.resLE U (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.resLE_eq_morphismRestrict]
    infer_instance
  have hriso := hr.isIso_fst_of_isIso hi

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.mem_baseComplement_iff
statement:
theorem mem_baseComplement_iff (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (x : Spec (.of A)) : x ∈ baseComplement I ↔ ¬ I ≤ x.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change (x : PrimeSpectrum A) ∈ ((⨆ r : I, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r.1) : TopologicalSpace.Opens (PrimeSpectrum A)) ↔ _
  erw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
  simp only [SetLike.le_def, not_forall]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r.1, r.2, hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hnot⟩
    exact ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, hnot⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.zeroSection_preimage_baseComplement
statement:
theorem zeroSection_preimage_baseComplement (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    zeroSection A ⁻¹ᵁ baseComplement (centreIdeal I) = baseComplement I
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change zeroSection A x ∈ baseComplement (centreIdeal I) ↔ x ∈ baseComplement I
  erw [mem_baseComplement_iff, mem_baseComplement_iff]
  change ¬ centreIdeal I ≤ Ideal.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) x.asIdeal ↔ _
  rw [← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.affineInfinityBase_restrict_complement_isIso
statement:
theorem affineInfinityBase_restrict_complement_isIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    IsIso (affineInfinityBase A I ∣_ baseComplement I)
proof:
:= by
  have hpb : IsPullback
      ((blowupZeroIsoInfinity A I).inv ≫ pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A))
      (affineInfinityBase A I) (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A) := by
    refine (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).of_iso
      (blowupZeroIsoInfinity A I) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · unfold affineInfinityBase
      simp
    · simp
    · simp
  have : IsIso (blowupToLine I ∣_ baseComplement (centreIdeal I)) :=
    projection_restrict_baseComplement_isIso (centreIdeal I)
  have hi := isIso_restrict_pullback_snd hpb (baseComplement (centreIdeal I))
  rw [zeroSection_preimage_baseComplement] at hi
  exact hi

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.mem_range_of_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem mem_range_of_restrict_isIso {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (p : X ⟶ S) (q : Y ⟶ S) (h : g ≫ q = p) (U : S.Opens)
    [IsIso (p ∣_ U)] [IsIso (q ∣_ U)] (y : Y) (hy : q y ∈ U) :
    y ∈ Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (p ∣_ U).surjective ⟨q y, hy⟩
  have hx' := congrArg Subtype.val hx
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.resLE_eq_morphismRestrict] at hx'
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.coe_resLE_apply] at hx'
  have hgx : q (g x.1) = q y := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h, hx']
  have hgmem : q (g x.1) ∈ U := hgx ▸ hy
  have he : (⟨g x.1, hgmem⟩ : (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) = ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
    apply (q ∣_ U).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [morphismRestrict_base_coe] using hgx
  exact ⟨x.1, congrArg Subtype.val he⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.affineInfinity_two_images_cover
statement:
theorem affineInfinity_two_images_cover (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (x : affineInfinity A I) :
    x ∈ Set.range (exceptionalToAffineInfinity A I) ∨
      x ∈ Set.range (affineOtherToInfinity A I)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : I ≤ (affineInfinityBase A I x).asIdeal
  · left
    rw [exceptionalToAffineInfinity_range]
    change affineInfinityBase A I x ∈ Set.range
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
    rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
    rw [Ideal.mk_ker]
    change I ≤ (affineInfinityBase A I x).asIdeal
    exact hx
  · right
    have := projection_restrict_baseComplement_isIso I
    have := affineInfinityBase_restrict_complement_isIso A I
    have hmap : affineOtherToInfinity A I ≫ affineInfinityBase A I = projection I := by
      unfold affineOtherToInfinity affineInfinityBase
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, affineOtherToBlowupZero_snd]
    exact mem_range_of_restrict_isIso (affineOtherToInfinity A I)
      (projection I) (affineInfinityBase A I) hmap (baseComplement I) x
      ((mem_baseComplement_iff A I _).mpr hx)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.infinity_two_images_cover
statement:
theorem infinity_two_images_cover (z : infinityFibre Y J) :
    z ∈ Set.range (componentι Y J) ∨ z ∈ Set.range (otherToInfinity Y J)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, x, hx⟩ := (infinityOtherTargetCover Y J).exists_eq z
  change affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U x = z at hx
  rcases affineInfinity_two_images_cover Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) x with hp | hp
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hp
    left
    refine ⟨exceptionalToComponent Y J U p, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, exceptionalToComponent_ι]
    change affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U (exceptionalToAffineInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) p) = z
    rw [hp]
    exact hx
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hp
    right
    refine ⟨GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U p, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, affineι_otherToInfinity]
    change affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U (affineOtherToInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) p) = z
    rw [hp]
    exact hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.infinity_two_images_union
statement:
theorem infinity_two_images_union :
    Set.range (componentι Y J) ∪ Set.range (otherToInfinity Y J) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  exact infinity_two_images_cover Y J

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentUnion.infinity_total_image_union
statement:
theorem infinity_total_image_union :
    Set.range (infinityFibreι Y J) =
      Set.range (componentToTotal Y J) ∪ Set.range (otherToTotal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rcases infinity_two_images_cover Y J z with ⟨p, hp⟩ | ⟨p, hp⟩
    · left
      refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
      change infinityFibreι Y J (componentι Y J p) = infinityFibreι Y J z
      rw [hp]
    · right
      refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
      change infinityFibreι Y J (otherToInfinity Y J p) = infinityFibreι Y J z
      rw [hp]
  · rintro (⟨p, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨componentι Y J p, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨otherToInfinity Y J p, rfl⟩

statement:
theorem squareComparisonIso_paste {U V W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (u : U ⟶ Y) (v : V ⟶ X) (w : W ⟶ Z)
    (q : X ⟶ Y) (p : Z ⟶ X) (r : V ⟶ U) (s : W ⟶ V)
    (hr : r ≫ u = v ≫ q) (hs : s ≫ v = w ≫ p) (M : W.Modules) :
    squareComparisonIso u v q r hr ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso (squareComparisonIso v w p s hs M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp p q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward w).obj M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward u).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s r).app M) ≪≫
      squareComparisonIso u w (p ≫ q) (s ≫ r)
        (show (s ≫ r) ≫ u = w ≫ (p ≫ q) from
          by rw [Category.assoc, hr, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.assoc]) M
proof:
:= by
  have h := pushforwardTransportCubeIso u v w q p r s hr hs M
  simp only [squareComparisonIso, Functor.mapIso_trans, Iso.trans_assoc] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_reesIdeal_iff (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    q ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I ↔
      ∀ m : ℕ, (q : Polynomial R).coeff m ∈ I ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hq ↦ coeff_mem_pow_succ_of_mem_map_rees R I hq,
    AffineDeformationSpace.mem_map_of_forall_coeff_mem_pow_succ R I q⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.monomial_coeff_mem_reesAlgebra
statement:
theorem monomial_coeff_mem_reesAlgebra (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    (Polynomial.monomial n ((p : Polynomial R).coeff n)) ∈ reesAlgebra I
proof:
:=
  reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr ((mem_reesAlgebra_iff I _).mp p.2 n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coe_reesProj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_reesProj (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((reesProj R I n p : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
      Polynomial.monomial n ((p : Polynomial R).coeff n)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.sum_reesProj
statement:
theorem sum_reesProj (p : reesAlgebra I) {N : ℕ} (hN : (p : Polynomial R).natDegree < N) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, reesProj R I n p = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  exact (Polynomial.as_sum_range' (p : Polynomial R) N hN).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesProj_mem_reesIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reesIdeal_iff] at hq ⊢
  intro m
  rw [coe_reesProj, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    exact hq _
  · exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grProj_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grProj_mk (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    grProj R I n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) p) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) (reesProj R I n p)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grProj_idem
statement:
theorem grProj_idem (n : ℕ) (x : associatedGradedRing R I) :
    grProj R I n (grProj R I n x) = grProj R I n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  rw [grProj_mk, grProj_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_reesProj, coe_reesProj, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_pos rfl]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grProj_comp_of_ne
statement:
theorem grProj_comp_of_ne {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≠ n) (x : associatedGradedRing R I) :
    grProj R I m (grProj R I n x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  rw [grProj_mk, grProj_mk]
  have hz : reesProj R I m (reesProj R I n p) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_reesProj, coe_reesProj, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg (Ne.symm h)]
    simp
  rw [hz, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.sum_grProj
statement:
theorem sum_grProj (x : associatedGradedRing R I) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, grProj R I n x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  refine ⟨(p : Polynomial R).natDegree + 1, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ grProj_mk R I n p, ← map_sum,
    sum_reesProj R I p (Nat.lt_succ_self _)]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.eq_zero_of_forall_grProj_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_grProj_eq_zero {x : associatedGradedRing R I}
    (h : ∀ n, grProj R I n x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := sum_grProj R I x
  rw [← hN, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ h n, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.mem_grPiece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grPiece_iff (n : ℕ) (x : associatedGradedRing R I) :
    x ∈ grPiece R I n ↔ grProj R I n x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [grPiece, LinearMap.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact grProj_idem R I n y
  · intro h
    exact ⟨x, h⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grProj_mem_grPiece
statement:
theorem grProj_mem_grPiece (n : ℕ) (x : associatedGradedRing R I) :
    grProj R I n x ∈ grPiece R I n
proof:
:= by
  rw [grPiece, LinearMap.mem_range]
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.injective_of_degreewise
statement:
theorem injective_of_degreewise {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (φ : associatedGradedRing R I →ₗ[R] M) (proj : ℕ → M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hcomm : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : associatedGradedRing R I), φ (grProj R I n x) = proj n (φ x))
    (hinj : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : associatedGradedRing R I), x ∈ grPiece R I n → φ x = 0 → x = 0) :
    Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  refine eq_zero_of_forall_grProj_eq_zero R I fun n ↦ ?_
  refine hinj n _ (grProj_mem_grPiece R I n x) ?_
  rw [hcomm n x, hx, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom_injective
statement:
theorem associatedGradedBaseRingHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (associatedGradedBaseRingHom R I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
  have hmem : (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) a) ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I := by
    rwa [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  rw [mem_reesIdeal_iff] at hmem
  have h0 := hmem 0
  have hc : ((algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) a : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R).coeff 0 = a := by
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  rw [hc, pow_one] at h0
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr h0

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded_injective
statement:
theorem conormalToAssociatedGraded_injective :
    Function.Injective (conormalToAssociatedGraded R I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective z
  rw [conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
    mem_reesIdeal_iff] at hz
  have h1 := hz 1
  rw [degreeOneRees_coe, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_pos rfl] at h1
  exact (I.toCotangent_eq_zero y).mpr h1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionCoordinates_generator
statement:
@[simp] theorem nativeSectionCoordinates_generator (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (m : conormalChartSections Y J U) :
    nativeSectionCoordinates Y J U (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U m)
proof:
:=
  symmetricCoordinateMap_ι _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionCoordinates_restriction
statement:
theorem nativeSectionCoordinates_restriction {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (nativeSectionCoordinates Y J U).toRingHom.comp
      (actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction Y J h) =
    (cotangentSymmetricRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (nativeSectionCoordinates Y J V).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, nativeSectionCoordinates,
      actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction, cotangentSymmetricRestrictionOfEq,
      symmetricSemilinearMap_base, symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_base]
    rfl
  | ι m =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, nativeSectionCoordinates,
      actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction, cotangentSymmetricRestrictionOfEq,
      symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (J.ideal U).Cotangent)
      (conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv_naturality Y J h m)
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSections_free
statement:
theorem nativeSections_free (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :

proof:
:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSections_finite
statement:
theorem nativeSections_finite (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionCoordinates_inverse
statement:
theorem nativeSectionCoordinates_inverse (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J U x).comp (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J U x) =
      GradedRingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun (symmetricCoordinateMap_comp_symm (conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U)) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionInverse_coordinates
statement:
theorem nativeSectionInverse_coordinates (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J U x).comp (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J U x) =
      GradedRingHom.id _
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionGradedRestriction_square
statement:
theorem nativeSectionGradedRestriction_square {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J U xU).comp (nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h) =
      (boundaryGradedRestriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U)
        (J.map_ideal h) xU).comp (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J V xV)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (nativeSectionCoordinates_restriction Y J h) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionGradedRestriction_route
statement:
theorem nativeSectionGradedRestriction_route {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h = (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J U xU).comp
      ((boundaryGradedRestriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U)
        (J.map_ideal h) xU).comp (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J V xV))
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun f => (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J U xU).comp f)
    (nativeSectionGradedRestriction_square Y J h xU xV)
  rw [← GradedRingHom.comp_assoc, nativeSectionInverse_coordinates, GradedRingHom.id_comp] at he
  exact he

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionRestriction_irrelevant
statement:
theorem nativeSectionRestriction_irrelevant {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    letI
proof:
:= nativeSections_free Y J U xU
    letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U xU
    letI := nativeSections_free Y J V xV
    letI := nativeSections_finite Y J V xV
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      (conormalChartSections Y J U)) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
      (conormalChartSections Y J V))).map (nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h) := by
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J U xU
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U xU
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J V xV
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J V xV
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal V) xV
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal V) xV
  have hv := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J V xV)
    (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J V xV) (nativeSectionCoordinates_inverse Y J V xV)
  have hu := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J U xU)
    (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J U xU) (nativeSectionInverse_coordinates Y J U xU)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hv
    (boundary_irrelevant_restriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU)
  have hr := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ht hu
  rw [← nativeSectionGradedRestriction_route Y J h xU xV] at hr
  exact hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionProjRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionProjRestriction_comparison {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    conormalBoundaryRestriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU ≫ (nativeSectionProjectiveIso Y J V xV).hom =
    (nativeSectionProjectiveIso Y J U xU).hom ≫ nativeSectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV
proof:
:= by
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J U xU
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U xU
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J V xV
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J V xV
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal V) xV
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal V) xV
  exact proj_map_actual_square _ _ _ _ (nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h)
    (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J V xV) (nativeSectionGradedCoordinates Y J U xU)
    (boundaryGradedRestriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xU)
    (nativeSectionRestriction_irrelevant Y J h xU xV)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (nativeSectionCoordinates_inverse Y J V xV))
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (nativeSectionCoordinates_inverse Y J U xU))
    (boundary_irrelevant_restriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU)
    (nativeSectionGradedRestriction_square Y J h xU xV)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionProjRestriction_toCone
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionProjRestriction_toCone {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    nativeSectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV ≫ nativeSectionChartToCone Y J V xV =
      nativeSectionChartToCone Y J U xU
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (nativeSectionProjectiveIso Y J U xU).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← nativeSectionProjRestriction_comparison]
  simp only [nativeSectionChartToCone, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  apply (cancel_epi (conormalBoundaryProjIso (J.ideal U) xU).hom).mp
  erw [← Category.assoc, ← conormalBoundaryRestriction_comparison]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.w (projectiveConeGluingData Y J).functor (homOfLE h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionProjectiveIso_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionProjectiveIso_toQuotient (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    (nativeSectionProjectiveIso Y J U x).hom ≫ nativeSectionChartToQuotient Y J U x =
      conormalBoundaryToQuotient (J.ideal U) x
proof:
:= by
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J U x
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U x
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  exact symmetricCoordinateProjIso_toSpec (conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionChartToCone_centre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeSectionChartToCone_centre (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    nativeSectionChartToCone Y J U x ≫ projectiveConeToCentre Y J =
      nativeSectionChartToQuotient Y J U x ≫ J.subschemeCover.f U
proof:
:= by
  rw [nativeSectionChartToCone, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, projectiveConeAffine_toCentre,
    ← conormalBoundaryProjIso_toQuotient (J.ideal U) x]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [← nativeSectionProjectiveIso_toQuotient Y J U x]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeSectionChartToCone_isPullback
statement:
theorem nativeSectionChartToCone_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    CategoryTheory.IsPullback (nativeSectionChartToCone Y J U x)
      (nativeSectionChartToQuotient Y J U x) (projectiveConeToCentre Y J)
      (J.subschemeCover.f U)
proof:
:= by
  refine (projectiveConeAffine_centre_isPullback Y J U).of_iso
    (conormalBoundaryProjIso (J.ideal U) x ≪≫ nativeSectionProjectiveIso Y J U x)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id,
      nativeSectionChartToCone, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  · simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]
    rw [nativeSectionProjectiveIso_toQuotient, conormalBoundaryProjIso_toQuotient]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.intrinsicToNativeFrameIso_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem intrinsicToNativeFrameIso_toCentre :
    (intrinsicToNativeFrameIso Y J C).hom ≫ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).toBase =
      intrinsicProjectiveNormalBoundaryToCentre Y J C

:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeFrameGradedMap_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem nativeFrameGradedMap_comp_inverse (i : C.J) :
    (nativeFrameGradedMap Y J C i).comp (nativeFrameGradedInverse Y J C i) =
      GradedRingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  exact @semilinearSymmetricGradedMap_comp_inverse
    Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)))
    (conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i))).isModule
    inferInstance inferInstance (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i)
    (RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i))
    (RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i))
    (nativeFrameSectionsEquiv Y J C i)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeFrameGradedInverse_comp_map
statement:
theorem nativeFrameGradedInverse_comp_map (i : C.J) :

proof:
:= by

    (conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))
    ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)))
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i))).isModule
    (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).symm
    (RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).symm)
    (RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec (i : C.J) :
    (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫
      ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).affineData i).toSpecBase =
    nativeSectionChartToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  have hc := @nativeSemilinear_degreeZero_square
    Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)))
    (conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i))).isModule
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom (nativeFrameSectionsEquiv Y J C i).toLinearMap
  have hh := proj_map_zero_structure _ _ (nativeFrameGradedMap Y J C i)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (nativeFrameGradedMap_comp_inverse Y J C i))
    (symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)) (M := (ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj
      (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i))))
    ((symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) (M := conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))).comp
      (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)
    hc
  have hspec : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      ((symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (M := conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))).comp
          (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (symmetricChartZero
        (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (M := conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i)))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom) :=
    Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (symmetricChartZero
        (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (M := conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))))
  exact hh.trans ((congrArg (fun g => Proj.toSpecZero
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (conormalChartSections Y J (C.U i))) ≫ g) hspec).trans
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toCentre (i : C.J) :
    (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartToAmbient i =
      nativeSectionChartToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) ≫ C.chartCover.f i
proof:
:= by
  have hf := @spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nativeFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom) ≫
    ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).affineOpen i).2.fromSpec = C.chartCover.f i at hf
  change (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫
    (((nativeFrameCover Y J C).affineData i).toSpecBase ≫
      ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).affineOpen i).2.fromSpec) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun f => nativeSectionChartToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) ≫ f) hf)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeFrameToCone_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeFrameToCone_toCentre (i : C.J) :
    nativeFrameToCone Y J C i ≫ projectiveConeToCentre Y J =
      (nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv).mp
  change (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫
    ((nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫ nativeSectionChartToCone Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)) ≫
    projectiveConeToCentre Y J = _
  rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact (nativeSectionChartToCone_isPullback Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).w.trans
    (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toCentre Y J C i).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleGlobal.nativeFrameToCone_isPullback
statement:

      ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).affineData i).toSpecBase

      ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).affineOpen i).2.fromSpec
proof:

  refine (nativeSectionChartToCone_isPullback Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).of_iso
    (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).symm (Iso.refl _)
    (nativeFrameScalarSpecIso Y J C i) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [nativeFrameToCone, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  · exact (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec Y J C i).symm
  · simp

      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)).symm

    ∃ O : Y.Opens, J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ O = W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,he⟩ := J.subschemeι.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.mp W.isOpen

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreOverlap.exists_ambientAffineRefinement
statement:
theorem exists_ambientAffineRefinement (i j : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hi : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
    (hj : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U j) (z : W.1) :
    ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, U ≤ C.U i ∧ U ≤ C.U j ∧
      (J.subschemeCover.f U).opensRange ≤ W.1 ∧ z.1 ∈ (J.subschemeCover.f U).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O,hO⟩ := exists_ambientOpen_for_centreOpen Y J W.1
  have hzO : J.subschemeι z.1 ∈ O := by
    have hz : z.1 ∈ J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ O := by rw [hO]; exact z.2
    exact hz
  have hzi : J.subschemeι z.1 ∈ (C.U i).1 := by
    have hz := hi z.2
    rw [localFrameOpen_eq_preimage Y J C i] at hz
    exact hz
  have hzj : J.subschemeι z.1 ∈ (C.U j).1 := by
    have hz := hj z.2
    rw [localFrameOpen_eq_preimage Y J C j] at hz
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨U,hUa,hzU,hU⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
    (U := O ⊓ (C.U i).1 ⊓ (C.U j).1) ⟨⟨hzO,hzi⟩,hzj⟩
  refine ⟨⟨U,hUa⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change U ≤ (C.U i).1
    exact (le_trans hU inf_le_left).trans inf_le_right
  · change U ≤ (C.U j).1
    exact le_trans hU inf_le_right
  · rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map, ← hO]
    intro z hz
    exact ((le_trans hU inf_le_left).trans inf_le_left) hz
  · rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map]
    exact hzU

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreOverlap.centreRefinementChartMap_jointly_surjective
statement:
theorem centreRefinementChartMap_jointly_surjective (i j : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hi : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
    (hj : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U j) (z : W.1.toScheme) :
    ∃ (a : CentreAmbientRefinementIndex Y J C i j W) (q : Spec (J.subschemeCover.X a.1)),
      centreRefinementChartMap Y J C i j W a q = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,hu,hv,hw,hz⟩ := exists_ambientAffineRefinement Y J C i j W hi hj z
  change z.1 ∈ Set.range (J.subschemeCover.f U) at hz
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hz
  let a : CentreAmbientRefinementIndex Y J C i j W := ⟨U,hu,hv,hw⟩
  refine ⟨a,q, W.1.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f q) (centreRefinementChartMap_toCentre Y J C i j W a)).trans hq

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreOverlap.nativeCentreRefinement_isPullback
statement:
theorem nativeCentreRefinement_isPullback (i j : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (a : CentreAmbientRefinementIndex Y J C i j W) :
    IsPullback (nativeCentreRefinementToComponentOpen Y J C i j W a)
      (affineRefinementSectionToQuotient Y J C i a.1 a.2.1)
      (pullback.snd (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) W.1.ι)
      (centreRefinementChartMap Y J C i j W a)

  refine IsPullback.of_right
    (h₁₂ := pullback.fst (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) W.1.ι)
    (h₂₂ := W.1.ι) ?_ (nativeCentreRefinementToComponentOpen_toBase Y J C i j W a)
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)
  exact (congrArg₂ (fun top bottom => IsPullback top
      (affineRefinementSectionToQuotient Y J C i a.1 a.2.1)
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) bottom)
    (nativeCentreRefinementToComponentOpen_toComponent Y J C i j W a)
    (centreRefinementChartMap_toCentre Y J C i j W a)).mpr
      (affineRefinementSection_isPullback Y J C i a.1 a.2.1)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.symmetricPolynomialInverse_comp_forward
statement:
theorem symmetricPolynomialInverse_comp_forward :
    (symmetricPolynomialInverse Q M).comp (symmetricPolynomialForward Q M) = AlgHom.id Q _
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  rcases m with ⟨m,a⟩
  change symmetricPolynomialInverse Q M
    (symmetricPolynomialForward Q M (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q (M × Q) (m,a))) =
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q (M × Q) (m,a)
  simp only [symmetricPolynomialForward_ι,
    map_add, symmetricPolynomialInverse_C, symmetricPolynomialCoefficient_ι,
    map_smul, symmetricPolynomialInverse_X]
  rw [← map_smul, ← map_add]
  congr 1
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.symmetric_map_mem_grade
statement:
theorem symmetric_map_mem_grade (f : SymmetricAlgebra Q M →+* S)
    (h0 : ∀ a : Q, f (algebraMap Q _ a) ∈ 𝒮 0)
    (h1 : ∀ m : M, f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q M m) ∈ 𝒮 1)
    {n : ℕ} {p : SymmetricAlgebra Q M} (hp : p ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q M n) :
    f p ∈ 𝒮 n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left'
    (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q M))
    (C := fun d y _ => f y ∈ 𝒮 d) ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · exact h0
  · intro y z d hy hz hy' hz'
    simpa only [map_add] using (𝒮 d).add_mem hy' hz'
  · intro y hy d z hz hz'
    obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [map_mul]
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (h1 m) hz'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.graded_inverse_mem
statement:
theorem graded_inverse_mem {R T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ R] [AddSubmonoidClass σ R]
    [SetLike τ T] [AddSubmonoidClass τ T]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (e : R ≃+* T) (he : e.toRingHom = f.toRingHom)
    {n : ℕ} {y : T} (hy : y ∈ ℬ n) : e.symm y ∈ 𝒜 n
proof:
:= by
  have hd := f.map_directSumDecompose (x := e.symm y) (i := n)
  have hf : ∀ z : R, f z = e z := fun z => (RingHom.congr_fun he z).symm
  have hfy : f (e.symm y) = y := (hf _).trans (e.apply_symm_apply y)
  rw [hfy, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same ℬ hy] at hd
  have heq : (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (e.symm y) n : R) = e.symm y :=
    e.injective (by rw [← hf]; exact hd.trans (e.apply_symm_apply y).symm)
  rw [← heq]
  exact (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (e.symm y) n).2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse {R T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R]
    [SetLike τ T] [AddSubgroupClass τ T]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒜) (hfg : f.comp g = GradedRingHom.id ℬ) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f
proof:
:= by
  change (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).toIdeal ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).toIdeal.map f
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_eq_span]
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨n,hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
  obtain ⟨hn,hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
  have hg := HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem 𝒜 hn (g.map_mem hy)
  have hm := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f hg
  have heq : f (g y) = y := GradedRingHom.congr_fun hfg y
  change f (g y) ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).toIdeal.map f at hm
  rwa [heq] at hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.proj_map_zero_structure
statement:
theorem proj_map_zero_structure {R T Q : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [CommRing Q]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R]
    [SetLike τ T] [AddSubgroupClass τ T]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (a : Q →+* 𝒜 0) (b : Q →+* ℬ 0) (h : (Proj.degreeZeroMap f).comp a = b) :
    Proj.map f hf ≫ Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) =
      Proj.toSpecZero ℬ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.map_toSpecZero, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k)) h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.projIsoOfActualGradedMaps_chart
statement:
theorem projIsoOfActualGradedMaps_chart {R T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R]
    [SetLike τ T] [AddSubgroupClass τ T]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒜)
    (hfg : f.comp g = GradedRingHom.id ℬ) (hgf : g.comp f = GradedRingHom.id 𝒜)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (s : R) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    Proj.awayι ℬ (f s) (f.map_mem hs) hn ≫
      (projIsoOfActualGradedMaps 𝒜 ℬ f g hfg hgf).hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f s)) ≫
        Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hn
proof:
:=
  Proj.awayι_comp_map f _ hn s hs

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I)
    (m : I.Cotangent) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (m,a)) =
      Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded A I m) +
        Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom A I a) * Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map (conormalComparisonEquiv I x).toRingHom
    (symmetricPolynomialForward (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (m,a))) = _
  rw [symmetricPolynomialForward_ι, Algebra.smul_def, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply,
    Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C,
    Polynomial.map_X]
  change Polynomial.C (conormalComparisonEquiv I x (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m)) +
    Polynomial.C (conormalComparisonEquiv I x (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) * Polynomial.X = _
  rw [conormalComparisonEquiv_ι, conormalComparisonEquiv_base]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_base
statement:

      Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom A I a)
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map (conormalComparisonEquiv I x).toRingHom
    (symmetricPolynomialForward (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) = _
  rw [(symmetricPolynomialForward (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent).commutes]
  change Polynomial.map _ (Polynomial.C (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) = _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_generator_grade

theorem normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_generator_grade
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) (m : I.Cotangent) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (m,a)) ∈
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι]
  apply (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I 1).add_mem
  · simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Polynomial.monomial_zero_left] using
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial I 1 0 _ (conormal_mem_grGrade_one I m)
  · rw [Polynomial.C_mul_X_eq_monomial]
    exact
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial I 0 1 _ (associatedGradedBase_mem_zero I a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundle.normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_mem_grade
statement:
theorem normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_mem_grade
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) {n : ℕ} {p : normalBundleCompletionRing I}
    (hp : p ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) n) :
    normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x p ∈ InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I n
proof:
:= by
  apply symmetric_map_mem_grade (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I)
    (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x).toRingHom ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro a
    change normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a) ∈ _
    rw [normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_base]
    simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Polynomial.monomial_zero_left] using
      InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial I 0 0 _ (associatedGradedBase_mem_zero I a)
  · rintro ⟨m,a⟩
    exact normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_generator_grade I x m a
