name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.pushedUnitMap_comp
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (U' : Z.Opens) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (hU : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U') (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap g U' U hU ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V hV) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X V) =
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap (f ≫ g) U' V
      (hV.trans ((Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE hU)).le)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext s
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    ]
  have a1 := pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app g U' U hU W s
  have a2 := pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app f U V hV (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    ((pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap g U' U hU).app W s)
  have a3 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE f g (U'.ι ''ᵁ U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (U.ι ''ᵁ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (V.ι ''ᵁ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ W))
    (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le g U' U hU W)
    (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le f U V hV (g ⁻¹ᵁ W))) s
  rw [a1] at a2
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at a3
  have h2 := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app (f := f) (g := g)
    (M := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X V) W
  refine Eq.trans ?_ a3
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun k ↦ (AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap g U' U hU) W ≫
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V hV) (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) ≫ k)) s) h2) ?_
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  rw [a1]
  exact a2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.pushedUnitMap_comp_of_eq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_comp_of_eq {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (e : f ≫ g = h)
    (U' : Z.Opens) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (hU : U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U') (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hh : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U') :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap g U' U hU ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V hV) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X V) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X V) =
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap h U' V hh
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]
  exact pushedUnitMap_comp f g U' U V hU hV

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.piPush_comp
statement:
theorem piPush_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (e : q ≫ r = h) {ι : Type u} (T : ι → Z.Modules) (S : ι → Y.Modules)
    (F : ι → X.Modules) (m1 : ∀ i, T i ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).obj (S i))
    (m2 : ∀ i, S i ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj (F i))
    (m3 : ∀ i, T i ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).obj (F i))
    (hm : ∀ i, m1 i ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map (m2 i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q r).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app (F i) = m3 i) :
    ((Pi.lift fun i ↦ Pi.π T i ≫ m1 i) ≫
      (PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r) S).inv) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map
      ((Pi.lift fun i ↦ Pi.π S i ≫ m2 i) ≫
        (PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q) F).inv) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q r).hom.app (∏ᶜ F) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app (∏ᶜ F) =
    (Pi.lift fun i ↦ Pi.π T i ≫ m3 i) ≫
      (PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h) F).inv
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext (q ≫ r) F
  intro i
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q r).hom.naturality (Pi.π F i)
  have hA := pullbackTwistOverlap_PiLiftPushforward_π r S (fun i ↦ Pi.π T i ≫ m1 i) i
  have hB := pullbackTwistOverlap_PiLiftPushforward_π q F (fun i ↦ Pi.π S i ≫ m2 i) i
  have hC := pullbackTwistOverlap_PiLiftPushforward_π (q ≫ r) F (fun i ↦ Pi.π T i ≫ m3 i) i
  rw [hC, ← hm i, pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [← hn]
  rw [Functor.comp_map]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hB, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [hA]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.kernelMap_comp
statement:
theorem kernelMap_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (e : q ≫ r = h) {T₀ T₁ : Z.Modules} {S₀ S₁ : Y.Modules} {U₀ U₁ : X.Modules}
    (t : T₀ ⟶ T₁) (s : S₀ ⟶ S₁) (w : U₀ ⟶ U₁)
    (a₁ : T₀ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).obj S₀)
    (b₁ : T₁ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).obj S₁)
    (a₂ : S₀ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj U₀)
    (b₂ : S₁ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj U₁)
    (a₃ : T₀ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).obj U₀)
    (b₃ : T₁ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).obj U₁)
    (h₁ : t ≫ b₁ = a₁ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map s)
    (h₂ : s ≫ b₂ = a₂ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map w)
    (h₃ : t ≫ b₃ = a₃ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map w)
    (ha : a₁ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map a₂ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q r).hom.app U₀ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app U₀ = a₃) :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap r t s a₁ b₁ h₁ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map (pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap q s w a₂ b₂ h₂) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q r).hom.app (kernel w) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app (kernel w) =
    pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap h t w a₃ b₃ h₃
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (q ≫ r)).map (kernel.ι w)) := inferInstance
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (q ≫ r)).map (kernel.ι w))).1
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap_ι, pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q r).hom.naturality (kernel.ι w)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [← hn]
  rw [Functor.comp_map]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap_ι]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_kernelMap_ι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← ha, pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeChartPushedUnitMap_comp
statement:
theorem nativeChartPushedUnitMap_comp {ι : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (i : ι) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.pullbackMate_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackMate_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    {K₀ : Z.Modules} {K₁ : Y.Modules} {K₂ : X.Modules}
    (α : K₀ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj K₁)
    (β : K₁ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj K₂) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (α ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map β ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app K₂) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv.app K₀ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm α) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm β
proof:
:= by
  have hm := CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)) (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv
    (α ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map β)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv] at hm
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  refine Eq.trans hm ?_
  congr 1
  rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (α ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map β)) = _
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.pullbackMate_comp_of_eq
statement:
theorem pullbackMate_comp_of_eq {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (e : f ≫ g = h)
    {K₀ : Z.Modules} {K₁ : Y.Modules} {K₂ : X.Modules}
    (α : K₀ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj K₁)
    (β : K₁ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj K₂) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (α ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map β ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app K₂ ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app K₂) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e).inv.app K₀ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv.app K₀ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm α) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm β
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id, pullbackMate_comp]
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.selSquare_component
statement:
theorem selSquare_component {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] (F : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞)
    {P₀ P₁ X : 𝒞} {Q₀ Q₁ Y : 𝒟}
    (s : P₀ ⟶ P₁) (p₀ : P₀ ⟶ X) (p₁ : P₁ ⟶ X) (m : X ⟶ F.obj Y)
    (q₀ : Q₀ ⟶ Y) (q₁ : Q₁ ⟶ Y) (t : Q₀ ⟶ Q₁)
    (c₀ : P₀ ⟶ F.obj Q₀) (c₁ : P₁ ⟶ F.obj Q₁)
    (hc₀ : c₀ ≫ F.map q₀ = p₀ ≫ m) (hc₁ : c₁ ≫ F.map q₁ = p₁ ≫ m)
    (hs : s ≫ p₁ = p₀) (ht : t ≫ q₁ = q₀) :
    (s ≫ c₁) ≫ F.map q₁ = (c₀ ≫ F.map t) ≫ F.map q₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, hc₁, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, ht, ← hc₀]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.kernelSel_square
statement:
theorem kernelSel_square {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] (F : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞)
    {K₀ K₁ P₀ P₁ : 𝒞} {L₀ L₁ Q₀ Q₁ : 𝒟}
    (s : K₀ ⟶ K₁) (cs : P₀ ⟶ P₁) (t : L₀ ⟶ L₁) (tq : Q₀ ⟶ Q₁)
    (k₀ : K₀ ⟶ F.obj L₀) (k₁ : K₁ ⟶ F.obj L₁) (c₀ : P₀ ⟶ F.obj Q₀) (c₁ : P₁ ⟶ F.obj Q₁)
    {i₀ : K₀ ⟶ P₀} {i₁ : K₁ ⟶ P₁} {j₀ : L₀ ⟶ Q₀} {j₁ : L₁ ⟶ Q₁} (hm : Mono (F.map j₁))
    (hk₀ : k₀ ≫ F.map j₀ = i₀ ≫ c₀) (hk₁ : k₁ ≫ F.map j₁ = i₁ ≫ c₁)
    (hs : s ≫ i₁ = i₀ ≫ cs) (ht : t ≫ j₁ = j₀ ≫ tq) (hcc : cs ≫ c₁ = c₀ ≫ F.map tq) :
    s ≫ k₁ = k₀ ≫ F.map t
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hm
  apply (cancel_mono (F.map j₁)).1
  calc (s ≫ k₁) ≫ F.map j₁ = s ≫ i₁ ≫ c₁ := by rw [Category.assoc, hk₁]
    _ = (s ≫ i₁) ≫ c₁ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (i₀ ≫ cs) ≫ c₁ := by rw [hs]
    _ = i₀ ≫ c₀ ≫ F.map tq := by rw [Category.assoc, hcc]
    _ = (i₀ ≫ c₀) ≫ F.map tq := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (k₀ ≫ F.map j₀) ≫ F.map tq := by rw [hk₀]
    _ = k₀ ≫ F.map (j₀ ≫ tq) := by rw [Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp]
    _ = k₀ ≫ F.map (t ≫ j₁) := by rw [ht]
    _ = (k₀ ≫ F.map t) ≫ F.map j₁ := by rw [F.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.selSquare_abstract
statement:
theorem selSquare_abstract {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] {T T₂ M₁ M₂ U U' V V₂ W W' W'' Z Z₂ : 𝒞}
    (a : T ⟶ M₁) (b : M₁ ⟶ U) (X : U ⟶ V) (Y : V ⟶ W) (S : W ⟶ W') (e : W' ⟶ W'')
    (K₁ : U ⟶ Z) (L₁ : Z ⟶ W') (c : T ⟶ T₂) (a₂ : T₂ ⟶ M₂) (b₂ : M₂ ⟶ U') (X₂ : U' ⟶ V₂)
    (Y₂ : V₂ ⟶ W) (K₂ : U' ⟶ Z₂) (L₂ : Z₂ ⟶ W'')
    (p₁ : X ≫ Y ≫ S = K₁ ≫ L₁) (p₂ : X₂ ≫ Y₂ ≫ S ≫ e = K₂ ≫ L₂)
    (sq : a ≫ b ≫ K₁ ≫ L₁ ≫ e = c ≫ a₂ ≫ b₂ ≫ K₂ ≫ L₂) :
    (a ≫ b ≫ X ≫ Y) ≫ S ≫ e = (c ≫ a₂ ≫ b₂ ≫ X₂ ≫ Y₂) ≫ S ≫ e
proof:
:= by
  calc (a ≫ b ≫ X ≫ Y) ≫ S ≫ e = a ≫ b ≫ (X ≫ Y ≫ S) ≫ e := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = a ≫ b ≫ (K₁ ≫ L₁) ≫ e := by rw [p₁]
    _ = a ≫ b ≫ K₁ ≫ L₁ ≫ e := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = c ≫ a₂ ≫ b₂ ≫ (K₂ ≫ L₂) := sq
    _ = c ≫ a₂ ≫ b₂ ≫ X₂ ≫ Y₂ ≫ S ≫ e := by rw [p₂]
    _ = (c ≫ a₂ ≫ b₂ ≫ X₂ ≫ Y₂) ≫ S ≫ e := by simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeChartSelection_naturality
statement:
theorem nativeChartSelection_naturality {ι κ : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (r : κ → ι) :
    NativeFamily.chartSelection 𝒜 f r ≫ nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) =
    nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (NativeFamily.chartSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext (Proj.map g hg)
  intro j
  exact selSquare_component (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg))
    (NativeFamily.chartSelection 𝒜 f r) _ _ _ _ _ _
    (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f) (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r))
    (nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg f (r j)) (nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) j)
    (NativeFamily.chartSelection_π 𝒜 f r j) (NativeFamily.chartSelection_π ℬ _ r j)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeKernelSelection_toPushforward
statement:
theorem nativeKernelSelection_toPushforward {ι κ : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (r : κ → ι) (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫ nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d =
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (f ∘ r)) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g (f ∘ r)) d))) := inferInstance
  exact kernelSel_square (hm := this) (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg))
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) (NativeFamily.chartSelection 𝒜 f r)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
    (NativeFamily.chartSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d)
    (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f) (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r))
    (nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) (nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_ι 𝒜 f r d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_ι ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
    (nativeChartSelection_naturality 𝒜 ℬ g hg f r)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection {ι κ : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (r : κ → ι) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d =
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d
proof:
:= by
  apply (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv _ _)).injective
  have h1 := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg))
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d) (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d)
  have h2 := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg))
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h2.symm
  rw [nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint]
  exact (nativeKernelSelection_toPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f r d).trans
    (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
      (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d))
      (nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.imageDegreeOneFamily_congr
statement:

proof:
:= by
  subst e

    (hk : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k)

:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeKernelPullbackHom_congr
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_congr {ι : Type u} {k k' : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ} (e : k = k')
    (hk : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k)
    (hk' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k')
    (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ k hk f d ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ F d)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily_congr 𝒜 ℬ e f)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 ℬ e hk hk')).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ k' hk' f d
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.kernelSelection_congr
statement:
theorem kernelSelection_congr {ι : Type u} {k k' : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ} (e : k = k') (fam : ι → 𝒜 1)
    (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ k fam) d ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ Native.degreeOneSheaf ℬ F d)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily_congr 𝒜 ℬ e fam)) =
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ k' fam) d
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeKernelSquare
statement:
theorem nativeKernelSquare {ι : Type u} (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp f g' hf hg').symm).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map f hf)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒟 F d)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h fam)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg')
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hf'))).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp g f' hg hf').symm).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map f' hf') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map f' hf')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 g hg fam d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒞 𝒟 f' hf' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 g fam) d
proof:
:= by
  have c1 := nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒟 f g' hf hg' fam d
  have c2 := nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 𝒞 𝒟 g f' hg hf' fam d
  have cg := nativeKernelPullbackHom_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg')
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hf') fam d
  rw [c1, c2] at cg
  exact ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg _ ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    (congrArg _ (Category.assoc _ _ _))))).symm.trans cg

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.allTarget_comp_selection
statement:
theorem allTarget_comp_selection {ι : Type u} (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (fam i)))
    (hB : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒟 (g'.comp f) fam) d =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d
proof:
:= by
  let S₁ := @asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d) (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA)
  let S₂ := @asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
    (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒟 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) d)
    (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB)
  have hsel : NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒟 (g'.comp f) fam) d =
    S₂.hom ≫ NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒟 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x))
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d :=
    (nativeKernelSelection_comp 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒟 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d).symm
  have hN : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map S₁.hom ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d =
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d ≫
        NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒟 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x))
          (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d :=
    nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d
  have hf1 : nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA =
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d ≫ S₁.inv := rfl
  have hg1 : nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB =
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d ≫ S₂.inv := rfl
  rw [hsel, hf1, hg1, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hinv : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map S₁.inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map S₁.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    erw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
    exact CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _
  have hinv' := reassoc_of% hinv
  erw [← hN]
  erw [hinv']
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.allTargetSquare
statement:
theorem allTargetSquare {ι : Type u} (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (fam i)))
    (hB : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i))
    (hC : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒞)).CoversTop
      (fun i : 𝒞 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒞 i)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp f g' hf hg').symm).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map f hf)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒟 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg')
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hf'))).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp g f' hg hf').symm).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map f' hf') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map f' hf')).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 g hg fam d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒞 𝒟 f' hf' (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x) d hC
proof:
:= by
  have p₁ := allTarget_comp_selection 𝒜 ℬ 𝒟 f g' hf hg' fam d hA hB
  have p₂ := allTarget_comp_selection 𝒜 𝒞 𝒟 g f' hg hf' fam d hA hC
  have hs := kernelSelection_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h fam d
  have sq := nativeKernelSquare 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 𝒟 f g f' g' hf hg hf' hg' h fam d
  haveI : IsIso (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒟 (g'.comp f) fam) d) :=
    allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒟 (g'.comp f)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg') fam d hA
  apply (cancel_mono (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒟 (g'.comp f) fam) d ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒟 F d)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h fam)))).1
  have p₂' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map f' hf')).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 g hg fam d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒞 𝒟 f' hf' (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x) d hC ≫
      (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒟 (fun x : 𝒟 1 ↦ x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒟 (g'.comp f) fam) d ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒟 F d)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily_congr 𝒜 𝒟 h fam))) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map f' hf')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 g hg fam d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒞 𝒟 f' hf' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 g fam) d := by
    rw [hs]
    exact p₂
  exact selSquare_abstract _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p₁ p₂' sq

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.polynomialExceptional_sheafSquare
statement:
theorem polynomialExceptional_sheafSquare (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (d : ℤ) :
    type_of% (allTargetSquare (totalGrade I) (totalGrade J) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J)) (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (comparisonGraded I)
    (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h)) (comparisonGraded J)
    (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (irrelevant_comparison I)
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h)) (irrelevant_comparison J)
    (total_comparison_naturality I f J h) (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d
    (polynomialNative_covers I) (polynomialNative_covers J) (exceptionalNative_covers I))
proof:
:=
  allTargetSquare (totalGrade I) (totalGrade J) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J)) (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (comparisonGraded I)
    (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h)) (comparisonGraded J)
    (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (irrelevant_comparison I)
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h)) (irrelevant_comparison J)
    (total_comparison_naturality I f J h) (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d
    (polynomialNative_covers I) (polynomialNative_covers J) (exceptionalNative_covers I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.polynomialNativeRestrictionHom_eq_allTarget
statement:
theorem polynomialNativeRestrictionHom_eq_allTarget (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (d : ℤ) :
    polynomialNativeRestrictionHom I f J h d =
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom (totalGrade I) (totalGrade J) (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
        (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d
        (polynomialNative_covers I)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.polynomialToExceptionalHom_eq_allTarget
statement:
theorem polynomialToExceptionalHom_eq_allTarget (I : Ideal A) (d : ℤ) :
    polynomialToExceptionalHom I d =
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom (totalGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
        (comparisonGraded I) (irrelevant_comparison I) (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d
        (polynomialNative_covers I)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom_eq_allTarget
statement:
theorem exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom_eq_allTarget (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (d : ℤ) :
    exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom I f J h d =
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
        (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J))
        (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
          (centreMapEquality I f J h))
        (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
          (centreMapEquality I f J h))
        (fun x : ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) 1 ↦ x) d (exceptionalNative_covers I)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.allTarget_comp_abstract
statement:
theorem allTarget_comp_abstract {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] {T M U V W W' Z : 𝒞}
    (a : T ⟶ M) (b : M ⟶ U) (X : U ⟶ V) (Y : V ⟶ W) (S : W ⟶ W') [Mono S]
    (K₁ : U ⟶ Z) (L₁ : Z ⟶ W') (AT : T ⟶ W) (Kk : T ⟶ W')
    (p₁ : X ≫ Y ≫ S = K₁ ≫ L₁) (hc : a ≫ b ≫ K₁ ≫ L₁ = Kk) (hAT : AT ≫ S = Kk) :
    AT = a ≫ b ≫ X ≫ Y
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono S).1
  rw [hAT, ← hc]
  calc a ≫ b ≫ K₁ ≫ L₁ = a ≫ b ≫ (X ≫ Y ≫ S) := by rw [p₁]
    _ = (a ≫ b ≫ X ≫ Y) ≫ S := by simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.nativeAllTarget_selection
statement:
theorem nativeAllTarget_selection {ι : Type u} (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (fam i))) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d =
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d
proof:
:=
  inverseSelectionHom_recovery _ (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ f fam) d) (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.allTarget_comp
statement:
theorem allTarget_comp {ι : Type u} (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (fam i)))
    (hB : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i)) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g.comp f) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg)
        fam d hA =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp f g hf hg).symm).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.map f hf)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g hg (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g.comp f) fam) d) :=
    allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒞 (g.comp f)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg) fam d hA
  exact allTarget_comp_abstract _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (allTarget_comp_selection 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 f g hf hg fam d hA hB)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 f g hf hg fam d).symm
    (nativeAllTarget_selection 𝒜 𝒞 (g.comp f)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg) fam d hA)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.allTarget_congr
statement:
theorem allTarget_congr {ι : Type u} {k k' : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ} (e : k = k')
    (hk : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k)
    (hk' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k')
    (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (fam i))) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ k hk fam d hA =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 ℬ e hk hk')).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ k' hk' fam d hA
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.allTarget_comp_of_eq
statement:
theorem allTarget_comp_of_eq {ι : Type u} {k : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞} (e : g.comp f = k)
    (hk : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k)
    (fam : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (hA : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (fam i)))
    (hB : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i)) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 k hk fam d hA =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 𝒞 e.symm hk
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg))).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp f g hf hg).symm).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.map f hf)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ f hf fam d hA) ≫
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g hg (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d hB
proof:
:= by
  exact (allTarget_congr 𝒜 𝒞 e.symm hk (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg)
    fam d hA).trans (congrArg (fun m ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_congr 𝒜 𝒞 e.symm hk
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hf hg))).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 fam d) ≫ m) (allTarget_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 f g hf hg fam d hA hB))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.polynomialNativeRestriction_cocycle
statement:
theorem polynomialNativeRestriction_cocycle (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (k : J.map g = K) (d : ℤ) :
    type_of% (allTarget_comp_of_eq (totalGrade I) (totalGrade J) (totalGrade K)
      (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (totalRestrictionOfEq J g K k)
      (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq J g K k)
      (totalRestrictionOfEq_comp I f J h g K k)
      (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
      (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d (polynomialNative_covers I) (polynomialNative_covers J))
proof:
:=
  allTarget_comp_of_eq (totalGrade I) (totalGrade J) (totalGrade K)
      (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (totalRestrictionOfEq J g K k)
      (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq J g K k)
      (totalRestrictionOfEq_comp I f J h g K k)
      (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
      (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d (polynomialNative_covers I) (polynomialNative_covers J)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.grRestrictionOfEq_congr_ringMap

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeComposition.exceptionalNativeRestriction_cocycle
statement:
theorem exceptionalNativeRestriction_cocycle (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (k : J.map g = K) (d : ℤ) :
    type_of% (allTarget_comp_of_eq (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
      (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal K))
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h))
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k))
      ((grRestrictionOfEq_comp (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k)).trans
        (grRestrictionOfEq_congr_ringMap (Polynomial.mapRingHom_comp g f) _
          (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (g.comp f))
        (centreIdeal K) (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])))
      (fun x : ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) 1 ↦ x) d (exceptionalNative_covers I)
      (exceptionalNative_covers J))
proof:
:=
  allTarget_comp_of_eq (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
      (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal K))
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h))
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k))
      ((grRestrictionOfEq_comp (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k)).trans
        (grRestrictionOfEq_congr_ringMap (Polynomial.mapRingHom_comp g f) _
          (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (g.comp f))
        (centreIdeal K) (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])))
      (fun x : ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) 1 ↦ x) d (exceptionalNative_covers I)
      (exceptionalNative_covers J)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_id
statement: theorem mapLaurent_id (g : A[T;T⁻¹]) : mapLaurent (RingHom.id A) g = g
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective ?_
  ext n
  change (mapLaurent (RingHom.id A) g).coeff n = g.coeff n
  rw [coeff_mapLaurent]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_comp
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* C) (x : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    mapLaurent (g.comp f) x = mapLaurent g (mapLaurent f x)
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective ?_
  ext n
  change (mapLaurent (g.comp f) x).coeff n = (mapLaurent g (mapLaurent f x)).coeff n
  rw [coeff_mapLaurent, coeff_mapLaurent, coeff_mapLaurent]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_mem_of_eq
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_mem_of_eq {g : A[T;T⁻¹]} (hg : g ∈ extendedRees A I) :
    mapLaurent f g ∈ extendedRees B J
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [coeff_mapLaurent, ← hJ, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hg n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_extReesMapOfEq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_extReesMapOfEq (x : extendedRees A I) :
    (extReesMapOfEq I f J hJ x : B[T;T⁻¹]) = mapLaurent f (x : A[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extReesMapOfEq_congr
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_congr {f' : A →+* B} (e : f = f') :
    extReesMapOfEq I f J hJ = extReesMapOfEq I f' J (e ▸ hJ)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extReesMapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    extReesMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun x ↦ Subtype.ext (mapLaurent_id (x : A[T;T⁻¹]))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extReesMapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C)
    (hK : J.map g = K) :
    extReesMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, hJ, hK]) =
      (extReesMapOfEq J g K hK).comp (extReesMapOfEq I f J hJ)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun x ↦ Subtype.ext (mapLaurent_comp f g (x : A[T;T⁻¹]))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extReesMapOfEq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_algebraMap (a : A) :
    extReesMapOfEq I f J hJ (algebraMap A (extendedRees A I) a) =
      algebraMap B (extendedRees B J) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change mapLaurent f (algebraMap A A[T;T⁻¹] a) = algebraMap B B[T;T⁻¹] (f a)
  rw [← C_eq_algebraMap, ← C_eq_algebraMap, mapLaurent_C]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extReesMapOfEq_parameter
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_parameter :
    extReesMapOfEq I f J hJ (parameter A I) = parameter B J
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change mapLaurent f (T (-1)) = T (-1)
  have h := mapLaurent_C_mul_T f 1 (-1)
  simpa only [map_one, one_mul] using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extReesMapOfEq_reesToExtended
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_reesToExtended (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    extReesMapOfEq I f J hJ (reesToExtended A I p) =
      reesToExtended B J (reesMapOfEq I f J hJ p)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change mapLaurent f (Polynomial.toLaurent (p : Polynomial A)) =
    Polynomial.toLaurent ((p : Polynomial A).map f)
  exact mapLaurent_toLaurent f _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_extReesMapOfEq
statement:
theorem isPushout_extReesMapOfEq [Algebra A B] [Module.Flat A B] (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B)
    (hJ : I.map (algebraMap A B) = J) :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (extendedRees A I)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (extReesMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (extendedRees B J)))
proof:
:= by
  subst hJ
  exact isPushout_reesBaseChange A I B

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extendedRees_mono
statement: theorem extendedRees_mono {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : extendedRees R I ≤ extendedRees R J
proof:
:=
  fun _ hf n ↦ Ideal.pow_right_mono h _ (hf n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mem_extendedRees_top
statement: theorem mem_extendedRees_top (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) : f ∈ extendedRees R ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [Ideal.top_pow]
  exact Submodule.mem_top

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_bot
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_bot {f : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f ∈ extendedRees R ⊥) {n : ℤ}
    (hn : 0 < n) : f.coeff n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf n
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n.toNat = k + 1 := ⟨n.toNat - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [hk, pow_succ, Ideal.mul_bot] at h
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_C_zero
statement: theorem coeff_C_zero (r : R) : (LaurentPolynomial.C r : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0 = r
proof:
:= by
  have h : (LaurentPolynomial.C r : R[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C r * T 0 := by
    rw [T_zero, mul_one]
  rw [h, ← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.structureMap_bot_bijective
statement: theorem structureMap_bot_bijective : Function.Bijective (structureMap R (⊥ : Ideal R))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p q h
    have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [coe_structureMap, coe_structureMap] at h'
    exact Polynomial.toLaurent_injective (involutive_invert.injective h')
  · intro f
    refine ⟨nonPosRetract R (f : R[T;T⁻¹]), Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [coe_structureMap]
    change nonPosHom R (nonPosRetract R (f : R[T;T⁻¹])) = f
    conv_rhs => rw [eq_sum_support R (f : R[T;T⁻¹])]
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_support R (f : R[T;T⁻¹])]
    simp only [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
    rcases le_or_gt n 0 with hn | hn
    · rw [nonPosRetract_C_mul_T, if_pos (by omega), nonPosHom_monomial,
        show (-((-n).toNat : ℤ)) = n by omega]
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_bot R f.2 hn, map_zero, zero_mul, map_zero, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.specialFibreRing_bot_algebraMap_bijective
statement:
theorem specialFibreRing_bot_algebraMap_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (specialFibreRing R (⊥ : Ideal R)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro r hr
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R)) r) = 0 at hr
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hr
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hr
    have h := congrArg (fun x : extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R) ↦ (x : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0) hg
    change ((g : R[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-1)).coeff 0 = (algebraMap R R[T;T⁻¹] r).coeff 0 at h
    rw [coeff_mul_T, ← C_eq_algebraMap, coeff_C_zero,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_bot R g.2 (by norm_num)] at h
    exact h.symm
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨p, h, hh, hf⟩ := exists_reesToExtended_add_parameter_mul R ⊥ f f.2
    refine ⟨(p : Polynomial R).coeff 0, ?_⟩
    have hp : (p : Polynomial R) = Polynomial.C ((p : Polynomial R).coeff 0) := by
      ext n
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp
      · rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_succ]
        have h1 := (mem_reesAlgebra_iff _ _).mp p.2 (n + 1)
        rw [pow_succ, Ideal.mul_bot] at h1
        exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp h1
    have hmem : h * T (-1) ∈ extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R) :=
      (extendedRees R ⊥).mul_mem hh (parameter R ⊥).2
    have hsplit : f = algebraMap R (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R)) ((p : Polynomial R).coeff 0) +
        ⟨h * T (-1), hmem⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) = algebraMap R R[T;T⁻¹] ((p : Polynomial R).coeff 0) + h * T (-1)
      rw [hf, hp, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, C_eq_algebraMap]
      simp
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R)) _) = _
    rw [hsplit, map_add,
      mk_eq_zero_of_eq_parameter_mul R ⊥ (f := ⟨h * T (-1), hmem⟩) hh rfl, add_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.fibreOne_algebraMap_bijective
statement:
theorem fibreOne_algebraMap_bijective (I : Ideal R) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (extendedRees R I ⧸ fibreOneIdeal R I))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑(algebraMap R (extendedRees R I ⧸ fibreOneIdeal R I)) =
      ⇑(fibreOneEquiv R I).symm := by
    funext r
    rw [← (fibreOneEquiv R I).symm.commutes r]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact (fibreOneEquiv R I).symm.bijective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isLocalization_inclusion_top
statement:
theorem isLocalization_inclusion_top (I : Ideal R) :
    letI
proof:
:= (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (le_top : I ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away (parameter R I) (extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) := by
  letI := (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (le_top : I ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI := isLocalization_parameter R I
  have halg : ∀ x : extendedRees R I,
      ((algebraMap (extendedRees R I) (extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) x :
        extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = algebraMap (extendedRees R I) R[T;T⁻¹] x :=
    fun _ ↦ rfl
  exact
    { map_units := by
        rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
        have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (extendedRees R I) R[T;T⁻¹] y) :=
          IsLocalization.map_units R[T;T⁻¹] ⟨y, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
        refine ⟨⟨algebraMap _ _ y, ⟨((v⁻¹ : R[T;T⁻¹]ˣ) : R[T;T⁻¹]), mem_extendedRees_top R _⟩, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
        · apply Subtype.ext
          change (algebraMap (extendedRees R I) R[T;T⁻¹] y) * ((v⁻¹ : R[T;T⁻¹]ˣ) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 1
          rw [← hv, Units.mul_inv]
        · apply Subtype.ext
          change ((v⁻¹ : R[T;T⁻¹]ˣ) : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (algebraMap (extendedRees R I) R[T;T⁻¹] y) = 1
          rw [← hv, Units.inv_mul]
      surj := by
        intro z
        obtain ⟨⟨g, s⟩, hs⟩ :=
          IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers (parameter R I)) (z : R[T;T⁻¹])
        exact ⟨⟨g, s⟩, Subtype.ext hs⟩
      exists_of_eq := by
        intro x y h
        refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
        have h' : (x : R[T;T⁻¹]) = y := congrArg (Subtype.val : extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R) → R[T;T⁻¹]) h
        rw [Subtype.ext h'] }

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.inclusion_parameter
statement:
theorem inclusion_parameter {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) :
    Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R h) (parameter R I) = parameter R J
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_specialFibre
statement:
theorem isPushout_specialFibre :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ I))).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R ⊥)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R I)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.quotientMap (parameterIdeal R I)
        (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ I))).toRingHom (by
          rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap]
          exact Ideal.subset_span (inclusion_parameter R bot_le))))
proof:
:= by
  refine isPushout_of_surjective _ _ _ _ rfl Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ?_
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  exact le_of_eq (congrArg (fun x ↦ Ideal.span {x}) (inclusion_parameter R bot_le).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_genericFibre
statement:
theorem isPushout_genericFibre :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ I))).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.inclusion
        (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : (⊥ : Ideal R) ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (le_top : I ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.id (extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R))))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (le_top : I ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI := (Subalgebra.inclusion
    (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : (⊥ : Ideal R) ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away (parameter R ⊥) (extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) :=
    isLocalization_inclusion_top R ⊥
  haveI : IsLocalization ((Submonoid.powers (parameter R ⊥)).map
      (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ I))).toRingHom)
      (extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    change IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers (parameter R I)) _
    exact isLocalization_inclusion_top R I
  exact CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isLocalization
    (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono R (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ I))).toRingHom
    (RingHom.id _) rfl (Submonoid.powers (parameter R ⊥))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.isPullback_of_forall
statement:
theorem Hom.isPullback_of_forall {𝒲 𝒞 𝒟 ℬ : AlgebraData X} (α : Hom X 𝒲 𝒞)
    (β : Hom X 𝒲 𝒟) (γ : Hom X 𝒞 ℬ) (δ : Hom X 𝒟 ℬ)
    (h : ∀ U, IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (α.app U).toRingHom))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (β.app U).toRingHom))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (γ.app U).toRingHom))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (δ.app U).toRingHom))) :
    IsPullback α.map β.map γ.map δ.map
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover α.map β.map γ.map δ.map (gluingData X 𝒞).cover
    fun U ↦ ?_
  have hα := α.isPullback_map U
  have key : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (α.app U).toRingHom))
      (affineι X 𝒲 U ≫ β.map) (affineι X 𝒞 U ≫ γ.map) δ.map := by
    rw [β.affineι_map, γ.affineι_map]
    exact (h U).paste_vert (δ.isPullback_map U)
  refine key.of_iso hα.flip.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact hα.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    change _ = hα.flip.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ β.map
    rw [← Category.assoc, hα.flip.isoPullback_hom_fst]
  · rfl
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.map_comp_lineHom
statement:
theorem map_comp_lineHom {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    ((algebraData X I).map h).comp (lineHom X I k φ V) = lineHom X I k φ U
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
  · change (algebraData X I).map h
        (structureMap _ _ (Polynomial.map (kAlg X k φ V) (Polynomial.C a))) =
      structureMap _ _ (Polynomial.map (kAlg X k φ U) (Polynomial.C a))
    rw [Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_C]
    have hC : ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (J : Ideal R) (r : R),
        structureMap R J (Polynomial.C r) = algebraMap R (extendedRees R J) r := fun R _ J r ↦ by
      rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      exact (structureMap R J).commutes r
    rw [hC, hC]
    change extReesMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (res X h) (I.ideal U) (I.map_ideal h) (algebraMap _ _ _) = _
    rw [extReesMapOfEq_algebraMap, ← res_comp_kAlg X k φ h]
    rfl
  · change (algebraData X I).map h
        (structureMap _ _ (Polynomial.map (kAlg X k φ V) Polynomial.X)) =
      structureMap _ _ (Polynomial.map (kAlg X k φ U) Polynomial.X)
    rw [Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_X, structureMap_X, structureMap_X]
    exact parameter_compat X I h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.toLineOver_flat
statement: theorem toLineOver_flat : Flat (toLineOver X I k φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover (gluingData X (algebraData X I)).cover fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [cover_f]
  change Flat (affineι X I U ≫ toLineOver X I k φ)
  rw [affineι_toLineOver]
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, U.1) with hU | hU
  · rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Flat)]
    have : Subsingleton (extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)) := by
      refine ⟨fun a b ↦ Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      refine AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective ?_
      ext n
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    letI := (lineHom X I k φ U).toAlgebra
    change Module.Flat (Polynomial k) (extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U))
    infer_instance
  · letI := (kAlg X k φ U).toAlgebra
    rw [lineHom_eq]
    exact AffineDeformationSpace.toLineOver_flat Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U) k

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.pushedUnitMap_comp
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_comp {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (q' : X' ⟶ X)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (W : X'.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h' : W ≤ q' ⁻¹ᵁ V) (h'' : W ≤ (q' ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q' V W h') =
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap (q' ≫ q) U W h'' ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  ext s
  change (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q' V W h').app
      (q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      ((SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h).app T s) =
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap (q' ≫ q) U W h'').app T s
  rw [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app,
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app,
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app]
  have e := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE q' q (U.ι ''ᵁ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ T) (V.ι ''ᵁ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ q ⁻¹ᵁ T)
    (W.ι ''ᵁ W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ q' ⁻¹ᵁ q ⁻¹ᵁ T) (by
      exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le
        q U V h T) (by
      exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le
        q' V W h' (q ⁻¹ᵁ T))
  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom e s)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.pushedUnitMap_comp_congr
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_comp_congr {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (q' : X' ⟶ X)
    (k : X' ⟶ Y) (e : q' ≫ q = k)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (W : X'.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h' : W ≤ q' ⁻¹ᵁ V) (h'' : W ≤ k ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q' V W h') ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W) =
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap k U W h''
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have hA := pushedUnitMap_comp q q' U V W h h' h''
  have hi := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).inv_hom_id_app
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W)
  have hr := InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardCongr_refl_obj (q' ≫ q)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W)
  calc _ = (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q' V W h')) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (rfl : q' ≫ q = q' ≫ q)).hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X' W) := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hA, hr]
      erw [Category.assoc, hi]
      exact Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.pushforward_kernel_pi_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (kernel.ι s)) := inferInstance
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (kernel.ι s))).1
  apply SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext q F
  intro i
  simpa only [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc] using h i

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.kernelComponent_comp
statement:
theorem kernelComponent_comp {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (q' : X' ⟶ X)
    (k : X' ⟶ Y) (e : q' ≫ q = k)
    {KA : Y.Modules} {KB : X.Modules} {KC : X'.Modules}
    {PA : Y.Modules} {PB : X.Modules} {PC : X'.Modules}
    (Ng : KA ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj KB)
    (Ng' : KB ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q').obj KC)
    (Nk : KA ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).obj KC)
    (xA : KA ⟶ PA) (xB : KB ⟶ PB) (xC : KC ⟶ PC)
    (u : PA ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj PB)
    (u' : PB ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q').obj PC)
    (w : PA ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).obj PC)
    (hA : Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map xB = xA ≫ u)
    (hB : Ng' ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q').map xC = xB ≫ u')
    (hK : Nk ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map xC = xA ≫ w)
    (hu : u ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map u' ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app PC ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app PC = w) :
    (Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map Ng' ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app KC ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app KC) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map xC =
    Nk ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map xC
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardCongr_refl_obj] at hu ⊢
  rw [Category.comp_id] at hu ⊢
  have hn : (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app KC ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (q' ≫ q)).map xC =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q').map xC) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app PC :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.naturality xC).symm
  have hm : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (Ng' ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q').map xC) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (xB ≫ u') := congrArg _ hB
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp] at hm
  rw [hK, ← hu]
  calc _ = Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map Ng' ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app KC ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (q' ≫ q)).map xC) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = Ng ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map Ng' ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q').map xC)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app PC := by
      refine (congrArg (fun z ↦ Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map Ng' ≫ z) hn).trans ?_
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = Ng ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map xB ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map u') ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app PC := by rw [hm]
    _ = (Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map xB) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map u' ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp q' q).hom.app PC := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hA]; simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.projMap_comp_eq
statement:

proof:
:=
  (Proj.map_comp g g' hg hg').symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.nativeKernelToPushforward_comp
statement:
theorem nativeKernelToPushforward_comp (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (nativeKernelToPushforward ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f)) d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk)).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f)) d) =
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d
proof:
:= by
  apply pushforward_kernel_pi_hom_ext (Proj.map (g'.comp g) hk)
  intro i
  exact kernelComponent_comp (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map (g'.comp g) hk)
    (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk)
    (hA := nativeKernelToPushforward_component 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d i)
    (hB := nativeKernelToPushforward_component ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d i)
    (hK := nativeKernelToPushforward_component 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d i)
    (hu := pushedUnitMap_comp_congr (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map (g'.comp g) hk)
      (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk) _ _ _ le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk).symm).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d
proof:
:= by
  let e := projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk
  let KC := Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f)) d
  let Ng := nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d
  let Ng' := nativeKernelToPushforward ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d
  let c₀ := Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map Ng' ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app KC
  have hk0 : c₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app KC =
      nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d := by
    have := nativeKernelToPushforward_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk f d
    refine Eq.trans ?_ this
    simp only [c₀, Category.assoc]
    rfl
  have hc0 : Ng ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map Ng' =
      c₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app KC := by
    simp only [c₀, Category.assoc]
    erw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    exact (Category.comp_id _).symm
  have h1 := iteratedComponentMate (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g' hg')) Ng Ng'
  have h2 := compositeComponentMate (Proj.map g hg) (Proj.map g' hg') (M := Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)
    (N := KC) c₀
  have h3 := equalityComponentMate e.symm (M := Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) (N := KC) c₀
  have h4 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g' hg' ≫ Proj.map g hg)).homEquiv
            (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) KC).symm c₀ := by
    have hc1 := congrArg (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g' hg'))).homEquiv
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) KC).symm hc0
    exact h1.symm.trans (hc1.trans h2)
  calc nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d
      = ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map (g'.comp g) hk)).homEquiv
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) KC).symm
          (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d) := rfl
    _ = ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map (g'.comp g) hk)).homEquiv
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) KC).symm
          (c₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app KC) := by rw [hk0]
    _ = _ := h3
    _ = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e.symm).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) ≫
          nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) := by
      refine Eq.symm ((congrArg (fun z ↦
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e.symm).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
            (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫ z) h4).trans ?_)
      simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_isIso_over_nbhd_ARRM4
statement:
theorem exists_isIso_over_nbhd_ARRM4
    (f : tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme ⟶ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (i : C.I) (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
    (hf : f.app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) (1 : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)) =
      (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) from
        C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m))
    (y : C.chart i)
    (hy : y ∈ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) m) :
    ∃ V : C.scheme.Opens, C.chartι i y ∈ V ∧ IsIso (f.over V)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, y ∈ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k) := by
    have h := linearOpen_iSup_eq_top Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i)
    have hy' : y ∈ ⨆ j, linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i j) := by
      rw [h]; trivial
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy'
  let S := C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩
  let j : S.toScheme ⟶ C.scheme := S.ι ≫ C.chartι i
  let yk : S.toScheme := ⟨y, hk⟩
  have hjy : j yk = C.chartι i y := rfl
  have hA := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  obtain ⟨VA, hxA, ⟨tA⟩⟩ := exists_overTriv hA (C.chartι i y)
  let b := C.sectionBasis i
  let Ov : (C.chart i).Opens := linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m
  let V' : S.toScheme.Opens := j ⁻¹ᵁ VA ⊓ S.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Ov
  let V : C.scheme.Opens := j ''ᵁ V'
  have hyOv : y ∈ Ov := by
    change y ∈ linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact ⟨hk, hy⟩
  have hyV' : yk ∈ V' := ⟨hxA, hyOv⟩
  have hxV : C.chartι i y ∈ V := ⟨yk, hyV', rfl⟩
  have hVle : V ≤ VA := by
    change j ''ᵁ V' ≤ VA
    refine (j.image_mono inf_le_left).trans ?_
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hVU : V ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i :=
    (j.image_le_opensRange V').trans (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k)
  let eA := LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVle tA
  let tt : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) := tautQuotient_t C i k
  let t : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, V) :=
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op tt
  have hgen : ∃ a : Γ(C.scheme, V), (coefLE eA).symm (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) = a • t := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso j (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩)
      (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k) tt (tautQuotient_literal_t C i k) V'
      ((coefLE eA).symm (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)))
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hc : f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) from
          C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m) := by
    have h1 := tautChart_app_map f (homOfLE hVU) (1 : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i))
    rw [hf] at h1
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h1
    congr 1
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one (homOfLE hVU)).symm
  have hT : j.opensRange ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i := tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k
  let Φ := C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩
  have hexp := generating_explicit_ARRM4 j (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) Φ hT tt
    (tautQuotient_literal_t C i k) V' (f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)))
  let z : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, j ''ᵁ ⊤) :=
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op
      (chartTautSec_ARRM4 C i m)
  have hz : Φ.hom.app ⊤ z =
      ratioTop_ARRM4 Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m :=
    literal_chartTautSec_ARRM4 C i k m
  have hcz : f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (j.image_mono (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤))).op z := by
    rw [hc]
    change _ = (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _ ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _ _)
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rw [tautPH_app_eq_chartTautSec_ARRM4]
    rfl
  have hw : Φ.hom.app V' (f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V))) =
      S.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤)).op
        (ratioTop_ARRM4 Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m) := by
    rw [hcz, ← hz]
    exact tautChart_app_map Φ.hom (homOfLE (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤)) z
  have hwu : IsUnit (show Γ(S.toScheme, V') from Φ.hom.app V' (f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)))) := by
    rw [hw]
    exact ratioTop_restrict_isUnit_ARRM4 Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b k m V' inf_le_right
  have hρu : IsUnit ((j.appIso V').inv (show Γ(S.toScheme, V') from Φ.hom.app V' (f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V))))) :=
    hwu.map (j.appIso V').inv.hom
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgen
  have h1 : (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) = a * coefLE eA t := by
    have := congrArg (coefLE eA) ha
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at this
    exact this
  have htu : IsUnit (coefLE eA t) := IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one a (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h1.symm)
  refine ⟨V, hxV, ?_⟩
  let eB : (tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme).over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme).over V := Iso.refl _
  have hcoef : coeffAt f V eB eA = coefLE eA (f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V))) := rfl
  have hcu : IsUnit (coeffAt f V eB eA) := by
    rw [hcoef]
    have hs : f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) =
        ((j.appIso V').inv (Φ.hom.app V' (f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V))))) • t := hexp
    rw [hs, LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hρu.mul htu
  refine isIso_over_of_isUnit_coeff f V eB eA le_rfl ?_
  have hid : (homOfLE (le_refl V)).op = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  rw [hid, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  exact hcu

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartSection_mem_linearOpen_ARRM4
statement:
theorem chartSection_mem_linearOpen_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
    (hm : quotientSectionMap q (C.U i) m = 1) (x : (C.U i).toScheme) :
    C.chartSection q hq i x ∈ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) m
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartSection localSection
  let P := semilinearSymmetricProjMap (RingHom.id Γ(X, C.U i)) (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i))
    (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq (C.U i))
  have hpre := semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen (RingHom.id Γ(X, C.U i))
    (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i)) (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq (C.U i)) m
  rw [hm] at hpre
  have htop : linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) Γ(X, C.U i) (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) = ⊤ := basicOpen_symGen_eq_top _
  rw [htop] at hpre
  have hmem : ∀ w, P w ∈ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) m := by
    intro w
    have : w ∈ P ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) m := by
      rw [hpre]; trivial
    exact this
  exact hmem _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quotientSection_eq_chartι_ARRM4
statement:
theorem quotientSection_eq_chartι_ARRM4 (i : C.I) (z : X) (hz : z ∈ C.U i) :
    C.quotientSection q hq z = C.chartι i (C.chartSection q hq i ⟨z, hz⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.baseCover_quotientSection q hq i
  have h2 := congrArg (fun g => g ⟨z, hz⟩) (congrArg (fun g => g.base) h)
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_unit_hom_iso_range_ARRM4
statement:
theorem exists_unit_hom_iso_range_ARRM4 (m₀ : Γ(E, ⊤))
    (hm₀ : q.app ⊤ m₀ = (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    ∃ (f : tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme ⟶ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (W : C.scheme.Opens),
      IsIso (f.over W) ∧ Set.range (C.quotientSection q hq) ⊆ (W : Set C.scheme)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, ⊤) :=
    (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) from
      C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app ⊤ m₀)
  let f : tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme ⟶ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1 :=
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).unitHomEquiv.symm
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop _ c)
  have hfV : ∀ V : C.scheme.Opens, f.app V (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op c :=
    fun V => tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ V
  let J : Type u := {V : C.scheme.Opens // IsIso (f.over V)}
  refine ⟨f, ⨆ V : J, V.1, isIso_over_iSup f (fun V : J => V.1) (fun V => V.2), ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hzi⟩ : ∃ i, z ∈ C.U i := by
    have h := C.covers
    have hz : z ∈ ⨆ i, C.U i := by rw [h]; trivial
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hz
  let m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)) := E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : C.U i ≤ ⊤)).op m₀
  have hm : quotientSectionMap q (C.U i) m = 1 := by
    have h := quotientSectionMap_restrict q (le_top : C.U i ≤ ⊤) m₀
    change quotientSectionMap q (C.U i) (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE le_top).op m₀) = 1
    rw [h]
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (q.app ⊤ m₀) = 1
    rw [hm₀]
    exact map_one (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : C.U i ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
  have hf : f.app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) (1 : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)) =
      (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) from
        C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m) := by
    rw [hfV]
    have h := tautChart_app_map C.tautologicalPushforwardHom (homOfLE (le_top : C.U i ≤ ⊤)) m₀
    exact h.symm
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, hVi⟩ := C.exists_isIso_over_nbhd_ARRM4 f i m hf
    (C.chartSection q hq i ⟨z, hzi⟩)
    (C.chartSection_mem_linearOpen_ARRM4 q hq i m hm ⟨z, hzi⟩)
  rw [C.quotientSection_eq_chartι_ARRM4 q hq i z hzi]
  exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, hVi⟩, hyV⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quotientSection_twist_nonempty_ARRM4
statement:
theorem quotientSection_twist_nonempty_ARRM4 (m₀ : Γ(E, ⊤))
    (hm₀ : q.app ⊤ m₀ = (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.quotientSection q hq)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      tensorUnitSheaf X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, W, hW, hrange⟩ := C.exists_unit_hom_iso_range_ARRM4 q hq m₀ hm₀
  haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.NormalCone.ARRM4.isIso_pullback_map_of_range_subset
    (C.quotientSection q hq) f W hW hrange
  exact ⟨(asIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.quotientSection q hq)).map f)).symm ≪≫
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso (C.quotientSection q hq)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.zeroSection_twist_nonempty_ARRM4
statement:
theorem zeroSection_twist_nonempty_ARRM4 :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.zeroSection).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      tensorUnitSheaf Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine C.quotientSection_twist_nonempty_ARRM4 biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
    ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf Z ⟶ N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤))) ?_
  have h := congrArg (fun g : tensorUnitSheaf Z ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf Z => g.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    (biprod.inr_snd : (biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf Z ⟶ N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z) ≫ biprod.snd =
      𝟙 (tensorUnitSheaf Z))
