name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection_noTwist_ARRM4
statement:
theorem adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection_noTwist_ARRM4 {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] {Nsh : Z.Modules} {d : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank Z (Nsh ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z) (d + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover Z (Nsh ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z))
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent Z)
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators C.scheme) (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent C.scheme) (N : K0 Z)
    (hEN : k0ClassOf Z (Nsh ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z) hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = N + 1)
    (push : K0 Z →+ K0 C.scheme) (pushLoc : KLoc j Z →+ KLoc j C.scheme)
    (hpushLoc : ∀ x, pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (push x))
    (proj : ∀ y x, pushLoc (locMap (pullbackK0RingHom C.zeroSection) y * x) = y * pushLoc x)
    (koszul : push 1 =
      lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE))
    (x : K0 Z) :
    haveI
proof:
:= C.isNoetherian_scheme
    algebraMap (K0 C.scheme) (KLoc j C.scheme) (adamsRingHom hrankP j (push x)) =
      pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankZ j x) *
        ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z)) :=
  adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection hj hE C hrankZ hnilZ hrankP hnilP N hEN
    C.zeroSection_twist_iso_ARRM4 push pushLoc hpushLoc proj koszul x

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.pfId_naturality
statement:
theorem pfId_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}} {q : X ⟶ X} (e : q = 𝟙 X) {M N : X.Modules}
    (φ : M ⟶ N) : pfId e M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map φ = φ ≫ pfId e N
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp only [pfId]
  have h1 := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.naturality φ
  have h2 := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (rfl : 𝟙 X = 𝟙 X)).hom.naturality φ
  simp only [Functor.id_map] at h1
  rw [Category.assoc, ← h2]
  erw [← Category.assoc, ← h1]

      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)

  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext s
  have := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app
    (𝟙 X) U U h W.unop s

  have e : ∀ (A : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ A), X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op = 𝟙 _ := fun A h => by simp

theorem nativeKernelToPushforward_id
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜))
    (e : Proj.map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg = 𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg f d =
      pfId e (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)
proof:
:= by

  intro i
  have h1 := nativeKernelToPushforward_component 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg f d i

      Pi.π (fun i => SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)

      pfId e (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))) :=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.nativeKernelPullbackHom_id
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_id
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜))
    (e : Proj.map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg = 𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg f d =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId (Proj 𝒜)).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nativeKernelPullbackHom
  rw [nativeKernelToPushforward_id 𝒜 f hg e d]
  have h1 := equalityComponentMate e
    (M := Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) (N := Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId (Proj 𝒜)).inv.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d))
  have h2 := CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    (Adjunction.id (C := (Proj 𝒜).Modules))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId (Proj 𝒜)).hom
    (𝟙 (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d))
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackId_hom] at h2
  have h3 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜))).homEquiv
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)).symm
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId (Proj 𝒜)).inv.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId (Proj 𝒜)).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) := by
    erw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at h2
    exact h2
  exact h1.trans (congrArg _ h3)

statement:
theorem kernelSelection_comp {A σ : Type u} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] {ι κ μ : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (r : κ → ι) (s : μ → κ) (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫ NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (f ∘ r) s d =
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f (r ∘ s) d
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι _)).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  have a1 := NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 (f ∘ r) s d j
  have a2 := NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f r d (s j)
  have a3 := NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f (r ∘ s) d j
  exact ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (fun q => NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫ q) a1).trans
    a2)).trans a3.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.sel_chase
statement:
theorem sel_chase {𝒳 𝒴 : Type*} [Category 𝒳] [Category 𝒴] (F : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳)
    {K K' PA : 𝒳} {Kb Kb' Pb : 𝒴} (nK : K ⟶ F.obj Kb) (nK' : K' ⟶ F.obj Kb')
    (sel : K ⟶ K') (selb : Kb ⟶ Kb') (ι : K ⟶ PA) (ι' : K' ⟶ PA) (ιb : Kb ⟶ Pb)
    (ιb' : Kb' ⟶ Pb) (u : PA ⟶ F.obj Pb)
    (h1 : nK' ≫ F.map ιb' = ι' ≫ u) (h2 : nK ≫ F.map ιb = ι ≫ u)
    (h3 : sel ≫ ι' = ι) (h4 : selb ≫ ιb' = ιb) :
    sel ≫ nK' ≫ F.map ιb' = (nK ≫ F.map selb) ≫ F.map ιb'
proof:
:= by
  rw [h1, reassoc_of% h3, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, h4, h2]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.nativeKernelToPushforward_selection
statement:
theorem nativeKernelToPushforward_selection (d : ℤ) :

      nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
          (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d)
proof:
:= by

  intro j
  have h1 := nativeKernelToPushforward_component 𝒜 ℬ g hg (f ∘ r) d j
  have h2 := nativeKernelToPushforward_component 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d (r j)
  have h3 := NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f r d j
  have h4 := NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) r d j
  exact sel_chase (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3 h4

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection

theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection (d : ℤ) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.allTarget_chase
statement:
theorem allTarget_chase {𝒴 𝒵 : Type*} [Category 𝒴] [Category 𝒵] (F : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒵)
    {Kp A B : 𝒴} {C D₁ D₂ : 𝒵} (m : Kp ⟶ B) (e : A ≅ B) (n₂ : F.obj B ⟶ D₂)
    (N : F.obj A ⟶ D₁) (s' : C ≅ D₁) (sc : C ≅ D₂) (sel : D₁ ⟶ D₂)
    (hsc : s'.hom ≫ sel = sc.hom) (hnat : F.map e.hom ≫ n₂ = N ≫ sel) :
    F.map (m ≫ e.inv) ≫ N ≫ s'.inv = F.map m ≫ n₂ ≫ sc.inv
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : F.map e.inv ≫ N ≫ sel = n₂ := by
    rw [← hnat, ← Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, e.inv_hom_id, F.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  have h2 : sel ≫ sc.inv = s'.inv := by
    apply (cancel_epi s'.hom).1
    rw [s'.hom_inv_id, ← Category.assoc, hsc, sc.hom_inv_id]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, ← h2, ← h1]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeIdentityC5.nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp
statement:
theorem nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp (d : ℤ)
    (h : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)))
    (h' : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i)) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d
        (h) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk).symm).hom.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
          (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d h) ≫
        nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d h'
proof:
:= by
  unfold nativeAllTargetPullbackHom
  rw [nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk f d]
  have key := allTarget_chase (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg'))
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection ℬ (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d h))
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d h'))
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) f) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) hk f d h))
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x))
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (kernelSelection_comp 𝒞 (fun x : 𝒞 1 ↦ x) (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x))
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom_selection ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
  exact ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun z => CategoryStruct.comp _ z)
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun z => CategoryStruct.comp _ z)
      (Category.assoc _ _ _))))).trans
    (congrArg (fun z => CategoryStruct.comp _ (CategoryStruct.comp _ z)) key.symm)

statement:
theorem frameBoundaryRatioSection_map (i : C.J)
    (x y : SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)
      ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i))) 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE (frameBoundaryToFrame Y J C i)
      (Proj.basicOpen (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)))) (x.val*y.val))
      (Proj.basicOpen (grGrade (J.ideal (C.U i)))
        (frameBoundaryGradedMap Y J C i (x.val*y.val))) (by rfl))
      ((Proj.awayToSection (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)))) (x.val*y.val))
        (degreeOneOverlapRatio (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,(nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (op ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)))) x.val y.val x.property y.property)) =
    (Proj.awayToSection (grGrade (J.ideal (C.U i)))
      (frameBoundaryGradedMap Y J C i (x.val*y.val)))
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grGrade (J.ideal (C.U i)))
        (GradedRingHom.map_mem (frameBoundaryGradedMap Y J C i)
          (SetLike.mul_mem_graded x.property y.property)) 1
        ((frameBoundaryGradedMap Y J C i y.val)^2)
        (by simpa using (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2
          (GradedRingHom.map_mem (frameBoundaryGradedMap Y J C i) y.property)))) :=
  by
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwist.frameBoundaryToFrame_toCone
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem frameBoundaryToFrame_toCone (i : C.J) :
    frameBoundaryToFrame Y J C i ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C i =
      projectiveConeAffineι Y J (C.U i)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  have hs : nativeSectionChartToCone Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) =
      (sectionConeProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective).hom ≫
        projectiveConeAffineι Y J (C.U i) := by
    rw [sectionConeProjIso_original]
    rfl
  have hf : frameBoundaryToFrame Y J C i =
      (sectionConeProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective).inv ≫
        (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv :=
    frameBoundaryProjMap_original Y J C i
  have ht : nativeFrameToCone Y J C i =
      (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫
        ((sectionConeProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective).hom ≫
          projectiveConeAffineι Y J (C.U i)) :=
    congrArg (fun q => (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫ q) hs
  exact (congrArg₂ (fun f g => f ≫ g) hf ht).trans
    (inversePair_route_cancel (nativeFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i)
      (sectionConeProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective)
      (projectiveConeAffineι Y J (C.U i)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwist.frameBoundaryToFrame_globalRecovery
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem frameBoundaryToFrame_globalRecovery (i : C.J) :
    (frameBoundaryToFrame Y J C i ≫ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartι i) ≫
      (nativeFrameConeIso Y J C).hom = projectiveConeAffineι Y J (C.U i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, nativeFrameConeIso_chart, frameBoundaryToFrame_toCone]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwist.frameBoundaryNativeKernelHom_selection
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem frameBoundaryNativeKernelHom_selection (i : C.J) (d : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    frameBoundaryNativeKernelHom Y J C i d ≫
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection (grGrade (J.ideal (C.U i))) (fun x => x)
        (frameBoundaryImageFamily Y J C i) d =
    InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.originalBasisImageKernelPullbackHom _ _
      (frameBoundaryGradedMap_irrelevant Y J C i) ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionBasis i) d := by
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  exact InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.originalBasisNativeKernelPullbackHom_selection _ _
    (frameBoundaryGradedMap_irrelevant Y J C i) ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).sectionBasis i) d

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.comp_tensorLift
statement:
theorem comp_tensorLift {S' : Type u} [CommRing S'] [Algebra R S']
    (g : B →ₐ[R] C) (f₁ : S →ₐ[R] B) (f₂ : S' →ₐ[R] B) :
    g.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f₁ f₂ fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (g.comp f₁) (g.comp f₂) fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
  · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]
  · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight',
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight']

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.comp_translate

    g.comp (translate α φ l) = translate α (g.comp φ) (g.toLinearMap.comp l)
proof:

  rw [translate, translate, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, comp_tensorLift, comp_symLift]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.comp_contraction
statement:
theorem comp_contraction (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (r : R) :
    φ.comp (contraction ψ r) = scale ψ φ (algebraMap R B r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contraction, comp_scale, AlgHom.comp_id, AlgHom.commutes]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.scale_comp_of_isConeHom
statement:
theorem scale_comp_of_isConeHom {S' : Type u} [CommRing S'] [Algebra R S']
    {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S'} {φ₀ : S →ₐ[R] S'}
    (h : IsConeHom ψ ψ' φ₀) (g : S' →ₐ[R] B) (b : B) :
    (scale ψ' g b).comp φ₀ = scale ψ (g.comp φ₀) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [scale, scale, AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.ConeAction.scale_translate
statement:
theorem scale_translate (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (l : F →ₗ[R] B) (b : B) :
    scale A.coaction (translate A.act φ l) b =
      translate A.act (scale A.coaction φ b) (b • l)
proof:
:= by
  set L : (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] B :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift φ (SymmetricAlgebra.lift l) fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _ with hL
  have key : scale (tensorCoaction A.coaction (symCoaction R F)) L b =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (scale A.coaction φ b) (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (b • l))
        fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _ := by
    refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [scale_comp_of_isConeHom (isConeHom_includeLeft A.coaction (symCoaction R F)),
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]
    · rw [scale_comp_of_isConeHom (isConeHom_includeRight A.coaction (symCoaction R F)),
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight',
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight', ← pointsEquiv_symm_eq,
        ← pointsEquiv_symm_eq, scale_symCoaction]
  calc scale A.coaction (translate A.act φ l) b
      = (evalHom (L.comp A.act) b).comp A.coaction := rfl
    _ = (evalHom L b).comp ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom A.act).comp A.coaction) := by
        rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom]
    _ = (scale (tensorCoaction A.coaction (symCoaction R F)) L b).comp A.act := by
        rw [A.conic, scale, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = translate A.act (scale A.coaction φ b) (b • l) := by rw [key]; rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.ConeAction.scale_zero_eq
statement:
theorem scale_zero_eq {ε : S →ₐ[R] R} (hv : IsConeVertex A.coaction ε) (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) :
    scale A.coaction φ (0 : B) = (Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : φ.comp (contraction A.coaction (0 : R)) = scale A.coaction φ (0 : B) := by
    rw [comp_contraction, map_zero]
  rw [← h0, hv, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact AlgHom.ext fun r => φ.commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.ConeAction.scale_vertex
statement:
theorem scale_vertex {ε : S →ₐ[R] R} (hv : IsConeVertex A.coaction ε) (b : B) :
    scale A.coaction ((Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε) b = (Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε
proof:
:= by
  have h := A.scale_zero_eq hv ((Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε)
  calc scale A.coaction ((Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε) b
      = scale A.coaction (scale A.coaction ((Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε) (0 : B)) b := by rw [h]
    _ = scale A.coaction ((Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε) (0 * b) := A.isCone.scale_scale _ 0 b
    _ = (Algebra.ofId R B).comp ε := by rw [zero_mul, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.ConeAction.comp_contraction_translate
statement:
theorem comp_contraction_translate (r : R) (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (l : F →ₗ[R] B) :

      translate A.act (φ.comp (contraction A.coaction r)) (algebraMap R B r • l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_contraction, comp_contraction, A.scale_translate]

statement:

    (fun x => QuotientGroupoid.ext (AlgHom.id_comp _)) fun x y f => ?_

proof:

  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun x => QuotientGroupoid.ext ?_) fun x y f => ?_
  · exact comp_scale A.coaction g x.point b
  · refine Hom.ext ?_

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.tensorCoaction_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorCoaction_tmul {S S' : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [CommRing S']
    [Algebra R S'] (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S') (a : S) (b : S') :
    tensorCoaction ψ ψ' (a ⊗ₜ[R] b) =
      Polynomial.mapAlgHom
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S') (ψ a) *
        Polynomial.mapAlgHom
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S' →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S') (ψ' b)
proof:
:=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_symComul_lift
statement:
theorem translate_symComul_lift (m l : F →ₗ[R] B) :
    translate (symComul R F) (SymmetricAlgebra.lift m) l = SymmetricAlgebra.lift (m + l)
proof:
:=
  lift_comp_symComul m l

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_symComul
statement:
theorem translate_symComul (φ : SymmetricAlgebra R F →ₐ[R] B) (l : F →ₗ[R] B) :
    translate (symComul R F) φ l = SymmetricAlgebra.lift (SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm φ + l)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← SymmetricAlgebra.lift.apply_symm_apply φ]
  exact translate_symComul_lift _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translationAction_hom_unique
statement:
theorem translationAction_hom_unique (x y : QuotientGroupoid (translationAction R F) B) :
    ∃! l : F →ₗ[R] B, translate (translationAction R F).act x.point l = y.point
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm y.point - SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm x.point, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change translate (symComul R F) x.point _ = y.point
    rw [translate_symComul, add_sub_cancel, SymmetricAlgebra.lift.apply_symm_apply]
  · intro l hl
    have hl' : translate (symComul R F) x.point l = y.point := hl
    rw [translate_symComul] at hl'
    have h2 := congrArg SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm hl'
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm_apply_apply] at h2
    rw [← h2]
    abel

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_comp
statement:
theorem translate_comp (h : IsEquivariant A A' φ u) (x : S' →ₐ[R] B) (l : F' →ₗ[R] B) :
    (translate A'.act x l).comp φ = translate A.act (x.comp φ) (l.comp u)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift x (SymmetricAlgebra.lift l)
        fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _).comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (symMap u)) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (x.comp φ) (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (l.comp u))
        fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _ := by
    refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp_includeLeft, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]
    · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp_includeRight, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight',
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight', symLift_comp_symMap]
  rw [translate, translate, AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, key]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.isEquivariant_id
statement:
theorem isEquivariant_id (A : ConeAction R S F) :
    IsEquivariant A A (AlgHom.id R S) (LinearMap.id)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : symMap (LinearMap.id : F →ₗ[R] F) = AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R F) := by
    rw [symMap, LinearMap.comp_id, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι]
  rw [IsEquivariant, hs, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_id, AlgHom.id_comp, AlgHom.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.IsEquivariant.comp
proof:
:= by
  have hs : symMap (u'.comp u) = (symMap u').comp (symMap u) := by
    refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_)
    simp
  rw [IsEquivariant, hs, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp, AlgHom.comp_assoc, h,
    ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, h', AlgHom.comp_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.quotientFunctor_comp
statement:
theorem quotientFunctor_comp {φ' : S' →ₐ[R] S''} {u' : F' →ₗ[R] F''}
    (h : IsEquivariant A A' φ u) (h' : IsEquivariant A' A'' φ' u')
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] :
    quotientFunctor (h.comp h') B = quotientFunctor h' B ⋙ quotientFunctor h B
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    (fun x => QuotientGroupoid.ext (AlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm) fun x y f => ?_

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.quotientFunctor_comp_mapQuotient
statement:
theorem quotientFunctor_comp_mapQuotient (h : IsEquivariant A A' φ u) (g : B →ₐ[R] C) :
    quotientFunctor h B ⋙ QuotientGroupoid.mapQuotient A g =
      QuotientGroupoid.mapQuotient A' g ⋙ quotientFunctor h C
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    (fun x => QuotientGroupoid.ext (AlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _)) fun x y f => ?_
  refine QuotientGroupoid.Hom.ext ?_
  ext m
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.isEquivalence_quotientFunctor
statement:
theorem isEquivalence_quotientFunctor (h : IsEquivariant A A' φ u) (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R B]
    (hsurj : ∀ y : S →ₐ[R] B, ∃ x : S' →ₐ[R] B, ∃ l : F →ₗ[R] B,
      translate A.act (x.comp φ) l = y)
    (hinj : ∀ (x y : S' →ₐ[R] B) (l₁ l₂ : F' →ₗ[R] B), translate A'.act x l₁ = y →
      translate A'.act x l₂ = y → l₁.comp u = l₂.comp u → l₁ = l₂)
    (hlift : ∀ (x y : S' →ₐ[R] B) (l : F →ₗ[R] B),
      translate A.act (x.comp φ) l = y.comp φ →
      ∃ l' : F' →ₗ[R] B, translate A'.act x l' = y ∧ l'.comp u = l) :
    (quotientFunctor h B).IsEquivalence where
  faithful
proof:
:=
    ⟨fun {x y} f g hfg => QuotientGroupoid.Hom.ext
      (hinj x.point y.point f.val g.val f.translate_eq g.translate_eq
        (congrArg QuotientGroupoid.Hom.val hfg))⟩
  full :=
    ⟨fun {x y} k => by
      obtain ⟨l', hl', hu⟩ := hlift x.point y.point k.val k.translate_eq
      exact ⟨⟨l', hl'⟩, QuotientGroupoid.Hom.ext hu⟩⟩
  essSurj :=
    ⟨fun y => by
      obtain ⟨x, l, hl⟩ := hsurj y.point
      exact ⟨⟨x⟩, ⟨(Groupoid.isoEquivHom _ _).symm ⟨l, hl⟩⟩⟩⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.isConeHom_tensor_ext
statement:
theorem isConeHom_tensor_ext {S' S'' : Type u} [CommRing S'] [Algebra R S']
    [CommRing S''] [Algebra R S''] {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S'}
    {ψ'' : S'' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S''} {α : (S ⊗[R] S') →ₐ[R] S''}
    (hL : IsConeHom ψ ψ''
      (α.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S')))
    (hR : IsConeHom ψ' ψ''
      (α.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S' →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S'))) :
    IsConeHom (tensorCoaction ψ ψ') ψ'' α
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
  · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← isConeHom_includeLeft ψ ψ', ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, mapAlgHom_comp,
      hL, AlgHom.comp_assoc]
  · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← isConeHom_includeRight ψ ψ', ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, mapAlgHom_comp,
      hR, AlgHom.comp_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.freeCoaction_comp_includeLeft
statement:
theorem freeCoaction_comp_includeLeft :
    (freeCoaction R S F).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
          (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] _).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [freeCoaction, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft, freeLeft]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.freeCoaction_comp_includeRight
statement:
theorem freeCoaction_comp_includeRight :
    (freeCoaction R S F).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          SymmetricAlgebra R F →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          SymmetricAlgebra R F →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F)
        (AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R F))).comp (symComul R F)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [freeCoaction, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight', freeRight]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.tensorPoint_eq
statement:
theorem tensorPoint_eq (Φ : (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] B) :
    Φ = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
      (SymmetricAlgebra.lift
        (SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)))
      (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift.apply_symm_apply]
  refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
  · rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]
  · rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight']

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_freeCoaction
statement:
theorem translate_freeCoaction (x : S →ₐ[R] B) (v l : F →ₗ[R] B) :
    translate (freeCoaction R S F)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift x (SymmetricAlgebra.lift v)
          fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _) l =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift x (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (v + l))
        fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
  · rw [translate, AlgHom.comp_assoc, freeCoaction_comp_includeLeft, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]
  · rw [translate, AlgHom.comp_assoc, freeCoaction_comp_includeRight, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight']
    have key : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift x (SymmetricAlgebra.lift v)
            fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _) (SymmetricAlgebra.lift l)
            fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
              SymmetricAlgebra R F →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F)
            (AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R F))) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (SymmetricAlgebra.lift v) (SymmetricAlgebra.lift l)
          fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _ := by
      refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
      · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp_includeLeft, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight',
          Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]
      · rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp_includeRight, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight', AlgHom.comp_id,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight']
    rw [key, lift_comp_symComul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_freeCoaction_point
statement:
theorem translate_freeCoaction_point (Φ : (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] B)
    (l : F →ₗ[R] B) :
    translate (freeCoaction R S F) Φ l =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
        (SymmetricAlgebra.lift
          (SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) + l))
        (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [tensorPoint_eq Φ]
  rw [translate_freeCoaction]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.freeCoaction_comp_translate
statement:
theorem freeCoaction_comp_translate (Φ : (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] B)
    (l : F →ₗ[R] B) :
    (translate (freeCoaction R S F) Φ l).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft =
      Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
proof:
:= by
  rw [translate, AlgHom.comp_assoc, freeCoaction_comp_includeLeft, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.freeCoaction_translate_injective
statement:
theorem freeCoaction_translate_injective (Φ : (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] B)
    {l₁ l₂ : F →ₗ[R] B}
    (heq : translate (freeCoaction R S F) Φ l₁ = translate (freeCoaction R S F) Φ l₂) :
    l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [translate_freeCoaction_point, translate_freeCoaction_point] at heq
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun k => SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm
      (k.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
        SymmetricAlgebra R F →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F))) heq
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight',
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm_apply_apply] at h1
  exact add_left_cancel h1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.freeAction_nonempty_hom_iff
statement:
theorem freeAction_nonempty_hom_iff (Φ Ψ : QuotientGroupoid (freeAction (F := F) h) B) :
    Nonempty (Φ ⟶ Ψ) ↔
      Φ.point.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft =
        Ψ.point.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f⟩
    rw [← f.translate_eq]
    exact (freeCoaction_comp_translate Φ.point f.val).symm
  · intro hC
    refine ⟨⟨SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (Ψ.point.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) -
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (Φ.point.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight), ?_⟩⟩
    change translate (freeCoaction R S F) Φ.point _ = Ψ.point
    rw [translate_freeCoaction_point, add_sub_cancel, hC, ← tensorPoint_eq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_neg_freeCoaction
statement:
theorem translate_neg_freeCoaction (Φ : (S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) →ₐ[R] B) :
    translate (freeCoaction R S F) Φ
        (-SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
        (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (0 : F →ₗ[R] B)) (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [translate_freeCoaction_point, add_neg_cancel]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.IsExactSequence.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext (h : IsExactSequence A ψD φ) {x y : QuotientGroupoid A B} (f g : x ⟶ y) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine QuotientGroupoid.Hom.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 (h.free x.point (f.val - g.val) ?_))
  have h1 : translate A.act (translate A.act x.point f.val) (-g.val) =
      translate A.act x.point (f.val - g.val) := by
    rw [A.act_add]
    congr 1
    abel
  rw [← h1, f.translate_eq, ← g.translate_eq, A.act_add, add_neg_cancel, A.act_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.IsExactSequence.nonempty_hom_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_hom_iff (h : IsExactSequence A ψD φ) (x y : QuotientGroupoid A B) :
    Nonempty (x ⟶ y) ↔ x.point.comp φ = y.point.comp φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨f⟩ => ?_, fun hxy => ?_⟩
  · rw [← f.translate_eq, h.invariant]
  · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h.orbit x.point y.point hxy
    exact ⟨⟨l, hl⟩⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.isExactSequence_freeAction
statement:
theorem isExactSequence_freeAction {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) :
    IsExactSequence (freeAction (F := F) h) ψ
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] SymmetricAlgebra R F) where
  coneHom
proof:
:= isConeHom_includeLeft ψ (symCoaction R F)
  invariant := by
    intro B _ _ x l
    exact freeCoaction_comp_translate x l
  surjective := by
    intro B _ _ y
    exact ⟨Algebra.TensorProduct.lift y (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (0 : F →ₗ[R] B))
      fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft _ _ _⟩
  orbit := by
    intro B _ _ x y hxy
    refine ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (y.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) -
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm (x.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight), ?_⟩
    change translate (freeCoaction R S F) x _ = y
    rw [translate_freeCoaction_point, add_sub_cancel, hxy, ← tensorPoint_eq]
  free := by
    intro B _ _ x l hl
    refine freeCoaction_translate_injective x (hl.trans ?_)
    exact ((freeAction (F := F) h).act_zero x).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.zeroSectionMap_comp_actionMap
statement:
theorem zeroSectionMap_comp_actionMap (A : ConeAction R S F) :
    zeroSectionMap R S F ≫ actionMap A = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroSectionMap, actionMap, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
  congr 1
  exact CommRingCat.hom_ext
    (congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (A.act_zero (AlgHom.id R S)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.actionMap_comp_contractionMap
statement:
theorem actionMap_comp_contractionMap (A : ConeAction R S F) (r : R) :
    actionMap A ≫ contractionMap A.coaction r =
      contractionMap (tensorCoaction A.coaction (symCoaction R F)) r ≫ actionMap A
proof:
:= by
  rw [actionMap, contractionMap, contractionMap, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact CommRingCat.hom_ext (congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (A.conic.comp_contraction r))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.mixedLeftIso
statement:
private theorem mixedLeftIso {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M).symm
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (pushforwardComp_assoc_mixed_left_obj f g h M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.mixedRightIso
statement:
private theorem mixedRightIso {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M).symm
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (pushforwardComp_assoc_mixed_obj f g h M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.congrFirstInvIso
statement:
private theorem congrFirstInvIso {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    (a : f = g) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : X.Modules) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).app M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ h) a)).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app M).symm
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (pushforwardComp_congr_first_inv_obj a h M).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.congrSecondIso
statement:
private theorem congrSecondIso {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {g h : Y ⟶ Z} (a : g = h) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).app M =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ f ≫ k) a)).app M
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (pushforwardComp_congr_second_obj f a M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.isoForwardCancel
statement:
private theorem isoForwardCancel {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞]
    {P Q R S T : 𝒞} (a : P ≅ Q) (b : Q ≅ R) (c : P ≅ S)
    (d : S ≅ T) (e : T ≅ R) (h : a ≪≫ b = c ≪≫ d ≪≫ e) :
    c ≪≫ d = a ≪≫ b ≪≫ e.symm
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≪≫ e.symm) h
  simpa only [Iso.trans_assoc, Iso.self_symm_id, Iso.trans_refl] using hh.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.assocForwardIso
statement:
private theorem assocForwardIso {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M).symm
proof:
:=
  isoForwardCancel
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M)
    (Iso.ext (pushforwardComp_assoc_obj f g h M))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.cubeNormalForm
statement:
private theorem cubeNormalForm {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞]
    {O₀ O₁ O₂ O₃ O₄ O₅ O₆ O₇ O₈ O₉ O₁₀ O₁₁ O₁₂ O₁₃ O₁₄ : 𝒞}
    (a : O₀ ≅ O₁) (b : O₁ ≅ O₂) (c : O₂ ≅ O₃) (d : O₃ ≅ O₄)
    (e : O₄ ≅ O₅) (f : O₅ ≅ O₆) (g : O₆ ≅ O₇)
    (j : O₂ ≅ O₈) (k : O₈ ≅ O₉) (l : O₉ ≅ O₄)
    (p : O₉ ≅ O₁₀) (q : O₁₀ ≅ O₅) (r : O₁₀ ≅ O₁₁) (s : O₁₁ ≅ O₇)
    (t : O₁ ≅ O₁₂) (v : O₁₂ ≅ O₈)
    (a₀ : O₀ ≅ O₁₃) (b₀ : O₁₃ ≅ O₁₄) (c₀ : O₁₄ ≅ O₁₂)
    (h₁ : c ≪≫ d = j ≪≫ k ≪≫ l) (h₂ : l ≪≫ e = p ≪≫ q)
    (h₃ : f ≪≫ g = q.symm ≪≫ r ≪≫ s)
    (h₄ : b ≪≫ j = t ≪≫ v) (h₅ : a ≪≫ t = a₀ ≪≫ b₀ ≪≫ c₀) :
    a ≪≫ b ≪≫ c ≪≫ d ≪≫ e ≪≫ f ≪≫ g =
      a₀ ≪≫ b₀ ≪≫ c₀ ≪≫ v ≪≫ k ≪≫ p ≪≫ r ≪≫ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Iso.trans_assoc c d (e ≪≫ f ≪≫ g), h₁]
  simp only [Iso.trans_assoc]
  rw [← Iso.trans_assoc l e (f ≪≫ g), h₂, h₃]
  simp only [Iso.trans_assoc, Iso.self_symm_id_assoc]
  rw [← Iso.trans_assoc b j (k ≪≫ p ≪≫ r ≪≫ s), h₄]
  simp only [Iso.trans_assoc]
  rw [← Iso.trans_assoc a t (v ≪≫ k ≪≫ p ≪≫ r ≪≫ s), h₅]
  simp only [Iso.trans_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.cubeExpandedIso
statement:
theorem cubeExpandedIso {U V W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (u : U ⟶ Y) (v : V ⟶ X) (w : W ⟶ Z)
    (q : X ⟶ Y) (p : Z ⟶ X) (r : V ⟶ U) (s : W ⟶ V)
    (hr : r ≫ u = v ≫ q) (hs : s ≫ v = w ≫ p) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r u).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hr).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M) ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp v q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M)).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s v).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hs).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w p).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp p q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward w).obj M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward u).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s r).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (s ≫ r) u).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s r u).symm).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ s ≫ k) hr)).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s v q).symm).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ q) hs)).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc w p q).symm).app M).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w (p ≫ q)).app M).symm
proof:
:=
  cubeNormalForm
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r u).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hr).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M))
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp v q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M)).symm)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s v).app M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hs).app M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w p).app M).symm)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp p q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward w).obj M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s (v ≫ q)).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s v q).symm).app M)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (s ≫ v) q).app M).symm)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ q) hs)).app M)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (w ≫ p) q).app M).symm)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc w p q).symm).app M).symm)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w (p ≫ q)).app M).symm)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s (r ≫ u)).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ s ≫ k) hr)).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward u).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s r).app M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (s ≫ r) u).app M)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s r u).symm).app M).symm)
    (mixedLeftIso s v q M) (congrFirstInvIso hs q M) (mixedRightIso w p q M)
    (congrSecondIso s hr M) (assocForwardIso s r u M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.castIso_refl
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (pushforwardCongr_refl_obj f M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.castChainWithInverse
statement:
private theorem castChainWithInverse {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {f₀ f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ f₅ : X ⟶ Y} (a : f₁ = f₀) (b : f₁ = f₂)
    (c : f₂ = f₃) (d : f₃ = f₄) (e : f₅ = f₄) (M : X.Modules) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr b).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr c).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr d).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).app M).symm =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (a.symm.trans (b.trans (c.trans (d.trans e.symm))))).app M
proof:
:= by
  subst f₀
  subst f₂
  subst f₃
  subst f₄
  subst f₅
  simp only [castIso_refl, Iso.refl_trans]
  exact Iso.refl_trans _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.cubeCastIso
statement:
theorem cubeCastIso {U V W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (u : U ⟶ Y) (v : V ⟶ X) (w : W ⟶ Z)
    (q : X ⟶ Y) (p : Z ⟶ X) (r : V ⟶ U) (s : W ⟶ V)
    (hr : r ≫ u = v ≫ q) (hs : s ≫ v = w ≫ p) (M : W.Modules) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s r u).symm).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ s ≫ k) hr)).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s v q).symm).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ q) hs)).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc w p q).symm).app M).symm =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (show (s ≫ r) ≫ u = w ≫ (p ≫ q) from
      by rw [Category.assoc, hr, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.assoc])).app M
proof:
:=
  castChainWithInverse (Category.assoc s r u).symm
    (congrArg (fun k ↦ s ≫ k) hr) (Category.assoc s v q).symm
    (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ q) hs) (Category.assoc w p q).symm M

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.isoWhiskerFive
statement:
private theorem isoWhiskerFive {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞]
    {P₀ P₁ P₂ P₃ P₄ P₅ P₆ P₇ P₈ : 𝒞}
    (a : P₀ ≅ P₁) (b : P₁ ≅ P₂) (c : P₂ ≅ P₃) (d : P₃ ≅ P₄)
    (e : P₄ ≅ P₅) (f : P₅ ≅ P₆) (g : P₆ ≅ P₇) (last : P₇ ≅ P₈)
    (k : P₂ ≅ P₇) (h : c ≪≫ d ≪≫ e ≪≫ f ≪≫ g = k) :
    a ≪≫ b ≪≫ c ≪≫ d ≪≫ e ≪≫ f ≪≫ g ≪≫ last = a ≪≫ b ≪≫ k ≪≫ last
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg (fun l ↦ a ≪≫ b ≪≫ l ≪≫ last) h
  simpa only [Iso.trans_assoc] using hh

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.pushforwardTransportCubeIso
statement:
theorem pushforwardTransportCubeIso {U V W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (u : U ⟶ Y) (v : V ⟶ X) (w : W ⟶ Z)
    (q : X ⟶ Y) (p : Z ⟶ X) (r : V ⟶ U) (s : W ⟶ V)
    (hr : r ≫ u = v ≫ q) (hs : s ≫ v = w ≫ p) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r u).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hr).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M) ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp v q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj M)).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s v).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hs).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w p).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp p q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward w).obj M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward u).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s r).app M) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (s ≫ r) u).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (show (s ≫ r) ≫ u = w ≫ (p ≫ q) from
        by rw [Category.assoc, hr, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.assoc])).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w (p ≫ q)).app M).symm
proof:
:=
  (cubeExpandedIso u v w q p r s hr hs M).trans
    (isoWhiskerFive
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward u).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s r).app M))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (s ≫ r) u).app M)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s r u).symm).app M).symm)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ s ≫ k) hr)).app M)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc s v q).symm).app M)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ q) hs)).app M)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc w p q).symm).app M).symm)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp w (p ≫ q)).app M).symm)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (show (s ≫ r) ≫ u = w ≫ (p ≫ q) from
        by rw [Category.assoc, hr, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.assoc])).app M)
      (cubeCastIso u v w q p r s hr hs M))

name: RRB6.secF_map
statement: theorem secF_map {A B : P.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (W : P.Opens) : (secF W).map f = f.app W
proof: := rfl

name: RRB6.zhom_one
statement: theorem zhom_one {G : Ab.{u}} (x : G) : zhom x ⟨1⟩ = x
proof:
:= by
  change (1 : ℤ) • x = x
  simp

name: RRB6.zhom_comp
statement: theorem zhom_comp {G H : Ab.{u}} (x : G) (f : G ⟶ H) : zhom x ≫ f = zhom (f x)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨n⟩
  change f (n • x) = n • f x
  simp

name: RRB6.eq_of_zhom
statement: theorem eq_of_zhom {G : Ab.{u}} {x y : G} (h : zhom x = zhom y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (zhom_one x).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun f => f ⟨1⟩) h).trans (zhom_one y))

name: RRB6.pi_sections_ext
statement:
theorem pi_sections_ext {ι : Type u} (S : ι → P.Modules) [HasProduct S] (W : P.Opens)
    (x y : Γ(∏ᶜ S, W)) (h : ∀ i, (Pi.π S i).app W x = (Pi.π S i).app W y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hl := secF_isLimit W (productIsProduct S)
  apply eq_of_zhom
  refine hl.hom_ext (fun j => ?_)
  change zhom x ≫ (secF W).map (Pi.π S j.as) = zhom y ≫ (secF W).map (Pi.π S j.as)
  rw [zhom_comp, zhom_comp]
  exact congrArg zhom (h j.as)

name: RRB6.pi_sections_exists
statement:
theorem pi_sections_exists {ι : Type u} (S : ι → P.Modules) [HasProduct S] (W : P.Opens)
    (a : ∀ i, Γ(S i, W)) : ∃ x : Γ(∏ᶜ S, W), ∀ i, (Pi.π S i).app W x = a i
proof:
:= by
  have hl := secF_isLimit W (productIsProduct S)
  let c : Cone (Discrete.functor S ⋙ secF W) :=
    { pt := AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)
      π := Discrete.natTrans (fun i => zhom (a i.as)) }
  refine ⟨(hl.lift c) ⟨1⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
  have := hl.fac c ⟨i⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f ⟨1⟩) this
  exact h2.trans (zhom_one _)

name: RRB6.zhom_zero
statement: theorem zhom_zero {G : Ab.{u}} : zhom (0 : G) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨n⟩
  change n • (0 : G) = 0
  simp

name: RRB6.ker_sections_inj
statement:
theorem ker_sections_inj {A B : P.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (W : P.Opens) (x y : Γ(kernel f, W))
    (h : (kernel.ι f).app W x = (kernel.ι f).app W y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  haveI : PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf P) :=
    (preservesSmallestLimits_of_preservesLimits (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf P)).preservesLimitsOfShape
  have hl := secF_isLimit W (kernelIsKernel f)
  have hl' := (KernelFork.isLimitMapConeEquiv _ _) hl
  apply eq_of_zhom
  refine Fork.IsLimit.hom_ext hl' ?_
  change zhom x ≫ (secF W).map (kernel.ι f) = zhom y ≫ (secF W).map (kernel.ι f)
  rw [zhom_comp, zhom_comp]
  exact congrArg zhom h

name: RRB6.ker_sections_exists
statement:
theorem ker_sections_exists {A B : P.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (W : P.Opens) (y : Γ(A, W))
    (h : f.app W y = 0) : ∃ x : Γ(kernel f, W), (kernel.ι f).app W x = y
proof:
:= by
  haveI : PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf P) :=
    (preservesSmallestLimits_of_preservesLimits (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf P)).preservesLimitsOfShape
  have hl := secF_isLimit W (kernelIsKernel f)
  have hl' := (KernelFork.isLimitMapConeEquiv _ _) hl
  have hk : zhom y ≫ (secF W).map f = 0 := by
    rw [zhom_comp]
    change zhom (f.app W y) = 0
    rw [h, zhom_zero]
  obtain ⟨l, hl2⟩ := KernelFork.IsLimit.lift' hl' (zhom y) hk
  refine ⟨l ⟨1⟩, ?_⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (fun g => g ⟨1⟩) hl2
  exact h2.trans (zhom_one _)

name: RRB6.rs_zero
statement: theorem rs_zero (M : P.Modules) {A B : P.Opens} (h : A ≤ B) : rs M h 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rs]

name: RRB6.rs_sub
statement:
theorem rs_sub (M : P.Modules) {A B : P.Opens} (h : A ≤ B) (x y : Γ(M, B)) :
    rs M h (x - y) = rs M h x - rs M h y
proof:
:= by
  simp [rs]

name: RRB6.rs_rs
statement:
theorem rs_rs (M : P.Modules) {A B C : P.Opens} (h1 : A ≤ B) (h2 : B ≤ C) (x : Γ(M, C)) :
    rs M h1 (rs M h2 x) = rs M (h1.trans h2) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold rs
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: RRB6.hom_rs
statement:
theorem hom_rs {M N : P.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) {A B : P.Opens} (h : A ≤ B) (x : Γ(M, B)) :
    φ.app A (rs M h x) = rs N h (φ.app B x)
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h).op) x

name: RRB6.hom_zero'
statement: theorem hom_zero' {M N : P.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (A : P.Opens) : φ.app A 0 = 0
proof: := by simp

name: RRB6.hom_sub'
statement:
theorem hom_sub' {M N : P.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (A : P.Opens) (x y : Γ(M, A)) :
    φ.app A (x - y) = φ.app A x - φ.app A y
proof: := by simp

name: RRB6.loc_eq
statement:
theorem loc_eq (M : P.Modules) {ι : Type*} (O : ι → P.Opens) {V : P.Opens} (hO : ∀ i, O i ≤ V)
    (hc : V ≤ iSup O) (s t : Γ(M, V)) (h : ∀ i, rs M (hO i) s = rs M (hO i) t) : s = t
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab P) O V
    (fun i => homOfLE (hO i)) hc s t h

name: RRB6.glue
statement:
theorem glue (M : P.Modules) {ι : Type*} (O : ι → P.Opens) {V : P.Opens} (hO : ∀ i, O i ≤ V)
    (hc : V ≤ iSup O) (sf : ∀ i, Γ(M, O i))
    (h : ∀ i j, rs M (inf_le_left : O i ⊓ O j ≤ O i) (sf i) =
      rs M (inf_le_right : O i ⊓ O j ≤ O j) (sf j)) :
    ∃ s : Γ(M, V), ∀ i, rs M (hO i) s = sf i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' (⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab P)
    O V (fun i => homOfLE (hO i)) hc sf h
  exact ⟨s, hs⟩

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.proj_compat
statement:
theorem proj_compat (W : P.Opens) (k : Γ(G.K, W)) :
    G.Compat W (fun V => (G.proj V).app W k)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  have h0 := kernel.condition (G.left - G.right)
  have h1 : kernel.ι (G.left - G.right) ≫ G.left = kernel.ι (G.left - G.right) ≫ G.right :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp (by rw [← Preadditive.comp_sub]; exact h0)
  have e1 : G.left ≫ Pi.π (fun q : G.Ref => G.S (G.c q)) q = Pi.π G.S (G.l q) ≫ G.ρ (G.hl q) :=
    G.left_π q
  have e2 : G.right ≫ Pi.π (fun q : G.Ref => G.S (G.c q)) q = Pi.π G.S (G.r q) ≫ G.ρ (G.hr q) :=
    G.right_π q
  have h3 : (kernel.ι (G.left - G.right) ≫ Pi.π G.S (G.l q)) ≫ G.ρ (G.hl q) =
      (kernel.ι (G.left - G.right) ≫ Pi.π G.S (G.r q)) ≫ G.ρ (G.hr q) := by
    have := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ Pi.π (fun q : G.Ref => G.S (G.c q)) q) h1
    simp only [Category.assoc, e1, e2] at this
    simpa [Category.assoc] using this
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.app W k) h3

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.proj_ext
statement:
theorem proj_ext (W : P.Opens) (k₁ k₂ : Γ(G.K, W))
    (h : ∀ V, (G.proj V).app W k₁ = (G.proj V).app W k₂) : k₁ = k₂
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_sections_inj
  apply pi_sections_ext
  intro V
  exact h V

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.proj_exists
statement:
theorem proj_exists (W : P.Opens) (a : ∀ V, Γ(G.S V, W)) (ha : G.Compat W a) :
    ∃ k : Γ(G.K, W), ∀ V, (G.proj V).app W k = a V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := pi_sections_exists G.S W a
  have hx0 : (G.left - G.right).app W x = 0 := by
    show G.left.app W x - G.right.app W x = 0
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    apply pi_sections_ext
    intro q
    have e1 : G.left ≫ Pi.π (fun q : G.Ref => G.S (G.c q)) q = Pi.π G.S (G.l q) ≫ G.ρ (G.hl q) :=
      G.left_π q
    have e2 : G.right ≫ Pi.π (fun q : G.Ref => G.S (G.c q)) q = Pi.π G.S (G.r q) ≫ G.ρ (G.hr q) :=
      G.right_π q
    have f1 := congrArg (fun f => f.app W x) e1
    have f2 := congrArg (fun f => f.app W x) e2
    refine f1.trans (Eq.trans ?_ f2.symm)
    change (G.ρ (G.hl q)).app W ((Pi.π G.S (G.l q)).app W x) =
      (G.ρ (G.hr q)).app W ((Pi.π G.S (G.r q)).app W x)
    rw [hx, hx]
    exact ha q
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ker_sections_exists (G.left - G.right) W x hx0
  refine ⟨k, fun V => ?_⟩
  change (Pi.π G.S V).app W ((kernel.ι (G.left - G.right)).app W k) = a V
  rw [hk, hx]

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.compat_ex
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hV, hU, hC⟩ := G.ex V U C h1 h2
  subst hV hU hC
  exact ha q

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.O_le
statement: theorem O_le {C V : I} (h : C ≤ V) : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W ⊓ G.R V
proof: := inf_le_inf_left W (G.Rmono h)

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.inj_comb
statement:
theorem inj_comb (hW : W ≤ G.R U) (a : ∀ V, Γ(G.S V, W)) (ha : G.Compat W a) (h0 : a U = 0)
    (V : I) : a V = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (G.supp V W).1
  rw [rs_zero]
  refine loc_eq (G.S V) (fun C : {C : I // C ≤ U ∧ C ≤ V} => W ⊓ G.R C.1)
    (fun C => O_le C.2.2) ?_ _ _ ?_
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨C, hCU, hCV, hxC⟩ := G.ov U V x (hW hx.1) hx.2
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨C, hCU, hCV⟩, ⟨hx.1, hxC⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨C, hCU, hCV⟩
    simp only [rs_rs, rs_zero]
    apply (G.bij hCV (W ⊓ G.R C) inf_le_right).1
    rw [hom_rs, hom_zero', compat_ex G ha hCV hCU, h0, hom_zero', rs_zero]

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.piece
statement:
theorem piece {C D V : I} (hDC : D ≤ C) (hCU : C ≤ U) (hCV : C ≤ V) (t : Γ(G.S U, W))
    {σ : Γ(G.S V, W ⊓ G.R C)}
    (hσ : (G.ρ hCV).app (W ⊓ G.R C) σ = rs (G.S C) inf_le_left ((G.ρ hCU).app W t)) :
    (G.ρ (hDC.trans hCV)).app (W ⊓ G.R D) (rs (G.S V) (O_le hDC) σ) =
      rs (G.S D) inf_le_left ((G.ρ (hDC.trans hCU)).app W t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← G.comp hDC hCV, hom_rs, hσ, rs_rs, hom_rs, G.comp hDC hCU]

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.surj_one
statement:
theorem surj_one (hW : W ≤ G.R U) (t : Γ(G.S U, W)) (V : I) :
    ∃ aV : Γ(G.S V, W), ∀ (C : I) (hCU : C ≤ U) (hCV : C ≤ V),
      rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W) ((G.ρ hCV).app W aV) =
      rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W) ((G.ρ hCU).app W t)
proof:
:= by
  let e : ∀ C : {C : I // C ≤ U ∧ C ≤ V},
      Γ(G.S C.1, W ⊓ G.R C.1) ≃ Γ(G.S V, W ⊓ G.R C.1) := fun C =>
    (Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.bij C.2.2 (W ⊓ G.R C.1) inf_le_right)).symm
  let σ : ∀ C : {C : I // C ≤ U ∧ C ≤ V}, Γ(G.S V, W ⊓ G.R C.1) := fun C =>
    e C (rs (G.S C.1) inf_le_left ((G.ρ C.2.1).app W t))
  have hσ : ∀ C : {C : I // C ≤ U ∧ C ≤ V}, (G.ρ C.2.2).app (W ⊓ G.R C.1) (σ C) =
      rs (G.S C.1) inf_le_left ((G.ρ C.2.1).app W t) := fun C =>
    (Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.bij C.2.2 (W ⊓ G.R C.1) inf_le_right)).apply_symm_apply _
  have hcov : W ⊓ G.R V ≤ iSup (fun C : {C : I // C ≤ U ∧ C ≤ V} => W ⊓ G.R C.1) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨C, hCU, hCV, hxC⟩ := G.ov U V x (hW hx.1) hx.2
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨C, hCU, hCV⟩, ⟨hx.1, hxC⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := glue (G.S V) (fun C : {C : I // C ≤ U ∧ C ≤ V} => W ⊓ G.R C.1)
    (fun C => O_le C.2.2) hcov σ (by
      intro C C'
      refine loc_eq (G.S V) (fun D : {D : I // D ≤ C.1 ∧ D ≤ C'.1} => W ⊓ G.R D.1)
        (fun D => le_inf (O_le D.2.1) (O_le D.2.2)) ?_ _ _ ?_
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨D, hDC, hDC', hxD⟩ := G.ov C.1 C'.1 x hx.1.2 hx.2.2
        exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨D, hDC, hDC'⟩, ⟨hx.1.1, hxD⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨D, hDC, hDC'⟩
        rw [rs_rs, rs_rs]
        apply (G.bij (hDC.trans C.2.2) (W ⊓ G.R D) inf_le_right).1
        have h1 := piece hDC C.2.1 C.2.2 t (hσ C)
        have h2 := piece hDC' C'.2.1 C'.2.2 t (hσ C')
        exact h1.trans h2.symm)
  refine ⟨(Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.supp V W)).symm s, fun C hCU hCV => ?_⟩
  have ha : rs (G.S V) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R V ≤ W)
      ((Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.supp V W)).symm s) = s :=
    (Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.supp V W)).apply_symm_apply s
  have hs' := hs ⟨C, hCU, hCV⟩
  calc rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W)
        ((G.ρ hCV).app W ((Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.supp V W)).symm s))
      = (G.ρ hCV).app (W ⊓ G.R C) (rs (G.S V) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W)
          ((Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.supp V W)).symm s)) := (hom_rs _ _ _).symm
    _ = (G.ρ hCV).app (W ⊓ G.R C) (rs (G.S V) (O_le hCV : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W ⊓ G.R V)
          (rs (G.S V) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R V ≤ W)
          ((Equiv.ofBijective _ (G.supp V W)).symm s))) := by rw [rs_rs]
    _ = (G.ρ hCV).app (W ⊓ G.R C) (σ ⟨C, hCU, hCV⟩) := by rw [ha, hs']
    _ = _ := hσ ⟨C, hCU, hCV⟩

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.surj_comb
statement:
theorem surj_comb (hW : W ≤ G.R U) (t : Γ(G.S U, W)) :
    ∃ a : ∀ V, Γ(G.S V, W), a U = t ∧ ∀ (V C : I) (hCU : C ≤ U) (hCV : C ≤ V),
      rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W) ((G.ρ hCV).app W (a V)) =
      rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W) ((G.ρ hCU).app W t)
proof:
:= by
  choose a ha using surj_one hW t
  refine ⟨a, ?_, fun V C hCU hCV => ha V C hCU hCV⟩
  refine loc_eq (G.S U) (fun _ : Unit => W ⊓ G.R U) (fun _ => inf_le_left) ?_ _ _ ?_
  · intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨(), ⟨hx, hW hx⟩⟩
  · intro _
    apply (G.bij (le_refl U) (W ⊓ G.R U) inf_le_right).1
    rw [hom_rs, hom_rs]
    exact ha U U le_rfl le_rfl

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.compat_of_P
statement:
theorem compat_of_P (hW : W ≤ G.R U) (t : Γ(G.S U, W)) (a : ∀ V, Γ(G.S V, W))
    (ha : ∀ (V C : I) (hCU : C ≤ U) (hCV : C ≤ V),
      rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W) ((G.ρ hCV).app W (a V)) =
      rs (G.S C) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ G.R C ≤ W) ((G.ρ hCU).app W t)) :
    G.Compat W a
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  apply (G.supp (G.c q) W).1
  refine loc_eq (G.S (G.c q)) (fun D : {D : I // D ≤ U ∧ D ≤ G.c q} => W ⊓ G.R D.1)
    (fun D => O_le D.2.2) ?_ _ _ ?_
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨D, hDU, hDE, hxD⟩ := G.ov U (G.c q) x (hW hx.1) hx.2
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨D, hDU, hDE⟩, ⟨hx.1, hxD⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨D, hDU, hDE⟩
    rw [rs_rs, rs_rs]
    apply (G.bij hDE (W ⊓ G.R D) inf_le_right).1
    rw [hom_rs, hom_rs]
    rw [G.comp hDE (G.hl q), G.comp hDE (G.hr q), ha _ D hDU (hDE.trans (G.hl q)), ha _ D hDU (hDE.trans (G.hr q))]

name: RRB6.GlueDatum.proj_bijective
statement: theorem proj_bijective (hW : W ≤ G.R U) : Function.Bijective ((G.proj U).app W)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro k1 k2 h
    apply G.proj_ext
    have hc1 := G.proj_compat W k1
    have hc2 := G.proj_compat W k2
    have hd : G.Compat W (fun V => (G.proj V).app W k1 - (G.proj V).app W k2) := by
      intro q
      have h1 := hc1 q
      have h2 := hc2 q
      simp only at h1 h2
      show (G.ρ (G.hl q)).app W ((G.proj (G.l q)).app W k1 - (G.proj (G.l q)).app W k2) =
        (G.ρ (G.hr q)).app W ((G.proj (G.r q)).app W k1 - (G.proj (G.r q)).app W k2)
      rw [hom_sub', hom_sub', h1, h2]
    intro V
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (inj_comb hW _ hd (sub_eq_zero.mpr h) V)
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨a, haU, hP⟩ := surj_comb hW t
    have hc := compat_of_P hW t a hP
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := G.proj_exists W a hc
    exact ⟨k, (hk U).trans haU⟩

name: RRB6.rs_id
statement: theorem rs_id (M : P.Modules) {A : P.Opens} (h : A ≤ A) (x : Γ(M, A)) : rs M h x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rs]

name: RRB6.rs_bij
statement:
theorem rs_bij (M : P.Modules) {A B : P.Opens} (h : A ≤ B) (h' : B ≤ A) :
    Function.Bijective (rs M h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun y => ⟨rs M h' y, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := congrArg (rs M h') hxy
    rwa [rs_rs, rs_rs, rs_id, rs_id] at this
  · rw [rs_rs, rs_id]

name: RRB6.restrict_comm
statement:
theorem restrict_comm (K : P.Modules) (N : X.Modules) (p : K ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ι).hom.app K ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι).homEquiv K N).symm p =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).homEquiv K N).symm p
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).homEquiv K N).injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  have h1 := Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι) K
  have h2 : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ι).hom.app K =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).leftAdjointUniq
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι)).hom.app K := rfl
  rw [h2, h1]
  have h3 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι).homEquiv K N) p
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h3
  exact h3

name: RRB6.chart_isIso
statement:
theorem chart_isIso (K : P.Modules) (N : X.Modules) (p : K ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj N)
    (hp : ∀ W : P.Opens, W ≤ ι.opensRange → Function.Bijective (p.app W)) :
    IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι).homEquiv K N).symm p)
proof:
:= by
  have hα : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ι).hom.app K) := inferInstance
  have hφ : IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).homEquiv K N).symm p) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]
    have hr : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).map p) := by
      rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
      intro W
      have hb := hp (ι ''ᵁ W) (Scheme.Hom.image_le_opensRange ι W)
      exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2 hb
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).counit.app N) :=
      NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).counit N
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso' hr this
  rw [← restrict_comm] at hφ
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ι).hom.app K) _

name: RRB6.mate_bij
statement:
theorem mate_bij (N : P.Modules) (N' : X.Modules) (φ : N ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj N')
    (hm : IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι).homEquiv N N').symm φ))
    (A : P.Opens) (hA : A ≤ ι.opensRange) : Function.Bijective (φ.app A)
proof:
:= by
  have hα : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ι).hom.app N) := inferInstance
  have hφ'' : IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).homEquiv N N').symm φ) := by
    rw [← restrict_comm]; infer_instance
  have hφ := (Equiv.apply_symm_apply ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).homEquiv N N') φ).symm
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hφ
  have hle : A ≤ ι ''ᵁ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ A) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hA hx
    exact ⟨y, hx, rfl⟩
  have key : ⇑(φ.app A) = (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction ι).homEquiv N N').symm φ).app
      (ι ⁻¹ᵁ A) ∘ rs N (Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_le ι A) := by
    funext x
    have := congrArg (fun f => f.app A x) hφ
    exact this
  rw [key]
  refine Function.Bijective.comp ?_ ?_
  · exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).1 inferInstance
  · exact rs_bij N _ hle

name: RRB6.supp_pushforward
statement:
theorem supp_pushforward (N : X.Modules) (W : P.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective (rs ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj N)
      (inf_le_left : W ⊓ ι.opensRange ≤ W))
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ι ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ ι ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ ι.opensRange) := fun x hx => ⟨hx, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  have e : rs ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj N) (inf_le_left : W ⊓ ι.opensRange ≤ W) =
      rs N ((Opens.map ι.base).monotone (inf_le_left : W ⊓ ι.opensRange ≤ W)) := rfl
  rw [e]
  exact rs_bij N _ hle

name: RRB6.map_eq_rs
statement:
theorem map_eq_rs (M : P.Modules) {A B : P.Opens} (f : A ⟶ B) (x : Γ(M, B)) :
    M.presheaf.map f.op x = rs M (leOfHom f) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold rs
  exact congrArg (fun g => M.presheaf.map g.op x) (Subsingleton.elim f (homOfLE (leOfHom f)))

name: RRB6.homEquiv_conj
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, conjugateEquiv_apply_app]
  have n1 := adj₂.unit.naturality (R₁.map h)
  have n2 := σ.naturality (R₁.map h)
  have n3 := adj₂.unit.naturality (adj₁.unit.app K)
  have n4 := σ.naturality (adj₁.unit.app K)
  have tri := adj₁.left_triangle_components K
  have n5 := adj₁.counit.naturality h
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj] at n1 n2 n3 n4 n5
  rw [Category.assoc]
  erw [reassoc_of% n1]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, n2]
  erw [Category.assoc, n5]
  erw [reassoc_of% n3]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  erw [← Category.assoc, n4]
  erw [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% tri]

name: RRB6.homEquiv_pullbackComp
statement:
theorem homEquiv_pullbackComp {X0 X1 X2 : Scheme.{u}} (f1 : X1 ⟶ X0) (f2 : X2 ⟶ X1)
    (K0 : X0.Modules) (K1 : X1.Modules) (K2 : X2.Modules)
    (α : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0 ⟶ K1) (β : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).obj K1 ⟶ K2) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f2 ≫ f1)).homEquiv K0 K2
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv.app K0 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2
proof:
:= by
  have h := homEquiv_conj ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).comp
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f2 ≫ f1))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv K0 K2 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv] at h
  erw [h, Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  have step : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f2).obj K2)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0) K2
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  exact congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2) step

name: RRB6.homEquiv_pullbackComp_congr
statement:
theorem homEquiv_pullbackComp_congr {X0 X1 X2 : Scheme.{u}} (f1 : X1 ⟶ X0) (f2 : X2 ⟶ X1)
    (f12 : X2 ⟶ X0) (e : f12 = f2 ≫ f1)
    (K0 : X0.Modules) (K1 : X1.Modules) (K2 : X2.Modules)
    (α : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0 ⟶ K1) (β : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).obj K1 ⟶ K2) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f12).homEquiv K0 K2
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e).hom.app K0 ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv.app K0 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2 ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e.symm).hom.app K2
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have hcg : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (rfl : f2 ≫ f1 = f2 ≫ f1)).hom.app K2) = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
    intro U
    simp
  rw [hcg, Category.comp_id]
  have hc : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (rfl : f2 ≫ f1 = f2 ≫ f1)).hom.app K0 =
      𝟙 _ := rfl
  rw [hc, Category.id_comp]
  exact homEquiv_pullbackComp f1 f2 K0 K1 K2 α β

name: RRB6.rhoMap_app
statement:
theorem rhoMap_app (f : X' ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ P) (g' : X' ⟶ P) (w : f ≫ g = g')
    {N : X.Modules} {N' : X'.Modules} (φ : N ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj N')
    (W : P.Opens) (hle : g' ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ W))
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj N, W)) :
    (rhoMap f g g' w φ).app W x = rs N' hle (φ.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) x)
proof:
:= by
  subst w
  have h0 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app
    (M := N') (rfl : f ≫ g = f ≫ g) W) (φ.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) x)
  have h1 : (rhoMap f g (f ≫ g) rfl φ).app W x =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (rfl : f ≫ g = f ≫ g)).hom.app N').app W
        (φ.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) x) := rfl
  rw [h1, h0]
  exact map_eq_rs N' _ _

name: RRB6.rho_cocycle
statement:
theorem rho_cocycle (resDC : XD ⟶ XC) (resCV : XC ⟶ XV) (resDV : XD ⟶ XV)
    (e : resDV = resDC ≫ resCV) (iV : XV ⟶ P) (iC : XC ⟶ P) (iD : XD ⟶ P)
    (wCV : resCV ≫ iV = iC) (wDC : resDC ≫ iC = iD) (wDV : resDV ≫ iV = iD)
    {NV : XV.Modules} {NC : XC.Modules} {ND : XD.Modules}
    (φCV : NV ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward resCV).obj NC)
    (φDC : NC ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward resDC).obj ND)
    (φDV : NV ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward resDV).obj ND)
    (hφ : φDV = φCV ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward resCV).map φDC ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp resDC resCV).hom.app ND ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e.symm).hom.app ND)
    (W : P.Opens) (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward iV).obj NV, W)) :
    (rhoMap resDC iC iD wDC φDC).app W ((rhoMap resCV iV iC wCV φCV).app W x) =
      (rhoMap resDV iV iD wDV φDV).app W x
proof:
:= by
  have hleCV : iC ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ resCV ⁻¹ᵁ (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W) := by subst wCV; exact le_rfl
  have hleDC : iD ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ resDC ⁻¹ᵁ (iC ⁻¹ᵁ W) := by subst wDC; exact le_rfl
  have hleDV : iD ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ resDV ⁻¹ᵁ (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W) := by subst wDV; exact le_rfl
  rw [rhoMap_app resDV iV iD wDV φDV W hleDV x, rhoMap_app resDC iC iD wDC φDC W hleDC _,
    rhoMap_app resCV iV iC wCV φCV W hleCV x, hom_rs φDC hleCV]
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f.app (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W) x) hφ
  simp only at h2
  rw [h2]
  have h3 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app
    (M := ND) e.symm (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (φDC.app (resCV ⁻¹ᵁ (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (φCV.app (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W) x))
  refine (rs_rs ND hleDC _ _).trans ?_
  have h4 : ((φCV ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward resCV).map φDC ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp resDC resCV).hom.app ND ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e.symm).hom.app ND).app (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W)) x =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e.symm).hom.app ND).app (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W)
        (φDC.app (resCV ⁻¹ᵁ (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (φCV.app (iV ⁻¹ᵁ W) x)) := rfl
  rw [h4, h3]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (rs ND hleDV) (map_eq_rs ND _ _)).symm
  exact (rs_rs ND hleDV _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.isPullback_subschemeCoverChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_subschemeCoverChart (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
      (J.subschemeCover.f U) U.1.ι J.subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [J.subschemeCover_map_subschemeι]
    rfl
  · rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.isPullback_subschemeLineAffine
statement:
theorem isPullback_subschemeLineAffine (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom))
      (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J)
      (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) U ≫
        DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥)
      J.subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  have P0 := isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_polynomialMap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)))
  have hs : ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp
      (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom =
        Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)) :=
    toLineHom_comp_structureMap Y J U
  have hA : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom) ≫
        (lineAffineIso Y U).hom := by
    change _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom)
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun g => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)) hs.symm
  have hB : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1)
        (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))))) =
      (lineAffineIso Y U).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(Y, U.1) →+* _)) := by
    change _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom) ≫ _
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    refine congrArg (fun g => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)) (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)
    exact ((structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).commutes a).symm
  have A'' : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) →+* _)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1)
        (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv) := by
    refine P0.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (lineAffineIso Y U).symm (Iso.refl _) U.2.isoSpec.symm
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Iso.symm_hom]
      rw [hA, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    · simp
    · simp only [Iso.symm_hom]
      rw [← Category.assoc, (lineAffineIso Y U).inv_comp_eq.mpr hB]
    · simp
  have T := A''.paste_vert (isPullback_subschemeCoverChart Y J U)
  rw [affineι_polynomialToClosedBase]
  have e := RelativeSpec.affineι_toBase Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) U
  change IsPullback _ _ (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) U ≫
    RelativeSpec.toBase Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥)) _
  rw [e]
  exact T
