name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.specMap_mapRingHom_mem_basicOpen_X
statement:
theorem specMap_mapRingHom_mem_basicOpen_X {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (p : Spec (CommRingCat.of B[X])) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)) p) ∈
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : A[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum A[X])) ↔
      p ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : B[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum B[X]))
proof:
:= by
  show (Polynomial.X : A[X]) ∉
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (show PrimeSpectrum B[X] from p)).asIdeal ↔
    (Polynomial.X : B[X]) ∉ (show PrimeSpectrum B[X] from p).asIdeal
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.preimage_basicOpen_X_le_uChartGlobal
statement:
theorem preimage_basicOpen_X_le_uChartGlobal :
    blowupGlobalToLineOver Y J k φk ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]) ≤
      (uChartGlobal Y J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨆ U : Y.affineOpens, (blowupAffineι Y J U).opensRange := by
    rw [iSup_opensRange_blowupAffineι]; trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx'
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hU
  have hb : b ∈ blowupToLine (J.ideal U) ⁻¹ᵁ
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : Γ(Y, U.1)[X]) := by
    have h1 : blowupGlobalToLineOver Y J k φk (blowupAffineι Y J U b) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg Y k φk U)))
          (blowupToLine (J.ideal U) b) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupAffineι_toLineOver]
      rfl
    have h2 : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom
        (DeformationSpace.kAlg Y k φk U)))) (blowupToLine (J.ideal U) b) ∈
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum k[X])) := by
      rw [← h1]; exact hx
    exact (specMap_mapRingHom_mem_basicOpen_X _ _).mp h2
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := blowupToLine_preimage_basicOpen_X_le (J.ideal U) hb
  refine ⟨DeformationSpace.affineι Y J U z, ?_⟩
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, (isPullback_uChartGlobal Y J U).w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.preimage_opensRange_chart_one
statement:
theorem preimage_opensRange_chart_one :
    toP1Global Y J k φk ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange = (lineTι Y J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w
        (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) WalkingSpan.Hom.snd)
    · change blowupGlobalι Y J y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : blowupGlobalToLineOver Y J k φk y ∈ (chart k 0) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange := by
        show chart k 0 (blowupGlobalToLineOver Y J k φk y) ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← blowupGlobalι_toP1 Y J k φk, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [chart_zero_preimage] at hy
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := preimage_basicOpen_X_le_uChartGlobal Y J k φk hy
      have hw : w ∈ (DeformationSpace.genericι Y J).opensRange := by
        rw [DeformationSpace.opensRange_genericι Y J k φk]
        have : DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y J k φk w =
            blowupGlobalToLineOver Y J k φk (uChartGlobal Y J w) := by
          rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, uChartGlobal_toLineOver]
        show DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y J k φk w ∈
          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum k[X]))
        rw [this]; exact hy
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hw
      refine ⟨DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y v, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← gmToBlowupGlobal_blowupGlobalι]
      rfl
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show toP1Global Y J k φk (lineTι Y J y) ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, lineTι_toP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.preimage_opensRange_chart_zero
statement:
theorem preimage_opensRange_chart_zero :
    toP1Global Y J k φk ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange = (blowupGlobalι Y J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨gmToBlowupGlobal Y J y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w
        (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · change lineTι Y J y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk y ∈ (chart k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange := by
        show chart k 1 (DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk y) ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← lineTι_toP1 Y J k φk, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [chart_one_preimage] at hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (DeformationSpace.genericι Y ⊥).opensRange := by
        rw [DeformationSpace.opensRange_genericι Y ⊥ k φk]
        exact hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨gmToBlowupGlobal Y J (inv (DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y) z), ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, gmToBlowupGlobal_blowupGlobalι, DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial,
        Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (inv (DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y)), IsIso.inv_hom_id]
      rfl
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show toP1Global Y J k φk (blowupGlobalι Y J y) ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupGlobalι_toP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι_isPullback
statement:

statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.fibre_isPullback_P1Global
statement:
theorem fibre_isPullback_P1Global (c : k) :
    IsPullback ((DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c).inv ≫
        DeformationSpace.quotientToPoint Y ⊥ k φk _ (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c))
      ((DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c).inv ≫
        (RelativeSpec.quotientHom (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) _
          (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c)).map ≫ lineTι Y J)
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k c) (toP1Global Y J k φk)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (DeformationSpace.quotient_isPullback Y ⊥ k φk _
    (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c) c (fun _ ↦ rfl)).flip.paste_vert
    (lineTι_isPullback Y J k φk)
  refine h.of_iso (DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ (by simp [DeformationSpace.pointAt]) (by simp)
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.fibreιGlobal_toBase
statement: theorem fibreιGlobal_toBase (c : k) : fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J = 𝟙 Y
proof:
:= by
  have hT : lineTι Y J ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J = DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ :=
    pushout.inr_desc _ _ _
  have h2 := RelativeSpec.Hom.map_toBase (RelativeSpec.quotientHom
    (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) _ (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c))
  unfold fibreιGlobal
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hT]
  change _ ≫ (_ ≫ RelativeSpec.toBase Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥)) = _
  rw [h2]
  exact (DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c).inv_hom_id

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.chartSectionsEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem chartSectionsEquiv_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J V, ⊤)) :
    ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U
        (affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h m) =
      affineIdealRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J V m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [chartSectionsEquiv_val, ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing_apply]
  change Y.presheaf.map _ ((ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι J).app _
    ((ConormalSheaf.idealModule J).presheaf.map _ m)) = _
  have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι J).val
    (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Y h)).op m
  have hn' : (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι J).app _
      ((ConormalSheaf.idealModule J).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Y h)).op m) =
    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Y h)).op
      ((ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι J).app _ m) := hn
  refine (congrArg (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top U).symm).op) hn').trans ?_
  change Y.presheaf.map _ (Y.presheaf.map _ _) =
    (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing J V m)
  rw [ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing_apply]
  change Y.presheaf.map _ (Y.presheaf.map _ _) = Y.presheaf.map _ (Y.presheaf.map _ _)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealSectionCotangent_naturality
statement:
theorem idealSectionCotangent_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J V, ⊤)) :
    cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)
        ((J.ideal V).toCotangent (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J V m)) =
      (J.ideal U).toCotangent (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U
        (affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartSectionsEquiv_naturality, cotangentRestrictionOfEq_toCotangent]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealTensorRestrictionOfEq_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem idealTensorRestrictionOfEq_tmul (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (K : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = K) (q : A ⧸ I) (m : I) :
    idealTensorRestrictionOfEq I f K h (q ⊗ₜ[A] m) =
      GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap I f K h q ⊗ₜ[B] (idealSemilinearOfEq I f K h m)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul (I : Ideal A) (q : A ⧸ I) (m : I) :
    AffineNormalCone.tensorCotangentEquiv I (q ⊗ₜ[A] m) = q • I.toCotangent m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
  change TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul I I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a ⊗ₜ[A] m) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.tensorCotangentEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem tensorCotangentEquiv_naturality (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (K : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = K) (t : (A ⧸ I) ⊗[A] I) :
    AffineNormalCone.tensorCotangentEquiv K (idealTensorRestrictionOfEq I f K h t) =
      cotangentRestrictionOfEq I f K h (AffineNormalCone.tensorCotangentEquiv I t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul q m =>
    rw [idealTensorRestrictionOfEq_tmul, tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul,
      tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul, cotangentRestrictionOfEq_smul,
      cotangentRestrictionOfEq_toCotangent]
    rfl
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.cotangentRestrictionOfEq_congr
statement:
theorem cotangentRestrictionOfEq_congr (I : Ideal A) (K : Ideal B) (f g : A →+* B)
    (e : f = g) (hf : I.map f = K) (hg : I.map g = K) :
    cotangentRestrictionOfEq I f K hf = cotangentRestrictionOfEq I g K hg
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.quotientBaseMap_congr
statement:
theorem quotientBaseMap_congr (I : Ideal A) (K : Ideal B) (f g : A →+* B)
    (e : f = g) (hf : I.map f = K) (hg : I.map g = K) :
    GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap I f K hf = GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap I g K hg
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartPlusLineCoordinates_naturality
statement:
theorem idealChartPlusLineCoordinates_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (p : idealChartPlusLine Y J V) :
    idealChartPlusLineCoordinates Y J U (idealChartPlusLineRestriction Y J h p) =
      conormalLineSemilinearOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) (idealChartPlusLineCoordinates Y J V p)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact (idealSectionCotangent_naturality Y J h p.1).symm
  · rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartPlusLineSymmetricCoordinates_naturality
statement:
theorem idealChartPlusLineSymmetricCoordinates_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (idealChartPlusLineSymmetricCoordinates Y J U).comp
        (idealChartPlusLineSymmetricRestriction Y J h) =
      (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (idealChartPlusLineSymmetricCoordinates Y J V)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, idealChartPlusLineSymmetricCoordinates,
      idealChartPlusLineSymmetricRestriction, normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq,
      symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
    rfl
  | ι m =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, idealChartPlusLineSymmetricCoordinates,
      idealChartPlusLineSymmetricRestriction, normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq,
      symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _) (idealChartPlusLineCoordinates_naturality Y J h m)
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorCoordinates_tmul
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorCoordinates_tmul (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (q : Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U, ⊤)) :
    idealChartTensorCoordinates Y J U (q ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)] m) =
      q • (J.ideal U).toCotangent (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U m)
proof:
:=
  tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorCoordinates_naturality
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorCoordinates_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (t : idealChartTensor Y J V) :
    idealChartTensorCoordinates Y J U (idealChartTensorRestriction Y J h t) =
      cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U)
        (J.map_ideal h) (idealChartTensorCoordinates Y J V t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul q m =>
    change idealChartTensorCoordinates Y J U
      (GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) q ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)]
        affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h m) = _
    rw [idealChartTensorCoordinates_tmul, idealChartTensorCoordinates_tmul,
      cotangentRestrictionOfEq_smul, idealSectionCotangent_naturality]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorEquiv_apply (U : Y.affineOpens) (t : idealChartTensor Y J U) :
    idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U t = idealChartTensorCoordinates Y J U t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul q m => rfl
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add,hp,hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (p : idealChartTensorPlusLine Y J V) :
    idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv Y J U (idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J h p) =
      conormalLineSemilinearOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)
        (idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv Y J V p)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · change idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U (idealChartTensorRestriction Y J h p.1) =
      cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)
        (idealChartTensorEquiv Y J V p.1)
    rw [idealChartTensorEquiv_apply, idealChartTensorEquiv_apply]
    exact idealChartTensorCoordinates_naturality Y J h p.1
  · rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_square
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_square {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap
        (idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv Y J U)).toRingHom.comp
      (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J h) =
    (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp
      (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap
        (idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv Y J V)).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction,
      normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq, symmetricSemilinearMap_base,
      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, AlgHom.commutes]
  | ι m =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction,
      normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι,
      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _) (idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality Y J h m)
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add,hp,hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul,hp,hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_id
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_id (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (p : idealChartTensorPlusLine Y J U) :
    idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J (le_refl U) p = p
proof:
:= by
  apply (idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv Y J U).injective
  rw [idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality]
  change (cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal U) (GlobalBlowup.res Y (le_refl U)) (J.ideal U)
    (J.map_ideal (le_refl U)) _, GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap (J.ideal U)
      (GlobalBlowup.res Y (le_refl U)) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal (le_refl U)) _) = _
  rw [cotangentRestrictionOfEq_congr (J.ideal U) (J.ideal U) _ _ (GlobalBlowup.res_refl Y U)
      (J.map_ideal (le_refl U)) (Ideal.map_id _),
    quotientBaseMap_congr (J.ideal U) (J.ideal U) _ _ (GlobalBlowup.res_refl Y U)
      (J.map_ideal (le_refl U)) (Ideal.map_id _)]
  simp only [cotangentRestrictionOfEq_id, InfinityNormalBundleGlue.quotientBaseMap_id,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply, RingHom.id_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_comp {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (k : V ≤ W)
    (p : idealChartTensorPlusLine Y J W) :
    idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J (h.trans k) p =
      idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J h (idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J k p)
proof:
:= by
  apply (idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv Y J U).injective
  rw [idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality, idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality,
    idealChartTensorPlusLineEquiv_naturality]
  change (cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal W) (GlobalBlowup.res Y (h.trans k)) (J.ideal U)
      (J.map_ideal (h.trans k)) _, GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap (J.ideal W)
        (GlobalBlowup.res Y (h.trans k)) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal (h.trans k)) _) = _
  have hm : (J.ideal W).map ((GlobalBlowup.res Y h).comp (GlobalBlowup.res Y k)) = J.ideal U := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_map, J.map_ideal k, J.map_ideal h]
  rw [cotangentRestrictionOfEq_congr (J.ideal W) (J.ideal U) _ _ (GlobalBlowup.res_comp Y h k)
      (J.map_ideal (h.trans k)) hm,
    quotientBaseMap_congr (J.ideal W) (J.ideal U) _ _ (GlobalBlowup.res_comp Y h k)
      (J.map_ideal (h.trans k)) hm]
  ext
  · exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (cotangentRestrictionOfEq_comp (J.ideal W) (GlobalBlowup.res Y k) (J.ideal V) (J.map_ideal k)
        (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)) _
  · exact RingHom.congr_fun
      (InfinityNormalBundleGlue.quotientBaseMap_comp (J.ideal W) (GlobalBlowup.res Y k)
        (J.ideal V) (J.map_ideal k) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_common_refinement
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_common_refinement
    {T U V W : Y.affineOpens} (hU : U ≤ T) (hV : V ≤ T) (kU : W ≤ U) (kV : W ≤ V)
    (p : idealChartTensorPlusLine Y J T) :
    idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J kU (idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J hU p) =
      idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J kV (idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction Y J hV p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_comp, ← idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorSymmetricEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorSymmetricEquiv_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (p : SymmetricAlgebra (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V) (idealChartTensorPlusLine Y J V)) :
    idealChartTensorSymmetricEquiv Y J U (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J h p) =
      normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)
        (idealChartTensorSymmetricEquiv Y J V p)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_square Y J h) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_id
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_id (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J (le_refl U) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction, symmetricSemilinearMap_base, RingHom.id_apply]
    rw [quotientBaseMap_congr (J.ideal U) (J.ideal U) _ _ (GlobalBlowup.res_refl Y U)
      (J.map_ideal (le_refl U)) (Ideal.map_id _), InfinityNormalBundleGlue.quotientBaseMap_id]
    rfl
  | ι m =>
    simp only [idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, RingHom.id_apply]
    rw [idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_id]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add,hp,hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul,hp,hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_comp {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (k : V ≤ W) :
    idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J (h.trans k) =
      (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J h).comp (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J k)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (J.ideal W).map ((GlobalBlowup.res Y h).comp (GlobalBlowup.res Y k)) = J.ideal U := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_map, J.map_ideal k, J.map_ideal h]
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction, symmetricSemilinearMap_base, RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [quotientBaseMap_congr (J.ideal W) (J.ideal U) _ _ (GlobalBlowup.res_comp Y h k)
      (J.map_ideal (h.trans k)) hm,
      InfinityNormalBundleGlue.quotientBaseMap_comp (J.ideal W) (GlobalBlowup.res Y k)
        (J.ideal V) (J.map_ideal k) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)]
    rfl
  | ι m =>
    simp only [idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [idealChartTensorPlusLineRestriction_comp]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add,hp,hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul,hp,hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameNaturality.idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_common_refinement
statement:
theorem idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_common_refinement
    {T U V W : Y.affineOpens} (hU : U ≤ T) (hV : V ≤ T) (kU : W ≤ U) (kV : W ≤ V) :
    (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J kU).comp (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J hU) =
      (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J kV).comp (idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J hV)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_comp, ← idealChartTensorSymmetricRestriction_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.homogeneousMonomial_mem_grade
statement:
theorem homogeneousMonomial_mem_grade (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (c : A) :
    homogeneousMonomial I n c ∈ grade I n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hc : c ∈ I ^ n
  · change ((homogeneousMonomial I n c : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]) =
      monomial n (((homogeneousMonomial I n c : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]).coeff n)
    rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I n c hc]
    simp
  · have hzero : homogeneousMonomial I n c = 0 := by simp [homogeneousMonomial, hc]
    rw [hzero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.mul_mem_pow_add
statement:
theorem mul_mem_pow_add (I : Ideal A) {n m : ℕ} {c d : A}
    (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) (hd : d ∈ I ^ m) : c * d ∈ I ^ (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_add]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hc hd

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.homogeneousMonomial_mul
statement:
theorem homogeneousMonomial_mul (I : Ideal A) (n m : ℕ) (c d : A)
    (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) (hd : d ∈ I ^ m) :
    homogeneousMonomial I n c * homogeneousMonomial I m d =
      homogeneousMonomial I (n + m) (c * d)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, homogeneousMonomial_coe I n c hc,
    homogeneousMonomial_coe I m d hd,
    homogeneousMonomial_coe I (n + m) (c * d) (mul_mem_pow_add I hc hd)]
  exact monomial_mul_monomial n m c d

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chartElem_val (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n : ℕ) (c : A) :
    (chartElem I r n c).val =
      Localization.mk (homogeneousMonomial I n c)
        (⟨generator I r ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers (generator I r))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.generator_pow
statement:
theorem generator_pow (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (k : ℕ) :
    generator I r ^ k = homogeneousMonomial I k (r.1 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I k _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow r.2 k)]
  change ((generator I r : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]) ^ k = _
  rw [show ((generator I r : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]) = monomial 1 r.1 from rfl]
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, monomial_mul_monomial, pow_succ]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_add
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_add, chartElem_val, chartElem_val, chartElem_val,
    Localization.add_mk_self]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, homogeneousMonomial_coe I n c hc,
    homogeneousMonomial_coe I n d hd,
    homogeneousMonomial_coe I n (c + d) (Ideal.add_mem _ hc hd)]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_mul
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, chartElem_val, chartElem_val, chartElem_val,
    Localization.mk_mul, homogeneousMonomial_mul I n m c d hc hd]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [pow_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_shift
statement:
theorem chartElem_shift (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n k : ℕ) {c : A} (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) :
    chartElem I r n c = chartElem I r (n + k) (r.1 ^ k * c)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [chartElem_val, chartElem_val]
  rw [show homogeneousMonomial I (n + k) (r.1 ^ k * c) =
      generator I r ^ k * homogeneousMonomial I n c by
    rw [generator_pow, homogeneousMonomial_mul I k n _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow r.2 k) hc,
      Nat.add_comm k n]]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  change (1 : reesAlgebra I) * (generator I r ^ (n + k) * homogeneousMonomial I n c) =
    1 * (generator I r ^ n * (generator I r ^ k * homogeneousMonomial I n c))
  rw [pow_add]
  ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem chartElem_eq_zero_iff (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n : ℕ) {c : A} (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) :
    chartElem I r n c = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, r.1 ^ k * c = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hval : (chartElem I r n c).val = 0 := by rw [h, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    rw [chartElem_val, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hval
    obtain ⟨⟨m, k, hk⟩, hm⟩ := hval
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have hm' : generator I r ^ k * homogeneousMonomial I n c = 0 := by
      rw [show generator I r ^ k = m from hk]
      exact hm
    have hpoly := congrArg (fun x : reesAlgebra I ↦ (x : A[X])) hm'
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, generator_pow] at hpoly
    rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I k _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow r.2 k),
      homogeneousMonomial_coe I n c hc, monomial_mul_monomial] at hpoly
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : A[X] ↦ p.coeff (k + n)) hpoly
    simpa using hcoeff
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [chartElem_val, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply,
      IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨generator I r ^ k, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    change generator I r ^ k * homogeneousMonomial I n c = 0
    rw [generator_pow, homogeneousMonomial_mul I k n _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow r.2 k) hc, hk]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [homogeneousMonomial]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.baseElement_eq_chartElem
statement:
theorem baseElement_eq_chartElem (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (a : A) :
    baseElement I r a = chartElem I r 0 a
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [chartElem_val]
  change Localization.mk (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a) _ = _
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I 0 a (by simp)]
  simp [Polynomial.monomial_zero_left]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.baseRingHom_eq_chartElem
statement:
theorem baseRingHom_eq_chartElem (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (a : A) :
    baseRingHom I r a = chartElem I r 0 a
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseRingHom_apply, baseElement_eq_chartElem]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_surjective
statement:
theorem chartElem_surjective (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (z : chartRing I r) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : A), c ∈ I ^ n ∧ chartElem I r n c = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ :=
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) z
  have ha' : a ∈ grade I n := by
    convert ha using 2
    simp
  refine ⟨n, (a : A[X]).coeff n,
    ((mem_reesAlgebra_iff I (a : A[X])).mp a.property) n, ?_⟩
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [chartElem_val, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I n _ (((mem_reesAlgebra_iff I (a : A[X])).mp a.property) n)]
  exact ha'.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.reesMap_homogeneousMonomial
statement:
theorem reesMap_homogeneousMonomial (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (n : ℕ) {c : A}
    (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) :
    reesMap I f (homogeneousMonomial I n c) =
      homogeneousMonomial (I.map f) n (f c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hfc : f c ∈ (I.map f) ^ n := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f hc
  rw [reesMap_coe, homogeneousMonomial_coe I n c hc,
    homogeneousMonomial_coe (I.map f) n (f c) hfc]
  exact map_monomial f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.reesMap_generator'
statement:
theorem reesMap_generator' (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) :
    reesMap I f (generator I r) = generator (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [generator, mapGenerator]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.reesMap_generator_pow
statement:
theorem reesMap_generator_pow (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) (n : ℕ) :
    reesMap I f (generator I r ^ n) = generator (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_pow, reesMap_generator']

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartBaseChangeHom_chartElem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chartBaseChangeHom_chartElem (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) (n : ℕ) {c : A}
    (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) :
    chartBaseChangeHom I f r (chartElem I r n c) =
      chartElem (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r) n (f c)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [chartBaseChangeHom, chartElem, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, chartElem_val]
  change Localization.mk (reesMap I f (homogeneousMonomial I n c))
      ⟨reesMap I f (generator I r ^ n), _⟩ = _
  rw [reesMap_homogeneousMonomial I f n hc]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact reesMap_generator_pow I f r n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartBaseChangeHom_baseRingHom
statement:
theorem chartBaseChangeHom_baseRingHom (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) (a : A) :
    chartBaseChangeHom I f r (baseRingHom I r a) =
      baseRingHom (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseRingHom_eq_chartElem, baseRingHom_eq_chartElem,
    chartBaseChangeHom_chartElem I f r 0 (by simp)]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_zero
statement: theorem chartElem_zero (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n : ℕ) : chartElem I r n 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [chartElem_val, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero,
    show homogeneousMonomial I n (0 : A) = 0 by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [homogeneousMonomial]]
  exact Localization.mk_zero _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartAlgebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem chartAlgebraMap_eq (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    algebraMap A (chartRing I r) = baseRingHom I r
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartAlgebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem chartAlgebraMap_apply (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (a : A) :
    algebraMap A (chartRing I r) a = chartElem I r 0 a
proof:
:=
  baseRingHom_eq_chartElem I r a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chartTensorMap_tmul (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (z : chartRing I r) (b : B) :
    chartTensorMap I r (z ⊗ₜ[A] b) =
      chartBaseChangeHom I (algebraMap A B) r z *
        baseRingHom (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) b
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartTensorMap, chartBaseChangeAlgHom, chartTargetAlgHom]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElem_mem_range
statement:
theorem chartElem_mem_range (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n : ℕ) {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) (I ^ n)) :
    b ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A B)) ^ n ∧
      ∃ w : chartRing I r ⊗[A] B,
        chartTensorMap I r w =
          chartElem (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) n b
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun b _ ↦ b ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A B)) ^ n ∧
      ∃ w : chartRing I r ⊗[A] B, chartTensorMap I r w =
        chartElem (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) n b)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb
  · rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨by rw [← Ideal.map_pow]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hc,
      chartElem I r n c ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B), ?_⟩
    rw [chartTensorMap_tmul, map_one, mul_one,
      chartBaseChangeHom_chartElem I (algebraMap A B) r n hc]
  · exact ⟨Ideal.zero_mem _, (0 : chartRing I r ⊗[A] B), by rw [map_zero, chartElem_zero]⟩
  · rintro x y _ _ ⟨hx, wx, hwx⟩ ⟨hy, wy, hwy⟩
    exact ⟨Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy, wx + wy, by
      rw [map_add, hwx, hwy, chartElem_add _ _ n hx hy]⟩
  · rintro c x _ ⟨hx, wx, hwx⟩
    refine ⟨Ideal.mul_mem_left _ c hx, (1 ⊗ₜ[A] c) * wx, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, hwx, chartTensorMap_tmul, map_one, one_mul, baseRingHom_eq_chartElem,
      chartElem_mul _ _ 0 n (by simp) hx, zero_add, smul_eq_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_surjective
statement:
theorem chartTensorMap_surjective (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    Function.Surjective (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb, rfl⟩ :=
    chartElem_surjective (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) z
  exact (chartElem_mem_range I r n (by rwa [Ideal.map_pow])).2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElemLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chartElemLinear_apply (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n : ℕ) (c : (I ^ n : Ideal A)) :
    chartElemLinear I r n c = chartElem I r n c.1
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.idealPowShift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealPowShift_apply (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n k : ℕ) (c : (I ^ n : Ideal A)) :
    ((idealPowShift I r n k c : (I ^ (n + k) : Ideal A)) : A) = r.1 ^ k * c.1
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartElemLinear_comp_shift
statement:
theorem chartElemLinear_comp_shift (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n k : ℕ) :
    (chartElemLinear I r (n + k)).comp (idealPowShift I r n k) = chartElemLinear I r n
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  exact (chartElem_shift I r n k c.2).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.idealPowTensorEval_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealPowTensorEval_tmul (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (c : (I ^ n : Ideal A)) (b : B) :
    idealPowTensorEval I n (c ⊗ₜ[A] b) = algebraMap A B c.1 * b
proof:
:= by
  simp [idealPowTensorEval, Algebra.smul_def]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.idealPowTensorEval_injective
statement:
theorem idealPowTensorEval_injective (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) [Module.Flat A B] :
    Function.Injective (idealPowTensorEval (B := B) I n)
proof:
:=
  (TensorProduct.lid A B).injective.comp
    (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ (Submodule.injective_subtype _))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.idealPowTensorEval_mem
statement:
theorem idealPowTensorEval_mem (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (w : (I ^ n : Ideal A) ⊗[A] B) :
    idealPowTensorEval I n w ∈ (I.map (algebraMap A B)) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c b =>
      rw [idealPowTensorEval_tmul]
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
      rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ c.2
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.idealPowTensorEval_shift
statement:
theorem idealPowTensorEval_shift (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n k : ℕ)
    (w : (I ^ n : Ideal A) ⊗[A] B) :
    idealPowTensorEval I (n + k) (LinearMap.rTensor B (idealPowShift I r n k) w) =
      algebraMap A B r.1 ^ k * idealPowTensorEval I n w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul c b =>
      rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, idealPowTensorEval_tmul, idealPowTensorEval_tmul,
        idealPowShift_apply, map_mul, map_pow, mul_assoc]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, mul_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_rTensor
statement:
theorem chartTensorMap_rTensor (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (n : ℕ)
    (w : (I ^ n : Ideal A) ⊗[A] B) :
    chartTensorMap I r (LinearMap.rTensor B (chartElemLinear I r n) w) =
      chartElem (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) n
        (idealPowTensorEval I n w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [chartElem_zero]
  | tmul c b =>
      rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, chartElemLinear_apply, chartTensorMap_tmul,
        chartBaseChangeHom_chartElem I (algebraMap A B) r n c.2, baseRingHom_eq_chartElem,
        chartElem_mul _ _ n 0 (by rw [← Ideal.map_pow]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ c.2)
          (by simp), add_zero, idealPowTensorEval_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add,
        chartElem_add _ _ n (idealPowTensorEval_mem I n x) (idealPowTensorEval_mem I n y)]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.exists_rTensor_chartElemLinear_eq
statement:
theorem exists_rTensor_chartElemLinear_eq (I : Ideal A) (r : I)
    (z : chartRing I r ⊗[A] B) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (w : (I ^ n : Ideal A) ⊗[A] B),
      LinearMap.rTensor B (chartElemLinear I r n) w = z
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∀ (n k : ℕ) (w : (I ^ n : Ideal A) ⊗[A] B),
      LinearMap.rTensor B (chartElemLinear I r (n + k))
        (LinearMap.rTensor B (idealPowShift I r n k) w) =
        LinearMap.rTensor B (chartElemLinear I r n) w := by
    intro n k w
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, chartElemLinear_comp_shift]
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, map_zero _⟩
  | tmul z b =>
      obtain ⟨n, c, hc, rfl⟩ := chartElem_surjective I r z
      exact ⟨n, (⟨c, hc⟩ : (I ^ n : Ideal A)) ⊗ₜ[A] b, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨n, w, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨m, v, rfl⟩ := hy
      rcases Nat.le_total n m with hnm | hmn
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
        exact ⟨n + k, LinearMap.rTensor B (idealPowShift I r n k) w + v, by
          rw [map_add, hshift]⟩
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
        exact ⟨m + k, w + LinearMap.rTensor B (idealPowShift I r m k) v, by
          rw [map_add, hshift]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_injective
statement:
theorem chartTensorMap_injective (I : Ideal A) (r : I) [Module.Flat A B] :
    Function.Injective (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, w, rfl⟩ := exists_rTensor_chartElemLinear_eq I r z
  rw [chartTensorMap_rTensor] at hz
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    (chartElem_eq_zero_iff _ _ n (idealPowTensorEval_mem I n w)).mp hz
  have hzero : LinearMap.rTensor B (idealPowShift I r n k) w = 0 := by
    apply idealPowTensorEval_injective (B := B) I (n + k)
    rw [idealPowTensorEval_shift, map_zero]
    exact hk
  rw [← chartElemLinear_comp_shift I r n k, LinearMap.rTensor_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    hzero, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_bijective
statement:
theorem chartTensorMap_bijective (I : Ideal A) (r : I) [Module.Flat A B] :
    Function.Bijective (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨chartTensorMap_injective I r, chartTensorMap_surjective I r⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_includeLeft
statement:
theorem chartTensorMap_includeLeft (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r).toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom) =
      chartBaseChangeHom I (algebraMap A B) r
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  change chartTensorMap I r (z ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) = _
  rw [chartTensorMap_tmul, map_one, mul_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartTensorMap_includeRight
statement:
theorem chartTensorMap_includeRight (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r).toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[A] _).toRingHom =
      baseRingHom (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro b
  change chartTensorMap I r ((1 : chartRing I r) ⊗ₜ[A] b) = _
  rw [chartTensorMap_tmul, map_one, one_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartMap_comp_projection
statement:
theorem chartMap_comp_projection (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    chartMap I r ≫ projection I = chartProjection I r
proof:
:=
  chartMap_projection I r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartSchemeBaseChange_comm
statement:
theorem chartSchemeBaseChange_comm (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    chartSchemeBaseChange I r ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (chartRing I r))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B
          (chartRing (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r)))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartSchemeBaseChange, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  exact chartBaseChangeHom_baseRingHom I (algebraMap A B) r a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chart_isPullback
statement:
theorem chart_isPullback (I : Ideal A) (r : I) [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsPullback (chartSchemeBaseChange I r)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B
        (chartRing (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r)))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (chartRing I r))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
proof:
:= by
  have hiso : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r).toRingHom)) := by
    rw [isIso_SpecMap_iff]
    exact chartTensorMap_bijective I r
  refine IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨chartSchemeBaseChange_comm I r⟩
    (asIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartTensorMap (B := B) I r).toRingHom)) ≪≫
      (pullbackSpecIso A (chartRing I r) B).symm) ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst,
      ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, chartSchemeBaseChange]
    congr 2
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro z
    change chartTensorMap I r (z ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) = chartBaseChangeHom I (algebraMap A B) r z
    rw [chartTensorMap_tmul, map_one, mul_one]
  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd,
      ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro b
    change chartTensorMap I r ((1 : chartRing I r) ⊗ₜ[A] b) =
      baseRingHom (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) b
    rw [chartTensorMap_tmul, map_one, one_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartProjection_isPullback
statement:
theorem chartProjection_isPullback (I : Ideal A) (r : I) [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsPullback (chartSchemeBaseChange I r)
      (chartProjection (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r))
      (chartProjection I r) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
proof:
:=
  chart_isPullback I r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.baseRingHom_eq_awayBaseHom
statement:
theorem baseRingHom_eq_awayBaseHom (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    baseRingHom I r = awayBaseHom I (generator I r)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.awayι_comp_projection
statement:
theorem awayι_comp_projection (I : Ideal A) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I) (hs : s ∈ grade I d)
    (hd : 0 < d) :
    Proj.awayι (grade I) s hs hd ≫ projection I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (awayBaseHom I s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projection, ← Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.awayMap_awayBaseHom
statement:
theorem awayMap_awayBaseHom (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (s : reesAlgebra I) (a : A) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap I f) s (awayBaseHom I s a) =
      awayBaseHom (I.map f) ((gradedMap I f) s) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ y : grade I 0,
      HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grade I) (Submonoid.powers s) y =
        HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, y, 1, one_mem _⟩ := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have h2 : ∀ y : grade (I.map f) 0,
      HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grade (I.map f))
          (Submonoid.powers ((gradedMap I f) s)) y =
        HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, y, 1, one_mem _⟩ := fun _ ↦ rfl
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [awayBaseHom, awayBaseHom, RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, h1, h2,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map, HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk]
  congr 1
  · apply Subtype.ext
    simp [zeroEquiv, component, gradedMap]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_one (reesMap I f)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.awayι_comp_schemeMap_comp_projection
statement:
theorem awayι_comp_schemeMap_comp_projection (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (s : reesAlgebra I) (hs : s ∈ grade I d) :
    Proj.awayι (grade (I.map f)) ((gradedMap I f) s) ((gradedMap I f).2 hs) hd ≫
        schemeMap I f ≫ projection I =
      Proj.awayι (grade (I.map f)) ((gradedMap I f) s) ((gradedMap I f).2 hs) hd ≫
        projection (I.map f) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, schemeMap,
    Proj.awayι_comp_map (gradedMap I f) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap I f) hd s hs,
    Category.assoc, awayι_comp_projection I s hs hd,
    awayι_comp_projection (I.map f) ((gradedMap I f) s) ((gradedMap I f).2 hs) hd,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  exact awayMap_awayBaseHom I f s a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.schemeMap_comp_projection
statement:
theorem schemeMap_comp_projection (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) :
    schemeMap I f ≫ projection I = projection (I.map f) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Proj.mapAffineOpenCover (gradedMap I f)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap I f)).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun s ↦ ?_
  exact awayι_comp_schemeMap_comp_projection I f s.1.2 s.2.1 s.2.2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.awayι_comp_schemeMap
statement:
theorem awayι_comp_schemeMap (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I)
    (q : reesAlgebra (I.map f)) (hq : q ∈ grade (I.map f) 1)
    (h : (gradedMap I f) (generator I r) = q)
    (hle : Submonoid.powers (generator I r) ≤ (Submonoid.powers q).comap (gradedMap I f)) :
    Proj.awayι (grade (I.map f)) q hq Nat.one_pos ≫ schemeMap I f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.map (gradedMap I f) hle)) ≫
        chartMap I r
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact Proj.awayι_comp_map (gradedMap I f) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap I f) Nat.one_pos _
    (generator_mem_grade_one I r)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartMap_comp_schemeMap
statement:
theorem chartMap_comp_schemeMap (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) :
    chartMap (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r) ≫ schemeMap I f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartBaseChangeHom I f r)) ≫ chartMap I r
proof:
:=
  awayι_comp_schemeMap I f r _ (generator_mem_grade_one _ _) (reesMap_generator' I f r) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.schemeMap_preimage_chartMap_opensRange
statement:
theorem schemeMap_preimage_chartMap_opensRange (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) :
    schemeMap I f ⁻¹ᵁ (chartMap I r).opensRange =
      (chartMap (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r)).opensRange
proof:

    reesMap_generator']

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartMap_isPullback_schemeMap
statement:
theorem chartMap_isPullback_schemeMap (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartBaseChangeHom I f r)))
      (chartMap (I.map f) (mapGenerator I f r)) (chartMap I r) (schemeMap I f)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (chartMap_comp_schemeMap I f r)
    (schemeMap_preimage_chartMap_opensRange I f r)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartMap_isPullback
statement:
theorem chartMap_isPullback (I : Ideal A) (r : I) [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsPullback (chartSchemeBaseChange I r)
      (chartMap (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) ≫
        projection (I.map (algebraMap A B)))
      (chartMap I r ≫ projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartMap_projection, chartMap_projection]
  exact chart_isPullback I r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.isIso_snd_blowupComparison
statement:
theorem isIso_snd_blowupComparison (I : Ideal A) (r : I) [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsIso (pullback.snd (blowupComparison (B := B) I) (chartPullbackMap I r))
proof:
:= by
  have hfst : blowupComparison (B := B) I ≫
      pullback.fst (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) =
      schemeMap I (algebraMap A B) := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hsnd : blowupComparison (B := B) I ≫
      pullback.snd (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) =
      projection (I.map (algebraMap A B)) := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hmfst : chartPullbackMap (B := B) I r ≫
      pullback.fst (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) =
      pullback.fst (chartMap I r ≫ projection I)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) ≫ chartMap I r :=
    pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hmsnd : chartPullbackMap (B := B) I r ≫
      pullback.snd (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) =
      pullback.snd (chartMap I r ≫ projection I)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) := by
    rw [chartPullbackMap, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]
  have hδfst := (chartMap_isPullback (B := B) I r).isoPullback_hom_fst
  have hδsnd := (chartMap_isPullback (B := B) I r).isoPullback_hom_snd
  have hS3 : IsPullback (pullback.fst (chartMap I r ≫ projection I)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))))
      (chartPullbackMap (B := B) I r) (chartMap I r)
      (pullback.fst (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_bot ?_ hmfst.symm (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)
    rw [hmsnd]
    exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _
  have hp : (chartMap_isPullback (B := B) I r).isoPullback.hom ≫ chartPullbackMap I r =
      chartMap (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r) ≫
        blowupComparison (B := B) I := by
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, hmfst, ← Category.assoc, hδfst, Category.assoc, hfst]
      exact (chartMap_comp_schemeMap I (algebraMap A B) r).symm
    · rw [Category.assoc, hmsnd, hδsnd, Category.assoc, hsnd]
  have hS4 : IsPullback (chartMap_isPullback (B := B) I r).isoPullback.hom
      (chartMap (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (mapGenerator I (algebraMap A B) r))
      (chartPullbackMap (B := B) I r) (blowupComparison (B := B) I) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_right ?_ hp hS3
    rw [hδfst, hfst]
    exact chartMap_isPullback_schemeMap I (algebraMap A B) r
  have hres : pullback.snd (blowupComparison (B := B) I) (chartPullbackMap I r) =
      hS4.flip.isoPullback.inv ≫ (chartMap_isPullback (B := B) I r).isoPullback.hom := by
    rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp]
    exact hS4.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd
  rw [hres]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.isIso_blowupComparison
statement:
theorem isIso_blowupComparison (I : Ideal A) [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsIso (blowupComparison (B := B) I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover
    (Scheme.Pullback.openCoverOfLeft (generatorAffineOpenCover I).openCover
      (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))) fun r ↦ ?_
  rw [MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  exact isIso_snd_blowupComparison I r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.isPullback_schemeMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_schemeMap (I : Ideal A) [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsPullback (schemeMap I (algebraMap A B)) (projection (I.map (algebraMap A B)))
      (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
proof:
:= by
  have := isIso_blowupComparison (B := B) I
  exact IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨schemeMap_comp_projection I (algebraMap A B)⟩
    (asIso (blowupComparison (B := B) I)) (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.opensRange_schemeMap
statement:
theorem opensRange_schemeMap (I : Ideal A) [Module.Flat A B]
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))] :
    (schemeMap I (algebraMap A B)).opensRange =
      projection I ⁻¹ᵁ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  have h : (isPullback_schemeMap (B := B) I).isoPullback.hom ≫
      pullback.fst (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) =
      schemeMap I (algebraMap A B) := (isPullback_schemeMap (B := B) I).isoPullback_hom_fst
  refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext ?_
  have hset : Set.range (schemeMap I (algebraMap A B)) =
      Set.range (pullback.fst (projection I)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))) := by
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (isPullback_schemeMap (B := B) I).isoPullback.hom := by
      exact (isPullback_schemeMap (B := B) I).isoPullback.hom.homeomorph.surjective
    rw [← h, Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.coe_comp, Set.range_comp,
      Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hsurj, Set.image_univ]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange, hset]
  exact IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.isPullback_schemeMap_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isPullback_schemeMap_isLocalization (I : Ideal A) (S : Submonoid A)
    [IsLocalization S B] :
    IsPullback (schemeMap I (algebraMap A B)) (projection (I.map (algebraMap A B)))
      (projection I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Flat A B := IsLocalization.flat B S
  exact isPullback_schemeMap I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.opensRange_schemeMap_localizationAway

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersection.original_intersection_isPullback
statement:
theorem original_intersection_isPullback :
    IsPullback (pullback.fst (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J) J.subschemeι)
      (boundaryToComponent Y J) (otherToInfinity Y J) (componentι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have ho := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J) J.subschemeι).flip
  have hc := boundaryToComponent_ι Y J
  have ho' : IsPullback (boundaryToComponent Y J ≫ componentToCentre Y J)
      (pullback.fst (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J) J.subschemeι) J.subschemeι
      (otherToInfinity Y J ≫ infinityToBase Y J) := by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersection.original_affine_intersection_isPullback
statement:
theorem original_affine_intersection_isPullback (I : Ideal A) :
    IsPullback (exceptionalι I) (affineBoundaryToExceptional I)
      (affineOtherToInfinity A I) (exceptionalToAffineInfinity A I)
proof:
:= by
  have ho := (exceptional_isPullback I).flip
  rw [← affineOtherToInfinity_base A I] at ho
  have ho' : IsPullback
      (affineBoundaryToExceptional I ≫
        (exceptionalToCenter (centreIdeal I) ≫ (centreIso A I).hom))
      (exceptionalι I) (centerι I)
      (affineOtherToInfinity A I ≫ affineInfinityBase A I) := by
    rw [affineBoundaryToExceptional_toCentre]
    exact ho
  exact (ho'.of_right (affineBoundaryToExceptional_infinity I)
    (exceptional_affineInfinity_isPullback A I).flip).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.theta_apply
statement:
theorem theta_apply (r : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    theta I x r = sndGraded I (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse I (grMk (centreIdeal I) r)))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.theta_generator
statement:
theorem theta_generator :
    theta I x (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) = SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen (A ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta_apply]
  have h1 : grMk (centreIdeal I) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) =
      InfinityNormalCone.variableGr I := rfl
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse I (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr I) :
      Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) = Polynomial.X :=
    CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_symm_variable I
  rw [h2]
  have h3 : normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x Polynomial.X =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1) := by
    change (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x).symm Polynomial.X = _
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι]
    simp
  rw [h3]
  change symmetricSemilinearMap (RingHom.id (A ⧸ I))
    (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I)) _ = _
  rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.grMk_generator_eq
statement:
theorem grMk_generator_eq (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I) :
    grMk (centreIdeal I) (generator (centreIdeal I) ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩) =
      InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap I (grMk I (generator I ⟨a, ha⟩))
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _ =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap I (centreIdeal I) Polynomial.C _ _)
  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (Subtype.ext (by
    simp [generator, Polynomial.map_monomial]))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.theta_generator_C
statement:
theorem theta_generator_C (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I) :
    theta I x (generator (centreIdeal I) ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta_apply, grMk_generator_eq I a ha]
  have h2 : (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse I
      (InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap I (grMk I (generator I ⟨a, ha⟩))) :
      Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) =
      Polynomial.C (grMk I (generator I ⟨a, ha⟩)) :=
    CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_symm_coefficient I _
  rw [h2]
  have h3 : normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x (Polynomial.C (grMk I (generator I ⟨a, ha⟩))) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (I.toCotangent ⟨a, ha⟩, 0) := by
    change (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x).symm _ = _
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι]
    simp only [map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent]
    rfl
  rw [h3]
  change symmetricSemilinearMap (RingHom.id (A ⧸ I))
    (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I)) _ = _
  rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.grMk_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem grMk_algebraMap_eq (p : A[X]) :
    grMk (centreIdeal I) (algebraMap A[X] (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) p) =
      InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap I (grZero I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p.coeff 0)))
proof:
:= by
  have hX : p - Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) ∈ centreIdeal I := by
    refine Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ?_)
    rw [Polynomial.X_dvd_iff]
    simp
  have h1 : grMk (centreIdeal I) (algebraMap A[X] (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) p) =
      grMk (centreIdeal I) (algebraMap A[X] (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0))) := by
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← map_sub]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hX
  rw [h1]
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _ = InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap I (centreIdeal I) Polynomial.C _
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) (p.coeff 0)))
  rw [InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap_mk, InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_algebraMap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.theta_algebraMap
statement:
theorem theta_algebraMap (p : A[X]) :
    theta I x (algebraMap A[X] (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) p) =
      algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p.coeff 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta_apply, grMk_algebraMap_eq]
  have h2 : (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse I
      (InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap I (grZero I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p.coeff 0)))) :
      Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) =
      Polynomial.C ((grZero I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p.coeff 0)) : grGrade I 0) :
        AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) :=
    CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_symm_coefficient I _
  rw [h2]
  have h3 : normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x
      (Polynomial.C ((grZero I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p.coeff 0)) : grGrade I 0) :
        AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) =
      algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p.coeff 0)) := by
    change (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x).symm _ = _
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_base]
    rfl
  rw [h3]
  change symmetricSemilinearMap (RingHom.id (A ⧸ I))
    (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I)) _ = _
  rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.rankOneHom_bijective
statement: theorem rankOneHom_bijective : Function.Bijective (rankOneHom (symGen Q))
proof:
:= by
  refine (fromZeroRingHom_symGen_bijective Q).comp ?_
  exact (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Q) (M := Q)).symm.bijective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.rankOneHom_mk
statement:
theorem rankOneHom_mk (t : SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) (ht : t ∈ symGrading Q Q 1) (n : ℕ)
    (b : SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) (hb : b ∈ symGrading Q Q n) (hbt : t = symGen Q) :
    rankOneHom t (symEval Q b) = Away.mk (symGrading Q Q) ht n b (by simpa using hb)
proof:
:= by
  subst hbt
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  change Localization.mk _ 1 = _
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
  conv_rhs => rw [eq_of_mem_symGrading Q hb]
  have hz : ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Q) (M := Q)).symm (symEval Q b) :
      SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) = algebraMap Q _ (symEval Q b) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Q) (M := Q)).symm.commutes (symEval Q b))
  change symGen Q ^ n * ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Q) (M := Q)).symm (symEval Q b) :
      SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) = _
  rw [hz, mul_comm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.rankOneHom_bijective'
statement:
theorem rankOneHom_bijective' (t : SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) (ht : t = symGen Q) :
    Function.Bijective (rankOneHom t)
proof:
:= by
  subst ht; exact rankOneHom_bijective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.awayι_comp_rankOneToSpec
statement:
theorem awayι_comp_rankOneToSpec (t : SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) (ht : t ∈ symGrading Q Q 1) :
    Proj.awayι (symGrading Q Q) t ht one_pos ≫ rankOneToSpec Q =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (rankOneHom t))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rankOneToSpec rankOneHom
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.rankOne_chart
statement:
theorem rankOne_chart (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ symGrading Q Q) (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading Q Q) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f) (s : R₀) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (e : f s = symGen Q) :
    ∃ ρ : Away 𝒜 s →+* Q,
      inv (rankOneToSpec Q) ≫ Proj.map f hf =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ) ≫ Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs one_pos ∧
      ∀ z, rankOneHom (f s) (ρ z) = Away.map f s z
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Function.Bijective (rankOneHom (f s)) := rankOneHom_bijective' _ e
  let E : Away (symGrading Q Q) (f s) ≃+* Q := (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).symm
  have hfs : f s ∈ symGrading Q Q 1 := f.2 hs
  have hiso : IsIso (Proj.awayι (symGrading Q Q) (f s) hfs one_pos) :=
    isIso_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq_top _ (by
      rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι, e]; exact basicOpen_symGen_eq_top Q)
  refine ⟨E.toRingHom.comp (Away.map f s), ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := awayι_comp_rankOneToSpec (f s) hfs
    have h2 : inv (rankOneToSpec Q) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom) ≫ Proj.awayι (symGrading Q Q) (f s) hfs one_pos := by
      apply (cancel_mono (rankOneToSpec Q)).mp
      rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.assoc, h1, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
      congr 1
      apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
      apply RingHom.ext
      intro q
      exact ((RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).symm_apply_apply q).symm
    rw [h2, Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf one_pos s hs, ← Category.assoc,
      ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  · change rankOneHom (f s) (E (Away.map f s z)) = _
    exact (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).apply_symm_apply _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.uChart_ringHom_ext
statement:
theorem uChart_ringHom_ext
    (F G : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) →+* S)
    (hb : ∀ p : A[X], F (baseRingHom (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) p) =
      G (baseRingHom (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) p))
    (hr : ∀ (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I), F (ratioElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)
        ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩) =
      G (ratioElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩)) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  let P : extendedRees A I → Prop := fun z => ∃ w, F w = G w ∧ uChartHom I w = z
  have Padd : ∀ z z', P z → P z' → P (z + z') := by
    rintro z z' ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w + w', by rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw'], map_add _ _ _⟩
  have Pmul : ∀ z z', P z → P z' → P (z * z') := by
    rintro z z' ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w * w', by rw [map_mul, map_mul, hw, hw'], map_mul _ _ _⟩
  have Pone : P 1 := ⟨1, by rw [map_one, map_one], map_one _⟩
  have Pzero : P 0 := ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero], map_zero _⟩
  have Pbase : ∀ p : A[X], P (φ I p) := fun p =>
    ⟨baseRingHom (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) p, hb p, uChartHom_baseRingHom I p⟩
  have Pdeg : ∀ a : I, P (degreeOne A I a) := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨ratioElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) ⟨Polynomial.C a.1, C_mem_centreIdeal I a.2⟩,
      hr a.1 a.2, ?_⟩
    refine chartLift_ratioElement _ _ _ _ _ _ (degreeOne A I a) ?_
    change degreeOne A I a * φ I Polynomial.X = φ I (Polynomial.C a.1)
    rw [φ_X, φ_C, mul_comm, parameter_mul_degreeOne]
  have Palg : ∀ a : A, P (algebraMap A (extendedRees A I) a) := by
    intro a; rw [← φ_C]; exact Pbase _
  have Ppar : P (parameter A I) := by
    rw [← φ_X]; exact Pbase _
  have Ppow : ∀ m : ℕ, P (parameter A I ^ m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact Pone
    | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact Pmul _ _ ih Ppar
  have hmono : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ I ^ n →
      ∃ z, P z ∧ (z : A[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro a _
      refine ⟨algebraMap A _ a, Palg a, ?_⟩
      simp [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a ha
      rw [pow_succ] at ha
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on ha ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx y hy
        obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := ih x hx
        refine ⟨z * degreeOne A I ⟨y, hy⟩, Pmul _ _ hz (Pdeg _), ?_⟩
        rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, hzx, coe_degreeOne]
        simp only [map_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        rw [T_add]; ring
      · rintro x y ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ ⟨w, hw, hwy⟩
        exact ⟨z + w, Padd _ _ hz hw, by rw [AddMemClass.coe_add, hzx, hwy, map_add, add_mul]⟩
  have hneg : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : A), ∃ z, P z ∧
      (z : A[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C b * T (-(m : ℤ)) := by
    intro m b
    refine ⟨algebraMap A _ b * parameter A I ^ m, Pmul _ _ (Palg b) (Ppow m), ?_⟩
    rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, coe_parameter, T_pow]
    simp [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
  have hall : ∀ f : extendedRees A I, P f := by
    intro f
    suffices h : ∃ z, P z ∧ (z : A[T;T⁻¹]) = (f : A[T;T⁻¹]) by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzf⟩ := h
      rwa [← Subtype.ext hzf]
    rw [eq_sum_support A (f : A[T;T⁻¹])]
    refine Finset.sum_induction _ (fun g => ∃ z, P z ∧ (z : A[T;T⁻¹]) = g) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro g h ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z + w, Padd _ _ hz hw, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨0, Pzero, rfl⟩
    · intro n _
      rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
      · obtain ⟨z, hz, e⟩ := hmono n.toNat _ (coeff_mem_of_mem A I f.2 n)
        exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [e, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn]⟩
      · obtain ⟨z, hz, e⟩ := hneg (-n).toNat ((f : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n)
        exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [e]; congr 2; omega⟩
  ext w
  obtain ⟨w', hw', hu⟩ := hall (uChartHom I w)
  have := uChartHom_injective I hu
  subst this
  exact hw'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.chart_step
statement:
theorem chart_step {𝒜 : ℕ → σ₁} {ℬ : ℕ → σ₂} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (s : R₁) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (t : R₂) (ht : t ∈ ℬ 1) (e : f s = t) :
    ∃ τ : Away 𝒜 s →+* Away ℬ t,
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R₁) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (n • 1)),
        τ (Away.mk 𝒜 hs n a ha) = Away.mk ℬ ht n (f a) (by simpa using f.2 ha)) ∧
      Proj.awayι ℬ t ht one_pos ≫ Proj.map f hf =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ) ≫ Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs one_pos
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  exact ⟨Away.map f s, fun n a ha => Away.map_mk f s hs n a ha,
    Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf one_pos s hs⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.rankOne_inv
statement:
theorem rankOne_inv :
    ∃ E : Away (symGrading Q Q) (symGen Q) →+* Q,
      inv (rankOneToSpec Q) = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E) ≫
        Proj.awayι (symGrading Q Q) (symGen Q) (symGen_mem Q) one_pos ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : SymmetricAlgebra Q Q) (hb : b ∈ symGrading Q Q (n • 1)),
        E (Away.mk (symGrading Q Q) (symGen_mem Q) n b hb) = symEval Q b
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Function.Bijective (rankOneHom (symGen Q)) := rankOneHom_bijective
  let E : Away (symGrading Q Q) (symGen Q) ≃+* Q := (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).symm
  refine ⟨E.toRingHom, ?_, fun n b hb' => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := awayι_comp_rankOneToSpec (symGen Q) (symGen_mem Q)
    apply (cancel_mono (rankOneToSpec Q)).mp
    rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.assoc, h1, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
    congr 1
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro q
    exact ((RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).symm_apply_apply q).symm
  · have := rankOneHom_mk (symGen Q) (symGen_mem Q) n b (by simpa using hb') rfl
    change (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).symm _ = _
    rw [show Away.mk (symGrading Q Q) (symGen_mem Q) n b hb' =
      rankOneHom (symGen Q) (symEval Q b) from this.symm]
    exact (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).symm_apply_apply _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.iota_mem
statement:
theorem iota_mem :
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1) ∈
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) 1
proof:
:= by
  change _ ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) :
    (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) →ₗ[A ⧸ I] _) ^ 1
  rw [pow_one]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.sndGraded_iota
statement:
theorem sndGraded_iota :
    sndGraded I (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1)) =
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen (A ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  change symmetricSemilinearMap (RingHom.id (A ⧸ I))
    (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I)) _ = _
  rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.nb_inverse_X
statement:
theorem nb_inverse_X :
    normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x (Polynomial.X) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1)
proof:
:= by
