name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.cmp_inverse_variable
statement:
theorem cmp_inverse_variable :
    InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse I (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr I) =
      Polynomial.X
proof: := CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_symm_variable I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.sndGraded_irrelevant
statement:
theorem sndGraded_irrelevant :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (A ⧸ I)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I)
        (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))).map (sndGraded I) :=
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  nativeSemilinear_irrelevant (RingHom.id (A ⧸ I))
      (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I))
      (span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.localSection_eq
statement:
theorem localSection_eq :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    localSection (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I))
        (span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩) =
      inv (rankOneToSpec (A ⧸ I)) ≫ Proj.map (sndGraded I) (sndGraded_irrelevant I x) :=
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  congrArg (fun m => inv (rankOneToSpec (A ⧸ I)) ≫ m)
    (semilinearProjMap_eq_native (RingHom.id (A ⧸ I))
      (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I))
      (span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.step2
statement:
theorem step2 :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    ∀ h3, ∃ τ : Away (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) Polynomial.X →+*
        Away (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I))
        (ha : a ∈ InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I (n • 1)),
        τ (Away.mk (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I)
            (InfinityNormalConeProj.variable_mem_totalGrade_one I) n a ha) =
          Away.mk (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
            (iota_mem I) n (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x a)
            (by simpa using (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x).2 ha)) ∧
      Proj.awayι (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1)) (iota_mem I) one_pos ≫
        Proj.map (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x) h3 =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ) ≫
          Proj.awayι (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) Polynomial.X
            (InfinityNormalConeProj.variable_mem_totalGrade_one I) one_pos := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  intro h3
  exact chart_step (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x) h3 _
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.variable_mem_totalGrade_one I) _ (iota_mem I) (nb_inverse_X I x)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.step1
statement:
theorem step1 :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    ∃ τ : Away (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1)) →+*
        Away (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (A ⧸ I))
          (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen (A ⧸ I)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : SymmetricAlgebra (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
        (ha : a ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (n • 1)),
        τ (Away.mk (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
            (iota_mem I) n a ha) =
          Away.mk (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (A ⧸ I))
            (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen_mem _) n (sndGraded I a)
            (by simpa using (sndGraded I).2 ha)) ∧
      Proj.awayι (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (A ⧸ I))
          (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen (A ⧸ I)) (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen_mem _) one_pos ≫
        Proj.map (sndGraded I) (sndGraded_irrelevant I x) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ) ≫
          Proj.awayι (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
            (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)) (0, 1)) (iota_mem I) one_pos := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  exact chart_step (sndGraded I) (sndGraded_irrelevant I x) _ (iota_mem I)
    _ (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen_mem _) (sndGraded_iota I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.step4
statement:
theorem step4 :
    ∃ τ : Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) →+*
        Away (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr I),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (ha : a ∈ grade (centreIdeal I) (n • 1)),
        τ (Away.mk (grade (centreIdeal I))
            (generator_mem_grade_one (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) n a ha) =
          Away.mk (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
            (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr_degree_one I) n (grMk (centreIdeal I) a)
            (by simpa using (grMk (centreIdeal I)).2 ha)) ∧
      Proj.awayι (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr I)
          (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr_degree_one I) one_pos ≫
        ReesBlowup.grMap (centreIdeal I) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ) ≫ chartMap (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)
proof:
:=
  chart_step (grMk (centreIdeal I)) (irrelevant_le_map_grMk (centreIdeal I)) _
    (generator_mem_grade_one (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) _
    (InfinityNormalCone.variableGr_degree_one I) rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.chain_chart
statement:
theorem chain_chart :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    ∃ ρ : Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) →+* (A ⧸ I),
      localSection (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I))
          (span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩) ≫
        (normalBundleProjIso I x).inv ≫
        (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).inv ≫ ReesBlowup.grMap (centreIdeal I) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ) ≫ chartMap (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I))
        (ha : a ∈ grade (centreIdeal I) (n • 1)),
        ρ (Away.mk (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator_mem_grade_one (centreIdeal I) (uGen I))
          n a ha) = SchemeProjectiveBundle.symEval (A ⧸ I) (theta I x a) := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  obtain ⟨h3, e3⟩ : ∃ h3, (normalBundleProjIso I x).inv =
      Proj.map (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x) h3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h2, e2⟩ : ∃ h2, (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).inv =
      Proj.map (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse I) h2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEmk⟩ := rankOne_inv (Q := A ⧸ I)
  obtain ⟨τ1, hτ1, c1⟩ := step1 I x
  obtain ⟨τ2, hτ2, c2⟩ := step2 I x h3
  obtain ⟨τ3, hτ3, c3⟩ := step3 I h2
  obtain ⟨τ4, hτ4, c4⟩ := step4 I
  refine ⟨E.comp (τ1.comp (τ2.comp (τ3.comp τ4))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [localSection_eq I x, hE, e3, e2]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% c1, reassoc_of% c2, reassoc_of% c3, c4]
    simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  · intro n a ha
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [hτ4, hτ3, hτ2, hτ1, hEmk]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.coeff_zero_φ
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_φ (p : A[X]) :
    ((φ I p : extendedRees A I) : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0 = p.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((φ I p : extendedRees A I) : A[T;T⁻¹]) = invert (Polynomial.toLaurent p) :=
    coe_structureMap A I p
  rw [h]
  exact (invert_apply _ 0).trans (by rw [neg_zero]; exact coeff_zero_toLaurent A p)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.coeff_zero_degreeOne
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_degreeOne (a : I) :
    ((degreeOne A I a : extendedRees A I) : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_degreeOne, ← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
    if_neg (by decide)]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.uChartHom_ratio
statement:
theorem uChartHom_ratio (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I) :
    uChartHom I (ratioElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩) =
      degreeOne A I ⟨a, ha⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine chartLift_ratioElement _ _ _ _ _ _ (degreeOne A I ⟨a, ha⟩) ?_
  change degreeOne A I ⟨a, ha⟩ * φ I Polynomial.X = φ I (Polynomial.C a)
  rw [φ_X, φ_C, mul_comm, parameter_mul_degreeOne]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionARRRG.zeroSection_affine
statement:
theorem zeroSection_affine :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    localSection (LinearMap.snd (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (A ⧸ I))
        (span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩) ≫
      (normalBundleProjIso I x).inv ≫
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).inv ≫ ReesBlowup.grMap (centreIdeal I) =
    origin (A ⧸ I) ≫ subschemeToBlowup I := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hmk⟩ := chain_chart I x
  have hG : ρ = (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A ⧸ I)).comp
      ((subschemeHom A I).comp (uChartHom I)) := by
    apply uChart_ringHom_ext
    · intro p
      have e := hmk 0 (algebraMap A[X] (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) p)
        (algebraMap_mem_grade_zero (centreIdeal I) p)
      rw [theta_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes] at e
      rw [baseRingHom_apply]
      refine e.trans ?_
      change _ = Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A ⧸ I)
        (subschemeHom A I (uChartHom I (baseElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) p)))
      rw [← baseRingHom_apply, uChartHom_baseRingHom, evalZero_subschemeHom, coeff_zero_φ]
      rfl
    · intro a ha
      have e := hmk 1 (generator (centreIdeal I) ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩)
        (by simpa using generator_mem_grade_one (centreIdeal I) ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩)
      rw [theta_generator_C I x a ha, map_zero] at e
      refine e.trans ?_
      change _ = Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A ⧸ I)
        (subschemeHom A I (uChartHom I (ratioElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)
          ⟨Polynomial.C a, C_mem_centreIdeal I ha⟩)))
      rw [uChartHom_ratio I a ha, evalZero_subschemeHom, coeff_zero_degreeOne, map_zero]
  rw [hρ, hG]
  simp only [subschemeToBlowup, uChartι, uChartIso_hom, origin, subschemeι,
    ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.allTarget_comp_of_eq
statement:
theorem allTarget_comp_of_eq (g₃ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (e : g'.comp g = g₃)
    (hg₃ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map g₃)
    (eP : Proj.map g' hg' ≫ Proj.map g hg = Proj.map g₃ hg₃) (d : ℤ)
    (h : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)))
    (h' : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i)) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 g₃ hg₃ f d h =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eP.symm).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
          (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d h) ≫
        nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d h'
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have key := nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hg₃ f d h h'
  have e2 : eP = InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCube.projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hg₃ := rfl
  rw [e2]
  exact key

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.nativeKernelRestrictionMate_eq_allTarget
statement:
theorem nativeKernelRestrictionMate_eq_allTarget {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J h d =
      nativeAllTargetPullbackHom (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal U))
        (nativeGradedRestriction Y J h) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J h)
        (fun x => x) d (affineNativeGenerator_covers Y J V)
proof:
:= by
  native_cache_exact (nativeKernelRestrictionMateNormalization Y J h d)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.nativeKernelRestrictionMate_comp
statement:
theorem nativeKernelRestrictionMate_comp {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (k : V ≤ W) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J (h.trans k) d =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (nativeRestriction_scheme_comp Y J h k).symm).hom.app
          (affineNativeKernel Y J d W) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
          (boundaryRestriction Y J k)).inv.app (affineNativeKernel Y J d W) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (boundaryRestriction Y J h)).map
          (nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J k d) ≫
        nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J h d
proof:
:= by
  have key := allTarget_comp_of_eq (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal W))
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal U))
    (nativeGradedRestriction Y J k) (nativeGradedRestriction Y J h)
    (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J k) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J h)
    (fun x => x) (nativeGradedRestriction Y J (h.trans k)) (nativeRestriction_coeff_comp Y J h k)
    (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J (h.trans k))
    (nativeRestriction_scheme_comp Y J h k) d (affineNativeGenerator_covers Y J W)
    (affineNativeGenerator_covers Y J V)
  rw [nativeKernelRestrictionMate_eq_allTarget Y J (h.trans k) d,
    nativeKernelRestrictionMate_eq_allTarget Y J k d,
    nativeKernelRestrictionMate_eq_allTarget Y J h d]
  exact key

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.nativeGlobalProjection_compatible'
statement:
theorem nativeGlobalProjection_compatible' {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (hU : W ≤ U) (hV : W ≤ V) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeGlobalProjection Y J d U ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J hU d =
      nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J hV d
proof:
:= by
  have := nativeGlobalProjection_compatible Y J d (NativeRefinement.mk U V W hU hV)
  with_reducible exact this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.nativeGlobalProjection_restriction
statement:
theorem nativeGlobalProjection_restriction {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J h d =
      nativeGlobalProjection Y J d U
proof:
:= by
  have hc := nativeGlobalProjection_compatible' Y J h (le_refl U) d
  simp only [pushedNativeRestriction_refl, Category.comp_id] at hc
  exact hc

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.pushforwardComp_hom_eq_inv
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_hom_eq_inv {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app M = (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).inv.app M
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  ext s
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.cancel_hom_inv
statement:
theorem cancel_hom_inv {C : Type*} [Category C] {K A B : C} (a : K ⟶ A) (e : A ≅ B) :
    (a ≫ e.hom) ≫ e.inv = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.nativeGlobalChartHom_restriction
statement:
theorem nativeGlobalChartHom_restriction {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (d : ℤ) :
    nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d U =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (boundaryRestriction_affineι Y J h).symm).hom.app
          (nativeGlobalKernel Y J d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
          (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).inv.app (nativeGlobalKernel Y J d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (boundaryRestriction Y J h)).map (nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d V) ≫
        nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J h d
proof:
:= by
  have s1 := iteratedComponentMate
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (boundaryRestriction Y J h))
    (nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V) (nativeKernelRestriction Y J h d)
  have s2 := compositeComponentMate (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V) (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
    (M := nativeGlobalKernel Y J d) (N := affineNativeKernel Y J d U)
    ((nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).map
          (nativeKernelRestriction Y J h d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
        (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).hom.app (affineNativeKernel Y J d U))
  have s3 := equalityComponentMate (boundaryRestriction_affineι Y J h).symm
    (M := nativeGlobalKernel Y J d) (N := affineNativeKernel Y J d U)
    ((nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).map
          (nativeKernelRestriction Y J h d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
        (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).hom.app (affineNativeKernel Y J d U))
  have hcan : ((nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).map
          (nativeKernelRestriction Y J h d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
        (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).hom.app (affineNativeKernel Y J d U)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
        (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).inv.app (affineNativeKernel Y J d U) =
      nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).map
          (nativeKernelRestriction Y J h d) := by
    exact cancel_hom_inv _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
      (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).app (affineNativeKernel Y J d U))
  have hcc : ((nativeGlobalProjection Y J d V ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).map
          (nativeKernelRestriction Y J h d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
        (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).hom.app (affineNativeKernel Y J d U)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (boundaryRestriction_affineι Y J h)).hom.app
        (affineNativeKernel Y J d U) =
      nativeGlobalProjection Y J d U := by
    rw [← nativeGlobalProjection_restriction Y J h d]
    unfold pushedNativeRestriction
    rw [pushforwardComp_hom_eq_inv]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rfl
  rw [hcan] at s2
  rw [hcc] at s3
  have E := s1.symm.trans s2
  unfold nativeGlobalChartHom nativeKernelRestrictionMate
  erw [E]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  exact s3

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistChartRecoveryB5.nativeGlobalChartHom_isIso_of_le
statement:
theorem nativeGlobalChartHom_isIso_of_le {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (d : ℤ)
    [IsIso (nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d V)] : IsIso (nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nativeGlobalChartHom_restriction Y J h d]
  haveI h1 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (boundaryRestriction_affineι Y J h).symm).hom.app
      (nativeGlobalKernel Y J d)) := inferInstance
  haveI h2 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (boundaryRestriction Y J h)
      (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)).inv.app (nativeGlobalKernel Y J d)) := inferInstance
  haveI h3 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (boundaryRestriction Y J h)).map
      (nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d V)) := inferInstance
  haveI h4 : IsIso (nativeKernelRestrictionMate Y J h d) := inferInstance
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso' h1 (IsIso.comp_isIso' h2 (IsIso.comp_isIso' h3 h4))

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.eval_mem_span_pow
statement:
theorem eval_mem_span_pow (x : ι → R) {d : ℕ} {F : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hF : F.IsHomogeneous d) : MvPolynomial.eval x F ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range x)) ^ d
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous x _).2 ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.eval_mem_mul_span_pow
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : MvPolynomial.eval x F =
      ∑ α ∈ F.support, MvPolynomial.eval x (monomial α (F.coeff α)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [F.as_sum]
    rw [map_sum]
  rw [hsum]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun α hα => ?_
  have hdeg : α.degree = d := by
    by_contra h
    exact (mem_support_iff.mp hα) (hF.coeff_eq_zero h)
  have hmon : MvPolynomial.eval x (monomial α (1 : R)) ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range x)) ^ d :=
    eval_mem_span_pow x (isHomogeneous_monomial _ hdeg)
  rw [eval_monomial, one_mul] at hmon
  rw [eval_monomial]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hc α) hmon

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.coeff_mul_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_mem (K : Ideal R) (p q : MvPolynomial ι R)
    (hq : ∀ α, q.coeff α ∈ K) (β) : (p * q).coeff β ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_mul]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun _ _ => K.mul_mem_left _ (hq _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.coeff_rename_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_rename_mem {τ : Type*} (K : Ideal R) (e : ι → τ) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (p : MvPolynomial ι R) (hp : ∀ α, p.coeff α ∈ K) (β) : (rename e p).coeff β ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ α, Finsupp.mapDomain e α = β
  · obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [coeff_rename_mapDomain e he]
    exact hp α
  · rw [coeff_rename_eq_zero e p β (fun u hu => absurd ⟨u, hu⟩ h)]
    exact K.zero_mem

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.coeff_mem_of_isHomogeneous_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_of_isHomogeneous_zero (x : ι → R) (F : MvPolynomial ι R)
    (hF : F.IsHomogeneous 0)
    (hval : MvPolynomial.eval x F ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (α) :
    F.coeff α ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hC : F = C (F.coeff 0) :=
    (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C).1
      (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_zero_iff_isHomogeneous (σ := ι) |>.2 hF)
  have hv : F.coeff 0 ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x) := by
    rw [hC] at hval
    simpa using hval
  rcases eq_or_ne α 0 with rfl | hα
  · exact hv
  · rw [hC, coeff_C, if_neg (Ne.symm hα)]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isQuasiregular_of_isEmpty
statement: theorem isQuasiregular_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty ι] (x : ι → R) : IsQuasiregular x
proof:
:= by
  intro d F hF hval α
  rcases eq_or_ne F 0 with rfl | hFne
  · simp
  · have hd : d = 0 := hF.inj_right (by rw [F.eq_C_of_isEmpty]; exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C _ _) hFne
    subst hd
    exact coeff_mem_of_isHomogeneous_zero x F hF (by simpa using hval) α

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular.comp_equiv
statement:
theorem IsQuasiregular.comp_equiv {κ : Type*} {x : ι → R} (h : IsQuasiregular x) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    IsQuasiregular (x ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range (x ∘ e) = Set.range x := by
    rw [Set.range_comp, e.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]
  intro d F hF hval α
  rw [hrange]
  have hF' : (rename (e : κ → ι) F).IsHomogeneous d := hF.rename_isHomogeneous
  have hval' : MvPolynomial.eval x (rename (e : κ → ι) F) ∈
      (Ideal.span (Set.range x)) ^ (d + 1) := by
    rw [eval_rename]
    rw [hrange] at hval
    exact hval
  have := h d _ hF' hval' (Finsupp.mapDomain (e : κ → ι) α)
  rwa [coeff_rename_mapDomain _ e.injective] at this

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isHomogeneous_iff_degree
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_iff_degree {F : MvPolynomial ι R} {n : ℕ} :
    F.IsHomogeneous n ↔ ∀ β, F.coeff β ≠ 0 → β.degree = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h β hβ
    by_contra hd
    exact hβ (h.coeff_eq_zero hd)
  · intro h β hβ
    rw [Pi.one_def, ← Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact h β hβ

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.pow_le_pow_of_le
statement: theorem pow_le_pow_of_le {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) (n : ℕ) : I ^ n ≤ J ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact Ideal.mul_mono ih h

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.optionEquivLeft_symm_C
statement:
theorem optionEquivLeft_symm_C (q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (optionEquivLeft R σ).symm (Polynomial.C q) = rename some q
proof:
:= by
  simp [optionEquivLeft]

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.exists_split_of_isHomogeneous_succ
statement:
theorem exists_split_of_isHomogeneous_succ [Finite σ] {d : ℕ}
    {F : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R} (hF : F.IsHomogeneous (d + 1)) :
    ∃ (F₀ : MvPolynomial σ R) (G : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R),
      F = rename some F₀ + X none * G ∧ F₀.IsHomogeneous (d + 1) ∧ G.IsHomogeneous d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set p := optionEquivLeft R σ F with hp
  set F₀ : MvPolynomial σ R := p.coeff 0 with hF₀
  set G : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R := (optionEquivLeft R σ).symm p.divX with hG
  have hsymm : (optionEquivLeft R σ).symm p = F := by rw [hp, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hsplit : F = rename some F₀ + X none * G := by
    have h1 : (optionEquivLeft R σ).symm (Polynomial.X * p.divX + Polynomial.C F₀) = F := by
      rw [hF₀, Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add, hsymm]
    rw [← h1, map_add, map_mul, optionEquivLeft_symm_X, optionEquivLeft_symm_C, hG]
    ring
  have hhom0 : F₀.IsHomogeneous (d + 1) :=
    MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.coeff_isHomogeneous_of_optionEquivLeft_symm
      (p := p) (by rw [hsymm]; exact hF) 0 (d + 1) (by ring)
  have hXG : (X none * G : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R).IsHomogeneous (d + 1) := by
    have hsub : (X none * G : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) = F - rename some F₀ := by
      rw [hsplit]; ring
    rw [hsub]
    exact hF.sub hhom0.rename_isHomogeneous
  have hhomG : G.IsHomogeneous d := by
    rw [isHomogeneous_iff_degree]
    intro β hβ
    have hne : (X none * G : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R).coeff
        (Finsupp.single none 1 + β) ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [coeff_X_mul]
    have hdeg := (isHomogeneous_iff_degree.1 hXG) _ hne
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at hdeg
    omega
  exact ⟨F₀, G, hsplit, hhom0, hhomG⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.IsQuasiregular.option
statement:
theorem IsQuasiregular.option [Finite σ] {x' : σ → R} (hx' : IsQuasiregular x') (f : R)
    (hf : ∀ a : R, f * a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x') → a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x')) :
    IsQuasiregular (fun o : Option σ => o.elim f x')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set x : Option σ → R := fun o => o.elim f x' with hxdef
  set J : Ideal R := Ideal.span (Set.range x') with hJdef
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span (Set.range x) with hIdef
  have hrange : Set.range x = insert f (Set.range x') := by
    ext r
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨o, rfl⟩
      cases o with
      | none => exact Set.mem_insert _ _
      | some i => exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rintro (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨none, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨some i, rfl⟩
  have hI : I = Ideal.span {f} ⊔ J := by rw [hIdef, hrange, Ideal.span_insert]
  have hJI : J ≤ I := by rw [hI]; exact le_sup_right
  have hfI : f ∈ I := by
    rw [hI]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  
  have L1 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : R), f * a ∈ J ^ m → a ∈ J ^ m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro a _; simp
    | succ m ih =>
      intro a ha
      have ha' : a ∈ J ^ m := ih a (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ m) ha)
      obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ :=
        (Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous (n := m) x' a).1 ha'
      have hvalCA : MvPolynomial.eval x' (C f * A) ∈ J ^ (m + 1) := by
        rw [map_mul, eval_C]
        exact ha
      have hcoeff : ∀ α, (C f * A).coeff α ∈ J := hx' m _ (hA.C_mul f) hvalCA
      have hAcoeff : ∀ α, A.coeff α ∈ J := by
        intro α
        refine hf _ ?_
        have hα := hcoeff α
        rwa [coeff_C_mul] at hα
      have hfin := eval_mem_mul_span_pow x' J hA hAcoeff
      rwa [← pow_succ'] at hfin
  
  have L2 : ∀ e : ℕ, I ^ (e + 1) ≤ J ^ (e + 1) ⊔ Ideal.span {f} * I ^ e := by
    intro e
    induction e with
    | zero =>
      have e1 : I ^ (0 + 1) = Ideal.span {f} ⊔ J := by
        simp only [zero_add, pow_one]
        exact hI
      have e2 : J ^ (0 + 1) ⊔ Ideal.span {f} * I ^ 0 = J ⊔ Ideal.span {f} := by simp
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact sup_le le_sup_right le_sup_left
    | succ e ih =>
      rw [pow_succ' I (e + 1)]
      refine le_trans (Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl ih) ?_
      rw [Ideal.mul_sup]
      refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · conv_lhs => rw [hI]
        rw [Ideal.sup_mul]
        refine sup_le ?_ ?_
        · exact le_sup_of_le_right (Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl (pow_le_pow_of_le hJI _))
        · refine le_sup_of_le_left ?_
          rw [← pow_succ']
      · refine le_sup_of_le_right ?_
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm I (Ideal.span {f}), mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
  
  have L3 : ∀ (d : ℕ) (a : R), f * a ∈ I ^ (d + 1) → a ∈ I ^ d := by
    intro d a ha
    obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (L2 d ha)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.1 hw
    have key : f * (a - v) = u := by linear_combination -huw
    have h1 : a - v ∈ J ^ (d + 1) := L1 _ _ (by rw [key]; exact hu)
    have hav : a = a - v + v := by ring
    rw [hav]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ d) (pow_le_pow_of_le hJI _ h1)) hv
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro F hF hval α
    exact coeff_mem_of_isHomogeneous_zero x F hF (by simpa using hval) α
  | succ d ih =>
    intro F hF hval α
    obtain ⟨F₀, G, hsplit, hhom0, hhomG⟩ := exists_split_of_isHomogeneous_succ hF
    have hxsome : x ∘ (some : σ → Option σ) = x' := rfl
    have hevalsplit : MvPolynomial.eval x F
        = MvPolynomial.eval x' F₀ + f * MvPolynomial.eval x G := by
      rw [hsplit, map_add, eval_rename, hxsome, map_mul, eval_X]
      rfl
    have hF0val : MvPolynomial.eval x' F₀ ∈ J ^ (d + 1) := eval_mem_span_pow x' hhom0
    obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (L2 (d + 1) hval)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.1 hw
    rw [hevalsplit] at huw
    have h4 : f * (v - MvPolynomial.eval x G) ∈ J ^ (d + 1) := by
      have heq : f * (v - MvPolynomial.eval x G) = MvPolynomial.eval x' F₀ - u := by
        linear_combination huw
      rw [heq]
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _ hF0val (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ _) hu)
    have h5 : v - MvPolynomial.eval x G ∈ J ^ (d + 1) := L1 _ _ h4
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hWval⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous (n := d + 1) x' _).1 h5
    have h6 : ∀ β, (F₀ - C f * W).coeff β ∈ J := by
      refine hx' (d + 1) _ (hhom0.sub (hW.C_mul f)) ?_
      have hev : MvPolynomial.eval x' (F₀ - C f * W) = u := by
        rw [map_sub, map_mul, eval_C, hWval]
        linear_combination -huw
      rw [hev]
      exact hu
    have h7 : ∀ β, F₀.coeff β ∈ I := by
      intro β
      have hexp : F₀.coeff β = (F₀ - C f * W).coeff β + f * W.coeff β := by
        rw [coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul]; ring
      rw [hexp]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (hJI (h6 β)) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hfI)
    have h8 : MvPolynomial.eval x' F₀ ∈ I ^ (d + 1 + 1) := by
      have h := eval_mem_mul_span_pow x' I hhom0 h7
      have hle : I * J ^ (d + 1) ≤ I ^ (d + 1 + 1) := by
        calc I * J ^ (d + 1) ≤ I * I ^ (d + 1) :=
              Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl (pow_le_pow_of_le hJI _)
          _ = I ^ (d + 1 + 1) := (pow_succ' I (d + 1)).symm
      exact hle h
    have h9 : f * MvPolynomial.eval x G ∈ I ^ (d + 1 + 1) := by
      have hfg : f * MvPolynomial.eval x G
          = MvPolynomial.eval x F - MvPolynomial.eval x' F₀ := by
        rw [hevalsplit]; ring
      rw [hfg]
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _ hval h8
    have h10 : MvPolynomial.eval x G ∈ I ^ (d + 1) := L3 (d + 1) _ h9
    have h11 : ∀ β, G.coeff β ∈ I := ih G hhomG h10
    rw [hsplit, coeff_add]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (coeff_rename_mem I some (Option.some_injective σ) F₀ h7 α)
      (coeff_mul_mem I _ G h11 α)

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ofList_ofFn
statement:
theorem ofList_ofFn {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → R) :
    Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn x) = Ideal.span (Set.range x)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {r : R | r ∈ List.ofFn x} = Set.range x := by
    ext r; simp
  exact congrArg Ideal.span hset

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isQuasiregular_of_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem isQuasiregular_of_isWeaklyRegular :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → R), IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn x) → IsQuasiregular x
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro x _; exact isQuasiregular_of_isEmpty x
  | succ n ih =>
    intro x hx
    set x' : Fin n → R := fun i => x i.castSucc with hx'def
    set f : R := x (Fin.last n) with hfdef
    have hlist : List.ofFn x = List.ofFn x' ++ [f] := by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ']
      simp only [List.concat_eq_append]
      exact congrArg (· ++ [f]) (congrArg List.ofFn hx'def.symm)
    rw [hlist, isWeaklyRegular_append_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
    have hQ : IsQuasiregular x' := ih x' hx1
    have hJ : (Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn x') • ⊤ : Submodule R R)
        = Ideal.span (Set.range x') := by
      rw [ofList_ofFn, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
    rw [isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff] at hx2
    have hfreg : ∀ a : R, f * a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x') →
        a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x') := by
      intro a ha
      have hz : f • (Submodule.Quotient.mk a :
          R ⧸ (Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn x') • ⊤ : Submodule R R)) = f • 0 := by
        rw [smul_zero, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hJ]
        exact ha
      have h0 := hx2 hz
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hJ] at h0
      exact h0
    have hopt : IsQuasiregular (fun o : Option (Fin n) => o.elim f x') := hQ.option f hfreg
    have hcomp : (fun o : Option (Fin n) => o.elim f x') ∘
        (finSuccEquivLast : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Option (Fin n)) = x := by
      funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
      · simpa using hfdef
      · intro j; simpa using congrFun hx'def j
    have hfin := hopt.comp_equiv (finSuccEquivLast : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Option (Fin n))
    rwa [hcomp] at hfin

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.chart_exceptional_mem
statement:
theorem chart_exceptional_mem (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    baseElement (centreIdeal I) r r.1 ∈ RingHom.ker (chartGrMap (centreIdeal I) r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  exact chartGrMap_baseElement (centreIdeal I) r r.2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.chart_other_mem
statement:
theorem chart_other_mem (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    ratioElement (centreIdeal I) r (uGen I) ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationChartMap I r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, evaluationChartMap, ratioElement, Away.map_mk]
  apply val_injective
  rw [Away.val_mk, val_zero]
  have h0 : (gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
      (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) = 0 := by
    change reesMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
      (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) = 0
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [generator, uGen]
  rw [h0]
  first
  | exact Localization.mk_zero (M := Submonoid.powers ((gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I)
      (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I))
      (generator (centreIdeal I) r))) _
  | (rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk']; exact IsLocalization.mk'_zero _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.ideal_comap_mul_of_bijective
statement:
theorem ideal_comap_mul_of_bijective {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f) (I J : Ideal S) :
    (I * J).comap f = I.comap f * J.comap f
proof:
:= by
  let e := RingEquiv.ofBijective f hf
  have h : ∀ K : Ideal S, K.comap f = K.map e.symm := fun K => (Ideal.map_symm e).symm
  rw [h, h, h, Ideal.map_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.spec_ideal_le_mul
statement:
theorem spec_ideal_le_mul {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : R →+* T) (K : Ideal R) (hK : K ≤ RingHom.ker f * RingHom.ker g) :
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (K.comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom) ≤
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).ker * (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_of_isAffine
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, Scheme.ker_of_isAffine]
  simp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal, homOfLE_refl, Pi.mul_apply]
  have hmap : ∀ I : Ideal Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤),
      Ideal.map (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map (𝟙 (Opposite.op ⊤)))) I = I := by
    intro I
    have hid : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).presheaf.map
        (𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens))) = 𝟙 _ :=
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _
    rw [hid]
    exact Ideal.map_id I
  erw [hmap, hmap, hmap]
  rw [spec_map_appTop_kernel, spec_map_appTop_kernel,
    ← ideal_comap_mul_of_bijective _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom)]
  exact Ideal.comap_mono hK

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.IdealSheaf_mul_le_inf
statement: theorem IdealSheaf_mul_le_inf {X : Scheme.{u}} (K L : X.IdealSheafData) : K * L ≤ K ⊓ L
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  exact Ideal.mul_le_inf

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.comap_mul_of_openImmersion
statement:
theorem comap_mul_of_openImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (K L : Y.IdealSheafData) : (K * L).comap f = K.comap f * L.comap f
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext
  funext U
  simp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion,
    Pi.mul_apply]
  exact ideal_comap_mul_of_bijective _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (f.appIso U.1).inv) _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.chart_branch_product
statement:
theorem chart_branch_product (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (evaluationChartMap I r))).ker *
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartGrMap (centreIdeal I) r))).ker =
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X}).comap
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
          (Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r)))).hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (IdealSheaf_mul_le_inf _ _).trans ?_
    rw [actual_standard_chart_sheaf_intersection]
  · apply spec_ideal_le_mul
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    have hx : baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X =
        ratioElement (centreIdeal I) r (uGen I) * baseElement (centreIdeal I) r r.1 := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact (baseElement_mul_ratioElement (centreIdeal I) r (uGen I)).symm
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hx]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (chart_other_mem I r) (chart_exceptional_mem I r)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityARRM4.affine_branch_product
statement:
theorem affine_branch_product (I : Ideal A) :
    (affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker * (exceptionalι (centreIdeal I)).ker =
      (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply ideal_eq_of_affineCover_comap (generatorAffineOpenCover (centreIdeal I))
  intro r
  change ((affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker * (exceptionalι (centreIdeal I)).ker).comap
    (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) = (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).ker.comap
      (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r)
  rw [comap_mul_of_openImmersion, original_other_chart_kernel, original_exceptional_chart_kernel,
    chart_branch_product, original_zero_fibre_chart_kernel]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isReduced_homogeneousLocalization
statement:
theorem isReduced_homogeneousLocalization [_root_.IsReduced A] (f : A) :
    _root_.IsReduced (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x ⟨n, hn⟩ => ?_⟩
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  have h : (x.val) ^ n = 0 := by
    rw [← HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow, hn, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
  exact IsNilpotent.eq_zero ⟨n, h⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isReduced_proj
statement: theorem isReduced_proj [_root_.IsReduced A] : IsReduced (Proj 𝒜)

:= by

    rw [Scheme.AffineOpenCover.openCover_X, affine_isReduced_iff]
    exact isReduced_homogeneousLocalization 𝒜 (i.2 : A)
  exact IsReduced.of_openCover (Proj 𝒜) (Proj.affineOpenCover 𝒜).openCover

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.irreducibleSpace_proj
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_proj [IsDomain A]
    (h : ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : A), f ∈ 𝒜 m ∧ 0 < m ∧ f ≠ 0) :
    IrreducibleSpace (Proj 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  let ξ : ProjectiveSpectrum 𝒜 :=
    { asHomogeneousIdeal := ⊥
      isPrime := by simpa using Ideal.isPrime_bot
      not_irrelevant_le := by
        obtain ⟨m, f, hf, hm, hf0⟩ := h
        intro hle
        have : f ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜) :=
          HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem 𝒜 hm hf
        have h0 := hle this
        have h1 : f ∈ (⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜).toIdeal := h0
        rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_bot, Ideal.mem_bot] at h1
        exact hf0 h1 }
  have hξ : closure ({ξ} : Set (Proj 𝒜)) = Set.univ := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact (ProjectiveSpectrum.le_iff_mem_closure 𝒜 ξ y).mp
      ((ProjectiveSpectrum.as_ideal_le_as_ideal 𝒜 ξ y).mp bot_le)
  rw [irreducibleSpace_def]
  show IsIrreducible (Set.univ : Set (Proj 𝒜))
  rw [← hξ]
  exact (isIrreducible_singleton (x := ξ)).closure

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_proj
statement:
theorem isIntegral_proj [IsDomain A] (h : ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : A), f ∈ 𝒜 m ∧ 0 < m ∧ f ≠ 0) :
    IsIntegral (Proj 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := irreducibleSpace_proj 𝒜 h
  haveI := isReduced_proj 𝒜 (A := A)
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_reesScheme
statement:
theorem isIntegral_reesScheme [IsDomain R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    IsIntegral (ReesBlowup.scheme I)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_proj (grade I) ?_
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
  refine ⟨1, generator I ⟨r, hr⟩, generator_mem_grade_one I ⟨r, hr⟩, one_pos, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun z : reesAlgebra I => ((z : R[X])).coeff 1) h
  simp [generator] at this
  exact hr0 this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_of_isOpenCover
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_isOpenCover {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (V : ι → X.Opens)
    (hcov : IsOpenCover V) (hint : ∀ i, IsIntegral (V i))
    (hn : ∀ i j, ¬ Disjoint (V i) (V j)) : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsReduced X := by
    haveI : ∀ i, IsReduced ((X.openCoverOfIsOpenCover V hcov).X i) := fun i => by
      change IsReduced (V i)
      infer_instance
    exact IsReduced.of_openCover X (X.openCoverOfIsOpenCover V hcov)
  haveI : PreirreducibleSpace X := by
    refine PreirreducibleSpace.of_isOpenCover (U := V) (fun i j _ => hn i j) hcov fun i => ?_
    haveI := hint i
    exact (inferInstance : PreirreducibleSpace (V i))
  haveI : Nonempty X := by
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
    haveI := (hint i).nonempty
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (V i))
    exact ⟨x.1⟩
  haveI : IrreducibleSpace X := { toPreirreducibleSpace := inferInstance, toNonempty := inferInstance }
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced X

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_of_cartesianCover
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_cartesianCover {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral T] (p : X ⟶ T)
    {ι : Type*} (B C : ι → Scheme.{u}) (b : ∀ i, B i ⟶ T) (hb : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (b i))
    (c : ∀ i, C i ⟶ X) (hc : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (c i)) (g : ∀ i, C i ⟶ B i)
    (hpb : ∀ i, IsPullback (g i) (c i) (b i) p)
    (hcover : ⨆ i, (c i).opensRange = ⊤)
    (hbasis : ∀ i j (t : T), t ∈ (b i).opensRange → t ∈ (b j).opensRange →
      ∃ k, t ∈ (b k).opensRange ∧ (b k).opensRange ≤ (b i).opensRange ⊓ (b j).opensRange)
    (hne : ∃ i, Nonempty (B i))
    (hint : ∀ i, Nonempty (B i) → IsIntegral (C i)) : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hb
  haveI := hc
  have hrange : ∀ i, (c i).opensRange = p ⁻¹ᵁ (b i).opensRange := fun i =>
    GlobalCompletion.opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback (hpb i)
  let ι' := {i : ι // Nonempty (B i)}
  let V : ι' → X.Opens := fun i => (c i.1).opensRange
  haveI : Nonempty ι' := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩⟩
  have hcov : IsOpenCover V := by
    refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
    have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, (c i).opensRange := by rw [hcover]; trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
    have hpx : p x ∈ (b i).opensRange := by
      have : x ∈ p ⁻¹ᵁ (b i).opensRange := by rw [← hrange]; exact hi
      exact this
    obtain ⟨y, -⟩ := hpx
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨i, ⟨y⟩⟩, hi⟩
  have hintV : ∀ i : ι', IsIntegral (V i) := fun i => by
    haveI := hint i.1 i.2
    exact IsIntegral.of_isIso (c i.1).isoOpensRange.hom
  refine isIntegral_of_isOpenCover V hcov hintV fun i j hdisj => ?_
  have hi : (V i : Set X) = p ⁻¹' ((b i.1).opensRange : Set T) := by
    simp only [V, hrange]; rfl
  have hj : (V j : Set X) = p ⁻¹' ((b j.1).opensRange : Set T) := by
    simp only [V, hrange]; rfl
  obtain ⟨t, hti, htj⟩ := nonempty_preirreducible_inter (b i.1).opensRange.isOpen
    (b j.1).opensRange.isOpen
    (by obtain ⟨y⟩ := i.2; exact ⟨b i.1 y, y, rfl⟩) (by obtain ⟨y⟩ := j.2; exact ⟨b j.1 y, y, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨k, htk, hksub⟩ := hbasis i.1 j.1 t hti htj
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := htk
  haveI : Nonempty (B k) := ⟨y⟩
  haveI := hint k ‹_›
  obtain ⟨z⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (C k))
  have hz : c k z ∈ p ⁻¹ᵁ (b k).opensRange := by
    have h0 : c k z ∈ (c k).opensRange := ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [hrange k] at h0
    exact h0
  have hzi : c k z ∈ V i := by
    have : (c k z) ∈ p ⁻¹' ((b i.1).opensRange : Set T) := hksub hz |>.1
    rw [← hi] at this; exact this
  have hzj : c k z ∈ V j := by
    have : (c k z) ∈ p ⁻¹' ((b j.1).opensRange : Set T) := hksub hz |>.2
    rw [← hj] at this; exact this
  have hbot := disjoint_iff.mp hdisj
  have : c k z ∈ (V i ⊓ V j : X.Opens) := ⟨hzi, hzj⟩
  rw [hbot] at this
  exact this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_of_affineCover
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_affineCover {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y] (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (C : Y.affineOpens → Scheme.{u}) (c : ∀ U, C U ⟶ X) [∀ U, IsOpenImmersion (c U)]
    (g : ∀ U, C U ⟶ U.1.toScheme)
    (hpb : ∀ U, IsPullback (g U) (c U) U.1.ι p)
    (hcover : ⨆ U, (c U).opensRange = ⊤)
    (hint : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 → IsIntegral (C U)) : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_of_cartesianCover p (fun U : Y.affineOpens => U.1.toScheme) C
    (fun U => U.1.ι) (fun U => inferInstance) c (fun U => inferInstance) g hpb hcover ?_ ?_ hint
  · intro U V t htU htV
    rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] at htU htV
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, htW, hWsub⟩ := Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
      (show t ∈ ((U.1 ⊓ V.1 : Y.Opens) : Set Y) from ⟨htU, htV⟩) (U.1 ⊓ V.1).isOpen
    refine ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]; exact htW
    · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
      exact hWsub
  · obtain ⟨y⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty Y)
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hyW, -⟩ := Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
      (Set.mem_univ y) isOpen_univ
    exact ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, ⟨⟨y, hyW⟩⟩⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_space
statement: theorem isIntegral_space : IsIntegral (DeformationSpace.space Y J)

    (fun U => AffineDeformationSpace.space Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U)) (DeformationSpace.affineι Y J)
    _ (fun U => DeformationSpace.isPullback_affine Y J U)
    (DeformationSpace.iSup_opensRange_affineι Y J) ?_
  intro U hU
  haveI : IsDomain Γ(Y, U.1) := IsIntegral.component_integral U.1
  change IsIntegral (Spec (.of (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U))))
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_line

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_gm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_blowupGlobal
statement: theorem isIntegral_blowupGlobal : IsIntegral (blowupGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_of_affineCover (blowupGlobalToBase Y J)
    (fun U => ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.blowup (J.ideal U)) (blowupAffineι Y J)
    (gluingApp Y J) (isPullback_blowupAffine Y J) (iSup_opensRange_blowupAffineι Y J) ?_
  intro U hU
  haveI : IsDomain Γ(Y, U.1) := IsIntegral.component_integral U.1

  intro h
  have := X_mem_centreIdeal (J.ideal U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
statement: theorem isIntegral_totalGlobal : IsIntegral (totalGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover
    (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))
  let V : WalkingSpan → (totalGlobal Y J).Opens := fun j => (𝒰.f j).opensRange
  have hcov : IsOpenCover V := by
    have := Scheme.OpenCover.iSup_opensRange 𝒰
    exact this
  have hw : ∀ (j : WalkingSpan) (h : WalkingSpan.zero ⟶ j)
      (z : ((span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)).obj WalkingSpan.zero)),
      (colimit.ι (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) j)
        (((span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)).map h) z) =
      (colimit.ι (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))
        WalkingSpan.zero) z := by
    intro j h z
    have := colimit.w (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) h
    rw [← this]
    rfl
  have hle : ∀ j, V WalkingSpan.zero ≤ V j := by
    intro j
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · exact ⟨_, hw _ (𝟙 _) z⟩
    · exact ⟨_, hw _ WalkingSpan.Hom.fst z⟩
    · exact ⟨_, hw _ WalkingSpan.Hom.snd z⟩
  refine isIntegral_of_isOpenCover V hcov ?_ ?_
  · intro j
    have hX : IsIntegral (𝒰.X j) := by
      obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
      · exact isIntegral_gm Y
      · exact isIntegral_blowupGlobal Y J
      · exact isIntegral_line Y
    exact IsIntegral.of_isIso (𝒰.f j).isoOpensRange.hom
  · intro i j hdisj
    haveI : Nonempty (𝒰.X WalkingSpan.zero) := by
      haveI := isIntegral_gm Y
      exact (inferInstance : Nonempty (DeformationSpace.gm Y))
    obtain ⟨z⟩ := this
    have hi : (𝒰.f WalkingSpan.zero) z ∈ V i := hle i ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hj : (𝒰.f WalkingSpan.zero) z ∈ V j := hle j ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hbot := disjoint_iff.mp hdisj
    have : (𝒰.f WalkingSpan.zero) z ∈ (V i ⊓ V j : (totalGlobal Y J).Opens) := ⟨hi, hj⟩
    rw [hbot] at this
    exact this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_globalBlowup
statement:
theorem isIntegral_globalBlowup

    (GlobalBlowup.gluingApp Y J) (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine' Y J)
    (GlobalBlowup.iSup_opensRange_affineι Y J) ?_
  intro U hU
  haveI : IsDomain Γ(Y, U.1) := IsIntegral.component_integral U.1
  exact isIntegral_reesScheme (J.ideal U) (hJ U hU)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionSectionsARRRG.conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso_snd
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso_snd (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso Y J U).hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
        (J.ideal U).Cotangent (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).map biprod.snd ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ tildeSelf.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  let Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)
  letI hF : F.Additive := { map_add := by intro M N f g; rfl }
  letI hP : PreservesBinaryBiproduct (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) F :=
    preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  rw [conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso_factor]
  exact @biprodRoute_snd J.subscheme.Modules (Spec (.of Q)).Modules
    (inferInstanceAs (Category J.subscheme.Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Category (Spec (.of Q)).Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Preadditive J.subscheme.Modules))
    (inferInstanceAs (Preadditive (Spec (.of Q)).Modules)) F hF
    (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) _ _ hP
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj (ModuleCat.of Q (J.ideal U).Cotangent))
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj (ModuleCat.of Q Q))
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj (ModuleCat.of Q ((J.ideal U).Cotangent × Q)))
    _ (conormalChartTildeIso Y J U)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ (@tildeSelf (.of Q)).symm)
    (tildeProductIso (ModuleCat.of Q (J.ideal U).Cotangent) (ModuleCat.of Q Q)).hom
    ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd Q (J.ideal U).Cotangent Q)))
    (tildeProductIso_hom_snd _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionSectionsARRRG.conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv_snd
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv_snd (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (m : conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U) :
    (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U m).2 =
    scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U
      ((biprod.snd : InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J ⟶ ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme).app
        (J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤) m)
proof:
:= by
  exact tildeSections_projection_apply (conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso Y J U)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≪≫ (@tildeSelf (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).symm)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).map biprod.snd)
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      (J.ideal U).Cotangent (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)))
    (conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso_snd Y J U) m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionSectionsARRRG.scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_eq (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (a : Γ(J.subscheme, J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤)) :
    scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U a =
      @spectrumImageRingEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme
        (J.subschemeCover.f U) (J.subschemeCover.map_prop U) a
proof:
:= by
  let f := J.subschemeCover.f U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion f := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  let ι := @spectrumImageSectionsEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    J.subscheme f _ (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme)
  have h1 := ι.map_smul' a
    (show (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme).val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ ⊤)) from (1 : Γ(J.subscheme, f ''ᵁ ⊤)))
  have e1 : ι (show (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme).val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ ⊤)) from a) =
      (spectrumImageRingEquiv f a) • ι (show (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme).val.obj
        (op (f ''ᵁ ⊤)) from (1 : Γ(J.subscheme, f ''ᵁ ⊤))) := by
    simpa using h1
  have e2 := congrArg (fun m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj
    (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤) => scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U m) e1
  refine e2.trans ?_
  change scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U
    ((spectrumImageRingEquiv f a) • (1 : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj
      (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme), ⊤))) = _
  rw [map_smul, scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.ZeroSectionSectionsARRRG.centreImageSectionsEquiv_snd
statement:
theorem centreImageSectionsEquiv_snd (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (n : (conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op (J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤))) :
    (centreImageSectionsEquiv Y J U n).2 =
      @spectrumImageRingEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme
        (J.subschemeCover.f U) (J.subschemeCover.map_prop U)
        (show Γ(J.subscheme, J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤) from
          ((biprod.snd : InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J ⟶
            ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme).app (J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤) n))
proof:
:= by
  change (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U n).2 = _
  rw [conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv_snd]
  exact scalarLineChartSectionsEquiv_eq Y J U _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.leftAdjointComparison_transpose
statement:
theorem leftAdjointComparison_transpose {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F F' : C ⥤ D} {G G' : D ⥤ C} (a : F ⊣ G) (b : F' ⊣ G') (i : G ≅ G')
    (M : C) (N : D) (h : M ⟶ G'.obj N) :
    ((a.ofNatIsoRight i).leftAdjointUniq b).hom.app M ≫ (b.homEquiv M N).symm h =
      (a.homEquiv M N).symm (h ≫ i.inv.app N)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((a.ofNatIsoRight i).homEquiv M N).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]
  change b.homEquiv M N ((b.homEquiv M N).symm h) = _
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_ofNatIsoRight_symm_apply]
  exact (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.compositeTranspose
statement:
theorem compositeTranspose {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} {H : D ⥤ E} {K : E ⥤ D}
    (a : F ⊣ G) (b : H ⊣ K) (M : C) (N : E) (h : M ⟶ G.obj (K.obj N)) :
    ((a.comp b).homEquiv M N).symm h = H.map ((a.homEquiv M (K.obj N)).symm h) ≫ b.counit.app N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  change (b.homEquiv _ _).symm ((a.homEquiv _ _).symm h) = _
  exact b.homEquiv_symm_apply _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.inverseCounitSquare
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono t.hom).1
  rw [Category.assoc, h, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.identityAround
statement:
theorem identityAround {C : Type*} [Category C] {X Y Z : C} (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z) :
    𝟙 X ≫ a ≫ 𝟙 Y ≫ b = a ≫ b
proof: := by simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.unitComparison_paste
statement:
theorem unitComparison_paste {C : Type*} [Category C] {A B D E F G : C}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (u : B ⟶ D) (v : A ⟶ E) (c : E ⟶ D) (d : D ⟶ F)
    (w : A ⟶ G) (p : G ≅ F) (hn : a ≫ u = v ≫ c) (hu : a ≫ u ≫ d = w ≫ p.hom) :
    v ≫ c ≫ d ≫ p.inv = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc v c, ← hn, Category.assoc a u, ← Category.assoc u d, ← Category.assoc a (u ≫ d), hu,
    Category.assoc, p.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.tildePullbackComparison_transpose
statement:
theorem tildePullbackComparison_transpose (M : ModuleCat A) (N : (Spec (.of B)).Modules)
    (h : M ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of B)).obj N)) :
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).hom ≫
      (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).comp
        (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of B))).homEquiv M N).symm h =
    (((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).homEquiv M N).symm
      (h ≫ (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) N).inv)
proof:
:= by
  exact leftAdjointComparison_transpose
    ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
    ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).comp (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of B)))
    (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) M N h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.tildePullbackComparison_unit
statement:
theorem tildePullbackComparison_unit (M : ModuleCat A) :
    (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of A)).hom.app M ≫
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app
          ((tilde.functor (.of A)).obj M)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj ((tilde.functor (.of A)).obj M))).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of B)).map ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).hom) =
    (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app M ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of B)).hom.app ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M))
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app
    (((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))).ofNatIsoRight
        (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
    ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).comp (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of B))) M
  simp only [Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight_unit, Adjunction.comp_unit_app, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Category.assoc, affineTildeAdjunction_unit,
    affineGlobalSectionsFunctor, Functor.comp_map, moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso,
    tildePullbackSpecMapIso, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.app_hom] at hu ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hu

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affineCounitRestriction_square
statement:
theorem affineCounitRestriction_square (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) (N : (Spec (.of B)).Modules)
    (f : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj N) :
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E)).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor (.of B)).map
        (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv
          ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E)
          ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of B)).obj N)).symm
          ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f ≫
            (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) N).hom)) ≫ Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of B) N =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of A) E) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).homEquiv E N).symm f
proof:
:= by
  have h := tildePullbackComparison_transpose φ ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E) N
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) N).hom)
  have hi : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) N).hom) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) N).inv =
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f := by
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [hi] at h
  rw [compositeTranspose, compositeTranspose] at h
  have hc := (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).counit.naturality f
  change (tilde.functor (.of A)).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f) ≫
      (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).counit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj N) =
      (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).counit.app E ≫ f at hc
  rw [(tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of A)).homEquiv_symm_apply, hc,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp] at h
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_apply,
    affineTildeAdjunction_counit, affineGlobalSectionsFunctor] using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affineCounitRestriction_inverse_square
statement:
theorem affineCounitRestriction_inverse_square (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules)
    (N : (Spec (.of B)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (f : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map
      (affineCounitIso (.of A) E).inv ≫
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E)).hom ≫
    (tilde.functor (.of B)).map
      (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E)
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of B)).obj N)).symm
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f ≫
          (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) N).hom)) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).homEquiv E N).symm f ≫
      (affineCounitIso (.of B) N).inv
proof:
:= by
  exact inverseCounitSquare
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).mapIso (affineCounitIso (.of A) E))
    (affineCounitIso (.of B) N) _ _ (affineCounitRestriction_square φ E N f)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affinePullbackSectionUnitNat_app
statement:
theorem affinePullbackSectionUnitNat_app (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) :
    (affinePullbackSectionUnitNat φ).app E = affinePullbackSectionUnit φ E
proof:
:= by
  simp [affinePullbackSectionUnitNat, affinePullbackSectionUnit, moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso]
  with_unfolding_all exact (identityAround
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app E))
    (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj E)).hom)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affinePullbackSectionUnit_naturality
statement:
theorem affinePullbackSectionUnit_naturality {E F : (Spec (.of A)).Modules} (f : E ⟶ F) :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map f ≫ affinePullbackSectionUnit φ F =
      affinePullbackSectionUnit φ E ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of B)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map f))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (affinePullbackSectionUnitNat φ).naturality f
  simp only [affinePullbackSectionUnitNat_app, Functor.comp_map] at hn
  with_unfolding_all exact hn

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affineCounitIso_sections_inv
statement:
theorem affineCounitIso_sections_inv (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map (affineCounitIso (.of A) E).inv =
      (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of A)).hom.app ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map (affineCounitIso (.of A) E).hom) :=
    inferInstance
  apply (cancel_mono ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map (affineCounitIso (.of A) E).hom)).1
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  exact ((tilde.adjunction (R := .of A)).right_triangle_components E).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit
statement:
theorem affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    affinePullbackSectionUnit φ E ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
      (affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso φ E).hom =
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  let M := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ
  let ΓB := moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of B)
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let c := (affineCounitIso (.of A) E).inv
  let e := (tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M
  let t := (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of B)).app ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M)
  have hn := affinePullbackSectionUnit_naturality φ c
  rw [affineCounitIso_sections_inv] at hn
  have hu : (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of A)).hom.app M ≫
      affinePullbackSectionUnit φ ((tilde.functor (.of A)).obj M) ≫ F.map (ΓB.map e.hom) =
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app M ≫ (F.mapIso t).hom := by
    exact tildePullbackComparison_unit φ M
  have hp := unitComparison_paste
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of A)).hom.app M)
    (affinePullbackSectionUnit φ ((tilde.functor (.of A)).obj M))
    (affinePullbackSectionUnit φ E) (F.map (ΓB.map (P.map c)))
    (F.map (ΓB.map e.hom)) ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app M)
    (F.mapIso t) hn hu
  simp only [affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Functor.map_comp, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc,
    Functor.mapIso_inv] at hp ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit_apply
statement:
theorem affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit_apply (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (m : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).obj E) :
    (affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso φ E).hom.hom ((affinePullbackSectionUnit φ E).hom m) =
      (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A,φ] m
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) (affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit φ E)
  exact h.trans (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_unit_app_apply φ _ m)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.geometricRestrictionSections_top_cast
statement:
theorem geometricRestrictionSections_top_cast (Y : Scheme.{u}) {X V : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : X ⟶ Y) (v : V ⟶ Y) (k : X ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion v]
    [IsOpenImmersion k] (comm : k ≫ v = q) (E : Y.Modules)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj E, ⊤)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj E).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (show k ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ = ⊤ by simp)).op
        ((geometricRestrictionHom Y q v k comm E).app ⊤ m) =
      geometricTopSectionsRestriction Y q v k comm E m
proof:
:= by
  change E.presheaf.map (q.opensFunctor.map
    (eqToHom (show k ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ = ⊤ by simp))).op
      ((geometricRestrictionHom Y q v k comm E).app ⊤ m) =
    E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show q ''ᵁ (k ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) = q ''ᵁ ⊤ by simp)).op
      ((geometricRestrictionHom Y q v k comm E).app ⊤ m)
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.affineChartRestrictionHom_sections
statement:
theorem affineChartRestrictionHom_sections (Y : Scheme.{u})
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (E : Y.Modules)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).obj E, ⊤)) :
    (((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(Y,V.1))).map (affineChartRestrictionHom Y h E)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalBlowup.res Y h))
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).hom).hom m =
      affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y E h m
proof:
:= by
  change (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalBlowup.res Y h))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).hom.hom
      ((affineChartRestrictionHom Y h E).app ⊤ m) = _
  rw [spectrumPushforwardSections_hom_apply (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)
    ((affineChartRestrictionHom Y h E).app ⊤ m)]
  exact (geometricRestrictionSections_top_cast Y U.2.fromSpec V.2.fromSpec
    (affineRefinement Y h) (affineRefinement_toAmbient Y h) E m).trans
      (congrArg (fun f => f m) (affineChartSectionsRestriction_eq_native Y h E))

statement:
theorem idealChartPullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit_apply (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U, ⊤)) :
    (idealChartPullbackTensorSectionsIso Y J U).hom.hom
      ((affinePullbackSectionUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
        (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).hom m) =
      (1 : Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1), Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)] m
proof:
:= by
  exact @affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit_apply _ _ _ _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
    (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U) (ConormalSheaf.idealChart_isQuasicoherent J U) m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.linearEquivFactor_inv_apply
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg (fun i => i.hom.hom (a.inv.hom v)) hf
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom] at hh

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_factor
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_factor (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).toModuleIso =
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).mapIso
        (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U) ≪≫
      idealChartPullbackTensorSectionsIso Y J U
proof:
:= by
  unfold conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv
  refine (moduleIso_linearEquiv_roundtrip
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).mapIso
      (conormalChartTensorIso Y J U) ≪≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).app _).symm)).trans ?_
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [conormalChartTensorIso, idealChartPullbackTensorSectionsIso, affinePullbackTensorSectionsIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.conormalChartGeometricGenerator_apply
statement:
theorem conormalChartGeometricGenerator_apply (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U, ⊤)) :
    conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J U m =
      (((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
        (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).inv).hom
          ((affinePullbackSectionUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
            (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).hom m))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.conormalChartGeometricGenerator_coordinates
statement:
theorem conormalChartGeometricGenerator_coordinates (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U, ⊤)) :
    conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U (conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J U m) =
      (1 : Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1), Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)] m
proof:
:= by
  let a := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).mapIso
    (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U)
  let b := idealChartPullbackTensorSectionsIso Y J U
  have hh : a.inv ≫ (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).toModuleIso.hom = b.hom := by
    rw [conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_factor]
    change a.inv ≫ (a ≪≫ b).hom = b.hom
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  have hp := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
    ((affinePullbackSectionUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
      (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).hom m)) hh
  have hu := idealChartPullbackTensorSectionsIso_unit_apply Y J U m
  rw [conormalChartGeometricGenerator_apply Y J U m]
  exact hp.trans hu

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.centreChartRestrictionHom_sections
statement:
theorem centreChartRestrictionHom_sections (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (E : J.subscheme.Modules)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f V)).obj E, ⊤)) :
    (((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V))).map
      (centreChartRestrictionHom Y J h E)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h))
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj E)).hom).hom m =
      centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h E m
proof:
:= by
  change (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj E)).hom.hom
      ((centreChartRestrictionHom Y J h E).app ⊤ m) = _
  rw [spectrumPushforwardSections_hom_apply (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj E)
    ((centreChartRestrictionHom Y J h E).app ⊤ m)]
  exact geometricRestrictionSections_top_cast J.subscheme (J.subschemeCover.f U)
    (J.subschemeCover.f V) (centreRefinement Y J h) (centreRefinement_toCentre Y J h) E m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.centreChart_image_top
statement:
theorem centreChart_image_top (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
