name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.globalConormalUnitSections_naturality
statement:
theorem globalConormalUnitSections_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {O P : Y.Opens} (h : O ≤ P) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule J, P)) :
    (ConormalSheaf.conormal J).presheaf.map
      ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map J.subschemeι.base).map (homOfLE h)).op
      (globalConormalUnitSections Y J P m) =
    globalConormalUnitSections Y J O
      ((ConormalSheaf.idealModule J).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf Y).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction J.subschemeι).unit.app
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J))).naturality (homOfLE h).op
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) hn).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.conormalChartPullbackIdealIso_eq_square
statement:
theorem conormalChartPullbackIdealIso_eq_square (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U =
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso J.subschemeι (J.subschemeCover.f U) U.2.fromSpec
        (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U) (ConormalSheaf.subschemeCover_f_comp J U)).app
          (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.conormalUnitRoutes_eq
statement:
theorem conormalUnitRoutes_eq (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    conormalLocalUnitRoute Y J U = conormalGlobalUnitRoute Y J U
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_coherence J.subschemeι
    (J.subschemeCover.f U) U.2.fromSpec (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)
      (ConormalSheaf.subschemeCover_f_comp J U) (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J)
  change conormalLocalUnitRoute Y J U =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction J.subschemeι).unit.app (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward J.subschemeι).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (J.subschemeCover.f U)).unit.app (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (J.subschemeCover.f U) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward J.subschemeι).map
      ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso J.subschemeι (J.subschemeCover.f U) U.2.fromSpec
        (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U) (ConormalSheaf.subschemeCover_f_comp J U)).app
          (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J)).hom at h
  rw [← conormalChartPullbackIdealIso_eq_square] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.presheafRestriction_eq_cast
statement:
theorem presheafRestriction_eq_cast (X : Scheme.{u}) (E : X.Modules)
    {O P Q R : X.Opens} (eO : O = Q) (eP : P = R) (h : O ≤ P) (k : Q ≤ R)
    (m : Γ(E, R)) :
    E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom eP).op m) =
      E.presheaf.map (eqToHom eO).op (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE k).op m)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : E.presheaf.map (eqToHom eP).op ≫ E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op =
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE k).op ≫ E.presheaf.map (eqToHom eO).op := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) hh

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_naturality
statement:
theorem centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule J, V.1)) :
    centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)
      (centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator Y J V m) =
    centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator Y J U
      ((ConormalSheaf.idealModule J).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centreChartSectionsRestriction_apply]
  change (ConormalSheaf.conormal J).presheaf.map _
      ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).presheaf.map _ (globalConormalUnitSections Y J V.1 m)) =
    (ConormalSheaf.conormal J).presheaf.map _
      (globalConormalUnitSections Y J U.1
        ((ConormalSheaf.idealModule J).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op m))
  have hp := presheafRestriction_eq_cast J.subscheme (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)
    (centreChart_image_top Y J U) (centreChart_image_top Y J V)
    (centreChartImage_le Y J h)
    (show J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ≤ J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 from
      by intro x hx; exact h hx) (globalConormalUnitSections Y J V.1 m)
  refine hp.trans ?_
  congr 1
  exact globalConormalUnitSections_naturality Y J h m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalNaturality.centreChartSectionsRestriction_smul
statement:
theorem centreChartSectionsRestriction_smul (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (E : J.subscheme.Modules)
    (r : Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f V)).obj E, ⊤)) :
    centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h E (r • m) =
      GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h r • centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h E m
proof:
:= by
  let f := ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V))).map
      (centreChartRestrictionHom Y J h E)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h))
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj E)).hom
  rw [← centreChartRestrictionHom_sections Y J h E (r • m),
    ← centreChartRestrictionHom_sections Y J h E m]
  change f.hom (r • m) = r • f.hom m
  exact f.hom.map_smul r m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherComponent.affineOtherToBlowup_naturality
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherComponent.reesEvaluationSection_rightInverse

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherComponent.otherAffineToBlowupGlobal_naturality
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherComponent.otherAffineToInfinity_naturality
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.pushedUnitMap_comp_aux
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_comp_aux {X0 X1 X2 : Scheme.{u}} (f1 : X1 ⟶ X0) (f2 : X2 ⟶ X1)
    (U0 : X0.Opens) (U1 : X1.Opens) (U2 : X2.Opens)
    (h01 : U1 ≤ f1 ⁻¹ᵁ U0) (h12 : U2 ≤ f2 ⁻¹ᵁ U1) (h02 : U2 ≤ (f2 ≫ f1) ⁻¹ᵁ U0) :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f1 U0 U1 h01 ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f2 U1 U2 h12) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X2 U2) =
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap (f2 ≫ f1) U0 U2 h02
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext s
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  change (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f2 U1 U2 h12).app (f1 ⁻¹ᵁ W)
      ((pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f1 U0 U1 h01).app W s) = _
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app, pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app,
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE f2 f1 _ _ _ _ _) s

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.pushedUnitMap_comp
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_comp {X0 X1 X2 : Scheme.{u}} (f1 : X1 ⟶ X0) (f2 : X2 ⟶ X1) (f12 : X2 ⟶ X0)
    (e : f2 ≫ f1 = f12)
    (U0 : X0.Opens) (U1 : X1.Opens) (U2 : X2.Opens)
    (h01 : U1 ≤ f1 ⁻¹ᵁ U0) (h12 : U2 ≤ f2 ⁻¹ᵁ U1) (h02 : U2 ≤ f12 ⁻¹ᵁ U0) :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f1 U0 U1 h01 ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f2 U1 U2 h12) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X2 U2) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X2 U2) =
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f12 U0 U2 h02
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]
  exact pushedUnitMap_comp_aux f1 f2 U0 U1 U2 h01 h12 h02

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.kernelChartComposition
statement:
theorem kernelChartComposition {𝒞 𝒟 ℰ : Type*} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] [Category ℰ]
    (P1 : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞) (P2 : ℰ ⥤ 𝒟) (P12 : ℰ ⥤ 𝒞)
    (θ : ∀ X : ℰ, P1.obj (P2.obj X) ⟶ P12.obj X)
    (hθ : ∀ {X Y : ℰ} (φ : X ⟶ Y), θ X ≫ P12.map φ = P1.map (P2.map φ) ≫ θ Y)
    {K0 : 𝒞} {K1 : 𝒟} {K2 : ℰ} {C0 : 𝒞} {C1 : 𝒟} {C2 : ℰ} {U0 : 𝒞} {U1 : 𝒟} {U2 : ℰ}
    (ι0 : K0 ⟶ C0) (ι1 : K1 ⟶ C1) (ι2 : K2 ⟶ C2)
    (π0 : C0 ⟶ U0) (π1 : C1 ⟶ U1) (π2 : C2 ⟶ U2)
    (χ1 : C0 ⟶ P1.obj C1) (χ2 : C1 ⟶ P2.obj C2)
    (u1 : U0 ⟶ P1.obj U1) (u2 : U1 ⟶ P2.obj U2) (u12 : U0 ⟶ P12.obj U2)
    (a : K0 ⟶ P1.obj K1) (b : K1 ⟶ P2.obj K2) (ab : K0 ⟶ P12.obj K2)
    (ha : a ≫ P1.map ι1 = ι0 ≫ χ1) (hb : b ≫ P2.map ι2 = ι1 ≫ χ2)
    (hχ1 : χ1 ≫ P1.map π1 = π0 ≫ u1) (hχ2 : χ2 ≫ P2.map π2 = π1 ≫ u2)
    (hc : u1 ≫ P1.map u2 ≫ θ U2 = u12)
    (hab : ab ≫ P12.map (ι2 ≫ π2) = ι0 ≫ π0 ≫ u12) :
    (a ≫ P1.map b ≫ θ K2) ≫ P12.map (ι2 ≫ π2) = ab ≫ P12.map (ι2 ≫ π2)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : b ≫ P2.map (ι2 ≫ π2) = ι1 ≫ π1 ≫ u2 := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, hb, Category.assoc, hχ2]
  have e2 : a ≫ P1.map (ι1 ≫ π1 ≫ u2) = ι0 ≫ π0 ≫ u1 ≫ P1.map u2 := by
    calc a ≫ P1.map (ι1 ≫ π1 ≫ u2) = (a ≫ P1.map ι1) ≫ P1.map π1 ≫ P1.map u2 := by
          simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      _ = ι0 ≫ (χ1 ≫ P1.map π1) ≫ P1.map u2 := by rw [ha]; simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ι0 ≫ (π0 ≫ u1) ≫ P1.map u2 := by rw [hχ1]
      _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hab, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hθ, ← hc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (P1.map b), ← Functor.map_comp, e1, ← Category.assoc a, e2]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.homEquiv_conj
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, conjugateEquiv_apply_app]
  have n1 := adj₂.unit.naturality (R₁.map h)
  have n2 := σ.naturality (R₁.map h)
  have n3 := adj₂.unit.naturality (adj₁.unit.app K)
  have n4 := σ.naturality (adj₁.unit.app K)
  have tri := adj₁.left_triangle_components K
  have n5 := adj₁.counit.naturality h
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj] at n1 n2 n3 n4 n5
  rw [Category.assoc]
  erw [reassoc_of% n1]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, n2]
  erw [Category.assoc, n5]
  erw [reassoc_of% n3]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.homEquiv_pullbackComp
statement:
theorem homEquiv_pullbackComp {X0 X1 X2 : Scheme.{u}} (f1 : X1 ⟶ X0) (f2 : X2 ⟶ X1)
    (K0 : X0.Modules) (K1 : X1.Modules) (K2 : X2.Modules)
    (α : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0 ⟶ K1) (β : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).obj K1 ⟶ K2) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f2 ≫ f1)).homEquiv K0 K2
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv.app K0 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2
proof:
:= by
  have h := homEquiv_conj ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).comp
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f2 ≫ f1))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv K0 K2 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv] at h
  erw [h, Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  have step : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f2).obj K2)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0) K2
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  exact congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2) step

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.homEquiv_pullbackComp_congr
statement:
theorem homEquiv_pullbackComp_congr {X0 X1 X2 : Scheme.{u}} (f1 : X1 ⟶ X0) (f2 : X2 ⟶ X1)
    (f12 : X2 ⟶ X0) (e : f12 = f2 ≫ f1)
    (K0 : X0.Modules) (K1 : X1.Modules) (K2 : X2.Modules)
    (α : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f1).obj K0 ⟶ K1) (β : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).obj K1 ⟶ K2) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f12).homEquiv K0 K2
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e).hom.app K0 ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f2 f1).inv.app K0 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f2).map α ≫ β) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f1).homEquiv K0 K1 α ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f1).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f2).homEquiv K1 K2 β) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f2 f1).hom.app K2 ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr e.symm).hom.app K2
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]
  have hc : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (rfl : f2 ≫ f1 = f2 ≫ f1)).hom.app K0 =
      𝟙 _ := rfl
  rw [hc, Category.id_comp]
  exact homEquiv_pullbackComp f1 f2 K0 K1 K2 α β

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeChartPushedUnitMap_comp

      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map

      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg')).symm).hom.app _ =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeKernelToPushforward_comp
statement:
theorem nativeKernelToPushforward_comp (d : ℤ) :
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        (nativeKernelToPushforward ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app _ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg')).symm).hom.app _ =
    nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map (g'.comp g)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg'))).map
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) f) -
      Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) f) d)))).1
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext
  intro i
  have hθ : ∀ {M N : (Proj 𝒞).Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N),
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg')).symm).hom.app M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map (g'.comp g)
          (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg'))).map φ =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g' hg')).map φ) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app N ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg')).symm).hom.app N) := by
    intro M N φ
    rw [Category.assoc, ← (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
      (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg')).symm).hom.naturality φ]
    erw [← reassoc_of% ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.naturality φ)]
  refine kernelChartComposition (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g hg))
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map g' hg'))
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Proj.map (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg')))
    (fun M ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg')).symm).hom.app M)
    hθ
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d))
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) -
        Native.generatorDescentRight ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d))
    (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f)) -
        Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f)) d))
    (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i)
    (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj ℬ)
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f j))) i)
    (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒞)
      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒞 (imageDegreeOneFamily ℬ 𝒞 g' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) j))) i)
    (nativeChartCochainMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f)
    (nativeChartCochainMap ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f))
    (nativeChartPushedUnitMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i)
    (nativeChartPushedUnitMap ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) i)
    (nativeChartPushedUnitMap 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f i)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d
  · exact nativeKernelToPushforward_ι ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d
  · exact nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i
  · exact nativeChartCochainMap_π ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) i
  · exact nativeChartPushedUnitMap_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g hg g' hg' f i
  · have h3 := nativeKernelToPushforward_ι 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d
    have h3' := nativeChartCochainMap_π 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f i
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun t ↦ kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f -
      Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫ t) h3')
    rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc]
    erw [h3]
    exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCubeC2.nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_comp (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Proj.map_comp (hf := hg) (hg := hg'))).hom.app
        ((Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) ≫
      nativeKernelPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d =
    nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g) (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map (g'.comp g)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg'))).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [homEquiv_pullbackComp_congr, nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint, nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint]
  exact (nativeKernelToPushforward_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g hg g' hg' f d).trans
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom_adjoint 𝒜 𝒞 (g'.comp g)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hg hg') f d).symm

    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) ≫ (isAffineOpen Y U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineProjection_preimage_chart_zero
statement:
theorem affineProjection_preimage_chart_zero (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    affineToIntegerP1 A I ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0).opensRange = (blowupι I).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine A)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨gmToBlowup I y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine A)) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · change trivialι I y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) y ∈
          (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0).opensRange := by
        show ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) y) ∈
          (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← trivialι_affineToIntegerP1 A I, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [ProjectiveLine.chart_one_preimage] at hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (gmToTrivialLine A).opensRange := by
        rw [← integerLine_preimage_X A]
        exact hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨gmToBlowup I z, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, gmToBlowup_blowupι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show affineToIntegerP1 A I (blowupι I y) ∈ (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_affineToIntegerP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.semilinearGradedSquare
statement:
theorem semilinearGradedSquare {A B S T M N P L : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module S P] [AddCommGroup L] [Module T L]
    (a : B →+* T) (b : A →+* B) (c : S →+* T) (d : A →+* S)
    (α : N →ₛₗ[a] L) (β : M →ₛₗ[b] N) (γ : P →ₛₗ[c] L) (δ : M →ₛₗ[d] P)
    (hs : a.comp b = c.comp d) (hm : ∀ m, α (β m) = γ (δ m)) :
    (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap a α).comp (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap b β) =
      (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap c γ).comp (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap d δ)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap x =>
    change symmetricSemilinearMap a α (symmetricSemilinearMap b β (algebraMap A _ x)) =
      symmetricSemilinearMap c γ (symmetricSemilinearMap d δ (algebraMap A _ x))
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base, symmetricSemilinearMap_base,
      symmetricSemilinearMap_base, symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
    exact congrArg (algebraMap T _) (RingHom.congr_fun hs x)
  | ι m =>
    change symmetricSemilinearMap a α (symmetricSemilinearMap b β (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A M m)) =
      symmetricSemilinearMap c γ (symmetricSemilinearMap d δ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A M m))
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι,
      symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι T L) (hm m)
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.nativeSemilinearProj_toSpec
statement:
theorem nativeSemilinearProj_toSpec {A B M N : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    [Module.Free A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Module.Free B N] [Module.Finite B N]
    (f : A →+* B) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading B N) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading A M)).map
        (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ)) :
    Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ) hf ≫
      InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricChartToSpec (M := M) =
    InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricChartToSpec (M := N) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  let a := InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricChartZero (Q := A) (M := M)
  let b := InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricChartZero (Q := B) (M := N)
  have hh := proj_map_zero_structure _ _ (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ) hf a (b.comp f)
    (nativeSemilinear_degreeZero_square f φ)
  change Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ) hf ≫
    (Proj.toSpecZero (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading A M) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a)) =
    (Proj.toSpecZero (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading B N) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
  exact hh.trans ((congrArg (fun c => Proj.toSpecZero (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading B N) ≫ c)
    (Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom f) (CommRingCat.ofHom b))).trans
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.projectionRoute
statement:
theorem projectionRoute {K : Type*} [Category K] {X A B C D S : K}
    (x : X ⟶ A) (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ S) (p : A ⟶ D) (d : D ⟶ S)
    (q : X ⟶ C) (k : C ⟶ D) (c : C ⟶ S)
    (ha : a ≫ b = p ≫ d) (hx : x ≫ p = q ≫ k) (hk : k ≫ d = c) :
    (x ≫ a) ≫ b = q ≫ c
proof:
:=
  (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (fun t => x ≫ t) ha).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun t => t ≫ d) hx).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun t => q ≫ t) hk)))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.linearCoordinateGraded_eq_native
statement:
theorem linearCoordinateGraded_eq_native {A M N : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    [Module.Free A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Module.Free A N] [Module.Finite A N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[A] N) :
    InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e =
      semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (RingHom.id A) e.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap e (algebraMap A _ a) =
      symmetricSemilinearMap (RingHom.id A) e.toLinearMap (algebraMap A _ a)
    exact (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap e).commutes a |>.trans
      (symmetricSemilinearMap_base (RingHom.id A) e.toLinearMap a).symm
  | ι m =>
    exact (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap_ι e m).trans
      (symmetricSemilinearMap_ι (RingHom.id A) e.toLinearMap m).symm
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul, hp, hq]

statement: theorem spectrumRefinementImage_le : f ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ g ''ᵁ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k)) := by
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k) ≫ g) := by
      rw [comm]

    Z f g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k)) comm ⊤

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.spectrumImageRingEquiv_restriction
statement:
theorem spectrumImageRingEquiv_restriction :
    (spectrumImageRingEquiv f).toRingHom.comp
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (spectrumRefinementImage_le Z f g k comm)).op).hom =
    k.comp (spectrumImageRingEquiv g).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  let U := spectrumImageAffineOpen f
  let V := spectrumImageAffineOpen g
  have hf := spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec f
  have hg := spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec g
  have hr := V.2.map_fromSpec U.2
    (homOfLE (spectrumRefinementImage_le Z f g k comm) : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op
  have hs : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((spectrumImageRingEquiv f).toRingHom.comp
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (spectrumRefinementImage_le Z f g k comm)).op).hom)) ≫ V.2.fromSpec =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (k.comp (spectrumImageRingEquiv g).toRingHom)) ≫ V.2.fromSpec := by
    change Spec.map (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (spectrumRefinementImage_le Z f g k comm)).op ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (spectrumImageRingEquiv f).toRingHom) ≫ V.2.fromSpec =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (spectrumImageRingEquiv g).toRingHom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom k) ≫ V.2.fromSpec
    rw [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_comp]
    exact ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun a => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (spectrumImageRingEquiv f).toRingHom) ≫ a) hr).trans hf)).trans
      (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        ((congrArg (fun a => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k) ≫ a) hg).trans comm)).symm)
  have hc := Spec.map_injective ((cancel_mono V.2.fromSpec).mp hs)
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hc

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.spectrumImageSectionsRestriction_apply

statement:
theorem spectrumImageNativeRestriction_irrelevant
    (hspan : Submodule.span Γ(Z,f ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (Set.range (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction Z f g k comm E)) = ⊤) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj E))) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj E)))).map
      (spectrumImageNativeGradedRestriction Z f g k comm E)
proof:
:= by
  have ho := nativeSemilinear_irrelevant
    (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (spectrumRefinementImage_le Z f g k comm)).op).hom
    (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction Z f g k comm E) hspan
  have hc := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ho (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant Z f E)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
    (spectrumImageCoordinateInverse_irrelevant Z g E) hc
  exact (congrArg (fun a =>
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj E))) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of R)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj E)))).map a)
      (spectrumImageNativeRestriction_route Z f g k comm E)).mpr ht

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.spectrumImageProjRestriction_square
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem spectrumImageProjRestriction_square
    (hspan : Submodule.span Γ(Z,f ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (Set.range (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction Z f g k comm E)) = ⊤) :
    Proj.map (spectrumImageNativeGradedRestriction Z f g k comm E)
      (spectrumImageNativeRestriction_irrelevant Z f g k comm E hspan) ≫
      Proj.map (spectrumImageCoordinateGradedMap Z g E) (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant Z g E) =
    Proj.map (spectrumImageCoordinateGradedMap Z f E) (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant Z f E) ≫
      Proj.map (spectrumImageOpenGradedRestriction Z f g k comm E)
        (nativeSemilinear_irrelevant _ (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction Z f g k comm E) hspan)
proof:
:= by
  exact proj_map_actual_square _ _ _ _
    (spectrumImageOpenGradedRestriction Z f g k comm E)
    (spectrumImageCoordinateGradedMap Z g E) (spectrumImageCoordinateGradedMap Z f E)
    (spectrumImageNativeGradedRestriction Z f g k comm E)
    (nativeSemilinear_irrelevant _ (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction Z f g k comm E) hspan)
    (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant Z g E) (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant Z f E)
    (spectrumImageNativeRestriction_irrelevant Z f g k comm E hspan)
    (spectrumImageGradedRestriction_square Z f g k comm E)

statement:
theorem commonAffineQuotientRestriction_refinement (V : Z.affineOpens) (h : W ≤ V)
    (hV : V.1 ≤ f ''ᵁ ⊤) :
    commonAffineQuotientRestriction Z f W ((show W.1 ≤ V.1 from h).trans hV) =
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : W.1 ⟶ V.1).op).hom.comp
        (commonAffineQuotientRestriction Z f V hV)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (commonAffineQuotientRestriction Z f W ((show W.1 ≤ V.1 from h).trans hV))) ≫ f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : W.1 ⟶ V.1).op).hom.comp
          (commonAffineQuotientRestriction Z f V hV))) ≫ f := by
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (commonAffineQuotientRestriction Z f W ((show W.1 ≤ V.1 from h).trans hV))) ≫ f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (commonAffineQuotientRestriction Z f V hV) ≫
        Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : W.1 ⟶ V.1).op) ≫ f
    rw [Spec.map_comp]
    exact (commonAffineQuotientRestriction_toCentre Z f W ((show W.1 ≤ V.1 from h).trans hV)).trans
      (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        ((congrArg (fun a => Spec.map (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : W.1 ⟶ V.1).op) ≫ a)
          (commonAffineQuotientRestriction_toCentre Z f V hV)).trans
          (V.2.map_fromSpec W.2 (homOfLE h : W.1 ⟶ V.1).op))).symm)
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective ((cancel_mono f).mp hs))

theorem centreNativeRestriction_irrelevant {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientRestriction_irrelevant
statement:
theorem commonQuotientRestriction_irrelevant (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    letI
proof:
:= commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
    letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
    letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,W.1)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(J.subscheme,W.1))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.2.fromSpec).obj (conormalPlusLine Y J)))) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading
      (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i)))).map
      (commonQuotientGradedRestriction Y J C i W hW) := by
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  let E := conormalPlusLine Y J
  letI := C.chartCover.map_prop i
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W E)
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W E)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  let fw : Spec Γ(J.subscheme,W.1) ⟶ J.subscheme := W.2.fromSpec
  let iw : IsOpenImmersion fw := inferInstanceAs (IsOpenImmersion W.2.fromSpec)
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) ⟶ J.subscheme := C.chartCover.f i
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := C.chartCover.map_prop i
  let kq := @commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq W hW
  have hk : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom kq) ≫ q = fw :=
    @commonAffineQuotientRestriction_toCentre (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq W hW
  let V := @spectrumImageAffineOpen Γ(J.subscheme,W.1) inferInstance J.subscheme fw iw
  have hv : V.1 ≤ D.U i := @spectrumRefinementImage_le
    Γ(J.subscheme,W.1) (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    inferInstance (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme fw q iw iq kq hk
  let vf := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i V hv
  let vn := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i V hv
  let sf := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W E)
  let sn := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W E)
  let qf : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := D.sectionModule_free i
  let qn : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := D.sectionModule_finite i
  exact @spectrumImageNativeRestriction_irrelevant
    Γ(J.subscheme,W.1) (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    inferInstance (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme fw q iw iq kq hk E
    vf vn sf sn qf qn
    (conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i))
    (conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i))
    (D.restriction_spans i V.1 hv)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientProjRestriction_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonQuotientProjRestriction_toSpec (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    commonQuotientProjRestriction Y J C i W hW ≫
      chartSectionsToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) =
    commonSpectrumToSpec Y J C i W hW ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (@commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW))
proof:
:= by
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  exact @nativeSemilinearProj_toSpec
    (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) Γ(J.subscheme,W.1)
    (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i))
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(J.subscheme,W.1))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.2.fromSpec).obj (conormalPlusLine Y J)))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) inferInstance inferInstance
    (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i)).isModule
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    (@commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW)
    (@commonAffineNativeSectionsRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)
      W hW (conormalPlusLine Y J)) (commonQuotientRestriction_irrelevant Y J C i W hW)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientToComponent_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonQuotientToComponent_toCentre (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    commonQuotientToComponent Y J C i W hW ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J =
      commonSpectrumToSpec Y J C i W hW ≫ W.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  exact projectionRoute _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (chartSections_isPullback Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).w
    (commonQuotientProjRestriction_toSpec Y J C i W hW)
    (@commonAffineQuotientRestriction_toCentre (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientCoefficient_original
statement:
theorem commonQuotientCoefficient_original (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom =
    (@commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW).comp
      (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  let kq := @commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW
  have hl := (D.affineOpen i).2.map_fromSpec W.2 (homOfLE hW : W.1 ⟶ D.U i).op
  have hf := @spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)
  have hk := @commonAffineQuotientRestriction_toCentre (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW
  have hs : Spec.map (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op) ≫ (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (kq.comp (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)) ≫
        (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec := by
    change Spec.map (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op) ≫ (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom kq) ≫ (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec
    rw [Spec.map_comp]
    exact hl.trans (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun a => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom kq) ≫ a) hf).trans hk)).symm)
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (Spec.map_injective ((cancel_mono (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec).mp hs))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientSections_original
statement:
theorem commonQuotientSections_original (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
    (m : (conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))) :
    affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J)
      ((conormalPlusLine Y J).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op m) =
    @commonAffineNativeSectionsRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)
      W hW (conormalPlusLine Y J) (localFrameSectionsEquiv Y J C i m)
proof:
:= by
  let E := conormalPlusLine Y J
  let kq := @commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW
  have hk := @commonAffineQuotientRestriction_toCentre (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW
  let hw := @spectrumRefinementImage_le Γ(J.subscheme,W.1)
    (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) inferInstance (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    J.subscheme W.2.fromSpec (C.chartCover.f i) inferInstance (C.chartCover.map_prop i) kq hk
  change E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top W)).op
      (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op m) = E.presheaf.map (homOfLE hw).op m
  exact (Functor.map_comp_apply E.presheaf _ _ m).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun a => E.presheaf.map a m) (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientGradedRestriction_original
statement:
theorem commonQuotientGradedRestriction_original (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap Y J C i W hW =
      (commonQuotientGradedRestriction Y J C i W hW).comp (localFrameGradedMap Y J C i)
proof:
:= by
  exact semilinearGradedSquare (RingHom.id Γ(J.subscheme,W.1))
    (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom
    (@commonAffineQuotientRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i) W hW)
    (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom
    (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J)).toLinearMap
    (commonOpenSectionsSemilinear Y J C i W hW)
    (@commonAffineNativeSectionsRestriction (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)
      W hW (conormalPlusLine Y J)) (localFrameSectionsEquiv Y J C i).toLinearMap
    ((RingHom.id_comp _).trans (commonQuotientCoefficient_original Y J C i W hW))
    (commonQuotientSections_original Y J C i W hW)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonOpenToSpectrum_irrelevant
statement:
theorem commonOpenToSpectrum_irrelevant (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    letI
proof:
:= (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
    letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
    letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,W.1)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(J.subscheme,W.1))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.2.fromSpec).obj (conormalPlusLine Y J)))) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading
      Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
      ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))))).map
      (commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap Y J C i W hW) := by
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  have hc := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (localFrameGradedMap_comp_inverse Y J C i))
    (commonQuotientRestriction_irrelevant Y J C i W hW)
  exact (congrArg (fun a =>
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,W.1)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(J.subscheme,W.1))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.2.fromSpec).obj (conormalPlusLine Y J)))) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading
      Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
      ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))))).map a)
      (commonQuotientGradedRestriction_original Y J C i W hW)).mpr hc

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientProjRestriction_original
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonQuotientProjRestriction_original (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    letI
proof:
:= (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
    letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
    letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    commonQuotientProjRestriction Y J C i W hW ≫ (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv =
      Proj.map (commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap Y J C i W hW)
        (commonOpenToSpectrum_irrelevant Y J C i W hW) := by
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  change Proj.map (commonQuotientGradedRestriction Y J C i W hW)
      (commonQuotientRestriction_irrelevant Y J C i W hW) ≫
    Proj.map (localFrameGradedMap Y J C i)
      (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (localFrameGradedMap_comp_inverse Y J C i)) = _
  exact (Proj.map_comp (localFrameGradedMap Y J C i)
    (commonQuotientGradedRestriction Y J C i W hW) _ _).symm.trans
    (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (commonQuotientGradedRestriction_original Y J C i W hW).symm _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonOpenSectionsSemilinear_eq_direct

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap_eq_direct
statement:
theorem commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap_eq_direct (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    letI
proof:
:= (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
    letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
    letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
    (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))).comp
      (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestriction
          (C := localFrameCover Y J C) i W hW)) = commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap Y J C i W hW := by
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J))
  exact congrArg₂ GradedRingHom.comp
    (linearCoordinateGraded_eq_native (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J)))
    (congrArg (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom)
      (commonOpenSectionsSemilinear_eq_direct Y J C i W hW).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientProjRestriction_original_square
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonQuotientProjRestriction_original_square (i : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    commonQuotientProjRestriction Y J C i W hW ≫ (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv =
      (commonSpectrumProjIso Y J C i W hW).inv ≫
        SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap
          (C := localFrameCover Y J C) i W hW i hW
proof:
:= by
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  let e := affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv J.subscheme W (conormalPlusLine Y J)
  let β := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestriction (C := D) i W hW
  letI := D.sectionModule_free i
  letI := D.sectionModule_finite i
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hW
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hW
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv e
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv e
  have hb := nativeSemilinear_irrelevant (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom β
    (D.restriction_spans i W.1 hW)
  have he := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap_comp_symm e)
  have hr : Proj.map (commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap Y J C i W hW)
      (commonOpenToSpectrum_irrelevant Y J C i W hW) =
      (commonSpectrumProjIso Y J C i W hW).inv ≫
        SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap
          (C := D) i W hW i hW := by
    change Proj.map (commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap Y J C i W hW) _ =
      Proj.map (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e) he ≫
        SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap
          (J.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom β (D.restriction_spans i W.1 hW)
    exact (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr
      (commonOpenToSpectrumGradedMap_eq_direct Y J C i W hW).symm _).trans
      ((Proj.map_comp _ _ hb he).trans
        (congrArg (fun a => Proj.map (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e) he ≫ a)
          (semilinearProjMap_eq_native _ β (D.restriction_spans i W.1 hW)).symm))
  exact (commonQuotientProjRestriction_original Y J C i W hW).trans hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleComponentOverlap.commonQuotientToComponent_original
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonQuotientToComponent_original (i : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    commonQuotientToComponent Y J C i W hW =
      ((commonSpectrumProjIso Y J C i W hW).inv ≫
        SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap
          (C := localFrameCover Y J C) i W hW i hW) ≫
      localFrameToComponent Y J C i

:= by

    (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i)
    (chartSectionsToComponent Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i))).trans
    (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ localFrameToComponent Y J C i)
      (commonQuotientProjRestriction_original_square Y J C i W hW))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.exists_common_chart_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem exists_common_chart_of_mem_range (U V : Y.affineOpens) (x : projectiveNormalCone Y J)
    (hU : x ∈ Set.range (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U))
    (hV : x ∈ Set.range (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V)) :
    ∃ (C : Y.affineOpens) (_ : C ≤ U) (_ : C ≤ V),
      x ∈ Set.range (projectiveConeAffineι Y J C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hV
  have he : U.1.ι (projectiveConeApp Y J U a) = V.1.ι (projectiveConeApp Y J V b) := by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z => (projectiveConeToBase Y J) z) hb
    change (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V ≫ projectiveConeToBase Y J) b =
      (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U ≫ projectiveConeToBase Y J) a at h1
    unfold projectiveConeAffineι projectiveConeToBase at h1
    erw [(projectiveConeGluingData Y J).ι_toBase U, (projectiveConeGluingData Y J).ι_toBase V] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  obtain ⟨k, fi, fj, uk, h1, h2⟩ := Y.directedAffineCover.exists_of_f_eq_f
    (projectiveConeApp Y J U a) (projectiveConeApp Y J V b) he
  obtain ⟨xk, hx1, hx2⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
    (boundaryRestriction_base_isPullback Y J (leOfHom fj)) b uk h2.symm
  refine ⟨k, leOfHom fi, leOfHom fj, xk, ?_⟩
  rw [← hb, ← hx1, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, boundaryRestriction_affineι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.range_inter_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem range_inter_eq_iUnion (U V : Y.affineOpens) :
    Set.range (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U) ∩ Set.range (projectiveConeAffineι Y J V) =
      ⋃ (C : Y.affineOpens) (_ : C ≤ U) (_ : C ≤ V),
        Set.range (projectiveConeAffineι Y J C)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hU, hV⟩
    exact exists_common_chart_of_mem_range Y J U V x hU hV
  · rintro ⟨C, hCU, hCV, y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨boundaryRestriction Y J hCU y, ?_⟩, ⟨boundaryRestriction Y J hCV y, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, boundaryRestriction_affineι]
    · rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, boundaryRestriction_affineι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.geometricRestrictionIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem geometricRestrictionIso_naturality {E F : Y.Modules} (φ : E ⟶ F) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor k).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map φ) ≫
      (geometricRestrictionIso Y q v k comm F).hom =
        (geometricRestrictionIso Y q v k comm E).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ
proof:
:= by
  exact (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp k v).symm ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr comm).hom.naturality φ)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.geometricRestrictionHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem geometricRestrictionHom_naturality {E F : Y.Modules} (φ : E ⟶ F) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map φ ≫ geometricRestrictionHom Y q v k comm F =
      geometricRestrictionHom Y q v k comm E ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map φ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction k).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj F) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction k).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj E) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor k).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map φ)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction k).unit.naturality ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map φ)
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map φ ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction k).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj F) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map (geometricRestrictionIso Y q v k comm F).hom) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction k).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj E) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map (geometricRestrictionIso Y q v k comm E).hom) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ)
  rw [← Category.assoc, hn]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  rw [geometricRestrictionIso_naturality]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.geometricRestriction_domain_le
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.geometricRestrictionHom_app
statement:
theorem geometricRestrictionHom_app (E : Y.Modules) (O : V.Opens) :

      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (geometricRestriction_domain_le Y q v k comm O)).op
proof:
:= by

    geometricRestrictionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  change E.presheaf.map _ ≫ E.presheaf.map _ ≫ E.presheaf.map _ = _
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.geometricTopSectionsRestriction_apply
statement:
theorem geometricTopSectionsRestriction_apply (E : Y.Modules)
    (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj E, ⊤)) :
    geometricTopSectionsRestriction Y q v k comm E m =
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ v ''ᵁ ⊤ by
        simpa using geometricRestriction_domain_le Y q v k comm ⊤)).op m
proof:
:= by
  change E.presheaf.map _ ((geometricRestrictionHom Y q v k comm E).app ⊤ m) = _
  rw [geometricRestrictionHom_app]
  have hh : E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (geometricRestriction_domain_le Y q v k comm ⊤)).op ≫
      E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show q ''ᵁ (k ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) = q ''ᵁ ⊤ by simp)).op =
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show q ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ v ''ᵁ ⊤ by
        simpa using geometricRestriction_domain_le Y q v k comm ⊤)).op := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) hh

statement:
theorem centreChartSectionsRestriction_comp (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (k : V ≤ W) (E : J.subscheme.Modules) :
    centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J (h.trans k) E =
      (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h E).comp (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J k E)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro m
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, centreChartSectionsRestriction_apply]
  have hh : E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (centreChartImage_le Y J k)).op ≫
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (centreChartImage_le Y J h)).op =
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (centreChartImage_le Y J (h.trans k))).op := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) hh).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.centreChartSectionsRestriction_id
statement:

proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext

  have he : (homOfLE (centreChartImage_le Y J (le_refl U))).op =
      𝟙 (op (J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hh := E.presheaf.map_id (op (J.subschemeCover.f U ''ᵁ ⊤))
  rw [← he] at hh
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) hh

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.productSections_ext
statement:
theorem productSections_ext {X : Scheme.{u}} {κ : Type u} (U : X.Opens)
    (F : κ → X.Modules) (x y : Γ(∏ᶜ F,U))
    (h : ∀ j, (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U)).map (Pi.π F j) x =
      (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U)).map (Pi.π F j) y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U)
  let e := PreservesProduct.iso E F ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun j ↦ E.obj (F j))
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).injective
  funext j
  have hx : productSectionsTuple U F (e.hom x) = x := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Iso.hom_inv_id e) x
  have hy : productSectionsTuple U F (e.hom y) = y := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Iso.hom_inv_id e) y
  exact (productSectionsTuple_projection U F (e.hom x) j).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun z ↦ E.map (Pi.π F j) z) hx).trans
      ((h j).trans ((congrArg (fun z ↦ E.map (Pi.π F j) z) hy).symm.trans
        (productSectionsTuple_projection U F (e.hom y) j))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTransition_cocycle
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameTransition_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i a c : ι) :
    Units.map (generatorOverlapToTripleXY 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)).toMonoidHom
        (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 (-d) (f i) (f a)) =
      Units.map (generatorOverlapToTripleYZ 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)).toMonoidHom
          (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d (f a) (f c)) *
        Units.map (generatorOverlapToTripleXZ 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)).toMonoidHom
          (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 (-d) (f i) (f c))
proof:
:= by
  let A := Units.map
    (generatorOverlapToTripleXY 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)).toMonoidHom
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d (f i) (f a))
  let B := Units.map
    (generatorOverlapToTripleYZ 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)).toMonoidHom
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d (f a) (f c))
  let C := Units.map
    (generatorOverlapToTripleXZ 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)).toMonoidHom
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d (f i) (f c))
  have h : A * B = C :=
    generatorTwistTransitionUnit_cocycle 𝒜 d (f i) (f a) (f c)
  simp only [generatorTwistTransitionUnit_neg]
  change A⁻¹ = B * C⁻¹
  rw [← h]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorTripleOpen_eq_inf
statement:
theorem generatorTripleOpen_eq_inf (x y z : 𝒜 1) :
    generatorTripleOpen 𝒜 x y z =
      (generatorOpen 𝒜 x ⊓ generatorOpen 𝒜 y) ⊓ generatorOpen 𝒜 z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  change Proj.basicOpen (𝒜)
      ((x.val * y.val) * z.val) =
    Proj.basicOpen (𝒜) (x.val * y.val) ⊓
      Proj.basicOpen (𝒜) (z.val)
  exact Proj.basicOpen_mul (𝒜)
    (x.val * y.val) (z.val)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq (d : ℤ) (x y z : 𝒜 1) :
    generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY 𝒜 d x y z =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (𝒜)
        (generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 x y z)
        (generatorTripleEquation_mem_degree_three 𝒜 x y z) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (generatorOverlapToTripleXY 𝒜 x y z).toMonoidHom
          (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x y))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change ((Proj (𝒜)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (generatorTripleOpen_le_overlapXY 𝒜 x y z)).op)
        ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (𝒜)
          (generatorOverlapEquation 𝒜 x y)
          (generatorOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two 𝒜 x y) (by omega)).hom
            (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x y : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 x y)) = _
  change (Proj.awayToSection (𝒜) (generatorOverlapEquation 𝒜 x y) ≫
      (Proj (𝒜)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (generatorTripleOpen_le_overlapXY 𝒜 x y z)).op)
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x y : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 x y) =
    Proj.awayToSection (𝒜) (generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 x y z)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (generatorOverlapToTripleXY 𝒜 x y z))
        (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x y : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 x y))
  exact
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (f := generatorOverlapEquation 𝒜 x y)
        (x := generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 x y z) 𝒜 z.property (by rfl))
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x y : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 x y)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ_eq
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ_eq (d : ℤ) (x y z : 𝒜 1) :
    generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ 𝒜 d x y z =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (𝒜)
        (generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 x y z)
        (generatorTripleEquation_mem_degree_three 𝒜 x y z) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (generatorOverlapToTripleYZ 𝒜 x y z).toMonoidHom
          (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d y z))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change (Proj.awayToSection (𝒜) (generatorOverlapEquation 𝒜 y z) ≫
      (Proj (𝒜)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (generatorTripleOpen_le_overlapYZ 𝒜 x y z)).op)
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d y z : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 y z) =
    Proj.awayToSection (𝒜) (generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 x y z)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (generatorOverlapToTripleYZ 𝒜 x y z))
        (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d y z : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 y z))
  exact
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (f := generatorOverlapEquation 𝒜 y z)
        (x := generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 x y z) 𝒜 x.property (by
          change x.val*y.val*z.val = (y.val*z.val)*x.val
          ring))
      (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d y z : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 y z)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ_eq
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ_eq (d : ℤ) (x y z : 𝒜 1) :
    generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ 𝒜 d x y z =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (𝒜)

          (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x z))
proof:
:= by

      (Proj (𝒜)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (generatorTripleOpen_le_overlapXZ 𝒜 x y z)).op)

        (generatorTwistTransitionUnit 𝒜 d x z : GeneratorOverlapRing 𝒜 x z))
  exact
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (f := generatorOverlapEquation 𝒜 x z)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTransitionSection_cocycle
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameTransitionSection_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i a c : ι) :
    generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY 𝒜 (-d) (f i) (f a) (f c) =
      generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ 𝒜 d (f i) (f a) (f c) *
        generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ 𝒜 (-d) (f i) (f a) (f c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq,
    generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ_eq,
    generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ_eq]
  let F := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (𝒜)
    (generatorTripleEquation 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c))
    (generatorTripleEquation_mem_degree_three 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c))
      (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
  have h := congrArg (Units.map F)
    (generatorLocalFrameTransition_cocycle 𝒜 f d i a c)
  exact h.trans (map_mul (Units.map F) _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTuple_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generatorLocalFrameTuple_component (d : ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    (Pi.π (fun a : ι ↦
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f a))) j).app
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)) (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i) =
      generatorLocalFrameComponent 𝒜 f d i j
proof:
:= by
  exact productSectionsTuple_projection (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))
    (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j)))
    (fun j ↦ generatorLocalFrameComponent 𝒜 f d i j) j

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameComponent_compatibility
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameComponent_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i a c : ι) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f a) (f c)).le.trans inf_le_left)).app
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)) (generatorLocalFrameComponent 𝒜 f d i a) =
    (pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f a) (f c)).app (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i))
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f a) (f c)).le.trans inf_le_right)).app
          (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)) (generatorLocalFrameComponent 𝒜 f d i c))
proof:
:= by
  let X := Proj 𝒜
  let U := generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)
  let W := generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 (f a) (f c)
  let P := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let eW := W.ι.appIso P
  have q : W.ι ''ᵁ P =
      generatorTripleOpen 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c) := by
    dsimp only [W, P, U]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf, generatorTripleOpen_eq_inf]
    ac_rfl
  let qIso := X.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso q).op
  let sL : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f a) (f c)).le.trans
        inf_le_left)).app U
        (generatorLocalFrameComponent 𝒜 f d i a)
  let sR : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f a) (f c)).app U
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f a) (f c)).le.trans
          inf_le_right)).app U
          (generatorLocalFrameComponent 𝒜 f d i c))
  change sL = sR
  let T : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules W.toScheme, P) →
      Γ(X, generatorTripleOpen 𝒜 (f i) (f a) (f c)) :=
    fun z ↦ qIso.inv (eW.inv z)
  suffices hT : T sL = T sR by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso eW.inv).injective
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso qIso.inv).injective
    exact hT
  dsimp only [T, sL, sR]
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    generatorOverlapTransitionIso]
  simp [generatorLocalFrameComponent, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  dsimp only [eW, qIso]
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  change
    (generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY 𝒜 (-d)
      (f i) (f a) (f c)).1 =
      (generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ 𝒜 d
        (f i) (f a) (f c)).1 *
        (generatorLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ 𝒜 (-d)
          (f i) (f a) (f c)).1
  exact congrArg Units.val
    (generatorLocalFrameTransitionSection_cocycle 𝒜 f d i a c)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameTuple_compatibility
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameTuple_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f).app (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)) (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i) =
    (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d).app (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)) (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i)
proof:
:= by
  let U := generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)
  let overlaps := fun ij : ι×ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
    (generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 (f ij.1) (f ij.2))
  apply productSections_ext U overlaps
  rintro ⟨a,c⟩
  change ((generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f ≫ Pi.π overlaps (a,c)).app U)
    (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i) =
    ((generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d ≫ Pi.π overlaps (a,c)).app U)
      (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i)
  dsimp only [overlaps]
  rw [generatorDescentLeft_π, generatorDescentRight_π]
  change (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f a) (f c)).le.trans inf_le_left)).app U
        ((Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) a).app U
          (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i)) =
    (pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f a) (f c)).app U
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f a) (f c)).le.trans inf_le_right)).app U
          ((Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) c).app U
            (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i)))
  rw [generatorLocalFrameTuple_component, generatorLocalFrameTuple_component]
  exact generatorLocalFrameComponent_compatibility 𝒜 f d i a c

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameHom_compatibility
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameHom_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f) =
      generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
          (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι
  apply ((G.obj (generatorOverlapCochains 𝒜 f)).unitHomEquiv).injective
  change SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f))
      ((G.obj (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f)).unitHomEquiv
        (generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i)) =
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d))
      ((G.obj (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f)).unitHomEquiv
        (generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i))
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  rw [generatorLocalFrameHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change ((G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f)).val.app V)
      (((G.obj (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f)).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op) (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i)) =
    ((G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)).val.app V)
      (((G.obj (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f)).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op) (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i))
  let a : (op (⊤ : (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.Opens)) ⟶ V :=
    (homOfLE le_top).op
  have hL := (G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f)).val.naturality a
  have hR := (G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)).val.naturality a
  have htop :
      ((G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i) =
        ((G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i) := by
    let U := generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)
    let left := generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f
    let right := generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d
    let chart := generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f
    let overlap := generatorOverlapCochains 𝒜 f
    let tuple := generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i
    change left.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      right.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple)
    have hf := congrArg (fun q ↦ q tuple)
      (left.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
    have hg := congrArg (fun q ↦ q tuple)
      (right.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
    change left.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      overlap.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
        (left.app U tuple) at hf
    change right.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      overlap.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
        (right.app U tuple) at hg
    rw [hf, hg, generatorLocalFrameTuple_compatibility]
  calc
    _ = ((G.obj (generatorOverlapCochains 𝒜 f)).val.map a)
        (((G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i)) := by
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hL
        (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i)
    _ = ((G.obj (generatorOverlapCochains 𝒜 f)).val.map a)
        (((G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i)) := congrArg _ htop
    _ = _ := (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hR
      (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection_app_eq
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameProjection_app_eq (d : ℤ) (i : ι)
    (V : (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.Opens)
    (x : Γ((degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d).restrict
      (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι, V)) :
    (generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 f d i).app V x =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom ((generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι.preimage_image_eq V).symm).op
        ((Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
              (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i).app
          ((generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι ''ᵁ V)
          ((kernel.ι
            (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)).app
              ((generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι ''ᵁ V) x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

theorem generatorLocalFrameHom_project (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :

        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).inv.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
            (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme)
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
            (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i)).app ⊤
      ((generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i).app ⊤
        (1 : (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
      (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).inv.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
          (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme)).app ⊤
      (1 : (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
  have hsec :
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).obj
        (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f)).unitHomEquiv)
          (generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i) =
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop _

    rw [generatorLocalFrameHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
