      (1 : (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
        generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i := by
    have htop := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.val (op (⊤ :
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.Opens))) hsec
    change (generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i).app ⊤
        (1 : (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).obj
        (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE le_top).op)
            (generatorLocalFrameTopSection 𝒜 f d i) at htop
    have q : (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ :
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op = 𝟙 (op ⊤) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [q, Functor.map_id_apply] at htop
    exact htop
  rw [hframe]
  let U := generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)

  let πi := Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i
  let s := (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f).presheaf.map
    (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i)

        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) U) ⊤).inv
          (πi.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) s) := by
    rfl
  change (G.map πi).app (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
        (generatorChartCochains 𝒜 f) ⊤).inv s) = _
  rw [hπ]
  have hnat := congrArg (fun q ↦ q (generatorLocalFrameTuple 𝒜 f d i))
    (πi.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)

    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) U).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op

      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) U) ⊤).inv
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) U).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
            ((Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
                (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i).app U

statement:
theorem generatorDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility
    (d : ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (kernel.ι (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun t : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
            (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f t))) i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f i) (f j)).le.trans inf_le_left)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (kernel.ι (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun t : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
            (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f t))) j) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f i) (f j)).le.trans inf_le_right)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f i) (f j))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι
  let charts := fun t : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f t))
  let overlaps := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
      (generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 (f ij.1) (f ij.2))
  let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
  let rL := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f i) (f j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let rR := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f i) (f j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let t := pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f i) (f j)
  have hK :
      G.map (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
          G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f) =
        G.map (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
          G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg G.map
      (nativeDegreeOneDescentSheaf_compatibility 𝒜 (fun i ↦ (f i).val)
        (fun i ↦ (f i).property) d)
  show G.map
      (kernel.ι (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
    G.map
      (kernel.ι (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t
  have hLeft := congrArg G.map (generatorDescentLeft_π 𝒜 f i j)
  have hRight := congrArg G.map (generatorDescentRight_π 𝒜 f d i j)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hLeft hRight
  calc
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        (G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f) ≫ G.map qij) :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ G.map (kernel.ι
        (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫ q) hLeft.symm
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        (G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫ G.map qij) := by
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij) hK).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _))
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun q ↦ G.map (kernel.ι
        (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫ q) hRight

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorRestrictedKernel_generatedByFrame
statement:
theorem generatorRestrictedKernel_generatedByFrame (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
        (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
          (kernel.ι
            (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).map
          (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
              (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).hom.app
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
              (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme) ≫
        generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι
  let charts := fun j : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜) (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _
  apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso G charts).hom).1
  apply (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)))).hom_ext
  rintro ⟨j⟩
  simp only [PreservesProduct.iso_hom]
  change _ ≫ piComparison G charts ≫
      Pi.π (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)) j =
    _ ≫ piComparison G charts ≫ Pi.π (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)) j
  simp only [Category.assoc, piComparison_comp_π]
  let rL := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f i) (f j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let rR := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 (f i) (f j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let t := pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition 𝒜 d (f i) (f j)
  let hIsoR : IsIso (G.map rR) :=
    restrictedLinearOverlapRestriction_isIso 𝒜 (f i) (f j)
  letI : IsIso (G.map rR) := hIsoR
  letI : Mono (G.map rR) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hIsoR
  let hIsoT : IsIso t := by
    dsimp only [t, pushedGeneratorOverlapTransition]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso t := hIsoT
  let hIsoGT : IsIso (G.map t) := Functor.map_isIso G t
  letI : IsIso (G.map t) := hIsoGT
  letI : Mono (G.map t) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hIsoGT
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme)
  have hKij := generatorDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility
    𝒜 f d i j
  have hFij :
      generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
        generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    let overlaps := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
        (generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 (f ij.1) (f ij.2))
    let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
    have hLeft := congrArg G.map (generatorDescentLeft_π 𝒜 f i j)
    have hRight := congrArg G.map (generatorDescentRight_π 𝒜 f d i j)
    simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hLeft hRight
    calc
      _ = generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          (G.map (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f) ≫ G.map qij) :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫ q) hLeft.symm
      _ = generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          (G.map (generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫ G.map qij) := by
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij)
            (generatorLocalFrameHom_compatibility 𝒜 f d i)).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _))
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun q ↦ generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫ q) hRight
  have hεF :
      ε ≫ generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) =
        𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [ε, G, charts]
    exact (congrArg (fun q ↦
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).toScheme) ≫ q)
      (generatorLocalFrameHom_project 𝒜 f d i)).trans (Iso.hom_inv_id_app _ _)
  have hεFij :
      G.map rL =
        ε ≫ generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    calc
      _ = (ε ≫ generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts i)) ≫ G.map rL := by
        rw [hεF]
        exact (Category.id_comp (G.map rL)).symm
      _ = ε ≫ (generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ε ≫ (generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t) :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ ε ≫ q) hFij
      _ = _ := by rfl
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map rR)).1
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map t)).1
  calc
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL := by
      dsimp only [G, charts, rL, rR, t]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      exact hKij.symm
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫
          (ε ≫ generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t) := by
      rw [hεFij]
      rfl
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [ε, G, charts]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistLineRecovery.Native.generatorLocalFrameProjection_kernelLift
statement:
theorem generatorLocalFrameProjection_kernelLift (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 f d i ≫
        generatorLocalFrameKernelLift 𝒜 f d i =
      𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).obj
          (degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι
  let φ := generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map (kernel.ι φ))).1
  have h1 := congrArg (fun q ↦ generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 f d i ≫ q)
    (generatorLocalFrameKernelLift_ι 𝒜 f d i)
  have h2 : generatorLocalFrameProjection 𝒜 f d i ≫
      generatorLocalFrameHom 𝒜 f d i = G.map (kernel.ι φ) := by
    dsimp only [generatorLocalFrameProjection, G, φ]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    exact (generatorRestrictedKernel_generatedByFrame 𝒜 f d i).symm
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (h1.trans (h2.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))

    AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap (E := InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J)

      (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap (E := InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J)
        biprod.snd ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i) n) := h1

statement:
theorem frameQuotientGraded_algebraMap (i : C.J) (a : Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) :
    frameQuotientGraded Y J C i (algebraMap _ _ a) = frameScalarGraded Y J C i (algebraMap _ _
        a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameQuotientGraded frameScalarGraded
  simp only [GradedRingHom.comp_apply]
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  have h1 : (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J (C.U i)).symm)
      (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ a :=
    (symmetricCoordinateMap (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J (C.U i)).symm).commutes a
  rw [h1]
  change symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (algebraMap _ _ a)) =
    symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (algebraMap _ _ a))
  rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base, symmetricSemilinearMap_base, symmetricSemilinearMap_base,
    symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.frameQuotientGraded_ι
statement:
theorem frameQuotientGraded_ι (i : C.J)
    (m : (J.ideal (C.U i)).Cotangent × (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) :
    frameQuotientGraded Y J C i (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m) =
      frameScalarGraded Y J C i (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameQuotientGraded frameScalarGraded
  simp only [GradedRingHom.comp_apply]
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  have h1 : (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J (C.U i)).symm)
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _
        ((conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J (C.U i)).symm m) :=
    symmetricCoordinateMap_ι _ m
  rw [h1]
  change symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ _)) =
    symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m))
  rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι,
    symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
  exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _) (frameQuotient_snd Y J C i m)

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.frameQuotientGraded_eq
statement:
theorem frameQuotientGraded_eq (i : C.J) :
    frameQuotientGraded Y J C i = frameScalarGraded Y J C i
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a => exact frameQuotientGraded_algebraMap Y J C i a
  | ι m => exact frameQuotientGraded_ι Y J C i m
  | add p q hp hq => exact (map_add _ _ _).trans (by rw [hp, hq]; exact (map_add _ _ _).symm)
  | mul p q hp hq => exact (map_mul _ _ _).trans (by rw [hp, hq]; exact (map_mul _ _ _).symm)

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.chartSectionsProjIso_inv_eq
statement:
theorem chartSectionsProjIso_inv_eq (i : C.J) :
    letI
proof:
:= InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
    ∃ hb, (chartSectionsProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).inv =
      Proj.map (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap
        (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J (C.U i)).symm) hb := by
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.localFrameChartSectionsIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem localFrameChartSectionsIso_hom_eq (i : C.J) :
    letI
proof:
:= InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)

    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    ∃ ha, (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom =

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.projMap_comp3
statement:
theorem projMap_comp3 {R₁ R₂ R₃ R₄ : Type u} [CommRing R₁] [CommRing R₂] [CommRing R₃] [CommRing R₄]
    {σ₁ σ₂ σ₃ σ₄ : Type u} [SetLike σ₁ R₁] [AddSubgroupClass σ₁ R₁] [SetLike σ₂ R₂]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ₂ R₂] [SetLike σ₃ R₃] [AddSubgroupClass σ₃ R₃] [SetLike σ₄ R₄]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ₄ R₄] {𝒜₁ : ℕ → σ₁} {𝒜₂ : ℕ → σ₂} {𝒜₃ : ℕ → σ₃} {𝒜₄ : ℕ → σ₄}
    [GradedRing 𝒜₁] [GradedRing 𝒜₂] [GradedRing 𝒜₃] [GradedRing 𝒜₄]
    (f₁ : 𝒜₁ →+*ᵍ 𝒜₂) (f₂ : 𝒜₂ →+*ᵍ 𝒜₃) (f₃ : 𝒜₃ →+*ᵍ 𝒜₄)
    (h₁ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₂ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₁).map f₁)
    (h₂ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₃ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₂).map f₂)
    (h₃ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₄ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₃).map f₃)
    (h : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₄ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜₁).map (f₃.comp
        (f₂.comp f₁))) :
    Proj.map (f₃.comp (f₂.comp f₁)) h =
      Proj.map f₃ h₃ ≫ Proj.map f₂ h₂ ≫ Proj.map f₁ h₁
proof:
:= by
  have e : Proj.map (f₃.comp (f₂.comp f₁)) h = Proj.map (f₃.comp (f₂.comp f₁))
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp h₁ h₂)
          h₃) :=
    rfl
  rw [e, Proj.map_comp (f₂.comp f₁) f₃ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp h₁ h₂) h₃,
    Proj.map_comp f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂]

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.frameQuotientGraded_map
statement:
theorem frameQuotientGraded_map (i : C.J) :
    letI
proof:
:= InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    ∀ hΦ hQ, Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap
        (RingHom.id Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i))
        (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap (E := InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J)
          biprod.snd ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))) hΦ ≫
        (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫
        (chartSectionsProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).inv =
      Proj.map (frameQuotientGraded Y J C i) hQ := by
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  intro hΦ hQ
  obtain ⟨ha, ea⟩ := localFrameChartSectionsIso_hom_eq Y J C i
  obtain ⟨hb, eb⟩ := chartSectionsProjIso_inv_eq Y J C i
  rw [ea, eb]
  exact (projMap_comp3 _ _ _ hb ha hΦ hQ).symm

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.chartSection_eq
statement:
theorem chartSection_eq (i : C.J) :
    letI
proof:
:= (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
    letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
    ∃ hΦ, (localFrameCover Y J C).chartSection biprod.snd
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i =
      ((localFrameCover Y J C).isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫
        inv (rankOneToSpec Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)) ≫
        Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (RingHom.id Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J
            C).U i))
          (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap (E := InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J)
            biprod.snd ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))) hΦ := by
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  refine ⟨nativeSemilinear_irrelevant (RingHom.id _) _
    (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_spans (E := InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine Y J)
      biprod.snd (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) _), ?_⟩
  unfold AffineFrameCover.chartSection localSection
  rw [semilinearProjMap_eq_native]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.rank_scalar
statement:
theorem rank_scalar (i : C.J) :
    ∃ hS, Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (frameScalarHom Y J C i)) ≫
        inv (rankOneToSpec (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) =
      inv (rankOneToSpec Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)) ≫
        Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (frameScalarHom Y J C i)
          (ringHomSemilinear (frameScalarHom Y J C i))) hS
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nativeSemilinear_irrelevant (frameScalarHom Y J C i) _
    (ringHomSemilinear_spans _), ?_⟩
  rw [← semilinearProjMap_eq_native]
  exact specMap_comp_inv_rankOneToSpec (frameScalarHom Y J C i)

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.section_chain
statement:
theorem section_chain (i : C.J) :
    letI
proof:
:= InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
    (localFrameCover Y J C).chartSection biprod.snd
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i ≫
      (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫
      (chartSectionsProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).inv =
    frameToSpec Y J C i ≫
      localSection (LinearMap.snd (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
          (J.ideal (C.U i)).Cotangent (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)))
        (span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩) := by
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := InfinityNormalBundle.conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  obtain ⟨hΦ, hcs⟩ := chartSection_eq Y J C i
  obtain ⟨hS, hrank⟩ := rank_scalar Y J C i
  have hS' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
      Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        ((J.ideal (C.U i)).Cotangent × (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))))).map
        (frameScalarGraded Y J C i) :=
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (ZeroSectionARRRG.sndGraded_irrelevant _ (C.gens i)) hS
  have hQ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)
      Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        ((J.ideal (C.U i)).Cotangent × (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))))).map
        (frameQuotientGraded Y J C i) := by
    rw [frameQuotientGraded_eq]; exact hS'
  have hsnd := ZeroSectionARRRG.sndGraded_irrelevant (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  have hm : Proj.map (frameQuotientGraded Y J C i) hQ =
      Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (frameScalarHom Y J C i)
        (ringHomSemilinear (frameScalarHom Y J C i))) hS ≫
      Proj.map (ZeroSectionARRRG.sndGraded (J.ideal (C.U i))) hsnd := by
    refine (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (frameQuotientGraded_eq Y J C i) hQ).trans ?_
    exact Proj.map_comp (ZeroSectionARRRG.sndGraded (J.ideal (C.U i)))
      (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap (frameScalarHom Y J C i)
        (ringHomSemilinear (frameScalarHom Y J C i))) hsnd hS
  rw [hcs]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [frameQuotientGraded_map Y J C i hΦ hQ, hm, ← Category.assoc (inv _), ← hrank,
    ZeroSectionARRRG.localSection_eq _ (C.gens i)]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.localFrameToTotal_eq
statement:
theorem localFrameToTotal_eq (i : C.J) :
    localFrameToTotal Y J C i =
      (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫
      (chartSectionsProjIso Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).inv ≫
      (InfinityNormalBundle.normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).inv ≫
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso (J.ideal (C.U i))).inv ≫
      ReesBlowup.grMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal (C.U i))) ≫
      blowupι (J.ideal (C.U i)) ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J (C.U i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold localFrameToTotal chartSectionsToTotal chartSectionsToComponent
    normalBundleAffineToComponent InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjToComponent
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjIso
  simp only [Category.assoc, asIso_hom]
  rw [InfinityExceptionalGlobal.exceptionalToComponent_toTotal, ← Category.assoc
    (ReesBlowup.grToExceptional _), ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_exceptionalι]

name: KSpecialization.ARRRG.localFrameToTotal_factor
statement:
theorem localFrameToTotal_factor (i : C.J) :
    (localFrameCover Y J C).chartSection biprod.snd
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i ≫ localFrameToTotal Y J C i =
      (frameToSpec Y J C i ≫ AffineDeformationSpace.origin (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) ≫
        pushout.inl _ _ ≫ GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalAffineι Y J (C.U i)) ≫
      GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : subschemeToBlowup (J.ideal (C.U i)) ≫ blowupι (J.ideal (C.U i)) ≫
      GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J (C.U i) =
      pushout.inl _ _ ≫ GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalAffineι Y J (C.U i) ≫
        GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J := by
    rw [← Category.assoc (subschemeToBlowup _), ← inl_subschemeTotalι, Category.assoc,
      ← GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalAffineι_totalGlobalι]
  rw [localFrameToTotal_eq, reassoc_of% (section_chain Y J C i)]
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  apply congrArg (fun f => frameToSpec Y J C i ≫ f)
  erw [reassoc_of% (ZeroSectionARRRG.zeroSection_affine (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)), h1]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isPushout_of_surjective (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ C) (i : B ⟶ P) (j : C ⟶ P)
    (w : f ≫ i = g ≫ j) (hg : Function.Surjective g.hom) (hi : Function.Surjective i.hom)
    (hker : RingHom.ker i.hom ≤ Ideal.map f.hom (RingHom.ker g.hom)) :
    IsPushout f g i j
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ∀ a, i.hom (f.hom a) = j.hom (g.hom a) := fun a ↦ congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom a) w
  have key : ∀ s : PushoutCocone f g, ∃ m : P ⟶ s.pt, i ≫ m = s.inl ∧ j ≫ m = s.inr := by
    intro s
    have hcond : ∀ a, s.inl.hom (f.hom a) = s.inr.hom (g.hom a) := fun a ↦
      congrArg (fun φ : A ⟶ s.pt ↦ φ.hom a) s.condition
    have hkill : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker i.hom, s.inl.hom x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hle : Ideal.map f.hom (RingHom.ker g.hom) ≤ RingHom.ker s.inl.hom := by
        rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        intro y hy
        rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, hcond, RingHom.mem_ker.mp hy, map_zero]
      exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hle (hker hx))
    refine ⟨CommRingCat.ofHom ((Ideal.Quotient.lift _ s.inl.hom hkill).comp
      (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hi).symm.toRingHom), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun b ↦ ?_)
      change (Ideal.Quotient.lift _ s.inl.hom hkill)
        ((RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hi).symm (i.hom b)) = s.inl.hom b
      rw [RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk]
    · refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun c ↦ ?_)
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hg c
      change (Ideal.Quotient.lift _ s.inl.hom hkill)
        ((RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hi).symm (j.hom (g.hom a))) = s.inr.hom (g.hom a)
      rw [← hw a, RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk,
        hcond]
  refine ⟨⟨w⟩, ⟨PushoutCocone.IsColimit.mk w (fun s ↦ (key s).choose)
    (fun s ↦ (key s).choose_spec.1) (fun s ↦ (key s).choose_spec.2) ?_⟩⟩
  intro s m h₁ _
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun p ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hi p
  have e₁ : m.hom (i.hom b) = s.inl.hom b := congrArg (fun φ : B ⟶ s.pt ↦ φ.hom b) h₁
  have e₂ : (key s).choose.hom (i.hom b) = s.inl.hom b :=
    congrArg (fun φ : B ⟶ s.pt ↦ φ.hom b) (key s).choose_spec.1
  rw [e₁, e₂]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mk_comp_structureMap
statement:
theorem mk_comp_structureMap :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R I)).comp (structureMap R I).toRingHom =
      (specialFibreBaseHom R I).comp (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R))
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have h : (structureMap R I).toRingHom (Polynomial.C a) =
        algebraMap R (extendedRees R I) a := by
      rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      exact (structureMap R I).commutes a
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, h]
    simp [specialFibreBaseHom]
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, show
      (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)) Polynomial.X = 0 by simp, map_zero]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (structureMap R I Polynomial.X) = 0
    rw [structureMap_X, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.map_ker_evalRingHom_zero
statement:
theorem map_ker_evalRingHom_zero :
    Ideal.map (structureMap R I).toRingHom (RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R))) =
      parameterIdeal R I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  congr 1
  change {(structureMap R I) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 0)} = _
  rw [map_zero, sub_zero, structureMap_X]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mk_comp_structureMap_one
statement:
theorem mk_comp_structureMap_one :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreOneIdeal R I)).comp (structureMap R I).toRingHom =
      (fibreOneBaseHom R I).comp (Polynomial.evalRingHom (1 : R))
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have h : (structureMap R I).toRingHom (Polynomial.C a) =
        algebraMap R (extendedRees R I) a := by
      rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      exact (structureMap R I).commutes a
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, h]
    simp [fibreOneBaseHom]
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, show
      (Polynomial.evalRingHom (1 : R)) Polynomial.X = 1 by simp, map_one]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (structureMap R I Polynomial.X) = 1
    rw [structureMap_X, ← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreOneIdeal R I)),
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.map_ker_evalRingHom_one
statement:
theorem map_ker_evalRingHom_one :
    Ideal.map (structureMap R I).toRingHom (RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom (1 : R))) =
      fibreOneIdeal R I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  congr 1
  change {(structureMap R I) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 1)} = _
  rw [map_sub, structureMap_X, Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, map_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.specialFibre_isPullback
statement:
theorem specialFibre_isPullback :
    IsPullback (specialFibreι R I) (specialFibreToBase R I) (toLine R I) (origin R)
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_of_surjective _ _ _ _
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext (mk_comp_structureMap R I))
      (fun r ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C r, by simp⟩) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (by
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
        exact (map_ker_evalRingHom_zero R I).ge))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.fibreOne_isPullback
statement:
theorem fibreOne_isPullback :
    IsPullback (fibreOneι R I) (fibreOneToBase R I) (toLine R I) (pointOne R)
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_of_surjective _ _ _ _
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext (mk_comp_structureMap_one R I))
      (fun r ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C r, by simp⟩) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (by
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
        exact (map_ker_evalRingHom_one R I).ge))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.normalCone_isPullback
statement:
theorem normalCone_isPullback :
    IsPullback (normalConeι R I) (normalConeToBase R I) (toLine R I) (origin R)
proof:
:= by
  refine (specialFibre_isPullback R I).of_iso (normalConeIsoSpecialFibre R I).symm
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ (by simp) (by simp)
  · simp [normalConeι]
  · simp [normalConeToBase]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.fibreOne_isPullback_spec
statement:
theorem fibreOne_isPullback_spec :
    IsPullback ((fibreOneIso R I).inv ≫ fibreOneι R I)
      ((fibreOneIso R I).inv ≫ fibreOneToBase R I) (toLine R I) (pointOne R)
proof:
:= by
  refine (fibreOne_isPullback R I).of_iso (fibreOneIso R I) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.map_powers_structureMap
statement:
theorem map_powers_structureMap :
    Submonoid.map ((structureMap R I).toRingHom : Polynomial R →+* extendedRees R I)
        (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)) =
      Submonoid.powers (parameter R I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
  exact congrArg Submonoid.powers (structureMap_X R I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.genericFibre_isPullback
statement:
theorem genericFibre_isPullback :
    IsPullback (genericFibreι R I) (genericFibreToGm R) (toLine R I) (gmToLine R)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Submonoid.map ((structureMap R I).toRingHom : Polynomial R →+* extendedRees R I)
      (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)) = Submonoid.powers (parameter R I) :=
    map_powers_structureMap R I
  have hloc : IsLocalization (Submonoid.map
      ((structureMap R I).toRingHom : Polynomial R →+* extendedRees R I)
      (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R))) R[T;T⁻¹] := by
    rw [h]
    exact isLocalization_parameter R I
  have hcomm : (invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (Polynomial R) R[T;T⁻¹]) =
      (algebraMap (extendedRees R I) R[T;T⁻¹]).comp (structureMap R I).toRingHom := by
    refine RingHom.ext fun p ↦ ?_
    exact (coe_structureMap R I p).symm
  exact isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isLocalization (structureMap R I).toRingHom
      (invert (R := R)).toRingHom hcomm (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_toLaurent
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_toLaurent (p : Polynomial R) :
    mapLaurent φ (Polynomial.toLaurent p) = Polynomial.toLaurent (p.map φ)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.map_eq (M := Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R))
    (S := R[T;T⁻¹]) (Q := S[T;T⁻¹]) (g := Polynomial.mapRingHom φ) _ p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_T
statement: theorem mapLaurent_T (m : ℕ) : mapLaurent φ (T (m : ℤ)) = T (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, mapLaurent_toLaurent, Polynomial.map_pow,
    Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_C_mul_T (a : R) (n : ℤ) :
    mapLaurent φ (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n) = LaurentPolynomial.C (φ a) * T n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ n + (m : ℤ) := ⟨n.natAbs, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n + (m : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) := ⟨(n + m).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hL : mapLaurent φ (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n) * T (m : ℤ) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (φ a) * T (k : ℤ) := by
    rw [← mapLaurent_T φ m, ← map_mul, mul_T_assoc, hk, ← Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T,
      mapLaurent_toLaurent, Polynomial.map_monomial, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T]
  have hR : LaurentPolynomial.C (φ a) * T n * T (m : ℤ) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (φ a) * T (k : ℤ) := by
    rw [mul_T_assoc, hk]
  exact (isUnit_T (m : ℤ)).mul_right_cancel (hL.trans hR.symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_C
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_C (a : R) :
    mapLaurent φ (LaurentPolynomial.C a) = LaurentPolynomial.C (φ a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mapLaurent_C_mul_T φ a 0

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_mapLaurent
statement:
theorem coeff_mapLaurent (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) (n : ℤ) :
    (mapLaurent φ g).coeff n = φ (g.coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add,
      Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq, map_add]
  | C_mul_T m a =>
    rw [mapLaurent_C_mul_T, ← single_eq_C_mul_T, ← single_eq_C_mul_T,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · exact (map_zero _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosHom_apply
statement:
theorem nonPosHom_apply (p : Polynomial S) :
    nonPosHom S p = invert (Polynomial.toLaurent p)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosRetract_apply
statement:
theorem nonPosRetract_apply (g : S[T;T⁻¹]) :
    nonPosRetract S g = LaurentPolynomial.trunc (invert g)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosRetract_nonPosHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nonPosRetract_nonPosHom (p : Polynomial S) : nonPosRetract S (nonPosHom S p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonPosRetract_apply, nonPosHom_apply, involutive_invert _, Polynomial.trunc_toLaurent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosHom_injective
statement: theorem nonPosHom_injective : Function.Injective (nonPosHom S)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := nonPosRetract S) (nonPosRetract_nonPosHom S)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosHom_monomial
statement:
theorem nonPosHom_monomial (m : ℕ) (c : S) :
    nonPosHom S (Polynomial.monomial m c) = LaurentPolynomial.C c * T (-(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonPosHom_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T, map_mul, invert_C, invert_T]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosRetract_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem nonPosRetract_C_mul_T (c : S) (n : ℤ) :
    nonPosRetract S (LaurentPolynomial.C c * T n) =
      if 0 ≤ -n then Polynomial.monomial (-n).toNat c else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonPosRetract_apply, map_mul, invert_C, invert_T, trunc_C_mul_T]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reduceLaurent_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem reduceLaurent_C_mul_T (a : R) (n : ℤ) :
    reduceLaurent R I (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) * T n
proof:
:=
  mapLaurent_C_mul_T _ a n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_reduceLaurent
statement:
theorem coeff_reduceLaurent (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) (n : ℤ) :
    (reduceLaurent R I g).coeff n = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (g.coeff n)
proof:
:=
  coeff_mapLaurent _ g n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosHom_nonPosRetract_reduceLaurent
statement:
theorem nonPosHom_nonPosRetract_reduceLaurent {g : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hg : g ∈ extendedRees R I) :
    nonPosHom (R ⧸ I) (nonPosRetract (R ⧸ I) (reduceLaurent R I g)) = reduceLaurent R I g
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_sum_support R g]
  simp only [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [reduceLaurent_C_mul_T]
  rcases le_or_gt n 0 with hn | hn
  · rw [nonPosRetract_C_mul_T, if_pos (by omega), nonPosHom_monomial,
      show (-((-n).toNat : ℤ)) = n by omega]
  · have h0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk I (g.coeff n) = 0 := by
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      exact Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega) (coeff_mem_of_mem R I hg n)
    rw [h0, map_zero, zero_mul, map_zero, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.subschemeHom_apply
statement:
theorem subschemeHom_apply (f : extendedRees R I) :
    subschemeHom R I f = nonPosRetract (R ⧸ I) (reduceLaurent R I (f : R[T;T⁻¹]))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.nonPosHom_subschemeHom
statement:
theorem nonPosHom_subschemeHom (f : extendedRees R I) :
    nonPosHom (R ⧸ I) (subschemeHom R I f) = reduceLaurent R I (f : R[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:=
  nonPosHom_nonPosRetract_reduceLaurent R I f.2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.subschemeHom_surjective
statement: theorem subschemeHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (subschemeHom R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨f + g, map_add _ _ _⟩
  | monomial m c =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
    refine ⟨⟨LaurentPolynomial.C a * T (-(m : ℤ)),
      isExtendedRees_of_nonpos R I (by omega)⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [subschemeHom_apply]
    change nonPosRetract (R ⧸ I) (reduceLaurent R I (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T (-(m : ℤ)))) = _
    rw [reduceLaurent_C_mul_T, nonPosRetract_C_mul_T, if_pos (by omega),
      show (-(-(m : ℤ))).toNat = m by omega]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.subschemeHom_comp_structureMap
statement:
theorem subschemeHom_comp_structureMap :
    (subschemeHom R I).comp (structureMap R I).toRingHom =
      Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
  · refine nonPosHom_injective (R ⧸ I) ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, nonPosHom_subschemeHom]
    have h : (((structureMap R I).toRingHom (Polynomial.C a) : extendedRees R I) : R[T;T⁻¹]) =
        LaurentPolynomial.C a * T 0 := by
      have h1 : (structureMap R I) (Polynomial.C a) = algebraMap R (extendedRees R I) a := by
        rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
        exact (structureMap R I).commutes a
      change ((structureMap R I) (Polynomial.C a) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = _
      rw [h1, T_zero, mul_one]
      exact (C_eq_algebraMap a).symm
    rw [h, reduceLaurent_C_mul_T, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C,
      nonPosHom_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, T_zero, mul_one, invert_C]
  · refine nonPosHom_injective (R ⧸ I) ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, nonPosHom_subschemeHom]
    have hX : (((structureMap R I).toRingHom Polynomial.X : extendedRees R I) : R[T;T⁻¹]) =
        LaurentPolynomial.C 1 * T (-1) := by
      change ((structureMap R I) Polynomial.X : R[T;T⁻¹]) = _
      rw [structureMap_X, coe_parameter, map_one, one_mul]
    rw [hX, reduceLaurent_C_mul_T, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X,
      nonPosHom_apply, Polynomial.toLaurent_X, invert_T]
    simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.subschemeι_comp_toLine
statement:
theorem subschemeι_comp_toLine :
    subschemeι R I ≫ toLine R I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [subschemeι, toLine, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    subschemeHom_comp_structureMap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_zero_toLaurent
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_toLaurent (p : Polynomial R) :
    (Polynomial.toLaurent p).coeff (0 : ℤ) = p.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Polynomial.toLaurent p).coeff ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = p.coeff 0 := by
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.castEmbedding.injective _ 0
  simpa using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_zero_subschemeHom
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_subschemeHom (f : extendedRees R I) :
    (subschemeHom R I f).coeff 0 = Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((f : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonPosHom_subschemeHom R I f
  have h0 : (nonPosHom (R ⧸ I) (subschemeHom R I f)).coeff (0 : ℤ) =
      (subschemeHom R I f).coeff 0 := by
    rw [nonPosHom_apply]
    exact (invert_apply _ 0).trans (by rw [neg_zero]; exact coeff_zero_toLaurent (R ⧸ I) _)
  rw [← h0, h, coeff_reduceLaurent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.evalZero_subschemeHom
statement:
theorem evalZero_subschemeHom (f : extendedRees R I) :
    Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R ⧸ I) (subschemeHom R I f) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((f : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, ← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  exact coeff_zero_subschemeHom R I f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.specialFibreAugmentation_rees
statement:
theorem specialFibreAugmentation_rees (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    specialFibreAugmentation R I (reesToSpecialFibre R I q) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((q : Polynomial R).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (specialFibreEquiv R I).symm (reesToSpecialFibre R I q) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) q := by
    rw [← specialFibreEquiv_mk R I q, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedAugmentation R I ((specialFibreEquiv R I).symm _) = _
  rw [h, AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedAugmentation_mk]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.subschemeHom_specialFibre
statement:
theorem subschemeHom_specialFibre :
    (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R ⧸ I)).comp (subschemeHom R I) =
      (specialFibreAugmentation R I).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R I))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (parameter R I : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 0 = 0 := by
    rw [coe_parameter, ← one_mul (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]), ← map_one (LaurentPolynomial.C (R := R)),
      ← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (by decide)]
  have hpar : Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R ⧸ I) (subschemeHom R I (parameter R I)) = 0 := by
    rw [evalZero_subschemeHom, hp, map_zero]
  have hkill : ∀ x ∈ parameterIdeal R I,
      Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R ⧸ I) (subschemeHom R I x) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hx
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hpar, mul_zero]
  refine RingHom.ext fun f ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := reesToSpecialFibre_surjective R I (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R I) f)
  have hsub : f - reesToExtended R I q ∈ parameterIdeal R I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
    rw [← reesToSpecialFibre_apply R I q, hq]
  have hzero := hkill _ hsub
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, hzero, evalZero_subschemeHom, coe_reesToExtended,
    coeff_zero_toLaurent, ← hq, specialFibreAugmentation_rees]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.vertex_comp_normalConeIso
statement:
theorem vertex_comp_normalConeIso :
    AffineNormalCone.vertex R I ≫ (normalConeIsoSpecialFibre R I).hom =
      specialFibreVertex R I
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalConeIsoSpecialFibre, specialFibreVertex]
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom, Iso.symm_hom, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_inv,
    Scheme.Spec_map, Quiver.Hom.unop_op, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.origin_comp_subschemeι
statement:
theorem origin_comp_subschemeι :
    origin (R ⧸ I) ≫ subschemeι R I =
      AffineNormalCone.vertex R I ≫ normalConeι R I
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalConeι, ← Category.assoc, vertex_comp_normalConeIso, origin, subschemeι,
    specialFibreVertex, specialFibreι, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, subschemeHom_specialFibre]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurentAlg_apply
statement:
theorem mapLaurentAlg_apply (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) :
    mapLaurentAlg R B g = mapLaurent (algebraMap R B) g
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.laurentTensorMap_tmul
statement:
theorem laurentTensorMap_tmul (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) (b : B) :
    laurentTensorMap R B (g ⊗ₜ[R] b) =
      mapLaurent (algebraMap R B) g * LaurentPolynomial.C b
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurentTensorMap, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.laurentTensorMap_eq
statement:
theorem laurentTensorMap_eq :
    (laurentTensorMap R B).toLinearMap = (laurentTensorEquiv R B).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun g b ↦ ?_
  refine AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective ?_
  ext i
  have hl : (laurentTensorMap R B (g ⊗ₜ[R] b)).coeff i =
      b * algebraMap R B (g.coeff i) := by
    rw [laurentTensorMap_tmul, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_C_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul_apply,
      coeff_mapLaurent, smul_eq_mul]
  have hr : (laurentTensorEquiv R B (g ⊗ₜ[R] b)).coeff i = g.coeff i • b := by
    rw [laurentTensorEquiv]
    change ((AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv R).symm
      (TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft R B ℤ (g.coeff ⊗ₜ[R] b))).coeff i = _
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv_symm_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_ofCoeff,
      TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply]
  change (laurentTensorMap R B (g ⊗ₜ[R] b)).coeff i = (laurentTensorEquiv R B (g ⊗ₜ[R] b)).coeff i
  rw [hl, hr, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.laurentTensorMap_injective
statement: theorem laurentTensorMap_injective : Function.Injective (laurentTensorMap R B)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑(laurentTensorMap R B) = ⇑(laurentTensorEquiv R B) :=
    congrArg (fun f : (R[T;T⁻¹] ⊗[R] B) →ₗ[R] B[T;T⁻¹] ↦ ⇑f) (laurentTensorMap_eq R B)
  rw [h]
  exact (laurentTensorEquiv R B).injective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_mem_extendedRees
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_mem_extendedRees {g : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hg : g ∈ extendedRees R I) :
    mapLaurent (algebraMap R B) g ∈ extendedRees B (I.map (algebraMap R B))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [coeff_mapLaurent, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hg n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesTensorToLaurent_tmul
statement:
theorem reesTensorToLaurent_tmul (x : extendedRees R I) (b : B) :
    reesTensorToLaurent R I B (x ⊗ₜ[R] b) =
      mapLaurent (algebraMap R B) (x : R[T;T⁻¹]) * LaurentPolynomial.C b
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesTensorToLaurent, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesTensorToLaurent_eq
statement:
theorem reesTensorToLaurent_eq (z : (extendedRees R I) ⊗[R] B) :
    reesTensorToLaurent R I B z =
      laurentTensorMap R B (LinearMap.rTensor B (extendedRees R I).val.toLinearMap z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | tmul x b => rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, laurentTensorMap_tmul]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesTensorToLaurent_mem
statement:
theorem reesTensorToLaurent_mem (z : (extendedRees R I) ⊗[R] B) :
    reesTensorToLaurent R I B z ∈ extendedRees B (I.map (algebraMap R B))
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | tmul x b =>
    rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul, C_eq_algebraMap]
    exact mul_mem (mapLaurent_mem_extendedRees R I B x.2)
      ((extendedRees B (I.map (algebraMap R B))).algebraMap_mem b)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.monomial_mem_range_reesTensorToLaurent
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun a _ ↦ LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n ∈ (reesTensorToLaurent R I B).range)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    have hmem : LaurentPolynomial.C c * T n ∈ extendedRees R I :=
      (mem_extendedRees_iff R I _).mpr (isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I hc)
    refine ⟨(⟨LaurentPolynomial.C c * T n, hmem⟩ : extendedRees R I) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B), ?_⟩
    change reesTensorToLaurent R I B
      ((⟨LaurentPolynomial.C c * T n, hmem⟩ : extendedRees R I) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) = _
    rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul]
    change mapLaurent (algebraMap R B) (LaurentPolynomial.C c * T n) * LaurentPolynomial.C 1 = _
    rw [mapLaurent_C_mul_T, map_one, mul_one]
  · rw [map_zero, zero_mul]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [map_add, add_mul]
    exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro c x _ hx
    have h : LaurentPolynomial.C (c • x) * T n =
        reesTensorToLaurent R I B ((1 : extendedRees R I) ⊗ₜ[R] c) *
          (LaurentPolynomial.C x * T n) := by
      rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul, OneMemClass.coe_one, map_one, one_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
        mul_assoc]
    rw [h]
    exact mul_mem (Set.mem_range_self _) hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.extendedRees_le_range_reesTensorToLaurent
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_sum_support B g]
  refine sum_mem fun n _ ↦ ?_
  refine monomial_mem_range_reesTensorToLaurent R I B n ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_pow]
  exact hg n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesTensorToLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem reesTensorToLaurent_injective [Module.Flat R B] :
    Function.Injective (reesTensorToLaurent R I B)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Function.Injective (LinearMap.rTensor B (extendedRees R I).val.toLinearMap) :=
    Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ Subtype.val_injective
  intro z w hzw
  refine h ?_
  refine laurentTensorMap_injective R B ?_
  rw [← reesTensorToLaurent_eq, ← reesTensorToLaurent_eq, hzw]

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesTensorMap_surjective
statement: theorem reesTensorMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (reesTensorMap R I B)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := extendedRees_le_range_reesTensorToLaurent R I B y.2
  exact ⟨z, Subtype.ext hz⟩

    Function.Bijective (reesTensorMap R I B)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_reesBaseChange
statement:
theorem isPushout_reesBaseChange [Module.Flat R B] :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (extendedRees R I)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesBaseChangeHom R I B))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (extendedRees B (I.map (algebraMap R B)))))
proof:
:= by
  refine (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct R (extendedRees R I) B).of_iso (Iso.refl _)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (reesTensorEquiv R I B).toCommRingCatIso (by simp) (by simp)
    ?_ ?_
  · refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    change (reesTensorToLaurent R I B (x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = _
    rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul, map_one, mul_one]
    rfl
  · refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun b ↦ ?_)
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    change (reesTensorToLaurent R I B ((1 : extendedRees R I) ⊗ₜ[R] b) : B[T;T⁻¹]) = _
    rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul, OneMemClass.coe_one, map_one, one_mul, C_eq_algebraMap]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesBaseChange_isPullback
statement:
theorem reesBaseChange_isPullback [Module.Flat R B] :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesBaseChangeHom R I B)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap B (extendedRees B (I.map (algebraMap R B))))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (extendedRees R I))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _ (isPushout_reesBaseChange R I B)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesBaseChange_isPullback_isLocalization
statement:
theorem reesBaseChange_isPullback_isLocalization (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M B] :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesBaseChangeHom R I B)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap B (extendedRees B (I.map (algebraMap R B))))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (extendedRees R I))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
proof:
:=
  have : Module.Flat R B := IsLocalization.flat B M
  reesBaseChange_isPullback R I B

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.bundleTranslationCoaction_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bundleTranslationCoaction_ι (d : N →ₗ[A] F) (m : N) :
    bundleTranslationCoaction d (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A N m) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι A N m ⊗ₜ[A] 1 + 1 ⊗ₜ[A] SymmetricAlgebra.ι A F (d m)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_bundleTranslationCoaction_lift

theorem translate_bundleTranslationCoaction_lift (d : N →ₗ[A] F) (m : N →ₗ[A] B)
    (l : F →ₗ[A] B) :
    translate (bundleTranslationCoaction d) (SymmetricAlgebra.lift m) l =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (m + l.comp d)
proof:
:= by
  refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  simp [translate]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConeQuotient.translate_bundleTranslationCoaction
statement:
theorem translate_bundleTranslationCoaction (d : N →ₗ[A] F)
    (φ : SymmetricAlgebra A N →ₐ[A] B) (l : F →ₗ[A] B) :
    translate (bundleTranslationCoaction d) φ l =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm φ + l.comp d)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← SymmetricAlgebra.lift.apply_symm_apply φ]
  exact translate_bundleTranslationCoaction_lift d _ l

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gmAffineι_genericι
statement:
theorem gmAffineι_genericι :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ DeformationSpace.genericι Y J =
      genericFibreι Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) ≫ DeformationSpace.affineι Y J U
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmAffineι, DeformationSpace.affineι, Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.genericι,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, ← Category.assoc]
  change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊤ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).val.toRingHom) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono Γ(Y, U.1) (le_top : J.ideal U ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom)) ≫ _ = _
  rw [DeformationSpace.specMap_val_top_comp_inclusion Y J U]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gmAffineι_gmToBlowupGlobal
statement:
theorem gmAffineι_gmToBlowupGlobal :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ gmToBlowupGlobal Y J =
      gmToBlowup (J.ideal U) ≫ blowupAffineι Y J U
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmToBlowupGlobal, ← Category.assoc, gmAffineι_genericι,
    Category.assoc, affineι_uChartGlobal, ← Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gmAffineι_gmToTrivial
statement:
theorem gmAffineι_gmToTrivial :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y =
      gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1) ≫ lineAffineι Y U
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmAffineι, DeformationSpace.affineι, DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial, DeformationSpace.gmInvert,
    Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊤) U),
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map]
  rw [Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.genericι, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map]
  unfold lineAffineι
  suffices h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊤ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).val.toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((DeformationSpace.invertHom Y).app U).toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((DeformationSpace.inclusionHom (bot_le : (⊥ : Y.IdealSheafData) ≤ ⊤)).app U).toRingHom) =
      gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1) ≫ (lineAffineIso Y U).inv by
    simpa only [DeformationSpace.affineι, Category.assoc] using congrArg
      (fun f ↦ f ≫ DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊥ U) h
  apply (cancel_mono (lineAffineIso Y U).hom).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  dsimp only [lineAffineIso, asIso_hom]
  rw [gmToTrivialLine, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext ?_ ?_
  · intro a
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
    change invert ((structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) (Polynomial.C a) :
      extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) ⊥) : Γ(Y, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]) = algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1)[T;T⁻¹] (Polynomial.C a)
    rw [structureMap, Polynomial.aeval_C]
    simp [invert_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
  · simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
    change invert ((structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) Polynomial.X :
      extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) ⊥) : Γ(Y, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]) = algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1)[T;T⁻¹] Polynomial.X
    rw [structureMap_X, coe_parameter, invert_T]
    norm_num

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.blowupι_totalAffineι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem blowupι_totalAffineι :
    blowupι (J.ideal U) ≫ totalAffineι Y J U =
      blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J
proof:
:=
  pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.trivialι_totalAffineι

theorem trivialι_totalAffineι :
    trivialι (J.ideal U) ≫ totalAffineι Y J U =
      lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J
proof:
:=
  pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι_toBase
statement:
theorem lineAffineι_toBase :
    lineAffineι Y U ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ = lineAffineToOpen Y U ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineAffineι lineAffineToOpen DeformationSpace.affineι DeformationSpace.toBase
  rw [Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.affineι_toBase, ← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gm_affine_toOpen
statement:
theorem gm_affine_toOpen :
    gmToBlowup (J.ideal U) ≫ gluingApp Y J U =
      gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1) ≫ lineAffineToOpen Y U
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono U.1.ι).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [(isPullback_blowupAffine Y J U).w,
    ← lineAffineι_toBase, ← Category.assoc,
    ← gmAffineι_gmToBlowupGlobal, Category.assoc,
    gmToBlowupGlobal_toBase, ← gmToTrivial_toBase Y,
    ← Category.assoc, gmAffineι_gmToTrivial, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι_toBase
statement:
theorem totalAffineι_toBase :
    totalAffineι Y J U ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J = totalAffineToOpen Y J U ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · simp only [totalAffineι, totalGlobalToBase, totalAffineToOpen, blowupGlobalι,
      pushout.inl_desc_assoc, Category.assoc, pushout.inl_desc]
    exact (isPullback_blowupAffine Y J U).w.symm
  · simp only [totalAffineι, totalGlobalToBase, totalAffineToOpen, lineTι,
      pushout.inr_desc_assoc, Category.assoc, pushout.inr_desc]
    exact lineAffineι_toBase Y U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_lineAffine
statement:
theorem isPullback_lineAffine (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (lineAffineToOpen Y U) (lineAffineι Y U) U.1.ι
      (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  refine (DeformationSpace.isPullback_affine Y ⊥ U).of_iso (lineAffineIso Y U)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    unfold lineAffineToOpen
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    unfold lineAffineι
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gmAffineι_toBase
statement:
theorem gmAffineι_toBase :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊤ = gmAffineToOpen Y U ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  change ((gmAffineIso Y U).hom ≫ RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊤) U) ≫ _ = _
  unfold gmAffineToOpen DeformationSpace.toBase
  rw [Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.affineι_toBase, ← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_gmAffine
statement:
theorem isPullback_gmAffine :
    IsPullback (gmAffineToOpen Y U) (gmAffineι Y U) U.1.ι
      (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  refine (DeformationSpace.isPullback_affine Y ⊤ U).of_iso (gmAffineIso Y U).symm
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    unfold gmAffineToOpen
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    change _ = (gmAffineIso Y U).inv ≫ (gmAffineIso Y U).hom ≫ _
    simp
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gmToTrivialLine_toOpen
statement:
theorem gmToTrivialLine_toOpen :
    gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1) ≫ lineAffineToOpen Y U = gmAffineToOpen Y U
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono U.1.ι).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, ← lineAffineι_toBase, ← Category.assoc,
    ← gmAffineι_gmToTrivial, Category.assoc, gmToTrivial_toBase, gmAffineι_toBase]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_gmToTrivialLine
statement:
theorem isPullback_gmToTrivialLine :
    IsPullback (gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1)) (gmAffineι Y U)
      (lineAffineι Y U) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := isPullback_gmAffine Y U
  rw [← gmToTrivialLine_toOpen, ← gmToTrivial_toBase] at h
  exact h.of_right (gmAffineι_gmToTrivial Y U).symm (isPullback_lineAffine Y U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffine_points
statement:
theorem totalAffine_points (x : total (J.ideal U)) :
    (∃ b, blowupι (J.ideal U) b = x) ∨ (∃ l, trivialι (J.ideal U) l = x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
    (span (gmToBlowup (J.ideal U)) (gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1))) x
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · left
    refine ⟨gmToBlowup (J.ideal U) y, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (gmToBlowup (J.ideal U))
      (gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y, U.1))) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffine_cross_eq
statement:
theorem totalAffine_cross_eq (b : blowup (J.ideal U)) (l : Spec (.of Γ(Y, U.1)[X]))
    (h : (blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J) b =
      (lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J) l) :
    blowupι (J.ideal U) b = trivialι (J.ideal U) l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hl⟩ := pushout_inl_eq_inr (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J)
    (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y) h
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
    (isPullback_gmToTrivialLine Y U) l z hl.symm
  have hb : gmToBlowup (J.ideal U) w = b := by
    apply (blowupAffineι Y J U).isOpenEmbedding.injective
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← gmAffineι_gmToBlowupGlobal, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      hzw, hz]
    rfl
  rw [← hb, ← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
    gmToBlowup_blowupι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι_injective
statement: theorem totalAffineι_injective : Function.Injective (totalAffineι Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  rcases totalAffine_points Y J U x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · rcases totalAffine_points Y J U y with ⟨b', rfl⟩ | ⟨l', rfl⟩
    · have h' : (blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J) b =
          (blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J) b' := by
        simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_totalAffineι] using h
      exact congrArg (blowupι (J.ideal U))
        ((blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J).isOpenEmbedding.injective h')
    · apply totalAffine_cross_eq Y J U
      simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_totalAffineι,
        trivialι_totalAffineι] using h
  · rcases totalAffine_points Y J U y with ⟨b', rfl⟩ | ⟨l', rfl⟩
    · symm
      apply totalAffine_cross_eq Y J U
      simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_totalAffineι,
        trivialι_totalAffineι] using h.symm
    · have h' : (lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J) l =
          (lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J) l' := by
        simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, trivialι_totalAffineι] using h
      exact congrArg (trivialι (J.ideal U))
        ((lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J).isOpenEmbedding.injective h')

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι_isOpenMap
statement: theorem totalAffineι_isOpenMap : IsOpenMap (totalAffineι Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  have hset : (totalAffineι Y J U) '' S =
      (blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J) '' ((blowupι (J.ideal U)) ⁻¹' S) ∪
      (lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J) '' ((trivialι (J.ideal U)) ⁻¹' S) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rcases totalAffine_points Y J U x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
      · left
        refine ⟨b, hx, ?_⟩
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_totalAffineι]
      · right
        refine ⟨l, hx, ?_⟩
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, trivialι_totalAffineι]
    · rintro (⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩)
      · refine ⟨blowupι (J.ideal U) b, hb, ?_⟩
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_totalAffineι]
      · refine ⟨trivialι (J.ideal U) l, hl, ?_⟩
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, trivialι_totalAffineι]
  rw [hset]
  exact ((blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap _
    (hS.preimage (blowupι (J.ideal U)).continuous)).union
    ((lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineTι Y J).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap _
      (hS.preimage (trivialι (J.ideal U)).continuous))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal_points
statement:
theorem totalGlobal_points (x : totalGlobal Y J) :
    (∃ b, blowupGlobalι Y J b = x) ∨ (∃ l, lineTι Y J l = x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
    (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) x
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · left
    refine ⟨gmToBlowupGlobal Y J y, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w
      (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι_opensRange
statement:
theorem totalAffineι_opensRange :
    (totalAffineι Y J U).opensRange = totalGlobalToBase Y J ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
    change (totalGlobalToBase Y J) ((totalAffineι Y J U) a) ∈ U.1
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, totalAffineι_toBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact (totalAffineToOpen Y J U a).property
  · intro x hx
    rcases totalGlobal_points Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · change (totalGlobalToBase Y J) ((blowupGlobalι Y J) b) ∈ U.1 at hx
      have hb : (blowupGlobalToBase Y J) b ∈ U.1 := by
        simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, totalGlobalToBase, blowupGlobalι,
          pushout.inl_desc] using hx
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
        (isPullback_blowupAffine Y J U) ⟨blowupGlobalToBase Y J b, hb⟩ b rfl
      refine ⟨blowupι (J.ideal U) a, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_totalAffineι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (blowupGlobalι Y J) hab
    · change (totalGlobalToBase Y J) ((lineTι Y J) l) ∈ U.1 at hx
      have hl : (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥) l ∈ U.1 := by
        simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, totalGlobalToBase, lineTι,
          pushout.inr_desc] using hx
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hal⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
        (isPullback_lineAffine Y U) ⟨DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ l, hl⟩ l rfl
      refine ⟨trivialι (J.ideal U) a, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, trivialι_totalAffineι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hal]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_totalAffine
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.totalAffineToSpec_affineBaseι
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_totalAffineSpec
statement:
theorem isPullback_totalAffineSpec :
    IsPullback (totalAffineToSpec Y J U) (totalAffineι Y J U) (affineBaseι Y U)
      (totalGlobalToBase Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPullback_totalAffine Y J U).of_iso (Iso.refl _)
    (isAffineOpen Y U).isoSpec (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  · simp
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    unfold affineBaseι
    simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  · simp

statement:
theorem mappedInverseSelection_recovery {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟]
    (F : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) {P Q S : 𝒞} (a : P ⟶ Q) (e : S ≅ Q)
    (c : F.obj P ≅ F.obj Q) (h : F.map a = c.hom) :
    F.map (a ≫ e.inv) = (c ≪≫ F.mapIso e.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, h, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom]

      (polynomialToExceptionalHom I d) = (polynomialExceptionalNativeChartIso I d x).hom

    (nativeKernelPullbackHom (totalGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
      (comparisonGraded I) (irrelevant_comparison I) (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d)
    (polynomialExceptionalImageSelectionIso I d)
    (nativeProjKernelChartIso (totalGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
      (comparisonGraded I) (irrelevant_comparison I) (fun x : totalGrade I 1 ↦ x) d x)
    (nativeKernelPullbackHom_chartRecovery (totalGrade I)

    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map (comparisonGraded I) (irrelevant_comparison I))).map

statement:

    (b : Module.Basis κ (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I))) (d : ℤ) (i : κ) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x

      (Native.generatorOpen (totalGrade I)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily (symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I))) (totalGrade I)
          (normalBundleGradedComparison I x) (basisDegreeOneFamily b) i)).ι).map
      (quasiregularPolynomialCanonicalIso I x b d).hom =
    (quasiregularPolynomialNativeChartIso I x b d i).hom := by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.boundaryRestriction_chart
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryRestriction_chart {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    boundaryRestriction Y J h ≫ boundaryChart Y J V = boundaryChart Y J U
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (pullback.fst (toBase Y J) J.subschemeι)).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, boundaryChart_fst]
  rw [← Category.assoc, boundaryRestriction, grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_grMap, Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun k => grMap (J.ideal U) ≫ k)
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.w (GlobalBlowup.gluingData Y J).functor (homOfLE h))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.boundaryChart_isPullback
statement:
theorem boundaryChart_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (grMap (J.ideal U)) (boundaryChart Y J U)
      (affineι Y J U) (pullback.fst (toBase Y J) J.subschemeι)
proof:
:= by
  have ho := (grMap_isPullback (J.ideal U)).flip.paste_horiz
    (ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_subschemeCover Y J U)
  have ho' : IsPullback (grToCenter (J.ideal U) ≫ J.subschemeCover.f U)
      (grMap (J.ideal U)) J.subschemeι (affineι Y J U ≫ toBase Y J) := by
    simpa only [← (isPullback_affine Y J U).w, Category.assoc,
      IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι] using ho
  have hb := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (toBase Y J) J.subschemeι).flip
  have hh := boundaryChart_snd Y J U
  have ho'' : IsPullback (boundaryChart Y J U ≫ pullback.snd (toBase Y J) J.subschemeι)
      (grMap (J.ideal U)) J.subschemeι (affineι Y J U ≫ toBase Y J) := by
    rw [hh]
    exact ho'
  exact (ho''.of_right (boundaryChart_fst Y J U) hb).flip

statement:
theorem boundaryChart_base_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :

      (boundaryChart Y J U) U.1.ι
      (pullback.fst (toBase Y J) J.subschemeι ≫ toBase Y J)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.projectiveConeApp_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem projectiveConeApp_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    boundaryRestriction Y J h ≫ projectiveConeApp Y J V =
      projectiveConeApp Y J U ≫ Y.homOfLE h
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveConeApp
  rw [← Category.assoc, boundaryRestriction, grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_grMap, Category.assoc]
  have hn := (GlobalBlowup.gluingNatTrans Y J).naturality (homOfLE h)
  change ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (J.ideal V) (res Y h) (J.ideal U) _ ≫
    GlobalBlowup.gluingApp Y J V = GlobalBlowup.gluingApp Y J U ≫ Y.homOfLE h at hn
  erw [hn]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.boundaryRestriction_base_isPullback
statement:
theorem boundaryRestriction_base_isPullback {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPullback (boundaryRestriction Y J h) (projectiveConeApp Y J U)
      (projectiveConeApp Y J V) (Y.homOfLE h)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := boundaryChart Y J V) (h₂₂ := V.1.ι) ?_
    (projectiveConeApp_naturality Y J h) (boundaryChart_base_isPullback Y J V).flip
  rw [boundaryRestriction_chart, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
  exact (boundaryChart_base_isPullback Y J U).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.projectiveConeAffine_toCentre

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.projectiveConeBoundaryIso_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem projectiveConeBoundaryIso_toCentre :
    (projectiveConeBoundaryIso Y J).hom ≫ pullback.snd (toBase Y J) J.subschemeι =

proof:
:= by

  intro U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.projectiveConeAffine_toOther

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.projectiveConeToCentre_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem projectiveConeToCentre_toBase :

proof:

  have hc := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ J.subschemeι) (boundaryChart_snd Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionGlobal.projectiveConeAffine_toTotal
