name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeComparison_restriction
statement:
theorem sectionConeComparison_restriction {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (hU : Function.Bijective (nsToGr Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)))
    (hV : Function.Bijective (nsToGr Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V))) :
    (sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J U hU).toRingHom.comp
      (actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction Y J h) =
      (grMapOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp
        (sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J V hV).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  change (normalSheafCoordinateMap Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).comp
    ((nativeSectionCoordinates Y J U).toRingHom.comp _) = _
  rw [nativeSectionCoordinates_restriction, ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
    boundaryComparison_restriction, RingHom.comp_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeComparison_inverse
statement:
theorem sectionConeComparison_inverse

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeInverse_comparison
statement:
theorem sectionConeInverse_comparison

        (conormalChartSections Y J U))
proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeGradedInverse_original
statement:
theorem sectionConeGradedInverse_original :
    letI
proof:
:= nativeSections_free Y J U x
    letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U x
    letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
    letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
    sectionConeGradedInverse Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective =
      (nativeSectionGradedInverse Y J U x).comp (boundaryGradedInverse (J.ideal U) x) := by
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J U x
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U x
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeProjIso_original
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionConeProjIso_original :
    letI
proof:
:= nativeSections_free Y J U x
    letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U x
    letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
    letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
    (sectionConeProjIso Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective).hom =
      (nativeSectionProjectiveIso Y J U x).inv ≫ (conormalBoundaryProjIso (J.ideal U) x).inv := by
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J U x
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U x
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  change Proj.map (sectionConeGradedInverse Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective) _ = _
  exact (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (sectionConeGradedInverse_original Y J U x) _).trans
    (Proj.map_comp _ _ _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeToGlobal_original
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionConeToGlobal_original :
    letI
proof:
:= nativeSections_free Y J U x
    letI := nativeSections_finite Y J U x
    letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
    letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
    sectionConeToGlobal Y J U x.nsToGr_bijective = nativeSectionChartToCone Y J U x := by
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J U x

  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x

  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeGradedRestriction_square
statement:
theorem sectionConeGradedRestriction_square :
    (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J U hU).comp (nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h) =
      (grRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J V hV)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (sectionConeComparison_restriction Y J h hU hV)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeGradedRestriction_route
statement:
theorem sectionConeGradedRestriction_route :
    nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h = (sectionConeGradedInverse Y J U hU).comp
      ((grRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)).comp (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J V hV))
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply (sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J U hU).injective
  change sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J U hU ((nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h) p) =
    sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J U hU
      ((sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J U hU).symm
        ((grMapOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
          (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)) (sectionConeComparisonEquiv Y J V hV p)))
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (sectionConeComparison_restriction Y J h hU hV) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeRestriction_irrelevant
statement:
theorem sectionConeRestriction_irrelevant :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      (conormalChartSections Y J U)) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
      (conormalChartSections Y J V))).map (nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J V hV)
    (sectionConeGradedInverse Y J V hV) (sectionConeComparison_inverse Y J V hV)
  have hu := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (sectionConeGradedInverse Y J U hU)
    (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J U hU) (sectionConeInverse_comparison Y J U hU)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hv
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h))
  have hr := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ht hu
  rw [← sectionConeGradedRestriction_route Y J h hU hV] at hr
  exact hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSectionProjRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem refinedSectionProjRestriction_comparison :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) ≫ (sectionConeProjIso Y J V hV).inv =
      (sectionConeProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫ refinedSectionProjRestriction Y J h hU hV
proof:
:= by
  exact proj_map_actual_square _ _ _ _ (nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h)
    (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J V hV) (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J U hU)
    (grRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h))
    (sectionConeRestriction_irrelevant Y J h hU hV)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionConeComparison_inverse Y J V hV))
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionConeComparison_inverse Y J U hU))
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h))
    (sectionConeGradedRestriction_square Y J h hU hV)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSectionProjRestriction_toGlobal
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem refinedSectionProjRestriction_toGlobal :
    refinedSectionProjRestriction Y J h hU hV ≫ sectionConeToGlobal Y J V hV =
      sectionConeToGlobal Y J U hU
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (sectionConeProjIso Y J U hU).inv).mp
  change (sectionConeProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫
      refinedSectionProjRestriction Y J h hU hV ≫
      (sectionConeProjIso Y J V hV).hom ≫ projectiveConeAffineι Y J V =
    (sectionConeProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫
      (sectionConeProjIso Y J U hU).hom ≫ projectiveConeAffineι Y J U
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← refinedSectionProjRestriction_comparison]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.w (projectiveConeGluingData Y J).functor (homOfLE h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.conormalCommonSections_free
statement:
theorem conormalCommonSections_free (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.conormalCommonSections_finite
statement:
theorem conormalCommonSections_finite (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (h : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedCentreImage_le
statement:
theorem refinedCentreImage_le (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    (J.subschemeCover.f U) ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := iq
  let g : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) ⟶ J.subscheme := C.chartCover.f i
  let ig : IsOpenImmersion g := C.chartCover.map_prop i
  exact @spectrumRefinementImage_le (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
    (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    J.subscheme q g iq ig (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h) (centreRefinement_toCentre Y J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSections_free
statement:
theorem refinedSections_free (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.Free (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalChartSections Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := iq
  let W := @spectrumImageAffineOpen (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq
  have hw : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i := refinedCentreImage_le Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := conormalCommonSections_free Y J C i W hw
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (@spectrumImageSectionsEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq (ConormalSheaf.conormal J))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSections_finite
statement:
theorem refinedSections_finite (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    Module.Finite (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalChartSections Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let iq : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := iq
  let W := @spectrumImageAffineOpen (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq
  have hw : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i := refinedCentreImage_le Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) ((ConormalSheaf.conormal J).val.obj (Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := conormalCommonSections_finite Y J C i W hw
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective (@spectrumImageSectionsEquiv (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme q iq (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)).toLinearMap (spectrumImageSectionsEquiv q (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)).surjective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedCotangent_free
statement:
theorem refinedCotangent_free (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedCotangent_finite
statement:
theorem refinedCotangent_finite (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSectionToGlobal_independent
statement:
theorem refinedSectionToGlobal_independent (i j : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (hi : U ≤ C.U i) (hj : U ≤ C.U j) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSectionRestriction_toGlobal
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem refinedSectionRestriction_toGlobal (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    refinedSectionRestriction Y J C i U h ≫ nativeSectionChartToCone Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) =
      refinedSectionToGlobal Y J C i U h
proof:
:= by
  letI := refinedSections_free Y J C i U h
  letI := refinedSections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := refinedCotangent_free Y J C i U h
  letI := refinedCotangent_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)
  exact (congrArg (fun a => refinedSectionRestriction Y J C i U h ≫ a)
    (sectionConeToGlobal_original Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).symm).trans
    (refinedSectionProjRestriction_toGlobal Y J h
      (NormalCone.bijective_nsToGr_of_le Y J h (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective) (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionCone_degreeZero_square
statement:
theorem sectionCone_degreeZero_square
    (hU : Function.Bijective (nsToGr Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))) :
    (Proj.degreeZeroMap (𝒜 := SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      (conormalChartSections Y J U)) (ℬ := grGrade (J.ideal U))
      (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J U hU)).comp
        (symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (M := conormalChartSections Y J U)) =
      grZero (J.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change normalSheafCoordinateMap Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)
    (symmetricCoordinateMap (conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U)
      (symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (M := conormalChartSections Y J U) a)) =
      (grZero (J.ideal U) a : associatedGradedRing Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
  rw [symmetricChartZero_val, (symmetricCoordinateMap _).commutes, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.sectionConeProjIso_inv_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionConeProjIso_inv_toQuotient
    (hU : Function.Bijective (nsToGr Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))) :
    (sectionConeProjIso Y J U hU).inv ≫
      symmetricChartToSpec (Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (M := conormalChartSections Y J U) =
        grToCenter (J.ideal U)
proof:
:=
  proj_map_zero_structure _ _ (sectionConeGradedComparison Y J U hU)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionConeComparison_inverse Y J U hU))
    (symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (M := conormalChartSections Y J U))
    (grZero (J.ideal U)) (sectionCone_degreeZero_square Y J U hU)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSectionConeIso_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem refinedSectionConeIso_toQuotient (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    (refinedSectionConeIso Y J C i U h).hom ≫ grToCenter (J.ideal U) =
      refinedSectionToQuotient Y J C i U h
proof:
:= by

  letI := refinedSections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := refinedCotangent_free Y J C i U h
  letI := refinedCotangent_finite Y J C i U h
  apply (cancel_epi (refinedSectionConeIso Y J C i U h).inv).mp
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  exact (sectionConeProjIso_inv_toQuotient Y J U
    (NormalCone.bijective_nsToGr_of_le Y J h (C.gens i).nsToGr_bijective)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedSection_isPullback
statement:
theorem refinedSection_isPullback (i : C.J) (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :

    (refinedSectionConeIso Y J C i U h).symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [refinedSectionToGlobal, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  · simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rw [← refinedSectionConeIso_toQuotient Y J C i U h]

  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedImageChartIso_original
statement:
theorem refinedImageChartIso_original (i : C.J)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    refinedNativeToFrame Y J C i U h =
      (refinedImageChartIso Y J C i U h).hom ≫
        refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C i U h
proof:
:= by
  let E := ConormalSheaf.conormal J
  let D := nativeFrameCover Y J C
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let g : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f (C.U i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion g := J.subschemeCover.map_prop (C.U i)
  let W := refinedImageOpen Y J U
  let hw := refinedImage_le Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    conormalCommonSections_free Y J C i W hw
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    conormalCommonSections_finite Y J C i W hw
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,g ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (g ''ᵁ ⊤))) := D.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,g ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (g ''ᵁ ⊤))) := D.sectionModule_finite i
  letI := refinedSections_free Y J C i U h
  letI := refinedSections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := nativeSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := nativeSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI : Module.Free (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj E)) := refinedSections_free Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Finite (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj E)) := refinedSections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Free (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj E)) := nativeSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI : Module.Finite (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj E)) := nativeSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  let k := GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h
  let comm := InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.centreRefinement_toCentre Y J h
  have hs : Submodule.span Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (Set.range (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction J.subscheme q g k comm E)) = ⊤ := by
    exact D.restriction_spans i W.1 hw
  have hn : spectrumImageNativeGradedRestriction J.subscheme q g k comm E =
      nativeSectionGradedRestriction Y J h := refinedCentreGradedRestriction_eq_actual Y J h
  have hsquare := spectrumImageProjRestriction_square J.subscheme q g k comm E hs
  have hm := ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr hn
    (spectrumImageNativeRestriction_irrelevant J.subscheme q g k comm E hs)
  exact (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ Proj.map (spectrumImageCoordinateGradedMap J.subscheme g E)
    (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant J.subscheme g E)) hm).symm.trans hsquare

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedOriginalRestrictions_toGlobal
statement:
theorem refinedOriginalRestrictions_toGlobal (i j : C.J)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hi : U ≤ C.U i) (hj : U ≤ C.U j) :
    refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C i U hi ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C i =
      refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C j
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (refinedImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom).mp
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun a => a ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C i)
      (refinedImageChartIso_original Y J C i U hi).symm).trans
    ((refinedNativeToFrame_toGlobal Y J C i U hi).trans
    ((refinedSectionToGlobal_independent Y J C i j U hi hj).trans
    ((refinedNativeToFrame_toGlobal Y J C j U hj).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun a => a ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C j)
      (refinedImageChartIso_original Y J C j U hj)).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ (refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫
        nativeFrameToCone Y J C j))
        (refinedImageChartIso_hom_independent Y J C i j U hi hj).symm)))))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.originalRestrictionToCone_isPullback
statement:
theorem originalRestrictionToCone_isPullback (i : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hi : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    IsPullback (originalRestrictionToCone Y J C i W hi)
      (originalRestrictionSourceToBase Y J C i W hi)
      (projectiveConeToCentre Y J) W.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  let D := nativeFrameCover Y J C
  have hp := (D.isPullback_directRestrictionChartMap i i W hi hi).paste_horiz
    (nativeFrameToCone_open_isPullback Y J C i)
  have hb : J.subscheme.homOfLE hi ≫ (D.U i).ι = W.1.ι := Scheme.homOfLE_ι J.subscheme hi
  exact (congrArg (fun b => IsPullback (originalRestrictionToCone Y J C i W hi)
    (originalRestrictionSourceToBase Y J C i W hi)
    (projectiveConeToCentre Y J) b) hb).mp hp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_isPullback
statement:
theorem nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_isPullback (i j : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (hi : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)
    (a : CentreAmbientRefinementIndex Y J C i j W) :
    IsPullback (nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C i j W hi a)
      (refinedSectionToQuotient Y J C i a.1 a.2.1)
      (originalRestrictionSourceToBase Y J C i W hi)
      (centreRefinementChartMap Y J C i j W a)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := originalRestrictionToCone Y J C i W hi)
    (h₂₂ := W.1.ι) ?_ (nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toBase Y J C i j W hi a)
    (originalRestrictionToCone_isPullback Y J C i W hi)
  exact (congrArg₂ (fun top bottom => IsPullback top
      (refinedSectionToQuotient Y J C i a.1 a.2.1)
      (projectiveConeToCentre Y J) bottom)
    (nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toCone Y J C i j W hi a)
    (centreRefinementChartMap_toCentre Y J C i j W a)).mpr
      (refinedSection_isPullback Y J C i a.1 a.2.1)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.refinedNativeToFrame_toScheme_independent
statement:
theorem refinedNativeToFrame_toScheme_independent (i j : C.J)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hi : U ≤ C.U i) (hj : U ≤ C.U j) :
    refinedNativeToFrame Y J C i U hi ≫ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartι i =
      refinedNativeToFrame Y J C j U hj ≫ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartι j
proof:
:= by
  let D := nativeFrameCover Y J C
  have hd := D.directRestrictionChartMap_chartι i j (refinedImageOpen Y J U)
    (refinedImage_le Y J C i U hi) (refinedImage_le Y J C j U hj)
  calc
    _ = (refinedImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom ≫
        (refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C i U hi ≫ D.chartι i) :=
      (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ D.chartι i) (refinedImageChartIso_original Y J C i U hi)).trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _)
    _ = (refinedImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom ≫
        (refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ D.chartι j) :=
      congrArg (fun a => (refinedImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom ≫ a) hd
    _ = (refinedImageChartIso Y J C j U hj).hom ≫
        (refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ D.chartι j) :=
      congrArg (fun a => a ≫ (refinedOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ D.chartι j))
        (refinedImageChartIso_hom_independent Y J C i j U hi hj)
    _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ D.chartι j) (refinedImageChartIso_original Y J C j U hj).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_swap
statement:
theorem nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_swap (i j : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (hi : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U i)
    (hj : W.1 ≤ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).U j)
    (a : CentreAmbientRefinementIndex Y J C i j W) :
    nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C i j W hi a =
      nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C j i W hj
        (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a)
proof:

  apply (cancel_mono (originalRestrictionSourceToScheme Y J C i W hi)).mp
  exact (nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toScheme Y J C i j W hi a).trans
    ((refinedNativeToFrame_toScheme_independent Y J C i j a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2.1).trans
    ((nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toScheme Y J C j i W hj
      (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a)).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun f => nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource Y J C j i W hj
      (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a) ≫ f)
      (originalRestrictionSourceToScheme_independent Y J C i j W hi hj).symm)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.originalRestrictionToCone_independent
statement:
theorem originalRestrictionToCone_independent (i j : C.J) (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)

    ((nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_toCone Y J C j i W hj
      (centreAmbientRefinement_swap Y J C i j W a)).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun f => f ≫ originalRestrictionToCone Y J C j W hj)
      (nativeCentreRefinementToOriginalSource_swap Y J C i j W hi hj a).symm)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeFrame_commonBasic_compatible

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeFrame_overlap_compatible
statement:
theorem nativeFrame_overlap_compatible (i j : C.J) :
    (nativeFrameCover Y J C).overlapToChart i j ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C i =
      ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).transition i j ≫ (nativeFrameCover Y J C).overlapToChart j i) ≫
        nativeFrameToCone Y J C j
proof:
:= by
  let D := nativeFrameCover Y J C
  apply (D.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).hom_ext
  intro c
  have hl := D.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft i j c
  have hr := (D.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition_assoc i j c (D.overlapToChart j i)).trans
    (D.localTransition_toChart i j c)
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C i) hl).symm.trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun f => (D.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ f)
      (nativeFrame_commonBasic_compatible Y J C i j c)).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ nativeFrameToCone Y J C j) hr).symm.trans
      (by simp only [Category.assoc]; rfl))))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.chart_nativeFrameToGlobalCone
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem chart_nativeFrameToGlobalCone (i : C.J) :

      nativeFrameToCone Y J C i
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeFrameToGlobalCone_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeFrameToGlobalCone_toCentre :
    nativeFrameToGlobalCone Y J C ≫ projectiveConeToCentre Y J =
      (nativeFrameCover Y J C).toBase
proof:
:= by
  apply (nativeFrameCover Y J C).cover.hom_ext
  intro i
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ projectiveConeToCentre Y J)
      (chart_nativeFrameToGlobalCone Y J C i)).trans
    ((nativeFrameToCone_toCentre Y J C i).trans
      ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartι_toBase i).symm))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.chart_nativeFrameToGlobalCone_isPullback
statement:
theorem chart_nativeFrameToGlobalCone_isPullback (i : C.J) :
    IsPullback ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).chartι i) (𝟙 ((nativeFrameCover Y J C).chart i))
      (nativeFrameToGlobalCone Y J C) (nativeFrameToCone Y J C i)
proof:
:= by
  let D := nativeFrameCover Y J C
  refine IsPullback.of_bot ?_ ?_ (nativeFrameToCone_open_isPullback Y J C i)
  · exact (congrArg₂ (fun left right => IsPullback (D.chartι i) left right (D.U i).ι)
      (Category.id_comp (D.chartToBase i)).symm
      (nativeFrameToGlobalCone_toCentre Y J C).symm).mp (D.isPullback_chartι_toBase i)
  · exact (chart_nativeFrameToGlobalCone Y J C i).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeFrameConeIso_chart

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.nativeFrameConeIso_toCentre

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.intrinsicBoundaryConeIso_toCentre

@[reassoc] theorem intrinsicBoundaryConeIso_toCentre :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.intrinsicBoundaryFrameChartι_coneIso

    ((intrinsicToNativeFrameIso Y J C).hom ≫ (nativeFrameConeIso Y J C).hom) = _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleOverlap.intrinsicBoundaryFrameChartι_toCentre

      ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ projectiveConeToCentre Y J)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isExtendedRees_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem isExtendedRees_C_mul_T {a : R} {n : ℤ} (ha : a ∈ I ^ n.toNat) :
    IsExtendedRees R I (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    exact ha
  · exact zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isExtendedRees_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem isExtendedRees_of_nonpos {a : R} {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 0) :
    IsExtendedRees R I (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n)
proof:
:= by
  apply isExtendedRees_C_mul_T
  rw [Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr hn, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
  exact Submodule.mem_top

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isExtendedRees_C
statement: theorem isExtendedRees_C (a : R) : IsExtendedRees R I (LaurentPolynomial.C a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using isExtendedRees_of_nonpos R I (a := a) (n := 0) le_rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isExtendedRees_toLaurent
statement:
theorem isExtendedRees_toLaurent {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p ∈ reesAlgebra I) :
    IsExtendedRees R I p.toLaurent
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hn
    have h : p.toLaurent.coeff m = p.coeff m := by
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
      exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.castEmbedding.injective _ m
    rw [h, Int.toNat_natCast]
    exact (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I p).mp hp m
  · have h : p.toLaurent.coeff n = 0 := by
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
      apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
      rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
      have : (0 : ℤ) ≤ m := Int.natCast_nonneg m
      change (m : ℤ) = n at hm
      omega
    rw [h]
    exact zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mem_extendedRees_iff
statement:
theorem mem_extendedRees_iff (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) :
    f ∈ extendedRees R I ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, f.coeff n ∈ I ^ n.toNat
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_of_mem {f : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f ∈ extendedRees R I) (n : ℤ) :
    f.coeff n ∈ I ^ n.toNat
proof: := hf n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_parameter
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_parameter : (parameter R I : R[T;T⁻¹]) = T (-1)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_degreeOne
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_degreeOne (a : I) :
    (degreeOne R I a : R[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C (a : R) * T 1
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.parameter_mul_degreeOne
statement:
theorem parameter_mul_degreeOne (a : I) :
    parameter R I * degreeOne R I a = algebraMap R (extendedRees R I) a
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change T (-1) * (LaurentPolynomial.C (a : R) * T 1) = algebraMap R R[T;T⁻¹] (a : R)
  rw [T_mul, mul_T_assoc, ← C_eq_algebraMap]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.parameter_isSMulRegular
statement: theorem parameter_isSMulRegular : IsSMulRegular (extendedRees R I) (parameter R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h' : (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) = T (-1) * (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact (isUnit_T (-1)).mul_left_cancel h'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.structureMap_X
statement: @[simp] theorem structureMap_X : structureMap R I Polynomial.X = parameter R I
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.aeval_X _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coeff_mul_T
statement: theorem coeff_mul_T (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) (n m : ℤ) : (f * T n).coeff m = f.coeff (m - n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_eq_coeff_mul (x := f) (m := n) (r := (1 : R))
    (m₁ := m) (m - n) (fun m' _ ↦ by constructor <;> intro h <;> omega)
  rw [mul_one] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.eq_sum_support
statement:
theorem eq_sum_support (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) :
    f = ∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single f]
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
  exact single_eq_C_mul_T _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_reesToExtended
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_reesToExtended (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    (reesToExtended R I p : R[T;T⁻¹]) = Polynomial.toLaurent (p : Polynomial R)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesToSpecialFibre_apply
statement:
theorem reesToSpecialFibre_apply (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesToSpecialFibre R I p = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesToExtended R I p)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mk_eq_zero_of_eq_parameter_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  exact ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, Subtype.ext hf.symm⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.exists_reesToExtended_add_parameter_mul
statement:
theorem exists_reesToExtended_add_parameter_mul (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) (hf : f ∈ extendedRees R I) :
    ∃ (p : reesAlgebra I) (h : R[T;T⁻¹]), h ∈ extendedRees R I ∧
      f = Polynomial.toLaurent (p : Polynomial R) + h * T (-1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := f.coeff.support
  let p₀ : Polynomial R :=
    ∑ n ∈ s with 0 ≤ n, Polynomial.monomial n.toNat (f.coeff n)
  have hp₀ : p₀ ∈ reesAlgebra I := by
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun n hn ↦ ?_
    exact reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (hf n)
  let h : R[T;T⁻¹] := ∑ n ∈ s with ¬ 0 ≤ n, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T (n + 1)
  have hh : h ∈ extendedRees R I := by
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun n hn ↦ ?_
    have hn' : ¬ 0 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    exact isExtendedRees_of_nonpos R I (by omega)
  refine ⟨⟨p₀, hp₀⟩, h, hh, ?_⟩
  have e1 : Polynomial.toLaurent p₀ =
      ∑ n ∈ s with 0 ≤ n, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n := by
    simp only [p₀, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
    have hn' : 0 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_X_pow,
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn']
  have e2 : h * T (-1) = ∑ n ∈ s with ¬ 0 ≤ n, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n := by
    simp only [h, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
    rw [mul_T_assoc]
    congr 2
    omega
  rw [e1, e2, Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not]
  exact eq_sum_support R f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.reesToSpecialFibre_surjective
statement: theorem reesToSpecialFibre_surjective : Function.Surjective (reesToSpecialFibre R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨p, h, hh, hf⟩ := exists_reesToExtended_add_parameter_mul R I f f.2
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  rw [reesToSpecialFibre_apply]
  have hmem : h * T (-1) ∈ extendedRees R I := (extendedRees R I).mul_mem hh (parameter R I).2
  have hsplit : f = reesToExtended R I p + ⟨h * T (-1), hmem⟩ := Subtype.ext hf
  rw [hsplit, map_add, mk_eq_zero_of_eq_parameter_mul R I (f := ⟨h * T (-1), hmem⟩) hh rfl,
    add_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mem_map_of_forall_coeff_mem_pow_succ
statement:
theorem mem_map_of_forall_coeff_mem_pow_succ (q : reesAlgebra I)
    (hq : ∀ m : ℕ, (q : Polynomial R).coeff m ∈ I ^ (m + 1)) :
    q ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ (i : ℕ) (c : R), c ∈ I ^ (i + 1) →
      ∃ hc : c ∈ I ^ i, (⟨Polynomial.monomial i c, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc⟩ :
        reesAlgebra I) ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I := by
    intro i c hc
    rw [pow_succ'] at hc
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hc ?_ ?_
    · intro a ha b hb
      refine ⟨Ideal.mul_mem_left _ a hb, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨Polynomial.monomial i (a * b),
            reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ a hb)⟩ : reesAlgebra I) =
          algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) a * ⟨Polynomial.monomial i b,
            reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hb⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change Polynomial.monomial i (a * b) = Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.monomial i b
        rw [Polynomial.C_mul_monomial]
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)
    · rintro x y ⟨hx, hx'⟩ ⟨hy, hy'⟩
      refine ⟨Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨Polynomial.monomial i (x + y),
            reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy)⟩ : reesAlgebra I) =
          ⟨Polynomial.monomial i x, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hx⟩ +
            ⟨Polynomial.monomial i y, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hy⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change Polynomial.monomial i (x + y) =
          Polynomial.monomial i x + Polynomial.monomial i y
        rw [map_add]
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx' hy'
  have hsum : q = ∑ i ∈ (q : Polynomial R).support,
      (⟨Polynomial.monomial i ((q : Polynomial R).coeff i),
        reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr ((mem_reesAlgebra_iff I _).mp q.2 i)⟩ : reesAlgebra I) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact Polynomial.as_sum_support (q : Polynomial R)
  rw [hsum]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := key i _ (hq i)
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ker_reesToSpecialFibre
statement:
theorem ker_reesToSpecialFibre :
    RingHom.ker (reesToSpecialFibre R I) = Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, reesToSpecialFibre_apply]
  constructor
  · intro hq
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hq
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hq
    have ha' : (a : R[T;T⁻¹]) * T (-1) = Polynomial.toLaurent (q : Polynomial R) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ha
    apply mem_map_of_forall_coeff_mem_pow_succ
    intro m
    have hm : (Polynomial.toLaurent (q : Polynomial R)).coeff m = (q : Polynomial R).coeff m := by
      rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
      exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.castEmbedding.injective _ m
    rw [← hm, ← ha', coeff_mul_T]
    have := a.2 (m - (-1))
    have hexp : (m - (-1) : ℤ).toNat = m + 1 := by omega
    rwa [hexp] at this
  · intro hq
    have hcoeff := AffineNormalCone.coeff_mem_pow_succ_of_mem_map_rees R I hq
    let h : R[T;T⁻¹] := Polynomial.toLaurent (q : Polynomial R) * T 1
    have hh : h ∈ extendedRees R I := by
      intro m
      rw [coeff_mul_T]
      rcases le_or_gt 1 m with hm | hm
      · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, m - 1 = k := ⟨(m - 1).toNat, by omega⟩
        rw [hk]
        have hcast : (Polynomial.toLaurent (q : Polynomial R)).coeff k =
            (q : Polynomial R).coeff k := by
          rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
          exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.castEmbedding.injective _ k
        rw [hcast]
        have hexp : m.toNat = k + 1 := by omega
        rw [hexp]
        exact hcoeff k
      · have : (Polynomial.toLaurent (q : Polynomial R)).coeff (m - 1) = 0 := by
          rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
          apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
          rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
          change (k : ℤ) = m - 1 at hk
          omega
        rw [this]
        exact zero_mem _
    apply mk_eq_zero_of_eq_parameter_mul R I hh
    change Polynomial.toLaurent (q : Polynomial R) = h * T (-1)
    simp only [h, mul_T_assoc]
    simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.specialFibreEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem specialFibreEquiv_mk (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    specialFibreEquiv R I (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = reesToSpecialFibre R I p
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isLocalization_parameter
statement:
theorem isLocalization_parameter : IsLocalization.Away (parameter R I) R[T;T⁻¹] where
  map_units
proof:
:= by
    rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ht
    change IsUnit ((parameter R I ^ n : extendedRees R I) : R[T;T⁻¹])
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_pow, coe_parameter, T_pow]
    exact isUnit_T _
  surj := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨n, f', hf⟩ := f.exists_T_pow
    let N : ℕ := f'.natDegree
    let g : R[T;T⁻¹] := Polynomial.toLaurent f' * T (-((n + N : ℕ) : ℤ))
    have hg : g ∈ extendedRees R I := by
      intro m
      rw [coeff_mul_T]
      rcases le_or_gt m 0 with hm | hm
      · rw [Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr hm, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
        exact Submodule.mem_top
      · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, m - -((n + N : ℕ) : ℤ) = k := ⟨(m + (n + N : ℕ)).toNat, by omega⟩
        rw [hk]
        have hcast : (Polynomial.toLaurent f').coeff k = f'.coeff k := by
          rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
          exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.castEmbedding.injective _ k
        rw [hcast, Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]
        exact zero_mem _
    refine ⟨(⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨parameter R I ^ N, N, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    change f * ((parameter R I ^ N : extendedRees R I) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = g
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_pow, coe_parameter, T_pow]
    simp only [g]
    rw [hf, mul_T_assoc]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  exists_of_eq := by
    intro x y h
    exact ⟨1, by rw [Subtype.ext (h : (x : R[T;T⁻¹]) = y)]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.range_genericFibreι
statement:
theorem range_genericFibreι :
    Set.range (genericFibreι R I) = (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (parameter R I)).1
proof:
:=
  haveI := isLocalization_parameter R I
  PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range R[T;T⁻¹] (parameter R I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.evalOneLaurent_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem evalOneLaurent_C_mul_T (a : R) (n : ℤ) :
    evalOneLaurent R (LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n) = a
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.evalOneLaurent_T

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.evalOne_apply

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.evalOne_parameter

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.exists_T_sub_one_eq
statement:
theorem exists_T_sub_one_eq (m : ℤ) : ∃ g : R[T;T⁻¹], T m - 1 = (T (-1) - 1) * g ∧
    ∀ a ∈ I ^ m.toNat, LaurentPolynomial.C a * g ∈ extendedRees R I
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, by simp, fun a _ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [mul_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hmem⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨g - T ((i : ℤ) + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : ((T (-1) - 1 : R[T;T⁻¹])) * T ((i : ℤ) + 1) = T (i : ℤ) - T ((i : ℤ) + 1) := by
        rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← T_add]
        congr 2
        ring
      rw [mul_sub, ← hg, h1]
      ring
    · intro a ha
      rw [mul_sub]
      refine (extendedRees R I).sub_mem (hmem a ?_) (isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I ha)
      exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) ha
  | pred i ih =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hmem⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨g + T (-(i : ℤ)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : ((T (-1) - 1 : R[T;T⁻¹])) * T (-(i : ℤ)) = T (-(i : ℤ) - 1) - T (-(i : ℤ)) := by
        rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← T_add]
        congr 2
        ring
      rw [mul_add, ← hg, h1]
      ring
    · intro a _
      rw [mul_add]
      refine (extendedRees R I).add_mem (hmem a ?_) (isExtendedRees_of_nonpos R I (by omega))
      have h0 : (-(i : ℤ)).toNat = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
      exact Submodule.mem_top

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.exists_eq_parameter_sub_one_mul
statement:
theorem exists_eq_parameter_sub_one_mul {f : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hf : f ∈ extendedRees R I)
    (h0 : evalOneLaurent R f = 0) :
    ∃ g ∈ extendedRees R I, f = (T (-1) - 1) * g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose g hg hmem using fun m ↦ exists_T_sub_one_eq R I m
  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * g n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ hmem n _ (hf n)
  · have heval : evalOneLaurent R f = ∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, f.coeff n := by
      conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_support R f]
      rw [map_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ evalOneLaurent_C_mul_T R _ _
    have hsum : f = ∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * (T n - 1) := by
      have : ∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * (T n - 1) =
          ∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n -
            LaurentPolynomial.C (∑ n ∈ f.coeff.support, f.coeff n) := by
        rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ by rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
      rw [this, ← heval, h0, map_zero, sub_zero]
      exact eq_sum_support R f
    conv_lhs => rw [hsum]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hg n]
    ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ker_evalOne
statement: theorem ker_evalOne : RingHom.ker (evalOne R I) = Ideal.span {parameter R I - 1}
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  constructor
  · intro h0
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := exists_eq_parameter_sub_one_mul R I f.2 h0
    refine ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change g * (T (-1) - 1) = (f : R[T;T⁻¹])
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact hfg.symm
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [map_mul, map_sub, evalOne_parameter, map_one, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_structureMap
statement:
theorem coe_structureMap (q : Polynomial R) :
    (structureMap R I q : R[T;T⁻¹]) = invert (Polynomial.toLaurent q)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (extendedRees R I).val.comp (structureMap R I) =
      (invert (R := R)).toAlgHom.comp Polynomial.toLaurentAlg := by
    apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
    simp [structureMap]
  exact congrArg (fun φ : Polynomial R →ₐ[R] R[T;T⁻¹] ↦ φ q) h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_lineRingHom
statement:
theorem coe_lineRingHom (p : Polynomial k) :
    (lineRingHom R I k p : R[T;T⁻¹]) =
      invert (Polynomial.toLaurent (p.map (algebraMap k R)))
proof:
:= by
  change (structureMap R I (Polynomial.map (algebraMap k R) p) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = _
  exact coe_structureMap R I _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.lineRingHom_X_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem lineRingHom_X_mul_eq_zero {f : extendedRees R I}
    (h : lineRingHom R I k Polynomial.X * f = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  have h1 : (lineRingHom R I k Polynomial.X : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 0 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [coe_lineRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.toLaurent_X, invert_T] at h1
  exact (isUnit_T _).mul_right_eq_zero.mp h1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff {q r : Polynomial R}
    (hq : IsUnit q.leadingCoeff) (h : q * r = 0) : r = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hr
  have hne : q.leadingCoeff * r.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 :=
    fun h' ↦ hr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp (hq.mul_right_eq_zero.mp h'))
  have := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul' hne
  rw [h, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_zero] at this
  exact hne this.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isTorsionFree_line
statement:
theorem isTorsionFree_line [Nontrivial R] :
    letI
proof:
:= (lineRingHom R I k).toAlgebra
    Module.IsTorsionFree (Polynomial k) (extendedRees R I) := by
  let _ := (lineRingHom R I k).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨fun p hp f g hfg ↦ ?_⟩
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.left.ne_zero
  set q : Polynomial R := p.map (algebraMap k R) with hqdef
  have h1 : (lineRingHom R I k p : R[T;T⁻¹]) * f = (lineRingHom R I k p : R[T;T⁻¹]) * g := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hfg
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using this
  rw [coe_lineRingHom] at h1
  have h2 : Polynomial.toLaurent q * invert (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) =
      Polynomial.toLaurent q * invert (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) := by
    have := congrArg invert h1
    simpa only [map_mul, involutive_invert _] using this
  obtain ⟨a, f', hf'⟩ := (invert (f : R[T;T⁻¹])).exists_T_pow
  obtain ⟨b, g', hg'⟩ := (invert (g : R[T;T⁻¹])).exists_T_pow
  have h3 : Polynomial.toLaurent (q * f' * Polynomial.X ^ b) =
      Polynomial.toLaurent (q * g' * Polynomial.X ^ a) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow,
      Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, hf', hg']
    calc Polynomial.toLaurent q * (invert (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) * T a) * T b
        = Polynomial.toLaurent q * invert (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (T a * T b) := by ring
      _ = Polynomial.toLaurent q * invert (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (T a * T b) := by rw [h2]
      _ = Polynomial.toLaurent q * (invert (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) * T b) * T a := by ring
  rw [Polynomial.toLaurent_inj] at h3
  have hq : IsUnit q.leadingCoeff := by
    rw [hqdef, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_map_of_injective (algebraMap k R).injective]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp0)).map _
  have hcancel : f' * Polynomial.X ^ b = g' * Polynomial.X ^ a := by
    have hzero : q * (f' * Polynomial.X ^ b - g' * Polynomial.X ^ a) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, h3, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff R hq hzero)
  have h4 : invert (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) * T a * T b = invert (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) * T b * T a := by
    have := congrArg Polynomial.toLaurent hcancel
    rwa [map_mul, map_mul, Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, hf',
      hg'] at this
  have h5 : invert (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) = invert (g : R[T;T⁻¹]) := by
    rw [mul_T_assoc, mul_T_assoc, add_comm] at h4
    exact (isUnit_T _).mul_right_cancel h4
  exact Subtype.ext (involutive_invert.injective h5)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.flat_line
statement:
theorem flat_line [Nontrivial R] :
    letI
proof:
:= (lineRingHom R I k).toAlgebra
    Module.Flat (Polynomial k) (extendedRees R I) := by
  let _ := (lineRingHom R I k).toAlgebra
  have := isTorsionFree_line R I k
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.lineRingHom_flat

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.toLineOver_flat

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotientExtendedReesHom_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientExtendedReesHom_coe (f : extendedRees R I) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotientExtendedReesHom_C_mul_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientExtendedReesHom_C_mul_T (a : R) (n : ℤ)
    (ha : a ∈ I ^ n.toNat) :
    quotientExtendedReesHom R I P
        ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n, isExtendedRees_C_mul_T R I ha⟩ =
      ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C (q a) * T n,
        isExtendedRees_C_mul_T (R ⧸ P) (I.map q)
          (by
            rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
            exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem q ha)⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [quotientExtendedReesHom_coe, mapLaurent_C_mul_T]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotientExtendedReesHom_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientExtendedReesHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (quotientExtendedReesHom R I P)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : Function.Surjective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
        extendedRees R I →ₐ[R] (extendedRees R I) ⊗[R] (R ⧸ P)) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_surjective R (extendedRees R I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := reesTensorMap_surjective R I (R ⧸ P) y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hleft z
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  rw [← hz]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change mapLaurent q (x : R[T;T⁻¹]) = _
  rw [coe_reesTensorMap]
  change mapLaurent q (x : R[T;T⁻¹]) =
    reesTensorToLaurent R I (R ⧸ P) (x ⊗ₜ[R] 1)
  rw [reesTensorToLaurent_tmul]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotientExtendedReesHom_mem_ker_iff
statement:
theorem quotientExtendedReesHom_mem_ker_iff (f : extendedRees R I) :
    f ∈ RingHom.ker (quotientExtendedReesHom R I P) ↔
      ∀ n : ℤ, (f : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf n
    have hzero : mapLaurent q (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hf
      exact this
    have hc := congrArg (fun z : (R ⧸ P)[T;T⁻¹] ↦ z.coeff n) hzero
    rw [coeff_mapLaurent] at hc
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp (by simpa using hc)
  · intro hf
    apply RingHom.mem_ker.mpr
    apply Subtype.ext
    change mapLaurent q (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 0
    refine AddMonoidAlgebra.ext fun n => ?_
    change (mapLaurent q (f : R[T;T⁻¹])).coeff n = 0
    rw [coeff_mapLaurent]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hf n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotientExtendedReesHom_parameter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientExtendedReesHom_parameter :
    quotientExtendedReesHom R I P (parameter R I) =
      parameter (R ⧸ P) (I.map q)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change mapLaurent q (T (-1)) = T (-1)
  calc
    mapLaurent q (T (-1)) =
        mapLaurent q (LaurentPolynomial.C (1 : R) * T (-1)) := by simp
    _ = LaurentPolynomial.C (q 1) * T (-1) := mapLaurent_C_mul_T q 1 (-1)
    _ = T (-1) := by simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotientNormalConeMap_comp_normalConeι
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.selectedComponentIdentity
proof:
:=
  (Category.assoc a c p).trans
    (h.trans (congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ p) (Category.id_comp c)).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.selectedComponentComposition
statement:
theorem selectedComponentComposition {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] {P Q R S T : 𝒞}
    (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : Q ⟶ R) (c : R ⟶ S) (p : S ⟶ T)
    (e : Q ⟶ T) (d : P ⟶ T) (t : P ⟶ R)
    (hb : b ≫ c ≫ p = e) (ha : a ≫ e = d) (ht : t ≫ c ≫ p = d) :
    ((a ≫ b) ≫ c) ≫ p = (t ≫ c) ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ((a ≫ b) ≫ c) ≫ p = a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ p := by simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact hL.trans ((congrArg (fun q ↦ a ≫ q) hb).trans
    (ha.trans (ht.symm.trans (Category.assoc t c p).symm)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.nativeKernelSelection_id
statement:
theorem nativeKernelSelection_id (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f (fun i : ι ↦ i) d = 𝟙 (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d))).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  exact selectedComponentIdentity _ _ _
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f (fun i : ι ↦ i) d i)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.nativeKernelSelection_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem nativeKernelSelection_comp (r : κ → ι) (s : ζ → κ) (d : ℤ) :
    NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f r d ≫ NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (f ∘ r) s d =
      NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 f (r ∘ s) d
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 (f ∘ r ∘ s) -
    Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 (f ∘ r ∘ s) d))).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  exact selectedComponentComposition _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 (f ∘ r) s d i)
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f r d (s i))
    (NativeFamily.kernelSelection_component 𝒜 f (r ∘ s) d i)

    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.nativeAwayRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem nativeAwayRestriction_comp
    {R S T σ τ υ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R] [SetLike τ S] [AddSubgroupClass τ S]
    [SetLike υ T] [AddSubgroupClass υ T]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) (𝒞 : ℕ → υ)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] [GradedRing 𝒞]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (s : R) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (g.comp f) s =
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g (f s)).comp
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f s)
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_comp f g s

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.nativeAwayRestriction_id
statement:
theorem nativeAwayRestriction_id
    {R σ : Type u} [CommRing R] [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (s : R) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) s = RingHom.id _
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRestriction.nativeAwayRestriction_square
statement:
theorem nativeAwayRestriction_square
    {R S T U σ τ υ ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R] [SetLike τ S] [AddSubgroupClass τ S]
    [SetLike υ T] [AddSubgroupClass υ T] [SetLike ω U] [AddSubgroupClass ω U]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) (𝒞 : ℕ → υ) (𝒟 : ℕ → ω)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] [GradedRing 𝒞] [GradedRing 𝒟]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (f' : 𝒞 →+*ᵍ 𝒟) (g' : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒟)
    (h : g'.comp f = f'.comp g) (s : R) :
    HEq ((HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g' (f s)).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f s))
      ((HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f' (g s)).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_comp, ← HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_comp]
  have hh := congrArg (fun k : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒟 ↦
    (Sigma.mk (k s) (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map k s) :
      Sigma (fun t : U ↦ HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 s →+* HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒟 t))) h
  exact (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp hh).2

    (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)

      (totalRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])) s)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushUnitRoute_normalize
statement:
theorem pushUnitRoute_normalize
    {𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒜] [Category ℬ] [Category 𝒞]
    (F : ℬ ⥤ 𝒞) (G : 𝒜 ⥤ ℬ) (H : 𝒜 ⥤ 𝒞) (e : G ⋙ F ≅ H)
    {M : ℬ} {N P : 𝒜} (a : M ⟶ G.obj N) (b : N ⟶ P) :
    (F.map a ≫ e.hom.app N) ≫ H.map b =
      F.map (a ≫ G.map b) ≫ e.hom.app P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun q ↦ F.map a ≫ q) (e.hom.naturality b).symm).trans
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)

statement:
theorem pushedUnitMap_actualSectionRoute {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
      (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (q.resLE U V h).toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (q.resLE U V h) U.ι).hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h)).hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι q).inv.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme)
proof:
:= by
  let r := q.resLE U V h
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r).unit.app
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme)
  let b := (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom
  have hN := pushUnitRoute_normalize (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι)
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r) (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (r ≫ U.ι))
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r U.ι) a b
  have hU := unitSectionMap_actualUnitRoute r
  have hNU := hN.trans (congrArg (fun c ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map c ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r U.ι).hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme)) hU)
  exact congrArg (fun c ↦ c ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h)).hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι q).inv.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme)) hNU

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_assoc_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_assoc_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  have h0 := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app (f := f) (g := g) (M := M) (h ⁻¹ᵁ T)
  have h1 := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app (f := f ≫ g) (g := h) (M := M) T
  have h2 := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app (f := g) (g := h)
    (M := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) T
  have h4 : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).hom.app M) T = 𝟙 _ := by
    change M.presheaf.map (𝟙 _) = 𝟙 _
    exact M.presheaf.map_id _
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app, h0]
  erw [h1, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, h2, h4]
  change (𝟙 Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ h ⁻¹ᵁ T) ≫ 𝟙 _) = (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _)
  simp only [Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardCongr_refl_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr_refl_obj {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (rfl : f = f)).hom.app M =
      𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  have h0 := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app (f := f) (g := f) (M := M) rfl T
  exact h0.trans (M.presheaf.map_id _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardCongr_trans_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr_trans_obj {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g h : X ⟶ Y}
    (a : f = g) (b : g = h) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr b).hom.app M =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (a.trans b)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  subst h
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj]
  exact Category.id_comp _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_congr_first_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_congr_first_obj {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    {f g : X ⟶ Y} (a : f = g) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).hom.app M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).hom.app M =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ h) a)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj]
  have hm := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map_id ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)
  have hc := pushforwardCongr_refl_obj (f ≫ h) M
  exact (congrArg (fun a ↦ a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).hom.app M) hm).trans
    ((Category.id_comp _).trans ((Category.comp_id _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun a ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).hom.app M ≫ a) hc.symm)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_congr_second_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_congr_second_obj {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {g h : Y ⟶ Z} (a : g = h) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).hom.app M =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ f ≫ k) a)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.id_comp,
    pushforwardCongr_refl_obj, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_assoc_inv_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_assoc_inv_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).inv.app M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let L := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M
  let R := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M
  have he : L = R := Iso.ext (pushforwardComp_assoc_obj f g h M)
  exact congrArg Iso.inv he

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.isoAssociativity_mixed
statement:
theorem isoAssociativity_mixed {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞]
    {P Q R S T : 𝒞} (a : P ≅ Q) (b : Q ≅ R) (c : P ≅ S)
    (d : S ≅ T) (e : T ≅ R)
    (h : a.hom ≫ b.hom = c.hom ≫ d.hom ≫ e.hom) :
    a.inv ≫ c.hom = b.hom ≫ e.inv ≫ d.inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi a.hom).1
  have hh := congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ e.inv ≫ d.inv) h
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hh.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_assoc_mixed_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_assoc_mixed_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).inv.app M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).inv.app M
proof:
:=
  isoAssociativity_mixed
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M)
    (pushforwardComp_assoc_obj f g h M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_congr_first_inv_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_congr_first_inv_obj {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    {f g : X ⟶ Y} (a : f = g) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ h) a)).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).inv.app M =

      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a).hom.app M)

    (congrArg (fun a ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f h).inv.app M ≫ a) hm.symm))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_congr_second_inv_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_congr_second_inv_obj {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {g h : Y ⟶ Z} (a : g = h) (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun k ↦ f ≫ k) a)).hom.app M ≫

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardCongr_inv_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr_inv_obj {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    (a : f = g) (M : X.Modules) :

      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr a.symm).hom.app M
proof:
