name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.isoAssociativity_mixed_left
statement:
theorem isoAssociativity_mixed_left {𝒞 : Type u} [Category 𝒞]
    {P Q R S T : 𝒞} (a : P ≅ Q) (b : Q ≅ R) (c : P ≅ S)
    (d : S ≅ T) (e : T ≅ R)
    (h : a.hom ≫ b.hom = c.hom ≫ d.hom ≫ e.hom) :
    c.inv ≫ a.hom = d.hom ≫ e.hom ≫ b.inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi c.hom).1
  have hh := congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ b.inv) h
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hh

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeFunctor.pushforwardComp_assoc_mixed_left_obj
statement:
theorem pushforwardComp_assoc_mixed_left_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).inv.app M
proof:
:=
  isoAssociativity_mixed_left
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f ≫ g) h).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f (g ≫ h)).app M)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc f g h).symm).app M)
    (pushforwardComp_assoc_obj f g h M)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.evalHom_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalHom_C (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (b : B) (s : S) : evalHom φ b (Polynomial.C s) = φ s
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.eval₂_C _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.evalHom_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalHom_X (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (b : B) : evalHom φ b (Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) = b
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.eval₂_X _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.evalHom_unique
statement:
theorem evalHom_unique {φ : S →ₐ[R] B} {b : B} (g : Polynomial S →ₐ[R] B)
    (hC : ∀ s, g (Polynomial.C s) = φ s) (hX : g (Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) = b) :
    g = evalHom φ b
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.algHom_ext' (AlgHom.ext fun s => (hC s).trans (evalHom_C φ b s).symm)
    (hX.trans (evalHom_X φ b).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.comp_evalHom
statement:
theorem comp_evalHom (g : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (b : B) :
    g.comp (evalHom φ b) = evalHom (g.comp φ) (g b)
proof:
:=
  evalHom_unique _ (fun s => by simp) (by simp)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom
statement:
theorem evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom (φ : S' →ₐ[R] B) (b : B) (ψ : S →ₐ[R] S') :
    (evalHom φ b).comp (Polynomial.mapAlgHom ψ) = evalHom (φ.comp ψ) b
proof:
:=
  evalHom_unique _ (fun s => by simp) (by simp)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.comul_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_C (s : S) :
    comul (R := R) (Polynomial.C s) = Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C s : Polynomial S)
proof:
:=
  evalHom_C _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.comul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_X :
    comul (R := R) (Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) =
      Polynomial.C (Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) * Polynomial.X
proof:
:=
  evalHom_X _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.comp_scale
statement:
theorem comp_scale (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (g : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (b : B) :
    g.comp (scale ψ φ b) = scale ψ (g.comp φ) (g b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [scale, scale, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, comp_evalHom]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeCoaction.scale_one
statement:
theorem IsConeCoaction.scale_one {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ)
    (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) : scale ψ φ (1 : B) = φ
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : φ.comp (evalHom (AlgHom.id R S) (1 : S)) = evalHom φ (1 : B) := by
    rw [comp_evalHom, AlgHom.comp_id, map_one]
  rw [scale, ← h1, AlgHom.comp_assoc, h.counit, AlgHom.comp_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeCoaction.scale_scale
statement:
theorem IsConeCoaction.scale_scale {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ)
    (φ : S →ₐ[R] B) (b c : B) : scale ψ (scale ψ φ b) c = scale ψ φ (b * c)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (evalHom (evalHom φ b) c).comp comul = evalHom φ (b * c) :=
    evalHom_unique _ (fun s => by simp [comul]) (by simp [comul])
  have hL : (evalHom (evalHom φ b) c).comp ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom ψ).comp ψ) =
      scale ψ (scale ψ φ b) c := by
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom]
    rfl
  rw [← hL, h.coassoc, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, key]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contraction_algebraMap (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (r r' : R) :
    contraction ψ r (algebraMap R S r') = algebraMap R S r'
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.commutes _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_one
statement:
theorem contraction_one {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) :
    contraction ψ (1 : R) = AlgHom.id R S
proof:
:= by
  rw [contraction, map_one, h.scale_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_mul
statement:
theorem contraction_mul {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) (r r' : R) :
    contraction ψ (r * r') = (contraction ψ r).comp (contraction ψ r')
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (contraction ψ r).comp (contraction ψ r') =
      scale ψ (contraction ψ r) (algebraMap R S r') := by
    have e := comp_scale ψ (contraction ψ r) (AlgHom.id R S) (algebraMap R S r')
    rw [AlgHom.comp_id, contraction_algebraMap] at e
    exact e
  rw [e1, contraction, map_mul, ← h.scale_scale]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.vertex_comp_ofId
statement: theorem vertex_comp_ofId (ε : S →ₐ[R] R) : ε.comp (Algebra.ofId R S) = AlgHom.id R R
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext fun r => ε.commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.injective_algebraMap_of_vertex
statement:
theorem injective_algebraMap_of_vertex {ε : S →ₐ[R] R} :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := ε) fun r => ε.commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeVertex.comp_contraction
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Algebra.ofId R S) :=
    injective_algebraMap_of_vertex (ε := ε)
  refine AlgHom.ext fun s => hinj ?_
  have h0 : contraction ψ (0 * r) = (contraction ψ 0).comp (contraction ψ r) :=
    contraction_mul hψ 0 r
  rw [zero_mul, h] at h0
  simpa using (DFunLike.congr_fun h0 s).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.mem_homogeneous
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_homogeneous {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {n : ℕ} {s : S} :
    s ∈ homogeneous ψ n ↔ ψ s = Polynomial.C s * Polynomial.X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneous, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.algebraMap_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_homogeneous (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (r : R) :
    algebraMap R S r ∈ homogeneous ψ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous, AlgHom.commutes, pow_zero, mul_one, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.one_mem_homogeneous
statement: theorem one_mem_homogeneous (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) : (1 : S) ∈ homogeneous ψ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.mul_mem_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous] at ha hb ⊢
  rw [map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, pow_add]
  ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_of_mem_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous] at hs
  change (evalHom (AlgHom.id R S) (algebraMap R S r)) (ψ s) = _
  rw [hs, map_mul, map_pow, evalHom_C, evalHom_X]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.comul_coeff
statement:
theorem comul_coeff (p : Polynomial S) (n : ℕ) :
    (comul (R := R) p).coeff n = Polynomial.C (p.coeff n) * Polynomial.X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq, add_mul]
  | monomial k a =>
    rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, comul_C, comul_X, mul_pow,
      ← Polynomial.C_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial,
      Polynomial.coeff_monomial, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs with hk
    · rw [hk, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
    · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.proj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_apply (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    proj ψ n s = (ψ s).coeff n
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.proj_of_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem proj_of_mem_homogeneous {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {n : ℕ} {s : S}
    (hs : s ∈ homogeneous ψ n) (m : ℕ) : proj ψ m s = if m = n then s else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous] at hs
  rw [proj_apply, hs, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · rfl
  · exact absurd h1.symm h2
  · exact absurd h3.symm h1
  · rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.proj_eq_self
statement:
theorem proj_eq_self {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {n : ℕ} {s : S}
    (hs : s ∈ homogeneous ψ n) : proj ψ n s = s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using proj_of_mem_homogeneous hs n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.proj_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem proj_mem_homogeneous {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    proj ψ n s ∈ homogeneous ψ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p n) (DFunLike.congr_fun h.coassoc s)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgHom, Polynomial.coeff_map,
    RingHom.coe_coe, comul_coeff] at h1
  rw [mem_homogeneous]
  exact h1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.sum_proj
statement:
theorem sum_proj {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) (s : S) :
    ∑ n ∈ (ψ s).support, proj ψ n s = s
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ n ∈ (ψ s).support, proj ψ n s
      = evalHom (AlgHom.id R S) (1 : S) (ψ s) := by
        rw [evalHom, Polynomial.eval₂AlgHom_apply, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def]
        exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => by simp).symm
    _ = s := DFunLike.congr_fun h.counit s

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.proj_mem_span_homogeneous
statement:
theorem proj_mem_span_homogeneous {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) (s : S) :
    s ∈ Submodule.span R (⋃ n : ℕ, (homogeneous ψ n : Set S))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_proj h s]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun n _ => Submodule.subset_span ?_
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, proj_mem_homogeneous h n s⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.linearMap_ext_of_graded
statement:
theorem linearMap_ext_of_graded {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {f g : S →ₗ[R] M}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : 𝒮 n), f (x : S) = g (x : S)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_
  conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒮 s]
  conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒮 s]
  rw [map_sum, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => h n _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.algHom_ext_of_graded
statement:
theorem algHom_ext_of_graded {T : Type*} [Semiring T] [Algebra R T] {f g : S →ₐ[R] T}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : 𝒮 n), f (x : S) = g (x : S)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.toLinearMap_injective (linearMap_ext_of_graded 𝒮 h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.gradedCoaction_of_mem
statement:
theorem gradedCoaction_of_mem {n : ℕ} {s : S} (hs : s ∈ 𝒮 n) :
    gradedCoaction 𝒮 s = Polynomial.C s * Polynomial.X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedCoaction, AlgHom.comp_apply]
  change DirectSum.toAlgebra R (fun n => 𝒮 n) _ _ _ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒮 s) = _
  rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem 𝒮 hs, DirectSum.toAlgebra_apply]
  exact DirectSum.toSemiring_of _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.mem_homogeneous_gradedCoaction
statement:
theorem mem_homogeneous_gradedCoaction {n : ℕ} {s : S} (hs : s ∈ 𝒮 n) :
    s ∈ homogeneous (gradedCoaction 𝒮) n
proof:
:=
  mem_homogeneous.2 (gradedCoaction_of_mem 𝒮 hs)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_gradedCoaction
statement:
theorem isConeCoaction_gradedCoaction : IsConeCoaction (gradedCoaction 𝒮) where
  counit
proof:
:= by
    refine algHom_ext_of_graded 𝒮 fun n x => ?_
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, gradedCoaction_of_mem 𝒮 x.2, map_mul, map_pow, evalHom_C, evalHom_X]
    simp
  coassoc := by
    refine algHom_ext_of_graded 𝒮 fun n x => ?_
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, gradedCoaction_of_mem 𝒮 x.2]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgHom, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X,
      comul_C, comul_X, RingHom.coe_coe, gradedCoaction_of_mem 𝒮 x.2]
    ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.gradedCoaction_coeff
statement:
theorem gradedCoaction_coeff (n : ℕ) (s : S) :
    (gradedCoaction 𝒮 s).coeff n = GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒮 n s
proof:
:= by
  have key : ((Polynomial.lcoeff S n).restrictScalars R).comp
      (gradedCoaction 𝒮).toLinearMap = GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒮 n := by
    refine linearMap_ext_of_graded 𝒮 fun m x => ?_
    change (gradedCoaction 𝒮 (x : S)).coeff n = GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒮 n (x : S)
    rw [gradedCoaction_of_mem 𝒮 x.2, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial,
      Polynomial.coeff_monomial, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply]
    by_cases hmn : m = n
    · subst hmn
      rw [if_pos rfl, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒮 x.2]
    · rw [if_neg hmn, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒮 x.2 hmn]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key s

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.homogeneous_gradedCoaction
statement:
theorem homogeneous_gradedCoaction (n : ℕ) :
    homogeneous (gradedCoaction 𝒮) n = 𝒮 n
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun s hs => ?_) fun s hs => mem_homogeneous_gradedCoaction 𝒮 hs
  have h1 : GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒮 n s = s := by
    rw [← gradedCoaction_coeff]
    exact proj_eq_self hs
  rw [← h1, GradedAlgebra.proj_apply]
  exact SetLike.coe_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.symCoaction_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symCoaction_ι (m : M) :
    symCoaction R M (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) =
      Polynomial.C (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) * Polynomial.X
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.ι_mem_homogeneous_one
statement:
theorem ι_mem_homogeneous_one (m : M) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∈ homogeneous (symCoaction R M) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous, symCoaction_ι, pow_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_symCoaction
statement:
theorem isConeCoaction_symCoaction : IsConeCoaction (symCoaction R M) where
  counit
proof:
:= by
    refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_)
    simp
  coassoc := by
    refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_)
    change Polynomial.mapAlgHom (symCoaction R M)
        (symCoaction R M (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m)) =
      comul (symCoaction R M (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m))
    simp only [symCoaction_ι, map_mul, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgHom, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.map_X, comul_C, comul_X, RingHom.coe_coe]
    ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeVertex_symCoaction
statement:
theorem isConeVertex_symCoaction :
    IsConeVertex (symCoaction R M) (SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv (R := R) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_)
  change contraction (symCoaction R M) 0 (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) =
    algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M)
      (SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m))
  rw [contraction_of_mem_homogeneous (ι_mem_homogeneous_one R M m),
    SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_symCoaction
statement:
theorem contraction_symCoaction (r : R) :
    contraction (symCoaction R M) r = AffineCone.contraction R M r
proof:
:= by
  refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_)
  change contraction (symCoaction R M) r (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) =
    AffineCone.contraction R M r (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m)
  rw [contraction_of_mem_homogeneous (ι_mem_homogeneous_one R M m),
    AffineCone.contraction_generator, pow_one, Algebra.smul_def]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isGeneratedInDegreeOne_symCoaction
statement:
theorem isGeneratedInDegreeOne_symCoaction :
    IsGeneratedInDegreeOne (symCoaction R M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsGeneratedInDegreeOne, eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r
  | ι m => exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (ι_mem_homogeneous_one R M m)
  | mul a b ha hb => exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ ha hb

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.symIInv_ι
statement: theorem symIInv_ι (m : F) : symIInv R F (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F m) = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [symIInv]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.ι_injective
statement: theorem ι_injective : Function.Injective (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (symIInv_ι R F)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.adjoin_range_ι
statement: theorem adjoin_range_ι : Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r
  | ι m => exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨m, rfl⟩
  | mul a b ha hb => exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ ha hb

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.span_closure_range_ι
statement:
theorem span_closure_range_ι :
    Submodule.span R
      (Submonoid.closure (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F)) : Set (SymmetricAlgebra R F)) =
      ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := Algebra.adjoin_eq_span (R := R) (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F))
  rw [adjoin_range_ι, Algebra.top_toSubmodule] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.exists_degree_of_mem_closure
statement:
theorem exists_degree_of_mem_closure {x : SymmetricAlgebra R F}
    (hx : x ∈ Submonoid.closure (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F))) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ homogeneous (symCoaction R F) n ∧
      (n = 0 → ∃ r : R, x = algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R F) r) ∧
      (n = 1 → x ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F))
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨1, ι_mem_homogeneous_one R F m, by omega, fun _ => ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩
  | one => exact ⟨0, one_mem_homogeneous _, fun _ => ⟨1, (map_one _).symm⟩, by omega⟩
  | mul x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨nx, hx, hx0, hx1⟩ := ihx
    obtain ⟨ny, hy, hy0, hy1⟩ := ihy
    refine ⟨nx + ny, mul_mem_homogeneous hx hy, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hx0 (by omega)
      obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := hy0 (by omega)
      exact ⟨r * r', by rw [hr, hr', map_mul]⟩
    · have hcase : nx = 0 ∧ ny = 1 ∨ nx = 1 ∧ ny = 0 := by omega
      rcases hcase with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hx0 h1
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hy1 h2
        exact ⟨r • m, by rw [map_smul, hm, hr, Algebra.smul_def]⟩
      · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx1 h1
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hy0 h2
        exact ⟨r • m, by rw [map_smul, hm, hr, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.proj_one_mem_range
statement:
theorem proj_one_mem_range (s : SymmetricAlgebra R F) :
    proj (symCoaction R F) 1 s ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F)
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : s ∈ Submodule.span R
      (Submonoid.closure (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F)) :
        Set (SymmetricAlgebra R F)) := by
    rw [span_closure_range_ι]
    trivial
  induction hspan using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn, -, h1⟩ := exists_degree_of_mem_closure R F hx
    rw [proj_of_mem_homogeneous hn]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact h1 h.symm
    · exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem ihx ihy
  | smul a x _ ih =>
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a ih

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.homogeneous_one_symCoaction
statement:
theorem homogeneous_one_symCoaction :
    homogeneous (symCoaction R F) 1 = LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun s hs => ?_) ?_
  · rw [← proj_eq_self hs]
    exact proj_one_mem_range R F s
  · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ι_mem_homogeneous_one R F m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeHom_id
statement: theorem isConeHom_id (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) : IsConeHom ψ ψ (AlgHom.id R S)
proof:

    Polynomial.algHom_ext' (AlgHom.ext fun s => by simp) (by simp)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeHom.comp
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsConeHom, ← mapAlgHom_comp, AlgHom.comp_assoc, h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, h',
    AlgHom.comp_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeHom.comp_contraction
proof:
:= by
  have hL : φ.comp (contraction ψ r) = (evalHom φ (algebraMap R S' r)).comp ψ := by
    rw [contraction, scale, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, comp_evalHom, AlgHom.comp_id, AlgHom.commutes]
  have hR : (contraction ψ' r).comp φ = (evalHom φ (algebraMap R S' r)).comp ψ := by
    rw [contraction, scale, AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
      evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom, AlgHom.id_comp]
  rw [hL, hR]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeHom.comp_vertex
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun s => injective_algebraMap_of_vertex (ε := ε') ?_
  have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun (h.comp_contraction (0 : R)) s
  rw [hv, hv'] at h1
  simpa using h1.symm

statement:
theorem vertexSection_comp_projection (ε : S →ₐ[R] R) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexSection, projection, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contractionMap_one
statement:
theorem contractionMap_one {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) :

theorem contractionMap_mul {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ) (r r' : R) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.vertexSection_comp_contractionMap
proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeHom.comp_counit
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom, AlgHom.id_comp]
  exact hψ.scale_one φ

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.IsConeHom.comp_coassoc
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom ψ').comp ψ').comp φ =
      (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ)).comp (comul.comp ψ) := by
    rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, mapAlgHom_comp, ← h, ← mapAlgHom_comp,
      AlgHom.comp_assoc, hψ.coassoc]
  have e2 : (comul.comp ψ').comp φ =
      (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ)).comp (comul.comp ψ) := by
    rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← h, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, comul_comp_mapAlgHom, AlgHom.comp_assoc]
  rw [e1, e2]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_of_injective
statement:
theorem isConeCoaction_of_injective {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S'}
    {φ : S →ₐ[R] S'} (h : IsConeHom ψ ψ' φ) (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (h' : IsConeCoaction ψ') : IsConeCoaction ψ where
  counit
proof:
:= by
    refine AlgHom.ext fun s => hφ ?_
    have e1 : φ.comp (evalHom (AlgHom.id R S) (1 : S)) = evalHom φ (1 : S') := by
      rw [comp_evalHom, AlgHom.comp_id, map_one]
    have e2 : (evalHom (AlgHom.id R S') (1 : S')).comp (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ) =
        evalHom φ (1 : S') := by
      rw [evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom, AlgHom.id_comp]
    calc φ (evalHom (AlgHom.id R S) (1 : S) (ψ s))
        = evalHom φ (1 : S') (ψ s) := AlgHom.congr_fun e1 _
      _ = evalHom (AlgHom.id R S') (1 : S') (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ (ψ s)) :=
          (AlgHom.congr_fun e2 _).symm
      _ = evalHom (AlgHom.id R S') (1 : S') (ψ' (φ s)) := by
          rw [show Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ (ψ s) = ψ' (φ s) from AlgHom.congr_fun h s]
      _ = φ s := AlgHom.congr_fun h'.counit (φ s)
  coassoc := by
    have hL : (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ)).comp
        ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom ψ).comp ψ) = (comul.comp ψ').comp φ := by
      rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, mapAlgHom_comp, h, ← mapAlgHom_comp, AlgHom.comp_assoc, h,
        ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, h'.coassoc]
    have hR : (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ)).comp (comul.comp ψ) =
        (comul.comp ψ').comp φ := by
      rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← comul_comp_mapAlgHom, AlgHom.comp_assoc, h,
        ← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Polynomial.mapAlgHom φ)) := fun _ _ hpq =>
      Polynomial.map_injective _
        (Polynomial.map_injective (φ : S →+* S') hφ) hpq
    refine AlgHom.ext fun s => hinj ?_
    exact (AlgHom.congr_fun hL s).trans (AlgHom.congr_fun hR s).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.tensor_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_ext {C : Type*} [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] {f g : (S ⊗[R] S') →ₐ[R] C}
    (hL : f.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft =
      g.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
    (hR : f.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight =
      g.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => ?_
  have ha := AlgHom.congr_fun hL a
  have hb := AlgHom.congr_fun hR b
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply] at ha hb
  have h1 : (a ⊗ₜ[R] b : S ⊗[R] S') = (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S')) * ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] b) := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [h1, map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeHom_includeLeft
statement:
theorem isConeHom_includeLeft (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S') :
    IsConeHom ψ (tensorCoaction ψ ψ')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S')
proof:
:=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeHom_includeRight
statement:
theorem isConeHom_includeRight (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S') :
    IsConeHom ψ' (tensorCoaction ψ ψ')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S' →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S')
proof:
:=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight' _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_tensorCoaction
proof:
:= by
    refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [AlgHom.id_comp]
      exact (isConeHom_includeLeft ψ ψ').comp_counit h
    · rw [AlgHom.id_comp]
      exact (isConeHom_includeRight ψ ψ').comp_counit h'
  coassoc := by
    refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
    · exact (isConeHom_includeLeft ψ ψ').comp_coassoc h
    · exact (isConeHom_includeRight ψ ψ').comp_coassoc h'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeVertex_tensorCoaction
statement:
theorem isConeVertex_tensorCoaction {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} {ψ' : S' →ₐ[R] Polynomial S'}
    {ε : S →ₐ[R] R} {ε' : S' →ₐ[R] R} (hv : IsConeVertex ψ ε) (hv' : IsConeVertex ψ' ε') :
    IsConeVertex (tensorCoaction ψ ψ')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ε ε' fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext ?_ ?_
  · rw [← (isConeHom_includeLeft ψ ψ').comp_contraction, hv, AlgHom.comp_assoc,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeLeft, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
    rfl
  · rw [← (isConeHom_includeRight ψ ψ').comp_contraction, hv', AlgHom.comp_assoc,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_comp_includeRight', ← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
    congr 1
    exact AlgHom.ext fun r =>
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S' →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S').commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isClosedImmersion_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_of_surjective (φ : S →ₐ[R] S') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.abelianHull_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem abelianHull_ι (x : homogeneous ψ 1) :
    abelianHull ψ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (homogeneous ψ 1) x) = (x : S)
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeHom_abelianHull
statement:
theorem isConeHom_abelianHull :
    IsConeHom (symCoaction R (homogeneous ψ 1)) ψ (abelianHull ψ)
proof:
:= by
  refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  change Polynomial.mapAlgHom (abelianHull ψ)
      (symCoaction R (homogeneous ψ 1) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (homogeneous ψ 1) x)) =
    ψ (abelianHull ψ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (homogeneous ψ 1) x))
  have hx : ψ (x : S) = Polynomial.C (x : S) * Polynomial.X ^ 1 := mem_homogeneous.mp x.2
  rw [symCoaction_ι, abelianHull_ι, hx, pow_one]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.abelianHull_surjective
statement:
theorem abelianHull_surjective (h : IsGeneratedInDegreeOne ψ) :
    Function.Surjective (abelianHull ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgHom.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← h]
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro s hs
  exact ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (homogeneous ψ 1) ⟨s, hs⟩, by simp⟩

statement:

    IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (abelianHull ψ).toRingHom))
proof:
:=
  isClosedImmersion_of_surjective _ (abelianHull_surjective ψ h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeHom_quotientCoaction
statement:
theorem isConeHom_quotientCoaction (ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (J : Ideal S)
    (hJ : ∀ x ∈ J, (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J)).comp ψ x = 0) :
    IsConeHom ψ (quotientCoaction ψ J hJ) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J)
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_comp J _ hJ).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_quotientCoaction
statement:
theorem isConeCoaction_quotientCoaction {ψ : S →ₐ[R] Polynomial S} (h : IsConeCoaction ψ)
    (J : Ideal S)
    (hJ : ∀ x ∈ J, (Polynomial.mapAlgHom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J)).comp ψ x = 0) :
    IsConeCoaction (quotientCoaction ψ J hJ) where
  counit
proof:
:= by
    refine AlgHom.ext fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun ((isConeHom_quotientCoaction ψ J hJ).comp_counit h) y
  coassoc := by
    refine AlgHom.ext fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun ((isConeHom_quotientCoaction ψ J hJ).comp_coassoc h) y

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_comul
statement:
theorem isConeCoaction_comul :
    IsConeCoaction (comul : Polynomial R →ₐ[R] Polynomial (Polynomial R)) where
  counit
proof:
:= Polynomial.algHom_ext' (AlgHom.ext fun a => by simp) (by simp)
  coassoc := by
    refine Polynomial.algHom_ext' (AlgHom.ext fun a => by simp) ?_
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, comul_X, map_mul, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgHom, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.map_X, comul_C, RingHom.coe_coe]
    ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.X_mem_homogeneous_one
statement:
theorem X_mem_homogeneous_one :
    (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ∈ homogeneous (comul : Polynomial R →ₐ[R] _) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous, comul_X, pow_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem isConeCoaction_mvPolynomial :
    IsConeCoaction (gradedCoaction (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R))
proof:
:=
  isConeCoaction_gradedCoaction _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.homogeneous_mvPolynomial
statement:

    homogeneous (gradedCoaction (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R)) n =
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R n

:=
  homogeneous_gradedCoaction _ n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.mapAlgHom_reesVal_injective
statement:
theorem mapAlgHom_reesVal_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (Polynomial.mapAlgHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hpq =>
    Polynomial.map_injective ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →+* Polynomial R)
      Subtype.val_injective hpq

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.comul_mem_range_rees
statement:
theorem comul_mem_range_rees (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    comul (R := R) (q : Polynomial R) ∈
      AlgHom.range
        (Polynomial.mapAlgHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R))
proof:
:= by
  have hl : comul (R := R) (q : Polynomial R) ∈
      Polynomial.lifts ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →+* Polynomial R) := by
    rw [Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts]
    intro n
    rw [comul_coeff, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
    refine ⟨⟨Polynomial.monomial n ((q : Polynomial R).coeff n), ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_reesAlgebra_iff]
    intro k
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs with hk
    · subst hk
      exact (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I (q : Polynomial R)).mp q.2 n
    · exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := (Polynomial.mem_lifts _).mp hl
  exact ⟨P, hP⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeHom_reesVal
statement:
theorem isConeHom_reesVal :
    IsConeHom (reesCoaction R I) (comul : Polynomial R →ₐ[R] Polynomial (Polynomial R))
      ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R)
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext fun q =>
    congrArg Subtype.val
      ((AlgEquiv.ofInjective _ (mapAlgHom_reesVal_injective R I)).apply_symm_apply
        ⟨comul (q : Polynomial R), comul_mem_range_rees R I q⟩)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.isConeCoaction_reesCoaction
statement: theorem isConeCoaction_reesCoaction : IsConeCoaction (reesCoaction R I)
proof:
:=
  isConeCoaction_of_injective (isConeHom_reesVal R I) Subtype.val_injective
    (isConeCoaction_comul R)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.reesCoaction_mem_ker
statement:
theorem reesCoaction_mem_ker (x : reesAlgebra I)
    (hx : x ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) :
    (Polynomial.mapAlgHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I))).comp
      (reesCoaction R I) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I ≤
      RingHom.ker (((Polynomial.mapAlgHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I))).comp
        (reesCoaction R I)) : reesAlgebra I →+*
          Polynomial (reesAlgebra I ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro s hs
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
    change ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I))).comp
      (reesCoaction R I)) (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) s) = 0
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply]
    have hzero : algebraMap R
        (reesAlgebra I ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) s = 0 := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (reesAlgebra I)
        (reesAlgebra I ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I),
        Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hs
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
  exact hle hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.evalHom_comp_comul
statement:
theorem evalHom_comp_comul (r : R) :
    (evalHom (AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.C r)).comp comul =
      AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux R r
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.algHom_ext' (AlgHom.ext fun a => ?_) ?_
  · change evalHom (AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.C r)
      (comul (Polynomial.C a)) = AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux R r (Polynomial.C a)
    rw [comul_C, evalHom_C, AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux]
    simp
  · change evalHom (AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.C r)
      (comul (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)) =
      AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux R r (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)
    rw [comul_X, map_mul, evalHom_C, evalHom_X, AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux,
      Polynomial.aeval_X, mul_comm]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_reesCoaction
statement:
theorem contraction_reesCoaction (r : R) :
    contraction (reesCoaction R I) r = AffineNormalCone.reesScale R I r
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun q => Subtype.val_injective ?_
  have e1 : ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R).comp
      (evalHom (AlgHom.id R (reesAlgebra I)) (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r)) =
      evalHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R) (Polynomial.C r) := by
    rw [comp_evalHom, AlgHom.comp_id]
    rfl
  have e2 : (evalHom (AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.C r)).comp
      (Polynomial.mapAlgHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R)) =
      evalHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R) (Polynomial.C r) := by
    rw [evalHom_comp_mapAlgHom, AlgHom.id_comp]
  calc ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R) (contraction (reesCoaction R I) r q)
      = evalHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R) (Polynomial.C r)
          (reesCoaction R I q) := AlgHom.congr_fun e1 _
    _ = evalHom (AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.C r)
          (Polynomial.mapAlgHom ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R)
            (reesCoaction R I q)) := (AlgHom.congr_fun e2 _).symm
    _ = evalHom (AlgHom.id R (Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.C r) (comul (q : Polynomial R)) := by
          rw [show Polynomial.mapAlgHom
              ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R) (reesCoaction R I q) =
              comul (q : Polynomial R) from AlgHom.congr_fun (isConeHom_reesVal R I) q]
    _ = AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux R r (q : Polynomial R) :=
          AlgHom.congr_fun (evalHom_comp_comul R r) _
    _ = ((reesAlgebra I).val : reesAlgebra I →ₐ[R] Polynomial R)
          (AffineNormalCone.reesScale R I r q) := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.contraction_normalConeCoaction
statement:
theorem contraction_normalConeCoaction (r : R)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I) :
    contraction (normalConeCoaction R I) r x = AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedScale R I r x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  have hcomm := AlgHom.congr_fun
    ((isConeHom_normalConeCoaction R I).comp_contraction r) q
  rw [AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedScale_mk, ← contraction_reesCoaction]
  exact hcomm.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.pointsEquiv_symm_apply

@[simp]
theorem pointsEquiv_symm_apply {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] (l : F →ₗ[R] B) (m : F) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GradedCone.scale_symCoaction
statement:
theorem scale_symCoaction {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] (l : F →ₗ[R] B) (b : B) :

      (pointsEquiv R F B).symm (b • l)
proof:
:= by

  change scale (symCoaction R F) ((pointsEquiv R F B).symm l) b (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F m) =
    (pointsEquiv R F B).symm (b • l) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R F m)
  rw [scale, AlgHom.comp_apply, symCoaction_ι, map_mul, evalHom_C, evalHom_X,

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.conormalChartTildeIso_factor
statement:
theorem conormalChartTildeIso_factor (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    conormalChartTildeIso Y J U = conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).mapIso
        (ConormalSheaf.idealChartIsoTilde J U) ≪≫
      (tildePullbackSpecMapIso (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).app (ModuleCat.of _ (J.ideal U)) ≪≫
      (tilde.functor _).mapIso (AffineNormalCone.extendCotangentIso (J.ideal U))
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [conormalChartTildeIso, conormalChartPullbackIdealIso, Iso.trans_hom,

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.idealChartTensorEquiv_factor
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.idealChartPullbackTilde_coordinate_square
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem idealChartPullbackTilde_coordinate_square (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).map
        ((tilde.functor Γ(Y,U.1)).map (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U).toModuleIso.hom) ≫
      ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).app (ModuleCat.of _ (J.ideal U))).hom =
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).app
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(Y,U.1))).obj (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U))).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor _).map
        ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).map
          (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U).toModuleIso.hom)
proof:
:=
  (tildePullbackSpecMapIso (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).hom.naturality
    (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U).toModuleIso.hom

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.coordinate_paste
statement:
theorem coordinate_paste {C D B : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category B]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : B ⥤ D) {X M N : C} {P Q R : B}
    (c : X ⟶ M) (f : M ⟶ N) (e : P ⟶ Q) (d : Q ⟶ R)
    (a : F.obj M ⟶ G.obj P) (b : F.obj N ⟶ G.obj Q)
    (h : F.map f ≫ b = a ≫ G.map e) :
    F.map (c ≫ f) ≫ b ≫ G.map d = F.map c ≫ a ≫ G.map (e ≫ d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.map_comp, G.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (F.map f) b, h, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.conormalChartTensorIso_coordinates
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorIso_coordinates (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    conormalChartTildeIso Y J U = conormalChartTensorIso Y J U ≪≫
      (tilde.functor _).mapIso (idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U).toModuleIso
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalChartTildeIso_factor, idealChartIsoTilde_factor, idealChartTensorEquiv_factor]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [conormalChartTensorIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun q => (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).hom ≫ q)
    (coordinate_paste (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U))
      (tilde.functor (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)))
      (idealChartCounitIso Y J U).hom
      ((tilde.functor Γ(Y,U.1)).map (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U).toModuleIso.hom)
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).map
        (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U).toModuleIso.hom)
      (AffineNormalCone.extendCotangentIso (J.ideal U)).hom
      _ _ (idealChartPullbackTilde_coordinate_square Y J U))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.tildeSections_coordinate_square
statement:
theorem tildeSections_coordinate_square {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    {M N : ModuleCat Q} (e : M ⟶ N) :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).map ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map e) ≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv =
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).inv ≫ e
proof:
:=
  (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).inv.naturality e

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_coordinates
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_coordinates (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U =
      (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).trans (idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  have hc := congrArg (fun e =>
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).mapIso e).hom)
    (conormalChartTensorIso_coordinates Y J U)
  have hn := tildeSections_coordinate_square (idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U).toModuleIso.hom
  change ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).app _).inv
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
        (conormalChartTildeIso Y J U).hom m) = _
  change ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
    (conormalChartTildeIso Y J U).hom) =
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
        ((conormalChartTensorIso Y J U).hom ≫
          (tilde.functor _).map (idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U).toModuleIso.hom) at hc
  have hp := congrArg (fun q => (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).map
    (conormalChartTensorIso Y J U).hom ≫ q) hn
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp] at hc
  have hm := CategoryTheory.congr_fun hp m
  exact (congrArg
    (((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).app
      (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (J.ideal U).Cotangent)).inv)
    (CategoryTheory.congr_fun hc m)).trans hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_generator
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_generator (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (q : Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U, ⊤)) :
    conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U
      ((conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).symm (q ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)] m)) =
    q • (J.ideal U).toCotangent (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv J U m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_coordinates]
  change idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U
    (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U
      ((conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).symm (q ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)] m))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, idealChartTensorEquiv_apply, idealChartTensorCoordinates_tmul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.mapBiprod_coordinate_square
statement:
theorem mapBiprod_coordinate_square {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (M N M' N' : C)
    [HasBinaryBiproduct M N] [HasBinaryBiproduct M' N']
    [HasBinaryBiproduct (F.obj M) (F.obj N)] [HasBinaryBiproduct (F.obj M') (F.obj N')]
    [PreservesBinaryBiproduct M N F] [PreservesBinaryBiproduct M' N' F]
    (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    F.map (biprod.map f g) ≫ (F.mapBiprod M' N').hom =
      (F.mapBiprod M N).hom ≫ biprod.map (F.map f) (F.map g)
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.map_fst, Functor.mapBiprod_hom, biprod.lift_fst]
    rw [← F.map_comp, biprod.map_fst, F.map_comp]
    rw [← Category.assoc, biprod.lift_fst]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd, Functor.mapBiprod_hom, biprod.lift_snd]
    rw [← F.map_comp, biprod.map_snd, F.map_comp]
    rw [← Category.assoc, biprod.lift_snd]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.biprodIsoProd_hom_fst
statement:
theorem biprodIsoProd_hom_fst {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q] (M N : ModuleCat Q) :
    (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst Q M N) = biprod.fst
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).inv).mp
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_fst]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.biprodIsoProd_hom_snd
statement:
theorem biprodIsoProd_hom_snd {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q] (M N : ModuleCat Q) :
    (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd Q M N) = biprod.snd
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).inv).mp
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_snd]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.biprodIsoProd_coordinate_square
statement:
theorem biprodIsoProd_coordinate_square {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    (M N M' N' : ModuleCat Q) (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    biprod.map f g ≫ (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M' N').hom =
      (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.prodMap g.hom)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M' N').inv).mp
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_fst]
    have h : ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.prodMap g.hom) ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst Q M' N') =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst Q M N) ≫ f := by rfl
    rw [← Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc, biprodIsoProd_hom_fst]
    rw [Category.assoc, biprodIsoProd_hom_fst, biprod.map_fst]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_snd]
    have h : ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.prodMap g.hom) ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd Q M' N') =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd Q M N) ≫ g := by rfl
    rw [← Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc, biprodIsoProd_hom_snd]
    rw [Category.assoc, biprodIsoProd_hom_snd, biprod.map_snd]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.tildeProductIso_coordinate_square
statement:
theorem tildeProductIso_coordinate_square {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    (M N M' N' : ModuleCat Q) (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    biprod.map ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map f) ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map g) ≫
      (tildeProductIso M' N').hom =
    (tildeProductIso M N).hom ≫ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.prodMap g.hom))
proof:
:= by
  let T := tilde.functor (.of Q)
  letI : T.Additive := AlgebraicGeometry.tildeFunctor_additive_pinned _
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproduct M N T := preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproduct M' N' T := preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  have hn := mapBiprod_coordinate_square T M N M' N' f g
  have hi := congrArg (fun q => (T.mapBiprod M N).inv ≫ q ≫ (T.mapBiprod M' N').inv) hn
  have hi' : biprod.map (T.map f) (T.map g) ≫ (T.mapBiprod M' N').inv =
      (T.mapBiprod M N).inv ≫ T.map (biprod.map f g) := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using hi.symm
  change biprod.map (T.map f) (T.map g) ≫ (T.mapBiprod M' N').inv ≫
    T.map (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M' N').hom =
      (T.mapBiprod M N).inv ≫ T.map (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N).hom ≫
        T.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.prodMap g.hom))
  rw [← Category.assoc, hi', Category.assoc, ← T.map_comp,
    biprodIsoProd_coordinate_square, T.map_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.biprodMap_coordinate_comp
statement:
theorem biprodMap_coordinate_comp {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    {X Y M N P Q : C} [HasBinaryBiproduct X Y] [HasBinaryBiproduct M N] [HasBinaryBiproduct P Q]
    (a : X ⟶ M) (b : Y ⟶ N) (f : M ⟶ P) (g : N ⟶ Q) :
    biprod.map (a ≫ f) (b ≫ g) = biprod.map a b ≫ biprod.map f g
proof:
:= by
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.map_fst, biprod.map_fst_assoc]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd, biprod.map_snd_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.biprod_coordinate_paste
statement:
theorem biprod_coordinate_paste {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    {X Y M N P R S : C} [HasBinaryBiproduct X Y] [HasBinaryBiproduct M N] [HasBinaryBiproduct P N]
    (a : X ⟶ M) (b : Y ⟶ N) (f : M ⟶ P)
    (t : P ⊞ N ⟶ S) (s : M ⊞ N ⟶ R) (d : R ⟶ S)
    (h : biprod.map f (𝟙 N) ≫ t = s ≫ d) :
    biprod.map (a ≫ f) b ≫ t = biprod.map a b ≫ s ≫ d
proof:
:= by
  have hc : biprod.map (a ≫ f) b = biprod.map a b ≫ biprod.map f (𝟙 N) := by
    calc
      _ = biprod.map (a ≫ f) (b ≫ 𝟙 N) := by rw [Category.comp_id]
      _ = _ := biprodMap_coordinate_comp a b f (𝟙 N)
  rw [hc, Category.assoc, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso_factor
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso_factor (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    conormalPlusLineChartTildeIso Y J U = conormalPlusLineTildeRoute Y J U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.conormalPlusLineTildeRoute_coordinates
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineTildeRoute_coordinates (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (M N : ModuleCat (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).obj (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) ≅
      (tilde.functor (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).obj M) (k : M ≅ N) :
    conormalPlusLineTildeRoute Y J U N (e ≪≫ (tilde.functor _).mapIso k) =
      conormalPlusLineTildeRoute Y J U M e ≪≫
        (tilde.functor _).mapIso (k.toLinearEquiv.prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl _ _)).toModuleIso
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)
  letI : F.Additive := { map_add := by intro M N f g; rfl }
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproduct (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) F :=
    preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  letI : HasBinaryBiproduct (F.obj (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)) (F.obj (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme)) :=
    inferInstance
  let Q := Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U
  let T := tilde.functor (.of Q)
  let L := ModuleCat.of Q Q
  let a : F.obj (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) ⟶ T.obj M := e.hom
  let b : F.obj (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme) ⟶ T.obj L :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (J.subschemeCover.f U)).hom ≫ tildeSelf.symm.hom
  let hsource : HasBinaryBiproduct (F.obj (ConormalSheaf.conormal J))
      (F.obj (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme)) := inferInstance
  let hmiddle : HasBinaryBiproduct (T.obj M) (T.obj L) := inferInstance
  let htarget : HasBinaryBiproduct (T.obj N) (T.obj L) := inferInstance
  have hn := tildeProductIso_coordinate_square M L N L k.hom (𝟙 L)
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id] at hn
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [conormalPlusLineTildeRoute, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    biprod.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun q => (F.mapBiprod
      (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme)).hom ≫ q)
    (@biprod_coordinate_paste ((Spec (.of Q)).Modules) inferInstance inferInstance
      (F.obj (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)) (F.obj (ConormalSheaf.unitX J.subscheme))
      (T.obj M) (T.obj L) (T.obj N)
      (T.obj (ModuleCat.of Q (M × Q))) (T.obj (ModuleCat.of Q (N × Q)))
      hsource hmiddle htarget a b
      (T.map k.hom) (tildeProductIso N L).hom (tildeProductIso M L).hom
      (T.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (k.hom.hom.prodMap (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (𝟙 L))))) hn)

theorem coordinate_terminal_paste {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) {X M N : C} {P Q : D} (c : X ⟶ M) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (e : P ⟶ Q) (a : F.obj M ⟶ P) (b : F.obj N ⟶ Q)
    (h : F.map f ≫ b = a ≫ e) : F.map (c ≫ f) ≫ b = F.map c ≫ a ≫ e
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.map_comp, Category.assoc, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.spectrumSectionsIso_coordinates
statement:
theorem spectrumSectionsIso_coordinates {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    {P : (Spec (.of Q)).Modules} {M N : ModuleCat Q}
    (e : P ≅ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).obj M) (k : M ≅ N) :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).mapIso (e ≪≫ (tilde.functor (.of Q)).mapIso k) ≪≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).symm =
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q)).mapIso e ≪≫
      ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).symm ≪≫ k
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  have h := coordinate_terminal_paste (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of Q))
    e.hom ((tilde.functor (.of Q)).map k.hom) k.hom
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app M).inv
    ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := .of Q)).app N).inv
    (tildeSections_coordinate_square k.hom)
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalCoherence.symmetricCoordinateMap_trans
statement:
theorem symmetricCoordinateMap_trans {Q M N P : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module Q M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Q N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module Q P]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) (f : N ≃ₗ[Q] P) :
    (symmetricCoordinateMap (e.trans f)).toRingHom =
      (symmetricCoordinateMap f).toRingHom.comp (symmetricCoordinateMap e).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, AlgHom.commutes]
  | ι m =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      symmetricCoordinateMap_ι, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add,hp,hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul,hp,hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.nativeFamily_differential_zero
statement:
theorem nativeFamily_differential_zero {M : (projectiveNormalCone Y J).Modules} (d : ℤ)
    (s : ∀ U, M ⟶ pushedAffineNativeKernel Y J d U)
    (hs : ∀ R : NativeRefinement Y,
      s R.left ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J R.leftLE d =
        s R.right ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J R.rightLE d) :
    Pi.lift s ≫ (nativeDescentLeft Y J d - nativeDescentRight Y J d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : Pi.lift s ≫ nativeDescentLeft Y J d = Pi.lift s ≫ nativeDescentRight Y J d := by
    apply Pi.hom_ext
    intro R
    have hl := nativeDescentLeft_component Y J d R
    have hr := nativeDescentRight_component Y J d R
    have hsl := Pi.lift_π s R.left
    have hsr := Pi.lift_π s R.right
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun q => Pi.lift s ≫ q) hl).trans
        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun q => q ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J R.leftLE d) hsl).trans
            ((hs R).trans
              ((congrArg (fun q => q ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J R.rightLE d) hsr.symm).trans
                ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
                  ((congrArg (fun q => Pi.lift s ≫ q) hr.symm).trans
                    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)))))))
  exact (Preadditive.comp_sub _ _ _).trans (sub_eq_zero.mpr he)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.nativeGlobalLift_projection
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nativeGlobalLift_projection {M : (projectiveNormalCone Y J).Modules} (d : ℤ)
    (s : ∀ U, M ⟶ pushedAffineNativeKernel Y J d U)
    (hs : ∀ R : NativeRefinement Y,
      s R.left ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J R.leftLE d =
        s R.right ≫ pushedNativeRestriction Y J R.rightLE d) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    nativeGlobalLift Y J d s hs ≫ nativeGlobalProjection Y J d U = s U
proof:
:= by
  have hι := kernel.lift_ι (nativeDescentLeft Y J d - nativeDescentRight Y J d)
    (Pi.lift s) (nativeFamily_differential_zero Y J d s hs)
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun q => q ≫ Pi.π (pushedAffineNativeKernel Y J d) U) hι).trans
      (Pi.lift_π s U))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundleTwistDescent.nativeGlobalProjection_hom_ext
proof:
:= by

statement:
theorem moduleHom_eq_cast {X : Scheme.{u}} {E F : X.Modules} (f : E ⟶ F)
    {O P : X.Opens} (he : P = O) (m : Γ(E,O)) :
    F.presheaf.map (eqToHom he).op (f.app O m) =
      f.app P (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom he).op m)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := ((Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X).map f).naturality (eqToHom he).op

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.restrictUnit_top
statement:
theorem restrictUnit_top {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (O : Y.Opens) (he : q ''ᵁ ⊤ = O) (E : Y.Modules) (m : Γ(E,O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj E).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (openChart_preimage_top q O he).symm).op
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app E).app O m) =
      E.presheaf.map (eqToHom he).op m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  change E.presheaf.map (q.opensFunctor.map
    (eqToHom (openChart_preimage_top q O he).symm)).op
      (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (q.image_preimage_le O)).op m) = _
  have hh : E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (q.image_preimage_le O)).op ≫
      E.presheaf.map (q.opensFunctor.map
        (eqToHom (openChart_preimage_top q O he).symm)).op =
      E.presheaf.map (eqToHom he).op := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom m) hh

statement:

    J.subschemeCover.f U ⁻¹ᵁ (J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) = ⊤

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalGlobalUnitRoute_top
statement:
theorem conormalGlobalUnitRoute_top (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule J,U.1)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).obj
      (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (centreChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm).op
        ((conormalGlobalUnitRoute Y J U).app U.1 m) =
    (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).hom.app ⊤
      (centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator Y J U m)
proof:
:= by
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).obj
    (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).presheaf.map _
      ((conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).hom.app
        (J.subschemeCover.f U ⁻¹ᵁ (J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (J.subschemeCover.f U)).unit.app
          (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)).app (J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
          (globalConormalUnitSections Y J U.1 m))) = _
  have hp := moduleHom_eq_cast (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).hom
    (centreChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (J.subschemeCover.f U)).unit.app
      (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)).app (J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
        (globalConormalUnitSections Y J U.1 m))
  refine hp.trans ?_
  congr 1
  exact restrictUnit_top (J.subschemeCover.f U) _ (centreChart_image_top Y J U)
    (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) (globalConormalUnitSections Y J U.1 m)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.pullbackUnit_top_cast
statement:
theorem pullbackUnit_top_cast {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (E : Y.Modules) (O : Y.Opens) (he : O = ⊤) (m : Γ(E,O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (pullbackPreimage_top f O he).symm).op
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E).app O m) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (pullbackPreimage_top f ⊤ rfl).symm).op
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E).app ⊤
          (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom he.symm).op m))
proof:
:= by
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E
  have hn := moduleHom_eq_cast ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E)
    he.symm m
  have hc : F.presheaf.map ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (eqToHom he.symm)).op ≫
      F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (pullbackPreimage_top f ⊤ rfl).symm).op =
      F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (pullbackPreimage_top f O he).symm).op := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  have hh := congrArg (fun g => g.hom
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E).app O m)) hc
  exact hh.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x => F.presheaf.map
    (eqToHom (pullbackPreimage_top f ⊤ rfl).symm).op x) hn)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.affinePullbackSectionUnit_apply
statement:
theorem affinePullbackSectionUnit_apply {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (E : (Spec (.of A)).Modules) (m : Γ(E,⊤)) :
    (affinePullbackSectionUnit φ E).hom m =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj E).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (pullbackPreimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⊤ rfl).symm).op
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app E).app ⊤ m)
proof:
:= by
  change (moduleSpecΓPushforwardIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj E)).hom.hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app E).app ⊤ m) = _
  exact spectrumPushforwardSections_hom_apply φ _ _

theorem centre_local_preimage_eq (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    J.subschemeCover.f U ⁻¹ᵁ (J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalLocalUnitRoute_top
statement:
theorem conormalLocalUnitRoute_top (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule J,U.1)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).obj
      (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (centreChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm).op
        ((conormalLocalUnitRoute Y J U).app U.1 m) =
    (affinePullbackSectionUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
      (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).hom
        (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y U (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) m)
proof:
:= by
  let E := ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).obj E
  let v := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.2.fromSpec).unit.app
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J)).app U.1 m
  change F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (centreChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm).op
    (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (centre_local_preimage_eq Y J U)).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).unit.app E).app (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) v)) = _
  have hc : F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (centre_local_preimage_eq Y J U)).op ≫
      F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (centreChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm).op =
      F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (localChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm).op := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  have hcast := congrArg (fun g => g.hom
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).unit.app E).app
      (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) v)) hc
  have hu := pullbackUnit_top_cast (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U) E
    (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (ambientChart_preimage_top Y U) v
  have ha : E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ambientChart_preimage_top Y U).symm).op v =
      affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y U (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) m :=
    restrictUnit_top U.2.fromSpec U.1 (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top U)
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) m
  refine hcast.trans (hu.trans ?_)
  rw [ha]
  exact (affinePullbackSectionUnit_apply (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)) E
    (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y U (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) m)).symm

theorem moduleIso_inv_hom_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} {E F : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ F)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_eq_local
statement:
theorem centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_eq_local (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule J,U.1)) :
    centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator Y J U m =
      conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J U
        (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y U (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) m)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)).obj
    (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)
  have hr := congrArg (fun f => F.presheaf.map
    (eqToHom (centreChart_preimage_top Y J U).symm).op (f.app U.1 m))
    (conormalUnitRoutes_eq Y J U)
  have hg := conormalGlobalUnitRoute_top Y J U m
  have hl := conormalLocalUnitRoute_top Y J U m
  have hgen := hg.symm.trans (hr.symm.trans hl)
  calc
    centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator Y J U m =
      (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).inv.app ⊤
        ((conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).hom.app ⊤
          (centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator Y J U m)) :=
      (moduleIso_inv_hom_apply (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U) ⊤ _).symm
    _ = (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).inv.app ⊤
        ((affinePullbackSectionUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
          (ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U)).hom
            (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y U (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) m)) :=
      congrArg (fun z => (conormalChartPullbackIdealIso Y J U).inv.app ⊤ z) hgen
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalChartGeometricGenerator_naturality
statement:
theorem conormalChartGeometricGenerator_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J V,⊤)) :
    centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.conormal J)
      (conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J V m) =
    conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J U
      (affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h m)
proof:
:= by
  let e := affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y V (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J)
  have hn := centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_naturality Y J h (e.symm m)
  rw [centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_eq_local,
    centreChartGlobalConormalGenerator_eq_local] at hn
  have he : affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Y V (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) (e.symm m) = m :=
    e.apply_symm_apply m
  rw [he] at hn
  have hr := affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h (e.symm m)
  rw [he] at hr
  exact hn.trans (congrArg (conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J U) hr.symm)

statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.tensor_smul_one
statement:
theorem tensor_smul_one {A B M : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (q : B) (m : M) :
    q • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] m) = q ⊗ₜ[A] m
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_symm_tmul (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (q : Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
    (m : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealChart J U,⊤)) :
    (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).symm (q ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)] m) =
      q • conormalChartGeometricGenerator Y J U m
proof:
:= by
  apply (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_smul, conormalChartGeometricGenerator_coordinates]
  exact (tensor_smul_one (A := Γ(Y,U.1)) q m).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_symm_naturality
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_symm_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (t : idealChartTensor Y J V) :
    conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U
      (actualConormalSectionsSemilinear Y J h
        ((conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V).symm t)) =
      idealChartTensorRestriction Y J h t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | tmul q m =>
    rw [conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_symm_tmul,
      map_smulₛₗ, actualConormalSectionsSemilinear_generator,
      map_smul, conormalChartGeometricGenerator_coordinates]
    change GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h q •
      ((1 : Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)]
        affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h m) =
      GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h q ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y,U.1)]
        affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Y (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J) h m
    exact tensor_smul_one (A := Γ(Y,U.1)) _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (m : conormalChartSections Y J V) :
    conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U
      (actualConormalSectionsSemilinear Y J h m) =
      idealChartTensorRestriction Y J h (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V).symm.surjective m
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
    conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_symm_naturality Y J (U := U) (V := V) h t

statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_centreRestriction_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (m : conormalChartSections Y J V) :
    conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U
      (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) m) =
