name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (m : conormalChartSections Y J V) :
    conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J U
      (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) m) =
      InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) (conormalChartCotangentSectionsEquiv Y J V m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_coordinates, conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_coordinates]
  change idealChartTensorEquiv Y J U (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U
    (centreChartSectionsRestriction Y J h (ConormalSheaf.conormal J) m)) =
    InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.cotangentRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)
      (idealChartTensorEquiv Y J V (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V m))
  rw [conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_centreRestriction_naturality,
    idealChartTensorEquiv_apply, idealChartTensorEquiv_apply]
  exact idealChartTensorCoordinates_naturality Y J h (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V m)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_base
statement:
theorem symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_base {Q M N : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module Q M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Q N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) (r : Q) :
    (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap e).toRingHom
      (algebraMap Q (SymmetricAlgebra Q M) r) = algebraMap Q (SymmetricAlgebra Q N) r
proof:
:=
  (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap e).commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_ι
statement:
theorem symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_ι {Q M N : Type u} [CommRing Q]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module Q M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Q N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) (m : M) :
    (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap e).toRingHom
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q M m) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q N (e m)
proof:
:=
  InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap_ι e m

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleConormalGeneratorNaturality.conormalChartTensorSymmetric_naturality
statement:
theorem conormalChartTensorSymmetric_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap
      (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J U)).toRingHom.comp
        (actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction Y J h) =
    (actualIdealTensorSymmetricRestriction Y J h).comp
      (InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap
        (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv Y J V)).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction,
      actualIdealTensorSymmetricRestriction, InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_base,
      symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_base]
  | ι m =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, actualConormalSectionsSymmetricRestriction,
      actualIdealTensorSymmetricRestriction, InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_ι,
      symmetricCoordinateMap_toRingHom_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (idealChartTensor Y J U))
      (conormalChartTensorSectionsEquiv_naturality Y J h m)
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_projectiveSpace
statement:
theorem isIntegral_projectiveSpace (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (n : ℕ) :
    IsIntegral (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_proj (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) ⟨1, MvPolynomial.X 0,
    MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X R 0, one_pos, MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero 0⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal
statement:
theorem isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal [IsIntegral J.subscheme] :
    IsIntegral (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : ⨆ U : Y.affineOpens, (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U).opensRange = ⊤ := by
    have h1 : ⨆ U : Y.affineOpens, (J.subschemeCover.f U).opensRange = ⊤ :=
      Scheme.OpenCover.iSup_opensRange J.subschemeCover.openCover
    have h2 : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U).opensRange =
        totalToClosedBase Y J ⁻¹ᵁ (J.subschemeCover.f U).opensRange := fun U =>
      (preimage_closedBaseChart Y J U).symm
    simp only [h2]
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup, h1]
    exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _
  refine isIntegral_of_cartesianCover (totalToClosedBase Y J)
    (fun U : Y.affineOpens => Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)))
    (fun U => subschemeTotal (J.ideal U)) J.subschemeCover.f
    (fun U => J.subschemeCover.openCover.map_prop U)
    (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J) (fun U => inferInstance)
    (fun U => affineSubschemeToBase (J.ideal U))
    (fun U => isPullback_closedBaseChart Y J U) hcover ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U V t htU htV
    rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map] at htU htV
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, htW, hWsub⟩ := Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
      (show J.subschemeι t ∈ ((U.1 ⊓ V.1 : Y.Opens) : Set Y) from ⟨htU, htV⟩)
      (U.1 ⊓ V.1).isOpen
    refine ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map]; exact htW
    · rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map, J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map,
        J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map]
      intro s hs
      exact hWsub hs
  · obtain ⟨z⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty J.subscheme)
    let U := J.subschemeCover.idx z
    exact ⟨U, (J.subschemeCover.covers z).elim fun w _ => ⟨w⟩⟩
  · intro U hU
    haveI : IsIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))) :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (J.subschemeCover.f U)
    haveI : IsDomain (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) :=
      (affine_isIntegral_iff (CommRingCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).mp inferInstance
    haveI : IsIntegral (ProjectiveLine.P1 (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) :=
      isIntegral_projectiveSpace (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) 1
    exact IsIntegral.of_isIso (affineSubschemeIsoP1 (J.ideal U)).inv

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalComplement
statement:
theorem isIntegral_totalComplement [IsIntegral Y] [Nonempty (totalComplement Y J)] :
    IsIntegral (totalComplement Y J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_totalGlobal Y J
  exact isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (totalComplement Y J).ι

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.nonempty_totalComplement
statement:
theorem nonempty_totalComplement (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) (y : Y)
    (hy : y ∉ Set.range J.subschemeι) : Nonempty (totalComplement Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨GlobalCompletion.fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 y, ?_⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  apply hy
  have h1 : J.subschemeι (totalToClosedBase Y J x) =
      GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, totalToClosedBase_subschemeι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  refine ⟨totalToClosedBase Y J x, ?_⟩
  rw [h1, hx, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, GlobalCompletion.fibreιGlobal_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.map_centreIdeal_mapRingHom
statement:
theorem map_centreIdeal_mapRingHom {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (K : Ideal A)
    (f : A →+* B) :
    (centreIdeal K).map (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) = centreIdeal (K.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centreIdeal, centreIdeal, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map,
    Polynomial.mapRingHom_comp_C]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.exists_chartMap_comp_schemeMapOfEq
statement:
theorem exists_chartMap_comp_schemeMapOfEq {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (K : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (K' : Ideal B) (h : K.map f = K') (r : K) (r' : K')
    (hr : f r.1 = r'.1) :
    ∃ ψ : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade K) (generator K r) →+*
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade K') (generator K' r'),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : A), c ∈ K ^ n → ψ (chartElem K r n c) = chartElem K' r' n (f c)) ∧
      chartMap K' r' ≫ schemeMapOfEq K f K' h = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ chartMap K r
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  obtain rfl : r' = mapGenerator K f r := Subtype.ext hr.symm
  exact ⟨chartBaseChangeHom K f r, fun n c hc ↦ chartBaseChangeHom_chartElem K f r n hc,
    chartMap_comp_schemeMap K f r⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.uChartHom_chartElem
statement:
theorem uChartHom_chartElem (n : ℕ) (c : R[X]) (hc : c ∈ centreIdeal I ^ n) :
    uChartHom I (chartElem (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) n c) * parameter R I ^ n = φ I c
proof:
:= by
  rw [uChartHom, chartElem, chartLift_mk (centreIdeal I) (φ I) (uGen I) _ _ n _
    (homogeneousMonomial_mem_grade _ n c)]
  have hspec := principalCoefficient_spec (centreIdeal I) (φ I) (φ I (uGen I).1)
    (map_centreIdeal I) n _ (((mem_reesAlgebra_iff _ _).mp
      (homogeneousMonomial (centreIdeal I) n c).property) n)
  rw [← φ_X I]
  refine hspec.trans ?_
  congr 1
  rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe _ n c hc]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.extReesMapOfEq_φ
statement:
theorem extReesMapOfEq_φ (p : A[X]) :
    extReesMapOfEq K f K' hK (φ K p) = φ K' (p.map f)
proof:
:= by
  have : (extReesMapOfEq K f K' hK).comp (φ K) = (φ K').comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, φ_C,
        extReesMapOfEq_algebraMap]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, φ_X,
        extReesMapOfEq_parameter]
  exact congrArg (fun g ↦ g p) this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.uChartHom_natural
statement:
theorem uChartHom_natural
    (ψ : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal K)) (generator _ (uGen K)) →+*
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal K')) (generator _ (uGen K')))
    (hψ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : A[X]), c ∈ centreIdeal K ^ n →
      ψ (chartElem _ (uGen K) n c) = chartElem _ (uGen K') n (Polynomial.mapRingHom f c))
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal K)) (generator _ (uGen K))) :
    uChartHom K' (ψ z) = extReesMapOfEq K f K' hK (uChartHom K z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, c, hc, rfl⟩ := chartElem_surjective _ _ z
  rw [hψ n c hc]
  have hc' : Polynomial.mapRingHom f c ∈ centreIdeal K' ^ n := by
    rw [← hK, ← map_centreIdeal_mapRingHom, ← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hc
  apply ((parameter_isRegular K').pow n).right
  change uChartHom K' _ * parameter B K' ^ n = extReesMapOfEq K f K' hK _ * parameter B K' ^ n
  rw [uChartHom_chartElem K' n _ hc', ← extReesMapOfEq_parameter K f K' hK, ← map_pow,
    ← map_mul, uChartHom_chartElem K n c hc, extReesMapOfEq_φ]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.uChartι_natural
statement:
theorem uChartι_natural (hc : (centreIdeal K).map (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) = centreIdeal K') :
    uChartι K' ≫ schemeMapOfEq (centreIdeal K) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal K') hc =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extReesMapOfEq K f K' hK)) ≫ uChartι K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hsq⟩ := exists_chartMap_comp_schemeMapOfEq (centreIdeal K)
    (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal K') hc (uGen K) (uGen K')
    (by simp [uGen])
  rw [uChartι, uChartι, Category.assoc, hsq, uChartIso_hom, uChartIso_hom,
    ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun g ↦ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ chartMap (centreIdeal K) (uGen K))
    (RingHom.ext (f := (uChartHom K').comp ψ) (g := (extReesMapOfEq K f K' hK).comp (uChartHom K))
      fun z ↦ uChartHom_natural K f K' hK ψ hψ z)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_polyRes
statement:
theorem isPullback_polyRes {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (polyRes Y h)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(Y, U.1) →+* Γ(Y, U.1)[X])))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(Y, V.1) →+* Γ(Y, V.1)[X])))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (res Y h)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (res Y h).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1)[X] := Polynomial.algebra Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(Y, U.1)
  exact isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(Y, V.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(Y, U.1)[X])

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.isPullback_blowup_polyRes
statement:
theorem isPullback_blowup_polyRes {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPullback (schemeMapOfEq (centreIdeal (J.ideal V)) (polyRes Y h) (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))
        (map_centreIdeal_polyRes Y J h))
      (blowupToLine (J.ideal U)) (blowupToLine (J.ideal V))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (polyRes Y h)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (res Y h).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1)[X] := Polynomial.algebra Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(Y, U.1)
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(Y, U.1) := res_flat Y h
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(Y, V.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1)[X] :=
    Module.Flat.isBaseChange Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(Y, V.1)[X] Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(Y, U.1)[X]
      (Algebra.IsPushout.out (R := Γ(Y, V.1)) (S := Γ(Y, V.1)[X]) (R' := Γ(Y, U.1)))
  exact isPullback_schemeMapOfEq _ _ (map_centreIdeal_polyRes Y J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.gluingNatTrans_equifibered
statement: theorem gluingNatTrans_equifibered : (gluingNatTrans Y J).Equifibered
proof:
:= by
  intro U V h
  rw [← homOfLE_leOfHom h, Scheme.Cover.functorOfLocallyDirected_map,
    Scheme.directedAffineCover_trans]
  change IsPullback (schemeMapOfEq _ (polyRes Y (leOfHom h)) _ _)
    (blowupToLine (J.ideal U) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom Polynomial.C) ≫
      (isAffineOpen Y U).isoSpec.inv)
    (blowupToLine (J.ideal V) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom Polynomial.C) ≫
      (isAffineOpen Y V).isoSpec.inv)
    (Y.homOfLE (leOfHom h))
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using
    ((isPullback_blowup_polyRes Y J (leOfHom h)).paste_vert
      (isPullback_polyRes Y (leOfHom h))).paste_vert (isPullback_specMap_res Y (leOfHom h))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.uChart_compat
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.uChartGlobal_toBase

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalCompletion.toP1Global_flat
statement: theorem toP1Global_flat : Flat (toP1Global Y J k φk)
proof:
:= by

    (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))) fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover_f]
  haveI := blowupGlobalToLineOver_flat Y J k φk
  haveI := DeformationSpace.toLineOver_flat Y ⊥ k φk
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · change Flat (colimit.ι (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))
      WalkingSpan.zero ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
    rw [← colimit.w (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))
      WalkingSpan.Hom.fst, Category.assoc]
    change Flat (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
    rw [blowupGlobalι_toP1]
    infer_instance
  · change Flat (blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
    rw [blowupGlobalι_toP1]
    infer_instance
  · change Flat (lineTι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
    rw [lineTι_toP1]
    infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.overlapToClosedBase
statement:
theorem overlapToClosedBase :
    (subGmToUHom Y J).map ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J =
      (subGmToTHom Y J).map ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  change RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientLaurentData Y J) U ≫
      ((subGmToUHom Y J).map ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J) =
    RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientLaurentData Y J) U ≫
      ((subGmToTHom Y J).map ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J)
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    affineι_polynomialToClosedBase, ← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map,
    Category.assoc, affineι_polynomialToClosedBase]
  unfold polynomialChartToClosedBase
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  apply congrArg CommRingCat.ofHom
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  change nonPosHom (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (Polynomial.C a) = Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.C a)
  simp [nonPosHom, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, invert_C]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.subschemeUι_totalToClosedBase
statement:

statement:
theorem overlapToIntegerP1 :
    (subGmToUHom Y J).map ≫ polynomialToIntegerLine Y J ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0 =
      (subGmToTHom Y J).map ≫ polynomialToIntegerLine Y J ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map]
  simp only [Category.assoc, affineι_polynomialToIntegerLine_assoc]
  let f := integerMap (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
  have hU : ((subGmToUHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) =
      (mapLaurent f).comp (nonPosHom integerRing) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro p
    exact (mapLaurent_nonPosHom f p).symm
  have hT : ((subGmToTHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) =
      (mapLaurent f).comp Polynomial.toLaurent := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro p
    exact (mapLaurent_toLaurent f p).symm
  unfold polynomialChartToIntegerLine
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (((subGmToUHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom f))) ≫ _ =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (((subGmToTHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom f))) ≫ _
  rw [hU, hT, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  rw [line_chart_compat integerRing]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.normalizedChartMap
statement:
theorem normalizedChartMap {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (i : Fin 2) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized f 1 i).comp
      (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i).symm.toRingHom =
      (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv B i).symm.toRingHom.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C]
    change SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized f 1 i
      ((ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i).symm (Polynomial.C a)) =
        (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv B i).symm (Polynomial.C (f a))
    rw [chartEquiv_symm_C, chartEquiv_symm_C,
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized_coefficient]
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X]
    change SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized f 1 i
      ((ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i).symm Polynomial.X) =
        (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv B i).symm Polynomial.X
    rw [chartEquiv_symm_X, chartEquiv_symm_X,
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized_coordinateRatio]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.projectiveLineChart_map
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem projectiveLineChart_map {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (i : Fin 2) :
    ProjectiveLine.chart B i ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map f 1 =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)) ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart A i
proof:
:= by
  unfold ProjectiveLine.chart
  rw [Category.assoc, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_comp_map_normalized,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  apply congrArg CommRingCat.ofHom
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  have hp := RingHom.congr_fun (normalizedChartMap f i) (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i z)
  change SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized f 1 i
      ((ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i).symm (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i z)) =
    (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv B i).symm ((ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv A i z).map f) at hp
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hp
  have hh := congrArg (ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv B i) hp
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hh
  exact hh

    unfold polynomialChartToClosedBase affineSubschemeToBase

  · simp only [← Category.assoc]
    rw [subschemeTotalAffineι, pushout.inr_desc]
    rw [Category.assoc, subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase,
      affineι_polynomialToClosedBase]
    unfold polynomialChartToClosedBase affineSubschemeToBase

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.subschemeTotalAffineι_toIntegerP1
statement:

  · simp only [← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToClosedBase_subschemeι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem totalToClosedBase_subschemeι :
    totalToClosedBase Y J ≫ J.subschemeι =
      subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J
proof:
:= by
  have hB : GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalToBase Y J := pushout.inl_desc _ _ _
  have hT : GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ := pushout.inr_desc _ _ _
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change subschemeUιGlobal Y J ≫ (totalToClosedBase Y J ≫ J.subschemeι) =
      subschemeUιGlobal Y J ≫ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J)
    rw [subschemeUι_totalToClosedBase_assoc, polynomialToClosedBase_subschemeι,
      subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι_assoc]
    unfold subschemeToBlowupGlobal
    rw [hB, Category.assoc, GlobalCompletion.uChartGlobal_toBase]
    exact (RelativeSpec.Hom.map_toBase (toDeformationHom Y J)).symm
  · change subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ (totalToClosedBase Y J ≫ J.subschemeι) =
      subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J)
    rw [subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase_assoc, polynomialToClosedBase_subschemeι,
      subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι_assoc, hT]
    exact (RelativeSpec.Hom.map_toBase (toLineHom Y J)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.preimage_closedBaseChart
statement:
theorem preimage_closedBaseChart (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    totalToClosedBase Y J ⁻¹ᵁ (J.subschemeCover.f U).opensRange =
      (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    totalToClosedBase_subschemeι, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  rw [← GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι_opensRange Y J U]
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  let h := isPullback_subschemeTotalAffine Y J U
  have hs : Function.Surjective h.isoPullback.hom :=
    (TopCat.epi_iff_surjective h.isoPullback.hom.base).mp inferInstance
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : subschemeTotal (J.ideal U) ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J ↦
    Set.range f) h.isoPullback_hom_snd
  change Set.range ((pullback.snd (GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U)
    (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)) ∘ h.isoPullback.hom) = _ at hc
  rw [Set.range_comp, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hs, Set.image_univ] at hc
  have hp := congrArg (fun O : (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J).Opens ↦ O.carrier)
    (Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackSnd (f := GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U)
      (g := subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J))
  exact hp.symm.trans hc

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProductGlobal.isPullback_totalIntegerP1
statement:
theorem isPullback_totalIntegerP1 :
    IsPullback (totalToClosedBase Y J) (totalToIntegerP1 Y J)
      (closedBaseToInteger Y J) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec integerRing 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ J.subschemeCover.openCover fun U ↦ ?_
  let h := (isPullback_closedBaseChart Y J U).flip
  refine (isPullback_affineSubscheme (J.ideal U)
    (integerMap (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).flip.of_iso
    h.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact h.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    change affineSubschemeToP1 (J.ideal U) (integerMap (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) =
      h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst (totalToClosedBase Y J) (J.subschemeCover.f U) ≫
        totalToIntegerP1 Y J
    rw [← Category.assoc, h.isoPullback_hom_fst, subschemeTotalAffineι_toIntegerP1]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact (closedBaseChart_toInteger Y J U).symm
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.isPushout_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem isPushout_of_algEquiv (φ : S →+* T) (e : B ⊗[A] S ≃ₐ[B] T)
    (he : ∀ s : S, e ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] s) = φ s) :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A S)) (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B T))
proof:
:= by
  refine (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A B S).flip.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (Iso.refl _) e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    ext s
    exact he s
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    ext b
    change e (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : S)) = algebraMap B T b
    rw [← e.commutes b]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.gluingNatTrans_equifibered
statement: theorem gluingNatTrans_equifibered : (gluingNatTrans X 𝒜).Equifibered
proof:
:= by
  intro U V h
  rw [← homOfLE_leOfHom h, Scheme.Cover.functorOfLocallyDirected_map,
    Scheme.directedAffineCover_trans]
  change IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (𝒜.map (leOfHom h))))
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (𝒜.ring U))) ≫
      (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (𝒜.ring V))) ≫
      (isAffineOpen X V).isoSpec.inv) (X.homOfLE (leOfHom h))
  exact (isPullback_specMap_map X 𝒜 (leOfHom h)).paste_vert (isPullback_specMap_res X (leOfHom h))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.isPullback_affine
statement:
theorem isPullback_affine (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (projection X 𝒜 U) (affineι X 𝒜 U) U.1.ι (toBase X 𝒜)
proof:
:=
  (gluingData X 𝒜).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.affineι_toBase
statement:
theorem affineι_toBase (U : X.affineOpens) :
    affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ toBase X 𝒜 = projection X 𝒜 U ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_affine X 𝒜 U).w.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.iSup_opensRange_affineι
statement: theorem iSup_opensRange_affineι : ⨆ U : X.affineOpens, (affineι X 𝒜 U).opensRange = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (gluingData X 𝒜).cover.iSup_opensRange

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.property_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem property_restrict_iff (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.RespectsIso]
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    P (toBase X 𝒜 ∣_ U.1.ι.opensRange) ↔ P (projection X 𝒜 U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange (toBase X 𝒜) U.1.ι)]
  exact (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (Arrow.isoMk (isPullback_affine X 𝒜 U).flip.isoPullback
    (Iso.refl _) (by
      simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      exact (isPullback_affine X 𝒜 U).flip.isoPullback_hom_snd))).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.property_restrict_iff'
statement:
theorem property_restrict_iff' (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.RespectsIso]
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    P (toBase X 𝒜 ∣_ U.1) ↔ P (projection X 𝒜 U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← property_restrict_iff X 𝒜 P U, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.property_toBase_of_forall
statement:
theorem property_toBase_of_forall (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P]
    (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, P (projection X 𝒜 U)) : P (toBase X 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_iSup_eq_top (P := P)
    (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ U.1) (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top X)).mpr fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [property_restrict_iff' X 𝒜 P U]
  exact h U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.isIso_toBase_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_toBase_of_bijective
    (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, Function.Bijective (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (𝒜.ring U))) :
    IsIso (toBase X 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  refine property_toBase_of_forall X 𝒜 (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme) fun U ↦ ?_
  have : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (𝒜.ring U)))) := by
    rw [isIso_SpecMap_iff]
    exact h U
  exact inferInstanceAs (IsIso (_ ≫ _))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map
statement:
theorem affineι_map (U : X.affineOpens) :
    affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ φ.map = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.app U).toRingHom) ≫ affineι X ℬ U
proof:
:=
  ι_colimMap φ.gluingNatTrans U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.specMap_app_projection
statement:
theorem specMap_app_projection (U : X.affineOpens) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.app U).toRingHom) ≫ projection X ℬ U = projection X 𝒜 U
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 3
  ext a
  exact (φ.app U).commutes a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.map_toBase
statement: theorem map_toBase : φ.map ≫ toBase X ℬ = toBase X 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit.hom_ext
  intro U
  change affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ φ.map ≫ toBase X ℬ = affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ toBase X 𝒜
  rw [← Category.assoc, affineι_map, Category.assoc, affineι_toBase, affineι_toBase,
    ← Category.assoc, specMap_app_projection]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.isPullback_map
statement:
theorem isPullback_map (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.app U).toRingHom)) (affineι X 𝒜 U)
      (affineι X ℬ U) φ.map
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right ?_ (φ.affineι_map U).symm (isPullback_affine X ℬ U)
  rw [specMap_app_projection, map_toBase]
  exact isPullback_affine X 𝒜 U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.property_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem property_restrict_iff (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.RespectsIso]
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    P (φ.map ∣_ (affineι X ℬ U).opensRange) ↔
      P (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.app U).toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange φ.map (affineι X ℬ U))]
  exact (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (Arrow.isoMk (φ.isPullback_map U).flip.isoPullback
    (Iso.refl _) (by
      simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      exact (φ.isPullback_map U).flip.isoPullback_hom_snd))).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.property_map_of_forall
statement:
theorem property_map_of_forall (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P]
    (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, P (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.app U).toRingHom))) :
    P φ.map
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_iSup_eq_top (P := P)
    (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ (affineι X ℬ U).opensRange)
    (iSup_opensRange_affineι X ℬ)).mpr fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [φ.property_restrict_iff P U]
  exact h U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.map_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem map_isClosedImmersion (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, Function.Surjective (φ.app U)) :
    IsClosedImmersion φ.map
proof:
:=
  φ.property_map_of_forall @IsClosedImmersion fun U ↦
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (h U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.isIso_map
statement: theorem isIso_map (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, Function.Bijective (φ.app U)) : IsIso φ.map
proof:
:=
  φ.property_map_of_forall (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme) fun U ↦ by
    change IsIso _
    rw [isIso_SpecMap_iff]
    exact h U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesMapOfEq_coe (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (p : reesAlgebra I) : (reesMapOfEq I f J h p : B[X]) = (p : A[X]).map f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq_mem_grade
statement:
theorem reesMapOfEq_mem_grade (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) (hp : p ∈ grade I n) :
    reesMapOfEq I f J h p ∈ grade J n
proof:
:= by
  change (p : A[X]).map f = monomial n (((p : A[X]).map f).coeff n)
  change (p : A[X]) = monomial n ((p : A[X]).coeff n) at hp
  rw [hp, map_monomial, coeff_monomial]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq_rfl
statement:
theorem gradedMapOfEq_rfl (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) :
    gradedMapOfEq I f (I.map f) rfl = gradedMap I f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfEq
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfEq (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade J) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade I)).map (gradedMapOfEq I f J h)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap I f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq_rfl
statement:
theorem schemeMapOfEq_rfl (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) :
    schemeMapOfEq I f (I.map f) rfl = schemeMap I f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq_comp_projection
statement:
theorem schemeMapOfEq_comp_projection (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    schemeMapOfEq I f J h ≫ projection I = projection J ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact schemeMap_comp_projection I f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.isPullback_schemeMapOfEq
statement:
theorem isPullback_schemeMapOfEq [Algebra A B] [Module.Flat A B] (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map (algebraMap A B) = J) :
    IsPullback (schemeMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J h) (projection J) (projection I)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact isPullback_schemeMap I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr
statement:
theorem projMap_congr {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [SetLike τ B]
    [AddSubgroupClass τ B] {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    {φ φ' : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ} (e : φ = φ')
    (hφ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map φ) :
    Proj.map φ hφ = Proj.map φ' (e ▸ hφ)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq_congr
statement:
theorem schemeMapOfEq_congr (I : Ideal A) {f f' : A →+* B} (e : f = f') (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    schemeMapOfEq I f J h = schemeMapOfEq I f' J (e ▸ h)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem gradedMapOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h₁ : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (h₂ : J.map g = K) :
    (gradedMapOfEq J g K h₂).comp (gradedMapOfEq I f J h₁) =
      gradedMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h₁, h₂])
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((p : A[X]).map f).map g = (p : A[X]).map (g.comp f)
  rw [Polynomial.map_map]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem schemeMapOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h₁ : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (h₂ : J.map g = K) :
    schemeMapOfEq J g K h₂ ≫ schemeMapOfEq I f J h₁ =
      schemeMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h₁, h₂])
proof:
:= by
  unfold schemeMapOfEq
  rw [← Proj.map_comp]
  exact projMap_congr (gradedMapOfEq_comp I f J h₁ g K h₂) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem gradedMapOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    gradedMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = GradedRingHom.id (grade I)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (p : A[X]).map (RingHom.id A) = p
  rw [Polynomial.map_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem schemeMapOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    schemeMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  unfold schemeMapOfEq
  rw [projMap_congr (gradedMapOfEq_id I)]
  exact Proj.map_id

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.res_refl
statement: theorem res_refl (U : X.affineOpens) : res X (le_refl U) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  change (X.presheaf.map (𝟙 _)).hom = RingHom.id _
  rw [X.presheaf.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.res_comp
statement:
theorem res_comp {U V W : X.affineOpens} (h₁ : U ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ W) :
    res X (h₁.trans h₂) = (res X h₁).comp (res X h₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [res, res, res, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.res_flat
statement: theorem res_flat {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) : (res X h).Flat
proof:
:= by
  have key := U.1.ι.flat_appLE (isAffineOpen X V) (isAffineOpen_top U.1.toScheme)
    (show (⊤ : U.1.toScheme.Opens) ≤ U.1.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 from fun x _ ↦ h x.2)
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appLE] at key
  have aux : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hW : W = U.1) (e : W ≤ V.1),
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op).hom.Flat → (res X h).Flat := by
    intro W hW e key'
    subst hW
    exact key'
  exact aux _ (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top U.1) _ key

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.gluingFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem gluingFunctor_obj (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (gluingFunctor X I).obj U = scheme (I.ideal U)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.gluingFunctor_map
statement:
theorem gluingFunctor_map {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ⟶ V) :
    (gluingFunctor X I).map h =
      schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (res X (leOfHom h)) (I.ideal U) (I.map_ideal (leOfHom h))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.gluingApp_eq
statement:
theorem gluingApp_eq (U : X.affineOpens) :
    gluingApp X I U = ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ≫ (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.specMap_res_comp_isoSpec_inv
statement:
theorem specMap_res_comp_isoSpec_inv {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (res X h)) ≫ (isAffineOpen X V).isoSpec.inv =
      (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv ≫ X.homOfLE (h : U.1 ≤ V.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono V.1.ι, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι,
    Scheme.homOfLE_ι, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  exact (isAffineOpen X V).map_fromSpec (isAffineOpen X U) (homOfLE (h : U.1 ≤ V.1)).op

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_specMap_res
statement:
theorem isPullback_specMap_res {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (res X h))) (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv
      (isAffineOpen X V).isoSpec.inv (X.homOfLE (h : U.1 ≤ V.1))
proof:
:=
  IsPullback.of_vert_isIso ⟨specMap_res_comp_isoSpec_inv X h⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.gluingNatTrans_equifibered
statement: theorem gluingNatTrans_equifibered : (gluingNatTrans X I).Equifibered
proof:
:= by
  intro U V h
  rw [← homOfLE_leOfHom h, Scheme.Cover.functorOfLocallyDirected_map,
    Scheme.directedAffineCover_trans]
  change IsPullback (schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (res X (leOfHom h)) (I.ideal U) _)
    (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ≫ (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv)
    (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal V) ≫ (isAffineOpen X V).isoSpec.inv)
    (X.homOfLE (leOfHom h))
  let _ := (res X (leOfHom h)).toAlgebra
  have hflat : Module.Flat Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, U.1) := res_flat X (leOfHom h)
  exact (isPullback_schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (I.ideal U) (I.map_ideal (leOfHom h))).paste_vert
    (isPullback_specMap_res X (leOfHom h))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine
statement:
theorem isPullback_affine (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ≫ (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv)
      (affineι X I U) U.1.ι (toBase X I)
proof:
:=
  (gluingData X I).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.iSup_opensRange_affineι
statement: theorem iSup_opensRange_affineι : ⨆ U : X.affineOpens, (affineι X I U).opensRange = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (gluingData X I).cover.iSup_opensRange

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.property_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem property_restrict_iff (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.RespectsIso]
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    P (toBase X I ∣_ U.1.ι.opensRange) ↔
      P (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ≫ (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange (toBase X I) U.1.ι)]
  exact (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (Arrow.isoMk (isPullback_affine X I U).flip.isoPullback
    (Iso.refl _) (by
      simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      exact (isPullback_affine X I U).flip.isoPullback_hom_snd))).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.property_restrict_iff'
statement:
theorem property_restrict_iff' (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.RespectsIso]
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    P (toBase X I ∣_ U.1) ↔
      P (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ≫ (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← property_restrict_iff X I P U, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.toBase_isProper
statement: theorem toBase_isProper [IsLocallyNoetherian X] : IsProper (toBase X I)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_iSup_eq_top (P := @IsProper)
    (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ U.1) (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top X)).mpr fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [property_restrict_iff' X I @IsProper U]
  have : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  have : IsProper (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U)) := projection_isProper (I.ideal U)
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_affineι_top
statement: theorem isIso_affineι_top [IsAffine X] : IsIso (affineι X I (topIndex X))
proof:
:= by
  have hι : MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme (⊤ : X.Opens).ι :=
    (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mpr ⟨⟨X.topIso.inv, X.ι_toIso_inv, X.toIso_inv_ι⟩⟩
  exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_affine X I (topIndex X)) hι

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.blowupIsoAffine_hom_toBase
statement:
theorem blowupIsoAffine_hom_toBase [IsAffine X] :
    (blowupIsoAffine X I).hom ≫ toBase X I =
      ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal (topIndex X)) ≫
        (isAffineOpen X (topIndex X)).isoSpec.inv ≫ (⊤ : X.Opens).ι
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isPullback_affine X I (topIndex X)).w
  change affineι X I _ ≫ toBase X I = _
  rw [← h, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le
statement:
theorem isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) {U V : Z.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hU : IsIso (f ∣_ U)) : IsIso (f ∣_ V)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme (f ∣_ U) := hU
  have h2 : MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme ((f ∣_ U) ∣_ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :=
    IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.restrict h1 _
  have h3 : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) = V := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    exact inf_eq_right.mpr hVU
  have h4 := (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)
    (morphismRestrictRestrict f U (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V))).mp h2
  rw [h3] at h4
  exact h4

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_morphismRestrict_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isIso_morphismRestrict_of_isIso {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIso f]
    (U : Z.Opens) : IsIso (f ∣_ U)
proof:
:= by
  have h : MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme f := inferInstance
  exact IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.restrict h U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.mem_centreComplement
statement: theorem mem_centreComplement {x : X} : x ∈ centreComplement X I ↔ x ∉ (I.support : Set X)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isoSpec_inv_preimage_affineAway_le
statement:
theorem isoSpec_inv_preimage_affineAway_le (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv ⁻¹ᵁ affineAway X I U ≤ baseComplement (I.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hp' : (isAffineOpen X U).fromSpec p ∉ (I.support : Set X) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact hp
  have hmem : (isAffineOpen X U).fromSpec p ∈ (U.1 : Set X) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec (isAffineOpen X U)]
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hz : (isAffineOpen X U).fromSpec p ∉ X.zeroLocus (U := U.1) (I.ideal U : Set _) := by
    intro hz
    apply hp'
    have hI : (isAffineOpen X U).fromSpec p ∈ (I.support : Set X) ∩ U.1 := by
      rw [I.coe_support_inter U]
      exact ⟨hz, hmem⟩
    exact hI.1
  have hz' : p ∉ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.ideal U : Set _) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus]
    exact hz
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus, Set.not_subset] at hz'
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrp⟩ := hz'
  exact le_iSup (fun r : I.ideal U ↦
    (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r.1 : (Spec (.of Γ(X, U.1))).Opens)) ⟨r, hr⟩ hrp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_gluingApp_restrict
statement:
theorem isIso_gluingApp_restrict (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsIso (gluingApp X I U ∣_ affineAway X I U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gluingApp_eq, morphismRestrict_comp]
  have h1 : IsIso (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal U) ∣_
      ((isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv ⁻¹ᵁ affineAway X I U)) :=
    isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le _ (isoSpec_inv_preimage_affineAway_le X I U)
      (projection_restrict_baseComplement_isIso _)
  have h2 : IsIso ((isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv ∣_ affineAway X I U) :=
    isIso_morphismRestrict_of_isIso _ _
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso' h1 h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine'
statement:
theorem isPullback_affine' (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (gluingApp X I U) (affineι X I U) U.1.ι (toBase X I)
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_restrict
statement:
theorem isPullback_restrict (U : X.affineOpens) (V : U.1.toScheme.Opens) :
    IsPullback (gluingApp X I U ∣_ V) ((gluingApp X I U ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ affineι X I U)
      (V.ι ≫ U.1.ι) (toBase X I)
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_morphismRestrict (gluingApp X I U) V).paste_vert (isPullback_affine' X I U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.range_affineAway_ι_comp_ι_subset
statement:
theorem range_affineAway_ι_comp_ι_subset (U : X.affineOpens) :
    Set.range ((affineAway X I U).ι ≫ U.1.ι) ⊆ Set.range (centreComplement X I).ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.awayCoverMap_ι
statement:
theorem awayCoverMap_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    awayCoverMap X I U ≫ (centreComplement X I).ι = (affineAway X I U).ι ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.range_restrict_subset
statement:
theorem range_restrict_subset (U : X.affineOpens) :
    Set.range ((gluingApp X I U ⁻¹ᵁ affineAway X I U).ι ≫ affineι X I U) ⊆
      Set.range (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  change toBase X I (((gluingApp X I U ⁻¹ᵁ affineAway X I U).ι ≫ affineι X I U) y) ∈
    centreComplement X I
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← (isPullback_restrict X I U (affineAway X I U)).w,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  exact ((gluingApp X I U ∣_ affineAway X I U) y).2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.awayPieceMap_ι
statement:
theorem awayPieceMap_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    awayPieceMap X I U ≫ (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι =
      (gluingApp X I U ⁻¹ᵁ affineAway X I U).ι ≫ affineι X I U
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_awayPiece
statement:
theorem isPullback_awayPiece (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (gluingApp X I U ∣_ affineAway X I U) (awayPieceMap X I U) (awayCoverMap X I U)
      (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I)
proof:
:= by
  have big := isPullback_restrict X I U (affineAway X I U)
  rw [← awayCoverMap_ι, ← awayPieceMap_ι] at big
  refine IsPullback.of_bot big ?_ (isPullback_morphismRestrict (toBase X I) (centreComplement X I))
  rw [← cancel_mono (centreComplement X I).ι, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, awayCoverMap_ι,
    morphismRestrict_ι, reassoc_of% (awayPieceMap_ι X I U)]
  exact (isPullback_restrict X I U (affineAway X I U)).w

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.toBase_restrict_isIso
statement: theorem toBase_restrict_isIso : IsIso (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I)
proof:
:= by
  refine (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mp ?_
  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_iSup_eq_top (P := MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)
    (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ (awayCoverMap X I U).opensRange)
    (awayCover X I).iSup_opensRange).mpr fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [(MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme).arrow_mk_iso_iff
    (morphismRestrictOpensRange (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I) (awayCoverMap X I U))]
  refine ((MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme).arrow_mk_iso_iff
    (Arrow.isoMk (isPullback_awayPiece X I U).flip.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (by
      simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      exact (isPullback_awayPiece X I U).flip.isoPullback_hom_snd))).mp ?_
  exact (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mpr (isIso_gluingApp_restrict X I U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.eq_zero_of_forall_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  suffices hsuff : Module.eqIdeal A z 0 = ⊤ by
    simpa [Module.eqIdeal] using (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mp hsuff
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨r, hrs, hdisj⟩ := Ideal.exists_disjoint_powers_of_span_eq_top s hs _ hne
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h r hrs
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (by simpa [Module.eqIdeal] using hn) ⟨n, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.gen_mem

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.symLift_C
statement:
@[simp]

statement:

:=

statement:

proof: := eval₂Hom_X' _ _ i

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.coe_reesLift
statement:
theorem coe_reesLift (p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R) :
    ((x.reesLift p : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) = x.polyLift p
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((reesAlgebra I).val.toRingHom).comp x.reesLift = x.polyLift := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, reesLift_C, polyLift_C]
      rfl
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, reesLift_X, polyLift_X]
      change (Polynomial.monomial 1 (x.gen i) : Polynomial R) = _
      rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, pow_one]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f p) hcomp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.symLift_surjective
statement: theorem symLift_surjective : Function.Surjective x.symLift
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
      exact ⟨C r, x.symLift_C r⟩
  | ι m =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
      have hy : (y : R) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x.gen) := by
        rw [x.span_eq]
        exact y.2
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun R).1 hy
      refine ⟨∑ i, C (c i) * X i, ?_⟩
      have hy' : y = ∑ i, c i • x.genMem i := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [genMem] using hc.symm
      have hcot : I.toCotangent y
          = ∑ i, (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (c i)) • x.conormalGen i := by
        rw [hy', map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [map_smul, algebraMap_smul]
        rfl
      rw [map_sum, hcot, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_mul, symLift_C, symLift_X, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul,
        Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p * q, map_mul _ _ _⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_symLift
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_symLift :
    (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I).comp x.symLift
      = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)).comp x.reesLift
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, symLift_C, reesLift_C,
      normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]
    rfl
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, symLift_X, reesLift_X,
      normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι, conormalGen, conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.polyLift_coeff
statement:
theorem polyLift_coeff (p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R) (m : ℕ) :
    (x.polyLift p).coeff m = MvPolynomial.eval x.gen (homogeneousComponent m p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial β c =>
      have hprod : (β.prod fun i k => (Polynomial.C (x.gen i) * Polynomial.X) ^ k)
          = Polynomial.C (β.prod fun i k => x.gen i ^ k) * Polynomial.X ^ β.degree := by
        rw [Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.degree_apply, map_prod,
          ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [mul_pow, ← Polynomial.C_pow]
      have hL : x.polyLift (monomial β c)
          = Polynomial.C (c * β.prod fun i k => x.gen i ^ k) * Polynomial.X ^ β.degree := by
        change MvPolynomial.eval₂ Polynomial.C _ (monomial β c) = _
        rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial, hprod, Polynomial.C_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [hL, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
        homogeneousComponent_of_mem
          ((mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).2 (isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl))]
      split_ifs with h
      · simp [eval_monomial]
      · simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, hp, hq, map_add, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.symLift_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem symLift_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem {p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R}
    (hp : ∀ β, p.coeff β ∈ I) : x.symLift p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun β _ => ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq, map_mul, symLift_C,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (hp β), map_zero, zero_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.coeff_mem_of_symLift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_of_symLift_eq_zero {p : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R}
    (hp : normalSheafCoordinateMap R I (x.symLift p) = 0) (β) : p.coeff β ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have happ := congrArg (fun f => f p) (normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_symLift x)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at happ
  have hmem : x.reesLift p ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← happ]
    exact hp
  have hQ : ∀ (d : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin x.length) R), F.IsHomogeneous d →
      MvPolynomial.eval x.gen F ∈ I ^ (d + 1) → ∀ α, F.coeff α ∈ I := by
    intro d F hF hval α
    have hc := x.isQuasiregular d F hF (by rw [x.span_eq]; exact hval) α
    rwa [x.span_eq] at hc
  have hcomp : ∀ m, MvPolynomial.eval x.gen (homogeneousComponent m p) ∈ I ^ (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    rw [← polyLift_coeff, ← coe_reesLift]
    exact coeff_mem_pow_succ_of_mem_map_rees R I hmem m
  have hcoeff := hQ β.degree (homogeneousComponent β.degree p)
    (homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous _ _) (hcomp _) β
  rwa [coeff_homogeneousComponent, if_pos rfl] at hcoeff

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.normalSheafCoordinateMap_injective
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := x.symLift_surjective a
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := x.symLift_surjective b
  have hzero : normalSheafCoordinateMap R I (x.symLift (p - q)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have hsub := x.symLift_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem (x.coeff_mem_of_symLift_eq_zero hzero)
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hsub
  exact hsub

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.normalSheafCoordinateMap_bijective
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨x.normalSheafCoordinateMap_injective, normalSheafCoordinateMap_surjective R I⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.nsToGr_bijective
statement: theorem nsToGr_bijective : Function.Bijective (nsToGr R I)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z : normalSheafRing R I,
      nsToGr R I z = normalSheafCoordinateMap R I (normalSheafRingEquiv R I z) := fun z =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun (normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_equiv R I) z).symm
  refine ⟨fun a b hab => ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
  · apply (normalSheafRingEquiv R I).injective
    apply x.normalSheafCoordinateMap_injective
    rw [← key, ← key]
    exact hab
  · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (normalSheafCoordinateMap_surjective R I) z
    refine ⟨(normalSheafRingEquiv R I).symm w, ?_⟩
    rw [key, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hw]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators.coneToNormalSheaf_isIso
statement: theorem coneToNormalSheaf_isIso : IsIso (coneToNormalSheaf R I)
proof:
:= by
  have hiso : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I))) := by
    rw [isIso_SpecMap_iff]
    exact x.normalSheafCoordinateMap_bijective
  exact hiso

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsToGr_nsTensorEquiv
statement:
theorem nsToGr_nsTensorEquiv (z : B ⊗[A] normalSheafRing A I) :
    nsToGr B J (nsTensorEquiv I J hJ z) =
      grTensorEquiv I J hJ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) (nsToGr A I) z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | tmul b w =>
      have hbw : (b ⊗ₜ[A] w : B ⊗[A] normalSheafRing A I) = b • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] w) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [hbw]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq,
        nsTensorEquiv_one_tmul, grTensorEquiv_one_tmul]
      exact congrArg (fun y ↦ b • y)
        (DFunLike.congr_fun (nsToGr_naturality I (algebraMap A B) J hJ) w)
  | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsToGr_bijective_of_flat
statement:
theorem nsToGr_bijective_of_flat (h : Function.Bijective (nsToGr A I)) :
    Function.Bijective (nsToGr B J)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : Function.Bijective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) (nsToGr A I)) := by
    have he : ⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) (nsToGr A I)) =
        ⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl : B ≃ₐ[B] B)
          (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (nsToGr A I) h)) := rfl
    rw [he]
    exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl : B ≃ₐ[B] B)
      (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (nsToGr A I) h)).bijective
  refine ⟨fun a₁ a₂ hab => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z₁, rfl⟩ := (nsTensorEquiv I J hJ).surjective a₁
    obtain ⟨z₂, rfl⟩ := (nsTensorEquiv I J hJ).surjective a₂
    rw [nsToGr_nsTensorEquiv, nsToGr_nsTensorEquiv] at hab
    exact congrArg _ (hmap.injective ((grTensorEquiv I J hJ).injective hab))
  · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hmap.surjective ((grTensorEquiv I J hJ).symm y)
    refine ⟨nsTensorEquiv I J hJ w, ?_⟩
    rw [nsToGr_nsTensorEquiv, hw, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coe_coeff_reesCoaction
statement:
theorem coe_coeff_reesCoaction (q : reesAlgebra I) (n : ℕ) :
    ((GradedCone.reesCoaction R I q).coeff n : Polynomial R) =
      Polynomial.monomial n ((q : Polynomial R).coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p n)
    (AlgHom.congr_fun (GradedCone.isConeHom_reesVal R I) q)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgHom, Polynomial.coeff_map,
    GradedCone.comul_coeff, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesCoaction_degreeOneRees
statement:
theorem reesCoaction_degreeOneRees (y : I) :
    GradedCone.reesCoaction R I (degreeOneRees R I y) =
      Polynomial.C (degreeOneRees R I y) * Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_one (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (reesAlgebra I)),
    Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  refine Polynomial.ext fun n => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_coeff_reesCoaction]
    change Polynomial.monomial 1 ((Polynomial.monomial 1 (y : R)).coeff 1) = _
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_pos rfl]
    rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_coeff_reesCoaction]
    change Polynomial.monomial n ((Polynomial.monomial 1 (y : R)).coeff n) = _
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg h]
    simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grQuotCoaction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grQuotCoaction_apply (z : associatedGradedRing R I) :

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalConeCoaction_mk
statement:
theorem normalConeCoaction_mk (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    GradedCone.normalConeCoaction R I
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) q) =
      Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I))
        (GradedCone.reesCoaction R I q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := AlgHom.congr_fun (GradedCone.isConeHom_normalConeCoaction R I) q
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgHom, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coeff_grQuotCoaction_mk
statement:
theorem coeff_grQuotCoaction_mk (q : reesAlgebra I) (n : ℕ) :
    (grQuotCoaction R I
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) q)).coeff n =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)
        ((GradedCone.reesCoaction R I q).coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [grQuotCoaction_apply, normalConeCoaction_mk, Polynomial.coeff_map]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.conormal_mem_homogeneous_one
statement:
theorem conormal_mem_homogeneous_one (m : I.Cotangent) :
    conormalToAssociatedGraded R I m ∈ GradedCone.homogeneous (grQuotCoaction R I) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
  rw [GradedCone.mem_homogeneous, conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent, grQuotCoaction_apply,
    normalConeCoaction_mk, reesCoaction_degreeOneRees, pow_one, Polynomial.map_mul,
    Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.mem_range_of_mem_homogeneous_one
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  have hcoeff : (q : Polynomial R).coeff 1 ∈ I := by
    have h1 := (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I (q : Polynomial R)).mp q.2 1
    rwa [pow_one] at h1
  refine ⟨I.toCotangent ⟨(q : Polynomial R).coeff 1, hcoeff⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent]
  rw [GradedCone.mem_homogeneous] at hz
  have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)
      ((GradedCone.reesCoaction R I q).coeff 1) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) q := by
    rw [← coeff_grQuotCoaction_mk, hz]
    simp
  have hval : (GradedCone.reesCoaction R I q).coeff 1
      = degreeOneRees R I ⟨(q : Polynomial R).coeff 1, hcoeff⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_coeff_reesCoaction]; rfl)
  rw [hval] at h1
  exact h1

theorem homogeneous_one_eq_range :

proof:

  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩

statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_conormalEquivDegreeOne (m : I.Cotangent) :

proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.abelianHull_symCongr
statement:
theorem abelianHull_symCongr (z : normalSheafCoordinateRing R I) :
    GradedCone.abelianHull (grQuotCoaction R I) (symCongr (conormalEquivDegreeOne R I) z) =
      normalSheafCoordinateMap R I z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]
      rfl
  | ι m =>
      rw [symCongr_ι, GradedCone.abelianHull_ι, normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι,
        coe_conormalEquivDegreeOne]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.isGeneratedInDegreeOne_grQuotCoaction
statement:
theorem isGeneratedInDegreeOne_grQuotCoaction :
    GradedCone.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne (grQuotCoaction R I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedCone.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne, eq_top_iff]
  rintro z -
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (normalSheafCoordinateMap_surjective R I) z
  rw [← abelianHull_symCongr]
  generalize symCongr (conormalEquivDegreeOne R I) w = v
  induction v using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => rw [AlgHom.commutes]; exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r
  | ι x =>
      rw [GradedCone.abelianHull_ι]
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin x.2
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul]; exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ ha hb

statement:
theorem subschemeApp_naturality {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ⟶ V) :
    (gluingData X 𝒜).functor.map h ≫ subschemeApp X 𝒜 I ψ V = subschemeApp X 𝒜 I ψ U
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono I.subschemeι, Category.assoc, subschemeApp_subschemeι X 𝒜 I ψ hψ,
    subschemeApp_subschemeι X 𝒜 I ψ hψ, ← affineι_toBase, ← affineι_toBase, ← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.toSubscheme_subschemeι

  rw [← Category.assoc]
  change (affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ toSubscheme X 𝒜 I ψ hψ) ≫ I.subschemeι = _
  rw [affineι_toSubscheme, subschemeApp_subschemeι X 𝒜 I ψ hψ]
  exact (affineι_toBase X 𝒜 U).symm

proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.NormalCone.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero {V : X.affineOpens} (r : Γ(X, V.1))
    (hbijr : Function.Bijective
      (nsToGr Γ(X, X.basicOpen r) (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩)))
    {z : normalSheafRing Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V)}
    (hz : nsToGr Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V) z = 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, r ^ n • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have inst : IsLocalization.Away r Γ(X, X.basicOpen r) := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen r
  have hJ : (I.ideal V).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))
      = I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩ :=
    I.map_ideal (U := ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) (V := V) (X.basicOpen_le r)
  have hflat : Module.Flat Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r) :=
    IsLocalization.flat _ (Submonoid.powers r)
  have h0 : nsMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))
      (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) hJ z = 0 := by
    apply hbijr.1
    have hnat : nsToGr Γ(X, X.basicOpen r) (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩)
          (nsMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))
            (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) hJ z) =
        grMapOfEq (I.ideal V) (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))
            (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) hJ (nsToGr Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V) z) :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (nsToGr_naturality (I.ideal V)
        (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))
        (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) hJ) z
    rw [hnat, hz, map_zero]
    exact (map_zero _).symm
  have h1 : (1 : Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V.1)] z = 0 := by
    apply (nsTensorEquiv (I.ideal V) (I.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) hJ).injective
    rw [nsTensorEquiv_one_tmul, h0, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, hn⟩ :=
    (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers r)
      (f := TensorProduct.mk Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)
        (normalSheafRing Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V)) 1)).mp h1
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.NormalCone.bijective_nsToGr_of_cover
statement:
theorem bijective_nsToGr_of_cover {ι : Type*} (U : ι → X.affineOpens)
    (hU : ⨆ i, (U i).1 = ⊤)
    (hbij : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (nsToGr Γ(X, (U i).1) (I.ideal (U i))))
    (V : X.affineOpens) :
    Function.Bijective (nsToGr Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V))
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Ideal.span {r : Γ(X, V.1) | ∃ i, X.basicOpen r ≤ (U i).1} = ⊤ := by
    rw [← V.2.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
    intro x hxV
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hU.ge (Set.mem_univ x))
    obtain ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := (U i).1) ⟨x, hi⟩ hxV
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨r, ⟨i, hr₁⟩⟩, hr₂⟩
  have key : ∀ z : normalSheafRing Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V),
      nsToGr Γ(X, V.1) (I.ideal V) z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    refine eq_zero_of_forall_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero hspan ?_
    rintro r ⟨i, hri⟩
    exact exists_pow_smul_eq_zero X I r
      (bijective_nsToGr_of_le X I (U := ⟨X.basicOpen r, V.2.basicOpen r⟩) (V := U i) hri
        (hbij i)) hz
  refine ⟨fun a b hab => ?_, nsToGr_surjective _ _⟩
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (key (a - b) (by rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]))
