    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U)).map (centreGlue s hs) ≫
        nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d U =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (s U)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U))
    (centreGlue s hs) (nativeGlobalProjection Y J d U)
  refine h1.symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg _ (centreGlue_projection s hs U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC7.centreGlue_isIso_of_local
statement:
theorem centreGlue_isIso_of_local {M : (projectiveNormalCone Y J).Modules}
    (s : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, M ⟶ pushedAffineNativeKernel Y J d U)
    (hs : CentreGlueData Y J d s)
    (hloc : ∀ {P Q : (projectiveNormalCone Y J).Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q),
      (∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U)).map f)) →
        IsIso f)
    (hchart : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsIso (nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d U))
    (hs_iso : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, IsIso
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (s U))) :
    IsIso (centreGlue s hs)
proof:
:= by
  apply hloc
  intro U
  haveI h1 := hchart U
  have h2 := hs_iso U
  rw [← centreGlue_chart s hs U] at h2
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (nativeGlobalChartHom Y J d U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.other_chart_pullback
statement:
theorem other_chart_pullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U)
      (chartTotal Y J U) (otherToTotal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := otherToInfinity_chart_isPullback Y J U
  have hB := (isPullback_affineInfinity Y J U).flip
  have hout := hA.paste_horiz hB
  have hcomm : GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U ≫ otherToTotal Y J =
      affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) ≫ chartTotal Y J U := by
    rw [affineι_otherToTotal]; rfl
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ hcomm ?_
  have hrange := range_fst_of_isPullback hout.flip
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : otherToTotal Y J x ∈ Set.range (totalAffineι Y J U) := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨blowupι (J.ideal U) z, hz⟩
    have : x ∈ Set.range (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U) := by
      rw [hrange]
      exact hx'
    exact this
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) b, by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.component_chart_pullback
statement:
theorem component_chart_pullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))) (exceptionalToComponent Y J U)
      (chartTotal Y J U) (componentToTotal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := exceptionalToInfinity_chart_isPullback Y J U
  have hB := (isPullback_affineInfinity Y J U).flip
  have hout := hA.paste_horiz hB
  have hcomm : exceptionalToComponent Y J U ≫ componentToTotal Y J =
      exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) ≫ chartTotal Y J U := by
    rw [exceptionalToComponent_toTotal]; rfl
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ hcomm ?_
  have hrange := range_fst_of_isPullback hout.flip
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : componentToTotal Y J x ∈ Set.range (totalAffineι Y J U) := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨blowupι (J.ideal U) z, hz⟩
    have : x ∈ Set.range (exceptionalToComponent Y J U) := by
      rw [hrange]
      exact hx'
    exact this
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) b, by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.infinity_chart_pullback
statement:
theorem infinity_chart_pullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (pullback.fst (blowupToLine (J.ideal U)) (zeroSection Γ(Y,U.1)))
      ((blowupZeroIsoInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).hom ≫ affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U)
      (chartTotal Y J U) (infinityFibreι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have hB := isPullback_affineInfinity Y J U
  have hcomm : ((blowupZeroIsoInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).hom ≫ affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U) ≫
      infinityFibreι Y J = pullback.fst (blowupToLine (J.ideal U)) (zeroSection Γ(Y,U.1)) ≫
        chartTotal Y J U := by
    rw [Category.assoc, affineInfinityToGlobal_ι, blowupZeroIsoInfinity_ι_assoc]
    rfl
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ hcomm ?_
  have hrange := range_fst_of_isPullback hB
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : infinityFibreι Y J x ∈ Set.range (totalAffineι Y J U) := by
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨blowupι (J.ideal U) w, hw⟩
    have hx'' : x ∈ Set.range (affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U) := by
      rw [hrange]; exact hx'
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx''
    exact ⟨(blowupZeroIsoInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).inv z, by
      change affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U (((blowupZeroIsoInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).inv ≫
        (blowupZeroIsoInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).hom) z) = _
      rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨pullback.fst (blowupToLine (J.ideal U)) (zeroSection Γ(Y,U.1)) b, by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.chart_total_product
statement:
theorem chart_total_product (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    ((otherToTotal Y J).ker * (componentToTotal Y J).ker).comap (chartTotal Y J U) =
      (infinityFibreι Y J).ker.comap (chartTotal Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion Y J
  rw [comap_mul_of_openImmersion,
    ← closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (other_chart_pullback Y J U),
    ← closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (component_chart_pullback Y J U),
    ← closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (infinity_chart_pullback Y J U)]
  exact affine_branch_product (J.ideal U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.ideal_eq_of_family_comap
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_of_family_comap {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type*} (S : ι → Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i, IsAffine (S i)] (f : ∀ i, S i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (f i)]
    (hcov : ⨆ i, (f i).opensRange = ⊤) (K L : X.IdealSheafData)
    (h : ∀ i, K.comap (f i) = L.comap (f i)) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top
    (fun i ↦ ⟨(f i).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange (f i)⟩) hcov
  intro i
  have hi := congrArg (fun J : (S i).IdealSheafData ↦
    J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩) (h i)
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion] at hi
  have he := Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((f i).appIso ⊤).inv).2 hi
  have e : (⟨(f i) ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion (f i)⟩ : X.affineOpens) =
      ⟨(f i).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange (f i)⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _)
  rw [← e]
  exact he

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint {V X M : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (f : V ⟶ M) [IsOpenImmersion f] (h : Disjoint (Set.range g) (Set.range f)) :
    g.ker.comap f = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hpb : IsPullback (pullback.fst f g) (pullback.snd f g) f g := IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g
  rw [← closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback hpb]
  haveI : IsEmpty ↥(pullback f g) := by
    refine ⟨fun z => ?_⟩
    have hz : f (pullback.fst f g z) = g (pullback.snd f g z) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.condition]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h ⟨_, hz.symm⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩
  exact Scheme.ker_eq_top_of_isEmpty _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.infinityFibreι_ne_lineTι
statement:
theorem infinityFibreι_ne_lineTι (c : infinityFibre Y J) (y : DeformationSpace.line Y) :
    lineTι Y J y ≠ infinityFibreι Y J c
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : totalToIntegerP1 Y J (lineTι Y J y) = totalToIntegerP1 Y J (infinityFibreι Y J c) :=
    congrArg _ h
  have h2 : totalToIntegerP1 Y J (infinityFibreι Y J c) =
      infinityPoint (infinityToInteger Y J c) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, (infinity_isPullback Y J).w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [h2, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, lineTι_totalToIntegerP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h1
  set s := infinityToInteger Y J c with hs
  have hmem : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s ∈
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1).opensRange := by
    show ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s) ∈
        (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1).opensRange
    exact ⟨_, h1⟩
  rw [ProjectiveLine.chart_zero_preimage] at hmem
  have hmem' : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s ∈
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : integerRing[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum integerRing[X])) :=
    hmem
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen] at hmem'
  apply hmem'
  show (Polynomial.X : integerRing[X]) ∈
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)) (show PrimeSpectrum integerRing from s)).asIdeal
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.disjoint_range_infinityFibreι_lineTι
statement:
theorem disjoint_range_infinityFibreι_lineTι :
    Disjoint (Set.range (infinityFibreι Y J)) (Set.range (lineTι Y J))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact infinityFibreι_ne_lineTι Y J c y hy

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.ideal_eq_at_range
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_at_range {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] (f : S ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (K L : X.IdealSheafData) (h : K.comap f = L.comap f) :
    K.ideal ⟨f.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange f⟩ =
      L.ideal ⟨f.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange f⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hi := congrArg (fun J : S.IdealSheafData ↦
    J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩) h
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion] at hi
  have he := Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (f.appIso ⊤).inv).2 hi
  have e : (⟨f ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion f⟩ : X.affineOpens) =
      ⟨f.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange f⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _)
  rw [← e]
  exact he

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.exists_blowupGlobal_or_line
statement:
theorem exists_blowupGlobal_or_line (x : totalGlobal Y J) :
    (∃ b, blowupGlobalι Y J b = x) ∨ (∃ l, lineTι Y J l = x)
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover
    (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))
  obtain ⟨j, z, hz⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq x
  have hw : ∀ (j : WalkingSpan) (h : WalkingSpan.zero ⟶ j)
      (z : ((span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)).obj WalkingSpan.zero)),
      (colimit.ι (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) j)
        (((span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)).map h) z) =
      (colimit.ι (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y))
        WalkingSpan.zero) z := by
    intro j h z
    have := colimit.w (span (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)) h
    rw [← this]
    rfl
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · left
    refine ⟨gmToBlowupGlobal Y J z, ?_⟩
    rw [← hz]
    exact hw _ WalkingSpan.Hom.fst z
  · left
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.range_comp_subset_ARRM4
statement:
theorem range_comp_subset_ARRM4 {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Set.range (f ≫ g) ⊆ Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨f y, by rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.comap_line_eq
statement:
theorem comap_line_eq (j : (DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.I₀) :
    ((otherToTotal Y J).ker * (componentToTotal Y J).ker).comap
        ((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J) =
      (infinityFibreι Y J).ker.comap
        ((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion Y J
  have hd := disjoint_range_infinityFibreι_lineTι Y J
  have hr : Set.range ((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J) ⊆
      Set.range (lineTι Y J) := range_comp_subset_ARRM4 _ _
  have h1 : Disjoint (Set.range (otherToTotal Y J))
      (Set.range ((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J)) :=
    (hd.mono_left (range_comp_subset_ARRM4 _ _)).mono_right hr
  have h2 : Disjoint (Set.range (componentToTotal Y J))
      (Set.range ((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J)) :=
    (hd.mono_left (range_comp_subset_ARRM4 _ _)).mono_right hr
  have h3 : Disjoint (Set.range (infinityFibreι Y J))
      (Set.range ((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J)) :=
    hd.mono_right hr
  rw [comap_mul_of_openImmersion, ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint _ _ h1,
    ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint _ _ h2, ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint _ _ h3]
  exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.top_mul _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.comap_chart_eq
statement:
theorem comap_chart_eq (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (j : (ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).affineOpenCover.I₀) :
    ((otherToTotal Y J).ker * (componentToTotal Y J).ker).comap
        ((ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ chartTotal Y J U) =
      (infinityFibreι Y J).ker.comap
        ((ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ chartTotal Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
    chart_total_product]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.total_branch_product
statement:
theorem total_branch_product :
    (otherToTotal Y J).ker * (componentToTotal Y J).ker = (infinityFibreι Y J).ker
proof:
:= by
  haveI := otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion Y J
  let ι₁ := Σ U : Y.affineOpens,
    (ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).affineOpenCover.I₀
  let ι₂ := (DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.I₀
  let F : ι₁ ⊕ ι₂ → (totalGlobal Y J).affineOpens := Sum.elim
    (fun a ↦ ⟨((ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal a.1))).affineOpenCover.f a.2 ≫
        chartTotal Y J a.1).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩)
    (fun j ↦ ⟨((DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ lineTι Y J).opensRange,
      isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩)
  have hcov : ⨆ i, (F i).1 = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    rcases exists_blowupGlobal_or_line Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp
        ((iSup_opensRange_blowupAffineι Y J).ge (Set.mem_univ b))
      obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hU
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := (ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).affineOpenCover.openCover.exists_eq b'
      refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Sum.inl ⟨U, j⟩, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      change ((ReesBlowup.scheme (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).affineOpenCover.f j ≫ chartTotal Y J U) y = _
      have hct : chartTotal Y J U = blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J :=
        blowupι_totalAffineι Y J U
      rw [hct, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ hy)
    · obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := (DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover.openCover.exists_eq l
      refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Sum.inr j, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg _ hy
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top F hcov
  rintro (a | j)
  · exact ideal_eq_at_range _ _ _ (comap_chart_eq Y J a.1 a.2)
  · exact ideal_eq_at_range _ _ _ (comap_line_eq Y J j)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.symmetricSemilinearMap_mem_grade
statement:
theorem symmetricSemilinearMap_mem_grade {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    (φ : R →+* S) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N) {n : ℕ} {p : SymmetricAlgebra R M}
    (hp : p ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading R M n) :
    symmetricSemilinearMap φ f p ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading S N n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M))
    (C := fun d y _ => symmetricSemilinearMap φ f y ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading S N d)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro a
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
    change algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N) (φ a) ∈
      (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N)) ^ 0
    rw [pow_zero, Submodule.one_eq_range]
    exact ⟨φ a,rfl⟩
  · intro y z d hy hz hy' hz'
    simpa only [map_add] using (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading S N d).add_mem hy' hz'
  · intro y hy d z hz hz'
    obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [map_mul, symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
    have hm : SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N (f m) ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N) :=
      ⟨f m,rfl⟩
    change _ ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N)) ^ (d + 1)
    rw [pow_succ']
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hm hz'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionCoordinate_comp_inverse
statement:

    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionCoordinate_inverse_comp

    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionGradedRestriction_coordinate_square
statement:
theorem sectionGradedRestriction_coordinate_square {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J U xU).comp (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) =
    (normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU).comp (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J V xV)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (conormalPlusLineChartSymmetric_naturality Y J h) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionGradedRestriction_route
statement:
theorem sectionGradedRestriction_route {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    sectionGradedRestriction Y J h =
    (sectionCoordinateGradedInverse Y J U xU).comp
      ((normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
        (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU).comp (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J V xV))
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := sectionGradedRestriction_coordinate_square Y J h xU xV
  have he := congrArg (fun f => (sectionCoordinateGradedInverse Y J U xU).comp f) hsq
  rw [← GradedRingHom.comp_assoc, sectionCoordinate_inverse_comp, GradedRingHom.id_comp] at he
  exact he

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionRestriction_irrelevant
statement:
theorem sectionRestriction_irrelevant {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U xU
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U xU
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J V xV
    letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J V xV
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V))).map (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) := by
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U xU
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U xU
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J V xV
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J V xV
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal V) xV
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal V) xV
  have hv := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J V xV)
    (sectionCoordinateGradedInverse Y J V xV) (sectionCoordinate_comp_inverse Y J V xV)
  have hu := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ (sectionCoordinateGradedInverse Y J U xU)
    (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J U xU) (sectionCoordinate_inverse_comp Y J U xU)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hv
    (normalBundle_irrelevant_restriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU)
  have hr := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ht hu
  rw [← sectionGradedRestriction_route Y J h xU xV] at hr
  exact hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionProjRestriction_comparison {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU ≫ (chartSectionsProjIso Y J V xV).hom =
    (chartSectionsProjIso Y J U xU).hom ≫ sectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U xU
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U xU
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J V xV
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J V xV
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) xU
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal V) xV
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal V) xV
  exact proj_map_actual_square _ _ _ _ (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h)
    (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J V xV) (sectionCoordinateGradedMap Y J U xU)
    (normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU)
    (sectionRestriction_irrelevant Y J h xU xV)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionCoordinate_comp_inverse Y J V xV))
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (sectionCoordinate_comp_inverse Y J U xU))
    (normalBundle_irrelevant_restriction (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU)
    (sectionGradedRestriction_coordinate_square Y J h xU xV)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionProjRestriction_toComponent {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    sectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV ≫ chartSectionsToComponent Y J V xV =
      chartSectionsToComponent Y J U xU
proof:
:= by
  have hn : normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq (J.ideal V) (GlobalBlowup.res Y h)
      (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h) xV xU ≫ normalBundleAffineToComponent Y J V xV =
      normalBundleAffineToComponent Y J U xU := by
    apply (cancel_epi (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal U) xU).hom).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← normalBundleProjRestriction_comparison]
    simp only [normalBundleAffineToComponent, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    exact InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent Y J h
  apply (cancel_epi (chartSectionsProjIso Y J U xU).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← sectionProjRestriction_comparison]
  simpa only [chartSectionsToComponent, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc] using hn

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_id
statement:
theorem sectionProjRestriction_id (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    sectionProjRestriction Y J (le_refl U) x x = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartSectionsToComponent_isOpenImmersion Y J U x
  apply (cancel_mono (chartSectionsToComponent Y J U x)).mp
  rw [sectionProjRestriction_toComponent, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem sectionProjRestriction_comp {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (k : V ≤ W)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V))
    (xW : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,W.1) (J.ideal W)) :
    sectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV ≫ sectionProjRestriction Y J k xV xW =
      sectionProjRestriction Y J (h.trans k) xU xW
proof:
:= by
  letI := chartSectionsToComponent_isOpenImmersion Y J W xW
  apply (cancel_mono (chartSectionsToComponent Y J W xW)).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, sectionProjRestriction_toComponent,
    sectionProjRestriction_toComponent, sectionProjRestriction_toComponent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_common_refinement
statement:
theorem sectionProjRestriction_common_refinement {U V W T : Y.affineOpens}
    (hU : U ≤ W) (hV : V ≤ W) (kU : T ≤ U) (kV : T ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V))
    (xW : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,W.1) (J.ideal W))
    (xT : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,T.1) (J.ideal T)) :
    sectionProjRestriction Y J kU xT xU ≫ sectionProjRestriction Y J hU xU xW =
      sectionProjRestriction Y J kV xT xV ≫ sectionProjRestriction Y J hV xV xW
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionProjRestriction_comp, sectionProjRestriction_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionChart_isPullback_open
statement:
theorem sectionChart_isPullback_open (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    IsPullback (chartSectionsToComponent Y J U x) (sectionChartToAmbient Y J U x)
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J ≫ J.subschemeι) U.1.ι
proof:
:=
  (chartSections_isPullback Y J U x).paste_vert
    (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.quotientChart_isPullback_open Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_toAmbient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem sectionProjRestriction_toAmbient {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    sectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV ≫ sectionChartToAmbient Y J V xV =
      sectionChartToAmbient Y J U xU ≫ Y.homOfLE h
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono V.1.ι).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, ← (sectionChart_isPullback_open Y J V xV).w,
    ← Category.assoc, sectionProjRestriction_toComponent,
    (sectionChart_isPullback_open Y J U xU).w, Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjNaturality.sectionProjRestriction_isPullback_open
statement:
theorem sectionProjRestriction_isPullback_open {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (xU : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (xV : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)) :
    IsPullback (sectionProjRestriction Y J h xU xV) (sectionChartToAmbient Y J U xU)
      (sectionChartToAmbient Y J V xV) (Y.homOfLE h)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := chartSectionsToComponent Y J V xV)
    (h₂₂ := V.1.ι) ?_ (sectionProjRestriction_toAmbient Y J h xU xV)
    (sectionChart_isPullback_open Y J V xV)
  rw [sectionProjRestriction_toComponent, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
  exact sectionChart_isPullback_open Y J U xU

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineCone.contraction_generator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contraction_generator (r : A) (x : M) :
    contraction A M r (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A M x) =
      r • SymmetricAlgebra.ι A M x
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineCone.contraction_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contraction_one : contraction A M 1 = AlgHom.id A (coordinateRing A M)
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
  ext x
  simp [contraction]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineCone.contraction_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contraction_mul (r s : A) :
    contraction A M (r * s) = (contraction A M r).comp (contraction A M s)
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
  ext x
  simp [contraction, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineCone.contraction_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contraction_zero :
    contraction A M 0 =
      (Algebra.ofId A (coordinateRing A M)).comp (augmentation A M)
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
  ext x
  change contraction A M 0 (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A M x) =
    algebraMap A (coordinateRing A M) ((augmentation A M) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A M x))
  rw [contraction_generator, zero_smul, SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineCone.schemeIsoBase_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem schemeIsoBase_hom [Subsingleton M] :
    (schemeIsoBase A M).hom = projection A M
proof:
:= by
  change _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ =
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _
  rw [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_inj]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesAlgebra_bot_eq
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra_bot_eq :
    reesAlgebra (⊥ : Ideal R) = (⊥ : Subalgebra R (Polynomial R))
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rw [Algebra.mem_bot]
    refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    apply Polynomial.ext
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      simp
    · have hcoeff : p.coeff n = 0 := by
        have := hp n
        simpa [hn] using this
      change (Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0)).coeff n = p.coeff n
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_of_ne_zero hn, hcoeff]
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Algebra.mem_bot.mp hp
    exact (reesAlgebra (⊥ : Ideal R)).algebraMap_mem r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.degreeOneRaw_mul
statement: theorem degreeOneRaw_mul (x y : I) : degreeOneRaw R I (x * y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (degreeOneRees R I (x * y)) = 0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  let q : reesAlgebra I := degreeOneRees R I y
  have hx : algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) x.1 ∈
      Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I :=
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) x.2
  have hprod := Ideal.mul_mem_right q
    (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) hx
  convert hprod using 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Polynomial.C_mul_monomial.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded_mul_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem conormalToAssociatedGraded_mul_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero
    (x y : I) (hxy : (x : R) * (y : R) = 0) :
    conormalToAssociatedGraded R I (I.toCotangent x) *
        conormalToAssociatedGraded R I (I.toCotangent y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold conormalToAssociatedGraded
  rw [LinearMap.extendScalarsOfSurjective_apply,
    LinearMap.extendScalarsOfSurjective_apply,
    Ideal.Cotangent.lift_toCotangent,
    Ideal.Cotangent.lift_toCotangent]
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (degreeOneRees R I x) *
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (degreeOneRees R I y) = 0
  rw [← map_mul]
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  have hzero : degreeOneRees R I x * degreeOneRees R I y = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change Polynomial.monomial 1 (x : R) * Polynomial.monomial 1 (y : R) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial, hxy]
    simp
  rw [hzero]
  exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.degreeOneRees_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeOneRees_coe (z : I) :
    ((degreeOneRees R I z : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
      Polynomial.monomial 1 (z : R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent (z : I) :
    conormalToAssociatedGraded R I (I.toCotangent z) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)
        (degreeOneRees R I z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold conormalToAssociatedGraded
  rw [LinearMap.extendScalarsOfSurjective_apply, Ideal.Cotangent.lift_toCotangent]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coeff_mem_pow_succ_of_mem_map_rees
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_pow_succ_of_mem_map_rees :
    ∀ {q : reesAlgebra I}, q ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I →
      ∀ m : ℕ, (q : Polynomial R).coeff m ∈ I ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hq' : q ∈ Submodule.span (reesAlgebra I)
      ((algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) '' (I : Set R)) := hq
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun (y : reesAlgebra I) _ => ∀ m : ℕ, (y : Polynomial R).coeff m ∈ I ^ (m + 1))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hq'
  · rintro y ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ m
    have hcoe : ((algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
        Polynomial.C r := rfl
    rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | hm
    · rw [hcoe, Polynomial.coeff_C, if_pos rfl, pow_one]
      exact hr
    · rw [hcoe, Polynomial.coeff_C, if_neg hm]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro m
    simp
  · intro y z _ _ ihy ihz m
    have hcoe : ((y + z : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
        (y : Polynomial R) + (z : Polynomial R) := rfl
    rw [hcoe, Polynomial.coeff_add]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (ihy m) (ihz m)
  · intro a y _ ihy m
    have hcoe : ((a • y : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
        (a : Polynomial R) * (y : Polynomial R) := rfl
    rw [hcoe, Polynomial.coeff_mul]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun ij hij => ?_
    have hija : ij.1 + ij.2 = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
    have ha : (a : Polynomial R).coeff ij.1 ∈ I ^ ij.1 :=
      (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I _).mp a.2 ij.1
    have hprod := Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha (ihy ij.2)
    rw [← pow_add] at hprod
    have hexp : ij.1 + (ij.2 + 1) = m + 1 := by omega
    rwa [hexp] at hprod

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedAugmentation_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem associatedGradedAugmentation_mk (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    associatedGradedAugmentation R I
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) q) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((q : Polynomial R).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (Polynomial.eval 0 ((q : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R)) = _
  rw [← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedAugmentation_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem associatedGradedAugmentation_base (r : R ⧸ I) :
    associatedGradedAugmentation R I (associatedGradedBaseRingHom R I r) = r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
  change associatedGradedAugmentation R I
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r)) = _
  rw [associatedGradedAugmentation_mk]
  have hcoe : ((algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
      Polynomial.C r := rfl
  rw [hcoe, Polynomial.coeff_C, if_pos rfl]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι (x : I.Cotangent) :
    normalSheafCoordinateMap R I
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent x) =
      conormalToAssociatedGraded R I x
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalSheafCoordinateMap
  exact SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ x

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_base
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_base (r : R ⧸ I) :
    normalSheafCoordinateMap R I
        (algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (normalSheafCoordinateRing R I) r) =
      associatedGradedBaseRingHom R I r
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalSheafCoordinateMap
  let f := @SymmetricAlgebra.lift (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent
    (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _ (Ideal.Quotient.commRing I)) _
    (Ideal.instModuleQuotientCotangent I) (associatedGradedRing R I)
    (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)))
    (associatedGradedLiftAlgebra R I) (conormalToAssociatedGraded R I)
  exact f.commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_surjective
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I)
proof:
:= by
  let f := @SymmetricAlgebra.lift (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent
    (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _ (Ideal.Quotient.commRing I)) _
    (Ideal.instModuleQuotientCotangent I) (associatedGradedRing R I)
    (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)))
    (associatedGradedLiftAlgebra R I) (conormalToAssociatedGraded R I)
  change Function.Surjective f
  intro z
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  let generators : Set (Polynomial R) :=
    Submodule.map (Polynomial.monomial 1 : R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R) I
  have hgenerated : Algebra.adjoin R generators = reesAlgebra I :=
    adjoin_monomial_eq_reesAlgebra I
  have toRees {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p ∈ Algebra.adjoin R generators) :
      p ∈ reesAlgebra I := by
    rw [← hgenerated]
    exact hp
  let P : (p : Polynomial R) → p ∈ Algebra.adjoin R generators → Prop :=
    fun p hp ↦ ∃ s, f s = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
      (⟨p, toRees hp⟩ : reesAlgebra I)
  have hp : (p : Polynomial R) ∈ Algebra.adjoin R generators := by
    rw [hgenerated]
    exact p.2
  have hP : ∀ (a : Polynomial R) (ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin R generators), P a ha := by
    intro a ha
    induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
        rcases ha with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        let ix : I := ⟨x, hx⟩
        refine ⟨@SymmetricAlgebra.ι (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent
          (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _ (Ideal.Quotient.commRing I)) _
          (Ideal.instModuleQuotientCotangent I) (I.toCotangent ix), ?_⟩
        rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
        rfl
    | algebraMap r =>
        let s : @SymmetricAlgebra (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent
            (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _ (Ideal.Quotient.commRing I)) _
            (Ideal.instModuleQuotientCotangent I) :=
          @algebraMap (R ⧸ I) _
            (@CommRing.toCommSemiring _ (Ideal.Quotient.commRing I)) _ _
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r)
        refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
        exact (f.commutes (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r)).trans rfl
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        obtain ⟨sx, hsx⟩ := ihx
        obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := ihy
        refine ⟨sx + sy, ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, hsx, hsy]
        rfl
    | mul x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        obtain ⟨sx, hsx⟩ := ihx
        obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := ihy
        refine ⟨sx * sy, ?_⟩
        rw [map_mul, hsx, hsy]
        rfl
  exact hP (p : Polynomial R) hp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux_monomial
statement:
theorem reesScaleAux_monomial (r a : R) (m : ℕ) :
    reesScaleAux R r (Polynomial.monomial m a) = Polynomial.monomial m (r ^ m * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesScaleAux, Polynomial.aeval_monomial, mul_pow, ← Polynomial.C_pow,
    ← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  rw [show (algebraMap R (Polynomial R)) a = Polynomial.C a from rfl]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_comm a (r ^ m)]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux_coeff
statement:
theorem reesScaleAux_coeff (r : R) (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) :
    (reesScaleAux R r p).coeff n = r ^ n * p.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, hp, hq, mul_add]
  | monomial m a =>
      rw [reesScaleAux_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      by_cases h : m = n
      · subst h
        simp
      · simp [h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesScaleAux_mem
statement:
theorem reesScaleAux_mem (r : R) {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p ∈ reesAlgebra I) :
    reesScaleAux R r p ∈ reesAlgebra I
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reesAlgebra_iff] at hp ⊢
  intro n
  rw [reesScaleAux_coeff]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hp n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesScale_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesScale_coe (r : R) (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((reesScale R I r q : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
      reesScaleAux R r (q : Polynomial R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesScale_algebraMap
statement:
theorem reesScale_algebraMap (r s : R) :
    reesScale R I r (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) s) = algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) s
proof:
:=
  (reesScale R I r).commutes s

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesScale_degreeOneRees
statement:
theorem reesScale_degreeOneRees (r : R) (w : I) :
    reesScale R I r (degreeOneRees R I w) =
      algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r * degreeOneRees R I w
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [reesScale_coe, degreeOneRees_coe, reesScaleAux_monomial, pow_one]
  change _ = Polynomial.C r * Polynomial.monomial 1 (w : R)
  rw [Polynomial.C_mul_monomial]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedScale_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem associatedGradedScale_mk (r : R) (q : reesAlgebra I) :
    associatedGradedScale R I r
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I) q) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I)) I)
        (reesScale R I r q)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_contraction
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_contraction (r : R)
    (z : normalSheafCoordinateRing R I) :
    normalSheafCoordinateMap R I
        (AffineCone.contraction (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) z) =
      associatedGradedScale R I r (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap s =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective s
      rw [AlgHom.commutes, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]
      change _ = associatedGradedScale R I r
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) s))
      rw [associatedGradedScale_mk, reesScale_algebraMap]
      rfl
  | ι m =>
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
      rw [AffineCone.contraction_generator, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
        normalSheafCoordinateMap_base, normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι,
        conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent, associatedGradedScale_mk,
        reesScale_degreeOneRees, map_mul]
      rfl
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedAugmentation_normalSheafCoordinateMap
statement:
theorem associatedGradedAugmentation_normalSheafCoordinateMap
    (z : normalSheafCoordinateRing R I) :
    associatedGradedAugmentation R I (normalSheafCoordinateMap R I z) =
      AffineCone.augmentation (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      rw [normalSheafCoordinateMap_base, associatedGradedAugmentation_base]
      exact ((AffineCone.augmentation (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent).commutes r).symm
  | ι m =>
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
      rw [normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι, conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent,
        associatedGradedAugmentation_mk, SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι,
        degreeOneRees_coe, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg (by decide), map_zero]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coneToNormalSheaf_comp_projection
statement:
theorem coneToNormalSheaf_comp_projection :
    coneToNormalSheaf R I ≫ AffineCone.projection (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent =
      projection R I
proof:
:= by
  change _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ ≫ _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ =
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _
  rw [← _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_comp,
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_inj]
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  exact normalSheafCoordinateMap_base R I r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.vertex_comp_coneToNormalSheaf
statement:
theorem vertex_comp_coneToNormalSheaf :
    vertex R I ≫ coneToNormalSheaf R I =
      AffineCone.vertex (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent
proof:
:= by
  change _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ ≫ _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ =
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _
  rw [← _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_comp,
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_inj]
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRingBotEquiv_base_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem associatedGradedRingBotEquiv_base_mk (r : R) :
    associatedGradedRingBotEquiv R
        (associatedGradedBaseRingHom R (⊥ : Ideal R)
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk ⊥ r)) = r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [associatedGradedBaseRingHom, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk,
    associatedGradedRingBotEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply]
  exact (reesAlgebraBotEquiv R).commutes r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom_bot_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  apply (RingEquiv.quotientBot R).injective
  have h := congrArg (associatedGradedRingBotEquiv R) hxy
  rw [associatedGradedRingBotEquiv_base_mk,
    associatedGradedRingBotEquiv_base_mk] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_bot_injective
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_bot_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (normalSheafCoordinateMap R (⊥ : Ideal R))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Subsingleton (conormalModule R (⊥ : Ideal R)) := by
    change Subsingleton ((⊥ : Ideal R) ⧸
      ((⊥ : Ideal R) • ⊤ : Submodule R (⊥ : Ideal R)))
    infer_instance
  have existsBase (z : normalSheafCoordinateRing R (⊥ : Ideal R)) :
      ∃ r : R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R),
        z = algebraMap (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R))
          (normalSheafCoordinateRing R (⊥ : Ideal R)) r := by
    induction z using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
    | algebraMap r => exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
    | ι m =>
        rw [Subsingleton.elim m 0, map_zero]
        exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | mul x y hx hy =>
        obtain ⟨rx, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨ry, rfl⟩ := hy
        exact ⟨rx * ry, by simp⟩
    | add x y hx hy =>
        obtain ⟨rx, rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨ry, rfl⟩ := hy
        exact ⟨rx + ry, by simp⟩
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨rx, hx⟩ := existsBase x
  obtain ⟨ry, hy⟩ := existsBase y
  rw [hx, hy, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base,
    normalSheafCoordinateMap_base] at hxy
  have hr := associatedGradedBaseRingHom_bot_injective R hxy
  calc
    x = algebraMap (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R))
        (normalSheafCoordinateRing R (⊥ : Ideal R)) rx := hx
    _ = algebraMap (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R))
        (normalSheafCoordinateRing R (⊥ : Ideal R)) ry := congrArg _ hr
    _ = y := hy.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.schemeBotIsoNormalSheaf_hom

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.conormalModule_bot_eq_zero

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.schemeBotIsoNormalSheaf_hom_comp_normalSheafBotIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem schemeBotIsoNormalSheaf_hom_comp_normalSheafBotIso_hom :
    (schemeBotIsoNormalSheaf R).hom ≫ (normalSheafBotIso R).hom =
      (schemeBotIso R).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [schemeBotIsoNormalSheaf, normalSheafBotIso, schemeBotIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, AffineCone.schemeIsoBase_hom]
  change _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ ≫
      _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ ≫
        _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _ =
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map _
  rw [← _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_comp,
    ← _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_comp,
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_inj]
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, Iso.op_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Quiver.Hom.unop_op, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom,
    RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_inv]
  change normalSheafCoordinateMapBotEquiv R
      (algebraMap (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R))
        (normalSheafCoordinateRing R (⊥ : Ideal R))
        ((RingEquiv.quotientBot R).symm r)) =
    (associatedGradedRingBotEquiv R).symm r
  apply (associatedGradedRingBotEquiv R).injective
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change associatedGradedRingBotEquiv R
      (normalSheafCoordinateMap R (⊥ : Ideal R)
        (algebraMap (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R))
          (normalSheafCoordinateRing R (⊥ : Ideal R))
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk ⊥ r))) = r
  rw [normalSheafCoordinateMap_base,
    associatedGradedRingBotEquiv_base_mk]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.graded_homogeneous_lift
statement:
theorem graded_homogeneous_lift (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (n : ℕ) (b : B) (hb : b ∈ ℬ n) :
    ∃ a : A, a ∈ 𝒜 n ∧ f a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf b
  refine ⟨DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a n, (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a n).property, ?_⟩
  rw [GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose, ha]
  exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same ℬ hb

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.away_map_surjective
statement:
theorem away_map_surjective (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (s : A) (d : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    Function.Surjective (Away.map f s)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective ℬ (f.2 hs) z
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := graded_homogeneous_lift 𝒜 ℬ f hf (n • d) b hb
  refine ⟨Away.mk 𝒜 hs n a ha, ?_⟩
  rw [Away.map_mk]
  subst b
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.proj_map_chart_isPullback
statement:
theorem proj_map_chart_isPullback (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (s : A) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map f s)))
      (Proj.awayι ℬ (f s) (f.2 hs) hd) (Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hd) (Proj.map f hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf hd s hs
  · rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι, Proj.opensRange_awayι, Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.proj_map_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem proj_map_isClosedImmersion (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) : IsClosedImmersion (Proj.map f hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @IsClosedImmersion)
    (Proj.affineOpenCover 𝒜).openCover
  intro s
  have hpb := proj_map_chart_isPullback 𝒜 ℬ f hf s.2 s.1 s.1.2 s.2.2
  have hci : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map f s.2))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (away_map_surjective 𝒜 ℬ f hsurj s.2 s.1 s.2.2)
  have heq := hpb.flip.isoPullback_inv_snd
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (Proj.map f hf) (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2))
  rw [← heq]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.affineOtherToBlowup_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem affineOtherToBlowup_isClosedImmersion (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.affineOtherToBlowupZero_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem affineOtherToBlowupZero_isClosedImmersion (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    IsClosedImmersion (affineOtherToBlowupZero A I)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsClosedImmersion (zeroSection A) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (fun a ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C a, by simp⟩)
  have : IsClosedImmersion (affineOtherToBlowupZero A I ≫ pullback.fst _ _) := by
    rw [affineOtherToBlowupZero_fst]
    exact affineOtherToBlowup_isClosedImmersion A I
  exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion (affineOtherToBlowupZero A I)
    (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.affineOtherToInfinity_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem affineOtherToInfinity_isClosedImmersion (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherSourceChart_isPullback
statement:
theorem otherSourceChart_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (ReesBlowup.projection (J.ideal U)) (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U)
      (affineBaseι Y U) (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine Y J U).of_iso (Iso.refl _)
    (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen Y U).isoSpec (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    unfold affineBaseι
    simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherToInfinity_chart_isPullback
statement:
theorem otherToInfinity_chart_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (affineOtherToInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U)
      (affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U) (otherToInfinity Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have h := otherSourceChart_isPullback Y J U
  rw [← otherToInfinity_toBase Y J] at h
  have hbase : affineOtherToInfinity Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) ≫
      affineInfinityBase Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U) = ReesBlowup.projection (J.ideal U) := by
    unfold affineOtherToInfinity affineInfinityBase
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, affineOtherToBlowupZero_snd]
  rw [← hbase] at h
  exact h.of_right (affineι_otherToInfinity Y J U).symm
    (affineInfinity_isPullback_base Y J U).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherToInfinity_isClosedImmersion
statement: theorem otherToInfinity_isClosedImmersion : IsClosedImmersion (otherToInfinity Y J)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @IsClosedImmersion)
    (infinityOtherTargetCover Y J)
  intro U
  have hpb := otherToInfinity_chart_isPullback Y J U
  have := affineOtherToInfinity_isClosedImmersion Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (otherToInfinity Y J) (affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U))
  rw [← hpb.flip.isoPullback_inv_snd]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion
statement: theorem otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion : IsClosedImmersion (otherToTotal Y J)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.coe_decompose
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grIdeal_isHomogeneous
statement: theorem grIdeal_isHomogeneous : (grIdeal I).IsHomogeneous (grade I)
proof:
:= by

  have h : (DirectSum.decompose (grade I) q n : reesAlgebra I) =
      AffineNormalCone.reesProj A I n q := Subtype.ext (coe_decompose I q n)
  change (DirectSum.decompose (grade I) q n : reesAlgebra I) ∈ grIdeal I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grMk_apply

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartGrMap_surjective
statement: theorem chartGrMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (chartGrMap I r)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  have hf : grMk I (generator I r) ∈ grGrade I 1 := (grMk I).map_mem (generator_mem_grade_one I r)
  obtain ⟨n, a', ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective (grGrade I) hf y
  exact ⟨Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) n a ha, by
    rw [Away.map_mk]; rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartGrMap_baseElement
statement:
theorem chartGrMap_baseElement {a : A} (ha : a ∈ I) :
    chartGrMap I r (baseElement I r a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseElement, Away.map_mk]
  apply val_injective
  have h0 : grMk I (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)
  rw [Away.val_mk, val_zero, h0]
  first
  | exact Localization.mk_zero (M := Submonoid.powers (grMk I (generator I r))) _
  | (rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk']; exact IsLocalization.mk'_zero _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.monoElt_mem
statement: theorem monoElt_mem (N : ℕ) (c : A) (hc : c ∈ I ^ N) : monoElt I N c hc ∈ grade I (N • 1)
proof:
:= by
  change monomial N c = monomial (N • 1) ((monomial N c).coeff (N • 1))
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.mk_monoElt_mem
statement:
theorem mk_monoElt_mem (N : ℕ) (c : A) (hc : c ∈ I * I ^ N) (hc' : c ∈ I ^ N) :
    Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N c hc') (monoElt_mem I N c hc')
      ∈ I.map (baseRingHom I r)
proof:
:= by
  let K := I.map (baseRingHom I r)
  suffices H : c ∈ I ^ N ∧ ∀ hc' : c ∈ I ^ N, Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N
      (monoElt I N c hc') (monoElt_mem I N c hc') ∈ K from H.2 hc'
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hc ?_ ?_
  · intro m hm n hn
    refine ⟨Ideal.mul_mem_left _ m hn, fun hmn ↦ ?_⟩
    have heq : Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N (m * n) hmn)
        (monoElt_mem I N _ hmn) = baseElement I r m *
          Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N n hn)
            (monoElt_mem I N _ hn) := by
      apply val_injective
      simp only [val_mul, baseElement, Away.val_mk]
      rw [Localization.mk_mul]
      simp_rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
      rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq]
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_zero, one_mul, monoElt,
        Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]
      rw [Polynomial.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply,
        Polynomial.C_mul_monomial]
    rw [heq]
    refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
    rw [← baseRingHom_apply]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hm
  · rintro x y ⟨hx, hx'⟩ ⟨hy, hy'⟩
    refine ⟨add_mem hx hy, fun hxy ↦ ?_⟩
    have heq : Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N (x + y) hxy)
        (monoElt_mem I N _ hxy) =
        Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N x hx) (monoElt_mem I N _ hx)
        + Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N y hy)
          (monoElt_mem I N _ hy) := by
      apply val_injective
      simp only [val_add, Away.val_mk]
      rw [Localization.add_mk_self]
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [monoElt]
    rw [heq]
    exact add_mem (hx' hx) (hy' hy)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.mk_mem_of_mem_grIdeal
statement:
theorem mk_mem_of_mem_grIdeal (N : ℕ) (b : reesAlgebra I) (hb : b ∈ grade I (N • 1))
    (hbJ : b ∈ grIdeal I) :
    Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N b hb ∈ I.map (baseRingHom I r)
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : (b : A[X]) = monomial N ((b : A[X]).coeff N) := by simpa [grade] using hb
  have hc : (b : A[X]).coeff N ∈ I * I ^ N := by
    have := (AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff A I b).mp hbJ N
    rwa [pow_succ'] at this
  have hc' : (b : A[X]).coeff N ∈ I ^ N := Ideal.mul_le_left hc
  have heq : Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N b hb =
      Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) N (monoElt I N _ hc')
        (monoElt_mem I N _ hc') := by
    apply val_injective
    simp only [Away.val_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext hb'
  rw [heq]
  exact mk_monoElt_mem I r N _ hc hc'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.ker_chartGrMap
statement: theorem ker_chartGrMap : RingHom.ker (chartGrMap I r) = I.map (baseRingHom I r)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) x
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Away.map_mk] at hx
    have hv := congrArg val hx
    rw [Away.val_mk, val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hv
    obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hv
    have hJ : generator I r ^ k * a ∈ grIdeal I := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      simpa using hk
    have hdeg : generator I r ^ k * a ∈ grade I ((n + k) • 1) := by
      have h := SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded k (generator_mem_grade_one I r)) ha
      have e : k • 1 + n • 1 = (n + k) • 1 := by simp; omega
      exact e ▸ h
    have heq : Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) n a ha =
        Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) (n + k) _ hdeg := by
      apply val_injective
      simp only [Away.val_mk]
      rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      exact ⟨1, by simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]; ring⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact mk_mem_of_mem_grIdeal I r _ _ hdeg hJ
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, baseRingHom_apply]
    exact chartGrMap_baseElement I r ha

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem chartQuotientEquiv_mk (x : Away (grade I) (generator I r)) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.irrelevant_le_map_grMk
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_grMk :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grGrade I) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade I)).map (grMk I)
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousQuotient.irrelevant_le_map (grade I) (grIdeal I) (grIdeal_isHomogeneous I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.irrelevant_gr_le_span
statement:
theorem irrelevant_gr_le_span :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grGrade I)).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun r : I ↦ grMk I (generator I r))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grGrade I)).toIdeal ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade I)).toIdeal.map (grMk I) := irrelevant_le_map_grMk I
  refine h.trans ?_
  refine (Ideal.map_mono (irrelevant_le_span_generators I)).trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.algebraMap_mem_grade_zero
statement: theorem algebraMap_mem_grade_zero (a : A) : algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a ∈ grade I 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]) =
    monomial 0 (((algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]).coeff 0)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.coe_grZero_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_grZero_mk (a : A) :
    (grZero I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) =

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.chartQuotientEquiv_quotientMap
statement:
theorem chartQuotientEquiv_quotientMap :
    (chartQuotientEquiv I r).toRingHom.comp
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (baseRingHom I r)) (baseRingHom I r) Ideal.le_comap_map) =
      chartCenterHom I r
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  ext a
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grChart_center_isPullback
statement:
theorem grChart_center_isPullback :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartCenterHom I r)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartGrMap I r))) (centerι I)
      (chartMap I r ≫ projection I)
proof:
:= by
  have S := ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_quotient (baseRingHom I r) I
  rw [chartMap_projection]
  refine S.of_iso (asIso (Spec.map (chartQuotientEquiv I r).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom))
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, asIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp]
    congr 1
    ext x
    have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ f x) (chartQuotientEquiv_quotientMap I r)
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] at h
    change _ = (chartQuotientEquiv I r).symm (chartCenterHom I r (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x))
    rw [← h, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, asIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp]
    congr 1
    ext x
    change _ = (chartQuotientEquiv I r).symm (chartGrMap I r x)
    rw [← chartQuotientEquiv_mk, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  · simp [centerι]
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grMk_generator_mem
statement: theorem grMk_generator_mem : grMk I (generator I r) ∈ grGrade I 1
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grChart_grMap
statement:
theorem grChart_grMap :
    grChart I r ≫ grMap I = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartGrMap I r)) ≫ chartMap I r
proof:
:=
  Proj.awayι_comp_map (grMk I) _ (by omega) (generator I r) (generator_mem_grade_one I r)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grChart_grToCenter
statement:
theorem grChart_grToCenter :
    grChart I r ≫ grToCenter I = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartCenterHom I r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [grChart, grToCenter, ← Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext a
  change (fromZeroRingHom (grGrade I) _ (grZero I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a))).val =
    (chartGrMap I r (baseRingHom I r a)).val
  rw [baseRingHom_apply, baseElement, Away.map_mk, Away.val_mk]
  simp only [fromZeroRingHom, RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, val_mk]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grMap_projection
statement: theorem grMap_projection : grMap I ≫ projection I = grToCenter I ≫ centerι I
proof:
:= by
  refine (grCover I).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun r ↦ ?_
  change grChart I r ≫ _ = grChart I r ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, grChart_grMap, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (grChart I r),
    grChart_grToCenter]
  exact (grChart_center_isPullback I r).w.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_exceptionalι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem grToExceptional_exceptionalι : grToExceptional I ≫ exceptionalι I = grMap I
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_toCenter
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem grToExceptional_toCenter : grToExceptional I ≫ exceptionalToCenter I = grToCenter I
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grChart_isPullback
statement:
theorem grChart_isPullback :
    IsPullback (grChart I r ≫ grToExceptional I) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartGrMap I r)))
      (exceptionalι I) (chartMap I r)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right ?_ ?_ (exceptional_isPullback I).flip
  · rw [Category.assoc, grToExceptional_toCenter, grChart_grToCenter]
    exact grChart_center_isPullback I r
  · rw [Category.assoc, grToExceptional_exceptionalι, grChart_grMap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.range_grChart_comp
statement:
theorem range_grChart_comp :
    Set.range (grChart I r ≫ grToExceptional I) =
      exceptionalι I ⁻¹' Set.range (chartMap I r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (grChart_isPullback I r).isoPullback_hom_fst
  have hs : Function.Surjective (grChart_isPullback I r).isoPullback.hom := fun y ↦
    ⟨(grChart_isPullback I r).isoPullback.inv y, by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
  rw [← h, Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.coe_comp, Set.range_comp, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hs,
    Set.image_univ, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_preimage
statement:
theorem grToExceptional_preimage :
    grToExceptional I ⁻¹ᵁ exceptionalChartOpen I r =
      Proj.basicOpen (grGrade I) (grMk I (generator I r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [exceptionalChartOpen, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, grToExceptional_exceptionalι,
    chartMap_opensRange]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem grToExceptional_restrict_isIso :
    IsIso (grToExceptional I ∣_ exceptionalChartOpen I r)
proof:
:= by
  have hr1 : Set.range (grChart I r) =
      Set.range (grToExceptional I ⁻¹ᵁ exceptionalChartOpen I r).ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, grToExceptional_preimage, grChart,
      ← Proj.opensRange_awayι (grGrade I) _ (grMk_generator_mem I r) (by omega)]
    rfl
  have hr2 : Set.range (grChart I r ≫ grToExceptional I) =
      Set.range (exceptionalChartOpen I r).ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, range_grChart_comp]
    rfl
  let e1 := IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (grChart I r)
    (grToExceptional I ⁻¹ᵁ exceptionalChartOpen I r).ι hr1
  let e2 := IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (grChart I r ≫ grToExceptional I)
    (exceptionalChartOpen I r).ι hr2
  have : grToExceptional I ∣_ exceptionalChartOpen I r = e1.inv ≫ e2.hom := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (exceptionalChartOpen I r).ι, morphismRestrict_ι, Category.assoc,
      IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac, ← Category.assoc,
      IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_inv_fac]
  rw [this]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.iSup_exceptionalChartOpen
statement: theorem iSup_exceptionalChartOpen : ⨆ r : I, exceptionalChartOpen I r = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [exceptionalChartOpen, chartMap_opensRange]
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup,
    Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top (grade I) _ (irrelevant_le_span_generators I)]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.grMap_isPullback
statement:
theorem grMap_isPullback :
    IsPullback (grMap I) (grToCenter I) (projection I) (centerι I)
proof:
:=
  IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨grMap_projection I⟩ (asIso (grToExceptional I))
    (grToExceptional_exceptionalι I) (grToExceptional_toCenter I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.blowupToIntegerLineU_naturality
statement:
theorem blowupToIntegerLineU_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (GlobalCompletion.gluingFunctor Y J).map (homOfLE h) ≫ blowupToIntegerLineU Y J V =
      blowupToIntegerLineU Y J U
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowupToIntegerLineU, blowupToIntegerLineU]
  change schemeMapOfEq _ (polyRes Y h) _ _ ≫ blowupToLine (J.ideal V) ≫ _ = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, schemeMapOfEq_comp_projection, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, polyRes, Polynomial.mapRingHom_comp, integerMap_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ blowupToIntegerLine Y J = blowupToIntegerLineU Y J U
proof:
:=
  colimit.ι_desc _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.deformationToIntegerLineU_naturality
statement:
theorem deformationToIntegerLineU_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (RelativeSpec.gluingData Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y J)).functor.map (homOfLE h) ≫
      deformationToIntegerLineU Y J V = deformationToIntegerLineU Y J U
proof:
:= by
  unfold deformationToIntegerLineU toLine
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extReesMapOfEq (J.ideal V) (res Y h) (J.ideal U)
      (J.map_ideal h))) ≫ _ = _
  simp only [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  change extReesMapOfEq (J.ideal V) (res Y h) (J.ideal U) (J.map_ideal h)
      (φ (J.ideal V) (p.map (integerMap Γ(Y,V.1)))) =
    φ (J.ideal U) (p.map (integerMap Γ(Y,U.1)))
  rw [extReesMapOfEq_φ, Polynomial.map_map, integerMap_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine (U : Y.affineOpens) :

proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.uChartGlobal_toIntegerLine
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem uChartGlobal_toIntegerLine :
    uChartGlobal Y J ≫ blowupToIntegerLine Y J = deformationToIntegerLine Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  change DeformationSpace.affineι Y J U ≫ _ = DeformationSpace.affineι Y J U ≫ _
  rw [affineι_uChartGlobal_assoc, blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine,
    deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine]
  unfold blowupToIntegerLineU deformationToIntegerLineU
  rw [← Category.assoc, uChartι_toLine]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.lineAffineι_toIntegerLine
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem lineAffineι_toIntegerLine (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    lineAffineι Y U ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap Γ(Y,U.1))))
proof:
