  unfold deformationToIntegerLineU toLine
  change (lineAffineIso Y U).inv ≫ (lineAffineIso Y U).hom ≫ _ = _
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.genericFibreι_toLine
statement:
theorem genericFibreι_toLine (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    genericFibreι A I ≫ toLine A I = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(genericFibre_isPullback A I).w, genericFibreToGm, gmToLine,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.affineIntegerOverlap
statement:
theorem affineIntegerOverlap (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    gmToBlowup I ≫ blowupToLine I ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) ≫
        ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0 =
    gmToTrivialLine A ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) ≫
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmToBlowup, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (uChartι I), uChartι_toLine,
    ← Category.assoc (genericFibreι A I), genericFibreι_toLine]
  have hU : (nonPosHom A).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A)) =
      (mapLaurent (integerMap A)).comp (nonPosHom integerRing) :=
    RingHom.ext fun p ↦ (GlobalSubscheme.mapLaurent_nonPosHom (integerMap A) p).symm
  have hT : (Polynomial.toLaurent : A[X] →+* A[T;T⁻¹]).comp
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A)) =
      (mapLaurent (integerMap A)).comp Polynomial.toLaurent :=
    RingHom.ext fun p ↦ (mapLaurent_toLaurent (integerMap A) p).symm
  unfold gmToTrivialLine
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((nonPosHom A).comp
    (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A)))) ≫ _ =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((Polynomial.toLaurent : A[X] →+* A[T;T⁻¹]).comp
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A)))) ≫ _
  rw [hU, hT, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    line_chart_compat integerRing]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.gmAffineι_blowupIntegerRoute
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem gmAffineι_blowupIntegerRoute (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ gmToBlowupGlobal Y J ≫ blowupToIntegerLine Y J =
      gmToBlowup (J.ideal U) ≫ blowupToIntegerLineU Y J U
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, gmAffineι_gmToBlowupGlobal, Category.assoc,
    blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.gmAffineι_lineIntegerRoute
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem gmAffineι_lineIntegerRoute (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ =
      gmToTrivialLine Γ(Y,U.1) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap Γ(Y,U.1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, gmAffineι_gmToTrivial, Category.assoc, lineAffineι_toIntegerLine]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.gmAffineι_integerOverlap
statement:
theorem gmAffineι_integerOverlap (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ (gmToBlowupGlobal Y J ≫ blowupToIntegerLine Y J ≫
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0) =
    gmAffineι Y U ≫ (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ ≫
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmAffineι_blowupIntegerRoute_assoc, gmAffineι_lineIntegerRoute_assoc]
  exact affineIntegerOverlap Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.globalIntegerOverlap
statement:
theorem globalIntegerOverlap :
    gmToBlowupGlobal Y J ≫ blowupToIntegerLine Y J ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0 =
      DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  change DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊤ U ≫ _ = DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊤ U ≫ _
  have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ (gmAffineIso Y U).inv ≫ f) (gmAffineι_integerOverlap Y J U)
  have hg : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (extendedRees Γ(Y,U.1) (⊤ : Ideal Γ(Y,U.1))).val.toRingHom) =
      (gmAffineIso Y U).hom := rfl
  simpa only [gmAffineι, hg, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp] using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1 : blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
    blowupToIntegerLine Y J ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0
proof: := pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.lineTι_totalToIntegerP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem lineTι_totalToIntegerP1 : lineTι Y J ≫ totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
    deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1
proof: := pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.blowupι_affineToIntegerP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem blowupι_affineToIntegerP1 (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    blowupι I ≫ affineToIntegerP1 A I = blowupToLine I ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) ≫
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0
proof: := pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.trivialι_affineToIntegerP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem trivialι_affineToIntegerP1 (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    trivialι I ≫ affineToIntegerP1 A I =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) ≫
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1
proof: := pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.totalAffineι_toIntegerP1
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem totalAffineι_toIntegerP1 (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    totalAffineι Y J U ≫ totalToIntegerP1 Y J = affineToIntegerP1 Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change blowupι (J.ideal U) ≫ (totalAffineι Y J U ≫ totalToIntegerP1 Y J) =
      blowupι (J.ideal U) ≫ affineToIntegerP1 Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)
    rw [← Category.assoc, blowupι_totalAffineι, Category.assoc,
      blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1, blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine_assoc,
      blowupι_affineToIntegerP1]
    rfl
  · change trivialι (J.ideal U) ≫ (totalAffineι Y J U ≫ totalToIntegerP1 Y J) =
      trivialι (J.ideal U) ≫ affineToIntegerP1 Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)
    rw [← Category.assoc, trivialι_totalAffineι, Category.assoc,
      lineTι_totalToIntegerP1, lineAffineι_toIntegerLine_assoc,
      trivialι_affineToIntegerP1]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem infinityPoint_toSpec :
    infinityPoint ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec integerRing 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  unfold infinityPoint
  rw [Category.assoc, projectiveLineChart_toSpec, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  have he : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)).comp Polynomial.C = RingHom.id integerRing := by
    ext a
    simp
  rw [he]
  exact Spec.map_id _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.infinity_isPullback
statement:
theorem infinity_isPullback : IsPullback (infinityFibreι Y J) (infinityToInteger Y J)

proof: := IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.affineInfinityToGlobal_ι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineInfinityToGlobal_ι (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U ≫ infinityFibreι Y J =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.affineInfinityToGlobal_toInteger
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineInfinityToGlobal_toInteger (U : Y.affineOpens) :

proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.isPullback_affineInfinity
statement:
theorem isPullback_affineInfinity (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (affineInfinityToGlobal Y J U) (affineInfinityι Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U))
      (infinityFibreι Y J) (totalAffineι Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := infinityToInteger Y J)
    (h₂₂ := totalToIntegerP1 Y J) (v₁₃ := infinityPoint) ?_ ?_
    (infinity_isPullback Y J).flip
  · rw [affineInfinityToGlobal_toInteger, totalAffineι_toIntegerP1]
    exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).flip
  · exact affineInfinityToGlobal_ι Y J U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.centre_integerRingHom
statement:
theorem centre_integerRingHom (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (centreIdeal I)).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A)) =
      (integerMap (A[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I)).comp (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing))
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_C]
    exact RingHom.congr_fun (integerMap_comp
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (centreIdeal I)).comp Polynomial.C)) a
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_X, map_zero]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (X_mem_centreIdeal I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.exceptional_affineToIntegerP1
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem exceptional_affineToIntegerP1 (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    exceptionalι (centreIdeal I) ≫ blowupι I ≫ affineToIntegerP1 A I =
      (exceptionalToCenter (centreIdeal I) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integerMap (A[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I)))) ≫ infinityPoint
proof:
:= by
  have key : centerι (centreIdeal I) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap A))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integerMap (A[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing))) := by
    rw [centerι, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, centre_integerRingHom]
  rw [blowupι_affineToIntegerP1, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, exceptional_square]
  simpa only [infinityPoint, Category.assoc] using
    congrArg (fun f ↦ exceptionalToCenter (centreIdeal I) ≫ f ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0) key

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityGlobal.exceptionalToAffineInfinity_ι
statement:

theorem exceptionalToAffineInfinity_ι (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :

      exceptionalι (centreIdeal I) ≫ blowupι I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.conormalChartIso_factor
statement:
theorem conormalChartIso_factor (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    ConormalSheaf.conormalChartIso J U x = conormalChartTildeIso Y J U ≪≫
      (tilde.functor _).mapIso
        (x.conormalBasis.repr.trans (Finsupp.domLCongr Equiv.ulift.symm)).toModuleIso ≪≫ tildeFinsupp _
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConormalSheaf.conormalChartIso conormalChartTildeIso

  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmetricCoordinateMap_ι (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) (m : M) :
    symmetricCoordinateMap e (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q M m) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q N (e m)
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap_comp_symm
statement:
theorem symmetricCoordinateMap_comp_symm (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) :
    (symmetricCoordinateMap e).comp (symmetricCoordinateMap e.symm) = AlgHom.id Q _
proof:
:= by
  apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro n
  change symmetricCoordinateMap e (symmetricCoordinateMap e.symm (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q N n)) = _
  simp only [symmetricCoordinateMap_ι, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateMap_mem_grade
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left'
    (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q M))
    (C := fun d y _ => symmetricCoordinateMap e y ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q N d) ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · intro a
    rw [(symmetricCoordinateMap e).commutes]
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q N 0).smul_mem a (SetLike.one_mem_graded _)
  · intro y z d hy hz hy' hz'
    simpa only [map_add] using (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q N d).add_mem hy' hz'
  · intro y hy d z hz hz'
    obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [map_mul, symmetricCoordinateMap_ι]
    have hm : SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q N (e m) ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading Q N 1 := by
      change _ ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q N)) ^ 1
      rw [pow_one]
      exact ⟨e m,rfl⟩
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hm hz'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateGradedMap_comp_symm
statement:
theorem symmetricCoordinateGradedMap_comp_symm (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) :
    (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e).comp (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e.symm) = GradedRingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun (symmetricCoordinateMap_comp_symm e) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricChartZero_val
statement:
theorem symmetricChartZero_val (a : Q) :
    (symmetricChartZero (M := M) a : SymmetricAlgebra Q M) = algebraMap Q _ a
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((SchemeProjectiveBundle.degreeZeroAlgEquiv
    (R := Q) (M := M)).symm.commutes a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinate_degreeZero_square
statement:
theorem symmetricCoordinate_degreeZero_square (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) :
    (Proj.degreeZeroMap (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e)).comp (symmetricChartZero (M := M)) =
      symmetricChartZero (M := N)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change symmetricCoordinateMap e (symmetricChartZero (M := M) a) =
    (symmetricChartZero (M := N) a : SymmetricAlgebra Q N)
  rw [symmetricChartZero_val, symmetricChartZero_val, (symmetricCoordinateMap e).commutes]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.symmetricCoordinateProjIso_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem symmetricCoordinateProjIso_toSpec (e : M ≃ₗ[Q] N) :
    (symmetricCoordinateProjIso e).hom ≫ symmetricChartToSpec (M := M) = symmetricChartToSpec (M := N)
proof:
:=
  proj_map_zero_structure _ _ (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap e)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap_comp_symm e))
    (symmetricChartZero (M := M)) (symmetricChartZero (M := N)) (symmetricCoordinate_degreeZero_square e)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.conormalPlusLineChartSections_free
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartSections_free (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    Module.Free (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    Module.Finite (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.chartSectionsProjIso_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem chartSectionsProjIso_toQuotient (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    (chartSectionsProjIso Y J U x).hom ≫ chartSectionsToQuotient Y J U x = normalBundleToQuotient (J.ideal U) x
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_free (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormal_finite (J.ideal U) x
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J U x
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J U x
  exact symmetricCoordinateProjIso_toSpec (conormalPlusLineChartSectionsEquiv Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.chartSections_isPullback
statement:
theorem chartSections_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    IsPullback (chartSectionsToComponent Y J U x) (chartSectionsToQuotient Y J U x)
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) (J.subschemeCover.f U)
proof:
:= by
  refine (normalBundleAffineToComponent_isPullback Y J U x).of_iso
    (chartSectionsProjIso Y J U x) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [chartSectionsToComponent, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, chartSectionsProjIso_toQuotient]
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.chartSections_jointly_surjective
statement:
theorem chartSections_jointly_surjective {r : ℕ} (C : ConormalSheaf.QuasiregularCover J r)
    (p : InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component Y J) :
    ∃ (i : C.J) (q : chartSectionsProjectiveModel Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)),
      chartSectionsToComponent Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) q = p
proof:
:=
  (componentChartSectionsCover Y J C).exists_eq p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleChartComparison.chartSectionsToTotal_recovery
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem chartSectionsToTotal_recovery (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    (chartSectionsProjIso Y J U x).hom ≫ chartSectionsToTotal Y J U x =
      normalBundleAffineToComponent Y J U x ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_forward
statement:
theorem totalGrade_forward (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (p : Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) (hp : p ∈ totalGrade I n) :
    CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I p ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.as_sum_support p, map_sum]
  apply AddSubgroup.sum_mem
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n := by
    by_contra h
    have hz := (hp k).2 (by omega)
    exact Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hk hz
  have h := CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_monomial_degree I (n-k) k (p.coeff k) (hp k).1
  simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hkn] using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.grProj_mem_grade
statement:
theorem grProj_mem_grade (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) :
    AffineNormalCone.grProj A I n x ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade I n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  rw [AffineNormalCone.grProj_mk]
  apply HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_grade
  change Polynomial.monomial n ((p : A[X]).coeff n) =
    Polynomial.monomial n ((Polynomial.monomial n ((p : A[X]).coeff n)).coeff n)
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.mem_grade_of_other_grProj_zero
statement:
theorem mem_grade_of_other_grProj_zero (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)
    (h : ∀ m, m ≠ n → AffineNormalCone.grProj A I m x = 0) :
    x ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade I n
proof:
:= by
  have hx : AffineNormalCone.grProj A I n x = x := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := AffineNormalCone.sum_grProj A I x
    rw [← hN, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    by_cases he : m = n
    · subst m
      exact AffineNormalCone.grProj_idem A I n x
    · rw [h m he, map_zero]
  rw [← hx]
  exact grProj_mem_grade I n x

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.diagonalGrExtract_homogeneous_zero
statement:
theorem diagonalGrExtract_homogeneous_zero (I : Ideal A) (n m k : ℕ)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I))
    (hx : x ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) n) (h : m+k ≠ n) :
    CentrePowers.diagonalGrExtract I m k x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hx
  change (p : Polynomial A[X]) = Polynomial.monomial n ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n) at hp
  change ReesBlowup.grMk I (CentrePowers.diagonalReesExtract I m k p) = 0
  have he : CentrePowers.diagonalReesExtract I m k p = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [CentrePowers.diagonalReesExtract_coe, hp]
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, Ne.symm h]
  rw [he, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_inverse
statement:
theorem totalGrade_inverse (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I))
    (hx : x ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) n) :
    (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm x ∈ totalGrade I n
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  have hz (m : ℕ) (h : m+k ≠ n) :
      AffineNormalCone.grProj A I m (((CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm x).coeff k) = 0 := by
    rw [CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_symm_diagonal]
    exact diagonalGrExtract_homogeneous_zero I n m k x hx h
  by_cases hk : k ≤ n
  · exact ⟨mem_grade_of_other_grProj_zero I (n-k) _ (fun m hm => hz m (by omega)),
      fun h => by omega⟩
  · have he : ((CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm x).coeff k = 0 :=
      AffineNormalCone.eq_zero_of_forall_grProj_eq_zero A I (fun m => hz m (by omega))
    exact ⟨by rw [he]; exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _, fun _ => he⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_iff
statement:
theorem totalGrade_iff (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (p : Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) :
    p ∈ totalGrade I n ↔ CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I p ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact totalGrade_forward I n p
  · intro h
    have hi := totalGrade_inverse I n (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I p) h
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hi
    exact hi

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.totalDecomposeEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem totalDecomposeEquiv_symm (I : Ideal A) :
    (totalDecomposeEquiv I).symm.toAddMonoidHom = DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (totalGrade I)
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.addHom_ext
  intro n p
  change (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm
    ((DirectSum.decomposeAddEquiv (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))).symm
      ((DirectSum.congrAddEquiv (fun n => (gradeEquiv I n).symm)).symm
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => totalGrade I n) n p))) = _
  change (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm
    ((DirectSum.decomposeAddEquiv (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))).symm
      (DirectSum.map (fun n => (gradeEquiv I n).toAddMonoidHom)
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => totalGrade I n) n p))) = _
  rw [DirectSum.map_of]
  change (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm
    ((DirectSum.decompose (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))).symm
      (DirectSum.of _ n (gradeEquiv I n p))) = _
  rw [DirectSum.decompose_symm_of]
  change (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I p) = _
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.irrelevant_comparison
statement:
theorem irrelevant_comparison (I : Ideal A) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (totalGrade I)).map (comparisonGraded I)
proof:
:= by
  change (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))).toIdeal ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (totalGrade I)).toIdeal.map (comparisonGraded I)
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_eq_span]
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  obtain ⟨hn, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  have hs := totalGrade_inverse I n x hx
  have hmem := HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (totalGrade I) hn hs
  have hm := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (comparisonGraded I) hmem
  change CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I ((CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm x) ∈ _ at hm
  rwa [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.irrelevant_comparison_inverse
statement:
theorem irrelevant_comparison_inverse (I : Ideal A) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (totalGrade I) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))).map
        (comparisonGradedInverse I)
proof:

  change (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (totalGrade I)).toIdeal ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))).toIdeal.map (comparisonGradedInverse I)
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_eq_span]
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨n, hp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
  obtain ⟨hn, hp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
  have hs := totalGrade_forward I n p hp
  have hmem := HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) hn hs
  have hm := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (comparisonGradedInverse I) hmem
  change (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I).symm (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I p) ∈ _ at hm
  rwa [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade_monomial

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.projIsoOfInverseGradedMaps_chart
statement:
theorem projIsoOfInverseGradedMaps_chart
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup R) (ℬ : ℕ → AddSubgroup S)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒜)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).map g)
    (hfg : f.comp g = GradedRingHom.id ℬ) (hgf : g.comp f = GradedRingHom.id 𝒜)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (s : R) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    Proj.awayι ℬ (f s) (f.map_mem hs) hn ≫
      (projIsoOfInverseGradedMaps 𝒜 ℬ f g hf hg hfg hgf).hom =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f s)) ≫
      Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hn
proof:
:=
  Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf hn s hs

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback
statement:

  · simp

proof: := normalSheafCoordinateMap_base A I a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundaryComparison_restriction
statement:
theorem boundaryComparison_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    (normalSheafCoordinateMap B J).comp (cotangentSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h) =
      (grMapOfEq I f J h).comp (normalSheafCoordinateMap A I)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change normalSheafCoordinateMap B J
      (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) =
        grMapOfEq I f J h (normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a))
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base,
      normalSheafCoordinateMap_base, associatedGraded_base_naturality]
  | ι m =>
    change normalSheafCoordinateMap B J
      (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent m)) =
        grMapOfEq I f J h (normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ m))
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_ι, normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι,
      normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι, conormal_associatedGraded_naturality]
    rfl
  | mul p q hp hq => simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg₂ (· * ·) hp hq
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hp hq

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundaryGradedComparison_inverse
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundarySymmetricRestriction_mem_grade
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h).map_mem (boundaryComparison_mem_grade I hp)
  have hi := (boundaryGradedInverse J y).map_mem ht
  have he := RingHom.congr_fun (boundaryComparison_restriction I f J h) p
  change conormalComparisonEquiv J y (cotangentSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h p) =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundary_graded_restriction_square
statement:
theorem boundary_graded_restriction_square (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (y : QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    (boundaryGradedComparison J).comp (boundaryGradedRestriction I f J h y) =
      (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (boundaryGradedComparison I)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (boundaryComparison_restriction I f J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundary_graded_restriction_route
statement:
theorem boundary_graded_restriction_route (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (y : QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    boundaryGradedRestriction I f J h y = (boundaryGradedInverse J y).comp
      ((grRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (boundaryGradedComparison I))
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply (conormalComparisonEquiv J y).injective
  change conormalComparisonEquiv J y (cotangentSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h p) =
    conormalComparisonEquiv J y ((conormalComparisonEquiv J y).symm
      (grMapOfEq I f J h (normalSheafCoordinateMap A I p)))
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (boundaryComparison_restriction I f J h) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundary_irrelevant_restriction
statement:
theorem boundary_irrelevant_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    letI := conormal_free J y
    letI := conormal_finite J y
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (B ⧸ J) J.Cotangent) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent)).map
        (boundaryGradedRestriction I f J h y) := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI := conormal_free J y
  letI := conormal_finite J y
  have hi := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) (grGrade I) (boundaryGradedComparison I)
    (boundaryGradedInverse I x) (boundaryGradedComparison_inverse I x)
  have hj := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse (grGrade J)
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (B ⧸ J) J.Cotangent) (boundaryGradedInverse J y)
    (boundaryGradedComparison J) (boundaryGradedInverse_comparison J y)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hi (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
  have hr := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ht hj
  rw [← boundary_graded_restriction_route] at hr
  exact hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundary_irrelevant_comparison
statement:
theorem boundary_irrelevant_comparison (I : Ideal A) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grGrade I) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent)).map
        (boundaryGradedComparison I) := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  change (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grGrade I)).toIdeal ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent)).toIdeal.map
      (boundaryGradedComparison I)
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_eq_span]
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨n, hp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
  obtain ⟨hn, hp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
  have hg := (boundaryGradedInverse I x).map_mem hp
  have hm := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (boundaryGradedComparison I)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) hn hg)
  have he := GradedRingHom.congr_fun (boundaryGradedComparison_inverse I x) p
  change boundaryGradedComparison I (boundaryGradedInverse I x p) = p at he
  change boundaryGradedComparison I (boundaryGradedInverse I x p) ∈ _ at hm
  rw [he] at hm
  exact hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryProjIso_hom
statement:
theorem conormalBoundaryProjIso_hom (I : Ideal A) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    (conormalBoundaryProjIso I x).hom =
      @Proj.map (normalSheafCoordinateRing A I) (associatedGradedRing A I)
        (Submodule (A ⧸ I) (normalSheafCoordinateRing A I)) (AddSubgroup (associatedGradedRing A I))
        inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) inferInstance inferInstance
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) (grGrade I)
        inferInstance (grGradedRing I) (boundaryGradedComparison I)
      (boundary_irrelevant_comparison I x) := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryRestriction_eq
statement:
theorem conormalBoundaryRestriction_eq (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    letI := conormal_free J y
    letI := conormal_finite J y
    conormalBoundaryRestriction I f J h x y = Proj.map (boundaryGradedRestriction I f J h y)
      (boundary_irrelevant_restriction I f J h x y) := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI := conormal_free J y
  letI := conormal_finite J y
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryRestriction_comparison (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq I f J h ≫ (conormalBoundaryProjIso I x).hom =
      (conormalBoundaryProjIso J y).hom ≫ conormalBoundaryRestriction I f J h x y
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI := conormal_free J y
  letI := conormal_finite J y
  rw [conormalBoundaryProjIso_hom I x, conormalBoundaryProjIso_hom J y,
    conormalBoundaryRestriction_eq]
  unfold grSchemeRestrictionOfEq
  erw [← Proj.map_comp, ← Proj.map_comp]
  exact ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (boundary_graded_restriction_square I f J h y).symm _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryZero_val
statement:
theorem conormalBoundaryZero_val (I : Ideal A) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    (conormalBoundaryZero I x a : normalSheafCoordinateRing A I) = algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((SchemeProjectiveBundle.degreeZeroAlgEquiv
    (R := A ⧸ I) (M := I.Cotangent)).symm.commutes a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.boundary_degreeZero_square
statement:
theorem boundary_degreeZero_square (I : Ideal A) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    letI : CommRing (associatedGradedRing A I) := Ideal.Quotient.commRing _
    (Proj.degreeZeroMap (𝒜 := SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent)
      (ℬ := grGrade I) (boundaryGradedComparison I)).comp (conormalBoundaryZero I x) = grZero I := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI : CommRing (associatedGradedRing A I) := Ideal.Quotient.commRing _
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (conormalBoundaryZero I x a) =
    (grZero I a : associatedGradedRing A I)
  rw [conormalBoundaryZero_val, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base]
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryProjIso_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryProjIso_toQuotient (I : Ideal A) (x : QuasiregularGenerators A I) :
    (conormalBoundaryProjIso I x).hom ≫ conormalBoundaryToQuotient I x = grToCenter I
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI : CommRing (associatedGradedRing A I) := Ideal.Quotient.commRing _
  rw [conormalBoundaryProjIso_hom I x]
  unfold conormalBoundaryToQuotient grToCenter
  erw [← Category.assoc, Proj.map_toSpecZero, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k)) (boundary_degreeZero_square I x)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryChartToCone_centre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryChartToCone_centre (i : C.J) :
    conormalBoundaryChartToCone Y J C i ≫ projectiveConeToCentre Y J =
      conormalBoundaryToQuotient (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i) ≫ C.chartCover.f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [conormalBoundaryChartToCone, Category.assoc, projectiveConeAffine_toCentre,
    ← conormalBoundaryProjIso_toQuotient (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryChartRestriction_toCone
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryChartRestriction_toCone {i j : C.J} (h : C.U i ≤ C.U j) :
    conormalBoundaryChartRestriction Y J C h ≫ conormalBoundaryChartToCone Y J C j =
      conormalBoundaryChartToCone Y J C i
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (conormalBoundaryProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).hom).mp
  unfold conormalBoundaryChartRestriction
  erw [← Category.assoc, ← conormalBoundaryRestriction_comparison]
  simp only [conormalBoundaryChartToCone, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.w (projectiveConeGluingData Y J).functor (homOfLE h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.nativeBoundaryChart_centre_isPullback
statement:
theorem nativeBoundaryChart_centre_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    CategoryTheory.IsPullback (boundaryChart Y J U) (grToCenter (J.ideal U))
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J) J.subschemeι) (J.subschemeCover.f U)
proof:
:= by
  have hApp : grToCenter (J.ideal U) ≫ (centerι (J.ideal U) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv) =
      projectiveConeApp Y J U := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← grMap_projection]
    rfl
  have ho : CategoryTheory.IsPullback
      (grToCenter (J.ideal U) ≫ (centerι (J.ideal U) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv))
      (boundaryChart Y J U) U.1.ι
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J) J.subschemeι ≫ J.subschemeι) := by
    rw [hApp, ← CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.condition]
    exact boundaryChart_base_isPullback Y J U
  have hIso : CategoryTheory.IsPullback U.2.isoSpec.inv U.2.fromSpec U.1.ι (𝟙 Y) :=
    CategoryTheory.IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso ⟨by rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, Category.comp_id]⟩
  have hc := (ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_subschemeCover Y J U).flip.paste_horiz hIso
  simp only [Category.comp_id] at hc
  exact (ho.of_right (boundaryChart_snd Y J U).symm hc).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.projectiveConeAffine_centre_isPullback
statement:
theorem projectiveConeAffine_centre_isPullback (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    CategoryTheory.IsPullback (projectiveConeAffineι Y J U) (grToCenter (J.ideal U))
      (projectiveConeToCentre Y J) (J.subschemeCover.f U)
proof:
:= by
  refine (nativeBoundaryChart_centre_isPullback Y J U).of_iso (Iso.refl _)
    (projectiveConeBoundaryIso Y J).symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    rw [← projectiveConeAffine_boundaryIso, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rw [← projectiveConeBoundaryIso_toCentre, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryChartToCone_isPullback
statement:
theorem conormalBoundaryChartToCone_isPullback (i : C.J) :
    CategoryTheory.IsPullback (conormalBoundaryChartToCone Y J C i)
      (conormalBoundaryToQuotient (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i))
      (projectiveConeToCentre Y J) (C.chartCover.f i)
proof:
:= by
  refine (projectiveConeAffine_centre_isPullback Y J (C.U i)).of_iso
    (conormalBoundaryProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i))
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, conormalBoundaryChartToCone,
      ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact (conormalBoundaryProjIso_toQuotient (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryCharts_jointly_surjective
statement:
theorem conormalBoundaryCharts_jointly_surjective (p : projectiveNormalCone Y J) :

  (conormalBoundaryCover Y J C).exists_eq p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryChartToCone_toOther
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryChartToCone_toOther (i : C.J) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryChartToCone_toTotal

@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryChartToCone_toTotal (i : C.J) :

      (conormalBoundaryProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).inv ≫
        grMap (J.ideal (C.U i)) ≫ GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J (C.U i) ≫

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityComponentIntersectionNormalBundle.conormalBoundaryChart_original_embeddings
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem conormalBoundaryChart_original_embeddings (i : C.J) :
    conormalBoundaryChartToCone Y J C i ≫ projectiveConeToOther Y J ≫
        InfinityOtherComponent.otherToInfinity Y J =
      conormalBoundaryChartToCone Y J C i ≫ projectiveConeToExceptional Y J ≫
        InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J
proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.spectrumImageSectionsEquiv_apply
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumCoeff_symm
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumCoeff_symm (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.affineOpens) :
    (spectrumImageRingEquiv U.2.fromSpec).symm.toRingHom =
      (Z.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top U)).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (ConormalSheaf.chartCoeff_eq U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumSections_smul
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumSections_smul (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.affineOpens) (E : Z.Modules)
    (a : Γ(Z,U.1)) (m : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(Z,U.1))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E))) :
    a • m = (Z.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top U)).op a) •
      (show E.val.obj (op (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤)) from m)
proof:
:= by
  change ((U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Z,U.1)).inv a)) •
    (show E.val.obj (op (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤)) from m) = _
  have h := RingHom.congr_fun (affineSpectrumCoeff_symm Z U) a
  exact congrArg (fun b => b • (show E.val.obj (op (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤)) from m)) h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumImage_le
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumImage_le {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ V.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top U, ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top V]
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (m : E.val.obj (op V.1)) :
    affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E h (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E m) =
      affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op m)
proof:
:= by
  change E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Z h)).op
    (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top V)).op m) =
      E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top U)).op
        (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op m)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction_id
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction_id (U : Z.affineOpens) :
    affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E (le_refl U) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro m
  change E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Z (le_refl U))).op m = m
  have h : (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Z (le_refl U))).op = 𝟙 (op (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤)) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction_comp {U V W : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) (k : V ≤ W) :
    affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E (h.trans k) =
      (affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E h).comp (affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E k)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro m
  change E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Z (h.trans k))).op m =
    E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Z h)).op
      (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (affineSpectrumImage_le Z k)).op m)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction_smul
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction_smul {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (a : Γ(Z,V.1)) (m : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(Z,V.1))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).obj E))) :
    affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E h (a • m) =
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op a) • affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E h m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E).surjective m
  rw [← (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E).map_smul,
    affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality, affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality]
  have hm : E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op (a • m) =
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op a) •
        E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op m := E.val.map_smul _ a m
  rw [hm, (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E).map_smul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSpectrumSymmetricRestriction_ι
statement:
theorem affineSpectrumSymmetricRestriction_ι {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (m : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := Γ(Z,V.1))).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).obj E))) :
    affineSpectrumSymmetricRestriction Z E h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(Z,V.1) _ m) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(Z,U.1) _ (affineSpectrumSectionsRestriction Z E h m)
proof:
:=
  InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.affineSymmetricRestriction_square
statement:
theorem affineSymmetricRestriction_square {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (affineSpectrumSymmetricRestriction Z E h).comp
      (symmetricCoordinateMap (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)).toRingHom =
    (symmetricCoordinateMap (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)).toRingHom.comp
      (affineOpenSymmetricRestriction Z E h)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      AlgHom.commutes, affineSpectrumSymmetricRestriction, affineOpenSymmetricRestriction,
      InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_base]
  | ι m =>
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      symmetricCoordinateMap_ι, affineSpectrumSymmetricRestriction_ι,
      affineOpenSymmetricRestriction, InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_ι]
    exact congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(Z,U.1) _)
      (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv_naturality Z E h m)
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul, hp, hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.frameSpectrumSections_free
statement:
theorem frameSpectrumSections_free (i : D.I) :
    Module.Free Γ(Z,D.U i) (frameSpectrumSections D i)
proof:
:= by
  letI := D.sectionModule_free i
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (frameSpectrumSectionsEquiv D i)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.frameSpectrumSections_finite

theorem frameSpectrumSections_finite (i : D.I) :
    Module.Finite Γ(Z,D.U i) (frameSpectrumSections D i)

:= by
  letI := D.sectionModule_finite i
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (frameSpectrumSectionsEquiv D i)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.frameSpectrumProjIso_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem frameSpectrumProjIso_toSpec (i : D.I) :
    (frameSpectrumProjIso D i).hom ≫ frameSpectrumToSpec D i = (D.affineData i).toSpecBase
proof:
:= by
  letI := D.sectionModule_free i
  letI := D.sectionModule_finite i
  letI := frameSpectrumSections_free D i
  letI := frameSpectrumSections_finite D i
  exact symmetricCoordinateProjIso_toSpec (frameSpectrumSectionsEquiv D i).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.frameSpectrumProjIso_toAmbient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem frameSpectrumProjIso_toAmbient (i : D.I) :
    (frameSpectrumProjIso D i).hom ≫ frameSpectrumToAmbient D i = D.chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameSpectrumToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, frameSpectrumProjIso_toSpec]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.frameSpectrumChartι_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem frameSpectrumChartι_toBase (i : D.I) :
    frameSpectrumChartι D i ≫ D.toBase = frameSpectrumToAmbient D i
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (frameSpectrumProjIso D i).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  simp only [frameSpectrumChartι, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [D.chartι_toBase, frameSpectrumProjIso_toAmbient]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleFrameComparison.frameSpectrumChart_isPullback
statement:
theorem frameSpectrumChart_isPullback (i : D.I) :
    IsPullback (frameSpectrumChartι D i) (frameSpectrumToSpec D i) D.toBase (D.affineOpen i).2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  refine (D.isPullback_chartι_toBase i).of_iso (frameSpectrumProjIso D i)
    (Iso.refl _) (D.affineOpen i).2.isoSpec (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [frameSpectrumChartι, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [frameSpectrumProjIso_toSpec]
    simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartToBase,
      SchemeRelativeProj.AffineData.toBase, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  · simp
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.X_mem_centreIdeal
statement: theorem X_mem_centreIdeal : (Polynomial.X : R[X]) ∈ centreIdeal I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.C_mem_centreIdeal
statement: theorem C_mem_centreIdeal {a : R} (ha : a ∈ I) : Polynomial.C a ∈ centreIdeal I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.φ_X
statement: theorem φ_X : φ I Polynomial.X = parameter R I
proof: := structureMap_X R I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.φ_C
statement: theorem φ_C (a : R) : φ I (Polynomial.C a) = algebraMap R (extendedRees R I) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
  exact (structureMap R I).commutes a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.parameter_isRegular
statement: theorem parameter_isRegular : IsRegular (parameter R I)
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsLeftRegular (parameter R I) := fun x y hxy => parameter_isSMulRegular R I hxy
  exact ⟨h, fun x y hxy => h (by simpa [mul_comm] using hxy)⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.φ_injective
statement: theorem φ_injective : Function.Injective (φ I)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  have h := congrArg (fun z : extendedRees R I => (z : R[T;T⁻¹])) hpq
  simp only [φ, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe] at h
  rw [coe_structureMap, coe_structureMap] at h
  exact Polynomial.toLaurent_injective (invert.injective h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.map_centreIdeal
statement:
theorem map_centreIdeal :
    (centreIdeal I).map (φ I) = Ideal.span {φ I (uGen I).1}
proof:
:= by
  change (I.map Polynomial.C ⊔ Ideal.span {Polynomial.X}).map (φ I) = _
  rw [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  refine sup_eq_right.mpr ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap]
  rw [φ_C, φ_X, ← parameter_mul_degreeOne R I ⟨a, ha⟩]
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨degreeOne R I ⟨a, ha⟩, mul_comm _ _⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.uChartHom_injective
statement: theorem uChartHom_injective : Function.Injective (uChartHom I)
proof:
:=
  chartLift_injective _ _ _ (φ_injective I) _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.uChartHom_baseRingHom
statement:
theorem uChartHom_baseRingHom (p : R[X]) :
    uChartHom I (baseRingHom (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) p) = φ I p
proof:
:=
  chartLift_baseRingHom _ _ _ _ _ p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.degreeOne_mem_range
statement: theorem degreeOne_mem_range (a : I) : degreeOne R I a ∈ (uChartHom I).range
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ratioElement (centreIdeal I) (uGen I) ⟨Polynomial.C a.1, C_mem_centreIdeal I a.2⟩, ?_⟩
  refine chartLift_ratioElement _ _ _ _ _ _ (degreeOne R I a) ?_
  change degreeOne R I a * φ I Polynomial.X = φ I (Polynomial.C a.1)
  rw [φ_X, φ_C, mul_comm, parameter_mul_degreeOne]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.monomial_mem_range
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_range : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R), a ∈ I ^ n →
    ∃ z ∈ (uChartHom I).range, (z : R[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C a * T n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro a _
    refine ⟨algebraMap R _ a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← φ_C, ← uChartHom_baseRingHom]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · simp [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro a ha
    rw [pow_succ] at ha
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on ha ?_ ?_
    · intro x hx y hy
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := ih x hx
      refine ⟨z * degreeOne R I ⟨y, hy⟩, Subring.mul_mem _ hz (degreeOne_mem_range I _), ?_⟩
      rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, hzx, coe_degreeOne]
      simp only [map_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [T_add]; ring
    · rintro x y ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ ⟨w, hw, hwy⟩
      exact ⟨z + w, Subring.add_mem _ hz hw, by rw [AddMemClass.coe_add, hzx, hwy, map_add, add_mul]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.negMonomial_mem_range
statement:
theorem negMonomial_mem_range (m : ℕ) (b : R) :
    ∃ z ∈ (uChartHom I).range, (z : R[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C b * T (-(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨algebraMap R _ b * parameter R I ^ m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Subring.mul_mem _ ?_ (Subring.pow_mem _ ?_ _)
    · rw [← φ_C, ← uChartHom_baseRingHom]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · rw [← φ_X, ← uChartHom_baseRingHom]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · rw [MulMemClass.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, coe_parameter, T_pow]
    simp [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.uChartHom_surjective
statement: theorem uChartHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (uChartHom I)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  suffices h : ∃ z ∈ (uChartHom I).range, (z : R[T;T⁻¹]) = (f : R[T;T⁻¹]) by
    obtain ⟨z, ⟨y, rfl⟩, hz⟩ := h
    exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext hz⟩
  rw [eq_sum_support R (f : R[T;T⁻¹])]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (fun g => ∃ z ∈ (uChartHom I).range, (z : R[T;T⁻¹]) = g)
    ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro g h ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z + w, Subring.add_mem _ hz hw, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨0, Subring.zero_mem _, rfl⟩
  · intro n _
    rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, e⟩ := monomial_mem_range I n.toNat _ (coeff_mem_of_mem R I f.2 n)
      exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [e, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn]⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, e⟩ := negMonomial_mem_range I (-n).toNat ((f : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff n)
      exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [e]; congr 2; omega⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.homogeneousLocalization_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousLocalization_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup A} [GradedRing 𝒜] (x : Submonoid A) (c : 𝒜 0)
    (hc : ∀ y : A, (c : A) * y = 0 → y = 0) (z : HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x)
    (hz : HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x c * z = 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  have h := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at h
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
  obtain ⟨⟨a, t⟩, e⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (S := Localization x) x z.val
  change IsLocalization.mk' (Localization x) a t = z.val at e
  rw [← e] at h ⊢
  have hval : (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x c).val =
      algebraMap A (Localization x) (c : A) := by
    change Localization.mk (c : A) 1 = _
    exact Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap _
  rw [hval, IsLocalization.mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨m, hc _ ?_⟩
  rw [← hm]; ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.grade_zero_regular
statement:
theorem grade_zero_regular (c : grade (centreIdeal I) 0)
    (hq : IsUnit (zeroEquiv (centreIdeal I) c).leadingCoeff) (y : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I))
    (h : (c : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) * y = 0) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ((c : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) : R[X][X]) =
      Polynomial.C (zeroEquiv (centreIdeal I) c) := by
    rw [← Polynomial.monomial_zero_left]; exact c.2
  have h' := congrArg (fun w : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I) => (w : R[X][X])) h
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, hc, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at h'
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext1 n
  have hn := congrArg (fun w : R[X][X] => w.coeff n) h'
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hn
  rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
  exact eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff R hq hn

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.blowupToLineOver_flat
statement: theorem blowupToLineOver_flat : Flat (blowupToLineOver I k)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover
    (Proj.affineOpenCover (grade (centreIdeal I))).openCover fun i => ?_
  change Flat (Proj.awayι (grade (centreIdeal I)) i.2.1 i.2.2 i.1.2 ≫ blowupToLineOver I k)
  rw [blowupToLineOver, blowupToLine, ReesBlowup.projection, Category.assoc,
    Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
    HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Flat)]
  let ψ : k[X] →+* HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (i.2.1 : reesAlgebra _) :=
    (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom _ _).comp
      ((zeroEquiv (centreIdeal I)).symm.toRingHom.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k R)))
  change ψ.Flat
  letI := ψ.toAlgebra
  change Module.Flat k[X] _
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · have : Subsingleton (grade (centreIdeal I) 0) := (zeroEquiv (centreIdeal I)).toEquiv.subsingleton
    have : Subsingleton
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (i.2.1 : reesAlgebra _)) := by
      refine subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one ?_
      rw [← map_zero (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grade (centreIdeal I)) _),
        ← map_one (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grade (centreIdeal I)) _),
        Subsingleton.elim (0 : grade (centreIdeal I) 0) 1]
    infer_instance
  · have : Module.IsTorsionFree k[X]
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (i.2.1 : reesAlgebra _)) := by
      refine ⟨fun p hp z w hzw => ?_⟩
      have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.left.ne_zero
      have hzw' : ψ p * (z - w) = 0 := by
        rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        simpa [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hzw
      refine sub_eq_zero.mp (homogeneousLocalization_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero _
        ((zeroEquiv (centreIdeal I)).symm (p.map (algebraMap k R))) ?_ _ hzw')
      intro y hy
      refine grade_zero_regular _ ?_ y hy
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
        Polynomial.leadingCoeff_map_of_injective (algebraMap k R).injective]
      exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp0)).map _
    infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.gmToBlowup_blowupι

:=
  pushout.condition

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.lineOver_flat
statement: theorem lineOver_flat : Flat (lineOver R k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Flat)]
  letI := (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
  change Module.Flat k[X] R[X]
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · infer_instance
  · have : Module.IsTorsionFree k[X] R[X] := by
      refine ⟨fun p hp z w hzw => ?_⟩
      have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.left.ne_zero
      have hq : IsUnit (p.map (algebraMap k R)).leadingCoeff := by
        rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_map_of_injective (algebraMap k R).injective]
        exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp0)).map _
      have h : p.map (algebraMap k R) * (z - w) = 0 := by
        rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        simpa [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hzw
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff R hq h)
    infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.gm_ringHom_zero
statement:
theorem gm_ringHom_zero :
    ((algebraMap (extendedRees R I) R[T;T⁻¹]).comp (φ I)).comp
        (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k R)) = lineLaurent (algebraMap k R)
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, φ_C,
      lineLaurent_C]
    rfl
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, φ_X,
      lineLaurent_X]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.gm_ringHom_one
statement:
theorem gm_ringHom_one :
    (algebraMap R[X] R[T;T⁻¹]).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k R)) =
      (invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp (lineLaurent (algebraMap k R))
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, lineLaurent_C,
      algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_C]
    change _ = invert (algebraMap R R[T;T⁻¹] _)
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, invert_C]
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, lineLaurent_X,
      algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_X]
    change _ = invert (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹])
    rw [invert_T, neg_neg]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.gm_chart_compat
statement:
theorem gm_chart_compat :
    gmToBlowup I ≫ blowupToLineOver I k ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart k 0 =
      gmToTrivialLine R ≫ lineOver R k ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart k 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : gmToBlowup I ≫ blowupToLineOver I k =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lineLaurent (algebraMap k R))) := by
    rw [gmToBlowup, blowupToLineOver, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (uChartι I),
      uChartι_toLine, toLine, genericFibreι, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← gm_ringHom_zero I k]
  have h1 : gmToTrivialLine R ≫ lineOver R k =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp
        (lineLaurent (algebraMap k R)))) := by
    rw [gmToTrivialLine, lineOver, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, gm_ringHom_one]
  rw [← Category.assoc, h0, ← Category.assoc, h1]
  unfold ProjectiveLine.chart
  rw [← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((lineLaurent (algebraMap k R)).comp
      (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom)) ≫ _ =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (((invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp
      (lineLaurent (algebraMap k R))).comp (chartEquiv k 1).toRingHom)) ≫ _
  rw [← overlapHom_awayMap_zero, RingHom.comp_assoc, ← overlapHom_awayMap_one,
    CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp_assoc, Spec.map_comp_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι ..).trans (Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι ..).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.blowupι_toP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem blowupι_toP1 : blowupι I ≫ toP1 I k = blowupToLineOver I k ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart k 0
proof:
:=
  pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.trivialι_toP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem trivialι_toP1 : trivialι I ≫ toP1 I k = lineOver R k ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart k 1
proof:
:=
  pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.toP1_flat
statement: theorem toP1_flat : Flat (toP1 I k)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover
    (Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R))) fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover_f]
  haveI := blowupToLineOver_flat I k
  haveI := lineOver_flat (R := R) k
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · change Flat (colimit.ι (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R)) WalkingSpan.zero ≫ toP1 I k)
    rw [← colimit.w (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R)) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst, Category.assoc]
    change Flat (gmToBlowup I ≫ blowupι I ≫ toP1 I k)
    rw [blowupι_toP1]
    infer_instance
  · change Flat (blowupι I ≫ toP1 I k)
    rw [blowupι_toP1]
    infer_instance
  · change Flat (trivialι I ≫ toP1 I k)
    rw [trivialι_toP1]
    infer_instance

statement:
