:=
  TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    (PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range R[T;T⁻¹] (Polynomial.X : R[X]))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.lineOver_preimage_basicOpen_X
statement:
theorem lineOver_preimage_basicOpen_X :
    lineOver R k ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]) =
      (gmToTrivialLine R).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineOver, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen, opensRange_gmToTrivialLine]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.blowupToLineOver_preimage_basicOpen_X
statement:
theorem blowupToLineOver_preimage_basicOpen_X :
    blowupToLineOver I k ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]) ≤
      (gmToBlowup I).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hy' : y ∈ blowupToLine I ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : R[X]) := by
    rw [blowupToLineOver, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen] at hy
    simpa using hy
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := blowupToLine_preimage_basicOpen_X_le I hy'
  have hw : w ∈ toLine R I ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : R[X]) := by
    rw [← uChartι_toLine, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]; exact hy'
  rw [toLine, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen] at hw
  have e : (CommRingCat.ofHom (structureMap R I).toRingHom).hom Polynomial.X = parameter R I :=
    φ_X I
  rw [e] at hw
  have hw' : w ∈ Set.range (genericFibreι R I) := by
    rw [range_genericFibreι]
    exact hw
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hw'
  exact ⟨z, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.preimage_opensRange_chart_zero
statement:
theorem preimage_opensRange_chart_zero :
    toP1 I k ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 0).opensRange = (blowupι I).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨gmToBlowup I y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · change trivialι I y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : lineOver R k y ∈
          (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 0).opensRange := by
        show ProjectiveLine.chart k 1 (lineOver R k y) ∈ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 0).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← trivialι_toP1 I k, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [chart_one_preimage] at hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (gmToTrivialLine R).opensRange := by
        rw [← lineOver_preimage_basicOpen_X k]; exact hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨gmToBlowup I z, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, gmToBlowup_blowupι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show toP1 I k (blowupι I y) ∈ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 0).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowupι_toP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.preimage_opensRange_chart_one
statement:
theorem preimage_opensRange_chart_one :
    toP1 I k ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1).opensRange = (trivialι I).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨gmToTrivialLine R y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (gmToBlowup I) (gmToTrivialLine R))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.snd)
    · change blowupι I y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : blowupToLineOver I k y ∈
          (ProjectiveLine.chart k 0) ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1).opensRange := by
        show ProjectiveLine.chart k 0 (blowupToLineOver I k y) ∈
          (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← blowupι_toP1 I k, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [chart_zero_preimage] at hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := blowupToLineOver_preimage_basicOpen_X I k hy
      refine ⟨gmToTrivialLine R z, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← gmToBlowup_blowupι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show toP1 I k (trivialι I y) ∈ (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, trivialι_toP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.blowupι_isPullback
statement:
theorem blowupι_isPullback :
    IsPullback (blowupToLineOver I k) (blowupι I) (ProjectiveLine.chart k 0) (toP1 I k)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (blowupι_toP1 I k) (preimage_opensRange_chart_zero I k)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.trivialι_isPullback
statement:
theorem trivialι_isPullback :
    IsPullback (lineOver R k) (trivialι I) (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1) (toP1 I k)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (trivialι_toP1 I k) (preimage_opensRange_chart_one I k)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.centre_ringHom
statement:
theorem centre_ringHom :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (centreIdeal I)).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap k R)) =
      (algebraMap k (R[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I)).comp (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_C]
    rfl
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_X, map_zero]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (X_mem_centreIdeal I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.exceptional_toP1
statement:
theorem exceptional_toP1 :
    exceptionalι (centreIdeal I) ≫ blowupι I ≫ toP1 I k =
      (exceptionalToCenter (centreIdeal I) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (R[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I)))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) ≫
          ProjectiveLine.chart k 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : centerι (centreIdeal I) ≫ lineOver R k =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (R[X] ⧸ centreIdeal I))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) := by
    rw [centerι, lineOver, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, centre_ringHom]
  rw [blowupι_toP1, blowupToLineOver, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, exceptional_square]
  simp only [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% key]

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral [Algebra.IsIntegral B A] [FaithfulSMul B A] :
    ringKrullDim A = ringKrullDim B
proof:
:= by
  let f : PrimeSpectrum A → PrimeSpectrum B := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B A)
  have hmono : StrictMono f := fun P Q h ↦ by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal] at h ⊢
    exact Ideal.IsIntegral.comap_lt_comap h
  have hlift : ∀ (P : PrimeSpectrum A) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), f P < q →
      ∃ P', P < P' ∧ f P' = q := by
    intro P q hlt
    have hle : P.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B A) ≤ q.asIdeal :=
      (PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal _ _).mpr hlt |>.le
    obtain ⟨Q, hPQ, hQ, hQq⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral q.asIdeal P.asIdeal hle
    refine ⟨⟨Q, hQ⟩, ?_, PrimeSpectrum.ext hQq⟩
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hPQ fun hPQ' ↦ hlt.ne ?_
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, hPQ', hQq]
  have hco : ∀ P : PrimeSpectrum A, Order.coheight P = Order.coheight (f P) :=
    Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono f hmono hlift
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ringKrullDim, ringKrullDim, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight,
      Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
    exact iSup_le fun P ↦ (hco P) ▸ le_iSup (fun q : PrimeSpectrum B ↦
      ((Order.coheight q : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) (f P)
  · rw [ringKrullDim, ringKrullDim, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight,
      Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
    refine iSup_le fun q ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQq⟩⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_primesOver (S := A) q.asIdeal
    have hfQ : f ⟨Q, hQ⟩ = q := by
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal]
      exact hQq.over.symm
    rw [← hfQ, ← hco]
    exact le_iSup (fun P : PrimeSpectrum A ↦ ((Order.coheight P : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic (R : Type u) (S A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [CommRing A] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S A] [IsScalarTower R S A] [Nontrivial R]
    [NoZeroDivisors A] [FaithfulSMul R S] [FaithfulSMul S A] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic S A] :
    Algebra.trdeg R A = Algebra.trdeg R S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trdeg_add_eq R S (A := A), trdeg_eq_zero (R := S) (A := A), add_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg (k A : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing A]
    [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] :
    ringKrullDim A = (Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k A) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, g, hinj, hfin⟩ := exists_finite_inj_algHom_of_fg k A
  algebraize [g.toRingHom]
  have : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) A :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' g.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have : Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) A := hfin
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) A := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite _ _
  have : FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) A :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hinj
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) A,
    MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field,
    trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic k (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) A, MvPolynomial.trdeg_of_isDomain]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient
statement:
theorem PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient (p : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    ((Order.coheight p : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  let f : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ p.asIdeal) → PrimeSpectrum A :=
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal)
  have hmono : StrictMono f :=
    RingHom.strictMono_comap_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hrange : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A, p ≤ q → ∃ a, f a = q := by
    intro q hq
    have hmem : q ∈ Set.range f := by
      rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, Ideal.mk_ker]
      exact hq
    exact hmem
  have hlift : ∀ a b, f a < b → ∃ a', a < a' ∧ f a' = b := by
    intro a b hab
    have hpb : p ≤ b := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hab.le
      change p.asIdeal ≤ a.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal)
      intro x hx
      change Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal x ∈ a.asIdeal
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx]
      exact a.asIdeal.zero_mem
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hrange b hpb
    refine ⟨a', ?_, ha'⟩
    rw [← ha'] at hab
    have hle : a ≤ a' := by
      change a.asIdeal ≤ a'.asIdeal
      rw [← Ideal.comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
      exact hab.le
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h ↦ hab.ne (by rw [h])
  have h0 : f ⊥ = p := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    change (⊥ : Ideal (A ⧸ p.asIdeal)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal) = p.asIdeal
    rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have h1 : Order.coheight (⊥ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ p.asIdeal)) = Order.coheight p := by
    rw [Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono f hmono hlift ⊥, h0]
  rw [← h1, ringKrullDim, ← Order.coheight_bot_eq_krullDim]

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_isFractionRing'
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_isFractionRing' (A K : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Field K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A K
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x ↦ (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff A K K).mpr (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x)⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_toENat_trdeg_residueField
statement:
theorem PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_toENat_trdeg_residueField {k : Type u} [Field k] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] (p : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    Order.coheight p = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (A ⧸ p.asIdeal) p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    isAlgebraic_of_isFractionRing' _ _
  have h1 := PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient p
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k (A ⧸ p.asIdeal),
    ← trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic k (A ⧸ p.asIdeal) p.asIdeal.ResidueField] at h1
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.fiberPrime_comap_includeRight
statement:
theorem fiberPrime_comap_includeRight (P : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    (fiberPrime B P).asIdeal.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = P.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h := PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber_symm_apply_coe B A
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B A) P) (fiberPrime B P)
  have h' : (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber B A (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B A) P)).symm
      (fiberPrime B P) = ⟨P, rfl⟩ :=
    (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber B A _).symm_apply_apply ⟨P, rfl⟩
  rw [h'] at h
  exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_algebraic_towers
statement:
theorem trdeg_eq_of_algebraic_towers (C D E κ : Type u) [CommRing C] [CommRing D] [CommRing E]
    [CommRing κ] [Nontrivial C] [NoZeroDivisors E] [Algebra C D] [Algebra D E] [Algebra C E]
    [Algebra C κ] [Algebra κ E] [IsScalarTower C D E] [IsScalarTower C κ E]
    [FaithfulSMul C D] [FaithfulSMul D E] [FaithfulSMul C κ] [FaithfulSMul κ E]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic D E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic C κ] :
    Algebra.trdeg C D = Algebra.trdeg κ E
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := trdeg_add_eq C D (A := E)
  have h2 := trdeg_add_eq C κ (A := E)
  rw [trdeg_eq_zero (R := D) (A := E), add_zero] at h1
  rw [trdeg_eq_zero (R := C) (A := κ), zero_add] at h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.coheight_eq_coheight_add_coheight_fiberPrime
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_coheight_add_coheight_fiberPrime [Algebra.FiniteType k B]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] (P : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    Order.coheight P =
      Order.coheight (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B A) P) +
        Order.coheight (fiberPrime B P)
proof:
:= by
  set Q := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B A) P with hQ
  set P' := fiberPrime B P with hP'
  have hlies : P.asIdeal.LiesOver Q.asIdeal := ⟨rfl⟩
  have : Algebra.FiniteType B A := Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType k B A
  have instDomD : IsDomain (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain P.asIdeal
  have instDomC : IsDomain (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain Q.asIdeal
  have instDomE : IsDomain (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain P'.asIdeal
  have instFTF : Algebra.FiniteType Q.asIdeal.ResidueField (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.baseChange (R := B) (A := A) Q.asIdeal.ResidueField
  have instFTE : Algebra.FiniteType Q.asIdeal.ResidueField (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) :=
    inferInstance
  have instFTD : Algebra.FiniteType k (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) := inferInstance
  have instFTC : Algebra.FiniteType k (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) := inferInstance
  
  let instCD : Algebra (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver P.asIdeal Q.asIdeal
  have hCD : ∀ b : B, algebraMap (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q.asIdeal b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A b) := fun b ↦
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_mk_of_liesOver P.asIdeal Q.asIdeal b
  have hPcomap : P.asIdeal = P'.asIdeal.comap
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := B) (A := Q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
        (B := A)).toRingHom :=
    (fiberPrime_comap_includeRight B P).symm
  
  let _ : Algebra A (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  have hAF : ∀ a : A, algebraMap A (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A) a = 1 ⊗ₜ[B] a := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hPcomap' : P.asIdeal ≤ P'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A)) :=
    le_of_eq hPcomap
  let instDE : Algebra (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap hPcomap'
  have hψ : ∀ a : A, algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal (1 ⊗ₜ[B] a) := fun a ↦ rfl
  have hψinj : Function.Injective
      (algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)) :=
    Ideal.quotientMap_injective' (le_of_eq hPcomap.symm)
  
  have hCE : ∀ b : B, algebraMap (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q.asIdeal b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal (algebraMap B (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A) b) := fun b ↦
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_mk_of_liesOver P'.asIdeal Q.asIdeal b
  let instCE : Algebra (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver P'.asIdeal Q.asIdeal
  have towerCκE : @IsScalarTower (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) Q.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) Algebra.toSMul Algebra.toSMul instCE.toSMul := by
    refine @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ instCE fun x ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rw [hCE, show Ideal.Quotient.mk Q.asIdeal b = algebraMap B (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) b from rfl,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) Q.asIdeal.ResidueField]
    change _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal (algebraMap Q.asIdeal.ResidueField (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A)
      (algebraMap B Q.asIdeal.ResidueField b))
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B Q.asIdeal.ResidueField (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A)]
  have towerCDE : @IsScalarTower (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A ⧸ P.asIdeal)
      (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) instCD.toSMul instDE.toSMul instCE.toSMul := by
    refine @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ instCD instDE instCE fun x ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rw [hCE, hCD, hψ, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B A (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A), hAF]
  have towerkCD : @IsScalarTower k (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A ⧸ P.asIdeal)
      Algebra.toSMul instCD.toSMul Algebra.toSMul := by
    refine @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ instCD _ fun x ↦ ?_
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k B (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) x, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, hCD,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k B A, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k A (A ⧸ P.asIdeal),
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  
  have : FaithfulSMul (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr Ideal.quotientMap_injective
  have : FaithfulSMul (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hψinj
  have : FaithfulSMul (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) Q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr
      Q.asIdeal.injective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField
  
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) := by
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    obtain ⟨r, hr, s, hrs⟩ := Ideal.Fiber.exists_smul_eq_one_tmul Q.asIdeal x
    have hy0 : algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h' : Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r) = 0 :=
        hψinj (by rw [h, map_zero])
      exact hr (Ideal.mem_comap.mpr (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h'))
    have hmul : algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r)) * Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal x =
        algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal s) := by
      have h1 : (1 : Q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[B] algebraMap B A r =
          algebraMap B (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A) r := by
        rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
        exact Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.commutes r
      calc algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r)) * Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal x
          = Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal (algebraMap B (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A) r * x) := by
            rw [hψ, ← map_mul, h1]
        _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal (r • x) := by rw [Algebra.smul_def]
        _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal ((1 : Q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[B] s) := by rw [hrs]
        _ = _ := (hψ s).symm
    have halg1 : IsAlgebraic (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal)
        (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r))) :=
      isAlgebraic_algebraMap _
    have halg2 : IsAlgebraic (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal)
        (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r)) *
        Ideal.Quotient.mk P'.asIdeal x) := by
      rw [hmul]
      exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap _
    have hy : algebraMap (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (algebraMap B A r)) ∈
        nonZeroDivisors (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) :=
      mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hy0
    exact IsAlgebraic.of_mul (R := A ⧸ P.asIdeal) (S := Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)
      hy halg1 halg2
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) Q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    isAlgebraic_of_isFractionRing' _ _
  
  have hP := PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient P
  have hQ' := PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient Q
  have hP'' := PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient P'
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k] at hP hQ'
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg Q.asIdeal.ResidueField] at hP''
  have hP1 : Order.coheight P = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (A ⧸ P.asIdeal)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hP
  have hQ1 : Order.coheight Q = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hQ'
  have hP2 : Order.coheight P' =
      Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg Q.asIdeal.ResidueField (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hP''
  rw [hP1, hQ1, hP2, ← trdeg_eq_of_algebraic_towers (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A ⧸ P.asIdeal)
    (Q.asIdeal.Fiber A ⧸ P'.asIdeal) Q.asIdeal.ResidueField,
    ← map_add, trdeg_add_eq k (B ⧸ Q.asIdeal) (A := A ⧸ P.asIdeal)]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.restrictedGradedMap_eq_native
statement:
theorem restrictedGradedMap_eq_native {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) :
    letI : Algebra R S
proof:
:= f.toAlgebra
    letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
    letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
      ⟨fun r s n => by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) =
      semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ := by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n => by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraMap _ (algebraMap R _ a) = symmetricSemilinearMap f φ _
    exact (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap (S := S)
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) a).trans
      (symmetricSemilinearMap_base f φ a).symm
  | ι m =>
    change SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraMap _ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) = symmetricSemilinearMap f φ _
    exact (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraMap_ι (S := S)
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) m).trans
      (symmetricSemilinearMap_ι f φ m).symm
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add,hp,hq]
  | mul p q hp hq => simp only [map_mul,hp,hq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.nativeSemilinear_irrelevant
statement:
theorem nativeSemilinear_irrelevant {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading S N) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading R M)).map
        (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n => by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
  have hg := SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan
  rw [restrictedGradedMap_eq_native] at hg
  exact hg

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.semilinearProjMap_eq_native
statement:
theorem semilinearProjMap_eq_native {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hspan =
      Proj.map (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ) (nativeSemilinear_irrelevant f φ hspan)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n => by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
  exact ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (restrictedGradedMap_eq_native f φ) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.nativeSemilinear_degreeZero_square
statement:
theorem nativeSemilinear_degreeZero_square {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) :
    (Proj.degreeZeroMap (semilinearSymmetricGradedMap f φ)).comp
      (symmetricChartZero (Q := R) (M := M)) =
      (symmetricChartZero (Q := S) (M := N)).comp f
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change symmetricSemilinearMap f φ (symmetricChartZero (Q := R) (M := M) a) =
    (symmetricChartZero (Q := S) (M := N) (f a) : SymmetricAlgebra S N)
  rw [symmetricChartZero_val, symmetricChartZero_val]
  exact symmetricSemilinearMap_base f φ a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.spectrumGradedRestriction_square
statement:
theorem spectrumGradedRestriction_square {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    [Module.Free Γ(Z,U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(Z,U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1))]
    [Module.Free Γ(Z,V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(Z,V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1))] :
    (spectrumCoordinateGradedMap Z E U).comp (openGradedRestriction Z E h) =
      (spectrumGradedRestriction Z E h).comp (spectrumCoordinateGradedMap Z E V)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact (RingHom.congr_fun (affineSymmetricRestriction_square Z E h) p).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.spectrumProjRestriction_square
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem spectrumProjRestriction_square {U V : Z.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    [Module.Free Γ(Z,U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(Z,U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1))]
    [Module.Free Γ(Z,V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(Z,V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1))]
    (hspan : Submodule.span Γ(Z,U.1) (Set.range (affineOpenSectionsSemilinear Z E h)) = ⊤) :
    letI
proof:
:= Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)
    letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)
    letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)
    letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op).hom
      (affineSpectrumSectionsSemilinear Z E h) (spectrumRestriction_spans Z E h hspan) ≫
      (symmetricCoordinateProjIso (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)).hom =
    (symmetricCoordinateProjIso (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)).hom ≫
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap
        (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h : U.1 ⟶ V.1).op).hom
        (affineOpenSectionsSemilinear Z E h) hspan := by
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)
  letI := Module.Free.of_equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)
  letI := Module.Finite.equiv (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)
  rw [semilinearProjMap_eq_native, semilinearProjMap_eq_native]
  exact proj_map_actual_square _ _ _ _ (openGradedRestriction Z E h)
    (spectrumCoordinateGradedMap Z E V) (spectrumCoordinateGradedMap Z E U)
    (spectrumGradedRestriction Z E h)
    (nativeSemilinear_irrelevant _ _ hspan)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _
      (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap_comp_symm (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z V E)))
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _
      (symmetricCoordinateGradedMap_comp_symm (affineSpectrumSectionsEquiv Z U E)))
    (nativeSemilinear_irrelevant _ _ (spectrumRestriction_spans Z E h hspan))
    (spectrumGradedRestriction_square Z E h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec {Q : Type u} [CommRing Q] {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Spec (.of Q) ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f] :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (spectrumImageRingEquiv f).toRingHom) ≫
      (spectrumImageAffineOpen f).2.fromSpec = f
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f (spectrumImageAffineOpen f).2
    (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of Q))) (f.preimage_image_eq ⊤).ge
  change Spec.map (f.appLE (f ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (f.preimage_image_eq ⊤).ge) ≫
    (spectrumImageAffineOpen f).2.fromSpec = (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of Q))).fromSpec ≫ f at h
  rw [← f.appIso_hom' ⊤] at h
  have hh := congrArg (fun g => Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of Q)).hom ≫ g) h
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp] at hh
  rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom] at hh
  change Spec.map ((f.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of Q)).hom) ≫
    (spectrumImageAffineOpen f).2.fromSpec =
      (Spec (.of Q)).isoSpec.hom ≫ (Spec (.of Q)).isoSpec.inv ≫ f at hh
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc] at hh
  exact hh

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec (i : C.J) :
    (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫
      ((localFrameCover Y J C).affineData i).toSpecBase =
    chartSectionsToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_free i
  letI := (localFrameCover Y J C).sectionModule_finite i
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  have hc := @nativeSemilinear_degreeZero_square
    Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i) (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i)))
    (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i))
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))).isModule
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom (localFrameSectionsEquiv Y J C i).toLinearMap
  have hh := proj_map_zero_structure _ _ (localFrameGradedMap Y J C i)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (localFrameGradedMap_comp_inverse Y J C i))
    (symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(J.subscheme,(localFrameCover Y J C).U i)) (M := (conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj
      (op ((localFrameCover Y J C).U i))))
    ((symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)) (M := conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i))).comp
      (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)
    hc
  have hspec : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      ((symmetricChartZero (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (M := conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i))).comp
          (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (symmetricChartZero
        (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (M := conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i)))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom) :=
    Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (symmetricChartZero
        (Q := Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
        (M := conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i))))
  exact hh.trans ((congrArg (fun g => Proj.toSpecZero
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J (C.U i))) ≫ g) hspec).trans
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toCentre (i : C.J) :
    (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫ (localFrameCover Y J C).chartToAmbient i =
      chartSectionsToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) ≫ C.chartCover.f i
proof:
:= by
  have hf := @spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (localFrameScalarEquiv Y J C i).toRingHom) ≫
    ((localFrameCover Y J C).affineOpen i).2.fromSpec = C.chartCover.f i at hf
  change (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫
    (((localFrameCover Y J C).affineData i).toSpecBase ≫
      ((localFrameCover Y J C).affineOpen i).2.fromSpec) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun f => chartSectionsToQuotient Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i) ≫ f) hf)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.localFrameToComponent_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem localFrameToComponent_toCentre (i : C.J) :
    localFrameToComponent Y J C i ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J =
      (localFrameCover Y J C).chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv).mp
  change (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).inv ≫
    ((localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).hom ≫ chartSectionsToComponent Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)) ≫
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J = _
  rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact (chartSections_isPullback Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).w.trans
    (localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toCentre Y J C i).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.localFrameToComponent_isPullback
statement:
theorem localFrameToComponent_isPullback (i : C.J) :
    IsPullback (localFrameToComponent Y J C i)
      ((localFrameCover Y J C).affineData i).toSpecBase
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J)
      ((localFrameCover Y J C).affineOpen i).2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  refine (chartSections_isPullback Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)).of_iso
    (localFrameChartSectionsIso Y J C i).symm (Iso.refl _)
    (localFrameScalarSpecIso Y J C i) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [localFrameToComponent, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  · exact (localFrameChartSectionsIso_inv_toSpec Y J C i).symm
  · simp
  · exact (@spectrumImageScalar_fromSpec (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) J.subscheme (C.chartCover.f i) (C.chartCover.map_prop i)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.commonSpectrumRestriction_original_square_inv
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonSpectrumRestriction_original_square_inv (i : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :
    commonSpectrumRestrictionToFrame Y J C i W h ≫
      (frameSpectrumProjIso (localFrameCover Y J C) i).inv =
    (commonSpectrumProjIso Y J C i W h).inv ≫
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap
        (C := localFrameCover Y J C) i W h i h
proof:
:= by
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  letI := commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W h
  letI := commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W h
  letI := D.sectionModule_free i
  letI := D.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,(D.affineOpen i).1)
      ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op (D.affineOpen i).1)) := D.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,(D.affineOpen i).1)
      ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op (D.affineOpen i).1)) := D.sectionModule_finite i
  exact spectrumProjRestriction_square J.subscheme (conormalPlusLine Y J)
    (show W ≤ D.affineOpen i from h) (D.restriction_spans i W.1 h)

@[reassoc] theorem commonSpectrumRestriction_original_square (i : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U i) :

      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap
        (C := localFrameCover Y J C) i W h i h ≫
        (frameSpectrumProjIso (localFrameCover Y J C) i).hom

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.commonSpectrumRestrictionToAnyFrame_original_square_inv
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem commonSpectrumRestrictionToAnyFrame_original_square_inv (source target : C.J)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)

    (ht : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U target) :

        (C := localFrameCover Y J C) source W hs target ht

      ((conormalPlusLine Y J).val.obj (op (D.affineOpen target).1)) := D.sectionModule_finite target

theorem fourFactorRoute_congr {K : Type*} [Category K] {P Q R A B S : K}
    (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : Q ⟶ R) (l : R ⟶ A) (r : R ⟶ B)
    (fi : A ⟶ S) (fj : B ⟶ S) (h : l ≫ fi = r ≫ fj) :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleProjCoverNaturality.commonSpectrumRestrictions_overlap_toScheme
statement:
theorem commonSpectrumRestrictions_overlap_toScheme {i j source : C.J}
    (c : (localFrameCover Y J C).CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : J.subscheme.affineOpens)
    (hs : W.1 ≤ (localFrameCover Y J C).U source) (hc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    commonSpectrumRestrictionToAnyFrame Y J C source i W hs
      (hc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) ≫ frameSpectrumChartι (localFrameCover Y J C) i =
    commonSpectrumRestrictionToAnyFrame Y J C source j W hs
      (hc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) ≫ frameSpectrumChartι (localFrameCover Y J C) j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frameSpectrumChartι, ← Category.assoc,
    commonSpectrumRestrictionToAnyFrame_original_square_inv]
  rw [← c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hs hc,
    ← c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hs hc]
  exact fourFactorRoute_congr _ _ _ _ _ _
    (frameCommonChart_toScheme (localFrameCover Y J C) c)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.coe_generator_pow
statement:
theorem coe_generator_pow (m : ℕ) :
    ((generator I r ^ m : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]) = C (r.1 ^ m) * X ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [SubmonoidClass.coe_pow]
  change (monomial 1 r.1) ^ m = _
  rw [monomial_pow, one_mul, C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.generator_pow_succ_mul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun q : reesAlgebra I => (q : A[X])) h
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_generator_pow, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
    ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at h'
  have key : ∀ k, r.1 ^ (m + 1) * (p : A[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
    intro k
    have := congrArg (fun q : A[X] => q.coeff (k + m)) h'
    simp only [coeff_zero] at this
    rw [← this]
    rw [show C (r.1 ^ m) * X ^ m * (algebraMap A A[X] r.1 * (p : A[X])) =
        X ^ m * (C (r.1 ^ (m + 1)) * (p : A[X])) by
      rw [Polynomial.algebraMap_eq, pow_succ, C_mul]; ring]
    rw [coeff_X_pow_mul, coeff_C_mul]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_generator_pow, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  ext k
  rw [show C (r.1 ^ (m + 1)) * X ^ (m + 1) * (p : A[X]) =
      X ^ (m + 1) * (C (r.1 ^ (m + 1)) * (p : A[X])) by ring]
  rw [coeff_X_pow_mul', coeff_zero]
  split_ifs
  · rw [coeff_C_mul, key]
  · rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.baseElement_val
statement:
theorem baseElement_val (a : A) :
    (baseElement I r a).val =
      algebraMap (reesAlgebra I) (Localization.Away (generator I r))
        (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseElement, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  simp only [pow_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  exact IsLocalization.mk'_one _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.baseElement_self_isRegular
statement: theorem baseElement_self_isRegular : IsRegular (baseElement I r r.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : ∀ z, baseElement I r r.1 * z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    have hz' := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, baseElement_val, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hz'
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    obtain ⟨⟨p, s⟩, hps⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers (generator I r)) z.val
    rw [← hps] at hz' ⊢
    rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (M := Submonoid.powers (generator I r)) (Localization.Away _),
      ← IsLocalization.mk'_mul, one_mul, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hz'
    obtain ⟨⟨_, m, rfl⟩, hm⟩ := hz'
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨_, m + 1, rfl⟩, generator_pow_succ_mul_eq_zero I r hm⟩
  refine (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr ?_
  intro x y hxy
  have : baseElement I r r.1 * (x - y) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hxy
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hleft _ this)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_fst
statement:
theorem idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_fst (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (K : Ideal R) :
    (idealPullbackSpecIso R S K).inv ≫
      pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (K.map (algebraMap R S))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealPullbackSpecIso, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc]
  erw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst R S (R ⧸ K)]
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.op_inv, Scheme.Spec_map, Quiver.Hom.unop_op]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext s
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S K).symm (s ⊗ₜ[R] 1) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s
  rw [show (1 : R ⧸ K) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K 1 by rfl]
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot_symm_tmul]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_snd
statement:
theorem idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_snd (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (K : Ideal R) :
    (idealPullbackSpecIso R S K).inv ≫
      pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.quotientMap (K.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map))
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealPullbackSpecIso, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc]
  erw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd R S (R ⧸ K)]
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.op_inv, Scheme.Spec_map, Quiver.Hom.unop_op]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext a
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S K).symm
    (1 ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) = _
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot_symm_tmul]
  simp [Ideal.quotientMap_mk, Algebra.smul_def]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_quotient
statement:
theorem isPullback_quotient {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (K : Ideal R) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.quotientMap (K.map φ) φ Ideal.le_comap_map)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (K.map φ))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
proof:
:= by
  letI := φ.toAlgebra
  have h1 : IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (K.map (algebraMap R S)))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.quotientMap (K.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk K))) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨?_⟩ (idealPullbackSpecIso R S K).symm ?_ ?_
    · rw [← idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_fst, ← idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_snd, Category.assoc,
        Category.assoc, pullback.condition]
    · exact idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_fst _ _ _
    · exact idealPullbackSpecIso_inv_snd _ _ _
  exact h1.flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_subschemeCover
statement:
theorem isPullback_subschemeCover :
    IsPullback (I.subschemeCover.f U) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))))
      I.subschemeι U.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  let E0 := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafOpenPullbackIso I U
  have R0 : IsPullback (I.subschemeCover.f U)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
      I.subschemeι U.1.ι := by
    refine IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨?_⟩ E0.symm ?_ ?_
    · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeCover_map_subschemeι]
      rfl
    · rw [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_comp_eq]
      exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_subschemeCover I U).symm
    · rw [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_comp_eq]
      have h := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient I U
      calc pullback.snd I.subschemeι U.1.ι
          = (pullback.snd I.subschemeι U.1.ι ≫ U.2.isoSpec.hom) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv := by simp
        _ = _ := by rw [← h, Category.assoc]; rfl
  have L0 : IsPullback (𝟙 _) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
      U.2.isoSpec.inv :=
    IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso ⟨by simp⟩
  have := L0.paste_horiz R0
  simp only [Category.id_comp] at this
  exact this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_chart_outer

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_exceptional_chart

proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.mk_chartQuotientIso
statement:
theorem mk_chartQuotientIso :

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.exceptionalChartIso_hom_quotient
statement:
theorem exceptionalChartIso_hom_quotient :
    (exceptionalChartIso X I U r).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {equation X I U r}))) =
      pullback.snd (exceptionalι X I) (chartι X I U r)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Spec.map (chartQuotientIso X I U r).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {equation X I U r}))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.ideal U).map (baseRingHom (I.ideal U) r)))) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg Spec.map (mk_chartQuotientIso X I U r)
  have h3 := (isPullback_exceptional_chart X I U r).isoPullback_inv_snd
  simp only [exceptionalChartIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc, h2]
  exact h3

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.exists_mem_range_chartι
statement:
theorem exists_mem_range_chartι (b : blowup X I) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (r : I.ideal U), b ∈ Set.range (chartι X I U r)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b ∈ (⨆ U : X.affineOpens, (affineι X I U).opensRange) := by
    rw [iSup_opensRange_affineι]; trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hb
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hU
  let 𝒰 := generatorAffineOpenCover (I.ideal U)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := 𝒰.covers p
  refine ⟨U, 𝒰.idx p, q, ?_⟩
  change (chartMap (I.ideal U) (𝒰.idx p) ≫ affineι X I U) q = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ExceptionalDivisor.exceptional_isEffectiveCartier
statement:
theorem exceptional_isEffectiveCartier (b : blowup X I) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (r : I.ideal U), b ∈ Set.range (chartι X I U r) ∧
      IsRegular (exceptionalChart X I U r).equation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, r, hb⟩ := exists_mem_range_chartι X I b
  exact ⟨U, r, hb, equation_isRegular X I U r⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreRecovery.ambientRefinementImageChartIso_original
statement:
theorem ambientRefinementImageChartIso_original (i : C.J)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ C.U i) :
    ambientRefinementNativeToFrame Y J C i U h =
      (ambientRefinementImageChartIso Y J C i U h).hom ≫
        ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C i U h
proof:
:= by
  let E := conormalPlusLine Y J
  let D := localFrameCover Y J C
  let q : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f U
  let g : Spec (.of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))) ⟶ J.subscheme := J.subschemeCover.f (C.U i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  letI : IsOpenImmersion g := J.subschemeCover.map_prop (C.U i)
  let W := ambientRefinementImageOpen Y J U
  let hw := ambientRefinementImage_le Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    commonOpenSections_free Y J C i W hw
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (q ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    commonOpenSections_finite Y J C i W hw
  letI : Module.Free Γ(J.subscheme,g ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (g ''ᵁ ⊤))) := D.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(J.subscheme,g ''ᵁ ⊤) (E.val.obj (op (g ''ᵁ ⊤))) := D.sectionModule_finite i
  letI := affineRefinement_sections_free Y J C i U h
  letI := affineRefinement_sections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI : Module.Free (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj E)) := affineRefinement_sections_free Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Finite (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj E)) := affineRefinement_sections_finite Y J C i U h
  letI : Module.Free (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj E)) := conormalPlusLineChartSections_free Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  letI : Module.Finite (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i))
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of (Γ(Y,(C.U i).1) ⧸ J.ideal (C.U i)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).obj E)) := conormalPlusLineChartSections_finite Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)
  let k := GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h
  let comm := InfinityNormalBundleConormalRestriction.centreRefinement_toCentre Y J h
  have hs : Submodule.span Γ(J.subscheme,q ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (Set.range (spectrumImageOpenSectionsRestriction J.subscheme q g k comm E)) = ⊤ := by
    exact D.restriction_spans i W.1 hw
  have hn : spectrumImageNativeGradedRestriction J.subscheme q g k comm E =
      sectionGradedRestriction Y J h := centreNativeGradedRestriction_eq_actual Y J h
  have hsquare := spectrumImageProjRestriction_square J.subscheme q g k comm E hs
  have hm := ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr hn
    (spectrumImageNativeRestriction_irrelevant J.subscheme q g k comm E hs)
  exact (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ Proj.map (spectrumImageCoordinateGradedMap J.subscheme g E)
    (spectrumImageCoordinate_irrelevant J.subscheme g E)) hm).symm.trans hsquare

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreRecovery.ambientRefinementNativeToFrame_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem ambientRefinementNativeToFrame_toComponent (i : C.J)

      affineRefinementSectionToComponent Y J C i U h

statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCentreRecovery.ambientRefinementOriginalRestrictions_toComponent
statement:
theorem ambientRefinementOriginalRestrictions_toComponent (i j : C.J)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hi : U ≤ C.U i) (hj : U ≤ C.U j) :
    ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C i U hi ≫ localFrameToComponent Y J C i =
      ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫ localFrameToComponent Y J C j
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (ambientRefinementImageChartIso Y J C i U hi).hom).mp
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun a => a ≫ localFrameToComponent Y J C i)
      (ambientRefinementImageChartIso_original Y J C i U hi).symm).trans
    ((ambientRefinementNativeToFrame_toComponent Y J C i U hi).trans
    ((affineRefinementSectionToComponent_independent Y J C i j U hi hj).trans
    ((ambientRefinementNativeToFrame_toComponent Y J C j U hj).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun a => a ≫ localFrameToComponent Y J C j)
      (ambientRefinementImageChartIso_original Y J C j U hj)).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun a => a ≫ (ambientRefinementOriginalRestriction Y J C j U hj ≫
        localFrameToComponent Y J C j))
        (ambientRefinementImageChartIso_hom_independent Y J C i j U hi hj).symm)))))))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι_app_injective
statement:
theorem idealModuleι_app_injective (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Injective ((idealModuleι I).app V)
proof:
:= by
  let T := idealComplex I
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E := by
    dsimp only [E]
    infer_instance
  letI : PreservesLimit (cospan T.f T.f) E := by
    exact SheafOfModules.evaluationPreservesLimit (F := cospan T.f T.f) (Opposite.op V)
  have hmono : Mono (E.map T.f) :=
    @preserves_mono_of_preservesLimit _ _ _ _ E _ _ T.f inferInstance
      (idealComplex_mono_f I)
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (E.map T.f)).mp hmono

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealModule_exact
statement:
theorem idealModule_exact (V : X.Opens) :
    Function.Exact ((idealModuleι I).app V) ((structureMap I).app V)
proof:
:= by
  let T := idealComplex I
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op V)
  have hzero : E.PreservesZeroMorphisms := by
    dsimp only [E]
    exact Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
  let TE := @ShortComplex.map _ _ _ _ _ _ T E hzero
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits E := by
    dsimp only [E]
    infer_instance
  letI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair T.g 0) E := by
    exact SheafOfModules.evaluationPreservesLimit (F := parallelPair T.g 0) (Opposite.op V)
  have hE : TE.Exact :=
    @ShortComplex.Exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel _ _ _ _ _ _ T _
      (idealComplex_exact I) E hzero inferInstance (idealComplex_mono_f I) inferInstance
  exact (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact TE).mp hE

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.idealChart_isQuasicoherent
statement: theorem idealChart_isQuasicoherent : (idealChart I U).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let h := U.2.fromSpec
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor h
  let B : PUnit.{u + 1} → (Spec Γ(X, U)).Modules := fun _ => F.obj (unitX X)
  let C : PUnit.{u + 1} → (Spec Γ(X, U)).Modules :=
    fun _ => F.obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (unitX _))
  let u' : ∀ V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens,
      Γ(idealChart I U, V) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] (∀ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, Γ(F.obj (unitX X), V)) :=
    fun V => LinearMap.pi fun _ => Scheme.Modules.appₗ (F.map (idealModuleι I)) V
  let d : ∀ V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens, (∀ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, Γ(F.obj (unitX X), V)) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
      (∀ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, Γ(F.obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (unitX _)), V)) :=
    fun V => LinearMap.pi fun _ =>
      (Scheme.Modules.appₗ (F.map (structureMap I)) V).comp (LinearMap.proj PUnit.unit)
  refine Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_exact_ladder
    (idealChart I U) B C (fun _ => inferInstance) (fun _ => inferInstance)
    u' d ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U V h x i
    exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ (F.map (idealModuleι I)) h x
  · intro U V h s k
    exact Scheme.Modules.appₗ_mapₗ (F.map (structureMap I)) h (s PUnit.unit)
  · intro V x y hxy
    exact idealModuleι_app_injective I _ (congrFun hxy PUnit.unit)
  · intro V y
    have hex := idealModule_exact I (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ V)
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hex (y PUnit.unit)).mp (congrFun hy PUnit.unit)
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      funext i
      exact hx
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      funext i
      exact (hex _).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.fromSpec_image_top
statement: theorem fromSpec_image_top : U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤ = U.1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.chartCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem chartCoeff_eq :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv =
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U)).op
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq]
  refine Iso.inv_ext ?_
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, U.2.fromSpec_app_of_le _ (fromSpec_image_top U).ge]
  have hS : ∀ f : (Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) ⟶ Opposite.op ⊤), f = 𝟙 _ :=
    fun f => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hS, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  convert (X.presheaf.map_id _)
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.specUnitTopLinear_apply

theorem specUnitTopLinear_apply (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (x : Γ(unitX (Spec A), ⊤)) :

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.chartCoeff_eq'
statement:
theorem chartCoeff_eq' :
    (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).hom =
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U).symm).op
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U).symm).op ≫
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U)).op = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    convert X.presheaf.map_id _
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [← Category.id_comp ((U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ _), ← hcomp, Category.assoc,
    ← chartCoeff_eq U]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing_apply
statement:
theorem chartSectionsToRing_apply (s : Γ(idealChart I U, ⊤)) :
    chartSectionsToRing I U s = X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U).symm).op
      ((idealModuleι I).app (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f => f.hom ((idealModuleι I).app (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) s))
    (chartCoeff_eq' U)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.subschemeι_app_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem subschemeι_app_map_eq_zero {V W : X.Opens} (i : Opposite.op V ⟶ Opposite.op W)
    (y : Γ(X, V)) (hy : I.subschemeι.app V y = 0) :
    I.subschemeι.app W (X.presheaf.map i y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.hom y) (I.subschemeι.naturality i)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h
  rw [h, hy, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing_injective
statement: theorem chartSectionsToRing_injective : Function.Injective (chartSectionsToRing I U)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  rw [chartSectionsToRing_apply, chartSectionsToRing_apply] at hst
  apply idealModuleι_app_injective I
  have hinj : Function.Injective (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U).symm).op) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
  exact hinj hst

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.range_chartSectionsToRing
statement:
theorem range_chartSectionsToRing :
    LinearMap.range (chartSectionsToRing I U) = I.ideal U
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [LinearMap.mem_range, ← I.ker_subschemeι_app U, RingHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    rw [chartSectionsToRing_apply]
    apply subschemeι_app_map_eq_zero
    exact (idealModule_exact I _).apply_apply_eq_zero s
  · intro hy
    let t : Γ(X, U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) := X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U)).op y
    have ht : (structureMap I).app _ t = 0 := subschemeι_app_map_eq_zero I _ y hy
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ((idealModule_exact I _) t).mp ht
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    rw [chartSectionsToRing_apply]
    change X.presheaf.map _ ((idealModuleι I).app _ s) = y
    rw [hs]
    simp only [t, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    have hS : (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U)).op ≫ (eqToHom (fromSpec_image_top U).symm).op =
        𝟙 (Opposite.op U.1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hS, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.conormal_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem conormal_hasConstantRank {r : ℕ} (C : QuasiregularCover I r) :

proof:

      (fun j => ULift.{u} (Fin (C.gens j).length)) (fun j => conormalChartIso I (C.U j) (C.gens j)),
    inferInstance, inferInstance, fun j => ?_⟩
  change Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.gens j).length)) = r
  rw [Nat.card_ulift, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin, C.length_eq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_regular
statement:
theorem conormal_hasConstantRank_of_regular {r : ℕ} (J : Type u) (U : J → X.affineOpens)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.openComponentMate
statement:
theorem openComponentMate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (v : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion v]
    {M : X.Modules} {N : Y.Modules} (c : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).obj N) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v).homEquiv _ _).symm c =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map c ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).counit.app N
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v) (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v) N
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).obj N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v).counit.app N =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).counit.app N at hc
  have hc' : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v).counit.app N =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).inv.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).obj N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).counit.app N := by
    rw [← hc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, hc']
  rw [← (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).inv.naturality_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.compositeComponentMate
statement:
theorem compositeComponentMate {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (v : Z ⟶ X)
    {M : Y.Modules} {N : Z.Modules}
    (c : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (v ≫ q)).obj N) :
    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (c ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp v q).inv.app N)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp v q).hom.app M ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (v ≫ q)).homEquiv _ _).symm c
proof:
:= by
  have h := CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (v ≫ q))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp v q).hom c
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.equalityComponentMate
statement:
theorem equalityComponentMate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g)
    {M : Y.Modules} {N : X.Modules} (c : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj N) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (c ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h.symm).hom.app N) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.app M ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm c
proof:
:= by
  have hm := CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom c
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom_symm] at hm
  exact hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.pushedUnitComponentMate
statement:
theorem pushedUnitComponentMate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    {M : Y.Modules} (c : M ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) :
    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction V.ι)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (c ≫ SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp V.ι q).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h).symm).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (q.resLE U V h) U.ι).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (q.resLE U V h)).map
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U.ι).homEquiv _ _).symm c) ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (q.resLE U V h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let r := q.resLE U V h
  let N := SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme
  let P := SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme
  let c' : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj N := c
  let a : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj N ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (r ≫ U.ι)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj N) :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit U.ι r N
  let b : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (r ≫ U.ι)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj N) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (r ≫ U.ι)).obj P :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (r ≫ U.ι)).map (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom
  let t : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (r ≫ U.ι)).obj P ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (V.ι ≫ q)).obj P :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h)).hom.app P
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (V.ι ≫ q)).obj P ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj P) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι q).inv.app P
  have h₀ : c ≫ SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h =
      (((c' ≫ a) ≫ b) ≫ t) ≫ e := by
    change c' ≫ (a ≫ b ≫ t ≫ e) = _
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have h₁ := compositeComponentMate q V.ι (((c' ≫ a) ≫ b) ≫ t)
  have h₂ := equalityComponentMate (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h).symm ((c' ≫ a) ≫ b)
  have h₃ := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (r ≫ U.ι)).homEquiv_naturality_right_symm
    (c' ≫ a) (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom
  have h₄ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit_mate U.ι r c'
  let p := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp V.ι q).hom.app M
  let z := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h).symm).hom.app M
  calc
    _ = ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction V.ι)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((((c' ≫ a) ≫ b) ≫ t) ≫ e)) := congrArg
          ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction V.ι)).homEquiv _ _).symm) h₀
    _ = p ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (V.ι ≫ q)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (((c' ≫ a) ≫ b) ≫ t) := h₁
    _ = p ≫ (z ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (r ≫ U.ι)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((c' ≫ a) ≫ b)) := congrArg (fun w ↦ p ≫ w) h₂
    _ = p ≫ (z ≫ (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (r ≫ U.ι)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (c' ≫ a) ≫ (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom)) :=
      congrArg (fun w ↦ p ≫ (z ≫ w)) h₃
    _ = p ≫ (z ≫ (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r U.ι).inv.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U.ι).homEquiv _ _).symm c')) ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom)) :=
      congrArg (fun w ↦ p ≫ (z ≫ (w ≫ (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom))) h₄
    _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]; rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.functorComponentRecovery
statement:
theorem functorComponentRecovery {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟]
    (F : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞) {K S Q : 𝒞} {T C P : 𝒟}
    (k : K ⟶ F.obj T) (r : T ⟶ C) (p : C ⟶ P)
    (a : K ⟶ S) (b : S ⟶ F.obj C) (c : S ⟶ Q) (v : Q ⟶ F.obj P)
    (h₁ : k ≫ F.map r = a ≫ b) (h₂ : b ≫ F.map p = c ≫ v) :
    k ≫ F.map (r ≫ p) = (a ≫ c) ≫ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, h₁, Category.assoc, h₂, ← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.iteratedComponentMate
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  change (a₂.homEquiv _ _).symm ((a₁.homEquiv _ _).symm (c ≫ F₁.map r)) = _
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.openCompositeComponentMate
statement:
theorem openCompositeComponentMate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (v : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion v]
    {M N : X.Modules} {P : Y.Modules}
    (c : M ⟶ N) (r : N ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward v).obj P) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v).homEquiv _ _).symm (c ≫ r) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map c ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).map r ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).counit.app P
proof:
:= by
  rw [openComponentMate, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.fiveIsoRouteMate
statement:
theorem fiveIsoRouteMate {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟]
    (F : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) {X₀ X₁ X₂ Z : 𝒟} {M N : 𝒞}
    (p : X₀ ≅ X₁) (q : X₁ ≅ X₂) (r : X₂ ≅ F.obj M)
    (e : M ≅ N) (t : F.obj N ≅ Z) (c : M ⟶ N) (hc : c = e.hom) :
    (p ≪≫ q ≪≫ r ≪≫ F.mapIso e ≪≫ t).hom =
      p.hom ≫ q.hom ≫ r.hom ≫ F.map c ≫ t.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.chartComparison_from_unit
statement:
theorem chartComparison_from_unit {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟]
    {F G : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟} (e : F ≅ G) {M N : 𝒞} {Q : 𝒟}
    (m : M ⟶ N) (p : F.obj N ⟶ Q) [Mono p]
    (s : G.obj N ⟶ Q) (u : G.obj M ⟶ Q) (a : F.obj M ⟶ F.obj N)
    (hs : s = e.inv.app N ≫ p) (hu : G.map m ≫ s = u)
    (ha : a ≫ p = e.hom.app M ≫ u) : F.map m = a
proof:
:= by
  have hp : e.hom.app N ≫ s = p := by
    rw [hs, ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.id_comp]
  apply (cancel_mono p).1
  calc
    F.map m ≫ p = F.map m ≫ (e.hom.app N ≫ s) := congrArg (fun w ↦ F.map m ≫ w) hp.symm
    _ = e.hom.app M ≫ (G.map m ≫ s) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, e.hom.naturality, Category.assoc]
    _ = e.hom.app M ≫ u := congrArg (fun w ↦ e.hom.app M ≫ w) hu
    _ = a ≫ p := ha.symm

statement:
theorem nativeProjKernelChartUnitIso_mate (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (nativeProjKernelChartUnitIso 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d i).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f i)).ι (Proj.map g hg)).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (nativeBasicOpenMap_toProj 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i).symm).hom.app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫

        (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).inv.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (nativeBasicOpenMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i)).map
        (nativeComponentMate 𝒜 f d i) ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (nativeBasicOpenMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hS : nativeComponentMate 𝒜 f d i =
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)).symm ≪≫
        (Native.degreeOneSheafLinearOpenIso 𝒜 f d i).symm).hom :=
    nativeComponentMate_projection 𝒜 f d i
  exact fiveIsoRouteMate (Scheme.Modules.pullback (nativeBasicOpenMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i))

      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f i)).ι (Proj.map g hg)).app
        (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d))

      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d))
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (nativeBasicOpenMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg f i)
      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)).symm)
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)).ι).app
      (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d)).symm ≪≫
      (Native.degreeOneSheafLinearOpenIso 𝒜 f d i).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeRecovery.nativeKernelPullbackHom_unitRecovery
statement:
theorem nativeKernelPullbackHom_unitRecovery (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f i)).ι).map
        (nativeKernelPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) ≫
      nativeComponentMate ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d i =
    (nativeProjKernelChartUnitIso 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d i).hom
proof:
:= by
  let U := Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)
  let V := Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f i)
  let c := kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft 𝒜 f - Native.generatorDescentRight 𝒜 f d) ≫
    Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj 𝒜)
      (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f j))) i
  let r := kernel.ι (Native.generatorDescentLeft ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) -
    Native.generatorDescentRight ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f) d) ≫
    Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (Proj ℬ)
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 ℬ g f j))) i
  let a := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Proj.map g hg)
  let b := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction V.ι
  have h := congrArg (((a.comp b).homEquiv _ _).symm)
    (nativeKernelToPushforward_component 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d i)
  have hL := iteratedComponentMate a b (nativeKernelToPushforward 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d) r
  have hR := pushedUnitComponentMate (Proj.map g hg) U V le_rfl c
  exact hL.symm.trans (h.trans
    (hR.trans (nativeProjKernelChartUnitIso_mate 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d i).symm))

statement:
theorem nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp_of_eq (k : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞)
    (hk : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k)
    (hk' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map (g'.comp g))
    (e : g'.comp g = k)
    (hP1 : Proj.map k hk = Proj.map (g'.comp g) hk')
    {ι : Type u} (f : ι → 𝒜 1) (d : ℤ)
    (h : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 (f i)))
    (h' : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj ℬ)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ℬ 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen ℬ i)) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒞 k hk f d h =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hP1).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (projMap_comp_eq 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk').symm).hom.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Proj.map g' hg') (Proj.map g hg)).inv.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Proj.map g' hg')).map
          (nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 ℬ g hg f d h) ≫
        nativeAllTargetPullbackHom ℬ 𝒞 g' hg' (fun x : ℬ 1 ↦ x) d h'
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  have hc : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hP1).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 f d) = 𝟙 _ := by
    simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]
  rw [hc, Category.id_comp]
  exact nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_comp 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 g g' hg hg' hk' f d h h'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_id
statement:
theorem nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_id
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜))
    (e : Proj.map (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg = 𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)) (d : ℤ)
    (h : (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Proj 𝒜)).CoversTop
      (fun i : 𝒜 1 ↦ Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 i)) :
    nativeAllTargetPullbackHom 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d h =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr e).hom.app (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId (Proj 𝒜)).hom.app
          (Native.degreeOneSheaf 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nativeAllTargetPullbackHom
  rw [nativeKernelPullbackHom_id 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) hg e d]
  have hsel : NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)
      (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)) d =
      𝟙 _ := by
    change NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) (fun i : 𝒜 1 ↦ i) d = 𝟙 _
    exact nativeKernelSelection_id 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d
  have hinv : (@asIso _ _ _ _
      (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d h)).inv =
      𝟙 _ := by
    have h1 := (@asIso _ _ _ _
      (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d h)).hom_inv_id
    have h2 : (@asIso _ _ _ _
      (NativeFamily.kernelSelection 𝒜 (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)
        (imageDegreeOneFamily 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x)) d)
      (allDegreeOneToImage_isIso 𝒜 𝒜 (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) hg (fun x : 𝒜 1 ↦ x) d h)).hom =
      𝟙 _ := hsel
    rw [h2] at h1
    erw [Category.id_comp] at h1
    exact h1
  rw [hinv]
  exact Category.comp_id _
