name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.polynomialProj_congr
statement:
theorem polynomialProj_congr (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* D) (K : Ideal D) (k : J.map g = K) :
    Proj.map (totalRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
        (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])) =
      Proj.map ((totalRestrictionOfEq J g K k).comp (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
          (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq J g K k))
proof:
:=
  (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (totalRestrictionOfEq_comp I f J h g K k).symm _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.polynomialNativeRestrictionHom_id
statement:
theorem polynomialNativeRestrictionHom_id (I : Ideal A) (d : ℤ) :
    polynomialNativeRestrictionHom I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) d =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (completionRestrictionOfEq_id I)).hom.app
          (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId (InfinityNormalConeProj.projectiveNormalCompletion I)).hom.app
          (projectiveNormalNativeDescentSheaf I d)
proof:
:=
  nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_id_of_eq (totalGrade I)
    (totalRestrictionOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I))
    (irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I))
    (totalRestrictionOfEq_id I) (completionRestrictionOfEq_id I) d (polynomialNative_covers I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.grRestrictionOfEq_congr'
statement:
theorem grRestrictionOfEq_congr' (I : Ideal A) {f f' : A →+* B} (e : f = f') (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    grRestrictionOfEq I f J h = grRestrictionOfEq I f' J (e ▸ h)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.exceptionalGr_id_eq
statement:
theorem exceptionalGr_id_eq (I : Ideal A) :
    grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (RingHom.id A)) (centreIdeal I)
      (centreMapEquality I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I)) =
    GradedRingHom.id (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := grRestrictionOfEq_id (centreIdeal I)
  refine (grRestrictionOfEq_congr' (centreIdeal I)
    (Polynomial.mapRingHom_id (R := A)) _ _).trans h1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.exceptionalScheme_id_eq
statement:
theorem exceptionalScheme_id_eq (I : Ideal A) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (RingHom.id A)) (centreIdeal I)
      (centreMapEquality I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I)) =
    𝟙 (ReesBlowup.grScheme (centreIdeal I))
proof:
:=
  proj_map_id_of_graded_id _ _ _ (exceptionalGr_id_eq I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.exceptionalGr_comp_eq
statement:
theorem exceptionalGr_comp_eq (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* D) (K : Ideal D) (k : J.map g = K) :
    (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k)).comp
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h)) =
    grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (g.comp f)) (centreIdeal K)
      (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := grRestrictionOfEq_comp (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
    (centreMapEquality I f J h) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
    (centreMapEquality J g K k)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  exact grRestrictionOfEq_congr' (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom_comp g f) _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.exceptionalScheme_comp_eq
statement:
theorem exceptionalScheme_comp_eq (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* D) (K : Ideal D) (k : J.map g = K) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k) ≫
      grSchemeRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h) =
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (g.comp f)) (centreIdeal K)
      (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
proof:
:=
  proj_map_comp_of_graded_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (exceptionalGr_comp_eq I f J h g K k)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.exceptionalProj_congr
statement:
theorem exceptionalProj_congr (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* D) (K : Ideal D) (k : J.map g = K) :
    Proj.map (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (g.comp f)) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])))
      (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq _ _ _ _) =
    Proj.map ((grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal J) (Polynomial.mapRingHom g) (centreIdeal K)
        (centreMapEquality J g K k)).comp
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h)))
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq _ _ _ _)
        (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq _ _ _ _))
proof:
:=
  ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr (exceptionalGr_comp_eq I f J h g K k).symm _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeCentreCocycleC6.exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom_id
statement:
theorem exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom_id (I : Ideal A) (d : ℤ) :
    exceptionalNativeRestrictionHom I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) d =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (exceptionalScheme_id_eq I)).hom.app
          (exceptionalNativeDescentSheaf I d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId (ReesBlowup.grScheme (centreIdeal I))).hom.app
          (exceptionalNativeDescentSheaf I d)
proof:
:=
  nativeAllTargetPullbackHom_id_of_eq (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
    (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom (RingHom.id A)) (centreIdeal I)
      (centreMapEquality I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I)))
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq _ _ _ _)
    (exceptionalGr_id_eq I) (exceptionalScheme_id_eq I) d (exceptionalNative_covers I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.NormalCone.ARRM4.isIso_pullback_map_of_range_subset
proof:
:= by
  haveI h1 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map f) :=
    (SchemeKTheory.over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso W f).1 hW
  haveI h2 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map f) :=
    (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso W.ι f).1 h1
  have hr : Set.range s ⊆ Set.range W.ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact hs
  obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ : ∃ s' : Z ⟶ W.toScheme, s' ≫ W.ι = s :=
    ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift W.ι s hr, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac W.ι s hr⟩
  subst hs'
  haveI h3 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback s').map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map f)) :=
    inferInstance
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s' W.ι).hom.naturality f
  have h4 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s' W.ι).hom.app F ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (s' ≫ W.ι)).map f) := by
    rw [← hn]
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s' W.ι).hom.app G) :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s' W.ι).app G).isIso_hom
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h3 inferInstance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s' W.ι).hom.app F) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.mem_coefficientIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_coefficientIdeal (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (p : A[X]) :
    p ∈ coefficientIdeal I n ↔ ∀ k, p.coeff k ∈ I ^ (n - k)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.coefficientIdeal_mul_le
statement:
theorem coefficientIdeal_mul_le (I : Ideal A) (n m : ℕ) :
    coefficientIdeal I n * coefficientIdeal I m ≤ coefficientIdeal I (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.mul_le.mpr
  intro p hp q hq k
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul]
  apply Ideal.sum_mem
  intro ij hij
  have he := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
  have hle : n + m - k ≤ (n - ij.1) + (m - ij.2) := by omega
  apply Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hle
  rw [pow_add]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hp ij.1) (hq ij.2)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.centreIdeal_le_coefficientIdeal
statement:
theorem centreIdeal_le_coefficientIdeal (I : Ideal A) :
    centreIdeal I ≤ coefficientIdeal I 1
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    simpa using (InfinityNormalCone.mem_centreIdeal_iff_coeff_zero I p).mp hp
  · have hsub : 1 - k = 0 := by omega
    simp [hsub]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.centreIdeal_pow_le_coefficientIdeal
statement:
theorem centreIdeal_pow_le_coefficientIdeal (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    centreIdeal I ^ n ≤ coefficientIdeal I n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro p hp k; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact (Ideal.mul_mono ih (centreIdeal_le_coefficientIdeal I)).trans
      (coefficientIdeal_mul_le I n 1)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.coefficientIdeal_le_centreIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem coefficientIdeal_le_centreIdeal_pow (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientIdeal I n ≤ centreIdeal I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [Polynomial.as_sum_support p]
  apply Ideal.sum_mem
  intro k hk
  have hm := InfinityNormalCone.monomial_mem_centreIdeal_pow I (n-k) k (p.coeff k) (hp k)
  exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : n ≤ n-k+k) hm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.centreIdeal_pow_eq_coefficientIdeal
statement:
theorem centreIdeal_pow_eq_coefficientIdeal (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    centreIdeal I ^ n = coefficientIdeal I n
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (centreIdeal_pow_le_coefficientIdeal I n)
    (coefficientIdeal_le_centreIdeal_pow I n)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (p : A[X]) :
    p ∈ centreIdeal I ^ n ↔ ∀ k, p.coeff k ∈ I ^ (n-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centreIdeal_pow_eq_coefficientIdeal]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.mem_centreRees_iff
statement:
theorem mem_centreRees_iff (I : Ideal A) (p : Polynomial A[X]) :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I) ↔
      ∀ n k, (p.coeff n).coeff k ∈ I ^ (n-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reesAlgebra_iff]
  simp only [mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.mem_centreGrIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_centreGrIdeal_iff (I : Ideal A) (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    p ∈ ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I) ↔
      ∀ n k, ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n).coeff k ∈ I ^ (n+1-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff]
  simp only [mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.centreGrMk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem centreGrMk_eq_zero_iff (I : Ideal A) (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) p = 0 ↔
      ∀ n k, ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n).coeff k ∈ I ^ (n+1-k)
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_centreGrIdeal_iff]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.centreGrMk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem centreGrMk_eq_iff (I : Ideal A) (p q : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) p = ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) q ↔
      ∀ n k, ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n).coeff k -
        ((q : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n).coeff k ∈ I ^ (n+1-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, centreGrMk_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_sub, Polynomial.coeff_sub]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.coefficientIdeal_map
statement:
theorem coefficientIdeal_map {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (I : Ideal A)
    (f : A →+* B) (n : ℕ) :
    (coefficientIdeal I n).map (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) =
      coefficientIdeal (I.map f) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← centreIdeal_pow_eq_coefficientIdeal, ← centreIdeal_pow_eq_coefficientIdeal,
    Ideal.map_pow, map_centreIdeal_mapRingHom]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.monomial_mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ) (a : A) :
    Polynomial.monomial k a ∈ centreIdeal I ^ n ↔ a ∈ I ^ (n-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_centreIdeal_pow_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using h k
  · intro h j
    by_cases hj : k = j
    · subst j
      simpa using h
    · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hj]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalReesExtract_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalReesExtract_coe (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ)
    (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    (diagonalReesExtract I n k p : A[X]) =
      Polynomial.monomial n (((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff (n+k)).coeff k)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalReesExtract_ideal
statement:
theorem diagonalReesExtract_ideal (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ)
    (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (hp : p ∈ ReesBlowup.grIdeal (centreIdeal I)) :
    diagonalReesExtract I n k p ∈ ReesBlowup.grIdeal I
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff]
  intro m
  rw [diagonalReesExtract_coe]
  by_cases hm : n = m
  · subst m
    have h := (mem_centreGrIdeal_iff I p).mp hp (n+k) k
    have he : n+k+1-k = n+1 := by omega
    simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_monomial_same, he] using h
  · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalGrExtract_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalGrExtract_mk (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ)
    (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    diagonalGrExtract I n k (ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) p) =
      ReesBlowup.grMk I (diagonalReesExtract I n k p)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.eq_zero_of_diagonalGrExtract_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_diagonalGrExtract_eq_zero (I : Ideal A)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I))
    (h : ∀ n k, diagonalGrExtract I n k x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_centreGrIdeal_iff]
  intro m k
  by_cases hk : k ≤ m
  · have he : m-k+k = m := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
    have hz := h (m-k) k
    change diagonalGrExtract I (m-k) k (ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) p) = 0 at hz
    rw [diagonalGrExtract_mk] at hz
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (diagonalReesExtract I (m-k) k p) = 0 at hz
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, AffineNormalCone.mem_reesIdeal_iff] at hz
    have hc := hz (m-k)
    rw [diagonalReesExtract_coe, Polynomial.coeff_monomial_same, he] at hc
    have hp : m-k+1 = m+1-k := by omega
    simpa only [hp] using hc
  · have he : m+1-k = 0 := by omega
    simp [he]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalGrExtract_jointly_injective
statement:
theorem diagonalGrExtract_jointly_injective (I : Ideal A)
    (x y : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I))
    (h : ∀ n k, diagonalGrExtract I n k x = diagonalGrExtract I n k y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_diagonalGrExtract_eq_zero I
  intro n k
  rw [map_sub, h n k, sub_self]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.shiftRees_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftRees_coe (I : Ideal A) (k : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    (shiftRees I k p : Polynomial A[X]) =
      Polynomial.map Polynomial.C (p : A[X]) * Polynomial.monomial k (Polynomial.X ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftRees, InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_coe,
    ReesBlowup.generator, uGen, Polynomial.monomial_pow]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.polynomialGrComparison_monomial_mk
statement:
theorem polynomialGrComparison_monomial_mk (I : Ideal A) (k : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I
      (Polynomial.monomial k (ReesBlowup.grMk I p)) =
      ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) (shiftRees I k p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison_monomial]
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap _ _ _ _ p) *
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (ReesBlowup.generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I))) ^ k = _
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _ * (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _) ^ k =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (shiftRees I k p)
  simp only [shiftRees, map_mul, map_pow]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalReesExtract_shift
statement:
theorem diagonalReesExtract_shift (I : Ideal A) (n l k : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    diagonalReesExtract I n l (shiftRees I k p) =
      if l = k then AffineNormalCone.reesProj A I n p else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [diagonalReesExtract_coe, shiftRees_coe]
  have hc :
      ((Polynomial.map Polynomial.C (p : A[X]) *
        Polynomial.monomial k (Polynomial.X ^ k)).coeff (n+l)).coeff l =
      if l = k then (p : A[X]).coeff n else 0 := by
    rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (Polynomial.C _),
      mul_assoc, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow']
    by_cases h : k ≤ n+l
    · rw [if_pos h, Polynomial.coeff_map]
      rw [mul_comm, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      by_cases hl : l = k
      · subst l
        simp
      · simp [hl, Ne.symm hl]
    · rw [if_neg h]
      have hl : l ≠ k := by omega
      simp [hl]
  rw [hc]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst l
    rfl
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalGrExtract_comparison_monomial
statement:
theorem diagonalGrExtract_comparison_monomial (I : Ideal A) (n l k : ℕ)
    (a : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) :
    diagonalGrExtract I n l (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I (Polynomial.monomial k a)) =
      if l = k then AffineNormalCone.grProj A I n a else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  change diagonalGrExtract I n l (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I
    (Polynomial.monomial k (ReesBlowup.grMk I p))) = _
  rw [polynomialGrComparison_monomial_mk, diagonalGrExtract_mk, diagonalReesExtract_shift]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact map_zero _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.diagonalGrExtract_comparison
statement:
theorem diagonalGrExtract_comparison (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ)
    (p : Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) :
    diagonalGrExtract I n k (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I p) =
      AffineNormalCone.grProj A I n (p.coeff k)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [(InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I).map_add,
        (diagonalGrExtract I n k).map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add,
        (AffineNormalCone.grProj A I n).map_add, hp, hq]
  | monomial l a =>
      rw [diagonalGrExtract_comparison_monomial]
      by_cases h : k = l
      · subst l; simp
      · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, h, Ne.symm h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.polynomialGrComparison_injective
statement:
theorem polynomialGrComparison_injective (I : Ideal A) :
    Function.Injective (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro k
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply AffineNormalCone.eq_zero_of_forall_grProj_eq_zero A I
  intro n
  rw [map_sub]
  have hd := congrArg (diagonalGrExtract I n k) h
  rw [diagonalGrExtract_comparison, diagonalGrExtract_comparison] at hd
  rw [hd, sub_self]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.doubleMonomial_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleMonomial_coe (I : Ideal A) (m k : ℕ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ I ^ (m-k)) :
    (doubleMonomial I m k a ha : Polynomial A[X]) =
      Polynomial.monomial m (Polynomial.monomial k a)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.doubleMonomial_mk_mem_range
statement:
theorem doubleMonomial_mk_mem_range (I : Ideal A) (m k : ℕ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ I ^ (m-k)) :
    ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) (doubleMonomial I m k a ha) ∈
      (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I).range
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ m
  · let p : reesAlgebra I := ⟨Polynomial.monomial (m-k) a,
      reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr ha⟩
    refine ⟨Polynomial.monomial k (ReesBlowup.grMk I p), ?_⟩
    rw [polynomialGrComparison_monomial_mk]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [shiftRees_coe, doubleMonomial_coe]
    change Polynomial.map Polynomial.C (Polynomial.monomial (m-k) a) * _ = _
    rw [Polynomial.map_monomial, Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hk, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  · have hz : ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) (doubleMonomial I m k a ha) = 0 := by
      rw [centreGrMk_eq_zero_iff]
      intro n l
      rw [doubleMonomial_coe]
      by_cases hn : m = n
      · subst n
        by_cases hl : k = l
        · subst l
          have he : m+1-k = 0 := by omega
          simp [he]
        · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hl]
      · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hn]
    rw [hz]
    exact (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I).range.zero_mem

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.rees_double_decomposition
statement:
theorem rees_double_decomposition (I : Ideal A) (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) :
    p = ∑ m ∈ (p : Polynomial A[X]).support,
      ∑ k ∈ ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff m).support,
        doubleMonomial I m k (((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff m).coeff k)
          ((mem_centreRees_iff I _).mp p.property m k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (p : Polynomial A[X]) = (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)).val _
  rw [map_sum]
  conv_lhs => rw [Polynomial.as_sum_support (p : Polynomial A[X])]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  rw [map_sum]
  change Polynomial.monomial m ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff m) =
    ∑ k ∈ ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff m).support,
      Polynomial.monomial m (Polynomial.monomial k (((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff m).coeff k))
  rw [← map_sum (Polynomial.monomial m)]
  congr 1
  exact Polynomial.as_sum_support ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff m)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.polynomialGrComparison_surjective
statement:
theorem polynomialGrComparison_surjective (I : Ideal A) :
    Function.Surjective (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  change ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) p ∈
    (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I).range
  rw [rees_double_decomposition I p, map_sum]
  apply Subring.sum_mem
  intro m hm
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Subring.sum_mem
  intro k hk
  exact doubleMonomial_mk_mem_range I m k _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.polynomialGrComparison_bijective
statement:
theorem polynomialGrComparison_bijective (I : Ideal A) :
    Function.Bijective (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨polynomialGrComparison_injective I, polynomialGrComparison_surjective I⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_restriction
statement:
theorem polynomialGrEquiv_restriction {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (p : Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)) :
    InfinityNormalCone.centreRestriction I f (polynomialGrEquiv I p) =
      polynomialGrEquiv (I.map f) (Polynomial.map (InfinityNormalCone.coefficientRestriction I f) p)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison_restriction I f) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_symm_restriction
statement:
theorem polynomialGrEquiv_symm_restriction {B : Type u} [CommRing B]

    (polynomialGrEquiv (I.map f)).symm (InfinityNormalCone.centreRestriction I f x) =
      Polynomial.map (InfinityNormalCone.coefficientRestriction I f) ((polynomialGrEquiv I).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (polynomialGrEquiv (I.map f)).injective
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← polynomialGrEquiv_restriction,
    RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.restrictionUnitTop
statement:
theorem restrictionUnitTop {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (a : Γ(Y,U)ˣ) (b : Γ(X,q ⁻¹ᵁ U)ˣ)
    (h : q.app U a.val = b.val) :
    Units.map (q.resLE U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) =
    Units.map (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b
proof:
:= by
  have hr : U.topIso.inv ≫ (q.resLE U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl).appTop =
      q.app U ≫ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appTop, Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top]
    rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  apply Units.ext
  have hx := RingHom.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hr) a.val
  simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, Units.coe_map,
    RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, h] using hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.sectionCast_heq
statement:
theorem sectionCast_heq {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (e : U = V)
    (b : Γ(X,V)) : HEq (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom e).op b) b
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  simpa only [eqToHom_refl, op_id, Functor.map_id_apply] using (HEq.rfl : HEq b b)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.restrictionUnitTopEq
statement:
theorem restrictionUnitTopEq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (V : X.Opens) (e : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (a : Γ(Y,U)ˣ) (b : Γ(X,V)ˣ)
    (h : HEq (q.app U a.val) b.val) :
    Units.map (q.resLE U V e.ge).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) =
    Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  exact restrictionUnitTop q U a b (eq_of_heq h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.componentSquares_comp
statement:
theorem componentSquares_comp {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟]
    (F : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞) {P Q : 𝒞} {R S : 𝒟}
    (r : P ⟶ Q) (t : Q ⟶ Q) (s : R ⟶ S) (v : S ⟶ S)
    (a : P ⟶ F.obj R) (b : Q ⟶ F.obj S)
    (hr : r ≫ b = a ≫ F.map s) (ht : t ≫ b = b ≫ F.map v) :
    (r ≫ t) ≫ b = a ≫ F.map (s ≫ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, ht, ← Category.assoc, hr, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.adjointComponentRecovery
statement:
theorem adjointComponentRecovery {𝒞 𝒟 : Type u} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟]
    {L : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟} {F : 𝒟 ⥤ 𝒞} (adj : L ⊣ F)
    {K S Q : 𝒞} {T C P : 𝒟}
    (k : K ⟶ F.obj T) (r : T ⟶ C) (p : C ⟶ P)
    (a : K ⟶ S) (b : S ⟶ F.obj C) (c : S ⟶ Q) (v : Q ⟶ F.obj P)
    (h₁ : k ≫ F.map r = a ≫ b) (h₂ : b ≫ F.map p = c ≫ v) :
    (adj.homEquiv K T).symm k ≫ (r ≫ p) =
      L.map (a ≫ c) ≫ (adj.homEquiv Q P).symm v
proof:
:= by
  apply (adj.homEquiv K P).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, h₁, Category.assoc, h₂, ← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeTransition_app
statement:
theorem nativeTransition_app (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    (Proj.map g hg).app (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y)
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit 𝒜 d x y).val =
    (nativeImageOverlapUnit 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y).val
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Units.val (nativeTransitionSection_map 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y d)
  have happ : (Proj.map g hg).appLE (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (x.val*y.val))
      (Proj.basicOpen ℬ (g (x.val*y.val))) (by rfl) =
      (Proj.map g hg).app (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y) :=
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (Proj.map g hg)
  rw [happ] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeOverlapMap_transitionUnit
statement:
theorem nativeOverlapMap_transitionUnit (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    Units.map (nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit 𝒜 d x y)) =
    Units.map ((Proj.map g hg) ⁻¹ᵁ Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (nativeImageOverlapUnit 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y)
proof:
:=
  restrictionUnitTop (Proj.map g hg) _ _ _ (nativeTransition_app 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeOverlapMap_transition_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem nativeOverlapMap_transition_naturality (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)).map
      (Native.generatorOverlapTransitionIso 𝒜 d x y).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)).hom =
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)).hom ≫
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
        (Units.map ((Proj.map g hg) ⁻¹ᵁ Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
          (nativeImageOverlapUnit 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y))).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwist_unitMul_naturality
    (nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)
    (Units.map (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit 𝒜 d x y))
  rw [nativeOverlapMap_transitionUnit 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeImageOverlap_eq_inf
statement:
theorem nativeImageOverlap_eq_inf (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    (Proj.map g hg) ⁻¹ᵁ Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y =
      Native.generatorOpen ℬ ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⊓
      Native.generatorOpen ℬ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.basicOpen ℬ (g (x.val*y.val)) = _
  rw [map_mul]
  exact Proj.basicOpen_mul ℬ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeGeneratorMap_toProj
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem nativeGeneratorMap_toProj (x : 𝒜 1) :
    nativeGeneratorMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x ≫ (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 x).ι =
      (Native.generatorOpen ℬ ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩).ι ≫ Proj.map g hg
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeOverlapMap_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem nativeOverlapMap_left (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y ≫
      (Proj 𝒜).homOfLE ((Native.generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 x y).le.trans inf_le_left) =
    nativeImageOverlapToLeft 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y ≫ nativeGeneratorMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 x).ι).1
  rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι, Category.assoc, nativeGeneratorMap_toProj,
    ← Category.assoc]
  exact (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _).trans
    (congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ Proj.map g hg)
      (Scheme.homOfLE_ι (Proj ℬ)
        ((nativeImageOverlap_eq_inf 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y).le.trans inf_le_left)).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeOverlapMap_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem nativeOverlapMap_right (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    nativeOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y ≫
      (Proj 𝒜).homOfLE ((Native.generatorOverlapOpen_eq_inf 𝒜 x y).le.trans inf_le_right) =
    nativeImageOverlapToRight 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y ≫ nativeGeneratorMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg y
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (Native.generatorOpen 𝒜 y).ι).1
  rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι, Category.assoc, nativeGeneratorMap_toProj,
    ← Category.assoc]
  exact (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _).trans
    (congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ Proj.map g hg)
      (Scheme.homOfLE_ι (Proj ℬ)
        ((nativeImageOverlap_eq_inf 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y).le.trans inf_le_right)).symm)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeOverlap_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem nativeOverlap_preimage_eq (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    (Proj.map g hg) ⁻¹ᵁ Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y =
      Native.generatorOverlapOpen ℬ
        ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩

:=
  congrArg (Proj.basicOpen ℬ) (map_mul g x.val y.val)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeImageOverlapUnit_heq
statement:
theorem nativeImageOverlapUnit_heq (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    HEq (nativeImageOverlapUnit 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y).val
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit ℬ d
        ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩).val
proof:
:=
  sectionCast_heq (congrArg (Proj.basicOpen ℬ) (map_mul g x.val y.val)) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeTransition_app_heq
statement:
theorem nativeTransition_app_heq (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    HEq ((Proj.map g hg).app (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y)
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit 𝒜 d x y).val)
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit ℬ d
        ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩).val
proof:
:=
  (heq_of_eq (nativeTransition_app 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y)).trans
    (nativeImageOverlapUnit_heq 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeCanonicalOverlapMap_transitionUnit
statement:
theorem nativeCanonicalOverlapMap_transitionUnit (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    Units.map (nativeCanonicalOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit 𝒜 d x y)) =
    Units.map (Native.generatorOverlapOpen ℬ
      ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (Native.generatorTwistTransitionSectionUnit ℬ d
        ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩)
proof:
:=
  restrictionUnitTopEq (Proj.map g hg) _ _
    (nativeOverlap_preimage_eq 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y) _ _
    (nativeTransition_app_heq 𝒜 ℬ g hg d x y)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleTwistNativeOverlap.nativeCanonicalOverlapMap_transition_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem nativeCanonicalOverlapMap_transition_naturality (d : ℤ) (x y : 𝒜 1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (nativeCanonicalOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)).map
      (Native.generatorOverlapTransitionIso 𝒜 d x y).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (nativeCanonicalOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)).hom =
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (nativeCanonicalOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)).hom ≫
      (Native.generatorOverlapTransitionIso ℬ d
        ⟨g x.val,g.map_mem x.property⟩ ⟨g y.val,g.map_mem y.property⟩).hom

    (nativeCanonicalOverlapMap 𝒜 ℬ g hg x y)
    (Units.map (Native.generatorOverlapOpen 𝒜 x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom

theorem isPushout_polynomialMap :

      (CommRingCat.ofHom f) (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom f))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : B →+* B[X]))
proof:
:= by
  letI := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra A[X] B[X] := Polynomial.algebra A B
  have h := CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout A A[X] B B[X]
  simpa only [Polynomial.algebraMap_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
    Polynomial.algebraMap_eq] using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPushout_laurentMap
statement:
theorem isPushout_laurentMap :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (LaurentPolynomial.C : A →+* A[T;T⁻¹]))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f) (CommRingCat.ofHom (mapLaurent f))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (LaurentPolynomial.C : B →+* B[T;T⁻¹]))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalization ((Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : A[X])).map
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)) B[T;T⁻¹] := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X]
    infer_instance
  have he : (mapLaurent f).comp (algebraMap A[X] A[T;T⁻¹]) =
      (algebraMap B[X] B[T;T⁻¹]).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) := by
    exact RingHom.ext fun p ↦ mapLaurent_toLaurent f p
  have hloc := CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isLocalization (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)
    (mapLaurent f) he (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : A[X]))
  have ht := (isPushout_polynomialMap f).paste_horiz hloc.flip
  convert ht using 1
  · apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    ext a
    simp [LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent]
  · apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    ext b
    simp [LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent]

statement:
theorem isPullback_subGmToU {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (L : Ideal R) :
    IsPullback (subGmToU L) (reduceGm L) (subschemeι R L) (genericFibreι R L)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback (reduceGm L) (subGmToU L)
    (genericFibreι R L) (subschemeι R L) ?_ ?_).flip
  · apply (cancel_mono (uChartι L)).mp
    simpa only [Category.assoc, subschemeToBlowup, gmToBlowup] using
      subGmToU_subschemeToBlowup L
  · simp only [subGmToU, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp_of_isIso, opensRange_gmToTrivialLine]
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    change (subschemeι R L).base ⁻¹' Set.range (genericFibreι R L) = _
    rw [range_genericFibreι]
    change ((subschemeι R L) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (parameter R L)).carrier = _
    rw [subschemeι, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen]
    change (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (subschemeHom R L (parameter R L))).carrier = _
    rw [subschemeHom_parameter]
    rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes_comp
statement:
theorem quotientRes_comp {U V W : Y.affineOpens} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    quotientRes Y J (hUV.trans hVW) = (quotientRes Y J hUV).comp (quotientRes Y J hVW)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  ext a
  simp only [quotientRes, quotientBaseMap, RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.quotientMap_mk]
  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)) (RingHom.congr_fun (res_comp Y hUV hVW) a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPushout_quotientRes
statement:
theorem isPushout_quotientRes {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal V)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (res Y h)) (CommRingCat.ofHom (quotientRes Y J h))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)))
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPushout.flip
  refine isPushout_of_surjective _ _ _ _ rfl Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ?_
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
  exact (J.map_ideal h).symm.le

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.affineι_subschemeToBlowupGlobal
statement:
theorem affineι_subschemeToBlowupGlobal (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J =
      subschemeToBlowup (J.ideal U) ≫ GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι Y J U
proof:
:= by
  unfold subschemeToBlowupGlobal subschemeToDeformation
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc]
  change subschemeι Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) ≫ DeformationSpace.affineι Y J U ≫ _ = _
  rw [GlobalCompletion.affineι_uChartGlobal, ← Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_blowupAffine_subscheme
statement:
theorem isPullback_blowupAffine_subscheme (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U)
      (subschemeToBlowup (J.ideal U)) (subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J)
      (GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι Y J U)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((toDeformationHom Y J).isPullback_map U).paste_horiz
    (GlobalCompletion.isPullback_uChartGlobal Y J U).flip
  apply IsPullback.flip
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.toLineHom_comp_structureMap
statement:
theorem toLineHom_comp_structureMap (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp
      (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom =
        Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
proof:
:= by
  have hincl : (((DeformationSpace.inclusionHom (bot_le : (⊥ : Y.IdealSheafData) ≤ J)).app U).toRingHom).comp
      (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom =
        (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U)).toRingHom := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
    · change (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono Γ(Y, U.1)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) ≤ J.ideal U)))
        (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) ⊥ (Polynomial.C a)) =
          structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) (Polynomial.C a)
      simp only [structureMap, Polynomial.aeval_C]
      rfl
    · change (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono Γ(Y, U.1)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) ≤ J.ideal U)))
        (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) ⊥ Polynomial.X) =
          structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) Polynomial.X
      rw [structureMap_X, structureMap_X]
      exact inclusion_parameter Γ(Y, U.1) bot_le
  change (subschemeHom Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U)).comp
    (((DeformationSpace.inclusionHom (bot_le : (⊥ : Y.IdealSheafData) ≤ J)).app U).toRingHom.comp
      (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom) = _
  rw [hincl, subschemeHom_comp_structureMap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.subGmToUHom_toDeformation
statement:
theorem subGmToUHom_toDeformation :
    (subGmToUHom Y J).map ≫ subschemeToDeformation Y J =
      (reduceGmHom Y J).map ≫ DeformationSpace.genericι Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    subschemeToDeformation, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map,
    ← Category.assoc (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientLaurentData Y J) U),
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.genericι,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact RingHom.ext fun p ↦ nonPosHom_subschemeHom Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.toLineHom_toLaurent
statement:
theorem toLineHom_toLaurent (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (p : extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))) :
    Polynomial.toLaurent ((toLineHom Y J).app U p) =
      reduceLaurent Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) (invert (p : Γ(Y, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (invert (R := Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U))
    (nonPosHom_subschemeHom Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U)
      (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono Γ(Y, U.1)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) ≤ J.ideal U)) p))
  rw [nonPosHom_apply, involutive_invert] at h
  exact h.trans (mapLaurent_invert (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)) p.1).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.subGmToTHom_toLine
statement:
theorem subGmToTHom_toLine :
    (subGmToTHom Y J).map ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J =
      (reduceGmHom Y J).map ≫ DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    subschemeToLineGlobal, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map,
    ← Category.assoc (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientLaurentData Y J) U),
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial, DeformationSpace.gmInvert,
    ← Category.assoc (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊤) U),
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    DeformationSpace.genericι, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact RingHom.ext (toLineHom_toLaurent Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_subGmToUHom
statement:
theorem isPullback_subGmToUHom :
    IsPullback (subGmToUHom Y J).map (reduceGmHom Y J).map
      (subschemeToDeformation Y J) (DeformationSpace.genericι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeSpec.Hom.isPullback_of_forall (subGmToUHom Y J) (reduceGmHom Y J)
    (toDeformationHom Y J) (DeformationSpace.inclusionHom (le_top : J ≤ ⊤)) fun U ↦ ?_
  refine (isPullback_subGmToU (J.ideal U)).of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (GlobalCompletion.gmAffineIso Y U) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact subGmToU_eq (J.ideal U)
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    change reduceGm (J.ideal U) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊤ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).val.toRingHom) = _
    rw [reduceGm, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    change genericFibreι Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendedRees Γ(Y, U.1) (⊤ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).val.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.inclusion
          (extendedRees_mono Γ(Y, U.1) (le_top : J.ideal U ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom)
    exact (DeformationSpace.specMap_val_top_comp_inclusion Y J U).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_subGmToBlowupGlobal
statement:
theorem isPullback_subGmToBlowupGlobal :
    IsPullback (subGmToUHom Y J).map (reduceGmHom Y J).map
      (subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J) (GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsPullback (𝟙 (subschemeUGlobal Y J)) (subschemeToDeformation Y J)
      (subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J) (GlobalCompletion.uChartGlobal Y J) :=
    IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso_mono ⟨by simp [subschemeToBlowupGlobal]⟩
  simpa only [Category.comp_id, GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal] using
    (isPullback_subGmToUHom Y J).paste_horiz h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.toLineHom_map
statement:
theorem toLineHom_map :
    (toLineHom Y J).map = subschemeToDeformation Y J ≫ DeformationSpace.toLine Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  rw [RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, ← Category.assoc, subschemeToDeformation,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.toLine,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_subGmToUHom_line
statement:
theorem isPullback_subGmToUHom_line :
    IsPullback (subGmToUHom Y J).map (reduceGmHom Y J).map
      (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.genericι Y ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isPullback_subGmToUHom Y J).paste_vert
    (DeformationSpace.genericFibre_isPullback Y J)
  rw [← toLineHom_map] at h
  simp only [Category.comp_id] at h
  convert h using 1 <;> rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.invertQuotientGmHom_subGmToU
statement:
theorem invertQuotientGmHom_subGmToU :
    (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map ≫ (subGmToUHom Y J).map = (subGmToTHom Y J).map
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact RingHom.ext fun p ↦ by
    change invert (nonPosHom (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) p) = Polynomial.toLaurent p
    rw [nonPosHom_apply, involutive_invert]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.invertQuotientGmHom_reduceGm
statement:
theorem invertQuotientGmHom_reduceGm :
    (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map ≫ (reduceGmHom Y J).map =
      (reduceGmHom Y J).map ≫ DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map,
    ← Category.assoc (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientLaurentData Y J) U),
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.gmInvert,
    RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact RingHom.ext fun p ↦ by
    change invert (reduceLaurent Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) p.1) =
      reduceLaurent Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) (invert p.1)
    exact (mapLaurent_invert (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U)) p.1).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_subGmToTHom
statement:
theorem isPullback_subGmToTHom :
    IsPullback (subGmToTHom Y J).map (reduceGmHom Y J).map
      (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPullback_subGmToUHom_line Y J).of_iso
    (asIso (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map).symm (Iso.refl _)
    (asIso (DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y)).symm (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    apply (cancel_epi (asIso (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map).hom).mp
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact invertQuotientGmHom_subGmToU Y J
  · simp only [Iso.symm_hom]
    apply (cancel_epi (asIso (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map).hom).mp
    change (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map ≫ (reduceGmHom Y J).map ≫
      inv (DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y) =
        (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map ≫ inv (invertQuotientGmHom Y J).map ≫ (reduceGmHom Y J).map
    rw [← Category.assoc, invertQuotientGmHom_reduceGm]
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  · simp
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    unfold DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial
    change DeformationSpace.genericι Y ⊥ =
      inv (DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y) ≫ DeformationSpace.gmInvert Y ≫ DeformationSpace.genericι Y ⊥
    simp only [IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι : subschemeUιGlobal Y J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J =
    subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι Y J
proof: := pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι : subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J =
    subschemeToLineGlobal Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J
proof: := pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalGlobal_points
statement:
theorem subschemeTotalGlobal_points (x : subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) :
    (∃ b, subschemeUιGlobal Y J b = x) ∨ (∃ l, subschemeTιGlobal Y J l = x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
    (span (subGmToUHom Y J).map (subGmToTHom Y J).map) x
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · left
    refine ⟨(subGmToUHom Y J).map y, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w
      (span (subGmToUHom Y J).map (subGmToTHom Y J).map) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.preimage_blowupGlobalι_subschemeTotal
statement:
theorem preimage_blowupGlobalι_subschemeTotal :
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ⁻¹ᵁ (GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι Y J).opensRange =
      (subschemeUιGlobal Y J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rcases subschemeTotalGlobal_points Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hx
      have h : GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι Y J b =
          GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J l) := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hb
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzl⟩ := pushout_inl_eq_inr (GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal Y J)
        (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y) h
      obtain ⟨w, hw, _⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
        (isPullback_subGmToTHom Y J) l z hzl.symm
      refine ⟨(subGmToUHom Y J).map w, ?_⟩
      rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f w) (pushout.condition
        (f := (subGmToUHom Y J).map) (g := (subGmToTHom Y J).map))
  · rintro x ⟨b, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J b, ?_⟩
    simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ f b) (subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι Y J)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.preimage_lineTι_subschemeTotal
statement:
theorem preimage_lineTι_subschemeTotal :
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ⁻¹ᵁ (GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J).opensRange =
      (subschemeTιGlobal Y J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rcases subschemeTotalGlobal_points Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hx
      have h : GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι Y J (subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J b) =
          GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J l := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hl.symm
      obtain ⟨z, hzb, hz⟩ := pushout_inl_eq_inr (GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal Y J)
        (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial Y) h
      obtain ⟨w, hw, _⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
        (isPullback_subGmToBlowupGlobal Y J) b z hzb.symm
      refine ⟨(subGmToTHom Y J).map w, ?_⟩
      rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact (congrArg (fun f ↦ f w) (pushout.condition
        (f := (subGmToUHom Y J).map) (g := (subGmToTHom Y J).map))).symm
    · exact ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · rintro x ⟨l, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨subschemeToLineGlobal Y J l, ?_⟩
    simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ f l) (subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι Y J)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_blowupGlobalι_subschemeTotal
statement:
theorem isPullback_blowupGlobalι_subschemeTotal :
    IsPullback (subschemeUιGlobal Y J) (subschemeToBlowupGlobal Y J)
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι Y J)
proof:
:=
  (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι Y J)
    (preimage_blowupGlobalι_subschemeTotal Y J)).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal
statement:
theorem isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal :
    IsPullback (subschemeTιGlobal Y J) (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J)
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J)
proof:
:=
  (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι Y J)
    (preimage_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J)).flip

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.specMap_toLineHom
statement:
theorem specMap_toLineHom (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom) =
      reduceLine (J.ideal U) ≫ (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso Y U).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso Y U).hom).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom) ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))).toRingHom) = _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, toLineHom_comp_structureMap]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.affineι_subschemeToLineGlobal
statement:
theorem affineι_subschemeToLineGlobal (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J =
      reduceLine (J.ideal U) ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι Y U
proof:
:= by
  unfold subschemeToLineGlobal
  rw [RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, specMap_toLineHom, Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.subschemeTotalAffineι_totalGlobalι
statement:
theorem subschemeTotalAffineι_totalGlobalι (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J =
      subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U) ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · simp only [subschemeTotalAffineι, pushout.inl_desc_assoc, Category.assoc]
    rw [subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι, ← Category.assoc,
      affineι_subschemeToBlowupGlobal]
    simp only [subschemeTotalι, GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι, pushout.inl_desc_assoc,
      blowupι, pushout.inl_desc, Category.assoc]
  · simp only [subschemeTotalAffineι, pushout.inr_desc_assoc, Category.assoc]
    rw [subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι, ← Category.assoc,
      affineι_subschemeToLineGlobal]
    simp only [subschemeTotalι, GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι, pushout.inr_desc_assoc,
      trivialι, pushout.inr_desc, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.GlobalSubscheme.isPullback_subschemeTotalAffine
statement:
theorem isPullback_subschemeTotalAffine (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U)) (subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U)
      (GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U) (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ (affineTotalCover Y J U) fun j ↦ ?_
  cases j
  · have ha := isPullback_blowupι_subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U)
    have hg := (isPullback_blowupAffine_subscheme Y J U).paste_horiz
      (isPullback_blowupGlobalι_subschemeTotal Y J)
    refine hg.flip.of_iso ha.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      exact ha.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      change RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ subschemeUιGlobal Y J =
        ha.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst (subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U)) (blowupι (J.ideal U)) ≫
          subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U
      rw [← Category.assoc, ha.isoPullback_hom_fst]
      change _ = pushout.inl _ _ ≫ subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U
      rw [subschemeTotalAffineι, pushout.inl_desc]
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
      exact (GlobalCompletion.blowupι_totalAffineι Y J U).symm
    · simp
  · have ha := isPullback_trivialι_subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U)
    have hline : IsPullback (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U)
        (reduceLine (J.ideal U)) (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι Y U) := by
      have h := (toLineHom Y J).isPullback_map U
      refine h.flip.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso Y U)
        (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · simp
      · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
        rw [specMap_toLineHom, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
        rfl
      · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
        unfold GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι
        simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
        rfl
    have hg := hline.paste_horiz (isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J)
    refine hg.flip.of_iso ha.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      exact ha.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
      change RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J =
        ha.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst (subschemeTotalι (J.ideal U)) (trivialι (J.ideal U)) ≫
          subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U
      rw [← Category.assoc, ha.isoPullback_hom_fst]
      change _ = pushout.inr _ _ ≫ subschemeTotalAffineι Y J U
      rw [subschemeTotalAffineι, pushout.inr_desc]
    · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
      exact (GlobalCompletion.trivialι_totalAffineι Y J U).symm
    · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.away_map_kernel
statement:
theorem away_map_kernel (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (s : A) (d : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    RingHom.ker (Away.map f s) =
      ((RingHom.ker f).map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s))).comap
        (algebraMap (Away 𝒜 s) (Localization.Away s))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 hs x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Away.map_mk]
  rw [← (val_injective (𝒜 := ℬ) (Submonoid.powers (f s))).eq_iff]
  rw [Away.val_mk, val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  change _ ↔ Localization.mk a (⟨s ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers s) ∈
    (RingHom.ker f).map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s))
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers s)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩
    refine ⟨s ^ k, ⟨k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change f (s ^ k * a) = 0
    simpa only [map_mul, map_pow] using hk
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩, hk⟩
    refine ⟨⟨(f s) ^ k, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    change f (s ^ k * a) = 0 at hk
    simpa only [map_mul, map_pow] using hk

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.actual_away_branch_kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem actual_away_branch_kernel_intersection (I : Ideal A)
    (s : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (d : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ grade (centreIdeal I) d) :
    RingHom.ker (Away.map
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
        (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I)) s) ⊓
      RingHom.ker (Away.map (grMk (centreIdeal I)) s) =
    ((Ideal.span {fibreVariable I}).map
      (algebraMap (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (Localization.Away s))).comap
        (algebraMap (Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) s) (Localization.Away s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [away_map_kernel _ _ _ s d hs, away_map_kernel _ _ _ s d hs]
  rw [← Ideal.comap_inf, ← IsLocalization.map_inf (Submonoid.powers s) (Localization.Away s)]
  have he : RingHom.ker
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
        (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I)) =
      RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) := rfl
  have hg : RingHom.ker (grMk (centreIdeal I)) = grIdeal (centreIdeal I) := Ideal.mk_ker
  rw [he, hg, kernel_exceptional_intersection_eq_fibre]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.standard_chart_branch_kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem standard_chart_branch_kernel_intersection (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    RingHom.ker (Away.map
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
        (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r)) ⊓
      RingHom.ker (chartGrMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
    ((Ideal.span {fibreVariable I}).map
      (algebraMap (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I))
        (Localization.Away (generator (centreIdeal I) r)))).comap
      (algebraMap (Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r))
        (Localization.Away (generator (centreIdeal I) r)))
proof:
:=
  actual_away_branch_kernel_intersection I _ 1 (generator_mem_grade_one _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.coefficientDivX_grade
statement:
theorem coefficientDivX_grade (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (p : reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (hp : p ∈ grade (centreIdeal I) n)
    (he : p ∈ grIdeal (centreIdeal I)) :
    (⟨coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X]), coefficientDivX_mem I p he⟩ :
      reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) ∈ grade (centreIdeal I) n
proof:
:= by
  change coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X]) =
    Polynomial.monomial n ((coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X])).coeff n)
  change (p : Polynomial A[X]) = Polynomial.monomial n ((p : Polynomial A[X]).coeff n) at hp
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro m
  rw [coefficientDivX_coeff, coefficientDivX_coeff, hp]
  by_cases h : n = m
  · subst m; simp
  · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.contracted_fibre_principal
statement:
theorem contracted_fibre_principal (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    ((Ideal.span {fibreVariable I}).map
      (algebraMap (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I))
        (Localization.Away (generator (centreIdeal I) r)))).comap
      (algebraMap (Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r))
        (Localization.Away (generator (centreIdeal I) r))) =
      Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X}
proof:
:= by
  let s := generator (centreIdeal I) r
  let C := centreIdeal I
  let hs := generator_mem_grade_one C r
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective (grade C) hs x
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hx
    change Localization.mk a (⟨s ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers s) ∈ _ at hx
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers s)] at hx
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hx
    have hp : s ^ k * a ∈ RingHom.ker (evaluationMap I) ⊓ grIdeal C := by
      rw [kernel_exceptional_intersection_eq_fibre]
      exact hk
    have hd : s ^ k * a ∈ grade C ((n + k) • 1) := by
      have h := SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded k hs) ha
      convert h using 1
      simp [Nat.add_comm]
    let p := s ^ k * a
    let q : reesAlgebra C := ⟨coefficientDivX (p : Polynomial A[X]), coefficientDivX_mem I p hp.2⟩
    have hq : q ∈ grade C ((n + k) • 1) := coefficientDivX_grade I _ p hd hp.2
    have hmul : fibreVariable I * q = p := fibreVariable_mul_coefficientDivX I p hp.2 hp.1
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    refine ⟨Away.mk (grade C) hs (n + k) q hq, ?_⟩
    apply val_injective
    rw [val_mul, Away.val_mk]
    change Localization.mk a (⟨s ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers s) =
      Localization.mk (fibreVariable I) (⟨s ^ 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers s) *
        Localization.mk q (⟨s ^ (n + k), ⟨n + k, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers s)
    rw [Localization.mk_mul, hmul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
    change (s ^ 0 * s ^ (n + k)) * a = s ^ n * p
    dsimp [p]
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, pow_add]
    ring
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x = baseElement C r Polynomial.X := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    change (algebraMap (Away (grade C) s) (Localization.Away s))
      (baseElement C r Polynomial.X) ∈
        (Ideal.span {fibreVariable I}).map (algebraMap (reesAlgebra C) (Localization.Away s))
    change Localization.mk (fibreVariable I) (⟨s ^ 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers s) ∈ _
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers s)]
    exact ⟨1, ⟨0, by simp⟩, by simp only [one_mul]; exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.standard_chart_branch_kernel_intersection_principal
statement:
theorem standard_chart_branch_kernel_intersection_principal (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    RingHom.ker (Away.map
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
        (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r)) ⊓
      RingHom.ker (chartGrMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
      Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X}

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.spec_map_appTop_kernel
statement:
theorem spec_map_appTop_kernel {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) :
    RingHom.ker (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).appTop.hom =
      (RingHom.ker f).comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.ker_equiv_comp _
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv]
  rw [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, Iso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv_toRingHom,
    ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality]
  exact RingHom.comap_ker _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.spec_map_kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem spec_map_kernel_intersection {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : R →+* T) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).ker ⊓ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)).ker =
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        ((RingHom.ker f ⊓ RingHom.ker g).comap
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_isAffine
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_inf, Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, Scheme.ker_of_isAffine]
  simp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal, homOfLE_refl]
  rw [spec_map_appTop_kernel, spec_map_appTop_kernel, Ideal.comap_inf]
  simp [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.actual_standard_chart_sheaf_intersection
statement:
theorem actual_standard_chart_sheaf_intersection (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (evaluationChartMap I r))).ker ⊓
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartGrMap (centreIdeal I) r))).ker =
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X}).comap
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
          (Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r)))).hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spec_map_kernel_intersection]
  rw [show RingHom.ker (evaluationChartMap I r) ⊓
      RingHom.ker (chartGrMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
      Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X} from
    standard_chart_branch_kernel_intersection_principal I r]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.original_other_chart_kernel
statement:
theorem original_other_chart_kernel (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    (affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker.comap (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (evaluationChartMap I r))).ker
proof:
:= by
  have h := proj_map_chart_isPullback (grade (centreIdeal I)) (grade I)
    (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
      (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I))
    (ReesBlowupOfEq.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I)
      (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I))
    (generator (centreIdeal I) r) 1 (by omega) (generator_mem_grade_one _ _)
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (Proj.map
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
        (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I))
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfEq (centreIdeal I)
        (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I))) :=
    affineOtherToBlowup_isClosedImmersion A I
  exact (closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback h).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.original_exceptional_chart_kernel

theorem original_exceptional_chart_kernel (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :

  (closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (grChart_isPullback (centreIdeal I) r).flip).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.original_standard_chart_sheaf_intersection
statement:
theorem original_standard_chart_sheaf_intersection (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    (affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker.comap (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) ⊓
      (exceptionalι (centreIdeal I)).ker.comap (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop

          (Away (grade (centreIdeal I)) (generator (centreIdeal I) r)))).hom.hom)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.spec_kernel_of_eq
statement:
theorem spec_kernel_of_eq {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : R →+* T) (h : RingHom.ker f = RingHom.ker g) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).ker = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, spec_map_appTop_kernel,
    spec_map_appTop_kernel, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.spec_kernel_comap
statement:
theorem spec_kernel_comap (f : A →+* B) {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (g : A →+* T) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)).ker.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) =
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (((RingHom.ker g).map f).comap
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (RingHom.ker g)))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have h := spec_kernel_of_eq g (Ideal.Quotient.mk (RingHom.ker g)) Ideal.mk_ker.symm
  rw [h, ← closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_quotient f (RingHom.ker g)).flip]
  rw [Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, spec_map_appTop_kernel, Ideal.mk_ker]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.chart_eval_kernel_image

statement:
theorem original_zero_fibre_chart_kernel_comap (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).ker.comap
      (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)))).ker.comap
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (centreIdeal I) r)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (zeroSection A) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (Polynomial.eval_surjective (0 : A))
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion,
    ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
  change (zeroSection A).ker.comap (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r ≫ projection (centreIdeal I)) = _
  rw [chartMap_projection]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.original_zero_fibre_chart_kernel
statement:
theorem original_zero_fibre_chart_kernel (I : Ideal A) (r : centreIdeal I) :
    (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).ker.comap
      (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal I) r Polynomial.X}).comap

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.comap_inf_of_openImmersion
statement:
theorem comap_inf_of_openImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (K L : Y.IdealSheafData) : (K ⊓ L).comap f = K.comap f ⊓ L.comap f
proof:
:= by
  ext U
  simp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_inf, Pi.inf_apply,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion, Ideal.comap_inf]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.ideal_eq_of_affineCover_comap
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_of_affineCover_comap {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : X.AffineOpenCover)
    (K L : X.IdealSheafData) (h : ∀ i, K.comap (𝒰.f i) = L.comap (𝒰.f i)) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top
    (fun i ↦ ⟨(𝒰.f i).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange (𝒰.f i)⟩) 𝒰.openCover.iSup_opensRange
  intro i
  have hi := congrArg (fun J : (Spec (𝒰.X i)).IdealSheafData ↦
    J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩) (h i)
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion] at hi
  have he := Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((𝒰.f i).appIso ⊤).inv).2 hi
  have e : (⟨(𝒰.f i) ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i)⟩ : X.affineOpens) =
      ⟨(𝒰.f i).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange (𝒰.f i)⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _)
  rw [← e]
  exact he

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.original_blowup_branch_kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem original_blowup_branch_kernel_intersection (I : Ideal A) :
    (affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker ⊓ (exceptionalι (centreIdeal I)).ker =
      (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply ideal_eq_of_affineCover_comap (generatorAffineOpenCover (centreIdeal I))
  intro r
  change ((affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker ⊓ (exceptionalι (centreIdeal I)).ker).comap
    (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r) =
    (pullback.fst (blowupToLine I) (zeroSection A)).ker.comap (chartMap (centreIdeal I) r)
  rw [comap_inf_of_openImmersion, original_standard_chart_sheaf_intersection,
    original_zero_fibre_chart_kernel]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.ideal_eq_bot_of_closed_map
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_bot_of_closed_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) (h : K.map i = i.ker) : K = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso K.subschemeι :=
    IsClosedImmersion.isIso_of_ker_eq (K.subschemeι ≫ i) i K.subschemeι rfl h
  exact (Scheme.isIso_subschemeι_iff_eq_bot K).mp inferInstance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.original_zero_fibre_scheme_union
statement:
theorem original_zero_fibre_scheme_union (I : Ideal A) :
    (affineOtherToBlowupZero A I).ker ⊓ (exceptionalToBlowupZero A I).ker = ⊥
proof:
