name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.cotangentRestrictionOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem cotangentRestrictionOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
    (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (hK : J.map g = K) :
    cotangentRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map,h,hK]) =
      (cotangentRestrictionOfEq J g K hK).comp (cotangentRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro m
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmetricSemilinearMap_ι {Q Q' M N : Type u} [CommRing Q] [CommRing Q']
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module Q M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Q' N]
    (f : Q →+* Q') (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (m : M) :
    symmetricSemilinearMap f φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q M m) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι Q' N (φ m)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.symmetricSemilinearMap_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmetricSemilinearMap_base {Q Q' M N : Type u} [CommRing Q] [CommRing Q']
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module Q M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Q' N]
    (f : Q →+* Q') (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (a : Q) :
    symmetricSemilinearMap f φ (algebraMap Q _ a) = algebraMap Q' (SymmetricAlgebra Q' N) (f a)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq_ι (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J) (m : I.Cotangent) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) _ (m,a)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι (B ⧸ J) _
        (cotangentRestrictionOfEq I f J h m, GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap I f J h a)
proof:
:=
  symmetricSemilinearMap_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.conormal_associatedGraded_naturality
statement:
theorem conormal_associatedGraded_naturality (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (m : I.Cotangent) :
    AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq I f J h (AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded A I m) =
      AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded B J (cotangentRestrictionOfEq I f J h m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective m
  rw [cotangentRestrictionOfEq_toCotangent,
    AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent,
    AffineNormalCone.conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent,
    AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_mk, AffineNormalCone.reesMapOfEq_degreeOneRees]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.associatedGraded_base_naturality
statement:
theorem associatedGraded_base_naturality (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) (a : A ⧸ I) :
    AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq I f J h (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom A I a) =
      AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom B J (GlobalSubscheme.quotientBaseMap I f J h a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  exact AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_algebraMap I f J h a

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_restriction
statement:
theorem normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y).toRingHom.comp (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h) =
      (normalBundlePolynomialRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  induction p using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y
      (symmetricSemilinearMap _ _ (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a)) =
      Polynomial.map (AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq I f J h)
        (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) _ a))
    rw [symmetricSemilinearMap_base, normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_base,
      normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_base, Polynomial.map_C, associatedGraded_base_naturality]
  | ι p =>
    rcases p with ⟨m,a⟩
    change normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y
      (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (m,a))) =
      Polynomial.map (AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq I f J h)
        (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ (m,a)))
    rw [normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq_ι, normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι,
      normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_ι, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_C,
      Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X,
      conormal_associatedGraded_naturality, associatedGraded_base_naturality]
  | mul p q hp hq => simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg₂ (· * ·) hp hq
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hp hq

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundle_graded_restriction_square
statement:
theorem normalBundle_graded_restriction_square (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    (normalBundleGradedComparison J y).comp (normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq I f J h x y) =
      (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (normalBundleGradedComparison I x)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_restriction I f J h x y) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundle_graded_restriction_route
statement:
theorem normalBundle_graded_restriction_route (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq I f J h x y =
      (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse J y).comp
        ((InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (normalBundleGradedComparison I x))
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y).injective
  change normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y (normalBundleSymmetricRestrictionOfEq I f J h p) =
    normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y ((normalBundlePolynomialEquiv J y).symm
      (normalBundlePolynomialRestrictionOfEq I f J h (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv I x p)))
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (normalBundlePolynomialEquiv_restriction I f J h x y) p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundle_irrelevant_restriction
statement:
theorem normalBundle_irrelevant_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    letI
proof:
:= conormal_free I x
    letI := conormal_finite I x
    letI := conormal_free J y
    letI := conormal_finite J y
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (B ⧸ J) (J.Cotangent × (B ⧸ J))) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))).map
        (normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq I f J h x y) := by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI := conormal_free J y
  letI := conormal_finite J y
  have hi := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) (normalBundleGradedComparison I x)
    (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse I x) (normalBundleGradedComparison_comp_inverse I x)
  have hj := irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade J)
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (B ⧸ J) (J.Cotangent × (B ⧸ J))) (normalBundleGradedComparisonInverse J y)
    (normalBundleGradedComparison J y) (normalBundleGradedComparison_inverse_comp J y)
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hi (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
  have hr := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp ht hj
  rw [← normalBundle_graded_restriction_route] at hr
  exact hr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.proj_map_actual_square
statement:
theorem proj_map_actual_square
    {R S T U σ τ ψ χ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    [SetLike σ R] [AddSubgroupClass σ R] [SetLike τ S] [AddSubgroupClass τ S]
    [SetLike ψ T] [AddSubgroupClass ψ T] [SetLike χ U] [AddSubgroupClass χ U]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) (𝒞 : ℕ → ψ) (𝒟 : ℕ → χ)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] [GradedRing 𝒞] [GradedRing 𝒟]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (q' : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒟) (g : 𝒞 →+*ᵍ 𝒟)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hq : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map q)
    (hq' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒟 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).map q')
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒟 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞).map g)
    (hsq : q'.comp f = g.comp q) :
    Proj.map g hg ≫ Proj.map q hq = Proj.map q' hq' ≫ Proj.map f hf
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Proj.map_comp, ← Proj.map_comp]
  exact ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr hsq.symm _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundleProjRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem normalBundleProjRestriction_comparison (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B)
    (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J)
    (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators A I) (y : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators B J) :
    InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestrictionOfEq I f J h ≫ (normalBundleProjIso I x).hom =
      (normalBundleProjIso J y).hom ≫ normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq I f J h x y
proof:
:= by
  letI := conormal_free I x
  letI := conormal_finite I x
  letI := conormal_free J y
  letI := conormal_finite J y
  exact proj_map_actual_square
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (A ⧸ I) (I.Cotangent × (A ⧸ I)))
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (B ⧸ J) (J.Cotangent × (B ⧸ J)))
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade J)
    (normalBundleGradedRestrictionOfEq I f J h x y) (normalBundleGradedComparison I x)
    (normalBundleGradedComparison J y) (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
    (normalBundle_irrelevant_restriction I f J h x y)
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (normalBundleGradedComparison_comp_inverse I x))
    (irrelevant_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ _ (normalBundleGradedComparison_comp_inverse J y))
    (InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
    (normalBundle_graded_restriction_square I f J h x y)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.comparison_degreeZero_square
statement:
theorem comparison_degreeZero_square (I : Ideal A) :
    (Proj.degreeZeroMap (𝒜 := InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I)
      (ℬ := ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGraded I)).comp (InfinityNormalBundle.totalZero I) =
      centreGrZero I
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv I
    (Polynomial.C (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedBaseRingHom A I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a))) =
    ReesBlowup.grMk (centreIdeal I) (algebraMap A[X] (reesAlgebra (centreIdeal I)) (Polynomial.C a))
  rw [CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_C]
  change InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap I
    (ReesBlowup.grMk I (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a)) = _
  unfold InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap
  change InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap I (centreIdeal I) Polynomial.C _
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a)) = _
  rw [InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap_mk, InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.projComparisonIso_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem projComparisonIso_toQuotient (I : Ideal A) :
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).hom ≫ InfinityNormalBundle.polynomialCompletionToQuotient I =
      ReesBlowup.grToCenter (centreIdeal I) ≫ (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.centreIso A I).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := @InfinityNormalBundle.proj_map_zero_structure
    (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I))
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I)) (A ⧸ I)
    (polynomialGrCommRing I) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing I)
    (AddSubgroup (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)))
    (AddSubgroup (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I))) _ _ _ _
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I))
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing I) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing (centreIdeal I))
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGraded I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.irrelevant_comparison I)
    (InfinityNormalBundle.totalZero I) (centreGrZero I) (comparison_degreeZero_square I)
  change _ = Proj.toSpecZero (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (centreGrZero I)) at h
  rw [centreGrZero, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq
statement:
theorem polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq (I : Ideal A) :
    InfinityNormalBundle.polynomialCompletionToQuotient I =
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).inv ≫ ReesBlowup.grToCenter (centreIdeal I) ≫
        (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.centreIso A I).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).hom).mp
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact projComparisonIso_toQuotient I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq_completionToCentre
statement:
theorem polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq_completionToCentre (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    InfinityNormalBundle.polynomialCompletionToQuotient (J.ideal U) =
      InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre Y J U
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq]
  unfold InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjToCentre
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjIso
  simp only [asIso_hom, ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_toCenter_assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobal.normalBundleAffineToComponent_isPullback
statement:
theorem normalBundleAffineToComponent_isPullback (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (x : AffineNormalCone.QuasiregularGenerators Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)) :
    IsPullback (normalBundleAffineToComponent Y J U x) (normalBundleToQuotient (J.ideal U) x)
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) (J.subschemeCover.f U)
proof:
:= by
  refine (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J U).of_iso
    (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal U) x) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [normalBundleAffineToComponent, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, normalBundleProjIso_toQuotient,
      polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq_completionToCentre]
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_grade
statement:
theorem mk_mem_grade {i : ι} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk J a ∈ grade 𝒜 J i
proof:
:=
  ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.HomogeneousQuotient.decompose₀_eq_zero
statement:
theorem decompose₀_eq_zero (hJ : J.IsHomogeneous 𝒜) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ J) :
    decompose₀ 𝒜 J a = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  change ((reduce 𝒜 J i) (decompose 𝒜 a i) : A ⧸ J) = 0
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hJ i ha)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.HomogeneousQuotient.coe_decompose₀
statement:
theorem coe_decompose₀ (a : A) :
    DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grade 𝒜 J) (decompose₀ 𝒜 J a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J a
proof:
:= by
  have key : (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grade 𝒜 J)).comp (DirectSum.map (reduce 𝒜 J)) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk J).toAddMonoidHom.comp (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom 𝒜) := by
    refine DirectSum.addHom_ext fun i x ↦ ?_
    simp [reduce]
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun key (decompose 𝒜 a)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h
  rw [decompose₀, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  change _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk J a
  refine h.trans ?_
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk J ((decompose 𝒜).symm (decompose 𝒜 a)) = _
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.HomogeneousQuotient.decomposeQ_mk
statement: theorem decomposeQ_mk (a : A) : decomposeQ 𝒜 J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a) = decompose₀ 𝒜 J a
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.HomogeneousQuotient.coe_decompose_mk
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_mk (a : A) (i : ι) :
    letI
proof:
:= gradedRing 𝒜 J hJ
    ((decompose (grade 𝒜 J) (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a) i : grade 𝒜 J i) : A ⧸ J) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk J (decompose 𝒜 a i) := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.HomogeneousQuotient.irrelevant_le_map
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map (𝒜' : ℕ → AddSubgroup A) [GradedRing 𝒜']
    (J' : Ideal A) (hJ' : J'.IsHomogeneous 𝒜') :
    letI
proof:
:= gradedRing 𝒜' J' hJ'
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade 𝒜' J')).toIdeal ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜').toIdeal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J') := by
  letI := gradedRing 𝒜' J' hJ'
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  have h0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk J' (decompose 𝒜' a 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← coe_decompose_mk 𝒜' J' hJ' a 0]
    exact hx
  have hmem : a - decompose 𝒜' a 0 ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜').toIdeal := by
    change GradedRing.proj 𝒜' 0 (a - decompose 𝒜' a 0) = 0
    rw [map_sub, GradedRing.proj_apply, GradedRing.proj_apply,
      decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜' (SetLike.coe_mem _), sub_self]
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Ideal.Quotient.mk J') hmem
  rwa [map_sub, h0, sub_zero] at this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.line_chart_compat
statement:
theorem line_chart_compat :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R)) ≫ chart R 0 =
      gmToTrivialLine R ≫ chart R 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : nonPosHom R = lineLaurent (RingHom.id R) := by
    ext a <;> simp [nonPosHom, lineLaurent]
  have h1 : (algebraMap R[X] R[T;T⁻¹]) =
      (invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp (lineLaurent (RingHom.id R)) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, lineLaurent_C, RingHom.id_apply,
        algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_C]
      exact (invert_C a).symm
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, lineLaurent_X, algebraMap_eq_toLaurent,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_X]
      change T 1 = invert (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹])
      rw [invert_T, neg_neg]
  rw [h0]
  unfold gmToTrivialLine chart
  rw [← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((lineLaurent (RingHom.id R)).comp
      (chartEquiv R 0).toRingHom)) ≫ _ =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraMap R[X] R[T;T⁻¹]).comp
      (chartEquiv R 1).toRingHom)) ≫ _
  rw [h1, ← overlapHom_awayMap_zero, RingHom.comp_assoc, ← overlapHom_awayMap_one,
    CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp_assoc, Spec.map_comp_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι ..).trans (Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι ..).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.isPullback_lineCharts
statement:
theorem isPullback_lineCharts :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R))) (gmToTrivialLine R)
      (chart R 0) (chart R 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (line_chart_compat R).symm ?_
  rw [ProjectiveLine.chart_one_preimage]
  exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    (PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range R[T;T⁻¹] (Polynomial.X : R[X])).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.gluedUι_toP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem gluedUι_toP1 : gluedUι R ≫ gluedLineToP1 R = chart R 0
proof: := pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.gluedTι_toP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem gluedTι_toP1 : gluedTι R ≫ gluedLineToP1 R = chart R 1
proof: := pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.gluedLine_points
statement:
theorem gluedLine_points (x : gluedLine R) :
    (∃ b, gluedUι R b = x) ∨ (∃ l, gluedTι R l = x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
    (span (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R))) (gmToTrivialLine R)) x
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · left
    refine ⟨Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R)) y, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w
      (span (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R))) (gmToTrivialLine R)) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.preimage_chart_zero
statement:
theorem preimage_chart_zero :
    gluedLineToP1 R ⁻¹ᵁ (chart R 0).opensRange = (gluedUι R).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rcases gluedLine_points R x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hx
      have h : chart R 0 b = chart R 1 l := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, gluedTι_toP1] at hb
        exact hb
      obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback (isPullback_lineCharts R) b l h
      refine ⟨Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R)) w, ?_⟩
      rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f w) (pushout.condition
        (f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R))) (g := gmToTrivialLine R))
  · rintro x ⟨b, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ f b) (gluedUι_toP1 R)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.preimage_chart_one
statement:
theorem preimage_chart_one :
    gluedLineToP1 R ⁻¹ᵁ (chart R 1).opensRange = (gluedTι R).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rcases gluedLine_points R x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hx
      have h : chart R 0 b = chart R 1 l := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, gluedUι_toP1] at hl
        exact hl.symm
      obtain ⟨w, hw, _⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback (isPullback_lineCharts R) b l h
      refine ⟨gmToTrivialLine R w, ?_⟩
      rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact (congrArg (fun f ↦ f w) (pushout.condition
        (f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nonPosHom R))) (g := gmToTrivialLine R))).symm
    · exact ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · rintro x ⟨l, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
    simpa only [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ f l) (gluedTι_toP1 R)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.isPullback_gluedUι
statement:
theorem isPullback_gluedUι :
    IsPullback (gluedUι R) (𝟙 _) (gluedLineToP1 R) (chart R 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback (𝟙 _) (gluedUι R) (chart R 0)
    (gluedLineToP1 R) ?_ ?_).flip
  · simpa using gluedUι_toP1 R
  · exact preimage_chart_zero R

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.isPullback_gluedTι
statement:
theorem isPullback_gluedTι :
    IsPullback (gluedTι R) (𝟙 _) (gluedLineToP1 R) (chart R 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback (𝟙 _) (gluedTι R) (chart R 1)
    (gluedLineToP1 R) ?_ ?_).flip
  · simpa using gluedTι_toP1 R
  · exact preimage_chart_one R

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.affineSubschemeUι_iso
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineSubschemeUι_iso (I : Ideal R) :
    pushout.inl (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) ≫ (affineSubschemeIsoP1 I).hom =
      chart (R ⧸ I) 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineSubschemeIsoP1, Iso.trans_hom, pushout.congrHom, gluedLineIsoP1, asIso_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  unfold pushout.map
  rw [pushout.inl_desc]
  simp only [Category.id_comp]
  exact gluedUι_toP1 (R ⧸ I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.affineSubschemeTι_iso
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineSubschemeTι_iso (I : Ideal R) :
    pushout.inr (subGmToU I) (gmToTrivialLine (R ⧸ I)) ≫ (affineSubschemeIsoP1 I).hom =
      chart (R ⧸ I) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineSubschemeIsoP1, Iso.trans_hom, pushout.congrHom, gluedLineIsoP1, asIso_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  unfold pushout.map
  rw [pushout.inr_desc]
  simp only [Category.id_comp]
  exact gluedTι_toP1 (R ⧸ I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.isPullback_affineSubscheme
statement:
theorem isPullback_affineSubscheme {K : Type u} [CommRing K]
    (I : Ideal R) (f : K →+* R ⧸ I) :
    IsPullback (affineSubschemeToP1 I f) (affineSubschemeToBase I)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec K 1) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  refine (SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map_toSpec f 1).of_iso
    (affineSubschemeIsoP1 I).symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [affineSubschemeToP1]
  · simp [affineSubschemeToBase]
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.affineSubschemeIsoPullback_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineSubschemeIsoPullback_fst {K : Type u} [CommRing K]
    (I : Ideal R) (f : K →+* R ⧸ I) :
    (affineSubschemeIsoPullback I f).hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = affineSubschemeToP1 I f
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_affineSubscheme I f).isoPullback_hom_fst

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.affineSubschemeIsoPullback_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineSubschemeIsoPullback_snd {K : Type u} [CommRing K]
    (I : Ideal R) (f : K →+* R ⧸ I) :
    (affineSubschemeIsoPullback I f).hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = affineSubschemeToBase I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.projectiveQuotientChart_closed
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem projectiveQuotientChart_closed (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    projectiveQuotientChart Y J U ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J =
      projectiveQuotientClosedι Y J U ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U
proof:
:= by
  simp only [projectiveQuotientChart, projectiveQuotientClosedι, Category.assoc,
    subschemeTotalAffineι_totalGlobalι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.SubschemeProduct.isPullback_projectiveQuotientChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_projectiveQuotientChart (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (projectiveQuotientClosedι Y J U) (projectiveQuotientChart Y J U)
      (GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U) (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPullback_subschemeTotalAffine Y J U).of_iso
    (affineSubschemeIsoP1 (J.ideal U)) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [projectiveQuotientClosedι]
  · simp [projectiveQuotientChart]
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mapLaurent_invert
statement:
theorem mapLaurent_invert (f : A →+* B) (g : A[T;T⁻¹]) :
    mapLaurent f (invert g) = invert (mapLaurent f g)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | C_mul_T n a =>
    rw [map_mul, invert_C, invert_T, mapLaurent_C_mul_T, mapLaurent_C_mul_T, map_mul, invert_C,
      invert_T]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.coe_invertTop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_invertTop (x : extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) :
    (invertTop R x : R[T;T⁻¹]) = invert (x : R[T;T⁻¹])
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.invertTop_invertTop
statement:
theorem invertTop_invertTop (x : extendedRees R (⊤ : Ideal R)) :
    invertTop R (invertTop R x) = x
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_invertTop, coe_invertTop]; exact involutive_invert _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.invertTop_bijective
statement: theorem invertTop_bijective : Function.Bijective (invertTop R)
proof:
:=
  Function.Involutive.bijective (invertTop_invertTop R)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.quotient_bot_bijective
statement:
theorem quotient_bot_bijective (c : R) (x : extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R))
    (hx : x = structureMap R ⊥ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R) ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))
proof:
:= by
  subst hx
  let e := RingEquiv.ofBijective (structureMap R (⊥ : Ideal R)) (structureMap_bot_bijective R)
  let E : (Polynomial R ⧸ Ideal.span {Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c}) ≃+*
      (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R) ⧸
        Ideal.span {structureMap R ⊥ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)}) :=
    Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ e (by rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; rfl)
  let F := (Polynomial.quotientSpanXSubCAlgEquiv c).toRingEquiv.symm.trans E
  have hF : ⇑(algebraMap R (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R) ⧸
      Ideal.span {structureMap R ⊥ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)})) = ⇑F := by
    funext r
    change _ = E ((Polynomial.quotientSpanXSubCAlgEquiv c).symm r)
    rw [Polynomial.quotientSpanXSubCAlgEquiv_symm_apply]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (extendedRees R (⊥ : Ideal R)) r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (structureMap R ⊥ (algebraMap R (Polynomial R) r))
    rw [(structureMap R ⊥).commutes]
  rw [hF]
  exact F.bijective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom
statement:
theorem chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom (i : Fin 2) (p : MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex 1 i) k) :
    chartEquiv k i (awayCoordinateHom k 1 i p) = MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k _ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chartEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply, awayCoordinateEquiv]
  rw [← RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply (awayCoordinateHom k 1 i)
    ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_injective k 1 i,
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_surjective k 1 i⟩, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.x01_mem
statement: theorem x01_mem : x01 k ∈ grading k 1 (1 + 1)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.mul_mem_graded (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem opensRange_chart (i : Fin 2) :
    (chart k i).opensRange = Proj.basicOpen (grading k 1) (coordinate k 1 i)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartEquiv k i).toRingHom)) := by
    rw [isIso_SpecMap_iff]
    exact (chartEquiv k i).bijective
  unfold chart P1 SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp_of_isIso, Proj.opensRange_awayι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv_coordinateRatio
statement:
theorem chartEquiv_coordinateRatio (i : Fin 2) (j : AffineChartIndex 1 i) :
    chartEquiv k i (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 i j) = Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  rw [show SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 i j =
      awayCoordinateHom k 1 i (MvPolynomial.X j) from (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _).symm,
    chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chart_one_preimage
statement:
theorem chart_one_preimage :
    chart k 1 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [opensRange_chart]
  unfold chart P1 SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (grading k 1)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1) Nat.zero_lt_one (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0)
    Nat.zero_lt_one, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  change chartEquiv k 1 _ = _
  rw [← chartEquiv_coordinateRatio k 1 ⟨0, by decide⟩]
  congr 1
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chart_zero_preimage
statement:
theorem chart_zero_preimage :
    chart k 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [opensRange_chart]
  unfold chart P1 SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (grading k 1)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) Nat.zero_lt_one (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1)
    Nat.zero_lt_one, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  change chartEquiv k 0 _ = _
  rw [← chartEquiv_coordinateRatio k 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩]
  congr 1
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.opensRange_gmToLine
statement:
theorem opensRange_gmToLine :
    (AffineDeformationSpace.gmToLine k).opensRange =
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k)
proof:
:=
  TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    (PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range k[T;T⁻¹] (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartEval_x01
statement: theorem chartEval_x01 : chartEval f (x01 k) = T (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chartEval, x01, coordinate, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, one_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartEval_x01_mul
statement: theorem chartEval_x01_mul : chartEval f (x01 k) * T 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartEval_x01, ← T_add, show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num, T_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapHom_awayMk
statement:
theorem overlapHom_awayMk {d : ℕ} (hx : x01 k ∈ grading k 1 d) (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
    (ha : a ∈ grading k 1 (n • d)) :
    overlapHom f (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k 1) hx n a ha) =
      chartEval f a * T 1 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [overlapHom, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  exact Localization.awayLift_mk (chartEval f) (x01 k) a (T 1) (chartEval_x01_mul f) n

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapHom_fromZero
statement:
theorem overlapHom_fromZero (c : grading k 1 0) :
    overlapHom f (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k 1) _ c) =
      chartEval f (c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
proof:
:= by
  have h : HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k 1) _ c =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k 1) (x01_mem k) 0 (c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
        (by simpa using c.2) := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
    change Localization.mk _ _ = _
    congr 1
  rw [h, overlapHom_awayMk, pow_zero, mul_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq
statement:
theorem coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq (i : Fin 2) (a : k) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.coefficientToCoordinateAway k 1 i a =
      HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k 1) _
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeZeroEquiv k 1).symm a)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartEval_C
statement: theorem chartEval_C (a : k) : chartEval f (MvPolynomial.C a) = algebraMap R R[T;T⁻¹] (f a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartEval]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.lineLaurent_C
statement: theorem lineLaurent_C (a : k) : lineLaurent f (Polynomial.C a) = algebraMap R R[T;T⁻¹] (f a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lineLaurent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.lineLaurent_X
statement: theorem lineLaurent_X : lineLaurent f Polynomial.X = T (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [lineLaurent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapHom_awayMap_zero
statement:
theorem overlapHom_awayMap_zero :
    (overlapHom f).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1) (rfl : x01 k = _)) =
    (lineLaurent f).comp (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have key : ((overlapHom f).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1) (rfl : x01 k = _))).comp (awayCoordinateHom k 1 0) =
      ((lineLaurent f).comp (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom).comp (awayCoordinateHom k 1 0) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
        chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom]
      rw [show awayCoordinateHom k 1 0 (MvPolynomial.C a) =
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.coefficientToCoordinateAway k 1 0 a from
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C _ _ _, coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq,
        HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_fromZeroRingHom, overlapHom_fromZero]
      simp only [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_C, lineLaurent_C]
      exact chartEval_C f a
    · intro j
      obtain rfl : j = ⟨1, by decide⟩ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
        chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom]
      rw [show awayCoordinateHom k 1 0 (MvPolynomial.X ⟨1, by decide⟩) =
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩ from
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio,
        HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk, overlapHom_awayMk]
      simp only [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X, lineLaurent_X]
      simp only [chartEval, coordinate, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', pow_one]
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, ← T_add]
      norm_num
  refine RingHom.ext fun z ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_surjective k 1 0 z
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapHom_awayMap_one
statement:
theorem overlapHom_awayMap_one :
    (overlapHom f).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) (mul_comm _ _ : x01 k = _)) =
    (invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp ((lineLaurent f).comp (chartEquiv k 1).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ((overlapHom f).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) (mul_comm _ _ : x01 k = _))).comp
        (awayCoordinateHom k 1 1) =
      ((invert (R := R)).toRingHom.comp ((lineLaurent f).comp (chartEquiv k 1).toRingHom)).comp
        (awayCoordinateHom k 1 1) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
        chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom]
      rw [show awayCoordinateHom k 1 1 (MvPolynomial.C a) =
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.coefficientToCoordinateAway k 1 1 a from
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C _ _ _, coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq,
        HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_fromZeroRingHom, overlapHom_fromZero]
      simp only [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_C, lineLaurent_C]
      change chartEval f (MvPolynomial.C a) = _
      rw [chartEval_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap (R := R)]
      exact (invert_C (R := R) _).symm
    · intro j
      obtain rfl : j = ⟨0, by decide⟩ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
        chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom]
      rw [show awayCoordinateHom k 1 1 (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, by decide⟩) =
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 1 ⟨0, by decide⟩ from
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio,
        HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk, overlapHom_awayMk]
      simp only [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X, lineLaurent_X]
      simp only [chartEval, coordinate, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', pow_one]
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, one_mul]
      change _ = invert (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹])
      rw [invert_T]
      norm_num
  refine RingHom.ext fun z ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_surjective k 1 1 z
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {𝒜 : AlgebraData X} {T : Scheme.{u}} {f g : relativeSpec X 𝒜 ⟶ T}
    (h : ∀ U, affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ f = affineι X 𝒜 U ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:=
  colimit.hom_ext h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeSpec.Hom.isPullback_of_forall_affine
statement:
theorem Hom.isPullback_of_forall_affine {𝒲 𝒞 : AlgebraData X} (α : Hom X 𝒲 𝒞)
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (β : relativeSpec X 𝒲 ⟶ Y) (γ : relativeSpec X 𝒞 ⟶ Z) (δ : Y ⟶ Z)
    (h : ∀ U, IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (α.app U).toRingHom))
      (affineι X 𝒲 U ≫ β) (affineι X 𝒞 U ≫ γ) δ) :
    IsPullback α.map β γ δ
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover α.map β γ δ (gluingData X 𝒞).cover fun U ↦ ?_
  have hα := α.isPullback_map U
  refine (h U).of_iso hα.flip.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact hα.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    change _ = hα.flip.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ β
    rw [← Category.assoc, hα.flip.isoPullback_hom_fst]
  · rfl
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

theorem chartι_totalToBase : chartι X I ≫ totalToBase X I = toBase X I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.val_lineHom
statement:
theorem val_lineHom (U : X.affineOpens) (p : Polynomial k) :
    ((lineHom X I k φ U p : extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)) : Γ(X, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]) =
      lineLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) p
proof:
:= by
  have : (extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)).val.toRingHom.comp (lineHom X I k φ U) =
      lineLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp [lineHom, lineLaurent, structureMap]
    · simp [lineHom, lineLaurent, structureMap]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.affineι_toLineOver'
statement:
theorem affineι_toLineOver' (U : X.affineOpens) :
    RelativeSpec.affineι X (algebraData X I) U ≫ toLineOver X I k φ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lineHom X I k φ U))
proof:
:=
  affineι_toLineOver X I k φ U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.inclusionHom_map_toLineOver
statement:
theorem inclusionHom_map_toLineOver {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) :
    (inclusionHom h).map ≫ toLineOver X I k φ = toLineOver X J k φ
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeSpec.hom_ext fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [← Category.assoc, Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc, affineι_toLineOver', affineι_toLineOver',
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  refine RingHom.ext fun p ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
  change ((lineHom X I k φ U p : _) : Γ(X, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]) = ((lineHom X J k φ U p : _) : _)
  rw [val_lineHom, val_lineHom]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.genericι_toLineOver
statement: theorem genericι_toLineOver : genericι X I ≫ toLineOver X I k φ = toLineOver X ⊤ k φ
proof:
:=
  inclusionHom_map_toLineOver k φ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.lineHom_comp_chartEquiv_zero
statement:
theorem lineHom_comp_chartEquiv_zero (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (lineHom X ⊤ k φ U).comp (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom =
      (overlapTop X k φ U).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1) (rfl : x01 k = _))
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun z ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
  change ((lineHom X ⊤ k φ U _ : _) : Γ(X, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]) = overlapHom (kAlg X k φ U) _
  rw [val_lineHom]
  exact (RingHom.congr_fun (overlapHom_awayMap_zero (kAlg X k φ U)) z).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.lineHom_comp_chartEquiv_one
statement:
theorem lineHom_comp_chartEquiv_one (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (invertTop Γ(X, U.1)).toRingHom.comp ((lineHom X ⊤ k φ U).comp (chartEquiv k 1).toRingHom) =
      (overlapTop X k φ U).comp (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) (mul_comm _ _ : x01 k = _))
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun z ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
  change invert ((lineHom X ⊤ k φ U _ : _) : Γ(X, U.1)[T;T⁻¹]) = overlapHom (kAlg X k φ U) _
  rw [val_lineHom]
  exact (RingHom.congr_fun (overlapHom_awayMap_one (kAlg X k φ U)) z).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.toLineOver_top_chart
statement:
theorem toLineOver_top_chart :
    toLineOver X ⊤ k φ ≫ chart k 0 = gmInvert X ≫ toLineOver X ⊤ k φ ≫ chart k 1
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeSpec.hom_ext fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [← Category.assoc, affineι_toLineOver', gmInvert, ← Category.assoc, Hom.affineι_map,
    Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (RelativeSpec.affineι _ _ U), affineι_toLineOver']
  unfold chart
  rw [← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp_assoc,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((lineHom X ⊤ k φ U).comp (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom)) ≫ _ =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((invertTop Γ(X, U.1)).toRingHom.comp
      ((lineHom X ⊤ k φ U).comp (chartEquiv k 1).toRingHom))) ≫ _
  rw [lineHom_comp_chartEquiv_zero, lineHom_comp_chartEquiv_one, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp_assoc, Spec.map_comp_assoc,
    Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι, Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.chartι_toP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartι_toP1 : chartι X I ≫ toP1 X I k φ = toLineOver X I k φ ≫ chart k 0
proof:
:=
  pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.trivialι_toP1
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem trivialι_toP1 : trivialι X I ≫ toP1 X I k φ = toLineOver X ⊥ k φ ≫ chart k 1
proof:
:=
  pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.toP1_flat
statement: theorem toP1_flat : Flat (toP1 X I k φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover
    (Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X))) fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.openCover_f]
  haveI := toLineOver_flat X I k φ
  haveI := toLineOver_flat X ⊥ k φ
  obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
  · change Flat (colimit.ι (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X)) WalkingSpan.zero ≫ toP1 X I k φ)
    rw [← colimit.w (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X)) WalkingSpan.Hom.fst, Category.assoc]
    change Flat (genericι X I ≫ chartι X I ≫ toP1 X I k φ)
    rw [chartι_toP1]
    infer_instance
  · change Flat (chartι X I ≫ toP1 X I k φ)
    rw [chartι_toP1]
    infer_instance
  · change Flat (trivialι X I ≫ toP1 X I k φ)
    rw [trivialι_toP1]
    infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.specMap_gmRingHom_compat
statement:
theorem specMap_gmRingHom_compat {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraData X ⊤).map h)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (gmRingHom X k φ V)) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (gmRingHom X k φ U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  refine RingHom.ext fun g ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
  change mapLaurent (res X h) (invert (mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ V) g)) =
    invert (mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) g)
  rw [mapLaurent_invert, ← mapLaurent_comp, res_comp_kAlg]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.lineLaurent_eq_invert
statement:
theorem lineLaurent_eq_invert (U : X.affineOpens) (p : Polynomial k) :
    lineLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) p =
      invert (mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) (algebraMap (Polynomial k) k[T;T⁻¹] p))
proof:
:= by
  have : lineLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) = (invert (R := Γ(X, U.1))).toRingHom.comp
      ((mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ U)).comp (algebraMap (Polynomial k) k[T;T⁻¹])) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp only [lineLaurent, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_C, RingHom.comp_apply]
      change _ = invert (mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ U)
        (algebraMap (Polynomial k) k[T;T⁻¹] (Polynomial.C a)))
      rw [algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, mapLaurent_C, invert_C,
        C_eq_algebraMap]
    · simp only [lineLaurent, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_X, RingHom.comp_apply]
      change _ = invert (mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ U)
        (algebraMap (Polynomial k) k[T;T⁻¹] Polynomial.X))
      rw [algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_X,
        show (T 1 : k[T;T⁻¹]) = T ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by norm_num, mapLaurent_T, invert_T]
      norm_num
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.genericι_isPullback_over
statement:
theorem genericι_isPullback_over :
    IsPullback (genericι X I) (gmOver X k φ) (toLineOver X I k φ)
      (AffineDeformationSpace.gmToLine k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Hom.isPullback_of_forall_affine _ _ _ _ fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [affineι_toLineOver']
  erw [RelativeSpec.affineι_desc]
  letI := (Subalgebra.inclusion (extendedRees_mono Γ(X, U.1)
    (le_top : I.ideal U ≤ ⊤))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsLocalization ((Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k)).map
      (lineHom X I k φ U)) (extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) ((⊤ : X.IdealSheafData).ideal U)) := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    have hX : lineHom X I k φ U Polynomial.X = parameter Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U) := by
      simp [lineHom]
    rw [hX]
    exact isLocalization_inclusion_top Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)
  have H : (gmRingHom X k φ U).comp (algebraMap (Polynomial k) k[T;T⁻¹]) =
      (algebraMap (extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U))
        (extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) ((⊤ : X.IdealSheafData).ideal U))).comp (lineHom X I k φ U) := by
    refine RingHom.ext fun p ↦ Subtype.ext ?_
    change invert (mapLaurent (kAlg X k φ U) (algebraMap (Polynomial k) k[T;T⁻¹] p)) =
      ((lineHom X I k φ U p : extendedRees Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)) : Γ(X, U.1)[T;T⁻¹])
    rw [val_lineHom, lineLaurent_eq_invert]
  exact (isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _ (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isLocalization
    (lineHom X I k φ U) (gmRingHom X k φ U) H (Submonoid.powers Polynomial.X)))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.opensRange_genericι
statement:
theorem opensRange_genericι :
    (genericι X I).opensRange =
      toLineOver X I k φ ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  have := IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
    (genericι_isPullback_over X I k φ).flip ⊤
  rw [← opensRange_gmToLine]
  simpa [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange] using this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.preimage_opensRange_chart_zero
statement:
theorem preimage_opensRange_chart_zero :
    toP1 X I k φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange = (chartι X I).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨genericι X I y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.fst)
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · change trivialι X I y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : toLineOver X ⊥ k φ y ∈ (chart k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange := by
        show chart k 1 (toLineOver X ⊥ k φ y) ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← trivialι_toP1 X I k φ, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [chart_one_preimage] at hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (genericι X ⊥).opensRange := by
        rw [opensRange_genericι X ⊥ k φ]
        exact hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨genericι X I (inv (gmInvert X) z), ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, genericι_chartι, gmToTrivial, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (inv (gmInvert X)), IsIso.inv_hom_id]
      rfl
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show toP1 X I k φ (chartι X I y) ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, chartι_toP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.preimage_opensRange_chart_one
statement:
theorem preimage_opensRange_chart_one :
    toP1 X I k φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange = (trivialι X I).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective
      (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X)) x
    obtain _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ := j
    · refine ⟨gmToTrivial X y, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) (colimit.w (span (genericι X I) (gmToTrivial X))
        WalkingSpan.Hom.snd)
    · change chartι X I y ∈ _ at hx ⊢
      have hy : toLineOver X I k φ y ∈ (chart k 0) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange := by
        show chart k 0 (toLineOver X I k φ y) ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← chartι_toP1 X I k φ, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact hx
      rw [chart_zero_preimage] at hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (genericι X I).opensRange := by
        rw [opensRange_genericι X I k φ]
        exact hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨gmToTrivial X z, ?_⟩
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← genericι_chartι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    show toP1 X I k φ (trivialι X I y) ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, trivialι_toP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.chartι_isPullback
statement:
theorem chartι_isPullback :
    IsPullback (toLineOver X I k φ) (chartι X I) (chart k 0) (toP1 X I k φ)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (chartι_toP1 X I k φ) (preimage_opensRange_chart_zero X I k φ)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.trivialι_isPullback
statement:
theorem trivialι_isPullback :
    IsPullback (toLineOver X ⊥ k φ) (trivialι X I) (chart k 1) (toP1 X I k φ)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (trivialι_toP1 X I k φ)
    (preimage_opensRange_chart_one X I k φ)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.specMap_pointRingHom_compat
statement:
theorem specMap_pointRingHom_compat {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((quotientData (algebraData X I) a ha).map h)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (pointRingHom X I k φ a ha V)) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (pointRingHom X I k φ a ha U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  refine RingHom.ext fun c ↦ ?_
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((algebraData X I).map h (lineHom X I k φ V (Polynomial.C c))) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (lineHom X I k φ U (Polynomial.C c))
  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (RingHom.congr_fun (map_comp_lineHom X I k φ h) _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.affineι_quotientToPoint
statement:
theorem affineι_quotientToPoint (U : X.affineOpens) :
    RelativeSpec.affineι X (quotientData (algebraData X I) a ha) U ≫
        quotientToPoint X I k φ a ha =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (pointRingHom X I k φ a ha U))
proof:
:=
  RelativeSpec.affineι_desc _ _ (fun h ↦ specMap_pointRingHom_compat X I k φ a ha h) U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.quotient_isPullback
statement:
theorem quotient_isPullback (c : k)
    (hac : ∀ U, a U = lineHom X I k φ U (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)) :
    IsPullback (quotientHom (algebraData X I) a ha).map (quotientToPoint X I k φ a ha)
      (toLineOver X I k φ) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c)))
proof:
:= by
  refine Hom.isPullback_of_forall_affine _ _ _ _ fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [affineι_toLineOver', affineι_quotientToPoint]
  refine (isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_of_surjective (CommRingCat.ofHom (lineHom X I k φ U))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a U})))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pointRingHom X I k φ a ha U)) ?_ ?_ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      ?_))
  · rw [← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 1
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun b ↦ ?_) ?_
    · show Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (lineHom X I k φ U (Polynomial.C b)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (lineHom X I k φ U (Polynomial.C (Polynomial.eval c (Polynomial.C b))))
      rw [Polynomial.eval_C]
    · have hmem : lineHom X I k φ U Polynomial.X - lineHom X I k φ U (Polynomial.C c) ∈
          Ideal.span {a U} := by
        rw [← map_sub, ← hac]
        exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
      show Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (lineHom X I k φ U Polynomial.X) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (lineHom X I k φ U (Polynomial.C (Polynomial.eval c Polynomial.X)))
      rw [Polynomial.eval_X]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr hmem
  · exact fun b ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C b, by simp⟩
  · simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, hac]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (by simp)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.parameter_eq_lineHom
statement:
theorem parameter_eq_lineHom (U : X.affineOpens) :

proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.specialFibre_isPullback_P1
statement:
theorem specialFibre_isPullback_P1 :
    IsPullback (quotientToPoint X I k φ _ (parameter_compat X I)) (specialFibreι X I ≫ chartι X I)
      (specialPoint k) (toP1 X I k φ)
proof:
:=
  (quotient_isPullback X I k φ _ (parameter_compat X I) 0
    (parameter_eq_lineHom X I k φ)).flip.paste_vert (chartι_isPullback X I k φ)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.normalCone_isPullback_P1
statement:
theorem normalCone_isPullback_P1 :
    IsPullback ((normalConeIsoSpecialFibre X I).hom ≫
        quotientToPoint X I k φ _ (parameter_compat X I))
      (normalConeι X I ≫ chartι X I) (specialPoint k) (toP1 X I k φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (specialFibre_isPullback_P1 X I k φ).of_iso (normalConeIsoSpecialFibre X I).symm
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ (by simp) (by simp)
  · simp
  · simp [normalConeι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat
statement:
theorem lineHom_bot_compat (c : k) {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (algebraData X ⊥).map h (lineHom X ⊥ k φ V (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)) =
      lineHom X ⊥ k φ U (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (map_comp_lineHom X ⊥ k φ h) _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.fibre_isPullback_P1
statement:
theorem fibre_isPullback_P1 (c : k) :
    IsPullback ((lineFibreIso X k φ c).inv ≫ quotientToPoint X ⊥ k φ _ (lineHom_bot_compat X k φ c))
      ((lineFibreIso X k φ c).inv ≫ (quotientHom (algebraData X ⊥) _
        (lineHom_bot_compat X k φ c)).map ≫ trivialι X I)
      (pointAt k c) (toP1 X I k φ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (quotient_isPullback X ⊥ k φ _ (lineHom_bot_compat X k φ c) c
    (fun _ ↦ rfl)).flip.paste_vert (trivialι_isPullback X I k φ)
  refine h.of_iso (lineFibreIso X k φ c) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_
    (by simp [pointAt]) (by simp)
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.degreeOneOverlapRatio_mul_inv
statement:
theorem degreeOneOverlapRatio_mul_inv :
    degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x y hx hy * degreeOneOverlapRatioInv 𝒜 x y hx hy = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, degreeOneOverlapRatio,
    degreeOneOverlapRatioInv, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_one, pow_one]
  change y^2*x^2 = (x*y)*(x*y)
  ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.degreeOneOverlapRatio_map
statement:
theorem degreeOneOverlapRatio_map (g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g (x*y) (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x y hx hy) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk ℬ (GradedRingHom.map_mem g (SetLike.mul_mem_graded hx hy))
        1 ((g y)^2) (by simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (GradedRingHom.map_mem g hy))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degreeOneOverlapRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk, map_pow]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.degreeOneOverlapRatio_map_heq
statement:
theorem degreeOneOverlapRatio_map_heq (g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) :
    HEq (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map g (x*y) (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x y hx hy))
      (degreeOneOverlapRatio ℬ (g x) (g y) (GradedRingHom.map_mem g hx)
        (GradedRingHom.map_mem g hy))
proof:
:= by
  have hcast (p q : B) (e : p = q) (hp : p ∈ ℬ 2) (hq : q ∈ ℬ 2)
      (a : B) (ha : a ∈ ℬ (1 • 2)) :
      HEq (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk ℬ hp 1 a ha)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk ℬ hq 1 a ha) := by
    subst q
    rfl
  simp only [degreeOneOverlapRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk, map_pow]
  exact hcast _ _ (map_mul g x y) _ _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.nativeTripleRatio_cocycle
statement:
theorem nativeTripleRatio_cocycle :
    nativeTripleRatioXY 𝒜 x y hx hy z hz * nativeTripleRatioYZ 𝒜 x y hx hy z hz =
      nativeTripleRatioXZ 𝒜 x y hx hy z hz
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, nativeTripleRatioXY, nativeTripleRatioYZ,
    nativeTripleRatioXZ, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  change (x*y*z)*((y^2*z)*(z^2*x)) = ((x*y*z)*(x*y*z))*(z^2*y)
  ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.nativeOverlapToTripleXY_ratio
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.nativeOverlapToTripleXZ_ratio

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.nativeOverlapRatio_cocycle
statement:
theorem nativeOverlapRatio_cocycle :
    nativeOverlapToTripleXY 𝒜 x y z hz (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x y hx hy) *
      nativeOverlapToTripleYZ 𝒜 x y hx z (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 y z hy hz) =
    nativeOverlapToTripleXZ 𝒜 x y hy z (degreeOneOverlapRatio 𝒜 x z hx hz)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.nativeOverlapRatioUnit_cocycle
statement:
theorem nativeOverlapRatioUnit_cocycle :

      (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit 𝒜 x y hx hy) *
    Units.map (nativeOverlapToTripleYZ 𝒜 x y hx z).toMonoidHom
      (degreeOneOverlapRatioUnit 𝒜 y z hy hz) =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.nativeTwistTransitionUnit_cocycle
statement:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleGlobalTwist.actualSectionRatioRestriction
statement:
theorem actualSectionRatioRestriction {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    [Module.Free (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V)]
    [Module.Finite (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V)]
    [Module.Free (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)]
    [Module.Finite (Γ(Y,U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J U)]
    (p q : SymmetricAlgebra (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V) (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V))
    (hp : p ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V) 1)
    (hq : q ∈ SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading (Γ(Y,V.1) ⧸ J.ideal V)
      (conormalPlusLineChartSections Y J V) 1) :
    HEq (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) (p*q)
      (degreeOneOverlapRatio _ p q hp hq))
      (degreeOneOverlapRatio _ (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h p) (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h q)
        (GradedRingHom.map_mem (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) hp)
        (GradedRingHom.map_mem (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h) hq))
proof:
:=
  degreeOneOverlapRatio_map_heq _ _ p q hp hq (sectionGradedRestriction Y J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem filteredReesMap_coe (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (f : A →+* B)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem filteredReesMap_algebraMap (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (f : A →+* B)
    (h : I.map f ≤ J) (a : A) :
    filteredReesMap I J f h (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a) =
      algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Polynomial.map_C f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_mem_grade
statement:
theorem filteredReesMap_mem_grade (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (f : A →+* B)
    (h : I.map f ≤ J) (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I)
    (hp : p ∈ ReesBlowup.grade I n) :
    filteredReesMap I J f h p ∈ ReesBlowup.grade J n
proof:
:= by
  change (p : A[X]).map f = monomial n (((p : A[X]).map f).coeff n)
  change (p : A[X]) = monomial n ((p : A[X]).coeff n) at hp
  rw [hp, map_monomial, coeff_monomial]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_ideal
statement:
theorem filteredReesMap_ideal (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (f : A →+* B)
    (h : I.map f ≤ J) :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I)) I ≤
      (Ideal.map (algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J)) J).comap (filteredReesMap I J f h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, filteredReesMap_algebraMap]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (h (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f ha))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap_mk
statement:

    (h : I.map f ≤ J) (p : reesAlgebra I) :

      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (filteredReesMap I J f h p)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap_mem_grade
statement:
theorem filteredGrMap_mem_grade (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (f : A →+* B)
    (h : I.map f ≤ J) (n : ℕ) (x : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)
    (hx : x ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade I n) :
    filteredGrMap I J f h x ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade J n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_grade (ReesBlowup.grade J) (ReesBlowup.grIdeal J)
    (filteredReesMap_mem_grade I J f h n p hp)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredReesMap_comp
statement:
theorem filteredReesMap_comp {D : Type u} [CommRing D]
    (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (K : Ideal D) (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* D)
    (h : I.map f ≤ J) (k : J.map g ≤ K)
    (l : I.map (g.comp f) ≤ K) :
    filteredReesMap I K (g.comp f) l =
      (filteredReesMap J K g k).comp (filteredReesMap I J f h)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [filteredReesMap_coe, RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.map_map]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.filteredGrMap_comp
statement:
theorem filteredGrMap_comp {D : Type u} [CommRing D]
    (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (K : Ideal D) (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* D)
    (h : I.map f ≤ J) (k : J.map g ≤ K)
    (l : I.map (g.comp f) ≤ K) :
    filteredGrMap I K (g.comp f) l =
      (filteredGrMap J K g k).comp (filteredGrMap I J f h)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  simp only [filteredGrMap_mk, RingHom.comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (RingHom.congr_fun
    (filteredReesMap_comp I J K f g h k l) p)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero
statement:
theorem centreIdeal_map_evalZero (I : Ideal A) :
    (centreIdeal I).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom 0) = I
proof:
:= by
  rw [centreIdeal, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_map]
  have hc : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)).comp Polynomial.C = RingHom.id A := by
    ext a
    simp
  rw [hc, Ideal.map_id, Ideal.map_span]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.evalZeroGrMap_coefficientGrMap
statement:
theorem evalZeroGrMap_coefficientGrMap (I : Ideal A) :
    (evalZeroGrMap I).comp (coefficientGrMap I) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, evalZeroGrMap, coefficientGrMap, filteredGrMap_mk,
    RingHom.id_apply]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [filteredReesMap_coe, Polynomial.map_map]
  have hc : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)).comp Polynomial.C = RingHom.id A := by
    ext a
    simp
  rw [hc, Polynomial.map_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap_injective
statement:
theorem coefficientGrMap_injective (I : Ideal A) :
    Function.Injective (coefficientGrMap I)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hx := RingHom.congr_fun (evalZeroGrMap_coefficientGrMap I) x
  have hy := RingHom.congr_fun (evalZeroGrMap_coefficientGrMap I) y
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply] at hx hy
  exact hx.symm.trans ((congrArg (evalZeroGrMap I) h).trans hy)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap_restriction
statement:
theorem coefficientGrMap_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) :
    (centreRestriction I f).comp (coefficientGrMap I) =
