  intro a
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.variableGr_restriction
statement:
theorem variableGr_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) :
    centreRestriction I f (variableGr I) = variableGr (I.map f)
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (filteredReesMap _ _ _ _
    (ReesBlowup.generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I))) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (ReesBlowup.generator (centreIdeal (I.map f)) (uGen (I.map f)))
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [filteredReesMap_coe, ReesBlowup.generator, uGen]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison_restriction
statement:
theorem polynomialGrComparison_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) :
    (centreRestriction I f).comp (polynomialGrComparison I) =
      (polynomialGrComparison (I.map f)).comp
        (Polynomial.mapRingHom (coefficientRestriction I f))
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    change centreRestriction I f (polynomialGrComparison I (Polynomial.C a)) =
      polynomialGrComparison (I.map f) (Polynomial.map (coefficientRestriction I f) (Polynomial.C a))
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.map_C,
      polynomialGrComparison_C] using RingHom.congr_fun (coefficientGrMap_restriction I f) a
  · change centreRestriction I f (polynomialGrComparison I Polynomial.X) =
      polynomialGrComparison (I.map f) (Polynomial.map (coefficientRestriction I f) Polynomial.X)
    simp only [Polynomial.map_X, polynomialGrComparison_X, variableGr_restriction]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.coefficientGrMap_mem_grade
statement:
theorem coefficientGrMap_mem_grade (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (a : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) (ha : a ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade I n) :
    coefficientGrMap I a ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) n
proof:
:=
  filteredGrMap_mem_grade I (centreIdeal I) Polynomial.C le_sup_left n a ha

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.variableGr_pow_degree
statement:
theorem variableGr_pow_degree (I : Ideal A) (k : ℕ) :
    variableGr I ^ k ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem :
      (1 : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I)) ∈
        ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) 0)
  | succ k ih =>
      simpa only [pow_succ] using SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ih (variableGr_degree_one I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialGrComparison_monomial (I : Ideal A) (k : ℕ)
    (a : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) :
    polynomialGrComparison I (Polynomial.monomial k a) =
      coefficientGrMap I a * variableGr I ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialGrComparison, Polynomial.eval₂_monomial]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.polynomialGrComparison_monomial_degree
statement:
theorem polynomialGrComparison_monomial_degree (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ)
    (a : AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) (ha : a ∈ ReesBlowup.grGrade I n) :
    polynomialGrComparison I (Polynomial.monomial k a) ∈
      ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I) (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialGrComparison_monomial]
  exact SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (coefficientGrMap_mem_grade I n a ha)
    (variableGr_pow_degree I k)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.mem_centreIdeal_iff_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem mem_centreIdeal_iff_coeff_zero (I : Ideal A) (p : A[X]) :
    p ∈ centreIdeal I ↔ p.coeff 0 ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have h := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) hp
    rw [centreIdeal_map_evalZero] at h
    change Polynomial.eval 0 p ∈ I at h
    simpa only [← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using h
  · intro hp
    have hd : Polynomial.X ∣ p - Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) := by
      rw [Polynomial.X_dvd_iff]
      simp
    have hs : p - Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) ∈ centreIdeal I :=
      (show Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} ≤ centreIdeal I from le_sup_right)
        ((Ideal.mem_span_singleton).mpr hd)
    have hc := C_mem_centreIdeal I hp
    simpa using (centreIdeal I).add_mem hs hc

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalCone.monomial_mem_centreIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_centreIdeal_pow (I : Ideal A) (n k : ℕ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ I ^ n) : Polynomial.monomial k a ∈ centreIdeal I ^ (n + k)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Polynomial.C a ∈ centreIdeal I ^ n := by
    apply (pow_le_pow_left' (show I.map Polynomial.C ≤ centreIdeal I from le_sup_left) n)
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem Polynomial.C ha
  have hx : Polynomial.X ^ k ∈ centreIdeal I ^ k :=
    Ideal.pow_mem_pow (X_mem_centreIdeal I) k
  rw [pow_add]
  simpa only [Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial] using Ideal.mul_mem_mul hc hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chart_isPullback
statement:
theorem chart_isPullback (i : C.J) :
    IsPullback (chartToComponent Y J C i) (chartToQuotient Y J C i)
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) (C.chartCover.f i)
proof:
:=
  normalBundleAffineToComponent_isPullback Y J (C.U i) (C.gens i)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.charts_jointly_surjective
statement:
theorem charts_jointly_surjective (p : InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component Y J) :
    ∃ (i : C.J) (q : chart Y J C i), chartToComponent Y J C i q = p
proof:
:=
  (componentSymmetricCover Y J C).exists_eq p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chartRestriction_comparison
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem chartRestriction_comparison {i j : C.J} (h : C.U i ≤ C.U j) :
    InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction Y J h ≫
      (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal (C.U j)) (C.gens j)).hom =
      (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).hom ≫ chartRestriction Y J C h
proof:
:=
  normalBundleProjRestriction_comparison _ _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chartRestriction_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem chartRestriction_toComponent {i j : C.J} (h : C.U i ≤ C.U j) :
    chartRestriction Y J C h ≫ chartToComponent Y J C j = chartToComponent Y J C i
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← chartRestriction_comparison]
  simp only [chartToComponent, normalBundleAffineToComponent, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent Y J h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chartRestriction_toQuotient
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem chartRestriction_toQuotient {i j : C.J} (h : C.U i ≤ C.U j) :
    chartRestriction Y J C h ≫ chartToQuotient Y J C j = chartToQuotient Y J C i ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (normalBundleProjIso (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i)).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← chartRestriction_comparison]
  unfold chartToQuotient
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [normalBundleProjIso_toQuotient (J.ideal (C.U j)) (C.gens j),
    ← Category.assoc, normalBundleProjIso_toQuotient (J.ideal (C.U i)) (C.gens i),
    polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq_completionToCentre,
    polynomialCompletionToQuotient_eq_completionToCentre]
  exact InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_toCentre Y J h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chartRestriction_isPullback
statement:
theorem chartRestriction_isPullback {i j : C.J} (h : C.U i ≤ C.U j) :
    IsPullback (chartRestriction Y J C h) (chartToQuotient Y J C i)
      (chartToQuotient Y J C j) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := chartToComponent Y J C j)
    (h₂₂ := J.subschemeCover.f (C.U j)) ?_ (chartRestriction_toQuotient Y J C h)
    (chart_isPullback Y J C j)
  rw [chartRestriction_toComponent, SubschemeProductGlobal.quotientChart_naturality]
  exact chart_isPullback Y J C i

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLine_hasConstantRank :
    SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank J.subscheme (conormalPlusLine Y J) (r+1)
proof:
:= by
  let q := SchemeKTheory.freeTrivializedOpenCoverLocalGeneratorsData C.chartCover.openCover
    (conormalPlusLine Y J) (fun i => ULift.{u} (Fin (C.gens i).length) ⊕ PUnit.{u+1})
    (conormalPlusLineChartIso Y J C)
  refine ⟨q, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun i => ?_⟩
  change Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.gens i).length) ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) = r+1
  rw [Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_ulift, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin,
    Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_unique, C.length_eq]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.conormalPlusLine_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem conormalPlusLine_isFiniteLocallyFree :
    SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree J.subscheme (conormalPlusLine Y J)

:=
  (conormalPlusLine_hasConstantRank Y J C).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chartRestriction_self
statement: theorem chartRestriction_self (i : C.J) : chartRestriction Y J C (le_refl (C.U i)) = 𝟙 (chart Y J C i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartRestriction
  rw [normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq_congr _ (res_refl Y (C.U i))]
  exact normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq_id _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalBundleCover.chartRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem chartRestriction_comp {i j k : C.J} (h : C.U i ≤ C.U j) (h' : C.U j ≤ C.U k) :
    chartRestriction Y J C h ≫ chartRestriction Y J C h' = chartRestriction Y J C (h.trans h')
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartRestriction
  rw [normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq_congr _ (res_comp Y h h')]
  exact normalBundleProjRestrictionOfEq_comp _ _ _ (J.map_ideal h') _ _ (J.map_ideal h)
    (C.gens k) (C.gens j) (C.gens i)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.mem_adjoin_insert_parameter_image
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set B := Algebra.adjoin R (insert (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) (Polynomial.toLaurent '' t)) with hBdef
  set s := f.coeff.support with hsdef
  set p₀ : Polynomial R := ∑ n ∈ s with 0 ≤ n, Polynomial.monomial n.toNat (f.coeff n) with hp₀def
  have hp₀ : p₀ ∈ reesAlgebra I := by
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ ?_
    exact reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (hf n)
  have hpos : Polynomial.toLaurent p₀ ∈ B := by
    have h1 : p₀ ∈ Algebra.adjoin R t := by rw [ht]; exact hp₀
    have h2 : Polynomial.toLaurent p₀ ∈
        Subalgebra.map (Polynomial.toLaurentAlg (R := R)) (Algebra.adjoin R t) := ⟨p₀, h1, rfl⟩
    rw [← Algebra.adjoin_image] at h2
    exact Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) h2
  have hneg : (∑ n ∈ s with ¬ 0 ≤ n, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n) ∈ B := by
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun n hn ↦ ?_
    have hn' : ¬ (0 : ℤ) ≤ n := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    have hTn : (T n : R[T;T⁻¹]) = (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) ^ n.natAbs := by
      rw [T_pow]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [hTn, C_eq_algebraMap]
    exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _)
      (Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)) _)
  have e1 : Polynomial.toLaurent p₀ =
      ∑ n ∈ s with 0 ≤ n, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n := by
    simp only [hp₀def, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
    have hn' : 0 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
    rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_X_pow,
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn']
  have hsplit : f = Polynomial.toLaurent p₀ +
      ∑ n ∈ s with ¬ 0 ≤ n, LaurentPolynomial.C (f.coeff n) * T n := by
    rw [e1, Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not]
    exact eq_sum_support R f
  rw [hsplit]
  exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hpos hneg

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.fg_extendedRees
statement: theorem fg_extendedRees [IsNoetherianRing R] : (extendedRees R I).FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htfin, ht⟩ := Subalgebra.fg_def.mp (reesAlgebra.fg (IsNoetherian.noetherian I))
  refine Subalgebra.fg_def.mpr ⟨insert (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) (Polynomial.toLaurent '' t),
    (htfin.image _).insert _, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact (parameter R I).2
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx'
      exact isExtendedRees_toLaurent R I (by rw [← ht]; exact Algebra.subset_adjoin hy)
  · intro f hf
    exact mem_adjoin_insert_parameter_image R I ht hf

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.parameter_ne_zero
statement: theorem parameter_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] : parameter R I ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact (isUnit_T (R := R) (-1)).ne_zero h'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.parameter_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem parameter_mem_nonZeroDivisors [IsDomain R] :
    parameter R I ∈ (extendedRees R I)⁰
proof:
:=
  mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (parameter_ne_zero R I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.not_isUnit_parameter
statement: theorem not_isUnit_parameter (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : ¬ IsUnit (parameter R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hu.exists_right_inv
  have hw' : (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (w : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val hw
  have h1 : (T 1 : R[T;T⁻¹]) * (T (-1) : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 1 := by
    rw [← T_add]
    simp
  have hwT : (w : R[T;T⁻¹]) = T 1 := by
    calc (w : R[T;T⁻¹]) = 1 * (w : R[T;T⁻¹]) := (one_mul _).symm
      _ = (T 1 * T (-1)) * (w : R[T;T⁻¹]) := by rw [h1]
      _ = T 1 * ((T (-1)) * (w : R[T;T⁻¹])) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = T 1 := by rw [hw', mul_one]
  have hmem := coeff_mem_of_mem R I w.2 1
  rw [hwT] at hmem
  have hcoeff : (T 1 : R[T;T⁻¹]).coeff 1 = 1 := by
    have hone : (T 1 : R[T;T⁻¹]) = LaurentPolynomial.C (1 : R) * T 1 := by simp
    rw [hone, ← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
    simp
  rw [hcoeff] at hmem
  simp only [Int.toNat_one, pow_one] at hmem
  exact hI ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one I).mpr hmem)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.parameterIdeal_ne_top
statement: theorem parameterIdeal_ne_top (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : parameterIdeal R I ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact not_isUnit_parameter R I hI (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.height_eq_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal
statement:
theorem height_eq_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hI : I ≠ ⊤) {p : Ideal (extendedRees R I)} (hp : p ∈ (parameterIdeal R I).minimalPrimes) :
    p.height = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hprinc : (parameterIdeal R I).IsPrincipal := ⟨⟨parameter R I, rfl⟩⟩
  have hle : p.height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ p hp
  have hspan : (parameterIdeal R I).height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (parameter_mem_nonZeroDivisors R I) (not_isUnit_parameter R I hI)
  have hge : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ p.height := hspan ▸ Ideal.height_mono hp.1.2
  exact le_antisymm hle hge

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.structureMap_injective
statement: theorem structureMap_injective : Function.Injective (structureMap R I)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  have h : (invert (R := R)) (Polynomial.toLaurent p) = invert (Polynomial.toLaurent q) := by
    rw [← coe_structureMap R I p, ← coe_structureMap R I q, hpq]
  exact Polynomial.toLaurent_injective ((invert (R := R)).injective h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ringKrullDim_extendedRees
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_extendedRees [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.FiniteType k R] :
    ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I) = ringKrullDim R + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfaith : FaithfulSMul k R :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k R).mpr (algebraMap k R).injective
  have halgX : ∀ x : k, algebraMap k (Polynomial R) x = Polynomial.C (algebraMap k R x) := by
    intro x
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R (Polynomial R)]
    rfl
  have hfaithX : FaithfulSMul k (Polynomial R) := by
    rw [faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective]
    intro a b hab
    apply (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k R).mp hfaith
    rw [halgX, halgX] at hab
    exact Polynomial.C_injective hab
  have hfaithL : FaithfulSMul (Polynomial R) R[T;T⁻¹] :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr Polynomial.toLaurent_injective
  have htower : IsScalarTower k (Polynomial R) R[T;T⁻¹] :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
      rw [halgX, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_eq_toLaurent, Polynomial.toLaurent_C,
        LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R R[T;T⁻¹] x
  have hFTX : Algebra.FiniteType k (Polynomial R) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := R) inferInstance inferInstance
  have hFTA : Algebra.FiniteType k (extendedRees R I) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := R) inferInstance inferInstance
  have h1 : Algebra.trdeg k (Polynomial R) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (extendedRees R I) :=
    _root_.trdeg_le_of_injective ((structureMap R I).restrictScalars k)
      (structureMap_injective R I)
  have h2 : Algebra.trdeg k (extendedRees R I) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k R[T;T⁻¹] :=
    _root_.trdeg_le_of_injective ((Subalgebra.val (extendedRees R I)).restrictScalars k)
      Subtype.val_injective
  have h3 : Algebra.trdeg k R[T;T⁻¹] = Algebra.trdeg k (Polynomial R) :=
    SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic k (Polynomial R) R[T;T⁻¹]
  have heq : Algebra.trdeg k (extendedRees R I) = Algebra.trdeg k (Polynomial R) :=
    le_antisymm (h3 ▸ h2) h1
  rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k (extendedRees R I), heq,
    ← SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k (Polynomial R),
    Polynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.toAssociatedGraded_surjective
statement: theorem toAssociatedGraded_surjective : Function.Surjective (toAssociatedGraded R I)
proof:
:=
  (specialFibreEquiv R I).symm.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ker_toAssociatedGraded
statement:
theorem ker_toAssociatedGraded :
    RingHom.ker (toAssociatedGraded R I) = parameterIdeal R I
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : (specialFibreEquiv R I).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R I) x) = 0 := hx
    have h := congrArg (specialFibreEquiv R I) hx'
    rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] at h
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h
  · intro hx
    change (specialFibreEquiv R I).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal R I) x) = 0
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx, map_zero]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.comap_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal
statement:
theorem comap_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal
    {q : Ideal (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)}
    (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)) :
    q.comap (toAssociatedGraded R I) ∈ (parameterIdeal R I).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  have h := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective (toAssociatedGraded_surjective R I) hq
  rwa [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, ker_toAssociatedGraded] at h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ker_quotientMk_comp_toAssociatedGraded
statement:
theorem ker_quotientMk_comp_toAssociatedGraded
    (q : Ideal (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)) :
    RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk q).comp (toAssociatedGraded R I)) =
      q.comap (toAssociatedGraded R I)
proof:
:= by
  ext x

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing_le [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (n : ℕ) (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ringKrullDim (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I) ≤ (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hquot : ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I ⧸ parameterIdeal R I) + 1 ≤
      ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I) :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_le_of_nonZeroDivisor (parameter_mem_nonZeroDivisors R I)
  rw [ringKrullDim_extendedRees R I k, hn] at hquot
  have hiso : ringKrullDim (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I) =
      ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I ⧸ parameterIdeal R I) :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (specialFibreEquiv R I).toRingEquiv
  rw [hiso]
  rcases eq_or_ne (ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I ⧸ parameterIdeal R I)) ⊥ with hd | hd
  · rw [hd]
    exact bot_le
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hd
  rw [← hy] at hquot ⊢
  have hy' : y + 1 ≤ (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hquot
  have hyn : y ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp hy'
  exact_mod_cast hyn

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_ideal
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_ideal [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (n : ℕ) (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞))
    (q : Ideal (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)) :
    ringKrullDim (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I ⧸ q) ≤ (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:=
  (ringKrullDim_quotient_le q).trans (ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing_le R I k n hn)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞)) (hdf : HasDimensionFormula (extendedRees R I))
    {p : Ideal (extendedRees R I)} (hp : p ∈ (parameterIdeal R I).minimalPrimes) :
    ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I ⧸ p) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hprime : p.IsPrime := hp.isPrime
  have hht : p.height = 1 := height_eq_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal R I hI hp
  have hform := hdf p hprime
  rw [hht, ringKrullDim_extendedRees R I k, hn] at hform
  have hnontriv : Nontrivial (extendedRees R I ⧸ p) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hprime.ne_top
  have hbot : ringKrullDim (extendedRees R I ⧸ p) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    have h0 := ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial (R := extendedRees R I ⧸ p)
    rw [h] at h0
    simp at h0
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hbot
  rw [← hy] at hform ⊢
  have hform' : y + 1 = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hform
  have hyn : y = (n : ℕ∞) :=
    le_antisymm ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp hform'.le)
      ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp hform'.ge)
  rw [hyn]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞)) (hdf : HasDimensionFormula (extendedRees R I))
    {q : Ideal (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)}
    (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)) :
    ringKrullDim (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I ⧸ q) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (quotientEquivQuotientComap R I q)]
  exact ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal R I k hI n hn hdf
    (comap_mem_minimalPrimes_parameterIdeal R I hq)

proof:

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ) (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞))
    (hdf : HasDimensionFormula (extendedRees R I)) :
    ringKrullDim (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hnt : Nontrivial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I) :=
    nontrivial_associatedGradedRing R I hI
  refine le_antisymm (ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing_le R I k n hn) ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨q, hq⟩⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes (I := (⊥ : Ideal
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I))) bot_ne_top
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes R I k hI n hn hdf hq
  rw [← hdim]
  exact ringKrullDim_quotient_le _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.topologicalKrullDim_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_zeroLocus {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (J : Ideal B) :
    topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B)) = ringKrullDim (B ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hemb : Topology.IsEmbedding (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isEmbedding_comap_of_surjective _ _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hrange : Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B) := by
    rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, Ideal.mk_ker]
  let e : PrimeSpectrum (B ⧸ J) ≃ₜ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B) :=
    hemb.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.setCongr hrange)
  rw [← IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq e e.isHomeomorph,
    PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.pureTopologicalDimension_spec
proof:
:= by
  intro Z hZ
  have hZ' : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum B) := hZ
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_minimalPrimes] at hZ'
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hZ'
  have hdim : topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (q : Set B)) = ringKrullDim (B ⧸ q) :=
    topologicalKrullDim_zeroLocus q
  change topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (q : Set B)) = _
  rw [hdim, h q hq]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.pureTopologicalDimension_normalCone
statement:

    [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ) (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞))
    (hdf : HasDimensionFormula (extendedRees R I)) :

proof:

        (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J h) (fun x => x) d x).hom
proof:
:= by
  native_cache_exact (nativeAllTargetRestrictionMate_chartRecovery
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal V)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (J.ideal U))
    (nativeGradedRestriction Y J h) (nativeGradedRestriction_irrelevant Y J h)
    (fun x => x) d (affineNativeGenerator_covers Y J V) x)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.DisjointARRM346.affineOtherToBlowup_preimage_uChart
statement:
theorem affineOtherToBlowup_preimage_uChart (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    affineOtherToBlowup A I ⁻¹ᵁ (uChartι I).opensRange = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [uChartι_opensRange]
  change Proj.basicOpen (grade I) (reesMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
    (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I))) = ⊥
  have : reesMapOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) I
      (InfinityNormalCone.centreIdeal_map_evalZero I) (generator (centreIdeal I) (uGen I)) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [generator, uGen]
  rw [this]
  exact Proj.basicOpen_zero _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.DisjointARRM346.otherToTotal_not_mem_range_lineTι
statement:
theorem otherToTotal_not_mem_range_lineTι (c : GlobalBlowup.blowup Y J) (y : DeformationSpace.line Y) :
    lineTι Y J y ≠ otherToTotal Y J c
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : totalToIntegerP1 Y J (lineTι Y J y) = totalToIntegerP1 Y J (otherToTotal Y J c) :=
    congrArg _ h
  have h2 : totalToIntegerP1 Y J (otherToTotal Y J c) =
      infinityPoint (infinityToInteger Y J (otherToInfinity Y J c)) := by
    rw [otherToTotal, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (infinityFibreι Y J),
      (infinity_isPullback Y J).w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [h2, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, lineTι_totalToIntegerP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h1
  set s := infinityToInteger Y J (otherToInfinity Y J c) with hs
  have hmem : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s ∈
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1).opensRange := by
    show ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s) ∈
        (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1).opensRange
    exact ⟨_, h1⟩
  rw [ProjectiveLine.chart_zero_preimage] at hmem
  have hmem' : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s ∈
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : integerRing[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum integerRing[X])) :=
    hmem
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen] at hmem'
  apply hmem'
  show (Polynomial.X : integerRing[X]) ∈
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)) (show PrimeSpectrum integerRing from s)).asIdeal
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.DisjointARRM346.otherToTotal_not_mem_range_uChart
statement:
theorem otherToTotal_not_mem_range_uChart (c : GlobalBlowup.blowup Y J)
    (w : DeformationSpace.space Y J) :
    blowupGlobalι Y J (uChartGlobal Y J w) ≠ otherToTotal Y J c
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : c ∈ ⨆ U : Y.affineOpens, (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U).opensRange := by
    rw [GlobalBlowup.iSup_opensRange_affineι]; trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hc
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hU
  have h1 : otherToTotal Y J (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U b) =
      blowupGlobalι Y J (blowupAffineι Y J U (affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) b)) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, affineι_otherToTotal, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (blowupι (J.ideal U)),
      blowupι_totalAffineι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [h1] at h
  have h2 := (blowupGlobalι Y J).isOpenEmbedding.injective h
  have h3 : blowupAffineι Y J U (affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) b) ∈
      (uChartGlobal Y J).opensRange := ⟨w, h2⟩
  have h4 : affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) b ∈ (uChartι (J.ideal U)).opensRange := by
    rw [opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback (isPullback_uChartGlobal Y J U)]
    exact h3
  have h5 : b ∈ affineOtherToBlowup Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U) ⁻¹ᵁ (uChartι (J.ideal U)).opensRange := h4
  rw [affineOtherToBlowup_preimage_uChart] at h5
  exact h5

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.DisjointARRM346.disjoint_range_otherToTotal_subschemeTotalGlobalι
statement:
theorem disjoint_range_otherToTotal_subschemeTotalGlobalι :
    Disjoint (Set.range (otherToTotal Y J)) (Set.range (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases subschemeTotalGlobal_points Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hx
    exact otherToTotal_not_mem_range_uChart Y J c _ hx
  · rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hx
    exact otherToTotal_not_mem_range_lineTι Y J c _ hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.DisjointARRM346.subschemeTotalGlobalι_mem_range_componentToTotal
statement:
theorem subschemeTotalGlobalι_mem_range_componentToTotal (x : subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)
    (hx : subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x ∈ Set.range (infinityFibreι Y J)) :
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x ∈ Set.range (componentToTotal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [infinity_total_image_union Y J] at hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · exact hx
  · exact absurd ⟨x, rfl⟩ (Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (disjoint_range_otherToTotal_subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) hx)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.algEquiv_one_tmul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem algEquiv_one_tmul_algebraMap (a : A) :
    ρ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] algebraMap A S a) = algebraMap B T (algebraMap A B a)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] algebraMap A S a = algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] S) a := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
  rw [h1, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B (B ⊗[A] S), AlgEquiv.commutes]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.map_algebraMap_map_eq
statement:
theorem map_algebraMap_map_eq :
    (I.map (algebraMap A B)).map (algebraMap B T) =
      ((I.map (algebraMap A S)).map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := B) (B := S))).map
          (ρ : B ⊗[A] S →+* T)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, ← algEquiv_one_tmul_algebraMap ρ a]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha))
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change ρ (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (algebraMap A S a)) ∈ _
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, algEquiv_one_tmul_algebraMap ρ a]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.quotBaseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk
statement:
theorem quotBaseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk (s : S) :
    quotBaseChangeEquiv ρ I ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s) =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesMapOfEq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem reesMapOfEq_algebraMap (a : A) :
    reesMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a) =
      algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J) (algebraMap A B a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Polynomial.map (algebraMap A B) (C a) = C (algebraMap A B a)
  rw [Polynomial.map_C]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesMapOfEqAlg_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesMapOfEqAlg_apply (x : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesMapOfEqAlg I J hJ x = reesMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesTensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesTensorMap_tmul (b : B) (x : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesTensorMap I J hJ (b ⊗ₜ[A] x) =
      algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J) b * reesMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesTensorMap, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesTensorMap_eq
statement:
theorem reesTensorMap_eq :
    reesTensorMap I J hJ =
      (reesEquivOfEq I J hJ).toAlgHom.comp (reesTensorMap I (I.map (algebraMap A B)) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.TensorProduct.ext' fun b x ↦ ?_
  change _ = reesEquivOfEq I J hJ (reesTensorMap I (I.map (algebraMap A B)) rfl (b ⊗ₜ[A] x))
  rw [reesTensorMap_tmul, reesTensorMap_tmul, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesTensorMap_apply_eq
statement:
theorem reesTensorMap_apply_eq (z : B ⊗[A] reesAlgebra I) :
    reesTensorMap I (I.map (algebraMap A B)) rfl z =
      ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap (B := B) I
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B (reesAlgebra I) z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul b x =>
    rw [reesTensorMap_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul, ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap_tmul]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesTensorMap_apply_eq'
statement:
theorem reesTensorMap_apply_eq' (z : B ⊗[A] reesAlgebra I) :
    reesTensorMap I J hJ z = reesEquivOfEq I J hJ (ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap (B := B) I
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B (reesAlgebra I) z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesTensorMap_eq, ← reesTensorMap_apply_eq]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesTensorMap_bijective
statement: theorem reesTensorMap_bijective [Module.Flat A B] : Function.Bijective (reesTensorMap I J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑(reesTensorMap I J hJ) = ⇑(reesEquivOfEq I J hJ) ∘
      ⇑(ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap (B := B) I) ∘
        ⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B (reesAlgebra I)) :=
    funext (reesTensorMap_apply_eq' I J hJ)
  rw [h]
  have hb : Function.Bijective (ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap (B := B) I) :=
    ⟨ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap_injective I, ReesBlowup.reesBaseChangeMap_surjective I⟩
  exact (reesEquivOfEq I J hJ).bijective.comp
    (hb.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B (reesAlgebra I)).bijective)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesTensorEquiv_one_tmul
statement:
theorem reesTensorEquiv_one_tmul [Module.Flat A B] (x : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesTensorEquiv I J hJ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] x) = reesMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ x
proof:
:= by
  change reesTensorMap I J hJ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] x) = _
  rw [reesTensorMap_tmul, map_one, one_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesMapOfEq_algebraMap'
statement:
theorem reesMapOfEq_algebraMap' (a : A) :
    reesMapOfEq I f J hJ (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a) = algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Polynomial.map f (C a) = C (f a)
  rw [Polynomial.map_C]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.map_le_comap_map_reesMapOfEq
statement:
theorem map_le_comap_map_reesMapOfEq :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I)) I ≤
      (Ideal.map (algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J)) J).comap (reesMapOfEq I f J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, reesMapOfEq_algebraMap']
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hJ ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f ha)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grMapOfEq_mk (x : reesAlgebra I) :
    grMapOfEq I f J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMapOfEq I f J hJ x)
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_congr
statement:
theorem grMapOfEq_congr {f' : A →+* B} (e : f = f') :
    grMapOfEq I f J hJ = grMapOfEq I f' J (e ▸ hJ)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem grMapOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    grMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  ext x
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) x) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x
  refine congrArg _ (Subtype.ext ?_)
  change (x : A[X]).map (RingHom.id A) = x
  rw [Polynomial.map_id]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem grMapOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C)
    (hK : J.map g = K) :
    grMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, hJ, hK]) =
      (grMapOfEq J g K hK).comp (grMapOfEq I f J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  ext x
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K _ x) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMapOfEq J g K hK (reesMapOfEq I f J hJ x))
  refine congrArg _ (Subtype.ext ?_)
  change (x : A[X]).map (g.comp f) = ((x : A[X]).map f).map g
  rw [Polynomial.map_map]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grMapOfEq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem grMapOfEq_algebraMap (a : A) :
    grMapOfEq I f J hJ (algebraMap A (associatedGradedRing A I) a) =
      algebraMap B (associatedGradedRing B J) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  change grMapOfEq I f J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap B (reesAlgebra J) (f a))
  rw [grMapOfEq_mk, reesMapOfEq_algebraMap']

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grTensorEquiv_one_tmul_mk
statement:
theorem grTensorEquiv_one_tmul_mk (x : reesAlgebra I) :

      grMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [grTensorEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, quotBaseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk,
    reesTensorEquiv_one_tmul, grMapOfEq_mk]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.grTensorEquiv_one_tmul
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.idealTensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealTensorMap_tmul (b : B) (x : I) :
    idealTensorMap I (b ⊗ₜ[A] x) = b * algebraMap A B x
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealTensorMap, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.range_idealTensorMap
statement: theorem range_idealTensorMap : LinearMap.range (idealTensorMap I) = J
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul b x =>
      rw [idealTensorMap_tmul]
      exact J.mul_mem_left b (hJ ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A B) x.2)
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact J.add_mem hx hy
  · rw [← hJ, Ideal.map, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] ⟨x, hx⟩, by rw [idealTensorMap_tmul, one_mul]⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.idealTensorMap_injective
statement: theorem idealTensorMap_injective : Function.Injective (idealTensorMap (B := B) I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealTensorMap, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  refine (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid A B B).injective.comp ?_
  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
  exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ Subtype.val_injective

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.idealTensorEquiv_one_tmul
statement:

    idealTensorEquiv I J hJ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] x) = idealMapLinear I J hJ x
proof:
:= by

  change idealTensorMap I ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] x) = algebraMap A B x
  rw [idealTensorMap_tmul, one_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symTensorEquiv_one_tmul
statement:
theorem symTensorEquiv_one_tmul (s : SymmetricAlgebra A I) :
    symTensorEquiv I J hJ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] s) = symMapOfEqAlg I J hJ s
proof:
:= by
  have key : ((symTensorEquiv I J hJ).toAlgHom.restrictScalars A).comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight = symMapOfEqAlg I J hJ := by
    refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
    change symTensorEquiv I J hJ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I x) =
      symMapOfEqAlg I J hJ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I x)
    rw [symMapOfEqAlg_ι, symTensorEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, ← idealTensorEquiv_one_tmul,
      ← symCongr_ι]
    congr 1
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    change _ = GradedCone.baseChangeForward A I B (SymmetricAlgebra.ι B (B ⊗[A] I) _)
    rw [GradedCone.baseChangeForward, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun key s

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_ι
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_ι (x : I) :
    symMapOfEq I f J hJ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I x) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι B J ⟨f x, hJ ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f x.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  exact symMapOfEqAlg_ι I J hJ x

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_algebraMap (a : A) :
    symMapOfEq I f J hJ (algebraMap A (SymmetricAlgebra A I) a) =
      algebraMap B (SymmetricAlgebra B J) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  change symMapOfEqAlg I J hJ (algebraMap A (SymmetricAlgebra A I) a) = _
  rw [AlgHom.commutes, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B (SymmetricAlgebra B J)]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_congr
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_congr {f' : A →+* B} (e : f = f') :
    symMapOfEq I f J hJ = symMapOfEq I f' J (e ▸ hJ)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    symMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  induction s using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a => rw [symMapOfEq_algebraMap]; rfl
  | ι x => rw [symMapOfEq_ι]; rfl
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C)
    (hK : J.map g = K) :
    symMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, hJ, hK]) =
      (symMapOfEq J g K hK).comp (symMapOfEq I f J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  induction s using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change _ = symMapOfEq J g K hK (symMapOfEq I f J hJ (algebraMap A (SymmetricAlgebra A I) a))
    rw [symMapOfEq_algebraMap, symMapOfEq_algebraMap, symMapOfEq_algebraMap]
    rfl
  | ι x =>
    change _ = symMapOfEq J g K hK (symMapOfEq I f J hJ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I x))
    rw [symMapOfEq_ι, symMapOfEq_ι, symMapOfEq_ι]
    rfl
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_map_le
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_map_le :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap A (SymmetricAlgebra A I)) I ≤
      (Ideal.map (algebraMap B (SymmetricAlgebra B J)) J).comap (symMapOfEq I f J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, symMapOfEq_algebraMap]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hJ ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f ha)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsMapOfEq_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nsMapOfEq_mk (s : SymmetricAlgebra A I) :
    nsMapOfEq I f J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (symMapOfEq I f J hJ s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsMapOfEq_congr
statement:
theorem nsMapOfEq_congr {f' : A →+* B} (e : f = f') :
    nsMapOfEq I f J hJ = nsMapOfEq I f' J (e ▸ hJ)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsMapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem nsMapOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    nsMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  refine RingHom.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (symMapOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) s) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s
  rw [symMapOfEq_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsMapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem nsMapOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C)
    (hK : J.map g = K) :
    nsMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, hJ, hK]) =
      (nsMapOfEq J g K hK).comp (nsMapOfEq I f J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  refine RingHom.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (symMapOfEq I (g.comp f) K _ s) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (symMapOfEq J g K hK (symMapOfEq I f J hJ s))
  rw [symMapOfEq_comp I f J hJ g K hK]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsMapOfEq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem nsMapOfEq_algebraMap (a : A) :
    nsMapOfEq I f J hJ (algebraMap A (normalSheafRing A I) a) =
      algebraMap B (normalSheafRing B J) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  change nsMapOfEq I f J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A (SymmetricAlgebra A I) a)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap B (SymmetricAlgebra B J) (f a))
  rw [nsMapOfEq_mk, symMapOfEq_algebraMap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symMapOfEq_eq_symMapOfEqAlg
statement:
theorem symMapOfEq_eq_symMapOfEqAlg (s : SymmetricAlgebra A I) :
    symMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ s = symMapOfEqAlg I J hJ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    rw [symMapOfEq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B (SymmetricAlgebra B J)]
  | ι x => rw [symMapOfEq_ι, symMapOfEqAlg_ι]; rfl
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsTensorEquiv_one_tmul
statement:
theorem nsTensorEquiv_one_tmul (z : normalSheafRing A I) :
    nsTensorEquiv I J hJ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] z) = nsMapOfEq I (algebraMap A B) J hJ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  rw [nsTensorEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, quotBaseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk,
    symTensorEquiv_one_tmul, nsMapOfEq_mk, symMapOfEq_eq_symMapOfEqAlg]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symToRees_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symToRees_ι (x : I) : symToRees A I (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I x) = degreeOneRees A I x
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coe_degreeOneRees
statement: theorem coe_degreeOneRees (x : I) : (degreeOneRees A I x : A[X]) = monomial 1 (x : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symToRees_surjective
statement: theorem symToRees_surjective : Function.Surjective (symToRees A I)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hp : (p : A[X]) ∈ Algebra.adjoin A
      (Submodule.map (monomial 1 : A →ₗ[A] A[X]) I : Set A[X]) := by
    rw [adjoin_monomial_eq_reesAlgebra]
    exact p.2
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin A (Submodule.map (monomial 1 : A →ₗ[A] A[X]) I : Set A[X]) ≤
      (symToRees A I).range.map (reesAlgebra I).val := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨symToRees A I (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I ⟨x, hx⟩), ⟨_, rfl⟩, by
      rw [symToRees_ι]
      rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, ⟨s, rfl⟩, hq⟩ := hle hp
  exact ⟨s, Subtype.ext hq⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.symToRees_map_le
statement:
theorem symToRees_map_le :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap A (SymmetricAlgebra A I)) I ≤
      (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I)) I).comap (symToRees A I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, AlgHom.commutes]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsToGr_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nsToGr_mk (s : SymmetricAlgebra A I) :
    nsToGr A I (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (symToRees A I s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsToGr_surjective
statement: theorem nsToGr_surjective : Function.Surjective (nsToGr A I)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := symToRees_surjective A I y
  exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s, rfl⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.reesMapOfEq_degreeOneRees
statement:
theorem reesMapOfEq_degreeOneRees (x : I) :
    reesMapOfEq I f J hJ (degreeOneRees A I x) =
      degreeOneRees B J ⟨f x, hJ ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f x.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (monomial 1 (x : A)).map f = monomial 1 (f x)
  rw [Polynomial.map_monomial]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.nsToGr_naturality
statement:
theorem nsToGr_naturality :
    (nsToGr B J).toRingHom.comp (nsMapOfEq I f J hJ) =
      (grMapOfEq I f J hJ).comp (nsToGr A I).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  refine RingHom.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (symToRees B J (symMapOfEq I f J hJ s)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMapOfEq I f J hJ (symToRees A I s))
  congr 1
  induction s using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    rw [symMapOfEq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, reesMapOfEq_algebraMap']
  | ι x => rw [symMapOfEq_ι, symToRees_ι, symToRees_ι, reesMapOfEq_degreeOneRees]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.quotTensorIdealEquiv_one_tmul
statement:
theorem quotTensorIdealEquiv_one_tmul (x : I) :
    quotTensorIdealEquiv A I ((1 : A ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[A] x) = I.toCotangent x
proof:
:= by
  change TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul I I ((1 : A ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[A] x) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafRingEquiv_mk_ι
statement:
theorem normalSheafRingEquiv_mk_ι (x : I) :
    normalSheafRingEquiv A I (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι A I x)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (I.toCotangent x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalSheafRingEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor_mk, ← quotTensorIdealEquiv_one_tmul,
    ← symCongr_ι]
  congr 1
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change _ = GradedCone.baseChangeForward A I (A ⧸ I) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι _ _ _)
  rw [GradedCone.baseChangeForward, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_equiv :
    (normalSheafCoordinateMap A I).comp (normalSheafRingEquiv A I).toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      (nsToGr A I).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  refine RingHom.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  change normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (normalSheafRingEquiv A I (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s)) =
    nsToGr A I (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s)
  induction s using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap a =>
    change normalSheafCoordinateMap A I (normalSheafRingEquiv A I
      (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) (normalSheafRing A I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a))) = _
    rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, normalSheafCoordinateMap_base, nsToGr_mk, AlgHom.commutes]
    rfl
  | ι x =>
    rw [normalSheafRingEquiv_mk_ι, normalSheafCoordinateMap_ι,
      conormalToAssociatedGraded_toCotangent, nsToGr_mk, symToRees_ι]
  | mul a b ha hb => simp only [map_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.coneToNormalSheaf_comp_specMap_equiv
statement:
theorem coneToNormalSheaf_comp_specMap_equiv :
    coneToNormalSheaf A I ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (normalSheafRingEquiv A I).toRingEquiv.toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nsToGr A I).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalSheafCoordinateMap_comp_equiv, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.NormalSheaf.isPullback_affine
statement:
theorem isPullback_affine (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (normalSheafRing Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)))) ≫
        (isAffineOpen X U).isoSpec.inv) (affineι X I U) U.1.ι (toBase X I)
proof:
:=
  RelativeSpec.isPullback_affine X (algebraData X I) U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.NormalCone.toNormalSheaf_toBase
statement: theorem toNormalSheaf_toBase : toNormalSheaf X I ≫ NormalSheaf.toBase X I = toBase X I
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.NormalCone.isPullback_toNormalSheaf
statement:
theorem isPullback_toNormalSheaf (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (nsToGr Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)).toRingHom))
      (affineι X I U) (NormalSheaf.affineι X I U) (toNormalSheaf X I)
proof:
:=
  (toNormalSheafHom X I).isPullback_map U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.NormalCone.isPullback_coneToNormalSheaf
statement:
theorem isPullback_coneToNormalSheaf (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (coneToNormalSheaf Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (normalSheafRingEquiv Γ(X, U.1) (I.ideal U)).toRingEquiv.toRingHom))
      (affineι X I U) (NormalSheaf.affineι X I U) (toNormalSheaf X I)

  exact isPullback_toNormalSheaf X I U

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.eq_zero_of_C_mem_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hg0
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hg
  have hCg : (Polynomial.C g : Polynomial D) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Polynomial.C_eq_zero] using hg0
  have hh0 : h ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hh
    exact hCg hh.symm
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by simp [h0] at hF
  have hdeg : (h * F).natDegree = h.natDegree + F.natDegree :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_mul hh0 hF0
  rw [hh, Polynomial.natDegree_C] at hdeg
  omega

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.natDegree_mvPolynomialEquivPolynomial
statement:
theorem natDegree_mvPolynomialEquivPolynomial {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) :
    (mvPolynomialEquivPolynomial k a p).natDegree = p.degreeOf a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.degreeOf_eq_natDegree]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.natCard_subtype_ne
statement: theorem natCard_subtype_ne {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s) : Nat.card {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} = s - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.le_ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem le_ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton {s : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial (Fin s) k}
    (hf0 : f ≠ 0) (hfu : ¬ IsUnit f) (hp : (Ideal.span {f}).IsPrime) :
    ((s - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ Ideal.span {f})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, f.degreeOf a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hcon' : ∀ b, f.degreeOf b = 0 := by
      intro b
      by_contra hb
      exact hcon ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hvars : f.vars = ∅ := by
      ext b
      simp [MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero, hcon' b]
    rw [MvPolynomial.vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C] at hvars
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, f = MvPolynomial.C c := ⟨f.coeff 0, hvars⟩
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hf0 (by rw [hc, h, map_zero])
    refine hfu ?_
    rw [hc]
    exact IsUnit.map MvPolynomial.C (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc0)
  set Φ := mvPolynomialEquivPolynomial k a with hΦ
  have hdeg : 0 < (Φ f).natDegree := by
    rw [hΦ, natDegree_mvPolynomialEquivPolynomial]
    omega
  
  have hmem : ∀ x : MvPolynomial (Fin s) k,
      x ∈ Ideal.span {f} → Φ x ∈ Ideal.span {Φ f} := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨Φ c, by rw [map_mul]⟩
  
  let ψ : MvPolynomial {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} k →ₐ[k]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (Ideal.span {f})).comp
      (Φ.symm.toAlgHom.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (MvPolynomial {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} k)
        (Polynomial (MvPolynomial {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} k))))
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
    intro g₁ g₂ hg
    have hsub : Φ.symm (Polynomial.C (g₁ - g₂)) ∈ Ideal.span {f} := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      have h1 : ψ g₁ - ψ g₂ = 0 := by rw [hg, sub_self]
      simpa [ψ, map_sub, Polynomial.C_sub] using h1
    have h2 : Polynomial.C (g₁ - g₂) ∈ Ideal.span {Φ f} := by
      have := hmem _ hsub
      rwa [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    have := eq_zero_of_C_mem_span_singleton hdeg h2
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  
  have hdomain : IsDomain (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _ |>.mpr hp
  have hft : Algebra.FiniteType k (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (Ideal.span {f})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have htr : Algebra.trdeg k (MvPolynomial {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} k) ≤
      Algebra.trdeg k (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :=
    _root_.trdeg_le_of_injective ψ hψ
  have hdimD : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} k) =
      ((s - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field,
      natCard_subtype_ne]
    simp
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ Ideal.span {f}), ← hdimD,
    ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k (MvPolynomial {b : Fin s // b ≠ a} k)]
  exact_mod_cast OrderHomClass.mono Cardinal.toENat htr

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height_le {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (x : PrimeSpectrum A) :
    ringKrullDim (A ⧸ x.asIdeal) + ((x.asIdeal.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum A) := ⟨x⟩
  have hco := PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient x
  have hht := PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight x
  calc ringKrullDim (A ⧸ x.asIdeal) + ((x.asIdeal.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
      = ((Order.height x + Order.coheight x : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        rw [← hco, hht, WithBot.coe_add]
        exact add_comm _ _
    _ ≤ ringKrullDim A := by
        rw [ringKrullDim, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_height_add_coheight_of_nonempty,
          WithBot.coe_le_coe]
        exact le_iSup (fun a : PrimeSpectrum A ↦ Order.height a + Order.coheight a) x

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_eq_of_height_eq_one
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_eq_of_height_eq_one (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra.FiniteType k B] (P : Ideal B) [hP : P.IsPrime] (hh : P.height = 1) :
    ringKrullDim (B ⧸ P) + 1 = ringKrullDim B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, g, hinj, hfin⟩ := exists_finite_inj_algHom_of_fg k B
  algebraize [g.toRingHom]
  have htower : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' g.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have hmf : Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B := hfin
  have hint : Algebra.IsIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite _ _
  have hfaith : FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hinj
  have hdimB : ringKrullDim B = ((s : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B,
      MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
    simp
  
  have hQprime : (P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)).IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under _ _
  
  have hmono : StrictMono
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B)) := fun x y hxy ↦ by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal] at hxy ⊢
    exact Ideal.IsIntegral.comap_lt_comap hxy
  have hge : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ (P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)).height := by
    have h1 := Order.height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono _ hmono (⟨P, hP⟩ : PrimeSpectrum B)
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight (⟨P, hP⟩ : PrimeSpectrum B), hh] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (le_of_eq (PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight
      (⟨P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k), hQprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k))).symm)
  
  have hgd : Algebra.HasGoingDown (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) B := inferInstance
  have hle : (P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)).height ≤ 1 := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight
      (⟨P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k), hQprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum _)]
    refine Order.height_le fun l hlast ↦ ?_
    have hlo : P.LiesOver l.last.asIdeal := by
      rw [hlast]
      exact ⟨rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hLlen, hLlast, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown l P
    have h3 := Order.length_le_height_last (p := L)
    rw [hLlast, hLlen] at h3
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight (⟨P, hP⟩ : PrimeSpectrum B), hh] at h3
    exact h3
  have hQh : (P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)).height = 1 := le_antisymm hle hge
  
  have hPrinc : (P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)).IsPrincipal :=
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.isPrincipal_of_height_eq_one hQh
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Submodule.IsPrincipal.principal (P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k))
  have hqspan : P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) = Ideal.span {q} := hq
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at hqspan
    simp only [Ideal.span_singleton_zero] at hqspan
    rw [hqspan] at hQh
    simp at hQh
  have hqu : ¬ IsUnit q := by
    intro hu
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu] at hqspan
    exact hQprime.ne_top hqspan
  have hqp : (Ideal.span {q} : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)).IsPrime := hqspan ▸ hQprime
  have hstep1 := le_ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton k hq0 hqu hqp
  
  have hfaith' : FaithfulSMul
      (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)) (B ⧸ P) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr Ideal.quotientMap_injective
  have hdimq : ringKrullDim (B ⧸ P) =
      ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ⧸ P.under (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)) :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral _ _
  
  have hs : 1 ≤ s := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hs0 : s = 0 := by omega
    have hle0 := Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top (I := P) hP.ne_top
    rw [hh, hdimB, hs0] at hle0
    have h10 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ (0 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hle0
    omega
  
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have hup := ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height_le (⟨P, hP⟩ : PrimeSpectrum B)
    change ringKrullDim (B ⧸ P) + ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim B at hup
    rw [hh] at hup
    simpa using hup
  · rw [hdimB, hdimq, hqspan]
    have hcast : ((s - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 = ((s : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      have hss : (s - 1 : ℕ) + 1 = s := by omega
      rw [← hss]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [← hcast]
    exact add_le_add hstep1 le_rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height_aux
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height_aux (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Ideal A) (_ : p.IsPrime), p.height = (n : ℕ∞) →
      ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) + ((n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro p hp hn
    have hbot : p = ⊥ := by
      have hmin := Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff (I := p) |>.mp (by exact_mod_cast hn)
      rw [IsDomain.minimalPrimes_eq_singleton_bot] at hmin
      simpa using hmin
    subst hbot
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot A)]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro p hp hn
    
    have hht : Order.height (⟨p, hp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight]
      exact_mod_cast hn
    obtain ⟨l, hlast, hlen⟩ := Order.exists_series_of_height_eq_coe _ hht
    have hlne : l.length ≠ 0 := by omega
    set x : PrimeSpectrum A := l.eraseLast.last with hxdef
    have hxlt : x < (⟨p, hp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) := by
      have hrel := l.eraseLast_last_rel_last hlne
      rwa [hlast] at hrel
    have hxlen : l.eraseLast.length = n := by
      rw [RelSeries.eraseLast_length, hlen]
      omega
    have hxge : ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ Order.height x := by
      have hle := Order.length_le_height_last (p := l.eraseLast)
      rwa [hxlen] at hle
    have hxle : Order.height x ≤ ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      have h0 : Order.height x + 1 ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [← hht]
        exact Order.height_add_one_le hxlt
      have h1 : Order.height x + 1 ≤ ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
        refine le_trans h0 (le_of_eq ?_)
        push_cast
        ring
      exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp h1
    have hxh : Order.height x = ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := le_antisymm hxle hxge
    
    set q : Ideal A := x.asIdeal with hqdef
    have hqprime : q.IsPrime := x.isPrime
    have hqp : q < p := by
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal] at hxlt
      exact hxlt
    
    have hsat : ∀ r : Ideal A, r.IsPrime → q ≤ r → r < p → r = q := by
      intro r hr hqr hrp
      by_contra hne
      have hqr' : (x : PrimeSpectrum A) < (⟨r, hr⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) := by
        rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne hqr (Ne.symm hne)
      have hrp' : (⟨r, hr⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) < (⟨p, hp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) := by
        rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
        exact hrp
      have h4 : ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        calc ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 + 1 := by push_cast; ring
          _ ≤ Order.height (⟨r, hr⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) + 1 := by
              refine add_le_add ?_ le_rfl
              rw [← hxh]
              exact Order.height_add_one_le hqr'
          _ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
              rw [← hht]
              exact Order.height_add_one_le hrp'
      have h5 : n + 2 ≤ n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h4
      omega
    
    have hqdomain : IsDomain (A ⧸ q) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime q |>.mpr hqprime
    have hqft : Algebra.FiniteType k (A ⧸ q) :=
      Algebra.FiniteType.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k q) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hmono : StrictMono (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)) :=
      RingHom.strictMono_comap_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hbotcomap : (⊥ : Ideal (A ⧸ q)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) = q := by
      rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
    set P : Ideal (A ⧸ q) := p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) with hPdef
    have hPprime : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_quotientMk_of_isPrime hqp.le
    have hPcomap : P.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) = p := by
      rw [hPdef, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hqp.le]
    have hcomapP : PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) (⟨P, hPprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q))
        = (⟨p, hp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) := PrimeSpectrum.ext hPcomap
    
    have hbelow : ∀ y : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q),
        y < (⟨P, hPprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q)) → y = ⊥ := by
      intro y hy
      have hylt : PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) y < (⟨p, hp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) := by
        rw [← hcomapP]
        exact hmono hy
      have hyq : q ≤ Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) y.asIdeal := by
        intro z hz
        change Ideal.Quotient.mk q z ∈ y.asIdeal
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hz]
        exact y.asIdeal.zero_mem
      have hyeq : Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) y.asIdeal = q := by
        refine hsat _ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) y).isPrime hyq ?_
        rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal] at hylt
        exact hylt
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      refine Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ?_
      rw [hyeq, show ((⊥ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q)).asIdeal) = ⊥ from rfl, hbotcomap]
    
    have hPne : P ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, hbotcomap] at hPcomap
      exact hqp.ne hPcomap
    have hPge : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ P.height := by
      by_cases h0 : P.height = 0
      · exfalso
        have hmin := Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff (I := P) |>.mp h0
        rw [IsDomain.minimalPrimes_eq_singleton_bot] at hmin
        exact hPne (by simpa using hmin)
      · exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h0
    have hPle : P.height ≤ 1 := by
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight (⟨P, hPprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q)),
        Order.height_eq_iSup_lt_height]
      refine iSup_le fun y ↦ iSup_le fun hy ↦ ?_
      rw [hbelow y hy]
      simp
    have hPh : P.height = 1 := le_antisymm hPle hPge
    
    have hker : RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)) = p := by
      ext z
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← Ideal.mem_comap,
        hPcomap]
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hequiv : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) = ringKrullDim ((A ⧸ q) ⧸ P) :=
      ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
        ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj))
    
    have hstep2 := ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_eq_of_height_eq_one k (A ⧸ q) P hPh
    have hqh : q.height = ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hqdef, PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight]
      exact hxh
    have hIH := ih q hqprime hqh
    have hcast : (((n + 1 : ℕ)) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ((n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hequiv, hcast, add_comm (((n : ℕ)) : WithBot ℕ∞) 1, ← add_assoc, hstep2, hIH]

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] (p : Ideal A) [hp : p.IsPrime] :
    ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) + ((p.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  have hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, p.height = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    have hlt := Ideal.height_lt_top (I := p) hp.ne_top
    exact ⟨p.height.toNat, by rw [ENat.coe_toNat hlt.ne]⟩
  rw [hn]
  exact_mod_cast ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height_aux k A n p hp hn

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.hasDimensionFormula
statement:
theorem hasDimensionFormula (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] : HasDimensionFormula A
proof:
:=
  fun p hp ↦ ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height (hp := hp) k A p

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes'
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes' [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k R] (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ) (hn : ringKrullDim R = (n : ℕ∞))
    {q : Ideal (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)}
    (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I)) :
    ringKrullDim (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing R I ⧸ q) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:=

statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_associatedGradedRing' [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

    (hasDimensionFormula_extendedRees k I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.pureTopologicalDimension_normalCone'
statement:
theorem pureTopologicalDimension_normalCone' [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

    (hasDimensionFormula_extendedRees k I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.grRestrictionOfEq_mk

theorem grRestrictionOfEq_mk (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)

    grRestrictionOfEq I f J h (ReesBlowup.grMk I p) =
      ReesBlowup.grMk J (ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq I f J h p)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.graded_quotient_restriction
statement:
theorem graded_quotient_restriction (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    (ReesBlowup.grMk J).comp (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq I f J h) =
      (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h).comp (ReesBlowup.grMk I)
proof:
:= by

  intro p
