name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.map_irrelevant_le
statement:
theorem map_irrelevant_le {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup R) (ℬ : ℕ → AddSubgroup S) [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f ≤ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ
proof:
:= by
  change (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).toIdeal.map f ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).toIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_eq_span]
  apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  obtain ⟨hn, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  exact HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem ℬ hn (f.map_mem hx)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_of_quotient_square
statement:
theorem irrelevant_of_quotient_square
    {R S T U : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup R) (ℬ : ℕ → AddSubgroup S)
    (𝒞 : ℕ → AddSubgroup T) (𝒟 : ℕ → AddSubgroup U)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] [GradedRing 𝒞] [GradedRing 𝒟]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (q' : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒟) (g : 𝒞 →+*ᵍ 𝒟)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hq' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒟 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).map q')
    (hsq : q'.comp f = g.comp q) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒟 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞).map g
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).map q' := hq'
    _ ≤ ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f).map q' := HomogeneousIdeal.map_mono _ hf
    _ = ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map q).map g := by
      rw [HomogeneousIdeal.map_map, HomogeneousIdeal.map_map, hsq]
    _ ≤ _ := HomogeneousIdeal.map_mono _ (map_irrelevant_le 𝒜 𝒞 q)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq
statement:
theorem irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (ReesBlowup.grGrade J) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (ReesBlowup.grGrade I)).map (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
proof:
:=
  @irrelevant_of_quotient_square
    (reesAlgebra I) (reesAlgebra J) (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing B J)
    inferInstance inferInstance (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    (ReesBlowup.grade I) (ReesBlowup.grade J) (ReesBlowup.grGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade J)
    (ReesBlowup.gradedRing I) (ReesBlowup.gradedRing J)
    (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing I) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing J)
    (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq I f J h) (ReesBlowup.grMk I) (ReesBlowup.grMk J)
    (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (ReesBlowupOfEq.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfEq I f J h)
    (ReesBlowup.irrelevant_le_map_grMk J) (graded_quotient_restriction I f J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.centreMapEquality
statement:
theorem centreMapEquality (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J) :
    (centreIdeal I).map (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) = centreIdeal J
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_centreIdeal_mapRingHom, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.total_comparison_naturality
statement:
theorem total_comparison_naturality (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGraded J).comp (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h) =
      (grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
        (centreMapEquality I f J h)).comp (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGraded I)
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv_restriction I f p).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.total_restriction_comparison_route
statement:
theorem total_restriction_comparison_route (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h =
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGradedInverse J).comp
        ((grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
          (centreMapEquality I f J h)).comp (InfinityNormalConeProj.comparisonGraded I))
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  have hn := GradedRingHom.congr_fun (total_comparison_naturality I f J h) p
  have hi := congrArg (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv J).symm hn
  change (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv J).symm
    (CentrePowers.polynomialGrEquiv J (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h p)) = _ at hi
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hi
  exact hi

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq
statement:
theorem irrelevant_totalRestrictionOfEq (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade J) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I)).map
        (totalRestrictionOfEq I f J h)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.irrelevant_comparison I)
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h))
  have ht := HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp hc
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.irrelevant_comparison_inverse J)
  rw [← total_restriction_comparison_route] at ht
  exact ht

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.grRestrictionOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem grRestrictionOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (I : Ideal A)
    (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (k : J.map g = K) :
    (grRestrictionOfEq J g K k).comp (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h) =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq_id

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.totalRestrictionOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem totalRestrictionOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (I : Ideal A)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.proj_map_id_of_graded_id
statement:
theorem proj_map_id_of_graded_id
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup R) [GradedRing 𝒜]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒜) (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (he : f = GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) : Proj.map f hf = 𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)
proof:
:=
  (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr he hf).trans Proj.map_id

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.proj_map_comp_of_graded_comp
statement:
theorem proj_map_comp_of_graded_comp
    {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup R) (ℬ : ℕ → AddSubgroup S) (𝒞 : ℕ → AddSubgroup T)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] [GradedRing 𝒞]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (k : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).map g)
    (hk : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map k)
    (he : g.comp f = k) : Proj.map g hg ≫ Proj.map f hf = Proj.map k hk
proof:
:= by
  exact (Proj.map_comp f g hf hg).symm.trans (ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr he _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.proj_map_square
statement:
theorem proj_map_square
    {R S T U : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup R) (ℬ : ℕ → AddSubgroup S)
    (𝒞 : ℕ → AddSubgroup T) (𝒟 : ℕ → AddSubgroup U)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] [GradedRing 𝒞] [GradedRing 𝒟]
    (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ 𝒞) (q' : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒟) (g : 𝒞 →+*ᵍ 𝒟)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hq : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map q)
    (hq' : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒟 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ).map q')
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒟 ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒞).map g)
    (hsq : q'.comp f = g.comp q) :
    Proj.map g hg ≫ Proj.map q hq = Proj.map q' hq' ≫ Proj.map f hf
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Proj.map_comp, ← Proj.map_comp]
  exact ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr hsq.symm _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_id
statement:
theorem grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) = 𝟙 (ReesBlowup.grScheme I)
proof:
:=
  @proj_map_id_of_graded_id (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I)
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (ReesBlowup.grGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing I)
    (grRestrictionOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I))
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I)) (grRestrictionOfEq_id I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (I : Ideal A)
    (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (k : J.map g = K) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq J g K k ≫ grSchemeRestrictionOfEq I f J h =
      grSchemeRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])
proof:
:=
  @proj_map_comp_of_graded_comp
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing B J)
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing C K)
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade J) (ReesBlowup.grGrade K)
    (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing I) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing J) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing K)
    (grRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (grRestrictionOfEq J g K k)
    (grRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq I f J h) (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq J g K k)
    (irrelevant_grRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k]))
    (grRestrictionOfEq_comp I f J h g K k)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestrictionOfEq_id
statement:
theorem completionRestrictionOfEq_id (I : Ideal A) :
    completionRestrictionOfEq I (RingHom.id A) I (Ideal.map_id I) =
      𝟙 (InfinityNormalConeProj.projectiveNormalCompletion I)
proof:
:=
  @proj_map_id_of_graded_id (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I))
    (polynomialGrCommRing I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I)
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing I) _ _ (totalRestrictionOfEq_id I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestrictionOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem completionRestrictionOfEq_comp {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (I : Ideal A)
    (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B) (h : I.map f = J) (g : B →+* C) (K : Ideal C) (k : J.map g = K) :
    completionRestrictionOfEq J g K k ≫ completionRestrictionOfEq I f J h =
      completionRestrictionOfEq I (g.comp f) K (by rw [← Ideal.map_map, h, k])
proof:
:=
  @proj_map_comp_of_graded_comp
    (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I))
    (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing B J))
    (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing C K))
    (polynomialGrCommRing I) (polynomialGrCommRing J) (polynomialGrCommRing K)
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade J) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade K)
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing J)
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing K) _ _ _ _ _ _ (totalRestrictionOfEq_comp I f J h g K k)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_grMap
statement:
theorem grSchemeRestrictionOfEq_grMap (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq I f J h ≫ ReesBlowup.grMap I =
      ReesBlowup.grMap J ≫ ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq I f J h
proof:
:=
  @proj_map_square (reesAlgebra I) (reesAlgebra J)
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I) (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing B J)
    inferInstance inferInstance (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    (ReesBlowup.grade I) (ReesBlowup.grade J) (ReesBlowup.grGrade I) (ReesBlowup.grGrade J)
    (ReesBlowup.gradedRing I) (ReesBlowup.gradedRing J)
    (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing I) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing J)
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (graded_quotient_restriction I f J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestrictionOfEq_comparison
statement:
theorem completionRestrictionOfEq_comparison (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map f = J) :
    grSchemeRestrictionOfEq (centreIdeal I) (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) (centreIdeal J)
      (centreMapEquality I f J h) ≫ (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso I).hom =
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso J).hom ≫ completionRestrictionOfEq I f J h
proof:
:=
  @proj_map_square
    (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A I))
    (Polynomial (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing B J))
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing A[X] (centreIdeal I))
    (AffineNormalCone.associatedGradedRing B[X] (centreIdeal J))
    (polynomialGrCommRing I) (polynomialGrCommRing J)
    (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _) (Ideal.Quotient.commRing _)
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGrade J)
    (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal I)) (ReesBlowup.grGrade (centreIdeal J))
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing I) (InfinityNormalConeProj.totalGradedRing J)
    (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing (centreIdeal I)) (ReesBlowup.grGradedRing (centreIdeal J))
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (total_comparison_naturality I f J h)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestrictionOfEq_congr

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineGrRestriction_exceptional
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem affineGrRestriction_exceptional {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    affineGrRestriction Y J h ≫ (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjIso Γ(Y,V.1) (J.ideal V)).hom =
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjIso Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).hom ≫
        InfinityExceptionalGlobal.exceptionalRestriction Y J h
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (ReesBlowup.exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal V)))).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjIso, asIso_hom,
    ReesBlowup.grToExceptional_exceptionalι,
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.exceptionalRestriction_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineGrRestriction_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem affineGrRestriction_toComponent {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    affineGrRestriction Y J h ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjToComponent Y J V =
      InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjToComponent Y J U

    affineGrRestriction Y J h ≫ (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso (J.ideal V)).hom =

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    affineCompletionRestriction Y J h ≫ InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent Y J V =
      InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent Y J U
proof:

  rw [← Category.assoc, ← affineCompletionRestriction_comparison]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem affineCompletionRestriction_toCentre {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    affineCompletionRestriction Y J h ≫ InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre Y J V =
      InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre Y J U ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (J.subschemeCover.f V)).mp
  have hV := (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J V).w
  have hU := (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J U).w
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hV hU ⊢
  rw [← hV, SubschemeProductGlobal.quotientChart_naturality, ← hU,
    ← Category.assoc, affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.affineCompletionRestriction_isPullback
statement:
theorem affineCompletionRestriction_isPullback {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPullback (affineCompletionRestriction Y J h)
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre Y J U)
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre Y J V)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalSubscheme.quotientRes Y J h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent Y J V)
    (h₂₂ := J.subschemeCover.f V) ?_ (affineCompletionRestriction_toCentre Y J h)
    (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J V)
  rw [affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent, SubschemeProductGlobal.quotientChart_naturality]
  exact InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.quotientChart_isPullback_open
statement:

    IsPullback (J.subschemeCover.f U)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
      J.subschemeι U.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  refine (ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_subschemeCover Y J U).of_iso
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) U.2.isoSpec.symm (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionChart_isPullback_open
statement:
theorem completionChart_isPullback_open (U : Y.affineOpens) :

      (completionGluingApp Y J U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionGluingApp_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem completionGluingApp_naturality {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    affineCompletionRestriction Y J h ≫ completionGluingApp Y J V =
      completionGluingApp Y J U ≫ Y.homOfLE h
proof:

  rw [Category.assoc, ← (completionChart_isPullback_open Y J V).w,
    ← Category.assoc, affineCompletionRestriction_toComponent,
    (completionChart_isPullback_open Y J U).w,
    Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionRestriction_isPullback_open
statement:
theorem completionRestriction_isPullback_open {U V : Y.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsPullback (affineCompletionRestriction Y J h) (completionGluingApp Y J U)
      (completionGluingApp Y J V) (Y.homOfLE h)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent Y J V)
    (h₂₂ := V.1.ι) ?_ (completionGluingApp_naturality Y J h)
    (completionChart_isPullback_open Y J V)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionGluingNatTrans_equifibered

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionChart_points_over

theorem completionChart_points_over {U V : Y.affineOpens}

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionAffine_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem completionAffine_toCentre (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    completionAffineι Y J U ≫ normalConeCompletionToCentre Y J =
      InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToCentre Y J U ≫ J.subschemeCover.f U

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionComponentIso_toCentre
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem completionComponentIso_toCentre :
    (completionComponentIso Y J).hom ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J =
      normalConeCompletionToCentre Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.hom_ext
  intro U
  change completionAffineι Y J U ≫ _ = completionAffineι Y J U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, completionAffine_componentIso, completionAffine_toCentre]
  exact (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J U).w

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.normalConeCompletionToCentre_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem normalConeCompletionToCentre_toBase :
    normalConeCompletionToCentre Y J ≫ J.subschemeι = normalConeCompletionToBase Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.colimit.hom_ext
  intro U
  change completionAffineι Y J U ≫ _ = completionAffineι Y J U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, completionAffine_toCentre]
  rw [← (InfinityNormalConeProj.completionToComponent_isPullback Y J U).w, Category.assoc]
  exact (completionChart_isPullback_open Y J U).w.trans
    ((completionGluingData Y J).ι_toBase U).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionAffine_toTotal
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem completionAffine_toTotal (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    completionAffineι Y J U ≫ normalConeCompletionToTotal Y J =
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso (J.ideal U)).inv ≫
        InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjToComponent Y J U ≫
          InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalConeCompletionToTotal, ← Category.assoc, completionAffine_componentIso]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.normalConeCompletionToTotal_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem normalConeCompletionToTotal_toBase :
    normalConeCompletionToTotal Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      normalConeCompletionToCentre Y J ≫ J.subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalConeCompletionToTotal, Category.assoc,
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal_toBase, ← Category.assoc,
    completionComponentIso_toCentre]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityNormalConeGlobal.completionAffine_toTotal_exceptional
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem completionAffine_toTotal_exceptional (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    completionAffineι Y J U ≫ normalConeCompletionToTotal Y J =
      (InfinityNormalConeProj.projComparisonIso (J.ideal U)).inv ≫
        (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjIso Γ(Y,U.1) (J.ideal U)).hom ≫
          ReesBlowup.exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) ≫
            blowupι (J.ideal U) ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalAffineι Y J U
proof:
:= by
  rw [completionAffine_toTotal, InfinityExceptionalGlobal.affineExceptionalProjToComponent,
    Category.assoc, InfinityExceptionalGlobal.exceptionalToComponent_toTotal]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.chartLocalizationMap_injective_of_injective
statement:
theorem chartLocalizationMap_injective_of_injective (I : Ideal A) (f : A →+* B) (r : I)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective (chartLocalizationMap I f r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ :=
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) z
  have ha' : a ∈ grade I n := by simpa using ha
  rw [chartLocalizationMap_mk I f r n a ha'] at hz
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hz
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := m.2
  have hhom : (a : A[X]) = monomial n ((a : A[X]).coeff n) := ha'
  have heval : reesEval I f a = f ((a : A[X]).coeff n) := by
    change Polynomial.eval₂ f 1 (a : A[X]) = _
    rw [hhom]
    simp
  have hcoeff : r.1 ^ j * (a : A[X]).coeff n = 0 := by
    apply hf
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_zero]
    simpa only [hj, heval] using hm
  have hkill : generator I r ^ j * a = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (monomial 1 r.1) ^ j * (a : A[X]) = 0
    rw [hhom, monomial_pow, monomial_mul_monomial]
    simpa using congrArg (monomial (j + n)) hcoeff
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
  change Localization.mk a _ = 0
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨generator I r ^ j, ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩, hkill⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.affineOtherToBlowup_preimage_complement
statement:
theorem affineOtherToBlowup_preimage_complement (I : Ideal A) :
    affineOtherToBlowup A I ⁻¹ᵁ blowupComplement (centreIdeal I) = blowupComplement I
proof:
:= by
  change affineOtherToBlowup A I ⁻¹ᵁ (blowupToLine I ⁻¹ᵁ baseComplement (centreIdeal I)) = _
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, affineOtherToBlowup_toLine, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    zeroSection_preimage_baseComplement]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.otherComplementToBlowup_comp_ι
statement:
theorem otherComplementToBlowup_comp_ι (I : Ideal A) :
    otherComplementToBlowup I ≫ (blowupComplement (centreIdeal I)).ι =
      (blowupComplement I).ι ≫ affineOtherToBlowup A I
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.resLE_square
statement:
theorem resLE_square {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ T)
    (p : X ⟶ S) (z : S ⟶ T) (h : g ≫ q = p ≫ z)
    (V : X.Opens) (W : Y.Opens) (U : S.Opens) (U' : T.Opens)
    (hVW : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W) (hWT : W ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U')
    (hVU : V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hUU : U ≤ z ⁻¹ᵁ U') :
    g.resLE W V hVW ≫ q.resLE U' W hWT =
      p.resLE U V hVU ≫ z.resLE U' U hUU
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono U'.ι).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι]
  simp only [Category.assoc, h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.otherComplement_square
statement:
theorem otherComplement_square (I : Ideal A) :
    otherComplementToBlowup I ≫ (projection (centreIdeal I) ∣_ baseComplement (centreIdeal I)) =
      (projection I ∣_ baseComplement I) ≫ zeroComplementMap I
proof:
:= by
  have h := resLE_square (affineOtherToBlowup A I) (projection (centreIdeal I))
    (projection I) (zeroSection A) (affineOtherToBlowup_toLine A I)
    (blowupComplement I) (blowupComplement (centreIdeal I))
    (baseComplement I) (baseComplement (centreIdeal I))
    (affineOtherToBlowup_preimage_complement I).ge le_rfl le_rfl
    (zeroSection_preimage_baseComplement A I).ge
  dsimp only [otherComplementToBlowup, zeroComplementMap, blowupComplement] at h ⊢
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.resLE_eq_morphismRestrict] using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.otherComplement_isPullback
statement:
theorem otherComplement_isPullback (I : Ideal A) :
    IsPullback (otherComplementToBlowup I) (projection I ∣_ baseComplement I)
      (projection (centreIdeal I) ∣_ baseComplement (centreIdeal I)) (zeroComplementMap I)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (projection I ∣_ baseComplement I) := projection_restrict_baseComplement_isIso I
  letI : IsIso (projection (centreIdeal I) ∣_ baseComplement (centreIdeal I)) :=
    projection_restrict_baseComplement_isIso (centreIdeal I)
  have hpb := IsPullback.of_vert_isIso
    (snd := projection I ∣_ baseComplement I)
    (f := projection (centreIdeal I) ∣_ baseComplement (centreIdeal I))
    ⟨otherComplement_square I⟩
  exact hpb

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.specMap_appTop_injective
statement:
theorem specMap_appTop_injective (f : A →+* B) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).appTop.hom
proof:
:= by
  let e := arrowIsoΓSpecOfIsAffine (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom.left).2 x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom.left).2 y
  apply congrArg e.hom.left
  apply hf
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom.right).1
  change (CommRingCat.ofHom f ≫ e.hom.right) a = (CommRingCat.ofHom f ≫ e.hom.right) b
  erw [← e.hom.w]
  exact hxy

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.specMap_ker_eq_bot
statement:
theorem specMap_ker_eq_bot (f : A →+* B) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.ker_of_isAffine]
  have hk : RingHom.ker (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).appTop.hom = ⊥ :=
    (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp (specMap_appTop_injective f hf)
  rw [hk]
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext
  funext U
  erw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal, Ideal.map_bot]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.ker_comap_eq_bot_of_factor
proof:
:= by
  have hk := l.le_ker_comp c
  rw [← h, Scheme.Hom.ker_comp] at hk
  have hc := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_mono i hk).trans
    (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_map_le d.ker i)
  exact le_bot_iff.mp (hd ▸ hc)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.isoPullback_hom_fst, Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.ideal_eq_bot_of_comap_cover
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_bot_of_comap_cover {X : Scheme.{u}} (K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) (h : ∀ i, K.comap (𝒰.f i) = ⊥) : K = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply (Scheme.isIso_subschemeι_iff_eq_bot K).mp
  rw [← MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme) 𝒰
  intro i
  rw [MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  change IsIso (pullback.snd K.subschemeι (𝒰.f i))
  apply IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr
  rw [closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback K.subschemeι (𝒰.f i)).flip,
    K.ker_subschemeι, h i]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.blowupComplement_kernel_comap_chart
statement:
theorem blowupComplement_kernel_comap_chart (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    (blowupComplement I).ι.ker.comap (chartMap I r) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_comap_eq_bot_of_factor (blowupComplement I).ι
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartLocalizationMap I (RingHom.id A) r)))
    (chartMap I r) (principalOpenToComplement I r)
  · exact (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _).symm
  · exact specMap_ker_eq_bot _ (chartLocalizationMap_injective_of_injective I
      (RingHom.id A) r (fun _ _ h ↦ h))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.blowupComplement_kernel_eq_bot
statement: theorem blowupComplement_kernel_eq_bot (I : Ideal A) : (blowupComplement I).ι.ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply ideal_eq_bot_of_comap_cover _ (generatorAffineOpenCover I).openCover
  intro r
  exact blowupComplement_kernel_comap_chart I r

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.zeroComplement_isPullback
statement:
theorem zeroComplement_isPullback (I : Ideal A) :
    IsPullback (zeroComplementMap I) (baseComplement I).ι
      (baseComplement (centreIdeal I)).ι (zeroSection A)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _).symm
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      zeroSection_preimage_baseComplement]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.zeroComplementMap_kernel
statement:
theorem zeroComplementMap_kernel (I : Ideal A) :
    (zeroComplementMap I).ker = (zeroSection A).ker.comap (baseComplement (centreIdeal I)).ι
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (zeroSection A) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (fun a ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C a, by simp⟩)
  exact closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (zeroComplement_isPullback I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.otherComplement_kernel
statement:
theorem otherComplement_kernel (I : Ideal A) :
    (otherComplementToBlowup I).ker =
      strictTransformOpenPartIdeal (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (zeroSection A) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (fun a ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C a, by simp⟩)
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (zeroComplementMap I) := by
    rw [← (zeroComplement_isPullback I).isoPullback_hom_fst]
    infer_instance
  rw [closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (otherComplement_isPullback I), zeroComplementMap_kernel]
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
  erw [morphismRestrict_ι]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.actualOther_strictTransformIdeal
statement:
theorem actualOther_strictTransformIdeal (I : Ideal A) :
    strictTransformIdeal (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker = (affineOtherToBlowup A I).ker
proof:
:= by
  change (strictTransformOpenPartIdeal (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker).map
    (blowupComplement (centreIdeal I)).ι = _
  rw [← otherComplement_kernel, Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ker,
    otherComplementToBlowup_comp_ι, Scheme.Hom.ker_comp, blowupComplement_kernel_eq_bot,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_bot]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.actualOtherToStrictTransform_ι
statement:
theorem actualOtherToStrictTransform_ι (I : Ideal A) :
    actualOtherToStrictTransform I ≫ strictTransformι (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker =
      affineOtherToBlowup A I
proof:
:=
  IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.actualOtherToStrictTransform_isIso
statement: theorem actualOtherToStrictTransform_isIso (I : Ideal A) : IsIso (actualOtherToStrictTransform I)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (affineOtherToBlowup A I) := affineOtherToBlowup_isClosedImmersion A I
  apply IsClosedImmersion.isIso_of_ker_eq (affineOtherToBlowup A I)
    (strictTransformι (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker) (actualOtherToStrictTransform I)
    (actualOtherToStrictTransform_ι I)
  change _ = (strictTransformIdeal (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker).subschemeι.ker
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι, actualOther_strictTransformIdeal]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.actualOtherStrictTransformIso_hom_ι
statement:
theorem actualOtherStrictTransformIso_hom_ι (I : Ideal A) :
    (actualOtherStrictTransformIso I).hom ≫ strictTransformι (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker =
      affineOtherToBlowup A I
proof: := actualOtherToStrictTransform_ι I

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.actualOtherStrictTransformIso_toLine
statement:
theorem actualOtherStrictTransformIso_toLine (I : Ideal A) :
    (actualOtherStrictTransformIso I).hom ≫ strictTransformι (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker ≫
      blowupToLine I = projection I ≫ zeroSection A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, actualOtherStrictTransformIso_hom_ι, affineOtherToBlowup_toLine]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.actualOtherStrictTransformIso_total
statement:
theorem actualOtherStrictTransformIso_total (I : Ideal A) :
    (actualOtherStrictTransformIso I).hom ≫ strictTransformι (centreIdeal I) (zeroSection A).ker ≫
      blowupι I = affineOtherToInfinity A I ≫ affineInfinityι A I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, actualOtherStrictTransformIso_hom_ι, affineOtherToInfinity_total]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.affineBaseι_preimage_centreComplement
statement:
theorem affineBaseι_preimage_centreComplement (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    affineBaseι Y U ⁻¹ᵁ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y J = baseComplement (J.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  change (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen Y U).fromSpec p ∉ (J.support : Set Y) ↔
    p ∈ baseComplement (J.ideal U)
  erw [mem_baseComplement_iff]
  have hpU : (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen Y U).fromSpec p ∈ (U.1 : Set Y) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen Y U)]
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have heq : (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen Y U).fromSpec p ∈ (J.support : Set Y) ↔
      p ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J.ideal U : Set _) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus]
    constructor
    · intro hp
      have h := (J.coe_support_inter U).le ⟨hp, hpU⟩
      exact h.1
    · intro hp
      exact ((J.coe_support_inter U).ge ⟨hp, hpU⟩).1
  rw [heq]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.globalOtherSourceComplement_chart
statement:
theorem globalOtherSourceComplement_chart (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U ⁻¹ᵁ globalOtherSourceComplement Y J = blowupComplement (J.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  have hproj : GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J =
      projection (J.ideal U) ≫ affineBaseι Y U := by
    exact (otherSourceChart_isPullback Y J U).w.symm
  change GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U ⁻¹ᵁ
    (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y J ⁻¹ᵁ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y J) = _
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hproj, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    affineBaseι_preimage_centreComplement]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.globalOtherSourceComplement_kernel_eq_bot
statement:
theorem globalOtherSourceComplement_kernel_eq_bot :
    (globalOtherSourceComplement Y J).ι.ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply ideal_eq_bot_of_comap_cover _ (GlobalBlowup.gluingData Y J).cover
  intro U
  change (globalOtherSourceComplement Y J).ι.ker.comap (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U) = ⊥
  apply ker_comap_eq_bot_of_factor (globalOtherSourceComplement Y J).ι
    (blowupComplement (J.ideal U)).ι (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y J U)
    (localComplementToGlobalSource Y J U)
  · exact (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _).symm
  · exact blowupComplement_kernel_eq_bot (J.ideal U)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.otherToTotal_preimage_away
statement:
theorem otherToTotal_preimage_away :
    otherToTotal Y J ⁻¹ᵁ globalOtherTotalAway Y J = globalOtherSourceComplement Y J
proof:
:= by
  change otherToTotal Y J ⁻¹ᵁ
    (totalGlobalToBase Y J ⁻¹ᵁ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y J) = _
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, otherToTotal_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.globalOtherTotalComplementMap_ι
statement:
theorem globalOtherTotalComplementMap_ι :
    globalOtherTotalComplementMap Y J ≫ (globalOtherTotalAway Y J).ι =
      (globalOtherSourceComplement Y J).ι ≫ otherToTotal Y J
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.globalOtherTotalComplement_isPullback
statement:
theorem globalOtherTotalComplement_isPullback :
    IsPullback (globalOtherTotalComplementMap Y J) (globalOtherSourceComplement Y J).ι
      (globalOtherTotalAway Y J).ι (otherToTotal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (globalOtherTotalComplementMap_ι Y J).symm
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, otherToTotal_preimage_away]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.globalOtherTotalComplement_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem globalOtherTotalComplement_isClosedImmersion :
    IsClosedImmersion (globalOtherTotalComplementMap Y J)
proof:
:= by
  letI := otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion Y J
  rw [← (globalOtherTotalComplement_isPullback Y J).isoPullback_hom_fst]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.otherToTotal_schematicClosure_from_centreComplement
statement:
theorem otherToTotal_schematicClosure_from_centreComplement :
    (globalOtherTotalComplementMap Y J).ker.map (globalOtherTotalAway Y J).ι =
      (otherToTotal Y J).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ker, globalOtherTotalComplementMap_ι,
    Scheme.Hom.ker_comp, globalOtherSourceComplement_kernel_eq_bot,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_bot]
